title: Tech Project Manager / Tech Team lead
description:
**Job Description – Technical Project Manager**
**Company:**
Kanhasoft
  
  
**Experience:**
4+ Years
  
  
**Location:**
Ahmedabad (Work from Office)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager with 4+ years of experience in managing IT software development projects, preferably in a service-based IT company.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have a strong technical background, excellent project management skills, and the ability to manage end-to-end project delivery. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating with clients, developers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered within defined timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Manage end-to-end software development projects, from requirement gathering to final delivery and maintenance.
* Understand client requirements, business workflows, and technical specifications.
* Coordinate with clients to gather requirements, provide project updates, and manage expectations.
* Prepare project plans, timelines, milestones, resource allocation, and delivery schedules.
* Manage and coordinate development teams, including Web Developers, Mobile Developers, UI/UX Designers, QA Engineers, and other technical resources.
* Monitor project progress, team performance, deliverables, and deadlines.
* Identify project risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and proactively implement solutions.
* Conduct regular project meetings, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and review meetings.
* Ensure effective communication between clients, management, and internal development teams.
* Handle scope changes, change requests, and project documentation.
* Ensure projects meet quality standards and client expectations.
* Track project status using project management tools and provide regular reports to management.
* Resolve project-related issues and ensure smooth project execution.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining delivery quality and timelines.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in Technical Project Management or Software Project Management.
* Strong experience working in an IT service-based software development company.
* Good understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies.
* Experience in managing web and mobile application development projects.
* Good understanding of technologies such as PHP, Laravel, Python, Django, React, Node.js, .NET, Flutter, React Native, or similar technologies.
* Ability to understand technical requirements, architecture discussions, APIs, databases, and development workflows.
* Experience in client communication, requirement gathering, and stakeholder management.
* Hands-on experience with project management tools such as Jira, Trello, Asana, ClickUp, or Monday.com.
* Strong knowledge of project planning, estimation, resource allocation, and risk management.
* Excellent leadership, team management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing international clients, especially from the USA, Europe, or the Middle East.
* Experience handling multiple software development projects simultaneously.
* Experience managing CRM, ERP, E-commerce, Marketplace, Healthcare, or other business applications.
* Knowledge of API integrations, third-party integrations, and database concepts.
* Experience in client meetings, project demonstrations, and delivery presentations.
* Technical background as a Software Developer, Business Analyst, or Technical Lead will be an added advantage.
* PMP, Scrum Master, or other project management certifications will be an advantage.

Skills:- Project Management, PHP, Laravel, Django, React.js, JIRA, Trello, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)

title: Program Manager
description:
**Program Manager - General Projects**

**Location:**

Ahmedabad, Gujarat 

**Type of Position:**

Full-Time 

**About the Role:**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Program Manager to provide comprehensive support and oversight for a range of general projects, with a particular focus on holistic rural development and health-related initiatives. Reporting directly to the Project Director, this position will leverage strategic, creative, and innovative skills to enhance existing project performance and address emerging challenges. The ideal candidate will work autonomously, exercising discretion and sound judgment on critical matters, to monitor and coordinate the organization's diverse projects. In this role, you will be required to provide expert-level project management and manage budgets ensuring proper allocation of resources. 

**Responsibilities:**

● Evaluate programs, functions, and procedures within the organization to ensure effective program implementation. Identify issues and develop alternative solutions.

● Review and analyze data related to a variety of projects to develop recommendations for achieving program goals. 

● Provide direction and support to project teams in various capacities, addressing technical and interpersonal needs, motivating team dynamics, and acting as a liaison, problem solver, and facilitator. 

● Perform the full range of the project management cycle – initiating, planning, executing, monitoring, and identifying leads for effective project implementation. 

● Lead the planning and operations for programs and functions. 

● Develop and manage program budgets, ensuring financial sustainability and compliance with organizational policies. 

● Develop and manage relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, and internal teams. 

● Manage multiple contending priorities simultaneously in an exciting environment. 

● Monitor and track program execution to success by removing blockers and always find the path forward in challenging situations. 

● Ensure standard program management processes are utilized and adequate support to the project team by coordinating PM reviews, preparing & publishing PM metrics. 

● Identify and manage risks, and develop contingency plans to mitigate their impact.

**Qualification & Skills**

● Bachelor's degree (Master's preferred) and 3+ years relevant experience.

● Proven ability to prioritize, organize, and execute with professionalism and attention to detail. 

● Demonstrated experience in program management, ideally in rural development or health. 

● Strong project management and relevant technical skills. 

● Understanding of current technologies (e.g., AI/GenAI). 

● Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple tasks, and work independently. 

● PMP certification (a plus).

description:

**Europe and Asia/Pacific**

**Job Description**
**The Kraft Heinz Internal Audit Department’s vision is to add value by providing objective and innovative assurance and advisory services.**
When performing our work, we evaluate risks, controls and governance processes. Further, we provide the board of directors, audit committee, and KH senior management reasonable assurance that the financial data used to make business decisions and to communicate to the public is true and accurate. **Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Europe**
,
**Middle East**
and Africa,
**Asia pacific**

* Support the Internal Audit manager to conduct the audit engagements, including the budgeting and staffing assignments for the different areas of review, ensuring that adequate documentation and timely execution of the tasks to successfully complete each project'

As such, work closely the Internal Audit Manager responsible for the area of expertise to analyze issues with global/regional/local impacts, develop trend analysis and compile best practices to be shared through the organization for adoption.
* Assess the efficiency and effectiveness of actions implemented to address audit issues.

**Communication**

* Communicate effectively verbally and in writing by adopting appropriate communication style to individuals at all levels of the organization and remaining open to disagreement or new ideas.

title: Head of Strength & Conditioning
company: SRT10 Altevol Centre of Excellence Ahmedabad
description:
**Job Title**
: Head of Strength & Conditioning

**Organisation**
: SRT10 Altevol Centre of Excellence

**Location**
: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Employment**
Type: Full-time, on-site

**Reporting to**
: Academy Management

**About Us**

SRT10 Altevol Centre of Excellence is Sachin Tendulkar’s second academy in India, operating under his SRT10 brand and personally inaugurated by him. Our centre brings together tennis, cricket, and high-performance athlete development.

This is an opportunity to build and lead a strength and conditioning department at an academy associated with one of the world’s most accomplished sporting icons.

We are seeking an experienced strength and conditioning professional who is currently serving as a Head of Strength & Conditioning and is ready to take ownership of our entire department.

**The Role**

You will lead strength and conditioning across our tennis academy, cricket academy, and high-performance programs, with particular emphasis on tennis fitness and the physical development of competitive tennis players.

You will design the programs, personally lead key high-performance sessions, and ensure consistent delivery across all batches. An initial team of one or two junior coaches will support you in delivering programs for younger athletes and other groups.

You will also work with management to introduce new fitness services, attract external athletes, and grow department revenue.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Tennis Fitness and High-Performance Development

Design structured tennis-specific programs covering court movement, acceleration, deceleration, change of direction, strength, power, endurance, mobility, and recovery.

Prepare tennis players for the physical demands of training, matches, and tournaments.

Develop individual physical preparation plans based on each player’s age, development, competition level, and goals.

Coordinate closely with tennis coaches to integrate fitness work with technical training and tournament schedules.

Personally lead key sessions for high-performance tennis players and monitor their progress.

Adjust training according to workload, fatigue, readiness, and competition demands.

2. Academy-Wide Strength and Conditioning

Create annual, seasonal, monthly, and weekly training plans for tennis, cricket, and high-performance groups.

Give particular planning and coaching attention to tennis students while ensuring cricket students receive appropriate, sport-specific physical preparation.

Develop age-appropriate programs covering movement fundamentals, strength, speed, agility, endurance, coordination, and mobility.

Conduct baseline assessments and regular reassessments, maintaining clear athlete progress records.

Ensure younger children establish sound movement foundations before progressing to more demanding training.

Work with physiotherapists and other qualified specialists on injury prevention and return-to-training plans within your professional scope.

3. Department and Junior Coach Leadership

Take full responsibility for the planning, delivery, and quality of the strength and conditioning department.

Lead, mentor, and supervise an initial team of one or two junior coaches.

Assign batches and responsibilities, with junior coaches supporting younger athletes and other groups under your guidance.

Establish session plans, assessment protocols, coaching standards, and department operating procedures.

Observe sessions and ensure programs are executed correctly and consistently.

Manage training schedules, equipment requirements, and safe use of fitness facilities.

4. New Programs and Revenue Development

Identify opportunities to launch fitness and athletic development programs for academy students and external participants.

Develop services such as tennis conditioning programs, speed and agility clinics, holiday camps, small-group training, individual performance coaching, and fitness assessments.

Attract external tennis players and athletes from other sports to train at our centre.

Build relationships with coaches, clubs, schools, teams, and sports organisations.

Work with management on program pricing, batch capacity, launch plans, and revenue targets.

Support marketing and admissions through demonstrations, workshops, and clear explanations of program benefits.

Grow participation and repeat enrolment while maintaining coaching quality.

5. Communication and Accountability

Explain training goals and progress clearly to athletes, parents, and sports coaches.

Provide regular reports on athlete development, attendance, program delivery, and department revenue.

Maintain a professional, disciplined, supportive, and child-safe training environment.

**Essential Candidate Requirements**

A minimum of 6–7 years of overall experience as a Strength & Conditioning Coach; candidates with greater experience are welcome. This experience does not need to have been spent as a department head.

Currently working as a Head of Strength & Conditioning, with responsibility for program planning, coaching quality, and department or team leadership.

Demonstrated experience designing and delivering structured programs for youth and competitive athletes.

Strong understanding of tennis fitness requirements and the ability to develop tennis-specific conditioning programs.

Experience working with high-performance athletes.

Ability to lead junior coaches and manage multiple training groups.

Strong knowledge of youth physical development, training progression, workload management, and performance testing.

Ability to demonstrate measurable athlete improvements and explain how those results were achieved.

Relevant education in sports science, exercise science, strength and conditioning, physical education, or a related discipline.

Strong planning, communication, leadership, and execution skills.

**Experience That Will Be a Strong Advantage**

Current or previous experience providing strength and conditioning to tennis players, particularly competitive juniors, academy players, or high-performance athletes.

Experience working closely with tennis coaches and planning physical preparation around tournament schedules.

Experience supporting cricket players alongside tennis or other sports.

Experience in a high-performance centre, professional sports organisation, or established sports academy.

Recognised strength and conditioning certification, such as NSCA-CSCS, ASCA, UKSCA, or an equivalent credential.

Experience launching fitness programs, attracting external athletes, or growing department revenue.

Current first-aid and CPR certification.

**What Success Looks Like**

A structured, consistently delivered tennis fitness program with measurable player progress.

Appropriate physical development programs for cricket students and other academy groups.

Individual training plans and regular assessments for high-performance athletes.

Junior coaches delivering high-quality sessions under clear guidance.

Strong coordination between fitness training, sports coaching, and athlete support.

Successful new programs, increased external athlete participation, and sustainable department revenue.

**Why Join Us?**

Lead a department at Sachin Tendulkar’s second academy in India, personally inaugurated by him.

Build your professional career within the SRT10 Altevol sporting environment.

Take ownership of program design, coaching standards, team development, and department growth.

Work across tennis, cricket, and high-performance athlete development.

Bring your ideas to life through new fitness services and external athlete programs.

**Location Requirement**

This position requires daily physical presence at our academy in Ahmedabad, Gujarat. Candidates based outside Ahmedabad must be willing to relocate before joining.

**Compensation**

Competitive compensation based on experience, qualifications, leadership capability, and demonstrated results. A performance-linked incentive structure may be discussed.

**How to Apply**

Please submit:

Your updated CV, including your total strength and conditioning experience and current leadership responsibilities.

Details of your experience with tennis players, including age groups and competition levels.

Two examples of measurable athlete development results.

A brief outline of how you would build our tennis fitness program and grow the strength and conditioning department.

Your current location, relocation availability, notice period, and compensation expectations.

* We are looking for a hands-on department leader who can develop athletes, guide coaches, execute consistently, and build new opportunities for growth.

Mail:- Info@altevol.com

Contact:- +919978971919

title: Lead Engineer-Water
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
At Jacobs, we push the limits of what’s possible to make the world smarter, more connected, and more sustainable. In our water business, this means delivering resilient and efficient water and wastewater conveyance systems that support communities and enable sustainable growth.
  
  
As a Lead Engineer, you will play a key role in delivering complex conveyance projects, leading engineering teams, managing technical delivery, and ensuring high-quality outcomes across planning, modelling, and detailed design assignments.
  
  
****Role Outline / Responsibilities****
As a
**Lead Engineer – Conveyance**
, you will provide day-to-day technical leadership for water and wastewater network projects and support multidisciplinary project delivery teams.
  
  
**Key Duties**

* Lead the planning, modelling, and design of water distribution and wastewater collection systems.
* Perform and review hydraulic analyses for water and wastewater networks.
* Lead development and review of

+ Network layouts and system configurations
+ Pipeline sizing calculations
+ Hydraulic profiles
+ Pumping and rising main assessments
+ Technical reports and design documentation

* Support master planning studies including

+ Demand forecasting
+ Load assessment
+ Capacity assessment
+ Network expansion planning

* Undertake network optioneering and evaluate alternative solutions based on technical, operational, and whole-life cost considerations.
* Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams including treatment, civil, mechanical, electrical, BIM, and GIS disciplines.
* Review engineering calculations, drawings, and reports prepared by team members.
* Ensure compliance with project requirements, client specifications, and applicable design standards.
* Support project managers in planning, monitoring, and delivering project tasks within agreed schedules and budgets.
* Participate in client meetings, technical workshops, and design reviews.
* Contribute to technical proposals, fee estimates, and bid submissions.
* Identify project risks and support mitigation planning.
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance to project teams.
* Support implementation of digital delivery and BIM-enabled workflows.

**Must Have**

* WaterGEMS
* SewerGEMS

****Preferred****

* InfoWorks ICM
* InfoWater WS Pro
* ArcGIS Pro
* QGIS
* Civil 3D
* Navisworks

**Key Behaviors**

* Strong technical and analytical skills.
* Proactive and solution-oriented approach.
* Effective leadership and team collaboration abilities.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and project deadlines.

Here's what you'll need
  
  
****Qualifications & Experience****

* 12+ years of experience in water and wastewater conveyance planning and design.
* Proven experience in hydraulic modelling and network design.
* Strong understanding of

+ Water distribution systems
+ Wastewater collection systems
+ Pump stations and rising mains
+ Network optimization principles

* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary infrastructure projects.
* Experience reviewing technical deliverables and providing technical direction to project teams.
* Experience in client interactions and technical presentations.
* Familiarity with BIM-enabled project delivery.

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering or related discipline.
* Experience on international infrastructure projects.

****Preferred****

* Master's Degree in Water Resources, Hydraulic, or Environmental Engineering.

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

title: Product & Business Operations Associate
description:
**PRODUCT & BUSINESS OPERATIONS ASSOCIATE**

**Ahmedabad, Gujarat**

**Full-time | On-site**

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

SVECTOR is hiring a Product & Business Operations Associate to work across product, customer, research and business execution.

This role is designed for an early-career technical professional who wants to operate beyond a narrow software-development function and work across technology, product, customers, research and company-building.

You will work closely with the Founder-CEO and relevant functional teams on selected high-priority initiatives across SVECTOR.

This is not an administrative role.

You will be expected to understand problems, structure them, identify what needs to happen, coordinate the relevant people and carry assigned work through to a clear and verified result.

The role requires someone who can move comfortably between technical and business problems.

**WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON**

**1. PRODUCT & BUSINESS EXECUTION**

You will take ownership of assigned product and business initiatives.

Typical responsibilities may include:

• Understanding a customer, product or business problem before work begins

• Converting unclear requests into structured problem statements and requirements

• Defining expected outcomes, owners, dependencies and timelines

• Coordinating with Product, Engineering and business teams

• Identifying missing inputs and blockers

• Following work through rather than simply forwarding instructions

• Reviewing whether the delivered result actually solves the original problem

• Maintaining clear records of open issues, decisions and next actions

• Escalating decisions when authority or additional support is required

You should be comfortable taking an objective that is initially ambiguous and turning it into practical execution.

**2. PRODUCT UNDERSTANDING**

Strong product understanding is important for this role.

You may be expected to:

• Use SVECTOR products and understand important workflows

• Understand the intended user and customer problem

• Review customer feedback and product issues

• Distinguish between defects, requirements and new product requests

• Prepare product requirements and acceptance criteria

• Understand APIs, integrations, data flows and technical dependencies

• Follow technical discussions with engineers

• Participate in demos, pilots and implementation discussions

• Verify whether an agreed workflow is actually ready

You do not need to be a full-time software developer.

However, you should have enough technical understanding to work intelligently with engineers and enough business understanding to know why the technical work matters.

**3. RESEARCH & ANALYSIS**

Research will be an important part of the role.

You may investigate:

• Companies

• Customers

• Markets

• Competitors

• Technologies

• Industries

• Product opportunities

• Enterprise accounts

• Candidates

• Market-entry questions

• Commercial models

• Strategic business questions

Good research should clearly distinguish between:

• Verified facts

• Estimates

• Assumptions

• Interpretation

• Missing information

You should be comfortable reading original material, comparing conflicting evidence, checking numbers and explaining the business implication of what you find.

We do not want surface-level summaries.

We want someone who can enter an unfamiliar subject, understand it quickly and produce a useful conclusion.

**4. AI-NATIVE WORK**

This is an AI-native role.

You should already be comfortable using tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or equivalent systems for professional work.

You may use AI for:

• Research

• Document analysis

• Writing

• Data organization

• Summarization

• Workflow automation

• Structured analysis

• Repetitive work

• Product thinking

However, you remain responsible for every output.

You should be able to explain:

• What you asked the system to do

• Which sources were used

• What assumptions were made

• What the model got wrong

• What you corrected

• What remains uncertain

Copying an AI-generated answer without understanding or verifying it is not acceptable.

**5. CUSTOMER & COMMERCIAL WORK**

You may support selected customer and commercial initiatives.

This may include:

• Researching customers and accounts before meetings

• Understanding customer workflows and requirements

• Preparing meeting briefs and talking points

• Drafting customer communication and follow-ups

• Preparing product or commercial material

• Coordinating internal responses to customer questions

• Maintaining customer commitments and next steps

• Supporting demos, pilots and implementation discussions

• Following open issues through to a confirmed outcome

Sending a follow-up is not the outcome.

The expectation is to understand what needs to happen next and keep the work moving until there is a clear result or next state.

**6. HIRING & PEOPLE RESEARCH**

The role may also support selected hiring initiatives.

You may work on:

• Understanding why a role exists

• Preparing role briefs

• Researching candidates

• Reviewing candidate evidence

• Preparing interview material

• Comparing candidates

• Coordinating selected hiring processes

• Maintaining accurate hiring records and next steps

This is not an HR or Talent Acquisition position.

The objective is to support better hiring decisions using structured evidence.

**7. BUSINESS COMMUNICATION & MEETING PREPARATION**

You may prepare:

• Customer briefs

• Internal memos

• Research summaries

• Meeting notes

• Talking points

• Product requirements

• Candidate comparisons

• Proposal content

• Presentation outlines

• Follow-up communication

For important meetings, you may be expected to understand:

• Who is attending

• Prior correspondence

• Relevant documents

• Outstanding questions

• Previous commitments

• Intended meeting outcome

• Required next actions

When the same topic returns later, the relevant context should already be organized and available.

**8. OWNERSHIP STANDARD**

This role is built around ownership.

We do not consider the following to be completed work:

“I sent the message.”

“I followed up.”

“I informed the team.”

“I completed my part.”

The expected operating pattern is:

Understand the result.

Build the plan.

Get the required inputs.

Move the work.

Resolve blockers.

Escalate what genuinely requires a decision.

Check the final result.

Close the loop.

For important assignments, you should always know:

• What outcome is expected

• Who is responsible

• What information is missing

• What dependencies exist

• What deadline applies

• What could block completion

• What remains unresolved

• What decision is required

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are particularly interested in early-career candidates with a strong technical foundation.

Preferred educational backgrounds include:

• Computer Science

• Computer Engineering

• Information Technology

• Software Engineering

• Artificial Intelligence

• Related technical disciplines

Typically, we are looking for candidates with approximately 1 to 5 years of professional experience.

Exceptional recent graduates with strong evidence of ownership, technical ability, product thinking or real-world execution are also encouraged to apply.

Relevant backgrounds may include:

• Product

• Product Operations

• Business Analysis

• Technical Consulting

• Technical Pre-Sales

• Implementation

• Solutions

• Customer Success for technical products

• AI products

• Enterprise software

• Technical project execution

• Early-stage startup roles

**WHAT WE VALUE**

**HIGH OWNERSHIP**

You attempt solutions and move work forward without waiting for detailed instructions at every step.

**TECHNICAL FLUENCY**

You can understand software products, APIs, integrations, data flows and implementation constraints.

**PRODUCT THINKING**

You think about the user, customer problem, workflow and outcome, not only the feature.

**RESEARCH DEPTH**

You can independently investigate unfamiliar subjects and reach a reasoned conclusion.

**STRONG WRITING**

Your work should be clear, structured and usable without requiring complete rewriting.

**JUDGMENT**

You understand what you can handle independently and what genuinely requires escalation.

**RELIABILITY**

If you commit to something, it gets done, or the problem is raised before the deadline.

**LEARNING SPEED**

You can enter a new subject, ask precise questions and become useful quickly.

**AI FLUENCY**

You use modern AI tools seriously and understand how to verify their outputs.

**DISCRETION**

You will have access to company, customer, personnel and strategic information. Confidential information must remain confidential and be shared only with authorized people for legitimate company work.

**WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT**

This is not:

• A personal assistant role

• A calendar-management position

• An administrative support role

• A pure strategy job

• A pure research role

• A pure software-development role

• A conventional project coordinator position

• A role where work ends after forwarding an instruction

Personal errands, household matters and lifestyle management are outside the scope of this position.

**WORKING ARRANGEMENT**

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Employment: Full-time

Work mode: On-site

The environment is fast-moving and priorities may change as customer, product and company requirements evolve.

You should be comfortable operating in ambiguity while creating structure around the work you own.

Important product, customer or company matters may occasionally require responsiveness outside normal working hours.

**SELECTION PROCESS**

We care more about actual ability than polished interview answers.

The selection process may include:

1. Initial conversation

2. Product or research exercise

3. Business writing / execution exercise

4. Final discussion

AI tools may be used during selected exercises.

Candidates will be expected to explain their reasoning, sources, assumptions, decisions and corrections.

If you are young, technically strong, curious about business, comfortable with AI, capable of learning quickly and want to work across product, customers and execution rather than remain inside one narrow function, we would like to hear from you.

2+ Years (Specialist) / 4+ Years (Sr. Specialist)

Specialist and Sr. Specialist

You will assess outputs for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, and adherence to the prompt; identify errors in meaning, mistranslation, register (formal vs informal), ambiguity, and logical consistency; fact-check claims when needed; write high-quality rewrites and model answers that demonstrate best practices in Gujarati writing; and rate and compare multiple AI responses based on correctness and overall quality.
  
  
This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your Gujarati expertise directly helps improve the world’s premier AI models by making their Gujarati language output more natural, reliable, culturally accurate, and clearly written.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop AI Training Content: Create prompts and gold-standard Gujarati answers across multiple domains (general knowledge, customer support, education, conversational writing).
* Optimize AI Performance: Evaluate and rank AI outputs to improve fluency, correctness, tone match, and cultural appropriateness.
* Ensure Model Integrity: Detect unsafe or misleading content, factual hallucinations, bias, and policy-risk language; validate reliability across use cases.

**Your Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Mathematics
* Native or near-native Gujarati proficiency (reading and writing required).
* Strong professional proficiency in English (minimum C1) to follow guidelines and provide detailed feedback in English.
* 3+ years of professional experience in writing, editing, localization, translation, content QA, journalism, education, or related language-focused work.
* Deep understanding of Gujarati grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, and style—able to explain why something is wrong and how to fix it.
* Comfortable handling multiple registers (formal/informal), dialect variation, and audience adaptation (e.g., India vs diaspora audiences).
* High attention to detail when spotting subtle meaning shifts, hallucinated claims, or culturally awkward phrasing.
* Reliable, self-directed, and able to deliver consistent quality in an hourly, remote contractor workflow across time zones.
* Prior experience with AI data training/annotation, translation QA, editorial QA, or rubric-based evaluation is strongly preferred.

Job Title
  
  
Senior Research Associate-AD
  
  
**Job Description**
The Senior Research Associate will be responsible for analytical method development, validation, troubleshooting, and routine sample analysis using advanced analytical techniques such as HPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS, ICP-MS, Ion Chromatography (IC), Gas Chromatography (GC), and Circular Dichroism (CD). The role involves Genotoxic Impurity (GTI) analysis, Extractables & Leachables (E&L) studies, impurity characterization, instrument calibration, data review, and preparation of scientific and regulatory documentation while ensuring compliance with cGLP, GMP, GDP, Data Integrity, and EHS requirements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Analytical Method Development & Validation
  
  

* Develop, optimize, troubleshoot, and validate analytical methods using HPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS, ICP-MS, IC, GC, and CD.
* Perform method validation, verification, transfer, and robustness studies in accordance with ICH, USP, EP, and internal guidelines.
* Prepare method development protocols, reports, and validation documentation.

Genotoxic Impurity Analysis
  
  

* Develop and validate sensitive analytical methods for quantification of genotoxic impurities and nitrosamine-related compounds.
* Conduct routine and project-based analysis using LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS, and ICP-MS.
* Support regulatory submissions through scientific data generation and technical documentation.

Extractables & Leachables Studies
  
  

* Execute Extractables and Leachables (E&L) studies for pharmaceutical packaging systems, processing equipment, and medical devices.
* Perform sample preparation, instrumental analysis, data interpretation, and reporting using LC-MS/MS, GC-MS/MS, HPLC, and ICP-MS.
* Support toxicological assessment by providing analytical data and impurity characterization.

Impurity Identification & Characterization
  
  

* Investigate unknown, degradation, and process-related impurities using LC-MS/MS and complementary analytical techniques.
* Interpret chromatographic and mass spectral data for structural elucidation.
* Prepare scientific investigation reports and technical presentations.

Sample Analysis
  
  

* Perform analysis of development, stability, qualification, validation, and external customer samples.
* Ensure timely completion of sample testing while maintaining quality and compliance requirements.

Instrument Calibration & Maintenance
  
  

* Perform calibration and performance verification of analytical instruments as per approved calibration schedules.
* Maintain instrument logbooks and ensure instrument readiness.
* Coordinate instrument preventive maintenance and troubleshooting activities.

Documentation & Data Review
  
  

* Prepare and review: Test Procedures (TP) Standard Test Procedures (STP) Method Development Reports Method Validation Reports Analytical Protocols Investigation Reports Scientific Justifications
* Review analytical data and laboratory records as a peer reviewer.
* Ensure accurate documentation in compliance with GDP and Data Integrity requirements.

Compliance & Quality Systems
  
  

* Follow cGLP, GMP, GDP, and applicable GxP requirements.
* Maintain ALCOA+ principles and Data Integrity throughout analytical activities.
* Participate in internal audits, regulatory inspections, and quality improvement initiatives.
* Adhere to laboratory SOPs and safety requirements.

Standard & Laboratory Management
  
  

* Manage analytical standards, reagents, consumables, and columns.
* Maintain laboratory housekeeping and hygienic conditions.
* Ensure proper storage and inventory control of reference standards and chemicals.

EHS Responsibilities
  
  

* Use appropriate PPE during laboratory operations.
* Attend mandatory EHS training programs.
* Ensure segregation and disposal of laboratory waste as per EHS procedures.
* Comply with all safety, health, and environmental requirements.

close deals, own your number
  
  
You'll own the full sales cycle at Saleshandy. You'll convert inbound trial users into paying customers and build your own pipeline through outbound, selling to founders, agencies and sales teams in the US, UK and EU.

We run a Results-Only Work Environment (ROWE). Nobody tracks your hours or how busy you look. You decide how to plan your day, and you're measured only on outcomes: pipeline created, deals closed, revenue and ticket size.
  
  
In return, you own your target completely. If you're behind, you raise it and fix it before your manager has to ask. This role won't suit someone who waits to be chased or leaves results to chance.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
Inbound sales and trial conversion
  
  

* Own inbound leads (trial sign-ups, demo requests, calendar bookings, chat conversations) from first contact to closed-won or closed-lost
* Respond fast: within the same business hour for demo requests, the same day for trial sign-ups
* Run discovery to understand the buyer's outreach goals, current tools, sending volume, team size and deliverability problems
* Give tailored demos that show only what solves the buyer's problem, instead of a full feature tour
* Handle pricing, competitor and "we're just researching" objections with value, not quick discounts
* Close deals and move customers from monthly to annual plans to grow ticket size

Outbound sales and pipeline building
  
  

* Identify target accounts and decision-makers across the US and EU: lead-gen agencies, SaaS founders, and SMB and mid-market sales teams
* Build and run your own outbound campaigns on Saleshandy across cold email, LinkedIn and calls
* Write personalised sequences and keep improving subject lines, offers and messaging based on results
* Book meetings and build enough pipeline to cover at least 3x your monthly quota
* Track open rate, reply rate, positive reply rate, meetings booked and meeting-to-close conversion

Follow-up and pipeline discipline
  
  

* Follow up on every lead across email, calls, LinkedIn and WhatsApp until you get a clear yes or no. One email followed by silence is not follow-up
* Keep every lead stage, meeting date, close date and lost reason updated in our CRM (Close). We report from the CRM, never from spreadsheets
* Review your own pipeline every week (stalled deals, overdue tasks, deals at risk) and bring a plan to your 1:1
* Forecast honestly every week and deliver the number you commit to

Product and technical understanding
  
  

* Know cold email deliverability well: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, domain and mailbox warm-up, sender rotation, sending limits, bounce rates and inbox placement
* Know the full Saleshandy product: Lead Finder and credits, email infrastructure, unified inbox, multichannel sequences, AI Sequence Copilot, agency and white-label features, API, and CRM integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Zoho)
* Explain technical concepts simply to non-technical founders and sales leaders
* Know the basics of cold email compliance in the US (CAN-SPAM) and EU (GDPR)
* Answer product questions yourself using our internal knowledge base instead of waiting on the product team

AI and sales automation
  
  

* Use AI tools for account research, personalisation, call preparation and follow-up drafting
* Build simple AI workflows that cut research and admin time, so more of your day goes to selling
* Use AI to make outreach more personal, not more generic

Working with other teams
  
  

* Hand closed customers over smoothly to onboarding and customer success, including setup expectations. New Pro-plan customers should finish domain and mailbox setup within their first month
* Share objections, lost reasons, competitor mentions and feature requests with product and marketing every week

You'll fit well if you
  
  

* Have 2 to 5 years of B2B SaaS sales, including at least 2 years of hands-on deal closing
* Have a record of hitting quota, with numbers you can share: quota, achievement, deal size and cycle length
* Have done both inbound conversion and self-sourced outbound pipeline
* Have sold to US, UK or EU customers over video calls
* Speak and write excellent English, and are strong at presenting, negotiating and handling objections
* Can write cold emails that get replies
* Have used a CRM (Close, HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive or similar) and at least one sales engagement or data tool (Saleshandy, Apollo, Clay, Lemlist, Instantly or similar)
* Are comfortable working US/UK night shift hours from Ahmedabad
* Keep learning. You read, listen to sales podcasts and review your own call recordings, and you can show how that improved your results

Good to have
  
  

* Experience selling a cold email, sales engagement or martech product
* Experience selling to lead-gen or marketing agencies
* Hindi and Gujarati for Indian accounts

How you're measured
  
  

* Revenue against quota, meaning monthly new revenue closed from inbound and self-sourced deals. We share the quota at offer stage
* Inbound conversion, the share of assigned trial and demo leads you turn into paying customers
* Average ticket size per deal, and the share of deals you close on annual plans
* Open pipeline of at least 3x your monthly quota
* Speed to lead, the time from lead assignment to your first contact
* Follow-up consistency. Every open lead has a next step and a future task in the CRM
* Reply rate, positive reply rate and meetings booked from your own outbound campaigns
* CRM hygiene, with stages, meeting dates, close dates and lost reasons always up to date

Your first 90 days
  
  

* By day 30 you're ready to sell. You know the product and deliverability basics well enough to run demos alone, and you've closed your first deals
* By day 60 you're at 70% or more of quota, your first outbound campaign is live, and your CRM stays clean without reminders
* By day 90 you're fully ramped and hitting 100% of quota consistently, with at least 30% of revenue from annual plans

Why join us
  
  

* A growing B2B SaaS product used by 25,000+ customers worldwide
* Uncapped incentives, so your earnings grow with your results
* Full ownership of the sales cycle, with real freedom over how you work
* You'll sell to US and EU founders, agencies and sales leaders every day
* Modern outbound and AI tools, and a path to senior AE or team lead roles as we scale

How to apply
  
  
Apply with your CV and answer the screening questions in the form. Shortlisted candidates will be asked for a 10 to 15 minute demo recording before the interview.

Work alongside industry experts trusted by leading brands like Audi, BMW, Deichmann, Meta, NewsCorp, Tandem, Paramount, Vorwerk, and Warner Bros. Discovery to create pioneering, sustainable digital experiences.**
**At intive, agile thinking and deep industry expertise come together across Automotive & Mobility, Commerce, Financial Services, Healthcare & Life Sciences, and Technology, Media & Communication. Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of digital innovation.**
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Junior / Associate Application Migration & Platform Support Engineer Contractor to join our Infrastructure Operations. In this role, you will play a key part in modernizing our application ecosystem by supporting the migration of applications from Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) to OpenShift (OCP), assisting with platform maintenance and upgrades, and helping onboard new development teams.
  
  
This is an excellent opportunity for a junior/mid engineer or operational support specialist looking to deepen their expertise in cloud-native platforms, container orchestration (Kubernetes/OpenShift), and platform engineering.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Application Migration Support: Assist in moving general-purpose applications from Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) to the OpenShift Container Platform (OCP), troubleshooting deployment scripts and configuration issues along the way.
* Platform Operations & Upgrades: Support routine OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) upgrades, cluster maintenance, component health monitoring, and incident triage.
* Testing & Quality Assurance: Participate in migration testing cycles (pre-migration validation, integration testing, and post-migration sanity checks) to guarantee environment stability and zero unexpected downtime
* Documentation & Process Improvement: Help create and maintain clear runbooks, onboarding guides, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for application teams.

**You Are a Good Match If You Have**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, System Engineering, or equivalent practical experience / certifications.
* Service Experience: 1–3 years of experience in IT operational support, systems administration, DevOps support, or application support.
* Container & Platform Fundamentals: Basic hands-on familiarity or conceptual understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, and OpenShift (OCP)
* Cloud Foundry Basics: Familiarity with Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF) architecture, CLI, and deployment mechanics.
* Operating Systems & Scripting: Working knowledge of Linux/Unix command-line navigation, shell scripting (Bash/Python), and basic networking concepts (DNS, routing, HTTP/HTTPS).
* Testing & Troubleshooting: Exposure to application testing methodology, log analysis, and root cause analysis tools.

***Soft Skills & Competencies***

* Customer-Centric Mindset: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with a focus on assisting and enabling non-infrastructure development teams.
* Problem-Solving Skills: Methodical approach to troubleshooting errors and escalation handling under guidance.
* Adaptability & Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about learning new cloud-native technologies, tools, and platform patterns quickly.

**It Is Beneficial If You Have**

* Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) certification.
* Exposure to CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Tekton, or ArgoCD).
* Experience using ticketing and collaboration software (Jira, Service-Now, Confluence).

title: Statutory/Forest Liaising Officer
description:
**Role Objective:**

To manage and coordinate all statutory approvals, forest clearances, regulatory permissions, and government liaison activities required for smooth execution of transmission line, substation, and infrastructure projects. The role involves close coordination with Forest Departments, Revenue Authorities, District Administration, and various government agencies to ensure timely project clearances and compliance with applicable regulations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Statutory & Regulatory Approvals**

* Obtain statutory approvals, permits, NOCs, and licenses from central, state, and local authorities.
* Coordinate with government departments for project-related approvals and compliance requirements.
* Monitor validity and renewal of statutory permissions.

**Forest Clearance & Compliance**

* Manage Forest Clearance (FC) proposals under applicable forest regulations.
* Coordinate with Forest Department officials for surveys, inspections, and approval processes.
* Track progress of Stage-I and Stage-II forest clearances.
* Ensure compliance with forest and environmental approval conditions.

**Government Liaisoning**

* Develop and maintain effective relationships with government authorities and regulatory agencies.
* Represent the organization before district, state, and central government bodies.
* Facilitate resolution of project-related issues with administrative authorities.

**Project Coordination**

* Coordinate with Land Acquisition, ROW, Legal, Engineering, and Project teams.
* Support project planning by identifying approval requirements and associated timelines.
* Highlight risks related to statutory and forest clearances and recommend mitigation measures.

**Documentation & Reporting**

* Prepare and maintain records of applications, approvals, correspondences, and compliance reports.
* Create status reports and dashboards on approval progress.
* Maintain statutory compliance documentation for audits and reviews.

**Qualification:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Forestry, Environmental Science, Law, Public Administration, or related discipline.

**Experience:**

* 8–15 years of experience in statutory approvals, forest clearances, regulatory compliance, and government liaisoning.
* Experience in Transmission Sector

**Critical Skills:**

* Forest Clearance Management
* Statutory Approvals & NOCs
* Government Liaisoning
* Regulatory Compliance
* Forest Conservation Act & Environmental Regulations
* Stakeholder Management
* ROW & Land Coordination
* Project Coordination
* Documentation & Compliance Reporting
* Negotiation & Relationship Management

**Key Competencies:**

* Strong networking and liaisoning ability
* Excellent communication and negotiation skills
* Problem-solving and conflict resolution
* Decision-making under regulatory constraints
* Ability to work with multiple stakeholders and government agencies
* Result-oriented approach with strong follow-up skills

title: Senior Manager - Legal
description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group:**
In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large-scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Adani Power Limited (APL):**
Adani Power Limited (APL), a part of the diversified Adani Group, is the largest private thermal power producer in India.We have a power generation capacity of 15,250 MW comprising thermal power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Rajasthan, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh, and Jharkhand, and a 40 MW solar power project in Gujarat.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
This role is responsible for overseeing the organization's legal proceedings by handling both regulatoty and non regulatory litigation. The role involves direct management of civil litigations, response to regulatory challenges, and coordination with various business units to support the company's legal position.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**
**Lead Litigation**
**Notice Management**
Draft initial legal notices and coordinate comprehensively with business functions to gather factual backgrounds upon receipt of notices.
  
  
Facilitate cross-departmental collaboration to ensure coherent and informed responses to legal notices while adhering to established protocols.
  
  
Advice and consult business teams on the issuance of notices to ensure compliance with legal standards and corporate policies.
  
  
**Regulatory Litigation Management**
Oversee the documentation for all regulatory litigation cases.
  
  
Assess the implications of regulatory litigation outcomes on the organization's operations and strategize the pursuit of appellate remedies or settlements.
  
  
Ensure detailed preparation and submission of regulatory petitions, liaising with advocates to represent the company's regulatory interests effectively.
  
  
**Non-Regulatory Litigation Management**
Assess the implications of non-regulatory litigation outcomes to determine appropriate follow-up actions, including potential appeals or alternative dispute resolution methods.
  
  
Brief external counsel and aid in preparation and management of responses to legal challenges.
  
  
Compile and maintain comprehensive documentation for all legal proceedings.
  
  
Assist law firms by supplying relevant data and insights for non regulatory litigation cases.
  
  
Provide support in court sessions, offering legal advice and strategies to representative business teams.
  
  
Evaluate the results of legal proceedings to assess the merit and strategic value of initiating appellate action.
  
  
**Internal Legal Advisory And Strategy Implementation**
Provide business teams with expert legal opinions on various issues to foster informed decision-making across the company.
  
  
Remain updated on current changes in the law and integrate insights into evolving legal strategies for the organization.
  
  
Communicate proactively with legal counsel regarding company developments that may impact pending or ongoing legal proceedings.
  
  
Document and startegically incorporate internal developments in court submissions.
  
  
Advise and inform relevant parties on the status of legal matters, maintaining transparency and consensus on legal actions.
  
  
**Legal Relationship Management**
Maintain and develop strategic relationships within the legal fraternity, including networking with law firms and industry associations to benefit the company's legal standing.
  
  
Aid the Head - Legal in selecting law firms to contract for various litigations, ensuring alignment with the specific needs and strengths of each case.
  
  
Oversee and manage engagements with external legal experts to ensure proficient case handling and representation.
  
  
**Legal Research And Technological Enhancement**
Execute detailed legal research utilizing technology to inform on various legal case decisions, maintaining a proactive stance toward legal inquiry and analysis. For e.g. Manupatra
  
  
Spearhead the implementation and management of innovative legal technologies to elevate data management, ensuring efficient storage, retrieval, and analysis capabilities for the legal team.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Heads of Departments (HoDs)
  
  
Business Development (BD) Team
  
  
Finance Team
  
  
Engineering Team
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Courts and Judicial Authorities
  
  
Regulatory authorities and government entities
  
  
Law Firms
  
  
Legal and Industry Associations
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Lead Litigation**
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor's/ Master's Degree (Law) Bar Council of India accreditation (optional), Additional Degrees or Certifications (Corporate Law, M&A) preferred
  
  
**Work Experience (Range Of Years)**
Minimum of 8 years of legal experience, with exposure to handeling litigation and strategizing in a corporate setting.
  
  
**Preferred Industry**
Background in corporate law within the energy sector, particularly with experience in managing legal aspects of litigations and having knowledge of industry specific laws and regulations.

title: visa counselor
description:
**Company Description**
Aussizz Group is a migrant-founded organization dedicated to helping individuals and families build new lives across borders. Since 2009, the group has grown into a team of over 600 professionals and more than 70 Registered Migration Agents, supporting over 195,000 clients, 9,000 students annually, and numerous global artists and professionals. The company combines digital tools, a wide network of offices, and strong ethical standards to make migration and visa processes more transparent and accessible. Aussizz Group focuses on dignity, opportunity, and long-term success for its clients, positioning itself as a trusted guide and advocate rather than just a consultancy.

**Role Description**
The Visa Counselor role is a full-time, on-site position based in Ahmedabad. The Visa Counselor will guide clients through visa and migration processes, including eligibility assessments, documentation support, and application preparation. This role involves conducting consultations, explaining visa options and requirements clearly, and maintaining up-to-date knowledge of relevant immigration regulations. The Visa Counselor will coordinate with internal teams and registered migration agents, manage case files, and track application progress to ensure timely follow-up. The position also includes providing client service via in-person meetings, phone, and email, addressing inquiries, and maintaining accurate records in company systems.

**Qualifications**

* Strong client service and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex information in clear, simple language.
* Attention to detail and organizational skills for handling documentation, case files, and compliance requirements.
* Problem-solving and analytical abilities to assess visa options, identify risks, and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Proficiency with basic computer applications and CRM or case-management systems for tracking client information.
* Prior experience in visa counseling, immigration services, or related fields is an advantage.
* Knowledge of major destination country visa categories and processes (e.g., student, skilled, family, visitor) is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in any Displine
* Ability to work on-site in Ahmedabad, collaborate with diverse teams, and manage multiple cases simultaneously.

**Designation: Assistant Manager - Logistics Operations**

**Location: Gandhinagar**

**About the role**

We are looking for someone to run our daily international express despatch operation at Gandhinagar and be answerable for its results.

You will own the daily outbound operation - every shipment correctly built, correctly documented and despatched within the carrier cut-off, every carrier deadline of the day met, and every exception closed the same day with a recorded reason. Shift In-charges run the floor on each shift; you own the outcome and you are the first person they escalate to.

If you have built your career inside an express carrier's network, this is the other side of the same business. You will use what you already know - cut-offs, consolidation, manifests, chargeable weight, exception handling, service recovery - on behalf of the shipper, with considerably more room to change how things are done.

**Preferred background**

Preferred: experience with an international express or air carrier, or its India operations - for example DHL Express, Blue Dart, Fed Ex , UPS, Aramex or DTDC - in station, gateway, hub, despatch or customer operations. Gateway or station experience at Ahmedabad or any major Indian export gateway is a strong advantage.

Equally welcome: experience running a high-volume international e-commerce or export despatch operation on the shipper side, with daily express carrier interface; or an air-focused role with a freight forwarder.

In either case, what matters is that you have personally been accountable for shipments leaving on time, at the right cost, and for fixing what did not.

**Key responsibilities**

* Own the daily outbound despatch operation across all shifts and be accountable for on-time despatch performance.
* Act as the first escalation point for the despatch floor, on a weekly rotation with the other Assistant Managers, and close what is escalated to you.
* Own shipment consolidation - parcels built correctly onto master air waybills so that the company does not pay for weight or space it did not need. This is one of the largest cost levers in the role.
* Ensure every carrier cut-off of the day is met - the morning despatch, the afternoon air connections and the evening departure - whichever shift is running.
* Manage the daily working relationship with express carriers: pickups, capacity, holds, re-bookings and missed connections, and hold them to their service commitments.
* Drive every shipment exception to closure - tracers, shipments past their expected delivery date, undelivered shipments, customs holds and returns - within the same or next shift, with a recorded cause in every case.
* Clear cross-functional blockages the same day they arise: goods not ready from production or packing, export documents pending, vehicles not placed by the transporter.
* Set and audit the working standard with the Shift In-charges, and catch problems before they reach senior management.
* Own the accuracy of the data the operation generates - cause coding on every delay, exceptions logged, handovers signed, weight captured correctly at the despatch counter.
* Report your area daily and weekly - what moved, what did not, why, and the corrective action - and present it in the departmental review.

**Required skills and experience**

* 6 to 9 years in express, courier, air cargo or e-commerce export operations, with increasing responsibility.
* Hands-on command of international express operations: air waybills, manifests, consolidation onto master air waybills, carrier cut-offs, chargeable versus actual weight, surcharge and accessorial heads, tracers and service recovery. You should be able to read a carrier invoice and explain what drove the cost.
* Experience running a daily operation and being answerable for its results, not only supervising a team.
* Strong Microsoft Excel - large data sets, pivot tables and lookups. This will be assessed during the interview.
* A performance measure you have personally owned and improved, and can walk us through - on-time despatch, connection performance, cost per shipment, damage or exception closure.
* Evidence of having built something where nothing existed: a process, a control, a report or a routine. This matters to us more than the size of the operation you came from.
* Clear written and spoken communication, and the confidence to hold a carrier to a commitment without damaging the relationship.
* Fluent English and Hindi. Gujarati is an advantage given the plant and transporter interface.

**Good to have**

* Experience in a Special Economic Zone (SEZ), bonded warehouse or export-oriented unit, and working knowledge of export documentation and shipping bills.
* Exposure to ERP, WMS or TMS systems.
* Power BI, Tableau or SQL - useful.

**Why this role is worth a look**

You will own a live international express operation from day one, working directly with the world's largest express carriers at an operational level and reporting into the logistics management line with visibility to the Head of Supply Chain & Logistics. As the business roughly doubles and new despatch locations open in Gurugram and overseas, the way this operation runs becomes the template they follow. There is a clear path to a larger role for the person who holds this well.

**Key skills**

Express Logistics, International Courier, Air Freight, Air Cargo, Courier Operations, Gateway Operations, Hub Operations, Station Operations, DHL, Fed Ex , UPS, Blue Dart, Aramex, DTDC, Air Waybill, Manifest, Consolidation, Carrier Management, Cut Off Management, Exception Management, Dimensional Weight, Chargeable Weight, Freight Cost, Export Logistics, E-commerce Logistics, Cross Border Logistics, SEZ, Export Documentation, Logistics Operations, Dispatch Operations, Advanced Excel

title: General Manager – Operations & Business
description:
**About Zippee**

* Zippee is building India’s #1 Quick Commerce Logistics for consumer brands.
* Brands connect their online store to Zippee in just a few clicks & can kickstart 30-Min Delivery/120-Min/Same-Day Delivery for customers through our dark store network across India.
* Our team comprises folks from Reliance Retail, Retention Science, oracle, zomato, & institutions like Hindu College, BITS Pilani, and the University of Southern California.
* Backed by VCs & founders of India's biggest unicorns, including Ashneer Grover (BharatPe), Kunal Shah (CRED), Peyush Bansal (Lenskart), and Prashant Pitti (easemytrip).

**About The Role**

* Hughes Services is a fast-growing 3PL and integrated logistics platform with 2-, 3- and 4-wheeler operations.
* We provide dedicated trucking to large e-commerce, cement and renewable-energy clients across industrial and consumer commodities, and our wider operations span riders, 3-wheelers and specialized trucks, covering mid-mile to last-mile movement.
* As we scale, the Managing Director needs a single, trusted owner for the business. We are hiring a General Manager who will run the company end to end and report directly to the MD.
* We need a true all-rounder: someone who can sit in a client's boardroom in the morning, review the P&L at noon, fix a dispatch problem in the afternoon and coach a team in the evening.
* This is a COO / VP-level mandate: you will own results across growth, delivery, finance, people and systems, and the MD will look to you as the person who makes the whole business work.

**What You'll Own**
**Business strategy and growth**

* Strategy and planning: work with the MD to set the annual plan, revenue and margin targets, and a clear roadmap across business lines (FTL, dedicated trucking, rail and rake, riders, specialized trucks); turn it into quarterly goals for each function
* Client and revenue growth: lead new-client acquisition and account growth with senior logistics and procurement heads; personally close large contracts, tenders and long-term SLAs
* Pricing and commercial discipline: approve lane-wise pricing, contract terms and exceptions, so every deal is priced and delivered to target margin
* New business lines and partnerships: evaluate and launch new services, geographies and partnerships; build alliances with transporters, fleet owners, rail and 3PL partners
* Market intelligence: track demand, competitor moves and lane rates, and feed them into pricing, capacity and investment decisions

**Operations and delivery**

* End-to-end operations: own truck deployment, vehicle placement, dispatch, delivery and turnaround across all client projects and vehicle types.
* Service performance: set and hold SLAs for on-time delivery, TAT, fleet utilization, vehicle availability, claims and damages.
* Vendor and fleet network: build and manage a strong network of transporters, fleet owners, rider-supply vendors and 3PL partners; negotiate rates and enforce performance.
* Process and SOPs: design scalable processes, SOPs and escalation paths so operations run consistently without depending on any one person.
* Capacity planning: keep fleet and rider capacity aligned with client demand and the sales pipeline.

**P&L, finance and controls**

* P&L ownership: own revenue, freight cost, trip economics, margins and operating performance for the whole business
* Budgeting and cost control: drive budgets, cost reduction and working-capital discipline; keep a tight check on leakage in freight, detention and vendor payments
* Billing and collections: ensure accurate, timely billing, reconciliation and receivables, with clear ownership of overdue accounts
* Financial governance: work with finance and the MD on cash flow, pricing approvals, vendor payment cycles, audits and statutory compliance

**People and organization**

* Build the leadership bench: hire, mentor and manage heads of operations, business development, finance, MIS/tech and support functions
* Team structure and accountability: set up the org structure, roles, KPIs and review rhythms, and build a culture of ownership and clear accountability
* Performance management: run regular business reviews, set targets, and recognize and correct performance fairly and quickly

**Technology, MIS and compliance**

* Systems and data: drive adoption of TMS, GPS tracking, dashboards and MIS so that leadership sees real-time performance; make decisions on facts
* Compliance and risk: keep the business compliant on transport, labour, safety, contracts, insurance and statutory requirements; manage operational and legal risk
* Safety and quality: set standards for driver and rider safety, vehicle condition, documentation and cargo handling

**Leadership and reporting to the MD**

* Be the MD's single point of accountability for the business: a weekly operating review, a monthly P&L and KPI review, and a clear view of risks and opportunities
* Represent the company with key clients, partners, banks, auditors and regulators
* Take decisions independently within agreed limits, and escalate the right things to the MD at the right time

**What We're Looking For Must Have**

* 12-18 years of experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain or 3PL, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role (GM, VP, COO, Business Head or equivalent)
* A proven track record of running a business or a large P&L end to end, covering both growth and operations
* Strong hands-on understanding of trucking and FTL operations, fleet management, vendor networks, route planning and trip economics
* Experience winning and growing large clients, closing contracts and handling tenders and RFQs
* Financial strength: ability to read and drive a P&L, budgets, pricing, margins, cash flow and receivables
* Experience building and leading teams of managers across operations, sales and support functions
* Comfort with data: MIS, dashboards and TMS or GPS-based performance tracking
* Excellent negotiation, communication and stakeholder management with clients, vendors and senior leadership
* A strong ownership mindset: you act like an owner, solve problems without being asked, and are equally at home in strategy and in the details

**Preferred**

* Experience in e-commerce, cement, steel or renewable-energy logistics
* Experience across multiple vehicle types and models (2-, 3- and 4-wheelers, riders, specialized trucks) and across mid-mile and last-mile
* Experience with rail and rake movement and coordination with railway stations
* Exposure to scaling a logistics business, setting up processes, and managing growth from a smaller base
* Experience working closely with founders or an MD in a growing, entrepreneurial company
* MBA or equivalent management qualification

**Why this role**

* Direct partnership with the MD, with real authority and a seat at the top table
* Full ownership of the business: growth, delivery, finance, people and systems, rather than a single function
* The chance to build and scale a fast-growing logistics platform and shape how it runs for years to come
* Exposure across road, rail, riders and specialized trucks, on multiple large client projects
* A role where your results are visible, your decisions matter and your growth tracks the company's

title: Head of Client Services
description:
**Role Overview**

The Head – Client Services will lead all customer-facing, pricing, coordination and service delivery functions across the Relocations & Storage business. This covers Household Goods (HHG) Moving (domestic and international), Corporate Relocations, Office Moves, DSP / Destination Services and all Storage operations.

The role is accountable for an exceptional customer experience, strong pricing and commercial governance, effective vendor rate contracts, strong international agent relationships and seamless end-to-end execution. It also plays a key part in business development with existing clients and in supporting Sales to win new accounts.

The position directly supervises the General Manager – Relocations and works closely with the Operations Head, Sales, Finance and Technology teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Leadership & Client Service Management**

* Lead the Client Services function, including move coordination, pricing, billing oversight, key accounts, agent partnerships and storage clients.
* Guide, mentor and review the performance of the General Manager – Relocations, ensuring high service standards.
* Set goals, objectives, policies and priorities for the function; recommend, administer and continuously improve policies, SOPs and procedures.
* Plan, direct and review work plans across the HHG and Storage services; monitor workflow, evaluate work products and methods, and resolve problems with the team.
* Build a culture of responsiveness, accuracy, professionalism and customer satisfaction.
* Select, train, motivate and evaluate team members; arrange or provide training, correct performance gaps and implement disciplinary or exit procedures where required.
* Oversee and ensure follow-through by independent contractors and service providers working with the division.

**2. Relocation & Storage Service Delivery**

* Oversee service delivery for all domestic and international Household Goods moves.
* Oversee execution of Corporate Relocations and Office Moves involving assets, equipment and furniture.
* Oversee DSP / Destination Services where applicable.
* Oversee Storage services, including customer coordination and documentation.
* Ensure smooth collaboration between Client Services and Operations for issue resolution and service quality.
* Manage escalations and ensure consistent service standards across all branches.
* Identify opportunities to improve service delivery methods, identify resource needs and implement improvements.

**3. Pricing, RFPs & Commercial Governance**

* Own pricing for all relocation, storage and DSP services.
* Review and approve quotations to ensure competitiveness and profitability.
* Prepare and submit rates for international moves, corporate RFPs/RFQs and government tenders.
* Maintain market intelligence and keep rate structures aligned with cost realities.

**4. Financial Management & Budgeting**

* Oversee the development and administration of the division's annual budget, including forecasting funds needed for staffing, equipment, materials and supplies.
* Monitor revenues, expenditures and cash flow; review monthly tracking and quarterly financial reviews; approve expenditures and implement adjustments.
* Drive revenue growth and profitability across Relocations, DSP and Storage.

**5. Vendor Management & Rate Contracts**

* Negotiate with vendors to secure competitive rate contracts.
* Establish standardised pricing frameworks with freight agents, transporters, operations and service partners wherever possible.
