title: Manager, Premium Support
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
  
  
**The Community You Will Join**
Premium Customer Experience team will be responsible for delivering outstanding and tailored customer service, handle complex and high-stakes interactions with high-end guests and hosts. They will interact directly with customers and internal stakeholders, taking ownership of cases and ensuring complete resolution while building strong relationships with the users.
  
  
**The Difference You Will Make**
We are seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic candidate to provide exceptional Customer Service management to the Airbnb community as a Manager, Premium Support. The ideal candidate is hospitable, analytical, and committed to delivering the highest standards of service through coaching and upleveling their team. This is a full time position based in ,India, Gurgaon.
  
  
The Manager Premium Support supports one or more internal CS services. The Manager Premium Support is an operational leadership role that requires substantial experience in customer service and team management. Manager Premium Supports oversee teams of approximately 10-15 specialists and should have the ability to guide and uplevel their specialists, demonstrating top-level customer service skills. Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance real-time and planned work are also required. They should also be adaptable and responsive in our fast paced environment, sometimes under pressure, while remaining flexible, proactive, resourceful, efficient and demonstrating a high level of professionalism and confidentiality. The ideal candidate should be agile and flexible to work in a 24 x 7 environment with rotating shifts and week offs and be open to working hybrid shifts.
  
  
**A Typical Day**
**Oversee a strong operational environment for your teams and ensure high quality support for the community from your team**

* Manage the team execution of complex, sensitive, and/or urgent issues that might pose a significant risk to our brand or community, including acting as the highest escalation point for case consults and high level escalations from other stakeholders
* Meet with your direct reports regularly to review their work and provide high quality, behavior-based coaching; must be able to create a performance development strategy/plan for your service(s).
* Provide best practices guidelines to your team on how to handle cases and situations, and ensure that ways of working are documented and followed.
* Ensure that the team is consistently staffed appropriately and that staff complete onboarding and ongoing training.
* For cases that involve internal stakeholders, guide specialists to take proper action to case closure and in rare cases, support with in-the-weeds case handling
* Collaborate with Capacity Planning & WFP on setting minimum headcount, ensuring adequate coverage, contingency planning impacts of changes, and advocating for staffing needs vs. volume/work

**Drive performance at the specialist, team, and service level**

* Ensure individual team members are held accountable to performance goals in a fair and equitable manner by setting clear expectations, following-up individually, and coaching team members positively to develop and improve their skills in a tailored way
* Manage both specialist and team performance, including identifying trends in performance, providing corrective actions and positive overall feedback, and writing year end reviews and improvement plans
* Ability to set and articulate the vision and focus for the quarter; deliver that vision and focus through all hands-type meetings
* Share input and recommendations about service target setting.
* Provide oversight on the overall service performance and contribute to reporting on trends and providing a holistic picture of the service to the Delivery Director

**Build and nurture an engaged and diverse team**

* Own and manage end-to-end people strategy and operations within your specialist team to foster a high performing and sustainable team environment. This includes hiring, driving onboarding, talent development, and people engagement/wellness/morale
* Enable team and individual professional success through supporting and challenging your team to meet and exceed expectations with clear goals/expectations, feedback, one-on-ones, and coaching
* Support team in professional development within a team by finding and creating development opportunities and leveraging company-wide resources to regularly drive development within your team.
* Keep up with day-to-day management duties such as time off approvals, team and one-on-one meetings, and managing Talent-related issues
* Maintain a culture of openness, transparency and accountability allowing our teams to deliver their best work while being themselves
* Demonstrate strong leadership on important issues including Diversity & Belonging, Allyship, Ethics, Compliance and maintaining high standards of service to the company

**Support strategic initiatives within Delivery and your service as needed**

* Lead the team toward the successful execution of company or other strategic changes or goals within your service by cascading updates and changes, communicating new requirements, and providing feedback
* Support, as needed, internal Delivery performance & operations improvement projects, in collaboration with the Delivery Excellence team and cross-functional partners
* Think critically and constantly evaluate our procedures. Collect feedback from the team to identify opportunities to improve performance and better optimize processes for the team, service, and global community

**Your Expertise**

* 8+ years of progressive experience in a customer service or an operations role, with 5 years in a role directly managing staff & the employee lifecycle as a People Leader.
* Demonstrable experience in driving improved performance of teams as a line manager
* Experience in the deployment of resources to manage real-time crisis situations, including managing high severity/sensitivity cases and decision-making authority for losses
* Experience in data analysis and reporting to identify performance trends, as well as developing and implementing performance management standards
* Experience translating big picture goals and strategy into implementable and concrete actions for your teams, including setting operational or functional targets or performance goals
* Ability to work weekend days, holidays, and on-call required
* Exceptional leadership and team management skills to manage a team of professionals - comfort with conflict, giving and receiving feedback, and handling employee/Talent issues
* Strong communication skills to collaborate with different stakeholders and manage sensitive cases, while remaining calm and poised under pressure
* Organized and resourceful; able to juggle and multi-task, with an attention to detail and follow through even in ambiguous situations
* In-depth understanding of customer service operations and processes; able to translate that to your team
* Strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities to evaluate procedures and identify opportunities for improvement
* Ability to cascade with context and lead your team through changes
* Exceptional coaching skills, you have high EQ and know how to tailor your feedback & communication style to meet the needs of your coachee or mentee
* Cultural competency and a strong commitment to fostering diversity and inclusion within the team
* Proficiency in various data analysis and reporting tools to track performance trends (tableau, SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, etc.)

**Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging**
Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**How We'll Take Care Of You**
Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.
  
  
India Annual Pay Range
  
  
₹2,590,000—₹3,700,000 INR
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodations:**
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.
  
  
**A Note on Recruiting Scams:**
Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Manager – Supply Chain & Logistics
description:
**Company Description**
Nitro Commerce is an AI-driven MarTech company focused on empowering India’s rapidly growing D2C and e-commerce brands. Backed by experience building solutions for leading commerce businesses, Nitro Commerce understands the operational and marketing challenges in a fast-changing digital landscape. The company uses advanced AI to help brands overcome issues such as anonymous visitors, complex marketing journeys, and low conversion rates. Nitro Commerce positions itself as a growth partner, providing intelligent tools that drive performance and shape the future of Indian e-commerce.

**About the role**

Nitro is hiring a hands-on
**Manager – Supply Chain & Logistics**
to own the flow of goods from our manufacturers to marketplaces, quick-commerce warehouses and B2B customers, and to build the systems that run it. You will book trucks and transport partners, secure inbound appointments at marketplace and quick-commerce warehouses, manage procurement, and run an operations dashboard that shows the team where every consignment stands.

This is part execution, part system-building: you will run weekly domestic consignments from day one while turning the process into repeatable SOPs, trackers and tools.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Transport & booking**

* Book trucks (FTL / PTL) for each consignment; source, negotiate and compare rates across transporters.
* Book logistics partners (3PL, courier, freight forwarders) and manage their SLAs.
* Book inbound appointments on marketplace and quick-commerce portals (Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart) and with modern-trade DCs; schedule pickups from manufacturers and avoid missed slots, rejections and detention.
* Track shipments end to end and resolve delays, damages and documentation issues (e-way bills, LR, POD, invoices).

**2. Supply chain management**

* Plan and run weekly domestic consignments: volumes, routes, lead times and load optimisation.
* Forecast demand and plan replenishment by SKU and location; keep stock-outs and ageing inventory low across D2C, marketplace, quick-commerce and B2B channels.
* Maintain a reliable transporter and vendor network with backup options for every lane.

**3. D2C business operations**

* Run fulfilment across every channel: own website (Shopify), marketplaces (Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa), quick commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart) and B2B / modern trade.
* Manage marketplace and quick-commerce inbound: POs from platforms, appointment slots, ASN / invoice matching, GRN discrepancies and rejected stock.
* Keep quick-commerce dark-store and marketplace FC stock healthy so listings never go out of stock during campaigns and sale events.
* Manage D2C last-mile partners and aggregators (Shiprocket, Delhivery, Blue Dart or similar): courier allocation, COD remittance, NDR follow-up.
* Reduce RTO (return to origin) and handle reverse logistics: returns, damaged goods and re-stocking.
* Work with the OMS / WMS (Unicommerce, EasyEcom or similar) to sync inventory across channels and avoid overselling.
* Coordinate with marketing and growth teams on launches, combos and promotions so stock and packaging are ready before demand spikes.
* Track logistics-side unit economics: shipping cost per order, RTO %, fill rate per platform, inventory days by channel.

**4. Procurement**

* Coordinate with third-party manufacturers and packaging suppliers so production matches procurement and dispatch plans; source and onboard vendors and transporters through RFQs and rate negotiation.
* Raise and track POs; keep landed cost and freight cost per unit under control.
* Evaluate vendors on cost, on-time performance and quality.

**5. Dashboard & operations**

* Own a live operations dashboard: consignments in transit, appointment fill rate, on-time %, freight cost per unit, inventory days by channel, pending PODs, vendor performance.
* Share weekly reports with leadership and flag risks early.

**6. System creation**

* Design SOPs for booking, appointments, dispatch, tracking and billing.
* Build trackers, templates and workflows (sheets, OMS / WMS such as Unicommerce or EasyEcom, TMS, or internal tools) so operations scale without adding headcount.
* Work with product / tech to digitise and automate the logistics workflow.

**Requirements**

* 3–6 years in logistics, transport or supply chain operations, with at least 2 years at a D2C / consumer brand (beauty, food, wellness or FMCG) selling on marketplaces and quick commerce.
* Hands-on experience booking trucks and managing transporters (FTL / PTL).
* Working knowledge of Indian logistics documentation: e-way bill, LR / bilty, POD, GST invoices.
* Experience in procurement or vendor management, including rate negotiation.
* Strong in Excel / Google Sheets; comfortable building trackers and simple dashboards.
* Organised, follows up relentlessly, and solves problems on the phone the same day.
* Clear communication in English and Hindi; regional languages a plus.

**Preferred qualifications**

* **Domestic logistics**
  experience across Indian lanes (road freight first; rail / air a plus).
* Has managed
  **weekly recurring consignments**
  with predictable volumes and fixed schedules.
* **Logistics specialisation:**
  degree, diploma or certification in logistics / SCM (e.g. MBA in SCM, CILT, CSCP).
* Experience with a TMS, WMS or ERP (Zoho, Tally, SAP, or similar).
* Has set up SOPs or a logistics function from scratch at a startup or growing company.

title: Warehouse Manager - Gurgaon
description:
**Location: Ugaoo Hub, Khata No 461, Khewat No 83, Hanuman Mandir, next to Baliawas, Baliawas, Gurugram, Bandhwari, Haryana 122101 - https://maps.app.goo.gl/dxgp2M8iBvJDmvb77**
**About Us**
At Ugaoo, we’ve always believed plants are more than décor. They’re companions, healers, and reminders of what truly matters. What began as a small idea sparked by a plant on a windowsill has grown into India’s leading gardening brand, backed by marquee investors like DSG Consumer Partners and V3 Ventures. From our 25-acre farm in Talegaon to a thriving D2C store and retail presence across Pune, Mumbai, Bangalore and Delhi, we’re building an ecosystem that brings nature closer to homes, offices, and communities.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Warehouse Manager to oversee and manage all warehouse activities. The ideal candidate will be responsible for ensuring efficient warehouse operations across receiving, storage, inventory management, order fulfilment and dispatch. The role will focus on optimizing warehouse processes, maintaining inventory accuracy, managing teams, controlling operational costs and ensuring timely movement of goods.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Oversee daily warehouse operations, including receiving, storage, order fulfilment, packing and dispatch of goods.
* Implement and maintain efficient warehouse processes to optimize workflow, productivity and operational efficiency.
* Plan and manage warehouse layout, storage systems and space utilization to ensure effective storage and movement of goods.
* Monitor inventory levels and maintain accurate stock records to prevent stockouts, overstocking, losses and damages.
* Implement inventory control procedures, including regular cycle counts, stock audits and stock reconciliations.
* Ensure accurate documentation and tracking of inward and outward goods movement.
* Lead, mentor and train warehouse staff, ensuring productivity, discipline and adherence to operational standards.
* Schedule and allocate tasks to warehouse personnel, monitor performance and conduct regular performance reviews.
* Implement and maintain quality control standards to ensure the accuracy, quality and condition of received, stored and dispatched goods.
* Monitor order fulfilment and dispatch schedules to ensure timely and accurate movement of goods.
* Collaborate with procurement, logistics and sales teams to forecast demand, plan inventory replenishment and ensure smooth supply chain operations.
* Prepare and maintain daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports covering inventory, warehouse performance, stock movement and operational metrics.
* Monitor warehouse operational expenses, optimize manpower and resource utilization, and identify opportunities for cost reduction.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements, system enhancements and automation to improve warehouse efficiency.
* Ensure proper maintenance of warehouse infrastructure and equipment.
* Conduct regular warehouse inspections and enforce safety policies and procedures to maintain a clean and secure working environment.
* Ensure compliance with applicable legal, statutory and regulatory requirements related to warehouse operations.

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain Management or a related field.
* 3–7 years of experience in warehouse management or warehouse operations.
* Strong understanding of warehouse operations, inventory management and supply chain processes.
* Hands-on experience with Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), ERP systems and inventory management tools.
* Experience in warehouse reporting, MIS, inventory audits and stock reconciliations.
* Strong understanding of warehouse space utilization, manpower planning and operational cost management.
* Excellent leadership and team management skills.
* Strong organizational, multitasking and problem-solving abilities.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.

title: Senior Manager - Business Operations
description:
BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.

BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.

Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.

We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

**About the role:**

The Senior Manager, Business Operations is responsible for leading large-scale In Life SMB Operations from India for UK Business, working in close partnership with functional leaders in the UK. The role leads customer service delivery across international voice, chat, digital and back-office channels and is accountable for delivering a consistent, high-quality experience for business customers. It aligns operational delivery with the UK Business strategy, owns customer, commercial, financial, people and service outcomes, and provides clear leadership across a complex, multi-site operation. The role also ensures change and transformation are translated into practical operational plans, successfully landed, embedded and sustained.

**Role Accountabilities:**

Lead In Life SMB Operations across international voice, chat, digital and back-office channels, ensuring a consistent, high-quality and efficient experience for business customers.

• Provide visible leadership for a large-scale operation of approximately 800–1,000 colleagues through direct and indirect people-management structures, with clear accountability for outcomes, culture and colleague experience.

• Own end-to-end operational performance across customer experience, service levels, first-contact resolution, productivity, quality, demand, capacity and cost, using insight to identify risks, address root causes and improve outcomes.

• Build and govern robust operating plans, including volume and capacity forecasts, staffing, scheduling, shrinkage, overtime, service recovery and business-continuity arrangements.

• Lead change-management and transformation initiatives, ensuring new journeys, processes, technology, AI and automation are operationally ready, successfully deployed and measured for sustained benefit.

• Represent In Life SMB Operations in senior forums, communicate performance and risk with clarity, and influence cross-functional decisions while maintaining a best-for-customer and best-for-BT approach.

**Skills & Experience:**

• Minimum 10 years of proven leadership of a large-scale, complex customer operation, ideally supporting approximately 800–1,000 colleagues through direct and indirect teams.

• Substantial experience leading customer service delivery across voice and chat, with additional exposure to digital and back-office operations.

• Strong telecoms or similarly complex service-industry experience, with a sound understanding of end-to-end customer journeys and international operations.

• Strong command of demand and capacity planning, forecasting, staffing models, scheduling, shrinkage, utilization, service-level management and intraday performance governance.

• Excellent stakeholder-management and influencing skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively, negotiate priorities, manage difficult conversations and hold partners accountable.

title: Manager - Retail Facility Management (Own Retail Stores)
description:
**Purpose**
This role is responsible for the quality management, development and coordination of Retail Facilities Management services across the adidas retail store portfolio in India.
  
  
The role ensures stores operate in a safe, compliant, efficient and brand-appropriate environment by managing hard and soft facilities management services, statutory compliance, maintenance program, supplier performance and facility-related projects.
  
  
Working with Retail Operations, Store Development, Procurement, HSEE and external service providers, this role will set and maintain the highest quality standards for retail facility operations, while ensuring cost-effective service delivery and excellent support for store teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead and continuously develop retail facilities management operations across the adidas store portfolio in India.
* Manage complex facility management activities requiring strong operational expertise, judgement and autonomous decision-making.
* Plan, organize and monitor retail facility management processes to ensure safe, compliance and uninterrupted store operations.
* Ensure all hard and soft facilities management services are delivered to agreed standards, including maintenance, cleaning, waste management, pest control and other operational services.
* Develop and implement preventive maintenance strategies to improve asset reliability and reduce reactive maintenance spending.
* Monitor and manage reactive maintenance activities, ensuring issues are resolved within agreed service levels.
* Establish and maintain facility management standards, policies, processes and reporting mechanisms across the retail portfolio.
* Partner with Retail Operations leaders and store teams to understand operational priorities and continuously improve service delivery.
* Work closely with Store Development teams to support store openings, refurbishments, relocations and closures.
* Manage facility management suppliers through service reviews, performance monitoring and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support tender processes, supplier selection, contract negotiations, mobilization and transition activities in partnership with Procurement.
* Ensure all supplier contracts, KPIs and SLAs are effectively monitored and achieved.
* Monitor budget performance and support annual planning, forecasting and cost control activities.
* Ensure all facilities management expenditure represents best value and delivers business benefit.
* Manage statutory compliance requirements and ensure all required inspections, certifications and maintenance activities are completed.
* Ensure compliance with local legislation, company standards and applicable health, safety, environmental and fire safety requirements.
* Identify, assess and mitigate facility-related operational risks across the retail portfolio.
* Manage facility-related incidents and escalate significant compliance, safety or operational risks to senior stakeholders.
* Support sustainability, energy efficiency and environmental initiatives across retail stores in alignment with company objectives.
* Coordinate and manage facilities-related projects and store improvement initiatives.
* Act as the primary interface between adidas and assigned facility management service providers.
* Lead and develop assigned employees where applicable.
* Ensure operator responsibilities and employer obligations relating to occupational health and safety are fulfilled in accordance with applicable laws, regulations and company standards.

**Key Relationships**
Retail Operations Leadership, Retail Field Teams, Store Managers and Store Employees, Store Development Teams, Procurement , Finance, Legal, HSEE, External Authorities, including government, fire, compliance and regulatory bodies. Landlords, Mall Management, and Property Management Companies, External Service Providers and Contractors
  
  
**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Strong facilities management expertise within a multi-site retail environment.
* Strong knowledge of hard and soft facility management services.
* Strong understanding of statutory compliance, health & safety and building operations.
* Proven experience managing large service provider contracts.
* Tender management and supplier selection experience.
* Contract negotiation and supplier performance management skills.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Budget planning, cost control and financial management capability.
* Project management skills.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple activities across a geographically dispersed store portfolio.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability.
* Ability to work independently and drive results through internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
* Very good English skills.

**Requisite Education And Experience / Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Facilities Management, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Property Management, Business Administration or a related field.
* Minimum 12-15+ years of professional experience in Facilities Management.
* Experience managing facilities services across a national retail portfolio of similar retail/fashion or consumer-facing brands preferred.
* Experience managing external contractors and service providers.
* Proven experience in budget management and cost control.
* Experience leading projects and operational improvement initiatives.
* Previous experience at a similar level in a complex organization and/or global brand.
* People management experience preferred.
* Professional facilities management, health & safety or engineering qualification preferred.

title: Assistant Manager-RMS Personal Independence-GMS
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Supervising Associate - Independence - Risk Management Services**
This role requires the candidate to build and demonstrate an in-depth technical knowledge of personal independence processes which are developed globally in accordance with the EY Global (EYG) Independence policies aimed towards safeguarding EY as an Independent auditor. These processes are standardized in nature and are performed by the RMS teams on behalf of EY engagement teams. The candidate will be responsible for coaching mentoring and supervising a team of about 15-25 members on technical matters and should be able to handle and resolve their queries. The role also involves liaising with Global Independence process owners and a variety of stakeholders and end users across countries and geographies. The candidate is also expected to contribute the GDS wide priorities and initiatives and help in building a better working world for our EY professionals and team members.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Risk Management Services (RMS) is an internal function within EY GDS (Global Delivery services), responsible for protecting the organization from the risks that may arise from its professional practice. We work closely with all parts of the organization to identify and manage risks, providing coordinated advice and assistance on suite of services like Independence, Conflicts, Compliance, regulatory, policy and security issues as well as dealing with claims and queries regarding ethics. Formed in 2007, the RMS team is growing rapidly as a Centre of Excellence for all standardized quality/compliance related activities.
  
  
This role will be part of the largest sub-service function, i.e., Independence within Risk Management Services (RMS) responsible for assisting EY professionals to maintain auditor objectivity by identifying and mitigating any potential conflicts of interest that could compromise an auditor's independence.
  
  
RMS Independence team is currently 950+ people strong, operating from 3 countries and 5 centres: India (Gurugram, Kochi, Bengaluru), Poland (Wroclaw), Philippines (Manila). The team is closely integrated with Global Independence and has been involved in development of key Independence processes.
  
  
The role offers opportunities to work in a dynamic, growth-focused environment, with a special emphasis on protecting EY’s reputation as an independent auditor, by providing support to EY Professionals, Global & Regional stakeholders on Personal Independence matters. It also involves close collaboration with global & regional teams to strengthen the compliance framework and foster a mindset of continuous improvement and client enablement. The role also involves liaising with Global Independence process owners and a variety of stakeholders and end users across countries and geographies. The candidate is also expected to contribute the GDS wide priorities and initiatives and help in building a better working world for our EY professionals and team members.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
An Assistant Manager in the RMS Independence GMS team, will lead 5-15 high performing individuals, fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment. Your role involves working closely with EY professionals as well as Global and Regional stakeholders to strengthen the personal independence compliance framework, spearheading continuous improvement at process level. By effectively managing your team, engaging with stakeholders, and optimizing the processes, you will contribute significantly to EY's success. Other responsibilities include conducting quality reviews, analyzing issues, and producing well-documented deliverables, as the work product for these individuals is subject to review and scrutiny by external regulators.
  
  
**Technical expertise**

* Develop & maintain subject matter expertise in personal independence processes and policies, thereby enabling EY professionals to uphold their Independence compliance requirements.
* Stay updated on relevant regulatory policies like EYG and local country policies and industry best practices related to potential investments conflicts of interest.
* Consistently drive team to deliver high-quality project outcomes by thoroughly understanding EY Global & Independence policies and adhering to best practices and standard operating procedures
* Identify & implement process improvements to enhance efficiency & the overall effectiveness of the Personal Independence process.
* Be abreast of emerging trends and regulatory changes and effectively communicate these developments to Independence team members.
* Conduct thorough secondary research using a wide range of internal and external databases to support personal independence monitoring processes.
* Effectively facilitate and implement process & policy updates, ensuring comprehensive knowledge sharing sessions are conducted.
* Establish credibility by consistently providing deep insights and technical expertise, actively engaging in strategic discussions with stakeholders.
* Continuously develop and refine technical knowledge in Independence processes to become a recognized subject matter expert within the team.
* Lead process trainings for team members to ensure consistent understanding and application of EY Global & Personal Independence policies.
* Understand and strive to meet or exceed individual and team KPIs for the role.
* Effectively address & resolve service delivery issues / escalations using tools like RCA (Root cause analysis) and CAPA (Corrective and preventive actions)
* Conduct reviews & second level sample audits for reviewers in the team to ensure strong quality assurance model is maintained.

**Client/Stakeholder Management**

* Maintain regular and proactive communication with stakeholders to keep them informed about project progress, potential issues and any changes in timelines or scope.
* Actively engage with global and regional Independence stakeholders to implement any process changes, enhancements and improvement to ensure their expectations are met
* Develop effective conflict resolution and escalation management strategies to address and resolve any issues or escalations promptly and professionally.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to client management to ensure high standards of service delivery.
* Act as a point of contact between EY Professionals, Global/Regional stakeholders, members of other Independence competencies, and relevant GDS functions to effectively coordinate efforts for a project/request.

**Operations Management:**

* Oversee volume inflows, strategize resource allocation and ensure adherence to work-flow protocol and tools.
* Engage in reporting activities to support internal and external stakeholder’s requirements.
* Establish and monitor the team's key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Contribute to strategic projects/initiatives to drive success & growth within Global EY landscape.

**People Management**

* Responsible for managing/leading a team of 5-10 professionals, ensuring the highest quality of work through effective project management and adherence to delivery standards.
* Maintain open and transparent communication with team members to ensure clarity of expectations and foster a collaborative environment that encourages engagement and participation in decision-making processes.
* Foster a culture of engagement by recognizing and rewarding team members' contributions, and encourage their professional development through coaching, mentoring, and recommending training to address skill gaps.
* Promote a healthy work-life balance by encouraging flexible working arrangements and supporting initiatives aimed at team members' well-being.
* Evaluate and manage team performance by setting clear goals, assessing against KPIs, and providing constructive feedback to enhance productivity and professional growth.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Act as first point of contact for guidance to the team and as well for the stakeholders.
* Lead and drive transformation initiatives on process improvements and client enablement to enhance efficiency and effectiveness for the team.
* Demonstrate strong problem solving and critical thinking abilities to navigate through complex situations.
* Must possess a client- centric and enablement mindset which involves continuously seeking ways to improve service delivery.
* Uphold and drive the highest standards of ethics, integrity, and values.
* Must be adaptable and agile in dynamic situations, facilitating change management.
* Innovative mindset with proficiency in using current technologies and willingness to adapt to new digital tools to enhance efficiency.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Masters/post-graduate degree (preferably in Finance) from a reputed institute.
* At least 7-8 years of professional experience, out of which minimum 4 years’ experience should have:
* Compliance or research functions in Big 4 or other professional service organizations
* Managing reasonably mid-size teams (5-10 team members)
* Experience in Risk Management/ Independence would be preferred
* Candidates with exposure of handing client interactions would be preferred
* Well-developed analytical, interpersonal, and communication (both verbal and written) skills in English
* Working knowledge of type of financial instruments, deposit accounts, loans, insurance etc
* Experience in performing external research, data reconciliation and exposure to performing data analysis and interpretation of output.

**Technologies and Tools**

* Experience in MS Office (Outlook, MS Word, MS Excel, SharePoint etc)
* Project management and Business analytics tool like Power-BI and experience in lean methodologies like Value stream mapping would be preferred.
* Stay abreast of emerging technologies, including generative AI, to maintain a competitive edge in tech-driven solutions.
* Knowledge of Databases like Factiva, D&B, Thomson Reuters etc would be preferred.

**What You Can Look For**

* A Team of people with business acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in face -moving ecosystem.
* A team which has its foundation in the core values of trust, respect and teaming. The team which focuses on supporting its colleagues to excel in their respective domains and provides avenues to help acquire and demonstrate new skills.
* A team of professionals driven by growth and client enablement mindset, while safeguarding EY’s brand name.
* A team that thrives on continuous improvement and bringing in efficiencies to processes.
* Opportunities to work with Global Executive risk management teams on strengthening and monitoring compliance framework

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Assistant Manager - B2C Logistics & Last-Mile Operations
description:
**About the Role**

Troovy is scaling rapidly across D2C, quick commerce, and marketplaces. We need a seasoned D2C logistics

professional to own last-mile end-to-end carrier performance, RTO reduction, SDD/NDD scale-up, and

delivery network expansion as we grow into new geographies. Hands-on, high-ownership role with direct

visibility into everything that goes out to our customer

**What You'll Own**

***Carrier Management***

* Own relationships with all B2C courier partners - Delhivery, Xpressbees, Ekart, Shadowfax, and
* others
* Run weekly scorecards on TAT, first-attempt delivery %, and pickup SLA
* Lead rate negotiations and manage contract terms; flag risk clauses before sign-off
* Maintain a multi-carrier allocation model balancing cost, speed, and serviceability

***Network Expansion***

* Identify pincode and geography gaps in current delivery coverage and close them
* Evaluate and onboard new carrier partners to expand reach without inflating per-shipment cost
* Build and manage a pincode-level serviceability matrix across all active carriers
* Balance network growth with cost and performance - no expansion at the cost of OTIF or RTO

***SDD / NDD Scaling***

* Drive same-day and next-day delivery expansion across priority pincodes
* Ensure cut-off adherence and dispatch readiness with warehouse teams
* Identify carrier gaps for express delivery and activate the right partners by geography

***RTO Reduction***

* Own RTO % as a primary KPI with weekly tracking
* Manage NDR workflows - proactive outreach, re-attempts, address correction
* Analyze and act on RTO root causes by carrier, pincode, and product type

***Cost Management***

* Track per-shipment cost by carrier, zone, and weight slab
* Dispute incorrect charges and eliminate avoidable billing
* Report logistics cost as % of GMV monthly with variance commentary

**What We're Looking For**

* 4–7 years in B2C logistics or last-mile ops - must be from a D2C brand or D2C-first environment
* Hands-on experience with Delhivery is mandatory - deep familiarity with their systems, SLAs, and
* escalation structure.
* Proven track record of expanding delivery networks while keeping cost and performance in check
* Direct carrier performance ownership at meaningful volume - not just vendor coordination
* Strong understanding of D2C shipping economics - zonal pricing, volumetric weight, RTO cost
* structure, NDR workflows
* Strong on data - Excel/Sheets, trackers, and dashboards; derives actions independently
* Familiarity with Unicommerce is a plus

**Qualifications**

**Qualifications and Skills:**

Must

(Required)

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline

Want

**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose,
**To Make Our Lives Easier**
. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

with us?

Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
This position is based in
**Coimbatore**
& will report to
**Regional Manager Core Lab.**
You will be covering assigned areas in Coimbatore, Salem, Hosur.
  
  
You will play a critical role in driving maximum value within our Core Lab accounts; taking full ownership of client retention and account development. Upon joining Roche Diagnostics India, you will adopt key stakeholder relationships with a portfolio of customers and be responsible for identifying upsell opportunities and ensuring targets and satisfaction levels are met.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities:**
**Business Development**

* Responsible for meeting with the sales budget
* Interacting with customers for enhancement of business
* Responsible of increasing existing business through adding new parameters / price hike / ownership transfer
* Initiation of Customers retention measures by building on customer relations
* Collect references from existing customers and create a customer pool for new business development
* Responsible to timely cater customer queries to increase business

**Distribution Management**

* Liase with distribution and channel partners in fulfilling customer orders
* Responsible for raising Purchase orders and Indent
* Responsible for various activities related to control and monitor or the orders, dispatches to the end user from the stockists

**Clarify Data Management**

* Updation of Information regarding customer visits
* Updation of Competitors information
* Creation of new database and process documentations
* Management of the entire data and usage of the same for catering customers

**Compliance**

* Liase with customers for IPC (Instrument Placement Contract)compliance or introduction of new assays

**Others**

* Organize and assist Product Mangers in conducting CME's

**Who You Are:**
You will have a successful and considerable proven track record in Sales, preferably acquired in the healthcare industry. To be considered for this role, you will need Degree educated or equivalent in engineering, scientific or related field and to evidence your success in service delivery; a proven track record of developing strong relationships with key stakeholders to the highest decision making level leading to successful business outcomes. A strategic thinker with an entrepreneurial spirit and the ability to prioritize and deliver, you can drive change and adoption of new concepts.
  
  
With confidence and passion, you will have excellent written and verbal communication skills, and be able to communicate with maximum impact.
  
  
Resilient, tenacious, you strive under pressure, working effectively as part of a close-knit team in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment with shifting priorities and multiple deadlines. With strong analytical skills, you are at ease working with technical and scientific information.
  
  
This position offers exposure to wider Roche organization at all levels and therefore you must have the qualities to make a positive, professional impact in a matrix environment and win the hearts and minds internally.
  
  
Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: HRSSC - Manager Enablement Lead
description:
**The Opportunity**
Responsible for the oversight, development and delivery of all global HR administrative and operational related activity including but not limited to workforce analytics, benefits and associated policies, and all relevant HR Information Systems. Manage the HR Solutions, Analytics, and HR Services teams responsible for all data input
  
  
**Job Title: HRSSC - Manager Enablement Lead**
**Location: Coimbatore (Shared Services Center)**
**Position Summary**

* HRSSC - Manager Enablement Lead serves as the primary source of guidance, consulting, coaching, and support for people managers across the organization.
* This role acts as a trusted advisor to managers by providing expertise on HR policies, processes, people practices, workforce insights, HR technologies, and organizational programs. The role combines the consultative capabilities of an HR Business Partner, the operational excellence of HR Shared Services, and the technical proficiency of HR Technology Support to empower managers with the knowledge, tools, and insights required to effectively lead their teams.
* Operating through ServiceNow case management, chat support, AI-enabled knowledge platforms, and self-service capabilities, the role ensures managers receive accurate, timely, and proactive support while driving manager effectiveness, digital adoption, and operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Manager Advisory & Consultation**

* Serve as the first point of contact for managers seeking guidance on HR policies, procedures, programs, and people-related matters.
* Provide consultative support on employee lifecycle activities including hiring, onboarding, performance management, talent reviews, employee movements, leave management, and offboarding.
* Interpret HR policies and recommend appropriate actions within established governance frameworks.
* Partner with HR Centers of Excellence, HR Business Partners, Employee Relations and Legal for complex or escalated people-related matters.

**HR Technology & Digital Enablement**

* Support managers in the effective use of HR systems and digital tools.
* Provide functional guidance related to HR technology platforms including employee data management, workflow approvals, reporting tools, and self-service solutions.
* Act as an HR technology ambassador, promoting adoption of digital HR capabilities.
* Collaborate with Workday, ServiceNow, and technology teams to identify recurring issues and improve user experience.

**ServiceNow Case and Chat Support**

* Manage manager inquiries received through ServiceNow tickets, virtual agent channels, chat platforms, and other support channels.
* Ensure resolution of cases within established service level agreements (SLAs).
* Monitor case queues, prioritize workload, and manage escalations effectively.
* Conduct root cause analysis on recurring inquiries and recommend process improvements.

**Knowledge Management & AI Enablement**

* Develop, maintain, and continuously improve manager-facing knowledge articles and support content.
* Ensure high-quality content is available for ServiceNow AI-assisted and self-service solutions.
* Identify opportunities to reduce ticket volumes through automation, AI-driven responses, and knowledge optimization.
* Monitor knowledge article usage, effectiveness, and manager feedback.

**Manager Capability Building & Coaching**

* Deliver coaching and practical guidance to managers on HR processes, systems, and people management practices.
* Facilitate virtual and instructor-led training sessions.
* Create learning materials, guides, FAQs, quick-reference tools, and manager toolkits.
* Enable managers to become confident users of self-service resources and technologies.

**Workforce Analytics & Insights Support**

* Provide managers with guidance on workforce metrics and standard HR reports.
* Assist managers in understanding headcount, turnover, attrition, hiring, performance, and organizational data.
* Translate workforce data into actionable insights where appropriate.
* Support data-driven decision-making by promoting available reporting capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Build strong relationships and credibility with managers across the organization.
* Act as a liaison between managers and HR functions.
* Escalate complex employee relations, compliance, or business-sensitive matters appropriately.
* Gather manager feedback and recommend service improvements.

**Service Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

* Analyze manager demand trends and support patterns.
* Improve processes, simplify manager experiences, and reduce service friction.
* Identify automation opportunities.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and manager satisfaction.
* Measure effectiveness through service metrics and business outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
* 6-10 years of progressive HR experience.
* Experience in HR Shared Services, HR Operations, HR Business Partnering, HR Advisory Services, or HR Service Delivery environments.
* Experience supporting managers and leaders within a complex organization.
* Experience using HR case management systems such as ServiceNow.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES (Those necessary to perform the job competently):**

* Experience in HR transformation or service center environments.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow HR Service Delivery and Workday.
* Understanding of AI-enabled employee/manager support solutions.
* Lean, Six Sigma, ITIL, or process improvement certifications preferred

title: SCT-Tech Enablment-Aera Technology-Manager
description:

**-**

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As an Aera Techno-Functional Manager, you will lead the design and delivery of Decision Intelligence solutions, own stakeholder alignment, and guide cross-functional teams from business problem definition through deployment and value realization. The role requires strong solution leadership, data fluency, and hands-on understanding of Aera delivery.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead discovery workshops to define business objectives, decision triggers, personas, KPIs, constraints, actions, and measurable outcomes.
* Own end-to-end solution design across data, recommendation logic, workflow, user experience, action enablement, security considerations, testing, deployment, and support.
* Guide teams in translating business needs into scalable Aera techno-functional designs and delivery plans.
* Review SQL, data mappings, business rules, solution configurations, test evidence, and release readiness for quality and traceability.
* Manage client stakeholders, scope, priorities, dependencies, risks, issues, and executive-level communication.
* Lead functional and technical teams, allocate work, coach team members, and ensure delivery governance.
* Drive user acceptance, adoption planning, operating model readiness, deployment, hypercare, and outcome tracking.
* Identify reusable assets, accelerators, and delivery standards to improve quality and productivity.
* Partner with sales and account teams on solution shaping, estimates, staffing, and proposal support where required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, business analytics, supply chain, operations, finance, or a related field; a master's degree is advantageous.
* MBA from Tier 1 institute will be preferred.
* More than 10 years of overall experience in consulting, enterprise technology, analytics, data solutions, or digital transformation.
* Demonstrated experience leading techno-functional solution delivery and multi-disciplinary teams.
* Strong SQL and data analysis capability sufficient to review solution logic, validate data, and guide technical teams.
* Proven stakeholder management, workshop facilitation, solution governance, risk management, and executive communication skills.
* Ability to connect solution design to business value, adoption, actionability, and measurable outcomes.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Prior Aera implementation and leadership experience is a strong plus.
* Experience designing Decision Intelligence solutions or equivalent recommendation and action-oriented enterprise solutions.
* Domain experience in supply chain, planning, procurement, manufacturing, commercial, or finance transformations.
* Experience with cloud data ecosystems, integration patterns, analytics, AI/ML, or process orchestration.

**What We Look For**

* Who can create clarity across business, functional, data, and technology workstreams.
* Coach teams toward high-quality, reusable, and supportable delivery.
* Escalate risks early and maintain transparent governance with account and client leadership.
* Own the connection between delivery outputs and client business outcomes.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: BIM Manager
description:
BIM Manager Gradiant India Private Limited Coimbatore, India 10/26/26 Engineering
  
  
Gradiant is a Different Kind of Water Company. With a full suite of differentiated and proprietary end-to-end solutions for advanced water and wastewater treatment powered by the top minds in water, the company serves its clients’ mission-critical operations in the world’s essential industries, including semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, food & beverage, lithium and critical minerals, and renewable energy. Gradiant’s innovative solutions reduce water used and wastewater discharged, reclaim valuable resources, and renew wastewater into freshwater. The Boston-headquartered company was founded at MIT and has over 1,400 employees worldwide. Discover us at www.gradiant.com.
  
  
**Role Overview**
The BIM Manager will be responsible for the setup, configuration, and implementation of Building Information Modeling (BIM) processes, specifically using Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) and BIM360 for process plant construction. This role requires a strong focus on mechanical systems, interdisciplinary coordination, and team leadership to ensure all project models and associated information are accurate, up-to-date, and compliant with the BIM Execution Plan (BEP)
  
  
**Responsibilities**
BIM Management
  
  

* Develop and implement BIM Execution Plans (BEP).
* Establish BIM standards, workflows, templates, and project procedures.
* Manage Revit models for civil, mechanical, piping, structural, electrical, and instrumentation disciplines.
* Ensure compliance with project BIM standards, client requirements, and company procedures.
* Coordinate BIM deliverables across engineering teams and external consultants.

Model Coordination
  
  

* Conduct interdisciplinary model reviews and clash detection using Navisworks.
* Resolve clashes between process equipment, piping, structures, cable trays, HVAC, and utilities.
* Coordinate 3D layouts for treatment units, pump stations, chemical dosing systems, pipe racks, and utility corridors.
* Facilitate BIM coordination meetings and track closure of issues.

Design Support
  
  

* Support engineering teams in developing accurate 3D models and drawings.
* Ensure consistency between P&IDs, process layouts, GA drawings, and Revit models.
* Review model quality, constructability, maintainability, and accessibility requirements.
* Manage LOD (Level of Development) requirements throughout project phases.

Information Management
  
  

* Manage Common Data Environment (CDE).
* Ensure proper model version control and document management.
* Generate schedules, quantity take-offs, and model-based reports.
* Support digital handover and asset information requirements.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead BIM coordinators and BIM modelers.
* Provide training and technical guidance on Revit and BIM workflows.
* Promote BIM best practices and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering is preffered.
* 7+ years of experience in BIM management, specifically within process plants or large-scale industrial projects.
* Proven expertise in Autodesk Revit, BIM360/Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), and Navisworks.
* Strong understanding of BIM Execution Plans (BEP) and Employer Information Requirements (EIR).
* Excellent communication skills for collaborating with local and international teams.
* Strong leadership skills, with experience managing, training, and mentoring BIM teams.

**Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)**
Gradiant is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, or any other protected class.

description:
**Power Electronics Design Engineer**
**Position**
**(Experience)**
**Lead PE AC PEBB**
10–15+ years in power electronics product development ,experience in grid-connected product taken to certification.
  
  
**Department**
R&D – Power Electronics
  
  
**Qualification**
B.E./B. Tech or M. Tech in Electrical, Electronics or Power Electronics
  
  
**Location**
Coimbatore
  
  
**Reports to**
Lead / Head – Power Electronics R&D
  
  
**Role Summary**
Power electronics engineer having hands on experience on High Power Converters, Exposure to grid-connected Power Conversion System (PCS, Bidirectional AC to DC) for BESS and solar applications.
  
  
Product development experience from architecture through prototype, validation and certification support.
  
  
**Required Skills**

* Hands-on design of 3-phase grid-connected converters (PCS, inverters, active front ends) above 50 kW.
* Strong knowledge of gate-drive design, SiC/IGBT switching behaviour, and dead-time, EMI and layout trade-offs.
* Experience with grid-interface hardware: LCL filters, contactors, breakers, pre-charge, surge and EMI filters.
* Preferred proficiency in Altium/OrCAD/Allegro and in simulation tools.
* Good understanding of safety, isolation, creepage and clearance, and thermal design.

**Leadership**

* Lead, mentor and review the work of a team of HW/ME-control engineers; plan schedules, estimates and resources.
* Work with Software, mechanical, testing, manufacturing and supply chain teams, and with customers on technical queries.
* Own technical documentation: design specifications, test plans, release notes and user manuals.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own design & Development from Requirement to production release for Power conversion system
* Define Power Conversion System architecture like 3-phase two-level or three-level topology, DC link, LCL filter and DC/AC interface to the battery or PV side.
* Select and design power stages using SiC/IGBT modules: loss and thermal analysis, busbar and layout design, snubber and DC-link capacitor selection.
* Design the LCL filter, magnetics, and pre-charge and contactor circuits.
* Design the control card and interface boards: DSP/MCU control card, isolated gate-driver boards with desaturation and short-circuit protection and active Miller clamp.
* Design the sensing chain: grid and DC voltage sensing, Hall/shunt current sensing, isolated ADC paths and temperature sensing.
* Design auxiliary power supplies, fan and cooling control, and the interlock and emergency-stop (E-stop) chain.
* Build protection hardware: over-current, over-voltage, ground fault, insulation monitoring and anti-islanding hardware support.
* Perform schematic capture, multilayer PCB layout guidance
* Simulation tools à LTspice, PLECS, PSIM or MATLAB/Simulink).
* Execute DFMEA, reliability and derating analysis, and design reviews.
* Lead bring-up and validation: Grid-simulator testing, regenerative load tests, efficiency and THD measurement, thermal and EMI/EMC pre-compliance.
* Support type testing and certification against IEC 62477-1, IEC 62109, IEC 61000 series, IEC 62116 and applicable grid codes (CEA India, IEEE 1547, UL 1741, VDE-AR-N 4105/4110).
* Coordinate with mechanical, firmware and vendor teams; prepare BOMs and production documentation.

**Preferred**

* Experience with 1000/1500 V DC systems, BESS or MW-scale PCS.
* Knowledge of 3-level (NPC/T-type) topologies and parallel module operation.

title: US Tax Analyst
description:
**Company Description**
StrategCube provides specialized services across finance, accounting, consulting, audit, taxation, investment management, and mergers & acquisitions. The company supports clients with end-to-end solutions that help optimize financial performance and manage regulatory requirements.

**Role Description**
This is a full-time, remote role for a US Tax Analyst at StrategCube. The US Tax Analyst for Business Tax returns will prepare and review federal, state, and local tax returns for LLCs and Corps, ensuring accuracy and timely filing. The role includes performing tax research on US tax laws and regulations, identifying opportunities for tax savings, and documenting positions in line with current guidance. The role also includes client interactions and consultation.

**Experience Level**
Junior Executive (3 to 4 years' experience) and Mid-level Executive (4 to 7 years' experience)

**Qualifications and Skills**

* Strong knowledge of US Business Tax Returns (1065, 1120 and 1120S) and Financial Statements preparation.
* Excellent Analytical Skills, including the ability to interpret complex tax rules and analyze financial data.
* Excellent verbal communication and client interaction skills.
* Proven experience working with and managing US stakeholders/customers.
* Ability to explain tax concepts clearly and provide effective support in a client-facing environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field; CPA, EA, or progress towards a certification is preferred.
* Proficiency with tax preparation software and Microsoft Excel; familiarity with accounting systems is a plus.
* Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in a remote environment.

**Job Description**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Risk Consulting – MENA FS Risk – Credit Risk - Senior Consultant**
**Divisional Overview**
EY GDS Risk Consulting is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge.
  
  
EY’s MENA Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) team, part of the EY GDS Risk Consulting Practice, delivers tailored risk solutions to help clients identify, assess, manage, and monitor a range of financial and regulatory risks. These include market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks arising from trading, asset-liability management, capital management, and broader capital markets activities. The division is ideal for collaborative individuals who have strong ethics and attention to detail.
  
  
Within FSRM, the Credit Risk (CR) team focuses on supporting clients—ranging from large domestic banks to global financial institutions—in implementing strategic, functional, and regulatory transformations across credit risk management within their banking book portfolios.
  
  
You will work within different sized, multi-disciplinary teams and play a key role in ensuring high quality outputs and service to our clients. The role involves developing knowledge and implementing new solutions to meet the ever-changing needs of our clients. We value intellectual curiosity and a passion for promoting solutions across organizational boundaries.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Demonstrate deep technical expertise and industry knowledge, particularly in financial products with a focus on lending solutions.
* Design, assessment, and benchmarking of financial risk management policies, frameworks, methodologies covering a range of risk domains such as credit risk, market risk, operational risk, liquidity risk, climate risk, and integrated risk topics viz., capital adequacy and stress testing measurement methodologies in financial institutions (FI)
* Monitor project progress, manage risks, and effectively communicate status, issues, and priorities to key stakeholders to ensure successful outcomes.
* Actively mentor and support the development of junior consultants within the organization.
* Review, analyze, and validate the work completed by junior team members to ensure accuracy and quality
* Adapt to projects involving model audits, validation, and development, demonstrating flexibility and domain knowledge

**Qualifications, Certifications, And Education**
**Must-have:**

* Graduate or Master’s degree in a technical or quantitative discipline such as Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or equivalent with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience
* Solid foundation in statistics and econometrics.
* In-depth knowledge of Credit risk model development, validation, audit and/or implementation of the banking book portfolio
* Advanced technical skills, with proficiency in Python, SAS, SQL, R, and Excel.
* Hands-on experience in data preparation, manipulation, and consolidation.
* Strong documentation skills, with the ability to quickly grasp complex concepts and present them clearly in documents or presentations.
* Strong multi-tasking skills with demonstrated ability to manage expectations and deliver high quality results under tight deadlines and minimal supervision.

**Preferred:**

* Professional certifications such as FRM, CFA, PRM, or SCR.
* Knowledge of regulatory modeling (BASEL, CCAR, IFRS9) is preferred
* Exposure to regulatory stress testing processes around credit risk & ICAAP
* Exposure to Interest Rate Risk in Banking Book (IRRBB)
* Experience in data/business intelligence (BI) reporting.
* Familiarity with machine learning models and their practical applications.
* Willingness to travel for client engagements

**What Working At EY Offers**
As a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction, and consulting services, we’re using the finance products, expertise and systems we’ve developed to build a better working world. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities, and creative freedom to make things better.
  
  
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from startups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career.
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
