**Your Key Responsibilities**
**SAP SAC Planning – Implementation & Delivery**

* A minimum of 1-3 years of experience in SAP Analytics Cloud Planning solutions.
* Lead end-to-end implementation of SAP Analytics Cloud Planning solutions, including requirement gathering, solution design, build, testing, deployment, and support.
* Design and build SAC Planning Models and Dimensions, including public and private dimensions with attributes and hierarchies.
* Develop Data Actions, Multi-Actions, and Allocation processes to support driver-based planning and automation.
* Configure planning workflows, version management, and data locking to enable governed planning cycles.
* Design and develop SAC Stories, Unified Stories, and Digital Boardrooms for executive and operational reporting.
* Build Optimized stories with advanced scripting to support complex planning and analysis use cases.
* Expertise in SAC security configuration.

**SAP Datasphere/HANA Modelling**

* Leverage 2–3 years of hands-on SAP HANA Modelling experience or Datasphere and SAP BW experience in implementation.
* Design and develop SAP HANA Calculation Views to support SAC Planning and Reporting use cases.
* Perform data modelling, transformations, and performance optimization in SAP Datasphere.
* Collaborate with SAC planning teams to ensure optimal data structures and model performance.

**Soft Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey ideas in both technical and business‑friendly language
* Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills
* Highly process‑oriented with a structured approach to solution design
* Ability to work independently and lead complex engagements
* Strong documentation and knowledge‑sharing mindset

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Experience in BW
* Good understanding on SAP BDC, Datasphere Seamless planning and SAP Joule and AI.

**What We Look For**

* Experience working on large‑scale finance transformation or planning initiatives
* Exposure to competitor EPM tools is a plus
* Ability to mentor junior consultants and contribute to capability building
* Expertise in delivering the process definition document post workshops. Preparing the system design document by mapping client requirements. Capable to work with the team on sprint planning for the delivery.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

title: Electrical Engineer
description:
KITCO is a multi-disciplinary Engineering, Management and Technical consulting firm that brings innovative solutions to the challenges faced by your business. A strong planning and engineering department enables KITCO to offer consultancy service under one roof from concept to commissioning.

The Electrical Engineer (MEP) will be responsible for overseeing the execution, coordination, supervision, and integration of electrical systems within multidisciplinary MEP projects. The role requires extensive experience in coordinating electrical works with mechanical, HVAC, plumbing, fire protection, ELV, and building management systems to ensure seamless project delivery. The engineer will ensure that all installations comply with approved drawings, technical specifications, project requirements, and applicable codes and standards while maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, and operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Review and evaluate electrical, mechanical, plumbing, fire protection, HVAC, ELV, and other MEP drawings, specifications, and contract documents to ensure coordinated execution.
* Supervise and monitor installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical systems, including power distribution, lighting, earthing, lightning protection, transformers, UPS systems, DG sets, fire alarm systems, ELV systems, BMS, and associated MEP services.
* Ensure all MEP works are executed in accordance with approved drawings, project specifications, applicable standards, and client requirements.
* Coordinate electrical installations with HVAC, plumbing, firefighting, civil, architectural, and structural disciplines to resolve interface issues and prevent clashes during construction.
* Conduct regular site inspections and provide technical guidance to contractors, and site teams to ensure compliance with quality and safety requirements.
* Monitor contractor performance, manpower deployment, work progress, and productivity to ensure project milestones and schedules are achieved.
* Participate in multidisciplinary coordination meetings with clients, contractors, and stakeholders to address technical and construction-related matters.
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and quality management systems throughout project execution.
* Support the implementation of value engineering initiatives and provide practical engineering solutions to site challenges.
* Maintain and review project documentation, including progress reports, inspection records, testing and commissioning reports, NCRs, snag lists, and handover documentation.
* Assist in troubleshooting and resolving technical issues related to integrated MEP systems.
* Support final inspections, integrated systems testing, commissioning activities, snag rectification, and project handover to the client.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering.
* 6–10 years of experience in the execution, supervision, or management of integrated MEP projects within commercial, institutional, healthcare, hospitality, airport, industrial, or large-scale infrastructure developments.
* Strong experience in coordinating electrical systems with HVAC, plumbing, firefighting, ELV, BMS, and other building services.
* Sound knowledge of electrical distribution systems, building services engineering, and multidisciplinary MEP coordination.
* Familiarity with applicable codes and standards such as IS, IEC, NFPA, NBC, ASHRAE, and other relevant regulations.
* Experience in construction supervision, project management consultancy (PMC), engineering consultancy, or contractor environments.
* Proficiency in reviewing engineering drawings, specifications, shop drawings, and technical documentation.
* Working knowledge of BIM/Revit-based MEP coordination will be an added advantage.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and interdisciplinary coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple activities simultaneously while meeting project deadlines.
* Demonstrated commitment to safety, quality, and client satisfaction.

title: Project Engineer
description:
We are looking for a skilled and reliable Home Automation PROJECT ENGINEER to join our team. This role involves supervising installation, configuration, and troubleshooting of smart home systems, including home automation, security, lighting, climate control, and audio/video solutions. The ideal candidate will have a passion for technology, strong problem-solving skills, and the ability to work effectively in residential environments.
  
  
Required Skills and Qualifications:
  
  
\* Proven experience as a PROJECT ENGINEER or in a similar role.
  
\* Strong technical knowledge of home automation systems, smart devices, and integration.
  
\* Proficient in low-voltage wiring, networking, and troubleshooting electronics.
  
\* Familiarity with industry-standard platforms (e.g., Google Home, Amazon Alexa, Apple Home Kit, etc.).
  
\* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  
\* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain complex systems to clients.
  
\* Customer service-oriented with a professional and positive attitude.

title: Growth Strategy & Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for a
**Growth Strategy & Analyst**
to drive data-backed growth initiatives for CoFee, our in-house SaaS product that simplifies fee collection and financial management for businesses.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of
**product, marketing, sales, and business strategy**
. You will analyse the end-to-end growth funnel, identify opportunities for optimisation, and translate data into actionable strategies that improve customer acquisition, conversion, retention, and revenue growth.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  

* Analyse the complete customer growth funnel, from lead generation and acquisition to conversion, product adoption, and retention.
* Evaluate marketing campaign performance, acquisition channels, customer acquisition costs, and ROI to identify optimisation opportunities.
* Analyse sales pipelines, conversion rates, and funnel drop-offs to identify bottlenecks and recommend improvements.
* Track product usage, customer behaviour, and engagement metrics to identify opportunities for improving adoption and retention.
* Develop data-driven growth strategies to improve customer acquisition, sales effectiveness, and overall business performance.
* Build dashboards, monitor key business KPIs, and provide actionable insights to support decision-making.
* Collaborate with marketing, sales, product, and leadership teams to implement growth initiatives and measure their impact.
* Identify market trends, customer segments, and new growth opportunities to support business expansion.

What We Are Looking For
  
  

* 3–5 years of experience in Growth Analytics, Growth Strategy, Business Analytics, Revenue Operations, or related roles.
* Strong understanding of marketing analytics, sales funnels, customer acquisition, and conversion optimisation.
* Experience analysing business performance and translating insights into actionable growth strategies.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and working knowledge of SQL and data visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio.
* Familiarity with growth metrics such as CAC, LTV, conversion rates, retention, churn, and ROI.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and business acumen.
* Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams and communicate insights effectively.

**Good to Have**

* Experience working with B2B SaaS products or technology-driven businesses.
* Familiarity with CRM and product analytics tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Google Analytics, Mixpanel, or Amplitude.
* Experience with growth experiments, funnel optimisation, and go-to-market strategies.

title: Architect
description:
**Company Description**
WeArch Developers is a multidisciplinary architecture and turnkey construction firm that focuses on creating spaces that shape how people live, work, and experience their environment. Headquartered in Kochi, Kerala, the firm brings together architects, designers, and engineers to deliver thoughtful, sustainable, and carefully crafted projects. With studios across Kerala and a growing presence in the UAE, WeArch Developers offers opportunities to work on diverse and high-impact assignments. The team is committed to architectural excellence, precise execution, and building lasting client relationships. Professionals joining WeArch Developers can contribute to a legacy of iconic spaces and meaningful design.
  
**Role Description**
The Architect role is a full-time, on-site position based in Kochi. The Architect will be responsible for developing architectural concepts, preparing detailed drawings, and translating client requirements into functional and aesthetic designs. Day-to-day tasks include collaborating with cross-functional teams, coordinating with consultants and contractors, and overseeing design implementation through various project phases. The role involves managing project timelines, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and sustainability practices, and participating in site visits and inspections to monitor construction progress and quality. **Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Architecture and Architectural Design, including concept development, space planning, and technical detailing.

title: GRC-SAP-PC-ITAC-Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Role Description:**
As part of our EY GRC Tech team you’ll contribute technically to IT Risk and SAP S4 transformation client engagements An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for Ernst & Young within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate. Similarly, you’ll anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Manager to join the group of our EY GDS GRC Tech Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of a new service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Interacts with business stakeholders to gather, understand, document, and analyse business requirements.
* Analyse reports and assessments to provide insights on whether a solution/technology being implemented is meeting business requirements.
* Evaluates business models, processes, and operations to develop a good understanding of business needs and requirements.
* Perform control testing for both ITAC & ITGC as per the client scope and requirement.
* Work effectively as a team member, share responsibility, provide support, maintain communication and update senior team members on progress of tasks.
* Conduct research and assist senior team members in preparing client presentations and information memorandums.
* Continuously strive towards exceeding client & team expectations and work on increasingly complex assignments
* Develop and maintain productive working relationships with client/onsite personnel.
* Ensuring adherence to quality protocols specified for the project

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Candidate will have minimum 8 – 12 years of experience in SAP IT Audit with knowledge of IT governance practices.
* Lead SAP Risk and Controls projects, ensuring high-quality delivery and client satisfaction.
* Should have completed at least 5-6 Risk & Control engagements covering pre-& post implementation reviews, assessments, control design and testing for SAP ECC and/or S4 HANA landscape.
* Perform SAP audits, focusing on system integrity and data accuracy.
* Design and assess SAP S4 controls, identifying gaps and recommending improvements.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate risk and control considerations into broader project objectives.

**Qualifications:**

* Good understanding of the COSO framework, Sarbanes-Oxley Act (Sections 302 and 404), GDPR etc
* Strong experience in performing test of design and effectiveness for internal controls related to SOD, ITAC, ITDM, ICFR and IFRS along with the ability to suggest best practice recommendations.

* Excellent project management and leadership skills.
* Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing.

* Experience in leading implementation / Risk and Controls engagements for various clients
* Experience in drafting proposals, RFP , pursuits, innovations etc.
* Strong communication, presentation and team building skills and experience in producing high quality reports, papers, and presentations.
* Owns the relationship with senior business stakeholders to fully understand complex business / functional requirements and strategies and oversees the translation of these into complex technical requirements and specifications, guiding senior management towards accepting change brought about through process and organizational change.
* Establishes the contribution that technology can make to business objectives, defining strategies, validating and justifying business needs, conducting feasibility studies, producing high-level and detailed business models and overseeing the development and implementation of solutions, taking into account the implications of change on the organisation and all stakeholders.
* Should possess the ability to conduct and drive workshops with the client stakeholders on understanding client’s process & system landscape
* Work effectively as a team member and drive the delivery of IT audit documents independently
* Demonstrate sound technical understanding of IT Audits (ITGC & ITACs) for SAP environment.
* Knowledge of the COSO framework, Sarbanes-Oxley Act (Sections 302 and 404) etc
* Inculcate positive learning attitude and the zeal to upskill as well as cross-skill.
* Understand and follow workplace policies and procedures.
* Participating in the organization-wide people initiatives
* Maintain an educational program to continuously upskill.
* Foster teamwork, quality culture and lead by example while training and mentoring juniors
* Inculcate positive learning culture and support learning agenda for self and team

**Technologies & Tools:**

* SAP Functional Knowledge
* Knowledge on Business Processes
* SAP ECC & S4 HANA
* MS Office Tools
* Risk and Compliance

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Brief knowledge of analytical tools and software to support data analysis and visualization engagements
* Brief understanding of tools like Power BI, Blue Prism or UI Path, SAC dashboarding etc., as well as RPA transformation approach

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees, and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
**Job Description – Senior Project Manager (Civil)**
====================================================

**Department:** Projects / Construction  
**Designation:** Senior Project Manager – Civil  
**Industry:** Civil Construction / Infrastructure / Real Estate  
**Experience:** 15+ Years  
**Qualification:** B.E / B.Tech in Civil Engineering  
**Reporting To:** Vice President – Projects / Management  
**Location:** Project Sites / Head Office

### **Job Summary**

The Senior Project Manager – Civil will be responsible for overseeing and managing multiple construction projects from project initiation to completion. The role involves strategic project planning, execution, resource allocation, budget control, quality assurance, safety compliance and timely project delivery. The candidate must possess strong leadership, technical expertise and project management capabilities to ensure projects are completed within approved budgets, timelines and quality standards.

### **Key Responsibilities**

1. **Project Planning & Execution**

* Develop comprehensive project execution plans, schedules and strategies to ensure timely completion of projects.
* Oversee the execution of multiple civil construction projects, ensuring adherence to approved drawings, specifications and contractual requirements.
* Establish project milestones, monitor progress and implement corrective measures to avoid delays.
* Coordinate with Project Managers, Construction Managers, Site Engineers and other project teams.

2. **Project Monitoring & Control**

* Monitor overall project progress against approved schedules, budgets and targets.
* Review daily, weekly and monthly project progress reports and identify potential delays.
* Conduct regular site visits to assess project performance and ensure proper execution.
* Implement effective project monitoring systems to track productivity and resource utilisation.

3. **Budgeting & Cost Control**

* Prepare and monitor project budgets, cash flow requirements and cost forecasts.
* Control project expenditure and ensure optimum utilisation of materials, manpower, machinery and equipment.
* Review BOQs, cost estimates, subcontractor bills and variation claims.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising quality and safety.

4. **Team Management & Leadership**

* Lead, guide and motivate Project Managers, Engineers, Supervisors and other project personnel.
* Allocate responsibilities and establish performance targets for project teams.
* Monitor team performance and ensure accountability at all project levels.
* Resolve operational challenges and provide technical and managerial guidance.

5. **Quality Assurance & Compliance**

* Ensure construction activities comply with approved drawings, specifications, IS codes and quality standards.
* Coordinate with the QA/QC department to implement quality control procedures.
* Monitor inspection activities and ensure timely closure of quality observations and non-conformities.
* Ensure proper documentation of quality records and project reports.

6. **Safety & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure strict implementation of occupational health and safety standards across project sites.
* Coordinate with the Safety Department to minimise workplace accidents and unsafe practices.
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory regulations and contractual obligations.
* Conduct periodic safety reviews and ensure timely corrective actions.

7. **Client & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Maintain effective relationships with clients, consultants, architects, contractors and government authorities.
* Attend project review meetings and provide regular updates on project progress.
* Address client concerns, technical issues and project-related escalations.
* Ensure timely approvals for drawings, materials, technical submissions and project variations.

8. **Contract & Subcontractor Management**

* Review contractual obligations, project specifications and scope of work.
* Coordinate with procurement and commercial teams for material procurement and subcontractor management.
* Monitor subcontractor performance, work quality and adherence to project schedules.
* Review claims, variations, extra works and contractual issues in coordination with the commercial team.

9. **Procurement & Resource Management**

* Ensure timely availability of construction materials, equipment and manpower.
* Coordinate with the Purchase and Stores Departments to avoid material shortages and project interruptions.
* Monitor material consumption, wastage and inventory control.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of construction machinery and resources.

10. **Reporting & Documentation**

* Submit periodic project status reports, progress updates and performance reports to management.
* Review project documentation, work schedules, material requirements and manpower planning.
* Escalate critical project issues and recommend appropriate solutions.
* Ensure proper project handover, completion certificates and closure documentation.

title: Scrum Master
description:
**Company Description**
At ContiTech, we are building a world-class Business Hub in Bangalore that supports global business functions and enables excellence across finance, technology, and corporate services.
  
  
The Digital & Data Enablement Solutions team supports ContiTech’s business units by developing web, mobile, IoT, data, and AI-enabled products that advance digital transformation
  
  
We are seeking a Scrum Master who is passionate about Agile delivery and interested in applying AI to improve team effectiveness, product development, and decision-making. This is a mid-level role for someone who can independently facilitate Scrum teams, remove impediments, coach team members, and promote continuous improvement.
  
  
The successful candidate should understand AI concepts and tools well enough to identify practical opportunities, encourage responsible experimentation, and help teams integrate AI into their ways of working. Deep AI engineering expertise is not required.
  
  
Do you want to be the chosen one?
  
  
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Facilitate Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, Retrospective, and backlog-refinement sessions.
* Coach the team in Scrum principles, self-organization, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Work with Product Owners to maintain healthy backlogs, clear priorities, and actionable user stories.
* Identify and remove impediments while escalating organizational blockers when necessary.
* Track and communicate delivery health through relevant metrics such as velocity trends, predictability, cycle time, and quality.
* Ensure the team follows the Definition of Ready, Definition of Done, and agreed delivery practices.
* Promote the practical use of AI tools for planning, analysis, documentation, knowledge discovery, testing, and process improvement.
* Help the team identify suitable AI use cases and conduct small, measurable experiments.
* Encourage critical evaluation of AI-generated outputs for accuracy, bias, privacy, security, and business relevance.
* Ensure AI tools are used in accordance with organizational policies and responsible-AI principles.
* Foster psychological safety, transparency, collaboration, and a learning mindset.
* Collaborate with other Scrum Masters, delivery leads, technical teams, and internal and external stakeholders.
* Facilitate Agile delivery and coach teams towards self-management while maintaining transparency on progress, risks and dependencies.
* Coordinate cross-team dependencies and escalate organizational impediments with clear ownership and follow-up.
* Support release planning and readiness discussions with Product Owners and engineering leads.

**Qualifications**
**Requirements**
**Agile and Scrum**

* Sound knowledge of Scrum and familiarity with other Agile approaches, such as Kanban.
* Experience facilitating Scrum events and coaching cross-functional teams.
* Good understanding of user stories, estimation, backlog refinement, story splitting, velocity, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Familiarity with software product-development lifecycles and quality practices.
* Experience using tools such as Jira and Confluence.
* Ability to interpret delivery metrics and convert insights into improvement actions.

**AI Skills And Mindset**

* Working knowledge of generative AI, machine learning, prompt design, and common AI-assisted workflows.
* Practical experience using approved AI tools to improve productivity, analysis, documentation, or team processes.
* Ability to distinguish appropriate AI use cases from tasks requiring human judgment.
* Awareness of AI limitations, including hallucinations, bias, data privacy, intellectual property, security, and explainability.
* Curiosity and willingness to learn, experiment, and share AI-enabled practices.
* Ability to help teams frame problems and evaluate AI use cases based on value, feasibility, risk, and measurable outcomes.
* AI or cloud certification is desirable but not mandatory.

**Experience And Education**

* Approximately 5–8 years of overall IT or digital-product experience.
* At least 2–4 years of experience as a Scrum Master or Agile practitioner.
* Prior experience in software development, quality assurance, business analysis, product delivery, or a related discipline is desirable.
* Experience supporting web, mobile, cloud, data, IoT, or AI-enabled products is preferred.
* Bachelor’s degree in technology, engineering, business, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience.
* Scrum Master certification such as PSM or CSM is preferred

**Additional Information**

* Strong facilitation, communication, coaching, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Effective problem-solving and conflict-resolution abilities.
* Ability to influence without formal authority.
* Analytical thinking and a data-informed approach to decision-making.
* A collaborative, outcome-focused, and learning-oriented attitude.

* Deliver the executive view of execution and delivery health on a predictable cadence

* Channel customer ideas and community input into roadmap decisions

* Fluency with AI tools in day-to-day work - you use LLMs and AI assistants to accelerate analysis, reporting and synthesis, with the judgment to recognise when the output is wrong

title: Scrum Master, IT
description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.
  
  
We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Scrum Master - IT supports Agile delivery for the Finance Product Team by facilitating Agile ceremonies, enabling effective planning and prioritization, improving delivery transparency, and helping the team deliver predictable business value. The role partners closely with the Product Owners, Finance stakeholders, delivery teams, and leadership to improve backlog health, manage dependencies, remove impediments, and foster continuous improvement while supporting established Agile ways of working
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Facilitate Agile delivery for one IT product team, with flexibility to support additional teams as business needs evolve.
* Facilitate team ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews, demos, and retrospectives.
* Use Scrum, Kanban, and applicable SAFe practices to help the team plan work, manage flow, and deliver against agreed priorities.
* Partner with Product Owners, Finance stakeholders, delivery leaders, and team members to maintain backlog health, clarity, support sprint goals, align delivery with business objectives
* Support work intake, prioritization, and capacity planning processes to ensure work is aligned to business priorities, operational commitments, and team capacity.
* Identify, track, and help remove team impediments, escalating risks, dependencies, or decisions when support is needed.
* Facilitate management of cross-functional dependencies, risks, and decisions that may impact delivery commitments or planned business outcomes.
* Maintain visibility into team progress, blockers, sprint health, and delivery metrics to support transparent communication and timely decisions.
* Monitor delivery performance using metrics such as sprint commitment reliability, velocity trends, throughput, carryover, cycle time, and dependency management to drive continuous improvement.
* Support release readiness by coordinating team inputs, tracking dependencies, managing risks, and following established delivery and governance practices.
* Coach the team on Agile principles, Scrum practices, accountability, self-organization, and continuous improvement while promoting collaboration and transparency.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, team engagement, and psychological safety through effective facilitation and constructive feedback practices.
* undefined

**Required Qualifications**

* Working knowledge of Scrum, Kanban, and Agile delivery practices, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, burndown tracking, and managing unplanned work.
* Ability to facilitate team discussions, resolve day-to-day delivery challenges, and support alignment across Product Owners, Delivery Managers, technical teams, and business stakeholders.
* Ability to communicate delivery status, risks, dependencies, and key metrics effectively to technical teams, Finance stakeholders, and leadership audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to support sprint execution, remove blockers, and improve delivery predictability over time.
* Strong organization, follow-through, attention to detail, and commitment to quality in team communication, documentation, and delivery practices.
* Collaborative, practical, and continuous improvement-oriented, with the ability to build trust and promote transparency within the team.
* Experience facilitating prioritization discussions and balancing competing business demands.
* Strong understanding of Agile metrics such as velocity, burndown, throughput, cycle time, carryover, and delivery predictability.
* Experience supporting backlog management, acceptance criteria refinement, and sprint readiness activities.
* Ability to influence without authority and build strong relationships across product, business, and technology teams.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile delivery facilitator, or similar role supporting business and technology product teams.
* Experience using Agile planning and delivery tools, such as ServiceNow, Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* First-level Scrum Master certification, such as CSM or PSM I, and/or SAFe Practitioner certification is strongly preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting technology delivery in a regulated industry.
* Familiarity with medical device, healthcare, or other regulated delivery environments.
* Experience supporting Finance, Corporate Functions, ERP, Workday, SAP, Oracle, or financial process transformation initiatives.
* Experience working with governance, compliance, audit, financial controls, or regulatory requirements.
* Experience supporting Agile transformation or product team maturity initiatives.

**Job Description**
Role Overview
  
  
We're looking for a strategic, highly structured Lead Product Designer / Design Manager to head the design for our Payment Gateway and Web Platforms pod. **Qualifications**

* 7–10 years of product design experience, with real ownership of complex enterprise, B2B, or fintech platforms.
* 1–2 years managing and scaling direct reports — you've grown designers, not just reviewed their work.

* Strong communication: You write clear UX copy, make a tight case for a direction, and give direct, useful feedback. You manage stakeholders without losing the user's point of view.

title: Staff UX Researcher, Mixed Methods
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in an applied research setting, or similar.
* 8 years of experience planning, conducting, and synthesizing user research for consumer-facing digital products in industry.
* Experience in leading end-to-end UX research strategy across both qualitative (ethnography, deep interviews, usability testing) and quantitative (surveys, behavioral analytics, telemetry collaboration) methodologies.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Human-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Science, Statistics, Psychology, Anthropology, or a related field.
* 10 years of user research experience, with 3 years of experience in a staff-level lead role within a global technology company.
* Experience leading field studies for Next Billion Users (NBU) and emerging markets, collaborating across global design and research teams in the US, Europe, and India.
* Expertise in conversational AI interfaces, location-based services, maps, navigation, and growth.
* Strong executive communication skills, with experience translating complex user behaviors into clear narratives that drive strategic impact and influence cross-functional product leadership.

**About The Job**
At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." As a User Experience Researcher (UXR), you make this possible. You will join our multi-disciplinary UX team, collaborating with Engineering and Product Management, to gather insights and create industry-leading products.
  
  
You’ll play a critical role in helping your team understand user needs and will drive impact at all stages of product development, ensuring products are useful, usable, and helpful. You will explore user behaviors and motivations by conducting primary research, including: field studies, interviews, diary studies, ethnography, surveys, usability testing, and logs analysis. You will also grow within a supportive UXR community offering mentorship, regular meetups, and exclusive internal tools.
  
  
Geo's mission is to help people explore and navigate the real world wherever they are. We want to make real-world exploration and navigation seamless, intelligent, and universally accessible to all users across every hardware tier and network condition globally. At Google Maps' scale of 2B+ monthly active users, even fractional improvements in funnel conversion, latency, or feature discoverability generate massive, world-scale impact.
  
  
The overall of Geo's "Strategic Markets & NIU" team is to drastically grow usage of Google Maps and other geospatial products across strategic emerging markets and amongst Novice Internet Users (NIU).
  
  
The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.
  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the Google Maps research outlook and roadmap by partnering with UX, Product, Engineering, and executive leaders to align user needs with business goals and translate insights into actionable product strategy, specs, and design frameworks.
* Pair quantitative and qualitative research methods to achieve the research goal and product advancement. Quant research to include stand-alone and in-product surveys, metrics development, etc.
* Explore and embrace AI tools to take our user research processes to the next level, to create efficiencies, innovate processes, and expand the impact of the UX Researcher role.
* Drive AI conversational evaluations and hyper-local field research across India and surrounding regions to optimize low-connectivity transit experiences and fuel sustainable Android user growth for Google Maps.

title: Head - Voice of Customer
description:
At Swish, we want to build a strong understanding of what customers want, what they love, and what makes them unhappy — and use that understanding to continuously improve the food and experience we offer.

We are looking for a Head – Voice of Customer to build this function from the ground up.

You will own Swish's Voice of Customer program end-to-end — from understanding what customers want before we launch a product, to capturing feedback after launch, identifying recurring problems, and working with Category, Culinary, Operations and Quality teams to fix them.

**What You Will Own**

**Build Swish's Voice of Customer Engine**

Design and run an always-on customer feedback system across the customer journey, covering pre-launch research, new product feedback, negative-rating triage, customer immersions, interviews, targeted outreach and surprise audits. Decide what we need to learn, from whom, how frequently and through which channel, using the right mix of qualitative and quantitative research.

**Turn Feedback Into Action**

Go beyond collecting feedback to identify the actual problem, understand its root cause and determine whether it is a one-off, product or category-level issue. Work closely with Category, Culinary, Operations and Quality teams to turn customer feedback → root cause → action → measurable improvement. The role will be measured on issues resolved and outcomes improved, not the number of calls or insights generated.

**Prioritise Research & Drive Decisions**

Build the framework to determine which categories and SKUs need deeper research, when to trigger audits, when patterns need escalation and where the VoC team's time and resources should be invested. Bring customer evidence into decisions around new launches, recipe changes, relaunches, taste, quality, portioning, pricing, packaging and assortment.

**Build & Lead the VoC Team**

Hire, coach and manage the initial VoC team, set clear goals and operating cadences, and build strong capabilities in customer conversations, probing, research and root-cause identification. Create a team that is accountable for outcomes rather than activity.

**Continuously Improve the System**

Own and improve the questionnaires, interview frameworks, sampling, feedback channels, tracking, reporting, escalation mechanisms and research methodology as the business grows.

**What We're Looking For**

* 8+ years of overall experience, with 3–4+ years of people management experience.
* Experience building and running customer research, insights or CX programs in-house, rather than only managing external agencies.
* Experience in consumer internet, food-tech, FMCG or another high-frequency consumer business.
* Experience running customer research or feedback programs at operational scale — not just occasional market research projects.
* Someone who has owned a business/customer metric end-to-end, rather than only producing reports or insights for another team.
* Experience working closely with Operations, Category/Product, Quality and other cross-functional teams to drive changes based on customer feedback.

**We Particularly Value**

* Someone who has built a function from scratch — team, processes, tools and operating cadence.
* Experience with both qualitative and quantitative research.
* Strong understanding of customer interviews, surveys, ratings/reviews and customer feedback analysis.
* Experience managing calling or field teams and understanding operational metrics such as connect rates, response rates, call fatigue and script adherence.
* Experience in food, FMCG, QSR or other categories where taste, freshness, quality, portioning and value directly influence customer satisfaction.

**What Good Looks Like**

**In the first 6–12 months, you should have:**

* Built a functioning VoC team and operating cadence.
* Created a reliable system to capture and prioritise customer feedback.
* Established clear feedback loops across categories and products.
* Identified recurring customer problems and driven them to resolution.
* Built a strong mechanism for feeding customer insights into launches, product changes and category decisions.
* Demonstrated measurable improvement in relevant customer metrics such as ratings, complaints, repeat issues or product-level satisfaction.

**SEO, AEO, GEO & Search Strategy:**
strong fundamentals in keyword research, technical SEO, on-page optimization, and hands-on understanding of AI answer engine optimization and discoverability.

comfortable managing content calendars, directing teams/freelancers/agencies, coordinating with internal experts, and managing budgets with cost-efficiency in mind.

**Analytics & Market Intelligence:**
strong at tracking content performance (traffic, engagement, video views, search visibility), understanding competitive trends, and measuring ROI across content formats.

Your work is critical and sits at the crossroads as Yubi moves into a new chapter of scale and visibility — how the company shows up in search, AI answer engines, and through authoritative content carries real weight and large visibility. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:
  
  
At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented marketer to head branded content and education for PhonePe. As the Head you will be the brand champion of PhonePe’s content channels across social media platforms (Youtube, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms), responsible for shaping and executing strategies that drive brand awareness, customer acquisition, and overall business growth.
  
  
This is a high-impact role that requires a blend of strategic thinking, P&L understanding, creative flair, and analytical prowess to build and scale PhonePe’s content playbook. You will work cross-functionally, collaborating with teams across Product, Business, Finance, Analytics, and Marketing to achieve shared goals.
  
  
**Core Competencies**
**Craft & Taste Supremacy**
: You possess an uncompromising eye for design, copy, storytelling, and brand nuance. You know the difference between a high-converting, humanly crafted campaign and generic noise. You have the experience of running long form content strategy and channels on Youtube.
  
  
**Thoughtful Tool Integration**
: You embrace modern creative technology and AI, but you evaluate tools through the lens of human enablement. You champion productivity and efficiency through automation, without compromising the creative soul of the content.
  
  
**High Execution Rigour & Governance**
: You establish rigorous editorial and operational standards, brand content guardrails, and human-in-the loop review processes to ensure every piece of work meets the highest standards of brand safety and quality.
  
  
**Executive Influence:**
You confidently articulate content strategy to senior leadership. You frame creative and content choices around business impact, brand equity, and emotional connection rather than vanity metrics or technological trends.
  
  
**Culture & Mentorship:**
You mentor brand marketers, social media teams and creative talent both inhouse and external, to elevate the story-telling craft. You build a collaborative culture where human curiosity and creative experimentation thrive alongside operational speed and business impact.
  
  
**Cultural Relevance & Trend intelligence:**
You have a deep connection to Indian consumer behavior. You spot subtle cultural shifts and turn them into brand campaigns that genuinely connect with our diverse user base. You have strong experience in enabling rapid-response and real-time content workflows that keep the brand embedded in daily national and regional conversations.
  
  
**Content Distribution:**
You have a deep understanding and experience of partnering with or working on media planning and distribution from your past experience.
  
  
**What You Will Own**
**Story-telling on Social Media Platforms:**
You will define and maintain the overarching content and narrative standards across PhonePe’s social media platforms. Establish clear guidelines for human editorial oversight, brand safety, and content quality, ensuring that the content and its distribution is able to meet business objectives.
  
  
You will translate complex financial and consumer tech products into clear, emotionally compelling brand campaigns. Present creative strategies, campaign concepts, and brand performance updates to executive leadership.
  
  
**Business Impact through Content:**
You will define the impact of our content on the business P&L and long term brand building. You will build and deliver on annual operating plans working closely with Business and finance teams.
  
  
**Team Leadership & Craft Mentorship:**
You will lead, mentor, and grow a team of social media, content and brand marketers. You will foster a culture of craft excellence, encouraging the team and agencies to push creative boundaries on content creation and distribution while maintaining strategic discipline.
  
  
**Campaign Execution & Performance Balance**
You will oversee key brand launches and high-stakes campaigns to ensure speed does not compromise quality.
  
  
You will collaborate seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Brand teams to protect brand integrity while meeting aggressive timeline demands.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Creative Mastery & Craft**
Deep experience in brand storytelling, content strategy or creation, high stakes execution at scale. across multi-channel environments (digital, visual, social, video).
  
  
A strong, proven portfolio that reflects deep attention to detail, diversity, narratives and formats. Clear editorial judgment with a track record of upholding brand integrity against low-quality, generic asset production.
  
  
**Understanding of YouTube as the growth engine**
Deep experience and understanding of building YouTube playbook: formats, series, packaging (titles, thumbnails, hooks), retention, search and discovery, and the long-form and Shorts mix.
  
  
Understand how to grow subscribers, watch time and return viewership through programming, not one-off campaigns, that leads to business growth.
  
  
Build YouTube capability across your team and agencies.
  
  
**Marketing Domain & Leadership Depth**
10 to 12 or more years of experience in creative leadership, brand strategy, or advertising agencies / high-growth consumer brands.
  
  
Proven track record of managing and mentoring teams of marketers, or creative strategists.
  
  
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to articulate creative decisions clearly to business leaders and technical teams.
  
  
Experience in fintech, e-commerce, or high-growth consumer tech is highly preferred.
  
  
**Mindset to Succeed**
You believe that Brand marketing leads to revenue growth and enjoy it!
  
  
**Craft Ownership:**
You take personal pride in the visual and narrative quality of everything PhonePe puts into the market. You reject mediocrity and generic content.
  
  
**Human-First Technology Approach:**
You view new tools and automation as a way to elevate human talent, save time on repetitive tasks, and unlock deeper creative potential.
  
  
**Systems Thinking:**
You build repeatable frameworks, review mechanisms, and workflows that help large teams scale quality output consistently.
  
  
**Adaptability & Judgment:**
You make sound creative choices in fast-moving environments, knowing when to move fast and when to pause for craft refinement.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 10 to 12 or more years in creative direction, brand marketing, or digital advertising, with at least 2 to 3 years leading brand or creative teams.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional craft alongside business impact.
* Demonstrated experience establishing brand content guardrails and quality review systems across large teams (50+ to 100+ marketers).
* A strong builder’s mindset with experience in high-growth consumer technology or fintech.

**Why This Role Matters**
In an era where digital noise and automated content are everywhere, genuine creative craft and human strategy stand out more than ever. PhonePe believes that blending human creative vision, authentic story-telling with modern tools and platforms provides a true competitive advantage. The Head of Branded Content and Education will ensure our brand remains distinct, emotionally resonant, always present and visually exceptional while empowering our marketing team to work with unmatched speed and focus.
  
  
**Additional Information**

title: Digital Content Experience Analyst
description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss & Co., you can be yourself — and be part of something bigger. We’re a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit — and your future.
  
  
**Summary Of The Role**
The Digital Content Experience Analyst is responsible for the quality, consistency and commercial effectiveness of content on Levi.com across East Asia Pacific. The role leads content strategy and experience design for the site, including the homepage, landing pages, product detail pages and campaign content, so that every market delivers accurate, localised and compelling brand storytelling that attracts, engages and converts consumers.
  
  
Working from the Global Talent Hub in India, the role acts as the content partner to country eCommerce teams. It translates campaign plans, product launches and consumer insight into content roadmaps, templates and standards that Site Operations can publish at scale, leads localisation, on-site SEO, content testing and CMS governance, and works with Creative, Marketing and Global teams to ensure timely and accurate asset hand-off.
  
  
**About The Role**
Content strategy, roadmap and storytelling
  
  

* Develop and own the regional Levi.com content strategy and roadmap, aligned with brand direction, seasonal product launches, promotional moments and market priorities.
* Build campaign and storytelling plans for product launches, site refreshes and platform activities, including editorial or blog content, adapting global content to the needs of each market.
* Maintain the content calendar across supported markets, co-ordinating inputs, approvals and delivery dates with country teams, Marketing, Creative and Site Operations.
* Use consumer insight, market study and performance data to identify content gaps and prioritise the highest-impact content opportunities.
* Ensure content reflects the brand voice and presents product in a way that builds brand equity and supports conversion.

Landing page, product detail page and campaign content experience
  
  

* Define the content experience for the homepage, landing pages, campaign pages and product detail pages, including layout, modules, imagery, video, copy and calls to action.
* Design and standardise reusable page templates and content modules that let markets launch faster and more consistently, while allowing approved local variation.
* Provide Site Operations with complete, approved content briefs and specifications, with clear acceptance criteria and publishing windows.
* Own the standard for product detail page content, including descriptions, imagery, video and product storytelling, working with Creative, Merchandising and Product teams.
* Take a mobile-first approach to content, and review the live site regularly to prioritise fixes, refreshes and improvements.

Localisation, content governance and CMS standards
  
  

* Lead translation and localisation with agencies and local teams, setting quality standards for second-language and market-specific content, tone and terminology.
* Establish and maintain content standards, style guides, brand and compliance guidelines and quality checklists for consumer-facing content.
* Act as the CMS subject matter expert, defining content models, template rules, permissions and release practices, and mitigating risks within the platform.
* Partner with Creative and Global teams to ensure timely, accurate asset hand-off and consistent use of global assets, naming and metadata.
* Validate content quality and business acceptance of new templates, modules and CMS changes, working with Site Operations and Digital Product on UAT.

SEO, testing and content performance optimisation
  
  

* Define and apply on-site SEO best practice for page structure, metadata, copy, taxonomy and product listing content, working with SEO and traffic-management agencies.
* Plan and run A/B and multivariate content tests with Digital Product and Data & Analytics, interpreting results and scaling winning experiences.
* Track content KPIs, including conversion rate, engagement, search visibility and average order value, and share insight and recommended actions with markets.
* Turn business questions into analyses that show the impact of content on sales, engagement and profitability, and maintain content reporting and dashboards.
* Use behavioural analytics tools (e.g. Content Square) to understand how consumers interact with content and prioritise optimisations.

Customer engagement, retention and lifecycle content
  
  

* Develop content experiences that attract new consumers and encourage repeat purchase, loyalty participation and ongoing engagement on Levi.com.
* Partner with CRM and Marketing to align on-site content with email, SMS and lifecycle programmes so messaging is consistent across touchpoints.
* Support loyalty and member-experience content on the site in line with programme priorities.
* Explore content formats that raise engagement, such as editorial, video, live streaming and influencer or creator content, with Marketing and agencies.
* Use consumer feedback and Customer Service insight to improve content clarity and the consumer journey.

Cross-functional partnership, vendor and capability leadership
  
  

* Lead the regional content practice by expertise, coaching coordinators, content specialists and agency resources on standards, tools and best practice.
* Manage content-creation, translation and SEO agencies on quality, responsiveness and capacity, and escalate performance issues early.
* Document playbooks, templates, checklists and training to reduce key-person dependency and enable consistent execution across markets.
* Communicate content priorities, risks and performance clearly to eCommerce leadership and market stakeholders.
* Maintain effective working rhythms across India and EAP time zones so market teams receive responsive, reliable support.

**About You**
Experience and qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, business, digital or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4+ years of eCommerce experience, ideally within apparel, retail or brand contexts.
* Experience producing and managing content for digital channels (site, landing pages, product detail pages, email, blog) in a CMS or back-office platform.
* Experience delivering localisation and translation across markets and co-ordinating content refreshes with agencies and local teams.
* Experience with site QA, troubleshooting and user acceptance testing alongside development teams.
* Experience with Shopify or another enterprise commerce platform and CMS tools.
* Working knowledge of on-site SEO, A/B testing and web analytics (e.g. Google Analytics) and BI dashboards.

Core capabilities
  
  

* Strong storytelling and content-planning skills, with an eye for how content shapes perception and conversion.
* Understanding of UX and UI principles with a consumer-focused, commercial mindset.
* Strong understanding of eCommerce KPIs and the conversion funnel, and ability to turn analytics into optimisations.
* Ability to turn campaign requirements into clear content briefs, specifications and acceptance criteria.
* Strong attention to detail and quality management across languages, formats and devices.
* Ability to work effectively across commercial, creative and technical teams in different markets and time zones.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with confidence managing agencies and competing priorities.

Leadership attributes
  
  

* Consumer-focused, detail-oriented and calm under pressure.
* Balances brand expression with performance, clarity and commercial outcomes.
* Balances speed with quality and regional consistency with legitimate local needs.
* Builds trust and influence across locations and functions without relying solely on formal authority.
* Curious and eager to learn; shares knowledge and helps raise content capability across the team.

**Benefits**
We put a lot of thought into our programs to provide you with a benefits package that matters. Whether it is for medical care, taking time off, improving your health or planning for retirement, we've got you covered.
  
  
**Here's a Small Snapshot**

* Complimentary preventive health check-up for you & your spouse
* OPD coverage
* Best in class leave plan including paternity & family care leaves
* Counselling sessions to prioritize mental well-being
* Exclusive discount vouchers on Levi’s products

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to empowering individuals from all walks of life to achieve their professional goals with us, regardless of race, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, disability, sexual orientation, age, national origin, citizenship status, or genetic information. We actively seek and encourage applications from diverse candidates, including those with disabilities, and offer accommodations throughout the selection process upon request.
  
  
To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status.*
**LOCATION**
Bengaluru, India
  
  
**FULL TIME/PART TIME**
Full time
  
  
**Current LS&Co Employees, apply via your Workday account.**

title: Lead Content Strategist
description:
**Why this role exists**

If you write across formats and you're the kind of person who keeps the whole pipeline on track, this role hands you both.

You'll define the narrative - how JustCall explains what it does and why it matters to the revenue teams who use our products, and the buyers deciding whether to. You'll set the voice and tone across web, blog, email, and social, and own the calendar that keeps all of it moving.

You'll write the cornerstone pieces yourself - the ones that set the standard for how we sound and hold that line across everything the wider team ships, from PMM and CRO to design and events.

**What you'll actually do**

**Write across formats**

* Draft and sharpen web and landing page copy - headlines, subcopy, feature sections, and CTAs
* Write and edit blogs and long-form content, from product announcements to thought leadership
* Own email and lifecycle copy - onboarding sequences, campaigns and A/B variants
* Write social copy and SEO content, including meta titles and descriptions, down to sections like FAQs

**Own the calendar**

* Plan what ships when, write the briefs, and track every piece from draft to publish
* Coordinate designers, freelancers, and other teams so work lands on time and on brief
* Keep clear visibility into what's in flight, what's done, and what's at risk, so no one has to chase

**Hold the quality bar**

* Self-edit hard, and hold every piece to our voice and style standards
* Review others' content for clarity, flow, and consistency
* Push every draft that's specific and reads like it was written by a human

**Build the systems**

* Build the workflows and reusable skills the content team runs on
* Use AI tools to do more with less, and write the prompts that make the whole team faster

**What we're looking for**

* Have 5+ years of writing copy, ideally in B2B SaaS
* Can show a portfolio across the web, blog, email, and social
* Stay organised under a full calendar and still ship clean work
* Write plain, specific copy and make technical ideas easy to read
* Like owning a process end-to-end, rather than waiting to be handed briefs

**Edges that help**

* Have written for sales and support teams
* Know SEO fundamentals and the tools we run on, like GA, HubSpot
* Have worked somewhere fast, where priorities shift week to week

**How we work**

* Outcomes over process. We measure engineering impact by production reliability, latency benchmarks, eval coverage, and the AI experiences we ship - not tickets closed.
* Deeply hands-on culture - leadership here means staying close to the hardest technical problems, not delegating your way out of them.
* Fast cycles, high ambiguity, and the expectation that you bring both architectural depth and shipping velocity to every initiative.
* Competitive pay tied to the systems you architect and the engineering culture you build.

**The bigger picture**

JustCall is SaaS Labs' flagship product - used by 6,000+ businesses across 70+ countries to run their customer conversations. We're backed by Peak XV and Base10 Partners, have crossed $40M ARR, and are building toward $100M with the team, the product, and the infrastructure to get there.

If this is the role you've been waiting to find - let's talk.

SaaS Labs takes pride in being an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products, which is why we're committed to making hiring or any employment decision regardless of race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic.

title: Content Strategist (Resorts)
description:
Okay Done is a digital marketing agency with a diverse clientele, such as Royal Challengers Bengaluru, OnePlus, VRL, Google, Bengaluru City Police, Heineken, and Health Care Global to name a few. We work across various industries, including sports, consumer, travel and resorts, luxury, F&B, real estate and D2C.

**Before you scroll further, a fair warning.**

Low-effort applications will never be considered. One-line answers, ChatGPT-sounding responses, and "please refer to my resume" will not be considered.

Read the JD all the way through. If you're not 100% sure you want this job, close the tab. No hard feelings.

If you are, this application takes about 5 minutes. The moment you apply, you unlock Round 2: a few real tasks from our world. That's where you show us how you think.

**The role, in one line**

You decide what our resort brands say, how they say it and why, then make sure it gets made well.

**Overview**

We're looking for a Content Strategist for a cluster of resort brands. These are brands people dream about, plan trips around and save for later. Your job is to make them feel that way on every scroll.

It's part content strategist, part social media manager, part copywriter. If you've worked in any of those roles at an agency and want to own the thinking behind a brand's content, this is for you.

Every brand in the cluster has its own voice, audience and rules. One can use any trending audio. Another can't go near it. You'll know the difference.

You'll work every day with our production team (videographers, editors and designers), Brand Solutions (our client servicing team), and our influencer marketing team.

This is a full-time, in-office role in Bengaluru.

**What you'll do**

**Think**

• Plan the monthly content calendar for each brand, with a reason behind every post.

• Track trending audio, formats, memes and topics every day across Instagram and YouTube, and decide which ones a brand should touch and which it should leave alone.

• Research your brands, their categories, competitors and guests, so every idea is grounded.

• Keep the team's trend and reference library up to date.

**Shape the ideas**

• Come up with short-form video concepts and the direction for carousels, statics and campaigns.

• Write the hooks, on-screen text and captions that go with them.

• Shape the storylines and direction for influencer collabs, so the brand fits into their story naturally.

• Catch the moments worth reacting to, and decide quickly whether a brand should join in.

**Get it made**

• Turn every approved concept into a pre-production deck: the idea, shot list, references, props, locations and talent.

• Brief editors and designers clearly enough that the first draft lands close to final.

• Be on set when the idea needs you there.

• Make revisions after internal and client feedback, quickly and without losing the idea.

**Learn from it**

• Review how every post performed, work out why, and carry the lessons into the next plan.

**Who we're looking for**

• At least 2 years in a content, social media or creative role, ideally at an agency.

• You've handled marketing for a resort, or for a travel or lifestyle brand, and you can show us.

• You understand how social content works: hooks, retention, pacing, formats, audio, and what the platforms reward.

• You can read a brand and know what it should and shouldn't do. Not every trend is for every brand.

• You think in strategy first, and you can write, because an idea without the words is half done.

• Range. You can be premium, warm, funny and punchy, and know which one the brand needs.

• You live online and know what's happening on the internet today, not last month.

**Why Okay Done**

• You'll make content for brands people actually talk about.

• Shoots, sets, launches, and the occasional work trip to some beautiful properties.

• Real ownership of what a brand posts and why.

• A team that lives online, eats well, and roasts each other often. In that order.
