title: Performance Marketer, APAC Digital Hub
description:
**Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively**
We are looking for a strategic, insight-driven digital marketing professional who combines strong performance marketing expertise with market partnership, stakeholder management, and cross-functional coordination.
  
  
This is a lead-level individual contributor (IC) role within the APAC Digital Hub. As the dedicated Marketing Partner for assigned APAC markets, you will act as the primary interface between market stakeholders and the Digital Hub, understanding business and marketing priorities, translating them into actionable plans, and mobilising the right Hub capabilities to deliver against them.
  
  
Alongside this market-facing responsibility, you will bring strong performance marketing expertise across paid media, analytics, measurement, optimisation, and digital strategy, helping markets make informed marketing decisions and continuously improve performance.
  
  
As APAC markets increasingly transition away from external agency support, this role will play an important part in strengthening internal digital marketing capabilities and establishing the Digital Hub as a trusted marketing partner across the region.
  
  
Success in this role requires the ability to move seamlessly between strategic consultation, relationship management, cross-functional orchestration, and hands-on digital marketing execution, while balancing market relevance with regional and global priorities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Market Partnership & Stakeholder Management
* Act as the primary Digital Hub contact and Marketing Partner for assigned APAC markets.
* Build strong, trusted relationships with market marketing teams and relevant business stakeholders.
* Maintain regular and proactive engagement to understand business priorities, marketing needs, upcoming campaigns, launches, and potential challenges.
* Participate in market planning discussions, business reviews, campaign reviews, and relevant marketing governance forums.
* Align stakeholders on business objectives, strategic priorities, delivery timelines, decision points, and overall success criteria.
* Provide strategic marketing guidance while ensuring activities remain aligned with regional and global strategy, brand standards, and established ways of working.
* Represent market needs, challenges, and opportunities within the Digital Hub while helping markets understand and activate broader regional and global priorities.
* Maintain clear and transparent communication around priorities, progress, dependencies, risks, and next steps.
* Digital Hub Orchestration & Go-to-Market Enablement
* Own the intake, clarification, prioritisation, and coordination of marketing requirements from assigned markets.
* Translate business and marketing needs into clear, actionable briefs for Digital Hub specialists.
* Mobilise and coordinate relevant Hub capabilities across Content, Creative, Website, SEO, Social Media, Performance Marketing, and Analytics.
* Connect specialist workstreams into cohesive marketing solutions rather than managing individual requests in isolation.
* Coordinate priorities, dependencies, timelines, and expectations across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Support regional and global product launches and strategic initiatives by coordinating digital readiness across relevant channels and workstreams.
* Identify potential delivery gaps, risks, or misalignment early and facilitate corrective action.
* Facilitate collaboration between markets, Digital Hub specialists, regional/global teams, and external partners where required.
* Identify opportunities to reuse and scale successful assets, campaigns, and approaches across APAC while maintaining appropriate local relevance.
* Paid Media Strategy & Campaign Management
* Develop and manage paid media strategies across: Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, and Other relevant digital channels
* Build integrated media plans aligned with market objectives, target audiences, customer journeys, and available budgets.
* Recommend channel mix, audience targeting strategies, campaign structures, and budget allocation.
* Manage campaign activation, monitoring, optimisation, and continuous performance improvement.
* Evaluate campaign effectiveness against agreed objectives and recommend actions to improve ROI and lead quality.
* Advise markets on digital media opportunities and investment decisions based on performance data, market context, and business objectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and scale successful approaches across markets.
* Performance Analysis & Strategic Advisory
* Own or coordinate monthly and quarterly digital performance reporting for assigned markets and contribute to broader APAC reporting.
* Translate campaign, website, social media, SEO, and wider digital performance into actionable business insights.
* Develop clear, insight-led reporting that explains what happened, why it happened, what actions should be taken next
* Identify cross-channel trends, business risks, market opportunities, and persistent performance gaps, and translate them into strategic recommendations for future planning and investment.
* Develop and maintain performance dashboards using GA4, Looker Studio, and other relevant reporting tools.
* Benchmark performance against historical results, relevant industry benchmarks, and regional trends.
* Use performance insights and market intelligence to inform campaign planning, channel selection, investment recommendations, and future marketing activity.
* Represent Digital Hub performance and contributions in relevant market business reviews and stakeholder forums.
* Bring market learnings back into the Digital Hub to help shape regional approaches, priorities, and future capabilities.
* Advise the Digital Hub Manager on aggregated market needs, recurring capability gaps, investment opportunities, and regional performance patterns across assigned markets.
* Analytics, Attribution & Conversion Optimisation
* Develop and maintain campaign tracking frameworks and measurement governance.
* Ensure accurate performance measurement through: Google Analytics 4,Google Tag Manager,CRM integrations,UTM governance
* Support lead attribution and reporting through CRM platforms where applicable.
* Align stakeholders on KPIs, reporting frameworks, and measurement approaches.
* Collaborate with regional and global stakeholders to maintain reporting consistency and accuracy.
* Partner with Website, SEO, Content, and Creative specialists to identify opportunities to improve landing-page and customer-journey effectiveness.
* Support A/B testing and experimentation across audiences, creatives, messaging, channels, and landing pages.
* Ensure campaigns and digital initiatives launch with appropriate tracking and measurement mechanisms in place.
* Content, Localisation & Market Activation
* Coordinate localisation requirements including translation, transcreation, and content adaptation.
* Assess when regional or global assets can be reused or adapted and when market needs require more specific localisation.
* Partner with Content and Creative specialists to ensure market requirements are translated into effective, locally relevant executions.
* Support market activation of regional and global campaign assets across relevant digital channels.
* Identify opportunities to make localisation and content adaptation more efficient and scalable through shared capabilities and emerging technologies.
* Ensure localised marketing activities remain aligned with applicable brand standards, approved claims, and regulatory requirements.
* Digital Operations & Problem Solving
* Provide hands-on support for campaign, platform, tracking, measurement, and reporting-related issues affecting assigned markets.
* Troubleshoot issues across platforms including Google Ads, Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, GA4, GTM, and reporting tools.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
**The Opportunity**

Some people see an advertisement.

You see the insight behind it, the words that make it work, the emotion it creates, and ten different ways it could have been better.

**If that's you, we should talk.**

At ShopOS, we're looking for a
**Creative Strategist**
who lives somewhere between a brilliant copywriter, a sharp cultural observer, and a fearless campaign thinker.

Someone who can take a vague brief and turn it into a powerful idea.

Someone who can write a headline that stops the scroll, create a campaign that starts conversations, and understand why certain stories make people care.

**We're not looking for someone who just writes content. We're looking for someone who creates the reason people want to consume it.**

**What You'll Be Creating**

**01 / Ideas That Deserve Attention**

Turn consumer insights, cultural trends, and brand challenges into original campaign concepts. Build creative territories, campaign narratives, and big ideas that can travel across formats and platforms.

**02 / Words That Actually Work**

Write irresistible hooks, sharp headlines, memorable taglines, compelling scripts, and persuasive campaign copy.

From a three-word headline to a full-fledged brand film, know how to make every word count.

**03 / Campaigns With a Point of View**

Conceptualise digital-first campaigns across social media, influencer marketing, brand storytelling, and performance marketing.

Don't just follow trends. Understand what makes them relevant and how brands can participate meaningfully.

**04 / Creativity Meets Consumer Psychology**

Go beyond what looks or sounds good. Understand what makes people click, watch, share, remember, and convert.

Use audience insights and campaign performance to make the next creative idea even stronger.

**05 / Reimagine Creativity With AI**

Experiment with AI-powered creative tools, generative content, visual storytelling, and emerging creative formats.

Collaborate with designers, video creators, and AI artists to turn concepts into powerful creative experiences, faster than traditional workflows allow.

**You're Probably Our Kind of Creative If...**

* You bring 3–6 years of experience from an advertising, creative, or marketing agency.
* **Copywriting is one of your strongest skills**
  , not just something you occasionally do.
* You've conceptualized campaigns from scratch and can show the thinking behind them.
* Your portfolio demonstrates a combination of sharp copy, creative strategy, and campaign execution.
* You understand brand building, digital marketing, consumer behavior, and performance-driven creativity.
* You have a strong pulse on internet culture, emerging trends, and what makes content resonate.
* You can turn complex ideas into simple, memorable, emotionally relevant communication.
* You don't wait around for the perfect brief. You ask better questions and build better ideas.

**Extra Creative Credit**

* Experience with fashion, lifestyle, D2C, ecommerce, or consumer brands.
* Experience writing scripts for brand films, digital videos, influencer campaigns, or social-first content.
* Ability to independently develop campaign concepts and confidently present your creative thinking.
* Genuine curiosity about AI-generated content and the future of advertising.

**Why You'll Love Building Here**

Because you'll get to do more than brainstorm ideas and prepare presentations.

You'll see your thinking come alive.

You'll collaborate with people experimenting at the edge of AI and creativity, build campaigns from zero, and have the freedom to challenge how creative work gets done.

**Less "make the logo bigger." More "let's create something nobody has seen before."**

We value ideas over hierarchy, ownership over job titles, and creative courage over playing safe.

**One Last Thing...**

We care more about what you've created than the brands you've worked for.

Show us your sharpest copy, your most interesting campaign, and an idea that made you think, "Damn, this is good."

**Build early. Own more. Go further.**

**Apply with:**
Your portfolio, two campaigns you've conceptualized, and your best piece of copy.

title: Head of Employee Relations for India and APAC, Vice President
description:
As
**Head of Employee Relations for India and APAC,**
you will provide strategic leadership and expert advice to business divisions and corporate functions across the region. You will be responsible for the effective management of complex employee relations matters and associated legal, financial, and reputational risks.
  
  
The Employee Relations function plays a critical role in supporting organisational performance by advising on workplace issues and addressing employee concerns. In this role, you will deliver pragmatic, commercially focused solutions while building manager capability and strengthening employee engagement.
  
  
This position is suited to a senior Employee Relations professional with deep regional expertise across India and APAC and a proven ability to operate in a complex, global environment at both an operational and strategic level.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The Head of Employee Relations - India & APAC is a senior leadership role responsible for providing strategic, operational, and people leadership across Employee Relations for India and the broader APAC region.
  
  
This role serves as the primary regional escalation point for complex and high-risk employee relations matters, ensures consistent application of ER standards across jurisdictions, and builds a scalable regional model aligned with global frameworks, local requirements, and evolving data- and technology-enabled ways of working.
  
  
Reporting into Head of Employee Relations – International, the role leads a team of ER professionals across APAC and India and partners closely with HR, Legal, Compliance, Conduct Standards, Ethics, Corporate Audit, Global Security, and business leadership to identify, manage, and mitigate employee-related risk.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Regional ER Leadership & Strategy
  
  

* Provide end-to-end leadership for Employee Relations across India and APAC, ensuring alignment with global ER strategy and standards.
* Partner with the Managing Director, Head of International Employee Relations, to shape and execute the regional ER operating model, including governance, escalation pathways, capability building, and technology-enabled process and service improvements.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior business and HR leaders on complex, sensitive, and high-risk employee relations matters.
* Provide leadership across diverse APAC jurisdictions with varying employment law frameworks, regulatory obligations, and cultural considerations, balancing global consistency with local requirements and business needs.

Case Oversight, Conduct & Risk Management
  
  

* Provide oversight and direction on complex investigations, grievances, employee misconduct matters, executive employee matters, and other high-risk employee relations issues.
* Oversee employee misconduct and conduct-related matters in partnership with Conduct Standards, Ethics, Legal, Compliance, and Global Security, ensuring consistent, fair, and risk-appropriate outcomes.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for significant employee conduct matters, sensitive investigations, and issues presenting legal, regulatory, reputational, operational, or cultural risk.
* Ensure matters are handled in a consistent, fair, and risk-aware manner, balancing legal, regulatory, cultural, and reputational considerations.
* Support regional governance and risk management activities, including audit reviews, regulatory inquiries, employee-related risk reporting, and senior leadership forums.

Leadership & Team Management
  
  

* Lead, develop, and coach a team of VP/AVP/Officer level Employee Relations consultants across India and APAC.
* Build a high-performing Employee Relations leadership team and succession pipeline through coaching, talent development, learning agility, knowledge sharing, and consistent decision-making.
* Set clear expectations, promote accountability, and foster a collaborative, inclusive team culture.
* Create a cohesive regional Employee Relations function that delivers consistent, high-quality support while effectively navigating local market and jurisdictional differences.
* Develop senior Employee Relations practitioners and sustainable regional capability by promoting continuous learning, adaptability, and readiness for emerging technologies and evolving workforce expectations.

Stakeholder Partnership
  
  

* Establish strong partnerships with HR Business Partners, COEs, and regional leadership teams.
* Provide guidance and challenge to stakeholders to drive appropriate outcomes while protecting the organisation and its employees.
* Support restructurings, integrations, transformation programs, and other organisational change, helping leaders adopt new ways of working effectively.
* Maintain strong relationships with internal and external counsel and relevant industry networks to anticipate legal, regulatory, and market developments across APAC.

Governance, Standards & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Ensure regional ER practices align with global policies, local labour laws, and regulatory expectations.
* Use Employee Relations metrics, case data, trend analysis, and thematic reporting to identify emerging risks, generate actionable insights, inform proactive interventions, and enable evidence-based senior leadership decisions.
* Report on Employee Relations activity, conduct-related concerns, organisational trends, and key risk indicators across the region.
* Contribute to the evolution of ER policies, frameworks, and manager capability initiatives.

**Experience**
**Required Experience & Capabilities**

* Significant senior-level experience in Employee Relations / Employment Law / HR Advisory, ideally within a complex, global organisation.
* Proven experience leading regional or multi-country ER teams.
* Strong track record managing high-risk, high-profile, and senior-level ER matters.
* Experience operating in regulated environments and partnering with Legal and Compliance.

Skills & Attributes
  
  

* Strong judgment and decision-making capability in complex and ambiguous situations.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills at senior leadership level.
* Ability to balance global consistency with local nuance and cultural sensitivity.
* Proven people leader with experience developing senior professionals.
* Commercial, pragmatic approach with a strong risk and conduct mindset.
* Ability to use data, technology, and innovative approaches to improve Employee Relations outcomes and processes.

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

description:
**Sr. Business Operations Manager – Rider Experience & Consumer Insights**
**Uber | India & South Asia**
**About The Role**
At Uber, millions of riders trust us to get them where they need to go, every day. But what makes a great ride experience? What frustrates riders, what builds their trust, and what makes them choose Uber again and again?
  
  
We are looking for someone who is
**obsessed with understanding consumers**
— someone who is endlessly curious about what riders think, feel and experience, and passionate about turning those insights into meaningful change.
  
  
In this role, you will be the
**champion of the rider's voice within Uber**
, ensuring that consumer needs, expectations and pain points are at the heart of how we build products, design experiences and make business decisions.
  
  
You will shape Uber's Rider Experience strategy across India & South Asia, working closely with Product, Operations, Marketing and Marketplace teams to make Uber the most trusted and preferred mobility platform.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to combine deep consumer understanding with strategic thinking and real business impact — moving beyond understanding what riders want to actually making it happen.
  
  

* Drive Consumer Insights & Problem Solving: Bring structure to ambiguous consumer problems, triangulating quantitative data, qualitative research and field insights to uncover root causes, size opportunities and drive actionable recommendations.
* Reimagine the Rider Experience: Identify and prioritize friction points across the end-to-end rider journey, with a focus on new rider experience, satisfaction and retention. Partner with cross-functional teams to drive measurable improvements.
* Build & Scale Rider Value Propositions: Identify opportunities for differentiated consumer propositions, validate them through research and experimentation, and partner with Product and Marketing to launch and scale impactful solutions.
* Own Critical Consumer Journeys: Drive improvements across priority areas including payments, rider communications and engagement programs, balancing consumer experience, business impact and investment efficiency.
* Champion the Voice of the Rider: Build a deep understanding of rider needs, frustrations and unmet expectations by combining consumer research, VOC and behavioral data. Translate insights into clear priorities that influence business and product decisions.
* Embed Consumer Obsession Across Uber: Bring compelling consumer insights and data-backed recommendations into leadership discussions, challenge assumptions and mobilize teams to act on what matters most to riders.

**What You'll Need**

* 5+ years of experience in consumer insights, customer experience, consumer strategy, product, growth or related fields.
* Consumer obsession: Deep curiosity about human behavior, strong empathy and a natural instinct to uncover what consumers really need.
* Analytical rigor & structured problem solving: Ability to bring clarity to ambiguous problems, synthesize complex datasets and marry quantitative evidence with qualitative insights.
* Insight-to-action orientation: Proven ability to translate consumer understanding into sharp strategic recommendations, prioritized initiatives and measurable business outcomes.
* Strong ownership & execution: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, driving cross-functional initiatives and moving from problem identification to implementation.
* Storytelling & influence: Ability to simplify complex insights, build compelling narratives and influence senior stakeholders to champion the consumer perspective.

**Ready to Ride?**
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.
  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centres. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+

Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
The TechOps SAP Integration Suite Manager is responsible for leading the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of enterprise integration solutions using SAP Integration Suite (SAP BTP Integration Suite). The role combines technical leadership, operational governance, stakeholder management, and team leadership to ensure seamless integration between SAP and non-SAP systems.

* Manage production support and operational readiness. Monitor integration interfaces and message processing.

Solution Development & Delivery

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

Governance, Compliance & Documentation
  
  

* Maintain architecture diagrams, integration catalogues, and operational procedures. Ensure compliance with security, audit, and regulatory requirements.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
* 12+ years of SAP integration experience.
* 3+ years leading integration teams or managing enterprise integration platforms. SAP Integration Suite/BTP certifications preferred.

What we offer you
  
  
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.

differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and
  
  
building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**

**How to Apply**

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.

title: Manager - RevOps & GTM Engineering: 371
description:
**Born in India, Built for the World**

Amagi is an Emmy®-winning, agentic industry cloud platform powering the modern video economy. We help media companies unify streaming and broadcast workflows, modernize operations, and maximize monetization—from live remote production and real-time ad decisioning to automated playout and global content syndication.

Trusted by a majority of the world's top 50 listed media companies, Amagi delivers:

* 9,000+ channels across 300+ content distributors
* 500,000+ hours of content processed
* 26 billion+ monetized ad impressions

﻿﻿﻿

We power marquee brands including CBS, BBC, Warner Bros. Discovery, NBC, NBA, and DAZN—and the world's biggest events: The Olympics, Super Bowl, The Grammys, and the US Presidential Debate.

Amagi is built on the belief that freedom and happiness are essential for people to do their best work. We call it the Amagi Way: a unique DNA of goodness, purpose, and innovation that shapes how we work, the teams we build, and the impact we want to make together. Over the last two decades, it has been the driving force behind how we have redefined the video economy while contributing to the communities around us.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, and listed on the BSE and NSE, Amagi is a global team of 1,000+ people spread across offices in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC.

To learn more about our impact, we invite you to explore here.

**Work Mode                   : In-Office**

**Location                        : Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road)**

**Job Profile:**

Amagi is hiring a Marketing Operations Lead to own the systems, data, and automation that power our GTM engine. This is not a traditional MOps seat - it sits at the intersection of marketing operations and GTM engineering. You’ll run the full marketing-ops backbone (campaign ops, lead lifecycle, attribution, database hygiene) while building AI-native automations that eliminate manual work across Sales, Marketing, and RevOps. If you instinctively reach for a Claude + Clay workflow before a spreadsheet, this is your playground - and you’ll own the reporting layer leadership runs on, accountable for turning dashboards into decisions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Marketing Operations Ownership**

Own the marketing-ops backbone: campaign operations, lead lifecycle, scoring/routing, attribution, and database hygiene across the funnel.

Administer HubSpot and Salesforce hands-on — objects, workflows, fields, and integration — keeping Salesforce as the single source of truth.

Drive SLA adherence and clean handoffs between Marketing, BDR/SDR, and Sales.

**AI-Native Automation & GTM Engineering**

Build end-to-end automations using a Claude + Clay combination plus n8n / Make to enrich, research, and act on data with minimal human overhead.

Stand up advanced enrichment and account-intelligence pipelines (ICP matching, contact/title enrichment, ABM, outreach automation).

Proactively identify automation opportunities; ensure workflows are scalable, fail-safe, and maintainable.

**Reporting That Drives Outcomes**

Own reporting and dashboards across HubSpot, Salesforce, and the GTM stack for stakeholders up to leadership.

Translate pipeline, campaign, and funnel data into actionable recommendations — and own the follow-through.

Use SQL (and Python where useful) to extract, transform, and analyze data across systems; run a 30-60-90 reporting cadence.

**Cross-Functional Partnership**

Partner with Sales, SalesOps, BDRs, PMM, and Leadership to turn business needs into scalable systems.

Document workflows and data flows, train the team, and support rapid deploy-measure-iterate experiments.

**Skills and Expertise Required:**

AI-native operator: fluent in applying LLMs (Claude in particular) to design and ship real workflows — not just prompt occasionally.

Hands-on, advanced proficiency with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Clay (all must-have).

Proven ability to build automations with Claude + Clay and orchestration tools (n8n / Make); SQL for querying GTM data.

Reporting and dashboarding, with the judgment to turn data into action.

Strong grasp of GTM workflows: lead routing, scoring, ICP matching, ABM automation, attribution, and pipeline hygiene.

**Competencies**

Funnel & lifecycle ownership: govern lead lifecycle and stage definitions (Inquiry → MQL → SQL → Opportunity), scoring models, and routing rules.

Attribution & measurement: stand up and defend a campaign measurement and multi-touch attribution methodology tying activity to pipeline and revenue.

Campaign ops & data governance: own campaign setup, UTM/taxonomy, segmentation, QA, and database health (dedupe, normalization, enrichment, compliance).

Martech stack ownership: administer, evaluate, and rationalize the stack; manage vendors, renewals, integrations, and license/credit utilization.

Planning & stakeholder leadership: partner on target-setting and multi-BU campaign governance; drive cross-functional alignment on process, SLAs, and a single source of truth.

**Good-to-Have**

Python; warehouse / BI exposure (Databricks, Looker / LookML basics).

B2B SaaS GTM experience (post-IPO / high-growth); familiarity with Gong Engage, Outreach, or Swoogo.

**Who You Are**

AI-first by default: you reach for a Claude-powered workflow before a manual process and treat LLMs as core to how you operate.

Hands-on operator: equally at home building enrichment in Clay, configuring Salesforce and HubSpot, and reviewing pipeline with leadership.

A systems thinker with a bias for automation, strong ownership, and a builder’s instinct in high-growth environments.

You flag data-quality issues honestly rather than shipping polished-but-wrong output.

**Life at Amagi:**

Amagi is an equal opportunity employer. Our culture is built around four values that show up in how we work every day.

* **Be Vulnerable, Be You.**
  Authenticity is our baseline.
* **Goodness Wins.**
  We always lead with integrity.
* **Have Fun with Challenges.**
  We see obstacles as opportunities, not roadblocks.
* **Think Macro, Do Micro.**
  We dream big but execute with relentless precision.

﻿

**A Place That Takes Care of You:**

We care about you as a whole person, and our offerings reflect that. You and your loved ones have access to comprehensive health insurance and our Employee Assistance Program, which covers mental health counselling, financial and legal guidance, and diet and nutrition support. Our office spaces are naturally lit and ventilated, with nutritious meals available every day. An on-site gym and wellness rooms are available for you to rejuvenate. We believe good work should transcend building a great product. Our Employee Resource Group gives you a community within the company. Our volunteering programs and community initiatives give you ways to contribute to the world outside of it.

* Strong knowledge of global financial policies and controllership alignment.
* Proven ability to lead large, diverse teams across geographies.

* Excellent business communication and stakeholder management skills.

title: Operations Executive - IAH
description:
**Job Title**
**Executive – Hub Operations**
**Function**
Hub Operations
  
  
**Reports To**
Head – Hub Operations
  
  
**Location**
Air Hub / Surface Hub
  
  
**Travel Required**
25% ☐ 50% ☐ 75% ☐
  
  
**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
*(Use the same standard About Blue Dart section exactly as in your master JD.)*
**Position Overview:**
The Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Hub Operations is responsible for managing end-to-end mid-mile operations at an assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring seamless movement of shipments across the Blue Dart network. The role oversees inbound, outbound and transit operations, enabling timely network connectivity, operational accuracy and service reliability while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance and productivity.
  
  
Reporting to the Head – Hub Operations, the incumbent leads shift operations across the hub by coordinating shipment processing, fleet movements, manpower deployment and operational resources. The role works closely with Network Operations, Aviation, Surface Linehaul, Customer Service and Regional Operations teams to ensure network schedules are met, operational exceptions are proactively managed and hub performance supports Blue Dart's service commitments.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To manage mid-mile hub operations by ensuring timely movement of shipments across the network, maximising hub productivity, maintaining network connectivity, driving operational excellence and ensuring compliance with organisational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
**Hub Operations Management**

* Lead day-to-day operations across the assigned Air Hub or Surface Hub, ensuring efficient inbound, outbound and transit shipment movement.
* Ensure adherence to network schedules, operational workflows and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Plan daily hub activities based on shipment volumes, network priorities and operational requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of hub infrastructure, operational resources and manpower.
* Support the Head – Hub Operations in achieving operational, service quality and productivity objectives.

**Mid Mile Network Operations**

* Ensure timely receipt, processing, consolidation and dispatch of shipments across the Blue Dart network.
* Coordinate movement of shipments through scheduled air, surface and feeder networks to maintain network connectivity.
* Monitor loading, unloading, scanning, tallying and dispatch activities to ensure shipment accuracy.
* Coordinate vehicle placement and dock activities to minimise turnaround times.

title: GBM - Loan Management & Due Diligence - CRE - Associate - Bengaluru
description:
**Job Description**
**About Goldman Sachs**
At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments, and individuals. For us, it’s all about bringing together people who are curious, collaborative and have the drive to make things possible for our clients and communities.
  
  
**Global Banking & Markets**
Our core value is building strong relationships with our institutional clients, which include corporations, financial service providers, and fund managers. We help them buy and sell financial products on exchanges around the world, raise funding, and manage risk. This is a dynamic, entrepreneurial team with a passion for the markets, with individuals who thrive in fast-paced, changing environments and are energized by a bustling trading floor.
  
  
**Business Unit Overview**
Loan Management primarily supports the Global Banking and Markets Segment within Goldman Sachs. Loan Management, amongst other things, is responsible for directing and facilitating due diligence (at both, the deal and asset levels) for the acquisitions, asset management and sales/securitizations of various types of loan portfolios in the US, EMEA and APAC.
  
  
The EMEA Mortgage desk makes markets in EMEA loan business (CRE/Resi/consumer) and Asset Backed securities, and increasingly places a large amount of focus on purchasing whole loan pools, originating/ financing new loan assets (CRE/Resi/consumer) or create new securities backed by loan assets which can be distributed to our clients. In this way the desk / structurers/ Loan management, in particular, are very much at the heart of a changing banking / capital-markets landscape, and designing ways in which Goldman can be a long-term participant in these new flows of capital.
  
  
Loan Management is currently seeking an Associate to support the EMEA mortgage desk in its asset management activities. The Associate will be primarily responsible for ongoing asset/loan management of EMEA commercial real estate loans, facilitating the acquisition, monitoring, reporting and disposition / securitization of loans purchased, financed and/or originated from different business platforms.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Managing commercial real estate loans secured against a variety of property types: multifamily, hospitality, retail, industrial, office, self-storage, data centers, etc.
* Reviewing legal documentation, financial models, business plans, and covenants to assess the loan and asset level risk.
* Ongoing monitoring of the asset and loan performance, preparing asset summary reports and internal business plan presentations, valuation analysis, market analysis.
* Supporting on critical workstreams including modification, restructuring, extensions, waivers etc. throughout the loan life cycle.
* Managing client relationships and interacting with property managers, legal counsel, servicers, co-lenders, institutional borrowers, etc . to ensure smooth / high-quality execution/monitoring of CRE deals.
* Data management of the CRE trades, including data setup, database management, ETL and data validations.
* Tracking and confirmation of collateral adequacy for funding and margining (collateral covenants, eligibility, concentration limits), monitoring of key deliverables and financial covenants under the legal documents.
* Ensure the flow of data underneath all of the analytics is accurate and correct. Working with mortgage desk, technology, and cash operations to achieve the same.
* Manage and create data related quality control checks for internal databases and provide resolution through analytic research.
* Develop reporting solutions through multiple tools as needed. Ability to produce interactive graphs, pivot tables, etc. for reporting.
* Maintains systems for tracking projects and communicate results to different business groups

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5-6 years of experience in mortgages or commercial real estate portfolios / collateral analytics / asset management, Data Management/ Modeling and handling ETL processes.
* Strong academic background – in finance, business, math, or accounting degree with a minimum 3.5 GPA equivalent / candidates pursuing CFA.
* Strong communication skills (clear, concise, and confident) with the ability to manage internal and external relationships.
* Solid analytical/logical mindset and attention to detail
* Technical skills required include SQL, RDBMS Databases (SQL Server or Sybase ASE preferred), Data Reporting and Data Visualizations. Tableau experience is a plus.
* Strong project management skills that include Stakeholder Management skills, program management experience and ability to translate requirements to deliverables.
* Commercial focus and interest in financial and RE markets
* Mortgage banking or other financial industry experience preferred
* Able to work under tight time constraints and extended hours as required
* Ability to prioritize workload, manage expectations and is a team player.

You will chip in to JIRA workflow automation, dashboard development, data analytics, and engineering process improvements that enable efficient execution across semiconductor development teams.

****Dashboard & UI Development****
Develop and maintain web-based dashboards and user interfaces that visualize project health, engineering metrics, defect trends, and execution status. Work with modern web technologies to enhance usability and user experience.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Strength in Trust**
 OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016\. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
   

  

**The Challenge**
 We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer with a passion for solving problems to join our agile Product Engineering team at OneTrust. Senior Software Engineers own the delivery of complex features end\-to\-end and are a go\-to technical resource for their immediate team.
   

  

**Your Mission**
*Execution \& Delivery*
* Independently own delivery of complex features or components from design through production, requiring evaluation of multiple interacting factors.
* Drive system architecture and component\-design discussions for your area of ownership.


*Collaboration \& Influence*

* Network with senior engineers across the org to align on shared technical decisions.
* Stays curious and has the ability to ideate, innovate \& improve by identifying patterns that can bring quality and velocity improvements


*Quality \& Craft*
* Conduct peer code reviews and help set the quality bar for your team.
* Champion testing practices, including exploratory and AI\-assisted testing approaches.


*Mentorship*
* Support the ramp\-up and growth of Associate and Software Engineers on your team.


**You Are**
 A seasoned, fully\-capable engineer who requires minimal day\-to\-day direction and only needs general guidance on genuinely new assignments. You proactively surface risks and ambiguity rather than waiting to be asked. You work independently on established types of work, taking ownership from design through delivery with limited need for oversight. You're not afraid to ask for input mainly when facing unfamiliar or ambiguous problems, where the right approach isn't yet obvious. Your passionate about flagging risks and open questions during planning or design, before they turn into issues later in the process
   

  

*Your Experience Includes*

* 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience on Core Java, Spring, Spring boot, hibernate, microservices and Kafka messaging. Also looking at experience working on agentic platforms like Microsoft foundry, agent core, google vertex, Bedrock.

 Resources

**About The Role**
Delivery Performance is building AI agents that support delivery teams, including agents that help write Epics and Features to the required quality standard and agents that help teams prepare for stage gates. Each agent is only as valuable as the way people actually use it. This role provides continuous user research across these agents, so the team always knows how people use them, where they struggle, whether the agents improve the work they are meant to support, and what should change.
  
  
Success in this role means agent owners make decisions about their agents from evidence of real use, and can see whether the changes they made have worked.
  
  
You will work with the Delivery Management System team, Delivery Leads, Programme and Project Managers, and the squads who use the agents day to day.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**
**Research planning**

* Agree with each agent owner, before every round of research, the question the round needs to answer and the decision it will inform.
* Decide where research time is spent based on where the biggest unknowns and risks are, so effort goes where it is most needed and is not spread evenly across agents.

**Continuous user research**

* Plan and run a continuous cycle of usability testing across every live and upcoming agent, so that each agent is tested with the people who use it on a regular rhythm and not only at launch.
* Before a new agent is built, study how teams do that work today, so the agent is designed around how the work is done.
* Find out whether each agent improves the work it supports, for example whether Epics and Features meet the quality standard and whether teams arrive at stage gates prepared, as well as whether people find it easy to use.
* Test with users across CFUs, so that findings do not rest on one group alone.
* Include people who tried an agent and stopped using it, and people who have not started, as well as regular users.
* Repeat the same tasks with users after a change has been made, and report whether the behaviour observed has changed.
* When shared on Wayfinder, are users able to find the information.
* Work with the Designer on discoverability of the Delivery Standards published including the agents and other guidelines.

**Observation and research practice**

* Observe people using the agents in their real work, and record what they did separately from what they said they did.
* Invite agent owners to watch sessions and to take part in making sense of what was seen, so the people who act on the findings have seen the evidence themselves.
* Support demonstrations and user sessions run by colleagues and show them how to observe without leading the user.
* Insight and recommendations
* Write up a report covering what was observed, what it means, how strong the evidence is, and a ranked set of recommendations. Agent owners decide what to act on and make the changes.
* Maintain record of findings across all agents, so that patterns and recurring needs across agents are visible.

**Data protection, consent and research ethics**

* Handle research data in line with BT data protection, consent and regulatory requirements, including participant privacy.
* Make sure research findings are never used to judge an individual’s performance, and tell participants this before each session.

**Essential Skills / Experience**

* Strong observation skill: you can describe a session so that someone who was not there understands what happened and why it matters.
* Experience planning and running moderated usability sessions and interviews from start to finish.
* Experience agreeing research questions with stakeholders and choosing the method that fits each question, including saying when a question does not need new research.
* Experience studying how people work before a product is designed, as well as testing products already in use.
* Experience turning observations into clear recommendations, written in plain language for senior stakeholders.
* Experience researching with enterprise users within data protection and compliance constraints.
* Three or more years of experience as a user researcher.

**Desirable Skills / Experience**

* Experience testing AI assistants, copilots or other AI-enabled workflow tools.
* Experience involving product owners and developers in observing sessions and analysing findings.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence and SharePoint as used by delivery teams.

BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.
  
  
BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.
  
  
Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best.
  
  
We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

**Platform integration**

* Integrate push notifications, deep links, biometrics, camera, location, maps and other device capabilities.

description:
Overview:

About Cvent:

www.cvent.com

Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6,000+ employees and 34,000+ customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn, iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-powered collaboration, we’d love to meet you.

Cvent will never request payment or ask for sensitive personal or financial information through chat or social media platforms. Cvent is not responsible for losses or damages arising from communications, payments, or disclosures made to third parties impersonating Cvent.*

*If you believe a communication may be fraudulent, we strongly recommend that you don't respond and report the incident at recruitingindia@cvent.com.*

*For more information, visit Cvent’s Recruitment Fraud Notice.* *https://www.cvent.com/en/notice-recruitment-fraud**.*

**About the role:**

**Scrum Master II (Delivery & Release Lead)**

The Scrum Master II owns end-to-end delivery for 2–3 sprint teams: from quarterly planning, through sprint execution, to a controlled production release. The role blends Scrum facilitation, project management and release management, and uses approved AI tools to cut coordination overhead so time goes to planning quality, risk and release outcomes. Decisions, commitments and accountability stay with people.

In This Role, You Will::

**In This Role, You Will:**

* Own the integrated delivery plan for your teams: outcome-based milestones, capacity, critical path and cross-team dependencies, kept current in Jira and Confluence and aligned to the Cvent release calendar.
* Lead quarterly/PI and release planning across teams; publish commitments and dependencies and track them through the quarter.
* Run scope and change control: quantify the impact of changes on dates, capacity and quality, and get decisions from the right owner before teams commit.
* Own risk and dependency management with named owners and due dates; drive mitigations and escalate with a recommendation.
* Own release readiness and go/no-go with Product, Engineering, QA and SRE: test sign-off, security and performance checks, feature flags, rollback plan, support enablement and release communications; follow the change-management process and keep records audit-ready.
* Coordinate deployments and post-release monitoring; run post-release reviews on escaped defects, incidents and rollbacks, and drive the fixes.
* Facilitate sprint events for 2–3 teams so they stay short and decision-oriented; remove impediments and escalate systemic ones with proposed fixes.
* Coach teams and Product Owners on backlog health, sprint goals, definition of done and sustainable pace; step back where teams are mature.
* Use flow, release and project metrics (cycle time, throughput, work-item age, escaped defects, change-failure rate, release lead time, scope variance, forecast ranges) for planning and improvement, not for ranking people or velocity quotas.
* Apply approved AI tools and bounded agents to high-friction work: status synthesis, meeting follow-through, risk and dependency sensing, release-note drafting, reporting. Define each use case problem-first with clear data access, limits and human decision points; pilot with Engineering, Security, Privacy and AI-governance partners and stop when evidence does not show value.
* Coach teams on approved tools, output verification and transparent AI use; protect human judgment in prioritization, commitments, performance conversations and go/no-go calls.
* Report delivery status to senior stakeholders in short, evidence-based narratives: outcomes, forecast confidence, scope variance, risks and decisions needed, separating facts, estimates and AI-generated suggestions.
* Mentor less-experienced Scrum Masters and share reusable planning, release and AI-use practices.

Here's What You Need::

**Here's What You Need:**

* 5+ years in software delivery, including 2+ years as a Scrum Master, project manager or release manager for engineering teams, with impact across multiple teams or a complex product.
* Hands-on experience with integrated planning, scope and change control, risk and dependency management and stakeholder reporting.
* Hands-on release management for a SaaS product: release calendars, readiness criteria, go/no-go, change management, rollback and post-release reviews.
* Working knowledge of CI/CD, environments, feature flags and incident processes, enough to plan releases credibly with SRE/DevOps and QA.
* Strong command of Scrum and experience running quarterly or PI planning across teams.
* Uses delivery metrics to forecast responsibly and can explain their limits.
* Applied AI literacy: has scoped and run at least one AI or agent-assisted delivery workflow, can test outputs, spot failure modes and define human oversight.
* Strong facilitation, influencing and conflict-resolution skills; leads through ambiguity without taking accountability from teams or Product Owners.
* Concise written and spoken communication, including executive status reporting.
* Day-to-day fluency with Jira and Confluence, including dashboards and JQL reporting

title: SAP ABAP-Fiori-UI5-CAP Developer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**
-------------

As an **SAP ABAP-Fiori-UI5-CAP Developer** , you will bridge backend enterprise architectures (ABAP and S/4HANA) with cloud-native technologies (SAP Business Technology Platform / BTP) and responsive, user-centric interfaces (SAP Fiori, SAPUI5, and CAP). You will translate complex business needs into high-performing, resilient applications and side-by-side extensions that support SAP’s "Clean Core" strategy across both on-premise and multi-cloud environments.

  

Employees in this role define and use design documentation, functional programming specifications, and high level design documents to implement identified components. Ensure implemented components are documented appropriately, unit tested, and ready for integration into the final product. Present/demonstrate implemented product features through playback sessions as required. Provide fixes to defects identified during pre-production and post-production phases in the software development life cycle. Provide work estimates for assigned development work. Guide and explain features, functional objectives, or technologies that are being built to interested parties.

  

Bring your specialist software engineering and cloud application development expertise to a dynamic enterprise environment. In this role, you will play a critical part in designing, building, and modernizing Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) applications across SAP’s modern development stack. You will be part of a global community of experts who share knowledge openly, collaborate freely, and lead the future of enterprise software modernization.

  

**What you will do**
--------------------

* **Cloud-Native & Extension Development:** Build and maintain cloud-native applications and extensions on SAP BTP (Cloud Foundry / Kyma runtime) using the SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP) framework with Node.js backends and SAP HANA Cloud.
* **Modern ABAP & RAP Services:** Design and build core business logic using Modern ABAP (OO-ABAP), Core Data Services (CDS Views), and the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) for consumption via OData (V2/V4).
* **Fiori & SAPUI5 Frontends:** Design intuitive UI/UX mockups and develop custom Fiori and SAPUI5 applications adhering strictly to SAP Fiori Design Guidelines, utilizing both freestyle development and Fiori Elements.
* **Enterprise Integration & API Management:** Connect SAP BTP applications with S/4HANA, line-of-business solutions (e.g., SuccessFactors), and third-party systems using SAP Integration Suite, SAP API Management (security/proxy policies), Cloud Connector, and BTP Destination services.
* **Quality Assurance & Testing Automation:** Write unit and integration test suites using frameworks such as Mocha, Chai, or standard SAP test suites; debug, profile, and troubleshoot complex full-stack issues.
* **Architecture, Design & Standards:** Collaborate with functional analysts and technical architects to translate functional requirements into technical design specifications; drive Clean Core principles and automated CI/CD practices.
* **Cross-Functional & Global Collaboration:** Drive technical discussions with global teams, business stakeholders, and system integrators to ensure seamless software delivery and operational support.

  

**Your future at Kyndyl**
-------------------------

Every position offers a transparent trajectory to advance your career—from Senior Consultant to Principal Enterprise Architect and Practice Leader. You will gain access to large-scale enterprise transformation programs, early adoption of S/4HANA Cloud and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) innovations, and hands-on opportunities to lead complex global rollouts.

We partner across dynamic sectors including manufacturing, banking, energy, retail, and life sciences. Whether your ambition is to master global statutory requirements, pioneer AI-driven financial analytics, or drive multi-tier ERP migrations, you will have the platform, continuous learning resources, and executive sponsorship to shape your professional journey.

**Who You Are**

You bring proven engineering rigor, strong problem-solving skills, and a dedication to high-quality code. In addition, you have

Along with proven engineering rigor, strong problem-solving skills, and a dedication to high-quality code, you bring a proactive growth mindset toward emerging SAP and cloud ecosystems, a customer-centric focus on delivering performant user experiences, and an inclusive, borderless approach to global collaboration and mentorship.

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **10+ years** of hands-on software development experience with proven delivery in full-lifecycle enterprise implementations.
* **SAP BTP & CAP Development:** Strong experience developing applications on SAP BTP using the **SAP Cloud Application Programming (CAP)** model with **Node.js** , Multi-Target Applications (MTA), and SAP Business Application Studio (BAS).
* **Frontend Engineering:** Proven expertise in **SAPUI5, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and SAP Fiori** (Freestyle & Fiori Elements) consuming OData services.
* **Modern ABAP / RAP:** Solid background in backend development including **ABAP on HANA, Core Data Services (CDS Views), RAP, OO-ABAP** , and OData V2/V4 service generation and extensions.
* **Connectivity & Integration:** Practical understanding of SAP Cloud Connector, BTP Destination configurations, and API integration protocols (REST, SOAP, OData).
* **Tooling & Engineering Practices:** Hands-on experience with Git repositories, Agile/Scrum delivery models, Postman, and automated unit testing tools.

  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, MCA, or a related discipline.

* Experience configuring and securing APIs via SAP API Management (policies, rate-limiting, proxies) and event-driven patterns with SAP Event Mesh.
* Familiarity with additional frontend frameworks or libraries (TypeScript, Angular, or Vue.js).
* Exposure to SAP HANA XSA, HDI containers, and Core Data Services persistence modeling in SAP HANA Cloud.
* Experience with automated CI/CD delivery pipelines for SAP BTP applications.
* Active **SAP Certifications** (e.g., SAP Certified Development Associate – SAP BTP / SAP Extension Suite / SAP Fiori / ABAP with SAP NetWeaver or S/4HANA).

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. title: SAP Integration Developer (BTP Integration Suite / CPI / PI/PO)
description:
**Who We Are**

For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

An SAP Integration Developer (BTP Integration Suite / CPI / PI/PO) acts as the central connective tissue of an enterprise’s IT ecosystem. This role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining seamless end-to-end data flows and process integrations between SAP systems (S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, C/4HANA, Ariba) and non-SAP cloud or on-premise applications.

With your vast knowledge of SAP and industry, you assist top-tier clients in their SAP digital transformation efforts. Your role entails providing guidance and executing SAP digital transformation initiatives. You also conceptualize, create, improve and optimize solutions using SAP development tools and platforms. Additionally, you work alongside global teams and partners across various functions to deliver solutions. You define and update solution and technology roadmaps, and architecture documents.

  

In this role, you will design, build, and optimize high-throughput interfaces running on SAP Process Orchestration (PI/PO) and SAP BTP Integration Suite. Concurrently, you will lead the refactoring and modernization of legacy interfaces to modern APIs, event-driven pipelines, and cloud-native integration patterns, enabling seamless data flow between core SAP S/4HANA systems and broader cloud or third-party enterprise platforms.

  

Lead enterprise integration assessments, interface architecture, and migration of legacy middleware to modern cloud integration platforms. Translate complex business and functional requirements into scalable, secure, resilient, and cost-effective integration solutions. Own interface development from design through implementation and transition to operations, balancing long-term integration strategy with day-to-day stability, maintainability, and business continuity.

  

Professionals in this role author and leverage detailed technical design documentation, mapping specifications, and interface runbooks to build robust data flows across hybrid landscapes. Ensure all integration components are thoroughly documented, rigorously unit-tested, and validated for seamless end-to-end processing across connected systems. Lead interface walkthroughs and playback demonstrations with functional teams and client stakeholders. Triage, isolate, and remediate integration defects during pre-production testing cycles, cutovers, and hypercare support. Provide precise development effort estimates and guide project teams on integration patterns, BTP capabilities, and technical trade-offs.

  

Bring your deep integration engineering background to an organization modernizing enterprise application ecosystems, playing a central role in connecting critical business processes. You will collaborate alongside a global community of SAP and cloud specialists driving the future of hybrid connectivity—professionals who value knowledge sharing, technical excellence, and open collaboration.

  

**What you will do**

* **Integration & Modernization Strategy:** Lead discovery and assessment of legacy PI/PO landscapes, evaluate interface technical debt, and build migration roadmaps to transition workloads toward SAP BTP Integration Suite.
* **Architecture & Interface Governance:** Establish enterprise integration guidelines, select optimal communication patterns (hub-and-spoke, API-led, event-driven), enforce error-handling standards, and ensure interface compliance with corporate security mandates.
* **Cloud & Hybrid Integration:** Architect, develop, and tune end-to-end integration flows across SAP BTP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration/CPI, API Management, Integration Advisor, Open Connectors, Event Mesh).
* **Core SAP & Third-Party Connectivity:** Build and support mission-critical interfaces linking SAP S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba, and C/4HANA with third-party SaaS and on-premise systems (e.g., Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow).
* **Protocol, Mapping & Security Management:** Implement data transformations using Groovy Script, XSLT, and Graphical Mapping; configure enterprise security standards including OAuth 2.0, SAML, Principal Propagation, SSL/TLS, and Keystore management.
* **Technical Leadership & Delivery:** Lead client design workshops, conduct code and mapping reviews, manage cutover/go-live risks, mentor junior developers, and coordinate interface testing between functional consultants and external partner counterparts.

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a structured pathway to expand your career, from Integration Consultant to Principal Integration Architect. We provide unique opportunities to engage with hybrid architectures and hyperscaler-connected ecosystems, paired with dedicated learning resources and support to achieve professional certifications across modern SAP and cloud platforms.

You will partner with top-tier clients across a wide range of industries—from banking and retail to manufacturing and healthcare. Whether your ambition is to deepen your focus on enterprise iPaaS architectures or broaden your leadership across complex multi-cloud digital transformations, you can build that trajectory here. You will contribute to critical business initiatives, influence technology roadmaps, and cultivate relationships with diverse technical communities while mastering modern integration practices.

**Who You Are**

You bring seasoned hands-on technical proficiency in SAP integration and possess the delivery track record to back it up. Equally critical: you possess a continuous learning mindset, an analytical approach to solving complex interface issues, and a customer-first focus dedicated to operational resilience. You thrive in open, globally distributed teams and communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* **8–10+ years** of hands-on experience in SAP integration engineering, middleware architecture, and interface delivery.
* **4+ years** of dedicated design and development experience on **SAP BTP Integration Suite / Cloud Integration (CPI)** .
* Proven track record in full-lifecycle **SAP PI (7.3/7.4) and PO (7.5)** implementations, dual-stack/single-stack administration awareness, and interface remediation.
* Solid experience delivering integration architecture for **SAP S/4HANA implementation and roll-in projects** , including legacy-to-cloud migrations.
* Deep proficiency in advanced mapping techniques: **Groovy Scripting, XSLT, Graphical Mapping, Value Mapping, and Custom Functions** .
* Comprehensive expertise across standard integration protocols and data structures: **OData (V2/V4), REST, SOAP/WSDL, IDoc, RFC, EDI/EDIFACT, AS2, SFTP, AMQP, JSON, and XML** .
* Strong grasp of BTP platform connectivity, including **SAP Cloud Connector** , Destination Services, Cloud Integration Automation Framework, and multi-tenant subaccount structures.
* Solid background in integration security: certificate and key lifecycle management, **OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, mutual TLS, and Principal Propagation** .

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

title: Incident Manager
description:
**Job Title**

Incident Manager

**Job Description**

Job Description

**So, who are we?**

IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.

The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.

Join us at IG – the future gets built here.

**Your team**

As an Incident & Problem Manager at IG, you will be responsible for responding to mission-critical issues which affect IG’s financial, reputational, and regulatory standing. The role has high visibility and broad scope, allowing you to learn and become responsible for IG’s business, systems, and priorities. You will work with highly skilled teams on industry-leading technology to deliver the best outcomes for IG’s customers and stakeholders.

**Your role in the Team's Success**

Your primary responsibility will be to manage the full incident lifecycle from rapid severity assessment through to resolution and post-incident review while simultaneously driving the Problem Management process to reduce IT risk and improve service stability. By identifying root causes, managing risks in ServiceNow and Jira, and coordinating cross-functional resolver groups, you will help maintain operational excellence across IG’s mission-critical platforms.

Your role is integral to ensuring clear, timely communication reaches senior stakeholders during incidents and that lessons learned translate into lasting improvements across the function.

**What you'll do**

* Quickly assess incident severity, coordinate resolver groups, chair war rooms and major incident calls, and deliver clear, accurate communications to senior management and business stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle.
* Own Problem Management governance end-to-end ensuring problems and risks are accurately logged in ServiceNow and Jira, regularly reviewed, and progressed to resolution, mitigation, or acceptance.
* Chair regular Problem Review Meetings and drive all open problems through to closure, ensuring lessons learned from incidents are captured and acted upon to prevent reoccurrence.
* Analyse incident records to identify trends impacting IT service availability, and use these insights to recommend and deliver targeted improvements across the function.
* Liaise with Change, Release, and other ITIL process teams to ensure smooth handoffs and a coordinated approach across service management.
Produce monthly Incident and Problem Management reporting packs that demonstrate process effectiveness and support senior and regulatory stakeholder oversight.  

**What you'll need for this role**

**Key Qualification Requirements:**

* 5+ years of experience in globally dispersed, controls-driven Service Management teams, with 2+ years specifically managing Incident and/or Problem Management processes in a fast-moving CI/CD environment. Financial services experience preferred.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to manage upwards and influence without direct authority across technical, business, and regulatory audiences.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of delivering accurate, timely reporting under pressure.
* Experience in data analysis and trending, with the ability to translate incident patterns into actionable improvements and drive process efficiency.
* Calm, detail-oriented, and adaptable with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously and own issues through to full resolution.
ITIL V3 Foundation (minimum); ITIL V4 or Problem Practitioner qualification desirable, along with familiarity with ServiceNow and Jira.  

**The Perks**

It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on..

* Matched giving for your fundraising activity
* Flexible working hours and work-from-home opportunities
* Performance-related bonuses
* Insurance and medical plans
* Career-focused technical and leadership training in-class and online, incl. unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning platform
* Contribution to gym memberships and more
* Free Lunch/Snacks
* A day off on your birthday
* Two days’ volunteering leave per year.

title: Technology Director - Controllers Tech
description:
