At Wells Fargo, a Technology Director directs engineering organizations that deliver secure, resilient, and scalable technology solutions aligned with enterprise priorities. You will translate strategy into actionable roadmaps, oversee engineering practices and risk management, and align people and financial resources with delivery commitments.

**In this role, you will:**

* Manage managers and senior professionals responsible for delivering technology services, solutions, and capabilities aligned with strategic priorities
* Develop and implement technology strategies, roadmaps, and plans in partnership with business and technology leaders
* Identify and implement opportunities to improve technology capabilities, processes, service delivery, and operational effectiveness
* Provide oversight of technology solutions and services to support security, stability, availability, resilience, scalability, and business needs
* Develop and implement risk management strategies and partner with stakeholders to address technology and enterprise risk
* Direct complex technology initiatives and promote innovation and modernization to achieve business and technology objectives
* Collaborate with and influence professionals and experienced managers and interact with third-party providers, regulatory bodies, or industry groups, as applicable
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources and develop a culture of talent development aligned with business objectives

**Required Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of technology strategic leadership experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 4+ years of management or leadership experience
* 10+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including significant experience delivering Treasury and liquidity technology solutions such as cash/liquidity management, funding, capital, payments, and regulatory reporting is preferred but not essential
* Strong exposure to Finance/Controllers technology, including General Ledger, Financial Reporting, Corporate Accounting or related platforms, preferred but not essential.
* Proven track record of leading large-scale engineering teams and modernizing complex financial platforms in a highly regulated banking environment

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Proven experience leading large-scale technology and engineering organizations, portfolios, budgets and high-performing teams.
* Experience driving AI-enabled transformation, production stability, operational resilience, technology risk and controls within complex regulated environments.
* Strong ability to partner with senior business leaders, drive measurable business outcomes and communicate technology strategy, risks and priorities at an executive level.
* Skill in business analysis and business enablement to translate business needs into actionable technology requirements and outcomes
* Ability to guide platform management decisions involving reliability, lifecycle, and service considerations
* Knowledge of compliance requirements, risk controls, and cyber security management practices applicable to technology solutions
* Proven success managing projects, including plans, dependencies, risks, and delivery commitments
* Capability to develop strategy and translate priorities into technology roadmaps and execution plans
* Effective stakeholder relationship management across business and technology partners

**Job Expectations:**

* This role will be a part of Finance technology, focused on controllers' technology area. Functionally responsible for external financial reporting, corporate accounting, general ledger.
* Relevant experience in this area will be preferred but not essential.
* Accountable for delivering business and regulatory outcomes through a resilient, well-controlled, modern and increasingly AI-enabled technology organization.
* Serves as a strategic technology partner to Controllers leadership, owns execution and health of the technology portfolio, drives engineering and architecture excellence, and ensures strong production stability and risk management.

* Ability to manage large teams and financial management, development of strong engineering and leadership talent, effective enterprise collaboration, and transparent executive communication.
* Success is measured not only by commitments delivered, but by business outcomes achieved, risk reduced, technology simplified, production health improved, delivery speed increased, and organizational capability strengthened.

description:

**Position Overview**
---------------------

We are looking for an experienced Solution Engineer to join our Managed Services team here at Vendavo.

As a Solution Engineer for Vendavo's Enterprise Pricing Platform (EPP), you will configure, implement, and customize the EPP platform for enterprise clients. You'll translate business pricing requirements into technical solutions — building pricing waterfalls, configuring workflows, authoring analytics, and integrating with ERP systems - to our clients from among the Global 2000 around the world.

* Opportunity to learn about the pricing domain, business, and pricing strategies of leading companies.
* Full responsibility for the solution design and implementation.
* Substantial personal autonomy and individual responsibility.
* Measurable value for the client on every single project we deliver.
* Use of an Agile methodology.

**We are looking for a team member who**

* Is open to learning the pricing domain and understanding the business and needs of our customers
* Is curious and willing to solve challenges
* Understands application development life cycle. (Development, testing, UAT etc.)
* Is a real team player – shares experiences, helps, listens and proactive

* Knows OOP (good knowledge of some object-oriented programming language),
* Knows XML, scripting language (e.g.: JavaScript)

You will gather or deepen your knowledge of the following technologies (only major items are listed)

* Java, Gradle, Groovy, VSL (proprietary scripting language), WIT (test automation framework), SQL, etc.
* Oracle Enterprise, Jetty, Spring Boot, proprietary in-memory analytic engine (Pricemart)

* IntelliJ IDEA

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:
Join our global team for a career filled with opportunities to solve challenges both small and large, local and global, simple and complex.
  
  
**Wilhelmsen Ship Management**
is a third-party ship manager providing a wide range of maritime services worldwide. With a strong workforce of shore-based employees and seafarers, we operate one of the world's largest maritime networks across more than 70 countries.
  
  
**Wilhelmsen Ship Management Chennai**
is looking for a
**Technical Support Engineer (PMS)**
to join the
**Global PMS Support Team**
. This role combines Planned Maintenance System (PMS) technical support and PMS database project activities, requiring close interaction with vessel personnel, Technical Managers, Fleet Managers, and other stakeholders.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for providing PMS support to vessels, maintaining PMS technical data, supporting database improvement initiatives, and ensuring accuracy and quality of PMS spare parts data. The role requires excellent communication skills, strong customer service orientation, and the ability to work effectively with both vessel and shore-based stakeholders.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**

* Provide first-line technical support for the Planned Maintenance System (PMS), responding to vessel and stakeholder queries in a timely and professional manner.
* Liaise with vessel crews, Technical Managers, Fleet Managers, and other stakeholders to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve PMS-related issues.
* Maintain and update PMS databases, including equipment hierarchies, maintenance tasks, spare parts records, and technical documentation in accordance with company standards.
* Review maker's manuals, drawings, and technical documents to extract, validate, and standardize spare parts, component, and maintenance information.
* Perform quality assurance and data validation activities to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency of PMS data.
* Support PMS database Projects, migration, standardization, and continuous improvement across the fleet.
* Execute bulk data updates, cleaning, and verification activities to maintain high data quality standards.
* Prepare reports, analyze PMS data, and provide insights using Microsoft Excel and other reporting tools.
* Contribute to process improvement initiatives and special PMS-related projects.
* Deliver a high level of customer service while supporting vessels and internal stakeholders.
* Support team objectives and undertake additional responsibilities assigned by the Team Lead.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in marine engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in PMS support, maintenance planning, PMS database building, or related technical functions.
* Experience in PMS data management and technical support for vessels or maritime operations is preferred.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including formulas, lookups, filtering, data analysis, and reporting.
* Basic knowledge of SQL is desirable.
* Good understanding of vessel equipment, maintenance practices, and technical documentation.
* Experience in spare parts extraction, data standardization, and quality assurance activities.
* Knowledge of PMS component structure and maintenance job extraction from maker's manuals is an advantage.
* Previous onboard sailing experience will be considered an added benefit.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication abilities.
* Effective stakeholder management and customer service orientation.
* High attention to detail with a focus on quality and accuracy.
* Proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented approach.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.

title: Advertising Representative
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – ADVERTISING REPRESENTATIVE

**(Performance Marketing & Social Media Management)**

**Company:**
Digenie – Digital Marketing Division of Spice N Oil, Chokkar Group of Companies

**Location:**
Egmore, Chennai (Monday - Saturday, 09:30 AM to 07:00 PM)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Experience:**
0–3 Years (Freshers with strong practical knowledge and demonstrable skills may apply)

About the Role

We are looking for a creative, analytical and result-oriented Advertising Representative specialising in Performance Marketing and Social Media Management. The candidate will be responsible for planning, executing, managing and optimising digital advertising campaigns while overseeing the social media presence of multiple client brands across different industries.

The role requires a combination of creative thinking, marketing strategy, advertising platform expertise, data analysis and communication skills. The candidate must understand how to convert marketing budgets into measurable business outcomes such as reach, engagement, leads, app installs, website traffic, enquiries, sales and conversions.

Key Responsibilities1. Performance Marketing & Paid Advertising

* Plan, execute, manage and optimise paid advertising campaigns across Meta Ads (Facebook and Instagram), Google Ads, YouTube, LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
* Develop campaign strategies based on client objectives, target audiences, budgets and expected outcomes.
* Set up and manage campaigns, ad sets, advertisements, objectives, placements, bidding strategies, budgets and schedules.
* Manage lead generation, website traffic, engagement, reach, app promotion, sales and conversion campaigns.
* Conduct audience research, segmentation, targeting, retargeting and lookalike audience development.
* Implement A/B testing for creatives, ad copies, headlines, audiences, placements and landing pages.
* Monitor and optimise CPM, CPC, CTR, CPL, CPA, CAC, ROAS, conversion rates and other campaign KPIs.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and implement corrective actions to improve results.
* Manage daily and monthly advertising budgets, pacing, allocation and performance.
* Plan remarketing and funnel-based campaigns targeting awareness, consideration, acquisition and retention.
* Coordinate with clients and internal teams to understand business objectives and generate qualified leads and conversions.

2. Social Media Management

* Manage social media accounts across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, X and other relevant platforms.
* Develop monthly and weekly content calendars aligned with brand objectives, campaigns and marketing trends.
* Plan and manage content across static posts, carousels, stories, reels, videos, shorts, polls and other formats.
* Write captions, headlines, hooks, descriptions, hashtags, calls to action and platform-specific content.
* Schedule and publish content while maintaining consistency in brand voice, visual identity and communication.
* Research trends, trending audio, competitor activities, industry developments and relevant content opportunities.
* Monitor comments, direct messages, mentions, reviews and audience interactions.
* Coordinate community management and ensure timely responses or escalation of customer queries.
* Track account growth, reach, impressions, engagement, profile visits, link clicks and follower demographics.
* Identify opportunities to improve organic reach, engagement, brand awareness and audience growth.

3. Marketing Strategy & Campaign Planning

* Understand client businesses, products, services, target audiences, competitors and market positioning.
* Develop digital marketing strategies based on business goals and available budgets.
* Plan integrated campaigns combining organic social media, paid advertising, influencer marketing and content marketing.
* Develop customer personas, audience segments, marketing funnels and campaign messaging.
* Research competitor advertising strategies, creatives, offers, positioning and digital presence.
* Identify relevant seasonal opportunities, festivals, events, launches and promotional campaigns.
* Recommend campaign improvements, new platforms, marketing opportunities and budget allocations.
* Prepare campaign briefs and coordinate with creative, content, video editing and design teams.

4. Tracking, Analytics & Reporting

* Set up, monitor and analyse campaign tracking using Meta Pixel, Conversions API, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager and UTM parameters.
* Understand website traffic, landing-page performance, user behaviour, conversion journeys and attribution.
* Coordinate tracking and event implementation for website leads, purchases, registrations and app installs.
* Analyse Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, GA4 and platform-specific analytics.
* Monitor campaign performance against defined objectives and KPIs.
* Prepare weekly and monthly performance reports with meaningful insights, not just numerical data.
* Identify bottlenecks in the marketing funnel and recommend actionable improvements.
* Maintain campaign records, budgets, lead reports, performance dashboards and client updates.
* Understand attribution limitations and distinguish between clicks, leads, qualified leads and actual conversions.

5. Creative & Content Coordination

* Work closely with graphic designers, motion graphic specialists, photographers, videographers and content writers.
* Develop creative briefs for advertisements, reels, carousels, banners, landing pages and promotional campaigns.
* Suggest creative concepts, hooks, scripts, headlines, visual directions and calls to action.
* Evaluate advertising creatives based on performance and recommend variations.
* Understand platform-specific creative requirements, aspect ratios, formats and advertising policies.
* Coordinate revisions and ensure creatives are delivered within campaign timelines.
* Use AI-assisted tools for research, content ideation, copywriting and creative development where appropriate.

6. Lead Generation & Conversion Optimisation

* Develop lead generation strategies using instant forms, landing pages, websites, WhatsApp and other conversion channels.
* Monitor lead quality, cost per lead, lead volume and conversion rates.
* Coordinate with sales teams or clients to understand lead quality and follow-up outcomes.
* Recommend improvements to landing pages, forms, calls to action and conversion journeys.
* Analyse lead drop-offs and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates.
* Maintain lead tracking and campaign-level performance records.

7. Client & Internal Team Coordination

* Understand client requirements and translate them into practical marketing plans.
* Coordinate with clients for approvals, campaign information, offers, assets and reporting.
* Communicate campaign progress, performance, challenges and recommendations.
* Work with internal creative and account management teams to ensure timely execution.
* Manage multiple client accounts and campaigns simultaneously.
* Ensure deadlines, deliverables and campaign objectives are met.

Required Skills & Technical Knowledge

* Practical knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Facebook/Instagram advertising.
* Working knowledge of Google Ads, including Search, Display, YouTube and Performance Max.
* Knowledge of LinkedIn advertising and other digital advertising platforms is an advantage.
* Understanding of targeting, retargeting, bidding, budget allocation and campaign optimisation.
* Knowledge of GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Conversions API and UTM tracking.
* Strong understanding of marketing funnels, lead generation and conversion optimisation.
* Knowledge of social media algorithms, platform analytics and content strategies.
* Excellent copywriting, caption writing and advertising communication skills.
* Ability to interpret marketing data, identify trends and make data-driven decisions.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for campaign tracking and reporting.

Performance Expectations & KPIs

The candidate will be evaluated based on:

* Campaign performance against agreed objectives and budgets.
* Lead volume, lead quality, CPL, CPA, CAC and ROAS, wherever applicable.
* Improvement in CTR, CPC, CPM and conversion rates.
* Social media reach, engagement, profile growth and content performance.
* Accuracy of tracking, analytics and reporting.
* Quality of campaign strategy, audience targeting and creative recommendations.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and meet deadlines.
* Proactive identification of opportunities and optimisation of underperforming campaigns.
* Client communication, accountability and coordination with internal teams.

Performance will be assessed based on the objectives and budgets of individual campaigns. Candidates must understand that advertising results depend on factors including budget, competition, product-market fit, creative quality, audience, pricing and client-side conversion processes.

Educational Qualification & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Advertising or a related field preferred.
* Freshers with strong practical knowledge, relevant certifications, personal projects or demonstrable campaign experience may also apply.
* Candidates must be able to demonstrate their understanding through a practical assessment.

Assessment & Selection Process

* All applicants must complete a practical assessment before the interview.
* The assessment may include campaign planning, audience targeting, advertising strategy, budget allocation, ad copywriting, social media content planning and performance analysis.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who can think like a marketer, work like a performance analyst and execute like a social media manager. The ideal candidate should not simply know how to boost posts or publish content. They must understand why a campaign is being run, who it is targeting, how much it should cost, what results it should generate and how to improve those results.

**The candidate must be comfortable taking ownership of campaigns from planning and execution to optimisation, reporting and measurable outcomes.**

title: Videographer & Editor
description:
**About Us**

**Tiger Food Ingredients Private Limited is a Chennai-based FMCG company that makes food ingredients across three manufacturing units, with high standards of quality and food safety. We have an established presence in South India across retail stores and online platforms. We are growing fast and building a team that takes pride in quality, discipline and speed.**

**The Role**

**You will be the person who makes our food look irresistible on screen. You will plan, shoot and edit the videos and photos that build our brand on Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and e-commerce platforms. That covers recipe reels and product launches as well as behind-the-scenes content from our factories. You will own content from idea to final export, working closely with the Marketing Manager, the graphic designer and the e-commerce executive.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Shooting**

* Plan and shoot product, recipe, how-to, factory, event and team videos and photos, using a shot list for every shoot.
* Style and light food so it looks fresh, colourful and appetising: close-ups, pours, sizzles and slow-motion.
* Shoot behind-the-scenes content at our factories while following hygiene, GMP and safety rules on the shop floor.
* Shoot product photos for e-commerce listings, catalogues and social media.

**2. Editing & Post-production**

* Edit reels, Shorts, ads and longer videos in platform-ready formats (9:16, 1:1, 16:9) for Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and e-commerce pages.
* Add motion graphics, captions and subtitles (English and Tamil), music, sound clean-up and colour grading.
* Use only licensed or copyright-free music and footage.
* Deliver final files on time, correctly named and in the right sizes for each platform.

**3. Content Planning & Performance**

* Plan the monthly content calendar with the marketing team, covering campaigns, festivals, product launches and trends.
* Bring fresh ideas: recipe hacks, trending formats, chef and creator collaborations, and regional-language content.
* Track views, watch time, retention and engagement; double down on what works and drop what doesn’t.

**4. Equipment & Media Library**

* Manage and maintain camera, lens, lighting, gimbal and audio equipment.
* Keep an organised, searchable library of raw footage, final edits and brand assets, backed up regularly.
* Collect signed consent from anyone featured in our videos.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* 4–5 quality reels or short videos delivered every week, plus at least 1 longer video every month
* Monthly growth in video views, watch time, average retention and engagement
* 100% on-time delivery for campaigns and product launches
* Product photos delivered within agreed timelines for e-commerce and catalogues
* A clean, backed-up and searchable media library

**What You Bring**

* Around 1 year of videography and editing experience. Food, FMCG or lifestyle content is a big plus.
* Hands-on skill with Adobe Premiere Pro and/or Final Cut Pro; After Effects, Lightroom or DaVinci Resolve is a plus
* Confident with DSLR / mirrorless cameras, gimbals, lighting and mobile shooting
* A strong eye for framing, lighting, food styling and current reel trends
* Understanding of what makes content work on Instagram and YouTube: hooks, pacing, captions
* Good communication in Tamil and English
* A showreel or portfolio link (mandatory)

**Your First 90 Days**

* **Month 1:**
  Learn our brands and products, set up the media library, and deliver your first reels.
* **Month 2:**
  Own the weekly content calendar and run product and recipe shoots on your own.
* **Month 3:**
  Lead a campaign or launch video end to end and report on its performance.

**Why Join Us**

* Creative ownership of a growing food brand’s video content
* Variety: shoots across our factories, kitchens, markets and events
* Your work seen by thousands of customers across South India
* A collaborative in-house creative team that moves fast
* Competitive salary

**How to Apply**

**Apply through LinkedIn, or email your CV with your showreel link to**
jobs@tigerfoodsindia.com with the subject “Application – Videographer & Editor – [Your Name]”. Please include your current CTC, expected CTC and notice period.

Tiger Food Ingredients is an equal opportunity employer.

****Job Description****
The IT Application Support Analyst role is responsible for the end-to-end investigation and resolution of ERP incidents requiring deeper functional or technical expertise, including root-cause analysis, integration troubleshooting, solution validation, documentation, and effective escalation to Level 3 when required.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities/Areas Of Accountability****
**Incident investigation and resolution**

* Analyze ERP incidents escalated from Level 1.
* Identify root causes and provide functional or technical solutions/workarounds.
* Reproduce issues and distinguish between configuration, master data, integration, application, and infrastructure problems.

**Functional support**

* Provide expertise across assigned ERP modules and business processes.
* Troubleshoot transactional errors and incorrect system behavior.
* Assist users with complex process or application-related questions.

**Integration troubleshooting**

* Investigate failures between the ERP and connected applications.
* Analyze interfaces, error messages, batch jobs, queues, and data flows.
* Coordinate resolution with other application/support teams when the problem crosses system boundaries.

**Escalation to Level 3**

* Determine when an issue requires development, product expertise, infrastructure changes, or vendor intervention.
* Provide Level 3 with a complete analysis, including reproduction steps, logs, examples, expected versus actual results, and business impact.
* Validate the solution after Level 3 implementation.

**Problem management and root-cause analysis**

* Identify recurring incidents and underlying systemic problems.
* Lead or contribute to root-cause analysis.
* Recommend permanent corrective and preventive actions.

**Change and release support**

* Assess the impact of fixes, configuration changes, and ERP updates.
* Perform functional/system testing and coordinate business validation when appropriate.
* Support deployments and post-deployment verification.

**Monitoring and operational support**

* Monitor critical ERP processes, scheduled jobs, integrations, and interfaces.
* Investigate failures proactively where monitoring is available.
* Ensure critical business processes are restored within agreed service levels.

**Ticket and SLA management**

* Own assigned incidents through resolution rather than simply forwarding them.
* Prioritize according to severity and business impact.
* Maintain clear, accurate ticket documentation and regular communication with users.

**Knowledge management**

* Document solutions, known errors, troubleshooting procedures, and recurring issues.
* Create knowledge articles that enable Level 1 to resolve more incidents independently.
* Share knowledge with other ERP support team members.

**Business and IT coordination**

* Act as a bridge between business users and technical teams.
* Translate business symptoms into technical/functional requirements for specialists.
* Communicate technical findings in language understandable to business stakeholders.

****CRITICAL CAPABILITIES****

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* ERP Functional Expertise
* Strong understanding of core ERP processes and assigned functional areas (BaanIV, Infor LN, or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012).
* Ability to understand how transactions flow across modules.
* Ability to distinguish process, configuration, master-data, and system issues.

**Advanced Troubleshooting & Root-Cause Analysis**

* Systematic investigation of complex incidents.
* Identify symptom vs. root cause.
* Analyze application errors, logs, jobs, interfaces, and transaction history.
* Develop and validate workarounds when immediate resolution is unavailable.

**Integration & End-to-End Process Understanding**

* Understand ERP interfaces with upstream and downstream applications.
* Trace transactions across systems.
* Determine where a failure occurred and which team/application owns it.
* Understand dependencies between ERP, middleware, databases, reporting, and external systems.

**Incident Ownership & Prioritization**

* Take ownership from escalation through resolution.
* Assess business impact, urgency, and priority.
* Drive resolution across multiple technical or functional teams.
* Maintain clear communication with impacted users and stakeholders.

**Technical Analysis**

* Ability to investigate application logs, batch processes, queues, interfaces, and error messages.
* Basic understanding of databases and data structures.
* Ability to perform data analysis and queries where appropriate.
* Understand enough of the ERP technical architecture to engage effectively with developers and infrastructure teams.

****Requirements****

* EDUCATION: Bachelor's Degree/College Diploma in a technical discipline (Engineering or IT related)
* EXPERIENCE: 3+ years of experience as an ERP application support or ERP analyst preferred.
* 3+ years of process improvement, data, or technology project experience would be a strong asset.
* 2+ years of experience working with BaanIV, Infor LN or Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012.

**Job Description**
**Job Description:**

* The team member is responsible for ensuring accounts impacted by bankruptcy are handled in strict compliance with applicable laws and regulations. This role involves reviewing and processing bankruptcy notifications, and updates, received from approved vendors or mail, coding accounts as bankrupt in the appropriate system of record, and excluding them from collection activities to prevent violations of the automatic stay.
* The Associate researches and resolves match criteria exclusions, manages manual coding for exceptions, and monitors joint filings and community property cases. Additional duties include quality assurance reviews, maintaining accurate documentation, collaborating with attorneys and account holders, and supporting compliance through regular training and adherence to procedural controls.
* The position covers a range of consumer and small business products, including credit cards, lines of credit, and installment loans. Strong attention to detail, excellent Microsoft suite skills, ability to complete complex tasks with minimal oversight and critical thinking skills.
* Experienced paralegal responsible for legal research, preparation of legal documents, file management and other assigned or routine tasks. Works under direct supervision using established principles, practices and procedures. Ability to determine and use appropriate internal and external resources.

**Role Responsibilities:**

* Proofs of Claim are legal documents submitted to bankruptcy courts to assert the bank’s claim for amounts owed. Filing must meet strict court deadlines (“Bar Dates”).
* Not all accounts require a POC. Automated and manual reviews ensure only eligible, compliant claims are filed (e.g., not out-of-statute, not low-value, not fees/interest only).
* Every POC undergoes multi-level review—first by the preparer, then by an approved designee, with checklists and system controls to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* Claims are filed electronically (ECF/PACER) or manually, depending on court requirements. Special handling is required for certain jurisdictions and product types.
* Claims can be amended or withdrawn for valid reasons (e.g., errors, payments, jurisdictional issues), but require management/designee approval.

**Competencies:**

* Bankruptcy Regulatory Compliance
* Account Review and Judgment
* Attention to Detail and Accuracy
* Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving
* Risk Identification and Mitigation
* Quality Assurance and Control Execution
* Independent Execution and Accountability

* Bankruptcy account coding and collection exclusion, Bankruptcy notification review and processing.
* Automatic stay compliance.

* Manual coding and exception processing.
* Joint filing and community property case management.
* Quality assurance review and control validation.
* Account documentation and audit-ready recordkeeping.
* Microsoft 365 proficiency.
* Complex task management and stakeholder communication

title: Lead Assessor – Signalling
description:
**About Us**
We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.
  
  
As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Purpose of the Role :**
The Lead Independent Safety Assessment (ISA) Assessor has the overall authority and responsibility to ensure that all Safety assessment activities under a project are correctly prepared, executed and reported.
  
  
The role provides impartial technical judgement on whether safety requirements have been adequately defined, implemented, verified, and justified. Assessing whether risks have been demonstrated to have been reduced to an acceptable level.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead independent safety assessments for railway systems, including signaling, control command, rolling stock, infrastructure, and system integration projects.
* Review and assess safety documentation, including Safety Cases, Hazard Logs, risk assessments, system safety plans, verification and validation evidence, test reports, and assurance arguments.
* Assess compliance with applicable railway safety standards and regulations, including EN 50126, EN 50128 (EN50716), EN 50129 and other project-specific requirements.
* Provide independent technical opinions on the adequacy of safety requirements, risk controls, safety evidence, and residual risk acceptance.
* Plan, manage, and coordinate ISA activities across the project lifecycle, including assessment planning, document review, audits, inspections, test witnessing, findings management, and final reporting.
* Act as the primary technical interface with clients, project teams, design authorities, validators, certification bodies, and regulatory stakeholders.
* Lead multidisciplinary assessment teams, allocate tasks, review outputs, and ensure consistency, quality, and independence of assessment conclusions.
* Identify safety-related issues, observations, and non-compliances, and provide clear recommendations to support timely resolution.
* Prepare high-quality ISA plans, interim assessment reports, findings logs, technical notes, and final ISA reports.
* Maintain impartiality and independence from design, delivery, and implementation activities in accordance with applicable accreditation and governance requirements.

What we offer
  
  
DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.
  
  
**About You**
**Required Qualification and Experience:**

* Bachelors degree in engineering, systems engineering or safety engineering discipline.
* Minimum of 10 years of experience in railways, metros, or trams.
* Specific experience in developing or assessing complex railway signalling systems.
* Minimum 5 years railway safety assurance, independent safety assessment, systems assurance, certification, verification and validation, or safety-critical engineering.
* Demonstrable experience applying railway safety standards, particularly CENELEC standards EN 50126, EN 50128 (EN 50716), and EN 50129, including RAMS (Reliability, Availability, Maintainability, and Safety) specifications and demonstrations. Leading assessment activities for at least 3 complex rail projects, including multidisciplinary systems and interfaces.
* Deep understanding of hazard identification, risk analysis, safety integrity levels, safety requirements management, assurance cases, and lifecycle safety processes.
* Experience engaging with clients, suppliers, infrastructure managers, operators, notified bodies, designated bodies, assessment bodies, and national safety authorities.
* Professional registration, chartered engineer status, or recognized safety/assurance certification is desirable.

**Key Skills And Competencies**

* Strong understanding of the processes and potential defects related to the lifecycle of the railway’s products
* Knowledge and understanding of risk management, systems engineering and human/organizational factors for the subsystems within scope of assessment
* Knowledge and understanding of the interfaces related to interoperability and safe integration
* Understanding of the risk derived or likely to be derived from the integration of the product into the railway system
* Ability to perform sound robust judgement on any deviation of the product under assessment
* Strong technical judgement and the ability to form clear, evidence-based independent conclusions.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to produce concise, defensible, and audit-ready assessment reports.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and confidence engaging with senior technical, project, and regulatory stakeholders.
* Ability to lead teams, manage priorities, and deliver assessment outputs within agreed scope, schedule, and budget.
* High attention to detail, analytical thinking, and a structured approach to reviewing complex safety evidence.
* Commitment to professional integrity, impartiality, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

*Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.*

title: Tamil Expert with Mathematical Background
description:
In this hourly, remote contractor role, you will work as a Tamil Language Specialist (SME) to review AI-generated Tamil content and/or create high-quality Tamil reference content, evaluating language quality and step-by-step reasoning while providing precise written feedback. You will assess outputs for accuracy, fluency, grammar, spelling, tone, cultural appropriateness, and adherence to the prompt; identify errors in meaning, mistranslation, register (formal vs informal), ambiguity, and logical consistency; fact-check claims when needed; write high-quality rewrites and model answers that demonstrate best practices in Tamil writing; and rate and compare multiple AI responses based on correctness and overall quality.
  
  
This role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI Data Services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate, delivering training data for many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation-model labs. Your Tamil expertise directly helps improve the world’s premier AI models by making their Tamil language output more natural, reliable, culturally accurate, and clearly written.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop AI Training Content: Create prompts and gold-standard Tamil answers across multiple domains (general knowledge, customer support, education, conversational writing).
* Optimize AI Performance: Evaluate and rank AI outputs to improve fluency, correctness, tone match, and cultural appropriateness.
* Ensure Model Integrity: Detect unsafe or misleading content, factual hallucinations, bias, and policy-risk language; validate reliability across use cases.

**Your Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Mathematics
* Native or near-native Tamil proficiency (reading and writing required).
* Strong professional proficiency in English (minimum C1) to follow guidelines and provide detailed feedback in English.
* 3+ years of professional experience in writing, editing, localization, translation, content QA, journalism, education, or related language-focused work.
* Deep understanding of Tamil grammar, spelling conventions, punctuation, and style—able to explain why something is wrong and how to fix it.
* Comfortable handling multiple registers (formal/informal), Tamil used in India vs Sri Lanka vs diaspora contexts, and audience adaptation as required.
* High attention to detail when spotting subtle meaning shifts, awkward literal translations, hallucinated claims, or culturally mismatched phrasing.
* Reliable, self-directed, and able to deliver consistent quality in an hourly, remote contractor workflow across time zones.
* Prior experience with AI data training/annotation, translation QA, editorial QA, or rubric-based evaluation is strongly preferred.

title: L2/L3 Application Support Engineer - Informatica IDMC & OMS
description:
Job Location: Cebu City, Chennai, Pune, Taguig City, Taguig City
  
  
Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country
  
  
Req Id: 13430
  
  
Posting Start Date: 11/6/26
  
  
At Fujitsu, we've been driven to create a sustainable world through innovation since 1935. Today, we lead in digital transformation globally with our 130,000 employees across 50+ countries. We empower our diverse community to achieve greatness through career development and opportunities. Explore our internal positions and join us in shaping a brighter future. Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future.
  
  

* Position purpose

Provide second- and third-level support for the Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) integration platform and the OMS operational data store. These underpin municipal and commercial collection services, resident-facing booking portals and council integrations. The engineer owns incidents end to end, monitors daily integration processing, reconciles job and work-order data across ERP, fleet, OMS and council systems, and delivers minor changes and council onboardings through Cleanaway change control.
  
  

* Key accountabilities

Incident management and service restoration
  
  

* Own assigned ServiceNow incidents from acceptance through resolution, including impact assessment, stakeholder updates and accurate resolution notes.
* Diagnose and resolve failed taskflows and mappings, Secure Agent and connection failures, SFTP and API errors, file and payload format errors, and authentication failures.
* Restore resident-facing portals and dependent services during outages, including database blocking, log growth and hosting VM issues, coordinating with Infrastructure and DBA teams.
* Reprocess or resend council, ERP and partner files and messages using documented, authorised procedures.
* Lead or support major incident response, service restoration and post-incident review for integration outages.

Monitoring and operational health
  
  

* Perform daily monitoring of IDMC jobs, the Application Integration console, infrastructure alerts (e.g. PRTG) and exception mailboxes. Triage, action and record exceptions.
* Follow up daily operational exception reports, such as jobs completed without mandatory driver data or vehicles not assigned, so that invoicing and council reporting stay accurate.
* Validate integrations after monthly ERP (JDE) and IDMC patching and after platform upgrades, including impact analysis before upgrades.

Integration operations and data reconciliation
  
  

* Investigate missing, delayed, duplicated or inconsistent records across JDE, fleet and job-dispatch systems (e.g. Verizon Connect, Echo), OMS and council systems.
* Reconcile work-order and job status across systems after outages or sync gaps. Close or correct records under business approval and confirm closure status to councils.
* Investigate data flows from HR, safety and compliance systems into downstream staging and reporting, and correct staging data on authorised request.
* Produce scheduled and ad hoc extracts and operational KPI reports (e.g. monthly integration performance and booking extracts) on time.

Service requests and configuration
  
  

* Fulfil authorised OMS configuration and data requests: service frequency codes, booking limits and entitlements, portal calendars and seasonal opening, exception-report maintenance and status resends.
* Run calendar-driven operations such as annual entitlement resets, month-end finance file loads and monthly credential rotations for messaging services.
* Manage user and service access within IDMC and OMS in line with security approvals and audit requirements.

Platform administration
  
  

* Administer the IDMC org, Secure Agent hosts, connections and runtime environments, including authentication modernisation and licence and subscription coordination with Informatica.

Change, release and enhancement
  
  

* Design, build, test and deploy minor changes and enhancements to IDMC assets and OMS objects, including new council onboardings and integration changes (SFTP, REST/SOAP, OAuth).
* Prepare change records, test evidence, deployment and rollback plans for CAB. Execute production deployments and cutover tasks.
* Take delivered project components (e.g. fleet-system migration and HR-system replacement integrations) into BAU through hypercare and documented handover.

Problem management and knowledge
  
  

* Raise and progress problem records for recurring failures such as portal outages, sync gaps and high-volume manual corrections, and propose permanent fixes or automation.
* Maintain runbooks, interface documentation, a business-rules register, knowledge articles and the credential and certificate expiry register.
* Maintain the contact and escalation matrix for councils, ERP and fleet vendors, Informatica support and internal business teams.
* Participate in knowledge transfer from the incumbent provider, demonstrate independent handling of common support scenarios, and transfer knowledge to new team members.

Security and compliance
  
  

* Use privileged and production access only through the approved access process (e.g. CyberArk), on a least-privilege basis and for authorised tasks.
* Never record passwords, tokens or other secrets in tickets, email or documents. Store and hand over credentials only through the approved vault.
* Handle customer, employee and payroll personal information in line with the Privacy Act and Cleanaway data classification, including compliant incident records and escalation of potential data breaches.
* Maintain segregation of duties: perform data corrections, approvals and production changes only with documented business or change approval, and keep an audit trail.
* Role boundaries

L2/L3 accountability
  
  

* Own operational investigation, incident coordination, monitoring, documented recovery, reconciliation and minor change delivery for IDMC and OMS.
* Retain ServiceNow ownership and stakeholder communication when a vendor, Infrastructure or DBA team performs specialist remediation.

Outside delegated authority
  
  

* Solution architecture and major redesign, such as OMS or Informatica replacement and new digital-channel platforms. The engineer contributes but does not lead.
* Business decisions on council contracts, entitlement rules, service pricing, master-data ownership or approval of data corrections.
* Server, operating system, database backup and patching operations owned by Infrastructure and DBA teams.
* Skills and experience

**Essential**

* Demonstrated enterprise production support and development experience with Informatica IDMC/IICS: taskflows, mappings, Secure Agent, connections and Application Integration.
* Strong SQL Server and T-SQL skills for diagnosis, reconciliation and data correction in an operational data store.
* Experience with file and API integrations: SFTP, REST/SOAP, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0 and API testing tools (e.g. Postman, SoapUI).
* ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change and request practice using ServiceNow or equivalent.
* Clear written and verbal communication with business operations, councils, vendors and IT teams, including during time-critical incidents.

Desirable
  
  

* Experience with ERP (JD Edwards) and fleet telematics or job-dispatch integrations.
* Waste, municipal services, logistics or field operations domain experience.
* Azure Application Insights, infrastructure monitoring tools (e.g. PRTG) and Windows server troubleshooting.
* Informatica Cloud Data Integration certification, ITIL 4 Foundation, AZ-900.
* Band expectations

**Senior / Lead:**
Technical escalation point for the platform. Leads major incident recovery, council onboarding design and change, platform administration and upgrades, problem management and vendor escalation. Reviews and approves runbooks.
  
  
**Mid:**
Daily monitoring, exception follow-up, service requests and OMS configuration, reconciliation under runbook, standard reprocessing, and changes under senior review.
  
  

* Key relationships

**OMS business support and operational teams:**
Issue validation, business impact, data-correction approval and recovery confirmation
  
  
**Councils and partner organisations:**
Council integrations, file and API contracts, firewall and connectivity testing
  
  
**ERP, fleet and SaaS vendors (e.g. DXC for JDE, Verizon Connect, Informatica):**
Vendor escalation, platform cases and coordinated fixes
  
  
**Service Desk / L1:**
Intake, initial triage, shift-left knowledge articles and incident escalation
  
  
**Technical Platform Owner / Principal Analyst:**
Platform priorities, risks, technical governance and acceptance
  
  
**Change and release management:**
CAB approval, controlled releases and production validation
  
  
**Infrastructure, DBA and Cyber Security teams:**
Servers, databases, privileged access, certificates and security approvals
  
  

* Performance measures
* Incident response and resolution against agreed service levels and business-critical processing windows.
* Completion and effectiveness of proactive monitoring, exception detection and recovery.
* Service request timeliness and first-time-right fulfilment.
* Changes delivered successfully through change control, without unplanned outage or rollback.
* Reduction in repeat incidents through problem records, root cause analysis and permanent fixes.
* Accuracy and currency of runbooks, knowledge articles, ServiceNow resolution notes and operational documentation.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and timely communication during incidents and changes.
* Timeliness of calendar-driven operations: month-end, monthly reports and annual entitlement resets.
* Transition readiness (by 21 December 2026)

Independence criteria Fujitsu must demonstrate before taking over from the incumbent provider. Remove this section after transition acceptance.
  
  

* Restore at least one real or simulated portal outage and at least two integration failures without incumbent assistance.
* Deliver at least one council integration change end to end through change control before the Christmas change freeze.
* Reconciliation runbook signed off by the OMS business support team.
* Daily monitoring checklists written. Alert and exception distribution lists repointed to Fujitsu groups.
* A knowledge article for each service request type, with at least 90% first-time-right fulfilment.
* Two monthly reporting cycles delivered on time. Problem records with RCA drafted for recurring failures.
* Incident SLAs met for four consecutive weeks.
* Working arrangements and cross-cover

Provide coverage of Australian business hours (AEST/AEDT) through agreed shift patterns, including the Australian morning window. Participate in a rostered on-call arrangement outside business hours, including weekends, for incidents and business-critical processing windows (e.g. portal outages, council file deadlines, month-end and annual entitlement resets), and in planned after-hours changes and maintenance. All operational activities must follow approved procedures, access controls, Cleanaway change governance and delegated authority.
  
  
**Cross-cover:**
Senior and mid engineers provide mutual primary and secondary cover across all IDMC and OMS services. Secondary cover with Azure Integration Services for shared Application Insights diagnosis and integration triage.
  
  
Relocation Supported: No
  
  
Visa Sponsorship Approved: No
  
  
At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.

title: Senior Scrum Master
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and collaborative
**Senior Scrum Master**
to join the
**Customer & Campaign Readiness Product Team**
. This role serves as an Agile leader, coach, and facilitator responsible for enabling high-performing teams and driving successful delivery of business outcomes. The Senior Scrum Master will champion Agile and SAFe principles, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and help teams deliver value efficiently and predictably.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong Agile delivery expertise, servant leadership, and coaching skills with experience supporting cross-functional teams in complex enterprise environments. This individual will partner with Product Managers, Product Owners, business stakeholders, architects, and development teams to improve team effectiveness, optimize delivery processes, and support the successful execution of product roadmaps.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
  

* Lead and facilitate Agile ceremonies including Daily Standups, Sprint Planning, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Team Demos.
* Coach teams on Agile and SAFe principles, practices, and behaviors to improve team maturity, effectiveness, and delivery predictability.
* Support SAFe events including PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums, ART Syncs, System Demos, and Inspect & Adapt workshops.
* Partner with Product Owners and Product Managers to ensure backlog readiness, prioritization alignment, and successful execution of product objectives.
* Remove impediments and proactively identify risks, dependencies, and blockers that may impact delivery timelines or business outcomes.
* Facilitate collaboration across business, technology, and vendor teams to ensure alignment and effective communication.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives through retrospectives, Agile metrics, and team health assessments.
* Monitor and communicate team progress, delivery performance, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders and leadership.
* Promote transparency and data-driven decision making through the use of Agile metrics, including velocity, predictability, cycle time, throughput, and PI objectives.
* Support capacity planning and dependency management across teams within the Agile Release Train (ART).
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, psychological safety, and continuous learning.
* Mentor team members and provide guidance on Agile best practices, servant leadership, and collaborative ways of working.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 8 - 12 years of experience in Computer Science, Business, Engineering, IT or related field

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience serving as a Scrum Master in a Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) environment.
* Experience supporting Marketing Operations, Commercial Operations, Digital, or Work Management product teams.
* Experience facilitating Agile Release Train (ART) activities and cross-team coordination.
* Experience working with Adobe Workfront or comparable enterprise work management platforms.
* Experience leading distributed teams across multiple geographies and time zones.
* Familiarity with organizational change management and Agile transformation initiatives.
* Experience supporting enterprise SaaS products and digital business solutions.
* Knowledge of Lean-Agile principles, flow metrics, and continuous improvement methodologies.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, particularly the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe)
* Prior experience with Agile project management tools, such as Jira, Confluence and Jira Align
* Experience in guiding teams through Agile events and ensuring adherence to SAFe practices and behaviors
* Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for tackling complex challenges with data
* Collaborative spirit and effective communication skills to work seamlessly in a cross-functional team

**Professional Certifications:**

* Certified SAFe Scrum Master or similar (preferred)
* Certified SAFe RTE or similar (preferred)

Soft Skills:
  
  

* Able to work effectively across multiple geographies (primarily India, Portugal, and the United States) under minimal supervision
* Demonstrated proficiency in written and verbal communication in English language
* Intellectual curiosity and the ability to question partners across functions
* Ability to prioritize successfully based on business value
* High degree of initiative and self-motivation
* Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully across virtual teams
* Team-oriented, with a focus on achieving team goals
* Strong presentation and public speaking skills

**Technical Skills:**

* Jira
* Confluence
* Jira Align
* Agile planning and portfolio management tools
* Reporting and Agile metrics dashboards
* Process mapping and workflow visualization tools
* Microsoft Office Suite and collaboration platforms
* Familiarity with DevOps and CI/CD concepts
* Experience working with enterprise SaaS platforms

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Office
  
  
**Department**
The MSD Semiconductor R&D department consists of around 400 engineers developing electron microscopy solutions and applications that help customers make the world cleaner, healthier, and safer. Our global teams in Eindhoven (NL), Brno (CZ), Hillsboro (US), Hyderabad (IN), and Bordeaux (FR) bring together expertise in hardware, software, and scientific applications.
  
  
Within this organization, the Cortex team develops software for semiconductor data workflows. Cortex helps customers organize, process, explore, and visualize microscopy data across semiconductor programs and customer workflows. We are looking for a Software Engineering Manager to build and lead an autonomous Cortex engineering organization.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Software Engineering Manager, you will lead the Cortex team’s people, engineering execution, and delivery. You will manage senior engineers and technical leads, build team capacity, and coordinate work across frontend, backend, DevOps, and QA.
  
  
This is a leadership role requiring broad technical understanding across modern software architecture and the production software lifecycle. You are not expected to be the deepest technical expert in every area, but you should be able to guide sound decisions, establish effective engineering practices, and help the team deliver predictable, high-quality software.
  
  
You will work closely with Cortex Product leadership, architects, and stakeholders across sites. As you build your understanding of the team and product, you may gradually take on agreed operational Product Owner responsibilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership & Development**

* Build, lead, and grow a collaborative, autonomous Cortex engineering team.
* Manage, mentor, and develop senior engineers and technical leads.
* Support career development through coaching, feedback, and continuous learning.
* Recruit, onboard, and retain team members with the skills the organization needs.
* Establish clear roles, ownership, and ways of working across the team.
* Address conflict constructively and foster an inclusive, high-performing team culture.
* Help the team navigate change and ambiguity.

**Engineering Execution**

* Own engineering execution, capacity planning, team commitments, and delivery.
* Coordinate frontend, backend, DevOps, and QA activities to support end-to-end delivery.
* Work with Cortex Product leadership to align priorities, scope, and delivery plans.
* Make dependencies, risks, delivery status, and trade-offs visible to stakeholders.
* Promote predictable delivery and product quality.
* Support the team in continuously improving its processes, tooling, and operational effectiveness.
* If agreed with Cortex Product leadership, gradually take on operational Product Owner responsibilities.

**Technical Leadership**

* Provide technical guidance across modern software architecture, frontend and backend development, microservices, and the production software lifecycle.
* Help engineers and technical leads evaluate options and make pragmatic technical decisions.
* Promote maintainable, secure, and production-ready software practices.
* Support effective use of Kubernetes and containerized applications, CI/CD, and automated testing.
* Work with architecture and engineering partners to address system dependencies, integration points, and technical risks.
* Help keep technical direction aligned with product priorities and delivery commitments.

**Collaboration & Impact**

* Coordinate with Cortex Product leadership, architects, and engineering stakeholders on shared priorities.
* Build strong working relationships across global and matrix teams.
* Drive knowledge transfer from the legacy Cortex organization and help preserve important product and technical context.
* Learn Athena, SDP, Cortex applications, SEMI programs, and customer workflows as part of Cortex onboarding.
* Communicate plans, decisions, delivery status, and risks clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and senior leadership.
* Contribute to broader engineering initiatives and knowledge sharing across sites.

**Education And Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in software engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* 10+ years of software development experience, including experience in technical leadership or team leadership.
* Experience managing or mentoring senior engineers and technical leads.
* Broad understanding of modern web and software architecture, frontend and backend development, and the production software lifecycle.
* Familiarity with microservices, Kubernetes or containerized applications, CI/CD, automated testing, and Agile software delivery.
* Experience managing team capacity, delivery commitments, and cross-functional dependencies.
* Ability to balance people leadership, delivery ownership, and technical guidance.
* Experience working in cross-functional, global, or matrix organizations.
* Strong communication, stakeholder-management, coaching, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Strong ownership and accountability, with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with scientific software, imaging, visualization, or data-intensive applications.
* Familiarity with technologies used in Cortex, such as C#, .NET, Python, Angular, TypeScript, or Blazor.
* Experience with distributed systems, large datasets, or semiconductor workflows.
* Familiarity with Athena, SDP, or other enterprise platforms relevant to Cortex.
* Interest in microscopy, semiconductor research, or scientific applications.

title: Release Delivery Lead
description:
About the job:
  
  
We are seeking to construct a best in class digital organization, where the ERP will be a solid, adaptive backbone of our systems and our supporting functions applications are innovation technology solutions that give our business the (digital) wings to fly everyday! Interested to know more? Contact us!
  
  
We are looking for Release Delivery Lead profile who ensures that the SAP system remains robust, secure, and aligned with business objectives while facilitating smooth system evolutions with releases and minimizing disruptions during changes.
  
  
Main responsibilities:
  
  
Lead SAP Change Advisory Boards (CAB) and Cross-Digital CAB ensuring change controls adherence and improvement of the release framework.
  
  
Coordinate release windows and annual calendar with business units, IT teams, and infrastructure teams to minimize operational disruption.
  
  
Define, maintain and communicate SAP release calendar across landscape.
  
  
Manage transport requests and ensure proper sequencing across SAP system landscapes.
  
  
Act as Release Delivery Manager to bring package of functionalities from scoping to delivery communicating with stakeholders, identifying risks and addressing them until resolution.
  
  
Continuous improvement of Release management ways of working from ideation to adoption, end to end without disruptions in the operation, and in cooperation with AMS, SAP experts and other stakeholders.
  
  
Ensure the sustain, evolution and governance of Release supporting toolset such as Solution Manager, JIRA, Confluence with strong emphasis in innovation and adoption of emerging technologies such AI and automation.
  
  
Establish and maintain the right level of governance, leading the Global Release meeting, conducting quality gates, milestone reviews and Business Go/No-Go reviews. Proactively report any releases risks and come with necessary mitigation plans.
  
  
Communicate with stakeholders to identify any issues or risks that may affect the release schedule or quality of the ERP platform.
  
  
Ensure the release notes are always set up and communicated with digital and business stakeholders as a part of release management process.
  
  
Perform post-release analysis to identify any issues that occurred during the release process and develop plans to prevent similar problems in future releases.
  
  
Organize recurrent alignment with major rollouts and live country projects (sharing changes to methodology, outages, etc..).
  
  
About applicant:
  
  
8+ years work experience as ERP Release Manager in complex landscape, preferably in a FMCG and/or FMCH context.
  
  
Solid experience in SAP release management, with a deep understanding of SAP S4HANA architecture and its modules, integrated systems and with technical knowledge to handle technical dependencies and conflicts.
  
  
Good understanding of S4HANA upgrade process and supporting toolset such SAP Readiness Check with at least one contribution to the delivery of a Major release with upgraded systems in scope.
  
  
Contributed in the design and adoption of retrofit, freeze and downtime strategies.
  
  
Hands on in related supporting tools such Jira, Solution Manager, Confluence, Service-now to support application lifecycle activities.
  
  
Experience in Focused Build or SAP Cloud ALM is a plus.
  
  
Familiar with SAP activate methodology is a plus.
  
  
Solid understanding of project management methodologies, software development life cycle (SDLC) methodologies and agile practices.
  
  
Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to work effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
  
  
At ease with Microsoft Office tools, and in general with IS tools.
  
  
Experience with multi-geography, multi-tier service design and management.
  
  
Conceptual and analytical thinking – ability to extract, analyse, and document complex business and technical requirements or strategies.
  
  
Soft skills:
  
  
Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills
  
  
Demonstrated conflict resolution & problem-solving skills in a global environment
  
  
Strong appetite to learn and discover, entrepreneur mindset
  
  
Adaptable and open to change
  
  
Team player, service-oriented
  
  
Analytical and synthetic, able to formalize solutions, good writing skills
  
  
Strong oral and written communication skills
  
  
With leadership attitude, autonomy and results driven
  
  
Role model our 4 values: teamwork, integrity, respect, courage
  
  
Education: Bachelor’s Degree (B.A.) or equivalent in Information Technology or Engineering
  
  
Languages: Fluent spoken and written English

title: Integrated System Lead
description:
**JOIN AMGEN’S MISSION OF SERVING PATIENTS**
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission to serve patients living with serious illnesses drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas, Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease, we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**Senior Manager – Integrated System Lead**
**What you will do:**
In this role as an individual contributor, you will coordinate integrated clinical system delivery across a defined group of platforms and study processes. You will maintain visibility of end-to-end dependencies across Clinical systems and enterprise data platforms, surface data and interface risks early, and help teams deliver reliable, traceable information flow measured by on-time delivery, interface quality, and data integrity.
  
  
**Strategic Leadership**

* Maintain an integrated view of upstream and downstream system dependencies, interfaces, data consumers, and delivery milestones for assigned systems or initiatives, so that the impact of a change in one system is understood across the clinical ecosystem.
* Contribute to integration and data flow standards, requirements, design decisions, and roadmap planning, ensuring cross-system sequencing and dependencies are reflected in release plans.
* Identify gaps in ownership, data quality, traceability, and operational readiness across system handoffs, and recommend practical actions with clear owners and success measures.

**Execution and Delivery Leadership**

* Coordinate system owners and delivery teams through requirements, interface design, end-to-end integration testing, release, and operational handoff, aligning release timing across dependent systems.
* Track interface and data issues, cross-system dependencies, decisions, and remediation actions through resolution, with clear visibility of aging, impact, and time to resolve.
* Support clear documentation of system context, data flows, controls, and support ownership.
* Define and report measurable integration outcomes, such as on-time milestone delivery, interface defect and failure rates, data reconciliation timeliness, and post-release incident trends.
* Review delivery outcomes and recurring issues to identify improvements to reliability and usability and demonstrate measurable progress over time.

**Individual Contribution**

* Work as an individual contributor, independently managing assigned integration work and coordinating across capability teams.
* Share system and data flow knowledge to support consistent decisions and effective handoffs.

**External Representation and Internal Stakeholder Partnerships**

* Partner with clinical system owners, Data Management, Clinical Operations, AI&D, DTI, architecture, security, privacy, and vendors.
* Facilitate working sessions to resolve cross-system requirements, dependencies, and conflicting priorities between platform teams.
* Provide concise, metrics-based status and risk updates to capability leadership and program teams.

**What we expect of you:**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The candidate we seek is a capable clinical systems professional with the following qualifications.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree and 8+ years of experience in clinical systems, system integration, data management, or technology delivery in a regulated environment OR
* Bachelor’s degree and 11+ years of experience in clinical systems, system integration, data management, or technology delivery in a regulated environment

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience coordinating integrations, system delivery, data flow, or cross-platform implementations with multiple interdependent systems and vendors.
* Understanding of clinical development processes and common clinical system data exchanges.
* Knowledge of requirements, testing, release, and change management practices.
* Strong facilitation, documentation, and issue-tracking skills.

**Core Competencies:**

* Ability to understand end-to-end system interactions, cross-system dependencies, and data lineage.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional technical work and vendors.
* Data quality and compliance awareness.
* Clear communication and disciplined follow-through.

They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:
  
  

* Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive
* Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection
* Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders
* Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

**What You Can Expect Of Us**
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.
  
  
As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
**Are you ready to shape the future of data?**

  

Matillion is the company behind Maia, the AI Data Automation platform.

  

In the AI economy, demand for data is exploding. Manual data engineering can’t keep up. Maia fixes that by combining 15 years of data expertise with agentic AI to eliminate the manual work that slows data teams down. Organisations like Cisco, DocuSign, and Slack are already using it to deliver real business impact, faster.

  

We started in Manchester and now we’re global - with teams across the UK, US and India.

  

We are driven, curious, energetic people who move fast, think big and hold ourselves to a high standard. We’re here to make a dent in the universe bigger than ourselves. And we’re looking for people who want to be part of it.

**Role Purpose**
  

Matillion is built around small development teams with responsibility for specific themes and initiatives. Each team is a mix of engineers with various levels of skills and experience.

  

As a Senior Quality Engineer you will bring technical guidance and demonstrable experience in integrating quality checks throughout our development cycle. The ambition is to deliver our services in the most efficient, controlled and high quality way possible. Outside of day to day delivery you will also support the overall quality journey within Engineering.

**What will you be doing?**
  
  

  
* As a Senior Quality Engineer at Matillion, you will spend significant time testing our software products, ensuring quality throughout the development process.
  
* You will help maintain and improve existing quality frameworks while promoting a shift-left approach to testing.
  
* You'll work with a variety of tools for automation, security, accessibility, and performance testing, while also honing your automation skills.
  
* As part of a cross-functional team, you will drive the focus on quality, always keeping the customer’s needs in mind.
  
* You will also contribute to identifying and improving areas in the overall quality journey, whilst also assisting in mentoring team members in developing their skills.
  
* Assist in recruitment and mentoring team members in developing their skills
  
  

  
  
**What are we looking for?**
  
  
  
  
  
  
  

Essential

  

  
* Proficiency in managing end-to-end testing of SaaS applications, using various testing approaches (e.g., rapid, risk-based, exploratory, regression, security, usability, performance) suitable for distributed systems, with a strong understanding of the Test Pyramid and automation.
  
* Experience developing and maintaining test automation tools (e.g., contract, integration, accessibility, performance, security) for applications and services, with coding skills in Java/JavaScript to implement frameworks like Cypress, Playwright and Pact.
  
* Solid understanding of the full software development lifecycle using CI/CD tooling, agile methodologies (e.g., Kanban, Scrum), and a strong focus on ensuring quality from business, customer, and technical perspectives.
  
* Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, Azure) and good knowledge of databases and SQL.
  
* A collaborative team player with a QA mindset, eager to challenge and improve practices, and committed to continuous learning and personal development in quality engineering.
  
* Matillion has fostered a culture that is collaborative, fast-paced, ambitious, and transparent, and an environment where people genuinely care about their colleagues and communities.
