title: Sr. Copywriter & Content Strategist - Telugu
description:
**Senior Copywriter – Content & Ad Strategy**

*A writer who thinks like a strategist: plan the content, shape the ad angles, and write the words that drive results — in Telugu and English.*

**Location**

Hyderabad (on-site)

**Employment type**

Full-time

**Experience**

3–5 years, agency-side

**Reports to**

Founder/Co Founder

**Works with**

Performance marketer, DOP, video editor, graphic designer, account executive, web team

**Languages**

Telugu and English (native-level writing in Telugu required)

**CTC range**

₹5.5–7 LPA, based on experience and test-task performance

About Emporia

Emporia is a Hyderabad-based marketing and creative agency. We run monthly retainers for clients in government, real estate, healthcare (India and US), food and beverage, fashion retail and ethnic retail, alongside brand identity and website projects. Our content work is shoot-led and short-form first: scripting, shoots, design, editing, posting, reporting and social listening.

The Role

You will own the copy and the monthly content plan across our retainers: calendars, reel and shoot scripts, captions, ad copy, website content and brand collaterals. A significant share of the work is for a government sector client, written in Telugu for public audiences.

Emporia is growing into a real estate performance marketing agency. You will write the ad copy, landing pages and campaign scripts that generate leads and site visits for property developers, working with our performance marketer.

This is not a write-to-brief role. You are expected to understand why content and ads work: who the audience is, what stage of the funnel a piece serves, which angle to test, and what the data says. You decide what to write as well as how to write it. Calendars are approved monthly by the founder; day-to-day content and creative decisions are yours.

Key Responsibilities: Content Strategy

•   
**Content pillars:**
define content pillars, audience segments and tone for each retainer, and revisit them quarterly.

•   
**Platform strategy:**
decide format mix and posting rhythm per platform — reels, carousels, statics, stories, YouTube Shorts — based on what each client's audience responds to.

•   
**Monthly content calendars:**
plan platform-wise calendars for each content retainer and get them approved before the month starts.

•   
**Campaign ideas:**
develop recurring series, seasonal and festive campaigns, and topical content tied to each client's business goals.

•   
**Performance review:**
read monthly post data (reach, watch time, saves, shares, profile actions) and change next month's plan because of it.

•   
**Social listening insights:**
turn the government account's listening data into content direction and write the insight section of its monthly report.

Key Responsibilities: Ad Strategy

•   
**Funnel thinking:**
map ad creatives to funnel stages — awareness, consideration, lead, retargeting — for each real estate and lead-generation campaign.

•   
**Creative angles:**
develop angles per audience (end-users, investors, NRI buyers): location, price, amenities, lifestyle, urgency, trust.

•   
**Testing plans:**
with the performance marketer, plan structured creative tests — hooks, offers, formats, copy length — and write the variants.

•   
**Ad data:**
read cost per lead, CTR, hook rate and lead quality feedback, and use it to decide the next round of creatives.

•   
**Organic to paid:**
identify organic posts that should be turned into ads for existing content clients, and pitch those upsells with the founder.

Key Responsibilities: Writing

•   
**Shoot briefs:**
write shoot briefs and shot lists with the DOP so a shoot day covers a month of content.

•   
**Scripts:**
write reel, shoot and video ad scripts in Telugu and English, with hooks, on-screen text and voiceover lines.

•   
**Social copy:**
captions, static post copy, carousel copy and hashtags for each client's calendar.

•   
**Real estate ad copy:**
headlines, primary text, lead-form copy and variants for Meta and Google lead-generation campaigns; scripts for walkthrough, location and testimonial videos; copy aimed at local and NRI buyers.

•   
**Landing pages:**
conversion-focused landing page copy for property projects — offer, location benefits, amenities, pricing cues and calls to action.

•   
**Compliance:**
ensure property ads carry required details such as the project's RERA registration number; no claims the client cannot substantiate.

•   
**Website content:**
page copy for client websites — home, about, services, product pages — written for clarity and search.

•   
**Collaterals:**
brochures, product descriptions, packaging copy, user manuals and other business collaterals for project clients.

•   
**Government communication:**
write accurate, appropriate Telugu content for public messaging; follow approval guidelines strictly.

•   
**Transcreation:**
adapt English content into natural Telugu and vice versa — not literal translation.

•   
**Revisions:**
turn around client and founder feedback quickly; maintain version control.

•   
**Brand voice:**
maintain voice documents and glossaries for each client, including Telugu terminology.

•   
**Time logging:**
log hours daily per client and task category.

Must-Have Skills

•   
**Telugu:**
native-level writing — grammar, spelling and tone, including formal and conversational registers.

•   
**English:**
clean, persuasive writing for social, ads and web.

•   
**Short-form scripting:**
understands how scripts translate to shots, edits and on-screen text for reels.

•   
**Range:**
can switch voice across sectors — government, healthcare, real estate, food, fashion.

•   
**Content strategy:**
has built content pillars and monthly calendars for multiple clients, and can explain the reasoning behind them.

•   
**Ad strategy:**
understands Meta and Google ad funnels, creative testing and audience-based messaging; has written ads for lead-generation or sales campaigns.

•   
**Data literacy:**
reads Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager data — reach, retention, CTR, cost per lead — and turns it into creative decisions.

•   
**Direct-response writing:**
understands hooks, offers and calls to action that drive leads, not just engagement.

•   
**Speed:**
delivers multiple scripts per day to deadline without dropping quality.

•   
**Typing:**
comfortable typing in Telugu Unicode (Google Input Tools, Lekhini or similar).

Good to Have

•   Real estate or property marketing copy experience.

•   Basic SEO writing knowledge for website content.

•   Experience with ad copy A/B testing.

•   Hindi as an additional language.

•   Interest in film, regional pop culture and social trends.

Selection Process

•   
**Writing samples:**
scripts, captions or web copy you have written, in both Telugu and English.

•   
**Test task, part A (content):**
a one-month calendar for one of our retainers with its content pillars and the reasoning behind them, plus three reel scripts (at least two in Telugu, one for public/government messaging).

•   
**Test task, part B (ads):**
a Meta lead ad plan for a sample residential project — funnel stages, two audience segments (one NRI), three creative angles with copy variants, and how you would judge which one wins.

•   
**Interview with the founders:**
walkthrough of both parts and a data-reading exercise on a real post and ad export.

How to Apply

Send your resume, writing samples and current/expected CTC with notice period to preetham@emporia.agency with the subject line “Senior Copywriter – [Your Name]”. Candidates who can join within 30 days will be prioritised.

title: Global Lead Generation & Market Intelligence Specialist
description:
About Flychem

Flychem is a Hyderabad-based B2B specialty chemistry company. We supply cosmetic actives, pharma intermediates and APIs, agrochemical intermediates and human nutrition ingredients to manufacturers and distributors in India and overseas.

The role

You will find and qualify international buyers for specific molecules. This is a research-first role: you work out who actually buys a product, how much and from whom, then open the conversation and hand over qualified RFQs.

What you will do

• Map each molecule (CAS / INCI / HS code) to its real buyers using customs trade data, regulatory registries, patents, product labels and trade-show lists

• Build tiered target account lists by product and region

• Find and verify decision-makers in procurement, R&D and QA

• Write and run multi-touch outreach across email, LinkedIn and WhatsApp

• Qualify enquiries (grade, quantity, Incoterm, destination, timeline) and pass clean RFQs to the commercial team

• Track samples through trial and vendor qualification

• Keep the CRM accurate and report weekly on accounts researched, replies and qualified RFQs

• Screen every lead for sanctions and export-control restrictions

What you bring

• 3–5 years in B2B international lead generation or export market research

• Minimum 2 years of hands-on LinkedIn Sales Navigator, including advanced features

• Proven data mining ability

• Degree in Chemistry, Pharmacy or Chemical Engineering, or solid experience selling chemicals, APIs or ingredients

• Clear, precise written English

LinkedIn Sales Navigator: advanced use (mandatory, 2+ years)

• Boolean search strings and layered lead and account filters

• Personas, saved searches and alerts

• Lead and account lists, with exclusion of existing customers

• Relationship Map and multi-contact account planning

• Buyer-intent, job-change and hiring signals

• InMail strategy and response tracking

• CRM sync and clean list export

Data mining knowledge (mandatory)

• Customs trade data: search by HS code and product description; separate real importers from traders and forwarders; work out volume, price and current supplier

• Regulatory registries: FDA DMF and Orange Book, EDQM CEP, EPA and other pesticide registrations, ECHA, CosIng

• Patent and product-label mining to find proven users of a molecule

• Trade-show exhibitor list extraction

• Boolean, LinkedIn X-ray and Google search operators

• Data cleaning: de-duplication, company-name normalisation, domain matching, email verification

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets (Power Query, pivots, lookups); SQL or Python is a plus

Tools you must be hands-on with

• Apollo: contact and company search, list building, sequences

• Lusha and RocketReach: email and direct-dial enrichment, cross-checking sources

• Claude (AI): account research, molecule-to-buyer mapping, data cleaning, outreach drafting, translation

• Trade data: Volza, ImportGenius, Panjiva or similar

• Email verification and sending: ZeroBounce or NeverBounce; Instantly, Smartlead or lemlist, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC and warm-up

• CRM: HubSpot or Zoho

Good to have

• Spanish, Portuguese or another export-market language

• Clay, Make or Zapier

• Trade-show prospecting (CPHI, in-cosmetics, Vitafoods, SupplySide)

How we hire

Shortlisted candidates complete a paid 48-hour practical test on one real molecule and one region.

Compensation

Fixed salary plus incentive linked to qualified RFQs.

To apply

Apply through LinkedIn only and answer the screening questions.

Through its premium brand MAPLE and other product categories, Group Welkin offers innovative kitchenware, home utility products and comprehensive corporate gifting solutions.

As part of our expansion into the B2B corporate gifting segment, we are looking for an experienced and result-oriented
**B2B Lead Generation & Appointment Setting Executive**
with strong expertise in LinkedIn prospecting, Sales Navigator and corporate client acquisition.

**2. Job Purpose**

To identify potential corporate clients, generate qualified B2B leads, directly engage with key decision-makers and fix business appointments for the Business Development Team.

The role involves end-to-end prospecting, from identifying the right companies and decision-makers to initiating conversations, understanding business requirements, nurturing prospects and converting them into confirmed client meetings.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. LinkedIn Lead Generation & Prospect Research**

* Identify and generate potential B2B leads using LinkedIn and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.
* Research and identify prospective corporate clients across IT companies, GCCs, MNCs, corporates, hospitals, educational institutions and other industries.
* Identify key decision-makers such as HR Heads, Admin Heads, Procurement Managers, Marketing Heads, Facility Managers and Corporate Communication professionals.
* Build targeted prospect lists based on industry, company size, designation, geography and business potential.
* Identify companies with potential requirements for employee gifting, festive gifting, onboarding kits, corporate events and channel partner gifting.

**B. Prospecting & Database Management**

* Build, maintain and regularly update a comprehensive database of prospective corporate clients.
* Capture relevant information, including contact name, designation, company name, LinkedIn profile, email address and contact number.
* Use tools such as Apollo, Lusha and other lead generation platforms to identify and enrich prospect information.
* Ensure database accuracy, completeness and proper segmentation.
* Categorise prospects based on industry, potential business value and lead status.

**C. LinkedIn Outreach & Engagement**

* Execute targeted LinkedIn connection campaigns to reach relevant corporate decision-makers.
* Develop personalised connection requests, introductory messages and follow-up communication.
* Introduce Group Welkin and generate interest in its corporate gifting solutions.
* Build professional relationships with prospective clients through consistent engagement.
* Nurture prospects and identify potential business opportunities through LinkedIn interactions.

**D. Client Outreach & Appointment Fixing**

* Directly reach out to identified corporate prospects through telephone calls, LinkedIn, emails and WhatsApp.
* Initiate conversations with HR Heads, Admin Heads, Procurement Managers and other relevant decision-makers.
* Present and communicate Group Welkin's corporate gifting solutions and understand prospective clients' requirements.
* Follow up with interested prospects and convert potential leads into business meetings.
* Fix confirmed appointments for the Business Development Team with prospective corporate clients.
* Coordinate meeting schedules between prospective clients and the internal sales team.
* Ensure regular follow-ups until appointments are confirmed and meetings are successfully conducted.
* Maintain a consistent pipeline of qualified corporate appointments for the Business Development Team.

**E. Lead Qualification & Sales Coordination**

* Qualify leads based on company profile, business potential, gifting requirements, budget and purchase timelines.
* Identify immediate and future corporate gifting opportunities.

title: Outbound Lead Generation Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an
**Outbound Lead Generation Specialist**
to build and fill the new-business pipeline for 8 Views.

**This is a pure outbound role.**
Your job is to start conversations with the right prospects and hand over qualified, meeting-ready leads. You will not handle proposals, negotiation or closing. The Business Development team picks up from your handover.

You will source leads from LinkedIn and other channels, build relationships with consultants and potential partners, and run a consistent weekly outreach cadence. If you enjoy research, outreach and the discipline of hitting activity and meeting targets, this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Source leads**
  from LinkedIn, referrals, events, directories, industry databases and other channels, with a focus on our core sectors: Real Estate, Education, Healthcare and other lead-generation businesses.
* Run structured
  **LinkedIn outreach**
  : build prospect lists, send connection requests, follow up and start conversations that lead to meetings.
* Build and nurture relationships with
  **consultants, agencies and other potential partners**
  to create referral and collaboration channels.
* Research each prospect's business, competitors and current digital presence so every outreach message is relevant and personalised.
* Qualify leads on budget, need, timeline and decision-maker access before handing them over.
* Book discovery calls and meetings for the BD team, with clear notes on the prospect's context and needs.
* Maintain a steady weekly outreach cadence and hit defined targets for connections, conversations and meetings booked.
* Keep the CRM updated daily with lead status, outreach activity and follow-ups.
* Track outreach performance (reply rates, meeting conversion, source-wise quality) and refine messaging and targeting based on the numbers.
* Use outreach and lead-generation tools, including LinkedIn automation, enrichment and email tools, to scale outreach without losing quality.
* Share weekly reports on pipeline activity and lead quality with the BD lead.

**What We're Looking For**

* **2-4 years of experience**
  in outbound lead generation, business development, inside sales or SDR roles, ideally in a digital marketing agency or similar service business.
* Strong command of
  **LinkedIn as a prospecting tool**
  , including Sales Navigator, search filters and connection-led conversations.
* Proven ability to source leads from multiple channels and book qualified meetings consistently.
* Excellent written communication: you can write short, personalised messages that get replies.
* Basic understanding of digital marketing and performance marketing, enough to hold a credible first conversation with a prospect.
* Comfort with numbers: reply rates, conversion rates and lead-to-meeting ratios.
* Hands-on experience with a CRM and outreach or lead-generation tools.
* Strong research skills and attention to detail.
* Self-driven and comfortable working to weekly activity and meeting targets.
* Comfortable using AI tools to improve research, outreach and productivity.

**What Will Make You Successful**

* You enjoy outreach and are not discouraged by silence or rejection.
* You research before you reach out, and your messages reflect it.
* You build genuine relationships with consultants and partners, not just send cold messages.
* You track your own numbers and keep improving what works.
* You stay disciplined with your daily and weekly cadence.
* You are curious about how performance marketing works and how it drives leads for clients.

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Experience selling digital marketing or performance marketing services.
* An existing network of consultants, agencies or channel partners.
* Experience with Real Estate, Education or Healthcare clients.
* Experience with LinkedIn automation tools, Clay, Apollo, Lusha or similar platforms.

**Prior experience in outbound lead generation is mandatory. Candidates with agency experience will be preferred.**

title: Command Centre Specialist
description:
****About Us:****
insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at
**insightsoftware.com.**
****Job Description:****
**insightsoftware**
**Job Description**
**Job Title**
Command Centre Specialist
  
  
**Department**
IT — Command Centre (DevOps)
  
  
**Location**
Hyderabad, India (On-site for the first 3–6 months; remote thereafter)
  
  
**Reports To**
Senior Manager / Director, Command Centre
  
  
**Employment Type**
Full-time, Permanent
  
  
**Shift Pattern**
24×7 rotational shifts
  
  
**About Insightsoftware**
insightsoftware is a global provider of connected solutions for the Office of the CFO. We empower business leaders with accessible insights and connected solutions to drive actionable business strategy. With operations spanning 40+ countries, we help finance and IT teams work smarter, faster, and with greater confidence.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are establishing a new Command Centre in Hyderabad to provide around-the-clock monitoring, incident response, and operational support for our global multi-cloud infrastructure, including AWS, Azure, and on-premises environments. The Command Centre Specialist will serve as an active operator, responsible for system monitoring, incident triage and resolution, execution of runbooks, and escalation of issues in accordance with established procedures. This role is highly execution-oriented and supports DevOps teams worldwide, adhering to ITIL best practices. The initial three to six months require on-site presence in Hyderabad for environment familiarization and team integration, after which the position will transition to remote work.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Incident Response and Troubleshooting
  
  

* Monitor alerts and triage incoming incidents—classify, prioritize, and document in Jira Service Management per ITIL guidelines.
* Troubleshoot issues across multi cloud infrastructure (EC2, VPC, VPN, load balancers), identity and access management (IAM, SSO, directory services), networking (DNS, firewalls, routing), databases, and application layers.
* Execute established runbooks and standard operating procedures to resolve or contain incidents within SLA targets.
* Escalate unresolved or high-severity incidents to senior specialists or engineering teams with clear, accurate context.

Monitoring and Alerting
  
  

* Monitor multi-cloud infrastructure, network, and security tooling 24×7 using enterprise observability platforms.
* Identify anomalies, threshold breaches, and potential security events; take first-response action or escalate per SOPs.
* Flag false positives and noisy alerts to senior specialists for threshold tuning and runbook updates.

Shift Operations
  
  

* Participate in 24×7 rotational shifts; execute clean handoffs with detailed shift logs.
* Follow escalation matrices and communication protocols during all incidents.
* Maintain accurate, real-time operational logs throughout each shift.

Documentation and Knowledge Contribution
  
  

* Update and maintain runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and SOPs in Confluence as issues are resolved.
* Document recurring incidents and known workarounds to build the Command Centre knowledge base.
* Log all actions taken during incidents for post-incident reviews and audit trails.

SLA Tracking and Reporting
  
  

* Track incident response and resolution times against defined SLAs; flag breaches or at-risk tickets promptly.
* Contribute to operational dashboards and shift reports as directed by senior specialists.

**Required Qualifications**

* 3–5 years in a Command Centre, NOC, or equivalent 24×7 operations environment.
* 1–2 years of hands-on exposure to AWS and/or Azure—working familiarity with EC2, VPC, VPN, and IAM basics.
* Practical troubleshooting skills across cloud, identity, network, database, and application layers.
* Awareness of Kubernetes and containerized workloads sufficient to interpret alerts.
* Networking fundamentals—TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, firewalls, and basic routing.
* Familiarity with ITIL concepts (Incident, Problem, Change Management).
* Experience with at least one monitoring/alerting tool—PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Datadog, Grafana, CloudWatch, or Azure Monitor.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills for shift logs, incident documentation, and escalations.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL V4 Foundation certification; any AWS or Azure foundational/associate certification.
* Experience with Jira Service Management and Confluence.
* Basic scripting skills (Bash, Python, or PowerShell) for log analysis or simple automation.
* Prior experience in a global, multi-time-zone support environment.

What We Offer
  
  

* Be part of a greenfield Command Centre build in a high-growth global software company.
* Hands-on exposure to a modern multi-cloud tech stack (AWS, Azure, SaaS, enterprise platforms).
* Clear growth path—learn from senior specialists and grow into advanced operational roles.
* Collaborative, results-oriented culture underpinned by our core values of Winning Attitude, One Team, and Disciplined Execution.
* Competitive compensation, benefits, and professional development opportunities.

****Additional Information****
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
Learn more about our high-energy, high-performance global team: Work With Us
  
  
insightsoftware About Us: Hear From Our Team

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

title: Telecom Specialist I
description:
NOC Engineer – (L1)
  
  
Network Operations Center (NOC)
  
  

* Entry Level (0-2 years)
* 24/7 Operations

Role Overview
  
  
The L1 NOC Engineer acts as the first line of defense for monitoring critical network, server, and cloud infrastructure. This role is responsible for real-time alert triage, initial diagnostic troubleshooting, incident logging, and escalating unresolved issues to higher-tier engineering teams to ensure system availability and strict SLA adherence.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Continuous Monitoring: Supervise enterprise network infrastructure, servers, applications, and links via monitoring tools (e.g., Nagios, Zabbix, SolarWinds, Datadog, PRTG).

* Basic Troubleshooting: Execute standard runbooks to resolve Tier-1 issues, such as device reboots, interface resets, ISP link flaps, disk space cleanups, and service restarts.
* Escalation & Communication: Escalate unresolved incidents to L2/L3 engineers, vendor support (e.g., ISPs, hardware vendors), or internal stakeholders within defined SLA timelines.

Physical Demand & Work Environment

title: Payroll Operations Consultant - Product Solutioning
description:
**Role: Payroll Operations Consultant – Product Solutioning**
**Location: Hyderabad**
**Darwinbox**
is the fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 900+ global enterprises to manage their 2.5 million+ employees across 116+ countries.
  
  
Darwinbox's new-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start-ups: DP World, Masafi, DIFC, Abu Dhabi Department of Finance, Nivea, Starbucks, Swiggy, DLF, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
  
  
Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, and Lightspeed Venture Partners.
  
  
**About the role:**
As a Payroll Operations Consultant, you are the
**first line of support for our clients**
on everything payroll. Clients come to you with questions, edge cases, and issues - and they expect clear, confident answers, fast. Your job is to understand the query, troubleshoot it on the spot wherever possible, and drive it to a clean resolution while keeping the client informed at every step.
  
  
**This is a client-facing role at heart.**
You will spend your day in conversation - on calls, on chat, and over email - so you should be comfortable holding a discussion with a client, explaining what is happening, and following through until the matter is closed. When an issue turns out to be a product bug rather than a configuration or data question, you
**become the bridge**
to our product team: you raise it, chase it, and stay on it until it is fixed.
  
  
***What you’ll do:***

* Own client payroll queries end to end - receive them through Ask Darwin and other support channels, understand the underlying problem, and troubleshooting to resolve them as quickly as possible.
* Bring strong payroll fundamentals to every conversation - understand payroll processing, statutory components, wage codes, and common processing scenarios well enough to diagnose issues without handholding.
* Hold clear, confident client conversations - be comfortable getting on a call or a chat, walking a client through an issue, and setting the right expectations on timelines.
* Document minutes of meeting (MOM) for client discussions and circulate them , so that actions, owners, and timelines are captured and agreed.
* Send timely, proactive status updates to clients - keep them informed on open items rather than waiting to be chased.
* Unlock clients when they are blocked - identify what is holding up their payroll run and clear the path so they can proceed.
* Identify product issues and escalate them to the product team with clear, well-documented context - then follow up persistently and drive the fix to closure.
* Track all open items to resolution, ensuring nothing slips through and every query reaches a defined outcome.

***What we are looking for/Who should apply:***

* 3+ years of experience in payroll operations, payroll support, or a closely related finance/HR function .
* Solid, hands-on understanding of payroll - you can reason through a payroll query and know where things typically go wrong.
* A confident communicator who does not hesitate to talk to clients - comfortable on calls, on chatting, and in writing.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving instincts, with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues under time pressure.
* A genuine self-starter - you take ownership, chase issues down, and follow through to closure without being reminded.
* Comfortable documenting clearly - MOMs, status updates, and issue write-ups - and proficiency with Email, MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Willingness to learn HRMS/payroll technology systems; prior exposure to an HRMS platform is an added advantage.
* We are looking for people who take ownership, push through until the job is done, communicate clearly, adapt fast, are comfortable in front of clients, and have a bias for closing things out.

title: Shift Manager
description:
**Business Unit:**
Cubic Transportation Systems
  
  
**Company Details:**
When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
  
  
We have a top-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
  
  
**Job Details:**
**Job Summary**
As a Shift Coordinator on the CTS 24x7 Service Operations team, you will provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 staff across the Network Operations Center (NOC), Security Operations Center (SOC), and Service Desk during your assigned shift. You act as the technical and operational command authority during the shift. You are responsible for ensuring that events across all three functions are correctly triaged, tickets are properly assigned and tracked, incidents are escalated per defined protocols, and shift handovers preserve full situational awareness for the incoming shift.
  
  
You are responsible for confirming shift staffing coverage in real time and for adjusting assignments to accommodate last-minute absences. You are the immediate escalation path for issues that exceed the authority of the Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts on the shift, and you escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for issues that exceed shift authority.
  
  
Work is conducted under the compliance frameworks that govern CTS operations, in particular ITIL 4 (Monitoring and Event Management, Incident Management, Continual Improvement), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (Annex A logging, monitoring, and incident management controls), and PCI DSS v4.0.1 (Requirements 10 and 12.10). You will be recognized inside CTS as the shift-level owner for cross-function coordination and evidence continuity.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities**
**Shift Command and Team Coordination**

* Provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 NOC, SOC, and Service Desk analysts during the assigned shift.
* Assign work at shift start and re-balance workload throughout the shift based on ticket volume, incident severity, and individual analyst capacity.
* Confirm complete shift coverage across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues at shift start; adjust in real time when staff are unavailable because of sick calls, unplanned PTO, or emergency absence.
* Serve as the initial escalation point for any Tier 1 or Tier 2 analyst who needs additional authority, judgment, or cross-functional coordination.
* Track and report shift-level metrics (ticket volume, SLA adherence, incident count by severity) at shift close.

**Shift Handover Discipline**

* Execute a formal shift handover at the start and end of every shift, per the protocols defined in the NOC Scope Definition and the CTS SOC Scope of Operations.
* Ensure the handover record captures, at minimum: open incidents with owner and next action; active containment actions in progress; watchlist items; active maintenance windows; tooling or coverage gaps.
* Retain handover records as ISMS evidence supporting ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5.10 and ITIL 4 Monitoring and Event Management practice.

**Incident Management Coordination**

* Apply ITIL 4 Incident Management practice throughout the shift: validate alerts, classify severity, assign ownership, coordinate escalation, and track resolution against SLA.
* Coordinate the first 15 to 30 minutes of any SEV 0 or SEV 1 incident: declare the incident, engage the appropriate tiers, initiate stakeholder communications, and hand off to the Incident Commander or on-call Tier 3 engineer.
* Enforce severity special rules from the NOC Scope Definition (for example, loss of logging or monitoring is never a SEV 4 event; SEV 0 or SEV 1 with a recent production change requires a change correlation step).
* Ensure joint NOC-SOC coordination during Major Incidents: NOC leads operational recovery; SOC leads security investigation and containment; the Shift Coordinator maintains the shared incident bridge until the Incident Commander takes over.

**Cross-Function Ticket Routing and Escalation**

* Monitor NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues in the ITSM platform; ensure tickets are correctly categorized and assigned per the RACI.
* Route security-relevant events from the NOC or Service Desk to the SOC per the defined Escalation pathway with enriched context.
* Route operational recovery actions from the SOC to the NOC or regional IT Operations per the defined protocol.
* Escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for any issue that exceeds shift authority.

**Compliance Evidence and Documentation**

* Ensure shift activities produce audit-ready evidence supporting PCI DSS v4.0.1 Requirement 10 and Requirement 12.10, and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5.24-A.5.28 and A.8.15-A.8.16.
* Verify handover records, incident timelines, and containment action logs are complete and accurate before shift close.
* Support monthly and quarterly evidence pack preparation.

**Continuous Improvement Contribution**

* Identify recurring patterns during the shift (repeat incidents, noisy alerts, gaps in playbook coverage) and log them for review by the NOC, SOC, and Service Desk Managers.
* Participate in post-incident reviews and contribute to the Continual Improvement Register per ITIL 4 Continual Improvement practice.
* Recommend changes to shift-level procedures where the shift experience identifies opportunities.

**General Duties And Responsibilities**

* Reliably demonstrate accountability for work assignments and proactive communications about issues and status. A strong history of proactively identifying effective solutions for challenges.
* Able to work effectively and uphold professional standards, with the customer and system stakeholders.
* Self-motivated and able to work unsupervised.
* Methodical and attentive to detail.
* Proactive in seeking advice from senior operations and security subject matter experts when required.
* Comfortable working with staff at all levels and in other geographical locations within the organization.
* Comply with Cubic's Quality Management System.
* Comply with Cubic's quality, health, safety, and security policies.
* Support the company's strategic objectives and collaborate across departments.
* Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures.

**Skills / Experience / Knowledge**
**Essential:**

* Experience providing direct supervision to a team of individual contributors in a technology operations, security operations, or service desk environment.
* Working knowledge of NOC operations: event monitoring, incident management, SLA management, change and configuration control.
* Working knowledge of SOC operations: SIEM and EDR alert triage, security incident classification, escalation protocols.
* Working knowledge of Service Desk operations under a Tier 1-3 tiered model.
* Familiarity with ITIL 4 practices, in particular Monitoring and Event Management and Incident Management.
* Ability to interpret and explain incident status, containment actions, and escalation decisions to peers, subordinate staff, and functional peer groups. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Collaboration and Interaction expectations.
* Sound judgment in resolving problems that require analysis of data and relevant factors under real-time pressure. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Complexity and Problem Solving expectations.
* Ability to develop and manage routine operational plans and meet targets against a monthly performance plan. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Discretion and Impact expectations.
* Experience preparing accurate shift reports and handover records.
* Comfort operating 24x7 shift patterns, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.

**Desirable:**

* Familiarity with PCI DSS v4.0.1 requirements, in particular Requirement 10, Requirement 11.5, and Requirement 12.10.
* Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A controls covering logging (A.8.15), monitoring activities (A.8.16), and incident management (A.5.24 to A.5.28).
* Exposure to NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 (NIST CSWP 29) Detect and Respond Functions.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow (or equivalent enterprise ITSM) and Jira.
* Understanding of the ITIL 4 Major Incident model and Problem Management practice.
* Experience coordinating across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk boundaries.

**Qualifications**
**Essential:**

* Must be able to work on-site at Cubic Hyderabad, Aparna Plaza, on a 24x7 rotating shift pattern.
* Minimum 5-8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree.
* University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other technical field; or Business Administration with relevant IT work experience.
* At least 5 years of experience in a Tier 1-3 operations environment (NOC, SOC, Service Desk, or NOC/SOC hybrid).
* At least 3 years’ experience managing shift workers.
* Demonstrated ability to make severity classification and escalation decisions in a real-time operations setting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a team through a shift, including workload assignment, coaching, and formal handover.
* At least 3 years’ experience working in an ITIL 4 operation.

**Desirable:**

* ITIL 4 Foundation certification; ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader preferred.
* CompTIA Security+, ISC2 SSCP, or equivalent security operations certification.
* ServiceNow ITSM administrator or user certification.
* Experience in a payment card processing environment, or in a similarly regulated real-time operations environment.
* Experience with global follow-the-sun shift models spanning NAM, EMEA, and APAC time zones.

**Condition of Employment:**
Successful outcome of a National Police Check

Employee

title: Manager, End User Support
description:
Manages and develops a team responsible for providing end user technical support in a desktop computing environment.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**Role Summary**
We’re looking for a people-first leader who knows how to turn potential into performance. The ideal Manager of End User Support brings at least three years of leadership experience, strong coaching and performance management skills, and a demonstrated ability to deliver results. This leader will play a critical role in developing entry-level technical talent, building high-performing teams, and creating an environment where people can learn, grow, and succeed while delivering an exceptional support experience. Ideally, we are looking for candidates with experience leading teams across Windows, MacOS, Virtual Desktop and Remote connectivity experience. Preferred candidates will have experience with ServiceNow and Genesys Contact Center Solutions
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Hires, evaluates, and supervises crew. Provides guidance and training as necessary to develop crew. Sets performance standards, reviews performance, and makes informed compensation decisions in accordance with all applicable Human Resources policies and procedures.
* Manages a team that addresses end user technical issues such as implementation, configurations, control, maintenance, troubleshooting, security, and usage monitoring.
* Manages the team's resolution of technical troubleshooting issues to ensure end user productivity.
* Leads consultations with clients and key stakeholders on potential technical issues or problems that were identified by the team.
* Creates and maintains knowledge-based articles, procedures, and training for support areas and crew. Partners with IT to train staff when necessary.
* Maintains an accurate data inventory regarding advanced end-user issues within the tracking system and according to policies and standards.

description:

**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
Global Markets Business Finance & Control (BF&C) is a division of Global Banking & Markets (GBAM) Finance responsible for the production and independent validation of Global Markets' profit and loss and balance sheet. In this regard, BF&C will ensure, inter alia, that accounting policies are correctly and consistently applied, and that trading portfolios are appropriately valued.
  
  
The team prepares and reports P&L and balance sheet to the business and ensures the accuracy and integrity of the general ledger. We are responsible for daily service delivery and ensuring effective controls, transparent management information and becoming a center of excellence delivering process simplification and efficiencies. We work closely with front office, middle office, traders and valuation control teams to drive the control agenda across the business.
  
  
**Job Description\***
Global Markets Business Finance & Control (BF&C) seeks to provide a support service with particular focus on the relationship between trading risk positions and P&L components. We are looking to recruit an individual to work in the P&L production area covering the Global Credit Trading desks. The candidate’s main responsibility will be to produce and deliver the daily P&L to front office, providing a high standard of analysis and explanation around any issues faced and daily revenue drivers. The candidate will therefore have considerable interaction with the respective Front Office, Middle Office, and Finance and Trade Capture teams so good communication and time management skills are an essential requirement for this job.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Primary products covered will include: Bonds, CDS, TRS, ETFs and Loans
* Production and reporting of daily P&L to Front Office & Senior Management
* Reconcile actual P&L with trader estimates and provide flash/actual variance analysis
* Working closely with the trading desks on position, P&L or other issues on an ad-hoc basis
* Front-to-Back analysis & reconciliations of front office PnL and balance sheet to firm sub-ledgers
* Assist with execution of month-end controls ensuring management vs financial P&L variances are within thresholds
* Analyze traders’ risk positions and understand and apply the Greeks (Delta, Vega Gamma) vs daily market moves
* Would be typical own set of books / cost center and Business Units
* Liaise with various business partners such as Technology, Market Risk, Credit Risk, Operations and Finance to resolve issues / queries
* Development & continuous improvement of existing processes & workflow
* Testing / UAT for systems work ranging from minor system releases to major system implementations
* Remediation of issues in an autonomous yet timely manner considering the principles of control and the need to mitigate operational risk

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
Qualified Chartered Accountant/CPA /CFA / MBA from Tier I/II institute
  
  
Certifications If Any
  
  

* CFA / FRM certified candidates would be preferred
* Advanced education and/or enhanced technical qualifications are a plus
* Ability to use Excel Power Query or Alteryx would enhance the candidate’s attractiveness significantly

**Experience Range\***
2-5 years of experience in Global Markets
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Prior BFC experience for >2 years is mandatory
* Proficiency in MS Office Suite; expert knowledge of Excel, Word, PowerPoint. Knowledge of Visual Basic, Access databases and macros will be an added advantage.
* The right individual will have strong people skills and can multi-task to manage the challenges of Finance processes yet have the awareness to escalate potential issues to their supervisor in a timely manner
* Candidate must have a proven track record of communicating effectively with personnel from various areas within an organization and at different management levels
* Must be proactive and be a highly motivated and self-starter. Reactive and/or passive individuals need not apply

**Desired Skills**

* Alteryx / Python / Tableau knowledge would be an added advantage
* Must be proactive and be a highly-motivated self-starter
* Effective communication skills with English proficiency
* Demonstrated ability to work in a high pressure environment
* Takes initiative and challenges existing processes and procedures in a proactive manner
* Strong team player
* Ability to analyze issues independently and derive solutions
* Analytical skills
* Inherent sense of principles of control through experience and sound judgment
* Reliability

**Work Timings\***
1:30 PM to 10:30 PM
  
  
**Job Location\***
Hyderabad/Gurugram/Mumbai

title: Article Assistant
description:

The Article Assistant will also help in gathering and analyzing client financial data, maintaining organized records, and contributing to client communication and follow-ups. This is an on-site role based in Himayatnagar, requiring consistent presence at the office and occasional visits to client locations as needed.

* Ability to work full-time on-site in Himayatnagar, manage multiple assignments, and meet deadlines under supervision.
* Qualified both groups of CA Inter
* Commitment to professional ethics, confidentiality, and continuous learning in audit and taxation.

title: Software Development Engineer III - Gainsight
description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
The Software Development Engineer (SDE) serves as a primary contact for any questions related to how IT systems work from both a business and technical perspective in Gainsight & Salesforce. The SDE will support business operations by resolving production issues and completing work requests in a scrum environment. The SDE partners with business liaisons/PO/PM to help translate software requirements into technical specifications and partners with Business Systems Analysts and QA analysts to develop logical technical processes. The SDE also performs basic cost-benefit calculations, interdependency analysis, and prioritization exercises related to systems changes.
  
  
The SDE has extensive experience in the analysis of complex business problems, determining appropriate systems solutions within Gainsight and other platform integrations. Provides project management of different groups to achieve results. Provides experienced technical expertise in identifying, evaluating and developing systems and procedures that are cost effective and improve work efficiency.
  
  
This position provides production support for Services Applications. In this position, you will work with cross functional IT and business teams to troubleshoot problems, propose solutions, and apply fixes to quickly resolve issues or restore service. Additionally, this role will look for opportunities to improve operational efficiency, or improve customer experience. This position also partners with IT delivery teams to create or enhance Gainsight solutions on the Gainsight NXT platform and transition capabilities to IT Operations.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
Release / Project Support (40% of time)
  
  

* Analyzing, designing solutions, developing an approach, driving the development of the solution with the developer and managing/maintaining solutions built on the Gainsight and Salesforce.com platform (Should be willing to do hands-on development if need be).
* Perform testing on Salesforce platform applications.
* Drive Development, test, manage the implementation of features and maintain application software working with established processes.
* Communicate effectively with developers, business, and QA teams.
* Identify opportunities to fine-tune and optimize applications of developed projects and processes.
* Provide technical support and consultation for application and infrastructure questions.
* Ensure that the work delivered by the team is of high quality by performing testing/validation and owning the functional area assigned.
* Work with business users to prioritize production issues for resolution
* Ensure that all documentation has been updated and that work product meets compliance requirements.

Application Expertise (30% of time)
  
  

* Function as a sub-team lead and Gainsight technical and business process SME.
* Experience working with Customer Success and Customer Service teams.
* Working independently, and in support of the Business Analyst team, contributes to the definition and documentation of functional requirements surrounding complex business issues.
* Works with users to understand their complex application requirements in order to design, document, and deploy configurations, enhancements and integrated solutions that meet F5 business needs.
* Manages relationships with external service providers, as needed.
* Responsible for mentoring and developing less senior analysts.
* Responsible for upholding F5’s Business Code of Ethics and for promptly reporting violations of the Code or other company policies.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

Production Support (30% of time)
  
  

* Following F5’s incident management processes monitor incoming production support ticket queues, resolve modest to high complexity tickets, assign other tickets to analysts as needed.
* Research and resolve ongoing Application/Data issues in production while working to improve F5’s incident management processes.
* Partner with Development Team(s) to help identify, test and deploy recommended fixes/patches.
* Lead troubleshooting and root cause determination and proactively identify opportunities to prevent service interruption.
* Ability to resolve issues quickly and accept responsibility for the resolution.
* Troubleshoot technical issues related to Gainsight and Salesforce Administration.
* Engage business and extract details that may be unclear as issues are described.
* Engage the appropriate IT teams and third-party vendors during service interruption issues to ensure quick resolution.
* Lead critical incident troubleshooting efforts of cross functional teams and third-party vendors to drive resolution of service interruption.
* Responsibility, at a high level, includes application availability, reliability, and stability on a 7 x 24 x 365 basis.
* Ensure timely resolution of all production issues meeting or exceeding SLAs.

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**

* Expertise with Custom Objects, Rules Engine, Data Designer, Journey Orchestrator, Renewal Center, Scorecards and Gainsight Surveys.

* Ability to explore new features in Gainsight platform, thus applying them to resolve and improve the productivity of current CSMs way of working.
* Basic to intermediate coding experience in Python for AI/ML workflows or agent integration.

* BS/BA or equivalent work experience

title: AES Salesforce Vlocity – Senior Associate
description:

title: Escalation Specialist (SME) - Technical voice support
description:
**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
We are seeking a Technically proficient Escalation Specialist to manage complex technical issues, critical incidents, and high-priority escalations in a healthcare IT environment. The role requires end-to-end case ownership, effective coordination with technical teams, timely resolution within defined SLAs, and strict adherence to patient-data confidentiality and information security requirements. Prior healthcare application experience is an advantage; hands-on Epic/EHR expertise is preferred but not mandatory.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Escalation Management: Own complex and high-priority cases from investigation through resolution, ensuring clear ownership, follow-ups, and SLA adherence.
* Technical Troubleshooting: Investigate application access, authentication, connectivity, performance, and related issues; coordinate with L2/L3, application, infrastructure, and vendor teams.
* Healthcare Application Support: Support technical issues involving clinical applications and EHR/EMR platforms; understand the operational impact of clinical system disruptions.
* Critical Incident Management: Assess severity and business impact, coordinate incident response, provide timely status updates, and escalate issues that may affect critical clinical workflows.
* Root Cause Analysis: Identify recurring issues and process gaps; drive corrective and preventive actions to reduce repeat incidents.
* SLA and Ticket Management: Monitor queues, aging cases, pending actions, and SLA risks while maintaining accurate ticket documentation and closure details.
* Stakeholder Communication: Communicate clearly with technical teams, customers, and management; set realistic expectations and remain professional under pressure.
* Patient Data Confidentiality: Access sensitive information only when authorized and necessary; follow applicable privacy and security requirements, including HIPAA where applicable, approved access controls, and secure data-handling procedures.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain troubleshooting guides, SOPs, knowledge articles, and escalation procedures; share learnings with frontline support teams.
* Reporting and Improvement: Analyze escalation trends, report operational risks, and recommend workflow, quality, and automation improvements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 3–5+ years of experience in technical support, IT service desk, application support, or escalation management.
* Experience troubleshooting complex issues and managing critical or time-sensitive escalations.
* Good understanding of incident management, SLA monitoring, ticket prioritization, and escalation procedures.
* Experience with ServiceNow, ManageEngine, Jira, or similar ticketing platforms.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, written communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to prioritize competing issues, work under pressure, and maintain end-to-end ownership.
* Sound documentation practices and understanding of information security, access controls, and confidential data handling.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in healthcare IT support, clinical applications, or healthcare enterprise systems.
* Exposure to EHR/EMR platforms such as Epic, including access or application issue troubleshooting.
* Awareness of HIPAA and applicable healthcare privacy and security requirements.
* Experience with major incident management, root-cause analysis, problem management, quality audits, or SOP development.
* Familiarity with Excel-based reporting, knowledge management, and automation initiatives.

**Key Competencies and Performance Expectations**
The successful candidate demonstrates ownership and accountability; sound prioritization based on severity, business impact, and SLA risk; calm communication during critical incidents; collaboration across technical teams; and a continuous-improvement mindset.
  
  
Performance will be assessed against defined targets for SLA adherence, escalation resolution, documentation quality, repeat-incident reduction, stakeholder satisfaction, and compliance with security and privacy requirements.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**S**
**ervice line - Position Title: TechOps\_SAP\_FSCM\_Senior\_3**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for an SAP FSCM Senior Consultant to join the EY GDS Team. As part of our EY GDS – TechOps team, you will be responsible for providing advanced functional support for SAP FSCM, Treasury, Banking and Cash Management across various regions for our global clients. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders and cross-functional teams to resolve complex issues, drive enhancements, optimize business processes, and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  
  
This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in delivering high-quality application management services, supporting global clients through best-in-class solutions, automation, and innovation.
  
  
**To qualify for the role, you must have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Technology (B.E./B.Tech) or Commerce/Finance (B.Com, M.Com), MBA (Finance), CA, ICWA/CMA, or equivalent professional experience.
* 5-7 years of experience in one or more areas within SAP FSCM, Treasury, Banking, or Cash Management, preferably supporting global clients.

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Strong experience in SAP Application Management and Production Support environments.
* Responsible for managing SAP FSCM incidents, service requests, defects, and enhancements while ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.
* Lead incident troubleshooting activities by analyzing complex issues, identifying root causes, and coordinating resolution activities.
* Work closely with customers and cross-functional teams to ensure timely resolution of issues and delivery of business requirements.
* Handle change requests with a clear understanding of business processes and system impacts.
* Support business process improvements through configuration changes, automation opportunities, and system optimization.
* Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes including Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management.
* Cross-functional communication skills with experience working in offshore/onsite delivery models.
* Experience in defect analysis, root cause identification, and resolution within SAP FSCM, Treasury, Banking, and Cash Management solutions.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced and time-critical environment.
* Strong communication, collaboration, analytical, and leadership skills with the ability to work effectively within global teams.
* Flexibility in managing work hours due to the nature of Application Management, including shift support and critical business escalations.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you'll also have:**

* Well versed with SAP FSCM and Treasury modules including Bank Account Management (BAM), Cash Management, Liquidity Management, In-House Bank (IHB), Treasury & Risk Management (TRM), IHB Settlement, Intercompany Settlement, Equity Management, Loan Management, Bank Communication Management (BCM), Electronic Bank Statements (EBS), Payment Processing, Cash Positioning and Liquidity Forecasting. Experience with SAP S/4HANA Treasury and FSCM is preferred.
* Experience with FSCM integration points across FI, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Banking, Treasury, MM, and SD modules.
* SAP Certification in SAP FSCM, Treasury & Risk Management, or SAP S/4HANA Finance is preferred.

**What you will do:**

* Provide day-to-day Application Management support for SAP applications across IT Service Management processes including Incident, Service Request, Enhancement, Change, and Problem Management activities as a Level 3 Application Management Specialist.
* Lead and coordinate the resolution of complex functional and technical issues, ensuring timely restoration of services and business continuity.
* Perform root cause analysis and drive permanent corrective actions for recurring issues.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams to gather requirements, assess impacts, and recommend SAP FSCM, Treasury, Banking, and Cash Management solutions.
* Support delivery of enhancements, minor projects, and continuous improvement initiatives within the SAP FSCM and Treasury landscape.
* Develop and maintain functional documentation including configuration documents, process flows, test scripts, and knowledge articles.
* Mentor and support junior team members by sharing functional expertise, best practices, and troubleshooting approaches.
* Drive process optimization, automation opportunities, and operational efficiencies across support activities.
* Stay current with SAP best practices, emerging technologies, and industry trends to support innovation within the support organization.
* Participate in on-call rotations and provide off-hours support as required to ensure availability and reliability of critical SAP systems.
* Be available to support client requirements across Australia, Asia, Europe, and Americas time zones as needed.

**What We Look For**

* A team of people with commercial acumen, experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 250+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Data practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits:**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply:**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
**Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.**
**“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.**
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Tech Process Senior Specialist - Customer Support (Orion) - M&A 360
description:
**Join Us!**
At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Tech Process Senior Specialist, you act as the critical bridge between global frontline support [across PTGSB segments], Product Engineering, and Center of Excellence (CoE). You are the final line of defense for complex technical challenges and the primary architect of the knowledge that empowers our entire support ecosystem. You will support agents, help troubleshoot advanced technical issues, while focusing on efficiency and product improvement. You will handle final level consults from their respective PAs to speed up and ensure correct solutions are provided for Account Managers and end customers.
  
  
In addition to consults from the frontline support, the Tech Process Senior Specialist will also handle escalations from the Sales team to resolve high priority tickets. You will also support new product launches (Closed and Open Beta) from resolving technical issues for clients, creating new content for launches, and capturing and disseminating knowledge gained on new features to the broader team across GOC and partners.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**

* You are responsible for resolving the most critical technical consults, architecting the knowledge management framework for new product launches (Beta), and upskilling GOC and partner teams to ensure high-quality support. You don't just solve problems; you perform root-cause analysis to implement long-term fixes that improve the product for everyone.
* Advanced Technical Resolution: Act as the final point of escalation for the most critical and complex technical consults, ensuring end-to-end ownership and resolution for Google customers.
* Engineering Liaison & Bug Management: Own the end-to-end bug reporting lifecycle. Translate complex, ambiguous technical failures into high-quality bug reports for Engineering, ensuring all technical requirements, reproduction steps, and impact assessments are clearly communicated to drive faster resolution.
* Knowledge Architecture: Partner with Product Enablement Team and Center of Excellence team to co-create, update, and audit troubleshooting content and documentation for current products and new Beta releases.
* Strategic Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering, and CoEs to provide strategic feedback based on support trends. Lead deep-dive root cause analysis to advocate for product and process improvements.
* Ecosystem Empowerment: Develop and deliver formal training, "Train-the-Trainer" (TTT) sessions, and certification programs to build a pipeline of product experts across GOC L1 and partner teams.
* AI & Innovation: Manage Agent Assist pilots for relevant new product launches and validate AI-generated support outputs. Model domain knowledge to improve automated support tools and test outputs for upcoming product features.
* Data-Driven Insights: Analyze complex datasets to identify systemic issues and performance trends. Translate these insights into actionable business recommendations to enhance the customer journey.
* Inclusive Leadership: Drive a culture of mentorship. Guide frontline SMEs on product nuances and foster a collaborative, globally dispersed team environment.

**Required Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of experience in project/program management, technical consulting, or a client-facing role.
* 4+ years of experience specifically within the Ads Product ecosystem
* Experience in end-to-end Campaign Operations and Performance Diagnostics, including media planning, traffic analysis, and real-time optimization. Must have a proven track record of performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on complex delivery issues and translating technical troubleshooting into customer-centric solutions.
* Strong written and oral communication and experiencing interfacing with Engineering and Product teams
* Experience in content development or knowledge management; with a focus on translating internal product specifications into actionable support content and instructional materials for iterative product releases.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience in data analysis and interpretation (e.g., SQL, PLX).
* Ability to pivot expertise across different Google Ads products [Search, Video, Display, Mobile, Commerce et] Platform analytics and tools.
* Proven track record of navigating interdependent processes and making decisions that prioritize the customer in ambiguous situations.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and competing priorities under tight deadlines.

**Benefits**

* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Operations Center (GOC) jobs profile, and any job applications you choose to submit, is subject to GOC's Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy.
  
  
Google Operations Center (GOC) is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or veteran status or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.
  
  
To ensure a barrier-free interview, please mention any required assistance or specific arrangements in your application and confirm them with your recruiter.
  
  
To all recruitment agencies: Google Operations Center (GOC) does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, GOC employees, or any other organization location. GOC is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
  
  
*Thanks for your interest in this opportunity! Our recruitment team will contact you if your profile is a good fit for the role. If you don't hear from us within 2-3 weeks, please consider your application unsuccessful at this time. We value your patience throughout this time. For any questions, feel free to reach out to us at goc-candidate-global@googleoperationscenter.com.*
