title: Learning Management System Administrator/Implementation Specialist (Cornerstone Preferred)
description:
**Certification Platform Specialist (LMS (Learning Solutions) Implementation/Admin Specialist | Hybrid | Hyderabad or Pune**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

**About the Role**

The Certification Platforms Specialist owns the technology behind the Cornerstone Certification Program and is on the critical path for launching paid, proctored credentials in January 2027. You implement, integrate, and run the credentialing stack (Credly, the proctoring platform, the Cornerstone LMS, e-commerce, and Salesforce) so candidates can buy, take, pass, and renew credentials with minimal manual effort, and so credential data reaches partner and account records accurately. You also manage the vendors behind these platforms and turn program needs into clear functional requirements.

**In This Role You Will**

* Implement and run proctoring on two Cornerstone LMS instances, working with the proctoring vendor’s implementation team to meet the January 2027 launch.
* Configure e-commerce for paid exams on the internal certification portal, including pricing, checkout, and receipts.
* Set up and manage voucher creation and redemption for partners in the Cornerstone partner program and its partner tiers.
* Configure and maintain Training Models functionality in the LMS for certification paths, and own LMS maintenance for certification (configuration, testing, and release-driven updates) in partnership with LMS platform owners.
* Administer Credly, including badge templates, issuance rules, expirations, and connections to program workflows.
* Build and maintain integrations (APIs and webhooks) between Credly, the proctoring vendor, the LMS, and Salesforce so credential data reaches partner and account records, following the integration standards set by the Product Manager and Architect, Enablement Experiences.
* Act as data steward for certification data: own data quality, definitions, and the data feed to the Strategy & Operations team.
* Keep every exam and certification configuration compliant within 3 weeks of each major Cornerstone release, working with the Instructional Designer (Assessment Programs).
* Manage relationships with Credly, the proctoring vendor, and other platform vendors, including service levels, escalations, renewals, and roadmap input, and translate program needs into functional requirements, test plans, and acceptance criteria.
* Serve as the technical escalation point for certification issues raised through Cornerstone Community, the program mailbox, and ServiceNow, and document configurations, integrations, and runbooks.
* Monitor proctoring for exam integrity, including AI identity verification results and signs of AI-enabled cheating, and escalate incidents to the Certification Team Lead.
* Identify, test, and implement AI-enabled automation for routine operational work; measure impact and retire unnecessary manual processes.
* Automate badge issuance, annual renewals, and reminder communications end to end, and review routine platform tasks each quarter to automate or retire them.
* Build AI-assisted candidate support (such as a support assistant and suggested responses) to deflect routine technical tickets, with human oversight for complex cases.
* Continuously maps the routine and repeatable tasks within this role, identifies automation opportunities using AI and workflow tools, proposes and implements solutions, and measures whether the automation delivers the expected time and quality improvement.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Launch: Paid, proctored credentials live on both LMS instances by the January 2027 launch date.
* Automation: Median time from passing result to badge issued under 48 hours, and 90% or more of renewals fully automated within 12 months of launch.
* Release compliance: 100% of exams compliant within 3 weeks of each major Cornerstone release.
* Support and AI transformation: First response to technical tickets within 1 business day and 85% resolved within 3 business days, with routine ticket volume down 30% through AI-assisted support.
* Data quality: Accuracy of the credential data feed to the Strategy & Operations team and Salesforce: 100% of pass records result in a correctly issued badge and an accurate record in Salesforce within 48 hours of exam completion, with discrepancies flagged and resolved within 3 business days.

**You Have Got What it Takes If You Have**

* 5+ years administering and implementing learning or certification platforms (implementation, not only support).
* Hands-on experience with digital badging (Credly or similar) and online proctoring platforms.
* Experience building or maintaining integrations using REST APIs and webhooks, including Salesforce data.
* LMS administration experience, including configuration and release testing.
* Experience managing vendors and writing functional requirements.
* Strong data management skills with attention to accuracy.
* Ability to evaluate AI outputs and apply sound judgment about when a human must decide.

**Preferred Experience**

* Cornerstone LMS administration.
* E-commerce or payment configuration for training or certification.
* Experience with AI identity verification and remote proctoring security.
* Scripting or workflow automation experience (such as Python or Power Automate).
* Experience launching a new certification or credential program.

**AI & Continuous Learning**

* Automates issuance, renewals, and reminders, builds AI-assisted candidate support that deflects routine tickets, and understands AI identity verification and AI-enabled cheating risks in proctoring.
* Uses AI tools every day in their own work and can show an example where AI changed how the work is done, not just how fast.
* Evaluates AI output critically for accuracy, bias, privacy and data handling, and knows when a human must decide.
* Actively explores internal (Cornerstone AI) and external tools, brings recommendations to the team, and retires tools and processes that do not earn their place.
* Keeps skills current through communities, certifications, hands-on experimentation and industry learning, and shares what they learn with the team.

**How You Work**

* Customer obsessed: Start with the learner’s and the account’s problem, not the tool.
* Innovate and transform: Challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that do not earn their place.
* Proactive leadership: See problems and act before being asked.
* Get it done: Ship, measure and iterate.
* Forward looking: Plan for where technology and the business are going.
* AI native: Use AI daily to rethink work, not just accelerate it.
* Get uncomfortable to succeed: Take on hard, ambiguous problems and stay with them.

title: Software Engineer
description:

title: Senior UX Designer
description:
**Role : Sr UX Designer
  
  
Job Type : Full Time**
**Location : On-site, Hyderabad**
(Work From Office)
  
  
**About HugoHub**
Hello and Welcome!
  
  
HugoHub is the intelligent foundation for the future of finance, providing a modular banking platform that empowers financial institutions to move at speed.
  
  
Designed to simplify the path to digitization for small and medium-sized banks, the platform consists of both backend core platform and frontend experience layer that offer a full suite of modular banking services through a single integration. By embedding intelligence and compliance directly into its architecture, HugoHub enables financial institutions to launch specialized products, automate back-office complexity, and scale with unparalleled efficiency.
  
  
HugoHub is a B2B platform with multiple offices across Singapore, India, United Kingdom, Indonesia, and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It is owned by Atlas Consolidated Pte Ltd.
  
  
****Atlas****
**Atlas Consolidated Pte Ltd. is Headquartered in Singapore.**
**A regulated entity with strong credentials**
Atlas Consolidated Pte Ltd satisfies stringent corporate governance, operations, and regulatory integrity requirements to maintain licences from regulatory bodies, such as:
  
  

* Monetary Authority of Singapore - Major Payment Institution licence and Financial Advisors licence
* Ministry of Law, Singapore - Regulated Precious Metals Dealers licence
* Visa Inc. - Principal Members Issuing licence

**Who are we looking for?**
**UX Designer**
for our HugoHub Design Team, with strong expertise in user experience design, research-driven problem-solving, and system-based design thinking.
  
  
As a UX Designer at HugoHub, you’ll be part of building experiences that shape the way users across the world interact with our fintech ecosystem. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design peers to craft thoughtful, intuitive, and scalable solutions for complex problems, balancing business goals with user needs.
  
  
**We’re Looking For Someone Who**

* Stays curious, updated, and keeps learning to grow as a designer.
* Questions norms to continuously improve and elevate user experiences.
* Empathises deeply, reimagines creatively, and designs with clarity and intent.
* Applies a systems-based approach to build scalable, cohesive design patterns.
* Breaks down and solves problems from the ground up with structured thinking.
* Collaborates across teams and proactively drives meaningful design improvements.
* Communicates design rationale confidently, backed with research and user insights.
* Manages time effectively, balancing exploration, iteration, and sound decision-making.

**Required Qualification**

* 6-8 years of relevant experience in UX Design.
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communication Design, Human–Computer Interaction, or a related field is preferred.

**Must Have Skills**

* Strong foundation in UX methodologies with proven experience in user research, testing, and translating insights into user-centered design.
* Ability to explore multiple design approaches and adapt based on feedback and testing.
* Deep understanding of Information Architecture and designing intuitive navigation systems.
* Proficiency in Figma and familiarity with established UX workflows.
* Leadership qualities to mentor junior designers and contribute to design standards and practices across the team.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Experience designing for B2C and B2B products, especially mobile-first experiences.
* Exposure to fintech domain projects and data-rich experiences.
* Ability to design clear, engaging layouts that simplify complex data.
* Advanced prototyping skills to create interactive prototypes for usability testing and iteration.

**How will you contribute to the company?**
You’ll collaborate with PMs, developers, fellow UX and UI designers to:
  
  

* Gather insights, advocate for users, and design thoughtful, data-informed fintech experiences.

* Conduct usability testing, analyse user feedback, and translate insights into impactful design improvements.
* Share and receive design feedback openly, growing together as a design team.
* Ship products and continuously refine experiences that thousands of users engage with daily.
* Own end-to-end design delivery across multiple product initiatives.
* Mentor interns and junior designers to build a strong design culture.

**HugoHub values being Responsible, Open, and Collaborative.**
You should be passionate about what HugoHub stands for:
  
  

* Honest, truthful and open communication at all times with the team members.
* We are responsible to our customers, community, and team to help shape a more open, collaborative approach to wealth. This is how HugoHub hopes to make a difference and help us build better communities.

**Curious To Know More**
Find and follow us here: Linkedin

title: Senior Designer (Brand and Marketing)
description:
**About Plane**
Plane's mission is to build the infrastructure the world's work runs on. Every organization runs on three things: the projects it's driving, the knowledge it keeps, and the requests it fields. Plane brings all three into one open, adaptable platform: simple enough for any team to adopt, dependable enough for organizations to build on. And we are building it for a future where humans and AI agents do that work together.
  
  
Plane began in public on GitHub at the end of 2022. Since then it has grown into a work management platform used by teams around the world: 61,000+ stars, 6,200+ forks, and a contributor community that reads our code and files our issues. Organizations run Plane as a managed Cloud service, on their own infrastructure, or inside fully isolated environments. Building in the open keeps us close to users and raises the standard for everything we ship.
  
  
Plane is the #1 work infrastructure in aerospace, defense, financial services, and other regulated industries: organizations whose requirements for control, auditability, and data residency rule most software out. When the strictest buyers pick a system of record, that choice means something. Adoption is growing fastest on Plane Cloud and in sovereign clouds, deployments that keep everything inside a country's own borders and rules.
  
  
Plane is backed by top investors and built across San Francisco, London, and Hyderabad. We work in tightly knit teams, stay close to users, and care about the visible product as much as the unglamorous details that make software dependable. People own problems end to end, and we add process only when it helps the work.
  
  
****Humans and agents****
We believe the next decade of work will be done by humans and AI agents together. Not agents replacing people, and not a chat window bolted onto software built for humans clicking around, but both working in one system of action, where an agent's work is as visible and as accountable as a person's.
  
  
Most software treats AI as a feature. We treat agents as a kind of worker, and that changes what the system underneath has to be. Agents are only as good as the context they can see and the state they are allowed to change, so shared context, explicit state, durable history, and accountable action are not items on our roadmap. They are the product. Plane is built so that when an agent acts, the humans responsible can see what happened, why, and on whose authority, and the record survives.
  
  
This is what the infrastructure is for: making the future where humans and agents work together useful, legible, and fully within the organization's control. Every role at Plane is some part of building that.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a
**Senior Brand & Marketing Designer**
to join Plane’s small but mighty creative team. You’ll shape how the world sees, feels, and remembers Plane — across every touchpoint. You’re someone who brings visual storytelling to life, sharpens narratives, and turns abstract ideas into design systems that scale across campaigns, screens, and cultures.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of brand and business: part visionary, part builder, always clear.
  
  
****What You’ll Do****

* Champion the Plane brand — evolve its visual language and ensure coherence across digital, social, experiential, and product marketing channels.
* Design and lead multi-platform marketing campaigns — from ideation to execution — across product launches, thought leadership, videos, events, and more.
* Collaborate with founders, engineers, and marketers to tell crisp, clear stories that reflect our values and vision.
* Take ownership of key brand projects including website design, social creative, motion graphics, and content marketing assets.
* Inspire and guide external agencies, freelancers, and partners — always with an eye on design clarity and brand integrity.
* Keep your ear to the ground on culture, design trends, and tech — and bring fresh inspiration into the brand.
* Contribute to the evolution of our design systems and drive cross-functional design rituals that promote creative excellence.

****What you'll bring****

* A sharp, versatile design portfolio that shows both concept and craft across campaigns, storytelling, and digital assets.
* 4+ years of experience in brand, marketing, or content design — preferably in a high-growth tech company or creative agency.
* Fluency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite; bonus if you dabble in motion, code, or AI tools.
* Proven ability to pitch ideas, present confidently, and guide stakeholders toward great creative outcomes.
* Ability to simplify complex ideas and work independently with structured thinking.
* Collaborative mindset — you work well with marketers, engineers, and founders alike.
* Comfort working in ambiguity and shipping quickly with care.

****Why Plane?****
Every company says it is different. We will try evidence instead.
  
  
**The scope is real.**
We are a passion team serving companies of every size, including some of the largest in the world. Something you ship this month will run inside a Fortune 500 company and a 50-person startup in the same week, and you will hear from both.
  
  
**The constraints make you better.**
Plane runs in our cloud, in customers' clouds, and on machines that will never touch the internet. Much of the work happens in the open, where the issues, the fixes, and the roadmap conversations are public. Building software that survives all of that is harder than building an ordinary SaaS product, and it is a better education than most companies can offer.
  
  
**The people-and-agents future is being built here, in production.**
We think humans and AI agents will share one system of action for work. We are building that system now, for customers who already depend on it, and you will work on that problem directly whatever your role.
  
  
**Your name is on the work.**
The teams are deeply connected enough that credit and responsibility both find you fast. That is some pressure. Mostly it is the fun part.
  
  
If that sounds like your kind of place, we would like to meet you.
  
  
*Plane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.*

title: Scrum Master
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Scrum Master to join our growing Technology team, supporting two of our General Insurance development squads based in Hyderabad. You will work across a combination of new development, maintenance, and support - spanning the full product lifecycle from concept and system design through to live deployment in the cloud.
  
The two squads you will support are drawn from:
  

* COA – Claims Outcome Adviser
* IVI – Intelligent Vehicle Inspection
* AIS – Automated Insurance Solutions
* Property UK

As Scrum Master, your primary role is to protect your squads and keep them focused. You will facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove impediments, coach teams on Scrum values and practices, and work closely with Product Owners and stakeholders to keep backlogs healthy and delivery on track. These squads are building innovative SaaS products for the insurance industry — used by insurers, suppliers, and regulators across the UK.

  

Key Responsibilities
  
Ceremony Facilitation & Team Focus
  

* Plan, facilitate, and follow up on all Scrum ceremonies for your squads — daily stand - ups, sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and backlog refinement sessions.
* Protect the team from outside distractions and scope creep during sprints, maintaining a focused and productive working environment.
* Ensure retrospectives are meaningful and that agreed actions are tracked and followed through, driving genuine continuous improvement.
* Adapt facilitation style to the needs of each squad — recognising that COA, IVI, AIS, and Property UK each have distinct delivery contexts and stakeholder landscapes.

Backlog Management & Release Planning
  

* Work closely with Product Owners to ensure the backlog is well - maintained, prioritised, and that stories are fully refined and ready for development before sprint commitment.
* Support release planning and sprint scheduling, helping Product Owners and stakeholders understand team capacity and realistic delivery timelines.
* Flag risks and dependencies early, facilitating cross - squad or cross - team coordination where needed — particularly where IVI, COA, AIS, or Property UK work intersects.
* Maintain accurate and up - to - date work boards in Azure DevOps / JIRA, ensuring cards move through the process efficiently and blockers are visible and actioned.

Impediment Removal & Continuous Improvement
  

* Proactively identify and remove impediments — whether technical, organisational, or interpersonal — that slow team progress or threaten sprint goals.
* Track and report key team metrics including velocity, focus factor, and sprint burndown, using data to identify trends and support informed delivery decisions.
* Coordinate with other Scrum Masters across the engineering function when cross - squad dependencies or shared platform needs arise.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Agile practices across the wider team, sharing learnings and good practice between squads.

Agile Coaching & Advocacy
  

* Coach squad members, Product Owners, and stakeholders on Agile principles, Scrum theory, and the value of iterative delivery.
* Champion a culture of transparency, inspection, and adaptation — helping the teams embrace the spirit of Agile, not just the mechanics.
* Support the onboarding of new team members into Agile ways of working, ensuring they understand ceremonies, roles, and expectations from day one.
* Act as a visible advocate for Agile best practices within the broader Hyderabad engineering community.

Stakeholder Communication & Collaboration
  

* Maintain clear, timely communication with Product Owners, the Tech Lead, and other stakeholders regarding squad progress, risks, and blockers.
* Work collaboratively with product management to align on development priorities, card readiness, and release timelines across both squads.
* Produce or contribute to sprint and delivery reporting as required, supporting visibility for UK - based counterparts and senior stakeholders.

  

Essential Requirements
  

* Scrum Master certification (CSM, PSM I, or equivalent) and/or 3+ years of hands - on Scrum Master experience in a software delivery environment.
* Strong knowledge of Agile methodology and frameworks, including Scrum and Kanban, with a solid understanding of iterative and incremental development.
* Demonstrable experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and managing backlogs in a commercial product development setting.
* Confident communicator and facilitator, able to engage effectively with developers, product managers, and senior stakeholders alike.
* Strong organisational and planning skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple teams simultaneously.
* Proven ability to identify and resolve impediments, manage conflict constructively, and keep teams on track under pressure.
* Proficient in Agile tooling, particularly Azure DevOps and/or JIRA and Confluence; comfortable with MS Office for reporting and documentation.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of outcomes without close supervision.

Desirable
  

* Experience working across multiple squads simultaneously, ideally within a scaled Agile environment.
* Familiarity with the general insurance or financial services industry — knowledge of claims, vehicle inspection, or property insurance workflows is a distinct advantage.
* Experience working with distributed or offshore development teams, particularly across UK and India time zones.
* Additional Agile certifications (SAFe, PSM II, A - CSM) are advantageous.
* Familiarity with SaaS product development and cloud - hosted delivery environments.

  

**Our People, Our Culture**

For more than 50 years, Verisk has helped property and casualty insurers make smarter decisions about risk through AI-powered risk modeling, advanced analytics, and technology solutions spanning the entire policy lifecycle. title: Medical Communications Expert
description:
Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
**Good Health Can’t Wait**
.
  
  
We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.
  
  
For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).
  
  
‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency
  
  
Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

**Job Description**

**Role Summary**

We are seeking an experienced
**Digital Medical Communications expert**
to develop evidence-based scientific content that supports healthcare professional (HCP) education, digital engagement, and informed clinical decision-making.

The role requires expertise in interpreting medical literature, synthesizing clinical evidence, and transforming complex scientific information into clear, compelling, and compliant content across medical, digital, and omnichannel platforms. The successful candidate will combine scientific rigor with content strategy to create impactful learning and engagement experiences for healthcare professionals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Scientific Storytelling & Insight Generation**

**Responsibilities**

**Omnichannel Content**

**Responsibilities**

* Medical Affairs
* Brand & Marketing Teams
* Product Managers
* Medical Review Teams

**Scientific Excellence**

* Deliver scientifically accurate and evidence-backed content
* Maintain balance, objectivity, and medical integrity

**Editorial Excellence**

* Ensure clarity, consistency, and readability across formats
* Adhere to editorial standards and best practices

**Compliance**

* Follow review and approval processes
* Maintain appropriate referencing and citation practices
* Ensure adherence to applicable regulatory and compliance requirements

**Qualifications**

**Required Experience:**
6-10 Years

* B.Pharm
* Pharm.D
* M.Pharm
* MSc (Life Sciences)
* Certification in Medical Writing or Scientific Communication

**Experience Requirements**

* Healthcare Content Strategy
* Pharmaceutical Communications
* Digital Medical Communications
* Medical Writing
* Scientific Communications

**Core Competencies**

* Scientific storytelling
* Strong written and verbal communication
* Omnichannel content planning
* HCP engagement strategies
* Content performance analytics
* Familiarity with AI-powered content tools

**Professional Skills**

* Analytical thinking
* Stakeholder management
* Collaboration
* Attention to detail
* Project ownership
* Ability to manage multiple priorities

**Additional Information**

**Benefits Offered**
  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
  
  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.
  
  
  
  
**Our Work Culture**
  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.

title: Senior Manager – USDM Enablement
description:
**JOIN AMGEN’S MISSION OF SERVING PATIENTS**
At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission to serve patients living with serious illnesses drives all that we do.
  
  
Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas, Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease, we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
  
  
Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
  
  
**Senior Manager – USDM Enablement**
**What you will do:**
In this role as an individual contributor, you will coordinate enablement for adoption of the Unified Study Definitions Model (USDM) and related protocol metadata standards. You will help translate standards into workable processes, structured content, and downstream-ready information across the digital protocol ecosystem.
  
  
**Strategic Leadership**

* Contribute to USDM and protocol metadata enablement plans, translating standards and business needs into prioritized deliverables.
* Maintain knowledge of standards changes, implementation guidance, and their implications for authoring and downstream systems.
* Identify gaps in protocol content, process, or system readiness and recommend clear remediation steps.

**Execution and Delivery Leadership**

* Coordinate requirements, mappings, examples, testing, and implementation activities for USDM-enabled workflows.
* Work with Medical Writing, Clinical Development, Data Management, Regulatory, and platform teams to support structured protocol content.
* Document standards decisions, process guidance, data mappings, and user-facing materials.
* Track adoption issues and downstream consumption outcomes; escalate ambiguity or delivery risks.

**Individual Contribution**

* Work as an individual contributor, independently managing assigned enablement deliverables and collaborating across teams.
* Share standards knowledge and support peer and stakeholder learning through examples and practical guidance.

**External Representation and Internal Stakeholder Partnerships**

* Partner with Digital Protocol, Medical Writing, Clinical Development, Data Management, Regulatory, DTI, AI&D, and platform providers.
* Facilitate working sessions to clarify standards interpretation, ownership, and downstream requirements.
* Provide concise progress, dependencies, and risks to capability leadership.

**What we expect of you:**
We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The candidate we seek is a capable clinical systems professional with the following qualifications.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree and 8+ years of experience in clinical development, medical writing, clinical data standards, data management, or related technology-enabled work OR
* Bachelor’s degree and 11+ years of experience in clinical development, medical writing, clinical data standards, data management, or related technology-enabled work

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with protocol authoring, clinical data standards, structured content, or clinical systems.
* Understanding of clinical development processes and downstream use of protocol information.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional requirements, testing, or implementation.
* Strong documentation, communication, and analytical skills.

**Core Competencies:**

* Knowledge of USDM, CDISC, protocol metadata, or related standards.
* Experience with digital protocol authoring or structured clinical content.
* Ability to translate standards into workflows, mappings, and user guidance.
* Collaborative problem solving and disciplined delivery.

They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:
  
  

* Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive
* Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection
* Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders
* Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

**What You Can Expect Of Us**
As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.
  
  
As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

We are the only professional services organization who has a separate business dedicated exclusively to the financial services marketplace. Join Risk and Compliance Transformation Team and you will work with multi-disciplinary teams from around the world to deliver a global perspective. Aligned to key industry groups including Asset management, Banking and Capital Markets, Insurance and Private Equity, Health, Government, Power and Utilities, we provide integrated advisory, assurance, tax, and transaction services. Through diverse experiences, world-class learning and individually tailored coaching you will experience ongoing professional development. We are looking for a Risk Data Platforms Specialist in the Risk and Compliance Transformation team, with 8-14 years of regulatory reporting data platforms experience with preferred prior experience in capital, financial and other regulatory reports, involving identification of critical data elements, documentation and validation of end-to-end reporting lineage, source-system analysis and data extraction processes, mapping of data movements, transformations and interfaces across reporting systems. EY Digital Engineering is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. Through our unique combination of competencies and solutions, EY’s DE team helps our clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by developing strategies to stay ahead of the rapid pace of change and disruption and supporting the execution of complex transformations.

* Use working experience for documenting end-to-end data lineage, CDE identification, controls and evidence
* Understand data transformations/aggregation at system hops and identify associated data risks in line with BCBS 239 guidelines

* Map data movements, transformations and interfaces across reporting systems

**Collaboration & Support**

* Ability to work across Regulatory Reporting, Finance, Risk, Data Office and IT
* Provide functional support to all phases of delivery (Sprints, Testing, Hypercare etc.)
* Ability to guide and coach junior team members

**Required Skills**
**Skills and attributes for success**

* 8-14 years of experience in data used for risk, financial and supervisory reporting within the broader data governance context, with right mix of practical lineage capability and strong analytical, investigative, documentation and stakeholder-management skills
* Working experience in Capital Adequacy and Risk Exposures (any 1 or more subject areas of  capital adequacy, own funds, credit risk, market risk, operational risk, leverage, liquidity metrics, large exposures, asset encumbrance)
* Working experience in:

+ Source-system analysis and data extraction processes
+ Mapping of data movements, transformations and interfaces across reporting systems
+ Automation of lineage capture and documentation activities
+ Data catalogue, metadata repository and reporting architecture initiatives
+ Identification of report owners, critical data elements and reporting metrics
+ Documentation and validation of end-to-end reporting lineage

:

**Company Description**
Beauty Gang India Pvt. Ltd., under the Beauty Gang Experts brand, is an innovative haircare company focused on transforming how individuals care for and maintain their hair at home. Leveraging cutting-edge cosmetic science, the brand offers signature lines such as Infusions Rennovador, x.PLEX, and Botoplastia to address diverse hair concerns, from repairing damage to improving strength, smoothness, and shine. Each product is formulated for visible, real-world results and expert-level performance. The company’s mission is to deliver high-quality haircare that keeps hair healthy, strong, and manageable in everyday settings. Beauty Gang Experts fosters a community of artists, professionals, and beauty enthusiasts who see hair as a core part of personal identity.

The Technical Trainer role is a full-time, on-site position based in Hyderabad. The Technical Trainer will design, deliver, and evaluate training programs focused on Beauty Gang Experts’ haircare products, protocols, and techniques for internal teams, salon partners, and other stakeholders. Daily responsibilities include conducting in-person training sessions, demonstrations, and workshops; developing training materials such as manuals, presentations, and videos; and ensuring consistent technical standards across all learners. title: SAP FI-DRC - Senior, Tax Technology Services
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**SAP FI-DRC - Senior, Tax Technology Services**
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited (“USI Tax”) commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service offerings have obtained support services through the USI Tax teams. USI Tax offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as Australia, Belgium, Canada, Germany, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
Deloitte Tax is leading its clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace, offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and technical tax resources to comply with reporting requirements, uncover insights and deploy smarter approaches for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**The Team**
Deloitte’s Tax Technology Consulting team helps organizations align tax, finance, and technology to support operational efficiency and regulatory compliance. The team works with clients to design and implement technology-enabled solutions across tax reporting, process transformation, and SAP-led modernization initiatives. Professionals in this practice collaborate across tax, finance, and technology functions to help clients address complex business and compliance needs.
  
  
As part of Deloitte Tax in India, you will work with multinational clients to address statutory reporting, e-invoicing, and finance process requirements in an evolving global tax environment. This role offers the opportunity to support complex implementations, collaborate across stakeholders, and contribute to large-scale tax technology initiatives.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a
**Senior, Tax Technology Services**
on the Tax Technology Consulting team, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Supporting the implementation of statutory reporting solutions in SAP environments
* Supporting the implementation of e-invoicing solutions for client tax and finance operations
* Gathering business and functional requirements from clients and translating them into implementation support activities
* Coordinating with cross-functional stakeholders to support solution design, testing, and deployment
* Contributing to SAP finance transformation initiatives involving financial posting processes and tax-related operational requirements

**Location: All Locations**
**Shift Timings: Regular hours**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* 6+ years of experience with SAP S/4HANA, or participation in 3 full lifecycle SAP implementations
* Experience supporting global template preparation and rollout activities
* Experience configuring or supporting SAP Finance (FI) processes including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Electronic Bank Statement, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, and Internal Orders
* Experience supporting Procure to Pay, Record to Report, and Order to Cash processes
* Experience working with SAP Finance (FI), Controlling (CO), and integration with Sales and Distribution (SD) and Materials Management (MM)
* Knowledge of generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP)
* Experience supporting change requests, enhancements, or functional improvements in SAP Finance and Controlling environments

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) solutions
* Experience with statutory reporting and e-invoicing implementations
* Experience with European Union tax business processes
* Experience gathering business requirements and working with multiple stakeholder groups
* Experience supporting SAP Finance and Controlling initiatives as an individual contributor or team lead

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

**Role Overview**
As a Technical Product Consultant, you act as the critical bridge between global frontline support [across PTGSB segments], Product Engineering, and Center of Excellence (CoE). You are the final line of defense for complex technical challenges and the primary architect of the knowledge that empowers our entire support ecosystem. You will support agents, help troubleshoot advanced technical issues, while focusing on efficiency and product improvement. You will handle final level consults from their respective PAs to speed up and ensure correct solutions are provided for Account Managers and end customers.

****Position Responsibilities**
**:****

* You are responsible for resolving the most critical technical consults, architecting the knowledge management framework for new product launches (Beta), and upskilling GOC and partner teams to ensure high-quality support. You don't just solve problems; you perform root-cause analysis to implement long-term fixes that improve the product for everyone.
* Advanced Technical Resolution: Act as the final point of escalation for the most critical and complex technical consults, ensuring end-to-end ownership and resolution for Google customers.
* Engineering Liaison & Bug Management: Own the end-to-end bug reporting lifecycle. Translate complex, ambiguous technical failures into high-quality bug reports for Engineering, ensuring all technical requirements, reproduction steps, and impact assessments are clearly communicated to drive faster resolution.
* Knowledge Architecture: Partner with Product Enablement Team and Center of Excellence team to co-create, update, and audit troubleshooting content and documentation for current products and new Beta releases.
* Strategic Stakeholder Partnership: Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering, and CoEs to provide strategic feedback based on support trends. Lead deep-dive root cause analysis to advocate for product and process improvements.
* Ecosystem Empowerment: Develop and deliver formal training, "Train-the-Trainer" (TTT) sessions, and certification programs to build a pipeline of product experts across GOC L1 and partner teams.
* AI & Innovation: Manage Agent Assist pilots for relevant new product launches and validate AI-generated support outputs. Model domain knowledge to improve automated support tools and test outputs for upcoming product features.
* Data-Driven Insights: Analyze complex datasets to identify systemic issues and performance trends. Translate these insights into actionable business recommendations to enhance the customer journey.
* Inclusive Leadership: Drive a culture of mentorship. Guide frontline SMEs on product nuances and foster a collaborative, globally dispersed team environment.

**Required Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of experience in project/program management, technical consulting, or a client-facing role.
* 4+ years of experience specifically within the Ads Product ecosystem
* Experience in end-to-end Campaign Operations and Performance Diagnostics, including media planning, traffic analysis, and real-time optimization. Must have a proven track record of performing Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on complex delivery issues and translating technical troubleshooting into customer-centric solutions.
* Strong written and oral communication and experiencing interfacing with Engineering and Product teams
* Experience in content development or knowledge management; with a focus on translating internal product specifications into actionable support content and instructional materials for iterative product releases.

**Preferred Qualifications**
****Preferred Qualifications:****

* Demonstrated experience in data analysis and interpretation (e.g., SQL, PLX).
* Ability to pivot expertise across different Google Ads products [Search, Video, Display, Mobile, Commerce et] Platform analytics and tools.
* Proven track record of navigating interdependent processes and making decisions that prioritize the customer in ambiguous situations.
* Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and competing priorities under tight deadlines.

**Benefits**

* We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage
* We support your family with gender-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums
* Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

title: Continuous Improvement Lead – Commissioning & Qualification (C&Q)
description:
**About Amgen**
Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.
  
  
**About The Role**
**Role Description:**

* In this vital role, you will lead continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen digital enablement, process standardization, and operational excellence supporting Engineering commissioning and qualification programs.
* This role focuses on advancing the use of Kneat and other digital validation and documentation tools to enhance C&Q execution, documentation quality, compliance, and inspection readiness across Engineering projects and manufacturing facilities.
* The Continuous Improvement Lead will drive improvements to processes, tools, and standards that enable efficient and scalable commissioning and qualification practices.
* This role helps establish and govern standardized C&Q processes, digital tools, and best practices that support consistent execution across Engineering projects and sites.
* The role partners closely with Engineering, Automation, Validation, Quality, Manufacturing, Facilities, Digital Technology, and Project teams to identify opportunities for improvement, implement digital solutions, and standardize C&Q practices across Amgen’s operations.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on C&Q document preparation, digital C&Q execution, and process standardization.
* Establish and maintain governance for C&Q digital tools, documentation standards, and continuous improvement initiatives across Engineering projects and sites.
* Drive optimization, governance, and adoption of Kneat and other digital validation tools across Engineering projects and manufacturing sites.
* Develop and maintain standardized templates, workflows, and best practices supporting digital commissioning and qualification execution.
* Partner with Engineering, Validation, Quality, Manufacturing, Facilities, and Digital Technology teams to identify and implement process and technology improvements.
* Establish and monitor performance metrics and reporting to measure efficiency, documentation quality, and program effectiveness.
* Analyze operational data and program metrics to identify opportunities to improve efficiency, compliance, and execution consistency.
* Lead implementation and adoption of standardized C&Q practices, templates, and procedures across Engineering projects and sites.
* Provide training, coaching, and user support for Kneat and other digital tools used in C&Q execution.
* Ensure digital processes and documentation practices align with GMP requirements, data integrity standards, and regulatory expectations.
* Provide leadership and direction for continuous improvement initiatives across the Commissioning & Qualification Center of Excellence.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence within the C&Q Center of Excellence.

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
* 8–13 years of experience in GMP commissioning, qualification, validation, engineering, technical operations, or continuous improvement within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
* Experience implementing or supporting digital transformation initiatives within Engineering, Validation, or Technical Operations environments.
* Experience implementing or supporting Kneat or other electronic validation/digital documentation platforms.
* Experience supporting commissioning and qualification activities in one or more of the following areas: drug substance, drug product, packaging, or facilities and utilities.

**Functional Skills (Must Have):**

* Strong understanding of risk-based qualification methodologies and lifecycle validation approaches.
* Strong knowledge of GMP documentation practices, data integrity expectations, and inspection readiness principles.
* Experience leading continuous improvement, digital enablement, or process standardization initiatives across engineering or technical operations programs.
* Experience developing or implementing standardized templates, processes, and governance practices supporting commissioning and qualification programs.
* Experience driving cross-site or global process standardization initiatives.
* Experience collaborating across Engineering, Validation, Quality, Manufacturing, Facilities, and Digital Technology organizations.
* Experience developing metrics, dashboards, or reporting tools using Power BI, Tableau, Smartsheet, or similar analytics platforms.
* Knowledge of ASTM E2500, ISPE guidance, or modern risk-based commissioning and qualification approaches.
* Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive adoption of new processes or tools.

**Good-to-Have Skills:**

* Familiarity with digital validation lifecycle management tools and automation platforms.
* Experience supporting large-scale Engineering capital projects or global operational excellence programs.
* Exposure to data analytics, reporting automation, and digital workflow optimization initiatives.
* Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies and operational excellence frameworks.
* Experience supporting inspection readiness initiatives and regulatory audits within GMP environments.

**Soft Skills:**

* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across global cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Ability to foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**
Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

A career in our Government and Public Sector Transformation Management practice, within General Consulting services, will provide you with the opportunity to help clients seize essential advantages by working alongside business leaders to solve their toughest problems and capture their greatest opportunities. We work with some of the world’s largest and most complex companies to understand their unique business issues and opportunities in an ever changing environment. We help create sustainable change by stimulating innovation, unlocking data possibilities, navigating risk and regulatory complexity, optimising deals, and aligning costs with business strategy to create a competitive advantage.
  
  
In joining, you’ll help federal, state and local government clients solve complex business issues and manage jurisdiction related risk. You’ll help our clients assess their operational and security and data management strategies so they can continue to operate more efficiently and effectively, both today and tomorrow.
  
  
**Experienced Recruitment**
Job Description Form

: IT eGov Consulting resource

: Consultant/Senior Consultant

: Advisory

: Government Technology (GovTech) Vertical

: Mumbai | Pune |

: Full time

At PwC, our purpose is to build trust in society and solve important problems. We’re a network of firms in 157 countries with more than 284,000 people who are committed to delivering quality in Assurance, Advisory and Tax services.
  
  
Within Advisory, PwC has a large team (GovTech) that enables government organisations to transform and provide better service to citizens and optimize operations. The open position is for a candidate who desires to work with government clients and bring about a change in society. A successful candidate will be expected to work pro-actively and effectively on multiple client engagements over the period of time and take ownership of the entire project delivery he/she entrusted with.
  
  
The candidate should strong interpersonal skills, who not only enjoys the challenge of working with other team members but externally with a diverse, senior-Government officials across varied Ministries and PSUs. Recent experience and understanding of the Indian business ecosystem and government initiatives is a must.
  
  
The candidate will be required to showcase excellent communication skills and will have demonstrated consistently the skill and capability in delivering impactful and insightful projects in the past. He/she will also be required to participate in client meetings and, during the course of a project, will be responsive to client enquiries, eventually leading the delivery engagement.
  
  
Candidate will also be expected to contribute to Practice or Firm development. This may be adjudged in various ways such as serving as a mentor to other team members, by leading training/development initiatives, contributing to thought leadership papers, assisting other network firms etc.
  
  
Positions are with PwC’s Government Technology (GovTech) practice, which works with Central & State Governments, PSUs, donor agencies, international government clients etc. The position is based out of
**Mumbai | Pune |**
. However, the ideal candidate should not have any constraints to travel for work related opportunities, whether domestic or internationally.

* Define project scope and deliverables that support business goals
* Develop project plans and schedule
* Communicate with stakeholders/customers on an ongoing basis
* Set and continually manage project expectations with team members and customers
* Draft and submit budget proposals, and recommend subsequent budget changes where necessary

* Plan and schedule project timelines and milestones using appropriate tools (Microsoft Project Management)
* Track project milestones and deliverables
* Develop and deliver progress reports, proposals, requirements documentation and presentations
* Issue status reports to the project team, analyse results, and troubleshoot problem areas
* Proactively manage changes in project scope, identify potential crises, and devise contingency plans
* Define project success criteria and disseminate them to involved parties throughout project life cycle.
* Build, develop, and grow business relationships vital to the success of the project.
* Conduct project “lessons learned” meetings and create a recommendations report in order to identify successful and unsuccessful project elements
* Develop best practices and tools for project execution and management

* Post-Graduation: MBA (preferable)
* Engineering (B.E / B.Tech / M.E / M.Tech) in IT/Computer Science/ Electronics / Telecommunication OR MCA

* PMP
* Prince-2
* TOGAF
* ITIL
* COBIT
* Six Sigma Green / Black Belt

Thorough knowledge of MS Excel, Power Point and other project management tools.

* Ability to handle complex assignment independently.

title: Senior Graphic Designer
description:
**Senior Graphic Designer**

Amaterasu Lifesciences LLP · Tardeo, Mumbai · Full-time · On-site

**Why this role exists**

Our brands are growing faster than our creative capacity. SkinEasi is expanding from anti-chafing into a full personal-care range. Soreze is building the bedsore-prevention category in India. Every new launch needs packaging, marketplace listings, website banners, ad creatives and social content, and it needs them before the product goes live, not after. We’re hiring a designer to own that whole visual engine.

**About Amaterasu**

Amaterasu Lifesciences is an R&D-led skincare company based in Mumbai and founded in 2016. Our products are built on our own patented skin-barrier technology, a silicone-based layer that works like a “second skin.” Every product is dermatologically tested, and we launch only once efficacy is established. We have two brands:

* **SkinEasi**
  : anti-chafing, acne care, cleansing and intimate hygiene for everyday comfort
* **Soreze**
  : bedsore prevention and wound care for patients and the families who care for them

We sell through skineasi.com and sorezecare.com, and on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Tata 1mg and Netmeds.

**What success looks like in your first year**

Every launch goes live with its full creative kit on day one. SkinEasi has a visual identity that holds together across a much broader range. Our ad accounts get a steady flow of tested creatives, and we know which ones win and why. Our marketplace listings and brand stores look like they belong to a science-led brand.

**What you’ll own**

* **Performance creatives:**
  static, carousel and short-video ads for Meta and marketplace campaigns, made in variants so we can test hooks, formats and messages
* **Marketplace content:**
  listing images, infographics, Amazon A+ content and Brand Stores, adapted to each platform’s specs
* **Website visuals:**
  homepage banners, product-page imagery and campaign landing pages for our Shopify stores
* **Packaging and print:**
  print-ready label, carton and insert artwork for new launches that meets label regulations
* **Social and educational content:**
  Instagram posts and Reels, influencer kits, and explainers that make skin science and caregiver guidance easy to understand
* **Brand consistency:**
  templates and guidelines so everything from a 1080×1080 ad to a carton feels like one brand
* **AI-assisted production:**
  use generative AI tools to speed up concepting, lifestyle and background scenes, ad variants and resizes, while keeping product shots, packaging and claims exactly true to the real product

**What we’re looking for**

Required:

* 4+ years of graphic design experience at a D2C, FMCG, beauty, personal-care or healthcare brand, or at an agency serving such brands
* A portfolio that shows both performance ad creatives and e-commerce assets (listing images, A+ content or web banners)
* Strong working skills in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign, plus Figma
* Regular, hands-on use of generative AI image tools in your design work, such as Adobe Firefly (including Generative Fill in Photoshop), Midjourney, or image generation in ChatGPT or Gemini
* Experience preparing print-ready packaging or label artwork (dielines, bleeds, colour specs)
* Comfort running several launches at once against fixed go-live dates

Nice to have:

* Motion design or video editing (After Effects, Premiere Pro or CapCut) for Reels and video ads
* AI video tools (Runway, Google Veo, Kling or similar) for short ad videos and Reels
* Using AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini) to draft creative briefs, concept routes and copy options
* Hands-on experience with Amazon A+ content, Brand Stores or Shopify
* Experience in a regulated category (pharma, OTC, cosmetics) where claims and labels need extra care
* Experience working with performance marketers and using results data to shape the next creative

**Why join us**

* Your work goes live within days across two websites and five marketplaces, and you’ll see how it performs
* A wide canvas: two brands, two very different audiences (everyday personal-care shoppers and family caregivers), and every format from a carton to a Reel
* You’ll work directly with the Head of Online Business and the brand and performance teams, with short feedback loops
* A product story worth designing for: patented technology and dermatologically tested products

**How to apply**

Apply on LinkedIn with a link to your portfolio (Behance, Dribbble, a personal site or a Google Drive folder). Include 2–3 pieces you made for an e-commerce or D2C brand, with a line on what each was for. Mark any AI-assisted work and the tools you used. We won’t review applications without a portfolio.

Role Overview

The City Revenue Lead is responsible for running the assigned city as an integrated business, with end-to-end ownership of the city P&L across stores, café, online channels and B2B. City Business and Sales Growth

* Own and deliver the city’s overall sales performance across stores, café, website,app, aggregators, quick commerce and B2B.

Operational Excellence and Compliance

* Maintain readiness for audits, quality,food safety and hygiene checks;ensure corrective actions are closed on time.

New Store Development and City Expansion

* Coordinate city-level new store openings with Projects and Ops Excellence teams.

This position entails coordinating and managing on-site logistics operations, including distribution, warehousing, transportation, and inventory management. The manager ensures efficient utilization of resources, timely delivery of goods, adherence to safety standards and resolving any operational challenges to ensure smooth and cost-effective operations. * Lead and manage the Field operations team for the region, ensuring efficient workflow and adherence to company standards.
* Oversee the entire field operations process, monitoring its progress and implementing necessary improvements.

* Identifying training needs and fostering opportunities for the continuous development of a highly skilled functional department.

* Foster positive relationships with customs officials and government agencies to facilitate smooth operations.
* Liaise with customers to address inquiries, resolve escalations, and provide updates on regulatory changes.

* Develop IKOs/KPIs with team members and monitor individual performance.

* Product Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of CDZ services related to customs brokerage and compliance.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.

* Cargo Handling Expertise: Manage cargo handling processes, including loading, and unloading.

**Qualified freshers are welcome.**

title: Manager / Senior Manager – Operational Excellence & Quality Management
description:
**Manager / Senior Manager – Operational Excellence & Quality Management**

**Industry:**
Flexible Packaging Manufacturing

**Experience**
: 7–10 Years

**Company:**
Nexibles

**1. Role Overview**

Responsible for improving manufacturing productivity, operational efficiency, product quality and profitability through Six Sigma, TQM, Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement.

Must have strong factory-floor experience, preferably in flexible packaging manufacturing, including printing, lamination, slitting and pouch making.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

1. Operational Excellence: Improve plant productivity, OEE, throughput, machine utilization, capacity utilization and production efficiency. Reduce downtime, setup time, changeover losses and process bottlenecks.

2. Quality Management (TQM): Strengthen quality systems across incoming materials, in-process production and finished goods. Improve quality parameters, reduce defects, rejection, rework and customer complaints.

3. Six Sigma & Lean Manufacturing: Implement DMAIC, SPC, FMEA, RCA, Kaizen, 5S and process standardization projects to improve quality, productivity and efficiency.

4. Flexible Packaging Process Optimization: Optimize printing, lamination, slitting and pouch-making processes. Reduce registration errors, colour variations, delamination, sealing defects and material wastage.

5. Quality Systems & CAPA: Conduct root cause analysis, manage corrective and preventive actions, strengthen inspections, internal audits and process controls. Ensure customer quality requirements are met.

6. Cost Optimization & Waste Reduction: Reduce film, ink, adhesive, solvent and other raw material losses. Improve first-pass yield, material utilization, conversion costs and manufacturing margins.

7. MIS & Performance Monitoring: Develop operational dashboards, monitor KPIs, track improvement projects and present weekly/monthly performance reports to Plant Management and senior leadership.

8. Training & Team Development: Train production, quality and shop-floor teams in Lean, Six Sigma, TQM, SOPs, problem-solving and continuous improvement. Drive quality ownership and process discipline.

**3. Required Qualifications & Experience**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical, Production, Industrial, Polymer, Chemical Engineering or related discipline.
* 7–10 years of experience in manufacturing operations, quality management or operational excellence.
* Strong preference for flexible packaging manufacturing experience.
* Practical knowledge of printing, lamination, slitting and pouch making.
* Proven experience in Six Sigma, TQM, Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated results in productivity improvement, rejection reduction and cost savings.
* Strong knowledge of OEE, SPC, FMEA, DMAIC, Kaizen, 5S and Root Cause Analysis.
* Experience working with Production, Quality, Maintenance and Plant Management teams.

**4. Preferred Skills & Certifications**

* Six Sigma Green Belt / Black Belt.
* Lean Manufacturing and TQM.
* ISO 9001, ISO 22000 and BRCGS Packaging Materials.
* Knowledge of printing, lamination, films, adhesives and packaging quality parameters.
* Minitab or equivalent statistical tools.
* ERP systems, Excel, MIS and operational dashboards.
* Experience leading cross-functional factory improvement projects.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The candidate will be evaluated on the following performance areas:

1. Manufacturing Efficiency :- Improve OEE, production output (throughput) and capacity utilization.

2. Quality Improvement :- Reduce product defects, rejection and rework.

3. Material Utilization :- Reduce wastage of film, ink, adhesives and other raw materials.

4. Cost Reduction :- Achieve measurable annual cost savings through process improvements.

5. Production Yield :- Improve first-pass yield (producing good-quality products without rework).

6. Process Stability :- Reduce variations and inconsistencies in manufacturing processes.

7. Equipment Performance :-Reduce machine downtime, setup time and changeover time.

8. Customer Satisfaction :-Reduce customer complaints and recurring quality issues.

9. Continuous Improvement :-Successfully implement Lean, Six Sigma and TQM projects.

10. Process Standardization :-Ensure proper implementation of SOPs and process controls.

**6. Ideal Candidate Profile**

An experienced manufacturing professional with 7–10 years of experience, preferably in flexible packaging, who can:

* Work directly on the factory floor.
* Understand manufacturing processes, machines and quality parameters.
* Analyze production data and identify root causes.
* Implement sustainable process improvements.
* Reduce wastage, rejection and manufacturing costs.
* Lead cross-functional teams.
* Present measurable business improvements to senior management.

**Most important expectation**

Success will be measured through tangible and sustainable improvements in manufacturing productivity, quality consistency, operational efficiency, waste reduction and profitability.

title: Manager, Specialist Function, Cash Ops
description:
****Job Summary****
This role exists to ensure the accurate, timely and controlled execution of cash management activities across payment processing, clearing, client instructions, account maintenance and static data services. The role is responsible for delivering reliable operational outcomes that support client transactions, safeguard financial assets and maintain the integrity of the Bank's cash management services.
  
  
The role is accountable for processing and validating transactions, maintaining critical customer and product data, identifying and escalating operational exceptions, and ensuring service delivery aligns with agreed service levels, regulatory obligations and internal control standards. Through disciplined execution and strong operational risk management, the role contributes to client satisfaction, operational resilience and sustainable business growth.
  
  
Working closely with Operations teams, Service Delivery partners, Risk and Compliance functions, Technology teams and business stakeholders, the role helps convert operational requirements into consistent service outcomes. The role supports process efficiency, client experience and operational excellence but does not own product strategy, client relationship management or enterprise-wide operational policy.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Service Delivery & Transaction Processing**

* Execute payment, clearing and cash management activities accurately and within agreed turnaround times to support uninterrupted client servicing.
* Validate customer instructions, transaction data and processing requirements to ensure operational accuracy and minimise processing risk.
* Resolve operational exceptions and processing breaks through timely investigation, escalation and corrective action.
* Deliver service outcomes that consistently meet productivity, quality and client service standards.

**Cash Management Operations & Data Integrity**

* Maintain customer, account and product static data to ensure completeness, accuracy and operational readiness across cash management services.
* Apply established operational controls when performing account maintenance, pricing, billing and related operational activities.
* Ensure transaction and client records are accurately captured and maintained to support operational, regulatory and audit requirements.
* Identify data quality issues and drive corrective actions that improve operational effectiveness and minimise service disruptions.

**Risk Management & Control Effectiveness**

* Apply operational risk controls that safeguard the Bank against transaction errors, operational losses and control breakdowns.
* Conduct independent validation activities in accordance with segregation of duties, authority limits and control requirements.
* Identify, assess and escalate operational risk events, control weaknesses and emerging risks through appropriate governance channels.
* Support remediation activities that strengthen control effectiveness and reduce recurring operational issues.

**Regulatory Compliance & Governance**

* Apply regulatory requirements, internal policies and operational procedures consistently across all cash management activities.
* Perform AML, sanctions and other financial crime-related checks in line with Bank standards and escalation requirements.
* Maintain accurate records and evidence that support audit reviews, governance reporting and regulatory inspections.
* Promote adherence to conduct, compliance and risk standards that protect the Bank and its clients.

**Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence**

* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve service quality and enhance operational efficiency across the end-to-end workflow.
* Contribute to operational change initiatives, testing activities and business continuity readiness to support resilient service delivery.
* Support the implementation of digitisation, automation and process enhancement initiatives that improve operational outcomes.
* Share process insights and improvement opportunities to strengthen team effectiveness and service performance.

**Stakeholder & Client Service Management**

* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to resolve service issues and ensure effective delivery of cash management services.
* Communicate operational issues, risks and service impacts clearly to relevant stakeholders to support timely resolution.
* Build trusted working relationships that facilitate effective issue management and service improvements.
* Support a client-focused culture by delivering responsive, accurate and professional operational services.

**Motivations**

* Motivated by delivering accurate and reliable operational outcomes in a high-volume, time-sensitive environment.
* Energised by solving operational challenges, improving processes and enhancing service quality.
* Thrives in environments that value collaboration, accountability, strong controls and continuous improvement.

****Skills And Experience****
**Priority Skills**

* Payment Processing
* Cash Management
* Certification and Accreditation
* Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
* Operations Management
* Project Management
* Service Delivery
* Settlement Management

****Other Skills****

* Transaction Management
* Issue Management
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Service Recovery

****Qualifications****
**Key Experiences**

* Experience in operations management, service delivery, governance, cost management, client/service management or risk & control functions within a complex organisation.
* Ability to manage regional stakeholders, regulatory engagements/forums, budgets, and business performance outcomes.
* Proven track record of driving operational excellence, process improvements, and effective issue resolution.
* Experience in process management, project delivery, change implementation, client implementation within financial services or other complex, regulated environments.
* Experience in supporting cross-functional initiatives and collaborating with stakeholders across business, operations, technology, compliance, and risk functions would be advantageous
* Exposure to payments, transaction banking, cash management, regulatory change, or large-scale operational programmes is beneficial but not mandatory.
