title: Store Manager - Retail
description:
**Store Manager - Retail**

* **The Opportunity**

Aliens Tattoo isn't just India's largest tattoo brand—we're redefining what a premium tattoo experience looks like. With 16+ premium studios, a team of 160+ passionate professionals, and an ambitious vision to become the world's most admired tattoo company, every studio is more than just a workplace—it's where unforgettable stories begin. We're not looking for someone who simply manages a studio. We're looking for a business leader who treats the studio like their own company. Someone who is passionate about delivering extraordinary customer experiences, building high-performing teams, driving revenue, maintaining operational excellence, and creating a culture where every customer leaves with a lifelong memory—not just a tattoo. As a Studio Manager, you are the face of Aliens Tattoo within your studio. You will lead the business, inspire your team, own the customer journey, drive commercial performance, and ensure every operational detail reflects the premium standards of the Aliens Tattoo brand. This role combines sales leadership, customer experience, operational excellence, financial ownership, people development, and business management. You'll work closely with the Cluster Manager and cross-functional teams to build a studio that consistently exceeds business targets while delivering world-class customer experiences.

* **The Mandate**

Your mission is simple. Build a studio that customers love, employees are proud to work in, and the business is proud to grow. As the Studio Manager, you are entrusted with the complete ownership of your studio's business performance. Every customer who walks through the door, every consultation conducted, every tattoo created, every team member coached, and every operational decision made ultimately reflects your leadership. Your responsibility extends far beyond achieving monthly sales targets. You are expected to create an environment where customers receive exceptional service from their very first enquiry through their entire tattoo journey. You will build a disciplined, customer-centric team that consistently delivers premium experiences while operating with the highest standards of professionalism, hygiene, safety, and operational excellence. You are responsible for driving sustainable business growth by balancing sales performance, profitability, operational efficiency, inventory management, studio readiness, and people development. Success in this role is not measured by how busy you are—it is measured by how effectively your studio performs. You will build systems that prevent problems before they occur, develop future leaders within your team, maintain impeccable operational standards, and create a culture where accountability, ownership, continuous learning, and customer obsession become everyday habits. Above all, your responsibility is to ensure that your studio represents everything Aliens Tattoo stands for—premium quality, artistic excellence, operational discipline, integrity, innovation, and unforgettable customer experiences.

* **What you'll be doing**

As the Studio Manager, you will own the complete business performance of your studio by balancing commercial success, operational excellence, customer delight, and people leadership. You will drive revenue growth by ensuring every consultation is converted professionally, every customer receives an exceptional experience, and every opportunity to maximize business value is effectively captured. Through disciplined CRM management, proactive follow-ups, repeat business initiatives, and premium upselling, you will ensure sustainable business growth while maintaining customer trust. You will lead and inspire a multidisciplinary team of tattoo artists, Assistant Studio Managers, customer experience professionals, and support staff by creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, coaching, and continuous improvement. Through daily briefings, regular feedback, performance reviews, and recognition, you will help every team member perform at their highest potential. Operational excellence will be one of your highest priorities. You will ensure your studio remains operationally ready every day by maintaining world-class hygiene standards, statutory compliance, inventory accuracy, equipment readiness, housekeeping excellence, and strict adherence to all operational SOPs. You will oversee inventory planning, stock accuracy, tattoo consumables, merchandise, aftercare products, biomedical waste management, and studio maintenance while ensuring resources are utilized efficiently and responsibly. You will coordinate closely with the Design Team, Artist Team Leaders, Cluster Manager, and other support functions to ensure tattoo designs are delivered on time, customer expectations are consistently managed, and business operations run seamlessly. Using data, business insights, and performance metrics, you will continuously identify improvement opportunities, solve operational challenges proactively, optimize profitability, and implement scalable processes that strengthen the studio's long-term success. Ultimately, your role is to ensure that your studio consistently operates as a profitable, customer-centric, operationally excellent, and high-performing business that sets the benchmark for premium tattoo experiences.

* **What we're looking for**

We are looking for a leader who combines entrepreneurial thinking with exceptional execution. You should possess a strong understanding of business operations, sales management, customer experience, financial accountability, inventory control, and team leadership. You naturally take ownership of results, make sound decisions under pressure, and consistently balance commercial objectives with customer satisfaction. You enjoy leading from the front, coaching people to succeed, solving operational challenges before they become problems, and continuously improving systems that make businesses more efficient. You believe great customer experiences are created through discipline, preparation, attention to detail, and genuine care for people. You are highly organized, commercially aware, operationally disciplined, and capable of managing multiple priorities without compromising quality. Most importantly, you lead with humility, integrity, accountability, and a relentless commitment to excellence while living the values that define Aliens Tattoo.

* **What success looks like**

Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. You'll know you're succeeding when. Business- Revenue targets are consistently achieved, Studios operate profitably, Business performance improves month after month. Customer-Customers become promoters of the brand, Google ratings consistently remain above target, Customer complaints reduce while loyalty increases. Operations- Studios consistently achieve operational audit standards. Compliance remains flawless. Business risks are proactively managed. People-Studio Managers become stronger leaders. Team engagement improves. Future leaders are developed internally. Attrition remains low. Commercial - Conversion improves. Average Bill Value grows. Sales teams consistently outperform targets. Continuous Improvement. Processes become simpler. Teams become smarter. Business becomes more scalable every quarter.

* **Practical details**

Success in this role isn't measured by effort. It's measured by outcomes. Business Monthly revenue targets are consistently achieved or exceeded. Average Bill Value and repeat business continue to improve. Studio profitability remains healthy while operational costs stay under control. Sales pipeline remains disciplined with zero lead leakage. Customer Customers become lifelong advocates of the Aliens Tattoo brand. Net Promoter Score consistently exceeds company benchmarks. Google Reviews and customer referrals continue to increase. Customer complaints are resolved quickly while customer loyalty continues to grow. Operations The studio remains operationally ready every single day. Hygiene, safety, statutory compliance, and operational audits consistently achieve excellent scores. Inventory accuracy remains high with minimal wastage and zero stock-outs. Tattoo design coordination and appointment execution happen seamlessly. People Team members are engaged, motivated, and continuously developing. Daily briefings, coaching sessions, and performance conversations become part of the studio culture. Attrition remains low while internal talent continues to grow. Future leaders are developed from within the studio. Commercial Excellence Consultation-to-booking conversion consistently improves. CRM compliance and customer follow-up discipline remain exceptional. Premium services, aftercare products, and merchandise sales continue to grow. Business opportunities are maximized without compromising customer trust. Continuous Improvement Processes become simpler. Teams become stronger. Customers become happier. The studio becomes more profitable every quarter.

title: Store Manager / Store In-charge – Construction
description:
**Store Manager – Construction Materials and Scrap Control**

*Leading infrastructure and real estate group | Navi-Mumbai Metropolitan Region | Full-time*

**About the role**

On a construction site, a store is where money quietly leaks: material that is received but not recorded, issued but not consumed, or scrapped and sold without a clean trail. We are looking for a Store Manager who runs a tight, auditable store, from the first delivery challan to the last kilo of scrap leaving the gate.

**Key responsibilities**

*Inventory and stores control*

* Manage receipt, inspection, storage and issue of construction materials: cement, steel, aggregates, shuttering, MEP materials, electrical items, consumables, tools and PPE
* Prepare and verify GRNs against POs and challans, and flag shortages, damages and quality mismatches at the gate
* Maintain accurate stock registers, bin cards and ERP or Tally records, with FIFO followed and minimum and reorder levels tracked
* Issue materials only against approved indents and requisitions, with site engineer sign-off
* Run weekly cycle counts and a monthly physical stock verification, and reconcile every variance
* Keep a register of tools, shuttering, scaffolding and plant spares, covering issue, return, damage and loss

*Scrap management*

* Segregate scrap at source and store it by category: steel and rebar offcuts, shuttering and timber, cable and copper, aluminium, packaging, and construction debris
* Record scrap by weight and category at the weighbridge, or by an agreed measure, with photographs where required
* Prepare scrap sale and disposal proposals for management approval, and release material only with an approved gate pass
* Reconcile scrap generated against theoretical wastage norms, and report abnormal wastage and its likely causes
* Maintain a clear audit trail for every scrap movement, including who approved it, who weighed it, who took it and what was received

*Control and reporting*

* Prevent pilferage and unauthorised movement through gate-pass discipline, access control and CCTV coverage of the store
* Submit weekly and monthly reports: stock position, consumption against budget, slow and non-moving items, scrap generated and sold, and discrepancies
* Coordinate with site engineers, procurement, QS, accounts and security
* Ensure safe storage and housekeeping, including stacking norms, fire safety and material segregation
* Support internal and external audits with complete documentation

**Requirements**

* Graduate, or diploma in Civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering (or any graduate with strong construction-store experience)
* 5–10 years of store management experience on construction, infrastructure or real estate projects
* Direct experience handling scrap, with documented sale and disposal
* Working knowledge of ERP, SAP or Tally, and strong MS Excel skills
* Good understanding of construction materials, units, specifications and wastage norms
* Strong record-keeping and a firm, fair approach to enforcing process
* Able to work on site, manage a store team, and handle vendors and contractors
* Good command of Hindi, Marathi and basic English

**Preferred**

* Experience with barcode or QR-based stock tracking
* Prior experience managing multi-site stores or a central store
* Familiarity with weighbridge records and GST documentation

**What we offer**

* Based on experience
* A role with real authority over a store and a scrap process that management will rely on
* Stable employment with a large, diversified group

**Applications are handled in confidence.**

Leading large teams in India and Operating ADSIPL Infrastructure at the lowest cost with the best in class customer service will stretch your leadership and problem-solving ability to your full potential. Candidates excelling at People management skills who have the exposure or running mission critical facilities (Power and Thermal plants, Shipping, Data Centers Etc.) with bar raising executive leadership presence are well suited for this role.
  
  
CloudPath participants can expect to lead high visibility projects, while mastering the tools, processes, and operations culture that have created a cloud computing leader within Earth’s most customer centric company. They will be driving efforts, both independently, and as part of larger teams in India, and will have a significant impact on the customer experience and the business. CloudPath participants have an opportunity to rotate and experience the Data Center functional organizations in India with a detailed curricula to provide exposure to running operations while raising the bar for our internal customers. These rotations are specifically designed to test a participant’s leadership and analytics capabilities. Great candidates think like business owners and drive results; look at a challenge, identify opportunities for improvement and build solutions to create the best outcome for our customers. Amazon programs have attracted innovative, talented leaders who are now highly influential senior leaders and executives in critical areas of Amazon’s business in locations all over the world. Join us as we continue to make history with AWS. In this 12-month program, you will be based out of Hyderabad for the first 4 months after which you will be given the opportunity to work in one of the cluster (Mumbai or Hyderabad) within India for the following 6 months.
  
  
The CloudPath participant would manage across each function but also have the ability to dive deep into any given function as needed. They must have a strong background on people management with a team size of 60+ employees.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a highly driven, self-managed individual who demonstrates initiative and proactively seeks solutions to problems. The candidate will have a strong understanding of network and compute architecture and have experience managing repair requests in a high volume environment, as well as managing response to high severity events. They will have a strong track record of developing talent, and managing performance of their team and organization. They will be creating, and tracking budgets; strategically planning through use of metrics; sponsoring, reporting and delivering large projects while proposing technical solutions to complicated problems. This position requires a candidate with the proven ability to drive continuous improvement and the ability to keep pace with our explosive growth while motivating others to meet the challenges of an extremely deadline-driven environment.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Lead and supervise a team of Data Center Managers and Engineers across multiple data centers, installing, maintaining and decommissioning network and server hardware.
  
  

* Oversee the safety, security, availability, quality, and performance of the team, while driving a positive customer experience.
* Strategic planning and forecasting; manage team and individual performance; delivering performance reviews, and address staffing needs
* Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and procedures.
* Mentor, train and develop career progression for direct reports and members of the organization.
* Obsess over team learning and development, both from a technical/functional and soft skills (critical thinking, emotional intelligence, and adaptability) development perspective.
* Coordinate support of change management resources in partnership with electrical and mechanical operations teams.
* Develop, improve, and share operational best practices across the region and with peers globally.
* Ability to oversee and manage complex projects for delivery against tight timelines to exceed customer expectations.
* Design and execute comprehensive strategic initiatives that align with organizational goals and drive operational efficiency
* Facilitate rapid response protocols and support dynamic problem-solving initiatives
* Provide expert guidance and mentorship to team members in high-pressure environments
* Proven ability to build, mentor, and retain high-performing teams in a fast-paced technical environment
* Experience with compliance requirements and industry standards (e.g., ISO, ITIL, SOC)

A day in the life
  
  
Your day will be a blend of strategic leadership and hands-on technical problem-solving. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor talented engineers, and develop innovative approaches to data center management. From optimizing hardware performance to fostering team growth, you'll be at the center of our operational success.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

description:
**About Business**
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**Adani Group**
: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Adani Airports Holding Limited**
: Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state-of-the-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
Duty Manager - Landside Security is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day execution of landside security operations, managing security personnel, responding to incidents, and ensuring adherence to established protocols. This role provides immediate supervision and support to the security team, coordinating access control, monitoring traffic, and addressing security issues as they arise. Through consistent communication with the Lead, the Duty Manager ensures that security measures are maintained effectively and efficiently, contributing to a safe and secure environment for all individuals in landside areas.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Security Operations Management:**
Oversee day-to-day landside security operations during shifts for landside, city side, airport village site, including patrolling, access control, and surveillance activities, to ensure adherence to established policies and procedures.
  
  
Act as the primary point of contact for on-site security teams, providing guidance and addressing any issues that arise promptly to maintain secure and seamless operations.
  
  
Conduct regular inspections of landside areas to identify potential risks or deviations from established standards.
  
  
Ensure operational readiness of all security equipment, including CCTV systems, access control devices, and communication tools. Coordinate with the Integrated Security Operations Center (ISOC) for seamless monitoring and response.
  
  
**Incident Reporting And Response**
Coordinate initial response efforts during security incidents, gathering relevant information and ensuring immediate actions are taken to address the situation effectively.
  
  
Prepare detailed incident reports for the Lead - Landside Security, capturing all relevant information and contributing to follow-up investigations and preventive measures.
  
  
**Supervision Of Access Control And Traffic Management**
Oversee access control, Crowd control, Traffic management, loss prevention and asset protections measures for landside areas, including vehicle and personnel access, ensuring compliance with security protocols and addressing any exceptions or irregularities.
  
  
Manage traffic flow within landside zones, implementing measures to prevent congestion and maintain a secure environment for all employees, visitors, and vendors.
  
  
Ensure round the clock protection to both the tangible and intangible assets.
  
  
**Risk Assessment And Mitigation**
Conduct routine risk assessments of landside operations and recommend mitigation measures.
  
  
Monitor local, national, and international developments that may impact landside security operations.
  
  
Report potential risks to the Lead - Landside Security and suggest proactive measures to address them.
  
  
**Team Coordination And Scheduling**
Plan and manage shift schedules for landside security staff, coordinating coverage to ensure all critical areas are monitored and secured at all times.
  
  
Facilitate communication within the team, holding regular briefings to discuss daily objectives, key concerns, and any updates to security protocols that need to be followed.
  
  
Provide on-the-job training and guidance to security staff to improve performance and compliance.
  
  
Monitor the performance of outsourced security staff and escalate issues to the vendor management team if needed.
  
  
**Compliance And Audit Support**
Conduct routine audits of landside security operations to identify areas for improvement and ensure full compliance with established standards.
  
  
Support internal and external audits by providing required documentation and ensuring compliance with findings.
  
  
Update staff on new regulations, SOP changes, and directives issued by regulatory agencies.
  
  
**Stakeholder Liaison**
Act as the primary point of contact for landside security issues during the shift.
  
  
Collaborate with airport operations, law enforcement agencies, and other stakeholders to resolve operational challenges.
  
  
Address complaints or concerns from passengers, visitors, and employees regarding security matters.
  
  
**Reporting And Documentation**
Review and submit shift reports detailing incidents, operational highlights, and staff performance.
  
  
Maintain accurate records of access control activities, visitor management, and incident investigations.
  
  
Ensure all documentation is updated and stored securely for audit and compliance purposes.
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - Internal**
Lead - Landside Security
  
  
Operations Team
  
  
Facilities Management
  
  
Security Control Room Team
  
  
Airlines
  
  
HR and Training Team
  
  
**Key Stakeholders - External**
Local Law Enforcement Agencies
  
  
Regulatory Bodies (e.g., BCAS)
  
  
Third-Party Security Service Providers
  
  
Contractors and Vendors
  
  
Community Representatives
  
  
Customs
  
  
Emergency Response Services (EMS, Fire Services)
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Educational Qualifications:**
Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Public Safety, or a related discipline.
  
  
AVSEC certification or equivalent airport security certification.
  
  
Training in Crisis Management or Incident Response is preferred.
  
  
**Work Experience**
5-10 (Depending on the site complexity/ requirement) years of experience in a security operations role, with at least 2 years in a supervisory capacity.
  
  
Experience in managing daily security operations, handling incidents, and ensuring compliance with security policies and protocols.

description:
**Suspire Marketing Executive - Brand, Growth & Product Marketing**

**About Suspire**

Suspire makes better living easier, through wellness-first, thoughtfully curated choices you can

trust. We are a 4-year-old startup building an ecosystem of 400+ sustainable brands, 500,000+

conscious community members, and 100,000+ delivered eco-friendly gifts. Our mission: help

people live healthier, stronger and calmer lives by building a high-trust wellness ecosystem.

We are a tight, high-ownership team at a critical growth stage. Every hire shapes our future.

**Marketing**

Suspire's full-stack marketing team isn't just about promotions; it owns our end-to-end digital

presence, brand voice, customer journeys, content, data analysis and revenue-generating

initiatives. We also build products and in-house technology. Suspire sits at an exciting

intersection of brand, customers and B2B clients, so marketing here touches almost every part

of the business. You'll lead a dynamic department that drives real business and proactively

accelerates Suspire’s growth journey.

**The Role**

Own marketing at Suspire as our Marketing Executive at a pivotal moment. The role sits between a brand manager and a growth marketer, with a product mindset: you will set how the brand

shows up, own growth and the best use of budgets, and help shape the features and products

that serve our customers, our partner brands and our B2B clients. This is not a one-dimensional role: the right person sees how every decision lands on sales, customers, finances and brand reputation, and decides accordingly.

**Your core responsibilities:**

●
**Strategy and brand:**
 Build and own the marketing strategy and plan, and own Suspire's

positioning, brand voice and consistency across channels as the new brand rolls out.

●
**Growth and budgets:**
 Own the marketing budget. Plan, allocate and optimize it across

paid, organic and retention, track returns, costs and contribution, and make fast

scale-or-stop calls.

●
**Channels and campaigns:**
 Direct end-to-end digital marketing funnels and customer

lifecycle management across Meta, Google, Instagram and social, website, SEO, PR,

email and WhatsApp, with content that can double as performance creative.

●
**Product thinking**
: Partner with tech and product teams to shape customer experience

and features, and to package offerings that can be sold to our partner brands and B2B

clients.

●
**Agencies and cross-functional work:**
 Brief, manage and review external agencies,

and coordinate across ops, sales, design and tech so teams move in the same direction.

●
**Reporting and leadership communication:**
 Track and analyse performance, and

translate it into clear updates, trade-offs and recommendations for the founder and the

CMO.

●
**AI-led ways of working:**
 Use AI to sharpen strategy, speed up execution, stress-test

ideas and improve creative work, and turn what works into repeatable processes.

●
**People and systems:**
 Lead, coach and set priorities for the in-house team, raise the

quality bar, and build simple systems and SOPs so the team runs well without you in

every decision.

This is a hands-on role. You won't just hand work to agencies, and you won't just

execute tasks yourself. You set the direction, hold the quality bar, make the call and keep things

moving.

**Primary KPIs**

Marketing-driven Revenue and Contribution | Channel-wise Performance | Budget Efficiency |

End-to-End Customer Experience | Average Order Value | Lifecycle & Retention Metrics |

Organic Growth | Experiment Velocity (test, learn, scale or kill) | Products Build & Launch

delivery | Team and agency output quality | Effort-Result Ratio

**Who You Are**

**Must-haves:**

● 2 years of marketing experience with a strong grasp of marketing, brand and customer

behaviour fundamentals.

● Big-picture judgement: you can see the impact of decisions on sales, customers,

finances and brand reputation, and balance them.

● Taste and judgement: you can review creative, content and campaigns, give sharp,

constructive feedback and decide what ships.

●Speed: you enjoy building, measuring and fixing quickly, you keep what works, and you

kill ideas fast when they don't.

● A real pulse on teams: you understand what ops, sales, design and tech need and plan

your work so it lands well across functions and with leadership.

● Working familiarity with Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, Google Ads, Meta Ads, CRM

platforms and Excel or Sheets. You don't need to be a hands-on technical expert, but

you should know enough to brief, audit and challenge.

● Fluent English and Hindi (spoken) with strong written English.

**AI is part of how we work:**

● You use AI regularly (ChatGPT, Claude, Lovable, etc.) for strategy, execution,

stress-testing ideas and creative work, and you know how to prompt clearly and iterate.

● You have the taste to judge AI-generated output and decide what is good enough to

ship.

● You are curious about building agentic and AI-assisted workflows that cut manual effort.

**Good-to-haves:**

● Experience in e-commerce or D2C brands (a big plus), including familiarity with Shopify.

● Exposure to a range of digital marketing formats, from paid and social to SEO, email,

WhatsApp and content.

● Digital marketing certifications, for example in Google Ads, Google Analytics or Meta

**Education:**
 A Bachelor's or Master's in Marketing, Business or a related field is strongly

preferred.

**Why Join Suspire**

● Join at a pivotal moment: a new brand and positioning, with you helping to shape it.

● Report directly to the founder and the CMO, and work closely with leadership on most

decisions.

● Work at the intersection of brand, customers and B2B clients, and see how marketing

connects to product and revenue.

● Take real ownership of strategy, budgets, experiments and a team, and see the impact of

your work quickly.

Suspire appreciates energetic ideas, coupled with even better execution. We welcome trial and

error and give you complete room to grow, explore and build, just like Suspire itself does.

**How to Apply**

Share your 
**CV + a short note**
 at swayam.doshi@suspire.in on the following:

● Why you'd like to work with Suspire.

● One marketing decision you made, such as scaling or killing a campaign or idea quickly,

and what made you decide.

Feel free to reach out to us on Instagram (@suspire.in) / LinkedIn if you'd like to chat, ask

questions or simply get a feel of the brand. Meanwhile, explore our website and socials to

understand our community, brands and philosophy.

**Thank you for your interest in being part of Suspire's journey. We would be happy to**

**connect and explore whether this role and our team are the right fit for you.**

With more than 165 years of ingredient innovation, we partner with leading food and beverage brands to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products enjoyed by millions of people every day. title: Social Media & Content Growth Strategist
description:
Social Media & Content Growth Strategist

**Company:**
Mudita

**Location:**
Goregaon West, Mumbai

**Work Mode:**
Full-Time | Work From Office

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

**Joining:**
Immediate joiners preferred

About Mudita

Mudita is a fast-growing education and transformation company working across AI, business, investing, trading, leadership, communication, and personal development.

We work with founders, speakers, coaches, educators, and subject-matter experts to build strong personal brands, grow engaged communities, and create meaningful business impact through content.

We are looking for a
**Social Media & Content Growth Strategist**
who can take ownership of content strategy, creative direction, execution, and measurable growth across multiple brands.

About the Role

This is not just a social media posting role.

You will work closely with our founders, speakers, creative team, video editors, and marketing team to develop authentic, high-performing content across Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other relevant platforms.

You should understand how to build founder-led personal brands, create engaging content, guide video shoots, manage calendars, coordinate execution, and use analytics to improve performance.

**We need someone who can think strategically and also ensure that ideas are executed successfully.**

Key Responsibilities

**1. Social Media & Content Strategy**

* Develop and execute platform-specific strategies for multiple founder, speaker, and business brands.
* Understand each brand's audience, positioning, voice, content pillars, business goals, and offers.
* Build weekly and monthly content calendars for Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reels, Shorts, Stories, podcasts, and other formats.
* Maintain consistent brand identity and communication across platforms.

**2. Founder & Speaker Content Development**

* Work directly with founders and speakers to identify compelling stories, insights, experiences, and content opportunities.
* Suggest video topics, hooks, scripts, talking points, and content angles.
* Guide speakers during content planning and shoots to ensure natural, authentic on-camera communication.
* Transform expert knowledge into engaging Reels, Shorts, carousels, thought-leadership posts, and long-form content.

**3. Creative Direction & Execution**

* Own content planning, scheduling, coordination, publishing, and timely execution across assigned brands.
* Coordinate with video editors, graphic designers, copywriters, and marketing teams.
* Guide creative quality, including hooks, thumbnails, titles, captions, storytelling, visual direction, and content packaging.
* Review content before publishing to ensure quality and brand consistency.
* Repurpose long-form videos, webinars, and podcasts into platform-specific content.

**4. Instagram Stories & Community Engagement**

* Develop Instagram Stories strategies using polls, Q&A, behind-the-scenes content, audience interactions, and community-building formats.
* Identify content ideas from comments, DMs, FAQs, audience feedback, and trending discussions.
* Improve engagement, community connection, audience trust, and brand recall.

**5. Growth, Analytics & Reporting**

* Track reach, engagement, views, watch time, retention, saves, shares, follower growth, subscribers, and conversions.
* Monitor YouTube CTR, audience retention, and thumbnail/title performance.
* Analyse Instagram, YouTube, and LinkedIn performance to identify improvement opportunities.
* Prepare performance reports with actionable recommendations.
* Research competitors, content trends, creator strategies, platform updates, and emerging formats.

**6. Campaigns & Process Improvement**

* Support workshops, webinars, masterclasses, launches, and lead-generation campaigns through content strategy.
* Develop SOPs, content templates, brand guidelines, and repeatable execution processes.
* Work closely with Management to build content systems that support brand growth and business objectives.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 3–5 years of experience in social media strategy, content growth, personal branding, or creator brand management.
* Strong understanding of Instagram, YouTube, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, Reels, Stories, and content repurposing.
* Experience developing strategies for founders, creators, coaches, speakers, or expert-led brands.
* Strong skills in storytelling, scriptwriting, hooks, audience psychology, and content packaging.
* Ability to guide founders and speakers with shoot ideas, talking points, and content direction.
* Experience managing content calendars and coordinating designers, video editors, and creative teams.
* Ability to analyse platform metrics and make data-driven content decisions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Ability to manage multiple brands, projects, and deadlines independently.
* Comfortable working full-time from our Goregaon West office.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with exposure to the following will have an advantage:

* Founder and speaker personal branding
* Instagram and YouTube organic growth
* LinkedIn thought leadership
* Podcast strategy and content repurposing
* Short-form and long-form video content
* Community engagement and Stories strategy
* Campaign and launch content planning
* EdTech, coaching, consulting, AI, business, finance, or personal development brands

Ideal Candidate

We're looking for someone who:

* Thinks like a strategist but takes complete ownership of execution.
* Understands how to build authentic, high-impact personal brands.
* Can turn founder insights into engaging content that connects with the right audience.
* Has a strong creative eye for messaging, storytelling, video editing, and design.
* Can manage multiple brands without compromising quality or timelines.
* Uses analytics, audience insights, and research to improve results.
* Can confidently coordinate with senior founders, speakers, and creative teams.
* Balances creative storytelling with measurable business outcomes.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be evaluated through:

* Content consistency and timely execution across brands.
* Improved content quality, storytelling, hooks, thumbnails, and engagement.
* Instagram reach, follower growth, saves, shares, and community interactions.
* YouTube views, watch time, CTR, retention, and subscriber growth.
* LinkedIn visibility, engagement, and personal brand positioning.
* Stronger brand identity, audience trust, and community growth.
* Effective content support for lead generation and campaigns.
* Clear reporting, team coordination, and performance-driven improvements.

Work Arrangement

This is a
**full-time, Work From Office role in Goregaon West, Mumbai**
.

You will work closely with Mudita's founders, speakers, designers, video editors, and marketing team.

Working hours, weekly offs, and leave policies will be governed by Company policy. Flexibility may be required during shoots, campaigns, launches, and events.

Why Join Mudita?

* Work directly with founders, speakers, coaches, and industry experts.
* Build and manage multiple personal and business brands.
* Gain exposure across AI, business, finance, trading, leadership, and personal development.
* Create content that contributes to audience growth, community engagement, and business results.
* Opportunity to grow into a senior content leadership position based on performance.

description:
Full Time, In-Office Role
  
  
Andheri East, Mumbai
  
  
Experience: 2-4 years
  
  
**Immediate Joiners Preferred**
**Company: A Leading Integrated Digital Media Agency.**
We are an integrated digital-first media and marketing company, specialising in organic media, meme marketing, influencer partnerships, and content-led brand solutions. We sit at the intersection of culture, creators, and communities, helping leading consumer and digital-native brands drive awareness, engagement, and cultural relevance across social platforms.
  
  
Through a vertically integrated ecosystem of proprietary meme networks, creator collectives, and media assets, we deliver scalable, content-first distribution models that combine strategy, storytelling, and organic reach to engineer attention at scale.
  
  
**Role Overview**
You'll own campaigns with guidance, turning briefs into social-first strategies, decks, and ideas that teams can execute. You will connect audience insight, cultural context, and brand objectives into simple, sharp strategic directions. This role works across all of our brands and accounts, not a single retainer.
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
Creative Strategists here turn chaos into clarity. You take client briefs, business objectives, and cultural signals and shape them into structured strategies for campaigns. You support senior strategists while owning parts of campaigns end-to-end, from early research and idea development to decks, grids, and alignment across internal teams.
  
  
You make sure every execution ladders up to a clear strategy and that every stakeholder knows what success looks like. Without this role, teams risk chasing disconnected ideas, and campaigns lose consistency between pitch and execution.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Campaign Management and Execution**

* Help develop strategies for campaigns and pitches
* Execute creative campaigns by aligning content, formats, and channels to the agreed strategy
* Support strategic planning by maintaining grids, routes, and frameworks
* Keep every stage aligned to the brief so nothing goes off-track
* Act as the final QC layer for decks, grids, and outgoing strategy documents

**Research, Insight and Innovation**

* Run market and category research for active and upcoming briefs
* Analyse competition and reference work to find whitespace
* Generate insights and opportunity territories for the brand
* Track trends, formats, and cultural shifts relevant to the campaign
* Support basic data analysis and feed performance learnings into future strategies

**Team and Stakeholder Management**

* Work closely with design, content, and campaign teams so strategy is understood and executed correctly
* Bring structured thinking and references to brainstorms
* Bridge the gap between idea and execution by being present at critical reviews and check-ins
* Keep internal alignment tight with clear documentation

**Client and Business Communication**

* Support senior team members in structuring client presentations and strategy narratives
* Contribute to decks and present the strategy when required
* Prepare updates and recaps for ongoing campaigns

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong creative ideation grounded in strategic thinking
* Solid understanding of organic marketing fundamentals and social platform behaviour
* Competent copywriting and a fair understanding of design logic and visual hierarchy
* Ability to structure decks and narratives clearly
* Comfort working across multiple categories, tones, and audience segments
* A portfolio that shows how you got to the idea (insight, strategy, campaign plan), not just the final lines

**Bonus Points If You Have**

* Experience in a digital, creative, or social-first agency
* Exposure to influencer, meme, or creator-led campaigns
* Familiarity with basic analytics dashboards and using performance to refine thinking
* Experience on multi-platform campaigns (Instagram, YouTube, X, LinkedIn, etc.)

**Soft Skills**

* Analytical thinking (you ask why before you jump to what)
* Proactive about hopping onto unfamiliar briefs and categories
* Clear communication with internal teams and, when needed, clients
* Team collaboration and openness to feedback
* Strong at writing briefs for internal teams and partners

**Experience & Background**

* 2-4 years in creative strategy, digital marketing, or agency environments
* Demonstrated experience contributing to end-to-end campaigns
* Strategy or social-first agency background preferred

**Note:**
This role may require stretched working hours and occasional weekend work to meet pitch and campaign timelines, given the pace of the social media and content industry.
  
  
Skills: social media,campaigns,copywriting,strategy

We blend digital technology, data analysis (which we have affectionately coined Music Science), and a strong, fearless business acumen to reach all corners of the globe. Our award-winning mobile products, partnerships, innovations and thought leadership have been featured in some of the world’s leading publications, from The New York Times, to The Wall Street Journal, The Economic Times to Forbes, and many more.

**OUR CULTURE:**

At JioSaavn, we ignite passion and performance to work towards a collective goal: creating the perfect mobile entertainment ecosystem that delivers the best possible music experience to millions of listeners around the world. Our default mode is that of perpetual innovation. Together, we form a concerted rhythm that goes beyond borders. We don't just go with the flow, we create it.

JioSaavn offers a dynamic and unconventional work environment, full of fun wholesome experience. We believe creativity and technology blend together like sweet melodies. When you choose JioSaavn, you join a diverse world of high-calibre techies, artists, and inventors hailing from companies like Yahoo!, Twitter, LinkedIn, Google, Qualcomm, HBO, Microsoft, Flipkart, Amazon, Paytm, Quikr etc.

Our value-based, people-first work culture is about empowering every individual in our team to be catalysts for change in this dynamic digital world. Every day is an opportunity to bring your vision to life, and to expand, learn and grow. No idea is left unconsidered. No voice is left unheard.

JioSaavn prides itself on being an equal opportunity employer. We have committed ourselves to creating a safe environment with fair and equal access and opportunities, sans discrimination. We encourage everyone to be open to experiences and perspectives beyond their normal; divergent thinkers create differentiated products, and even better music.

If our vibe matches with yours, we'd love to hear from you.

**ROLE**

We are looking for an
**Sr. Manager – Product Marketing**
to build and lead a world-class Product Marketing function at JioSaavn. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for turning products into categories users understand, value, and love. You will own product positioning, go-to-market strategy, user insight systems, feature adoption, and growth narratives across key products and experiences. You will work closely with Product, Growth, Analytics, Design, Business, and Leadership teams to ensure our products are not only built well, but launched, adopted, and scaled exceptionally well.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**1. Product Positioning & Strategy**

* Define differentiated positioning, messaging, and narratives for core and emerging products.
* Translate market signals, user behaviour, and competitive insights into strategic product recommendations.
* Influence product roadmaps through market-back thinking and customer insight.

**2. Go-To-Market Leadership**

* Own end-to-end GTM strategy for product launches, major feature releases, and strategic initiatives.
* Build scalable launch playbooks covering segmentation, targeting, messaging, channels, and measurement.
* Ensure launches deliver measurable business outcomes—not just awareness.

**3. User Insight & Market Intelligence**

* Build strong voice-of-customer systems using qualitative and quantitative inputs.
* Identify friction points across acquisition, activation, engagement, and retention funnels.
* Monitor competitive moves and identify whitespace opportunities for category leadership.

**4. Growth & Adoption**

* Drive feature adoption, engagement, and retention in partnership with Product and Growth teams.
* Design interventions that improve habit formation and lifecycle conversion.
* Own core metrics such as activation rate, feature penetration, repeat usage, and retention uplift.

**5. Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Act as the strategic bridge between Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and Business teams.
* Drive alignment across stakeholders on priorities, narratives, and success metrics.
* Build Product Marketing as a strategic capability within the organization.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* 8–10 years of experience across Product Marketing, Product Management, Growth, or consumer-tech strategy roles.
* Proven track record of driving product adoption and growth at scale.
* Strong understanding of consumer behavior, lifecycle funnels, and GTM strategy.
* Excellent analytical capability with comfort using data to drive decisions.
* Strong storytelling and communication skills with executive presence.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and operate cross-functionally.
* Experience in consumer internet, OTT, telecom, subscription, or digital products preferred.

**BENEFITS AND PERKS:**

At JioSaavn, we blur work and play, and you get all the perks of a global company. You will get to work with a dynamic group of entrepreneurs, who are delivering results and working zealously to make a difference in the way the world experiences music.

title: Senior Lead - Strategy & Operations
description:
**Who are we and what do we do?**
BrowserStack is the world’s leading cloud-based software testing platform, empowering over 50,000 customers—including Amazon, Microsoft, Meta, and Google—to deliver high-quality software at speed. Founded in 2011 by Ritesh Arora and Nakul Aggarwal, the company has grown to support more than two million tests daily across 22 global data centers, providing instant access to 35,000+ real devices and browsers.
  
  
With over 1,200 employees and a remote-first approach, BrowserStack operates at the intersection of scale, reliability, and innovation. Its suite of products spans manual and automated testing, visual regression, accessibility, and test management—all designed to simplify the testing process for modern development teams. Behind the scenes, BrowserStack continues to push the boundaries with AI capabilities like smart test case generation and design, flakiness detection, auto-healing and more —helping teams reduce maintenance overhead, debug faster, and catch issues earlier in the development lifecycle.
  
  
Recognized for its innovation and growth, BrowserStack has been named to the Forbes Cloud 100 list for four consecutive years. With backing from investors like Accel, Bond, and Insight Partners, the company continues to expand its product offerings and global footprint. Joining BrowserStack means being part of a mission-driven team dedicated to shaping the future of software testing.
  
  
**Location: This is a remote position; however, the role requires the candidate to be based in Mumbai.**
**Role in a Nutshell**

* Lead/Senior Lead, Business Strategy and Operations position will be responsible for partnering closely with functional leaders across Marketing and GTM to develop a shared set of priorities, growth strategy and operational plan. You will ensure our strategy is coordinated and cohesive, and supports our company objectives. As a key partner to Marketing leaders, you will act as a liaison between Marketing and the wider GTM teams, including Sales, GTM Strategy & Planning, and Financial Planning teams.
* In this role you will be required to meet our goals of supporting & optimizing all operations & technology to enable effective marketing at BrowserStack. This role will be a critical partner to the Marketing organisation for leading strategic planning and generating insights that drive Marketing performance.
* You will also conduct and support primary and secondary research projects and create relevant insights on market trends, market sizing, market forecasting, company bench- marking, customer needs, and competition that inform product, customer, and go-to-market strategies.

**What Will You Do?**

* Analyse unstructured, ambiguous and complex challenges facing the organisation making judicious use of qualitative and quantitative data; gather insights, define problems and identify underlying opportunities.
* Make compelling recommendations; develop a tactical plan to execute and translate them into results.
* Design and execute best-in-class quantitative and qualitative research to support decision-making, and strategic planning and shape marketing/brand strategies, campaign development, and product/solutions development
* Develop, implement, and maintain account intelligence strategies to identify profiitable, high-potential accounts, and garnish and retain customer base.
* Strategic Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of market trends, industry developments, and competitive landscapes to provide valuable insights that inform our corporate Strategy and executive decision-making.
* Data-driven Insights: Utilise data analytics and business intelligence tools to extract meaningful insights from various data sources, enabling informed strategic choices at the executive level.
* Market Opportunities: Identify new market opportunities and emerging trends that align with the organization's goals, enabling proactive decision-making to capitaliize on these opportunities.
* Competitive Intelligence: Monitor and analyse competitor activities, market positioning, and product offerings to help the organisation maintain a competitive edge.
* Marketing Database Hygiene: Should be able to handle large volumes of unstructured and structured marketing database/information for maintaining data accuracy by conducting regular data checks/cleansing and should also work on collecting and populating the accurate info for all the missing fields using secondary research, data mining and profile techniques
* Integrate data from multiple sources into a unified intelligence platform, and adjust database management to reflect changes, including adding new contacts and correcting inaccuracies
* CRM Tool Handling (Salesforce) – Detailed understanding/exp working on salesforce tool is a plus, end to end handling of Salesforce CRM tool. Conducting quality checks for the data/information collected by the team members before up- loading into salesforce. Preparing reports to ensure all the data is correctly mapped and accurate.
* Own the account, contact and lead enrichment activities along with its reporting and insights

**Desired Experience**

* 6 - 8 years of experience, with a minimum of 5 years in Strategy or Management Consulting, preferably with a leading global consulting firm or in a high-impact Corporate Strategy role within a leading B2B SaaS or technology company.
* At least 5 years experience in Marketing/Sales Strategy, Research roles for Marketing/Sales teams, using secondary and tertiary research methods.
* Must have exposure in SQL to create reports, analyses & insights Knowledge of working with tools like ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo,Rocket Reach, Lusha, Traxcn, etc.
* Proven experience in working with ICP identification across different segments and product portfolios.
* Advanced ability to analyze data and summarize information from multiple sources, including large and complex data sets to perform market, industry, financial and economic analyses. Structured thinking, strong problem-solving and communication skills, and the ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment
* Proficient in analytics and be able to develop actionable insights using data. Be able to multitask, prioritize, rapidly iterate, and manage communications with different functions in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Excellent project management skills; ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, often with non-congruent timelines.
* An MBA from a class A institution and an IIT or technology qualification will be a strong plus.

**Benefits**
In addition to your total compensation, you will be eligible for following benefits, which will be governed by the Company policy:
  
  

* Medical Insurance: Comprehensive INR 5,00,000 coverage for employee, spouse, up to 2 dependent children, and parents or parents-in-law
* Statutory Benefits: Gratuity per the Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
* Paid Time Off: 25 days of paid leave annually (Annual & Sick Leave) plus gazetted public holidays and special life-event leaves
* Remote-First work environment that allows our people to work from home
* Remote-First Allowance for home office setup, connectivity, accessories, co-working spaces, wellbeing to ensure an amazing remote work experience

description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
**General Manager – Sales & Operations**

**Company:**
CARA Healthcare Private Limited

**Industry:**
Healthcare | Wellness | Hair Transplant | Skin & Aesthetic Treatments

Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Department:**
Sales, Marketing & Operations

**Position:**
General Manager – Sales & Operations

8–12 Years (Preferred)

Full-Time

Founder / Managing Director

About CARA Healthcare Private Limited

CARA Healthcare Private Limited is a growing healthcare and aesthetic services organization specializing in hair restoration, skin treatments, aesthetic procedures, and wellness solutions. We are committed to delivering quality patient experiences through advanced treatments, professional healthcare services, and patient-centric care.

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented General Manager – Sales & Operations who can take ownership of business growth, sales performance, marketing initiatives, and overall operational excellence.

Role Overview

The General Manager will be responsible for developing and executing business growth strategies, driving revenue, strengthening sales and marketing channels, managing operational performance, and identifying new business opportunities.

The ideal candidate should have strong leadership skills, strategic thinking, and hands-on experience in healthcare, wellness, aesthetic clinics, hair transplant, or skin care industries.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth**

* Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets.
* Identify new business opportunities and explore potential revenue-generating channels.
* Monitor sales performance, conversion ratios, lead generation, and revenue growth.
* Develop strategies to improve patient acquisition, consultation conversion, and repeat business.
* Build effective sales processes and ensure proper lead management and follow-ups.
* Work closely with the counselling and sales teams to improve productivity and performance.
* Analyse market trends, competitors, pricing strategies, and customer behaviour.

**2. Strategic Marketing & Business Development**

* Develop comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Plan and execute digital and offline marketing campaigns.
* Identify new marketing opportunities to increase brand visibility and patient acquisition.
* Collaborate with digital marketing agencies and internal marketing teams.
* Monitor campaign performance, marketing ROI, lead quality, and customer acquisition costs.
* Develop strategic partnerships, corporate tie-ups, and referral networks.
* Explore new business opportunities in healthcare, wellness, hair restoration, and aesthetic services.

**3. Influencer Marketing & Brand Collaborations**

* Develop and execute influencer marketing strategies.
* Identify, evaluate, and collaborate with relevant influencers, content creators, and healthcare personalities.
* Establish brand collaborations to increase awareness and generate quality leads.
* Negotiate influencer partnerships, campaign deliverables, and commercial terms.
* Monitor influencer campaign performance, engagement, reach, and lead conversions.
* Build long-term relationships with influencers and brand ambassadors.

**4. PR Marketing & Brand Positioning**

* Develop public relations strategies to strengthen the company's brand image.
* Explore media coverage, press releases, interviews, publications, and brand features.
* Build relationships with media agencies, journalists, PR professionals, and relevant industry platforms.
* Identify opportunities for brand visibility through healthcare events, exhibitions, conferences, and collaborations.
* Maintain consistent brand communication and positioning across marketing channels.

**5. Business Operations & Management**

* Oversee the overall business operations and ensure smooth functioning of departments.
* Coordinate with sales, marketing, HR, finance, administration, and clinical teams.
* Develop operational strategies to improve efficiency, productivity, and profitability.
* Establish SOPs, performance monitoring systems, and accountability frameworks.
* Monitor daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports.
* Identify operational gaps and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure effective coordination between patient acquisition, consultation, treatment, and post-treatment services.

**6. Team Leadership & Performance Management**

* Lead, guide, and motivate sales, marketing, and operational teams.
* Set departmental targets, KPIs, and performance expectations.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and management meetings.
* Develop employee productivity and accountability.
* Identify training requirements and improve team capabilities.
* Build a performance-driven and result-oriented work culture.

**7. Business Expansion & Strategic Planning**

* Identify opportunities for business expansion and new service offerings.
* Study industry developments, competitors, and emerging healthcare and wellness trends.
* Develop strategies for improving market share and business profitability.
* Explore new locations, strategic partnerships, and business collaborations.
* Present business growth plans and performance reports to management.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate's performance will be evaluated based on:

* Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets.
* Revenue growth and overall business profitability.
* Improvement in lead-to-consultation and consultation-to-treatment conversion ratios.
* Marketing ROI and cost per acquisition.
* Quality and quantity of leads generated through influencer and PR campaigns.
* Brand visibility and market positioning.
* Operational efficiency and cost optimization.
* Team productivity and achievement of departmental targets.
* Successful implementation of business growth strategies.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, or a related field. MBA will be preferred.
* 8–12 years of relevant professional experience in sales, marketing, business development, or operations.
* Previous experience in the healthcare, wellness, dermatology, cosmetology, hair transplant, or aesthetic clinic industry is strongly preferred.
* Proven experience in managing sales teams and achieving revenue targets.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing, influencer marketing, PR, and brand management.
* Experience in business development, strategic planning, and operational management.
* Excellent leadership, negotiation, communication, and analytical skills.
* Ability to manage multiple departments and deliver measurable business results.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates with experience in hair transplant clinics, dermatology clinics, skin and aesthetic centres, wellness chains, or healthcare organizations.
* Strong industry connections with influencers, media agencies, marketing professionals, and strategic partners.
* Someone who understands both the business and operational side of healthcare services.
* A proactive leader who can independently develop strategies and take ownership of business outcomes.
* Strong commercial mindset with a focus on revenue, profitability, and sustainable business growth.

What We Expect

We are looking for a business leader, not just a sales manager. The individual should be capable of developing strategies, building teams, creating marketing opportunities, improving operational systems, and taking CARA Healthcare Private Limited to the next level of business growth.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Job Title: Technical Account Manager
  
  
Job Location: Mumbai
  
  
Posting Start Date: 17/11/2026
  
  
Job Description:
  
  
**Role Title: Technical Account Manager**
**Role Function and Department: Innovation and Technology, CTS AP**
**Role Purpose**
The Technical Account Manager (Customer Technical services (CTS) role will provide technical leadership and customer-facing support for the lubricants business in India. The role will act as a key technical interface between customers and internal technical teams, translating customer and market requirements into practical lubricant solutions and supporting their development, qualification, commercialization, and ongoing use.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer Technical Support and Relationship Management**

* Serve as a key technical contact for lubricant customers and OEM in India, developing a strong understanding of their technical requirements, product portfolios, operational challenges, and future needs.
* Build trusted technical relationships with customer formulation, technical, product development, quality, and other relevant teams.
* Provide technically sound recommendations to address customer formulation, performance, application, and product-related challenges.
* Lead and support technical discussions, product demonstrations, technical workshops, troubleshooting activities, and customer development programs.
* Translate customer needs into clear technical programs and coordinate effectively with internal product development, testing, analytical, and other technical teams.
* Support customers in understanding lubricant performance requirements, industry specifications, OEM requirements, and product qualification pathways.

**Lubricant Application and Formulation Support**

* Provide formulation and application expertise for lubricant development and optimization activities.
* Support the definition and execution of customer technical programs, including formulation development, blend preparation, analytical testing, performance testing, data interpretation, and technical recommendations.
* Assess formulation and performance data and convert results into actionable recommendations for customers.
* Support technical troubleshooting where customers encounter formulation, performance, manufacturing, or field-related issues.
* Apply sound technical judgement when balancing performance requirements, formulation constraints, base oil selection, viscosity grade, additive treat rate, and customer-specific needs.
* Work with internal technical specialists as required to develop robust solutions for complex customer requirements.

**Driveline Technical Capability**

* Bring relevant experience or strong technical exposure to driveline lubricant applications, in addition to engine lubricant experience.
* Support customer development activities involving areas such as manual transmission fluids, automatic transmission fluids, gear oils, axle fluids and other driveline applications, as appropriate to customer requirements.
* Understand the interaction between base oils, additive systems, viscosity, frictional characteristics, wear protection, durability, and component/material compatibility in driveline applications.
* Support technical discussions related to industry and OEM driveline requirements and qualification programs.
* Work with customers and internal specialists to identify appropriate technical solutions for conventional and emerging driveline applications.

**India Market and Customer Focus**

* Develop a strong understanding of the Indian lubricant and automotive market, including customer requirements, vehicle and equipment applications, operating conditions, lubricant quality expectations, and evolving technical needs.
* Maintain awareness of changes in Indian and global lubricant specifications, OEM requirements, vehicle technology, emission requirements, and market trends that may affect customers in India.
* Identify emerging technical needs and translate market/customer insights into opportunities for technical development and differentiated customer support.
* Support technical engagement with lubricant marketers, automotive/OEM customers, and other relevant industry stakeholders where required.
* Balance global technical standards and product capabilities with the practical requirements of the Indian market.

**Program Execution and Technical Governance**

* Independently plan and execute customer technical programs from problem definition through recommendation and implementation.
* Define appropriate experimental programs and coordinate with technical services analyst for blending, analytical testing, performance testing, and technical evaluation.
* Critically review technical data to ensure conclusions and recommendations are scientifically robust.
* Maintain appropriate technical documentation supporting customer programs, product claims, approvals, and commercialization activities.
* Work collaboratively with Product Development, testing laboratories, documentation teams, product management, sales and other functions to deliver customer programs.
* Ensure technical activities are conducted in accordance with applicable product stewardship, industry codes of practice, quality, and HSE requirements.

**Technical Knowledge And Experience**
The successful candidate is expected to have:
  
  

* Relevant industry experience, preferably within lubricants, lubricant additives, automotive fluids, automotive/OEM technical functions, or a closely related field.
* A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Tribology, or another relevant technical discipline.
* Strong understanding of lubricant formulation, performance testing, application requirements, and product development processes.
* Practical experience supporting customer-facing technical programs and translating customer problems into structured technical solutions.
* Experience with engine oils and exposure to driveline lubricant applications.
* Good understanding of lubricant industry specifications and relevant API, ACEA, ILSAC, JASO and OEM requirements, depending on application.
* Understanding of lubricant testing, analytical techniques, performance testing, and interpretation of technical data.
* Familiarity with lubricant qualification and approval processes would be highly desirable.
* Experience working with customers, laboratories, product development teams, commercial teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
