Accelerating Growth
  
  
Leverages industry and market expertise, proactively leading teams to identify solutions to drive new opportunities and strategies in alignment with customer needs. Establishes a technology-driven professional presence in the market and represents Microsoft as a thought leader who can articulate connections between Microsoft solutions to relevant business contexts with industry and market leaders (e.g., speaking at external events, sitting on boards). Pursues industry of choice to create more strategic relevance and value with customers. Coaches teams to consider global perspectives in best practices in local trade, regulatory, and policy environments across geographic areas. Coaches managers and teams to tailor customer engagement for specific industries with relevant customer references and socializes best practices across their organization. Identifies and creates customer references for landmark successes in one or more strategic industries to develop a competitive advantage and to articulate ability to deliver customer value to achieve outcomes. Leverages experiences and expertise with customers across industry to influence the development of programs that help scale and accelerate successful engagements.
  
  
Leads and coaches teams on the development and implementation of scalable go-to-market for maximizing revenue, consumption, and growth across solution areas. Shares best practices and holds managers and teams accountable for leveraging market-specific insights and highlighting solutions that solve business and technology challenges. Coaches teams to identify and proactively engage influencers to drive Microsoft's perspective across accounts and to utilizing available programs to drive customers to expand budget. Sets the expectations for and enables teams to be self-sufficient in leveraging digital assets and data insights, and exhausting all opportunities to develop relationships with new and existing customers.
  
  
Defines expectations and sets strategies for teams to leverage drivers of Digital & Artificial Intelligence (AI) transformation relevant to their customers and partners across business units, promoting the power of the AI within the Microsoft ecosystem, promoting the power of the AI within the Microsoft ecosystem. Drives communicating the importance of security, governance, and responsible use of AI as part of enterprise transformation. Acts as a thought leader in optimally leveraging transformation across solution areas. Consults with customers and internal/external Partners to ensure successful and secure value realization in delivery of solutions to customers. Drives and coaches teams to orchestrate across units and Partners to leverage and accelerate innovative transformation opportunities. Coaches managers to ensure internal partners are educated on industry trends and solutions. Develops and shares strategies for expanding relationships across customers' lines of business that enable innovative solutions, deliver business value, and create market growth. Coaches and supports teams to leverage industry experts within Microsoft to identify and execute on transformation opportunities.
  
  
Driving Success with and Through Others
  
  
Fosters and defines a culture of inclusion, learning, mentorship, coaching, customer-centricity, accountability, collaboration, and achievement of bold goals. Influences and inspires managers and teams across the organization to motivate, engage, and bring teams together. Leads a diverse and inclusive workforce, creates and hires diverse teams, and fosters an inclusive working environment via well-established inclusive behaviors. Develops and rewards high-performing individuals and teams, hires diverse talent, prioritizes development, leads by example, and prepares people for more senior positions in other parts of the organization.
  
  
Builds and maintains a broad executive network inclusive of partners. Cultivates an ecosystem of customer and external partners and defines where there is a need for partners to act in Microsoft's market to accelerate consumption and/or growth. Inspires and influences engagements between partners and executives on long-term business planning, development of scalable strategic partnerships, and influencing customer needs and outcomes across one or more industries. Ensures teams across their organization maintain relationships with an ongoing long-term focus that looks past quarterly and annual targets. Models and creates a rhythm of business (RoB) with customers and partners that enables continuous engagement and future strategic planning.
  
  
Leads business planning and alignment beyond fiscal year boundaries across segments, partners, and teams to drive growth and transformation, define expectations for sale execution, and holds teams accountable for results. Defines where orchestration is needed for success, creates new points of entry for integration and collaboration, sets the tone for an organizational culture of inclusion. Shares best practices and a global perspective across the organization for managing competing priorities, reducing complexity for customers, and mitigating execution challenges, while maintaining a high level of accountability. Drives clarity when leading engagements across the organization by defining mutual and shared priorities across lines of business to drive impactful outcomes. Leads and coaches teams on engagements with key stakeholders to develop clear short- and long-term, execution strategies that meet customers' and Microsoft's objectives. Defines best practices across teams for developing go-to-market strategies based on mutual business needs and scaling across markets and globally.
  
  
Leading and Transforming the Business
  
  
Leads the and aligns business within the segment, driving strategic direction across teams to enable revenue growth by proactively addressing business and competitive needs. Drives orchestration amongst internal teams and holds others accountable, incorporating security adherence into accountabilities. Leads and influences across segments, partners, and internal leaders to drive growth and transformation across accounts. Aligns and gains buy-in from leaders and functions across the organization to ensure success of mutual plans and objectives. Influences the adoption of change based on breakthrough discoveries to drive impact (e.g., new operating model, improving collaboration). Drives teams to deliver success for business accountabilities while maintaining secure operations, adhering to compliance and data security standards through opportunity development. Leads teams across an organization to consistently leverage customer/partner insights and market strategies to act on opportunities to drive consumption, new solutions, and annuity business. Leads and coaches team and/or managers to maintain a growth and customer/partner mindset in response to the business environment. Empowers teams to enable Digital & Artificial Intelligence (AI) transformation for our customers and realize value from solutions that drive impactful market share growth. Directs teams to strategies and expectations for leveraging established systems, programs, and tools that enable consistent customer planning and a rhythm of business (RoB) to align end-to end solutions with go-to-market priorities across the customer portfolio and Microsoft solutions lifecycles.
  
  
Defines ongoing and long-term customer value realization and satisfaction strategies contributing to net-new revenue and business growth. Holds teams accountable for customer value realization satisfaction, and coaches them on best practices and semi-annual survey results. Ensures teams safeguard sensitive customer information by embedding Secure Future Initiative principles into daily sales execution (e.g., least?privilege access, secure collaboration, disciplined data sharing, and proactive risk reduction to protect customer trust). Ensures internal and external executives are aligned on key areas of improvement to further impact increasing customer value realization and satisfaction. Manages and leverages key executive relationships across customer stakeholders (business and IT) to understand drivers of business value, satisfaction, and sentiments. Maintains a strategic perspective on customers and partners to business models and helps them evolve to achieve growth, be competitive, and realize greater alignment between the partner and Microsoft's business models and needs. Understands portfolio of strategic partners (Global Systems Integrator (GSI), Independent Software Vendor (ISV) and drives engagement across teams.
  
  
Develops and drives go-to-market sales strategy and execution to ensure success within their market based on Microsoft's and customer/partner needs. Develops strategies and coaches managers to align teams with customer, compete, and market strategies that drive sales, consumption, and Digital & Artificial Intelligence (AI) transformation solutions. Leads, collaborates with, and empowers managers to execute on strategic initiatives, achieve targets and build and manage pipelines that achieve growth and accelerate customer/partner value realization. Develops talent internally and attracts needed talent to Microsoft. Leads teams by example, driving high-value engagements and creating trusting relationships with customers and partners. Coaches teams on, and drives the execution of go-to-market based on customer, partner, and Microsoft needs, and scaling business across markets. Oversees and directs actions to drive balance in business, financial, and people outcomes. Manages customer planning across accounts to ensure that teams across organizations drive end-to-end orchestration for customer value realization and outcomes. Defines long-term expectations and goals across teams to consistently leverage opportunities and effectively develop, align, and execute on market sales strategies.
  
  
People Management
  
  
Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring. Model: Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles. Coach: Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn. Care: Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Required/minimum qualifications
  
  
Master's Degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, Computer Science, Engineering (e.g., Electrical or Mechanical), Business Management, Economics, or related field AND 7+ years experience in sales, marketing/advertising, managing high performance sales and technical-sales teams, and/or leadership roles in multi-tiered large organizations OR Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, Computer Science, Engineering (e.g., Electrical or Mechanical), Business Management, Economics, or related field AND 8+ years experience in sales, marketing/advertising, managing high performance sales and technical-sales teams, and/or leadership roles in multi-tiered large organizations OR equivalent experience.
  
  
3+ years direct/formal people management experience.

Master's Degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering (e.g., Electrical or Mechanical), Business Management, Economics, or related field AND 10+ years experience in sales, marketing/advertising, managing high performance sales and technical-sales teams, and/or leadership roles in multi-tiered large organizations OR Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering (e.g., Electrical or Mechanical), Business Management, Economics, or related field AND 13+ years experience in sales, marketing/advertising, managing high performance sales and technical-sales teams, and/or leadership roles in multi-tiered large organizations OR equivalent experience.
  
  
Knowledge of MEDDPICC

title: Senior Strategic Account Manager
description:
**About Titan**

At Titan, we’re redefining email for entrepreneurs, innovators, and creators—transforming it into a powerful tool for business growth. Built by a team that deeply cares about helping businesses succeed, Titan is more than just an email platform.

Founded by Bhavin Turakhia, who also founded Directi, Radix, and Zeta, with a combined enterprise value exceeding $2 billion—Titan is backed by a strong legacy of innovation. Today, Titan powers millions of conversations, with 2.4 million emails sent and received every week. In 2021, Automattic (the parent company of WordPress) invested $30M in Titan, valuing the company at $300M. This partnership fuels our mission to revolutionize email and build the future of digital communication.

At Titan, you’ll be part of a fast-growing business, solving meaningful problems and shaping a product that empowers millions. Join us to make a real impact..

**Role Overview**

Titan is seeking a dynamic and experienced
**Senior**
**Strategic Account Manager**
to manage relationships with our global reseller partners, which include some of the largest hosting companies and registrars globally, such as GoDaddy, Newfold Digital, Hostinger, Name.com , NameSilo, and others. You will own these partnerships end-to-end post-contract, ensuring seamless integration, flawless execution, and strong revenue growth. As the P&L owner for existing accounts and the primary point of contact (SPOC), you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive impact and deliver measurable results.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

1. Revenue growth

* Develop and execute strategies to drive revenue growth from existing partners.
* Launch new integration models to improve revenue outcomes.
* Implement initiatives that increase paid upgrades, retention, and LTV.
* Track partner KPIs (revenue, monetization, signups, conversions) and identify improvement opportunities.
* Analyze partnership dashboards to identify high-impact opportunities.
* Monitor outcomes vs. projections and iterate for continuous improvement.

2. Partner relationship management

* Own the full lifecycle of partner relationships post-deal.
* Act as Titan’s face and the SPOC for all business and technical conversations.
* Build strong, trust-led relationships to ensure high satisfaction and NPS.
* Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and drive alignment on priority initiatives.
* Negotiate renewals and ensure deals align with Titan’s strategic and revenue goals.

3. Operational excellence

* Ensure timely and successful delivery of all partner-related initiatives.
* Give final sign-off on integrations and partner projects.
* Own dashboards for revenue, monetization, and partner health.
* Represent the partner’s voice internally to drive alignment across teams.

4. Technical integration management

* Engage with partners to define technical and integration requirements.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deliver seamless integrations.
* Manage project timelines, risks, and cross-functional dependencies.
* Create reusable playbooks and documentation for integration processes.
* Communicate program updates clearly and manage competing priorities effectively.

**Skills and Qualifications**

* 10+ years in the software industry, with 5+ years managing large partners (multi-million USD ARR), ideally in the hosting ecosystem.
* Strong understanding of SaaS business metrics, including acquisition, activation, retention, and MRR.
* Excellent negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven experience in cross-functional coordination with engineering, product, business development, and other teams.
* Comfortable with APIs and system integrations; able to translate technical requirements into action.
* Knowledge of the web hosting industry and control panels (cPanel, Plesk, WHMCS, etc.) is a plus.
* Proficiency in tools for project management, forecasting, and reporting.

**Key competencies**

* Strong business acumen with the ability to balance short-term wins and long-term impact.
* High ownership mindset - driven, resilient, and outcome-oriented.
* Exceptional ability to articulate technical and business concepts to diverse audiences.
* Proactive problem solver who pushes for simple, scalable, and innovative solutions.
* Integrity, accountability, and a strong sense of responsibility to partner success.

**Preferred qualifications**

* MBA from a top-tier institute with a bachelor's degree in computer science or related fields.
* Understanding of managing large accounts in the hosting and reseller ecosystems.
* Proven track record of driving revenue growth and partner satisfaction in SaaS.

**Benefits and Perks**

We at Titan love our jobs. And it’s no surprise – we get to work on exciting and new projects, in a vibrant atmosphere that is designed to be comfortable and conducive for our personal and professional growth.

And Titan goes the extra mile to make you feel at home. We offer benefits ranging from affordable catered meals and even snacks on the house. Our workspaces are welcoming and fun, complete with bean bag chairs and ping pong tables. Oh, and we’ve got your family covered too, with excellent health insurance plans and other benefits. In short, everything you need to be your best self at work!

If you like the idea of working on products that have a truly global impact, get in touch!

description:

● Build and manage relationships with key fashion sellers and brand partners, particularly large organised sellers and

established fashion businesses.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
**About Blitz**

BlitzNow enables Same-Day Delivery for eCommerce brands and enterprises, helping them deliver the best on-

time experiences to their customers. We simplify scalability and unlock growth for new-age eCommerce brands

by making Same-Day delivery more convenient, reliable, and affordable.

Brands like Decathlon, Adidas, Healthkart, Giva, and GOAT have seen 30–40% increases in website conversions

and 2x improvement in customer retention by partnering with BlitzNow. We are a fast-growing, execution-first

team obsessed with delivery excellence.

**About the Role**

As a Key Account Manager at BlitzNow, you will be the primary growth partner for our enterprise clients. You will

own the relationship, the revenue, and the delivery experience for a portfolio of eCommerce brands – ensuring

they scale and succeed with BlitzNow month on month.

This is a high-ownership, client-facing role at the intersection of data, relationships, and operations. If you love

building deep client partnerships, are energised by revenue targets, and thrive in a fast-paced startup

environment – this role is for you.

**Key Responsibilities:-**

**1. Account Management & Retention**

• Own end-to-end management of enterprise accounts after Sales handover

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders at each client

• Monitor delivery SLAs and On-Time Delivery performance, aligning internal stakeholders to keep clients

on track

• Be the single point of contact for escalations and resolution across your portfolio

**2. Revenue Growth**

• Drive consistent Month-on-Month revenue expansion across your account portfolio

• Identify and execute upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts

• Pitch expansion of services to new cities, categories, or fulfilment models

• Proactively manage churn risk and take ownership of account retention

**3. Client Engagement**

• Conduct regular face-to-face meetings with client stakeholders across supply chain, eCommerce, and

leadership

• Run structured business reviews presenting delivery performance and growth opportunities

• Share inputs on network expansion aligned to client strategy and growth plans

**4. Data & Reporting**

• Analyse delivery performance across key lanes and share actionable insights with clients

• Maintain accurate CRM records and contribute to MIS and performance reporting

• Use data to drive strategic decisions and tell a compelling story to client stakeholders

**What We are Looking For**

**Must Have**

• Bachelor degree with 2–4 years of experience in Key Account Management, Client Success, or B2B

Sales

• Prior experience in logistics, eCommerce, SaaS, or supply-chain-adjacent roles strongly preferred

• Advanced MS Excel proficiency; experience with CRM tools (Salesforce, Zoho, HubSpot, or similar)

• Proven track record of owning revenue targets and growing accounts

**You'll Thrive Here If You Are...**

• Data-driven – comfortable with delivery analytics, performance metrics, and data storytelling

• A relationship builder – proven ability to manage enterprise stakeholders including C-suite

• Revenue-oriented – track record of expanding wallet share within existing accounts

• An owner – you take full accountability, escalate smartly, and operate with minimal supervision

• An effective communicator – clear and confident in both client-facing and internal settings

• Adaptable – energised by fast-paced, ambiguous environments

**Good to Have**

• Understanding of same-day, express, or quick-commerce delivery operations

• Experience managing delivery SLAs with D2C or eCommerce brands

• Prior experience in an incentive-linked, target-driven account management role

title: Manager, Account Management ( CRM )
description:
**When you join Accurate Background, you’re an integral part of making every hire the start of a success story. Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions.**
**Job Description**
The Manager, Account Management (CRM), leads a team responsible for retaining and growing a portfolio of clients generating < $150,000 in annual revenue. The role translates organizational growth priorities into disciplined client engagement strategies, coaches Client Relationship Managers to strengthen product adoption (upsells) and account expansion, and ensures consistent execution against revenue, pipeline, retention, and client experience objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**People Leadership & Performance Management**

* Lead, coach, and develop Client Relationship Managers through regular one-on-one meetings, performance reviews, call coaching, and targeted development plans.
* Set clear expectations for outreach, pipeline creation, opportunity progression, client documentation, and revenue performance.
* Monitor individual and team performance through dashboards, quality reviews, and operating rhythms; provide timely coaching and corrective action when needed.
* Build team capability in consultative discovery, client communication, opportunity qualification, product positioning, and opportunity management to execute timely revenue generation.

**Portfolio Growth & Commercial Execution**

* Own team performance against assigned pipeline, upsell, cross-sell and expansion.
* Segment and prioritize the portfolio using account value, client health, whitespace, engagement, and risk indicators.
* Review opportunity quality, remove blockers, and partner with internal teams to advance qualified opportunities.
* Collaborate and execute targeted account campaigns aligned with growth priorities, market trends, and product strategies.

**Client Success & Escalation Management**

* Establish a consistent approach for documenting client goals, service expectations, risks, product feedback, and value-realization plans.
* Serve as a leadership escalation point for complex client requirements, coordinating cross-functional resolution and clear client communication.
* Ensure material risks, blockers, and significant opportunities are communicated to leadership with context, impact, and recommended next steps.

**Operational Excellence & Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Drive consistent CRM discipline, including accurate client records, opportunity stages, notes, forecasts, ownership, and next steps.
* Use team and portfolio data to identify performance trends, improve workflows, and recommend process or enablement changes.
* Represent the client and team perspective in cross-functional forums, translating feedback into actionable recommendations.
* Promote clear ownership and alignment across client-facing teams to deliver consistent, professional client experience.

**Experience**

* Progressive experience in client success, account management, sales, business development, or a related client-facing function, including team leadership or coaching.
* Demonstrated success delivering portfolio growth, retention, pipeline, or revenue objectives in a B2B, SaaS, technology, HR technology, or recurring-revenue environment.
* Experience with performance management, CRM systems, client health tools, dashboards, and forecasting; background screening knowledge is preferred.

**Core Competencies**
People leadership and coaching; commercial execution; portfolio strategy; client and escalation management; opportunity qualification; data-driven forecasting; and cross-functional influence.
  
  
**Success Measures**

* Achievement of team pipeline, timely execution and revenue goal.
* Consistent client engagement, opportunity progression, CRM accuracy, forecasting, and timely intervention to resolve blockers.
* Team productivity, capability growth, performance improvement, and employee engagement.

**The Accurate Way**
We offer a fun, fast-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.
  
  
**Take ownership.**
Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.
  
  
**Be open.**
Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.
  
  
**Stay curious.**
Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.
  
  
**Work as one.**
Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
**About GobbleCube**

GobbleCube builds an agentic performance marketing and commerce intelligence platform for CPG brands selling on quick commerce and e-commerce marketplaces: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, Amazon and Flipkart. Our founders spent over a decade together, including years on Blinkit's core leadership team. We work with some of India's largest CPG brands.

**The role**

You will own a portfolio of enterprise CPG accounts and grow them. Our product touches several functions inside a brand: sales, performance marketing, category and supply chain. Your job is to understand what each of them needs, show them the value in their own numbers, and turn that into renewals and bigger contracts.

**What you will do**

* Own revenue, renewals and expansion for 10–20 accounts, depending on size.
* Build an account plan for each: stakeholders, their KPIs, where we can grow, and the risks.
* Build relationships across sales, performance marketing, category and supply chain teams, with at least two champions per account.
* Spot expansion opportunities: new brands, new platforms, new modules, and moving clients from insights to performance marketing.
* Demo the product and translate it into each persona's problem using their own data.
* Join the outcome reviews led by the Customer Success team, and own the next conversation that follows: renewal, expansion or a new module.
* Write and negotiate renewal and upsell proposals, including working with procurement.
* Know when to bring in the Head of GTM or founders for senior conversations, and prepare them.
* Keep your pipeline and forecast accurate.

**What success looks like in 12 months**

* Net revenue retention above target across your portfolio.
* Strong ACV expansion in the majority of your accounts, through new brands, platforms or modules.
* Every account has a written plan, refreshed every quarter, and at least two active champions in two different functions (for example, e-commerce and supply chain).

**What we're looking for**

* 5–8 years in account management or sales, including growing software or data accounts at CPG brands, or selling to them against a quota.
* A track record of expanding accounts, with numbers to show for it.
* A working understanding of how sales, performance marketing, category and supply chain teams inside a CPG operate, what they measure, and where they disagree.
* The ability to demo a product and frame it around each stakeholder's problem.
* Discipline in running a portfolio of accounts and deciding where your time goes.
* Experience owning renewal and upsell proposals, including pricing and procurement.

**Nice to have**

* Experience inside a CPG, in e-commerce or key account management.
* Hands-on with marketplace metrics: availability, share of search, ad performance.
* Comfortable pulling and reading data yourself.

title: Senior Account Manager - IT/ITeS, AGS-APJ-India-ITS
description:
**Description**
Do you have the business savvy and technical background to help establish Amazon Web Services as the preferred cloud platform for India's IT and ITeS industry? AWS India is seeking a Senior Account Manager to lead cloud strategy and revenue growth across one of India's most dynamic and globally influential sectors.
  
  
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
  
  
As a Senior Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will own the end-to-end cloud strategy for a portfolio of strategic, high-revenue IT services companies, software product firms, and technology-enabled services organizations. You will operate as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, influencing multi-year technology decisions and driving large-scale digital transformation programs. This role requires you to think at the level of how India's leading technology companies architect their platforms, modernize their delivery models, and build next-generation solutions on AWS for their global customers. You will define the strategic direction for your accounts, execute complex multi-stakeholder commercial engagements, mentor junior Account Managers, contribute to segment-level strategy, and represent the voice of the IT/ITeS customer within AWS to influence product roadmaps and go-to-market priorities.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Drive Cloud Adoption Across IT/ITeS Organizations: Lead strategic sales initiatives focused on workload migration, application modernization, DevOps transformation, and AI/ML adoption to help IT/ITeS companies build competitive advantage through AWS.
* Own the long-term cloud strategy for your accounts and develop multi-year account plans that align AWS capabilities with customer business objectives, including platform modernization, IP development on AWS, and enabling customers to build cloud-native offerings for their end clients.
* Executive Relationship Building and Influence: Establish and sustain CXO-level relationships across your accounts. Engage with CEOs, CTOs, Chief Digital Officers, Engineering Heads, and Delivery Leaders to position AWS as a strategic partner.
* Influence technology decisions at the board level and drive executive alignment on large transformation programs.
* Complex Deal Structuring and Negotiation: Lead multi-year commercial engagements including EDPs, PPAs, and custom pricing constructs.
* Navigate complex procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders, legal teams, and partner ecosystems.
* Structure deals that balance customer value with AWS business objectives.
* Cross-Functional Orchestration: Operate as the single-threaded leader for your accounts, orchestrating across Solutions Architects, Partner teams, Professional Services, Specialist sellers, and Product teams to deliver cohesive customer outcomes.
* Segment Strategy and Market Shaping: Contribute to the IT/ITeS segment strategy by identifying industry trends, competitive dynamics, and whitespace opportunities. Provide inputs that shape go-to-market priorities, pricing strategies, and product investments for the segment.
* Revenue Growth and Pipeline Management: Own revenue targets, build and manage a healthy sales pipeline, forecast accurately, and drive deals through complex procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
* Customer Success and Expansion: Ensure successful onboarding and adoption of AWS services, identify expansion opportunities across different business units and service lines, and drive consumption growth through strategic engagement across GenAI, data analytics, and modernization use cases.
* Thought Leadership and Advocacy: Organize and participate in workshops, hackathons, webinars, and industry events to build AWS mindshare, showcase customer success stories, and establish AWS as the innovation partner of choice for IT/ITeS organizations

A day in the life
  
  
As a Senior Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will own a portfolio of strategic accounts and be responsible for driving their cloud journey from initial engagement through large-scale adoption. Your day will involve a mix of strategic planning, customer engagement, internal collaboration, deal execution, and team development activities.
  
  
**A Typical Day May Include**
Strategic Planning: Reviewing multi-year account plans, analyzing consumption trends, identifying whitespace opportunities, and preparing for upcoming customer engagements with clear objectives and value propositions. Assessing deal progression across your portfolio, identifying blockers, and aligning resources to accelerate critical opportunities.
  
  
Customer Meetings: Conducting CXO steering committees and executive briefings with business leaders, technical deep-dives with engineering teams, and business reviews with account stakeholders to drive alignment and momentum on large transformation programs.
  
  
Internal Collaboration: Working with Solutions Architects on technical proposals, coordinating with Partner teams on joint go-to-market initiatives, engaging Product teams to address customer requirements, and providing customer feedback that influences service roadmaps critical to the IT/ITeS segment.
  
  
Deal Progression: Advancing complex commercial engagements through the sales cycle, structuring multi-year agreements, addressing procurement and commercial discussions, negotiating contracts, and removing blockers to close deals.
  
  
Relationship Development: Building trusted advisor relationships through regular cadence calls, proactive outreach, sharing relevant insights and best practices, and connecting customers with AWS resources and expertise.
  
  
Knowledge Building: Staying current on AWS service launches, industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer success stories to bring fresh ideas and relevant insights to customer conversations
  
  
**About The Team**
The IT/ITeS segment team focuses on one of India's most strategic industries, organizations that are transforming their own operations through cloud and building cloud-native solutions and services for customers worldwide. You'll be part of a collaborative, high-energy team that values customer obsession, innovation, and results.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above, or MBA
* Experience reaching and exceeding sales revenue goals
* Experience navigating prospective accounts from and into a senior executive level to identify new customer opportunities
* 10+ years of technology sales selling enterprise software, networking, infrastructure, managed hosting services, or cloud computing services experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree, or MBA
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Associate's degree or above

6. Verify customer purchase orders, approved samples, specifications, quality tolerances and acceptance criteria.
7. Identify recurring complaints, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), coordinate Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) and monitor their implementation and effectiveness.
8. Immediately escalate repeat complaints, critical quality issues and systemic concerns to Management, QC Head and Plant Head.
9. Facilitate commercially appropriate resolutions, including replacement, rework, credit adjustments and negotiated settlements, subject to management approval.
10. Review customer grievances and historical disputes and recommend improvements in Terms & Conditions of Sale and Supply to minimise commercial and operational risks.
11. Coordinate customer and vendor Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), including execution, authorised signatures, approved formats, renewals, validity tracking and confidentiality records.
12. Coordinate customer claims, compensation demands, commercial disputes and legal notices with Management and external legal advisors.
13. Maintain a centralised grievance register, ensuring proper complaint classification, ownership, resolution timelines, customer communication and documented closure.
14. Prepare weekly and monthly MIS reports covering complaints received and resolved, pending cases, ageing analysis, repeat grievances, customer-wise and product-wise trends, CAPA status, customer feedback and financial implications.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of direct experience in customer grievance management, complaint resolution or customer quality complaint handling.
* Flexible packaging manufacturing experience preferred.
* Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university.
* Understanding of manufacturing processes, packaging specifications and common quality defects.
* Experience in handling difficult customers, escalations, claims and commercial disagreements.
* Strong communication, negotiation, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Excel, complaint tracking, RCA, CAPA and MIS reporting.
* Ability to independently coordinate with multiple departments and senior management.
* Willingness and ability to handle urgent customer issues outside normal working hours.

**Key Expectations**

* Every complaint must have a responsible owner, a defined resolution timeline and a documented outcome.
* No customer complaint should remain unattended or unrecorded.
* Repeat complaints and critical quality issues must be immediately escalated.
* Focus on timely resolution, customer satisfaction, reduction of recurring grievances and prevention of avoidable commercial disputes.

**Note:**
A legal degree is not required. Familiarity with commercial contracts, Terms & Conditions, and NDAs will be an added advantage.

**Interested candidates can share their updated CV through LinkedIn DM or email at sneha.singh@perusalglobal.com**

**Account Director**

**BFSI**

**hunter and challenger mindset**
, with the ability to unlock new opportunities, influence strategic technology decisions, displace competition, and drive sustained cloud consumption growth.

You will work closely with senior technology and business leaders to help customers modernize infrastructure, accelerate digital transformation, adopt AI-driven capabilities, and realize measurable business value through Oracle Cloud.

4. OCI Adoption, New Workloads & Consumption Growth

* Drive adoption and expansion of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure across IaaS, PaaS, database, multicloud, hybrid cloud, and AI workloads.
* Identify and qualify opportunities for workload migration, application modernization, disaster recovery, cloud-native development, high-performance computing, and infrastructure optimization.

* Collaborate with solution engineering and technical specialists to develop transformation roadmaps, proof-of-concepts, and customer-specific solution strategies.
* Drive sustained quarter-on-quarter OCI consumption growth through new workload acquisition, expansion of existing deployments, and increased production adoption.
* Identify competitive displacement opportunities and execute structured strategies to win strategic workloads.

5. Complex Deal Leadership & Commercial Execution

* Lead end-to-end execution of large, complex enterprise cloud opportunities, from identification and qualification through negotiation and closure.
* Develop strategic deal plans involving executive sponsorship, competitive positioning, stakeholder alignment, business case development, and commercial structuring.
* Navigate complex enterprise procurement, legal, risk, finance, and technology evaluation processes.
* Negotiate strategic cloud agreements and commercial commitments in collaboration with Oracle's internal stakeholders.
* Demonstrate strong commercial acumen, ownership, and execution discipline in closing high-value opportunities.
* Consistently meet or exceed revenue, cloud consumption, and sales performance targets.

6. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Partner Ecosystem

* Collaborate closely with Oracle's Cloud Engineering, Data Platform, Applications, Customer Success, and other lines of business to deliver integrated account strategies.
* Work with system integrators, consulting organizations, technology partners, and ecosystem influencers to accelerate market development and cloud adoption.
* Leverage strategic partnerships to identify new opportunities, influence transformation programs, and strengthen Oracle's position within large enterprises.
* Coordinate internal teams to ensure seamless customer engagement from opportunity development through solution adoption and expansion.
* Provide market intelligence and customer insights to help shape Oracle's go-to-market initiatives.

7. Pipeline Management & Forecasting

* Build and maintain a robust, qualified pipeline across BFSI, Digital Native, and conglomerate accounts.
* Drive disciplined opportunity progression, pipeline conversion, and forecast accuracy.
* Maintain comprehensive account plans, stakeholder maps, opportunity strategies, and CRM updates.
* Proactively identify deal risks, competitive threats, and execution challenges while developing mitigation strategies.
* Provide timely and accurate business updates, sales forecasts, and account growth plans to regional and national sales leadership.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* **10–15+ years of experience**
  in enterprise technology sales, cloud infrastructure, platform services, or enterprise software, with demonstrated success managing large and strategic enterprise customers.
* **Proven sales experience across BFSI and at least one of the following segments: Digital Natives or large diversified conglomerates.**
  Exposure to all three segments is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of the enterprise technology landscape in West India, particularly Mumbai, and established relationships with key technology and business decision-makers.
* Demonstrated experience engaging and influencing C-suite executives and senior technology leadership.
* Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding enterprise sales targets and closing large, complex technology deals.
* Experience selling public cloud, hybrid cloud, cloud infrastructure, database, data platforms, or enterprise transformation solutions.
* Strong understanding of major cloud platforms such as OCI, AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Experience identifying new business opportunities, acquiring strategic workloads, expanding existing accounts, and driving recurring cloud consumption.
* Ability to manage complex multi-stakeholder sales cycles, competitive pursuits, and enterprise commercial negotiations.
* Strong account planning, relationship management, executive communication, and negotiation capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively with solution engineering, customer success, partner organizations, and cross-functional teams.
* Self-motivated, resilient, and results-oriented, with a strong hunter mindset and proven ability to build and grow strategic accounts.
* Based in Mumbai or willing to relocate, with flexibility to travel across West India as required.

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience managing a diversified portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts across multiple industries.
* Proven experience selling OCI or competing hyperscaler platforms into large enterprise environments.
* Experience engaging cloud-first organizations, fintechs, SaaS businesses, or high-growth technology companies.
* Understanding of cloud-native architectures, Kubernetes, DevOps ecosystems, GPU computing, AI/ML, and Generative AI workloads.
* Experience navigating diversified enterprise groups, multiple subsidiaries, and complex technology procurement structures.
* Exposure to large-scale cloud transformation, application modernization, database migration, and multicloud strategies.
* Demonstrated success in winning competitive cloud engagements and expanding enterprise consumption.
* Strong relationships within the system integrator and technology consulting ecosystem.

**If you are an accomplished enterprise technology sales professional with strong executive relationships, deep cloud sales expertise, and the ambition to drive strategic growth across BFSI, Digital Native, and conglomerate accounts, we would love to hear from you.**

title: Lead, AI Enablement
description:
Third Bridge is a leading global research firm established in 2007, with a team of over 1,500 employees worldwide dedicated to
**fueling decisions with expert insights**
. We accelerate and enhance decision-making for investors and business leaders by unearthing unique expert insights across multiple sectors, geographies, and topics.
  
  
For nearly 20 years, we’ve helped clients access knowledge on demand from experts, in-person and through our Library covering over 65,000 companies.
  
  
**About Third Bridge**
Third Bridge is a global investment research firm founded in 2007 and headquartered in London, helping the world's largest investment and advisory institutions make faster, better-informed decisions through human-led primary research. With 1,500+ people across 12 offices, the Mumbai hub is home to both client-facing research teams and Global Shared Services.
  
  
**About The Role**
Third Bridge is building a dedicated AI Enablement Group to accelerate practical AI adoption across our global business. This role will help define how teams across horizontal functions such as Finance, Commercial, Marketing, Editorial, People Operations, Legal, and Compliance leverage AI to improve productivity, decision-making, and operational efficiency.
  
  
As the AI Enablement Lead, you will own the knowledge foundation that enables AI adoption at scale across Third Bridge. Your focus will be on three core areas: building and maintaining the organisation's AI use-case library, developing reusable prompt libraries, and creating the training programmes that bring both to life for business teams.
  
  
This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building, testing, and scaling practical AI solutions. While you will work closely with stakeholders across the business, the primary focus is delivering tangible AI-enabled outcomes rather than managing projects, vendors, or large teams.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI Use Case Library**

* Build and own a version-controlled Markdown repository — template, taxonomy etc.
* Document AI workflows, best practices, guardrails, and business use cases.
* Develop governance, taxonomy, version control, and documentation standards.
* Partner with stakeholders across functions to capture and scale successful AI initiatives.

**Prompt Engineering & AI Assets**

* Design, test, and maintain reusable prompt libraries for high-value business workflows.
* Develop practical AI assets that support activities such as reporting, content creation, compliance etc.
* Establish prompt evaluation, testing, and continuous improvement frameworks.

**Training & Enablement**

* Design and deliver engaging AI training programmes for business users.
* Run workshops and enablement sessions that drive measurable AI adoption.
* Establish feedback mechanisms to continuously improve training content and AI assets.

**Required Experience**

* 8–10 years experience in Technology or an adjacent field
* 2+ years hands-on experience with GenAI and LLM implementation
* Strong technical writing; comfortable working across functions without formal authority
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, technical writing, and training skills.

**Technical Skills**

* Expertise with Anthropic Claude and other enterprise AI tools.

title: Engineer, Customer Order Engineering
description:
Shape Engineering Solutions from Concept to Production as an Engineering Support Supervisor
  
  
Are you ready for the next step in your engineering career? Join a team where you will play a key role in supporting engineered product delivery, guiding technical documentation, and enabling successful manufacturing outcomes. You will work closely with quotation teams, engineers, production, and quality functions to ensure products meet customer requirements and industry standards. This role offers the opportunity to combine technical expertise with team leadership while contributing to the successful execution of customer projects. If you enjoy solving engineering challenges, collaborating across functions, and developing people, this could be the next move for you.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and supervise the daily activities of an engineering support team of up to 15 employees, ensuring priorities are executed effectively.
* Plan, monitor, and coordinate engineering support work, including drawings, documentation, and printing activities while maintaining compliance with applicable regulations.
* Partner with quotation and application teams to provide technical support during the quotation phase.
* Evaluate customer specifications and collaborate with relevant teams to ensure product selection meets requirements and manufacturing feasibility.
* Create and maintain engineering documentation, including manufacturing drawings, BOMs, specifications, and engineered product records.
* Develop and maintain customer-facing technical documentation, including dimensional, instrumentation, assembly drawings, and engineering calculations.
* Support manufacturing, production, topworks, and quality teams by resolving technical and documentation-related challenges.
* Collaborate with senior engineers on technical issues, production information, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Lead team development by coaching, evaluating, and supporting engineering support employees while introducing operating manuals and training materials.
* Participate in COE and quotation support development projects and support domestic or international travel requirements for training and business needs.

Expectations from you
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or an equivalent technical discipline.
* 1 to 5 years of relevant engineering experience.
* Experience using 2D and 3D CAD software.
* Strong capability in creating and maintaining engineering drawings and technical documentation.
* Good Microsoft Office and general computer proficiency.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively, demonstrate flexibility, and maintain a professional approach with customers and colleagues.
* Experience in application engineering, valve and actuator technologies, or instrumentation and automation engineering is an advantage.
* Experience with GD&T, Product Data Management systems, ERP systems, fluid flow, pneumatics, and P&IDs is considered beneficial.
* Domestic or international travel may be required for training, internal meetings, and other business-related activities.

To succeed in this role
  
  
Success in this position requires a strong engineering foundation combined with the ability to manage technical documentation, support manufacturing operations, and collaborate across multiple functions. You will need to be confident interpreting customer specifications, creating accurate engineering deliverables, and providing technical guidance to both internal teams and production stakeholders. Strong communication skills, CAD expertise, and a structured approach to problem-solving are essential. Additionally, leading and developing a team while ensuring quality, compliance, and timely execution will be key to your success.
  
  
We Also Expect You To Align With Valmet’s Leadership Principles, Practical Behaviors That Guide How We Lead, Collaborate, And Succeed Together
  
  

* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
* Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value

We offer
  
  
You will join an engineering support team responsible for managing technical documentation, supporting quotation activities, enabling manufacturing execution, and ensuring engineering quality standards are met. The team works closely with engineering, production, quality, and application functions to deliver accurate documentation and technical expertise throughout the product lifecycle. In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead a team of engineering support professionals, contribute to development projects, and influence how engineering information is created and maintained. You will work in a collaborative environment where technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement are valued. The role offers exposure to customer requirements, manufacturing processes, and a broad range of engineering disciplines.
  
  
Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging environment where you can contribute to meaningful business outcomes while continuing to develop your professional capabilities. You will work alongside experienced colleagues in a collaborative and international setting, supported by modern tools, learning opportunities, and employee-focused benefits. We encourage growth, innovation, and teamwork while supporting a healthy and sustainable work environment.
  
  
When everything works together
  
  
*Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.*
*At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.*

title: Process & Training Lead
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
As Process & Training Lead for Customer Fulfillment at the General Mills India Center, you will be the local owner of training, systems support and process discipline for our Mumbai customer fulfillment team, and the first point of contact for questions from Customer Operations Specialists and Customer Replenishment Analysts. Working across three themes – Training, Systems and Process – you will build onboarding and cross-training programs, guide the team on SAP and reporting tools, and keep standard operating procedures current and adopted. Reporting to the Customer Fulfilment Head, you will partner closely with the North America Training & Process Lead and Customer Fulfillment Managers to help new hires ramp up faster, reduce repeat questions and errors, and build a consistent way of working between India and North America. This is a hybrid role based in Powai, Mumbai, with a shift timing of 3:30 pm to 12:30 am IST.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Own the training framework for the customer fulfillment team – onboarding plans for new Customer Operations Specialists and Customer Replenishment Analysts, cross-training, backup coverage training and periodic refreshers – with clear readiness criteria for each desk.
* Build and maintain training content (e-learning modules, onboarding files, job aids, quick-reference guides) in partnership with the North America Training & Process Lead, and deliver training and coaching to specialists, analysts and team managers, reducing reliance on North America buddies for onboarding.
* Act as the first point of contact for team queries – triage each by theme (Training, Systems, Process), resolve or route to the right owner, and maintain a query log and FAQ to identify and fix recurring root causes.
* Provide systems support and guidance on SAP, Fiori, macros, dashboards and standard reports; document how tools are used and coordinate fixes and enhancements with Digital & Technology and North America partners.
* Own the local library of standard operating procedures, one-point lessons, playbooks, hand-offs and process maps – keeping them current, version-controlled and adopted – and run periodic process-adherence checks across teams.
* Partner with the North America Training & Process Lead to roll out process and system changes (e.g., process decisions, customer or network transitions, new tools) and feed local pain points back into cross-regional process design.
* Lead continuous improvement – run utilization and workload studies, automate manual SAP pulls and reports, standardize rotational tasks, support transitions of work between desks or roles, and plan backup and cross-coverage with Customer Fulfillment Managers.
* Define and report training and process metrics (e.g., new-hire ramp time, training completion, query volume and resolution time, error and rework trends, procedure adherence) to the Customer Fulfilment Head and North America leadership, demonstrating ownership, responsiveness, collaboration and a proactive “heads-up before it breaks” mindset.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Education: Full-time graduation (bachelor’s degree) from an accredited university (mandatory).
* Experience: 10+ years in supply chain, customer fulfillment, order management or customer service, including hands-on experience in a customer operations or customer replenishment role.
* Technical Skills: Working knowledge of the order-to-cash process and SAP order processing (e.g., ZGOR, VA01, ZOUT); advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
* Training & Documentation: Demonstrated ability to train, coach and onboard others, and to create clear training materials and process documentation (standard operating procedures, one-point lessons).
* Soft Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence and collaborate across time zones with North America stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Fiori, Excel macros / VBA, Power BI or similar reporting and dashboard tools.
* Experience designing e-learning or instructional content (e.g., Easygenerator or similar authoring tools).
* Process-improvement mindset (Lean, Six Sigma or Business Process Management exposure), with experience mapping processes and writing standard operating procedures.
* Experience in a shared services or global capability center supporting North America operations.
* Experience supporting change management, system or process transitions, and rollouts of new ways of working.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, query-driven environment with competing priorities and multiple stakeholders.
* Familiarity with customer-specific order processes and customer portals

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

description:

We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.
  
  
**Position Description**
We are hiring a HubSpot Specialist / Developer role to act as a hands-on developer executing a substantial, already-documented backlog of HubSpot architecture, integration, lifecycle automation, and security remediation work. The candidate will work from existing Jira epics and tickets covering custom object data modeling, CRM/data pipeline integrations, and marketing automation for multiple product lines.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
The candidate will be responsible for developing, testing, and shipping work items across the following areas:
  
  

* Core HubSpot Architecture & Data Modeling

+ Architect, migrate, and deploy new HubSpot custom object data models to support team structures, multi-product subscription hierarchies, and lifecycle tracking.
+ Implement multi-product subscription modeling across B2B use cases.
+ Validate product/team hierarchy alignment and member associations.
+ Test custom object association traversal and workflow personalization logic.
+ Configure Databricks source table mapping and Hightouch synchronization models.

* CRM & Pipeline Integrations (Salesforce, Hightouch, Databricks, AppFlow)

+ Build and maintain Salesforce ↔ HubSpot sync configurations including resolving object sync threshold limits.
+ Investigate, triage, and resolve large-scale sync errors between Salesforce and HubSpot.
+ Configure HubSpot integration user permissions in Salesforce.
+ Fix revenue attribution and automated interaction-owner assignment logic.
+ Resolve lead deduplication and contact-eligibility logic across AppFlow, HubSpot, and Salesforce.
+ Diagnose and fix automated lead delivery/assignment failures.
+ Design robust handling for dropdown/enum properties to prevent pipeline sync failures.
+ Resolve Hightouch/Databricks sync failures caused by schema or column changes.
+ Ingest and map new data fields from Databricks into HubSpot
+ Manage ingress/egress and deprecation of third-party data attributes in HubSpot.
+ Scope and configure HubSpot object egress into Databricks for cross-functional reporting.

* Program-Specific Lifecycle & Marketing Automation

+ Scope risk and schema impact of funnel migrations affecting downstream data models.
+ Resolve missing/blocked CRM records that break workflow personalization.
+ Build data attributes to support self-service onboarding flows
+ Engineer persistent data frameworks to support multi-step nurture/pitch journeys in HubSpot.
+ Investigate and fix association bugs causing duplicate or incorrect notification delivery.
+ Configure property ingestion to support renewal and lifecycle email workflows.
+ Integrate product usage/deep-link data into HubSpot and resolve related association gaps.
+ Support market-expansion and segmentation work: enterprise segmentation, subscription product data matching, contact creation syncs, and workflow branching/property updates for new market launches.

* Security, Tooling & Incident Remediation

+ Audit permissions for third-party/AI connectors (e.g., AI assistants) integrated with HubSpot; identify high-risk write scopes and provide security recommendations.
+ Author root-cause analyses (RCAs) and recovery plans for production incidents affecting HubSpot-dependent lead/data flows; establish preventive protocols.
+ Evaluate and support integrations connecting HubSpot with messaging infrastructure for marketing use cases.

**Must Have Skills**

* Experience supporting B2B SaaS or subscription/membership-based products.
* Proven hands-on development experience with HubSpot (CRM, custom objects, workflows, properties, associations)
* Experience building and troubleshooting integrations between HubSpot and Salesforce.
* Working knowledge of data pipeline tools such Databricks (or comparable reverse-ETL/warehouse tools) is plus.
* Experience with AppFlow or similar data-ingestion/integration tooling.
* Strong SQL skills for schema design, data mapping, and troubleshooting.
* Experience diagnosing and resolving large-scale data sync errors across CRM systems.
* Familiarity with marketing automation concepts: lifecycle stages, lead scoring, workflow personalization, segmentation.
* Experience with incident response practices: writing RCAs, remediation plans, and preventive runbooks.
* Understanding of API/connector security — evaluating third-party and AI integration permission scopes.
* Ability to work independently from Jira-documented epics/tickets and translate written requirements into shipped, tested solutions.

title: UI/UX - 3D Designer #3
description:
**Binated is hiring for UI/UX Designer in Pune!**

We are looking for a creative UI/UX Designer who makes 3d components and animations to join our team. This role is ideal for someone passionate about designing user friendly digital experiences. You will work closely with product, development, and marketing teams to create intuitive and visually appealing interfaces.

**Online: Please submit your resume to hr@binated.com for faster response times**

**Job Type: Full-time, Permanent**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design modern user interfaces for web and mobile applications
* Create custom 3D components, objects, environments, and visual assets for use within websites, dashboards, applications, and digital experiences
* Create 3D models such as buildings, rooms, furniture, clothing, products, machines, characters/objects, and other interface-specific assets
* Develop 3D animations, transitions, interactions, and motion effects that enhance the user experience
* Integrate 3D elements thoughtfully into UI/UX designs without compromising usability or performance
* Create wireframes, mockups, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity interface designs
* Work with developers to prepare and optimize 3D assets for web and application implementation
* Create interactive concepts such as 360° product views, animated environments, configurable objects, and immersive interface components

* Explore and use AI-assisted 3D generation and design tools to accelerate asset creation and experimentation
* Stay current with emerging trends in 3D design, motion design, interactive experiences, and next-generation UI/UX

**Required Qualifications**

* Knowledge in Design, Animation, 3D Design, Computer Science, IT, Game Design, or a related field
* Strong understanding of visual design, composition, typography, color, lighting, materials, and spatial design
* Experience with 3D modeling, texturing, lighting, rendering, and animation
* Experience with at least one major 3D tool such as Blender, Cinema 4D, Maya, 3ds Max, or equivalent
* Familiarity with UI/UX design tools such as Figma
* Ability to create polished 3D assets from concepts, sketches, references, or design requirements
* Strong portfolio demonstrating 3D modeling, animation, motion, and/or interactive digital work
* Good communication and collaboration skills

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Blender and Figma
* Experience creating low-poly and optimized 3D assets for websites and real-time applications
* Understanding of Three.js, React Three Fiber, WebGL, Spline, or similar web-based 3D technologies
* Experience with motion tools such as After Effects, Rive, or equivalent
* Knowledge of rigging, keyframe animation, procedural animation, simulations, and motion principles
* Experience with materials, UV mapping, PBR textures, lighting, and rendering
* Understanding of formats such as GLB, GLTF, FBX, OBJ, USD/USDZ, and SVG
* Familiarity with AI tools for generating or accelerating 3D models, textures, environments, animations, and design concepts
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive design
* Experience working closely with front-end developers to turn 3D concepts into production-ready experiences

**Key Competencies**

* Strong 3D and spatial thinking
* Creativity and exceptional attention to visual detail
* Ability to translate ideas into polished 3D experiences
* Strong sense of motion, timing, composition, and storytelling
* Understanding of both aesthetics and usability
* Problem-solving mindset
* Ability to balance visual quality with technical performance
* Willingness to experiment with new technologies and AI-assisted workflows
* Ability to work quickly and iterate based on feedback

**Benefits:**

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

**Supplemental Pay Types:**

* Overtime pay
* Shift allowance
* Yearly bonus

*Binated does not charge any fee at any stage of the recruitment & selection process. Binated has not authorized any person/agency/partner to collect any fee for recruitment from candidates. If at all you notice the above, please bring it to our attention immediately.*

title: Jr. Product Engineer
description:
**About Venxr**
VenXR is an AI-driven AdTech startup building AdsGPT, redefining how brands plan, execute, and optimize ad campaigns through AI. We're a fast-growing, lean team looking for a Product Engineer who can own features end-to-end, from idea to shipped product.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a Product Engineer who thinks like a builder, not just a coder. Someone who cares as much about
*why*
we're building something as
*how*
it's built, and takes real ownership of the product outcomes, not just the code they ship.
  
  
**Tech Stack**
Frontend: React.js | Backend: Python (Django) | AI: Claude / LLM-driven development
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* End-to-End Feature Ownership
* Own features from concept to deployment — writing clean, scalable code while staying closely tied to the product goal and user impact behind it.
* Full-Stack Development
* Build and maintain front-end interfaces in React.js and back-end systems in Python/Django, ensuring performance, reliability, and scalability across the product.
* Product Thinking
* Work closely with Product, Design, and Founders to shape specs, question assumptions, and suggest simpler or smarter ways to solve user problems.
* Rapid Iteration
* Ship fast, test in production, gather feedback, and iterate, balancing speed with code quality.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Partner with Design and Data teams to bring dashboards, AI-driven features, and data visualizations to life.
* System Design & Architecture
* Contribute to technical architecture decisions, ensuring the codebase stays scalable as the product and team grow.
* Debugging & Problem Solving
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues quickly, treating downtime or bugs as urgent, customer-impacting problems.
* AI-Native Development
* Actively build with AI — using Claude and other LLM tools not just to assist coding, but to develop AI-powered features, prompt workflows, and intelligent product capabilities within AdsGPT itself.

**Requirements**

* 1-2 years of experience as a Product Engineer, ideally in a startup or B2B SaaS environment
* Candidates with B.Tech in CSE, AI/ML or any other equivalent educational background from Tier-1 and Tier-2 colleges will be preferred
* Strong proficiency in React.js for front-end development
* Strong proficiency in Python, with hands-on experience in Django for back-end development
* Solid understanding of REST APIs, databases (SQL/NoSQL), and system design fundamentals
* Hands-on experience building with AI tools (like Claude), not just using them for coding assistance, but developing core AI products.
* Experience working directly with Product/Design teams, not just executing tickets
* Comfortable working in ambiguous, fast-changing environments with minimal hand-holding
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

**Good to Have**

* Familiarity with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for securely connecting LLMs to external tools and APIs.
* Experience building conversational AI interfaces or managing complex multi-turn chatbot state across various platforms and channels.
* Experience in AdTech, MarTech, or data-heavy SaaS platforms.
* Exposure to cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience with LLM evaluation/monitoring tools (Ragas, LangSmith, Langfuse, or similar).
* Experience with data visualization libraries (Recharts, D3.js, Chart.js).
* Familiarity with compliance-aware or explainable AI design in regulated domains.

**What We Look For In Candidates**

* Customer Obsession – A genuine curiosity about how your code impacts the customer's experience, not just whether it compiles.
* Ownership – You drive features to completion, chasing down blockers instead of waiting on them.
* Stakeholder Understanding & Management – You know when to loop in Product, Design, or Business to unblock yourself fast.
* High Standards – You hold your own code to a higher bar, even when no one's checking.
* Disagree and Commit – You debate technical decisions hard, then commit fully once the call is made.
* Simplify Relentlessly – You reach for the simplest working solution, not the most "clever" one.
* Solidarity with the Team – You show up for your teammates, no invitation needed.
* Vitality – You bring real energy and resilience that keeps you (and others) going.
* Why Join Venxr?
* Be part of a fast-growing startup that puts data at the heart of every decision.
* Opportunity to work on high-impact, real-world business challenges.
* Collaborative, transparent, and learning-oriented work environment.
* Flexible work culture with a strong focus on career development.
* Comprehensive health benefits to support your well-being.
* Team offsites and engagement activities to build stronger connections beyond work.
* Performance-based incentives and rewards recognizing your contribution and impact.

Skills:- React.js, Python, Django, Anthropic Claude, Large Language Models (LLM), RESTful APIs, SQL, Product development and Systems architecture
