title: Scrum Master - Corporate Bank Technology - DAC, AVP
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title: Scrum Master - Corporate Bank Technology - DAC**

**Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President**

**Location: Pune, India**

**Role Description**

**Deutsche Bank Technology in Pune**

* DB Technology is a global team of tech specialists, spread across multiple trading hubs and tech centres. We have a strong focus on promoting technical excellence – our engineers work at the forefront of financial services innovation using cutting-edge technologies.
Our Pune location is a well established tech center in our global network of tech centres and growing strongly. We are committed to building a diverse workforce and to creating excellent opportunities for talented engineers and technologists. Our tech teams and business units use agile ways of working to create #GlobalHausbank solutions from our home market.  

**Digital Assets and Crypto-currencies**

* Join our innovative team in the fast-evolving world of digital assets and cryptocurrencies, where you'll develop and secure decentralized systems using blockchain technology. This domain encompasses creating and managing digital currencies, tokenized assets, and NFTs, enabling secure, transparent, and efficient peer-to-peer value exchange without intermediaries.
As a Scrum Master, you will work across our DAC Squads and actively live and promote agile thinking and culture as well as enable the team to work as efficiently as possible by removing obstacles and distractions.  

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* As Scrum Master you support DAC cross functional agile teams working on implementing end-to-end functionalities.
* You facilitate Scrum ceremonies and closely collaborate with all Squad team members to ensure that a healthy prioritized product backlog is maintained, and Tribe and Squad goals are understood by everyone in the Squad.
* You help the Squad to continuously improve the effectiveness of their incremental delivery of value to clients and stakeholders. Furthermore, you identify inefficiencies in the Squad operation and remove impediments to the Squad's progress.
* You live and promote an agile mindset and culture within the Tribe. You act as a coach and facilitator within the team for self-organization and cross-functionality – and deliver agile training within your Squads on demand.
You create physiologically safe environments for the squads, enabling them to their own outcomes, surface dependencies & risk and escalate in a timely manner.  

  

**Your skills and experience**

* You have several years of experience working in agile environments and applying agile methodologies and frameworks in practice (Scrum, Kanban), ideally in a scaled agile environment.
* You have at least one year of experience working as a Scrum Master for one or several Scrum teams.
* You are used to proactively structure and manage your workload and have very good organizational, communication and conflict management skills.
* You have strong motivational skills and practical experience in coaching others to continuously improve in their job.
You are a very good team player and are used to collaborate with stakeholders of diverse backgrounds and seniority levels. Furthermore, you can communicate fluently in English  

  

**Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.**

* **How we’ll support you**
* Training and development to help you excel in your career.
* Coaching and support from experts in your team.
* A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.  

**About us and our teams**

Please visit our company website for further information:

**https://www.db.com/company/company.html**

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Scrum Master - Technical Delivery Lead
description:
Date live: 11/17/2026

Business Area: Group Economic Crime COO

Area of Expertise: Change

Contract: Permanent

Reference Code: JR-0000126250

  

Join us as a Scrum Master - Technical Delivery Lead at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.

  
  

**To be successful as a Scrum Master - Technical Delivery Lead, you should have experience with:**

  
  

* Own and drive end-to-end delivery across SAM8 and TRACE, from planning and estimation through development, testing, implementation and production readiness.
* Partner with Product Owners, Financial Crime Business, Operations and Technology teams to translate business and regulatory priorities into clear, deliverable technology outcomes.
* Lead impact assessment, estimation and delivery planning for changes across the Transaction Monitoring ecosystem.
* Facilitate effective Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement and dependency planning.
* Drive predictable sprint delivery and measurable outcomes, rather than focusing solely on Scrum ceremonies and processes.
* Actively identify and resolve risks, issues, dependencies, assumptions and impediments, escalating early where cross-team or strategic intervention is required.
* Coordinate dependencies across development, testing, infrastructure, database, architecture, vendor and component teams.
* Support SAM8 technology modernization and lifecycle initiatives while ensuring ongoing platform stability and delivery commitments.
* Support the strategic evolution from SAM8 toward TRACE, helping teams balance current-state commitments with future-state transformation.
* Coach feature teams and Product Owners on Agile principles, effective backlog management, prioritization, estimation and continuous improvement.
* Use delivery data, JIRA metrics, sprint trends, velocity, blockers and dependency information to identify delivery risks and improve team performance.
* Ensure solutions and component changes align with end-to-end architecture, engineering standards and operational requirements.
* Drive appropriate documentation, governance, implementation readiness and reuse in accordance with Barclays standardsPractical experience with at least one state management approach,Redux (with Redux Toolkit), Zustand, or Recoil including when to use local vs. global state.
* Build strong relationships across Financial Crime Technology, AML Business, Operations, Product Owners, Solution Designers, Architects, Engineering, Infrastructure and component teams.
* Provide clear and concise visibility of delivery progress, milestones, risks, issues, dependencies and decisions to senior stakeholders.
* Challenge unrealistic priorities or delivery expectations constructively and provide evidence-based options and recommendations.
* Facilitate decisions where multiple teams or stakeholders have competing priorities.
* Create accountability across delivery teams while promoting collaboration and a problem-solving culture.
* Build confidence through credible commitments, transparency and consistent execution.
* Coach teams toward greater Agile maturity, ownership and continuous improvement.
* Where applicable, provide people leadership and support capability development within the team.
* Exercise sound judgement and operate independently within agreed delivery and governance frameworks.
* Analyze complex delivery situations, identify viable options and drive decisions to resolution.
* Anticipate delivery risks rather than waiting for them to become blockers.
* Resolve cross-team dependencies and impediments through appropriate collaboration and escalation.
* Balance BAU, regulatory change, strategic transformation and technology debt when supporting prioritization decisions.
* Adapt delivery approaches as business priorities, technology constraints and strategic direction evolve.
* Ensure all activities are performed in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements, the Barclays Operational Risk Framework, and relevant internal policies and standards.
* Embed appropriate risk, control, governance, and production-readiness considerations throughout the delivery lifecycle rather than treating them as final-stage activities.
* The successful candidate should be an experienced Agile Delivery Leader / Scrum Master / Technical Delivery Lead who can operate beyond traditional Scrum facilitation.
* They should be comfortable leading delivery within a complex Financial Crime technology environment involving multiple applications, infrastructure platforms, vendors and business stakeholders.
* Agile & Technical Delivery Leadership-Strong experience leading complex Agile technology delivery, including planning, execution, dependency management and implementation.
* Financial Crime / AML Domain Knowledge -Good understanding of Transaction Monitoring and AML processes, preferably including end-to-end data flows, alert generation, alert workflow and investigation processes.
* Stakeholder, RAID & Dependency Management- Demonstrated ability to manage senior stakeholders, competing priorities, risks, issues, dependencies and delivery impediments across multiple technology and business teams.

**Some other highly valued skills may include:**

  
  

* Strong experience working with Product Owners and Business/Technology stakeholders.
* Experience delivering within Financial Services or another highly regulated environment.
* Strong written, verbal and executive communication skills.
* Experience using JIRA for backlog management, sprint tracking, dependency management and delivery reporting.
* Ability to interpret delivery metrics and use them to drive continuous improvement.
* Strong problem-solving and decision-making capability.
* Experience managing technology transformation or modernization alongside live platform delivery.
* Experience working with distributed and cross-functional technology teams.
* End-to-end knowledge of AML and Transaction Monitoring data flows.
* Experience with Actimize/SAM8 or comparable Transaction Monitoring platforms.
* Knowledge of AML alert tuning and alert workflow management.
* Experience coordinating application, database, UNIX/Linux, infrastructure and vendor dependencies.
* Experience supporting modernization or strategic migration of legacy Financial Crime platforms.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

  
  

The role is based out of Pune.

**Purpose of the role**

To manage the efficient delivery of large-scale technical projects and capabilities across the bank and collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to understand their needs and expectations throughout the software product lifecycle, adhering to agreed time, budget and quality requirements.

**Accountabilities**

* Management of the delivery, resource allocation and improvement of complex technical project capabilities across the bank using Agile/Scrum methodologies for planning, stand-ups, demos, retrospectives and the execution of sprints.
* Collaboration with customers and business teams to manage and implement customer trails to support the proposal of technically feasible solutions, and effort and timeline expectations.
* Collaboration with software engineers, quality teams, product managers and other engineering teams to deliver high-quality products and features through the software project lifecycle aligned to the banks objectives, regulation and security policies.
* Identification, assessment, and mitigation of risks associated with technical projects to prepare the bank for potential challenges.
* Management of change requests and communication with stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Management of vendor relations involved in technical projects to ensure they deliver according to agreed terms.
* Stay abreast of the latest industry technology trends and technologies, to evaluate and adopt new approaches to improving deliver outcomes and to foster a culture of continuous learning, technical excellence and growth.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Agile and BDD Software Engineer - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are looking for a passionate and experienced **Senior Software Engineer** who thrives at the intersection of technical excellence and modern ways of working. This role is ideal for someone who not only writes great code but also acts as a **catalyst for change** — championing Agile methodologies, Behavior-Driven Development (BDD), feature management strategies, and a culture of continuous improvement across engineering teams.

  
  

You will work closely with cross-functional squads, product owners, and engineering leaders to embed modern development practices into the DNA of how we build and deliver software.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Agile Leadership & Ways of Working**
--------------------------------------

* Champion and role-model Agile values, principles, and frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) across engineering teams.
* Drive adoption of **modern ways of working** including iterative delivery, fast feedback loops, and continuous improvement.
* Facilitate agile ceremonies (sprint planning, retrospectives, demos) with a focus on team effectiveness and psychological safety.
* Coach and mentor engineers and product team members on Agile mindsets and practices.
* Partner with Scrum Masters and Agile Coaches to continuously evolve team maturity.
  

  

**Behavior-Driven Development (BDD)**
-------------------------------------

* Lead the adoption and practice of **BDD** across squads, ensuring shared understanding between business, QA, and engineering.
* Define and implement frameworks for writing **Gherkin-based specifications** (e.g., Cucumber) that serve as living documentation.
* Facilitate **Three Amigos** sessions to align on acceptance criteria before development begins.
* Promote test-first and specification-by-example thinking across the engineering community.

**Feature Flags & Controlled Delivery**
---------------------------------------

* Drive the strategy and implementation of **feature flag management** to enable safe, incremental releases.
* Champion **trunk-based development** and **continuous deployment** patterns supported by feature toggles.
* Educate teams on progressive rollouts, canary releases, and A/B testing enabled by feature flags.
* Ensure governance and hygiene practices around feature flag lifecycle management.

**Modern Development Practices**
--------------------------------

* Advocate and implement best practices including **Test-driven Development (TDD)** and **Continuous Testing/CD pipelines** and automated quality gates **Shift-left testing** and early defect detection **DevSecOps** principles and secure coding standards **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** and cloud-native patterns
* Identify and address technical debt while balancing delivery commitments.
* Contribute to and promote inner-source practices and engineering communities of practice (CoPs).

**Collaboration & Communication**
---------------------------------

* Work as an embedded engineering lead within squads, influencing culture and technical decisions.
* Collaborate with Product Managers to refine backlogs and ensure stories are well-defined, testable, and deliverable.
* Produce and maintain clear technical documentation, architectural decision records (ADRs), and runbooks.
* Share knowledge through internal talks, workshops, and written guides.

title: Division Manager - Ocean
description:
Are you ready to lead the charge in shaping a sustainable energy future? At Alfa Laval, we don’t just overcome challenges—we pioneer solutions that create a positive impact for our customers, our people, and the planet. Our curiosity sparks innovation, and our commitment drives us to deliver transformative results every single day.
  
  
Join a truly diverse and inclusive team where your leadership will make a real difference. At Alfa Laval, you’ll be empowered to build bridges to the future, delivering sustainable solutions that address the world’s most urgent energy challenges. Together, we’re making the world a better place.
  
  
**About Alfa Laval**
Alfa Laval is a leading global provider of products and solutions in heat transfer, separation, and fluid handling, serving customers across the energy, food, water, and Ocean industries. Headquartered in Lund, Sweden, the company operates in more than 100 countries, enabling customers to improve energy efficiency, productivity, and sustainability in industrial processes.
  
  
With a heritage of over 140 years, Alfa Laval plays a critical role in supporting the global energy transition, focusing on solutions for energy efficiency, waste heat recovery, decarbonization, and sustainable industrial growth. Sustainability and responsible use of resources are central to the company’s purpose of pioneering positive impact.
  
  
**Alfa Laval India**
Alfa Laval has been present in India since 1937 and plays a strategically important role within the group. The India headquarters is located in Pune, with eight manufacturing facilities based at Pune and Satara, and multiple sales and service locations across the country. The Manufacturing facilities supplies key components and systems in Separation, Heat Transfer, and Flow technology. It is also a hub for Centrifugal Separators, Decanters, and Flow equipment delivered to the global markets from here.
  
  
The company's products and solutions are omnipresent in over 25 multiple Indian industries including food processing, dairy, edible oil processing, sugar production, pharmaceutical & biotechnology, brewery, distillery, starch, pulp and paper, oil & gas, Ocean and energy. Alfa Laval caters to many national and international clients based across India and neighboring countries like Sri Lanka, Nepal, and Bangladesh.
  
  
We are now looking for a for an
**Inspirational leader to spearhead our Ocean division in India**
, partnering closely with the business leaders and managers. Ocean Division is a strategic pillar of Alfa Laval India, to achieve our growth ambition for the coming years.
  
  
Head of Ocean is responsible for driving the overall Ocean business strategy and execution across India and Bangladesh, delivering sustainable growth in Capital Sales and After Sales while strengthening Alfa Laval's market leadership position. The role owns the Ocean business P&L, manages strategic customer relationships, develops high-performing teams, and drives business growth across Naval, Coast Guard, Commercial Ocean, Shipbuilding, Energy & Power, Environmental Solutions, and Service businesses
  
  
**Role Description**
You will be a member of AL India Management team, directly reporting to Managing Director, as well as the key representative for India region. Moreover, you will be responsible for leading, developing and securing a high performing team in line with the Alfa Laval culture.
  
  
This is your opportunity to be a
**transition leader**
, accelerating the transition, driving innovation, and positioning Alfa Laval as a
**thought leader**
in the industry. You will play a pivotal role in transforming our business, preparing us for a digital future, and differentiating Alfa Laval as the partner of choice for sustainable energy solutions.
  
  
To help Alfa Laval uphold its promises and foster a thriving service culture, we are seeking a dynamic leader for the role of
**Head of Ocean Division**
to join our skilled, dedicated, and passionate team.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have proven experience in Sales and Aftersales management and lead teams within a fast-paced environment. Success in this role hinges on delivering profitable growth and developing a high-performing team. Moreover, you will be responsible for leading, developing and securing a high performing Divisional team in line with the Alfa Laval culture.
  
  
We offer a unique opportunity for you to play a crucial role in transforming our Ocean business, preparing us for a digital future, and positioning us as a key differentiator for Alfa Laval.
  
  
**Key elements of the Role involve**

* Develop and execute the Ocean Division strategy, business plans, and growth initiatives aligned with Alfa Laval’s regional and global objectives, ensuring sustainable and profitable business expansion across India.
* Drive order intake, revenue, profitability, and market share growth by identifying and capturing opportunities across Ocean, Naval & Defense, Energy & Power, Environmental Solutions, After Sales, and Service businesses.
* Lead business development and strategic customer engagement with key stakeholders including naval and defense organizations, commercial ship owners and operators, ship management companies, shipyards, EPCs, OEMs, contractors, and global Ocean accounts.
* Establish and strengthen executive-level relationships with strategic customers such as the Indian Navy, Indian Coast Guard, Shipping Corporation of India, Great Eastern Shipping, leading ship management companies, and major regional shipyards to drive long-term business growth and customer loyalty.
* Develop and implement market penetration strategies by conducting comprehensive market, customer, competitor, and industry analysis, translating insights into actionable business plans and growth programs.
* Expand Alfa Laval’s sales footprint by promoting Capital Equipment, Service Agreements, Spare Parts, Retrofits, Upgrades, Lifecycle Services, Compliance Packages, Digital Solutions, Environmental Solutions, and integrated system offerings.
* Lead growth initiatives in shipbuilding, naval modernization programs, commercial shipping, technical management companies, energy and power applications, ballast water treatment solutions, OceanGlide opportunities, and emerging sustainability-driven Ocean technologies.
* Drive the After Sales and Service business by developing strategic service partnerships, increasing recurring revenue through service agreements, compliance services, performance audits, equipment upgrades, spare parts optimization, and lifecycle support solutions.
* Lead the Bangladesh Ocean and Energy & Power business strategy, expanding customer coverage, strengthening market presence, supporting distributor performance, and building a sustainable regional growth platform.
* Own the Ocean Division P&L and ensure achievement of agreed sales, revenue, margin, profitability, and operational targets through effective forecasting, budgeting, resource allocation, and performance management.
* Collaborate closely with local and global business units, leveraging cross-functional synergies and best practices to optimize commercial performance, customer value, and operational efficiency.
* Lead, coach, and develop the Ocean Sales and Service organization, building a high-performance culture focused on customer centricity, accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, talent development, and succession planning.
* Serve as a key member of the Sales Company Leadership Team, contributing to overall business strategy, organizational development, and execution of Alfa Laval’s growth ambitions in the region.

**Strategic Skills & Leadership Profile**

* Bachelor's Degree in Marine, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial or related Engineering discipline. MBA or equivalent business qualification preferred.
* 15+ years of relevant experience in Ocean, Shipping, Shipbuilding, Energy, Industrial Equipment or Engineering industries.
* Minimum 5 years in a senior leadership role with P&L responsibility.
* Strong experience in Capital Sales, Services, Business Development and Key Account Management.
* Proven track record of leading high-performing commercial organizations.
* Strong exposure to Marine markets, Defense, Naval, Shipyard or Energy sectors preferred

**Reporting Relationship**
This role reports to the Managing Director, Alfa Laval India
  
  
**Location:**
Pune

To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.”*

description:
**Company Overview**
At Bridgenext, we engineer Growth Operating Systems. Most enterprises have spent millions on their revenue stack and still aren't seeing the growth they expected.They have tools that function, but no system that wins. We help growth-hungry companies close that gap by turning fragmented platforms, siloed teams, and disconnected data into one integrated Growth OS. More than a technology company or marketing agency, we're a global digital consultancy with experts in engineering, data, AI, creative and more.
  
  
Our teams are made up of experts who believe in engineering impact, starting with putting people at the center of everything we do. Every team member directly shapes our work, culture, and values. Nothing matters more to us than a kind, respectful, fulfilling environment that supports everyone. Our flexible, inclusive culture gives you the autonomy, resources, and opportunities to thrive.
  
  
**Position Description**
We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Application Support Manager to oversee the support operations for a Logistic Domain SaaS (Software as a Service) solution for our US-based client. As the Application Support Manager, you will be responsible for leading and managing a team of 15+ support professionals, ensuring smooth operations, exceptional client satisfaction, and efficient incident resolution.
  
  
**Work Mode And Shift Timing**

* 5 days a week work from Pune office
* 6.30pm IST shift

**Responsibilities**

* Team Leadership: Lead and mentor a team of 15+ application support specialists, providing guidance, training, and performance management to ensure high-quality support services.
* Client Communication: Act as the primary point of contact for the US-based client, maintaining regular communication to understand their needs, address concerns, and manage expectations effectively.
* Incident Management: Oversee the resolution of application-related incidents, including troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and timely escalation when necessary, ensuring minimal downtime and disruptions to client operations.
* Shift Management: Coordinate and manage support team schedules and shifts, ensuring adequate coverage to meet client requirements, including after-hours support as needed.
* Reporting and Documentation: Prepare and analyze support metrics and reports, identify trends, and provide recommendations for process improvements, ensuring accurate and timely reporting to both internal and client stakeholders.
* Escalation Management: Handle escalations from the support team, engage with appropriate internal departments or third-party vendors, and drive the resolution of critical incidents in a timely and efficient manner.
* Process Improvement: Continuously evaluate support processes and procedures, identify areas for improvement, and implement best practices to enhance the overall efficiency and effectiveness of the support operations.
* Relationship Management: Foster positive relationships with key stakeholders, including the client, internal teams, and external vendors, ensuring alignment of goals and effective collaboration.
* SLA Management: Ensure adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) by monitoring response and resolution times, tracking performance metrics, and implementing corrective measures when necessary. Collaborate with the client and internal teams to define SLA targets and continuously improve service delivery.
* Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Develop and maintain comprehensive Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for application support processes, incident management, and service request handling. Regularly review and update SOPs to align with industry best practices and changing client requirements.
* Knowledge Base (KB) Article Creation: Create and maintain a knowledge base repository by documenting common issues, resolutions, workarounds, and best practices. Develop KB articles and user guides to facilitate self-service support for end-users and internal team members.
* Deployment and Release Support: Collaborate with development and deployment teams to ensure smooth application deployments and releases. Participate in deployment planning, coordination, and post-deployment support activities to minimize disruptions and address any issues that arise.
* Post-Deployment Support: Provide ongoing support and assistance following application deployments or updates. Work closely with the client, development team, and other stakeholders to monitor application performance, address post-deployment issues, and gather feedback for future improvements.
* Change Management: Implement effective change management processes to minimize risks during application deployments and configuration changes. Coordinate with stakeholders to assess the impact of changes, communicate planned changes to the client, and ensure proper testing and documentation are carried out.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvement within the application support function. Proactively suggest and implement enhancements to streamline support processes, increase efficiency, and improve customer satisfaction.
* Training and Knowledge Sharing: Conduct training sessions for the support team to enhance their technical skills, customer service capabilities, and knowledge of the logistic domain. Encourage knowledge sharing and cross-training within the team to build a robust support knowledge base.

**Must Have Skills**

* Strong logistics domain experience supporting SaaS applications.
* Exposure to modern microservices-based applications. The candidate does not need to be deeply technical but should have a good understanding of microservices concepts, and related technologies.
* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
* Proven experience in managing application support teams, preferably in a SaaS environment.
* \*Must have\* Strong understanding of logistic domain applications and their operational requirements.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to effectively interact with clients, team members, and senior management.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and handle multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Experience in incident management, problem-solving, and root cause analysis.
* Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop a high-performing team.
* Proficiency in using support management tools and reporting systems.
* Flexibility to work in shifts and provide after-hours support when required.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with ITIL framework and its application in support operations is a plus.

**Professional Skills**

* Solid written, verbal, and presentation communication skills
* Strong team and individual player
* Maintains composure during all types of situations and is collaborative by nature
* High standards of professionalism, consistently producing high quality results
* Self-sufficient, independent requiring very little supervision or intervention
* Demonstrate flexibility and openness to bring creative solutions to address issues

Bridgenext is an Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Customer Support Team Lead
description:
**ROLE SUMMARY**

We are looking for a
**Customer Support Lead**
to manage our team. You will run the team day to day, allocate and track tickets, resolve advisors' queries, train new and existing team members, and keep output, accuracy and turnaround on target. Lead the team of Customer Support advisors on a day-to-day basis.

•       
Allocate and rebalance tickets by ageing, complexity and skill.

•       
Monitor productivity and individual ticket output, and address gaps early.

•       
Coach team members, give regular feedback and track performance against KPIs.

•       
Plan daily cover and manage team attendance and leave in line with company policy.

•       
Take part in recruitment and onboarding of new advisors.

Escalate to the Operations Manager or the client only when a query cannot be resolved within the team.

Train new joiners and refresh existing advisors on process and system changes.

Maintain a training matrix showing who is trained on which process areas.

Manage ticket states and escalation paths in Zendesk and Jira as agreed.

Spot trends, backlog risks and capacity issues, and raise them early.

Reduce the team's dependence on the client for queries, training and allocation.

Good working knowledge of MS Excel, including trackers and basic reports.

Experience training or coaching team members.

Understanding of SLAs, quality checks and process compliance.

Clear communication with the team and the client.

Calm handling of escalations and high-priority issues.

Ownership mindset with a focus on accuracy and delivery.

Good organisation and multitasking.

Experience in a BPO, shared-services or per-ticket outsourced delivery model.

Team attendance, training coverage, engagement and retention.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
In this role, you will work with leading enterprises to realize the power of cloud computing with Google Cloud Platform. You will manage customer escalations by combining business acumen with technical assessment skills. You will develop team members into skilled troubleshooting experts who can diagnose a wide variety of cloud computing issues within minutes. You will build relationships with leaders in site reliability engineering, software engineering, and product management that allow you to quickly solve issues and make you a trusted source of customer feedback. You will lead operational excellence within your team with a focus on reliable execution. You may lead a functional area across the Global team. You will be required to work in a shift pattern or non-standard work hours as required. This may include working in shifts/night/after hours and weekend work and public holidays.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a team of engineers who deliver technical support across all Google Cloud Platform products. Work as part of a team of Engineers/Consultants that globally ensure 24 hour customer support.
* Partner with software engineering and site reliability engineering to manage production incidents in real time, with emphasis on timely and thorough issue identification and customer communication.
* Suggest code-level resolutions for complex product bugs by leveraging relevant tools and effective communication to all stakeholders internally and externally.
* Resolve technical incidents and escalations by performing analysis utilizing relevant tools (e.g., SQL, R, Python) and leveraging existing data models to reach specific conclusions and next steps.
* Partner with product management and engineering to translate customer needs into a better overall product. Recognize trends in customer feedback and escalate issues within Google.

title: IT Manager
description:
**About Verto**
At Verto, we're on a mission to democratise global finance and empower businesses in Emerging Markets to reach the world. Founded by British-Nigerian entrepreneurs Ola Oyetayo and Anthony Oduu, our roots in Africa provided a firsthand understanding of the significant challenges businesses face with cross-border payments, ranging from illiquid currencies and high fees to slow transactions. This deep-rooted insight is why Africa remains a core focus, as we're committed to bridging the gap between emerging and developed markets and fostering global economic growth.
  
  
What started as an FX solution for the Nigerian Naira has evolved into a market-leading platform, enabling thousands of businesses to seamlessly transfer billions of dollars annually.
**We believe that where you do business shouldn’t determine your success or ability to scale.**
We're creating equal access to the easy payment and liquidity solutions that are already a given in developed markets.
  
  
We're not alone in realising this crucial need; we're backed by world-class investors including Y-Combinator, Quona, and MEVP. With Verto receiving the Milken-Motsepe Prize, appearing on CNBCs list of fastest growing UK companies, the Deloitte Fast 50 and Sifted’s fastest-growing UK tech companies, we are building a seamless cross-border payment future.
  
  
Join us as we continue to grow and transform global finance.
  
  
****Role Overview****
We are looking for a hands-on, strategic
**IT Manager**
(based in London or Pune) to own, scale, and secure Verto’s global IT operations across our 200+ employees in 8–9 countries. As a regulated SaaS fintech company, operational speed, seamless employee experience, and strict security are critical to our growth. In this role, you will lead our IT support function, architect automated onboarding and off-boarding workflows, and manage our global hardware fleet and vendor logistics - ensuring that whether a teammate is in our hubs
*(London, Pune, Nairobi, Lagos, Cape Town, Dubai, Sliema)*
or working remotely
*(US, Hong Kong, or wider Africa)*
, they have the tools and secure access they need to thrive from Day 1 while keeping our global IT spend lean and audit-ready.
  
  
****What You’ll Be Doing:****

* Lead, mentor, and manage our IT 1st & 2nd Line Support Technician, acting as the senior escalation point for complex Tier 3 technical issues and infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Own global IT support operations via Jira Service Management, setting SLAs, monitoring ticket trends, and continuously improving response times and employee satisfaction.
* Own the end-to-end global hardware lifecycle (procurement, zero-touch deployment, tracking, maintenance, and retrieval) for 200+ employees across multiple countries and time zones.
* Build and manage relationships with international hardware vendors, logistics partners, and couriers to reliably ship and retrieve devices in both regional office hubs and remote-only locations (including the US, Hong Kong, and across Africa).
* Maintain a 100% accurate, real-time global asset register and SaaS license inventory, optimising refresh cycles, vendor contracts, and software utilisation to keep costs efficient.
* Architect and automate global onboarding and off-boarding workflows so user provisioning, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and hardware delivery happen seamlessly and securely.
* Administer Verto’s core Identity and Access Management (IAM), Mobile Device Management (MDM), and collaboration stack—including JumpCloud, Google Workspace, Slack, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Partner closely with the InfoSec Manager to enforce strict fintech security standards across all macOS and Windows endpoints, including EDR monitoring, disk encryption, patch management, and phishing/incident response.
* Lead regular access reviews, device audits, and asset reconciliations to maintain compliance with financial and data security regulations.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and leverage modern automation and IT tooling to eliminate manual bottlenecks as Verto scales.

****What You Need:****

* 5+ years of experience in IT operations, systems administration, or enterprise IT support, including at least 1–2 years managing direct reports and supporting globally distributed teams.
* Deep hands-on expertise with MDM and IAM platforms (JumpCloud, Jamf, Kandji, Okta, or Intune), including device provisioning and security policy enforcement across both macOS and Windows.
* Proven experience managing global IT asset inventories and cross-border hardware logistics (customs, international shipping, regional vendor procurement, and remote device retrieval).
* Strong administrative command of Google Workspace, Slack, Microsoft Office Suite, and Jira Service Management (or equivalent ticketing platforms).
* Solid grasp of enterprise and fintech cybersecurity fundamentals, including EDR tools, MFA/SSO, RBAC, phishing remediation, and conducting regular security/access audits.
* Strong vendor negotiation and budget management skills, with a demonstrated track record of optimising hardware and SaaS spend without compromising employee productivity.
* Exceptional organisational and communication skills, capable of translating technical issues for non-technical stakeholders across diverse cultural contexts and time zones.

**Note**
: We will not be able to progress your application without all the above skills/qualifications
  
  
****Best If You Have:****

* Direct, hands-on administrative experience with JumpCloud (MDM & Directory).
* Previous experience working within a high-growth SaaS fintech, payments, or regulated financial services environment (familiarity with SOC 2, ISO 27001, or FCA compliance standards).
* Experience automating HRIS-to-IT onboarding/off-boarding workflows (e.g., integrating tools like HiBob, or Zapier with JumpCloud and Slack).
* Familiarity with IT asset management (IAM/ITAM) platforms or global EOR/device logistics providers (e.g., Deel IT, Hofy, Firstbase, or equivalent).
* Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL, CompTIA Security+, or JumpCloud Certification.

****Life At Verto****
****Perks****

* Insurance paid by the company
* Health and wellness benefits (with specific added benefits depending on the location of the role)
* Yearly salary review based on inflation, personal and business performance
* Access to entire Udemy’s library
* Budget for professional development courses
* Work-From-Anywhere policy for certain durations
* Integration programme (opportunity to work from our global offices)
* Regular team social events
* Pension scheme (depending on the role location)
* Flexible work arrangements
* Exposure to work with globally distributed teams
* Location specific benefits like car lease policy, cycle to work, gym membership, etc.

****You’ll Fit Right In If You****

* Love asking “why?”
* Value solving problems over just completing tasks
* Understand sync vs. async communication practices
* Thrive in ambiguity and change
* Actively seek feedback
* Prioritise impact over activity
* Are fun to work with - we love good humour!

****Culture****

* Our Core Values: These values reflect our focus, energy, and shared expectations.

+ Champion the Mission: We are driven by curiosity and belief to solve global cross-border payment challenges.
+ Be the Best: We are open, take calculated risks, focus on results, and excel in our work.
+ Work as One: We transparently share failures and successes.
+ Go the Extra Mile: We deliver beyond expectations and achieve the impossible.
+ Customer First: We creatively solve problems and boldly design better experiences for customers.
+ Run with It: We are determined, embrace challenges, own tasks, act swiftly, and deliver results.

* Industry Competitive Compensation & Benefits: We reward employees for their value to the business with competitive compensation and benefits across all locations. This includes performance-based salary reviews, comprehensive health and wellness benefits, generous paid time off, and flexible working arrangements to support your career and life.

****Diversity and Inclusion at Verto****
Verto is an equal opportunities employer and we value diversity. Anyone seeking employment at Verto is considered based on Merit, Competence, Qualifications and their Talent. We are proud to be a truly international team and we do not discriminate in our hiring process.

title: Production Manager-Sanitary Napkin, Pune (CTC-15 to 18 Lakhs per annum)
description:
**Company Description:**

Xolopak India Ltd is a pioneering company in manufacturing sustainable consumable products for HORECA, Bakery and Home/Personal care industry in India. We operate in B2B and institutional business within this segment and have a pan India presence. Our products include single use wooden cutlery, ice-cream sticks and spoons, cake bases, Silver Pouches, luxury napkins etc. Our prestigious customers include some of the largest brands in the food and ice-cream industry.

 

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a seasoned production Manager to lead end-to-end plant operations for our sanitary napkin and personal hygiene product lines. The role carries full ownership of production, quality, cost, safety, compliance and people and is accountable for delivering output at the required quality, yield and cost, with a strong focus on high-speed sanitary pad conversion lines.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Production & Operations Management**

* Lead daily plant operations across sanitary pad lines (including ultra-thin, XL and overnight variants) and allied hygiene products such as baby diapers, adult incontinence products, panty liners and wipes, where applicable.
* Ensure achievement of production plans, OEE, line efficiency, throughput and on-time delivery targets.
* Drive reduction of material wastage, rejections, downtime and changeover time across converting, packaging and secondary packing lines.
* Work with Planning, Sales and Supply Chain on production scheduling, capacity planning and demand fulfilment.

2.
**Quality and Regulatory Compliance**

* Maintain product quality in line with BIS standards (IS 5405 for sanitary napkins), and applicable FDA/medical-device-type and customer specifications.
* Ensure GMP, hygiene-zone discipline, clean-room and contamination-control practices suitable for products in contact with the body.
* Lead implementation and maintenance of ISO 9001, ISO 13485 (where applicable), ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 certifications, and prepare the plant for customer, regulatory and third-party audits.
* Oversee root cause analysis, CAPA, complaint investigation and change control.

**3.Techical and Process Leadership**

* Provide deep technical oversight on raw materials (fluff pulp, SAP, nonwovens, release paper, films, adhesives, hot melts) and their impact on product performance.
* Lead process optimisation, new product trials and scale-up in coordination with R&D and Quality.
* Evaluate, select and commission new machinery; oversee installation, validation and stabilisation of new lines.
* Drive automation, digitisation (MES, SCADA, vision inspection) and modernisation of lines.

**4.Maintenance & Engineering**

* Ensure high equipment uptime through preventive and predictive maintenance, spare-parts planning and TPM practices.
* Oversee utilities including compressed air, HVAC, dust extraction, steam and power, with a focus on energy efficiency.
* Manage capex projects for capacity expansion, debottlenecking and replacement.

**5.Cost, Budgeting & Financial Management**

* Own the manufacturing budget, conversion cost, material yield and cost-per-unit targets.
* Drive continuous improvement through Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen and 5S to improve productivity and reduce cost.
* Track and report plant KPIs and MIS to senior management on a regular basis.

**6.Enviornment, Health & Safety**

* Create and sustain a zero-harm safety culture; ensure statutory compliance under the Factories Act and related labour, pollution-control and fire-safety laws.
* Oversee waste management, effluent and emissions compliance, and sustainability initiatives (including waste reduction and recyclability).

**7.**
**People Leadership**

* Build, mentor and retain a high-performing team of engineers, supervisors and operators.
* Drive skill development, succession planning, multi-skilling and a strong performance culture.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:**

  B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Chemical, Production, Industrial, Polymer or Paper & Pulp Engineering. MBA or PG diploma in Operations Management is an advantage.
* **Certifications (preferred):**

  Lean / Six Sigma Black Belt, internal auditor for ISO standards, TPM.

**Preferred Experience**

* 18–25 years of manufacturing experience, with at least 8–10 years in a senior plant or operations leadership role.

**Must have**

extensive, hands-on experience in sanitary pad manufacturing; experience in baby diapers, adult diapers or other medical / personal hygiene products is strongly preferred.

* Proven track record of running high-speed converting lines, commissioning new lines and managing multi-line plants.
* Experience managing large teams (200+) in a regulated, high-volume FMCG or healthcare manufacturing environment.

**Key skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of absorbent hygiene product (AHP) processes: fluff pulp defibration, SAP dosing, core forming, lamination, embossing, ultrasonic and thermal bonding, adhesive application, cutting, folding, wrapping and packing.
* Familiarity with leading machine suppliers and technologies in the hygiene industry.
* Strong command of OEE, TPM, Lean, Six Sigma and data-driven problem solving.
* Sound understanding of GMP, quality systems, regulatory norms and audit readiness.
* Capex planning, vendor negotiation and project management ability.
* Excellent leadership, decision-making, communication and stakeholder management skills.

Key Performance Indicators

* Production volume vs plan, OEE and line efficiency
* Material yield and wastage percentage
* Cost per unit and conversion cost vs budget
* Quality metrics: customer complaints, rejection rate, audit findings
* On-time delivery and order fulfilment
* Safety performance (LTIFR, incidents) and compliance record
* Attrition, training hours and talent development

Xolopak India Limited is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Working with an energetic curious team of multi-disciplinary professionals

* Strategic Leadership: Develop and refine the third-party risk management strategy aligned with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.

* Vendor Lifecycle Management: Oversee the entire vendor lifecycle, from onboarding and due diligence to ongoing monitoring and offboarding.

* Issue & Incident Management: Oversee the investigation and resolution of third-party risk incidents, including breach or compliance issues.
* Audit & Review: Coordinate internal and external audits related to third-party risk, ensuring timely remediation of identified issues.
* Training & Awareness: Promote a risk-aware culture through training programs, workshops, and communication initiatives.
* External Relationships: Manage relationships with external vendors, risk assessment providers, and industry forums.

**What you need to have:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 8-10 years of experience. Masters preferred
* > 5 years of experience in third-party/vendor risk management, compliance, or related fields
* Deep understanding of regulatory frameworks, industry standards, and best practices related to third-party risk.
* Proven experience managing complex vendor portfolios, including high-risk or strategic vendors.
* Strong knowledge of cybersecurity, data privacy, operational resilience, and contractual risk mitigation.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and implement risk management frameworks and policies.
* Excellent leadership, strategic thinking, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Professional certifications such as Certified Third Party Risk Professional (CTPRP), Certified Risk Management Professional (CRMP), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or equivalent are highly desirable.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Experience in highly regulated industries such as financial services, Insurance, or technology.
* Familiarity with third-party risk management tools and platforms.
* Understanding of Procurement functions such as Sourcing, Contracting, Vendor Operations and Buyer functions.
* Ability to influence organizational culture and promote risk awareness.
* Strong communication skills, capable of presenting complex risk issues to executive leadership.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

FBS - Farmer Business Services is part of Farmers Insurance operations with the purpose of building a global approach to identifying, recruiting, hiring, and retaining top talent. By combining international reach with US expertise, we build diverse and high-performing teams that are equipped to thrive in today's competitive marketplace.
  
  
We believe that the foundation of every successful business lies in having the right people with the right skills. That is where we come in—helping Farmers build a winning team that delivers consistent and sustainable results.
  
  
Since we don't have a local legal entity, we've partnered with Capgemini, which acts as the Employer of Record. Capgemini is responsible for managing local payroll and benefits.
  
  
**What to expect on your journey with us:**

* A solid and innovative company with a strong market presence
* A dynamic, diverse, and multicultural work environment
* Leaders with deep market knowledge and strategic vision
* Continuous learning and development

This position provides strategic and operational leadership for a large nearshore and offshore claims support organization, accountable for standing up, scaling, and stabilizing a multi-location claims operational support model. The role defines the end-to-end delivery model, oversees the transition of work, and builds sustainable offshore capabilities that support long term operational effectiveness and growth. This leader operates at scale, balancing operational performance, workforce complexity, and enterprise priorities while partnering closely with key stakeholders to enable effective claims delivery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Sets and executes overall strategy by aligning priorities, service models, and outcomes to business needs and enterprise objectives
* Leads a large nearshore and offshore organization by providing direction across varied teams while ensuring consistent execution, engagement, and people management practices
* Oversees and integrates multiple, distinct claims support teams, with accountability for transitioning work across locations and owning stabilization
* This role balances standardization with the unique needs of diverse, claims adjacent services while establishing scalable, centralized delivery models
* Establishes performance measures and operating standards, monitors results, identifies risks and opportunities, and leads initiatives to improve efficiency, quality, and service effectiveness at scale
* Leads operational change efforts affecting processes, systems, and people, while ensuring appropriate controls, compliance, and risk management are embedded in daily operations
* Partners with cross functional stakeholders to align priorities and resolve tradeoffs, while managing budgets and exercising cost stewardship across assigned operations
* SCOPE: India and Mexico Market, focus on E2E Service Operations Excellence from Recruiting, training, development, operational execution and attrition reduction

**Requirements**

* +7 years of experience required in a similar role in Claims Operations for an American Insurance Company (MUST)

+ US P&C Experience is a MUST, + experience in estimating (general knowledge) MUST

* Full English Fluency
* Focus on Claims Experience: Quality and productivity, Metrics, analytics, team performance
* Team Size Experience: Over 150 people team
* Expected working hours: 6:30pm-3:30am India standard Time (Overlapping with US/Mexico Operations
* Hybrid Model in Pune

**Technical & Business Skills**

* Power BI - Intermediate
* Excel - Intermediate
* Quickbase - Intermediate
* Leadership - Advanced
* Strategy - Advanced
* Operational Excellence - Advanced, Metrics, Drivers, Reporting
* Data Analysis, resource Allocation
* Decision Making Skills (Autonomy)

**Benefits**
This position comes with competitive compensation and benefits package:
  
  

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career development and training opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
* Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
* Private Health Insurance
* Pension Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Training & Development

**Important Hiring Conditions and Disclosures**
By applying for this position, candidates acknowledge and agree that:
  
  

* Personal Data Processing: The personal data provided during the recruitment and selection process will be collected, processed, and retained for legitimate recruitment and compliance purposes, in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy laws and FBS internal policies
* Legal Authorization to Work: Employment with FBS is conditional upon the candidate having valid, local legal authorization to work in the country where the role is based at the time of hire. FBS does not sponsor or obtain work authorization unless explicitly stated
* Exclusivity of Employment and Conflict of Interest: Upon acceptance of an offer and during employment with FBS, employees will not be permitted to engage in parallel employment, professional activities, or paid work for other entities. Any ownership, partnership, directorship, or participation in other businesses or companies must be fully disclosed and formally reviewed in accordance with FBS internal conflict‑of‑interest and external engagement policies prior to the start date or as soon as such circumstances arise

Failure to comply with these conditions may impact the hiring decision or employment continuation.

title: Director, Delivery
description:
ICE is the leading cloud-based platform provider for the mortgage finance industry. ICE solutions enable lenders to originate more loans, reduce origination costs, and reduce the time to close, all while ensuring the highest levels of compliance, quality, and efficiency.
  
  
The Director, Delivery, DDS Operations leads our Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) operations and drives their transformation for the new era of AI. Based in India, this role directs multiple operational teams and projects at once, with a focus on operational transformation, efficiency improvement, and client delivery. The Director partners closely with the cross-functional leaders across the business to modernize HITL workflows, embed AI and automation into daily operations, and raise quality and throughput. This role sets strategic objectives for the department, leads transformation initiatives, briefs senior executives on key areas of concern, and participates in managing client delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Direct multiple operational teams and multiple projects simultaneously.
* Focus on operational transformation, optimization, client delivery and business planning.
* Manage and scale existing Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) operations, ensuring quality, throughput, and SLA commitments are consistently met.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and execute multi-year operating strategies, transformation roadmaps, and organizational change initiatives.
* Strong strategic planning and business skills, including the ability to align people, process, technology, and data investments with business objectives.
* Experience presenting strategic recommendations, investment priorities, and operational roadmaps to senior executives and business stakeholders
* Drive efficiency improvement initiatives in close partnership with the Model Operations and Analytics teams to identify automation opportunities and measure impact.
* Develop and maintain a multi-year operational transformation strategy and roadmap for DDS Operations, aligning investments, capabilities, and workforce planning with business objectives and AI maturity goals.
* Establish a forward-looking operating model that balances human expertise, automation, and AI-driven workflows to improve scalability, quality, and cost efficiency.
* Identify emerging industry, technology, and market trends, assessing their impact on the organization and incorporating relevant opportunities into strategic plans.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and QA teams across the R&D organization to align technology roadmaps with operational needs and feed field insights into product and model development.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams and their leaders across the business to align priorities, resolve dependencies, and drive shared initiatives forward.
* Oversees large team or area of the business; manage client communication; performs complex work and develops business plans, processes and policies.

**Knowledge And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
* 12+ years of progressive operations leadership experience, including experience managing human-in-the-loop or AI-augmented operations at scale.
* Exercises broad discretion in developing solutions to complex operational challenges; decisions in this role carry significant business impact.
* Production management processes and procedures.
* Proficient with job aids and standard operating procedures.
* Maintain client and domain knowledge.
* Contractual commitments.
* Human-in-the-loop (HITL) operations for AI/ML systems, including quality review, exception handling, and model feedback loops.
* Working knowledge of intelligent document processing and model evaluation practices, sufficient to partner effectively with Model Operations and Analytics teams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Strong problem solving and decision-making skills.
* Excellent time management and organizational skills
* Ability to work efficiently and independently.
* Ability to work under pressure and time constraints, handling multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Initiative and strong sense of ownership
* Must be comfortable communicating with both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Skills**

* People management.
* Operational excellence.
* Hiring management.
* Client management.
* Broad understanding of cloud technologies
* Experience leading HITL or similar AI-augmented operations, with a track record of driving automation and efficiency gains.
* Proven ability to partner effectively with Model Operations, Analytics, and R&D (Product, Engineering, QA) teams and cross-functional leaders.
* Experience leading teams in India within a global, matrixed organization.

title: Resilience Recovery Lead ResOps
description:
Join us as a Resilience Recovery Lead ResOps at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.
  
  
To be successful as a Resilience Recovery Lead ResOps
**,**
you should have experience with:
  
  
  

* Proven experience leading large-scale technology recovery, cyber recovery, crisis management or operational resilience activities within complex enterprise environments.
* Strong understanding of cyber recovery, operational resilience, disaster recovery, technology recovery and crisis management principles
* Experience coordinating recovery activities across multiple technology, infrastructure and business teams during high-pressure incidents and recovery events.
* Strong leadership and decision-making capability, with the ability to direct recovery activities, manage competing priorities and drive outcomes under pressure.
* Experience managing recovery readiness through recovery planning, dependency management, testing, validation and operational assurance activities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to operate effectively across senior technology, business and resilience leadership teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess recovery risks, identify critical dependencies and determine effective recovery strategies.
* Excellent communication, escalation management and executive reporting skills, with experience supporting governance forums, Command Centres and senior decision-makers during incidents.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Experience supporting resilience testing, simulation exercises, cyber recovery rehearsals and operational recovery events.
* Experience working within Technology Command Centres, Major Incident Management, Crisis Management or Recovery Coordination functions.
* Knowledge of enterprise infrastructure, hosting, cloud, network and critical technology service recovery architectures.
* Experience operating within a regulated financial services environment.
* Experience translating lessons learned into measurable improvements in recovery capability, recovery governance and operational readiness.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with experience working across Engineering, Infrastructure, Cyber Security, Technology Resilience and Business teams.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Pune.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To develop, implement, and maintain an effective resilience strategy and Operational Recovery Planning and Incident Management framework aligned to industry leading standards and controls and regulatory expectations, to enable the bank to respond and recover important business services to severe but plausible scenarios, and minimise the impact to customers, clients, colleagues and the wider market.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Socialisation and implementation of the resilience strategy and underpinning framework across the firm (e.g. SMRs and delegates, business / function resilience role owners and all colleagues), ensuring complaince to the standard and controls.
* Development and enhancement of the resilience, crisis and incident management framework to uplift recovery and response capabilities to ensure Important Business Services can continue to operate during disruption events to minimise the impact on customers, clients and the market.
* Operational Recovery Planning and Security Incident Management planning standards and controls enhancement according to industry practice, emerging threats and regulatory requirements.
* Provide oversight to the business and technology recovery capability improvements, and uplifts to third-party (suppliers and Financial Market Infrastructure) recovery capabilities to enable Important Business Services to remain within or mitigate impact tolerance thresholds.
* Communication of the firm’s / business’ resilience position (risks and remediation) through clear and transparent scorecards / dashboards to enable effective investment decisions to the Board and Executive Committees, Control Forums and business stakeholders.
* Enhancement of resilience, crisis management and incident response and recovery capability through sophisticated, regular and adequate testing coverage to demonstrate Important Business Services’ ability to recover within impact tolerance for a severe but plausible scenario.
* Assurance that services and products are built resiliently by the business through the change management process (NAPAs, DRAs, material change process).
* Continually remain abreast of resilience and crisis and incident management developments, regulatory policy requirements and the emerging landscape.
* Mitigation of the impact of unexpected incidents by identifying , responding to and enabling the resolution of events that threaten the services, operations, infrastructure, colleagues and clients of the bank.
* Execution of responses to reported incidents and potential threats from various channels including intelligence, email, phone and monitoring systems prioritised by the assessed or actual impact to the bank.
* Documentation and analysis of past prioritised incident details, the steps to resolution and the lessons learnt to support the identification and implementation of preventative measures and process improvements.

**Vice President Expectations**

* To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..
* If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..
* OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
* Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.
* Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.
* Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.
* Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.
* Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.
* Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.
