title: Eng Pgm Manager - Sustainability and BESS
description:
**Job Description**
**The ideal candidate will lead, coach, and guide a motivated, high-performing engineering team with clear objectives, accountability, and a strong culture of collaboration, innovation, and execution excellence. Plan resources, assign priorities, remove delivery barriers, and enable the team to meet quality, schedule, productivity, and cost commitments across design, engineering, testing, and site support, with a focus on compliance with industry standards and grid codes.**
**Responsibilities**
**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Project Design and Engineering:
* Participate in project design and detailed engineering.
* Understand and create Single Line Diagrams for Electrical Networks and Switchgear components.
* Prepare Bills of Materials (BOM), Functional Design Specifications (FDS), Heat Load/Current Load Calculations, General Arrangement (GA) drawings, and Input/Output (IO) assignments.
* Power Plant Controller and Power Management Systems:
* Lead the architecture, design, integration, testing, and commissioning of PPC and PMS solutions for PV solar, wind, BESS, utility, and industrial applications, including Front-of-the-Meter projects and compliance with the Indian Grid Code.
* Develop and validate control functions for voltage and frequency regulation, active and reactive power control, LVRT, HVRT, black start, load sharing, peak shaving, demand management, generation scheduling, grid synchronization, load shedding, and energy optimization.
* Integrate PPC and PMS with SCADA, Energy Management Systems, protection relays, meters, generators, renewable sources, and third-party equipment while ensuring interoperability, cybersecurity, safety, and regulatory compliance.
* Sustainability Projects:
* Lead sustainability and decarbonization projects, including renewable energy integration, energy-efficiency improvement, electrification, microgrids, and emissions-reduction initiatives.
* Conduct technical and commercial assessments, establish energy and carbon baselines, define measurable sustainability targets, and track project performance and benefits realization.
* Collaborate with customers, suppliers, consultants, and cross-functional teams to develop scalable, cost-effective sustainability solutions aligned with business objectives and applicable environmental requirements.
* Testing, Compliance, Simulation, and Modeling:
* Develop test procedures, conduct demonstrations aligned with grid-code requirements, and perform PSCAD and PSSE model simulations for renewable energy projects.
* SCADA and PLC/RTU Engineering:
* Prepare and configure SCADA databases and execute PLC/RTU programming using Function Block and Structured Text languages.
* Electrical Systems, Communications, and Integration:
* Design HV/MV/LV electrical networks to applicable engineering standards and integrate protection relays, IEDs, switchgear, SCADA, and third-party devices.
* Apply IEC 61850, IEC 60870-101/104, ICCP, OPC, DNP3, Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and other relevant communication protocols.
* Project Delivery and Customer Coordination:
* Participate in Pre-FAT, FAT, and Integrated FAT (I-FAT) with EPCs and end users; coordinate project updates, work assignments, and customer requirements.
* Travel to global sites as required to support project execution.
* Site Installation Supervision:
* Supervise installation and commissioning of BESS projects, including Containers, Power Conversion Systems (PCS), HVAC, and power cabling.

* Supervise installations of high-voltage DC panels & systems, ensuring adherence to design specifications.
* Prepare As-Built drawings and documentation, including cable schedules as per site modifications.
* Monitor contractor progress and manage site operations.

**9 . Solution Consultancy And Market Alignment**

* Lead solution consultancy engagements to understand customer needs and translate business and technical requirements into competitive, scalable, and compliant BESS and PPC solutions.
* Identify market trends, customer feedback, and application gaps; collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to drive product enhancements that strengthen product-market fit.

**10 . Productivity And Cost Optimization**

* Drive engineering productivity through standardization, reuse, automation, and continuous improvement of design and delivery processes.
* Develop technically robust, cost-optimized solutions by evaluating architecture alternatives, lifecycle costs, risks, and value-engineering opportunities without compromising safety, quality, or compliance.

**11 . Sales And Customer Support**

* Partner with Sales to support opportunity qualification, solution positioning, technical proposals, bid responses, and customer presentations.
* Deliver clear and persuasive technical presentations, solution demonstrations, and workshops that communicate business value and address customer requirements.
* Training, Certification, and Capability Development:
* Develop a role-based training and certification plan through an EMS Engineering consultant, covering required competencies, proficiency levels, assessment criteria, and certification pathways.
* Establish Share & Learn sessions led by Offering Management (OM) on the offering portfolio, customer needs, competitive landscape, and market benchmarking.

* Build a curated learning plan using internal subject-matter experts, supplemented by specialist providers such as Power Projects India and LTTS.
* Explore partnerships with engineering consultants, universities/research institutions, and Power Projects India to co-develop customized curricula, hands-on labs, mentoring, and certification programs.
* Define an annual training calendar, participant cohorts, completion targets, skill assessments, and effectiveness measures to track capability improvement and application on live projects.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration:
* Enable effective collaboration across Offering Management, Solution Consultants, R&D, Integrated Supply Chain (ISC), Services, and Legal to align customer requirements, solution architecture, product capabilities, sourcing and delivery constraints, serviceability, contractual obligations, risk, and compliance throughout the opportunity and project lifecycle.
* Establish clear ownership, decision forums, communication cadence, and timely escalation mechanisms to accelerate decisions, manage interdependencies, reduce rework, and ensure coordinated execution from bid and design through commissioning and lifecycle support.

**Qualifications**
**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering (B.E. Electrical/B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering).
* 12+ years of relevant technical experience in the delivery of electrical projects, including electrical systems and panel boards.
* Prior experience in data center electrical design or energy storage integration is a plus.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines.
* Customer-focused with a collaborative mindset and adaptability to changing environments.
* Self-motivated and capable of functioning with minimal supervision.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams in a diverse and global environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* In-depth understanding of BESS project design and delivery, including resolution of site technical issues.
* Experience in reviewing customer and engineering design requirements and creating project scope documents, technical reports, and proposals.
* Proven track record in delivering renewable energy systems, particularly BESS and photovoltaic (PV) systems.
* Experience in the design and deployment of Power Management Systems, Energy Management Systems, microgrids, or hybrid power systems.
* Demonstrated experience delivering sustainability, energy-efficiency, decarbonization, or renewable-integration projects with measurable business and environmental outcomes.
* Knowledgeable about inverters and DC converters within BESS projects, including inverter controls and operational standards.
* Proficient in analyzing single-line drawings, system studies, and protective relay settings applicable to renewable projects.
* Familiarity with industry standards and grid codes relevant to electrical power systems.

title: Manufacturing Manager 1
description:
**Job Description**
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Develop, qualify, and maintain Welding Procedure Specifications (WPS), Procedure Qualification Records (PQR), and related welding documentation for hardfacing, overlay welding, and valve fabrication applications.
* Define welding parameters, consumables, preheat requirements, interpass controls, and process specifications to achieve consistent, high-quality results.
* Drive welding process improvements that enhance quality, productivity, efficiency, and cost performance.
* Provide technical support for the fabrication of Triple Offset Valves, Ball Valves, pressure-containing components, and critical valve assemblies.
* Prepare weld maps and provide guidance on welding sequences, distortion control, and fabrication best practices.
* Investigate welding-related issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable industry codes, standards, customer requirements, and internal quality expectations, including ASME, API, ISO, and related specifications.
* Support non-destructive examination (NDE) activities, including PT, RT, UT, and MPI, and verify conformance to acceptance criteria.
* Perform metallurgical assessments for hardfacing, overlay applications, repair welding, and critical weldments.
* Maintain accurate records related to welding procedures, qualifications, traceability, consumables, heat treatment activities, repairs, and process audits.
* Review and support quality documentation, including Quality Assurance Plans (QAP), Inspection and Test Plans (ITP), and fabrication records.
* Conduct welder qualification tests and skill assessments in accordance with applicable standards.
* Coach and train welding personnel on TIG, MIG, PTA hardfacing, and advanced welding practices.
* Monitor welding performance and promote adherence to approved procedures, quality standards, and safety requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve weld quality, reduce waste, optimize consumable usage, and increase operational efficiency.
* Evaluate and support the implementation of advanced technologies such as automated PTA systems, robotic welding, laser cladding, and other innovative manufacturing solutions.
* Promote a safe working environment by ensuring compliance with safety procedures, risk assessments, LOTO requirements, PPE standards, and safe handling practices for welding equipment, gases, and consumables.
* Participate in safety audits, incident investigations, and continuous safety improvement initiatives.

Your analytical mindset, attention to detail, and commitment to continuous improvement enable you to solve complex technical challenges and support operational excellence.

* Experience developing, qualifying, and implementing welding procedures for industrial valves, pressure equipment, or critical fabrication applications.

* Experience working with stainless steels, duplex stainless steels, nickel-based alloys, cobalt-based alloys, Inconel, and hardfacing materials.
* Ability to interpret engineering drawings, welding symbols, specifications, and manufacturing documentation.
* Knowledge of relevant codes and standards such as ASME Section IX, ASME B31.3, ASME Sections V and VIII, ISO 15614-1, EN 13445-4, API 609, API 6D, API 600, and related industry standards.
* Familiarity with non-destructive examination techniques and weld acceptance requirements.
* Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting, documentation, and technical communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate with manufacturing, quality, engineering, and operations teams to achieve project and production goals.
* Commitment to workplace safety, quality excellence, integrity, and continuous improvement.

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, Welding Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Diploma or specialized training in Welding Technology combined with relevant industry experience.
* Experience supporting Triple Offset Valve (TOV) and Ball Valve manufacturing environments.
* Hands-on expertise in Stellite hardfacing using PTA, GTAW, or GMAW processes.
* Experience managing welder qualification programs, training initiatives, and workforce capability development.
* Knowledge of automated welding systems, robotic welding, laser cladding, or other advanced manufacturing technologies.

title: Team Lead, IB
description:
**Description**
Amazon is seeking bright, motivated, and detail-oriented individuals to fill the TL position within the IB (Inbound operations) team at our Fulfillment Center (FC). The ideal candidate possesses a strong work ethic, sharp analytical skills, meticulous attention to detail, the ability to meet deadlines, and a commitment to inventory accuracy and quality as it relates to product fulfillment.
  
  
This position is responsible for investigating inventory discrepancies, conducting root-cause analysis (RCA), performing audits, and driving corrective actions that protect inventory health across the FC. A TL is expected to interpret data from inventory and quality systems, identify process gaps, partner with Operations to resolve defects, and ensure adherence to inventory, quality, and standard-work processes. The role requires comfort working with data tools and dashboards, the ability to navigate the FC floor to validate physical inventory, and a willingness to work in multiple shifts. The job is demanding, and filled with learning and fun, as we aim to provide the best inventory accuracy and quality outcomes for our customers at all times.
  
  
**Job Duties**
Each employee must be able to perform all of the job duties described below on a regular basis, with or without reasonable accommodation, in order to meet the requirements of the job as a TL:
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  

* Conduct root-cause analysis (RCA) on inventory loss, mismatches, and process-violation incidents, and drive corrective actions to resolution.
* Analyze data from inventory and quality dashboards to surface trends, defects, and improvement opportunities.
* Partner with Operations and support teams to close process gaps and prevent recurrence.
* Maintain accurate records, trackers, and reports on inventory health and quality metrics.

Team Lead Best Behavior
  
  

* Listening to associates and being supportive to managers.
* Answering requests and always getting back to people.
* Lead by example — doing what we say and acting how we say.
* Be approachable; talk to associates to understand how IB can better support and improve quality on the floor.
* Exhibit the best behavior while at work.
* Always stay up to date with the latest investigation techniques, tools, and processes.
* Be right, be honest, and be willing to accept mistakes.
* Be willing to push your limits and take on more responsibilities.

Key job responsibilities
  
  
Job Deliverables
  
  

* Manage Day/Night shift operations for Inbound processes, including labor planning, allocation, and execution to meet daily volume and throughput targets.
* Prepare Shift Operating Strategy (SOS) plans, allocate labor across inbound flows, and lead flow meetings to ensure seamless shift execution.
* Direct and assign job duties to FC Associates, Process Assistants (PAs), and Problem Solvers to optimize inbound workflow efficiency.
* Monitor, mentor, and coach associates on productivity, quality, and safety standards.
* Lead the team of PAs and Problem Solvers, ensuring accountability and alignment with shift goals.
* Analyze and share shift performance reports and escalate system-related issues to leadership in a timely manner.
* Own shift-level productivity and quality outcomes, developing action plans to address gaps and drive improvement.
* Prepare and implement training and development plans for associates to build capability and support career growth.
* Conduct 4M and 5S audits at workstations daily to ensure process adherence and workplace organization.
* Ensure FC Associates have proper tools and equipment, coordinating repair or replacement as necessary.
* Stand in for the Area Manager as needed, providing leadership continuity during their absence.

A day in the life
  
  
Candidate will get varied opportunities to manage entire FC Inbound operations and work on improvement projects.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* Speak, write, and read fluently in English
* Experience with Microsoft Office products and applications
* Experience with Excel

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1+ years of customer-facing environment, warehousing, logistics or manufacturing experience

title: Manager - Portfolio Reconciliation
description:
**What You'll Do**
**What Makes This Opportunity Unique**
Are you ready to lead a world-class team in the heart of Pune? At Principal Financial Group, we are looking for a dedicated and ambitious individual to join us as a Manager - Portfolio Reconciliation. In this pivotal role, you will have the opportunity to develop our reconciliation processes, drive innovation, and ensure flawless implementation of our operational strategy.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Operational Oversight & Process Excellence**

* Provide end-to-end oversight of daily reconciliation processes including cash, position, trade, corporate actions, derivatives, and NAV breaks.
* Ensure timely break identification, root cause analysis, resolution, and documentation aligned with internal controls and SLA expectations.
* Coordinate and strengthen the control framework, ensuring full compliance with operational risk standards, audit requirements, and regulatory expectations.
* Own the Reconciliation team’s quality, accuracy, and efficiency SLAs; investigate and report breaches with remediation plans.
* Drive automation and digital transformation in reconciliation processes using tools such as workflow engines, exception management tools, AI/ML break prediction, and vendor platforms.
* Partner with Technology & Product teams to define business requirements, build platforms, and prioritize features/epics for reconciliation systems.
* Support new business, new product, and new account onboarding from a reconciliation perspective, ensuring readiness and control alignment.

**People Leadership & Capability Building**

* Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing reconciliation teams across locations.
* Drive structured mentoring, skill development, and succession planning for Analysts, Senior Analysts, and Team Leads.
* Ensure timely recruitment, onboarding, and continuous training, including capital markets knowledge, technology tools, and risk management.
* Foster a culture of accountability, curiosity, and operational rigor, while balancing employee morale and engagement.
* Coordinate team-level HR matters including performance reviews, talent development, reward & recognition programs, and attrition management.
* Enforce consistent processes, policies, and performance standards across teams.

**Risk, Governance & Compliance**

* Maintain a strong risk culture with emphasis on break aging, exception transparency, and timely resolution of blocking issues.
* Ensure all reconciliation processes align with Corporate Code of Ethics, audit guidelines, information security standards, and applicable regulations.

title: Senior Executive - Retail Expansion
description:
**Job Title:**
Senior Executive - Retail Expansion

**Company:**
PALMONAS

**Department:**
Retail Expansion

**Location:**
Pune, Maharashtra

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

About PALMONAS

PALMONAS is a modern demi-fine jewellery and lifestyle brand focused on making premium, stylish jewellery accessible to customers. With an expanding retail presence across India, we are looking for a proactive professional to support our store expansion strategy and identify high-potential locations for new retail outlets.

Role Overview

The Retail Expansion professional will be responsible for identifying suitable retail locations, conducting market research, evaluating properties, coordinating with landlords and property consultants, and supporting the end-to-end process of opening new stores. The role requires strong negotiation, market analysis, stakeholder management, and coordination skills.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Property Sourcing & Location Identification**

* Identify potential locations for new retail stores across target cities and markets.
* Source properties through brokers, landlords, property consultants, developers, and direct market research.
* Evaluate high-street locations, shopping malls, and other suitable retail spaces.
* Build and maintain a database of prospective properties and property owners.

**2. Market Research & Feasibility Analysis**

* Conduct market visits to assess location suitability, footfall, visibility, accessibility, and surrounding brands.
* Analyse catchment areas, customer demographics, competition, and market potential.
* Evaluate commercial viability based on rental costs, store size, expected sales potential, and business requirements.
* Prepare location evaluation reports and recommendations for management approval.

**3. Landlord & Broker Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with landlords, property owners, brokers, and mall management teams.
* Negotiate rental terms, security deposits, lock-in periods, rent-free periods, escalation clauses, and lease conditions.
* Coordinate site visits, commercial discussions, and documentation.
* Maintain a pipeline of properties and ensure timely follow-ups with relevant stakeholders.

**4. Lease Negotiation & Documentation**

* Coordinate the commercial closure of shortlisted properties.
* Work with the legal and finance teams to review lease agreements, commercial terms, and supporting documentation.
* Track approvals, agreement execution, and other property-related formalities.
* Ensure property proposals are aligned with approved budgets and company policies.

**5. New Store Opening Coordination**

* Coordinate with Retail Operations, Projects, Design, Finance, Legal, and other internal teams to facilitate new store openings.
* Track property handover, fit-out readiness, utilities, permissions, and other location-related requirements.
* Monitor expansion timelines and proactively highlight potential delays.
* Support the end-to-end process from property identification to store handover.

**6. Reporting & Pipeline Management**

* Maintain an updated database of available properties, site visits, negotiations, and closures.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports on the expansion pipeline.
* Track city-wise expansion targets, property acquisition costs, and closure timelines.
* Provide regular updates to management on progress, challenges, and upcoming opportunities.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Real Estate, Marketing, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in retail expansion, commercial real estate, property acquisition, or business development.
* Strong negotiation and communication skills.
* Good understanding of retail locations, commercial leasing, and rental negotiations.
* Ability to conduct market research and assess property feasibility.
* Strong stakeholder management, follow-up, and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint for reporting and analysis.
* Willingness to travel for site visits and market assessments.

Preferred Experience

* Experience in retail, jewellery, fashion, lifestyle, D2C, or consumer brands.
* Existing network of property brokers, landlords, and commercial real estate consultants.
* Experience in high-street retail and shopping mall leasing.
* Exposure to multi-city retail expansion and new store openings.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of qualified properties identified and shortlisted.
* Number of properties successfully negotiated and closed.
* Adherence to approved rental budgets and commercial terms.
* Timeliness of property acquisition and store handover.
* Quality and commercial viability of shortlisted locations.
* Achievement of city-wise and overall expansion targets.

Ideal Candidate

A commercially aware and result-oriented professional with strong local market knowledge, negotiation skills, and the ability to identify profitable retail locations and drive new store expansion in line with PALMONAS's growth strategy.

title: Senior Specialist Invoicing
description:

We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
  
  
**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
  
  
We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Sr. Specialist is responsible for the day-to-day operational excellence and delivery of the Invoice-to-Cash lifecycle across the global regions. This role acts as a critical bridge between global process standards and regional execution, ensuring that the Third-Party Service Provider (3PSP) performs O2C activities at the keystroke level with accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with business requirements. The role focuses on “running the engine”- supporting vendor performance, resolving operational issues, and ensuring that order management, invoicing, collections, and dispute processes are executed seamlessly in the global market context.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: 1. Operational Oversight & Vendor Management
  
  

* 3PSP Coordination: Act as the primary point of coordination and escalation for the 3PSP vendor, ensuring delivery of O2C services including collections, cash applications, credit management and dispute management meets contractual SLAs.
* Keystroke-Level Governance: Monitor execution quality in transactional systems (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Serrala, SAP-FSCM), ensuring adherence to Global Process Owner (GPO) standards.
* Service Delivery: Oversee timely execution of daily and period-end O2C processes including order entry, billing cycles, cash application, and collections follow-ups. 2. Regional Performance & Execution
* KPI Accountability: Own delivery of key O2C KPIs, including: Days Sales Outstanding (DSO), Cash Collection Effectiveness, Dispute Resolution Cycle Time, Cash Application on Time, etc.
* Operational Reviews: Conduct weekly/monthly performance reviews with the 3PSP and stakeholders to address service gaps and drive improvements.
* Exception Management: Identify and resolve issues such as blocked orders, billing errors, overdue receivables, and disputes. 3. Process Localization & Compliance
* Standardization Adherence: Ensure O2C operations are aligned with global O2C standards, minimizing deviations unless business-critical.
* Documentation & Knowledge: Maintain regional SOPs and ensure 3PSP documentation (SOPs, DTPs) is accurate and up to date.
* Audit & Controls: Ensure compliance with internal controls, SOX requirements, credit policies, and data privacy regulations. 4. Technology & Tactical Enablement
* System Utilization: Ensure effective use of SAP S/4HANA, and other supporting O2C tools like Serrala for Cash Applications, SAP-FSCM for Credit Management, Collections and Disputes Management.
* User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Support/lead testing for system changes or deployments, ensuring all the requirements are validated.
* Data Integrity: Ensure accuracy of master data (customer master, pricing, credit limits, payment terms). 5. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Alignment
* Regional Bridge: Act as liaison between Commercial, Customer Service, Finance (AR/Credit), and Global GPO teams.
* S&OP Integration: Work with sales and customer teams to resolve order blocks, disputes, and improve customer experience.
* Conflict Resolution: Manage trade-offs between revenue realization, customer service, and risk (credit exposure). 6. Issue Resolution & Continuous Improvement
* Identify root causes of recurring O2C issues (billing errors, delayed collections, disputes).
* Drive corrective actions with 3PSP and internal stakeholders.
* Support automation and process improvement initiatives in O2C operations.

**What You Need To Succeed**
Experiences & Qualifications
  
  

* University degree in Finance, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or related field.
* 10+ years of experience in Order-to-Cash, Accounts Receivable, or Customer Operations.
* Significant track record managing 3PSPs or BPO partners in a high-volume, keystroke-level environment.
* High "Super-User" comfort level with SAP S/4HANA, SAP-FSCM, and Serrala.
* Experience navigating the diverse market landscape of global regions and managing stakeholders across different time zones and languages. Must have competencies
* Analytical Thinking
* Strategic Vision
* Communication Skills
* Problem Solving
* Collaboration
* Leadership
* Adaptability

**Why join us?**
This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed - both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end-to-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
  
  
You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy - and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
  
  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.

Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
  
  
**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
  
  
If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
  
  
**Additional Information**
The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

Experience working with procurement governance, documentation, compliance requirements, and supplier performance management.

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  
  
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Proactive mindset with a strong focus on continuous improvement and value creation.
  
  
Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills across cross functional teams and suppliers.

Experience working in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  
  
Ability to effectively collaborate with global suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders.
  
  
Experience supporting procurement transformation, process improvement, and sustainability initiatives will be considered an advantage.
  
  
To succeed in this role
  
  
Success in this role requires a strong foundation in procurement and sourcing processes, the ability to manage supplier relationships effectively, and attention to detail when handling purchasing and contract activities. You will need to collaborate confidently with stakeholders, maintain compliance with procurement policies, and proactively monitor supplier performance, delivery schedules, and business outcomes. The ability to work independently while balancing multiple procurement activities will be essential.
  
  
We Also Expect You To Align With Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical Behaviors That Guide How We Lead, Collaborate, And Succeed Together

We offer
  
  
You will join a procurement team focused on sourcing, supplier management, contract administration, purchasing execution, logistics coordination, and procurement governance. Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with opportunities to learn, grow, and contribute to business success. title: Engineer, Pump Order Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
Position Summary
  
  
Pentair is looking for an Engineer with strong experience in centrifugal pump engineering, product configuration BOM finalisation, SAP engineering documentation and CAD design. The role will focus on finalising accurate configuration BOMs for centrifugal pumps, including Vertical Turbine Pumps, Solids Handling Pumps etc. The candidate should have a sound understanding of pump assemblies, material of construction, product variants, accessories and manufacturing processes. In addition to BOM engineering responsibilities, the candidate will support CAD activities such as 3D modelling, assembly modelling, detailed drawings and design documentation.
  
  
The selected candidate will work closely with global engineering counterparts to ensure that pump configurations are technically correct, manufacturable, properly documented and ready for downstream business processes such as quotation, order engineering, procurement and production.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Pump Configuration BOM and SAP Engineering Documentation
* Finalize configuration BOMs for centrifugal pump product families such as Vertical Turbine Pumps, Solids Handling Pumps and other pump assemblies.
* Create, review and update engineering BOMs in SAP based on approved product structures, configuration rules, materials, design standards and project requirements.
* Support material creation, classification, and master data maintenance in SAP.
* Validate pump assemblies and sub-assemblies including pump components and accessories.
* Ensure correct material of construction and documentation based on application and product standards.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to resolve BOM gaps, missing/incorrect parts and duplicate items.
* Support engineering change activities including part creation, BOM updates, drawing revisions.
* CAD Design and Engineering Support
* Create and update 3D models, assemblies and manufacturing drawings of centrifugal pump components and assemblies.
* Prepare detailed drawings with appropriate dimensions, tolerances, GD&T, surface finish and machining requirements.
* Perform assembly checks, fit-up reviews and tolerance stack-up reviews before releasing drawings or BOM updates.
* Support design standardization, VA/VE and product rationalization initiatives for pump platforms and configured products.
* Coordinate drawing corrections, model updates and engineering documentation changes with internal teams and global stakeholders.
* Manufacturing, Quality and Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Apply good understanding of manufacturing processes such as casting, machining, fabrication, welding and assembly while finalizing drawings and BOMs.
* Work with manufacturing and sourcing teams to ensure that BOM structures and drawings are aligned with practical manufacturing and procurement processes.
* Participate in technical discussions with overseas engineering teams through meetings, emails and design reviews.
* Document engineering decisions clearly and maintain traceability for BOM changes, drawing updates and configuration corrections.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* B.E. / B.Tech. or M.E. / M.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering or related streams.
* 2 to 6 years of relevant experience in centrifugal pump engineering, BOM engineering, product configuration, SAP engineering documentation and CAD design.
* Hands-on experience with centrifugal pump assemblies especially Vertical Turbine Pumps, Solids Handling Pumps, or similar rotating equipment will be preferred.
* Good experience in SAP for engineering BOM creation, BOM maintenance and part master data.
* Strong understanding of pump construction, assemblies, configurations and material of construction.
* Strong CAD experience in SolidWorks or equivalent software, assembly modelling and 2D manufacturing drawings.

Technical Skills
  
  
Skill Area Expected Capability
  
  
Pump Engineering Centrifugal pump assemblies, configuration options, pump components, MOC etc.
  
  
BOM and SAP Engineering BOM creation, review, clean-up, configuration BOM finalization etc.
  
  
CAD- 3D modelling, large assemblies and 2D drawings.
  
  
GD&T and Tolerance Application of GD&T, tolerance stack-up, fitment checks and manufacturing drawing quality.
  
  
Manufacturing Casting, machining, fabrication, welding, assembly, surface finish, inspection and DFM/DFA considerations.
  
  
Documentation Clear engineering documentation and communication with global teams.
  
  
**Other Requirements**

* Strong drawing reading and drawing interpretation skills.
* Good analytical ability to identify BOM gaps, configuration conflicts, drawing issues and manufacturing constraints.
* Good communication skills to work with internal teams, manufacturing locations and global engineering stakeholders.
* Ability to work with accuracy, ownership and attention to detail in data-sensitive engineering documentation activities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across BOM engineering, CAD updates, drawing releases etc.

**Preferred Background**

* Experience in centrifugal pumps especially Vertical turbine pumps, solids handling pumps or rotating equipment.
* Exposure to order engineering, configured products, SAP workflow, product standardization.
* Experience working with global teams, manufacturing plants and cross-functional stakeholders.

title: Associate Project Engineer
description:
As an Associate Project Engineer, you will contribute to the successful execution of AV integration projects by supporting your senior engineers and project managers. This entry-level role focuses on learning and development while assisting with post-award activities, such as creating or reviewing bill of materials, drawings, infrastructure requirements, network coordination, and preparing installation and commissioning documentation. Additionally, you will perform system testing and troubleshooting under supervision.
  
  
You will work closely with the project team to ensure tasks are completed accurately and efficiently. This position is ideal for a detail-oriented, flexible individual eager to build technical skills and gain hands-on experience in the AV field. Supervision from more-senior engineers and mentorship opportunities will guide your professional growth.
  
  
**Who We Are**
AVI-SPL is a digital enablement solutions provider who transforms how people and technology connect to elevate experiences, create new value, and enable organizations to thrive and grow. We are the largest provider of collaboration technology solutions, which include our award-winning managed services.
  
  
Our highly certified industry experts and innovation leaders share a vision to help people work smarter and live better. We believe that success starts with a sound team and that an inclusive and diverse workplace moves us all forward.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
As an Associate Project Engineer, you will contribute to the successful execution of AV integration projects by supporting your senior engineers and project managers. This entry-level role focuses on learning and development while assisting with post-award activities, such as creating or reviewing bill of materials, drawings, infrastructure requirements, network coordination, and preparing installation and commissioning documentation. Additionally, you will perform system testing and troubleshooting under supervision.
  
  
You will work closely with the project team to ensure tasks are completed accurately and efficiently. This position is ideal for a detail-oriented, flexible individual eager to build technical skills and gain hands-on experience in the AV field. Supervision from more-senior engineers and mentorship opportunities will guide your professional growth.
  
  
**Day-To-Day Responsibilities**

* Design and Documentation Support
* Assist in reviewing preliminary project design documents, such as Scope of Work (SOW) and contracts, to validate completeness and feasibility.
* Serve as a go-to peer review resource for engineers by ensuring accuracy and clarity in drawings and change orders.
* Help create and update engineering project documents, including infrastructure drawings, equipment placement diagrams, and riser diagrams, under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Generate cable pull sheets and assist with calculations, such as heat and power requirements.
* Project and Change Order Assistance
* Assist fellow engineers with large change order work by preparing and updating necessary design and documentation.
* Help assemble technical closeout documentation, including "as-built" drawings and programming files.
* Field Support and Flexibility
* Act as a backup to support the primary Project Engineer on large projects as needed.
* Collaborate with the commissioning and programming team to create deployment andcommissioning guides.
* Travel to job sites as needed to support the installation team and gain hands-on field experience.
* Perform additional tasks, responsibilities, and projects as needed to support the team and organization, ensuring flexibility in adapting to evolving priorities and objectives.
* Items to Consider:
* AVI-SPL reserves the right to alter work hours and work location as necessary. Work hours may vary based on client requirements and may include travel to various locations in support of the account.
* This position will generally work on customer sites and may deal with a construction site type of work environment.

**Must-Haves**
**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**

* A proactive approach to self-learning and improvement, with a willingness to take on new challenges.
* Flexibility to adapt to shifting priorities and support multiple projects effectively.
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and accuracy.
* Basic familiarity with AV systems, IT networking, or related technologies.
* Effective communication skills for collaborating with teammates and supervisors.
* Valid driver’s license and a motor vehicle record that meets company standards.
* Employees operating company or personal vehicles for business purposes must be legally authorized to drive, maintain a valid driver’s license and provide proof of coverage, meeting all minimum required insurance coverage as a condition of employment.
* Employees driving fleet vehicles must meet eligibility requirements; comply with all guidelines, including telematics monitoring, vehicle maintenance schedules, proper use of assigned fuel and toll devices.

**Nice-To-Haves**

* Formal education in Electronics, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* AV integration experience, especially field installation or service, is a plus but not required.
* Familiarity with industry standards such as AVIXA (CTS certification) or networking concepts.
* Experience with DSP or control system programming tools is a plus.
* Previous experience in a technical support or field-related role is a plus but not required.
* Proficiency with basic design tools (e.g., AutoCAD, Bluebeam Revu) and willingness to learn more advanced tools.

**WHY YOU’LL LIKE WORKING HERE**

* Medical benefits, including vision and dental
* Paid holidays and PTO
* Enjoyable and dynamic company culture
* Training and professional development opportunities

**More About Us**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran status, disability status, or membership in any other group protected by federal, state, or local law. title: Manager – Content & Internal Communications
description:
CBRE India is looking for an experienced Content & Internal Communications professional to strengthen its Marketing & Communications function. The role will be responsible for developing, managing and streamlining strategic content and communication across internal, leadership, business and client-facing platforms.

The individual will play a critical role in shaping consistent organisational narratives, translating business priorities into impactful communication, and ensuring alignment in messaging across leadership (including our chairman & ceo), business lines and corporate functions. This is a strategic communications role that combines strong content writing and storytelling capabilities with stakeholder partnership and execution.

1. Leadership & Strategic Communications

* Develop and manage leadership communication for senior leadership, including the Chairman and other key business leaders.
* Create leadership narratives, key messaging frameworks, speeches, talking points, briefing notes, presentations and communication documents.
* Ensure consistency in leadership messaging across internal and external communication channels and collaterals.
* Translate business strategy, organisational priorities and key developments into clear, compelling and relevant narratives.
* Support leadership visibility through communication for events, town halls, internal platforms, external engagements and corporate announcements.

2. Internal Communications & Employee Engagement

* Drive and streamline internal communications across CBRE India, ensuring timely, structured and consistent dissemination of information.
* Conceptualize and execute creative internal communication campaigns around organizational priorities, business milestones, employee engagement, CSR initiatives and key announcements.
* Develop communication plans and content for town halls, leadership messages, employee campaigns, newsletters, internal platforms and other engagement initiatives.
* Work closely with HR, shared services, business lines and other functional teams to identify communication requirements and translate them into effective content and campaigns.
* Establish greater consistency, clarity and discipline in internal communication, ensuring the right messaging reaches the right audience through the appropriate channels.
* Manage and strengthen key internal communication channels, including the company intranet and CBRE employee platforms and tools such as CBRE India Engage.
* Own the content calendar, editorial planning, publishing coordination and ongoing content management (all internal channels), ensuring they remain active, relevant and aligned with business and employee communication priorities.
* Partner with platform owners, HR, IT, shared services and business teams to source stories, curate updates, drive participation and improve employee reach and engagement through internal channels.

3. Business & Client Communications

* Partner with business lines to develop impactful business-related communication supporting business priorities, achievements, initiatives and market positioning.
* Develop client-facing communication, including corporate narratives, client presentations, business updates, thought leadership content, event communication and other marketing collaterals.
* Work with business leaders and subject matter experts to understand business requirements and translate complex information into engaging, accessible and audience-relevant content.
* Strengthen consistency in CBRE's external messaging and client communication across business divisions.
* Support differentiated communication that reinforces CBRE's brand positioning, expertise and value proposition.

4. Content Strategy, Storytelling & Creative Campaigns

* Develop compelling content and narratives for internal and external marketing campaigns.
* Bring a strong storytelling approach to corporate communication, ensuring content is engaging, relevant and aligned with the organisation's brand voice.
* Create and edit content across formats, including articles, newsletters, leadership messages, scripts, presentations, digital communication, social media and campaign collateral.
* Work with design and digital teams to translate content strategies into effective creative communication.
* Ensure quality, accuracy, tone of voice and consistency across all communication outputs.

5. Key Campaigns, Creative Thinking & Video Storyboarding

* Conceptualize and develop integrated creative campaigns aligned with CBRE India's business priorities, brand positioning, employee engagement agenda and key organizational milestones.
* Bring fresh, original and creative thinking to communication challenges, moving beyond routine content formats to develop distinctive campaign ideas and compelling storytelling.
* Develop campaign concepts, central themes, messaging architectures, creative briefs and content plans for internal and external campaigns.
* Lead content development and storyboarding for corporate films, leadership videos, employee engagement films, event AVs, campaign videos, social media videos and other digital formats.
* Translate business narratives and leadership messages into engaging video scripts, story arcs, scene-by-scene storyboards, voiceovers and visual direction in collaboration with design, production and agency partners.
* Identify opportunities to leverage video, visual storytelling and multi-format content to improve audience engagement and communication impact.
* Ensure campaign messaging and creative execution remain consistent with CBRE's brand guidelines, tone of voice and communication objectives.

6. Employee Experience

* Support the conceptualisation and curation of internal offsites, leadership meets, employee events and engagement forums.
* Develop event themes, narratives, communication strategies, content and experience-led elements.
* Work with HR, business teams and event partners to create cohesive and differentiated employee experiences.
* Develop pre-event communication, on-ground messaging, presentations, event scripts, AV content and post-event communication.
* Identify opportunities to improve employee engagement through creative communication, storytelling and interactive experiences.
* Contribute to strengthening the overall employee experience across key organisational touchpoints.

7. Stakeholder Management & Communication Governance

* Act as a central content and communications partner for business lines, shared services, HR, leadership teams and other internal stakeholders.
* Streamline communication workflows, briefing processes, content approvals and stakeholder coordination.
* Establish content standards, messaging guidelines and frameworks to ensure consistency across communication channels.
* Proactively identify communication opportunities and recommend appropriate formats, channels and approaches.
* Manage multiple communication requirements simultaneously while maintaining quality and delivery timelines.

Desired Skills & Experience

* 6–8 years of experience in internal communications, content specialist, creative writer, storyteller, campaign communication expert, internal events, and integrated marketing communications.
* Graduate degree in Communications or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification in Corporate Communications, Marketing Communications or Events would be an advantage. Excellent content writing, editing, storytelling and communication skills.
* Proven experience in developing leadership communication and engaging with senior stakeholders.
* Strong ability to simplify complex business information into clear, compelling narratives.
* Experience in managing internal communication programmes and business-facing communication.
* Ability to develop communication plan/calendar, content strategies as well as execute content independently.
* Strong stakeholder management, coordination and project management skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, matrixed corporate environment.
* Experience in real estate, professional services, consulting or a large multinational organisation would be an advantage.

**Role mandate: This position is not limited to content creation. It is about owning the content and internal, communications, business communications, strengthening leadership narratives and creating a more structured, consistent and impactful communication ecosystem for CBRE India across internal and external channels.**

description:

Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for over 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world. Arup is a UK-headquartered independent firm of designers, planners, engineers, consultants, and technical specialists offering a wide range of professional services. With 90 offices in 35 countries, their 19,000+ staff make a positive difference in the world through their work.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a senior renewable energy professional with combined expertise in wind resource assessment, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and technical due diligence including Lender’s Technical Advisor (LTA), Independent Engineer and Owner’s Engineer roles. The successful candidate will support and lead advisory assignments across wind, solar, hybrid and storage projects, including Round-the-Clock (RTC), Firm and Dispatchable Renewable Energy (FDRE) schemes and Standalone BESS systems including projects under the Viability Gap Funding schemes. The role requires strong analytical capability, practical understanding of project development and bankability, and confidence in working with investors, developers and lenders
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

The position is also responsible for preparing energy production forecasts, uncertainty assessments, P50/P90 estimates, and reviewing third-party technical reports for project bankability, investment, and financing decisions. It further involves integrating and optimising Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) for renewable and hybrid energy projects.
  
  
The role supports technical due diligence, construction monitoring, grid code compliance reviews, and risk assessments for wind, solar, and storage projects. Responsibilities include evaluating project designs, contracts, warranties, financial model assumptions, and operational strategies while preparing high-quality reports for investors and lenders. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Energy, Renewable Energy or a related engineering discipline
* Experience in BESS integration, sizing, and optimisation for hybrid, RTC, and FDRE renewable energy projects.
* Proven background in technical due diligence, lender advisory, independent engineering, or transaction advisory assignments.
* Good understanding of wind, solar, and energy storage project lifecycles, project risks, contracts, grid integration, and bankability.
* Strong analytical, reporting, client management, and stakeholder coordination skills, with the ability to manage projects independently
* Exposure to Python-based energy modelling, green hydrogen, Power-to-X projects, and experience in the Indian or international renewable energy market would be an added advantage.

description:

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Patient Journey Partner- Malignant Hematology / Oncology**
**Location:**
All Locations
  
  
**The Position**
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner. In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche’s capabilities and resources to co-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
  
  
**Your Opportunity**

* You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators
* You will be a one point of contact for specific accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the related public & private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations
* You will be building relationships with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and implementing strategies and driving results for enhancing access to Roche innovations
* You will be leading collaboration in field through co-creation of solutions for key accounts

**Who You Are**
You are someone who has a relevant graduate/ post graduate degree in Science. From an experience standpoint having more than 5 years’ experience with 2+ years in Commercial Role or similar preferred.
  
  
You must exhibit strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management.
  
  
**Core Role Capabilities:**

* Insight Generation (Intermediate): Translates multiple data points into actionable insights, prioritizes key drivers, and connects them to business decisions
* Situational Analysis (Intermediate): Connects account data, HCP dynamics, and patient barriers to form coherent recommendations
* Customer Segmentation (Intermediate): Leverages segmentation (potential, penetration, needs) to drive targeted engagement
* Patient Journey Mapping (Advanced): Identifies critical moments that matter across the journey and shapes strategic priorities
* Value Proposition (Intermediate): Connects customer needs to tailored value propositions for priority segments
* Omnichannel Engagement (Advanced): Creates personalized, seamless experiences aligned to desired behavior shifts
* Ecosystem / Account Planning (Intermediate): Develops coherent strategies connecting stakeholder needs, value opportunities, and resource allocation

**Key Functional Focus Areas:**

* Marketing & Strategy: Defining target outcomes, mapping the patient journey, and executing tailored omnichannel campaigns to drive brand adoption

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.

**6. Collaboration & Team Management**

* Work closely with Creative, Analytics, Tech and other internal teams.
* Coordinate campaign requirements and tracking implementation.

* 2–6 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, media buying or paid advertising.

* Strong understanding of campaign setup, audience targeting, bidding strategies and scaling.

* Exposure to financial services, insurance, lead generation or other performance marketing verticals.
* Experience managing international or high-budget advertising campaigns.
* Familiarity with Facebook Ads Manager, Google Ads Manager and analytics tools.
* Understanding of conversion funnels, landing page optimization and tracking mechanisms.

**Media Analyst / Media Buyer (2–3 Years)**

* Independently manage and optimize campaigns.
* Understand campaign metrics, creative testing and audience targeting.
* Manage assigned budgets and achieve campaign objectives.

**Senior Media Buyer (4–6 Years)**

* Own campaign strategy, performance and scaling.
* Demonstrate experience managing substantial advertising budgets.
* Drive profitability through advanced optimization and testing.

title: Lead Generation Intern
description:
**Dezainahub | 2-Month Internship | Part-Time | Remote | Unpaid**

**About Dezainahub**

Dezainahub is one of the
**leading IT firms in Delhi-NCR**

, building for
**brands that hate looking small**

.

We work with ambitious businesses to build stronger brands and digital experiences through branding, UI/UX design, website development, digital products, and technology.

We're constantly exploring new opportunities, connecting with businesses, and helping brands improve how they present themselves digitally.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for a
**Lead Generation Intern**

who can help us identify potential clients, discover business opportunities, and build a strong pipeline of prospects.

**About the role**

As a Lead Generation Intern, you'll work closely with our business development and founding team to identify, research, and organise potential business opportunities.

Your primary responsibility will be to find businesses that could benefit from Dezainahub's services and help build a qualified database of prospective clients.

This isn't just about collecting random contact numbers or email addresses. We want you to understand
**which businesses are worth approaching, why they might need our services, and how to identify the right decision-makers.**

**What You'll Work On**

Your responsibilities may include:

* Researching and identifying potential business prospects across different industries.
* Finding potential clients in sectors such as Real Estate, Hospitality, F&B, SaaS, Healthcare, Education, and other relevant industries.
* Identifying businesses that may require branding, website development, UI/UX, or digital solutions.
* Researching companies through Google, LinkedIn, Google Maps, business directories, and other platforms.
* Finding relevant decision-makers, founders, business owners, and marketing heads.
* Collecting verified business information, including company names, contact details, email addresses, and website URLs.
* Analysing business websites and digital presence to identify potential opportunities.
* Maintaining and updating lead databases and spreadsheets.
* Categorising and qualifying leads based on their relevance and potential.
* Supporting the team with prospect research for email, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp outreach campaigns.
* Meeting assigned lead research and database-building targets.
* Exploring new platforms and methods to discover potential clients.

**What We're Looking For**

We're not necessarily looking for someone with prior sales or lead generation experience.

We're looking for someone who is
**curious, resourceful, organised, and good at finding information.**

You could be a good fit if you:

* Are currently pursuing a college degree or diploma.
* Have an interest in business development, sales, marketing, or market research.
* Enjoy researching businesses and discovering new opportunities.
* Have good internet research and information-gathering skills.
* Are comfortable using Google, LinkedIn, Google Maps, and spreadsheets.
* Have basic knowledge of Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.
* Can identify relevant information instead of collecting data blindly.
* Have good attention to detail.
* Are organised and consistent with assigned tasks.
* Can work independently and manage your time.
* Are comfortable learning new tools, platforms, and research techniques.
* Take ownership of your responsibilities and deliver work on time.

**Who Should NOT Apply**

Please don't apply if you:

* Are looking for a paid internship.
* Are only interested in getting an internship certificate.
* Cannot dedicate consistent time during the internship.
* Don't enjoy research or information gathering.
* Are careless with data accuracy and quality.
* Need constant supervision or spoon-feeding to complete tasks.
* Are uncomfortable working with spreadsheets and online platforms.
* Are inconsistent with deadlines and commitments.
* Are not genuinely interested in learning about businesses, sales, or marketing.
* Are looking for a short-term time-pass opportunity.

**Who should apply**

You should apply if:

* You enjoy discovering new businesses and opportunities.
* You are naturally curious about how companies operate.
* You like researching, analysing, and finding useful information.
* You can spend time finding the right prospect rather than simply collecting hundreds of random leads.
* You enjoy working with data and organising information.
* You are willing to experiment with different lead discovery methods.
* You want practical exposure to how business development and sales pipelines are built.
* You are disciplined, sincere, and consistent with your work.

**You don't need to know everything about lead generation. You just need to be willing to learn, explore, and get things done.**

**What You'll Get**

* Real-world experience in lead generation and business development.
* Exposure to actual B2B sales and prospecting processes.
* Understanding of how businesses identify and approach potential clients.
* Practical experience with lead research, qualification, and database management.
* Exposure to different industries and business models.
* Opportunity to work closely with the founding and business development team.
* Certificate of Completion upon successfully completing the internship.
* Letter of Recommendation (LOR) based on performance.
* Opportunity to understand how a growing IT company acquires and develops business relationships.

**Internship Details**

**Position: Lead Generation Intern**

**Duration: 2 Months**

**Type: Part-Time Internship**

**Mode: Remote / Work From Home**

**Stipend: Unpaid**

**Working Hours: Flexible**

**Preferred Candidates: College Students**

**One Last Thing**

Dezainahub believe that finding the right opportunity is just as important as knowing how to close one.

We're looking for people who are
**curious enough to explore, smart enough to identify opportunities, and disciplined enough to execute consistently.**

If you're interested in understanding how businesses grow, how sales pipelines are built, and how opportunities turn into actual business, this is a good place to start.

**Come learn how businesses are built, one opportunity at a time.**

**Dezainahub — Built for brands that hate looking small.**

title: Meta Specialist
description:
Hands-on Specialist (Meta-focused)

Reports to: Performance Marketing Manager

Location: Gurugram, Haryana, India

Working Hours: US-aligned night shift · approx. 6:30pm – 3:30am IST

Type: Full-time

Role Overview

Maxima — parent company of Pro Standard — is hiring a hands-on Meta Specialist to be the daily build and test layer of our paid program. You'll spend most of your day inside Meta Ads Manager — building campaigns, refining audiences, managing creative variants, optimizing catalog ads, and monitoring performance. Your Manager directs the work; you execute it with speed and precision.

Working Hours Detail

US-aligned night shift · approx. 6:30pm – 3:30am IST

What You'll Own

• Daily campaign builds in Meta Ads Manager — taking direction from the Manager, executing the build, getting it ready for QA.

• Audience testing and refinement — lookalikes, interest-based, custom audiences, broad audiences. You know which to test when.

• Creative variant management — working with AI-generated variants, organizing them by angle, queueing rotation.

• Catalog ads and Dynamic Product Ads — especially for our priority styles and seasonal collections.

• Pixel and Conversion API health monitoring — flagging issues early.

• Daily QA on your own builds before sending to the Manager — catch your own mistakes first.

• Reporting on what shipped each day and what's queued for tomorrow.

Mindset for the Role

This role is about speed, precision, and curiosity on platform. We're looking for someone who:

• Loves being in Meta Ads Manager every day and knows it deeply.

• Catches small things — pixel mismatches, broken UTMs, audiences targeting the wrong list — before they ship.

• Stays current on Meta platform updates (the platform ships changes weekly and the team that wins is the team that adapts fastest).

• Tests systematically, documents results, and applies learning to the next build.

• Asks good questions when the brief isn't clear instead of guessing.

• Owns mistakes when they happen and applies the fix.

Working With AI

Maxima uses AI tools to generate ad creative variants, audience suggestions, and campaign structures. Your role is to assemble those outputs in the platform, validate them, and ship clean work. We're looking for someone who treats AI as a teammate that surfaces options, and who applies their own judgment on what to actually run.

Required Experience

• 2-4 years in paid media with a Meta specialization.

• Hands-on with Meta Ads Manager daily.

• Strong written English.

• Comfortable with AI tools producing variants — you assemble + validate.

• Detail-oriented with a track record of clean builds.

Nice to Have

• Apparel, sports, DTC, or licensed-goods category exposure.

• Catalog ads or Dynamic Product Ads deep expertise.

• Conversion API or server-side tracking experience.

Why This Role Matters

The volume of paid work — creative variants, audience tests, daily builds — is what scales the program. Without dedicated hands at this layer, the Manager becomes the bottleneck and the program slows. This role keeps the engine moving.

* Own collections end-to-end on your book chasing overdue invoices, resolving billing disputes, and working with Finance/AR to keep outstanding balances current and DSO in check.
* Handle the hard conversations at volume. This portfolio involves customers weighing competitors, raising product or billing concerns, or facing payment delays you'll be the person having those conversations, calmly and commercially, week in and week out.
* Proactively cultivate relationships with customers, ensuring their awareness of our product offerings and adoption of their current package.
* Identify upcoming renewals and maintain accurate account and payment status data within the CRM system.
* Develop quotes, manage administrative tasks, and oversee the execution of renewal contracts.
* Flag payment risk and churn risk early, and build recovery plans before either becomes a surprise.
* Feed what you're hearing from customers competitor moves, product gaps, payment friction back to leadership to shape our approach to the market.
* Run an accurate forecast which identifies outlook, best case scenarios, and risk, including collections status as part of that picture

**What You’ll Bring:**

* A Bachelor's degree or higher is required for this role.
* 3+ years in sales, renewals, or customer success, ideally SaaS including experience retaining customers in competitive or at-risk situations.
* Direct experience with collections or accounts receivable follow-up comfortable owning difficult payment conversations, not just renewal conversations.
* Comfort managing a varied portfolio across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise accounts, each with different stakeholders and different risk profiles.
* Exceptional organisational skills, emphasizing data accuracy and meticulous attention to detail.
* Customer-centric mindset, adept at engaging with customers and effectively addressing their concerns.
* A proactive approach to identifying and flagging upcoming renewals, payment risk, and potential issues before they arise.
* Strong communication skills to articulate renewal options clearly and collaborate effectively with Account Managers and customer success colleagues.
* Commercial acumen to spot risk early and ensure our services are evolving alongside our clients.
* Proficiency with CRM systems, ensuring the maintenance of accurate and up-to-date information. Salesforce experience is preferred.

**What We Offer:**

* Enjoy flexible paid time off for enhanced work-life balance.
* Meltwater demonstrates commitment to your well-being by contributing towards Discovery Health, ensuring robust healthcare coverage.
* Complimentary CalmApp subscription for you and your loved ones because mental wellness matters.
* Energetic work environment with a hybrid work style, providing the balance you need.
* Benefit from our family leave program, which grows with your tenure at Meltwater.
* Thrive within our inclusive community and seize ongoing professional development opportunities to elevate your career.

As Per Offer Letter

At Meltwater, we believe that when you have the right people in the right environment, great things happen. Our best-in-class technology empowers our

title: Patient Journey Partner - Oncology
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Patient Journey Partner-Oncology**
**Location: Delhi**
**The Position**
A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.
  
  
We are seeking candidates to join our team as Patient Journey Partner In this role, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on patient care by connecting Roche’s capabilities and resources to co-create solutions with key stakeholders involved in the patient journey. Your role is multifaceted, addressing diverse patient journey needs such as accelerating access to treatments, streamlining decision making. This role is locally embedded in the ecosystem, it is an integrated role, functionally agnostic, (i.e. it does not fit into the traditional concepts of Commercial/Sales or Medical Affairs). The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem.
  
  
**Your Opportunity**

* You will be responsible for end to end management of Top Therapy Area Expert relations and legitimate needs through right identification of challenges, belief, motivators
* You will be a one point of contact for top accounts of the state. You will be creating and executing strategies for the top public & private accounts, aligning with and support state teams for effective execution of the state strategies, so as to serve and maximize patients with Roche Innovations
* You will be building relationship with key decision makers in the account Identifying and resolving business issues in top accounts and Implement strategies and drive results for enhancing access to Roche innovations
* You will be leading collaboration in field through co-creation of solutions for key accounts

**Who You Are**

* You are someone who has a relevant graduate/ post graduate degree in Science. From an experience standpoint having more than 8 years’ experience with 4+ years in Oncology
* You must exhibit strong collaboration and networking skills, process orientation and alliance management

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
