title: Lifestyle Manager
description: About PinchThe last decade and a half has been dedicated to the rise of convenience in every way. Organisations, one after the other, have created products and services which make the life of customers convenient. Yet the pain, pressure and stress of the modern world has not really reduced, leave aside going away.At Pinch, our dream is to transform the physical environment of a family and help them create space for the truly important things, allowing them to focus on themselves and their mental well-being to build a meaningful life, filled with purpose and joy. We wish to build a home management system, which not only does the daily chores, seamlessly and effortlessly, but also preempts the needs of our customers, enhances their lifestyle in everyaspect while giving them the peace of mind to focus on achieving more in life. From full housekeeping to a quick tidy up or a dog walk, Pinch is available for the families all the time. We work as an extension of our customers’ family and bring to the table what is best for them.With our monthly plan, we combine services such as housekeeping, maintenance, food & nutrition management, grocery resupply, laundry management, etc. tailored to the unique needs of each family. On top, a dedicated Lifestyle Manager helps them with any miscellaneous home requests, from decorating home with fresh flowers to arranging a repairman for the broken washing machine, to planning details of the next holiday, taking care of children or the elderly. Basically, anything and everything our customers and their families would need to live a comfortable, convenient, healthy, guilt-free, and inspired life.How will we do it?There are three fundamental aspects of our business model which will help deliver this life-transforming service:Lifestyle Manager: Armed with irrefutable professional attention, prompt service, strict quality controls and effective anticipation of needs, our dedicated lifestyle team helps customers in a variety of things. Be it sending flowers on birthdays, reminders for paying bills on time, and even recommending the latest home products. Our team of lifestyle managers are mapped to each family, do all the research, analysis and short list the best products and service experience for the customers.Trained Professionals: Offering a much more professional service than domestic helpers, with Pinch, customers are served by a team of home specialists who will handle all the housework, chores and running around. If they already have a helper, we will have them trained by us to maximise their potential and effectiveness.Technology: We take the hassle out of home management. Customers are given constant home and personal management advice, reminders and nudges, where the back-end system incorporates an algorithm that remembers preferences and generates instructions to meet our customers’ home goals.Pinch has 4 broad customer segments:Individuals & FamiliesLandlords & Second Home OwnersDevelopers & RWAsCorporatesThe Lifestyle Manager – An Extension of the Customer’s FamilyA Lifestyle Manager at Pinch is deeply empathetic, has a natural attitude towards helping people and is committed to improving lives for the better. Every family has their own set of needs, wants, preferences & behaviours. Our Lifestyle Manager understands this, has the ability to develop a deep bond with a family & its members, and designs solutions keeping their specific requirements in mind. S/he is warm, courteous, patient & a good listener, with an eye for detail. S/he is able to not just solve for what the customer asks, but even anticipate or pre-empt their needs, through her/his deep understanding of the family. Our customer’s peace of mind relies immensely on the Lifestyle Manager, and how efficiently and swiftly s/he works with the other teams at Pinch to be able to meet the customer’s requirements. The Lifestyle Manager has a service-oriented mindset that puts the customer first, even before the company. Practically, s/he is an extension of the customer’s family & thus, the most important link between the company & the customer.Responsibilities of a Lifestyle Manager1. title: Paid Media Manager/ Senior Manager (Digital agency)
description:
A
**Digital Marketing agency**
is hiring for the profile of
**Paid Media Manager/ Senior Manager.**

**Location:**
Gurgaon

**Experience:**
4-7
years

**Major Responsibilities & Deliverables:**

**1. End-to-End Ownership of Client Portfolio**

* Own a portfolio of 5–6 clients across paid media and be accountable for their overall account health and performance.
* Have a clear understanding of each client's business objectives, media KPIs, budgets, funnel, target audiences and commercial priorities.
* Ensure every account has a clear performance plan, optimization roadmap and growth agenda.
* Maintain a daily pulse on account performance, identifying deviations, opportunities and risks before they become issues.
* Take ownership of performance outcomes rather than simply reporting numbers.

**2. Performance & Optimization**

* Drive performance across Google Ads, Meta, LinkedIn and other relevant paid media platforms.
* Monitor budgets, pacing, CPL/CPA/ROAS, conversion rates, lead quality, funnel movement and other relevant business KPIs.
* Go beyond platform metrics to understand lead → MQL → SQL → business outcome wherever applicable.
* Diagnose the root cause of performance issues and develop clear corrective action plans.
* Continuously identify opportunities for:

Campaign restructuring

Budget reallocation

Audience expansion

New platforms

New campaign formats

Automation

Experimentation

Creative testing

Landing-page optimization

Funnel optimization

* Ensure accounts are constantly evolving and are not being managed on a BAU/maintenance basis.

**3. Technical & Tracking Ownership**

* Own the technical health of paid media accounts.
* Ensure pixels, conversion tracking, events, audiences and platform integrations are correctly implemented and functioning.
* Work closely with analytics, technology, CRM and client teams on:

Meta Pixel / CAPI

Google Ads Conversion Tracking

GA4

Google Tag Manager

LinkedIn Insight Tag

Offline conversion imports

CRM integrations

Lead tracking

UTM governance

Attribution and funnel tracking

* Regularly conduct tracking and account-health audits.
* Identify discrepancies between platform, analytics and CRM data and drive resolution.
* Ensure tracking issues are identified proactively, rather than after performance has been impacted.

**4. Strategic Thinking & Proactiveness**

* Be the first person to identify an opportunity, not the person waiting for a brief.
* Bring new media ideas, platforms, formats, audiences, partnerships and technology opportunities to clients.
* Build proactive recommendations based on:

Market trends

Competitor activity

Search behavior

Platform developments

Audience insights

Performance data

Business priorities

* Challenge briefs constructively when the data indicates a different approach.
* Build quarterly/annual growth roadmaps for key accounts.
* Ensure every client has a pipeline of tests and innovations, rather than only optimization of existing campaigns.

**5. Client Management**

* Become a trusted paid-media partner for clients and not merely an execution contact.
* Lead regular performance discussions and translate data into clear business recommendations.
* Present performance, insights, challenges and action plans confidently to senior client stakeholders.
* Set the right expectations around performance, timelines, dependencies and outcomes.
* Proactively flag risks and communicate them with a solution, not just a problem.
* Identify opportunities to grow existing accounts through additional platforms, services or strategic interventions.

**6. Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor the paid media team working across the client pod.
* Plan and priorities the team's daily and weekly workload.
* Review campaign strategy, optimizations, reports and recommendations before they reach the client.
* Build strong ownership and accountability within the team.
* Identify capability gaps and coach team members on platform, analytical and strategic skills.
* Ensure quality, accuracy and timelines across all deliverables.
* Create a culture where the team thinks ahead rather than waits for instructions.

**Designation-Benefits Operations Manager (BOM)**
**Key Expectations**

* Own and manage overall operational performance for assigned client(s).
* Consistently meet or exceed contractual performance standards and SLAs.
* Ensure on time, high quality delivery of all ongoing work to plan sponsors and participants.
* Drive operational efficiency through process improvements and effective resource planning.
* Build strong client relationships and act as a trusted point of contact for clients and partners.
* Lead, coach, and develop team members to build a high performing operations team.

**Required Skills**

* Strong domain expertise in the US Pension / 401k Benefits Administration.
* Proven ability to manage SLAs, operational metrics, and client performance measures.
* Strong stakeholder management and client communication skills.
* Ability to lead teams, manage workloads, and drive capability building.
* Analytical and critical thinking
* Accountability and ownership

**Role Description**
The
**Benefits Operations Manager (BOM)**
is accountable for managing operational performance for assigned client(s), ensuring that contractual performance standards and defined operational measures are consistently met or exceeded. The role is responsible for ensuring all ongoing work is delivered on time and with high quality to plan sponsors and plan participants.
  
  
The BOM owns operational delivery for assigned clients, ensures process integrity and governance, manages escalations, and coordinates across teams, technology, and shared services. The role requires a strong understanding of client contractual agreements, client satisfaction, operational stability, change governance, and risk management, performance measures, and plan provisions, and being recognized as a subject matter expert in the domain.
  
  
The incumbent leads and manages BOA workloads, including work allocation, SLA tracking, SOP review, and approval, identifying training and cross training opportunities, and driving transitions to Shared Services where applicable. The role also partners closely with technology teams to ensure timely project completion, quality testing, and overall project signoff.
  
  
In addition, the BOM drives continuous improvement through process optimization, capacity, and resource planning, and delivers client specific operational training while fostering a culture of trust, collaboration, and coaching within the team.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Client & Operations Ownership
  
  

* Manage assigned benefits administration deliverables within defined SLAs (internal and external)
* Responsible for operations delivery for assigned clients in coordination with North America based colleagues
* Act as the client SME for complex, client‑specific requirements, processes, and interpretations
* Proactively identify operational risks and potential client‑facing issues and drive timely resolution

Escalation & Issue Management
  
  

* Act as escalation owner for client and participant issues
* Propose and take actions to resolve issues outside documented SOP scenarios
* Communicate with all stakeholders, significant risks or issues as required
* Create and ensure RCAs are completed, reviewed, and client ready
* Manage open defects in coordination with technology team members to ensure mitigation plans and impacted population cleanup are in place

SOPs & Governance
  
  

* Own and maintain SOPs for delivery processes
* Support governance for operational delivery quality

Projects
  
  

* Work with internal teams and clients to implement requirements for one‑time and ongoing projects with operational impact
* Coordinate with Technology Managers and internal teams to document requirements related to:
* Plan provisions
* Administrative events
* Data interfaces
* Delivery channels
* Partner with Client Technology Managers (CTM) for acceptance testing execution

Stakeholder Communication
  
  

* Maintain regular communication with delivery team colleagues (North America and India) and external clients to share operational insights, project progress, risks and mitigation plans
* Co-facilitate internal operational delivery discussions (North America & India) communicating status of delivery, risk, and work allocations for the team.

* Graduate

* Minimum 5 years of experience in US Pension / 401k Benefits Administration

title: Integrated Logistics Excellence Manager Performance
description:
**It's more than a job**
As a member of the Freight Forwarding team Kuehne+Nagel, you will play a key role in transporting goods, optimising processes, and fulfilling our customers' promises. And by transporting medicines, toys and important machine parts, you are not only delivering goods, you are making small and big moments possible for people all around the world. At Kuehne+Nagel, our contribution counts in more ways than we imagine.
  
  
‎
  
  
The IL Excellence Manager is responsible for driving operational excellence across the supply chain by managing LSP performance, ensuring compliance with SOPs and KPIs, and advancing digital integration through automation and real-time shipment visibility.
  
  
The role collaborates closely with internal stakeholders and external LSPs to support efficient operations, continuous improvement, and successful customer implementations.
  
  
**How you create impact**
LSP (3PL) Management
  
  

* Manage and oversee Logistics Service Providers (LSPs) to ensure service excellence
* Monitor supplier performance, drive continuous improvement, and manage escalations
* Support LSP onboarding, integration, SOP implementation, EDI, and digital initiatives
* Coordinate with customers, Control Towers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth operations
* Lead LSP training and change management during new implementations

Problem Solving
  
  

* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) to resolve operational issues affecting KPIs and service quality
* Identify process bottlenecks, analyze performance data, and implement corrective actions
* Monitor process deviations and troubleshoot system or data integration issues

Business Continuity & Hypercare
  
  

* Ensure BCP readiness and resolve critical supply chain disruptions during Hypercare

Freight Procurement
  
  

* Support transportation procurement, supplier management, and cost optimization

**What we would like you to bring**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience
* Strong background in 3PL/logistics operations
* Experience in transportation, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry
* Knowledge of reefer containers, GDP/GxP, and logistics data management
* Experience in LSP supplier management, including performance monitoring and escalation handling
* Candidates with an Operations Excellence Manager background may also be considered
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer who can translate user needs and product requirements into intuitive, engaging, and visually consistent digital experiences. You will work closely with the Product, Tech, and other cross-functional teams to design user interfaces, build interactive prototypes, improve usability, and ensure a seamless experience across devices and platforms. The ideal candidate has a strong eye for design, is highly proficient in Figma, and enjoys solving user and business problems through design.

**How you will make an impact:**

**Designing Visual Elements**

: 

* Creating engaging and visually consistent designs for user interfaces, including buttons, menus, icons, and layouts on figma.
* Ensuring alignment with brand guidelines, aesthetic principles, and accessibility standards.

**Prototyping**

: 

* Developing interactive prototypes to demonstrate the look and functionality of a design.
* Using tools like Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar to create mockups for review and testing.

**Collaboration with Teams**

:

* Working closely with the product and tech team, and other stakeholders to align design goals with user needs and technical constraints.
* Participating in brainstorming sessions and feedback loops to refine designs.

**Research and Analysis**

:

* Understanding target users, their needs, and preferences through collaboration with UX researchers or by reviewing analytics.
* Keeping up-to-date with design trends, technologies, and best practices.

**Ensuring Usability**

:

* Designing interfaces that are easy to navigate and accessible to a wide range of users, including those with disabilities.
* Ensuring responsive designs that work seamlessly across different devices and screen sizes.

**Testing and Iteration**

:

* Conducting or collaborating in usability testing to gather feedback on interface designs.
* Iterating designs based on test results, user feedback, and team input.

**Handoff to Developers**

:

* Preparing design assets and specifications for developers to ensure seamless implementation.
* Collaborating during development to address any design-related issues or questions.

**Maintaining Design Systems**

:

* Developing or contributing to a design system to ensure consistency across products and platforms.
* Updating and managing a repository of reusable design components.

**We are looking for people who:**

* 1–3 years of experience in UI/UX, Product Design, or a similar role.
* Strong proficiency in Figma and experience creating high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes.
* Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, user flows, wireframing, prototyping, and responsive design.
* Experience designing for web and mobile applications.
* Good understanding of usability, accessibility, and design best practices.
* Experience working closely with Product and Engineering/Tech teams.
* Strong visual design skills with excellent attention to detail.
* Ability to understand complex requirements and convert them into simple, intuitive user experiences.
* Experience working with or contributing to design systems and component libraries.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* A portfolio demonstrating relevant UI/UX and product design work is mandatory.

description:

Gurugram(Work From Office)

Senior Product Designer

**Experience Level:**
5+ Years of crafting great user experience and driving innovation

Beauty B2C

**Know about the company**

India’s largest beauty and wellness destination with more than half a million happy customers. Design at Nykaa welcomes candidates with diverse backgrounds, expertise, and perspectives. It offers opportunities for constant learning with fun and interactive sessions. It is a place where you’d feel welcomed and can contribute your skills and expertise to help build the business growth. We are committed to the safety and well-being of our employees, vendors, and clients.

**Life at Nykaa Design: Where Style, Meets Strategy ✨**

Imagine vibrant hues of creativity, collaborative spirits that thrive on trust, and an unending bank of ideas that’s every day at Nykaa Design. We are a tight bunch of progressive youth making beauty and fashion accessible to all through user-first experiences. We don’t just accept your unique style; we celebrate it! Whether it’s fun interactive sessions or working as a collective to build exceptional shopping journeys, Nykaa Design is a place where every member is an equal and every voice matters.

**The Role: Creative, Visionary & Pragmatic Problem-Solver**

As a Staff/Lead Product Designer, you aren’t just designing screens; you are setting the long-term vision for our digital products. As you stand as a custodian for our consumers, keeping your views in front of leaders within the org. You’ll also be the guardian to the team enriching, defending, challenging and ensuring delivery. While we revolutionize how the world learns and shops beauty.

**What You’ll Do: Lead, Innovate, & Elevate**

Innovate & Elevate: Stay on top of design trends and emerging technologies, bringing fresh ideas that push the boundaries of user experience on B2C platforms.

**Product Design Execution/Ownership:**

* Own product experiences in certain pod structures, from early concepts and user flows to final execution and launch.
* Define design direction for key product areas and ensure a clear, consistent experience across multiple touchpoints while advocating for users and balancing customer needs with business goals and technical constraints.
* Solving complex user and business problems by turning insights, data, and customer needs into simple, effective experiences.

**Functional Ownership:**

* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and other teams. Influence product decisions beyond visual design and help teams make clear, user-focused decisions.
* Identify opportunities to improve the overall customer experience across the product ecosystem.
* Lead and mentor designers, helping them grow their craft, product thinking, and ownership by setting clear design standards and ways of working across the team.
* Provide thoughtful feedback, challenge ideas constructively, and help designers make stronger decisions.
* Foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where designers can experiment, take ownership, and do their best work. Raise the overall quality and maturity of the design practice through better processes, principles, and collaboration.

**Who You Are**

* You have 5+ years of experience designing compelling user experiences for B2C platforms.
* You are a systems thinker who sees the larger ecosystem, not just isolated features.
* You possess the psychological power to place yourself in the user's shoes and a highly refined aesthetic sense.
* You are opinionated, able to give constructive feedback, and passionate about establishing a perspective behind design decisions.

**Why You’ll Love It Here**

**Unparalleled Ownership:**
Freedom to take initiative and make mistakes so we can learn together.

**Learning Playground:**
Constant learning, regular sync-ups, and a transparent, feedback-positive environment.

**Celebration & Support:**
Timely celebrations to acknowledge success and leaders who are approachable and eager to support you.

**How Our Team Looks**

We’re a close-knit team of designers, researchers, writers, visual designers. These are super creative minds from different backgrounds and cultures. Different perspectives, one shared love for making things better for our users. We brainstorm, debate, experiment, obsess over details, and occasionally ask, “But what if we tried this?” Our intrapreneurial culture gives us the space to explore ideas, solve tricky problems, and build experiences people love.

**Different disciplines. One team. Lots of ideas.**

**🎨Product Designers**

We turn “this could be better” into “this feels effortless.” Our Product Designers work across Nykaa’s products, making complex things feel simple, intuitive, and delightful. They think about the big picture, sweat the small stuff, and keep iterating until the experience feels just right.

**🔍UX Research**

We’re curious. Very curious. Our UX Researchers dig into what customers do, need, think, and sometimes don’t say. Their insights help us uncover opportunities, challenge assumptions, and make better product decisions.

**✍️UX Writing**

Yes, we really do debate one word. Our UX Writers make sure Nykaa’s products don’t just look good, they sound good too. From tiny bits of microcopy to larger content experiences, they turn complex moments into clear, helpful, and human ones.

**⚙️Design Operations**

Someone has to keep all the creative chaos moving. Design Operations makes it easier for everyone to do their best work. They think about tools, workflows, collaboration, learning, and culture basically, all the things that help a design team run smoothly.

**✨Product Visual Design**

Product Visual Design, Illustration & Motion The team that makes us stop and say, “Ooh, nice.” They bring personality to Nykaa through colour, type, illustration, animation, and all the little details in between. They collaborate with Product Designers to turn ideas into experiences that are polished, expressive, and unmistakably Nykaa.

title: Sr Java Developer
description:
**About Us**

Vecton is an AI-first technology partner dedicated exclusively to financial institutions. Unlike conventional IT consultancies, we go deep into finance. We design, build, and deploy AI-enabled solutions that span lending, trading, insurance, credit management, reconciliation, and wealth management.

What sets us apart is our ability to combine deep domain specialization with execution speed. We don't deliver pilots. We deliver production-ready systems that accelerate digital transformation while meeting the strictest compliance and regulatory standards.

We are guided by a clear set of values: speed with precision, domain depth in financial institutions, trust and compliance, partnerships over vendors, an AI-first mindset, and continuous improvement.

Our motto: Transform Businesses with Technology and AI.

**About the Role**

As a Java Developer – AI Projects (Client Site), you will be Vecton's engineering presence embedded within the client's environment. You will own the build and delivery of AI-enabled systems inside a regulated financial institution.

Our central team designs and architects AI solutions for complex financial use cases. Your job is to turn those designs into production-grade Java and Python services that run reliably inside the client's stack. They will be integrated with the client's core systems, released through the client's pipelines, and compliant with the client's security controls.

This is a forward-deployed, high-ownership role. You will report to Vecton's central engineering team, with a dotted-line accountability to the client's technical leadership.

**What will you do**

* Build and ship production-grade Java / Spring Boot services that expose, orchestrate, and integrate AI capabilities, including LLM calls and multi-agent workflows.
* Build and ship Python-based AI services (FastAPI, agent/RAG pipelines) alongside Java services, and define clean contracts between the two.
* Own delivery from development and code review through build, release, and post-deployment support.
* Work within the client's CI/CD pipelines and release governance, and handle configuration and secrets as per their standards.
* Add basic logging and metrics to your services, and drive RCA and permanent fixes for production issues.
* Identify manual, repetitive work in the client's engineering and business processes and automate it.
* Build integrations between AI systems and existing client applications, databases, message queues, and APIs, including core banking / LOS / LMS / CRM systems where applicable.
* Provide technical inputs to solution design and effort estimation for new scope within the account.
* Run technical walkthroughs and PoC demos that build client confidence.
* Actively use AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Copilot or equivalent) to accelerate delivery and improve code quality.

**What we are looking for**

* 3–5 years of hands-on software development experience, with Java as the primary language.
* Strong command of Java 11/17+, Spring Boot, Spring Data, dependency injection, and multithreading/concurrency fundamentals.
* Proven experience designing and building RESTful APIs and microservices. You should be comfortable with JSON, API contracts, versioning, and error handling.
* Solid SQL and RDBMS experience (Oracle / PostgreSQL / MySQL), and familiarity with message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ, or equivalent).
* Build and dependency tooling (Maven or Gradle), plus unit and integration testing (JUnit, Mockito).
* Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and/or traditional app server deployments (Tomcat, WebLogic).
* Working knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, RAG, and agentic AI concepts.
* **Python (working proficiency):**

  building and deploying AI services (FastAPI/Flask), LLM API integration, RAG, vector stores, and agent frameworks (LangChain/LangGraph or similar).
* Experience integrating LLM APIs into services, via Python AI services or Java-native frameworks (Spring AI, LangChain4j).
* Genuine curiosity about the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape and the initiative to keep pace with it.

**Good to have**

* **Golang:**

  experience building high-throughput or concurrent services, gRPC.
* Exposure to BFSI systems (LOS/LMS/core banking), RBI/DPDPA-aware design, and audit/data-masking patterns.
* Observability tooling (Grafana/Prometheus, ELK, OpenTelemetry), Jenkins/GitLab CI.

title: Demand Generation Manager - Fleet Partnerships
description:
**Company Description:**

Zynetic is a technology-first EV charging infrastructure company delivering intelligent, reliable, and scalable solutions for the future of mobility. With a global mindset and presence across India, UAE, and Singapore, the company focuses on innovating software, AI, and operational intelligence for large-scale EV charging networks.

Zynetic designs, deploys, operates, and manages EV charging ecosystems for fleets, public charging networks, hospitality, real estate, commercial hubs, and mobility operators. At the core of the business is the Zynetic Tech Platform, a software-driven intelligence layer built from extensive experience in charger operations, site execution, fault diagnosis, customer support, and network management.

**About the role:**

We’re hiring a Demand Generation Manager to fill our charging network with fleet demand. You’ll own the full fleet lifecycle — bringing fleet operators onto the network, getting them charging in their first 30 days, and keeping them active and growing month after month.

**What you’ll do:**

1. **Build the fleet pipeline:**
   Identify and target fleet operators. Run outbound campaigns and partnerships to generate qualified fleet leads.
2. **Onboard fleet accounts:**
   Own onboarding end to end - contracts, app/RFID setup, driver/ fleet account activation. Train fleet managers and drivers on charging and support processes.
3. **Retain and grow accounts:**
   Act as the single point of contact for fleet accounts; run regular check-ins and quarterly business reviews. Track account health (sessions, kWh, active vehicles, payment status) and step in early when usage drops. Resolve escalations on charger downtime, queues, billing and driver experience with ops and support. Grow existing accounts by adding vehicles, new locations and longer-term commitments.
4. **Drive charger utilization:**
   Monitor utilization by hub and charger; identify under-used sites and time slots. Fill idle capacity through targeted fleet placement.
5. **Reporting:**
   Report weekly on pipeline, onboarding, retention and utilization to leadership.

**What you’ll bring:**

* 2–5 years in B2B sales, demand generation, key account management or customer success.
* Experience selling to or managing fleet operators, logistics companies, or mobility/EV businesses.
* A track record of owning a number — revenue, retention or usage — and moving it.
* Comfort with data: you can read a utilization dashboard, spot a drop in usage and act on it.
* Strong negotiation and relationship skills with fleet owners, ops heads and procurement teams.
* Willingness to travel occasionally and spend time on the ground at depots, hubs and charging sites.
* Working knowledge of CRM tools (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce) and Excel/Google Sheets.
* Fluency in English and Hindi; a regional language is a plus.

**Nice to have:**

* Background in EV charging, energy or fleet electrification.
* Experience with fleet telematics or charge management platforms.
* An existing network among fleet aggregators, OEMs or leasing companies.

**What we offer:**

* A high-ownership role shaping how fleets use our charging network.
* Competitive salary
* Direct exposure to leadership.

title: Business Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced and highly connected
**Business Manager**
to drive revenue for our creator roster. This role will own the end-to-end business function for assigned creators by managing inbound brand opportunities, securing outbound partnerships, negotiating high-value deals, and building long-term relationships with brands and agencies.

The ideal candidate is deeply embedded in the creator economy and already has an established network across leading brands, media agencies, influencer marketing agencies, and marketing decision-makers. They should be capable of bringing business opportunities through existing relationships while continuously expanding the network.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Brand Partnerships & Revenue Growth**

* Own the revenue growth of assigned creators.
* Manage and close all inbound brand collaboration opportunities.
* Identify, pitch, and secure new outbound business opportunities for creators.
* Develop annual and quarterly monetization strategies for creators.
* Maximize creator earnings through campaigns, long-term retainers, ambassadorships, events, affiliate partnerships, licensing, and IP collaborations.

**Business Development**

* Leverage existing relationships with brands, agencies, and marketing leaders to generate business opportunities.
* Build a consistent outbound sales pipeline through networking, referrals, cold outreach, LinkedIn, industry events, and strategic partnerships.
* Represent the agency and creators in client meetings, pitches, and industry events.
* Build long-term partnerships that result in repeat business.

**Commercial Negotiation**

* Lead negotiations on commercials, deliverables, exclusivity, usage rights, timelines, and contracts.
* Ensure commercially strong deals while maintaining healthy client and creator relationships.
* Collaborate with internal operations and campaign teams to ensure seamless execution.

**Creator Management**

* Act as the primary business advisor for creators.
* Identify growth opportunities aligned with each creator's niche and audience.
* Guide creators on positioning, pricing, and brand-fit opportunities.
* Build long-term trust with creators by consistently driving business growth.

**Reporting**

* Track sales pipeline, revenue targets, deal closures, conversion rates, and repeat business.
* Maintain accurate CRM records and business forecasts.
* Monitor industry trends and identify emerging opportunities.

**Requirements**

* 2–7+ years of experience in Business Development, Brand Partnerships, Talent Management, Influencer Marketing, or Media Sales.
* Must possess a strong, existing network within the creator economy, including direct relationships with leading brands, media agencies, influencer marketing agencies, and marketing decision-makers.
* Demonstrated ability to independently source and close high-value brand partnerships.
* Strong commercial acumen with exceptional negotiation and relationship management skills.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management abilities.
* Self-motivated, target-driven, and comfortable owning revenue goals.

**Ideal Candidate**

The ideal candidate should:

* Already be well-known within the creator ecosystem.
* Have an active network that can immediately contribute to business generation.
* Understand the influencer marketing landscape across categories and platforms.
* Be confident pitching creators to CMOs, brand managers, and agency leaders.
* Thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and take complete ownership of creator revenue.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Revenue generated per creator.
* Number and value of inbound deals closed.
* Outbound business generated.
* New brands acquired.
* Repeat business from existing clients.
* Average deal size.
* Creator revenue growth.
* Client retention and satisfaction.
* Sales pipeline conversion rate.

title: Business Manager – Vinyl Records, Turntables & Partnerships
description:
**Company Description**
Mallar Media Ventures (MMV) is shaping India’s vinyl culture for listeners who grew up streaming but want to own the music that matters to them. The company collaborates with leading production houses in India and internationally to press premium vinyl editions of iconic soundtracks and songs. MMV operates at the intersection of music, physical media, and India’s analog revival, serving collectors and music lovers who choose vinyl as a meaningful way to celebrate their favorite tracks. Headquartered in Greater Noida, India, MMV focuses on turning digital listening habits into lasting, tangible music experiences.

About the role

MMV (Mallar Media Ventures) is building a premium music-and-entertainment products business, from vinyl records to high-end audio. We need a hands-on sales professional who can open doors with premium retailers, audio brands and corporate partners, and turn those conversations into revenue.

This is a field-first, relationship-led role. You will own your region targets, find and close tie-ups and collaborations, and bring back market intelligence that shapes what we build and sell next.

Key responsibilities

**Sales and revenue**

•        Own sales targets for vinyl records, turntables, high-end speakers, audio gadgets and allied products in your assigned city.

•        Build and manage a pipeline of premium retailers, audio and lifestyle stores, e-commerce partners and corporate gifting buyers.

•        Run product demos and listening sessions that show how a record sounds on a good turntable and speakers.

•        Track orders, collections and repeat business; keep CRM and weekly reports current.

**Tie-ups and collaborations**

•        Identify, pitch and close tie-ups with hotels, cafes, studios, lifestyle brands, music platforms, artists and corporate houses.

•        Co-create collaborations such as co-branded editions, in-store experiences, listening events and gifting programs with the marketing team.

•        Negotiate commercial terms and hand over signed deals with clear deliverables.

**Market and brand**

•        Represent MMV at trade shows, music events and premium retail activations in your city.

•        Report competitor pricing, new launches and customer feedback every month.

•        Work closely with marketing, operations and the corporate office in Greater Noida so every deal is delivered on time.

Requirements

**Must have**

•        4–5 years of B2B or B2C sales experience, ideally in premium audio, lifestyle, music or entertainment.

•        Proven record of meeting targets and closing partnerships, tie-ups or brand collaborations.

•        Based in, or willing to be based in, Delhi & NCR, Bangalore, Mumbai or Kolkata, with a strong local network.

•        Comfortable travelling within the city and region, and working Monday to Saturday.

•        Graduate in any discipline; an MBA or sales diploma is a plus.

•        Fluent in English and Hindi; the local language of the region is a plus.

**Good to have**

•        Good understanding of music, vinyl records and turntables, which is a strong advantage for this role.

•        Existing contacts with record stores, audiophile stores, hi-fi retailers, hospitality brands, artists or music communities.

•        Experience with CRM tools and basic Excel reporting.

Who will do well here

•        Confident communicator who can hold a room with a store owner, a hotel GM or a brand head.

•        Self-driven and comfortable owning a target without a team around you.

•        Curious about music and sound, and able to explain why a premium product is worth its price.

•        Organized on follow-ups, documentation and reporting.

What we offer

•        A fixed salary with performance-linked incentives (to be discussed at interview).

•        Travel and communication support as per company policy.

•        A chance to build the premium audio and vinyl business in your city from the ground up.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on a partnership or tie-up you have closed to the HR contact, with your preferred city in the subject line. Contact : sales@mallarmediaventures.com, sachin@mallarmediaventures.com

Women candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. MMV is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Sr. Product Designer- Experience Design
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
**ESIGN@LILLY | EXPERIENCE DESIGN**
**Sr. Product Designer - Experience Design | 3-5 years**
Eli Lilly is a global healthcare leader that unites caring with discovery to create medicines that make life better for people around the world. We’re leveraging cutting-edge technologies and innovative platforms to develop next-generation therapeutic ecosystems, connected devices, data, and analytics to transform patient experiences and improve treatment outcomes.
  
  
As a member of Design at Lilly within the Digital Office, you will be at the forefront of crafting intuitive, accessible, and impactful digital experiences. We work across every function of the organization, applying design thinking to solve complex challenges and create meaningful solutions for patients, healthcare professionals, and the people who care for them. Our team combines user insight with design expertise to ensure the human element is at the core of everything we build.
  
  
**Path/Level**
R3
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Experience Designer at Lilly, you will spend most of your time in the problem space — defining flows, validating ideas with users, and shaping how experiences work before they are built. At Lilly, that means your work has real stakes: the people on the other end of your screens are patients, caregivers, and the scientists trying to help them.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
Great design at Lilly starts here. These are the responsibilities we will expect from you:
  
  

* Elevate and maintain design standards through direct contribution across a wide range of outputs and mediums, from digital products to patient-facing experiences.
* Understand component-based design systems and know when to follow existing patterns and when to break constraints.
* Present and persuasively communicate design rationale at all levels, incorporate feedback constructively, and build trust with collaborators across the organization.
* Demonstrate accountability, flexibility, and initiative, with the ability to prioritize and deliver results efficiently.
* Embrace a learning and growth mindset, stay current on industry trends and tools, and contribute positively to a culture of critique, collaboration, and honest reflection at Design@Lilly.
* Produce polished, independent work across UX from research synthesis through delivery.
* Reframe ambiguous briefs, identify the real design opportunity, and build alignment before execution begins.
* Begin informally mentoring junior designers through critique and shared working sessions.

**What You Will Bring**

* 3+ years of experience in UX for digital products and experiences.
* A collaborative spirit and the ability to build strong working relationships and navigate conflict constructively with peers and partners.
* A degree in Design (Digital Design, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, Human-Computer Interaction, or related field) or equivalent practical experience.
* An exceptional portfolio of design work spanning multiple projects and mediums, with a focus on interface or screen-based experiences.
* Demonstrable experience identifying and addressing user pain points, synthesizing research, and advocating for user-centered design.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to make complex ideas clear and actionable for a broad range of collaborators.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills paired with a high level of intellectual curiosity and a passion for innovation in digital health.

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form (https://careers.lilly.com/us/en/workplace-accommodation) for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.
  
  
Lilly does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

title: UX Designer
description:
Join Xurrent, where our AI-driven Operations Management platform powers the way modern enterprises manage and evolve their service delivery. We’re looking for curious, driven individuals who want to make a real impact and grow with a company leading the next wave of service and operations innovation.

**Mission of the position**

Xurrent, Inc. (“Xurrent”) designates a UX Designer. The UX Designer joins the product team and reports to the Lead UX Designer. Your mission is to design intuitive, user-centered experiences for Xurrent’s products and to strengthen the design practice the team has already established. Reporting to the Lead UX Designer, you will you will take features from discovery to implementation and help evolve our product, design system and processes.

**Responsibilities**

* Design user interfaces and experiences that are intuitive, visually appealing and aligned with user expectations.
* Follow and help improve the team’s design processes, fostering collaboration, creativity and user-centered practices.
* Collaborate closely with the Lead UX Designer, Head of Product, product managers, engineers and other stakeholders to understand user needs, business goals and technical constraints.
* Translate the product and design strategy set by the Lead UX Designer and Head of Product into concrete designs.
* Drive assigned design projects from concept to implementation, doing hands-on design work throughout.
* Conduct user research, usability testing and analysis to inform design decisions and improvements.
* Contribute to and maintain design guidelines, patterns and the design system to ensure consistency and quality.
* Collaborate with UI front-end engineers to ensure accurate, high-quality implementation of design concepts and proposals.
* Present and explain design work to stakeholders, and give and receive constructive design feedback within the team.
* Stay informed about industry trends, best practices and emerging design technologies.

**Distinguishing Characteristics**

* Solid experience in user experience design, with a portfolio showcasing successful projects.
* Attention to detail and a passion for creating intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces.
* Proficiency in design and prototyping tools (e.g., Figma, Sketch, Adobe XD) and experience working within a design system.
* Familiarity with user research methodologies and usability testing.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain design concepts to non-designers.
* Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively within a design team and in cross-functional teams.
* Self-motivated and proactive, with a willingness to take ownership of design tasks.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a creative approach to design challenges.
* Openness to feedback and a continuous improvement mindset.

**Important Notice: Beware of Recruitment Scams**

We have been made aware of fraudulent job offers being circulated under Xurrent’s name. Please note that only communications from verified recruiters using emails ending in "@xurrent.com" are official. 
  
If you receive unsolicited job offers, interview requests, or messages that seem suspicious, please exercise caution and do not share personal information or make any payments. Please note that Xurrent does not issue job offers without an application and interview process. Only candidates who successfully complete the interview process may receive an offer letter. We're actively addressing this and appreciate your help in staying alert and helping us protect our community.

**Statement of Equal Opportunity**

Xurrent is an equal opportunity employer. We’re committed to creating an inclusive environment for all our employees, where different backgrounds and perspectives are valued and encouraged - regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

As a Staff Product Designer at Lilly, you will work across the full arc of design delivery, from making sense of research and shaping the problem, to crafting the interactions, nailing the visual execution, and getting it across the finish line with engineering and product. At Lilly, that means your work has real stakes: the people on the other end of your screens are patients, caregivers, and the scientists trying to help them.

Great design at Lilly starts here. These are the responsibilities we will expect from you:
  
  

* Elevate and maintain design standards through direct contribution across a wide range of outputs and mediums, from digital products to patient-facing experiences.

* Drive cross-functional alignment on design direction across a product area.
* Shape team culture through critique leadership, mentorship, and active contribution to Design@Lilly practices.

* Contribute to design system adoption and collaborate closely with product and engineering to bring work across the finish line.

**What You Will Bring**

* 5+ years of experience in product, UX, or visual design for digital products and experiences.
* An exceptional portfolio of design work spanning multiple projects and mediums, with a focus on interface or screen-based experiences.
* A degree in Design (Digital Design, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, Human-Computer Interaction, or related field) or equivalent practical experience.

* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to make complex ideas clear and actionable for a broad range of collaborators.

title: Senior Product Designer II
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
**The Opportunity**
You'll be designing with more human behavior data than almost anywhere else on the planet.
  
  
At Nielsen, we measure how billions of people watch, listen, and buy across the globe. As a Senior Product Designer II, you'll help build the design vision for major product lines and platforms, turning this huge, complex dataset into products that media professionals, advertisers, and agencies rely on for critical business decisions.
  
  
You'll work on problems where neither the question nor the answer is defined yet. What should cross-media measurement look like three years from now? How do we bring a fragmented product suite into one coherent experience? Which initiatives move the business, and which ones should we stop?
  
  
If you love shaping product direction, solving the hardest design problems, and raising the bar for the people around you, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Build the design vision for major product lines**
Set the direction for entire products or platforms, not just features. Your work connects user needs to business outcomes and shapes design standards across Nielsen.
  
  
**Solve The Problems Others Struggle With**
Lead core architectural changes, redesigns of critical flows, and high-priority initiatives where craft has to hold up under pressure. Work at the tactical and strategic level at the same time, across several projects.
  
  
**Set research strategy for ambiguous problems**
Decide which questions need answering and which methods fit, then guide the team through the work. Use behavioral data and research to shape product direction and fill gaps in what partners know.
  
  
**Influence the roadmap**
Negotiate trade-offs between Product, Engineering, and Design. Build data-backed cases for design-led initiatives that change priorities at the leadership level, and say so clearly when a project is high-effort but low-outcome.
  
  
**Evolve our design system**
Bring new patterns and help make governance decisions for the design system used across Nielsen's global products. Know when to go beyond the system, and be able to explain why.
  
  
**Grow the team around you**
Mentor designers, run workshops and design jams, and advocate for your teammates' growth. Improve how design works with other functions, from handoffs to sprint planning.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**What You Bring**
**You think in systems and business outcomes**
You understand the P&L and the competitive landscape, and you can explain how a design decision affects retention, LTV, conversion, or differentiation. You look for root causes: when the same mistakes keep happening, you fix the process that's causing them.
  
  
**You thrive in strategic ambiguity**
You're comfortable when both the problem and the solution are undefined. You run discovery that defines new product directions, and you create frameworks that help others work through uncertainty. You can make high-stakes calls with incomplete information.
  
  
**Your craft is a reference point**
Your work is detailed, handles edge cases thoroughly, and is used as an example for the team. You use high-quality prototypes and clear storytelling to get executives and partners behind an idea.
  
  
**You lead without a title**
You act as a design leader with or without formal authority. You build alignment among stakeholders with competing priorities and take ownership of outcomes beyond your own team.
  
  
**You've designed for complexity at scale**
Your portfolio shows dashboards, enterprise tools, or analytics platforms where you owned the direction, not just the screens. You can talk about sampling, statistical significance, and data pipelines with data scientists and engineers.
  
  
**You Keep Learning And Help Others Learn**
You follow emerging technologies like AI and what they mean for design, you're open to contrarian views, and you encourage experimentation and learning from failure.
  
  
**7+ years of experience**
Including significant time leading design for complex products. Experience with data-heavy or enterprise products is a strong plus. Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, or equivalent professional experience (formal education not required).
  
  
**Strong portfolio**
Show us how you shaped direction on ambiguous problems, the trade-offs you negotiated, and the measurable business impact of your work.
  
  
**Proficiency in design tools**
Expert in Figma and prototyping tools. You build advanced prototypes that feel like the real product.
  
  
**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Staff Product Designer
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
DESIGN@LILLY | PRODUCT DESIGN
  
  
Staff Product Designer | 5-7 years
  
  
Eli Lilly is a global healthcare leader that unites caring with discovery to create medicines that make life better for people around the world. We’re leveraging cutting-edge technologies and innovative platforms to develop next-generation therapeutic ecosystems, connected devices, data, and analytics to transform patient experiences and improve treatment outcomes.
  
  
As a member of Design at Lilly within the Digital Office, you will be at the forefront of crafting intuitive, accessible, and impactful digital experiences. We work across every function of the organization, applying design thinking to solve complex challenges and create meaningful solutions for patients, healthcare professionals, and the people who care for them. Our team combines user insight with design expertise to ensure the human element is at the core of everything we build.
  
  
Path/Level
  
R4
  
  
ABOUT THE ROLE
  
As a Staff Product Designer at Lilly, you will work across the full arc of design delivery, from making sense of research and shaping the problem, to crafting the interactions, nailing the visual execution, and getting it across the finish line with engineering and product. At Lilly, that means your work has real stakes: the people on the other end of your screens are patients, caregivers, and the scientists trying to help them.
  
  
CORE RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Great design at Lilly starts here. These are the responsibilities we will expect from you:
  
  

* Elevate and maintain design standards through direct contribution across a wide range of outputs and mediums, from digital products to patient-facing experiences.
* Bring attention to detail and a passion for all aspects of design including typography, motion, copy, composition and art direction.
* Understand component-based design systems and know when to follow existing patterns and when to break constraints.
* Present and persuasively communicate design rationale at all levels, incorporate feedback constructively, and build trust with collaborators across the organization.
* Demonstrate accountability, flexibility, and initiative, with the ability to prioritize and deliver results efficiently.
* Embrace a learning and growth mindset, stay current on industry trends and tools, and contribute positively to a culture of critique, collaboration, and honest reflection at Design@Lilly.
* Set the craft standard for the team, producing sophisticated work others reference and build from.
* Drive cross-functional alignment on design direction across a product area.
* Shape team culture through critique leadership, mentorship, and active contribution to Design@Lilly practices.
* Deliver high-quality UI and UX work across features, flows, and system-driven experiences.
* Contribute to design system adoption and collaborate closely with product and engineering to bring work across the finish line.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in product, UX, or visual design for digital products and experiences.
* An exceptional portfolio of design work spanning multiple projects and mediums, with a focus on interface or screen-based experiences.
* A degree in Design (Digital Design, Interaction Design, Visual Communication, Human-Computer Interaction, or related field) or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills paired with a high level of intellectual curiosity and a passion for innovation in digital health.
* Outstanding verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to make complex ideas clear and actionable for a broad range of collaborators.
* A collaborative spirit and the ability to build strong working relationships and navigate conflict constructively with peers and partners.
* Demonstrable experience identifying and addressing user pain points, synthesizing research, and advocating for user-centered design.
* For Visual Designers: Deep understanding of foundational design principles with excellent command of type, grid, composition, and color.

title: Specialist, Marketing Production Design
description:
At SEI, we value our employees and believe in driving growth through change. As part of our global expansion, we are building a Global Capability Center (GCC) in Hyderabad, India, to scale core marketing execution and production capabilities in support of global teams. We are seeking a Specialist, Marketing Production Design to support the creation, adaptation, and production of marketing assets across digital and campaign channels.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role, well suited for an early‑career designer who is detail‑oriented, eager to learn, and interested in developing strong production and execution skills within a global marketing environment. The role works closely with creative, content, digital, and marketing operations teams and will be part of a small, growing marketing team in Hyderabad, reporting to an onsite marketing manager.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Produce and adapt marketing design assets across digital channels, including paid media, website visuals, presentations, and campaign materials, following established brand and design standards.
* Execute production design work by resizing, formatting, and versioning assets for multiple channels and specifications.
* Support campaign and content launches by preparing creative assets for delivery to digital, web, and marketing operations teams.
* Partner with Content Enablement, Digital Campaign Execution, and Web/CMS teams to ensure design assets align with messaging, layout, and channel requirements.
* Perform quality assurance (QA) on creative assets to ensure brand consistency, accuracy, accessibility awareness, and readiness for deployment.
* Maintain organized design files and documentation, following naming conventions and version control standards.
* Support ongoing process improvements and playbooks related to marketing production workflows as the GCC scales.

**What We Need From You**

* 1–3 years of experience in graphic design, production design, or marketing creative execution (agency or in‑house).
* Hands‑on experience with common design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop) or equivalent.
* Understanding of digital asset requirements across channels (paid media, web, presentations, email, video, etc.).
* Strong attention to detail and ability to execute against established brand guidelines and templates.
* Comfort working in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment with multiple stakeholders and deadlines.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Digital Media, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

**Nice To Have / Growth Opportunity**

* Exposure to B2B marketing assets or enterprise brand systems.
* Basic familiarity with accessibility considerations (color contrast, legibility) and digital best practices.
* Interest in growing into broader or more senior creative, UX, or digital design roles over time.

**SEI’s competitive advantage**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including comprehensive care for your physical and mental well-being, hybrid working environment and a work-life balance that enables you to relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
Our benefits include Medical Insurance, Term Life Insurance, Voluntary Provident Fund, 10 Predefined Holidays and 2 Floating Holidays in a year, Paid Time off and more.
  
  
We are a technology and asset management company delivering on our promise of building brave futures—for our clients, our communities, and ourselves. Come build your brave future at SEI.
  
  
The position title reflected in this job description is aligned with SEI's current internal job architecture. As part of SEI's role and career framework, internal job titles may not directly correspond to external market titles and may differ from titles previously assigned during an employee's tenure or at the time of hire.
  
  
**SEI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and so much more…**
After 50 years in business, SEI is a leading global provider of investment processing, investment management, and investment operations solutions. Reflecting our experience within financial services and financial technology our offices encompass an open floor plan and numerous art installations designed to encourage innovation and creativity in our workforce. We recognize that our people are our most valuable asset and that a healthy, happy, and motivated workforce is key to our continued growth. At SEI, we’re (literally) invested in your success. We offer our employees paid parental leave, paid volunteer days, professional development assistance and access to thriving employee networks.
  
  
**AI Acceptable Use In The Application And Interview Process**
SEI acknowledges the growing integration of artificial intelligence (AI) tools into individuals’ personal and professional lives. If you intend to incorporate the use of any AI tools at any stage of the application and/or interview process, please ensure you have reviewed and adhere to our AI use guidelines.

title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
**At Aragen,**

**Digital Marketing Manager**
to own our digital ecosystem across website, search, paid media, email, webinars, marketing technology, lead management, analytics and AI.

Build integrated digital programs aligned with Aragen’s brand, commercial and demand-generation priorities.

Own the customer journey from digital discovery and engagement to lead qualification, nurturing and Sales/BD handover.

**•**
Improve visibility, conversion and pipeline contribution through data, automation, martech and AI.

**•**
Measure channel performance and continuously optimize campaigns, platforms and investments.

Digital Marketing Manager

**Website & Digital Experience:**

**•**
Own the corporate website with internal teams and agencies, including content, landing pages, forms, integrations and technical enhancements.

**•**
Improve user experience, mobile performance and conversion using GA4, Google Search Console, Microsoft Clarity and A/B testing.

Lead technical and content optimization across search engines, answer engines and generative AI platforms.

Manage keyword research, audits, indexing, rankings, backlinks and organic traffic for priority solutions and capabilities.

Plan and optimize campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, Meta, display and retargeting.

Own targeting, budgets, creatives, landing pages and performance metrics including CTR, CPC, CPL, MQLs and ROI.

**Email Marketing & Automation:**

**•**
Manage segmented campaigns, newsletters, event/webinar promotion and automated nurture journeys.

**•**
Improve deliverability, engagement and conversion through testing, consent management and database governance.

**Webinars & Digital Campaigns:**

**•**
Manage webinars end to end, including topics, speakers, registration, promotion, execution, follow-up and content repurposing.

**•**
Track registrations, attendance, engagement and influenced leads or opportunities.

**Lead Management & Nurturing:**

**•**
Review and qualify leads from website, campaigns, webinars, events and content downloads using agreed MQL and scoring criteria.

**•**
Route leads to Sales/BD, monitor follow-up, manage nurture journeys and track progression to opportunity and pipeline.

**Marketing Technology & AI:**

**•**
Own the martech stack connecting website, CRM, email, automation, advertising, webinars and analytics, with reliable data flow and attribution.

**•**
Apply AI responsibly across content, personalization, SEO/AEO/GEO, segmentation, lead scoring and campaign optimization, with human review and data governance.

**Analytics, Agency & Stakeholder Management:**

**•**
Build dashboards covering channel performance, funnel conversion, ROI and marketing-influenced pipeline, with actionable recommendations.

Manage agencies, vendors, briefs, budgets, timelines and KPIs; collaborate with Marketing, Sales/BD, business teams, IT and Information Security.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

**•**
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Digital Marketing or a related discipline; MBA or post-graduate qualification preferred.

**Experience:**

**•**
6–10 years of digital marketing experience, preferably in B2B, life sciences, pharmaceutical, biotech, CRO/CDMO, technology or complex services.

**•**
Hands-on experience across website management, paid media, SEO, email automation, webinars and lead generation.

**Technical Skills:**

**•**
Working knowledge of GA4, Google Search Console, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads, Meta Ads, CMS, CRM and marketing automation platforms.

**•**
Experience with Salesforce, HubSpot or equivalent; strong understanding of tracking, attribution, lead scoring and responsible AI use.

**Core Competencies:**

**•**
Customer centricity, analytical thinking, communication, cross-functional collaboration, project management, innovation and results orientation.

**Why Join Aragen?**

As Digital Marketing Manager, you will shape Aragen’s digital ecosystem and connect global audiences with our scientific capabilities. The role offers an opportunity to combine strategy, technology, data and AI to deliver measurable business impact.

**Apply Now**

Join Aragen and help build a connected, data-driven and AI-enabled marketing engine.

title: Marketing Campaign Operations Manager, Principal
description:
**About The Role**
Blackbaud is looking for a Campaign Operations Manager to define and support how our go-to-market teams plan, set up, track and manage campaigns, and to build the automation and AI-driven workflows that make that work faster and more consistent. In this role, you’ll set the standard for best-in-class campaign management and stay hands-on in the platforms, from request through setup, tracking, QA, launch and measurement.
  
  
You’ll work within Marketing Operations, across our Marketing Automation Team, Vertical Marketing, Web, Paid Media and Brand & Events teams, connecting process, technology, data and AI to create clearer ownership, faster delivery and measurable impact. This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define and own the campaign management standard, from request to close, including tracking, naming and UTMs, Marketo program and Salesforce campaign hierarchy, member statuses and what “done” means at each stage.
* Own marketing intake, triage, prioritisation and SLAs, and the Asana workflows and automations that support GTM Campaign Ops across vertical teams, Brand, Web, Events and Paid Media.
* Set up, track and manage complex and high-visibility campaigns hands-on, as well as building the playbooks, templates and QA checklists others support, and act as the expert escalation for our Marketing Automation Team.
* Lead our AI and agentic workflows initiative, deciding where agents earn a place and building them, starting with campaign setup, tracking and QA, intake completeness and campaign routing, status and risk monitoring.
