title: Local SEO/GMB
description:
**Job Description – Local SEO & Google Business Profile (GBP) Associate / Fresher**

**Company:**

Degefy Marketing Pvt. Ltd. – Digital Marketing Agency

**Job Title:**

Local SEO & Google Business Profile (GBP) Associate

**Location:**

G401, Galada Towers, Begumpet, Secunderabad

**Work Mode:**

Work from Office

**Experience:**

Fresher to 1 Year

**Work Schedule**

* **Monday to Friday:**

  10:00 AM – 7:00 PM (Work from Office)
* **1st & 3rd Saturday:**

  10:00 AM – 6:00 PM (Work from Home)

**About Degefy**

At Degefy Marketing Pvt. Ltd., we help businesses grow through creative strategies, technology, and performance-driven digital marketing.

Our services include SEO, Google Business Profile management, social media marketing, paid advertising, website development, branding, and video production.

We work with clients across multiple industries, helping them improve their online presence and attract the right customers.

We are looking for a
**Local SEO & GBP Associate**

who is eager to learn, detail-oriented, and interested in building a career in search engine optimisation and digital marketing.

**Position Overview**

We are looking for a motivated
**Local SEO & Google Business Profile (GBP) Associate**

to support our team in managing and improving clients' visibility on Google Search and Google Maps.

You will assist in optimising Google Business Profiles, conducting local keyword research, publishing updates, managing customer reviews, and monitoring local search performance.

**Freshers with basic SEO knowledge and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.**

Training and guidance will be provided to help you develop practical Local SEO skills.

**Roles & Responsibilities**
**1. Google Business Profile Management**

* Assist in creating, updating, and optimising Google Business Profiles for clients.
* Ensure business information, including name, address, phone number, operating hours, and services, is accurate.
* Upload relevant photos, posts, offers, and business updates regularly.
* Monitor GBP profiles and identify missing or outdated information.
* Follow Google's guidelines and best practices for managing business listings.

**2. Local SEO & Keyword Research**

* Conduct basic local keyword research using Google Search and SEO tools.
* Identify location-specific keywords relevant to clients' businesses.
* Assist in implementing Local SEO strategies to improve visibility on Google Maps and Google Search.
* Research competitors' Google Business Profiles and local search presence.
* Support the team in identifying opportunities to improve local rankings.

**3. Review Management & Online Reputation**

* Monitor customer reviews across assigned Google Business Profiles.
* Draft professional, personalised, and relevant responses to positive and negative reviews.
* Include relevant keywords naturally wherever appropriate.
* Identify suspicious, spam, or fake reviews and report them through Google's official process.
* Ensure timely responses to customer reviews.

**4. Local SEO Content & Posting**

* Create and publish Google Business Profile posts based on client services, offers, and updates.
* Coordinate with content and design teams for images and promotional creatives.
* Ensure posts contain relevant keywords and clear calls to action.
* Maintain a posting schedule for assigned client profiles.

**5. Local Citations & Directory Listings**

* Assist in submitting business information to relevant online directories.
* Check for consistency in business name, address, and phone number (NAP).
* Identify incorrect or duplicate business listings.
* Support citation building and off-page Local SEO activities under team guidance.

**6. Performance Monitoring & Reporting**

* Monitor Google Business Profile performance metrics, including views, searches, website clicks, calls, and direction requests.
* Track local keyword rankings and changes in Google Maps visibility.
* Maintain Google Sheets or Excel trackers for assigned clients.
* Assist in preparing monthly Local SEO performance reports.
* Highlight improvements, issues, and opportunities to the reporting manager.

**7. Team Collaboration & Learning**

* Coordinate with SEO, content, and design teams for daily tasks.
* Follow internal SOPs, checklists, and quality standards.
* Stay updated on Google Business Profile features and Local SEO best practices.
* Actively participate in training sessions and implement feedback.
* Complete assigned tasks within agreed timelines.

**Performance Expectations**

* Maintain accurate and updated information across assigned Google Business Profiles.
* Publish scheduled GBP posts consistently and without errors.
* Respond to at least 90% of customer reviews within 24–48 hours, subject to client approvals.
* Maintain accurate Local SEO tracking sheets and monthly reports.
* Support improvements in Google Maps visibility, profile engagement, and local keyword rankings.
* Complete assigned tasks on time with minimal follow-ups.
* Demonstrate consistent improvement in Local SEO knowledge and execution.

*Performance will be evaluated based on accuracy, consistency, ownership, learning progress, and contribution to client results.*

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Computer Science, or any relevant field.
* Fresh graduates with an interest in SEO and digital marketing are welcome.
* Basic understanding of SEO, Google Search, and Google Maps.
* Good written English communication skills.
* Familiarity with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, and Google Workspace.
* SEO or digital marketing certifications are an added advantage.

**Skills Required**
**Essential Skills**

* Basic understanding of Search Engine Optimisation (SEO).
* Familiarity with Google Business Profiles and Google Maps.
* Ability to research local keywords and competitor businesses.
* Good written communication for review responses and GBP posts.
* Basic knowledge of Google Sheets and Excel.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to follow instructions and manage multiple tasks.

**Good to Have**

* Basic understanding of Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
* Familiarity with SEO tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, BrightLocal, or Ubersuggest.
* Knowledge of local citations and directory listings.
* Basic understanding of on-page and off-page SEO.
* Familiarity with WordPress, Rank Math, or Yoast SEO.

*Advanced technical SEO knowledge is not mandatory for freshers.*

**Attitude Traits Required for Success**
**1. Detail-Oriented**

* Pays attention to small details such as business names, addresses, timings, and keywords.
* Checks work carefully before publishing.

**2. Proactive & Responsible**

* Takes ownership of assigned tasks.
* Identifies issues and communicates them without waiting for reminders.

**3. Willingness to Learn**

* Shows genuine interest in SEO and digital marketing.
* Is open to feedback, new tools, and changing Google guidelines.

**4. Organised & Process-Driven**

* Maintains trackers, follows checklists, and meets deadlines.
* Can manage routine tasks across multiple client accounts.

**5. Team Player**

* Communicates clearly with team members.
* Collaborates effectively with content, design, and SEO teams.

**6. Growth-Oriented**

* Is interested in building long-term expertise in Local SEO.
* Learns from mistakes and continuously improves performance.

**What You Will Learn at Degefy**

* Practical Google Business Profile optimisation.
* Local keyword research and competitor analysis.
* Google Maps ranking strategies.
* Review management and online reputation management.
* Local citations and off-page SEO techniques.
* SEO performance tracking and reporting.
* Working with multiple brands across different industries.
* Using professional SEO tools and implementing real client strategies.

**Why Join Degefy?**

* Gain hands-on experience working on live client projects.
* Learn Local SEO through practical training and guidance.
* Work with clients across healthcare, retail, services, and other industries.
* Collaborate with an experienced digital marketing team.
* Develop technical, analytical, and communication skills.
* Build a strong foundation for a long-term career in SEO and digital marketing.

**If you are passionate about digital marketing, curious about how businesses rank on Google, and eager to build practical SEO skills, we would love to have you on our team.**

Job Details
  
  
******About Salesforce******
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
****The Experience****
The Marketing Technology and Engineering (MTE) team builds, scales, and integrates go-to-market motions in partnership with Core and Slack's Marketing and Sales teams. We are looking for a MarTech Operations Specialist to manage the team's day-to-day operations and help our marketing technology portfolio run effectively.
  
  
In this role, you will support Slack's Marketing business and the MTE team by managing day-to-day operations across three main areas: procurement, budget management, and platform and process maintenance. You will help the business acquire and renew the technology it needs, maintain visibility into spending and commitments, and keep established platforms and workflows running reliably.
  
  
You will work closely with MarTech platform owners, Marketing, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Privacy, and Web Engineering. Your attention to detail and ability to improve processes will help the team deliver reliable support and create more capacity for strategic technology initiatives.
  
  
****What You'll Actually Be Doing****
**Budget Management**
Help the MTE team plan and manage technology spending by maintaining accurate financial records and giving team leadership clear visibility into budgets, commitments, and upcoming expenses.
  
  
**Some Of The Work For Example Would Include:**

* Maintain the MTE budget tracker, including planned spend, purchase commitments, invoices, and actuals.
* Partner with Finance and team leadership to reconcile expenses, update forecasts, and flag variances.
* Maintain a calendar of renewals and payment deadlines, and prepare budget summaries to support annual and quarterly planning.

**Procurement**

**Some Of The Work For Example Would Include:**

* Track approvals and signatures, follow up on blockers, and maintain executed agreements and renewal terms.
* Maintain the technology portfolio register, including business and platform owners, costs, contract dates, and renewal decisions.
* Work with platform owners to identify unused licenses, overlapping tools, and opportunities to reduce spend.
* Maintain visibility into active requests, procurement milestones, and operational deadlines. Prepare regular stakeholder updates on status, blockers, and upcoming changes.

**Marketing Operations Support**
Support the business and MTE team by keeping established marketing platforms and operational processes running reliably. Coordinate incoming requests, complete routine maintenance and support activities, and improve documentation and workflows to make everyday work easier.
  
  
**Some Of The Work For Example Would Include:**

* Manage the Marketing Operations intake channel: acknowledge requests, clarify requirements, triage issues, and route work to the appropriate owner.
* Execute list uploads into designated systems using approved source files and instructions.
* Create and maintain operating procedures, checklists, and self-service guidance.
* Identify recurring issues and partner with the team to simplify workflows and automate repetitive work using approved tools, including AI where appropriate.

**You're Our Person If...**

* 3+ years of experience in marketing operations, marketing technology operations, business operations, or a related role.
* Experience tracking budgets or vendor spend and coordinating procurement, purchase orders, contract workflows, or renewals.
* Experience managing an intake queue or support channel, prioritizing requests, and communicating clearly with business and technical partners.
* Working knowledge of marketing systems, campaign operations, audience lists, and lead management, with the ability to follow and troubleshoot documented workflows.
* Strong spreadsheet skills and attention to detail when reconciling financial records, validating data files, and tracking deadlines.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent tasks, follow through on dependencies, and handle confidential business and customer information responsibly.
* Experience documenting processes and using Project Management tools.
* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Even Better If...**

* Familiarity with Salesforce CRM, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, advertising platforms, and Slack.
* Experience supporting a SaaS technology portfolio and working with Finance, Procurement, Legal, Privacy, or Web Engineering.
* Experience improving operational reporting, creating self-service resources, or using workflow automation and AI tools to reduce manual work.

*be your best*

*do your best*

This role involves leading and mentoring the marketing team, managing budgets, setting performance metrics, and reporting results to the executive leadership.

**Qualifications**

* Strong market planning and marketing management skills, with experience designing and executing data-driven marketing strategies.
* Proficiency in market research and analytics to identify customer segments, track performance, and refine go-to-market approaches.

* Experience collaborating with sales teams to align marketing initiatives with sales objectives and revenue targets.
* Proven leadership experience in senior marketing roles, ideally in fintech, proptech, real estate, or financial services.
* Ability to build and lead diverse, high-performing teams and work cross-functionally with product, operations, and finance.
* Excellent strategic thinking, communication, and presentation skills, with comfort in a fast-paced, growth-focused environment.
* Master’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field preferred.

title: Marketing Ops -Operations Associate Vice President
description:

The role combines deep marketing domain expertise with large-scale operations leadership, commercial ownership, digital transformation, and AI-enabled innovation.
  
  
This leader will set the agenda across the portfolio—translating CMO priorities and market shifts into differentiated services; establishing repeatable operating models; steering complex transitions and multi-account delivery; and sponsoring automation and AI initiatives from opportunity identification through production deployment and benefits realization.
  
  
The VP will provide clear direction to capability, solutioning, transition, delivery, technology, and innovation leaders, while remaining close enough to the operation to challenge decisions, remove barriers, and protect quality. Success requires a leader who can move fluently between executive strategy and the operational detail of how marketing work is planned, produced, activated, measured, and optimized.
  
  
**LEADERSHIP MANDATE**
Set direction
  
  

* Scale operations
* Industrialize AI

**Job Responsibilities**
**Strategy, Thought Leadership & Growth**

* Set the strategic agenda and market point of view: Define positioning, growth priorities, the multi-year roadmap, and investment agenda; advise senior executives and lead market-facing thought leadership.
* Productize and grow the business: Build modular offerings, reference operating models, accelerators, commercial constructs, and go-to-market plans; shape complex opportunities and own pipeline, bookings, revenue, margin, and investment.
* Build executive and ecosystem relationships: Serve as a trusted adviser to client and Deloitte leaders and mobilize alliances and specialist partners around priority propositions and outcomes.
* Build market credibility: Lead thought leadership, executive forums, alliance narratives, case studies, and market-facing points of view that establish a differentiated position in marketing operations and managed services.

Marketing Operations & Enterprise Scale
  
  

* Provide end-to-end domain direction: Challenge the design and performance of operations across marketing demand and workflow, campaigns and media, CRM and personalization, creative and content supply chain, MarTech platforms, data, analytics, and measurement.
* Design the operating system: Define roles, handoffs, service boundaries, playbooks, controls, governance, and measures across retained marketing teams, agencies, technology partners, and global delivery.
* Build and scale enterprise operations: Set up, transition, stabilize, and expand multi-account, multi-tower operations supporting 300–1,000+ practitioners; standardize and reuse while protecting brand, creative, customer, market, and regulatory context.
* Scale operational delivery: Set priorities and govern service quality, capacity, risk, financial health, resilience, and continuous transformation; act as the senior escalation point when outcomes are at risk.

**AI-Enabled Transformation & Performance**

* Set a value-led AI and automation agenda: Prioritize analytics, automation, GenAI, and agentic use cases across intake, workflow, content, quality assurance, campaign operations, reporting, optimization, and knowledge management.
* Scale innovation into live operations: Sponsor initiatives from business case through production, adoption, and benefits realization; redesign processes, roles, skills, controls, KPIs, staffing, and commercial assumptions as work changes.
* Govern trust and performance: Establish responsible AI, data, privacy, security, intellectual property, and human-oversight guardrails, with scorecards covering marketing outcomes, SLAs, quality, productivity, innovation, financials, and risk.

**Enterprise & Talent Leadership**

* Lead through leaders: Build the organization and leadership system, clarify accountabilities, align multidisciplinary teams, coach senior leaders, and create succession depth.
* Build a differentiated talent model: Combine marketing craft, platform expertise, operational rigor, consulting capability, and AI fluency; mobilize consulting, creative, media, technology, data, finance, risk, talent, and alliance teams around a shared direction.

**Location:**
Hyderabad / Chennai
  
  
**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree required; postgraduate qualification or MBA preferred.
  
  
**Experience**

* Senior leadership experience: 16+ years of professional experience, including at least 10 years leading large-scale marketing operations, agency delivery, digital operations, or managed services and a minimum of 5 years in executive leadership roles.
* Proven build-and-scale track record: Demonstrated experience setting up, transitioning, stabilizing, and scaling global or enterprise operations, including organizations of approximately 300–1,000+ team members.
* Deep marketing operations credibility: Strong operational understanding across multiple marketing domains such as campaign and media operations, CRM and lifecycle marketing, creative and content supply chain, MarTech operations, customer journey orchestration, data, analytics, and measurement.
* AI and automation leadership: Evidence of identifying, sponsoring, and scaling automation, analytics, GenAI, or agentic initiatives within live operations, with responsibility for adoption, controls, operating-model change, and measurable benefits—not only pilots or technology implementation.
* Commercial and P&L ownership: Experience owning a multi-million-dollar portfolio or P&L and making decisions across growth, pricing, investment, margin, capacity, utilization, and risk.
* Global delivery and transformation: Experience leading distributed onshore, nearshore, and offshore models and large transformation programs across multiple clients, geographies, or service towers.
* Executive client leadership: Credibility with senior marketing, customer, digital, technology, operations, and procurement stakeholders and the ability to influence strategic decisions in complex client environments.
* Thought leadership and market orientation: A clear point of view on the evolution of marketing operations, agency models, platforms, data, AI, and managed services, with the ability to convert that perspective into propositions and client conversations.
* Leadership judgment: Strong analytical, commercial, organizational, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to make timely decisions, manage ambiguity, and provide calm direction during high-stakes delivery situations.

**The team**
Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team helps organizations design, build, transition, and scale digital products, experiences, and operations that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, data specialists, and operators, we connect the work of transformation with the discipline of ongoing operations. Our capabilities span the digital lifecycle from research, experience and platform design through content production, marketing automation, campaign operations, and continuous optimization—enabling clients to experiment, learn, and scale with confidence.
  
  
**Preferred Skills, Project Experience & Certifications**

* Marketing and technology platforms: Hands-on leadership exposure to major marketing ecosystems such as Adobe, Salesforce, Google, Meta, HubSpot, Marketo, Braze, leading media platforms, workflow tools, content platforms, and analytics environments.
* Operating excellence and transformation methods: Experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, process intelligence, service management, Agile, product management, or equivalent methods to redesign and improve live operations.

Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. title: Manager - Growth Marketing
description:

What you'll do

• Run growth experiments. Design, launch and read out fast experiments across lifecycle messaging, onboarding flows, pricing and conversion surfaces, and acquisition channels.

• Scale paid acquisition. Manage and optimize Google Ads, and test emerging channels, including ad and answer placements on AI assistant platforms such as ChatGPT.

• Build organic and community reach. Grow SEO and content programs, build a network of creators and influencers in the small-business and tax space, and engage authentically in communities like Reddit.

• Partner across teams. Work closely with Product, Engineering and Data to remove friction from onboarding and shorten time-to-value.

• Measure what matters. Keep live dashboards and regular reporting on core SaaS growth metrics: CAC, channel ROI, activation and conversion rates, trial-to-paid velocity, ARPU and payback period.

Nice to have

• Experience marketing tax, accounting or financial products to US small businesses

• Knowledge of SEO and AI answer-engine optimization (showing up in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews)

• Experience working with a US-based team across time zones

Why X.Tax

• A big, underserved market and a product built to win it

• Real ownership: you'll shape the growth playbook, not just run it

• A fast-moving, AI-first team at a company growing 350%+ a year

title: GTM Leader
description:
**Title: GTM Leader**

**Location: Hyderabad**

**Working hours: 4 PM - 1 AM IST**

**Team:**
Global Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success

**About the Role**

Pragma Edge is an enterprise integration and workflow automation company. We help organizations Connect People, Process, Technology and Partners.

We are hiring a Chief Revenue Officer to own revenue across all four of our business lines:
**software products, professional services, managed services, and SaaS**
. Reporting to the CEO, you will carry full accountability for the number and for the commercial organization that delivers it.

This is an operator's role as much as a seller's role. Today, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success run as separate functions with separate priorities. Your first job is to make them one system, with shared definitions, clean handoffs, and forecasting the CEO and board can rely on. Your second is to make our integration technology legible to enterprise buyers as a business outcome rather than a feature set.

**What You'll Own**

**Go-to-Market Across Four Revenue Streams**

* Build and iterate GTM motions for each business line, recognizing that they have genuinely different buyers, cycle lengths, and economics, transactional software and SaaS on one side, consultative services and multi-year managed contracts on the other.
* Standardize the handoffs between demand generation, pre-sales engineering, and delivery so clients experience one continuous relationship from first contact through expansion.
* Sharpen our positioning in the verticals where integration and automation are mission-critical: healthcare, supply chain, logistics, financial services, and retail.

**Revenue Operations and Forecasting**

* Own and modernize the revenue tech stack ,CRM, marketing automation, analytics — with data integrity and pipeline visibility as the standard, not the aspiration.
* Deliver forecasts to the CEO and board that hold up: granular by stream, honest about risk, and specific about where churn and expansion are likely.
* Manage the metrics that matter for a hybrid software-and-services model: ARR, NRR, LTV, CAC and CAC payback, services margin, and utilization-linked pipeline.

**Building the Commercial Organization**

* Recruit, develop, and retain a commercial team across regions. Set one sales methodology, clear quotas, and transparent performance expectations.
* Stay in the field on strategic pursuits. You will personally help navigate enterprise procurement and executive relationships on our largest deals.
* Develop technology alliances, channel partners, and marketplace listings into a meaningful, measurable second source of pipeline.

**What Success Looks Like**

**First 90 days**
— You know the business: every revenue stream, its margin profile, and its real win rate. Pipeline data is trustworthy or you have a dated plan to make it so. You have assessed the existing team and named the gaps.

**First 6 months**
— One forecasting cadence and one set of definitions across Sales, Marketing, and CS. Handoffs documented and working. A GTM plan per stream, with the investment case behind each.

**First 12 months**
— Forecast accuracy within an agreed tolerance. Measurable movement in NRR and CAC efficiency. Key hires in place. A partner channel contributing real pipeline.

**What We're Looking For**

**Experience**

* 10+ years in senior commercial leadership (CRO, CCO, or VP/SVP Sales) in enterprise B2B technology, including time carrying a company-level number.
* A track record of scaling a technology or IT services business through a rapid-growth phase, with clear ownership of the revenue trajectory.
* Demonstrated ability to run high-velocity product and SaaS sales alongside long-cycle consulting and managed services — most leaders are strong in one and weak in the other, and we need both.

**Domain**

* Working knowledge of enterprise integration (B2Bi, EDI, MFT), business process and robotic automation, hybrid cloud, and digital workflow modernization, GenAI, Agentic AI. You don't need to be an architect, but you do need to hold a credible technical conversation with a CIO.

**How You Work**

* You can translate integration and automation into financial and operational terms for a Fortune 1000 C-suite — cost avoided, risk reduced, cycle time cut.
* You build teams rather than inherit them, and you mentor deliberately. We are looking for someone who raises the ceiling for the people around them and strengthens the culture while growing the number, not at its expense.
* You are direct with the board about bad news early.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in business, computer science, management information systems, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience. MBA or executive education is a plus, not a requirement.

title: Director, Product Management
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Director of Product Management is a managerial position that supports the global growth of USP’s material products including Reference Standards, Analytical Reference Materials, Pharmaceutical Analytical Impurities, Certified Reference Materials and the Materials Strategy Program across the USP Novel Medicines, Generics, and Consumer Health business units.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
**The Director, Product Management Has The Following Responsibilities**
Product Strategy, Portfolio, and Business Leadership
  
  

* Define and lead the long-term product, portfolio, and pipeline strategy, ensuring alignment with corporate growth objectives, market opportunities, and financial targets.
* Own portfolio performance and financial outcomes, providing executive leadership with strategic insights, scenario analyses, and recommendations to inform investment, resource allocation, and growth decisions.
* Champion the development and approval of business cases for strategic investments, new product platforms, portfolio expansions, and lifecycle initiatives, balancing market opportunity, risk, and return.
* Direct portfolio prioritization and optimization activities, ensuring resources are focused on the highest-value opportunities while balancing customer needs, operational capabilities, and profitability objectives.
* Establish governance frameworks for product selection, portfolio rationalization, and lifecycle decisions to maximize portfolio health, competitive positioning, and margin performance.
* Lead the development and execution of product roadmaps that drive sustainable growth, innovation, and organizational priorities across short-, medium-, and long-term planning horizons.
* Define portfolio performance metrics and operating mechanisms to monitor business results, forecast accuracy, customer adoption, and strategic goal attainment.
* Ensure organizational readiness and business continuity through proactive identification and mitigation of supply, demand, operational, and market risks.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership by bringing a deep understanding of customer needs, market dynamics, and organizational priorities into decision-making.
* Sponsor customer and market insight initiatives to strengthen strategic planning, innovation, and commercial decision-making.

Market, Customer & Competitive Intelligence
  
  

* Shape portfolio strategy through deep understanding of industry trends, regulatory developments, market shifts, and emerging technologies.
* Champion customer-centric decision-making by translating voice-of-customer insights and market intelligence into strategic growth opportunities.
* Lead competitive intelligence efforts to identify market opportunities, differentiation strategies, and areas for innovation and investment.
* Partner with Commercial, Marketing, and Regional leaders to evaluate market potential, customer adoption trends, and evolving value propositions across the portfolio.

Product Development & Launch Leadership
  
  

* Provide leadership and governance for cross-functional product development initiatives, ensuring alignment across R&D, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Commercial functions.
* Establish strategic product requirements, launch objectives, and success criteria that align customer outcomes with business goals.
* Oversee enterprise-wide launch strategies and commercialization plans, ensuring organizational readiness and successful market adoption.
* Drive continuous improvement of innovation and commercialization processes to accelerate growth, improve launch performance, and maximize return on investment.
* Lead major organizational and capability transitions, including the successful transfer and scaling of product management responsibilities across global teams and regions.

Organizational Leadership & Talent Development
  
  

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing product management organization responsible for portfolio strategy, innovation, commercialization, and lifecycle management.
* Establish product management as a strategic business capability by driving best practices, governance, talent development, and organizational excellence.
* Foster collaboration and alignment across product, commercial, technical, and operational leadership teams to leverage enterprise capabilities and accelerate business impact.
* Provide leadership and oversight for global and regional teams, ensuring accountability, performance excellence, and alignment with strategic objectives.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution
  
  

* Influence and align senior stakeholders across Operations, Science, IT, Strategy, Analytics, Quality, Commercial, and Regional organizations to deliver strategic business outcomes.
* Lead the design and implementation of enterprise-wide processes, governance structures, and operating models that enhance portfolio management effectiveness and execution.
* Champion data-driven decision-making by advancing analytics capabilities, business intelligence tools, and performance reporting frameworks.

title: Assistant Manager – Brand & Creative
company: Only What's Needed by Food Pharmer
description:
**About Only What's Needed**

Most brands ask consumers to trust them.

We're building one that asks consumers to verify us.

Only What's Needed exists to make India protein sufficient. We build products with people, share our decisions in public, and believe facts matter more than marketing claims.

We're looking for someone who wants to help build that institution.

**The Role**

* We're looking for an Assistant Manager – Brand & Creative who can bring ideas to life and help shape how OWN shows up across platforms.
* This is a role for someone who thinks creatively, writes exceptionally well, understands what makes content work, and enjoys taking ideas from a brief to execution.
* You'll work closely with the Brand & Creative Manager across brand campaigns, product launches, partnerships, social media, and everyday brand communication.
* One day, you could be developing the creative direction for a campaign. The next, writing a script that makes a complex nutrition topic easy to understand or working with creators and designers to bring an idea to life.
* You'll be expected to take ownership of projects, contribute fresh perspectives, and ensure that everything we put out is strategically sound, creatively engaging, and unmistakably OWN.

**What You'll Do**

* Support the development and execution of creative ideas across brand campaigns, product launches, partnerships, and special projects.
* Help build and execute OWN's content strategy across social media and other brand platforms.
* Translate marketing objectives and business priorities into compelling creative concepts and communication.
* Develop campaign ideas, content pillars, scripts, captions, briefs, and platform-specific storytelling approaches.
* Work closely with designers, video editors, filmmakers, creators, and agency partners to execute creative projects.
* Take ownership of assigned campaigns and projects, ensuring timely delivery and quality of execution.
* Identify relevant cultural trends, internet conversations, and content opportunities that the brand can participate in.
* Simplify complex topics around protein, nutrition, food labels, and the food industry into engaging, accessible content.
* Maintain consistency in OWN's brand voice, visual identity, and communication across touchpoints.
* Stay on top of social media trends, emerging formats, and evolving content consumption behaviours.
* Collaborate with the broader marketing team to ensure creative output supports brand and business objectives.
* Proactively bring new ideas to the table and continuously push the quality of our content.

**What We're Looking For**

* 3–4 years of experience in a creative, content, brand, or marketing role, preferably in an agency or consumer brand environment.
* Strong writing skills and an instinct for storytelling, especially across digital and social platforms.
* A creative thinker who can turn a simple brief into an interesting idea.
* Understanding of social media platforms, content formats, trends, and internet culture.
* Ability to work across multiple projects while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines.
* Comfortable working with designers, writers, video teams, creators, and external agencies.
* Someone who takes ownership, pays attention to detail, and gets things done.
* A balance of creative thinking and executional rigour.
* Someone who enjoys experimenting, learning, and building rather than simply following instructions.
* Low ego, high ownership, and a genuine passion for creating good work.

**Bonus Points If**

* You have worked with consumer-facing brands.
* You understand food, health, nutrition, fitness, or wellness categories.
* You have experience developing social-first campaigns, reels, and creator-led content.
* You enjoy breaking down complex subjects and making them interesting for everyday consumers.
* You have built content formats or recurring content properties, not just one-off posts.
* You're familiar with the creator economy and understand what makes content shareable.

**Why Join?**

This isn't a role where you'll simply execute someone else's ideas. You'll have the opportunity to contribute to them, challenge them, and see them come to life.

You'll work closely with the brand leadership and founders, get hands-on experience across the entire creative process, and help build the voice of a brand that wants to change how India thinks about protein.

If you're excited by the idea of creating work that can genuinely influence consumer behaviour, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Lead Market Access & Pricing - Mumbai
description:

Purpose of the role is to develop and implement Boehringer Ingelheim India's Human Pharma Market Access Strategies & framework. It involves promoting the range of innovative products in both Public/Reimbursed and Out of Pocket market by developing and driving better market access initiatives for the payers/patients. Developing pricing strategies for the Boehringer Ingelheim portfolio which includes new product launch pricing, existing product pricing/pricing schemes as well as maintaining pricing from the external stakeholder/Government/NPPA perspective. Identifying, developing and design suitable market access initiatives on the lines of partnership models across therapies, pricing schemes, Health Economics & Outcomes etc. which can enable maximization of opportunities and drive business growth in the public/out of pocket market in close collaboration with the Government Affairs/Healthcare Affairs/Marketing/Medical Team. Monitor, interpret and shape developments and gaps in healthcare policies and healthcare delivery for our current and future HP product portfolio.

  

**Tasks & Responsibilities**

  

  
* Developing new pricing / price change proposal/business case for the complete portfolio of Boehringer Ingelheim India in alignment with local business requirements and working closely with the Global team for getting approvals of the same. Also, taking the lead for all submissions related to global market access such as price approval process, BIP track, Global launch tracker etc.
  
* Ensuring timely and continuous submissions to notify products price to Government pricing authority (NPPA). Streamlining any gaps in data with the government and ensuring all issues are resolved with the concerned authorities
  
* Developing the Market Access Strategies, tactical and execution plan for Boehringer Ingelheim’s portfolio products. Involves identifying suitable therapy opportunities within Government health policy/NCD policy and developing strategies towards increasing advocacy for Boehringer Ingelheim portfolio through either increase in government funding or increase in government priority. Meeting & presenting to senior level external stakeholders. Also, taking the lead for all submissions related to global team such as access related advocacy plan.
  
* Ideating and executing various strategic initiatives across the value chain of Market access such as Pricing Schemes, Payer value tools such as HEOR models, information, diagnosis, affordability, adherence etc. Also aligning with internal stakeholders such as Government Affairs, Sales & Marketing, Medical teams to ensure timely and effective implementation of all tactical plans.
  
* Taking the lead to devising the market access roadmaps & strategy for existing Boehringer Ingelheim brands and new launches. Providing inputs to the Business Teams for implementation.
  
* Manages prioritized health systems engagement on prevention, diagnosis, screening, quality of life and access to care initiatives, health & wellness programs, and patient support related efforts.
  
  

  
  

**Requirements**

  

  
* Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent related work experience required; Preferred an MBA from a reputed institution.
  
* At least 8-10 years of relevant experience in Health policy/Market Access.
  
* Deep understanding of Indian healthcare and regulatory environment with proven expertise in access related initiatives. Strong sales/marketing acumen.
  
* Strong business acumen with the capability and vision to plan and implement strategic company level initiatives.
  
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, both written and oral, as well as negotiation and presentation skills.
  
* Strong understanding of Indian Healthcare environment and relevant policies.
  
* Must have proven experience in access function by ideating/executing Access strategies, Customer focused solutions etc.

title: Client Servicing Manager - Events

title: Data Center Operations Technician, Data Center Operations (DCO)
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.
  
  
Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
  
  

* You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
* You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
* You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
* You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
* You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews

A day in the life
  
  
As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day-to-day work will include:
  
  

* Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
* Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
* Work within a ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
* Work on rotational shift-based schedule to maintain high system reliability
* Collaborate with internal teams and share ideas and contribute in innovative projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.
* This is a physically active role, we are always on the move onsite.

**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines
* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system

description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.
  
  
You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.
  
  
Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):

* Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
* Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
* Liaising with internal teams & management groups

* Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.
  
  
People Management.
  
  
As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.
  
  
Incident Management.
  
  
You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management.
  
  
Vendor Management.
  
  
An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same.
  
  
Process Improvement.
  
  
You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable
  
  
Health & Safety.
  
  
Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**Company:** Lord’s Pathology

**Location:** Thane, Maharashtra

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**1. About the Role**

Lord’s Pathology is looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and enthusiastic Graphic Designer Trainee to support the Marketing & Communications team in developing engaging visual content for digital marketing campaigns, social media, healthcare promotions, and print communication.

The candidate will work closely with the marketing, digital marketing, and content teams to create visually appealing and brand-consistent designs that support business growth, customer engagement, and brand awareness.

This role offers an opportunity to gain practical experience in healthcare marketing, brand communication, campaign design, and creative execution across multiple platforms.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Digital Marketing Creatives**

* Design creative assets for social media platforms, including Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, and other relevant channels.
* Create digital banners, promotional creatives, website banners, mobile app banners, and campaign graphics.
* Develop creatives for diagnostic packages, preventive health check-ups, seasonal campaigns, and special promotional offers.
* Support the design requirements of digital advertising campaigns across Google and Meta platforms.
* Adapt creative concepts into multiple formats and dimensions for different digital platforms.

**B. Branding & Marketing Communication**

* Create visually consistent designs in accordance with Lord’s Pathology's brand guidelines.
* Assist in developing brochures, flyers, posters, standees, banners, and other marketing collaterals.
* Support the creation of healthcare awareness creatives, service communication, and brand campaigns.
* Ensure appropriate use of logos, colours, typography, imagery, and other brand elements.
* Maintain consistency in visual communication across digital and offline marketing channels.

**C. Print & Offline Marketing Materials**

* Design visiting cards, leaflets, handbills, envelopes, report covers, and other print materials.
* Assist in preparing artwork for outdoor advertising, events, exhibitions, and promotional activities.
* Prepare print-ready files with appropriate dimensions, resolution, bleed, and colour settings.
* Coordinate with the marketing team and printing vendors for artwork finalisation and production requirements.

**D. Website & Mobile App Design Support**

* Create banners and promotional graphics for the Lord’s Pathology website and mobile application.
* Support the design of health package listings, digital promotions, landing page visuals, and campaign assets.
* Assist in maintaining visual consistency across website and app communication.
* Work with the marketing and technology teams to update creative assets as required.

**E. Creative Development & Team Collaboration**

* Convert creative briefs and content requirements into effective visual designs.
* Collaborate with content writers and digital marketing executives to develop campaign creatives.
* Research design trends, creative references, layouts, and visual communication techniques.
* Incorporate feedback and make revisions within agreed timelines.
* Maintain organised design files, artwork versions, templates, and creative assets.

**F. Quality Control & Execution**

* Proofread designs for spelling, alignment, layout consistency, and brand accuracy.
* Ensure that package names, prices, test details, offers, and other promotional information match approved content.
* Follow established design standards and meet campaign deadlines.
* Seek clarification whenever creative briefs or content contain incomplete or inconsistent information.

**3. Educational Qualifications**

* Diploma or degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Fine Arts, Multimedia, or a related field.
* Freshers with a strong portfolio and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.
* Relevant graphic design certifications or practical project experience will be an advantage.

**4. Technical Skills**

**Essential Skills**

* Working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator.
* Familiarity with Canva or similar graphic design tools.
* Understanding of typography, colour theory, composition, and visual hierarchy.
* Basic knowledge of digital design dimensions and print production requirements.
* Ability to work with brand guidelines and follow creative briefs.

**Additional Advantage**

* Knowledge of Adobe InDesign, Figma, or other layout and design tools.
* Basic video editing and motion graphics skills.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted creative tools.
* Understanding of social media design trends and digital advertising formats.

**5. Key Competencies**

* Creativity and visual storytelling.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Willingness to learn and accept feedback.
* Time management and ability to meet deadlines.
* Strong coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple creative assignments.
* A proactive approach to identifying design improvements.
* Interest in branding, digital marketing, and healthcare communication.

**6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The trainee's performance will be evaluated on:

* Timely completion of assigned creative requirements.
* Quality, creativity, and visual consistency of designs.
* Accuracy of promotional information and adherence to brand guidelines.
* Ability to understand and execute creative briefs.
* Number of assigned deliverables completed within agreed timelines.
* Responsiveness to feedback and quality of revisions.
* Organisation and maintenance of creative files and design assets.
* Improvement in design skills, efficiency, and creative execution.

**7. Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is a creative individual who enjoys visual communication, understands the fundamentals of good design, and is eager to develop practical experience in a professional marketing environment.

The candidate should be comfortable working on multiple types of design assignments, from social media creatives and digital advertisements to brochures, promotional materials, and branding assets.

A strong portfolio demonstrating creativity, design fundamentals, and attention to detail will be preferred over experience alone.

**8. Why Join Lord’s Pathology?**

* Gain hands-on experience in healthcare branding and marketing.
* Work on digital campaigns, product promotions, and brand communication.
* Develop skills across digital design, print production, and campaign execution.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Lead Generation Executive
description:
**Job Description – Business Development Executive (Lead Generation)**

**Location: Pune (Work From Office)**

**Experience Required:**
**3+ years**

**Target Markets:**
**USA and Europe**

**Role Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Business Development Executive to own outbound lead generation for our international IT services business. The role is focused on identifying and engaging decision-makers through LinkedIn Sales Navigator and personalized manual email outreach, qualifying them, and booking discovery calls for our senior sales team.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Lead Generation and Prospecting**

• Build targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Apollo.io, based on our ideal customer profile (industry, company size, geography, and decision-maker titles such as CEO, Founder, CTO).

• Run daily LinkedIn outreach: connection requests, personalized messages, and follow-ups.

• Write and send personalized manual emails to decision-makers, based on research of their business.

• Verify and maintain accurate contact data.

• Track market trends and buying signals to prioritize target accounts.

• Keep improving messaging and targeting to increase reply rates.

**2. Lead Qualification and Meeting Scheduling**

• Engage prospects who respond and qualify them on budget, authority, need, and timeline.

• Follow up on warm leads and schedule discovery and introductory calls with the senior sales team.

• Prepare a short brief for each meeting before handover.

**3. CRM and Reporting**

• Update all leads, conversations, and follow-ups in the CRM and tracking sheets.

• Share daily and weekly reports with the Manager (outreach volume, replies, and meetings booked).

**Required Experience and Qualifications**

• 3+ years of experience in lead generation / outbound business development for an IT services company (mandatory).

• Strong hands-on experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

• Proven experience with personalized manual email outreach to international decision-makers.

• Experience working with US and/or European clients and markets.

• Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to draft professional emails and lead introductory calls.

• Working knowledge of IT services (web, mobile, AI/GenAI, and software development).

• Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.

• Willing to work from our Pune office.

**Preferred Skills**

• Experience with Apollo.io, email verification tools, and a CRM.

• Experience with cold calling.

• Master's degree in Marketing or a related discipline (good to have).

title: Search Engine Optimization Manager
description:
Search has changed more in the last two years than in the ten before that. People now ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity what to buy, and the answer cites a handful of brands. We're looking for an SEO lead with 5+ years of experience who finds that exciting, to be Zerply's in-house SEO expert across every client we work with.

About Zerply

Zerply is an AI-native AEO growth firm. We get our clients into AI answers and into the search results that feed them. We sell the result, not a tool.

We do it on our own platform. Zerply tracks how AI models mention and cite a brand every day, plans content from real Search Console data, and publishes pages straight to the client's own domain. Agents handle the repetitive work, so our people spend their time on strategy and judgment.

We come from the team behind WittyPen, which has been doing content and search for 500+ companies since 2015. We're a small, high-ownership team. We'd rather ship steady, good work at a sustainable pace than perform busyness. If you do good work and want to push yourself further because you care about it, that's on you. We won't ask you to prove it with hours.

About the role

You'll set the SEO and AEO strategy for every client account. You'll be the person clients trust on anything search-related. You'll also lead a small team of AEO analysts who run the accounts day to day.

You'll have a platform built for exactly this work, and full freedom to build your own workflows on top of it with Claude Code, agents and whatever else makes you faster. This is the seat for someone who wants to move really fast and have the tools to do it.

What you'll do

* **Own the strategy across all clients.**
  Technical, on-page, off-page and AI visibility, run as one connected system, not four separate checklists.
* **Be the client's go-to person for SEO.**
  Run the strategy calls, present results and set honest expectations. When the numbers dip, have the hard conversation early.
* **Win visibility in search and in AI answers.**
  Answer-first content, entity clarity, schema, and the signals that get a brand mentioned and cited.
* **Drive off-page and authority.**
  Backlinks, digital PR and brand mentions in the places AI engines actually read. You run it, not just plan it.
* **Turn Zerply's signals into action.**
  Read mentions, citations, share of voice and AI bot traffic every day, and turn them into each account's next moves.
* **Lead and coach the analyst team.**
  Set the playbooks, review the work, and help each analyst get sharper every week.
* **Build AI workflows that make the whole team faster.**
  Use Claude Code, agents and scripts to automate audits, briefs, reporting, and anything else that slows us down.
* **Shape the product.**
  Feed what you learn back to the team building Zerply, so the platform gets better with every account.

What we're looking for

* 5+ years in SEO, with hands-on depth across technical, on-page and off-page.
* A current, practical understanding of how search works today, including how AI engines find, rank and cite content.
* Real link-building and off-page experience: campaigns you ran yourself and can talk us through.
* Some experience with AI-visibility or prompt-tracking tools, and a point of view on what actually moves citations.
* You're very hands-on with AI. You use tools like Claude Code, Claude or ChatGPT every day, and you've built at least one workflow that saved real time.
* Confidence with clients. You've owned accounts and you're comfortable being the expert in the room.
* Experience guiding or mentoring others, whether or not you had the title.
* Comfort with the usual stack: Search Console, GA4, Ahrefs or Semrush, and Screaming Frog or Sitebulb.

Nice to have

* Agency or consulting experience running several clients at once.
* Digital PR or publisher relationships you can bring with you.
* Some comfort with code: Python, scripts or APIs.

Why you'll love this role

* **You'll be early to AEO.**
  Very few people anywhere have run it across many clients at once. Your playbooks become the standard.
* **Agents do the grunt work.**
  Your time goes into strategy, judgment and client wins, not spreadsheets.
* **Real leverage.**
  Here, seniority doesn't mean managing more people. It means running more accounts with better systems.
* **A team to lead, and the founders next to you.**
  You'll work directly with the founders, shape the product you use every day, and grow the team as Zerply grows.

title: PUBLISHER
description:
About the Role:
  
  
As a Publisher, you will play a key role in the development, acquisition, and successful market release of Wolters Kluwer | Medknow health publications, including journals, books, and digital content. Building on your foundational publishing knowledge, you will assume increased responsibility across editorial and business development activities, contributing to the quality, reach, and commercial success of our publishing portfolio. Your work will directly support the dissemination of high‑quality health information that advances clinical practice and improves patient outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Extensive market research and outreaches to both the journals from India and Global. Contract negotiation and closure at profitable terms.
* Build, maintain, and regularly update a journal acquisition target list for India and other global markets.
* Key Account Management
* Stay current with publishing industry trends, develop strong competitive intelligence, and contribute insights on future market developments.
* Respond to Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and expressions of interest in collaboration with cross‑functional teams.
* Assist in identifying publishing priorities through marketplace research, competitive analysis, and idea generation.
* Prepare weekly progress reports and provide general administrative support to the publishing team.
* Coordinate with production, finance, IT, and dispatch teams to ensure timely scheduling, publication, and distribution of journals.

**Required Skills And Competencies**

* Market Research: Ability to conduct research and translate insights into actionable publishing strategies.
* Digital Publishing Tools: Familiarity with content management systems and digital publishing platforms.
* Business Development & Key Account Management: Experience supporting client relationships and acquisition activities.
* Communication Skills: Strong command of spoken and written English, with effective networking and interpersonal abilities.
* Presentation & Negotiation: Confident presentation skills and the ability to support commercial discussions.
* Administrative & Technical Skills: Proficient in MS Office applications (Outlook, Excel) and electronic communication tools.
* Organizational Skills: Strong time management, coordination, and attention to detail.

Our Interview Practices
  
  
*To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.*

title: Director – Strategic Customer Acquisition & Revenue Growth
description:
**Director – Strategic Customer Acquisition & Revenue Growth**

**Location:**
Pune (Work from Office)

**Reporting To:**
COO / Managing Director

**About the Role**

We are looking for a high-energy, revenue-focused business leader who combines the mindset of a hunter with the maturity of a strategic account leader. This role will be responsible for driving strategic customer acquisition, expanding existing accounts, managing key customer relationships, leading large delivery teams, and owning the P&L of assigned business units.

The ideal candidate has progressed from individual contributor sales roles into leadership positions and has successfully acquired new customers, built and expanded strategic accounts, developed high-performing teams, and delivered measurable revenue outcomes within IT Services, Technology Services, BPO, Demand Generation, Marketing Services, or Digital Services organizations.

Preference will be given to candidates with experience in startups and mid-sized organizations. Profiles from large organizations are not preferred.

This is a leadership position offering significant autonomy, influence, and growth opportunities. The individual will actively contribute to the company's business strategy, customer acquisition roadmap, and future expansion plans.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategic Customer Acquisition & Revenue Growth**

Drive new customer acquisition and revenue growth across assigned business units.

Identify, prospect, and convert high-value business opportunities into long-term customer relationships.

Develop and execute strategic sales plans to penetrate new markets and acquire key accounts.

Identify growth opportunities within existing customers through upselling, cross-selling, and service expansion.

Build and maintain executive-level relationships with customer stakeholders and decision-makers.

Develop account plans, revenue forecasts, and customer expansion roadmaps.

Drive customer retention, renewals, and long-term account profitability.

Own business unit P&L and profitability targets.

**2. Strategic Account Management**

Act as the primary relationship owner for strategic customer accounts.

Build strong relationships with decision-makers and influencers across customer organizations.

Ensure high customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term partnership growth.

Lead quarterly and annual business reviews with customers.

Proactively manage customer expectations, escalations, and relationship risks.

Identify opportunities to strengthen customer engagement and maximize account value.

**3. Operational Leadership**

Serve as the bridge between customers and internal execution teams.

Lead and mentor teams comprising Program Managers, Assistant Program Managers, Team Leads, and Business Development Specialists.

Ensure delivery excellence and achievement of customer SLAs, KPIs, and business outcomes.

Build scalable operational processes, governance models, and best practices.

Drive productivity, quality improvements, and operational efficiency initiatives.

Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**4. Business Strategy & Governance**

Conduct regular SWOT analysis of operations, customers, competitors, and market opportunities.

Present monthly and quarterly business reviews, revenue forecasts, strategic plans, and performance achievements.

Partner with Sales, Marketing, Digital, and Delivery teams to improve customer outcomes and accelerate business growth.

Monitor market trends and identify new business opportunities aligned with the company's service offerings.

Contribute actively to the company's strategic planning, revenue expansion, and future growth initiatives.

**Compensation**

**Salary will be no bar for the right candidate**
, based on relevant experience, leadership capabilities.
