title: Mobility Specialist
description:
**Job Title: Mobility Specialist**
**Position Summary**
The Mobility Specialist provides operational support for enterprise mobile services, including mobile device provisioning, carrier support, eSIM management, and user assistance. This role works with employees, mobile service providers, and internal teams to ensure reliable mobile connectivity and timely resolution of mobility-related requests.
  
  
The ideal candidate is customer-focused, organized, and experienced in supporting mobile devices, wireless services, and telecommunications processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Position Location & Regional Coverage**
We are currently hiring multiple Mobility Specialists to support employees across the following regions:
  
  

* North America (NAM)
* Latin America (LATAM)
* Europe, Middle East & Africa (EMEA)
* Asia Pacific (APAC)

Each Mobility Specialist will serve as the primary mobility operations resource for their assigned region, providing support for mobile services, carrier relationships, eSIM administration, provisioning activities, mobile number management, and end-user mobility support. While aligned to a specific region, team members will collaborate globally to ensure a consistent mobility experience and service delivery model across the organization.
  
  
**Mobile Service Administration**

* Process mobile service requests including new activations, upgrades, line changes, suspensions, and disconnects.
* Coordinate mobile device replacements and service transfers.
* Maintain accurate records of mobile numbers, devices, and service information.
* Assist with mobile inventory tracking and asset management activities.

**SIM & eSIM Support**

* Provision and activate physical SIMs and eSIMs.
* Support users with eSIM setup and activation.
* Troubleshoot common SIM and eSIM issues.
* Coordinate SIM replacements and device upgrade activities.

**User Support**

* Provide day-to-day support for mobile phones, tablets, and wireless services.
* Troubleshoot mobile connectivity, voice, text messaging, and data service issues.
* Assist users with device setup and carrier-related issues.
* Support requests involving lost, stolen, or damaged devices.
* Provide white-glove support for VIP users when required.

**Carrier Coordination**

* Submit support requests and service orders with mobile carriers.
* Track carrier tickets and follow up on outstanding issues.
* Escalate service-impacting issues when necessary.
* Assist with number porting and mobile service changes.

**Security & Account Support**

* Assist users with PIN and PUK code requests.
* Support carrier verification and account authentication processes.
* Coordinate SIM swap requests using approved procedures.
* Report suspected mobile fraud or unauthorized activity.

**Operational Support**

* Maintain mobility documentation and knowledge articles.
* Assist with reporting and inventory audits.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
* Participate in mobility-related projects and service enhancements.

**Required Qualifications**

* Associate degree or equivalent work experience.
* 1-3 years of experience supporting mobile devices, telecommunications services, or end-user technology.
* Experience working with mobile phones, tablets, and wireless carriers.
* Basic understanding of eSIM technology and mobile service provisioning.
* Strong customer service and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple requests and priorities.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting enterprise mobile phone programs.
* Experience working with wireless carriers such as Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, Vodafone, Orange, or Telefónica.
* Familiarity with telecom inventory management systems.
* ITIL or customer support experience.
* Experience supporting corporate mobile device deployments.

**Key Competencies**

* Customer Service
* Mobile Device Support
* eSIM Administration
* SIM Management
* Carrier Coordination
* Problem Solving
* Inventory Management
* Attention to Detail
* Communication Skills
* Organization and Planning

**Success Measures**

* Timely completion of mobility requests
* User satisfaction with mobility services
* Accuracy of device and service inventories
* Resolution of carrier and connectivity issues
* Successful device provisioning and activations
* Compliance with service-level expectations

**Reporting To:**
Mobility Services Lead / EUC Manager
  
  
This role serves as the primary operational resource for employee mobility services, ensuring users receive timely support for mobile devices, carrier services, eSIM activation, and mobile connectivity needs. This version will typically attract Mobility Analysts, Telecom Analysts, Service Desk Leads, and junior Mobility Specialists rather than senior telecom administrators or mobility architects.

title: Department Manager
description:
**WHO WE ARE**
**​**

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

​

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
**​**
  
As a Department Manager, you’ll be the leader supporting and encouraging your whole team. By fostering an inclusive culture that promotes collaboration and an entrepreneurial spirit, you’ll create an environment where everyone can thrive. Acting in line with our values, you’ll contribute to both your own success and the success of the company.

You will:

* Lead your team to deliver an outstanding customer experience by ensuring excellent operational and visual standards, while actively promoting and selling our products.
* Take responsibility for your store and department’s strengths, analyse sales performance, identify commercial opportunities, set goals, and create plans to optimize results, profits, and stock levels.
* Manage team planning, scheduling, and ensure seamless opening and closing routines.
* Recruit, onboard, and develop your team while fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture that promotes growth and innovation.
* Stay updated on fashion trends, customer preferences, and competitors to maintain a competitive edge.
* Represent yourself and the brand positively during all customer interactions.

​

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**
**​**

Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Assistant Store Managers, Cash Office Responsible, and Delivery Responsible in larger stores—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.

​

​

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**
**​**

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

· We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability.

· We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years.

· We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work

· You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits.

· We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness for self and family.

· You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M group.

· We offer 5 days of working in a week to have great work life balance.

Click here for complete role description.

**JOIN US**
**​**

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

​

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

​

​

*\*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.*

**Qualifications**

*We are looking for people with…*
​

* 3+ Years of experience in retail management and operations.
* Strong leadership skills, with a passion for coaching and developing teams while exemplifying company values and culture.
* Expertise in sales planning, analysis, and follow-up, using customer-centric tools and reporting.

*And people who are…*
​

* Strong and confident leaders who inspire, coach, and develop their teams with integrity.
* Thriving in collaborative, dynamic environments, with a solution-focused mindset.
* Motivated to create great customers experiences while promoting and selling our products.
* A keen interest in fashion trends, commerciality, and competitor insights to drive sales.
* Effective communicators, creative, and curious.
* Flexible, analytical, and achievement-oriented, with the ability to manage statistics and work with numbers.

​

**Additional Information**

This is a full-time position for our stores in Pune. The position reports to the Store Manager.

title: AVP - RCM Operations
description:
We're hiring: Assistant Vice President – Operations (US Healthcare RCM) | Pune

Our client, a US healthcare Revenue Cycle Management services organisation, is looking for a senior operations leader to run end-to-end RCM delivery from their Pune center.

This is a P&L-owning role. You'll be accountable for revenue realisation, client satisfaction, and building operations that scale.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

• End-to-end RCM operations: patient access, prior authorization, coding, charge capture, billing, AR follow-up, denial management, payment posting, and write-offs

• Operational strategy aligned to client SLAs, with SOPs, workflows, and escalation matrices that hold up at scale

• KPIs that matter: Days in AR, DSO, clean claim rate, denial rate, first-pass yield, cash collections, and old AR reduction

• AR and denial strategy across Commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid payers, driven by root-cause analysis and corrective action

• Client leadership relationships: primary point of contact, QBRs/MBRs, new client transitions and onboarding

• P&L for the Pune operation: revenue, margins, utilization, cost optimization, and automation-led productivity gains

• Compliance with CMS, OIG, HIPAA, and payer-specific regulations, including audits and internal controls

• A leadership bench of operations managers, team leaders, and functional heads across coding, billing, AR, and denials

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

• 15+ years in US healthcare RCM, with 5–7 years in senior leadership (Director / Sr. AVP / AVP or above)

• Experience running large, multi-functional RCM operations (voice and non-voice) from an India delivery center; Pune experience preferred

• Strong command of US payers, ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, and denial management levers

• Proven ability to link RCM metrics to business outcomes and manage a P&L

• Executive-level client communication and a data-driven approach to problem solving

**GOOD TO HAVE**

• Experience in BPO/ITeS or RCM outsourcing

• Exposure to PM/EHR systems such as Epic, NextGen, Athena, or eClinicalWorks

• Six Sigma, Lean, or other process improvement certifications

• Bachelor's in Healthcare Administration, Business, Finance, or related field; Master's preferred

title: AI Product Manager - Customer Experience & Retention
description:
Drishti Astro is a
**decision-making**
brand. People come to us stuck on the biggest decisions of their life — which career, whom and when to marry, where to put their money — and we use
**Vedic astrology as the tool to make that decision clear**
: what their own birth chart supports, when the timing is strongest, and what to do next. Led by an astrologer with 20 years of practice, we give the decision in writing first, in a personalised report, and then clear every doubt in a one-to-one consultation. Most of our customers are Hindi-speaking families aged 40+, and almost every conversation happens on WhatsApp.

**Vision:**
To become India's most trusted name for taking life's important decisions through Vedic astrology.

**Mission:**
Guide individuals — using Vedic astrology — in taking the important decisions of their life in career, relationships and finances.

**The role in one line:**
make sure every customer leaves able to take their decision with confidence — own customer satisfaction and retention end to end: find out why customers are happy, unhappy or don't come back, then design, ship and measure the fixes yourself, using AI wherever it helps.

**OUR CORE VALUES**

1. **Customer First — Only Promise What Can Be Delivered**
2. *“जो दे सकते हैं, वही कहेंगे।”*
3. The customer's need decides what we build, and we commit only to what we can actually deliver.
4. **Resilience / Adaptability**
5. *“जो बदले, उसके साथ बदलो — बिना घबराए।”*
6. We adapt quickly without losing the core. A setback is information, not a verdict.
7. **Measurable Outcome**
8. *“जो नापा नहीं गया, वो हुआ ही नहीं।”*
9. Every decision is judged on a number, not an opinion. If it can't be measured, it can't be claimed.

**FOUR CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

**01 Research**

* Talk to customers (calls, WhatsApp, surveys) — before and after they buy.
* Read report ratings, feedback and support chats to find the real reasons behind low satisfaction.

**02 Analyse**

* Map the journey: ad → website → checkout → report → rating → repeat purchase → consultation.
* Find where satisfaction and repeat buying drop, with numbers (funnels, cohorts, session recordings).

**03 Manage**

* Turn findings into a ranked backlog with a clear metric per item.
* Write simple specs; work with the founder, marketing and engineering (in-house and AI tools) to deliver.

**04 Execute**

* Ship the fix — report improvements, follow-up journeys, feedback loops, AI assistants.
* Test it, measure the result against the target, keep or roll back.

*Research → Analyse → Prioritise → Ship → Measure → Repeat*

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE (FIRST 90 DAYS)**

* **Day 30:**
  A clear, data-backed list of the top reasons customers rate us low or don't return.
* **Day 60:**
  Fixes for the top two reasons shipped and being measured.
* **Day 90:**
  A measurable rise in report ratings and repeat-purchase rate, and a working feedback loop that keeps finding the next problem.

**MUST-HAVE**

* 3+ years in product management, growth or customer experience at a
  **consumer (B2C)**
  product.
* Proven work on
  **retention, engagement or satisfaction**
  — and the numbers to show for it.
* Hands-on with user research and product analytics (e.g. Mixpanel, PostHog, Microsoft Clarity, GA, SQL / spreadsheets).
* Uses AI/LLM tools in daily work and can design AI-powered product features.
* **Comfortable speaking and writing in Hindi**
  — you will talk to our customers.
* Individual contributor mindset: you do the work yourself, end to end.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Experience with WhatsApp-first journeys, CRM (Zoho) or consumer apps for 40+ users.
* Ran A/B tests and can read whether a result is real.
* Can prototype with no-code / low-code tools (n8n, Make, simple front-end).
* Interest in astrology, spirituality or wellness products.

**NOT THE RIGHT FIT IF**

* You mainly manage teams or write documents without shipping.
* Your experience is only B2B / enterprise, with no consumer customers.

**ENGAGEMENT & COMPENSATION**

* **Engagement:**
  Part-time / Full-time, remote
* **Compensation:**
  ₹6–12 LPA (₹6,00,000 – ₹12,00,000 per year), based on experience and engagement type
* **Reports to:**
  Founder & CEO, working closely with the CMO
* **Start date:**
  Immediate

Apply here: https://maxfate.zohorecruit.in/jobs/Careers/42038000005577001/AI-Product-Manager---Customer-Experience-Retention

In your application, include
**one customer-retention problem you solved, with the number that proves it.**

This is a remote position.

We are looking for a creative, skilled, and detail-oriented **UI/UX Designer** to join our team. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience designing modern websites, SaaS products, dashboards, portals, and CRM systems.

The candidate should be proficient in Figma, understand React/component-based design principles, have experience with WordPress, and possess strong client communication and handling skills.

Key Responsibilities

* Design modern, responsive, and user-friendly websites, landing pages, SaaS applications, dashboards, portals, and CRM systems.
* Create wireframes, user flows, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs using **Figma**.
* Design scalable interfaces following **React/component-based design principles**.
* Develop reusable UI components, design systems, and style guides to maintain consistency across projects.
* Design and improve **WordPress websites**, ensuring visually appealing layouts and smooth user experiences.
* Collaborate closely with frontend developers to ensure accurate design implementation.
* Communicate directly with clients to understand project requirements, gather feedback, and present design concepts.
* Handle client revisions, design discussions, and project updates professionally.
* Improve existing websites and applications through UX analysis and usability improvements.
* Ensure designs are responsive and optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
* Stay updated with modern UI/UX trends, SaaS design patterns, and industry best practices.

Required Skills

* **Figma:** Strong proficiency in wireframing, prototyping, Auto Layout, components, and design systems.
* **SaaS & Dashboard Design:** Experience designing SaaS products, admin dashboards, customer portals, and CRM interfaces.
* **React/Component-Based Design:** Understanding of reusable components, design systems, and React-based frontend workflows.
* **WordPress:** Experience designing WordPress websites and understanding WordPress themes, layouts, and page builders.
* **Client Handling:** Strong communication skills with the ability to understand client requirements, present designs, and manage feedback.
* **Responsive Design:** Knowledge of mobile-first design and cross-device compatibility.
* **UI/UX Principles:** Strong understanding of typography, color theory, visual hierarchy, usability, and user-centered design.
* **Developer Collaboration:** Ability to prepare developer-friendly design files and provide clear design specifications.
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and frontend development is an added advantage.

Qualifications

* **Minimum 5+ years of professional UI/UX design experience.**
* Proven experience designing websites, SaaS platforms, dashboards, portals, or CRM systems.
* Strong portfolio showcasing Figma designs, web applications, and responsive website projects.
* Experience collaborating with React developers and WordPress development teams.
* Excellent communication, client management, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹100,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

● Ability to break down complex problems into structured evaluation scenarios

● Analyze interaction logs and transcripts to improve bot accuracy

**What We Expect From You**

● Strong written clarity and ability to reason through ambiguity

● Structured thinking under pressure

**Start with the customer**

**Master the details**

**Act with urgency**

title: Consultant - Smart Cities
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
We are looking for a Smart Cities Consultant who can focus on details and see the big picture. You will be joining a team who is delivering digital transformation in cities, regions and developments, supporting Clients on major projects globally across multiple sectors. This is an exciting opportunity to join a high-performing team in a rapidly growing market, realize real change and contribute to revolutionary change on a city scale.
  
  
As a Smart Cities Consultant, you will be tasked with working across the Smart City project lifecycle, from the analysis of qualities of place, to the identification and design of smart services, to planning for and driving their implementation. A successful candidate will be able to evidence an excellent capability in applying advanced techniques such as user-centric design on real-life problems as well as presenting outputs in visual forms, infographics and/or dashboards. You will need to collaboratively engage with engineers, urban designers, city stakeholders and industry professionals to develop solutions and agree outputs
  
  
You will be responsible for building your personal brand and developing relationships internally and with clients to help us share knowledge and deliver best practice, you will also be called upon to help colleagues develop their digital awareness, sharing their own knowledge to help others.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Assess the qualities, needs, and opportunities of cities, regions, developments, and communities.
* Develop City/Infrastructure based digital strategies and identify services that can create value for stakeholders.
* Support the planning, design, and implementation of smart city services and digital infrastructure.
* Apply user centered design and advanced techniques to real world challenges.
* Present findings and recommendations through clear written outputs, visualisations, infographics, or dashboards.
* Collaborate with engineers, urban designers, planners, clients, city stakeholders, and industry professionals.
* Build client and internal relationships, share knowledge, and contribute to good practice and digital awareness.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* Degree qualified
* Experience delivering strategies and projects for cities, regions, developments, and communities to help harness the potential of digital technologies.
* Experience of working with national or local government bodies and/or with property and infrastructure companies
* Analytical and Numerical skills are a strong advantage
* Expertise in both relevant technologies (such as 4G/5G communications, IoT, big data/analytics) and their business, social and economic impact
* Excellent communication, including both oral and written English
* Experience working in multi-disciplinary teams
* Experience and knowledge of digital master planning and related themes such as sustainability and climate change
* Experience working with planners, urban designers, and other built environment design disciplines
* Experience of networking and ability to build client relationships

At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.
  
  
At Jacobs it’s all about what you do, not where you are, which counts!
  
  
We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.

description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.**

  
About JumpCloud®
  

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

  
  
**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.**

**About the Role**
  

We have a well established technical writing team, and are evolving our approach to content at JumpCloud. We are looking for an experienced
**Technical Writer**
to lead, scale, and optimize our product and developer documentation. In this role, you won't just write—you will act as an information architect and workflow innovator.

  

You will leverage cutting-edge AI documentation tools, prompt engineering, and modern automation to streamline content creation. Your goal is to keep our documentation technically accurate, end user focused, and optimized for both human readers and AI retrieval systems (RAG/chatbots).

**Key Responsibilities :**
  
**Docs-as-Code & Version Control Management**
  

  
* **GitHub Native Workflow:**
  Manage documentation using standard developer tools—drafting in Markdown, managing branches, opening Pull Requests (PRs), and conducting code reviews in GitHub.
  
* **Continuous Publishing:**
  Integrate into automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using Static Site Generators (e.g., Docusaurus, MkDocs, Hugo).
  
* Maintain strict version control across multiple product releases, API versions, and branch merges.
  
  

  

**Content Generation & In-App User Guidance**

  

  
* Author, edit, and maintain clear, accurate end user documentation (API references, developer guides, user how to’s, configuration guides, and release notes) for IT admins and their teams
  
* **Cross-collaboration**
  : Partner closely with Engineering, Product Managers, and Designers to translate UX designs, and technical specs into intuitive content.
  
* **UX Writing**
  : Work with Design to provide copy and improve UX prototypes.
  
* **Manage Rolling Product Releases**
  : We have continuous releases meaning teams push new features and updates any time throughout the quarter. You should feel comfortable managing and prioritizing 15-20 feature/update releases during a quarter.
  
  

  

  
* **Conduct rigorous technical validation**
  : Test feature flags in the product, API endpoints, run sample code, and verify UI flows before publishing.
  
* **In-App Engagement**
  : Design, deploy, and manage in-app onboarding flows, tooltips, and release announcements using Pendo (or similar platforms like Appcues/WalkMe).
  
  

  
**AI Tooling & Workflow Optimization**
  

  
* **Prompt Engineering:**
  Design, test, and standardize custom prompts and prompt templates to accelerate process, information architecture, media, and content reformatting.
  
* **AI-Assisted Efficiency:**
  Integrate AI assistants into daily workflows to drastically reduce time spent on repetitive tasks (e.g., generating initial drafts, converting legacy docs, auditing terminology etc).
  
* **Human Quality Control:**
  Act as the final filter for AI-generated outputs, rigorously auditing content for technical accuracy, brand tone, hallucinations, and security compliance.
  
  

  
**Requirements & Qualifications :**
  

  
* **Experience:**
  4-7+ years of experience as a Technical Writer, Documentation Engineer, or Product Content Strategy Specialist in a SaaS or tech environment.
  
* **GitHub & Docs-as-Code (Required):**
  Proven mastery of
  **GitHub**
  (PRs, code reviews, branch management), Markdown, and Static Site Generators within a
  **Docs-as-Code pipeline**
  .
  
* **AI & Prompting Fluency:**
  Hands-on experience using generative AI tools (LLMs, AI coding assistants, etc) and a working knowledge of prompt engineering techniques.
  
* **Technical Depth:**
  Ability to quickly contribute to the platform and new features quickly given highly technical, and nuanced specifications.
  
* **Critical Thinking:**
  Strong editorial judgment. We want you to be able to catch subtle hallucinations, out-of-date parameters, or security risks in AI assisted drafts.
  
* **In-App Notification Tools (Required):**
  Hands-on, demonstrated experience building and targeting in-app messaging, guides, and analytics using
  **Pendo**
  (or comparable tools like Appcues, Userpilot, WalkMe).
  
  

  
**Additional Qualifications We Value :**
  

  
* Experience using Pendo to track documentation consumption and guide completion rates.
  
* Experience training and refining AI models on internal style guides and technical glossaries.
  
* Background in API design or developer-focused content strategy.
  
* Ability to create JSON scripts.
  
  

  

**Kindly share your portfolio while applying for the role. This can include documentation samples, AI prompts, demo video or video recordings of using AI to improve a process, examples of in-app notifications/announcements or onboarding flows, Git repositories etc.**

  



**Where you’ll be working/Location:**

  

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

  
  

**This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.**

  
  

**Language:**

  

JumpCloud® has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud®, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

  
  

**Why JumpCloud?**

 

  

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud® is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  

  
  

One of JumpCloud®'s three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO

  
  

Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud®.  Please note JumpCloud® is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   

  
  

JumpCloud® is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

title: Technical Writer
description:
**About Hevo**

At Hevo Data, we’re building the future of data infrastructure for AI. Over 2,000 companies across 40+ countries trust Hevo to power their analytics. As a deep tech company, our engineering team solves some of the hardest problems in data integration, scale, and reliability.

We’re looking for a Technical Writer who goes beyond polishing prose. We want someone who tests the product hands-on, reads connector configs and API references, and verifies every documented behavior before it ships. You’ll use AI tools like Claude to work faster, and you’ll have the judgment to catch what AI gets wrong.

If you can speak the language of engineers and turn complex data integration behavior into docs people trust, let’s talk.

**What you’ll do**

* Own documentation for new features and Sources end-to-end, from reading connector configuration and specs through testing, review, and PR merge, with minimal supervision.
* Test features in the product: create test accounts and data, run Pipelines, and verify the loaded data in the Destination (for example, with SQL), so every documented behavior is confirmed.
* Read connector configuration (YAML/JSON), API references, and code, with AI help, to understand authentication, sync modes, delete handling, and rate limits.
* Use Claude and Claude skills to draft, restructure, and QA large docs. Critically review the output for invented behavior, wrong links, and unsupported claims.
* Review automation-generated drafts and their open flags, and confirm each point with Product or Engineering before publishing.
* Automate repetitive content such as object tables, ERDs, link checks, and consistent screenshots instead of producing them by hand.
* Raise clear engineering queries and bug reports, with steps to reproduce and expected versus actual results, and track them to closure in Jira and Confluence.
* Work in Git: branch, raise PRs, resolve conflicts, run local builds, and respond to review comments.
* Help evolve our documentation standards, templates, and style guides. When AI output repeatedly needs the same fixes, improve the prompts and skills behind it.
* Review associate writers’ work and share effective research methods and prompts.

**What you bring**

* 3–5 years of technical writing experience, preferably for SaaS, API, or data products.
* Strong written English and the ability to explain complex technical behavior simply and accurately.
* Working knowledge of APIs and data integration concepts: OAuth and API key authentication, incremental and full loads, schemas, and primary keys.
* Hands-on docs-as-code experience: Markdown, YAML, Git, and a static site generator (for example, Jekyll).
* Daily, confident use of AI tools for research, drafting, and review, including creating and maintaining Claude skills and prompts.
* The ability to read code and config files and write basic SQL queries.
* The ability to set up test environments and test features end-to-end on your own.
* The ability to manage several tickets in parallel, track dependencies on releases and engineering answers, and communicate status proactively.

**Nice to have**

* Experience documenting ETL/ELT, data integration, or developer products.
* Basic scripting (Python or shell) to automate documentation tasks.
* Experience with ERD tools (for example, dbdocs) and browser automation for screenshots (for example, Playwright).

**Why Hevo**

* Work on docs for a data platform used by 2,000+ companies worldwide.
* Own your work from spec to merged PR, with real trust and autonomy.
* Work in an AI-forward team that expects you to use, question, and improve the tools.
* Collaborate directly with engineers solving hard problems in data integration, scale, and reliability.

title: Technical Newsletter Writer & AI Reporter
description:
**About The Code**

The Code is Superhuman's family of newsletters for developers and technical professionals. It's made up of three titles:

* **The Code**
  covers AI coding tools, developer tooling, open source and the engineering trends changing how software gets built.
* **The Code Cybersecurity**
  covers breaches, vulnerabilities, supply-chain attacks and the security news engineering teams need to act on.
* **The IT Code**
  covers infrastructure, cloud, enterprise IT and the tools and decisions that keep companies running.

Superhuman is one of the biggest technology newsletter publishers in the world, with 1.5M+ readers. Our mission is to become the biggest newsletter publisher in tech by being the most trusted source of news and insight for millions of readers. Journalists and editors from publications like NBC and BBC work here.

**About the role**

We're hiring a full-time writer for The Code's content team. You'll research and write daily issues that keep developers, security professionals and IT leaders up to date on what matters in their world. You'll explain what happened and why it matters to the people who build, secure and run software. A technical background is required, because our readers are technical and can tell when a writer isn't.

**What's in it for you**

* A chance to accelerate your career by a decade, with the platform to help build and lead the content function for one of the fastest-growing newsletter brands in tech.
* Top-tier mentorship, working directly with a founding team that has built eight- and nine-figure companies.
* A strong culture of coaching and promoting from within.
* Very competitive pay.
* The chance to interview industry leaders like Marc Benioff (CEO, Salesforce), Aaron Levie (CEO, Box), Mike Krieger (cofounder, Instagram) and more.

**What you'll be doing**

* **Research:**
  Follow developer, security and IT news closely across Hacker News, GitHub, security advisories, vendor blogs, X and the tech press. You'll spot the launches, vulnerabilities, outages and culture shifts our readers need to know about.
* **Pitching:**
  Pitch the lead story and angles each day, and decide what each section should cover for each audience.
* **Writing:**
  Write a sharp, roughly 1,000-word issue with 4–5 sections. You'll make technical topics, from a new coding model to a critical CVE (a publicly listed security flaw), clear, accurate and fun to read.
* **Editing:**
  Proofread, fact-check, edit and rewrite sections so they meet our standards for accuracy, tone and voice. Technical claims, version numbers and security details have to be right.
* **Collaborating:**
  Work daily with teammates who help with research, writing and editing, using our content management system.

**Requirements**

* At least 2 years of experience in content writing, reporting, editing or journalism.
* A technical background in programming, software development, security or IT is a plus.
* Newsletter experience is a plus.
* Experience writing about developer tools, cybersecurity, infrastructure or AI is a plus.
* Comfort reading code, changelogs, docs and security advisories, and turning them into stories readers care about.
* Strong research, writing, fact-checking and editing skills.
* A compelling writing style that informs readers and also entertains them enough to keep coming back.
* Strong organization and time management, so every issue goes out on time, every day.
* A genuine passion for helping technical people stay ahead.
* Ambition, resourcefulness and drive. You set big goals and put in the work to beat them.

**Compensation**

* Salary between USD 24,000 to USD 36,000 based on skill, experience and past performance.
* Fully remote.
* Typical hours are 9 AM to 6 PM IST, because of the news cycle.

The Product Engineer will be the technical link between customers, sales and manufacturing for fiber optic cable assemblies used in aerospace and defense applications. The role covers understanding customer requirements, reviewing drawings and specifications, processing RFQs, and defining product configurations that meet performance, quality and compliance standards. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with high-reliability interconnect products and can turn complex requirements into accurate, manufacturable and cost-effective solutions.

costing inputs, lead-time estimation and submission of technical and commercial responses within

deadlines.

title: R&D Product Support and Enhancement Engineer
description:
The opportunity
  
  
Join our R&D team and help keep our power conversion products performing at their best across their full lifecycle. You will work in a cross-functional environment alongside engineering, manufacturing, quality, procurement, project management, and external partners to resolve complex technical issues and drive continuous product improvement.
  
  
In this role, you will provide advanced technical support for power electronics products used in renewable energy and energy storage applications. You will analyze complex problems, interpret schematics and converter behavior, support commissioning and laboratory testing, and prepare clear technical documentation. Your work directly improves the reliability, maintainability, and cost-effectiveness of products deployed worldwide.
  
  
To excel, you bring strong product understanding, hands-on troubleshooting skills, and the analytical mindset needed to read schematics, debug signals, and trace root causes. You communicate clearly across functions, document rigorously, and enjoy turning recurring issues into lasting product improvements.
  
  
You will grow by engaging with the full product lifecycle, from prototype and customer tests through certification, commissioning, and field support. You will build deep expertise across power converters, energy storage systems, and validation environments while collaborating with global engineering, quality, and product teams.
  
  
How you’ll make an impact
  
  

* Act as a technical interface across manufacturing, engineering, procurement, project management, and quality, providing coordination, technical support, and product-related guidance.
* Analyze, track, and report bugs, defects, and non-conformities identified during validation, testing, commissioning, or field support activities.
* Drive incident resolution using product documentation, internal expertise, lab analysis, and coordination with suppliers and manufacturing teams.
* Perform technical analysis of logs, errors, signals, waveforms, and performance metrics, and prepare clear, reusable reports for engineering, quality, and certification activities.
* Support product optimization and enhancement initiatives to improve converter performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost-effectiveness.
* Maintain and continuously improve technical product documentation, troubleshooting guides, test records, and engineering support material.
* Perform commissioning of power conversion and control systems interfacing with energy storage systems in laboratory environments, and support prototype, customer, and certification tests including result reporting.
* Interpret electrical schematics, analyze converter topologies, operating modes, and system protection concepts, and collaborate with R&D, validation, quality, and product teams on root cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or an equivalent engineering field.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in power electronics, product support, validation, testing, or product engineering.
* Experience in the design of electrical systems and power electronics converters, including control aspects.
* Strong knowledge of power converters, especially AC/DC and DC/DC converter topologies.
* Experience in validation of electronic products and/or embedded software, with hands-on use of laboratory test benches, measurement equipment, and engineering test environments.
* Ability to interpret electrical schematics and understand conversion topologies, protection logic, and operating modes.
* Hands-on experience with laboratory instruments such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, network analyzers, and temperature recorders.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with proven ability to prepare structured technical reports, validation reports, issue summaries, and product support documentation.

title: SR PROJECT MGMT CONSULTANT II-INDIA
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.
  
  
At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.
  
  
This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.
  
  
**The Role**
The Change Management Specialist drives follow-through action plans arising from Change Control Board (CCB) decisions. The role works with accountable teams to establish clear actions, owners, due dates, and completion evidence; tracks progress; and escalates outstanding items to keep approved changes moving toward closure.
  
  
The Specialist maintains visibility into costs to be recouped from partners or customers, working with Finance, Procurement, National and Regional Teams and the responsible customer-facing teams to track recovery actions and financial outcomes. The role also ensures insights from changes are fed back to engineering teams for future design and planning considerations and regularly builds and maintains a shared lessons-learned record.
  
  
The focus is disciplined action-plan execution, accurate tracking, reporting, and continuous improvement—not direct leadership of cross-team change-management coordination. Accountable teams retain ownership of implementation, engineering decisions, and commercial or financial approvals.
  
  
**The Main Responsibilities**
CCB Action Plans and Follow-Through
  
  

* Translate CCB decisions and conditional approvals into documented action plans with clear deliverables, owners, due dates, dependencies, and completion criteria.
* Drive follow-through by obtaining updates, confirming next steps, and tracking commitments through completion.
* Facilitate action-status reviews, identify missed commitments and cross-team dependencies, and escalate unresolved blockers.
* Maintain CCB action logs and change-request records, including decisions, conditions, ownership, milestones, status, and closure evidence.
* Drive resolution of aging, on-hold, and unresolved change requests, keeping approved items visible until implementation and follow-up are complete.
* Coordinate post-approval handoffs, documentation, and required system, financial, project, or administrative updates. Verify implementation aligns with approved changes.
* Identify recurring gaps in documentation, ownership, handoffs, and follow-through.

Partner and Customer Cost Recovery
  
  

* Partner with Finance, commercial, customer-facing, and project teams to identify potentially recoverable costs arising from approved changes and validate responsibility, documentation, and recovery routes.
* Maintain a recovery register linked to change requests, tracking recovery basis, amounts identified and validated, owners, target dates, invoices/claims, amounts recovered, outstanding balances, and disputes.
* Drive follow-up on customer amendments, partner claims, invoices, credits, and supporting evidence; escalate missing documentation, disputes, and overdue recoveries.
* Reconcile recovery status with Finance and retain evidence of payments, credits, settlements, or approved write-offs, clearly distinguishing potential, validated, and realized recovery.
* Coordinate recovery activities while Finance and authorized commercial teams retain responsibility for billing, collections, settlements, and financial approvals.

Engineering Feedback and Lessons Learned
  
  

* Capture change drivers, design or scope gaps, implementation issues, and cost impacts, and share relevant findings with Engineering and project teams.
* Track engineering feedback, owners, responses, recommendations, and dispositions, including documented rationale.
* Maintain a lessons-learned register covering issues, confirmed causes, impacts, preventive actions, ownership, and status.
* Highlight recurring themes and track agreed improvement actions through closure to reduce repeat changes and avoidable costs.

Progress Reporting and Closure
  
  

* Provide consolidated leadership reporting on action-plan progress, completed and overdue items, aging, dependencies, blockers, financial exposure, and decisions required.
* Report cost-recovery progress by partner/customer and change request, including validated, invoiced/claimed, recovered, outstanding, and disputed amounts.
* Confirm closure with accountable teams using documented completion evidence. Track action implementation and financial recovery separately until resolved, including formally approved exceptions.

**What We Look For In a Candidate**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, telecommunications, , project management, , or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or comparable project management certification preferred
* Professional experience in technology or telecommunications project delivery, engineering support, project controls, or change control; experience with network infrastructure, fiber deployment, or construction programs preferred.
* Hands-on experience maintaining action logs and cost-recovery trackers, preparing status reports, and working with engineering, Finance, Procurement, and project-delivery teams.
* Demonstrated experience driving action plans, maintaining project or change-control records, and following up with multiple teams to achieve documented closure.
* Ability to influence without direct authority, obtain clear commitments, facilitate action-status reviews, and escalate unresolved issues constructively.
* Understanding change-request workflows, approval conditions, implementation handoffs, dependencies, and closure documentation.
* Experience tracking cost impacts, cost recovery, customer billing actions, partner claims, or comparable financial follow-up in coordination with Finance and commercial teams.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to data accuracy, including the ability to reconcile action and recovery records and distinguish estimates, validated amounts, and realized recoveries.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce concise leadership updates that clearly identify progress, risks, financial exposure, and decisions needed.
* Strong organizational, prioritization, and follow-through skills, with experience documenting lessons learned and translating recurring issues into actionable feedback for engineering and project teams.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and Microsoft 365 tools used for tracking, collaboration, and reporting.

title: Project Management Intern (Controls, Embedded & Autonomous Systems)
description:
**About the role**

We are hiring a Project Management Intern to keep our autonomous systems programs on schedule across its controls, embedded and autonomy workstreams. You will own the plan, the tracker and the cadence that keep these engineering teams moving together toward field-ready builds.

Our programs span hardware platforms, low-level controls and embedded firmware, autonomy software, connectivity, and the apps used to operate them. Your job is to make dependencies between these teams visible early and get blockers resolved before they slip a milestone.

**Key responsibilities**

**Planning and tracking**

* Build and maintain the integrated project plan: milestones, work breakdown and cross-team dependencies for controls, embedded and autonomy.
* Run the project tracker (Jira or equivalent): keep tickets current, flag overdue items and publish a weekly status report.
* Track hardware lead times, prototype build schedules and component procurement against the integration timeline.

Team Program management office

* Reports to Program Manager
* Location Nelamangala
* Duration 6 Months Full Time
* Stipend INR 25,000/- Month

**Team coordination**

* Run sprint planning, stand-ups, cross-team syncs and retrospectives; capture decisions and action items, and follow them to closure.
* Act as the single point of contact between controls, firmware, autonomy, hardware and test teams on schedule and scope questions.
* Coordinate with vendors and suppliers on deliveries, quotes and technical documentation.

**Integration and testing**

* Plan hardware-in-the-loop (HIL), software-in-the-loop (SIL) and field test campaigns with engineering leads; book test resources and vehicles.
* Track test results, open defects and their fixes through to verification.
* Maintain the release and version matrix linking firmware, controller software and autonomy stack versions on each vehicle.

**Risk, documentation and reporting**

* Keep a risk and issue register, with owners and mitigation plans, and escalate early.
* Maintain requirements traceability and engineering documentation (specs, interface
* control documents, test reports, change requests).
* Prepare progress summaries and review decks for leadership and stakeholders.

**Required qualifications**

* Familiarity with project management basics: work breakdown, Gantt charts, critical path, Agile/Scrum.
* Strong skills in Excel or Google Sheets and a task tracker such as Jira, Trello or Asana.
* Clear written and spoken English; comfortable running meetings and following up with senior engineers.
* Organized, detail-oriented and able to juggle several workstreams at once.
* Would prove a plus, if working knowledge of how controls, embedded systems and autonomous systems fit together: sensors, controllers (PLCs, ECUs, microcontrollers), actuators and the software that runs on them.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Hands-on project experience in robotics, EV, drones or automotive (student teams such as Formula Student, SAE BAJA or robotics clubs count).
* Exposure to embedded tools and stacks: C/C++, ROS/ROS 2, CAN bus, IEC 61131-3
* (Structured Text), MATLAB/Simulink.
* Understanding of the product development lifecycle: requirements, design reviews, prototyping, validation and release.
* Awareness of functional safety and quality practices (ISO 26262, V-model, FMEA).
* Coursework or certification in project management (e.g. CAPM, Scrum Master or a university course).

**What you will gain**

* Ownership of a real program plan for an autonomous vehicle headed for field deployment.
* Direct exposure to controls, embedded and autonomy engineering, from bench tests to on-vehicle trials.
* Mentorship from the program and engineering leads, with regular feedback on your work.
* An internship certificate, a letter of recommendation, and a possible pre-placement offer based on performance

title: Electrical CM Support Engineer - Operations Engineering Team
description:
**Job Description**
Join our Engineering Operations Team as an
**Electrical CM Support Engineer**
, where you will be responsible for developing, qualifying, and sustaining advanced assembly and interconnect processes used in high-performance electronic products. You will work across the entire product lifecycle, from New Product Introduction (NPI) through volume manufacturing, driving process optimization, yield improvement, and root cause analysis.
  
  
In this role, you will support complex assembly technologies including SMT, fine-pitch PCBA, organic and mSAP-based substrates, reflow soldering, hot bar soldering, laser soldering, flip-chip assembly, and advanced packaging solutions. You will leverage inspection and analytical techniques such as X-ray analysis, cross-sectioning, microscopy, and reliability testing to ensure robust manufacturing processes and superior product quality. Our collaborative environment encourages innovation, technical leadership, and continuous improvement while solving challenging manufacturing problems.
  
  
**NILightpath**
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Develop, optimize, and qualify SMT, through-hole, laser soldering, hot bar soldering, flip-chip, underfill, die attach, and advanced packaging processes.
* Define and maintain robust process windows for reflow soldering and advanced electronic assembly technologies.
* Support New Product Introduction (NPI) from prototype builds through high-volume manufacturing.
* Conduct process characterization, Design of Experiments (DOE), and process capability studies.
* Lead failure analysis and root-cause investigations using X-ray, cross-sectioning, microscopy, and electrical characterization.
* Perform cross-sectional analysis to assess solder joint integrity, PCB structures, and manufacturing defects.
* Drive yield improvement, quality enhancement, process optimization, and cost reduction initiatives.
* Collaborate with design teams to ensure Design for Manufacturing (DFM), Design for Assembly (DFA), and Design for Reliability (DFR).
* Develop manufacturing specifications, work instructions, control plans, process documentation, and qualification reports.
* Work closely with suppliers, contract manufacturers, and factory teams for reliability testing and production readiness.

**Key Skills And Experience**

* BS/MS/PhD in Electrical, Electronics, Manufacturing Engineering, Materials Science, or related field
* Strong expertise in electronics manufacturing, SMT assembly, reflow soldering, thermal profiling, and advanced PCB technologies.
* Hands-on experience with advanced interconnect and packaging technologies (laser soldering, flip-chip, underfill, die attach).
* Proven capability in X-ray inspection, cross-section analysis, solder joint characterization, and failure/root-cause investigations.
* Experience with semiconductor packaging, silicon photonics, RF/optical modules, advanced failure analysis techniques (e.g., SEM, EDS, FIB), and familiarity with Industry 4.0/automation.

title: Applications Engineer – Digital Power Controllers
description:
**Role: Applications Engineer – Digital Power Controllers**

**Job Description:**

We are seeking an experienced and customer-focused Applications Engineer to support the design-in and adoption of our UCD family of digital power controllers. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in digital power control topologies, embedded firmware, and system-level debug, with the ability to translate customer requirements into working solutions. This role requires close collaboration with design, marketing, and field sales teams to enable customers building mission critical data centres, AI servers, and a wide array of Industrial applications.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Customer design support: Provide technical guidance to customers on the design, configuration, and firmware development of systems using TI ASM UCD devices such as the UCD3138/UCD4138, across applications like Power Factor Correction (PFC), DC/DC converters, and other digital power topologies.
* Reference design development: Design, build, and validate reference designs, evaluation modules (EVMs), and demo boards that showcase UCD capabilities and accelerate customer adoption.
* Firmware and GUI tools: Develop and customize firmware, configuration tools, and GUIs (e.g., Fusion Digital Power) to simplify customer evaluation, tuning, and deployment of UCD-based designs.
* System bring-up and debug: Support customers with board bring-up, system integration, and troubleshooting of hardware, firmware, and communication interfaces (e.g., PMBus, I2C, SPI).
* Lab characterization: Use lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, power analyzers, and logic analyzers to characterize system performance, validate control loop stability, and resolve customer-reported issues.
* Pre- and post-sales support: Respond to customer technical queries via E2E forums, service requests, and direct engagement, including both pre-sales design consultation and post-sales production support.
* Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with design, test, marketing, and field sales teams to relay customer feedback, influence roadmap decisions, and support new product introductions (NPI).
* Documentation and collateral: Create and maintain technical reference manuals, datasheets, application notes, user guides, FAQs, and training materials to support customer self-sufficiency and broaden product adoption.
* Continuous Improvement: Participate in design reviews and contribute to improving applications engineering tools, processes, and support methodologies.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of industry experience in applications engineering, systems engineering, or embedded firmware development.
* Bachelor's or master's degree in Electronics/Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++, with the ability to read, debug, and modify firmware for digital power controllers.
* Experience with industry-standard communication protocols like PMBus, I2C, and SPI.
* Experience with TI's Code Composer Studio (CCS), IAR, Keil and other relevant development and debug tools.
* Familiarity with scripting languages like Python, JavaScript and ability to automate characterization, test, and support workflows.
* Strong customer-facing communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to customers of varying expertise.
* Direct, hands-on experience with TI's UCD digital power controller family or Fusion Digital Power GUI will be an added advantage.
* Deep understanding of digital power control theory and common topologies (PFC, buck, boost, LLC, etc.).
* Basic understanding of signal processing and experience using model-based development tools like MATLAB and Simulink will be a definite plus.
* Ability to read and interpret schematics and datasheets, with experience in hardware-software interaction and board-level debugging.
* Proficiency in using standard lab equipment and debugging tools.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, excellent communication abilities, and a collaborative, customer-centric mindset.

**About Us**

**Why TI?**

* The future starts here. As a TIer, you'll play a critical role in defining the next era of semiconductor technology and help create the innovations that shape the world around us.
* Surround yourself with a team of innovators who value your unique perspective and will challenge you to bring your best self to work every day. We believe that fostering a culture of collaboration fuels both personal growth and technological breakthroughs. Explore our company culture .
* At TI, your success goes beyond your work. Take advantage of comprehensive benefits designed to support your total well-being at work and in life, from competitive compensation to extensive health coverage and wellness programs. Learn more about our benefits offerings .

**About Texas Instruments**

Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. Learn more at TI.com .

Texas Instruments is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse, inclusive work environment.

If you are interested in this position, please apply to this requisition.

**About The Team**

TI does not make recruiting or hiring decisions based on citizenship, immigration status or national origin. However, if TI determines that information access or export control restrictions based upon applicable laws and regulations would prohibit you from working in this position without first obtaining an export license, TI expressly reserves the right not to seek such a license for you and either offer you a different position that does not require an export license or decline to move forward with your employment.

description:

title: Technical Content Writer
description:
**Technical Content Writer**

**Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

**Department:**
Marketing / Creative Content

**Reports To:**
Creative Content Manager

Website: IRISS | YouTube: IRISS

**About IRISS**

IRISS is the global leader in industrial safety and condition-based monitoring technologies, trusted by power generation, data center, and critical infrastructure teams worldwide.

We design and manufacture innovative solutions at our facility in Bradenton, Florida, USA, helping organizations prevent failures, reduce risk, and protect their people.

Headquartered in the United States, with operations across LATAM, EMEA, APAC, and India, we combine global reach with a people-first mission:
**We Humanize Safety.**

Our products and technologies make maintenance safer, smarter, and more connected through intuitive solutions designed around the people who use them.

**Why Join IRISS?**

Join a rapidly expanding global business with a startup mindset, where innovation, collaboration, and professional growth are part of our culture.

At IRISS, you'll have the opportunity to contribute meaningful ideas, work alongside talented professionals, and help shape how industries approach electrical safety and equipment reliability.

We move quickly, think boldly, and support each other. We believe in doing meaningful work while maintaining a collaborative and genuinely human environment.

**About the Role**

IRISS is seeking an experienced
**Technical Content Writer**
to develop clear, credible, and technically accurate content focused on industrial electrical safety, condition-based maintenance, equipment reliability, and IRISS solutions.

The primary focus of this position is senior-level technical writing and editorial quality, supported by foundational SEO knowledge to improve content visibility and performance.

Working closely with the Creative Content Manager, subject matter experts, and SEO specialist, you will transform technical information, expert interviews, product documentation, and research into informative content that helps readers understand complex subjects and make informed decisions.

This is
**not a dedicated SEO specialist position**
. Technical SEO strategy and ownership will remain with the SEO specialist.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical research capabilities with excellent writing, editing, and communication skills and can translate complex technical information into clear, practical content for professional audiences.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Technical Writing and Content Development**

* Develop technical blogs, whitepapers, case studies, articles, and guides covering electrical inspection, industrial maintenance, safety, and equipment reliability.

* Create and update website content, including product pages, service pages, industry pages, FAQs, and interactive Virtual Experience Centers.

* Translate complex engineering concepts, product specifications, and technical documentation into accurate, accessible content.

* Collaborate with subject matter experts to capture technical insights and communicate them effectively.

* Research and verify technical terminology, product capabilities, statistics, and supporting references.

**Video, Webinar, and Marketing Content**

* Develop video scripts, interview questions, webinar summaries, descriptions, and supporting promotional materials.

* Repurpose interviews, presentations, webinars, and technical publications into articles, social media content, email communications, and sales materials.

* Maintain consistency in technical messaging, editorial standards, and brand voice across content formats.

**Content Optimization and SEO Support**

* Review and improve existing website content for technical accuracy, clarity, readability, and relevance.

* Apply foundational on-page SEO practices, including keyword placement, headings, metadata, FAQs, image alt text, and internal linking.

* Collaborate with the SEO specialist on content briefs, keyword recommendations, and basic content performance insights.

* Identify content gaps and recommend improvements that enhance the reader experience.

* Support website content publishing and updates while maintaining technical accuracy.

**Research, Editing, and Collaboration**

* Conduct research using reliable technical and industry sources.

* Interview engineers, maintenance professionals, and other technical specialists to develop accurate content.

* Edit and proofread technical materials for grammar, clarity, consistency, and accuracy.

* Identify unsupported claims or information requiring additional technical verification.

* Manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, incorporate feedback, and maintain version control.

* Coordinate with colleagues in India and the United States, including agreed working-hour overlap for meetings and reviews.

**Technical Topics**

The successful candidate will develop content covering technologies and applications such as:

* Infrared thermography and infrared inspection windows.

* Electrical equipment, including switchgear, transformers, distribution systems, and control panels.

* Condition-based maintenance and asset management.

* Ultrasound inspection and partial discharge.

* Vibration analysis and Motion Amplification.

* Continuous monitoring, sensors, and asset management software.

* Electrical safety, risk reduction, and the hierarchy of controls.

* Equipment reliability across manufacturing, data centers, utilities, healthcare, and other industries.

**Candidates are not expected to be experts in every subject immediately but must demonstrate the ability to research, understand, and communicate unfamiliar technical concepts.**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in English, technical writing, journalism, communications, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

* Demonstrated experience in technical writing, industrial content development, engineering communications, or B2B technology marketing.

* A portfolio demonstrating ownership of substantial technical content projects.

* Experience producing technical articles, blogs, whitepapers, case studies, website copy, or similar materials.

* Excellent written English, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills.

* Ability to translate complex technical information into clear, practical content for engineering, maintenance, safety, and business audiences.

* Strong research and fact-checking skills, including evaluating sources and verifying technical claims.

* Experience collaborating with technical specialists and subject matter experts.

* Ability to adapt content for different audiences while maintaining consistent editorial standards.

* Familiarity with foundational SEO principles and digital content writing.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office or comparable collaborative writing and editing tools.

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently manage multiple assignments and deadlines.

* Ability to collaborate with international teams, including colleagues in the United States.

**Relevant work experience and strong writing samples are more important than a specific degree.**

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience writing about electrical engineering, industrial maintenance, manufacturing, or workplace safety.

* Familiarity with technical standards and the importance of expert interpretation.

* Experience interviewing engineers and technical professionals.

* Working knowledge of on-page SEO, including title tags, meta descriptions, keyword intent, heading structure, FAQs, and internal linking.

* Familiarity with SEMrush and Google Search Console.

* Experience using WordPress, Jira, and collaborative content management systems.

* Experience developing video scripts, presentation content, and interactive digital materials.

* Experience using AI-assisted writing and research tools responsibly, including independent fact verification and protection of confidential information.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Consistently delivering accurate, well-structured technical content that meets editorial requirements.

* Producing high-quality drafts requiring progressively fewer revisions.

* Meeting agreed content schedules and project deadlines.

* Effectively repurposing technical materials across multiple communication channels.

* Developing a strong understanding of IRISS products, technologies, customers, and editorial standards.

* Creating useful content that helps readers understand technical problems and solutions.

* Delivering SEO-ready content in collaboration with the SEO specialist.

**Compensation and Benefits**

IRISS offers competitive compensation, a comprehensive benefits package, and opportunities for professional growth and development.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates should submit their
**CV and three relevant writing samples**
, including at least one sample explaining a technical subject to a professional audience.

Please also include a brief description of your contribution to each writing sample, your experience with industrial or engineering topics, and your availability.

Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a brief writing exercise and discuss their research and editing process.

**Join IRISS and help us communicate technologies that make industrial maintenance safer, smarter, and more reliable.**

**We Humanize Safety.**
