title: Sr Safety Medical Writer
description:
**Company:**
Novo Nordisk Global Business Services (GBS)
  
  
**Job Level: 7**
Shape the safety narrative behind medicines that reach millions of patients worldwide. In this role, your words don't just inform — they protect.
  
  
**Your new role**
As a Senior Safety Medical Writer, you will independently deliver complex writing assignments that sit at the heart of pharmacovigilance. Your expertise in aggregate safety analyses and regulatory documentation will ensure that the safety profile of Novo Nordisk's products is communicated with accuracy, compliance, and clarity — ultimately safeguarding patients around the world.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include**

* Preparing complex aggregate safety reports, Risk Management Plans (RMPs), and responses to Health Authority questions
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality scientific writing and timely reporting of safety data
* Evaluating and implementing changes in local and global guidelines to ensure compliance with both internal and external requirements
* Contributing to innovation and technical optimisation projects within Safety Medical Writing to enhance efficiency, quality, and scalability of deliverables
* Driving process improvement activities, medical writing competency development, and skill building across the Safety Medical Writing function
* Acting as an expert resource for junior team members, sharing knowledge and taking proactive steps to raise the bar for the team

**Your new department**
Safety Medical Writing is a global team within Global Patient Safety, situated in Bangalore, India and Søborg, Denmark. Safety Medical Writing delivers expertise in regulatory pharmacovigilance documentation to ensure that the safety data of our products is presented clearly and concisely in documents that are fit-for-purpose, with transparency and ethics being our key drivers.
  
  
Global Patient Safety is an organization of more than 400 highly professional people with a high level of education within Life Sciences. Safety Medical Writing is responsible for reporting on the emerging safety profile based on routine surveillance of all Novo Nordisk’s products (both currently marketed and under development worldwide), to ensure patient safety.
  
  
**Your Skills & Qualifications**
We're looking for a Senior Safety Medical Writer who combines deep pharmacovigilance expertise with a genuine passion for clear, precise scientific communication. You'll bring with you:
  
  

* A master's degree and/or PhD in Life Sciences (e.g. Pharmacy, Medicine, Veterinary, or Biological Sciences), combined with more than 7 years of experience working within pharmacovigilance and medical writing
* Expert understanding of Periodic Safety Update Reports (PSURs), Development Safety Update Reports (DSURs), and RMPs, including the guidelines and regulations that drive their preparation
* Excellent analytical and communication skills, with fluency in written and spoken English and a flair for scientific communication and data presentation
* Experience in applying artificial intelligence, structured authoring, or other technical solutions in medical writing
* A highly collaborative approach, with the ability to lead cross-functional team members, negotiate solutions, and advise on document structure and content
* The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver high-quality documents on schedule
* Experience handling documents of high complexity, such as Marketing Authorisation Application submissions, is considered an advantage

**Working at Novo Nordisk**
Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations.
  
  
**What We Offer**
There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind.
  
  
We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
  
  
At Novo Nordisk, we're not chasing quick fixes – we're creating lasting change for long-term health. For over 100 years, we've been driven by a single purpose: to defeat serious chronic diseases and help millions of people live healthier lives. This dedication fuels our constant curiosity and inspires us to push the boundaries of what's possible in healthcare. We embrace diverse perspectives, seek out bold ideas, and build partnerships rooted in shared purpose. Together, we're making healthcare more accessible, treating and preventing diseases, and pioneering solutions that create change spanning generations. When you join us, you become part of something bigger – a legacy of impact that reaches far beyond today.

title: Field Application Specialist
description:
Cellink, part of BICO Group, is dedicated to Creating the Future of Health by leveraging the power of 3D cell culture through award-winning 3D bioprinters and carefully sourced biomaterials and bioinks. BICO is a lab automation partner and provider of selected workflows to pharma and biotech, with 46,000+ instruments installed in over 65 countries.

BICO products, software, and solutions are found in more than 3,500 laboratories, including the world's top 20 pharmaceutical companies, and have been cited in over 12,000 publications. Operating through two business areas: Lab Automation and Life Science Solutions - BICO strives toward enabling and automating the life science lab of the future. BICO is listed on Mid-Cap, Nasdaq Stockholm under BICO.

We are looking for a
**Field Application Specialist**
who is pivotal in providing technical and application support during both the pre- and post-sales process. You will provide technical support and expertise to customers regarding the application and use of Cellink's products in the field, collaborating with clients to ensure effective implementation, training, and ongoing support, ultimately driving customer satisfaction and product utilization.

This is a full-time position based in Bangalore, with an expectation of traveling up to 75% of the time to customer sites for training, troubleshooting, and relationship management.

**Employment will be managed through WorkMotion**
, acting as the direct employer to handle your local contract, payroll, and benefits.

**Key responsibilities**

* Technical Support: Provide on-site and remote technical assistance to customers, addressing product-related questions and troubleshooting issues.
* Training and Education: Conduct training sessions and workshops for customers to enhance their understanding of product features and applications.
* Customer Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders within customer organizations to understand their needs and provide tailored solutions, helping customers with scientific questions to achieve their research objectives and experiments in a contract research setting.
* Product Demonstrations: Deliver compelling product demonstrations and presentations to prospective and existing customers, showcasing the capabilities and advantages of the solutions.
* Feedback Collection: Gather and document customer feedback on product performance and application, relaying insights to the product development team for improvements.
* Market and Product Knowledge: Maintain a deep understanding of the company's products, industry trends, and competitive landscape to effectively address customer inquiries.
* Reporting: Maintain accurate records of customer interactions, training sessions, and support activities in the CRM system, and prepare reports on customer feedback and product usage.

**Candidate requirements**

* Education: At least a Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Master's degree in a related field is advantageous.
* Technical Background: Strong background in cell-based assays, particularly 3D cell culture assay.
* Scientific Knowledge: Understanding of cell biology, 3D modelling, biomaterials, tissue engineering and regeneration.
* Lab Experience: Lab experience in cell culture, microscopy, and biochemical assays.
* Experience: 3+ years of experience in a technical support or application specialist role, preferably within a scientific, medical, or engineering environment.
* Communication Skills: Excellent technical writing and public speaking skills.
* Customer-Facing Experience: Prior customer-facing experience preferred.
* Languages: Professional-level English is mandatory.

**Desirable (but not required)**

* Experience with 3D printing preferred.

**Benefits and perks**

* Private Health Insurance

*Please note that applications cannot be submitted directly to us. We are partnering with SynMatch for this recruitment process, and all applications should be submitted through them.*

title: Technical Specialist
description:
Responsible for supporting Exchange Traded Content automation, AI adoption, data quality improvements and process simplification. The role requires individuals with strong technical capabilities and demonstrated experience in applying AI, Python, SQL and other automation technologies to deliver measurable business outcomes.
  
  
Working within Content Operations, candidates will identify opportunities to eliminate manual activities, improve straight through processing (STP), strengthen proactive quality controls and develop solutions that identify and prevent data issues before they impact downstream products and clients.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Accountabilities**

* AI-enabled process improvement: Identify and assess opportunities to apply Generative AI, machine learning, Python, SQL, APIs and automation tools to operational workflows. Design, configure, test and enhance practical solutions directly where appropriate, while partnering with Data Scientists and Engineering on more complex development, integration and production deployment.
* Proactive Data Quality & Controls: Develop and enhance automated QC reports, exception monitoring, reconciliations and dashboards using AI and data analytics to proactively identify and prevent data-quality issues before they impact downstream products or clients, reducing operational risk and Data Corrected Cases.
* Data Engineering & Integration: Work with databases, APIs, data feeds and internal platforms to extract, transform, reconcile and validate data across systems. Develop practical solutions to improve data availability, consistency and processing efficiency.
* Content Operations & Market Data: Support day-to-day Real Time Pricing Content activities across Exchange Traded Content, Fixed Income, Forex Money Markets, including instrument onboarding, reference data updates, quality assurance, incident resolution and exchange changes, while identifying opportunities to improve existing workflows.
* Solution Ownership & Governance: Own the development, testing, documentation, deployment and ongoing maintenance of locally developed automation solutions, ensuring adherence to LSEG's technology, data governance, information security and change management standards.
* Technical SME and validation: Provide business rules, labelled examples, complex edge cases, acceptance criteria and structured error feedback to Data Science and Engineering teams. Support evaluation, UAT and human-in-the-loop quality assurance to ensure solutions are accurate, explainable and operationally effective.
* Knowledge building and capability development: Maintain standard operating procedures, data definitions, taxonomies, domain primers, control documentation and training materials. Coach colleagues on new AI-enabled ways of working and share reusable practices across Content Operations.
* Stakeholder partnership: Work closely with Content Operations colleagues and Team Leaders, Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Engineering, Process Excellence, Change, Risk and other partners to deliver sustainable improvements and effective service transition.

**Key Skills & Experience Required**
AI & Process Automation
  
  

* Demonstrated hands on experience in applying Generative AI, LLMs, machine learning and intelligent automation to solve business problems, with proven delivery of solutions and measurable outcomes.
* Ability to identify AI opportunities, assess feasibility and develop practical solutions for workflow automation, anomaly detection, reconciliation and quality monitoring, while adhering to AI governance and security standards.
* Understand common AI limitations, including hallucinations, incomplete coverage and inconsistent outputs. Experience in appropriate sampling, validation, control and escalation procedures, recognising when automated outputs require human review.

Programming & Technical Capabilities
  
  

* Strong working knowledge of Python, SQL, APIs and databases, with practical experience developing automation scripts, data-processing solutions and system integrations.
* Experience developing automated QC checks, exception reports, reconciliations and dashboards, with familiarity in Git, Power BI, Power Automate or similar technologies.

Data Quality & Process Improvement
  
  

* Proven experience identifying process inefficiencies and implementing automation to improve STP, reduce manual intervention and strengthen operational efficiency.
* Strong data analysis skills to identify anomalies, develop preventive quality controls, improve exception management and demonstrate measurable improvements in data quality and operational performance.

title: Lead Applications Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Change the world. Love your job.**
Texas Instruments (TI) is out front and ready for the next big challenge. Our innovations are at the core of nearly every electronics product in use today. And it doesn't stop there. We're developing breakthrough technology to power the world's future innovations as well. TI is committed to building a better future — from the responsible manufacturing of our semiconductors, to caring for our employees, to giving back inside our communities. Put your talent to work with us.
  
  
Our business has very high growth in TI and is in a segment where the market is fast growing. We're searching for applications engineer who have the passion and excitement to grow, innovative, take an active role in product definition, execute the characterization until ramp, and provide post ramp application support to customers.
  
  
This role is responsible for application support for high speed amplifiers. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Answer customer questions and supporting design-in activities for released products. This includes:
* Forum and email questions from customers
* Schematic and Layout Review of customer application
* Debug of customer problems by re-creating issues in our evaluation boards and/or customer boards
* On-site support for customer board as required
* Design EVM and internal evaluation boards to support correlation and evaluation activities of new products
* Create user guides, test procedures and proper release of EVM boards for customer consumption
* Participate in datasheet review to ensure completeness of datasheet being developed by the Systems Engineer
* Perform Bench Characterization for High Speed Amplifiers devices, including bench automation, hardware design and develop test techniques
* Participate in new silicon testing from an application perspective to ensure robustness of the product (i.e. destructive testing)
* Work with systems engineer to provide support to early design in activities for new products
* Create custom reference designs targeting relevant applications to be used as customer implementation ideas
* Write application notes that explain different use cases, implementation and/or flexibility of our products

**Qualifications**
**Minimum requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or ECE
* 5 Yrs of relevant experience in power electronics
* Experience in applications support of analog power products
* Solid hardware debugging skills
* Strong technical background, with the ability to produce high quality technical documentation

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with power electronics including Flyback, LLC, Push-Pull, PSFB
* Proficiency with lab equipment (oscilloscopes, power supplies, signal analyzers) and board-level debugging
* Experience with PCB design and board bring-up
* Knowledge of key end-equipment markets including data center power
* Design experience in automotive systems : Traction inverter, OBC, DC/DC
* Strong background in power electronics simulations and control loop compensation techniques
* Strong technical writing skills including the ability to create application notes or design guides
* Ability to establish strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders
* Ability to work cross-functionally with design, test, and marketing teams
* Demonstrated ability to take initiative and drive results with minimal day-to-day direction
* Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to quickly ramp on new systems and processes
* Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
* Ability to take the initiative and drive for results
* Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery

**About Us**
**Why TI?**

* The future starts here. As a TIer, you'll play a critical role in defining the next era of semiconductor technology and help create the innovations that shape the world around us.
* Surround yourself with a team of innovators who value your unique perspective and will challenge you to bring your best self to work every day. We believe that fostering a culture of collaboration fuels both personal growth and technological breakthroughs. Explore our company culture .

title: Electrical Engineer SME (Power Quality & Grid Analytics )
description:
As an Electrical Subject Matter Expert (SME) specializing in Power Quality and Grid Diagnostics at ABB India, you will serve as the primary domain authority for electrical power quality monitoring, disturbance analysis, and meter data integration and ensuring compliance with global industry standards for disturbance recording and reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Power Event Analysis:**
  Act as the technical authority on power quality metrics, including voltage, current, active/reactive power, power factor, Total Harmonic Distortion (THD), interharmonics, and voltage flicker (Pst/PltPst/Plt).
* Identify, classify, and perform root-cause analysis on complex power quality events and grid disturbances, including voltage sags/dips, swells, interruptions, transients, voltage unbalance, and harmonic distortions.
* **Standardized Data Handling:**
  Ingest, parse, and export power system event data using standard industry file formats, specifically
  **COMTRADE**
  (IEEE C37.111) and
  **PQDIF**
  (IEEE 1159.3).
* **Disturbance Reporting & Visualization:**
  Design the structure and logic for clear, actionable disturbance reports and dashboards that summarize event severity, compliance, and system impact for engineering teams and end users.
* **Standards Compliance:**
  Ensure all detection rules, aggregation methods, and reporting metrics align with international power quality standards such as
  **IEC 61000-4-30**
  and
  **IEEE 1159**
  .
* **Algorithm Logic & Validation:**
  Define technical logic, mathematical thresholds, and validation criteria for automated power event detection and classification algorithms.
* **Meter Data Interfacing:**
  Interface with power quality meters, smart sensors, and protective relays to extract, parse, and validate measurement data across various communication protocols.

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or a related technical field.
* **Power Quality Fundamentals:**
  Strong understanding of core electrical and power quality metrics, including voltage, current, active/reactive power, power factor, harmonics (THD/TDD), unbalance, and flicker.
* **Event & Waveform Diagnostics:**
  Proven experience identifying and analyzing transient and steady-state power disturbances (sags, swells, transients, harmonics) using waveform captures and trend data.
* **Industry File Formats:**
  Working knowledge of
  **COMTRADE**
  and
  **PQDIF**
  file structures for exchanging and analyzing fault and power quality records.
* **Metering & Data Analysis:**
  Hands-on experience interfacing with power quality analyzers/meters and extracting or analyzing meter datasets.
* **Standards Knowledge:**
  Familiarity with compliance testing and reporting requirements under IEEE 1159, IEC 61000-4-30 Class A, or EN 50160.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* **Data & Scripting Skills:**
  Experience using Python, MATLAB, or SQL to automate waveform parsing, test detection algorithms, and process large meter datasets.
* **Visualization:**
  Experience translating complex waveform data into intuitive visual reports (e.g., CBEMA/ITIC curves, harmonic spectrums, and phasor diagrams)

description:
**Meet the Team**
Cisco’s Campus & Branch Networking Product Management organization spans Enterprise Switching, Wireless, Routing, SD-WAN, Spaces, and Cameras. The Director, Pricing & Analytics leads the team responsible for pricing and monetization analytics, portfolio and market analytics, and decision support across the business. The role translates product, customer, competitive, and financial data into clear choices that improve portfolio performance. This role reports to the Senior Director, Strategy & Planning (Chief of Staff to the SVP/GM).
  
  
**Your Impact**
This role partners closely with Product Management, Finance, Engineering, and other cross-functional leaders to shape portfolio economics and support decisions on pricing, packaging, investment, and growth. The Director sets the pricing and portfolio analytics agenda for the organization and leads a multidisciplinary team that develops market and portfolio insights, financial and scenario models, and scalable decision tools. The role frames ambiguous questions, aligns stakeholders on assumptions, translates complex analysis into decision-ready recommendations, and tracks results after decisions are implemented. It combines strategic judgment, analytical depth, people leadership, and disciplined execution.
  
  

* Lead pricing and monetization analytics across the portfolio, including price architecture, packaging, tiering, and discounting, and translate the analysis into recommendations for product and business leaders.
* Partner with product leaders to assess portfolio positioning and economics across new product introductions, migrations, and bundles; recommend actions that improve revenue, adoption, and gross margin.
* Develop market sizing, segmentation, competitive, customer, and channel analyses to identify growth opportunities and guide product and go-to-market choices.
* Build business cases and scenario models that quantify volume, price, mix, software and support attach, investment, gross margin, and breakeven.
* Establish trusted metrics and reporting for portfolio and business performance; partner with Finance and data teams on definitions, data quality, dashboards, and AI-enabled analytical workflows.
* Lead cross-functional analyses and business reviews, communicate decision-ready recommendations and trade-offs to senior leaders, and measure outcomes after decisions are implemented.
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary pricing and analytics team, setting clear priorities and analytical standards, coaching and developing talent, and remaining hands-on in structuring critical analyses and reviewing the quality of the team’s work.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field.
* 12+ years of experience in pricing, business analytics, finance, product management, strategy, or a related discipline.

title: Lead Analyst - Strategic Modeling and Analytics
description:
**FC Global Services India LLP (First Citizens India), a part of First Citizens BancShares, Inc., a top 20 U.S. financial institution, is a global capability center (GCC) based in Bengaluru. Our India-based teams benefit from the company’s over 125-year legacy of strength and stability. First Citizens India is responsible for delivering value and managing risks for our lines of business. We are particularly proud of our strong, relationship-driven culture and our long-term approach, which are deeply ingrained in our talented workforce. This is evident across all key areas of our operations, including Technology, Enterprise Operations, Finance, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, and Credit Administration. We are seeking talented individuals to join us in our mission of providing solutions fit for our clients’ greatest ambitions.**
**Job Description**
**Job Description**
**Lead Analyst, Finance Quantitative Offices (FQO), Treasury**
**Value Proposition**

* Play a key role in a global financial modeling team that is pivotal in a top 25 US bank’s strategic decision making, capital planning and regulatory compliance.
* An opportunity to build cutting edge analytics and modeling capabilities for the bank by leveraging a blend of technical & quantitative prowess, financial acumen and excellent communication skills.

**Job Details**
Position Title: Lead Analyst, FQO, Treasury
  
  
Career Level: P3
  
  
Job Category: Manager
  
  
Role Type: Hybrid
  
  
Job Location: Bengaluru, India
  
  
**About The Team**
The FQO group is a part of the Corporate Treasury team within First Citizens Bank. This team is responsible for developing, maintaining, and monitoring Pre-Provision Net Revenue (PPNR), Balance Sheet Management (BSM) and other financial models that are consumed for First Citizens Bank’s CCAR stress testing as well as internal business/financial planning activities. FQO interacts closely with Finance and Treasury, Business units, Risk, Senior Management, and Model Risk Management (MRM) to ensure models are fit for use.
  
  
**Impact**
FQO team plays a critical role in capital planning for the bank, by developing models that project the balance sheet and net income/expenses in different economic scenarios. These serves regulatory expectations around stress testing (CCAR), as well as enable the bank to take strategic business decisions related to capital distribution, share buyback etc. Balance Sheet Management models aid in EVE calculations which are pivotal in Asset-Liability Management for the bank.
  
  
This role entails playing a lead role in the model development team, and hence contributing significantly to develop and enhance sophisticated models based on sound statistical techniques and robust data. It will involve interesting and challenging opportunities to continuously evolve the model suite and processes around model lifecycle as the bank grows rapidly and has heightened regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Key Deliverables**
**Model Data, Development & Maintenance**

* Support Treasury and Capital Markets teams through the assessment, implementation, enhancement, monitoring, and governance of vendor-provided derivative pricing, valuation, and risk models used for valuation, risk management, and stress testing.
* Manage data extraction, quality, reconciliation and processing at different levels of aggregation in coordination with FQO data/governance and IT teams.
* Analyze market, trade, valuation, and model output data to assess model performance, identify anomalies, and support valuation and risk management decisions.
* Support key decisions and provide support across all phases of model development including qualitative/quantitative methodology design, exploratory data analysis, variable selection, performance testing and documentation; modeling components include Deposits, Loans, Commitments and Net Interest Revenues/Expenses.
* Perform ongoing monitoring of vendor pricing and valuation models, investigate model performance issues, conduct root cause analysis, and support remediation activities.
* Support model implementation for new or re-developed models including data reconciliation, model execution logic, implementation testing, and documentation.
* Contribute to process enhancements and automation related to model development process, documentation, monitoring and production activities.
* Partner with businesses, Finance and Treasury, Risk, and Model Risk Management to ensure PPNR is contributing to a consistent and controlled approach across the end-to-end CCAR process.

**Governance & Controls**

* Engage with Model Risk Management (MRM) team to ensure models are fit for use as per bank policies and standards and resolve model findings/limitations.
* Support review and challenge process for stress test results and business overlays in collaboration with PPNR and business teams.
* Support governance team to establish and execute controls around data quality/reconciliation and model execution process.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Accountable for effective communication across Business units, MRM, Risk/Finance teams and working groups/committees including toll gate meetings, model review/challenge discussions etc.
* Manage onshore stakeholders including senior modeling leads and collaborate effectively across model development/maintenance activities.

**Skills and Qualification**
***(Functional and Technical Skills)***
**Functional Skills**

* Strong knowledge of US regulatory landscape including CCAR/DFAST regulations and SR 11-7 guidelines.
* Solid understanding of financial products and derivative instruments including interest rate swaps, caps/floors, swaptions, FX derivatives, futures, and options. Knowledge of Treasury and Capital Markets activities is preferred.
* Knowledge of Interest Rate Risk (IRR) and related concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for engagement with senior leadership and stakeholders.
* Efficient and well organized, able to work under tight deadlines.
* Outstanding attention to detail, accuracy, and ability to multitask.

**Technical Skills**

* In-depth understanding of statistical analysis and econometric modeling including sampling, segmentation, linear/logistic regression, time series forecasting, stress testing techniques concepts/techniques etc.
* Good understanding of best practices related to data management, quality and processing for modeling purposes.
* Experience working on data extraction, quality controls and processing for modelling purposes using SQL and/or statistical programming languages.
* Experience with at least one statistical programming language such as Python, R or SAS.

**Education & Experience**

* Master's/Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline, such as Statistics, Mathematics, Quantitative Finance or Applied Economics and related fields.
* 5+ years of relevant experience in derivative pricing, model validation, model risk management, quantitative analytics, Treasury/Capital Markets modeling, or vendor model governance. Experience with valuation models and regulatory model risk management frameworks is preferred.

**Accessibility Needs**
We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring process. If you require accommodations at any stage (e.g. application, interviews, onboarding) please let us know, and we will work with you to ensure a seamless experience.
  
  
**Equal Employment Opportunity**

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible environment and prohibit all forms of discrimination on the basis of gender, religion, caste, disability, sexual orientation, economic status or any other characteristics protected by the law. We strive to foster a safe and respectful environment in which all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. Our EEO policy ensures fairness throughout the employee life cycle.**

title: Staff UX Researcher, Mixed Methods
description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in an applied research setting, or similar.
* 8 years of experience planning, conducting, and synthesizing user research for consumer-facing digital products in industry.
* Experience in leading end-to-end UX research strategy across both qualitative (ethnography, deep interviews, usability testing) and quantitative (surveys, behavioral analytics, telemetry collaboration) methodologies.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Master's degree or PhD in Human-Computer Interaction, Cognitive Science, Statistics, Psychology, Anthropology, or a related field.
* 10 years of user research experience, with 3 years of experience in a staff-level lead role within a global technology company.
* Experience leading field studies for Next Billion Users (NBU) and emerging markets, collaborating across global design and research teams in the US, Europe, and India.
* Expertise in conversational AI interfaces, location-based services, maps, navigation, and growth.
* Strong executive communication skills, with experience translating complex user behaviors into clear narratives that drive strategic impact and influence cross-functional product leadership.

**About the job**
-----------------

At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." As a User Experience Researcher (UXR), you make this possible. You will join our multi-disciplinary UX team, collaborating with Engineering and Product Management, to gather insights and create industry-leading products.
  
  
You’ll play a critical role in helping your team understand user needs and will drive impact at all stages of product development, ensuring products are useful, usable, and helpful. You will explore user behaviors and motivations by conducting primary research, including: field studies, interviews, diary studies, ethnography, surveys, usability testing, and logs analysis. You will also grow within a supportive UXR community offering mentorship, regular meetups, and exclusive internal tools.

Geo's mission is to help people explore and navigate the real world wherever they are. We want to make real-world exploration and navigation seamless, intelligent, and universally accessible to all users across every hardware tier and network condition globally. At Google Maps' scale of 2B+ monthly active users, even fractional improvements in funnel conversion, latency, or feature discoverability generate massive, world-scale impact.

The overall of Geo's "Strategic Markets & NIU" team is to drastically grow usage of Google Maps and other geospatial products across strategic emerging markets and amongst Novice Internet Users (NIU).

The Geo team is focused on building the most accurate, comprehensive, and useful maps for our users, through products like Maps, Earth, Street View, Google Maps Platform, and more. Every month, more than a billion people rely on Maps services to explore the world and navigate their daily lives.  
  
The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive the Google Maps research outlook and roadmap by partnering with UX, Product, Engineering, and executive leaders to align user needs with business goals and translate insights into actionable product strategy, specs, and design frameworks.
* Pair quantitative and qualitative research methods to achieve the research goal and product advancement. Quant research to include stand-alone and in-product surveys, metrics development, etc.
* Explore and embrace AI tools to take our user research processes to the next level, to create efficiencies, innovate processes, and expand the impact of the UX Researcher role.
* Drive AI conversational evaluations and hyper-local field research across India and surrounding regions to optimize low-connectivity transit experiences and fuel sustainable Android user growth for Google Maps.

title: Senior Marketplace Manager
description:
**Job Location:**
Bengaluru

**About Company:**

The Souled Store is a homegrown youth casual-wear brand founded in 2013. Today, we are one of India’s largest online merchandising platforms, with licensing partnerships including Disney, Warner Bros., WWE, IPL and Viacom18, among others. We create products inspired by pop culture- superheroes, movies, TV shows and cartoons while staying deeply rooted in evolving youth fashion and lifestyle trends. Alongside our core men’s and women’s apparel categories, we are actively expanding into new product lines such as activewear, Supima products, personal care, footwear and backpacks.

While we began as a digital-first brand, we have steadily expanded into offline retail and currently operate 100+ stores across India, with further pan-India expansion underway. The Souled Store was built on a simple belief: people do their best work when they love what they do. We believe work should be driven by ownership, curiosity and leadership at every level not just by titles. Over the years, we’ve built a team of like-minded individuals who work smart, take accountability and grow with the business. If you resonate with our culture and want to be part of an aggressively scaling, consumer first brand, we’d love to have you join us!

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

1. Own end-to-end marketplace P&L across the portfolio (Myntra, Ajio, Nykaa, Amazon, Flipkart, and quick-commerce platforms such as Zepto and Swiggy Instamart), setting pricing and profitability strategy at a category and channel level

2. Translate marketplace strategy into an execution roadmap, and represent marketplaces in leadership reviews and cross-functional planning (finance, supply chain, marketing, category)

3. Build and own governance systems for catalog quality, product listings and QC across all marketplaces, going beyond issue resolution to preventive SOPs and audit cadences

4. Own the returns RCA charter end-to-end, converting root-cause findings into policy and process changes with marketplace and internal teams

5. Own the ads/marketing budget across marketplaces, driving spend allocation and ROI optimization rather than campaign execution alone

6. Own and deliver GMV and revenue targets at a portfolio level, including forecasting and course correction

7. Serve as the senior point of contact with marketplace platforms' category and account leadership, negotiating terms, visibility opportunities and escalation resolution

8. Drive evaluation and onboarding of new marketplaces and channels, including international expansion into new geographies (e.g., Southeast Asia)

9. Identify, prioritize and implement growth levers across categories and channels, and own the business case for new initiatives

10. Handle high-stakes escalations and operational issues requiring cross-functional coordination and senior stakeholder management

**Requirements:**

1. Proven expertise in marketplace operations at scale, with strong command of Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Ajio, Nykaa and quick-commerce platforms (Zepto, Swiggy Instamart)

2. Experience managing and developing a team, with the ability to delegate, coach and hold direct reports accountable

3. Strong P&L ownership and pricing strategy experience at a portfolio or category level, including budgeting and forecasting

4. Proven ability to build and scale processes (catalog governance, RCA frameworks, SOPs) rather than only executing them

5. Advanced analytical skills, comfortable building dashboards and using data to drive forecasting and decision-making; advanced Excel required, SQL/BI tool exposure preferred

6. Strong stakeholder management skills, including experience engaging senior leadership both internally and with marketplace platform partners

7. Strategic thinking with the ability to translate business goals into an execution plan

8. Prior exposure to international expansion or new market/channel evaluation is a strong plus

9. Excellent communication, negotiation and cross-functional collaboration skills

title: Operations Manager (FinCrime)
description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Financial Crimes Operations team helps protect Stripe’s financial ecosystem while supporting legitimate businesses. We conduct risk-based reviews and investigations, applying sound judgment and operational rigor to identify and mitigate financial crime risks. We collaborate across Operations, Compliance, Risk, Product, and Engineering to build effective, scalable processes and support compliance with applicable requirements.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
As a Financial Crimes Operations Manager, you’ll lead and develop a team conducting complex financial crime reviews. You’ll own day-to-day team performance, help investigators navigate ambiguous cases, and build a culture of sound judgment, accountability, and continuous improvement. Working with cross-functional partners, you’ll strengthen review quality, improve workflows, and help the team scale while balancing risk, efficiency, and user experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of investigators through regular feedback, performance conversations, and career development.
* Manage daily operations, including workload prioritization, queue health, and capacity planning, to meet quality and service-level expectations.
* Guide the team through complex and ambiguous reviews, ensuring risk assessments and recommendations are well-supported, clearly documented, and appropriately escalated.
* Reinforce consistent application of policies and procedures, partnering with relevant stakeholders to resolve questions and address gaps.
* Use operational data to identify trends, understand performance drivers, and take action on quality, productivity, and turnaround times.
* Partner with quality and training teams to address recurring errors, strengthen investigative skills, and improve onboarding.
* Collaborate with Compliance, Risk, Product, Engineering, and other Operations teams to resolve issues and improve review processes and tooling.
* Identify opportunities to simplify workflows and introduce automation while maintaining appropriate controls and human judgment.
* Translate changing business priorities and requirements into clear team goals and actionable operating plans.
* Foster an inclusive team environment where people raise concerns, learn from mistakes, and take ownership of outcomes.

Who you are
  
  
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* Experience in financial crime operations, customer due diligence, anti-money laundering investigations, or a closely related risk function.
* Experience directly managing an operations team, including coaching, performance management, and employee development.
* A working understanding of risk-based reviews, including assessing business models, ownership structures, customer activity, and relevant financial crime risk indicators.
* Demonstrated ability to manage operational delivery against quality, productivity, and service-level expectations.
* Strong analytical judgment, with the ability to evaluate incomplete or conflicting information and recognize when to escalate.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex findings and provide actionable feedback.
* Experience using spreadsheets, reporting tools, or operational dashboards to diagnose problems and guide decisions.
* Ability to prioritize competing demands, lead through change, and collaborate effectively across teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading complex financial crime investigations or risk review teams in a payments, fintech, or financial services environment.
* Experience reviewing higher-risk businesses or complex ownership structures across multiple markets.
* Experience improving investigative workflows, quality frameworks, training programs, or case-management tools.
* Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams on operational tooling or automation.
* Familiarity with SQL or other analytical tools for investigating trends and measuring operational performance.
* A relevant financial crime qualification, such as CAMS, or equivalent practical expertise.

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

It owns the performance and development of these services, including the centralized Category Assistant operating model, and balances day-to-day service continuity with longer-term improvement, automation and platform development.

**Where you will make a difference:**

**In this role you will:**

**Data, Reporting and Controls:**

* Ensure product data and priority reporting are accurate, complete, timely and fit for business use.
* Maintain appropriate validation, exception and remediation controls for critical product, supplier and commercial data.

**Category Support Service:**

* Lead and develop the Category Assistant Leads, setting clear expectations for service delivery, people leadership, workload management, quality and stakeholder engagement.
* Ensure clear decision rights and accountabilities between the Category Assistant service, Category Management and Merchandise Planning.
* Govern work intake, prioritization and capacity across the service, resolving cross-portfolio conflicts and reallocating resources where required.
* Ensure core category support processes are delivered consistently, accurately and within agreed service levels.

**Process Improvement and Automation:**

* Support improvements to end-to-end merchandise processes, addressing delays, control gaps, duplication and unnecessary manual effort.
* Ensure approved changes are supported by clear process ownership, controls, documentation, training and adoption plans.
* Measure the benefits of implemented improvements, including reduced cycle time, improved quality, lower rework and hours released.
* Use service performance and operational insights to identify recurring issues and inform future system, data and process priorities.

**Who you will be working with:**

  Align data, process and category support priorities with the Commercial strategy and operating model.
* **Category Management, Merchandise Planning and Category Support:**
  Establish clear service expectations, priorities and decision rights that enable effective category execution.
* **Technology, Data and Operational Functions:**

**External Technology and Data Partners:**

* Manage relevant platform, software and data providers against agreed service expectations, delivery outcomes and roadmaps.

**What success looks like:**

* **Service performance**
  : Merchandise systems, reporting, product data and category support services meet agreed quality, availability and service standards.
* **Operational effectiveness:**
  Work is prioritized transparently, capacity is deployed effectively and critical merchandise activity remains supported through changing demand.
* **Data and control:**
  Product data and reporting are accurate, complete, timely and supported by effective ownership and controls.
* **Technology performance**
  : Core merchandise platforms are reliable, issues are resolved promptly and recurring problems are addressed at their source.
* **Improvement outcomes**
  : Process and automation initiatives reduce cycle time, rework and manual effort, with benefits measured and sustained.
* **Leadership and stakeholder confidence:**
  Leaders are effective, team capability is sustainable and stakeholders have confidence in the services provided by the function.
* Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks’ values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture.

**How you will lead:**

**Leader of Leaders:**

* Leads a culture based on our Officeworks values and behaviours
* Builds capability and delivers results across a diverse global workforce.
* Leads for the future, thinking Officeworks wide with a strategic commercial mindset
* Demonstrates resilience, has determination and drive to persist through significant challenges
* Is self-aware; has humility and is self-reflective; understands how to bring out the best in self and others
* Strong sense of personal and team accountability, drives a genuine commitment to their teams’ and individual development
* Proactively contributes to a safe working environment, leads and manages appropriately if there is unsafe conditions or inappropriate behaviour
* Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
* Strong sense of personal and team accountability, drives a genuine commitment to their teams’ and individual development
* Builds inclusive teams and creates an environment where diverse perspectives, equitable opportunities and respectful behaviours enable team and business performance, Our values shape the way we work, our behaviours and how we interact with each other, our customers, suppliers and communities.

**Our Values:**

**We begin with customer:**

* We start with our customer’ needs in every decision.
* We offer simple, helpful and affordable solutions.
* We listen, learn and continuously improve.

**We do the right thing:**

* We lead with integrity and care for our team communities and planet.
* We work together safely and treat everyone with respect, inclusion, and trust.

**We execute with accountability:**

* We are accountable for our decisions, actions, results, and mistakes.
* We stay across the details and focus on delivering what matters.
* We move with pace and agility to deliver outcomes.

**We lead with ambition:**

* We set bold ambitions that help us to win and transform.
* We are courageous with new ideas.

We focus on transformation, not incremental steps.

**Qualification & Work Experience:**

**Essential:**

* **Education**
  : Tertiary qualification in Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business, Commerce or a related discipline (or equivalent senior merchandise systems experience).
* **Experience:**
  8–10+ years of experience in merchandise systems, reporting, data governance, process improvement, or a related commercial technology function.
* **Process improvement:**
  Demonstrated experience improving workflows, implementing automation and embedding new systems or ways of working
* **Technical Mastery:**

* **Governance Expertise:**

* **Continuous Improvement:**

**Preferred:**

title: Senior Manager - Ocean & Air Freight Operations
description:
**Role Title:**
Senior Manager - Ocean & Air Freight Operations

**Location:**
Bangalore

**Department:**
Freight Operations

**Reporting To:**
Head-Air Operations

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Manager - Ocean & Air Freight Operations will lead end-to-end Air and Ocean Freight operations for the Bangalore branch, covering imports, exports, documentation, customs coordination, customer service, and trade compliance.

The role is responsible for ensuring operational excellence, customer satisfaction, regulatory compliance, cost efficiency, revenue growth, and profitability. The position will also provide leadership oversight for branch administration and support HR in managing statutory, regulatory, and internal compliance requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Bangalore Branch Management**

* Take overall responsibility for the effective day-to-day functioning and performance of the Bangalore Branch.
* Provide leadership and direction across branch operations and supporting activities.
* Monitor overall branch performance covering revenue, profitability, productivity, service quality, compliance, and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate with Sales, Finance, HR, Administration, and other functions to address branch-level requirements.
* Handle critical customer, operational, vendor, employee, and administrative escalations.
* Identify operational and business risks and ensure appropriate corrective actions are taken.
* Provide regular updates to management on branch performance, business opportunities, risks, and key challenges.

**2. Air & Ocean Freight Operations**

* Lead end-to-end Air and Ocean Freight operations covering imports, exports, documentation, customs clearance coordination, and shipment execution.
* Ensure operational delivery in line with customer SLAs, regulatory requirements, carrier requirements, and internal processes.
* Monitor shipment performance and proactively address delays, exceptions, documentation gaps, and operational issues.
* Drive service consistency, operational accuracy, and timely execution across the branch.
* Implement controls to minimise operational errors, claims, penalties, demurrage, detention, and avoidable costs.

**3. P&L and Financial Management**

* Own and monitor the P&L performance of the Bangalore Branch and Air & Ocean operations.
* Drive revenue growth, gross profit, productivity, and cost efficiency.
* Monitor shipment-level profitability and take corrective action on low or negative-margin business.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation and margin improvement.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning for the branch.
* Ensure timely job closure, billing, vendor-cost validation, and resolution of financial discrepancies.
* Work closely with Finance and Commercial teams on outstanding receivables and financial controls.

**4. Business Development & Freehand Generation**

* Drive local freehand business development to increase branch revenue, volumes, and profitability.
* Identify opportunities through existing customers, new prospects, overseas agents, carriers, vendors, and market relationships.
* Work closely with Sales and Key Account teams on customer acquisition, retention, and growth.
* Support pricing, RFQs, tenders, solution development, and commercial discussions.
* Identify cross-selling opportunities across Air Freight, Ocean Freight, Customs Clearance, Transportation, and other logistics services.

**5. Customer, Carrier & Vendor Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, airlines, shipping lines, overseas agents, transporters, customs brokers, and other service partners.
* Act as a senior escalation point for significant customer and operational issues.
* Ensure timely resolution of customer concerns through root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Monitor carrier and vendor service levels, pricing, reliability, and overall performance.
* Conduct periodic customer and service-performance reviews where required.

**6. Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Air & Ocean Freight Operations team and provide overall leadership support to the Bangalore Branch.
* Establish clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and operational KPIs.
* Monitor team productivity, workload, service quality, and turnaround times.
* Build succession plans and develop future leaders within the function.
* Promote a culture of ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Work with HR on manpower planning, employee development, performance management, and other people-related requirements.

**7. Process Excellence & Digitalisation**

* Review and improve operational workflows to increase productivity and service quality.
* Drive digitisation and automation across Air and Ocean Freight operations.
* Ensure effective utilisation of operational systems and tools.
* Develop and monitor operational dashboards and KPIs.
* Reduce manual dependency, process duplication, errors, and turnaround time.
* Ensure SOPs and operational processes are properly documented and consistently followed.

**8. Compliance, Administration & Governance**

* Ensure adherence to applicable customs regulations, international trade requirements, statutory requirements, internal policies, and operational procedures.
* Maintain appropriate controls around shipment documentation, regulatory records, restricted cargo, dangerous goods, and other applicable operational requirements.
* Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of observations and corrective actions.
* Work closely with HR on statutory, administrative, and branch compliance requirements.
* Provide oversight of branch facilities, vendors, and administrative requirements.
* Escalate significant operational, compliance, financial, or administrative risks to management.

**9. Strategic & Cross-Functional Contribution**

* Support the overall growth strategy for the Bangalore Branch.
* Work closely with Sales, Key Accounts, Finance, HR, and other stakeholders on business and operational priorities.
* Provide operational inputs for new customer solutions, tenders, pricing, and service development.
* Participate in regional and global management discussions as required.
* Drive implementation of organizational initiatives and operational best practices at the branch level.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Bangalore Branch revenue and profitability
* P&L and gross-margin performance
* Freehand business generated
* Air & Ocean volume growth
* Customer retention and service levels
* Operational SLA performance
* Shipment and documentation accuracy
* Productivity and cost efficiency
* Job closure and billing turnaround time
* Reduction in claims, penalties, demurrage and detention
* Outstanding receivables
* Vendor and carrier performance
* Compliance and audit closure
* Team productivity, development, and retention

**Qualification & Experience**

* Graduate degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, International Business, Commerce, or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in Logistics, Supply Chain, or Business Management would be an advantage.
* **15+ years of experience**
  in Freight Forwarding / Logistics, with strong experience across Air and Ocean Freight.
* Strong experience in
  **branch management, operations leadership, P&L management, and business development**
  .
* Proven experience managing sizeable operational teams and multiple stakeholders.
* Strong knowledge of imports, exports, customs processes, documentation, carrier management, and international freight-forwarding practices.
* Experience in handling customers, carriers, overseas agents, vendors, and complex operational escalations.
* Commercial understanding with demonstrated exposure to revenue growth, margin improvement, and cost optimisation.

title: Sr. Planning & Ops Mgr, SIMS
description:
**Description**
We are looking for a dynamic, organized, and self-starting Planning and Ops Manager to drive innovation, build scalable processes, and execute in the space of operational and supply chain excellence for the Amazon India business - one of the most dynamic marketplace environments world-wide.
  
  
In this role, you will support the operational performance of independent sellers on the Amazon marketplace, helping them improve how they plan and send inventory into Amazon's fulfillment network. You will act as a key connection point between sellers, Amazon's fulfillment and supply chain operations, category teams, and product teams - working to protect both the seller and customer experience. You will drive system and process improvements in partnership with internal operations and seller-support teams, and deliver the operational programs that help make the Amazon India business efficient and scalable over the long term. You will create, write, and review business cases, conduct supporting research and analysis, and develop solutions from concept through execution and monitoring.
  
  
This role requires strong self-motivation, a bias for action, and sharp project management skills. The ideal candidate works closely with category leaders, supply chain teams, operations teams, and technology partners to develop strategy, automation, dashboards, and execution mechanisms that solve complex inbound operations problems. You will collaborate across cross-functional teams to improve seller operational performance alongside high-impact operations improvement programs
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Ensure seller/vendor account performance is healthy and delivered in line with targets for inventory and inbound health, while balancing out operating plans
* Identify and articulate the strategic importance of metrics to manage tradeoffs, improve customer experience, and drive decisions with internal and external stakeholders
* Partner with vendor operations teams on strategies to reduce cost, lead time, and waste across the end-to-end supply chain
* Define, prioritize, and monitor programs/projects to ensure targets are met on time
* Create, write, and review business cases; perform supporting research and analysis; write specifications; and drive the product development schedule from strategy to execution
* Retrieve and analyze data using Gen AI tools, Visualization dashboards, SQL, or other data management systems
* Monitor project execution to ensure delivery meets quality standards and target dates, maintaining overall program integrity
* Work with cross-functional teams to deliver operational performance and projects

A day in the life
  
  
Your day is anchored around your sellers' performance. You begin by reviewing inbound and inventory health metrics, identifying any gaps in availability and diving deep to find root causes. You partner with fulfillment and supply chain operations to resolve bottlenecks, and align with category teams on upcoming demand. You lead working sessions on the process improvements you own, and prepare recommendations for senior stakeholder forums. As the connective point across seller, operations, category, and product teams, you turn seller needs into coordinated action - balancing daily execution with the longer-term bets that make your sellers, and the business, stronger.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our team manages seller accounts on the Amazon India marketplace, partnering with independent sellers to run their supply chain with the rigor and efficiency of the platform's most mature businesses. We sit at the intersection of sellers, fulfillment and supply chain operations, category teams, and product teams - ensuring inventory flows smoothly, availability stays strong, and the customer experience is protected. Set up to give growing sellers a dedicated layer of supply chain experts, we've since raised our ambition toward seller self-sufficiency and end-to-end efficiency. We're fast-paced and collaborative, valuing ownership, curiosity, and a bias for action.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of digital sales, account management, business development, or partner management experience
* Experience and understanding of the retail and wholesale landscape in India and exposure to prior interactions with sellers and distributors
* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA
* Experience in vendor negotiations, pricing and promotion, inventory management, and product development

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- Amazon Digital Services Private Limited

title: GM - Voice Core Senior Operations Manager
description:

As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. #VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

Expert-level proficiency in Cramer Network Inventory or equivalent network inventory and service management platforms

**What's In It For You**

* Leadership responsibility with direct influence on service stability, operational readiness and customer experience
* Opportunity to drive innovation, operational resilience and technology adoption within a global telecom environment

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Cloud-native telecom operations and CNF lifecycle management
* Service assurance and operational automation methodologies
* Strategic vendor and supplier management capabilities
* Telecom change governance and major incident leadership
* Performance optimisation and resource management in large-scale telecom environments
* Cross-functional collaboration across cloud, data and voice technology domains

title: Regional Transportation Manager
description:
**Do you want to be a part of the fascinating story of over 500 iconic brands spanning across more than 100 countries?**

**Being the best beer company starts with finding the best people. While we have big brands, we have bigger opportunities as well.**

**AB InBev India is looking to hire Manager -Regional Transportation for its Logistics team based out of Bengaluru.**

**Job Description**

The role holder will be responsible for leading transportation operations for the assigned region, ensuring reliable and cost-effective movement of finished goods across breweries, depots, warehouses, and markets. The incumbent will own vehicle availability, dispatch adherence, transporter performance, transit reliability, transportation cost, compliance, and operational issue resolution across the regional network.

The role will partner closely with Planning, Brewery Logistics, Depot Operations, Sales, Finance, and transporter partners to ensure transportation capacity is aligned with business requirements while driving service excellence, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

**Key Job Responsibilities**

**Transportation Operations & Service Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end transportation operations for the assigned region.
* Ensure vehicle availability and placement against daily and weekly dispatch plans.
* Drive dispatch adherence and timely movement of finished goods from breweries and warehouses to destination locations.
* Monitor in-transit shipments and drive timely resolution of delays, breakdowns, vehicle shortages, and delivery exceptions.
* Ensure transportation capacity is aligned with peak season, business growth, and changing market requirements.
* Establish contingency transportation arrangements to ensure business continuity during capacity constraints.
* Drive reduction in detention, turnaround time, and transportation-related service failures.

**Transporter Management**

* Manage relationships and operational governance with transporters and logistics service providers across the region.
* Establish transporter performance reviews covering vehicle placement, transit time, delivery adherence, service quality, and compliance.
* Drive corrective action plans with underperforming transport partners.
* Partner with Procurement on transporter contracting, capacity requirements, commercial discussions, and supplier performance.
* Identify transportation capacity and supplier risks and develop appropriate mitigation plans.
* Support development of secondary transportation sources to improve network resilience.

**Planning & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Partner with Supply Planning and Commercial Planning teams to understand dispatch requirements and upcoming capacity needs.
* Work closely with Brewery Logistics Managers and Depot Operations teams to ensure seamless dispatch execution.
* Coordinate transportation plans with production, inventory, permit, and market requirements.
* Proactively highlight transportation constraints that could impact product availability or customer service.
* Support peak planning and scenario planning for high-volume periods and business events.

**Transportation Performance & Analytics**

* Own regional transportation KPIs and performance dashboards.
* Monitor vehicle placement, dispatch adherence, transit performance, detention, delivery adherence, freight cost, and transporter performance.
* Conduct root cause analysis on recurring service failures and establish corrective actions.
* Ensure timely publication of daily, weekly, and monthly transportation MIS.
* Use operational data to identify cost, service, and productivity improvement opportunities.
* Drive data accuracy and visibility across transportation operations.

**Cost & Productivity Management**

* Monitor regional transportation costs and identify opportunities to improve freight efficiency.
* Drive initiatives to improve truck utilization, route efficiency, turnaround time, and network productivity.
* Monitor operational cost deviations and support corrective actions.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance on freight-related performance and cost improvement initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for transportation network optimization without compromising service levels.

**Process, Controls & Compliance**

* Ensure adherence to transportation SOPs, operational controls, and defined governance standards.
* Drive accurate and timely POD closure and transportation documentation.
* Ensure transportation operations comply with applicable business and statutory requirements.
* Support audit requirements and closure of transportation-related observations.
* Drive process standardization across breweries, depots, and transportation partners within the region.

**Digitalization & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive adoption of TMS, vehicle tracking, SAP/ERP, and transportation visibility tools.
* Identify opportunities to automate transportation MIS and operational processes.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service, productivity, and visibility.
* Support implementation of transportation transformation projects and new logistics technologies.
* Promote exception-based management through improved dashboards and tracking mechanisms

.

**Team & Operational Leadership**

* Provide direction and governance to Transportation Operations Executives supporting the region.
* Establish clear operating routines, priorities, and escalation mechanisms.
* Build a culture of ownership, responsiveness, data accuracy, and continuous improvement.
* Coach operational teams on transportation processes, stakeholder management, and issue resolution.
* Ensure effective coordination across locations and transportation partners.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, Business Administration, or related discipline.
* MBA / Postgraduate qualification in Supply Chain or Operations preferred.
* **3-6 years of experience**
  in Transportation, Logistics Operations, Distribution, Fleet Management, or Supply Chain.
* Experience managing transporters and multi-location transportation operations.
* FMCG, Beverage, Consumer Goods, Manufacturing, or high-volume distribution experience preferred.

Working knowledge of SAP, TMS, ERP, or transportation management platforms.

**And above all of this, an undying love for beer!**

**Quench your thirst for success. Come, sit at the tab.**
