title: IT Infrastructure and Operations Lead
description:
BlueOptima gives CIOs, CTOs and CFOs objective, code-level visibility into software productivity, AI ROI, and engineering cost. This is a problem that until recently could not be measured at all. With AI-generated code now flowing into enterprise codebases at scale, that measurement gap has become a board-level priority.
  
  
10B+ code revisions analysed
  
  

* 800,000+ developers on platform
* 9 of the top 16 universal banks

The business is profitable, bootstrapped, and 20 years deep in enterprise relationships. You are joining a sales organisation that is mid-build. The foundations are in place, the product has genuine enterprise traction, and there is real room to grow fast.
  
  
Buyers are CIOs, CTOs, VP Engineering and CFO stakeholders at large software engineering organisations. The conversation is about developer productivity, engineering cost, and AI ROI. These are budget-backed problems that sit at the top of the technology agenda right now. You are not convincing anyone the problem exists.
  
  
**Job Description**
We're hiring a hands-on IT Manager to run day-to-day IT operations across our global offices while also building the IT strategy that scales with us. This is a working-manager role: you'll be in the trenches with your team resolving issues and administering infrastructure, while also thinking two steps ahead about what our technology environment needs to look like in a year.
  
  
You'll lead a team of 3 IT professionals, own our endpoints, network, directory services, and internal IT systems, and partner closely with Technology Leadership, DevOps, and Security to keep our environment secure, compliant, and reliable across four countries.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Endpoints & Devices — laptops, desktops, and mobile devices used by employees across all offices
* Office Networks — performance, uptime, and segmentation across India, UK, US, and Mexico
* Internal IT Systems — ManageEngine (UEM), Sophos (endpoint AV/security), ServiceDesk/ITSM platform, and related tooling
* Directory Services — Active Directory, group policies, and identity/access management, including administration of Google Workspace, SSO, and MFA enforcement
* Service Provisioning & User Management — onboarding/offboarding, access requests, asset lifecycle
* Procurement & License Management — hardware refresh cycles, software license tracking and renewals, and avoiding overspend or lapses
* Security & Compliance Alignment — working with Security to keep infrastructure and practices audit-ready

**Responsibilities**
**Team Leadership**

* Manage, coach, and develop a 3-person IT Operations team
* Participate in hiring, onboarding, and training of new team members
* Run regular 1:1s, feedback, and performance reviews
* Identify skill gaps and build development plans
* Ensure coverage across time zones (India, UK, US, Mexico) and resolve team conflicts or performance issues as they arise

**Day-to-Day Operations**

* Own resolution of IT issues raised via the ITSM/ServiceDesk platform, ensuring SLAs are met
* Manage team schedules to ensure coverage across all office hours and time zones
* Manage vendor relationships and contracts related to IT operations (ISPs, hardware, SaaS tools, MSPs)
* Own hardware procurement and lifecycle management, including laptop refresh cycles and cross-border logistics
* Track and manage software license renewals across the organization, avoiding lapses and unnecessary spend
* Maintain and support core infrastructure: laptops, desktops, servers, firewalls, routers, switches, printers, VPNs, LANs, and Active Directory

**Strategic Leadership**

* Proactively identify technology gaps and organizational IT needs; build and execute strategic plans to close them
* Define and evolve IT strategy as the company scales past 120 employees and adds offices or headcount
* Own the IT infrastructure budget: forecast costs, evaluate vendors, and optimize spend
* Report regularly to Technology Leadership/Operations on key metrics: SLA performance, ticket resolution times, system uptime, and IT spend
* Champion a strong IT experience for all employees, regardless of office location

**Security & Compliance**

* Implement and maintain information security processes, policies, and controls
* Run regular system and compliance audits against internal and regulatory standards
* Work with Legal/Compliance on data privacy obligations relevant to our footprint (e.g., UK GDPR, India's DPDP Act, and applicable US state privacy laws)
* Run security awareness training for employees, including phishing simulations and onboarding security education
* Lead incident response for security breaches and major operational disruptions

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with DevOps, Security, and Technology Leadership on infrastructure and tooling decisions
* Translate technical issues and trade-offs into clear, actionable updates for non-technical stakeholders
* Support cross-border technology initiatives with external vendors and legal stakeholders

**Business Continuity**

* Develop, implement, and maintain disaster recovery (DR) and business continuity (BC) plans for IT systems, appropriately scoped to a 120-person organization

**Qualifications**
**Experience**

* 7–9 years in IT operations/ITSM, including hands-on support and infrastructure administration
* 2+ years directly managing a team (formal or informal management experience considered)
* Experience supporting a distributed or multi-office workforce across time zones
* Experience scaling IT support functions and driving IT change through an organization
* Some exposure to information security practices (risk assessment, policy enforcement, security awareness)

**Technical Skills**

* Strong desktop support experience across Windows, macOS, and Linux
* Hands-on experience with Active Directory, group policies, patch management, and backup strategies
* Practical network management experience, including VLANs, network segmentation, and gateway/firewall administration
* Solid understanding of core networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, ACLs, and routing basics
* Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and limited oversight

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail
* Able to communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Comfortable partnering across Legal, Compliance, and Risk functions
* High ownership and bias toward action

**Travel**

* Scripting/automation experience (PowerShell, Bash, or Python)
* Familiarity with IPTables

This position supports LAD countries and works closely with customers, Collections, Accounts Receivable, Sales, and other internal teams to resolve payment and account issues and support timely cash posting.
  
  
The Manager will lead a team of approximately 7–8 employees, with responsibility for operational delivery, team performance, controls, reconciliations, issue resolution, and continuous process improvement.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The Manager – Cash Applications (Spanish) leads customer-payment operations for LAD countries from GFIC.
  
  
The Manager is responsible for ensuring customer payments are accurately and timely applied to Accounts Receivable, while overseeing the resolution of unapplied cash, unidentified receipts, short payments, overpayments, and other payment discrepancies.
  
  
The role manages team performance and operational controls, supports account reconciliations and month-end activities, and partners with customers, Collections, AR, Sales, and other stakeholders to resolve account issues.
  
  
The Manager is also responsible for identifying recurring cash-application issues, driving root-cause analysis, implementing process improvements, and developing the capability of a team of 7–8 employees.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Cash Application Operations
  
  

* Lead Cash Application operations for assigned LAD countries.
* Ensure customer payments are identified and accurately applied to the appropriate AR invoices.
* Ensure timely and accurate cash posting.
* Monitor unapplied and unidentified cash and drive appropriate resolution.
* Oversee resolution of:

+ Payment discrepancies
+ Short payments
+ Overpayments
+ Unidentified receipts
+ Unapplied cash

Reconciliation & Month-End
  
  

* Ensure customer-account and cash-application reconciliations are completed accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Monitor reconciliation exceptions and ensure timely resolution.
* Support and oversee relevant month-end close activities.
* Ensure accurate records, supporting documentation, and operational reporting.

People Leadership
  
  

* Lead and manage a team of approximately 7–8 employees.
* Set work priorities and allocate responsibilities.
* Monitor team performance and operational delivery.
* Provide coaching, feedback, and day-to-day guidance.
* Support employee development and knowledge sharing.
* Ensure the team consistently follows established processes and controls.

Customer & Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Collaborate with customers and Collections to identify payments and obtain information required for accurate allocation.
* Partner with Accounts Receivable, Sales, and other internal teams to resolve account issues.
* Use Spanish-language capability where required for LAD customer-payment operations.
* Act as an escalation point for complex payment-application issues.

Controls & Performance Management
  
  

* Monitor operational controls and cash-application accuracy.
* Track relevant performance and service measures.
* Identify risks affecting timely or accurate cash posting.
* Ensure operational issues are appropriately investigated and resolved.

Root-Cause Analysis & Process Improvement
  
  

* Identify recurring payment-application issues.
* Drive root-cause analysis to understand underlying process or data problems.
* Develop and implement practical process improvements.
* Identify opportunities to improve cash-application accuracy, efficiency, and controls.
* Work with relevant stakeholders to reduce recurring exceptions.

**Self-Assessment Questions**

* Do I have professional Spanish-language capability appropriate for LAD business interactions?
* Have I directly managed a team of approximately 7–8 employees or a comparable operational team?
* Do I have hands-on experience with Cash Application and customer-payment processing?
* Can I manage the resolution of unapplied cash, unidentified receipts, short payments, overpayments, and payment discrepancies?
* Have I managed account/payment reconciliations and supported month-end activities?
* Can I monitor team performance and operational controls?
* Have I worked directly with customers, Collections, AR, Sales, or similar stakeholders?
* Can I identify recurring payment issues, perform RCA, and implement process improvements?

Established in 2004, Morgan Stanley Fund Services (MSFS) is a global business within the Institutional Equities Division (IED) that provides fund administration services for over $700billion in assets across 350+ hedge funds, private equity and large family offices clients. description:

**THE LOCATION:**
Bengaluru, India

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Workplace Manager to take ownership of the day-to-day operations of our Bengaluru office and create an efficient, welcoming, and well-organized workplace for our employees, leadership team, and visitors.
  
  
As the central point of contact for office operations and workplace services, you will coordinate facilities, manage external service providers, oversee administrative processes, lead two members of our office administration team, and continuously improve how our office operates.
  
  
Working closely with our Executive Assistant, administrative team, People Team, IT, Finance, and other internal stakeholders, you will play an important role in ensuring a positive workplace experience and supporting the needs of a growing international organization.
  
This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving problems, bringing structure to complex environments, and making things run smoothly.
  
  
**TASK AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**
**Office & Workplace Operations:**
•  Take ownership of the daily operations of our Bengaluru office, ensuring a professional, efficient, and welcoming working environment.
  
•  Act as the primary point of contact for office-related matters, supporting employees, leadership, visitors, and external partners.

•  Identify opportunities to improve office processes, service quality, and operational efficiency.
  
•  Coordinate office layouts, seating arrangements, and workspace requirements in collaboration with relevant teams.
  
  
**Facilities & Vendor Management:**
•  Coordinate building maintenance, repairs, security, and facilities-related services.

•  Support vendor selection, contract administration, purchasing, and budget monitoring.
  
•  Support the designated Health & Safety lead with local coordination as required.
  
•  Work closely with IT to ensure that office infrastructure and workplace equipment meet operational requirements.
  
  
**Administration & Team Coordination:**
•  Coordinate administrative activities and establish clear responsibilities, priorities, and efficient workflows within the office administration function.
  
•  Provide functional and disciplinary leadership to two administrative team members, including guidance, operational support, and clear prioritization of responsibilities.
  
•  Collaborate closely with the Executive Assistant and other administrative stakeholders to ensure seamless support for the leadership team.
  
•  Coordinate meeting rooms, business visits, internal events, and selected travel or scheduling activities as agreed with the Executive Assistant to ensure clear responsibilities and avoid overlapping tasks.
  
•  Develop and maintain effective administrative processes, documentation, and service standards.
  
  
**Workplace Experience & Engagement**
•  Help create a workplace where employees feel welcome, supported, and connected.
  
•  Organize and coordinate office events, team activities, celebrations, and visits from international colleagues and business partners.
  
•  Work closely with the People Team to support workplace initiatives and enhance the on-site employee experience.
  
•  Actively seek employee feedback and identify practical improvements to the working environment. 
  
  
**Budget & Continuous Improvement**
•  Monitor office-related costs and support budget planning and cost control.
  
•  Coordinate purchasing activities and ensure adherence to internal approval processes.
  
•  Depending on experience and business needs, take on additional responsibilities within Procurement.
  
•  Review existing office procedures and introduce improvements that increase efficiency, transparency, and service quality.
  
•  Support cross-functional projects and workplace initiatives as the organization evolves.
  
  
**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:**
•  Several years of relevant professional experience in Office Management, Workplace Operations, Facilities Management, or a comparable role, ideally in an international organization.
  
•  Proven experience managing office operations independently, including coordination of external service providers and administrative processes.
  
•  Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  
•  Experience coordinating administrative teams, providing guidance, or managing people.
  
•  Solid understanding of vendor management, purchasing processes, and budget monitoring.
  
•  A practical, solution-oriented mindset combined with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  
•  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a confident and professional approach to working with employees, leadership, and external partners.
  
•  A service-oriented attitude and genuine interest in creating a positive employee and visitor experience.
  
•  Proficiency in MS Office and common collaboration tools, particularly Microsoft Teams.
  
•  Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  
  
You combine a structured, organized approach with the flexibility to respond to changing priorities. You are comfortable taking initiative, making decisions within your area of responsibility, and finding practical solutions.
  
  
You enjoy working with people at all levels of an organization, but you are equally confident handling operational details, coordinating vendors, and improving processes.
  
Most importantly, you take pride in creating a workplace that runs efficiently and where people enjoy coming to work.
  
  
**WORKPLACE:**
This role is based at our Bengaluru office and requires on-site presence five days per week to support employees, visitors, and daily office operations.
  
  
You will work closely with colleagues across different functions, countries, and cultures in an international technology environment.

title: Head Chef / Kitchen Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced and passionate
**Head Chef / Kitchen Manager**
to lead our commercial kitchen operations in Bengaluru, India. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in authentic Nepali cuisine, particularly a wide range of
**Mo, chutneys, noodles, and QSR-style menu items**
. The candidate will be responsible for maintaining food quality and consistency, recipe standardization, food costing, inventory control, staff management, kitchen SOPs, hygiene, and overall operational efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Food Production & Quality**

* Prepare authentic Nepali dishes while ensuring consistency in taste, quality, portion size, and presentation.
* Demonstrate expertise in preparing different varieties of Mo, including:
  + Steamed Mo
  + Jhol Mo
  + Kothey Mo
  + Chilli Mo
  + Fried Mo
  + Open Mo
* Prepare authentic Nepali chutneys and sauces, including red, sesame, tomato, peanut, and jhol-based gravies.
* Prepare complementary menu items such as Keema Noodles, Fried Rice, Chowmein, Thukpa, sausages, and other fast-moving QSR side dishes.
* Prepare or supervise the preparation of sausages, preferably with the ability to make them in-house rather than relying entirely on external suppliers.
* Prepare or oversee basic beverage production, including lemonade, iced tea, mojitos, and other soft beverages.
* Ensure consistency across every order served in-store or through food delivery platforms.

**Kitchen Operations & Cost Control**

* Develop, standardize, and implement recipes and kitchen SOPs.
* Manage food costing, portion control, gross margins, and profitability.
* Monitor inventory levels and ensure proper stock rotation using FIFO/FEFO principles.
* Minimize food wastage while maintaining quality and operational efficiency.
* Maintain proper storage conditions and monitor the shelf life of raw materials, prepared sauces, and chutneys.
* Operate and maintain kitchen equipment efficiently and report maintenance requirements when necessary.

**Packaging & Delivery Operations**

* Select and implement appropriate packaging for dine-in, takeaway, and food delivery orders.
* Ensure food remains fresh and properly presented during delivery.
* Prevent Mo and other products from becoming soggy due to steam.
* Ensure chutneys and sauces are packed securely without leakage.
* Maintain the crispiness and quality of fried products.
* Optimize packaging costs without compromising food quality or customer experience.
* Support and coordinate online food delivery operations as required.

**Leadership & Staff Management**

* Recruit, train, supervise, and motivate kitchen staff.
* Prepare duty rosters based on business requirements and expected customer volumes.
* Allocate manpower efficiently during peak and non-peak hours.
* Maintain kitchen discipline, cleanliness, and professional standards.
* Monitor employee productivity and provide regular on-the-job coaching.
* Ensure all kitchen staff follow established SOPs, hygiene requirements, and quality standards.

**Menu Development & Innovation**

* Develop new menu items based on customer preferences and market trends.
* Recommend improvements to recipes for better taste, efficiency, and profitability.
* Analyze customer feedback and implement improvements where appropriate.
* Support the development of seasonal and promotional menus.
* Balance authentic Nepali flavors with commercial viability and customer preferences in the Indian market.

**Job Specification**

* Minimum educational qualification:
  **12th Standard (Higher Secondary) or equivalent**
  .
* Minimum
  **3–5 years of hands-on experience**
  in a commercial kitchen specializing in authentic Nepali cuisine.
* Strong knowledge of food costing, recipe standardization, portion control, and kitchen SOPs.
* Must possess a valid
  **Nepal Citizenship/Identity Card or other required identity documentation**
  , or be willing to obtain the necessary documentation prior to employment.
* Preferably below
  **35 years of age**
  .
* Willing to commit to a minimum employment period of
  **two years**
  .
* Physically fit and capable of working in a fast-paced commercial kitchen environment.
* Must be willing to
  **relocate and work in Bengaluru, India**
  .

**Preferred Candidate**

The ideal candidate will:

* Have previous experience working with a successful
  **Mo or Nepali QSR brand**
  .
* Possess hands-on expertise in authentic Nepali Mo, chutneys, and popular QSR menu items.
* Have experience in setting up new restaurant kitchens or developing kitchen SOPs from scratch.
* Understand online food delivery operations and delivery-friendly food preparation.
* Have basic computer knowledge, including familiarity with POS systems, inventory software, or Microsoft Excel.
* Be fluent in
  **Nepali**
  ; basic knowledge of
  **Hindi and/or English**
  will be an added advantage.
* Be capable of balancing authentic Nepali food traditions with customer preferences in the Indian market.

**Required Skills**

* Authentic Nepali cuisine and Mo preparation
* Recipe formulation and standardization
* Food costing and gross margin management
* Portion control and wastage reduction
* Inventory and stock management
* FIFO/FEFO and shelf-life management
* Food safety and hygiene standards
* QSR kitchen operations
* Food packaging and delivery management
* Staff recruitment, training, and supervision
* Kitchen scheduling and manpower management
* Menu innovation and product development
* Problem-solving and decision-making
* Communication and interpersonal skills
* Ability to work efficiently under pressure
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to food quality

**Personal Attributes**

* Honest, disciplined, and reliable
* Strong work ethic and positive attitude
* Passionate about food quality and consistency
* Excellent leadership and team-management abilities
* Detail-oriented and highly organized
* Able to work effectively during peak business hours
* Willingness to continuously learn, innovate, and improve
* Committed to maintaining high standards of hygiene, discipline, and customer satisfaction

title: Assistant Manager Collections
description:
We are looking for a hands-on collections professional to lead our in-house tele-calling team for early bucket (1–30 DPD) resolution, with secondary responsibility for monitoring field and agency recovery performance up to the 90 DPD bucket. The role is primarily about daily floor management, call quality and discipline in the early bucket — where most delinquency can still be resolved without field intervention — supported by close tracking of field and agency output on cases that flow beyond 30 days.

**Key Responsibilities :**

**Primary – In-house Tele-Calling Team (1–30 DPD)**

* Own resolution and roll-back targets for the 1–30 DPD bucket through the in-house calling team.
* Manage daily floor operations: allocation, dialer/campaign planning, call plans, shift coverage and break discipline.
* Monitor agent-level productivity daily — calls attempted, connects, contact rate, PTPs taken, PTP kept ratio, collections per agent and talk time.
* Drive call quality: audit recordings, score calls, correct scripts, negotiation approach, tone and compliance with customer conduct norms.
* Coach, train and performance-manage callers; run daily huddles, weekly reviews and refresher training for new joiners and low performers.
* Ensure accurate and timely disposition, remarks, PTP capture and follow-up in the collections system with no data gaps.
* Manage payment facilitation — payment links, UPI, digital receipting — and follow up on PTP breaks and bounced/failed payments.
* Escalate high-value, disputed or high-risk accounts and coordinate handover of nonresponsive cases to the field team before roll-forward.

**Secondary – Field & Agency Monitoring (up to 90 DPD) :**

* Track field and agency performance on 31–90 DPD accounts: allocation coverage, visit compliance, resolution rate and recovery value.
* Review daily field MIS — visits done vs planned, geo-tagged visit proof, feedback quality and receipt/deposit timelines.
* Monitor agency-wise resolution against targets, flag underperformance and support corrective action plans with the field manager.
* Verify agency invoices, payout workings and cash/cheque deposit reconciliation before approval.
* Ensure field and agency activity complies with RBI Fair Practices Code, recovery agent guidelines and internal code of conduct; track and close customer complaints arising from field visits.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Publish daily, weekly and monthly collection dashboards covering bucket-wise resolution, flow rates, roll-back, PTP performance and agent/agency scorecards.
* Conduct root cause analysis on non-resolution and flow into higher buckets; recommend corrective actions on allocation, scripting or channel mix.
* Prepare presentations for senior management highlighting trends, risks and recommendations.

**Process Improvement**

* Identify gaps in calling strategy, allocation logic and channel sequencing (SMS/IVR/WhatsApp/call/field) and propose improvements.
* Support adoption of dialer, digital collection and AI/automated reminder tools, and measure their impact on early bucket resolution.

**Key Requirements :**

* **Education**
  : Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration or a related field.
* **Experience**
  : 4–8 years in banking/NBFC/fintech collections, with at least 2 years managing an in-house tele-calling team; exposure to field/agency monitoring preferred.
* **Domain Knowledge**
  : Strong understanding of retail/SME/consumer lending products, early and mid delinquency buckets, PTP-driven calling models, dialer operations and agency management.
* **Soft Skills**
  : Strong people management and coaching ability, communication, stakeholder management, problem solving and high personal integrity.

**Technical Skills :**

* Advanced MS Excel / Google Sheets for MIS, allocation and scorecards.
* Hands-on with dialer/CRM/LMS and collections platforms; familiarity with call quality monitoring tools.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint for management-level reporting.
* Plus: hands-on SQL and Power BI.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

* Improved 1–30 DPD resolution and reduced flow into 30+ buckets.
* Higher contact rate, PTP kept ratio and collections per caller month on month.
* Reliable, timely MIS that management can act on without rework.
* Zero conduct or compliance escalations from calling and field activity.

* Lead, coach and develop Workplace Managers and facilitate their cross collaboration, promoting consistent leadership capability, operational excellence, succession planning and a culture of continuous improvement across the region.
* To understand and live the client's values at all times, to be able to articulate what they mean and how they are applied in the execution of RWM responsibilities, and to ensure that all members of the regional team are able to do the same.
* To understand, commit to, uphold and be able to articulate the Operating Principles of this Agreement.
* To understand client's priorities globally and as they apply to the region.
* To understand and be able to articulate the vision for ‘next generation’ client's workplaces being delivered throughout the portfolio.
* To ensure the resources deployed in the region are appropriate at all times, and where adjustments are required to provide an evidenced case to the client's Regional Director for the region.
* To ensure that all direct reports have in place a measurable Development Plan identifying a clear career path and how to achieve it.
* To raise any matters of non-compliant performance and conduct of the Service Partner team in the region with line management and/or the Service Partner Human Resources, collating and providing evidence as required. Ensure client's Regional Director is informed of performance concerns and issues.

***Supply chain***

* To ensure all third-party services are delivered to the commitments of the global contract.
* Provide regional governance of supplier performance through regular performance reviews contract compliance monitoring, service improvement planning and relationship management.
* With Regional Directors, analyse supplier performance across the regional portfolio, identifying trends, risks and opportunities for service improvement.
* To recommend changes to third party supplier arrangements where service quality, commercial or compliance matters are compromised.

***Service quality***

* To regularly visit all locations within the region, depending on location of region.
* To establish and maintain relations with key client's colleagues in the region, as the trusted source of assistance and support as required.
* To provide an effective and responsive service to remotely managed locations, leveraging the supply chain where possible.
* Ensure workplace experience strategies, standards and initiatives are implemented consistently across the region, monitoring adoption, sharing best practice and supporting Workplace Managers in successful delivery.
* To regularly interact with fellow RWMs in other regions and to identify and share innovations with the RWM network for the benefit of the global contract.
* To manage the 9-point Key Performance Indicator (KPI) system for the region – based on colleague, commercial and compliance – and provide management reporting as required.
* Monitor operational performance across the regional portfolio through audits, KPIs, inspections and service reporting, ensuring corrective actions are implemented where required.
* To effectively manage minor works as directed by client and ensure that the appropriate resources are deployed in each case.
* To ensure that all Workplace Guides (full services directory) for locations across the region remain up to date at all times ensuring the updated guide is delivered to the client Change Management lead.
* To work closely with the client's IT team to ensure a seamless service across the region in areas such as access and security, visitor management, desktop IT, network availability and reprographics.
* To engage with the Service Partner published Research & Insight material and webinars to ensure access to evolving best practice in workplace management and as a contribution to continuous improvement in the role.

***Commercial***

* To effectively and diligently manage cost against budget for the region, reporting as required, and identifying potential cost savings opportunities when they arise.
* To identify any risks or threats to meeting budget as soon as they are known.
* Review regional financial performance, identifying improvements for operational efficiency, reviewing recommendations with Regional Director and Service Partner Finance Lead as required to retain approvals for implementation.

***Compliance***

* To effectively and diligently manage commercial risk in the region, maintaining an up to date register, as required to minimise and mitigate the potential effects of known and unforeseen risks.
* To effectively and diligently manage health and safety in the region, minimising or removing the potential for lost time incidents, completing all required audit requests, and liaising with specialist colleagues are required to deliver the service.
* To ensure all client's workplaces comply with defined foundation standards (‘client Workplace’) using the assessment tool as directed, reporting and costing upgrades where required to maintain alignment.
* To effectively and diligently manage sustainability within the region as directed by the client.
* To effectively and diligently manage the regional requirements of the client's Business Continuity Programme (BCP) within the region.

title: Enterprise Architecture Manager ( Portfolio Operations )
description:
**Summary:**

As a Portfolio Operations Manager within Enterprise Architecture, you will own LeanIX as the firm's enterprise architecture platform, along with the integrations, automation, reporting and automated diagramming that keep the application portfolio accurate at scale.

You will lead the Portfolio Operations team (Platform Operations and Solutions Engineering) and work closely with the ServiceNow team, Software Asset Management (SAM) and the other Portfolio & Enablement teams.

**Location: Bangalore/Kolkata/Hyderabad, India.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own LeanIX platform administration and access management.
* Implement approved metamodel and configuration changes under change control, with the portfolio management team owning data definitions.
* Manage LeanIX subscription capacity against the application limit, and provide the usage and capacity inputs for license renewal.
* Build automation that keeps LeanIX data current, including import automation, automated discovery and owner surveys that write back to LeanIX.
* Lead LeanIX MCP enablement and its connection to AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Cowork, with read-first guardrails and an audit trail for AI-assisted changes.
* Own the automated diagramming solutions that generate architecture landscapes, integration and data-flow diagrams, and current- and target-state views from LeanIX, partnering with the assigned enterprise architect, who refines diagrams for specific needs.
* Own LeanIX integrations built on GraphQL and REST APIs, including ServiceNow and OneTrust, and partner with the ServiceNow team on ServiceNow-to-LeanIX reconciliation.
* Publish the firm's approved software list from LeanIX and keep it current as intake decisions are made.
* Oversee portfolio reporting and analytics in LeanIX and Power BI, including the views behind the CTO portfolio story, roadmaps, cost-of-inaction reporting, integration and environment reporting, and lifecycle and obsolescence reporting.
* Run the integration that brings SAM license and contract data into LeanIX without manual rework.
* Lead and develop the Portfolio Operations team: Platform Operations and Solutions Engineering.
* Set priorities for the integration and automation backlog with the Associate Director, Portfolio & Enablement.

**Required Skills:**

* Experience leading and developing a technical team.
* LeanIX experience required, including platform administration, configuration and the data model.
* Track record of delivering integrations and automation, including ServiceNow and OneTrust integrations.
* Experience building Power BI reporting on maintained data rather than one-off extracts.
* Clear communication with technical teams and business stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with GraphQL and REST APIs, including API configuration and authentication.
* Experience with MCP servers and integrating AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Cowork with enterprise platforms.
* Flexible and willing to support other Portfolio & Enablement teams as priorities shift.

**Preferred Skills:**

* No additional preferred qualifications were specified in the source job description.

**Education / Professional Experience / Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems or a related field.
* 8–12 years of experience in enterprise architecture tooling, IT operations or integration delivery

title: Head of Operations
description:
**About the Company:**

Sequel Logistics is a Supply Chain Management company specializing in providing comprehensive solutions and services in the Critical Logistics segment.

Founded in 2004, Sequel owns and manages a global logistics network that is robust, secure, and technology-driven, specifically designed to manage the supply chains of valuable and life-science consignments.

**Role Objective:**

Dynamic operations leader with expertise in pan-India pharma and diagnostic logistics, dedicated to

enforcing strict regulatory compliance, driving asset lifecycle efficiency (shipper boxes, data

loggers), and elevating CRM-led client solutions to scale network profitability and service reliability.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**(Job Description)**

•
**Pan-India Operations Command**
: Direct daily operations across regional branches, hubs, and the central control tower to guarantee timely pickups, line-haul, and last-mile deliveries,

including vendor and fleet management.

•
**Zero-Deviation Quality & Audits**
: Enforce strict SOP and WHO-GDP/ISO compliance to achieve On-Time, In-Temp (OTIT) delivery, zero temperature excursions, and 100% audit readiness.

•
**Cold-Chain Asset & Cost Control**
: Manage nationwide inventory, conditioning, and lifecycle maintenance of shipper boxes, dry ice/LN2, gel packs, and data loggers while driving branch-level cost reduction, route optimization, and packaging efficiency (e.g., collapsible boxes, asset turnaround) to improve gross margins.

•
**Client & CRM Leadership**
: Lead the central CRM team for proactive tracking and escalation management while partnering with pharma, CRO, and diagnostic clients on

tailored logistics solutions.

•
**Network Expansion & Digitalization**
: Operationalize new locations/fulfilment hubs, drive CRM 2.0 and KPI dashboard adoption, and build team capability through GDP/DGR training and succession planning.

**Education & Experience:**

A Graduate with 10+ years of experience in end to end logistics operations management, including at least 3 years of cold chain operations management.

title: Supply Chain Operations Manager
description:
**Skill required:**
Plan - Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)
  
  
**Designation:**
Supply Chain Operations Manager
  
  
**Qualifications:**
Any Graduation
  
  
**Years of Experience:**
13 to 18 years
  
  
**About Accenture**
Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  
  
**What would you do?**

* Manage planning, procurement, distribution and aftermarket service supply chain operations, helping clients realize 5 for every 1 spent on our services
* OVERALL PURPOSE OF JOB
* To lead merchandising and supply chain operations end to end (category management, buying, replenishment and allocation, inventory and markdown management, vendor and sourcing collaboration, reporting), delivering sales, gross profit and OTIF targets across categories and channels
* To identify, recommend, and implement operational efficiencies, systems and process improvements that improve sell-through, margin and cost-to-serve
* To build, support, sustain and motivate a high performance, multi-level team of approximately 150 FTEs (Leads, Buyers, Planners, Analysts) through Managers and Leads
* Manage the end-to-end product lifecycle from conception to end-of-life, including developing and maintaining product and PLM platform roadmaps, delivery strategies, and operating models.

* Educational Profile
* Any Bachelors Degree with post graduation (Business, Fashion or Retail Management or Design preferred)
* Experience Profile
* 10+ year(s) experience in managing Team Leaders or Specialists
* 14 to 18 years business experience in retail buying and merchandising, replenishment, supply chain planning or retail operations, including leading large multi-level teams What are we looking for?
* Mandatory (Must have skills)
* Experience leading large multi-level teams (Managers, Leads, Buyers, Planners, Analysts) in retail merchandising or supply chain operations
* Deep knowledge of category management, buying and merchandising, assortment planning, allocation, replenishment systems, and inventory and markdown management across apparel, footwear, accessories, home, beauty and general merchandise
* Knowledge of the end-to-end product life cycle (design, development, sourcing), global and domestic sourcing, vendor management and private label development
* P&L, budget and sales-plan ownership across multi-channel retail (EBOs, department stores, e-commerce, general trade, supermarkets)
* Expert level capability in MS Office (Excel analytics); working knowledge of planning ERP systems and BI dashboards
* Tool Knowledge Expected: Microsoft Excel | Microsoft Word | Business Objects | Mainframe and POGDOG reporting | Intranet bulletin board | KCMS | PID | PIM | RMS | Supply Sync | IME | Supply Sync | Item-setup master-data systems | Ticket queue management systems | Point-of-Sale (POS) systems | Scale management systems | retail-support systems | Store-support queues service-request channels
* Non Mandatory (Nice to have skills)
* Exposure to demand planning, import PO and transport planning; Six Sigma Lean; fresh or perishables
* Experience setting up startup teams or scaling new businesses; academic or industry mentoring
* Aptitudes
* Strong vendor, supplier and cross-functional stakeholder management; commercial negotiation
* Data-led decision making: analyzing stock, sell-through, LTL and margin to guide assortment, promotion and markdown decisions
* Strategic, consumer-centric thinking; collaborative leadership; proactive team player with strong verbal and written communication
* Other Expectations
* Strong analytical and problem solving mindset; resolves business and interpersonal problems independently and simplifies complex tasks Roles and Responsibilities:
* Operational Responsibilities:
* The Service Delivery Lead should be able to guide the team and provide support when required on the below detailed activities, across buying, replenishment, planning, vendor collaboration, transport and reporting roles (CL8 to CL13).
* Category Management, Buying, Merchandising & Assortment Planning (apparel, footwear, accessories, home, beauty, GM)
* Replenishment & Allocation, incl. Fresh & Floral (stock intake, store allocation, replenishment systems)
* Inventory, Markdown & Discount Management (stock levels, sell-through, merchandise productivity from store to national level)
* Demand Planning, Material Planning & Planning GPO (forecast accuracy, promo or seasonal uplift)
* Supplier or Vendor Collaboration, Global & Domestic Sourcing, Import PO (vendor development, lead times, quality, cost, OTIF)
* Transport Planning (load planning, carrier scheduling, freight cost, on-time delivery)
* Promotions & Volume-driver Launches (bill penetration, basket size); Private Label Development with vendors
* Reporting & Analytics (dashboards, KPI reporting, MIS); Quality, OTIF & Cost Governance; Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Actions
* The individual will:
* Be responsible for P&L, budget and sales-plan delivery (revenue, GP and margin) of a multi-channel operation (EBOs, department stores, e-commerce, general trade, supermarkets) and make independent decisions with major impact
* Be accountable for OTIF, sell-through, in-stock and LTL growth; own KPIs such as bill penetration, basket size, new customer acquisition, forecast accuracy, fill rate, shrink and freight cost
* Direct buying, merchandising, allocation and replenishment cycles, ensuring stores meet sales and GP targets through replenishment systems
* Drive inventory, space productivity and markdown or discount management from store to national level
* Lead international and domestic vendor and sourcing partnerships: vendor development, quality, cost and lead times; support private label development
* Manage a multi-level team (CL8 to CL13): define role clarity and hand-offs across buying, replenishment, planning, vendor collaboration, transport and reporting; build succession
* Run the operating cadence (daily huddles, weekly reviews, demand or supply reviews, monthly or quarterly business reviews)
* Plan capacity and readiness for peak seasons, festive periods and promotional events
* Drive new business initiatives, launches and startup set-ups; turn around underperforming categories and pivot assortments against market headwinds

title: Global Billing Operations , Vice President
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are looking for an experienced operations leader to oversee billing delivery for Alpha, Alpha Data Services, Risk and Analytics, and State Street Markets. The successful candidate will be accountable for timely and accurate invoicing, effective team leadership, and strong stakeholder engagement. This person will work closely with in-market leads and teams to understand business priorities, resolve issues, create clear accountability, and deliver consistent client and operational outcomes across products and regions.
  
  
**Why This Role Is Important to Us**
Global Billing Operations supports accurate, timely, and controlled client invoicing across State Street’s businesses and geographies. Alpha, Alpha Data Services, Risk and Analytics, and State Street Markets bring together complex products, data, fee arrangements, and client requirements. This role provides the operational leadership needed to coordinate global delivery, maintain close alignment with in-market stakeholders, and ensure billing commitments are met as the businesses grow and evolve.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Lead end-to-end billing operations for Alpha, Alpha Data Services, Risk and Analytics, and State Street Markets, with accountability for timely and accurate invoicing, service quality, controls, and client outcomes.
* Manage and develop teams across global delivery locations, setting clear priorities, performance expectations, capacity plans, and accountability for meeting invoicing deadlines.
* Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and partner closely with in market leads and teams to understand business priorities, coordinate delivery, manage dependencies, and resolve billing issues.
* Oversee client and product onboarding into billing, ensuring fee arrangements, data requirements, system configuration, controls, and operational readiness are understood and delivered.
* Oversee the invoicing cycle and monitor readiness, billing accuracy, aged items, exceptions, service risks, and capacity; intervene early to protect delivery dates and drive issues to sustainable closure. Information Classification: Limited Access
* Maintain a strong control environment, including controls effectiveness, issue management, audit readiness, escalation, and timely remediation.
* Lead the response to significant billing incidents and client-impacting issues, ensuring clear communication, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and prevention of recurrence.
* Drive simplification, standardization, and automation across billing processes, reducing manual activity and improving scalability, transparency, and resilience.
* Support the Global Billing Operations transformation agenda by shaping operating models, prioritizing change, managing dependencies, and embedding new capabilities into business-as-usual operations.
* Provide concise updates and recommendations to senior leadership on delivery, risk, client impact, transformation progress, and decisions required.

title: Campaign Manager
description:
**About the role**

Popbrain is looking for a Campaign Manager to manage advertising campaigns for multiple advertisers across our own and partner inventory.

You will own campaign setup, tracking validation, daily monitoring, optimisation and reporting. Your responsibility will be to understand where advertiser budgets are being spent, assess the quality of the resulting traffic and conversions, and take action to improve campaign performance.

Campaign objectives include website traffic, lead generation, sales and app installs.

**Key responsibilities Campaign management**

* ● Set up and manage multiple advertiser campaigns with clearly defined objectives, budgets, targeting and performance targets.
* ● Handle creative uploads, landing-page URLs, scheduling, bids, frequency caps and daily budget pacing.
* ● Manage different advertising formats, including display and creator-led campaigns, with native, video and in-app formats where applicable.
* ● Monitor campaigns daily and address overspending, under delivery, broken links and sudden changes in performance.

**Tracking and attribution**

* ● Set up and validate click URLs, redirects, UTM parameters, tracking macros, click IDs, conversion pixels and server-to-server postbacks.
* ● Test the complete journey from ad click to lead, purchase, app install or in-app event before scaling campaigns.
* ● Work with advertisers and the technology team to verify event mapping, attribution settings and conversion reporting.
* ● Investigate discrepancies between Popbrain’s dashboard, advertiser analytics and third-party tracking platforms.
* ● Identify missing events, duplicate conversions and tracking failures, and coordinate their resolution.

**Inventory analysis and optimisation**

* ● Track performance by publisher, website or app, placement, creative, audience, geography and device.
* ● Identify effective inventory sources, adjust budget allocation and maintain placement inclusion and exclusion lists.
* ● Optimise towards agreed CPC, CPL, CPA, CPI or ROAS targets, depending on the campaign objective.
* ● Run structured tests across creatives, targeting and landing pages.
* ● Identify suspicious clicks, invalid traffic, poor engagement and low-quality leads. Use
* advertiser feedback to assess downstream conversion quality.

**Reporting and coordination**

* ● Maintain daily performance dashboards and prepare weekly reports with findings, issues and recommended actions.
* ● Coordinate with sales, account management, inventory partners, creative and technology teams.
* ● Communicate performance risks early and maintain records of campaign changes and optimisation decisions.
* ● Support campaign delivery reconciliation for advertiser reporting and billing.

**Required skills and experience**

* ● Hands-on experience managing campaigns through a DSP, ad network or ad-serving platform.
* ● Experience handling multiple advertisers, budgets and campaign objectives simultaneously.
* ● Strong understanding of publisher inventory and optimisation at the placement level.
* ● Practical knowledge of Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, conversion pixels,
* tracking parameters and postbacks.
* ● Understanding of CPM, CPC, CPL, CPA and CPI models, including the distinction
* between billing models and optimisation goals.
* ● Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including pivot tables, lookups and performance
* analysis.
* ● Ability to diagnose campaign problems, explain findings clearly and take ownership
* through resolution.

**Preferred experience**

* ● App-install and in-app event tracking using AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, Singular or a similar platform.
* ● Experience with StackAdapt, DV360, The Trade Desk, Taboola, Outbrain or comparable platforms.
* ● Familiarity with creator-led advertising, AI/chat-based placements, affiliate tracking, fraud detection and brand safety.
* ● Basic knowledge of HTML, JavaScript, browser developer tools or SQL for troubleshooting.
* Experience with every listed platform is not required.

**How success will be measured**

* ● Performance against agreed advertiser objectives.
* ● Accurate campaign setup and reliable tracking.
* ● Controlled budget pacing and timely delivery.
* ● Traffic, lead and conversion quality.
* ● Clear reporting and timely issue resolution.
* ● Documented improvements supported by campaign data.

title: Associate Customer Engineer — Onboarding Specialist
description:
**Job Title: Associate Customer Engineer — Onboarding Specialist**

**Location: Bangalore (On-site)**

**Job Type: Full-time (Rotational shift)**

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, shipping faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and sees AI as a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

What you will do as an Associate Customer Engineer — Onboarding Specialist

The Associate Customer Engineer — Onboarding Specialist is the frontline technical owner of the customer onboarding journey. You are the hands-on engine that turns a provisioned account into a live, value-generating deployment. Working within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will run structured onboarding engagements, guide customers to configure foundational settings, validate traffic behavior, and deliver standard guidance that accelerates customers to first value. You are not quota-carrying; your success is measured by onboarding velocity, time-to-value, customer satisfaction, and seamless hand-off to post-onboarding teams. You will spend your time executing approved runbooks, troubleshooting common issues, documenting everything with rigor, and collaborating with CEs, AEs, and Support to ensure no customer falls through the cracks.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Onboarding Execution & Technical Enablement: Own the end-to-end technical onboarding experience for assigned customers post-provision. Lead structured onboarding calls, guide customers to configure initial Cloudflare settings (e.g., DNS records, SSL/TLS modes, WAF rules, Zero Trust policies), and validate that traffic is behaving as expected before the customer is declared live. Guide customers through approved implementation runbooks with precision, and exercise judgment to identify when an engagement has outgrown the runbook and requires escalation to a Customer Engineer, Support, or Professional Services. Troubleshoot common onboarding issues including DNS resolution failures, SSL/TLS certificate errors, caching misconfigurations, and authentication failures. Ensure every onboarding reaches a clean, documented close with the customer able to operate independently on the Cloudflare platform.
* Customer Guidance & Communication: Deliver standardized customer guidance sessions that walk customers through the Cloudflare dashboard, DNS change procedures, SSL/TLS configuration, and product-specific best practices. Translate complex technical concepts into plain language that non-technical stakeholders can act on, and maintain a calm, patient presence when customers are frustrated or behind schedule. Set clear agendas for every call, provide concise written summaries, and document next steps so that customers and internal teams always know who owns what.
* Process & Operational Excellence: Maintain impeccable documentation hygiene across all customer engagements using Ai supported tools. Update CRM/Salesforce records after every touchpoint, produce call follow-ups and action-item lists, and track milestones within onboarding projects to ensure no step is skipped and no deadline is missed. Juggle a portfolio of concurrent onboarding customers with strong time management, prioritizing by committed timelines and customer urgency. Flag blockers early, manage expectations proactively, and treat the onboarding pipeline as a system you continuously optimize.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Escalation Management: Act as the customer’s voice inside Cloudflare during onboarding. Surface expansion opportunities (new products, additional seats, higher tiers) to CEs and AEs with enough context for them to act. Route complex technical issues, architectural questions, and break/fix escalations to the appropriate Support or Customer Engineering teams with clear, complete background documentation. Partner smoothly with adjacent teams without letting the customer feel handed off; you are the single point of accountability until onboarding is complete.
* Technical Breadth & Continuous Development: Build and maintain working knowledge across Cloudflare’s product foundations—Application Security, CDN, Zero Trust/SASE, and Network Services—at a depth appropriate to onboarding scenarios. Be familiar with and leverage AI technology available to you to create new and innovative tools to support and increase your onboarding activities. Stay current on Cloudflare product releases, feature roadmaps, and relevant certifications. Invest in expanding your technical foundation over time, treating each onboarding as a learning opportunity and engaging feedback from peers and leaders to improve with every customer.

Minimum Qualifications

Core Technical Skills

* Cloudflare product foundations: working knowledge of Application Security, CDN, Zero Trust/SASE, and Network Services.
* Networking fundamentals: understanding of DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP/HTTPS, CIDR, NAT, and BGP.
* Web security basics: familiarity with OWASP, WAF rules, OAuth, SAML, MFA, and Zero Trust principles.
* Configuration & integration: hands-on experience with the Cloudflare Dashboard, and comfort with Terraform, API-based configurations, or identity providers such as Okta, Azure AD, and SAML/OIDC integrations.
* Observability: ability to read and interpret Security Events, Logs, cURL outputs, and HAR files; awareness of common causes of 5xx/4xx errors post-onboarding.
* Scripting & APIs: ability to read and debug REST API calls; basic proficiency with Python and Bash.

Experience

* Experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Technical Support, Implementation Specialist, Onboarding Engineer, Junior Sales/Systems Engineer, or NOC/SOC analyst—or equivalent hands-on technical experience managing customer deployments. (Years of experience will vary based on Associate-level expectations.)
* Working Style
* Customer empathy: explains technical concepts without jargon; calms frustrated customers.
* Structured communication: clear agendas, concise summaries, documented next steps.
* Bias for action: progresses onboarding rather than waiting; knows when to escalate appropriately.
* Curiosity: digs into why something works and learns unfamiliar Cloudflare products quickly.
* Resilience: handles ambiguity, incomplete requirements, and changing priorities.
* Coachability: accepts feedback and improves from every onboarding engagement.
* Time management: juggles a portfolio of onboarding customers and meets committed timelines.

Communication

* Strong written and verbal communication skills. Able to document clearly, summarize concisely, and interact professionally with both technical and non-technical customer contacts.
* Regulatory & Security Awareness (Nice-to-Haves)
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, or ISO 27001 is a plus.
* Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")
* Cloudflare Certifications: Existing Cloudflare certifications (e.g., Cloudflare Fundamentals, Cloudflare for Teams, or Cloudflare for Developers).
* Prior Cloudflare Experience: Direct experience onboarding or administering Cloudflare in a production environment.
* Automation Mindset: Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi) or CI/CD pipelines for configuration management.
* AI-Augmented Workflow: Comfort using AI assistants, LLM-based tools, or scripting to accelerate routine onboarding tasks, log analysis, or documentation.
* Multilingual: Proficiency in languages relevant to the hiring region’s customer base.

Thanks & Regards,

**Vaishali Bhola**

Sr. HR Executive - Talent Acquisition

E - vaishali.bhola@trantrinc.com

* Proficiency supporting Windows and/or macOS operating systems
* Basic understanding of VPN configuration and networking fundamentals
* Experience working with Jira Service Management (JSM) or a similar ITSM/ticketing platform

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Excellent communication skills and a customer-service mindset
* Fluent in English

title: Digital Workplace Services Specialist
description:
**Job Requisition ID #**
26WD101910
  
  
**Position Overview**
This role supports day-to-day IT operations and technology services at assigned office locations, ensuring that employees have a reliable, secure, and productive technology experience. The successful candidate provides technical support for hardware, software, operating systems, collaboration tools, and workplace technology while resolving issues of mild to moderate complexity.
  
  
The role requires sound technical judgment, strong customer service skills, and the ability to troubleshoot issues using established processes, documentation, and standard procedures. The employee works independently on assigned tasks with moderate direction and seeks guidance when issues are complex, business-critical, or outside established support guidelines.
  
  
The position is responsible for maintaining IT service quality, supporting office technology infrastructure, coordinating with global IT teams, and ensuring the timely resolution of incidents and service requests.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day technical support to employees for laptops, desktops, mobile devices, peripherals, software, and workplace technology
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, operating system, network connectivity, and access-related issues
* Manage incidents and service requests within defined SLAs and established IT support processes
* Support Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, and enterprise applications
* Perform laptop provisioning, configuration, deployment, refresh, and replacement activities
* Support employee onboarding, offboarding, device handovers, and IT asset lifecycle management
* Maintain accurate documentation of troubleshooting steps, resolutions, asset information, and knowledge articles
* Coordinate with global IT teams, engineering teams, vendors, and other support functions to resolve technical issues
* Provide hands-on support for conference rooms, meeting room technology, office events, and executive or VIP technology needs when required
* Follow established security policies, endpoint management standards, and IT compliance requirements
* Identify recurring technical issues and recommend improvements to support processes and the employee experience
* Participate in IT projects, office technology initiatives, hardware refresh programs, and global support activities
* Share technical knowledge and provide guidance to colleagues to improve team efficiency and consistency

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Relevant education, technical training, or equivalent practical IT support experience
* Experience in IT support, desktop support, service desk operations, or enterprise technology operations
* Good understanding of Windows and macOS operating systems
* Knowledge of hardware troubleshooting, software installation, peripheral configuration, and basic network troubleshooting
* Familiarity with ITSM tools and incident and request management processes
* Understanding of endpoint management, device configuration, and IT asset management
* Ability to troubleshoot technical issues systematically and follow established procedures
* Strong customer service, communication, and problem-solving skills
* Ability to prioritize multiple incidents and service requests while meeting defined SLAs
* Good documentation skills and attention to detail
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with global and local IT teams

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting enterprise environments with geographically distributed employees
* Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Autopilot, and endpoint management solutions
* Experience with ServiceNow or other IT service management platforms
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook, VPN, and enterprise collaboration tools
* Experience with laptop imaging, provisioning, deployment, and hardware refresh processes
* Familiarity with ITIL practices and IT service management principles
* Experience supporting conference rooms, AV equipment, and executive-level technology requirements
* Exposure to IT security, endpoint compliance, MFA, and device management initiatives
* Experience creating knowledge articles, technical documentation, and standard operating procedures
* Ability to identify process gaps and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives

**Ideal Candidate**
The ideal candidate is a customer-focused and technically capable IT professional who takes ownership of employee technology issues and ensures a consistent support experience. They demonstrate strong troubleshooting skills, follow established processes, and are comfortable handling routine technical challenges independently.
  
  
They understand the importance of balancing technical resolution with the employee experience, communicate clearly with stakeholders, and collaborate effectively with global support teams. They are proactive in identifying recurring issues, maintaining documentation, and improving operational efficiency.
  
  
The candidate is curious about emerging technologies, willing to learn new tools and processes, and motivated to develop deeper expertise in enterprise endpoint management, IT operations, and workplace technology.

That engineering expertise positions us to power the next generation of AI workloads, from training to inference and agentic AI at scale.
  
  
Penguin Solutions brings together differentiated infrastructure software, advanced memory, compute systems, end-to-end services, and industry-leading partner solutions in a full-stack AI factory platform designed to help customers deploy and scale AI workloads with speed and precision.
  
  
At Penguin Solutions, we value ideas over hierarchy and believe in servant leadership, where leaders enable teams to do their best work. We empower employees to take ownership, drive innovation, and grow through challenging work, continuous learning, and exposure to advanced AI tools and technologies. With flexibility where it matters and a strong focus on outcomes, Penguin Solutions is a place to do your best work, grow your career, and make a meaningful impact.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Penguin Solutions is expanding its customer service operations in Bangalore and is hiring Service Analysts to support our 24x7 Support Coordination team. This team plays a critical role in Penguin Solutions’ global service delivery model by acting as the first point of contact for customers and partners across multiple service channels including phone, web, email, and system-generated alerts.
  
  
Service Analysts are responsible for providing timely first response, accurately assessing customer-reported issues or monitoring events, performing initial triage and entitlement validation, and coordinating escalation to appropriate technical resources in line with defined service level agreements (SLAs). The role requires a combination of strong customer service skills, operational discipline, and general technical acumen to support enterprise and mission-critical hardware and software environments.
