title: Technical Analyst
description:
Shape the future of work in complex industries.
  
  
At Falkor, we help some of the world's most complex industries operate with greater clarity, confidence, and control.
  
  
Built on more than 200 years of KONGSBERG industrial heritage, our industrial intelligence platform connects people, systems, and workflows across energy, processing, power, renewables, and other heavy-asset industries.
  
  
We turn complexity into clarity and data into decisions, helping organizations improve safety, efficiency, and performance across the asset lifecycle.
  
  
As industries evolve, we're building the technology that helps people see further, decide faster, and operate with confidence.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
Falkor is seeking a Technical Analyst to join the Customer Support team. This hands-on role is suited to candidates with 0–4 years of experience in application, technical, or product support and troubleshooting for internal or external customers.
  
  
You will install, configure, implement, and support real-time systems and applications for the oil and gas industry. Working directly with customers and collaborating with internal teams, you will troubleshoot technical issues, support reliable application operation, and deliver timely, customer-focused resolutions. The role requires rotational day and night shifts in India and travel to client offices when required.
  
  
Every Technical Analyst will have the opportunity to learn and support all products across Falkor’s portfolio, including SiteCom, LedaFlow, K-Spice, Falkor Platform, and Falkor Surface. Primary product assignments will be aligned to each analyst’s best fit, considering their technical strengths, domain knowledge, and interests, while maintaining opportunities to build expertise and contribute across the portfolio.
  
  

* SiteCom: Real-time drilling data management.
* LedaFlow: Transient multiphase flow simulation and flow assurance in wells and pipelines.
* K-Spice: Dynamic process simulation for engineering design, verification, optimisation, and operator training.
* Falkor Platform: Industrial data integration and contextualisation, providing a connected foundation for applications, simulation, and AI.
* Falkor Surface: A shared operational workspace connecting people, data, simulation, and AI agents for collaboration and decision support.

**What You'll Do**
Key Responsibilities-
  
  
**Customer Support and Application Operations**

* Install, configure, implement, and support Falkor applications across real-time drilling data, flow and process simulation, industrial data integration, and operational collaboration, in line with assigned responsibilities.
* Handle customer support requests over email and phone, troubleshooting and resolving issues on installed systems in a timely manner.
* Use knowledge of each customer’s environment to deliver high-quality incident resolution, with a focus on identifying root causes.
* SiteCom: Support real-time drilling data availability and WITSML data exchange; investigate data access, connectivity, and data-quality issues affecting customer workflows.
* LedaFlow: Assist users with application setup, simulation case execution, and access to results for multiphase flow and flow-assurance studies; capture reproducible issues for specialist investigation.
* K-Spice: Support application configuration and the operation of dynamic process simulation and operator-training environments; investigate simulation execution and integration issues with the relevant specialists.
* Falkor Platform: Support data-source connectivity, ingestion, contextualisation, and access to industrial data; investigate reported data availability and integration issues.
* Falkor Surface: Help users access and navigate operational workspaces, search and visualise asset information, and use collaboration features; troubleshoot access, display, and workflow issues.

**Customer Enablement and Delivery Support**

* Work with clients to configure and support SiteCom real-time data workflows and WITSML integrations for drilling environments.
* Support deployment and configuration of applicable Falkor applications.
* Collaborate with customers and internal teams to clarify technical requirements and resolve application issues.
* Assist customers with onboarding and initial setup across simulation, data-platform, and operational-workspace products, coordinating with delivery and product specialists as required.
* Help validate data connections and access in Falkor Platform, asset information and workspace configuration in Falkor Surface, and simulation environment readiness for LedaFlow and K-Spice.

**SLA Management and Support Operations**

* Manage support requests in line with defined service-level agreements, incident priorities, and support procedures.
* Provide clear, timely updates to customers throughout troubleshooting and resolution.
* Maintain accurate incident records, troubleshooting notes, and shift handovers to support continuity of service.

**Technical Troubleshooting and Escalation**

* Investigate application, Windows Server, network connectivity, configuration, and data-related issues across supported customer environments, distinguishing technical faults from matters requiring product or domain expertise.
* Apply knowledge of SQL, NoSQL, and flat-file databases to investigate issues in supported customer environments.
* Escalate complex issues to the appropriate internal teams with relevant context, diagnostic information, and troubleshooting steps already completed.
* Collect product-relevant diagnostics, such as SiteCom data-flow examples, LedaFlow and K-Spice simulation cases and execution logs, Falkor Platform ingestion and integration details, and Falkor Surface reproduction steps and affected views.
* Investigate automated alerts received for issues lying with the data quality, pipelines, asset and/or system health.
* Coordinate with product and domain specialists on simulation-model behaviour, flow-assurance questions, process-engineering issues, and complex data or workflow configurations; validate fixes and workarounds before confirming resolution.

**Knowledge Management and Continuous Improvement**

* Document troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and root cause findings for reuse by the support team.
* Identify recurring issues and contribute to improvements in support documentation and processes.
* Build working knowledge across SiteCom, LedaFlow, K-Spice, Falkor Platform, and Falkor Surface through product learning and cross-team knowledge sharing, while developing deeper expertise in best-fit product assignments.
* Maintain product-specific troubleshooting guides covering recurring data-flow, simulation execution, integration, access, and workspace issues.

**Shift-Based Support Coverage**

* Work rotational shifts in alignment with Customer Support coverage requirements and business needs.
* Provide weekend coverage when assigned, ensuring timely handovers and continuity of service.
* Provide clear handovers identifying the affected product, customer impact, troubleshooting completed, outstanding actions, and any specialist escalation needed to maintain continuity across shifts.
* Travel to client offices when required and work effectively with customers and colleagues across cultures.

**What We're Looking For**

* 0–2 years of experience in application, technical, or product support, including troubleshooting for internal or external customers over email and phone.
* Bachelor’s degree in petroleum engineering or computer science.
* Experience deploying, configuring, or supporting .NET applications or software on staging and production servers.
* Windows Server system administration experience and knowledge of network communication solutions.
* Knowledge of well construction processes, drilling workflows, drilling performance analytics, and standard operating practices in the oil and gas industry.
* Working knowledge and experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, and JSON.
* A proactive, customer-friendly approach, a commitment to on-time delivery, and strong troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team, including with people from different cultures.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
* Willingness to work rotational day and night shifts in India and travel to client offices when required.

**Desirable Experience**

* Familiarity with WITSML or WITS.
* Experience working on a drilling rig; beneficial but not mandatory.
* Experience administering SaaS solutions on Microsoft Azure.
* Knowledge of the software development life cycle (SDLC).

**Success Measures**

* Technical support issues are resolved promptly and effectively, with clear customer communication.
* Root cause findings and resolutions are documented accurately and made available for reuse.
* Deployments, configurations, and customer-specific solutions meet agreed requirements.
* Shift handovers and support records enable continuity of service.
* Recurring issues are identified and support knowledge and processes improve over time.

**Why join Falkor?**
You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate.
  
  
**At Falkor, You'll Have The Opportunity To**

* Work on meaningful challenges with real-world impact
* Collaborate with talented colleagues across technology and industry domains
* Learn from experts in software, engineering, operations, and digital transformation
* Grow your career in a business that is expanding globally
* Help shape technology that expands human capability in complex industries

We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and are committed to creating an environment where everyone feels respected, included, and able to do their best work.
  
  
**About Falkor**
Falkor is a KONGSBERG company that enables organizations in heavy-asset industries to expand human capability and redefine how assets are designed, operated, and optimized across their lifecycle.
  
  
By connecting people, systems, and workflows, Falkor's industrial intelligence platform turns complexity into clarity and data into decisions, helping leading organizations improve safety, efficiency, and performance.
  
  
**Ready to apply?**
If you're excited about solving complex challenges and making an impact through technology, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Apply today with your resume.

**Experience:**

business hours. Shift timings may vary based on business requirements.

description:
Position Description
  
  
Role purpose
  
  
Provide reliable day to day operational support for Lotus Domino services and business applications. The engineer monitors service health, responds to incidents and requests, performs approved administration and routine changes, coordinates third party support, and maintains clear operational records. Work is carried out in accordance with documented procedures, change controls, security requirements and agreed service levels.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
Monitoring and service health
  
  

* Use the agreed standard application monitoring tool and Azure Monitor to review service availability, alerts, logs and relevant health indicators for in scope applications and Domino components.
* Perform initial alert triage, assess user and business impact, create or update incident records, and escalate unresolved or high impact issues promptly.
* Monitor application performance, identify recurring degradation or capacity concerns, and provide evidence based recommendations for capacity adjustments.

Incident and third party coordination
  
  

* Own incident coordination from initial assessment through restoration or handover, keeping stakeholders informed in line with communication procedures.
* Engage and coordinate third party providers, including HCL, and track actions, dependencies and resolution progress through closure.
* Escalate security, service availability, data integrity and major performance concerns to the designated support lead.

Access and Domino administration
  
  

* Process authorized access requests and updates in accordance with approval, least privilege and access review procedures.
* Perform routine Domino database administration and agreed application specific operational routines using approved runbooks.
* Validate request details and approvals, document completed actions, and report exceptions or failed changes.

Change, deployment, patching and upgrades
  
  

* Implement approved application changes and instruction based application deployments by following supplied procedures and change records.
* Perform standard software updates and Domino patching within the approved maintenance process, including prerequisite checks, coordination, implementation records and post change validation.
* Support Domino version upgrades through planning and execution activities defined in the approved upgrade plan; coordinate dependencies and escalate risks or deviations.
* Do not implement unapproved changes or upgrades; obtain the required authorization and technical direction before proceeding.

Performance configuration and reporting
  
  

* Maintain agreed monitoring parameters and thresholds; make adjustments only through the approved review and change process.
* Review performance trends and alert patterns, identify potential false positives or coverage gaps, and recommend tuning for approval.
* Prepare agreed reports covering service health, incidents, changes, patching, upgrades, performance and operational risks.

Documentation and software lifecycle
  
  

* Maintain basic operational documentation, support procedures, known error information, configuration records and activity logs.
* Maintain records of relevant license information and supported software and Domino versions; flag upcoming support or compatibility concerns.
* Contribute to knowledge articles and handover notes so that recurring tasks can be performed consistently.

**Required Experience And Skills**

* Experience in application or platform operations, service desk escalation, or production support.
* Working knowledge of HCL Domino / Lotus Notes administration concepts, including databases, users and routine operational tasks.
* Experience using monitoring and ticketing tools; familiarity with Azure Monitor is desirable.
* Ability to follow runbooks, change controls, access approval processes and incident escalation procedures.
* Good troubleshooting, record keeping and stakeholder communication skills.
* Ability to coordinate with infrastructure teams, application owners and external support providers.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* HCL Domino administration or related platform training/certification.
* Experience with Domino patching, version upgrades, application deployment, and performance monitoring.
* Knowledge of ITIL incident, request, problem and change practices.

Performance expectations
  
  

* Respond to alerts and requests within agreed service levels and maintain accurate ticket updates.
* Complete operational changes with the required approvals, validation and documentation.
* Escalate promptly when impact, risk or technical complexity exceeds the role's authority or documented procedures.
* Maintain dependable service records and contribute to reduced repeat incidents through clear findings and knowledge sharing.

Role boundaries
  
  
The role performs approved operational support and routine administration. Application development, functional/business ownership, licensing procurement, major architectural decisions, and non standard changes are handled by the designated application owner, service lead or specialist team unless separately agreed. Major upgrades and performance threshold changes require approved plans and change authorization.

title: Customer Experience Engineer II

The Security Customer Experience Engineer is a highly customer-connected engineering role within Microsoft Security, focused on the Microsoft Defender portfolio. This role carries end-to-end ownership of high-impact, mission-critical customer escalations, ensuring not only timely resolution but also sustained customer confidence during complex and sensitive situations. Beyond resolving incidents, the engineer plays a strategic role in strengthening product reliability and supportability by working closely with Engineering and Product teams, translating real-world customer challenges into actionable improvements that enhance overall service quality and trust. The position extends well beyond traditional escalation management. Location:
  
  
Bengaluru, KA
  
  
**About The Role**
The End User Compute (EUC) team delivers the endpoint platforms, tools and services that enable our colleagues to work securely and effectively.
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on engineer to help shape and deliver improvements across device management, provisioning, automation and hardware lifecycles. Your primary expertise will be Windows endpoint management, particularly Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot and PowerShell. Experience administering both Windows and macOS is highly valued. Strong Windows engineers who are willing to learn and take increasing responsibility for Mac administration are encouraged to apply.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain and enhance our Microsoft Intune environments, including device enrolment, configuration, compliance and application management, ensuring services remain secure, reliable and scalable.
* Develop and improve light-touch provisioning using Windows Autopilot, with minimal manual IT intervention and a robust setup experience.
* Configure and troubleshoot the interactions between Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows Autopilot and Okta, working with identity teams to support reliable device provisioning, authentication and access.
* Plan and deliver endpoint migrations between Microsoft Entra ID tenants, managing dependencies, device transitions, user access, testing and communications while minimising disruption.
* Manage Windows update policies, deployment rings and operating system upgrades, including compatibility testing, pilot deployments, phased rollouts, compliance monitoring and remediation of failed updates.
* Package, test, deploy and maintain Windows applications, including installation and detection logic, dependencies, upgrades and removal. Use WinGet and other appropriate tools to improve application management and employee self-service.
* Develop reusable PowerShell scripts and automation to detect and remediate recurring endpoint issues, reduce manual administration and improve reporting. Apply appropriate testing, logging and error handling.
* Collaborate with Security teams to manage endpoint vulnerabilities, maintain endpoint security tools and implement controls such as encryption, security baselines and local administrator restrictions.
* Provide L3 support for complex issues involving device enrolment, policy conflicts, application deployment, updates, authentication and device trust. Investigate root causes, coordinate vendor escalations and implement lasting fixes through established incident, problem and change management processes.
* Monitor and report on device health, patch and device compliance, provisioning success and application deployment outcomes. Use findings to prioritise improvements and reduce recurring incidents.
* Contribute to the EUC roadmap and own assigned improvements from investigation and design through testing, implementation and operational handover, with clear rollout and recovery plans.
* Maintain technical documentation and runbooks, share knowledge, and provide training for technical teams and end users.

**Essential Skills & Requirements**

* Proven experience in a senior endpoint engineering or L3 EUC role, with strong hands-on administration and troubleshooting of enterprise Windows environments.
* Strong Microsoft Intune expertise across device enrolment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, application deployment, update management and troubleshooting.
* Practical experience implementing and supporting Windows Autopilot and automated device provisioning.
* Experience migrating Windows endpoints from one Microsoft Entra ID tenant to another, including planning, dependency assessment, execution and validation, with consideration for device enrolment, user profiles and data, authentication and application access.
* Experience managing Windows updates and operating system upgrades through controlled testing, deployment rings, compliance monitoring and remediation.
* Strong PowerShell scripting skills, with experience developing and maintaining scripts for endpoint administration, detection, remediation and reporting.
* Experience packaging and deploying Win32 applications, including installation contexts, detection rules, dependencies, upgrades and deployment failure investigation. Practical familiarity with WinGet.
* Experience managing endpoint hardware lifecycles, including asset records, warranty and support status, refresh planning, redeployment and secure decommissioning.
* A strong understanding of Microsoft Entra ID device identities, join types, groups and the relationship between device compliance and Conditional Access.
* A strong understanding of Okta or an equivalent identity provider (IdP), including single sign-on, multifactor authentication and user lifecycle management, with the ability to investigate endpoint-related authentication issues.
* Familiarity with Google Chrome browser management.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, using logs, testing and evidence to identify root causes, recognise recurring problems and verify solutions.
* A practical, service-focused approach, with a willingness to learn macOS administration and actively contribute to both Windows and Mac endpoint services.
* Strong communication skills in spoken and written English, with the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, provide timely updates on progress and risks, produce useful documentation and share knowledge effectively across global teams.

**Desirable Skills & Experience**

* Enterprise macOS administration using Jamf Pro, including configuration profiles, application deployment, patching and troubleshooting.

* Experience using Microsoft Graph and REST APIs to automate endpoint administration, reporting and integrations.
* Experience with version control and maintaining shared scripts and technical documentation.

title: Technical Support Analyst
description:
Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us.
  
  
Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon.
  
  
Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place.
  
  
**Position Summary**
As a Technical Support Analyst, you will work with our enterprise customer base to help achieve their safety and damage prevention goals by solving complex and escalated inquiries related to our AI-powered software products and services.
  
  
The Technical Support Analyst is a highly skilled technical support professional who is passionate about customer success, technically strong, analytical, and able to independently investigate and resolve issues with broad customer or business impact. This role requires sound judgment in selecting troubleshooting methods, deep product knowledge, and the ability to work cross-functionally with our Implementation, Customer Success, Machine Learning, Engineering, and Product teams.
  
  
We are seeking an exceptional and energetic Technical Support Analyst who thrives in a high-growth environment, takes ownership of difficult technical problems, contributes to improvements across the support organization, and helps raise the technical capability of the team.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Customer Support: Own technical support for enterprise customers experiencing issues with our SaaS products through email, chat, phone, and ticketing systems. Provide timely, accurate, and empathetic support while maintaining clear communication throughout the investigation.
* Complex Issue Ownership: Independently investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve escalated and highly complex technical problems. Use sound judgment to determine the appropriate investigative approach, examine multiple possible root causes, and coordinate with Engineering, Product, Machine Learning, or other teams when additional expertise is required while maintaining ownership of the customer issue through resolution.
* Technical Account Stewardship: Develop and maintain a strong understanding of the technology, configuration, integrations, workflows, and known technical risks associated with assigned customers or product areas. Use this knowledge to identify patterns, anticipate support needs, and improve issue resolution.
* Observability and Data-Driven Troubleshooting: Use observability, application monitoring, crash analytics, logs, telemetry, and available data to investigate product behavior and support root cause analysis. Apply tools such as Datadog, Sentry, Firebase Crashlytics, and Databricks as appropriate to the investigation.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration and Product Influence: Partner with Implementation, Customer Success, Machine Learning, Engineering, and Product teams to resolve customer-impacting issues. Translate support findings into clear technical information, identify recurring product problems, and recommend improvements that address customer needs and reduce future support demand.
* Process Improvement: Identify gaps, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities within support processes, tooling, documentation, and workflows. Develop practical solutions and help drive those improvements through implementation.
* Documentation and Knowledge Management: Maintain detailed and accurate records of customer interactions, investigations, findings, and resolutions. Create and maintain customer-facing knowledge base articles, internal troubleshooting documentation, technical briefings, reports, and other support materials.
* Release Testing: Participate in pre- and post-production release testing to validate functionality, identify potential issues, and clearly and effectively document and report findings to the appropriate stakeholders. Apply support knowledge and customer use cases to help identify release risks.
* Operational Performance: Support the successful execution of department goals by meeting service level agreements and contributing to team performance objectives. Track and monitor relevant KPIs, identify trends or risks, and provide findings or recommended actions when performance requires attention.
* Training and Team Development: Share technical knowledge with internal employees and customers through training, coaching, documentation, and knowledge transfer. Serve as a resource for less experienced team members and may participate in onboarding or other team development activities.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Customer Focus: Passionate about helping customers with empathy, professionalism, and a strong sense of ownership.
* Enterprise SaaS Experience: Experience supporting B2B enterprise SaaS customers in a technical support, production support, application support, or similar role.
* Advanced Troubleshooting: Demonstrated ability to independently investigate complex and escalated technical issues, think critically, investigate beyond obvious symptoms, and consider multiple possible root causes and solutions.
* Technical Aptitude: Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand, investigate, and clearly explain complex technical products, integrations, workflows, and issues.
* Observability Tools: Experience using observability and application monitoring tools such as Datadog, Sentry, Firebase Crashlytics, and Databricks, with the ability to use telemetry, logs, crash data, and system insights to support troubleshooting and root cause analysis.
* Data Skills: Working knowledge of SQL for analyzing data and troubleshooting issues. Familiarity with Python is beneficial for understanding automation, debugging workflows, or supporting technical investigations.
* Support Platforms: Experience using support and work management tools such as Zendesk, Jira, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or similar platforms.
* Independent Judgment: Ability to work independently, select appropriate troubleshooting methods, manage ambiguity, and make sound decisions within the scope of the role.
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to document technical findings clearly for customers and internal stakeholders.
* Organization: Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and deliver on multiple competing priorities in a high-growth environment.
* Leadership and Knowledge Sharing: Ability to mentor peers, share technical expertise, contribute to team learning, and help improve support practices and customer outcomes.
* Continuous Improvement: A demonstrated mindset of identifying recurring problems, proposing improvements, and following through on solutions rather than only resolving individual incidents.
* Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with the utility, safety, damage prevention, or related industries is a plus.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Utility and Energy Industry Experience: Experience supporting software solutions within the utilities, energy, field services, safety, damage prevention, infrastructure, or critical operations industries.
* AI-Powered Products: Experience supporting AI, machine learning, computer vision, or data-driven SaaS products and the ability to communicate model behavior, outcomes, or limitations to customers and internal stakeholders.
* API and Integration Troubleshooting: Experience troubleshooting APIs, web services, authentication protocols, system integrations, and data synchronization issues in enterprise environments.
* Cloud Technologies: Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform and an understanding of cloud-based application architectures.
* Application Performance Monitoring: Experience interpreting performance metrics, monitoring dashboards, and system health indicators to proactively identify customer-impacting issues.
* Automation and Scripting: Experience using Python, PowerShell, Bash, SQL, or similar technologies to automate support workflows, investigate issues, or improve operational efficiency.
* Incident and Problem Management: Familiarity with ITIL principles, incident management, problem management, root cause analysis, and post-incident review processes.
* Customer Escalation Management: Demonstrated experience managing high-priority customer escalations, coordinating cross-functional resolution efforts, and maintaining customer confidence during critical situations.
* Technical Leadership: Experience leading technical initiatives, mentoring team members, driving knowledge-sharing programs, or contributing to support process improvements across an organization.
* Analytics and Data Platforms: Exposure to data analytics platforms, reporting tools, or large-scale datasets used to investigate trends, monitor product health, and support customer success initiatives.
* Agile Environment: Experience working in agile, collaborative, and customer-centric software organizations with close partnership across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and Support teams.
* Education Required: Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related technical discipline.
* Availability: Work on a 24/7 rotating shift schedule to ensure around-the-clock support coverage, including weekends and holidays.
* Working Model: Hybrid: In office 1-3 days per week to foster collaboration with Engineering partners.

Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for!
  
  
The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience.
  
  
Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com.
  
  
Itron is transforming how the world manages energy, water and city services. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

title: Global People Operations - Systems Administrator
description:
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team And The Role**
The People Systems Operations Administrator supports the day-to-day work that keeps Stripe’s People technology running accurately and reliably. The role sits in the Service Delivery Center and works as part of the wider People Solutions team, with a close dotted-line partnership to People Solutions Systems Management.
  
  
You’ll own a defined set of routine tier 1 and tier 2 operational work across Workday and related People Systems. This includes monitoring support channels and system inboxes, triaging requests, completing repeatable administrative tasks, maintaining documentation, and routing complex issues to the right People Systems owner.
  
  
This is a hands-on operations role. It creates clearer separation between routine support work and the configuration, architecture, governance, and project delivery owned by the People Systems team.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
Support queue and request triage
  
  

* Monitor the Salesforce case management queue and Jira requests for People Systems work.
* Triage incoming requests by urgency, business impact, data sensitivity, and defined support process.
* Resolve standard requests using documented procedures, and route exceptions or higher-complexity work to the appropriate People Systems owner. Keep request records accurate and complete, including status updates, required approvals, supporting documentation, and clear handoffs.
* Identify recurring request patterns and flag opportunities to improve documentation, self-service, or system processes.

Workday operations
  
  

* Monitor the Workday inbox for business process errors, stuck transactions, alerts, and other operational issues.
* Complete routine Workday support tasks, including standard access requests, account maintenance, and operational follow-up.
* Support Salesforce and JIRA run work and respond to common People Systems questions using approved guidance.
* Help with recurring operational tasks such as account monitoring, account resets, and quarterly account reviews.
* Support year-end activity, including schedule extensions, alert configuration, audit requests, and tracking follow-up items.
* Assist with release readiness by reviewing assigned Workday updates, completing test steps, documenting results, and escalating issues found during testing.
* Support recurring People programs, such as performance-cycle launches, using established runbooks and checklists.

Reporting, documentation, and Jira support
  
  

* Intake and triage Workday reporting and data requests. Confirm required information, route requests to the right owner, and provide status updates to requesters.
* Complete standard reporting tasks and access-related requests where there is a documented process and appropriate approval.
* Maintain runbooks, Trailhead content, standard operating procedures, and request templates so guidance stays current and easy to find.
* Support data-quality checks and follow established processes to correct or escalate issues.

Partnership with People Systems
  
  

* Work closely with People Systems analysts and engineers to understand support priorities, upcoming releases, recurring work, and escalation paths.
* Provide clear handoffs for work that requires configuration changes, advanced reporting, integrations, security decisions, or policy interpretation.
* Participate in regular reviews of queue trends, service levels, documentation gaps, and operational risks.
* Build platform knowledge over time, with opportunities to take on more complex administration and configuration work as skills develop.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Experience in People operations, HR administration, systems support, service delivery, or another operations role involving high-volume, process-driven work.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly where accuracy affects People records, access, payroll, compliance, or reporting.
* Ability to work through a queue independently, prioritize requests, follow defined processes, and escalate issues at the right time.
* Clear written communication and comfort giving requesters concise status updates.
* Experience using Jira, Salesforce, or a similar case-management or ticketing tool.
* Comfort learning enterprise systems and following structured procedures across multiple tools.
* Strong organization skills and a consistent approach to documenting work and following requests through to resolution.
* Good judgment when working with confidential information.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting Workday, including Core HCM, business processes, security administration, reporting, or Workday inbox monitoring.
* Experience handling reporting requests, data access requests, and standard user provisioning.
* Experience supporting cyclical People programs, compliance activities, audit requests, or system-release testing.

What success looks like
  
  
**Within The First Six Months, You Will**

* Own the defined tier 1 and routine tier 2 People Systems queue work with accurate, timely resolution and clear escalation.
* Establish dependable monitoring for People Systems tickets in Salesforce, JIRA, the Workday inbox, and recurring operational tasks.
* Reduce avoidable handoffs and ensure complex work reaches the right People Systems owner with the context needed to act.
* Keep core runbooks and self-service guidance current based on recurring request patterns.
* Give People Systems analysts and engineers more capacity for configuration, governance, architecture, and strategic delivery work.

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

title: Technical Account Manager (MBA Supply Chain and Operantions)
description:

* Hands-on experience with global enterprise customers from day one
* Mentorship from experienced TAMs, plus structured training on our platform and the procurement domain
* Work on real AI-driven initiatives in enterprise Source-to-Pay
* A career that combines technology, consulting and business
* Ready to build your career at the meeting point of tech, supply chain and customer success? Apply now, or tag someone who fits this role.

title: Regional Alliance Manager, GSI

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. title: Engagement Manager - Bengaluru
description:
**About the Company**

The Founders Finance is a Bangalore-based finance partner for founder-led businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets. The team runs Virtual CFO, Accounting and Taxation, Fundraising, Company Secretarial and Advisory functions for companies across consumer and D2C, food and beverage, fashion, SaaS and financial services, working to a disciplined monthly rhythm rather than year-end scrambles. Clients get their books closed early in the month, a clear read on their cash runway, and a compliance calendar where nothing slips through. It's a small, senior-heavy team by design, so founders work directly with people who understand both the numbers and the business behind them.

**About the Role**

As an Engagement Manager, you own the client relationship. You're the person founders trust to know their numbers, spot problems early and keep every deliverable on time. You'll run a portfolio of clients end to end, from monthly closings and compliance to the conversations that shape their financial decisions.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

1. Own a portfolio of client engagements end to end, and act as the primary point of contact for founders and their teams

2. Deliver accounting, taxation, compliance and financial reporting services to clients on a disciplined monthly rhythm

3. Gather information and data from clients' finance managers, teams and other sources, and make sure it's complete, accurate and on time

4. Review books, reconciliations, MIS and P&Ls prepared by the team, and ensure quality before they reach the client

5. Present monthly performance, cash flow and key insights to founders, and advise on the actions that matter

6. Track compliance calendars (GST, TDS and other statutory deadlines) so nothing slips through

7. Guide and review the work of associates on your engagements, and help raise the quality bar across the team

8. Spot opportunities to expand services with existing clients, such as Virtual CFO, fundraising support and advisory

9. Manage timelines, deliverables and client expectations across multiple engagements at once

**Requirements**

1. CA Qualified (must)

2. 5+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations or client-facing finance services

3. Strong working knowledge of Tally (ERP 9 / Prime)

4. Solid understanding of GST, TDS and tax compliance

5. Strong Excel skills and experience in MIS and financial reporting

6. Proven ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines, and to review the work of others

7. Excellent communication, with the confidence to work directly with founders and senior stakeholders

8. Strong ownership, judgment and attention to detail

**Good to Have**

1. Experience working with or inside startups (preferred)

2. Familiarity with other accounting software such as Zoho or QuickBooks

3. Exposure to FP&A, fundraising support or investor reporting

4. Exposure to D2C, e-commerce, F&B, SaaS or financial services clients

5. Experience in a CA firm, advisory firm or virtual CFO setup

**What You'll Gain**

1. Full ownership of client portfolios across high-growth businesses

3. Exposure across virtual CFO reporting, fundraising and compliance

4. A fast track to larger portfolios and leadership responsibilities

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
**About GobbleCube**

GobbleCube builds an agentic performance marketing and commerce intelligence platform for CPG brands selling on quick commerce and e-commerce marketplaces: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, Amazon and Flipkart. Our founders spent over a decade together, including years on Blinkit's core leadership team. We work with some of India's largest CPG brands.

**The role**

You will own a portfolio of enterprise CPG accounts and grow them. Our product touches several functions inside a brand: sales, performance marketing, category and supply chain. Your job is to understand what each of them needs, show them the value in their own numbers, and turn that into renewals and bigger contracts.

**What you will do**

* Own revenue, renewals and expansion for 10–20 accounts, depending on size.
* Build an account plan for each: stakeholders, their KPIs, where we can grow, and the risks.
* Build relationships across sales, performance marketing, category and supply chain teams, with at least two champions per account.
* Spot expansion opportunities: new brands, new platforms, new modules, and moving clients from insights to performance marketing.
* Demo the product and translate it into each persona's problem using their own data.
* Join the outcome reviews led by the Customer Success team, and own the next conversation that follows: renewal, expansion or a new module.
* Write and negotiate renewal and upsell proposals, including working with procurement.
* Know when to bring in the Head of GTM or founders for senior conversations, and prepare them.
* Keep your pipeline and forecast accurate.

**What success looks like in 12 months**

* Net revenue retention above target across your portfolio.
* Strong ACV expansion in the majority of your accounts, through new brands, platforms or modules.
* Every account has a written plan, refreshed every quarter, and at least two active champions in two different functions (for example, e-commerce and supply chain).

**What we're looking for**

* 5–8 years in account management or sales, including growing software or data accounts at CPG brands, or selling to them against a quota.
* A track record of expanding accounts, with numbers to show for it.
* A working understanding of how sales, performance marketing, category and supply chain teams inside a CPG operate, what they measure, and where they disagree.
* The ability to demo a product and frame it around each stakeholder's problem.
* Discipline in running a portfolio of accounts and deciding where your time goes.
* Experience owning renewal and upsell proposals, including pricing and procurement.

* Comfortable pulling and reading data yourself.

title: Senior Account Manager - IT/ITeS, AGS-APJ-India-ITS
description:
**Description**
Do you have the business savvy and technical background to help establish Amazon Web Services as the preferred cloud platform for India's IT and ITeS industry? AWS India is seeking a Senior Account Manager to lead cloud strategy and revenue growth across one of India's most dynamic and globally influential sectors.
  
  
AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.
  
  
As a Senior Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will own the end-to-end cloud strategy for a portfolio of strategic, high-revenue IT services companies, software product firms, and technology-enabled services organizations. You will operate as a trusted advisor to C-suite executives, influencing multi-year technology decisions and driving large-scale digital transformation programs. This role requires you to think at the level of how India's leading technology companies architect their platforms, modernize their delivery models, and build next-generation solutions on AWS for their global customers. You will define the strategic direction for your accounts, execute complex multi-stakeholder commercial engagements, mentor junior Account Managers, contribute to segment-level strategy, and represent the voice of the IT/ITeS customer within AWS to influence product roadmaps and go-to-market priorities.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Drive Cloud Adoption Across IT/ITeS Organizations: Lead strategic sales initiatives focused on workload migration, application modernization, DevOps transformation, and AI/ML adoption to help IT/ITeS companies build competitive advantage through AWS.
* Own the long-term cloud strategy for your accounts and develop multi-year account plans that align AWS capabilities with customer business objectives, including platform modernization, IP development on AWS, and enabling customers to build cloud-native offerings for their end clients.
* Executive Relationship Building and Influence: Establish and sustain CXO-level relationships across your accounts. Engage with CEOs, CTOs, Chief Digital Officers, Engineering Heads, and Delivery Leaders to position AWS as a strategic partner.
* Influence technology decisions at the board level and drive executive alignment on large transformation programs.
* Complex Deal Structuring and Negotiation: Lead multi-year commercial engagements including EDPs, PPAs, and custom pricing constructs.
* Navigate complex procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders, legal teams, and partner ecosystems.
* Structure deals that balance customer value with AWS business objectives.
* Cross-Functional Orchestration: Operate as the single-threaded leader for your accounts, orchestrating across Solutions Architects, Partner teams, Professional Services, Specialist sellers, and Product teams to deliver cohesive customer outcomes.
* Segment Strategy and Market Shaping: Contribute to the IT/ITeS segment strategy by identifying industry trends, competitive dynamics, and whitespace opportunities. Provide inputs that shape go-to-market priorities, pricing strategies, and product investments for the segment.
* Revenue Growth and Pipeline Management: Own revenue targets, build and manage a healthy sales pipeline, forecast accurately, and drive deals through complex procurement cycles involving multiple stakeholders.
* Customer Success and Expansion: Ensure successful onboarding and adoption of AWS services, identify expansion opportunities across different business units and service lines, and drive consumption growth through strategic engagement across GenAI, data analytics, and modernization use cases.
* Thought Leadership and Advocacy: Organize and participate in workshops, hackathons, webinars, and industry events to build AWS mindshare, showcase customer success stories, and establish AWS as the innovation partner of choice for IT/ITeS organizations

A day in the life
  
  
As a Senior Account Manager for the IT/ITeS segment, you will own a portfolio of strategic accounts and be responsible for driving their cloud journey from initial engagement through large-scale adoption. Your day will involve a mix of strategic planning, customer engagement, internal collaboration, deal execution, and team development activities.
  
  
**A Typical Day May Include**
Strategic Planning: Reviewing multi-year account plans, analyzing consumption trends, identifying whitespace opportunities, and preparing for upcoming customer engagements with clear objectives and value propositions. Assessing deal progression across your portfolio, identifying blockers, and aligning resources to accelerate critical opportunities.
  
  
Customer Meetings: Conducting CXO steering committees and executive briefings with business leaders, technical deep-dives with engineering teams, and business reviews with account stakeholders to drive alignment and momentum on large transformation programs.
  
  
Internal Collaboration: Working with Solutions Architects on technical proposals, coordinating with Partner teams on joint go-to-market initiatives, engaging Product teams to address customer requirements, and providing customer feedback that influences service roadmaps critical to the IT/ITeS segment.
  
  
Deal Progression: Advancing complex commercial engagements through the sales cycle, structuring multi-year agreements, addressing procurement and commercial discussions, negotiating contracts, and removing blockers to close deals.
  
  
Relationship Development: Building trusted advisor relationships through regular cadence calls, proactive outreach, sharing relevant insights and best practices, and connecting customers with AWS resources and expertise.
  
  
Knowledge Building: Staying current on AWS service launches, industry trends, competitive landscape, and customer success stories to bring fresh ideas and relevant insights to customer conversations
  
  
**About The Team**
The IT/ITeS segment team focuses on one of India's most strategic industries, organizations that are transforming their own operations through cloud and building cloud-native solutions and services for customers worldwide. You'll be part of a collaborative, high-energy team that values customer obsession, innovation, and results.
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience working with and presenting to C-level executives, IT, and lines of businesses across organizations or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree or above, or MBA
* Experience reaching and exceeding sales revenue goals
* Experience navigating prospective accounts from and into a senior executive level to identify new customer opportunities
* 10+ years of technology sales selling enterprise software, networking, infrastructure, managed hosting services, or cloud computing services experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree, or MBA
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Associate's degree or above
* Experience in technology sales selling enterprise software, networking, infrastructure, managed hosting services, or cloud computing services

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

- AWS India - Maharashtra

title: Senior Manager, FDE
description:
**Function:**
Professional Services, Implementation Engineering |
**Level:**
Senior Manager
**| Team:**
Delta Prime (Forward Deployed Engineers)

**Summary**

Harness provides Agents for the Autonomous SDLC: Software Delivery, Security Testing, Runtime Protection, and Cost Management, now joined by a fifth Agent from the Augment Code acquisition. The Senior Manager, FDE Delivery owns the Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) motion that puts those Agents into production at strategic customers, while continuing to serve customers on core DevSecOps modules such as CI/CD, STO, and SCS. You lead Delta Prime, our team of embedded, hands-on Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) who build, deploy, configure, and extend Agents inside customer environments, and you carry what you learn back to Product and Engineering.

This role evolves the Senior Manager, Solution Architecture & Implementation Engineering charter from repeatable module implementation to outcome-driven delivery that adds agent-first deployment and product feedback, while still supporting module-based implementations.

**What the FDE motion is**

* Embedded engineers build and deliver working Agent outcomes in customer environments, not just configured modules.
* FDEs build, not just deploy: custom integrations, workflows, and tooling that close gaps between the platform and the customer's needs.
* Delegates, policy, approvals, and evidence are set up as part of every deployment, so Agents run in production safely.
* Field learnings become reusable assets (patterns, templates, guides) and product input, not one-off customer work.
* Focused on strategic, high-complexity accounts where speed to value and Agent adoption matter most.
* Meets customers where they are: module-first teams on DevSecOps, CI/CD, STO, and SCS, and AI-forward teams adopting Agents.

**Responsibilities**

**1. FDE Delivery**

* Own FDE delivery across the Harness Agents and core modules (DevSecOps, CI/CD, STO, SCS).
* Define the FDE engagement model: entry criteria, scope, duration, success metrics, and exit to steady state.
* Lead discovery and solution design with acceptance criteria tied to the customer success plan and customer outcomes.
* Build and deploy Delegates, SDLC Knowledge Graph context, worker agent workflows, custom integrations, and governance controls inside customer infrastructure.
* Run focus-account deep dives, blocked and on-hold escalations, and recovery plans as needed.
* Hold the quality bar: quarterly review of design docs and project plans for adherence to standards.

**2. Repeatability and Efficiency**

* Convert FDE engagements into reusable assets: Implementation Guides, Onboarding & Adoption templates, agendas and prerequisites per Agent, module, and capability, and Solution Factory or Software Factory assets.
* Roll out and contribute to HSF and fast-track implementation paths.
* Reduce time to first value and cost to deliver across customer success plan execution.
* Partner with PS Operations on staffing, utilization, and delivery forecasting.

**3. Product and Engineering Partnership**

* Be the voice of the field to Product: blockers, gaps, and feature requests backed by customer evidence.
* Align the FDE roadmap with the product vision for Agents, the Agent Harness, and Strategic Bets where relevant.
* Run early-access and design-partner deployments for new Agent capabilities.
* Feed field patterns back into product documentation, in-product guidance, and enablement.

**4. Presales and GTM Partnership**

* Contribute to scoping and staffing of FDE-led engagements; scoping quality is critical in the FDE model.
* Build services delivery confidence with Sales, Customer Architecture, and Account teams.
* Partner with PS Sales and GTM on enablement, positioning, and plays for Agent-led services.
* Communicate delivery risk and forecast to account teams and leadership.

**5. Team Leadership and Enablement**

* Hire, onboard, and grow Delta Prime FDEs: 30-60-90 plan, learning plan, certifications, shadowing, and HSF.
* Set clear quarterly goals and KPIs; coach, mentor, and give performance feedback.
* Build career paths from implementation engineer to FDE to architect and leadership tracks.
* Run quarterly enablement on new Agent features with Product and GTM.

**Success Measures**

* Time to first production value (Agent or module)
* Agent and module adoption and expansion in FDE accounts
* Delivery margin, utilization, and on-time delivery
* Customer satisfaction and reference-ability
* Reusable assets contributed per quarter
* Product feedback accepted into the roadmap
* FDE retention, growth, and promotion rate

**Qualifications**

* 10+ years in hands-on technical implementation of enterprise DevOps or SaaS platforms; 4+ years leading engineering or delivery teams.
* Deep knowledge of CI/CD and software delivery: pipelines, Kubernetes, Terraform/IaC, artifact and deployment management; strong software engineering skills, including building agents, integrations, and automation in code.
* Working knowledge of security testing, runtime protection, and cloud cost management (FinOps).
* Hands-on experience with AI and agentic workflows in the SDLC and with core DevSecOps modules (CI/CD, STO, SCS); comfortable with governance, policy (OPA), RBAC, and audit evidence.
* Proven record running customer-embedded or forward-deployed engineering, professional services, or solutions engineering.
* Ability to scope customer success plans, forecast delivery, and manage risk with Sales and Finance partners.
* Strong executive communication; credible with customer platform, AppSec, and FinOps leaders.
* Experience partnering with Product and Engineering to turn field insight into roadmap.

**Preferred**

* Prior experience with Harness or comparable platforms (CI/CD, IDP, security, cost).
* Experience with Kantata or similar PS tooling, and Salesforce/Clari forecasting.
* Background building and scaling an FDE or strategic delivery function.

~20% of time with SI, MSP, consultant and channel partners to unlock access and execution
  
  
Build acquisition pipeline, land new logos, expand subscriptions and drive revenue predictability.
  
  
**About Extreme Networks**
**Extreme Networks (NASDAQ: EXTR) is a global leader in cloud networking.**
We help enterprises drive digital transformation with AI-powered, cloud-managed solutions that are secure, scalable and simple to operate. Our platform-led approach helps customers simplify operations, improve resilience and deliver better connected experiences across campuses, branches, data centres and distributed environments.
  
  
**Business Mandate**

* Acquire new logos: Create and convert net-new opportunities in priority Karnataka accounts through direct customer engagement, executive mapping and disciplined qualification.

Build territory plan, prioritised account list, partner map, active pipeline view and top opportunity inspection cadence.
  
  
Create qualified acquisition pipeline, multi-thread top accounts and run joint GTM motions with selected partners.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

title: Enterprise Account Executive
description:
**About e6data**

e6data
is a lakehouse compute engine that runs SQL, streaming and AI workloads directly on open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake and Apache Hudi) within the customer's own cloud. It works alongside Databricks, Snowflake and Trino rather than replacing them, with no data movement required.

**The Role**

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to win and grow relationships with data-driven enterprises around the world. You will own the full customer journey: discovery, pilot, contract and onboarding, followed by long-term expansion. You will help customers cut compute costs and speed up analytics and AI workloads with e6data.

This role suits a consultative, technically fluent seller who is comfortable leading conversations with both engineering teams and senior executives across regions. Industry background is flexible. What matters is a strong record in technical, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales. You will also help shape e6data's sales motion as we scale globally.

Requirements
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
***Global Portfolio Management***

* Own a portfolio of named enterprise accounts across North America, EMEA and APAC, and consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets.

***Discovery and technical evaluation***

* Run in-depth discovery to understand each customer's data stack, workloads, cost drivers and business goals.
* Partner with Solutions Engineers to design and run pilots and proofs of concept with clear, measurable success criteria.
* Build business cases, ROI models and pricing proposals that quantify compute savings and performance gains and help internal champions secure approval.

***Closing and onboarding***

* Lead complex negotiations across, engineering, security, procurement, finance and legal through to signed contracts.
* Ensure a smooth handover from pilot to production, working with technical and customer teams to drive successful onboarding and early value.

***Stakeholder management and expansion***

* Build trusted relationships with Heads of Data, data engineering leaders, CIOs, CTOs and CFOs.
* Lead regular executive business reviews to track value delivered, align on roadmap and find expansion opportunities.
* Drive renewals, upsells and cross-sells across existing accounts.

***Internal collaboration***

* Work closely with solutions engineering, product, marketing and leadership to align on deal strategy and customer success.
* Share structured customer and market feedback to inform product roadmap and messaging.
* Keep CRM data and forecasts accurate and up to date.
* Help define sales playbooks, processes and best practices as the team grows.

**Basic Qualifications (Must Have)**

* 5+ years of B2B sales experience, including at least 3 years in a quota-carrying role selling enterprise software, SaaS or cloud solutions, in any industry.
* A proven record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets, with results you can share.
* Experience selling to global enterprise customers across multiple regions.
* End-to-end experience of the enterprise sales cycle, from discovery and technical evaluation or pilot through to contract and customer onboarding.
* Technical sales experience, and the ability to understand technical products and clearly explain their business value to technical and executive audiences.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including engaging senior executives and coordinating many decision-makers in complex deals.
* Experience building business cases, ROI models or pricing structures to support executive decisions.
* Strong communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline, or equivalent practical experience. A technical degree is a plus.

**Preferred Qualifications (Good to Have)**

* Experience selling data, analytics, database or cloud infrastructure products.
* Familiarity with the modern data stack, such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Spark or Trino.
* Cloud certifications, such as AWS, Google Cloud or Azure.
* Background in solution consulting, presales or proposal management on large, complex deals.
* Experience running or co-leading pilots and proofs of concept with technical teams.
* Experience with consumption-based or usage-based pricing models.
* Experience co-selling with cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) or through cloud marketplaces.
* Experience at an early-stage or high-growth company, helping build a sales function.
* An established network of data, engineering or technology leaders in enterprise accounts.

Benefits
  
  
**Why Join e6data**

* **Real ownership:**
  e6data is a
  small, high-ownership team
  , so your work directly shapes our global sales motion.
* **A compelling value proposition:**
  Customers lower compute costs without migrating data or replacing their existing platforms.
* **Global exposure:**
  Work with enterprise customers and leaders across North America, EMEA and APAC.
* **Strong backing:**
  e6data raised a
  $10M Series A led by Accel
  .

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

*e6data is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, caste, colour, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. All hiring decisions are based on qualifications, merits and business needs.*

title: Outbound Sales Specialist
description:
Job Description: Outbound Sales & Lead Generation Executive

Experience: 4–5 Years

Location: Bengaluru

Department: Sales & Business Development

Industry: Corporate Gifting / B2B Sales

Job Summary

We are looking for a proactive and result-oriented Business Development Executive with 4–5 years of experience in outbound sales, field sales, and B2B lead generation. The candidate will be responsible for independently identifying potential corporate clients, conducting client visits, building business relationships, and generating qualified leads for the inbound sales team to take forward.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable with fieldwork, cold outreach, client meetings, and independently developing new business opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

* **Outbound Lead Generation:**
  Independently identify and generate new business leads through cold calling, field visits, networking, referrals, and direct client outreach.
* **Field Sales & Client Visits:**
  Visit corporate offices, businesses, and potential clients to identify gifting requirements and explore business opportunities.
* **Corporate Client Acquisition:**
  Identify and approach decision-makers such as HR managers, procurement teams, administration heads, marketing teams, and business owners.
* **Lead Qualification:**
  Understand client requirements, budgets, purchase timelines, and gifting needs to qualify leads before passing them to the inbound sales team.
* **Lead Handover:**
  Maintain accurate lead details and share qualified leads with the inbound sales team for follow-up, proposal discussions, and closure.
* **Market Research:**
  Identify target industries, corporate gifting opportunities, potential accounts, and new business segments.
* **Relationship Building:**
  Establish and maintain relationships with prospective clients to create opportunities for repeat business and referrals.
* **Sales Pipeline Management:**
  Maintain a database of prospects, track outreach activities, update lead status, and ensure timely follow-ups.
* **Target Achievement:**
  Meet assigned targets for qualified leads, client visits, prospecting activities, and business opportunities generated.
* **Market Feedback:**
  Gather insights on customer requirements, competitor offerings, pricing expectations, and market trends, and share them with the sales team.
* **Internal Coordination:**
  Coordinate with the inbound sales team to ensure a smooth handover of leads and provide relevant client information.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* 4–5 years of experience in B2B sales, field sales, outbound sales, or business development.
* Proven experience in independently generating leads and acquiring new prospects through outbound activities.
* Experience in corporate sales, corporate gifting, promotional merchandise, FMCG, or related B2B industries would be an advantage.
* Strong communication, negotiation, networking, and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable conducting regular field visits and meeting prospective corporate clients.
* Ability to identify decision-makers and generate qualified business opportunities.
* Good organizational skills and the ability to maintain lead databases and sales reports.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented, and capable of working independently.
* Familiarity with CRM tools and lead management processes is preferred.

Performance Expectations

* Consistent generation of qualified outbound leads.
* Achievement of assigned field visit and prospecting targets.
* Quality and relevance of leads handed over to the inbound sales team.
* Development of a strong corporate prospect database.
* Effective follow-ups and accurate reporting of sales activities.

Ideal Candidate Profile

* The ideal candidate is someone who can independently go into the market, identify potential corporate customers, approach decision-makers, and generate genuine business opportunities without relying solely on inbound enquiries. The role is focused primarily on outbound prospecting and field-based lead generation, with qualified leads handed over to the inbound sales team for further conversion.
