title: Senior Manager – Pre-Sales & Solutioning
description:
Who are we?
  
  
Kapture CX is an AI-native customer experience platform helping enterprises turn their messiest service operations into seamless, intelligent experiences. We build cutting-edge AI (agentic automation, voice AI, real-time intelligence) for industries where complexity is the default: banking, financial services, retail, e-commerce and beyond.
  
  
Headquartered in Bangalore with a growing presence in the US and Dubai, we serve 1,000+ enterprise clients across 18+ countries. We've raised $20M to date, we're profitable, and we're growing 100% year on year, a combination that's rare at the intersection of AI and SaaS.
  
  
Today we're a 400+ strong team, and we're looking for people who want to build AI that actually ships, scales and solves real problems.
  
  
What is this role about?
  
  
As a
**Senior Manager – Pre-Sales & Solutioning**
, you will work closely with the Sales team and enterprise customers to understand business requirements and design technology-driven solutions using Kapture's products and AI capabilities.
  
  
You will play a key role in managing solution discovery, product demonstrations, technical presentations, RFPs, POCs and proposals. This role requires a combination of strong product and technology understanding, consultative selling skills and the ability to translate complex customer requirements into scalable business solutions.
  
  
You will collaborate with Sales, Product, Engineering and Delivery teams to ensure the proposed solutions align with customer expectations and business objectives.
  
  
Sounds interesting?
  
  
Here's a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:
  
  

* Understand customer business requirements, challenges and workflows, and translate them into effective technology solutions.
* Conduct solution discovery sessions and engage with business and technical stakeholders to understand customer needs.
* Drive product demonstrations, technical presentations, solution walkthroughs and proof of concepts (POCs).
* Design and present solution architectures covering product capabilities, integrations, APIs, workflows and implementation approaches.
* Work closely with Sales teams to support enterprise sales opportunities and develop compelling solution proposals.
* Prepare RFP/RFI responses, technical documentation, solution presentations and commercial proposals in collaboration with internal teams.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to evaluate technical feasibility and address complex customer requirements.
* Identify opportunities to position AI, automation, CRM and customer experience solutions based on customer business needs.
* Support Sales teams in handling technical objections, customer queries and solution-related discussions.
* Develop solution documents, reusable demo environments, presentations and knowledge resources to strengthen sales enablement.

This is a
**Bangalore-based**
role. We work five days a week from the office, as we believe in-person interactions fuel innovation and agility.
  
  
What does success look like in this role?
  
  
You successfully support enterprise sales opportunities by delivering impactful product demonstrations, designing scalable solutions, understanding customer requirements and positioning Kapture's AI-led technology effectively. You act as a strong bridge between Sales, Product and Engineering teams, contributing to improved customer engagement and business conversions.
  
  
What would make you a good fit for this role?
  
  
**Here Are The Basic Requirements**

* You have 4–7 years of experience in Pre-Sales, Solution Consulting, Sales Engineering, Solution Architecture or similar technology-facing roles.
* You have experience working with Enterprise SaaS, B2B technology products, CRM, AI or automation platforms.
* You possess a strong understanding of technology products, APIs, integrations, cloud-based solutions and enterprise applications.
* You have hands-on experience conducting product demonstrations, solution presentations, POCs and technical discussions.
* You can understand complex business requirements and translate them into practical technology solutions.
* You have experience working with enterprise customers and engaging with business and technical stakeholders.
* You have strong communication, presentation, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* You are comfortable working in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment and supporting multiple sales opportunities.

What are the most critical skills for this role?
  
  

* Strong product and technology understanding.
* Enterprise solutioning and consultative selling.
* Product demonstrations and technical presentations.
* Understanding of APIs, integrations, cloud and SaaS platforms.
* Customer requirement gathering and solution discovery.
* RFP/RFI management and POC execution.
* Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts in simple business language.

**You Will Have An Advantage If You**

* Have experience in AI, Customer Experience, CRM, Contact Centre Solutions, Automation or Enterprise SaaS.
* Have worked with enterprise customers across industries such as BFSI, Retail, E-commerce, Travel or Telecom.
* Have experience with omnichannel customer engagement platforms involving voice, chat, email and messaging channels.
* Understand AI/ML, Generative AI, conversational AI, chatbots, voicebots or agentic AI solutions.
* Have worked closely with Product, Engineering and Implementation teams on enterprise integrations and solution design.
* Have experience supporting international customers and complex enterprise sales cycles.

Why should you be interested?
  
  
**Here's What You Will Gain From This Role**

* Opportunity to work with an AI-first enterprise SaaS platform.
* Exposure to large enterprise customers across industries and international markets.
* Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI, automation and customer experience solutions.
* High visibility and collaboration with Sales, Product and Engineering teams.
* Opportunity to influence enterprise deals through technology-led solutioning.
* A fast-paced environment with significant learning, ownership and career growth opportunities.

title: Business Development Manager
description:

title: Ecommerce Head/ Channel Sales Head
description:
**About the Role**

You will own Opptra India's third-party (3P) marketplace channels and the operational efficiency of the India business. You are the business team's main partner to supply chain, tracking lead time, fill rate, inbound receipt, cancellations and channel in-stock across brands, finding the root cause when they slip, and fixing the process. Brand managers own the brand and the P&L; you own how well the business runs underneath them.

**Key Responsibilities**

**3P marketplace management**

* Run seller accounts on Amazon and Flipkart end to end: listings, catalogue health, account health, pricing and buy box.
* Choose between FBA / Flipkart fulfilment and self-ship based on cost and speed.
* Manage returns, claims, reimbursements and settlement reconciliation.
* Read 3P P&L by SKU (commission, fulfilment fees, ad spend, returns) and act on contribution margin.

**Channel PO to delivery (1P and quick commerce)**

* Act on channel POs from Amazon, Flipkart, Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy Instamart.
* Raise back-to-back POs to brands, including SKU substitution when stock is short.
* Book and expedite delivery appointments; handle PO expiry and channel rejections.
* Own ASN, GRN and invoice matching and cancellation tracking.

**Operations efficiency**

* Define and track lead time, fill rate, inbound receipt %, GRN turnaround, cancellation rate, channel in-stock, DRR and DOC.
* Build a single weekly view across brands and channels.
* Root-cause drops (for example, fill rate falling from 90% to 70%) and turn them into process fixes.

**Supply chain partnership**

* Drive inventory replenishment using tertiary sales and upcoming sale events, adjusted for in-stock.
* Work with warehouse and logistics partners on inbound quality (QC, SKU segregation, scanning, inward time) and last-mile / dispatch SLAs.
* Manage reverse logistics, returns handling, and ageing / near-expiry inventory before it becomes a write-off.

**Process building and automation**

* Write SOPs and bring brand managers onto one standard way of working.
* Identify repetitive manual work and scope automation with the tech team.

**Marketing and campaigns**

* Plan campaigns around sale events (Prime Day, Big Billion Days, festive) with stock, pricing and ads aligned.
* Run performance marketing on Amazon and Flipkart ads, tracking ROAS and spend vs. budget and linking spend to stock availability.
* Support influencer collaborations where they fit the brand and channel; brief and manage a junior marketing resource.

**Revenue, margin and working capital**

* Deliver sell-through and revenue targets by channel.
* Protect margin: pricing, discounts, fee leakage and return costs.
* Manage working capital: inventory days, ageing and PO sizing.

**Team leadership**

* Lead a team of 3-4 associates: set work, review output, coach.
* Hire for the team and build backups.
* Work across brand managers, supply chain, finance and tech without direct authority.

**Who You Are**

* Have run e-commerce for a D2C brand or a startup (for example, as a sales manager at a D2C brand).
* Know 3P on Amazon and Flipkart: what sells, what it costs to sell, and how inventory, appointments and returns work across marketplaces and quick commerce.
* Comfortable in the numbers and hands-on in the work.
* Strong in Excel / Google Sheets (pivots, VLOOKUP / INDEX-MATCH); experience with Unicommerce or similar middleware and marketplace seller panels.
* Have owned a revenue or margin number and managed people, even a small team.

**How You Work**

* I
  **ntegrity:**
  You own mistakes and give straight answers.
* **Conviction:**
  You move fast and hold a view backed by data, and change it when shown new facts.
* **High standards:**
  You set a high bar for yourself and your team.
* **Proactivity:**
  You find and fix problems before anyone asks.
* **Ownership:**
  You fix the cause, not just the instance.
* **Startup fit:**
  You execute without a playbook (and write one), adapt to setbacks, and are happy to do the work by hand before improving it.

**About The Role**

In addition to Market Analysis, the role includes multiple responsibilities within solutions, including block diagram analysis, performing teardowns, BOM analysis, and understanding and communicating conclusions to segment leads and management.
  
  
The successful candidate will combine their technical background with a strong work ethic, driving continuous learning toward understanding systems, business, market trends, marketing and partnerships. Success in this role includes:

Business & Market Analysis

title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:
**About Almabase**
Almabase builds software that helps universities, schools and other mission-driven organizations engage their communities and raise more from them. We are a B2B SaaS company serving higher education and K-12, and expanding into nonprofit and healthcare.
  
  
**About The Role**
Almabase is hiring an inbound leader who will own a large pipeline goal: every lead that finds us through search, ads, content, or our website, and every step until it becomes pipeline. You are accountable for the result, and you get there hands-on: you build the systems, automations, and reporting that keep the engine running, and you set the strategy and judgment for paid channels, SEO, AEO, and new-market campaigns. You report to the Senior Director of Demand Generation. The in-house content team reports to you, and you work closely with teams across the company.
  
  

* Reports to Senior Director, Demand Generation
* Manages in-house content strategist and content writer
* Experience: 4 to 7 years, including some experience managing people
* Ideally has experience at a bootstrapped B2B SaaS or AI company
* Location: India (Bengaluru; work arrangement to be confirmed)

**What You Will Do**
You are accountable for a large inbound pipeline goal, from the first search or ad click to a qualified meeting with the AE team. You decide where effort and budget go, and you do much of the building yourself. The work falls into five areas, and hands-on building comes first because it is how this role gets done.
  
  
Build and run the engine hands-on
  
  

* Ship website changes yourself using Claude Code to push updates on Webflow without waiting in a queue, ensuring changes stay safe with sensible review.
* Build agents for recurring work by creating and running agents to handle tasks such as recurring inbound lead maintenance, enrichment, routing checks, follow-up nudges, and data cleanup.
* Connect systems by setting up integrations between two systems or developing new technical solutions when the stack is insufficient.
* Report clearly by establishing a reporting structure that the team and leadership rely on, including weekly funnel numbers, a forecast, and explanations of what is being changed and why.

Generate demand
  
  

* SEO and SEM: Set the strategy for organic and paid search, including keywords, landing pages, budget allocation, and iteration on what converts.
* You do not need to run every campaign yourself but should know the fundamentals well enough to judge the work and redirect spend.
* Meta and Instagram ads: Build a paid social program beyond Google Ads.
* Bring judgment on audiences, creative tests, and landing pages, and keep a clear read on cost per qualified lead.
* Agency support is available for execution.
* AEO (answer engine optimisation): Make the company the source AI answer engines find and trust, ensuring what buyers hear from AI tools matches how the company describes itself.

Convert and hand off
  
  

* Website conversion metrics. Own the key conversion metrics for the website, with support from the Brand Marketing function, and report them weekly. Expect to track:

Visitor-to-lead rate, by source, page, and market.
  
  
Form completion rate and where visitors drop off.
  
  
Demo-request rate on high-intent pages such as pricing, product, and comparison pages.
  
  
Time from form fill to first touch, and form-to-meeting and meeting-to-SQL rates.
  
  
Qualified leads and pipeline per 1,000 visitors, by channel and market.
  
  
Branded search, direct and AI-referred traffic share, and how each converts (with Brand).
  
  
Landing page conversion and cost per qualified lead for each campaign.
  
  

* MQL-to-pipeline conversion. Own what happens to every inbound MQL after it arrives: speed to follow-up, qualification, drop-off by stage, and the fixes that turn more of them into meetings and pipeline. Report on it weekly.
* Forms and routing. Own our website forms and the routing that hands leads to the AE team. Fix gaps in capture, field mapping, lead assignment, and scheduling so no lead stalls or lands with the wrong person.
* Nurture and ABM handoff. Run lead nurture for leads that are not sales-ready, and make sure inbound-activated leads reach the ABM team with the right context and on time. Keep attribution clean so inbound and outbound do not double count.
* The website, with product marketing. Share ownership of the website with product marketing. Over time, move website changes in-house and bring turnaround on updates under one day. How the two teams split this is settled in your first quarter. Lead-gen assets on website will be owned by Inbound; meanwhile, overall messaging will continue to be owned by Product Marketing.

Open new markets
  
  
New-market campaigns. Own lead generation in healthcare, nonprofit and strategic higher ed. You decide the plays, run the experiments and are accountable for the leads these markets produce.
  
  
Lead and collaborate
  
  
Your team. Lead our in-house content strategist and content writer, and set their priorities across SEO, AEO, and campaigns.
  
  
Agencies. We have an agency budget. Use agencies where they help, mainly for paid execution and specialist work, and hold them accountable for results.
  
  
**What You Bring**
You are a hands-on operator who has owned a large inbound goal, knows the proven methods for generating leads and moving them down the funnel, and builds things yourself rather than only directing others.
  
  
**Experience**

* 4 to 7 years of experience in inbound, demand generation, or growth marketing
* Ideally worked at a B2B SaaS or AI SaaS company
* Some experience managing people
* Proven track record of generating leads using tried and tested methods
* Experience moving leads down the funnel into pipeline
* Ability to use judgment in selecting the right methods for the right market

**Skills**

* Working knowledge of SEO and the fundamentals of paid search and paid social, with good judgment on how to run them
* Ability to evaluate campaign quality and direct an agency, without needing to run campaigns daily
* Experience fixing forms, lead routing, and CRM handoffs between marketing and sales
* HubSpot depth is a strong plus
* Strong analytical habits: can read a funnel, find where leads stall and explain it to a non-marketer
* Able to set up a reporting structure for the team and leadership
* Hands-on technical fluency: use Claude Code to push website updates, build and run agents for recurring lead maintenance
* Ability to connect two systems or find a new technical solution when the stack falls short
* Awareness of where human review is still needed

**Preferred**

* Experience helping a company grow from about $1M to $10M in revenue, or anywhere in between
* Paid social experience on Meta and Instagram
* Early work on AEO or generative engine optimisation
* Experience launching campaigns in a new or unproven market, with an unclear ICP and few reference customers
* Familiarity with the alumni engagement, higher education, nonprofit or healthcare markets
* Preference for proof that you built and ran an inbound engine over job title held

**Tools you will work with**
You will inherit a working stack and are expected to improve it. Items in the right column are being trialled or planned, and the list will change as trials finish.
  
  
| Area | Tools in use today |
  
  
| CRM and forms | HubSpot (CRM, forms, and reporting); Typeform |
  
  
| Routing and scheduling | RevenueHero |
  
  
| Paid media | Google Ads; LinkedIn Ads; Capterra Ads |
  
  
| SEO, AEO, and website | SEMrush; Surfer SEO; Webflow; Google Analytics |
  
  
| Intent and demos | Factors.ai; Storylane |
  
  
| Data and outreach | Clay; Apollo; CauseIQ; Smartlead; JustCall |
  
  
| AI and automation | Claude; OpenAI; n8n; AssemblyAI |
  
  
| Calls and insight | Fathom |
  
  
**How Success Is Measured And How You Will Work**
The role is judged on inbound pipeline, with a lead number you carry every week.
  
  
**First 30 days**
: audit forms, routing, and the MQL-to-SQL handoff, fix the biggest leaks, and agree a weekly MQL and pipeline forecast.
  
  
**First 90 days**
: SEO and SEM running to a plan, a Meta and Instagram test live, an AEO plan agreed with the content team, and an owner’s plan for each new market.
  
  
**Year one**
: inbound pipeline roughly doubles its 2026 level, MQL-to-pipeline conversion improves, and new-market campaigns produce a steady flow of qualified leads.
  
  
You will forecast leads and pipeline every two weeks, review two or three real lead journeys each week with the team, and aim for a two-day turnaround on requests from other teams. Our team records internal meetings with Fathom and builds most workflows with AI first.

title: Lead - Performance Marketing
description:
**The role**

You will own performance marketing at Superhealth, end to end. That means every step from the first ad click to a patient who has booked, visited and been treated. You will track every stage of the journey, measure what is really happening, and fix whatever is holding results back, whether that sits in the ads, the tracking, the landing page or the follow-up after the lead comes in.

We are not hiring a campaign manager who stops at the lead. We want an owner of the whole funnel.

**What you will do**

**Own the funnel, lead to closure**

* Build and run one clear view of the journey: lead, qualified lead, appointment booked, appointment completed, treatment closed, repeat revenue.
* Track results by campaign, ad group and ad, and tie spend to real revenue, not just platform leads.
* When any stage underperforms, find the cause and drive the fix with sales, tech, content and clinical operations.

**Run paid media on Google and Meta**

* Plan, launch and scale Search, Display and Meta campaigns across our service lines.
* Manage budgets, bidding, keywords, audiences and creative testing.
* Decide where money goes using cost per qualified lead, cost per appointment and cost per closed patient.

**Make measurement trustworthy**

* Set up and maintain tracking across GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads and Meta, including offline conversion feedback from our CRM.
* Keep reporting clean, consistent and easy for leadership to read.

**Look beyond the click**

* Improve what happens after a lead arrives: speed to contact, call connect rates, follow-up and nurture, appointment show-up, and reactivation of older leads.
* Work with the sales and CRM teams to turn what you measure into process changes.

**Improve conversion**

* Run landing page and form experiments. Brief design and content teams with evidence from search terms, sales conversations and reviews.

**Plan and report**

* Build monthly plans worked back from revenue goals, and report daily and weekly on progress and next actions.
* Manage any agency or freelance partners. You own the outcome either way.

**You are a fit if you have**

* 7+ years in performance marketing, with deep hands-on Google Ads (Search) and Meta lead generation experience.
* Managed budgets of around ₹1 crore per month, efficiently and with due diligence and rigor.
* A background in healthcare lead generation, or in-house at a hospital, clinic network or similar business where leads close offline by phone and in person.
* Strong measurement skills: GA4, GTM, conversion tracking, UTM design, offline conversion import and Meta Conversions API.
* Comfort with funnel math, spreadsheets or SQL, and dashboards (Looker Studio, Metabase or similar).
* The habit of digging into the detail: search terms, call recordings, form drop-offs.
* A clear, direct way of communicating: answer first, evidence after.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with CRMs, telephony and WhatsApp automation.
* Conversion rate optimisation experience.
* An understanding of SEO and AI-search visibility.

**What success looks like**

* A funnel view the whole leadership team trusts.
* Spend that is tied to patients treated, not clicks.
* Steady gains at every stage of the journey, from lead quality to appointment show-up.

title: Manager - Social Media & Performance Marketing
description:

title: Performance Marketing & Growth Manager
description:
**Location:**
Bangalore

**Experience:**
3-5+ years

**Reporting to:**
Country Lead

**Hello. We’re Blood.**

**Our purpose is to revolutionize periods.**

**Who are we?**

Blood is a challenger brand in the period care space. We exist to challenge taboos, push boundaries, and help people with periods to bleed unapologetically. Our focus on deeply understanding our users drives our innovation in creating products that are both high performing, and better for their bodies and skin.

Blood is the creator of the world’s first Sanitary Pad made from Corn, and is the parent brand of MenstruHeat (menstrual cramp relief).

We’re scaling fast across Asia, with our core markets in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, and our newest market, India. Selling online and across more than 7,000 retail stores - making more than 12 million periods better so far.

Today was good. Tomorrow will bleed better.

**Why India, why now**

India is the biggest period care opportunity on earth and one of the least served. Most of the market still runs on skin-irritating products designed decades ago. Quick commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart) has torn down the distribution wall that used to keep challenger brands out for years.

We can now reach millions in months, instead of decades.

We've proven product-market fit across markets in Southeast Asia, and India is where we prove it at an even larger scale. You'd join at the first inning, and help write our India story together.

**Who we’re looking for:**

1. If hearing RoAS, CVR and CTR gets you excited
2. You’re hungry for growth and believe in always iterating to produce better work
3. You love analyzing numbers and taking action from your insights

As a Performance Marketing & Growth Manager at Blood, you will be responsible for planning, strategizing, and execution of paid growth campaigns to drive ad performance across Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, and Amazon, alongside other channels and media networks.

You'll own the connective tissue between "the product is listed" and "the product is found, chosen, and bought," running ad funnels, protecting profitability, and coordinating tightly with sales on CRO and operations on inventory.

You must have hands-on ad buying experience with Quick Commerce. A good eye for effective advertising headlines, promo mechanics and creatives will help immensely. At the same time, you are expected to move fast and be comfortable operating at an analytical, yet tactical, level and be deeply grounded in consumer insights.

**Responsibilities**

* **30% - Ads & Performance Marketing**
  - Plan, launch, and optimize paid campaigns (sponsored search, banners, keyword bidding) across quick commerce platforms; optimize for RoAS, ACoS, CTR, CVR, and sales velocity; drive top-of-search visibility and category rank
* **25% - Marketplace Strategy**
  - Plan visibility boosts for mega sale events, coordinate new launches with ad acceleration; manage budgets for incremental growth via structured ad funnels in order to achieve sales target & market share.
* **20% - Budget allocation and media planning**
  - Allocate monthly performance budgets across channels and marketplaces; Track daily spends and performance to ensure profitability and goal alignment
* **10% - Cross-Functional Collaboration**
  - Work with the creative team on ad assets; coordinate with the marketplace team on promotions,A/B testing inputs and working on SOV growth.
* **10% - Data & Analytics**
  - Analyze platform dashboards and SKU-level performance; build weekly RoAS and profitability reports; identify hero SKUs and track competitor pricing and promotions
* **5% - SKU & Category Optimization**
  - Improve listing visibility through keyword and search-term strategy; optimize titles, keywords, and creatives; manage pricing against contribution margins

**Ideal candidate:**

* 3-5+ years running growth marketing / performance marketing for a D2C or e-commerce brand, ideally with quick commerce experience in India
* Hands-on with Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, and Amazon ad platforms - sponsored search, keyword bidding, category ads
* Track record scaling paid revenue profitably (RoAS/ACoS-driven, not just spend-driven) for a consumer brand
* Startup mindset - comfortable with ambiguity, builds systems from scratch rather than inheriting one
* Data-driven with strong Excel/Sheets skills and comfort across platform ad dashboards
* Good to have : P&L understanding capability

title: Senior Manager - Performance & Growth Marketing
description:
**About the job**

About the CompanySamaaro is an AI-powered event marketing platform that enables marketing teams to turn events into a measurable growth channel by planning, promoting, executing, and measuring their business impact. We are building for marketing teams as they scale their event GTM, and we solve two hard problems for them: getting the right people in the room, and proving the ROI of events. Recognized by YourStory as one of the Top 30 Most Innovative Startups in India, Samaaro works with phenomenal brands including PepsiCo, FIFA, Dr. Reddy's, The Times of India, TVS Motor, and Sodexo across geographies and industries.

**About the Role**

Own Samaaro's paid growth engine, from first impression to closed revenue. You will run paid acquisition, the marketing funnel, the MarTech stack and our agencies, and turn marketing spend into qualified pipeline. Marketing and Sales work as one revenue team toward a shared pipeline number, and you are measured on pipeline and CAC, not lead volume.

**What You Will Own**

**Performance Marketing (about 65% of the role)**

* **Paid channels:**
  Run Google, LinkedIn, Meta and new paid channels end to end across India and the US, including campaign structure, audience targeting, budgets, creatives, offers and landing pages.
* **Pipeline target:**
  Own the monthly and quarterly pipeline target from marketing. Build the plan to reach it, spot gaps early and adjust spend, channels or conversion to close them.
* **Budget and efficiency:**
  Own the ad and marketing tool budget. Track each channel from spend to MQLs, SQLs, pipeline and revenue, know the CAC and pipeline generated per rupee, and move budget to what produces pipeline.
* **Experimentation and conversion:**
  Keep testing audiences, offers, messaging, creatives and landing pages. Find where the funnel leaks, run experiments and scale what works.
* **Lead nurturing and retargeting:**
  Build nurture journeys for accounts that engage, nurture leads that stall in the pipeline and retarget leads that drop out, so they are warm when Sales picks them up.
* **ABM and outbound support:**
  Run awareness campaigns on LinkedIn and Meta to warm up target accounts before Sales reaches out.
* **Competitive intelligence:**
  Track competitor ads, keywords, offers and positioning, and turn the gaps you find into campaign tests.

**Marketing Management (about 35% of the role)**

* **MarTech stack:**
  Run HubSpot and its connected tools for enrichment, intent, outbound and calling. Keep integrations healthy and cut tools that do not pay off.
* **Reporting:**
  Share a weekly update on what changed, why and what comes next, and a monthly view of spend, pipeline and revenue by channel. Build dashboards that leadership can read without help.
* **Lead management:**
  Own the lead lifecycle, routing, account scoring by fit, intent and engagement, and CRM hygiene. Agree lead stages, handoff rules and response times with Sales.
* **Agencies and vendors:**
  Brief and manage partners for the website, SEO, backlinks, campaigns and outbound, and hold them to results. You own their outcomes.
* **Cross-team collaboration:**
  Work hands-on with content and design to get campaign assets built and shipped. Give sales the data, assets and systems they need. Work with product and leadership when needed.

**You Have**

* **B2B experience:**
  6 to 9 years in B2B marketing, including at least 4 years running Google and LinkedIn Ads hands-on.
* **Long sales cycles:**
  Experience at a B2B tech company where buying cycles run over several months.
* **Commercial ownership:**
  You can work back from a pipeline target to the spend, traffic, conversion rates, MQLs, SQLs and opportunities needed to reach it, and you know how to find and fix a leaking funnel.
* **Cross-team leadership:**
  You have managed agencies to deadlines and led work across teams without formal authority.
* **Marketing stack:**
  Hands-on experience with CRM, intent and ABM tools, email marketing, websites and hosting.
* **AI-first:**
  You use AI tools every day to research, analyse, create, automate repetitive work and connect the marketing stack, and you keep trying new AI workflows.
* **Accountability:**
  You own your numbers, deliver on commitments and flag slips early with a fix in hand.

**Strong Plus**

* Experience running US or global B2B paid campaigns.
* Experience with ABM, intent data or account-scoring tools.
* Early testing of new paid channels.

**Not a fit if**

* Your paid experience is mostly in D2C or e-commerce.
* You prefer to plan and have agencies or a large team execute. This role is hands-on.
* You measure success in leads, not pipeline.

**What we offer**

* Competitive fixed pay and ESOPs.
* Direct work with the founders, with real ownership of budget and results.

title: Digital Marketing Executive (SEO)
description:

with strong expertise across

.

The ideal candidate will be highly hands-on and commercially driven, with a strong understanding of how customers discover, navigate and purchase products online. This role will be responsible for improving organic visibility, product discovery, website performance, conversion and overall e-commerce revenue.

The candidate should be equally comfortable working with
**data, product/catalogue teams, creative teams and performance marketers**
, translating insights into actionable growth initiatives.

* Conduct comprehensive

* Optimise category, collection, product and landing pages for organic search.
* Develop and optimise SEO-friendly product titles, descriptions, metadata, headings, internal linking and URL structures.
* Identify opportunities to improve
  **organic rankings, traffic, product discovery and non-brand search visibility**

* Work closely with content teams to develop SEO-led content and landing pages.
* Monitor Google Search Console, Google Analytics and other SEO platforms to identify opportunities and issues.

  **e-commerce SEO**

  .

  **category pages, PLPs, PDPs, site search, filters, taxonomy, navigation and product discovery**
  .
* Strong knowledge of
  **technical SEO, on-page SEO, keyword strategy, schema, internal linking and site architecture**
  .
* Demonstrated understanding of
  **performance marketing and paid acquisition**
  .
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and turn it into commercial actions.
* Experience with tools such as
  **Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager and SEO platforms such as SEMrush, Ahrefs or similar**
  .
* Experience working with an e-commerce platform such as

  .
* Strong understanding of product feeds and Google Merchant Center is preferred.

  .

**What We Are Looking For**

title: Marketing Manager | Brand, Communications and Growth
description:
RCD HR Consulting is recruiting a Marketing Manager on behalf of Reach GRC, an established governance, risk and compliance consultancy with a strong client base across India, the UAE and GCC, Singapore and the USA. The firm’s services include ISO certification and consulting, SOC 2, penetration testing, data protection and cybersecurity advisory. Its founders have completed more than 900 audits between them.

As Reach GRC’s
**first dedicated marketing hire**

, you will build and lead the marketing function, reporting directly to the Co-Founder and Director. Your mandate is to sharpen how Reach GRC presents its services, generate qualified enquiries and help grow business from existing clients. You will set the marketing plan and take a hands-on role in delivering it, working closely with the sales and technical teams.

**Role responsibilities**

* Develop Reach GRC’s positioning, messaging and brand guidelines, and apply them consistently across the website, proposals, presentations and other client communications.
* Work with technical specialists to create credible content for senior business and technology decision-makers. Manage the firm’s organic LinkedIn presence, website content, basic SEO and website analytics.
* Plan and run campaigns that generate qualified B2B enquiries. Work with sales to understand which enquiries progress and use that feedback to improve future campaigns.
* Plan marketing for existing clients, helping them understand where Reach GRC’s other services could support them and creating opportunities for referrals, upselling and cross-selling.
* Develop the firm’s podcast and YouTube presence, including planning topics and formats and coordinating production and publishing.
* Set priorities, track campaign performance and lead quality, and manage freelancers and agencies where specialist support is needed.

**Career opportunity**

This role is a step towards marketing leadership for someone who has already run B2B campaigns and is ready to take responsibility for a function. You’ll work directly with the founder and decision-makers and see how your work influences sales conversations, client relationships and growth.

The position starts as an individual contributor role, with a budget for freelancers and agencies and scope to build a small team as the function grows. It offers the chance to deepen your expertise in marketing technical services and build a track record you can point to: positioning you developed, programmes you put in place and commercial results you helped deliver.

**Candidate requirements**

* At least five years in B2B marketing, including at least three years marketing services in a relevant field such as professional services, consulting, IT services, cybersecurity, audit or B2B SaaS.
* Experience developing brand positioning and messaging, and communicating complex offerings to senior business or technology decision-makers.
* Strong written English and the ability to turn technical input into clear website copy, LinkedIn content, articles and sales materials.
* Hands-on experience with organic LinkedIn and B2B lead generation, including tracking enquiry quality and campaign performance.
* Working knowledge of website content management, basic SEO and tools such as Google Analytics.
* The ability to set a focused marketing plan and deliver it independently, working with internal teams and external vendors.
* Comfort planning marketing for existing clients and willingness to take on audio and video content.
* A bachelor’s degree and a portfolio that includes at least one brand guideline, communication guide or messaging framework you personally authored.

**Preferred experience**

Experience in cybersecurity, ISO certification or compliance, or marketing to CISOs, CTOs and compliance heads, would be an advantage. Other relevant experience includes building a brand from scratch, marketing internationally, launching a podcast or YouTube channel, founder thought leadership, events, advanced SEO, CRM and automation, marketing dashboards, and campaigns supporting referrals, upselling or cross-selling.

The role involves occasional travel within India for events and conferences, with possible travel to Dubai. A notice period of 30 days or less is preferred.

**To apply**

, share your CV and a link to your portfolio or relevant work samples. For one example, tell us what you personally contributed and what it achieved.

**Up to ₹70,000 per month · Five days a week in the office · Jeevanbhimanagar, Bengaluru · Full-time, permanent**

title: Head of Marketing - Growth
description:
Breakout AI is an early-stage, seed-funded Gen AI startup backed by top Silicon Valley investors. We are building autonomous agents that can independently own different parts of the sales process. The future of the Sales team is 100x Sales Reps empowered by AI teammates which can autonomously own different aspects of the sales process.

We're looking for a Head of Marketing who is an equal part growth architect and hands-on builder. You will own our entire acquisition and demand engine from 0 to 1—driving qualified pipeline, running rapid experimentation loops, and shaping how the market perceives agentic AI for sales.

This isn't a high-level delegator role where you just manage agencies and review slide decks. You'll be in the trenches with the founder, launching campaigns, architecting our inbound and outbound engines, optimizing conversion funnels, and scaling Breakout's revenue engine from scratch.

**What You'll Actually Do:**

* Work directly with the founder to establish our growth strategy, target ICPs, attribution models, and primary pipeline targets.
* Build and own the entire demand generation engine across paid acquisition, organic search, outbound automation, and product-led loops.
* Translate complex agentic AI and LLM workflows into sharp, high-converting positioning, landing pages, and content.
* Establish a rigorous, rapid-fire experimentation cadence—testing channels, messaging, ad creatives, and onboarding funnels to spot what scales and kill what doesn't.
* Own our social media presence end-to-end—driving narrative-led, organic growth across LinkedIn, X/Twitter, and YouTube to turn social reach into pipeline.
* Build founder-led branding flywheels: ghostwrite, produce high-signal teardowns, share behind-the-scenes product builds, and position Breakout leadership at the center of the AI sales conversation.
* Dig into full-funnel analytics to track CAC, LTV, conversion velocity, and pipeline quality, ensuring every marketing dollar and effort moves ARR.
* Partner tightly with sales and product teams to refine lead scoring, streamline demo-to-close workflows, and drive product adoption.
* Hire, manage, and scale specialized growth agencies, freelancers, and full-time marketers as the team expands.

**You Might Be a Good Fit If:**

* **You're a full-funnel growth operator:**

  You understand how to capture interest and convert it into a high-intent pipeline, blending quantitative performance marketing with compelling storytelling.
* **You have an experimental mindset:**

  You treat growth as a science—hypothesizing, testing, measuring, and scaling winners quickly without overthinking.
* **You are analytical to the core:**

  You live in metrics, funnels, and conversion rates, comfortable digging into data platforms and CRMs to find actionable leverage points.
* **You love the frontier of tech:**

  You grasp the nuances of AI, autonomous agents, and B2B SaaS, and know how to market technical products to modern revenue leaders.
* **You're scrappy and proactive:**

  You thrive in early-stage ambiguity, create your own playbooks when none exist, and have a strong bias toward immediate action.
* **You communicate with clarity:**

  You write crisp, compelling copy and can clearly articulate complex tech value propositions to technical and business buyers alike.

**What We're Looking For:**

* 6+ years of direct experience in growth marketing, demand generation, or performance marketing within high-growth B2B SaaS or AI-first companies.
* Pedigree from top-tier academic institutions (e.g., IITs, BITS, IIMs, Ivy League, top-tier engineering/business schools) or a strong track record at premier VC-backed startups (Tier-1 funded Series A–C, Y Combinator alumni) or high-scale category leaders.
* Proven track record of owning revenue and pipeline targets, scaling ARR from early stages to multi-million-dollar run rates.
* Deep proficiency with modern marketing and analytics stacks (HubSpot, Salesforce, PostHog, Mixpanel, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Zapier/Make).
* Experience building acquisition engines from 0 to 1 when there was no existing playbook or large team support.

**Why This Role Is Cool:**

You'll define and own the entire growth playbook for one of the most exciting frontiers in Gen AI. You will work side-by-side with the founders, enjoy complete creative and strategic autonomy, and play a direct role in establishing Breakout as the category-defining platform for autonomous sales agents.

title: Marketing Automation, Manager
description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
The Marketing Automation Manager will serve as a senior platform and solution lead responsible for the administration, governance, optimization, and continuous improvement of the enterprise marketing automation ecosystem. The role combines hands-on platform expertise with solution design, data and lead management, integration, quality assurance, stakeholder leadership, and process automation. The successful candidate will translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and measurable marketing capabilities.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
You will be joining the Investment Management function that allows us to deliver a comprehensive, holistic approach to each client relationship — for asset managers and asset owners, insurance companies, and official institutions globally. It means our client-facing functions work together to bring the very best solutions and services the firm has to offer — across all our locations, products, and capabilities.
  
  
Join us if making your mark on the long-lasting client relationships we build is a challenge you are up for.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As a Marketing Automation Manager, you will:
  
  

* Own platform administration and governance, including users, roles, permissions, workspaces, channels, fields, templates, operational programs, naming standards, system configuration, and documentation.
* Monitor platform health, campaign queues, database growth, system limits, CRM synchronization, and integration errors; lead root-cause analysis and resolution of complex issues.
* Design and implement scalable marketing programs, workflows, forms, landing pages, lifecycle processes, scoring models, personalization, and reusable automation frameworks.
* Lead database management practices covering data quality, normalization, validation, enrichment, deduplication, segmentation, retention, consent, archiving, and suppression.
* Optimize end-to-end lead management, including acquisition, identity matching, lifecycle stages, behavioral and demographic scoring, qualification, routing, nurturing, recycling, MQL/SQL handoffs, and sales follow-up.
* Lead integrations between the marketing automation platform, Salesforce, websites, ABM solutions, webinar platforms, data environments, and other third-party systems.
* Manage field mappings, synchronization rules, campaign-member processes, lead/contact flows, ownership rules, error handling, testing, and data reconciliation.
* Establish quality-assurance standards for campaign logic, personalization, links, forms, responsive rendering, tracking, consent, data capture, deliverability, and CRM synchronization.
* Support ABM and webinar capabilities, including account segmentation, audience activation, engagement signals, registration, attendance processing, follow-up automation, and reporting.
* Identify and implement AI and automation opportunities for campaign development, quality checks, anomaly detection, documentation, data classification, reporting, and workflow orchestration, with appropriate human review and governance.
* Lead technical discovery, solution design, testing, release management, change control, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Act as a trusted advisor to Marketing, Sales, Technology, Data, Privacy, Compliance, and regional teams; communicate options, dependencies, risks, and recommendations.
* Establish standards for platform administration, troubleshooting, documentation, and delivery.

**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* 7-10 years of experience in marketing automation, Marketing Operations, or Marketing Technology, including substantial hands-on platform administration experience.
* Advanced administration experience with Adobe Marketo Engage or a comparable enterprise marketing automation platform.
* Strong knowledge of marketing databases, data governance, segmentation, data quality, deduplication, retention, consent, and preference management.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
* Experience leading technical workstreams and mentoring team members

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in marketing, Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field. Relevant professional experience may be considered in place of a degree.
* Adobe Marketo Engage certification or a comparable marketing automation certification.
* Working knowledge of HTML and CSS; familiarity with JavaScript is preferred.
* Experience with Salesforce CRM, ABM platforms such as Demandbase or 6sense, and webinar platforms such as ON24 or Zoom.
* Experience with Workfront, Jira, ServiceNow, Tableau, Power BI, or similar work management and reporting tools.
* Practical experience using generative AI, copilots, or agentic automation in marketing operations.
* Experience in a regulated, financial services, or global enterprise environment.

**Work Requirement**

* Work from office 4 days a week
* Preferably working in EMEA shift 1 – 10 PM

**About State Street**
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
  
  
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. title: Social Media Manager

About the role

Decorpot is building a group of home brands that people follow, trust and

walk into showrooms for. Social is where a lot of that begins, and we are

looking for a Social Media Manager who knows how to make a brand

feel alive on it.

You will work across Decorpot (interiors) and FurnitureOne (furniture),

alongside our Head of Social Media and our Influencer Marketing

Executive. You will bring ideas as often as you carry them out: spotting

what is happening on the platforms, turning it into content that fits our

brands, and seeing it through from first thought to published post.

If you live on Instagram, can tell a moment worth jumping on from one

worth skipping, and enjoy the full journey from idea to performance

report, this role is for you.

What we need (essential)

•3 to 5 years of hands-on social media experience with B2C brands.

We are not considering B2B or purely corporate social

backgrounds.

•Experience at an agency, on the brand side, or both. Having done

both is preferred, and either works if your work is strong.

•Real social savvy. You are on top of trends, formats, audio, memes

and platform shifts, and you know how to adapt them to a brand

without losing its voice.

•A track record of generating content ideas: reels, carousels, series

and campaigns that you came up with, not just executed.

•A strong understanding of brand voice, and the ability to keep a brand

sounding consistent and distinct across platforms.

•Hands-on experience managing a brand’s pages end to end:

planning, publishing, community and day to day administration.

•Comfort with analytics. You track what works, understand why and

use it to shape what comes next.

•Good writing and a good eye, with the ability to brief designers,

editors and creators clearly.

•Links to the accounts or campaigns you have worked on.

Good to have

Experience in home, lifestyle, retail, D2C or other high-consideration

categories.

Experience delivering influencer or creator campaigns.

Basic video editing or Canva or CapCut skills for quick turnarounds.

Familiarity with AI tools that speed up content workflows.

What you will do

•Come up with the ideas. Develop content concepts, formats and

series for Decorpot and FurnitureOne, and pitch them to the team

with a clear point of view.

•Bring the brands alive. Translate each brand’s personality into content

that feels native to the platform and distinctly ours.

•Contribute to campaigns. Be part of campaign thinking with the Head

of Social Media, adding ideas and owning the social execution.

•Deliver influencer campaigns. Partner with our Influencer Marketing

Manager on creator briefs, content direction, approvals and

timelines, and contribute ideas for how creators can tell our stories.

•Run the pages. Own the content calendar, publishing and day to day

administration of our social channels.

•Manage the community. Keep conversations warm and responsive,

and flag leads and issues to the right team quickly.

•Work with the creative team. Collaborate with designers, editors,

photographers and our experience centre teams to get content

made and approved on time.

•Track and improve. Maintain performance reports, spot patterns and

turn learnings into better content each month.

•Stay ahead. Keep tabs on platform updates and cultural moments,

and bring in the ones that suit our brands.

2. One thing you built with AI tools for marketing or growth.
3. Look at joinvalley.co and at how our competitors show up online. In under 300 words, tell us what you would do / change in your first 30 days.

**What You Will Do**

You own every channel that brings buyers to Valley, the systems that run those channels, and the number of qualified demos they produce.

**The channels you run**

* **Founder and team content.**
  Our CEO's LinkedIn (28,000 followers), the company page, the team's LinkedIn accounts and X.
* **SEO and AI search.**
  The blog, comparison and alternatives pages, free tools, backlinks, and how often ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and Gemini name Valley when buyers ask about our category.
* **Outbound.**
  Our own LinkedIn outbound across about 15 accounts, and cold email at volume.
* **Paid.**
  LinkedIn ads and Google ads.
* **Email.**
  Two weekly newsletters to about 7,500 subscribers, plus the sequences around a demo.
* **Video and social.**
  Short-form video on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, user-generated content, Reddit and communities.
* **Creators, affiliates and partners.**
  The affiliate program and a creator program that needs to be built properly.
* **The website.**
  Positioning, pages, and the path from first click to a booked call.
* **Launches.**
  Product launches, Product Hunt, and anything else that earns a week of attention.

**The systems you build**

We want every channel to run as a loop that improves itself: it ships, measures what worked, feeds that back, and ships a better version, without a person in the middle of each step. You design those loops and build them with agents.

* Content agents that draft from our call transcripts and past winners, publish, read the performance data, and write the next batch from what worked.
* SEO and AI-search agents that watch which questions buyers ask, find where Valley is missing from the answer, write the page, and check whether we got cited.
* Outbound agents that build lists from signals, test offers and copy, read the replies, and move volume to what books demos.
* Reporting that builds itself, so the weekly numbers are there on Monday without anyone assembling them.

A lot of this exists in early form. Your job is to make it work and make it compound.

**The agencies and people you manage**

* A team of four across content, SEO, outbound and partnerships.
* Our outside agencies and vendors: cold email infrastructure and sending, paid ads, user-generated content, backlinks. You brief them, hold them to numbers, and replace the ones that do not perform.
* The growth budget. You decide where it goes.

**The targets**

* Qualified demos booked: 300 a month across inbound and outbound.
* Website visitors: from about 15,000 a month to 50,000.
* Valley named in AI answers and ranked on the first page for the questions buyers in our category ask.
* Every channel and every agency with a number, a date to judge it by, and a decision when that date comes.

**What We Are Looking For**

* **You are AI-native to the core.**
  You run your work through Claude Code, Codex, or similar tools every day. You have built agents and automated loops that did real marketing work, and you can show them to us. You reach for an agent before you reach for a hire.
* **You think in systems.**
  When something works once, your next move is to make it run and improve without you.
* **You have made a B2B software company well known in its market,**
  and you can show how you did it and what it produced.
* **You know how to feed a sales team.**
  You have run outbound, content and paid, and you know what makes a demo worth the call.
* **You can manage agencies and a small team.**
  You write a clear brief, set a number, and act on it.
* **You have energy and a point of view.**
  You arrive with a plan and change it when the numbers say so.
* **You write well,**
  and you are honest about numbers.
* **You have scaled a B2B SaaS company or growth/lead generation agency to over 5 million in ARR**

**Nice To Have**

* You have sold to founders, agencies or sales teams.
* You have your own audience on LinkedIn or X.
* You have run cold email at volume or built a creator program.

**Why This Job**

* It is yours. You set the strategy, you have the CEO's ear every week, and nobody sits between you and the decision.
* You are not starting from nothing. You have a product customers pay for, a founder with 33,000 LinkedIn followers, a team, and two years of data on what has and hasn't worked.
* The result will be visible. If Valley is the name people say in a year, everyone will know who did it.
* Real ownership: you set the growth strategy, not just execute it.
* Competitive salary and meaningful equity

**How To Apply**

Send three things to zayd@joinvalley.co. No cover letter.

1. The biggest growth result you have personally driven, with the numbers and what you did.
2. One thing you built with AI tools for marketing or growth.
3. Look at joinvalley.co and at how our competitors show up online. In under 300 words, tell us what you would do / change in your first 30 days.

We are moving fast on this hire. Shortlisted candidates do a short paid work sample, and we aim to make an offer within two weeks of a first call.

title: Manager – Regional Product Marketing, EPMA
description:
Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. We strive to develop a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter world, and our goal is to make every endpoint intelligent by offering product solutions in the automotive, industrial, infrastructure and IoT markets. Our robust product portfolio includes world-leading MCUs, SoCs, analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.

Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. At Renesas, we want to build a sustainable future where technology helps make our lives easier. Join us and build your future by being part of what’s next in electronics and the world.

**Job Description**

Renesas Electronics is seeking a highly accomplished and results-driven professional for the role of Regional Product Marketing Personal. This is a strategic and highly visible position responsible for driving market development, business growth, and customer engagement across India.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in microcontroller and microprocessor-based embedded systems, coupled with a strong background in product marketing, business development, and go-to-market execution. The role requires a proven ability to develop market opportunities, strengthen customer and partner relationships, and drive revenue growth through effective collaboration with sales teams, distributors, and ecosystem partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive regional business growth by enabling sales teams to achieve design-win objectives through comprehensive training, regular communications, customer engagement, and distributor support.
* Develop and deliver compelling product marketing collateral, promotional campaigns, and digital content that effectively influence customers, channel partners, distributors, and key decision-makers.
* Represent regional market requirements to Product Business Units by providing market intelligence, competitive analysis, customer feedback, and recommendations for future product development.
* Define and execute India-focused Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies in collaboration with management, including product launches, new product and solution introductions (NPI/NSI), customer demonstrations, trade shows, industry events, and promotional activities.
* Identify, evaluate, and engage design partners and ecosystem enablers to strengthen product ecosystems, accelerate design wins, and drive sustainable revenue growth.
* Establish, monitor, and report key performance indicators (KPIs) while proactively tracking and improving business performance.
* Provide product expertise, technical marketing support, and training to Renesas Sales teams, Field Application Engineers (FAEs), Sales Representatives, and Distribution Partners.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent technical discipline is required; an MBA is preferred, particularly with a focus on embedded software, technology management, or related fields.
* 12+ years of experience in microcontrollers, microprocessors, embedded systems, development tools, and technology marketing.
* Proven experience leading local, global, and cross-functional teams, programs, and external partners.
* Strong understanding of embedded system development methodologies, software tools, and system-level design techniques.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and public speaking skills, with the ability to engage technical and business audiences effectively.
* Demonstrated leadership capabilities with a strong sense of ownership, accountability, and execution excellence.
* Strong influencing and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build alignment across internal and external organizations.

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* In-depth knowledge of MCU/MPU ecosystems, applications, market segments, and industry requirements.
* Understanding of inverter motor control systems, industrial automation applications, Human-Machine Interface (HMI), and AI Ecosystem.
* Experience with embedded software platforms, development tools, and solutions used across multiple industries.
* Prior experience as an Application Engineer or Field Application Engineer is highly desirable.

**Additional Information**

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose,
**To Make Our Lives Easier**
. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and
**shape the future**
with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

title: Strategy & Marketing Head, Dengue
description:
By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**About This Role:**
The VP, Strategy & Marketing Head, Dengue is the senior global commercial strategy leader for Takeda's dengue vaccine franchise within the International Business Unit. The role is accountable for setting the global commercial ambition and translating it into an integrated brand, launch, lifecycle and market strategy that accelerates growth and broadens access across public and private channels.
  
  
As leader of the Qdenga Strategic Marketing organization within MCE, the role connects strategy to execution across Marketing Execution, Insights & Analytics, Market Access & Pricing, Health Economics, Medical, Public Affairs, Vaccine Policy, Intercontinental LOCs, Managed Markets, supranational engagement, regional leads, country teams and external commercial partners. The leader must create clarity across this network, align enterprise trade-offs, and hold the system accountable for the outcomes required to deliver Qdenga's ambition. This role will also lead engagement at a global level and function as a main point of contact in the Takeda global project team.
  
  
The role is also the first strategic leader charged with establishing the Bangaluru-based Qdenga Global Capability Model hub. The incumbent will build the leadership team, embed new ways of working, ensure effective knowledge transfer, and demonstrate how strategic commercial work can be delivered through a globally networked, capability-led and AI-enabled model.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  
Global Brand Strategy and Commercial Leadership
  
  

* Define and continuously evolve the global commercial strategy, brand ambition and strategic imperatives for Qdenga across launch and in-line markets.
* Translate the brand strategy into clear choices on customer segments, market archetypes, public and private channels, geographic priorities, launch sequencing and resource allocation.
* Own integrated global brand planning, ensuring regional and country plans are aligned to a common strategy while reflecting distinct market realities.
* Leads the management and engagement of key external partnerships, including business case development, negotiation management, and partner negotiations. Invest in and foster strong relationships.
* Lead competitive strategy and readiness, identifying shifts in the vaccine landscape and converting insights into timely actions.
* Ensure Qdenga has a differentiated, evidence-based value proposition and coherent narrative across customers, payers, policy makers, and public health stakeholders.

Launch, Growth and Lifecycle Leadership
  
  

* Lead global commercial launch strategy and governance for current and future market launches, with clear readiness standards, milestones, risks and escalation paths.
* Drive geographic expansion and uptake by aligning global strategy, market readiness, access pathways, customer activation and execution support.
* Provide commercial leadership for lifecycle priorities, evidence needs and future growth opportunities in partnership with the GPL & Asset Strategy lead and cross-functional partners.
* Guide commercial scenarios and trade-offs to maximize long-term franchise value while protecting near-term delivery in priority markets.
* Ensure launch and growth priorities remain focused, adequately supported and linked to measurable patient, customer and business outcomes.

Enterprise and Cross-Functional Integration
  
  

* Function as the senior commercial integrator for Qdenga across MCE, Market Access & Pricing, Medical, Public Affairs, Vaccine Policy, Intercontinental LOCs, Managed Markets, supranational engagement, supply and regional and country organizations.
* Ensures that key enterprise Qdenga topics are represented in the MCE LT forum in order for critical decisions to be made in an effective and timely manner.
* Establish clear decision rights, governance and operating rhythms that enable fast, fact-based decisions and reduce duplication across the matrix.
* Chair or sponsor the principal commercial and cross-functional forums required to align strategy, resolve issues and drive execution.
* Balance Qdenga priorities with broader IBU and Takeda priorities, making enterprise-level trade-offs rather than optimizing individual functions or geographies.
* Represent the franchise with senior internal stakeholders and, where appropriate, external stakeholders whose decisions materially affect Qdenga growth, access or reputation.

Strategic Marketing Operating Model
  
  

* Lead the Qdenga strategic marketing organization in a manner consistent with the MCE model define brand strategy, brand plans, campaign strategy, originator content requirements and implementation guidance for markets.
* Partner with Marketing Execution to create scalable, modular marketing deliverables that address the majority of market needs and can be efficiently localized and activated.
* Partner with Insights & Analytics to convert market, customer and competitive insights into coherent strategic choices, performance narratives and action.
* Create effective feedback loops with priority markets and regional strategic marketing leads so that global strategies are grounded in external realities and continuously improved.
* Clarify ownership across strategy, content production, localization and market activation, ensuring quality and speed without recreating work locally.

GPL and Asset Strategy Leadership
  
  

* Provide leadership, direction and enterprise context to the Global Program Lead role and the Asset Strategy role, both of which report to this position.
* Ensure strong integration between commercial strategy, asset strategy, evidence generation, regulatory considerations and lifecycle priorities.
* Hold the GPL & Asset Strategy lead accountable for effective Global Product Team leadership and cross-functional asset governance.
* Ensure material asset decisions reflect external market dynamics, customer needs, access requirements and the long-term commercial ambition for Qdenga.

Business Planning and Performance
  
  

* Lead the commercial contribution to long-range forecasting, annual and mid-range planning, business reviews, and investment prioritization.
* Establish a concise performance framework covering growth, launch readiness, uptake, access progress, strategic milestones and organizational health.
* Use scenarios, analytics, and market insight to identify performance gaps early and mobilize corrective action.
* Ensure resources and external spending are directed to the highest-value opportunities and managed with an owner's mindset.

Bangaluru GCM Hub Build and Transformation
  
  

* Serve as the inaugural senior leader of the Bangaluru-based Qdenga GCM hub with immediate short-term responsibility for building a high-performing strategic commercial organization from the ground up and for leading the expansion of the IBU GCC model and leadership organization in Bangaluru.
* Recruit, onboard, develop and retain leaders with the vaccine expertise, enterprise mindset and strategic capabilities required for the future model.
* Lead knowledge transfer and capability transition from the legacy organization while safeguarding business continuity and critical vaccine expertise.
* Define and embed practical ways of working across Bangaluru, global functions, regions and markets, including decision rights, governance, service expectations and escalation paths.
* Champion AI-enabled, data-driven and digitally connected approaches to strategy, planning, insight generation and execution.
* Document lessons from the Qdenga pilot and contribute to future GCM operating model choices across IBU.

**Leadership Expectations:**

* Enterprise leader consistently optimizes Takeda and IBU value, not only for the brand, function or geography.
* Strategic integrator connects complex commercial, access, policy, medical and market inputs into prioritized decision points.
* Decisive operator frames decisions, concentrates the right inputs, acts at appropriate speed and drives follow-through.
* Matrix leader creates outcomes through influence, shared accountability and trusted relationships across cultures and organizational boundaries.
* Builder and transformer, establishes new teams, capabilities and operating models while maintaining delivery during transition.
* Externally oriented vaccine leader that brings deep understanding of vaccine markets, public health systems, procurement pathways and stakeholder dynamics.
* Talent leader builds an inclusive, high-performance culture rooted in clarity, development, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Tech-forward leader actively applies analytics, digital tools and AI to improve strategic quality, speed and productivity.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in business, marketing, life sciences, public health or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 15+ years of progressive biopharmaceutical commercial leadership experience, including significant global or international responsibility.
* Deep vaccine industry experience, including direct experience with the distinctive commercial, launch, access, public health, policy, procurement and stakeholder dynamics of vaccines.
* Demonstrated success leading global brand or franchise strategy, launch planning, lifecycle management and growth acceleration.
* Proven enterprise perspective and leadership, with the ability to balance brand ambition, market needs, functional priorities, organizational capacity, and long-term company value.
* Experience leading complex, cross-functional and geographically distributed organizations through influence as well as formal authority.
* Demonstrated success integrating Commercial, Market Access, Pricing, Medical, Public Affairs, Analytics and regional or country stakeholders around shared outcomes.
* Strong financial and business acumen, including forecasting, strategic planning, investment prioritization, and performance management.
* Executive-level communication, judgment and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to create clarity and make decisions in ambiguity.
* Experience building and developing senior, diverse and geographically distributed teams.
* Experience establishing or scaling a Global Capability Model, Global Capability Center, Center of Excellence or comparable strategic capability hub.
* Experience leading capability transfer, organizational redesign, operating-model transformation or significant cross-border change.
* Experience using AI, advanced analytics, and digital capabilities to improve commercial strategy and execution.
* Experience across both emerging and established markets and across public and private vaccine channels.
* Experience engaging supranational organizations, public procurement systems, government stakeholders, or global health partners.

IND - Bengaluru
  
  
**Worker Type:**
Employee
  
  
**Worker Sub-Type:**
Regular
  
  
**Time Type:**
Full time

title: Head of Strategy(Startup Mobility)
description:
**Role Overview**

We are looking for a sharp, data-driven
**Head of Strategy**
to act as a core strategic partner to the CEO and executive leadership team. Sitting at the intersection of commercial strategy, CEO office program management, and hardware product direction, this role requires someone who is equally comfortable tearing apart a P&L, building a board presentation, and debating hardware product roadmaps with engineering teams.

You will translate high-level company vision into executable cross-functional initiatives, ensuring commercial, operational, and engineering priorities stay tightly aligned.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Commercial Strategy, Market Intelligence & Finance Support**

* **Go-To-Market (GTM) & Market Analysis:**
  Define target customer segments, conduct deep-dive market sizing, and track competitive landscapes to identify new revenue streams and positioning advantages.
* **Commercials & P&L Ownership:**
  Partner closely with the CBO and CFO to structure commercial models, pricing strategies, and unit economics. Own strategic P&L modeling and financial scenario planning.
* **Investor Relations:**
  Lead the analytical and narrative preparation for fundraising, investor updates, and capital allocation discussions.

**2. CEO Office, Program Management & Board Governance**

* **Cross-Functional Program Leadership:**
  Act as an extension of the CEO’s office to spearhead high-priority, zero-to-one strategic projects across operations, sales, and product. Unblock bottlenecks and drive accountability across teams.
* **Board Management & Executive Communications:**
  Own the end-to-end preparation of Board of Directors decks, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and executive narratives. Translate complex operational and financial data into crisp, decision-ready presentations.
* **Executive Alignment:**
  Work hand-in-hand with the Operations Head and C-suite to track OKRs, manage operational cadences, and ensure seamless execution across senior leadership.

**3. Hardware & Engineering Product Strategy**

* **Product Roadmap Alignment:**
  Bridge the gap between commercial market demands and engineering execution. Partner with engineering and product teams to prioritize hardware product features, lifecycle planning, and technical trade-offs.
* **Technical-Commercial Translation:**
  Leverage your engineering background to evaluate hardware feasibility, supply chain implications, and cost-down strategies alongside the Operations and Engineering leads.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (
  **B.E. / B.Tech**
  ) is mandatory. An MBA is
  **not required**
  —we prioritize raw intellect, business acumen, and execution over pedigree.
* **Background:**
  Proven experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, founder’s office, or strategic program management within a
  **hardware, deep-tech, manufacturing, or physical-product**
  environment.
* **Technical & Hardware Fluency:**
  Solid foundational understanding of hardware engineering, product development cycles, and manufacturing/operations dynamics.
* **Analytical Rigor:**
  Highly comfortable with numbers, financial modeling, P&L management, and extracting actionable insights from messy data.

**Non-Negotiable Traits**

* **Executive Presence & Stakeholder Management:**
  High emotional intelligence and confidence working directly with the CEO, CXOs, board members, and senior operational leaders without relying on formal authority.
* **Mastery of Storytelling & Presentations:**
  Exceptional ability to structure complex arguments and build crisp, high-impact executive presentations.
* **High Agency & Sharp Problem-Solving:**
  First-principles thinker who thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, and effortlessly switches between 30,000-foot strategy and granular operational troubleshooting.

title: Senior Director - Growth (Japan Business Unit)
description:

is a global digital transformation and technology consulting company with over two decades of SAP expertise. Incture helps enterprises modernize their technology landscape and accelerate business transformation through SAP services, enterprise solutions and digital innovation.
