**Cherrywork portfolio of enterprise applications and SAP BTP-based solutions**
. With global operations and strong SAP ecosystem relationships, Incture is expanding its presence in Japan to serve enterprise customers through local partnerships and global delivery capabilities.

Incture is looking for an entrepreneurial and commercially driven leader to establish, lead and grow its business in Japan. The successful candidate will have end-to-end ownership of the Japan business, including business strategy, revenue growth, profitability, customer acquisition, strategic partnerships and local organization development.

The role will focus on building Incture's market presence, developing relationships with Japanese enterprises, SAP Japan and local system integrators, and driving business opportunities by leveraging Incture's global capabilities and solution portfolio.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business Strategy & P&L:**
  Develop and execute Japan's business strategy, own revenue, bookings and profitability, and drive sustainable business growth.
* **Sales & Business Development:**
  Lead enterprise sales, acquire new customers, develop strategic accounts and manage the complete sales cycle from opportunity identification to deal closure.
* **SAP Alliance & Partnerships:**
  Build relationships with SAP Japan and leading Japanese system integrators, consulting firms and technology partners; drive joint go-to-market and co-selling opportunities.
* **Solution & Product Growth:**
  Drive opportunities across SAP S/4HANA, BTP, BDC, Integration, AI, Digital Transformation and Incture's Cherrywork products.
* **Organization Development:**
  Initially leverage Incture's India-based presales, consulting and delivery teams, while progressively building a Japan-based sales, consulting and delivery organization.
* **Market & Customer Leadership:**
  Establish Incture's brand in Japan, develop executive customer relationships and ensure customer satisfaction, retention and account growth.
* **Business Operations:**
  Coordinate with central corporate functions for Japan entity administration, finance, HR, legal and compliance requirements.

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 15+ years of experience in IT services, technology consulting, enterprise solutions or digital transformation.
* Proven track record of building business, driving enterprise sales and delivering revenue growth in Japan.
* Strong experience in business development, strategic account management, commercial negotiations and P&L management.
* Engineering or equivalent technical degree; MBA or postgraduate management qualification is an advantage.
* Experience in SAP or the broader SAP ecosystem is desirable but not mandatory.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Experience with global IT services companies or consulting firms.
* Established relationships with SAP Japan, Japanese SI partners and enterprise customers will be a strong advantage.
* Experience establishing or expanding the Japan operations of an international technology or IT services company.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong leadership, commercial acumen and execution capabilities.

**Language & Cultural Requirements**

* Business-level fluency in Japanese and English.
* Ability to lead executive discussions, customer engagements and commercial negotiations in both languages.
* Strong understanding of Japanese business culture, relationship management and enterprise decision-making.

title: Category Manager
description:
We are Licious and we are a Bengaluru based meat and seafood company founded in 2015 by Abhay

Hanjura and Vivek Gupta, our founders, foodies and friends. We pride ourselves on being India’s

most successful D2C food-tech brand operating in 20 cities across the country delighting over 32 lac

customers with our de-licious fresh meat and seafood!

Think you have what it takes to be the magic ingredient in the recipe that is Licious? Read on…

**What Makes this Role Meaty?**

1)
P&L Ownership & Commercial Performance

● Owning the end-to-end P&L for the Chicken category

● Improving Gross Margin % with a clear path to burn-zero, balancing growth investment with profitability discipline.

● Building financial models, tracking category metrics closely and making data-backed decisions on pricing, promotions and assortment.

2)
Category & Market Transformation

● Leading the shift of fresh meat from an unorganised, trust-deficit category to a structured, premium, consumer-first market

● Building consumer trust through standardisation, transparency and premiumisation;

and making affluent consumers aware of and invested in where their meat comes from.

3)

A hard requirement, not a nice-to-have. | Product Cost Controlling depth — costing variants and estimates, costing sheets, WIP, variance calculation and order settlement. | Replacing a spreadsheet costing process — codifying multi-tier allocation and derivation rules into a governed system layer, and running a formal six-month parallel run to sign-off. | Margin analysis and finance-facing communication — account-based CO-PA design, plus the ability to explain a costing result to CFO-level stakeholders in business terms.
  
  
**Job Description**
SAP S/4HANA Senior Consultant
  
  
Controlling — Product Cost / Actual Cost (CO-PC / CO-AC) and Profitability & Margin Analysis
  
  
SAP S/4HANA Implementation Program |
  
  
**Top 4 Job Requirements For This Role**

* Hands-on SAP Material Ledger implementation — activation, actual costing run, multi-level price determination, periodic unit price and actual cost component split. A hard requirement, not a nice-to-have.
* Product Cost Controlling depth — costing variants and estimates, costing sheets, WIP, variance calculation and order settlement.
* Replacing a spreadsheet costing process — codifying multi-tier allocation and derivation rules into a governed system layer, and running a formal six-month parallel run to sign-off.
* Margin analysis and finance-facing communication — account-based CO-PA design, plus the ability to explain a costing result to CFO-level stakeholders in business terms.

**Role Overview**
Actual cost today is produced entirely in Excel: SAP supplies only a raw variance extract, while product-number conversion, three-tier variance allocation, series derivation, category-based spending and absorption rules, sub-to-main mapping and quarter-end averaging live in spreadsheets maintained by a few individuals. The month-end process is long, the audit trail thin, and the logic carries real key-person risk. The target is SAP Material Ledger actual costing in collection-only mode — periodic unit price calculated and rolled up multi-level through the BOM for management reporting, while inventory remain at standard cost. Delivery includes a six-month parallel run before Excel is retired.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead Controlling validation workshops with the manufacturing controller and finance leadership; confirm the requirements and produce signed-off functional design.
* Configure Material Ledger actual costing in collection-only mode: ML activation per plant, currency and valuation setup, single- and multi-level price determination, and deliberate exclusion of post-closing so there is no financial-statement impact.
* Design the periodic unit price and multi-level roll-up so raw-material and semi-finished variances propagate through the full BOM to finished goods, with the actual cost component split carried through to allocation and reporting.
* Map the nine cost-variance GL accounts onto standard variance categories and ML cost components; design the business-specific allocation logic — direct-by-item, pooled ratio distribution by plant and business area, business-area-only vendor discount allocation, series derivation, category-based spending and absorption, sub-to-main mapping and quarter-end averaging.
* Take and document the architecture decision — reposting custom allocation into Material Ledger versus combining it with the ML periodic unit price in the reporting layer — before custom development begins; drive upstream posting-quality remediation as the primary lever.

**Preferred Required**
■ BATCH MANAGEMENT & TRACEABILITY EXPERIENCE — PREFERRED, NOT REQUIRED
  
  
Batch Management and traceability experience is preferred but not required for this role — the actual-costing scope is item-level rather than batch-level. Candidates who understand the following will integrate more effectively with the manufacturing and inventory workstreams:
  
  

* How batch-managed inventory and batch valuation interact with Material Ledger — including split and batch-specific valuation, and why this program's collection-only design does not require them.
* FIFO lot-based gross-profit reporting (deferred to a later phase here) and the batch-level data it would depend on.
* How scrap and yield reported at lot and batch level in execution flow into production-order variance and therefore into actual cost, so costing and shop-floor reporting design stay consistent.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8+ years SAP Controlling consulting with minimum 2 full-lifecycle implementations and hands-on Product Cost Controlling configuration responsibility; at least 2 on S/4HANA (1909 or later).
* Demonstrable hands-on SAP Material Ledger implementation experience — activation, actual costing run, single- and multi-level price determination, periodic unit price, actual cost component split and CKM3N/CKMVFM analysis. This is a hard requirement.
* Deep Product Cost Planning and Cost Object Controlling expertise: costing variants, cost estimates, costing sheets, WIP, variance calculation and settlement.
* Profitability analysis experience — margin analysis (account-based CO-PA) on S/4HANA, characteristic derivation, and product/customer-level margin reporting.
* Actual costing in report-only / collection-only mode, or the clear ability to explain the design implications of not running post-closing.
* Proven replacement of a spreadsheet-based finance process with a system process, including running a formal parallel run and securing sign-off.
* Strong CO–FI–MM–PP integration knowledge, SOX / J-SOX control experience, and the ability to explain a costing result to CFO-level stakeholders in business terms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Delivering costing allocation logic in a governed BW / SAP BTP reporting layer rather than bespoke ABAP.
* SAP Analytics Cloud or SAP Business Data Cloud for margin and cost reporting.
* Group Reporting, Universal Parallel Accounting or multi-valuation actual costing.
* Electronics or high-mix discrete manufacturing cost structures, including mold/tooling and engineer-to-order costing; ML performance tuning and month-end runtime benchmarking at scale.
* SAP certification in S/4HANA Management Accounting (Controlling).

title: Grants & Finance Analyst
description:
**About the role**

We’re looking for a Grants & Finance Analyst to identify and secure non-dilutive funding across the UK, EU and India, including public grants, consortium programmes and open funding calls. You’ll manage applications from bid to post-award compliance, and support financial analysis and investor readiness for future funding rounds, working closely with the leadership team.

**What you’ll do**

* Track open grant calls, innovation funds and consortium opportunities across the UK, EU and India that fit Marklytics’ work in battery traceability, sustainability and digital product passports.
* Assess eligibility, deadlines and fit, and keep a live pipeline of funding opportunities with clear recommendations.
* Prepare and coordinate grant applications end to end: budgets, cost justifications, work packages, impact statements and supporting documents, working with the tech and leadership teams for inputs.
* Support consortium bids by coordinating with partner organisations, universities and industry collaborators on shared proposals.
* Manage post-award requirements, including milestone reporting, financial claims and compliance with funder rules.
* Support preparation for upcoming funding rounds: financial models, investor-facing materials, data rooms and market and competitor analysis.
* Research and maintain a list of relevant investors, funds and strategic partners, and help track conversations.
* Work with leadership on budgeting, forecasting and runway planning as needed.

**What we’re looking for**

* A degree in finance, economics, business, commerce or a related field.
* Hands-on exposure to grant writing, funding applications, startup finance, investment analysis or a similar role.
* Strong financial modelling and Excel/Sheets skills.
* Clear, persuasive writing; you can turn technical work into a compelling funding case.
* Highly organised, comfortable juggling multiple deadlines, and detail-oriented with numbers and documentation.
* Self-driven and comfortable working in a small, fast-moving team.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with programmes such as Innovate UK, Horizon Europe, or Indian government startup and innovation schemes.
* Familiarity with the startup fundraising process (pitch decks, cap tables, due diligence).
* Interest in sustainability, EVs, batteries or climate tech.

**Why join us**

* Direct impact on the company’s growth and funding strategy from day one.
* Close work with the founding team on a regulation-driven, high-growth product in the EV and battery space.
* Exposure to international funding ecosystems across the UK, EU and Asia.
* A steep learning curve and room to grow as the function expands.

title: State Head
description:
Hiring for State Head- Chennai, Hyderabad, Mumbai,Surat

We are looking for a relationship-driven finance professional to acquire and manage SME and mid-market clients, understand their funding requirements, and deliver appropriate financing solutions. The role combines business development, working capital advisory, credit assessment, and portfolio management, with a strong emphasis on building long-term relationships with founders, CEOs, and CFOs.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Acquire SME and mid-market clients through targeted outreach, referrals, founder engagement, and professional networks.
* Build trusted relationships with founders and senior finance leaders to understand business performance, growth plans, and financing needs.
* Structure financing solutions across working capital, term loans, project finance, debt consolidation, and expansion funding.
* Evaluate financial statements, cash flows, liquidity, profitability, debt-servicing capacity, and collateral to assess funding suitability.
* Manage and grow client portfolios by identifying additional financing opportunities, strengthening retention, and maintaining service quality.
* Coordinate with internal credit, risk, and operations teams to support assessment, documentation, approval, and timely disbursement.
* Assess risks associated with complex financing requirements, including business expansion, asset acquisition, and debt restructuring.
* Align financing recommendations and deployment with clients’ working capital cycles and growth requirements.
* Monitor portfolio performance and emerging risks, coordinating timely action with relevant stakeholders.
* Track market trends and competitor offerings to identify new business opportunities.

**Who We're Looking For**

* 8-12 years Relevant experience in banking or NBFC lending, particularly SME or mid-market relationship management, working capital finance, or corporate lending.
* Demonstrated ability to acquire clients, deepen relationships, and grow a lending portfolio
* Strong understanding of credit appraisal, financial analysis, cash-flow assessment, and risk mitigation.
* Experience translating business requirements into customized financing solutions.
* Confidence engaging with founders, CEOs, CFOs, and other senior stakeholders.
* Ability to balance commercial growth with credit quality, compliance, and customer experience.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and managing multiple client requirements.
* Strong communication, negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Team Handling experience is must
* MBA/PGDM in Management, Finance, or a related discipline preferred.

title: Team Manager - RCM
description:
Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We help healthcare organizations build innovation capabilities and accelerate key growth initiatives, enabling organizations to own the future, instead of being disrupted by it. Together, we empower clients to create sustainable growth, optimize internal processes and deliver better consumer outcomes.
  
  
Health systems, hospitals and medical clinics are under immense pressure to improve clinical outcomes and reduce the cost of providing patient care. Investing in new partnerships, clinical services and technology is not enough to create meaningful and substantive change. To succeed long-term, healthcare organizations must empower leaders, clinicians, employees, affiliates and communities to build cultures that foster innovation to achieve the best outcomes for patients.
  
  
Joining the Huron team means you’ll help our clients evolve and adapt to the rapidly changing healthcare environment and optimize existing business operations, improve clinical outcomes, create a more consumer-centric healthcare experience, and drive physician, patient and employee engagement across the enterprise.
  
  
Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.
  
  
As a RCM Team Manager, you will be responsible for team management, service delivery of day to day back office RCM functions to ensure customer satisfaction and to meet contractual SLA’s. Demonstrate leadership and take accountability.
  
  
**Job Details**

* Streamline core day to day operations in RCM processes in the US Healthcare domain
* Formulate & implement strategic plans for new technologies & tools to support sustained profitable growth of the account
* Well versed in executing cost saving measures and modifications to achieve substantial reduction and work within the given budget/cost
* Understand & implement Lean Six Sigma methodologies of quality and complying with the norms of regulatory authorities
* Prioritize work and deploy staff as required to ensure customer deliverables are met in regards to on-time delivery of service and quality of work
* Manage, train & develops a work environment that promotes high motivation and customer satisfaction
* Should have managed a team / group of 50 to 70 FTEs
* Thorough understanding of RCM processes like Billing, Cash Posting, Credit Balance, Accounts Receivables, Denial Management & Correspondence review
* Very good understanding of RCM metrics like Days in AR, Ageing above 90 days, Collections and bad debt
* Periodically review teams performance and recommend performance improvement plan wherever required
* Hands on in preparing daily, weekly & monthly operational metrics reports from the Practice Management/Billing System and workflow tool using MS-Excel
* Identify trends and patterns from the generated reports and initiate action plan to resolve the AR issues
* Responsible for work allocation / distribution to the team and monitor the team work
* Create and maintain daily operational scorecards to track and report KPI’s; assist in volume forecast and capacity planning as required
* Generate and distribute management reports in accurate and timely manner
* Perform data analysis for generating reports on periodic basis including adhocs
* Establish a strong relationship with Team Managers by demonstrating the gaps, trends & patterns identified during the data/report compilation
* Drive improvement projects on productivity, improve SLA’s and quality
* Ensure brand integrity through adherence to standards and procedures in an effort to attain established profitability goals and brand awareness in the market place
* Communicate with existing and prospective clients
* Willing to work in night shift / US timings

**Qualifications**

* 12+ years of US Healthcare – RCM industry experience
* Good knowledge of Lean and Six sigma / Certification in Lean and other quality practices an added advantage
* Proficient in MS Excel and creating Excel macros
* Strong ability to analyze raw data, draw conclusions and develop actionable recommendations
* Ability to handle multiple tasks of reporting simultaneously
* Ability to adapt quickly to new and changing technical environments as well as strong analytical, problem solving and quantitative abilities.

**Education/Certifications**
Solid verbal and written communication skills are required.
  
  

* Graduate in any disclipline.

Senior Associate

India

title: Private Wealth Analyst (PMS, MF, AIF & Unlisted Stocks)
description:
We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Fundraising & Investment Manager with strong expertise in Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs), Wealth Management, Investment Advisory, and Portfolio Management.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying and acquiring HNI/UHNI investors, driving fundraising activities, evaluating investment opportunities, developing investment strategies, and managing investor relationships.

The role requires a combination of strong fundraising capabilities, financial market knowledge, investment analysis, and relationship management skills. The ideal candidate should have an established network of HNI/UHNI investors, practical experience in capital mobilisation, and the ability to identify and recommend suitable investment opportunities.

Roles & Responsibilities1. Fundraising & Investor Acquisition

* Identify, acquire, and develop relationships with HNI/UHNI individuals, family offices, institutional investors, and corporate investors.
* Drive fundraising initiatives for Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) and other investment opportunities.
* Build and maintain a strong investor database and generate new investment leads.
* Develop fundraising strategies to achieve assigned capital mobilisation targets.
* Conduct investor meetings, presentations, and investment discussions to secure commitments.
* Build relationships with wealth managers, financial advisors, brokers, distributors, and investment partners.
* Manage the complete fundraising cycle, from lead generation and investor engagement to commitment and onboarding.

2. Investment Research & Evaluation

* Identify and evaluate investment opportunities across AIFs, PMS, Private Equity, Mutual Funds, Debt Instruments, and structured investment products.
* Conduct financial analysis, market research, industry assessments, and investment due diligence.
* Evaluate investment proposals based on financial performance, risk factors, expected returns, liquidity, and market potential.
* Analyse fund structures, investment strategies, financial statements, and underlying assets.
* Prepare investment research reports, financial models, proposals, and recommendations.
* Monitor financial markets, economic developments, and emerging investment opportunities.

3. Investment & Portfolio Management

* Develop investment strategies and asset allocation recommendations based on investor objectives and risk profiles.
* Monitor investment portfolios, fund performance, asset allocation, and investment returns.
* Evaluate portfolio risks, diversification, liquidity, and overall performance.
* Recommend suitable investment products and portfolio adjustments based on market conditions.
* Maintain regular communication with investors regarding investment performance and opportunities.
* Coordinate with fund managers and investment partners to monitor existing investments.

4. Client & Relationship Management

* Develop and maintain long-term relationships with HNI/UHNI clients and prospective investors.
* Understand client financial objectives, investment preferences, and risk appetite.
* Present investment opportunities, fund structures, research findings, and portfolio recommendations.
* Prepare business presentations, investment proposals, and periodic portfolio reports.
* Participate in client meetings, investor discussions, and business development activities.
* Identify cross-selling and additional investment opportunities within the existing client network.

5. Compliance & Documentation

* Ensure fundraising and investment activities comply with applicable SEBI regulations and internal compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with legal, compliance, finance, and operations teams for investor onboarding and documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of investor commitments, fundraising pipelines, and investment activities.
* Ensure appropriate disclosures and investor communication throughout the investment lifecycle.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's or master's degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business Administration.
* MBA Finance, CFA, CA, or relevant professional qualifications will be preferred.
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in AIF, Wealth Management, Investment Banking, Portfolio Management, PMS, or Investment Advisory.
* Strong understanding of AIF Category I, II, and III, PMS, Mutual Funds, Private Equity, Debt Instruments, and alternative investment products.
* Proven experience in fundraising, capital mobilisation, and HNI/UHNI client acquisition.
* Established network of HNI/UHNI investors, family offices, or institutional investors.
* Strong knowledge of investment research, financial analysis, valuation, and portfolio evaluation.
* Ability to independently generate investment leads and convert prospects into investors.
* Excellent negotiation, communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, financial modelling, and investment research tools.
* NISM certifications or other relevant financial market certifications will be an advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Capital mobilisation and fundraising targets achieved.
* Number of new HNI/UHNI investors acquired.
* Investor conversion and onboarding ratio.
* Growth of investor database and business network.
* Quality of investment research and recommendations.
* Investment opportunity identification and evaluation.
* Portfolio monitoring and reporting efficiency.
* Client retention and relationship development.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are particularly interested in candidates who have worked with AIFs, PMS providers, Wealth Management firms, Private Banks, Investment Advisory firms, or Alternative Investment platforms.

Candidates with a combination of an established HNI/UHNI investor network, proven fundraising achievements, and hands-on investment analysis experience will be strongly preferred.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain standardized templates and checklists for bank reconciliations and record to report tasks that improve consistency reduce manual errors and support efficient onboarding of new team members.
* Collaborate with technology and process improvement teams to enhance automation of reconciliations and reporting flows which reduces operational risk and supports scalable finance operations.
* Support internal and external audit requests by supplying well organized schedules evidence and explanations that demonstrate robust control design and effective operation across bank accounting processes.
* Document detailed process notes desk procedures and control narratives for all assigned accounting tasks to create sustainable knowledge assets that support business continuity and regulatory readiness.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying recurring issues in night shift workflows and proposing data driven solutions that strengthen reliability and timeliness of financial reporting for global stakeholders.
* Engage with cross functional partners to align accounting outcomes with broader organizational objectives thereby ensuring that accurate bank and ledger information supports ethical business conduct and positive impact on society.

**Qualifications**

* Showcase strong technical skills in bank accounting with hands on experience managing reconciliations transaction postings and exception handling across diverse banking systems.
* Demonstrate practical exposure to record to report accounting including journal entry processing month end close activities and balance sheet substantiation in a corporate environment.
* Apply sound understanding of finance and accounting principles to interpret complex financial data and to ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and local regulatory expectations.
* Display proficiency with enterprise resource planning and accounting applications plus spreadsheet tools to manage large data sets and produce reliable analytical reports for stakeholders.
* Bring proven experience of four to eight years in accounting functions for multinational or large scale organizations working in hybrid and night shift models while adhering to robust governance frameworks.
* Exhibit strong communication and collaboration abilities that facilitate clear interaction with global teams and enable effective explanation of accounting outcomes to non finance partners.
* Maintain high attention to detail and professional skepticism when validating financial information to protect organizational trust and contribute to transparent reporting practices that support societal confidence in corporate disclosures.

**Certifications Required**
Certified Public Accountant or Chartered Accountant or Certified Management Accountant preferred with any advanced certification in banking or financial accounting being beneficial.

* Manage the issuance of materials to execution teams based on approved requisitions, ensuring real-time updates in stock registers or ERP systems.
* Conduct regular physical stock counts and lead reconciliation activities to minimize inventory variance.

**Finance & Accounts Operations**

* Record daily financial transactions, including invoices, payments, journal entries, and employee claims.
* Process vendor bills by validating invoices against site receipts and procurement approvals.
* Ensure timely statutory compliance regarding GST and TDS deductions for all site payments.
* Perform bank reconciliations and support monthly closing activities, including ledger scrutiny and schedule preparation.
* Coordinate with internal and statutory auditors to provide documentation and resolve queries.

**Internal Stakeholders**

* Project & Execution Teams: For material issuance, manpower deployment, and expense approvals.

* HR & Finance Corporate: For salary entries, employee reimbursements, and disciplinary case support.

**External Stakeholders**

* Vendors & Suppliers: For delivery confirmations, payment queries, and reconciliations.
* Contractors: For workforce attendance, wage records, and statutory submissions.
* Government Authorities: Facilitating site inspections by labor and tax officials.
* Banks & Auditors: For transactional coordination and financial review support.

* Primary: B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter / CMA Inter.

* Years of Experience: 5 to 15 years.

* English: Working knowledge for documentation and reporting.
* Local Language: High proficiency required for vendor coordination and labor relations.

**Technical Skills**

* Accounting & Finance: Proficiency in GST/TDS compliance, Accounts Payable/Receivable, and Bank Reconciliation.
* Compliance: Deep understanding of Labor Laws (CLRA, Factories Act, etc.) and Statutory Documentation.

Meeting strict deadlines for monthly closings and statutory filings

title: Assistant Accountant
description:
**Company Description**
Art&design Wall & Window Coverings is a growing business specializing in customized wall and window treatment solutions for residential and commercial spaces. The company focuses on quality materials, thoughtful design, and reliable installation services to enhance interior environments. Team members collaborate closely with clients, designers, and suppliers to deliver tailored products and services that meet diverse aesthetic and functional needs. The work culture emphasizes accountability, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement in both operations and service delivery.

**Role Description**
The Assistant Accountant is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai. This role supports day-to-day accounting operations, including recording transactions, maintaining ledgers, and assisting with accounts payable and receivable. Responsibilities include preparing and updating financial records, reconciling bank statements, supporting month-end and year-end closing activities, and helping generate basic financial reports. The Assistant Accountant will also assist with invoicing, payment follow-ups, vendor and customer account maintenance, and documentation for audits and compliance. Collaboration with the finance team and other departments is expected to ensure accurate data, timely reporting, and adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in basic accounting principles, including journal entries, ledger maintenance, and account reconciliation.
* Proficiency in accounting software and MS Office applications, especially Excel, for data entry, reporting, and analysis.
* Attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and the ability to organize and manage financial records effectively.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills for working with internal teams, vendors, and customers.
* Ability to work on-site in Chennai, manage time efficiently, and meet deadlines in a structured environment.
* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field preferred.
* Prior internship or experience in an accounting or finance support role is an advantage.
* Familiarity with GST, basic tax concepts, and local regulatory requirements is beneficial.

description:

Req Id: 14763
  
  
Posting Start Date: 11/17/26
  
  
At Fujitsu, our purpose is to make the world more sustainable by building trust in society through innovation. Founded in Japan in 1935, Fujitsu has been a pioneer in technology and innovation for decades. Today, as a world-leading digital transformation partner, we are committed to transforming business and society in the digital age.
  
  
With approximately 130,000 employees across over 50 countries, Fujitsu offers a broad range of products, services, and solutions. We collaborate with our customers to co-create solutions that drive enterprise-wide digitalization while actively working to address social issues and contribute to the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
  
  
**Position Title: SAP CO - Lead Functional Consultant - 14763**
**Shift Timing: 1:30PM-10:30PM**
**Locations: Pune, Bangalore, Chennai, Noida, Hyderabad**
**Experience: 12+ Years**
**Job Description**
**Position Overview:**
We are seeking a seasoned SAP S/4HANA RTR CO Consultant with SAP S/4HANA RTR functional & technical experience executing and delivering a complex migration project from SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA. The candidate will be responsible for the configuration of SAP S/4HANA Target System to receive selected data migrated from a current SAP ECC system to ensure a seamless transition, while providing expert guidance and support to clients throughout the configuration build, testing and cutover activities of their journey to SAP S/4HANA.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Functional and Technical Consulting:**

* Leading Workshops AS IS / TO BE Process to map requirements from business process understanding, cost management and reporting, integration with other modules and systems, overall business strategy.
* Provide expert guidance and support in RTR workstream including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Cash Management, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, and Profitability Analysis including Margin Analysis. Work with SAP S/4HANA Core Team to configure and customize SAP S/4HANA functionalities to meet client requirements, ensuring adherence to best practices and industry standards.
* Develop technical solutions and enhancements to support data migration, integration, and reporting requirements.
* Provide guidance and support with S/4 HANA transformation project including configuration, Data Migration, providing functional Expertise, trouble shooting, User training.
* Designs and optimizes controlling processes to meet the business needs.

**Business Process Analysis And Optimization**

* Work closely with finance and control departments to understand their processes and needs.
* Analyse existing financial processes and suggest improvements.
* Ensure the SAP system is aligned with business financial operations and reporting requirements.

**Testing, Training, And Support**

* Develop and execute test plans, scenarios, and scripts to validate SAP S/4HANA configurations and functionalities.
* Conduct system integration testing, user acceptance testing, and regression testing to ensure system reliability, accuracy, and performance.
* Collaborate with business users to resolve issues, address concerns, and implement solutions to meet project objectives.
* Train end-users on the functionality of SAP S/4HANA RTR Workstream
* Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting for SAP RTR Workstream issues.

**Integration And Data Migration**

* Ensure seamless integration of the S/4 Finance Accounting with other SAP modules like Order to Cash, Sourcing & Procurement, Manufacturing, Supply Chain.
* Oversee data migration from SAP ECC/legacy systems to SAP S/4HANA, ensuring data integrity and accuracy.
* Work with the Selective Data/Bluefield Migration Team on the migration of data from Customer’s SAP ECC System target SAP S/4HANA System to ensure minimal business disruption and maximum efficiency.
* Collaborate with data migration and technical teams on activities regarding data extraction, transformation, and loading into SAP S/4HANA during build, test and cutover phases of the project.

**Reporting And Analytics**

* Develop and maintain financial accounting reports and dashboards using SAP tools.
* Assist in the utilization of SAP S/4HANA's embedded analytics capabilities to provide actionable insights into financial data.

**Stakeholder Engagement And Communication**

* Act as the primary point of contact for key business and IT stakeholders including business users, project sponsors, and IT teams, providing regular updates, progress reports, and presentations on project status and milestones.
* Proactively engage with stakeholders to gather and validate requirements, address concerns, and obtain feedback throughout the migration and transformation process to SAP S/4HANA.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, fostering trust and confidence in the migration process and deliverables.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Information Technology, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
* 12+ years of experience in RTR workstream including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Asset Accounting, Cash Management, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, Internal Orders, Product Costing, and Profitability Analysis including Margin Analysis, implementation and support.
* Strong analytical Skills to analyze complex business data, identify potential issues, business challenges, recommend and develop solutions implementing with SAP Best practices.
* Should be well versed with end-to-end Product costing processes including Material Ledger functionality with integration points with other modules like Product Planning, Materials Management, Order to Cash etc.
* Should have worked on reports and able to identify the requirement and integrate effectively with SAP BW/BI or other reporting tools.

title: Major Accounts Reconcilation
description:
Job Title: AR Senior Analyst

Location: Chennai

Department: Finance/Accounts

Reports to: AR Manager

**Role Overview**

The AR Senior Analyst is part of the Order-to-Cash (O2C) team at our Shared Services Centre in Chennai. The role owns a portfolio of customer accounts and manages day-to-day cash application, collections, claims, disputes and deductions, reconciliation, and reporting. Working closely with customers, Sales and internal stakeholders, the analyst ensures accurate customer accounts, timely cash collection, and prompt issue resolution while driving process improvements that support the company’s working capital objectives.

**Primary Responsibilities**

**Supporting Actions**

**1. Cash Application**

* Apply customer receipts accurately against open invoices and claims using remittance advices.
* Follow up with customers to obtain missing or incomplete remittance information.
* Investigate and resolve payment discrepancies and payments split across multiple customer accounts.
* Regularly review and clear unapplied cash and unallocated credits to maintain accurate customer account balances.

**2. Collections**

* Monitor accounts receivable ageing and proactively follow up with customers to collect outstanding invoices, obtain payment updates and secure payment commitments.
* Track overdue balances and broken payment commitments, escalating long-outstanding accounts as required.
* Coordinate with customers and internal stakeholders to address payment delays and facilitate timely resolution of collection-related issues.
* Measure collection performance against targets, identify at-risk accounts, and provide regular updates on collection status and potential risks.

**3. Disputes & Deductions Management**

* Investigate trade and non-trade claims to ensure all items are accurately identified, recorded, and reviewed.
* Validate claims against supporting documentation, including promotional (TPM) rebates, pricing agreements, and PODs for short deliveries
* Follow up with customers on rejected claims and recover amounts relating to invalid deductions
* Collaborate with Sales, Credit team, and other internal stakeholders to obtain necessary approvals and facilitate the creation and issuance of credit notes for valid claims.
* Maintain clean and reconciled customer ledgers by ensuring timely resolution of open claims, escalating unresolved items to relevant internal stakeholders, and meeting monthly resolution targets.

**4. Reconciliation & Reporting**

* Reconcile assigned customer accounts and provide weekly and monthly overdue account reports with clear commentary on key movements and risks.
* Maintain accurate follow-up comments and activity logs in SAP, ensuring proper tracking of collection activities and claims actions.
* Complete month-end close activities within agreed timelines, including AR reporting and balance confirmations.
* Track and report KPIs and SLAs, highlighting overall process performance, compliance, and areas requiring attention.

**Experience & Skills**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in Accounts Receivable.
* Background in FMCG, retail or shared services environments managing high-volume customer accounts
* Hands-on involvement in process transitions, including knowledge transfer and stabilization of new customer portfolios.
* Flexibility to work in shifts aligned with business requirements.
* Strong working knowledge of SAP (FI-AR module)
* Advanced MS Excel skills, including Lookup, pivot tables, and data analysis.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with international customers and senior stakeholders.

**Walk-in Interview Details**

* Date: 27th and 28th November 2026 (Friday and Saturday)
* Time: 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM
* Venue: Lactalis Tirumala Corporate Office Chennai No. 75/8, 200 Feet Road, Thirumalai Nagar Extension, Ponniammanmedu, Madhavaram, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600110, India
* Contact Person: Abinaya - HR
* Documents Required: Updated Resume, ID Proof, Latest Salary Slips
* Skills: AR Senior Analyst - O2C, Collections, Cash Application, SAP FI-AR

title: Procurement Engineer 1
description:
Shape Smarter Sourcing Outcomes as a Procurement Engineer
  
  
Are you looking for a next step or a kick-start to your professional career? Join us as a
**Procurement Engineer**
and play a key role in ensuring materials, goods, and services are sourced, purchased, and delivered according to plan. In this role, you will work closely with internal stakeholders and suppliers, helping to secure smooth procurement operations while supporting sourcing initiatives across multiple indirect procurement categories. You will gain broad exposure to supplier management, contract administration, logistics coordination, and procurement analytics. With a primarily national scope and a strong focus on collaboration, this is an excellent opportunity to build procurement expertise while creating tangible business value.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Sourcing & Category Management**
Support and execute sourcing initiatives across multiple indirect procurement categories to deliver cost savings, cost avoidance, and business value (Main focus categories of MRO and Facilities)
  
  
Contribute to the development and implementation of category and sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives.
  
  
Identify sourcing opportunities and recommend new suppliers to meet operational and strategic requirements.
  
  
Conduct market research, supplier assessments, and benchmarking activities to support sourcing decisions.
  
  
Analyze spend data and procurement trends to identify optimization opportunities and drive value creation.

Develop and maintain strong relationships with strategic and high-spend suppliers.

Monitor supplier performance and facilitate continuous improvement initiatives to enhance quality, service, delivery, and cost performance.
  
  
**Stakeholder Collaboration**
Partner with internal stakeholders across functions to ensure procurement activities align with business requirements and strategic priorities.
  
  
Provide sourcing recommendations, contract guidance, and procurement expertise to support decision-making.
  
  
Maintain effective communication with stakeholders and suppliers throughout sourcing and contract management processes.
  
  
**Reporting & Governance**
Ensure procurement activities comply with company policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
  
  
Maintain accurate and organized records of contracts, supplier agreements, pricing information, and procurement documentation.
  
  
Prepare procurement reports and performance dashboards to provide spend visibility and track sourcing outcomes.
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications & Experience Education**
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline. Experience
  
  
Minimum 6 to 8 years of experience in indirect procurement, strategic sourcing, and contract management.
  
  
Demonstrated experience managing sourcing projects, supplier negotiations, and commercial agreements.
  
  
Experience working with procurement governance, documentation, compliance requirements, and supplier performance management.
  
  
**Technical Knowledge & Skills**
Strong knowledge of indirect procurement, strategic sourcing, supplier relationship management, vendor management, contract lifecycle management, commercial negotiations, and spend analysis.
  
  
Hands-on experience with procurement and ERP systems such as SAP Ariba, Basware, Guided Buying, Infor LN, and Adobe Sign or similar tools.
  
  
Advanced analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, procurement analytics tools, and Microsoft Office Suite.
  
  
**Personal Competencies**
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  
  
Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Proactive mindset with a strong focus on continuous improvement and value creation.
  
  
Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills across cross functional teams and suppliers.
  
  
**Preferred Experience**
Experience working in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
  
  
Ability to effectively collaborate with global suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders.
  
  
Experience supporting procurement transformation, process improvement, and sustainability initiatives will be considered an advantage.
  
  
To succeed in this role
  
  
Success in this role requires a strong foundation in procurement and sourcing processes, the ability to manage supplier relationships effectively, and attention to detail when handling purchasing and contract activities. You will need to collaborate confidently with stakeholders, maintain compliance with procurement policies, and proactively monitor supplier performance, delivery schedules, and business outcomes. The ability to work independently while balancing multiple procurement activities will be essential.
  
  
We Also Expect You To Align With Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical Behaviors That Guide How We Lead, Collaborate, And Succeed Together
  
  

* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
* Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value

We offer
  
  
You will join a procurement team focused on sourcing, supplier management, contract administration, purchasing execution, logistics coordination, and procurement governance. The team works closely with internal stakeholders across multiple functions and external supplier partners to ensure the right goods and services are delivered at the right time, quality, and cost. You will have the opportunity to contribute to sourcing strategies, supplier development, spend optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives while building expertise across the procurement lifecycle.
  
  
Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with opportunities to learn, grow, and contribute to business success. You will work in a collaborative environment where innovation, professional development, and continuous improvement are highly valued. We provide modern work tools, learning opportunities, and a supportive workplace that helps you build a rewarding career.
  
  
When everything works together
  
  
*Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers; we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.*

About the role

Marklytics is hiring a Sales Manager to own revenue end to end, from first conversation to signed contract. You will drive our sales and build pipeline with automotive OEMs, battery and cell manufacturers, and their supply chains.

About Marklytics

Marklytics is a UK-based B2B SaaS company building a digital battery passport platform, alongside AI-driven and supply chain traceability products. Our platform helps automotive and battery companies meet the EU Battery Regulation by capturing traceability, carbon footprint and compliance data across the battery value chain. We work with automotive OEMs and cell manufacturers across Europe and Asia, delivering one core platform configured to each client's needs.

What you will do

•⁠ ⁠Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, discovery, demos, proposals, negotiation and closing.

•⁠ ⁠Build and manage a qualified pipeline across automotive OEMs, battery and cell manufacturers, and battery supply chain companies.

•⁠ ⁠Run complex enterprise deals with multiple stakeholders, including sustainability, compliance, procurement, IT and leadership teams.

•⁠ ⁠Lead responses to RFQs, RFPs and tenders, working with product and engineering on scope, pricing and technical answers.

•⁠ ⁠Explain the EU Battery Regulation and battery passport requirements in clear business terms, and position Marklytics against clients' compliance deadlines.

•⁠ ⁠Own revenue targets, forecast accurately and report on pipeline health.

•⁠ ⁠Represent Marklytics at industry events, trade shows and partner meetings.

•⁠ ⁠Feed market and customer insight back to product to shape the roadmap.

•⁠ ⁠Set up and maintain the CRM, sales process and sales collateral.

What we are looking for

•⁠ ⁠4+ years in B2B sales, with at least 4 years selling enterprise SaaS.

•⁠ ⁠Domain experience in automotive, EV or battery sectors, such as selling to OEMs, cell manufacturers, Tier 1 suppliers or battery recyclers.

•⁠ ⁠A track record of closing enterprise deals with long sales cycles and multiple decision-makers.

•⁠ ⁠Experience running sales independently, owning targets and building pipeline from scratch.

•⁠ ⁠Confidence leading technical and regulatory conversations, and knowing when to bring in product or engineering.

•⁠ ⁠Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to write clear proposals and present to senior leadership.

•⁠ ⁠Comfort working across time zones with clients in Europe and Asia, and willingness to travel.

Nice to have

•⁠ ⁠Knowledge of the EU Battery Regulation, digital product passports (DPP), or ESG and sustainability reporting.

•⁠ ⁠Experience selling traceability, compliance, supply chain or ESG software.

•⁠ ⁠An existing network in automotive or battery manufacturing in Europe, India or Asia.

•⁠ ⁠Experience at an early-stage startup where you built the sales function yourself.

•⁠ ⁠A second language relevant to our markets, such as Japanese, Mandarin, Vietnamese or German.

What we offer

•⁠ ⁠Full ownership of the sales function at a fast-growing B2B SaaS company in climate tech and compliance.

•⁠ ⁠Direct exposure to global enterprise clients across Europe and Asia.

About Vista Tech
  
  
Vista Tech is an IT and career enablement company focused on helping students and aspiring professionals build industry-relevant technical skills and access career opportunities.
  
  
Through practical training, mentorship, real-time projects and placement assistance, we bridge the gap between academic learning and industry expectations.
  
  
We are looking for an enthusiastic and target-driven Business Development Executive to join our team and drive student admissions through effective academic counselling and sales.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The Business Development Executive will be responsible for managing incoming student enquiries, understanding their career aspirations, counselling them on suitable training programs and converting qualified leads into admissions.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a consultative sales approach and the ability to build trust with students and parents.

- Address student and parent queries regarding training, projects, mentorship and placement assistance.
  
- Build trust through transparent and professional counselling.

- Convert qualified enquiries into paid admissions.
  
- Handle sales objections related to pricing, course selection, career outcomes and competition.
  
- Share brochures, program details and payment links with prospective students.
  
- Coordinate registration and admission formalities.
  
- Ensure timely fee collection and admission confirmation.
  
  
4. Relationship Management
  
  
- Maintain professional relationships with prospective and enrolled students.
  
- Follow up with students throughout the admission process.
  
- Coordinate with the academic team whenever technical or curriculum-related clarification is required.
  
- Ensure a smooth handover of enrolled students to the academic team.
  
  
5. Reporting & Target Achievement
  
  
- Achieve daily, weekly and monthly admission targets.
  
- Maintain accurate records of calls, follow-ups, conversions and pending leads.
  
- Share daily sales reports with the reporting manager.
  
- Identify opportunities to improve lead conversion and counselling effectiveness.
  
  
Required Skills & Qualifications
  
  
- Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
  
- Excellent verbal communication skills in Tamil and English.
  
- Strong interpersonal and convincing skills.
  
- Interest in sales, education and career counselling.
  
- Ability to handle objections and negotiate professionally.
  
- Good follow-up and time-management skills.
  
- Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets and CRM tools.
  
- Willingness to work with sales targets and performance metrics.
  
  
Preferred Candidate Profile
  
  
- Freshers with strong communication and sales aptitude can apply.
  
- Candidates with experience in educational sales, academic counselling, edtech or business development will have an advantage.
  
- Candidates who are confident speaking with students and parents.
  
- Self-motivated individuals who enjoy working in a target-driven environment.
  
  
Performance Expectations
  
  
The candidate will be evaluated based on:
  
  
- Quality and consistency of lead follow-ups.
  
- Number of qualified counselling sessions.
  
- Admission conversion rate.
  
- Revenue generated through admissions.
  
- Fee collection and payment follow-ups.
  
- CRM accuracy and reporting discipline.
  
- Student experience and counselling quality.
  
  
What Vista Tech Offers
  
  
- Opportunity to work in a growing IT and EdTech company.
  
- Fixed salary with performance-based incentives.
  
- Practical exposure to business development and consultative sales.
  
- Opportunity to grow into Senior BDE / Sales Team Lead roles.
  
- Collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.
  
  
If you enjoy connecting with people, understanding their career aspirations and helping them make the right career decisions, we would love to have you on our team.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**10decoders | Chennai (Hybrid) | Full-time | US & GCC markets**

**About us**

10decoders is an AI-native IT services and products company (since 2015), ISO 27001 & ISO 9001 certified and Microsoft/Azure aligned. We help US and global enterprises modernize their applications and data, and we own a sharp healthcare wedge in prior authorization and denial-management automation through our own platforms, CheiAI and DocuFindr.

**The role**

We're hiring a Business Development Manager to drive new-logo acquisition and account growth across our three core service lines. You'll run the full cycle — from first conversation to signed SOW — and you'll be measured on closed revenue, not meetings.

**What you'll sell**

* AI Services — CheiAI (AI Agent Factory) and AI-native engineering pods for enterprise and mid-market buyers
* Healthcare — prior authorization and denial-management automation for US providers and India-based healthcare GCCs, with the CMS-0057-F mandate as a forcing function
* Modernization — application and data modernization engagements, including upsell into existing accounts

**What you'll do**

* Carry and hit a quarterly closed-revenue quota across all three service lines
* Generate your own demand — outbound, referrals, events and partner ecosystem
* Build named-account plans and multi-thread to economic buyers (CFO, VP RCM, GCC Site Head, VP Engineering)
* Partner with delivery and leadership to scope pods, shape SOWs and close deals
* Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene and an accurate weekly forecast

**What we're looking for**

* 4–10 years in B2B technology / IT services business development with a hunting mandate
* A documented track record of closed revenue selling to US clients
* Experience selling AI/data/cloud modernization or healthcare RCM / HealthTech solutions
* Consultative, solution-led selling across long enterprise cycles
* Strong CRM discipline and confident communication with C-level buyers

**Bonus points**

* Background from an RCM services major
* Existing relationships with US healthcare providers or India-based healthcare GCCs
* Familiarity with CMS-0057-F, FHIR, prior authorization and denial-management workflows
* Exposure to the Microsoft/Azure co-sell ecosystem

**What you'll get**

Competitive base plus uncapped incentive tied to closed revenue, a clear path to senior GTM roles, and ownership of a high-growth book of business in AI and healthcare.

title: Parts &  Service  Sales Representative
description:
**Career Area**
Sales
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
  
  
**About Electric Power Division And FG Wilson**
As a part of Caterpillar's Electric Power Division (EPD), FG Wilson offers integrated solutions, parts, and services to meet the needs of our various commercial and industrial electric power customers. FG Wilson supports a wide range of customer applications across the globe, including providing back-up power to hospitals, providing emergency power when natural disasters strike, and supporting critical infrastructure for data centres, municipalities, and more.
  
  
FG Wilson generator sets have been trusted to provide essential power to a wide range of applications globally. From 6.8 to 2,500 kVA, FG Wilson oﬀers one of the widest ranges of diesel-fuelled generator sets, built in modern facilities in Brazil, China and India.
  
  
As Aftermarket Parts & Service Sales Representative, you will play a key role in driving dealer success and customer satisfaction. You will build strong relationships with dealers, grow FG Wilson Brand Parts sales, increase POPS -F (Percentage of Parts Sales – FG Wilson) and support dealers to sell FG Wilson Expanded Offerings products and services. Your aftermarket expertise will help enhance dealer capabilities, identify growth opportunities, and deliver exceptional value to our customers.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Be responsible for dealer aftermarket business in Middle East and Africa region
* Be a primary point of contact for FG Wilson Aftermarket Parts business, handle dealer escalations, co-ordination with Parts Distribution Center and internal Supply Chain Team
* Identify FG Wilson Aftermarket Potential and support our Sales Team to develop Dealer Aftermarket annual business plan
* Work with dealers to identify, prioritize, and execute actions to achieve our yearly FG Wilson Aftermarket growth targets.
* Increase dealer sales of service, repair and overhaul parts with periodic reviews, corrective actions and support FG Wilson Dealer Governance
* Meet with customers on aftermarket needs and discuss FG Wilson Repower engines options, aftermarket solutions, and services
* Work with internal sales support teams to identify and drive regional actions to support FG Wilson Aftermarket growth.
* Increase customer and dealer engagement with FG Wilson Aftermarket
* Provide feedback to internal teams on aftermarket needs to support customers and provide additional growth.
* Identify aftermarket training requirements for new an existing dealer to support sales growth and capability development
* Develop quotations for custom solutions beyond standard offerings for FG Wilson Direct Sales Team
* Provide project-specific technical guidance and interface with core engineering teams

**What You Will Have**
Customer Focus: Working knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  
  
**Effective Communications:**
Working knowledge and understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  
  
Negotiating: Working knowledge of successful negotiation concepts and techniques; ability to negotiate successfully across the organization and with external vendors and clients in a constructive and collaborative manner.
  
  
Relationship Management: Working knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.
  
  
**Business Development:**
Strong understanding and knowledge of business development tools, techniques and approaches; ability to explore and develop potential areas of business growth for the organization.
  
  
Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
  
  
Value Selling: Working knowledge of the principles and practices for selling products, technology and services; ability to provide overall product/service 'value' and to differentiate support offerings that address clearly understood customer needs.
  
  
**What Will Put You Ahead**

* Strong product knowledge equipment aftermarket and electric power products including generator sets (gensets).
* Proven experience building and managing customer and dealer relationships to drive sales and service excellence.
* Excellent communication skills (fluency in English is required)
* Degree Requirement: Engineering or equivalent technical / commercial degree is required with Minimum 10years experience in relevant field.

**Additional Information**
This job required 5 days working from office.
  
  

* Business travel time - up to 25% is expected,
* ISE/Payroll Transfer is not considered for this role.

**Posting Dates**
November 17, 2026 - November 30, 2026

title: Sales Engineer
description:
Sicagen India Limited is a part of the Singapore-headquartered, US$2+ billion AM International Group. An ISO 9001:2015 certified organization, Sicagen operates through synergistic business verticals, with a strong presence across India through its multiple offices and warehouses. The company leverages a strategic combination of premium manufacturing and trading to deliver quality products and solutions across diverse industries. Sicagen operates through major business divisions: Building Material, Power & Control Systems, Industrial Packaging, Speciality Chemicals.

About Power & Control Systems Division:

Sicagen India Limited’s Power & Control Systems Division has over 30 years of experience in providing reliable and cost-effective power control, automation, and engineering solutions. As an authorised Woodward service provider since 1990, Woodward is a global leader in energy conversion and control solutions for aerospace and industrial applications. Sicagen India Limited specialises in the supply, servicing, repair, retrofitting and upgrading of governing systems, actuators, protection controls, VFDs and electrical switchgears for turbines and diesel engines.

With a strong focus on energy efficiency, operational reliability, and customer support, the division delivers customized solutions to various industries.

Job Summary

We are seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Sales Engineer to drive business growth for our industrial products portfolio. The role involves developing and managing customer relationships across process industries, identifying sales opportunities, providing technical solutions, and achieving business targets within the assigned territory. The ideal candidate should possess strong technical aptitude, excellent communication skills, and experience in industrial product sales.

Key Roles & Responsibilities:

* Develop and expand business opportunities for industrial products by targeting end-user customers across industries such as Sugar, Fertilizers, Cement, Steel, Refineries, Power Plants, and other Process Industries.
* Manage sales activities within the assigned territory, to achieve revenue and growth targets.
* Conduct regular customer visits to identify business opportunities and generate inquiries /orders for industrial controls and systems Actuators, Safety Systems, Upgrades, Systems, and other industrial automation solutions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers while identifying and acquiring new clients.
* Understand customer requirements and provide appropriate technical and commercial solutions to meet their operational needs.
* Prepare and present product demonstrations, technical proposals, quotations, and solution-based presentations to customers.
* Follow up on inquiries, negotiate commercial terms, and convert opportunities into confirmed orders.
* Provide periodic sales forecasts, market intelligence reports, and business updates to management.
* Participate in technical discussions, industry exhibitions, seminars, and customer engagement programs to enhance market presence and generate leads.
* Continuously develop product knowledge and stay updated on industry standards, technologies, and applications relevant to the company's product portfolio.

Required Skills

* Strong sales, business development, and customer relationship management skills.
* Sound technical understanding of industrial products, automation systems, control systems, plc, power solutions, or related equipment.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and provide solution-oriented recommendations.
* Self-motivated, target-driven, and capable of working independently.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to build long-term relationships with customers and key decision-makers.
* Candidates should be willing to travel within the assigned territory to meet customers, identify business opportunities and develop new accounts.

Required Qualifications / Experience

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 2–5 years of experience in Industrial Product Sales, Technical Sales, such as Automation Solutions, PLC, VFD, Control Systems, Power Systems, or related products.
* Experience in selling products to process industries such as Sugar, Cement, Fertilizers, Steel, Refineries, Power Plants, Petrochemicals, or Manufacturing Industries will be preferred.

Industry Experience

Candidates with prior experience in Industrial Automation, Power & Control Systems, Electrical Equipment, Instrumentation, Process Industries, Engineering Products, or Industrial Solution Sales is preferred.

Company Description
  
  
Swiggy is India’s leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role:Sales Manager
  
  
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants—learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
  
  
**Job Description:**

* Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
* Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
* Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
* Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
* Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
* Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
* Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
* Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction 80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month

**Qualifications**

* 0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
* Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
* Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partners.
* Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
* Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

**Job Description**
Company Description
  
  
Swiggy is India’s leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
  
  
**Job Description**
Role:Sales Manager
  
  
A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants—learning their business, understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.
  
  
**Job Description:**

* Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
* Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
* Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggy’s products as solutions, not features
* Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
* Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
* Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
* Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Googlesheet/WSP
* Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction 80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month

**Qualifications**
What We're Looking For Experience & Background:
  
  

* 0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
* Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
* Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partners.
* Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
* Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Additional Information
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law.

* Negotiate/implement terms of trade agreements and ensure adherence in-store.
* Track redistribution value and volume targets; present account‑wise reviews quarterly and identify gaps vs. business plans.

* Monitor, evaluate, and control CCS/scorecard metrics while ensuring on‑shelf availability and visibility standards at outlets.
