title: Sales & Lead Generation Intern
description:
**About Paathz**
Paathz is an AI-native hospitality workforce platform connecting pre-vetted professionals with hotels and restaurants across Southeast Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and beyond. We believe hospitality has a visibility problem, not a labour shortage. Our mission is to become the definitive cross-border talent corridor for the global hospitality industry.
  
  
**The Role**
The Sales & Lead Generation Intern is the engine behind Paathz’s commercial pipeline — a curious, persistent researcher who finds, qualifies, and opens doors with the hotels, resorts, restaurant groups, and hospitality employers who will become our first partners. This role is remote, but the prospecting is global, with no territory boundaries.
  
  
You will build lead lists and run outreach across Southeast Asia, Middle East, Europe, India, and other emerging hospitality markets. You will work directly with the CSO and founding team to turn market research into qualified conversations, and your work will shape where Paathz grows next.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Lead Research & Prospecting**

* Identify and research hospitality businesses worldwide, including hotel chains, independent and boutique hotels, resorts, serviced apartments, restaurant groups, and catering operators
* Find and verify decision-maker contacts (HR Directors, Talent Acquisition, General Managers, Hotel Managers, Owners, F&B Directors) using LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, company websites, and industry directories
* Build targeted lead lists by market and segment, covering Southeast Asia, Middle East Europe, India, and other high-potential regions
* Qualify leads against Paathz’s ideal customer profile (property size, hiring volume, international staffing needs, growth plans)

**Outreach & Pipeline Building**

* Run personalised multi-channel outreach via LinkedIn, email, and phone to generate interest and book discovery calls for the CSO and founding team
* Draft and test outreach messages and follow-up sequences, adapting tone and approach to different markets and cultures
* Follow up consistently with prospects and nurture warm leads until they are ready for a commercial conversation
* Represent Paathz professionally in early-stage conversations, explaining our value proposition to hospitality employers

**CRM & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate, up-to-date lead and pipeline data in our CRM or tracking sheets
* Track outreach metrics (leads sourced, response rates, meetings booked) and share a weekly pipeline report as part of the PAATHZ Weekly Update
* Flag what is and isn’t working by market, channel, and segment so the team can refine targeting

**Market Intelligence**

* Monitor hospitality news, new property openings, expansion announcements, and hiring trends that signal sales opportunities
* Map hospitality events, trade shows, associations, and communities in each region where Paathz can find partners
* Gather competitor and market insights to support go-to-market and positioning decisions

**Qualifications & Experience**
**Must-Haves**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Business, Hospitality Management, Marketing, International Business, or a related field
* Strong research skills and the ability to find the right person inside an organisation, even when the information is hard to locate
* Excellent written and verbal English; confident writing professional outreach messages to senior hospitality leaders
* Organised and detail-oriented, with comfort working in spreadsheets (Excel/Sheets) and tracking data accurately
* With a reliable laptop and internet connection
* Self-driven, persistent, and comfortable with rejection; able to work independently in a remote, fast-moving startup environment
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including some evenings (local time) to overlap with prospects in the Middle East and Europe

**Strong-to-Haves**

* Background or coursework in hospitality, hotel management, travel, or tourism
* Prior experience in sales, business development, lead generation, or recruitment (internships, part-time roles, or university projects count)
* Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Hunter, or similar prospecting tools, and any CRM (HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive)
* Understanding of data privacy basics for outreach (PDPA, GDPR)
* Fluency in a second language relevant to our markets (Hindi, Bahasa Indonesia, Filipino/Tagalog, Arabic, French, German, Spanish, Mandarin)

**What We Offer**

* Hands-on experience building a global sales pipeline at an AI-native startup from the earliest stage
* Direct mentorship from the CSO and founding team (CTO, European Markets, Head of Marketing)
* Exposure to the hospitality industry across Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Europe, India, and beyond from day one
* Exposure to senior hospitality decision-makers and industry networks across multiple markets
* Fully remote, flexible working with a certificate of completion and letter of recommendation for strong performers
* Pathway to a full-time role for outstanding interns as Paathz grows

title: Cost Intelligence & AI Analytics - Capital Projects
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Role Description Capital Projects Data Analyst**
**Function**
Capital Projects Data Analyst
  
  
**Location**
Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Reporting To**
Cost Estimating Lead – Global Project Services
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
This role is responsible for transforming historical capital project cost data—organized by Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)—into actionable insights using AI data mining techniques and advanced analytics. The primary objective is to support network facility planning and estimating by delivering dynamic cost metrics (e.g., cost per square foot, installation factors vs equipment cost, indirect percentages) tailored to user requirements. The role will also require support for future initiatives as necessary within the Technical Services group.
  
  
In addition, the role strengthens the Capital Governance process — which provides structure, oversight, and accountability in how Global Technical Services evaluates, approves, funds, and monitors capital investments — by supplying the performance data, analytics, and Key Performance Indicators that enable Stage Gate reviews, annual CapEx portfolio planning, and executive visibility into project cost, scope, and schedule performance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Data Mining & Structuring
* Source and organize historical capital project cost data segmented by WBS.
* Clean, normalize, and structure data for analysis using AI tools.
* Ensure data is enriched with relevant metadata (e.g., facility type, room classification, benchmark category).
* Design and maintain scalable data pipelines using SQL and modern data platforms (e.g., Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, Azure Data Lake) to consolidate multi-source project data into a unified, query-ready repository.
* Centralize scattered and legacy project cost data from disparate files and systems into a governed, single source of truth (e.g., unified SharePoint/data platform repository), eliminating manual tracking.
* AI-Driven Analysis
* Apply machine learning and natural language processing (NLP) to extract patterns, trends, and anomalies from cost data.
* Develop models to benchmark costs across facility types (e.g., API, fill-finish, QC labs) and scope categories.
* Leverage AI-powered assistants and agents (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, retrieval-augmented generation) to accelerate document intelligence, automate extraction of cost data from unstructured sources (e.g., PDFs, contracts, change orders), and improve estimating productivity.
* Apply predictive and forecasting techniques to improve the accuracy of cost projections and support variance and root-cause analysis for significant deviations.
* Metric Development & Reporting
* Generate cost metrics such as cost per square foot, cost per unit, and other KPIs based on user queries.
* Build interactive dashboards and visual tools for internal stakeholders using Power BI.
* Develop robust semantic models, DAX measures, and optimized datasets (including RLS/OLS security where required) to ensure dashboards are performant, governed, and scalable across the organization.
* Develop and manage performance data, analytics, and KPIs related to capital portfolio and CapEx performance (cost, schedule, quality), supporting Stage Gate governance reviews, capital projection cycles, and executive reporting.
* User Interaction & Customization
* Collaborate with other Global Technical Services team members to understand data needs.
* Translate ad hoc user requests into tailored cost analyses and reports using AI tools.
* Enable self-service capabilities for project teams to access cost benchmarks and trends.
* Lead requirements gathering and stakeholder engagement across time zones, translating business questions from Cost Estimating, Capital Governance, Finance, and Site Engineering stakeholders into clear analytical deliverables communicated in a concise, actionable manner.
* Tool & System Integration
* Integrate AI tools with existing project management and cost estimating platforms.
* Automate data ingestion and metric updates to ensure real-time relevance.
* Automate recurring data capture, refresh, and reporting workflows using the Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) and scripting (Python/SQL), reducing manual effort and turnaround time.
* Support integration of workflows, approvals, and documentation into capital project lifecycle platforms, maintaining data quality so information can be leveraged for reporting and decision-making.
* Data Governance & Quality
* Apply data governance practices — data quality checks, documentation, access control, and stewardship — to ensure the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of capital project data assets.
* Support knowledge management by helping capture benchmarks, lessons learned, and best practices in a central repository so they can be reused to improve future project outcomes.
* Handle confidential, strategic, and sensitive capital investment information with discretion and in compliance with organizational policies on data integrity and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support for Other Initiatives
* The role will also require supporting future initiatives as necessary within the Global Technical Services group.
* Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in AI, analytics, and digital operations; identify and implement innovative solutions and continuous-improvement opportunities in analytics and reporting workflows.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field; master’s degree preferred.
* 5–10+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or data engineering roles, preferably supporting capital projects, engineering, construction, infrastructure, or cost management functions; pharmaceutical or other regulated-industry experience is a plus.
* Expert-level proficiency in Power BI — including semantic/data modeling, DAX optimization, Power Query, RLS/OLS security, and deployment pipelines — with a portfolio of enterprise-grade dashboards delivered to senior stakeholders.
* Strong hands-on skills in the Microsoft ecosystem Microsoft Fabric, Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Copilot Studio), SharePoint, and Microsoft 365.
* Strong SQL skills and experience with modern data platforms such as Azure Data Lake, Databricks, Snowflake, or SAP HANA; proficiency in Python and/or R for data wrangling, statistical analysis, and modeling.
* Demonstrated experience applying AI to analytics workflows — machine learning, NLP, document intelligence (e.g., Form Recognizer), prompt engineering, AI agents, and retrieval-augmented generation (e.g., Azure OpenAI, Microsoft Copilot, Anthropic Claude).
* Experience with data preparation and automation tools such as Alteryx, and familiarity with visualization alternatives such as Tableau, is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of capital project delivery concepts — Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), cost estimating, stage-gate governance, cost/schedule performance metrics, and change control — or a demonstrated ability to learn them quickly; familiarity with tools such as SAP, Primavera/MSP, or capital portfolio platforms is a plus.
* Understanding of financial analysis fundamentals — budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and actuals-vs-plan reporting — as applied to project and portfolio performance.
* Experience conducting data governance or data maturity assessments and establishing data quality standards is preferred.
* Strong requirements-gathering, data storytelling, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to communicate complex quantitative analysis clearly and concisely to senior leaders across geographies and time zones.
* Self-starter comfortable operating in a global capability center (GCC) model with US–India collaboration, managing multiple priorities, and delivering to service levels with an operational excellence and continuous-improvement mindset.

**Value to the Organization**
This role will enable data-driven decision-making in capital planning, improve cost forecasting accuracy, and enhance transparency across Bristol Myers Squibb. It supports strategic initiatives such as digital transformation, strategic and business operations, cost optimization, and capital efficiency.
  
  
By supplying trusted benchmarks, automated KPIs, and AI-enabled insights, the role helps ensure the right projects are selected, funded, and executed in the right way at the right time — aligning capital spending with strategic priorities, strengthening disciplined stage-gate decision-making, improving visibility for leadership, and making every dollar invested in capital projects work harder for the organization.
  
  
**Why You Should Apply**

* You will help patients in their fight against serious diseases
* You will be part of a company that encourages excellence and innovation, respects diversity, develops leaders and values its employees
* You will have a rare opportunity to shape how AI and analytics transform capital project planning, estimating, and governance across a global network
* You'll get a competitive salary and a great benefits package including an annual bonus

description:
**Certification Lead / Instructional Design Project Manager | Pune or Hyderabad | Hybrid**

**About Cornerstone**

At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.

**About the Role**

The Credentialing Team Lead owns the day-to-day operations and outcomes of Cornerstone's certification and credentialing programs across India and Costa Rica. You will set the operational rhythm for the team, hold accountability for program quality and delivery timelines, and ensure credentials are valid, current, and reaching candidates on time. You will report to [Manager title] and directly influence the metrics that connect certification to partner and customer performance.

**In This Role You Will**

* Coordinate and lead the daily work of the team, providing task prioritization, workload management, and day-to-day guidance, while fostering a collaborative environment and supporting the professional development of team members.
* Communicate team progress, blockers, and updates to senior leadership on a regular basis, and prepare status updates, reports, and program summaries as needed.
* Oversee the execution of certification program operations, ensuring timely and consistent delivery across all initiatives, and monitor program workflows to identify opportunities to improve processes and efficiency.
* Own the management of certification assets, documentation, and program records, and assist with vendor coordination and platform administration as needed.
* Partner with the Instructional Designer (Assessment Programs) with credential development and updates, including content review, item writing support, and documentation, and coordinate exam development cycles, blueprint reviews, and content refresh activities.
* Work with the Certification Platforms Specialist to support platform operations, including badge issuance, system updates, and user experience improvements; coordinate integrations between certification platforms, proctoring solutions, and the LMS; and escalate technical issues and platform needs to the appropriate stakeholders.
* Lead the implementation of quality assurance processes across program content and delivery, and adherence to assessment quality standards and certification best practices.
* Help ensure program activities align with relevant industry standards and data privacy requirements, and flag compliance concerns to senior leadership for resolution.
* Serve as a reliable point of contact for internal teams on day-to-day certification questions and operational matters, collaborating with teams such as Marketing, Customer Support, and IT to support program needs.
* Identify, test, and implement AI-enabled automation for routine operational work; measure impact and retire unnecessary manual processes.
* Use AI to prepare status updates, reports, and program summaries, with human review before anything is shared with leadership.
* Continuously maps the routine and repeatable tasks within this role, identifies automation opportunities using AI and workflow tools, proposes and implements solutions, and measures whether the automation delivers the expected time and quality improvement.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Delivery: 95% or more of committed program milestones and team deliverables delivered on or before their dates each quarter.
* Reporting: Status updates to Sr. Manager of Certifications delivered on schedule 100% of the time, with blockers escalated within 2 business days.
* Compliance: Every compliance or data privacy concern flagged to Sr. Manager of Certifications within 2 business days of being identified.
* Program readiness (influenced): January 2027 launch milestones tracked weekly and on track, with every at-risk item escalated before it becomes a delay.
* AI transformation: Baseline hours spent on status reporting and routine coordination measured in the first 90 days, then reduced by 30% within 12 months, with review controls maintained.
* Candidate pass rates and renewal rates are tracked per credential and reviewed quarterly; trends are reported to program leadership with a recommended action when rates fall outside defined thresholds.
* Paid exam revenue and voucher redemption revenue are reported accurately each period; discrepancies are identified and resolved within 3 business days.
* Certification data (pass rates, badge issuance, renewal status) is delivered to the Strategy & Operations and partner performance teams on the agreed schedule with no missing records.
* All active exams are current within 3 weeks of each major product release.
* Badges are issued within 48 business hours of a passing result being confirmed.

**You Have Got What it Takes If You Have**

* Experience managing or coordinating a team in a learning, certification, or program operations environment.
* Familiarity with certification platforms, LMS administration, and proctoring systems.
* Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to prioritize across multiple workstreams.
* Ability to communicate clearly and reliably with both team members and senior leadership.
* Detail-oriented with a commitment to quality and operational consistency.
* Experience working cross-functionally with stakeholders across multiple teams.
* Ability to evaluate AI outputs and apply sound judgment about when a human must decide.
* Demonstrated experience owning program operations and outcomes, not just coordinating tasks under direction.
* Experience setting and reporting on operational metrics including delivery timelines, quality rates, and revenue reconciliation.
* Experience working across time zones with a distributed team.

Preferred Experience

* Experience with assessment or instructional design practices.
* Experience designing or improving AI-enabled workflows.

AI & Continuous Learning

* Uses AI to streamline team coordination, status reporting, and program documentation, and guides the team in adopting AI responsibly, with human review where it matters.
* Uses AI tools every day in their own work and can show an example where AI changed how the work is done, not just how fast.
* Evaluates AI output critically for accuracy, bias, privacy and data handling, and knows when a human must decide.
* Actively explores internal (Cornerstone AI) and external tools, brings recommendations to the team, and retires tools and processes that do not earn their place.
* Keeps skills current through communities, certifications, hands-on experimentation and industry learning, and shares what they learn with the team.
* Defines and enforces the team's standards for AI use in exam development, including when AI-generated items require SME review, what bias and accuracy checks must be completed before an item enters the bank, and how AI-assisted proctoring tools are evaluated and approved.
* Owns the governance framework for AI in candidate support, including escalation paths when AI-assisted responses are insufficient or incorrect.

**How You Work**

* Customer obsessed: Start with the learner’s and the account’s problem, not the tool.
* Innovate and transform: Challenge the status quo and retire systems and processes that do not earn their place.
* Proactive leadership: See problems and act before being asked.
* Get it done: Ship, measure and iterate.
* Forward looking: Plan for where technology and the business are going.
* AI native: Use AI daily to rethink work, not just accelerate it.
* Get uncomfortable to succeed: Take on hard, ambiguous problems and stay with them.

title: DESKTOP SUPPORT TECHNICIAN
description:
**THE TEAM & THE JOB**
The IT Service Delivery (Help Desk) team provides the day-to-day technology support that keeps our colleagues productive across our global offices. The team identifies, prioritises and resolves hardware, software and network issues for internal users, working to agreed service levels and in line with company security policies.
  
  
As Desktop Support Technician you will be the first point of contact for end users within the region and, remotely, for colleagues around the world. You will provide first and second line support, look after the lifecycle of end-user devices from set-up through to secure disposal, welcome new joiners to the business, and keep our meeting rooms and video conferencing running smoothly. Your work keeps downtime to a minimum, protects our security standards, and gives colleagues the tools they need to do their jobs. You will work under general guidance, escalating more complex issues to senior colleagues.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Provide first and second line support to end users for hardware, software and network issues via the IT ticketing system, resolving incidents promptly to minimise downtime and meet agreed SLAs.
* Deliver remote support to global users through the helpdesk, phone, email and remote assistance tools (e.g. TeamViewer) so that colleagues receive timely help wherever they are.
* Install, configure and maintain desktops, laptops and peripherals, and install and upgrade software applications as needed to keep users productive.
* Prepare and image devices ready for new users, including enrolling them in MDM platforms, and manage the delivery and collection of equipment for remote joiners and leavers.
* Maintain stock levels for the local office(s) and, when required, other regional offices, and keep the asset register up to date to ensure equipment is available and accurately recorded.
* Assist with the secure disposal of old hardware in line with security policies.
* Ensure all applicable assets have security applications and features installed, in line with security policies.
* Onboard new users to the company, both physically and remotely across the region, and run training sessions on basic system functionality so they are productive from day one.
* Install, configure and maintain video conferencing equipment in local meeting rooms, support meeting room users, and help set up larger meetings for executive staff such as Town Halls.
* Assist in the planning, auditing and execution of system upgrades, including hardware and software updates, ensuring compatibility and functionality afterwards.
* Create and maintain documentation for system configurations, procedures and troubleshooting steps to support knowledge transfer within the team.
* Provide out-of-hours support as and when required to carry out system maintenance and upgrades.
* Collaborate with IT colleagues to address complex issues and contribute to the development of IT solutions and projects, escalating issues to senior colleagues and management when needed.
* Key relationships: work regularly with IT team members, senior IT colleagues and management, new joiners, and colleagues across all departments to understand their technology needs.

**What You Need To Know (technical & Behavioural Skills/Competencies)**
These are the main skills and competencies needed to be successful in the role.
  
  
**Technical**

* Proven experience in desktop support or a related field, including troubleshooting hardware, software and network issues.
* Strong knowledge of Windows operating systems, and proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Active Directory, Azure AD, Office 365 and SharePoint/OneDrive.
* A basic understanding of IT security principles and practices, and the ability to apply security policies to devices and assets.
* Ability to image, configure and enrol devices, and to maintain an accurate asset register.
* Ability to document procedures and troubleshooting steps clearly for others to follow.
* Beneficial: experience with VDI infrastructure; experience with Apple MacBook, iPhone and other Apple technology; experience with Atlassian tools (Jira/Confluence).
* Beneficial: relevant certifications (e.g. CompTIA A+, ITIL, Microsoft certifications).
* Education: Associate degree or equivalent in a relevant field (e.g. Information Technology, Computer Science).

**Behavioural**

* Provide excellent customer service, communicating clearly and professionally, verbally and in writing, with users at all levels of the business (trust each other).
* Respond quickly and keep up to date with changes in technology and in our IT environment (be fast).
* Work independently, managing your own queue and priorities, as well as collaborating as part of a wider IT team (trust each other).
* Know when to escalate, and do so promptly and with clear information.
* Be flexible and willing to provide out-of-hours support when required.

**What We Are Ideally Looking For**
A proven track record of resolving end-user issues within agreed SLAs in a multi-site environment, with hands-on Windows and Microsoft 365 experience. Experience supporting Apple devices, VDI and Atlassian tools, and a relevant certification, would be a distinct advantage.
  
  
**Why join YouGov?**
Join our global team to help us achieve our social mission: to make millions of people’s opinions heard for the benefit of our local, national, and international communities.
  
  
Understanding diversity of opinion requires diversity of background. Although our global panel of millions of people worldwide powers our research, our biggest asset is our people. If our research is to be truly representative of what the world thinks, we need people from all walks of life to be part of the team to bring their perspective to the work we do.
  
  
**Life at YouGov**
We are driven by a set of shared values. We are fast, fearless, and innovative. We work diligently to get it right. We are guided by accuracy, ethics, and proven methodologies. We respect and trust each other, bringing these values into everything that we do.
  
  
We strive to provide YouGovers with best-in-class benefits to support their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. We want our employees to have a sense of belonging and uniqueness in a supportive workplace, so they can bring their full selves to work.

Assist with change requests, minor enhancements, deployment activities, testing, documentation, and knowledge transfer to ensure successful implementation of system changes.

Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand operational needs, provide regular status updates, and deliver a high level of customer service and support.

title: Application Custodian L2
description:
The Application Custodian L2 owns the application from a support and change point of view, handling issues that L1 cannot resolve. You will take ownership of escalated issues, review logs, code, data and workflow behaviour, analyse defects and root causes, and provide fixes, patches and workarounds. You will own the support codebase, plan and implement approved change requests, review them with estimates, and coordinate regression and deployment. You will also ensure issues are closed and documented, update the knowledge base, turn recurring issues into reusable support steps, train L1, and work with L3 on deeper technical issues.
  
  
**Must have:**
Knowledge of application codebase and architecture, release and deployment basics, regression risk awareness, problem management and trend analysis, with disciplined documentation and fix reuse. Skills in code reading and fixing, debugging, log and root cause analysis, change implementation, regression verification, version control, and AI tools for code understanding and fix drafting. Problem solving, clear communication, ownership, coordination with customers and internal teams, and the ability to explain technical issues simply. Accountability, thoroughness, persistence, calmness under pressure and a bias for resolution. A degree or equivalent experience in IT, engineering or computer science, strong hands-on exposure to application support or development, and an AI-assisted development or support certification.
  
  
**Good to have:**
Database, API, integration, security and performance troubleshooting, AI-assisted debugging, SQL analysis, API testing, quick-fix scripting, release packaging, and monitoring and alert analysis. Customer handling, mentoring L1, collaboration with delivery teams and conflict handling. Curiosity, discipline, continuous learning and a preventive mindset. ITIL Foundation, a relevant technology certification, or a cloud, platform support or secure coding certification.
  
  
Apply Now

title: Business Development Executive
description:
**Company:**
Transformatrix LLP

**Position:**
Business Development Executive

**Department:**
Business Development & Client Acquisition

**Location:**
Mumbai

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

1. About the Company

Transformatrix is a multi-domain business solutions and consulting firm offering a wide range of services to startups, SMEs and established businesses.

Our service portfolio spans across multiple domains, including:

* **Finance & Accounting:**
  Accounting, taxation, GST, statutory compliance, virtual CFO, financial advisory, due diligence and transaction advisory.
* **Technology & Automation:**
  Software solutions, AI-powered tools, business process automation, technology consulting and digital transformation.
* **HR & Recruitment:**
  Recruitment services, talent acquisition, HR consulting, payroll and HR process management.
* **Business Advisory:**
  Startup consulting, business strategy, fundraising support, investor connect and operational advisory.

We work with businesses to understand their challenges and provide integrated solutions that help them grow, improve efficiency and achieve their business objectives.

2. Role Overview

We are looking for a proactive, confident and result-oriented Business Development Executive who can identify potential clients, understand their business requirements and pitch appropriate solutions from our diverse service portfolio.

The candidate should have the ability to engage with business owners, founders, directors, CFOs, HR heads and other decision-makers.

This is not a conventional sales role where the candidate sells only one product or service. The BDE is expected to understand the client's overall business requirements, identify opportunities across different domains and coordinate with internal teams to offer suitable solutions.

3. Key Responsibilities

**A. Lead Generation & Client Acquisition**

* Identify and research potential clients across startups, SMEs, corporates and other business segments.
* Generate leads through cold calling, LinkedIn, email campaigns, networking, referrals and other channels.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective clients.
* Reach out to business owners, founders, CFOs, HR heads and decision-makers.
* Schedule meetings and business discussions with prospective clients.

**B. Understanding Client Requirements**

* Interact with prospective clients to understand their business operations, challenges and requirements.
* Identify gaps and opportunities where our services can add value.
* Understand client pain points relating to finance, accounting, technology, HR, recruitment and business operations.
* Explore cross-selling and upselling opportunities across different service verticals.

**C. Solution Pitching & Sales**

* Present relevant services and solutions based on the client's requirements.
* Prepare and deliver business proposals, presentations and commercial quotations in coordination with internal teams.
* Explain the value proposition and business benefits of our services.
* Follow up with prospective clients and convert opportunities into business engagements.
* Negotiate commercial terms and coordinate the onboarding of new clients.

**D. Client Relationship Management**

* Develop and maintain long-term relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Regularly follow up with clients to identify additional business requirements.
* Coordinate with internal finance, technology and HR teams to ensure smooth service delivery.
* Maintain professional communication and ensure a positive client experience.

**E. Market Research & Business Strategy**

* Research industry trends, competitors and potential business opportunities.
* Identify new sectors, customer segments and geographical markets.
* Explore strategic partnerships, referral networks and channel partnerships.
* Share market feedback and client requirements with management to help develop new service offerings.

**F. Reporting & CRM Management**

* Maintain a database of leads, prospects, meetings, proposals and conversions.
* Update CRM or sales trackers regularly.
* Prepare weekly and monthly business development reports.
* Track sales targets, conversion ratios and revenue generated.

4. Desired Candidate Profile

* Graduate in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing or a related discipline.
* 1–3 years of experience in business development, sales, client acquisition or B2B sales. Freshers with excellent communication and convincing skills may also apply.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Confidence in interacting with business owners and senior management.
* Strong negotiation, presentation and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to understand different business models and identify client requirements.
* Willingness to learn about multiple service offerings and industries.
* Self-motivated, target-oriented and comfortable with outbound sales activities.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint, LinkedIn and CRM tools.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate's performance will be evaluated based on:

1. Number of qualified leads generated.
2. Number of client meetings and business discussions conducted.
3. Number of proposals and commercial quotations submitted.
4. Conversion rate of leads into paying clients.
5. Revenue generated from new client acquisitions.
6. Cross-selling and upselling of services.
7. Quality of client relationships and follow-up management.
8. Accuracy and regularity of sales pipeline reporting.

6. What We Expect From You

* Don't just sell services; understand the client's business.
* Don't restrict yourself to one domain; explore opportunities across all our business verticals.
* Be proactive in identifying business opportunities rather than waiting for leads.
* Take ownership of the entire sales cycle, from lead generation to client conversion.
* Develop the ability to identify a problem and position the right solution.
* Build relationships that translate into long-term business engagements.

**The ideal candidate should think like a business consultant and act like a sales professional.**

7. Compensation & Growth

* Salary: As per experience and suitability.
* Performance-based incentives on business generation and client acquisition.
* Opportunity to work across finance, technology, HR and business advisory domains.
* Exposure to founders, entrepreneurs, business leaders and senior management.
* Career growth into Business Development Manager / Strategic Partnerships / Sales Leadership roles based on performance.

title: Closer (Sales) | Scribbleli
description:
About Scribbleli

Scribbleli is an AI tool for LinkedIn, built by Scribble Links in Mumbai. It runs as a Chrome extension and does the time-consuming LinkedIn work for founders and sales teams: it replies to messages, qualifies leads, books meetings, comments on posts in the user's voice, and finds buying-intent posts. Our customers are founders, sales professionals and agencies who rely on LinkedIn for their pipeline. Our tagline sums it up:
*You're busy. Your LinkedIn isn't.*

The role

As a Closer, your job is to turn interested leads into paying customers. Our telecalling team books demos and our demo team runs them. Once a prospect has seen the demo, they're yours: you follow up, handle objections and close the deal. When it makes sense, you'll also pitch, demo and close prospects yourself, start to finish. Your success is measured by the revenue you close.

Detail

Role

Closer (Sales) – 2 positions

Location

Onsite, Mumbai office

Working days

Monday to Saturday

Timings

9:00 AM – 7:00 PM

Salary

**₹3–3.6 LPA fixed + incentives**
,

Reports to

Founder (COO once hired)

**What you'll do**

* Take over prospects after their demo and close them into paid subscriptions (₹18,000/month per LinkedIn account)
* Run post-demo follow-ups on phone, WhatsApp and video to answer questions and move each prospect to a decision. When needed, run the pitch or demo yourself and close directly
* Understand each prospect's LinkedIn and sales goals, and show how Scribbleli fits them
* Handle objections on price, value, LinkedIn account safety and ROI, and negotiate to a close
* Follow up consistently until every lead is a yes or a clear no
* Spot and pursue bigger opportunities: teams with multiple accounts, agencies and enterprise plans
* Keep every lead, call and deal stage updated in the CRM or tracker
* Meet weekly and monthly closing targets
* Share feedback with the telecalling and demo teams on lead and demo quality, and with the founders on common objections and requests from customers

Who we're looking for

* 1–3 years of experience in closing or inside sales, ideally selling B2B SaaS, subscriptions or services
* A record of meeting targets, with numbers you can talk us through
* Confident, clear spoken English and Hindi; you're comfortable speaking with founders and business owners
* Persistent with follow-ups, and calm when you hear no
* Familiar with LinkedIn; you understand how businesses use it to get clients
* Organised enough to keep your pipeline up to date every day

**Good to have:**
experience selling to founders, agencies or sales teams, or selling marketing and sales tools.

What we offer

* Fixed salary of ₹25,000–30,000 plus incentives on every deal you close
* Most prospects reach you after a demo, so you spend most of your time closing instead of cold calling or pitching from scratch
* A front-row seat at an early-stage AI startup, working directly with the founder
* Room to grow into a senior sales or team-lead role as the team expands

How to apply

Apply through LinkedIn, or send your CV to hr@scribbleli.com with the subject line
**"Closer – [Your Name]"**
. In a few lines, tell us about the biggest deal you've closed and how you closed it.

**Interview process:**
HR call → closing role-play with the Founder → offer.

title: Assistant Sales Manager – West
description:
**Overview**
**About Bruker**
Bruker builds high-performance scientific instruments and analytical solutions that help researchers study life and materials at the molecular, cellular and microscopic level. Our customers work in life science research, pharma, materials science, semiconductors, industrial labs and clinical research.
  
  
We have more than 11,000 employees at over 90 locations worldwide. Our instruments are used in laboratories everywhere, and we keep investing in new technology to solve the analytical problems our customers face today.
  
  
**About The Role**
Bruker India Scientific Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an Assistant Sales Manager to grow our X-ray business in western India. You will sell our X-ray diffraction (XRD), X-ray fluorescence (XRF) and single-crystal X-ray diffraction (SCD) systems to universities, research institutes and industry.
  
  
These are capital-equipment sales with long buying cycles and several decision-makers. You will own each opportunity from the first conversation to the purchase order, working closely with our application scientists, product specialists and service team. Your customers will include IITs, NITs, IISc, IISERs and CSIR labs, as well as companies in pharmaceuticals,cement, glass, metals, , energy storage, semiconductors and geology.
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai (covering Maharashtra, Gujarat and parts of Madhya Pradesh)
  
  
**Reports to:**
Director – Sales & Service, AXS Division, India
  
  
**Employment type:**
Full-time, permanent
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**What You Will Do**

* Build and run a sales plan for your territory, and meet or exceed your sales target for XRD, XRF, SCD, XRM and XMA products.
* Manage the full sales cycle: finding and qualifying leads, understanding customer needs, proposing the right solution, running demos, negotiating and closing.
* Grow business with existing customers and win new accounts across academia, government labs and industry.
* Work with application scientists and product specialists to turn customer requirements into the right Bruker solution.
* Arrange and take part in customer demos at our application lab in Bangalore and at our facilities in Karlsruhe and Berlin, Germany.
* Prepare presentations, quotations, proposals and tender documents, and show customers clearly why Bruker is the better choice.
* Keep Salesforce up to date with opportunities, forecasts and order bookings, and maintain a pipeline of at least 3× your quarterly target.
* Give management accurate monthly, quarterly and annual forecasts.
* Keep track of competitors, market trends and new applications in the region, and share what you learn with the team.
* Represent Bruker at conferences, trade shows, technical meetings and customer events.

**Qualifications**
**What We Are Looking For**

* A degree in Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science, Geology or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience selling scientific instruments or capital equipment, ideally XRD, XRF or similar analytical techniques.
* A good track record of closing complex deals with academic, government and industrial customers, including public tenders.
* Experience working with a CRM system. Salesforce experience is a strong plus.
* Fluent English and Hindi. Marathi, Gujarati or another regional language is an advantage.
* Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
* Well organised and self-motivated, able to handle many opportunities, tenders and stakeholders at the same time.
* A team player who works well with colleagues in applications, service, marketing and back office.

**Travel**
This is a field-based role. Expect to travel 60–70% of the time within your territory, with occasional trips outside it for customer demos, conferences, training and internal meetings, including in Germany.
  
  
**What We Offer**

* The chance to sell instruments that are leaders in their field, in a growing Indian market.
* Product training with our application teams in Karlsruhe and Berlin, Germany, as part of a structured onboarding.
* Close support from a global team of scientists and engineers when you are in front of customers.
* Competitive salary, performance-based incentives and a full benefits package.
* A friendly, collaborative team where initiative is noticed and there is real room to grow your career.

Bruker is an equal-opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

The incumbent will work closely with the CEO and senior leadership to determine where the business should compete, how it should reach customers, which channels should drive growth and how commercial resources can be deployed for maximum effectiveness.

This position calls for a combination of strategic insight, analytical rigour and strong execution capabilities. The individual must be equally comfortable developing business strategies, evaluating market opportunities, designing channel models and driving their implementation on the ground.

KEY RESPONSIBILITY AREAS1. SALES STRATEGY & BUSINESS GROWTH

* Formulate the organisation's sales strategy across markets, projects, customer segments and distribution channels.
* Translate business growth ambitions into actionable sales plans, revenue targets and market-level priorities.
* Identify high-potential markets, customer segments and growth opportunities through structured market assessment.
* Develop market-entry strategies and commercial plans for new geographies and business categories.
* Drive annual business planning, including revenue projections, sales productivity, inventory movement and profitability objectives.
* Evaluate project and market performance to determine resource allocation, sales priorities and growth interventions.
* Establish a forward-looking view of the project portfolio, including launch priorities, inventory lifecycle and phase-wise sales planning.

2. GO-TO-MARKET STRATEGY & EXECUTION

* Develop differentiated GTM strategies for individual projects, markets and customer segments.
* Define market positioning, target customer profiles, value propositions and sales approaches for each launch.
* Lead commercial planning for new project introductions, ensuring alignment between market potential, pricing, channel readiness and sales capacity.
* Design launch strategies covering pre-launch preparation, market activation, sales mobilisation and post-launch performance assessment.
* Develop strategies for opening subsequent inventory phases in existing projects based on demand, absorption trends and competitive positioning.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of existing GTM models and introduce changes to improve market penetration and sales velocity.
* Work with marketing and sales teams to ensure that market positioning and customer acquisition strategies translate into commercial results.

3. CHANNEL STRATEGY & DISTRIBUTION MIX

* Define the optimal channel mix across direct sales, channel partners, digital acquisition, inside sales and other distribution avenues.
* Develop channel-specific strategies based on customer behaviour, market characteristics, project economics and acquisition costs.
* Determine the role, contribution and desired productivity of each channel within the overall sales architecture.
* Build frameworks for channel allocation, partner segmentation, coverage planning and performance evaluation.
* Develop strategies to expand and strengthen the channel partner ecosystem across existing and emerging markets.
* Evaluate channel effectiveness through metrics such as lead contribution, conversion, cost of acquisition, sales velocity and revenue realisation.
* Identify channel conflicts, productivity gaps and opportunities to improve channel economics.
* Recommend changes in channel mix and resource deployment in response to evolving market conditions.
* Establish a structured framework for channel performance reviews, partner engagement and business development.

4. PRICING, PRODUCT & REVENUE STRATEGY

* Drive market-led pricing recommendations in consultation with business leadership.
* Assess project-level pricing competitiveness through competitor benchmarking, customer insights and market absorption trends.
* Evaluate the relationship between pricing, product configuration, customer demand and inventory movement.
* Develop commercial scenarios to support pricing decisions, phase launches and revenue optimisation.
* Track market positioning and price realisation across projects and competing offerings.
* Identify opportunities to improve revenue realisation through pricing interventions, sales schemes and commercial structuring.

5. SALES INTELLIGENCE & PERFORMANCE ANALYTICS

* Develop a comprehensive sales intelligence framework to support strategic and operational decision-making.
* Analyse market demand, customer profiles, competitive activity and geographical sales potential.
* Establish visibility into the complete sales funnel, covering lead generation, qualification, site visits, bookings, closures and collections.
* Develop dashboards and analytical models to monitor sales performance, channel contribution, conversion efficiency and revenue forecasts.
* Identify gaps between business plans and actual performance, with clear recommendations for corrective action.
* Build predictive insights around demand trends, project absorption, channel productivity and sales pipeline movement.
* Strengthen the use of CRM and sales technology platforms to improve data quality, tracking and decision-making.

6. COMMERCIAL GOVERNANCE & CROSS-FUNCTIONAL ALIGNMENT

* Establish a structured operating rhythm for sales strategy reviews, project performance discussions and channel assessments.
* Drive periodic business reviews with clear performance indicators, ownership and action tracking.
* Partner with marketing to align brand campaigns, demand generation and customer acquisition priorities with sales objectives.
* Work closely with regional and project sales teams to translate strategic plans into market-level execution.
* Collaborate with finance and business leadership on revenue planning, commercial assessments and resource allocation.
* Identify execution bottlenecks and drive initiatives to improve sales productivity and organisational effectiveness.
* Institutionalise successful sales practices through standardised frameworks, playbooks and review mechanisms.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTSEXPERIENCE & EDUCATION

* **3–7 years of relevant professional experience**
  in sales strategy, GTM strategy, commercial strategy, business planning or sales excellence.
* **Full-time MBA / PGDM from a top-tier B-school is mandatory.**
  Candidates from IIMs, ISB, XLRI, FMS, SPJIMR, MDI and equivalent premier Indian or international institutions will be consider
* Experience in consumer-facing, real estate, retail, D2C or other multi-channel businesses is preferred.
* Deep understanding and experience from topm Top Real Estate companies in Sales & GTM Strategy is a mandatory requirement.
* Demonstrated involvement in developing and implementing business growth or go-to-market initiatives.

KEY SKILLS & ATTRIBUTES

* **Sales Strategy:**
  Ability to develop structured sales growth strategies, translate business objectives into market-level plans and identify revenue opportunities.
* **GTM Expertise:**
  Strong understanding of market segmentation, customer targeting, positioning, launch strategy and market penetration.
* **Channel Architecture:**
  Understanding of multi-channel distribution models, channel economics, partner ecosystems and channel productivity.
* **Commercial Acumen:**
  Ability to evaluate revenue drivers, pricing, sales productivity, acquisition costs and profitability.
* **Analytical Capability:**
  Strong command over business analytics, financial modelling, market research and data interpretation.
* **Strategic Problem Solving:**
  Ability to break down complex business challenges and develop practical, commercially viable solutions.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Confidence in working with senior leadership and influencing cross-functional teams.
* **Execution Orientation:**
  Ability to move beyond recommendations and drive implementation with measurable outcomes.

SUCCESS IN THE ROLE

The individual will be expected to build a stronger, more predictable and scalable sales engine by:

* Creating a clear and actionable sales strategy across markets and projects.
* Establishing the right GTM approach for different projects and customer segments.
* Optimising channel mix and improving the productivity and commercial contribution of each channel.
* Improving sales velocity, conversion rates and revenue predictability.
* Strengthening market intelligence and data-led commercial decision-making.
* Enabling the organisation to scale its sales operations while maintaining commercial discipline.

**This is an opportunity for a high-performing MBA professional to work directly with senior leadership, influence business growth decisions and shape the sales and distribution strategy of an expanding real estate platform.**

title: Coffee Program Manager
description:
**Coffee Program Manager**

**About the Role:**

We're looking for a Coffee Program Manager who can do two things equally well: dream up drinks people want to talk about, and build the systems that let multiple outlets execute them exactly the same way, every time. This role does not include roasting or green coffee sourcing — that sits with our Head Roaster and Quality Team. Your world is the bar: recipes, technique, equipment, training, and the guest-facing experience across every location. This is a role for someone who gets genuinely excited about a new milk texture or extraction tweak, but who also can't stand watching a great drink get executed inconsistently three miles away.

**What You'll Own:**

**Menu & Drink Development**

● Design and test new beverages (espresso-based, batch, seasonal, non-coffee) from concept to menu-ready

● Stay ahead of trends and translate them into drinks that fit our brand and margins

● Partner with the Head Roaster and Quality Team to build drinks around each roast's strengths

● Run tastings and calibration sessions to pressure-test new recipes before rollout

**Operations & Consistency**

●
Build and maintain SOPs and recipe specs (dial-in parameters, pour ratios, milk temps, presentation) so every outlet produces the same cup

● Design and run training programs for baristas and shift leads, including onboarding and skill certification ● Set up quality-control checks (cupping, spot audits, secret-shopper visits) across all outlets

● Manage equipment standards and maintenance schedules to eliminate variance from bad kit

● Own recipe costing and pour costs; balance creativity against margin targets

**Cross-Outlet Execution**

● Visit outlets regularly to audit execution against spec, not just review reports

● Create feedback loops so issues at one location get fixed everywhere, not just patched locally

● Coordinate menu rollouts and timing across all locations so launches land together

● Assist with B2B Accounts and Quality Programs where required

● Conduct Coffee Workshops when required (Customer Facing)

**What You Bring**

● 3+ years managing a multi-location beverage or coffee program, or equivalent experience running a high-volume single site with clear ambition to scale

● A track record of drinks you've created that actually shipped and sold

● Deep hands-on espresso/bar craft — a genuinely trained palate that can dial in, identify defects, and talk origin characteristics

● Systems thinking: your default is “how do I make this repeatable,” not just “how do I make this good once”

● Comfortable building training materials, SOPs, and checklists from scratch

● Basic P&L literacy — pour cost, recipe costing, labor impact of menu decisions

● Willingness to travel regularly between outlets

**Nice to Have**

● Experience working alongside a dedicated roasting/quality team and large team of Baristas

● Competition or judging experience (barista competitions, cupping certifications)

● Experience launching a new outlet's bar program from zero

● Experience with a range of equipments such as semi-automatic and automatic

#LI-Remote

* 8+ years of experience in publications within a pharma company or medical communications agency.

* Proven leadership in managing people and projects both directly and via matrixed or indirect leadership.
* Excellent communication skills.

* Multimedia and omnichannel experience.

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process includes two Technical Interviews with the Hiring Manager and peers, and a Technical Assessment, where candidates will have agreed upon timeline to complete the task. The final round will be the HR Interview. All interactions will be conducted virtually via MS Teams.

**AI at Cactus Life Sciences**  
The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.  
AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.  
We believe in Human-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline - science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.  
You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.

**Equal Opportunity**

Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

About Us:

At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.

Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

#### **What you'll do**

* **Produce the monthly HG Insider.** Work with Product Management on the agenda and slides, and own registration pages, calendar invites and on-demand publishing.

* **Close the loop with CSMs.** Turn registration, attendance and poll results into Vitally tasks and notes, and post account updates to customer Slack channels.
* **Grow the audience.** Carry out the Academy communication plan: invite emails, personal outreach to past registrants, and in-app and CSM-led promotion.
* **Support the community.** Help run the Power User Community, product roundtables and Customer Advisory Board sessions with CS and Marketing.
* **Report on impact.** Track enrollment, attendance, certification, and product adoption for customers who train.
* **Direct intern work** on customer education tasks.

#### **What we are looking for**

* 2 to 4 years in customer education, customer training or customer onboarding at a B2B SaaS company.
* Experience with an customer-focused LMS such as Thought Industries, Skilljar or Docebo, and a webinar platform such as Zoom or Sequel.
* Comfort editing video content with production and post-production tools such as Descript or Camtasia.
* Confidence teaching live to customer audiences and working with product managers.
* Strong organization with operational detail: registrations, CRM and CS platform records, calendars.

* Instructional design training or certification.
* HTML and CSS for LMS page customization.
* Experience with Salesforce and Vitally (or a similar CS platform).
* Experience using AI tools (such as Claude) to speed up course drafts and reporting.

**What we offer/Benefits**

We take care of our people fully and genuinely. Every HG Insights employee receives comprehensive healthcare coverage for themselves and their families, a monthly wellness reimbursement and access to Able To professional mental health coaching for stress, anxiety and depression support as per the regions. For your financial future, US employees benefit from a 401(k) with up to 5% company matching and all UK employees are enrolled in a pension scheme. Every employee also receives stock options because the people who build this company should share in its success.

We invest in your growth through an annual learning reimbursement and a genuine commitment to developing your career at every stage. And through our Culture Club, you will always have a real voice in shaping the kind of workplace we build together.

#### **Equal Opportunity Employer**

Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted directly to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of HG Insights.

title: Engineering Manager II
description:
**What you will do**

Lead the Air Handling Unit (AHU) engineering function for the India region, owning both product development and manufacturing engineering. Build and manage a team of design, product development and manufacturing engineers to deliver competitive, India-specific AHU platforms from concept, design, prototyping and testing through to production release and ramp-up. Translate the needs of the Indian market, including tropical climate conditions, high latent loads, indoor air quality and energy-efficiency requirements, into reliable, cost-optimized and manufacturable products. Partner with manufacturing, quality, supply chain, sales and marketing to ensure product feasibility, on-time launches and alignment with business goals. Drive manufacturing excellence on the shop floor through robust processes, lean practices and continuous cost and quality improvement. Ensure compliance with relevant codes, standards and safety regulations, mentor engineering talent, and support customer-facing teams with technical expertise and engineered-to-order solutions.

**How you will do it**

* Lead and manage a multi-disciplinary team of design, product development and factory engineers for AHU products, including modular, double-skin, ceiling-suspended, fresh-air/heat-recovery and hygienic/clean-room AHUs.
* Drive end-to-end new product development for India-specific AHU platforms, from voice of customer and concept through design, prototyping, validation, certification and production release, using a stage-gate approach.
* Oversee AHU design covering casing and panel construction, thermal-break profiles, coils, fan and motor selection (including EC/plug fans), filtration, heat recovery devices, dampers and acoustic treatment.
* Lead manufacturing engineering hands-on: process design, plant and line balancing and capacity planning for AHU production.
* Own new product introduction (NPI) into the factory, including pilot builds, first-article inspection, process qualification and smooth ramp-up to volume production.
* Drive DFM/DFA, value analysis/value engineering (VA/VE), localization and cost-reduction programs in partnership with procurement and the Indian supply base.
* Establish and maintain engineering and manufacturing documentation, including 3D models, drawings, BOMs, routings, work instructions, PFMEA and control plans, with accurate data in PLM/ERP systems.
* Improve productivity, quality and yield on the shop floor using Lean, 5S, Kaizen, SMED and Six Sigma tools, and reduce cost of poor quality.
* Plan and oversee product testing and validation, including casing leakage, deflection, thermal bridging, airflow, thermal and acoustic performance.
* Ensure product compliance with relevant standards such as EN 1886, EN 13053, AHRI 430/1350, Eurovent, ASHRAE/ISHRAE guidelines, ECBC, BIS and applicable safety regulations.
* Support sales, application and customer teams with technical expertise, product selection and customized or engineered-to-order solutions.
* Collaborate with global engineering centers to adapt global AHU platforms for India and to leverage India manufacturing for export markets.
* Mentor and develop engineers, and foster a safety-first culture of continuous improvement and cross-functional collaboration.

**What we look for**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree (BE/B.Tech) in Mechanical Engineering.
* 10+ years of experience in HVAC, with strong hands-on AHU product development experience for the India market, including at least 3 years in a leadership or managerial role.
* Proven hands-on experience managing manufacturing engineering in an AHU or HVAC equipment manufacturing environment, including process development, tooling, layout and NPI.
* Strong knowledge of psychrometrics, thermodynamics, heat transfer, fluid mechanics and fan/airflow fundamentals.
* Sound understanding of AHU manufacturing processes such as sheet-metal fabrication, panel foaming (PU/PIR), coil manufacturing and final assembly.
* Proficiency in CAD and PLM/ERP tools (e.g., Creo, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Windchill, SAP).
* Experience with product development processes, DFMEA, PFMEA, DVP&R, APQP and stage-gate methodologies.
* Familiarity with Indian and global AHU standards and certifications (EN 1886, EN 13053, AHRI, Eurovent, ECBC, BIS).
* Excellent communication, project management and team leadership skills.

**Preferred**

* Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or an MBA.
* Experience with hygienic, clean-room, pharma, healthcare or data center AHU applications.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Exposure to CFD/FEA tools and AHU selection software.
* Prior experience working with global teams and suppliers.

title: Head- QA & QC(Printing & Packaging Industry)
description:
**1. Job Purpose**

To lead and govern the organisation’s quality function across India by establishing a centralised quality management framework, ensuring consistent product and process standards across all plants, meeting customer and regulatory requirements, reducing quality losses and strengthening a culture of prevention and continuous improvement. The role is accountable for overall quality performance across locations and for developing capable branch-level QA/QC teams.

**2. Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**A. Pan-India Quality Governance and Standardization**

* Develop, implement and periodically review the organisation-wide quality policy, objectives, procedures, SOPs and quality standards.

* Establish common inspection plans, sampling methods, acceptance criteria, control plans and documentation formats across all plants.

* Ensure consistent implementation of customer specifications, approved artwork, colour standards and product requirements at every location.

* Maintain a central quality dashboard and provide periodic performance reviews and escalations to senior management.

**B. Process Quality Assurance and Quality Control**

* Establish quality controls from incoming materials through prepress, CTP, printing, finishing, packing and dispatch.

* Define and monitor quality parameters for paper, board, ink, varnish, adhesive and other packaging materials.

* Ensure checks for colour consistency, shade variation, registration, print defects, dimensions, GSM, barcode readability, die-cutting, creasing, pasting strength and finishing quality, as applicable.

* Ensure first-off approval, in-process inspection, final inspection, traceability, product identification and control of non-conforming output.

* Work with Production, Prepress, Planning, Purchase, Stores and Maintenance to prevent defects at source.

**C. Plant Audits and Performance Monitoring**

* Conduct planned quality system, process and product audits at all manufacturing locations.

* Review plant-wise rejection, rework, customer complaints, first-pass yield, process deviations and cost of poor quality.

* Benchmark branch performance, identify gaps and implement time-bound improvement plans.

* Verify the effectiveness and sustainability of corrective actions through follow-up audits and data.

**D. Customer Quality and Complaint Management**

* Lead resolution of critical and repeat customer complaints and quality escalations.

* Ensure structured root cause analysis using tools such as 5 Why, Fishbone and Pareto analysis.

* Approve or review corrective and preventive action plans and monitor closure within agreed timelines.

* Coordinate with Sales, Marketing and plant teams for customer visits, quality reviews, trials and technical discussions.

* Ensure lessons learned from complaints are communicated and applied across all relevant plants.

**E. Quality Management Systems and Compliance**

* Maintain and improve the quality management system and support compliance with applicable standards, customer requirements and statutory obligations.

* Coordinate internal, external, certification and customer audits and ensure timely closure of findings.

* Control quality-related documents, records, specifications, calibration and measuring equipment systems.

* Promote risk-based thinking, process discipline and continual improvement.

**F. Supplier and Incoming Material Quality**

* Define supplier quality requirements and incoming inspection standards for key raw materials and consumables.

* Work with Purchase and Stores to monitor supplier performance, material non-conformities and corrective actions.

* Support supplier evaluations, audits and improvement initiatives where required.

**G. Leadership, Capability Building and Culture**

* Lead, coach and develop branch QA/QC Heads, Managers, Supervisors and Inspectors.

* Define roles, responsibilities, competency requirements and performance expectations for quality teams.

* Develop annual technical and behavioural training plans and verify training effectiveness.

* Build quality ownership among employees and promote the principle that quality is everyone’s responsibility.

* Ensure adequate quality manpower, succession cover and consistent working practices across locations.

**H. Cost of Quality and Continuous Improvement**

* Drive reduction in internal rejection, customer rejection, rework, wastage and quality-related returns.

* Identify and lead improvement projects using appropriate problem-solving and process-improvement tools.

* Quantify the cost of poor quality and track savings and benefits from improvement initiatives.

* Share successful practices across plants and ensure standardisation of proven improvements.

**3. Functional Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of printing and packaging processes, including mono cartons, labels and leaflets.

* Knowledge of prepress, CTP, offset / relevant printing processes, colour management and finishing operations.

* Knowledge of paper, board, ink, varnish, adhesives and packaging material characteristics.

* Quality management systems, preferably ISO 9001; internal / lead auditor capability.

* Inspection planning, sampling, measurement systems and calibration controls.

* Root cause analysis, CAPA, 5 Why, Fishbone, Pareto, SPC and risk-based process control.

* Customer audit management, supplier quality and quality documentation.

**4. Behavioural and Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic and systems thinking; ability to translate business priorities into quality objectives.

* Leadership, coaching and development of geographically distributed teams.

* Analytical thinking, sound judgement and evidence-based decision-making.

* Customer orientation, ownership and accountability.

* Cross-functional collaboration, influencing and conflict resolution.

* Communication, presentation and management reporting skills.

* Integrity and the confidence to escalate critical quality risks independently.

* Change management and continuous improvement orientation.

**5. Key Deliverables**

* A standardised quality management system implemented across all manufacturing locations.

* Monthly consolidated and plant-wise quality performance dashboard for senior management.

* Annual quality improvement roadmap with measurable targets and ownership.

* Risk-based audit calendar and timely closure of audit observations.

* Effective customer complaint and CAPA process with controls to prevent recurrence.

* Competent branch quality teams with defined roles, training and performance goals.

* Demonstrable reduction in rejection, rework, customer complaints and cost of poor quality.
