title: Senior Manager (Content and Training)
description:
Job Title:
**Senior Manager (Content and Training)**

Location:
**Pune**

Travel:
**As per the project need**

**Position Overview:**

* Vocational education is now part of school learning from Grade 6. NEP 2020 and NCF-SE 2023 set the direction, and CBSE has started Kaushal Bodh for Grades 6–8 and Kaushal Vikas for Grades 9–10.
* Done well, children learn by building, growing, cooking and repairing. They understand how things work, respect all kinds of work, and see more choices for their future. Done badly, it becomes one more period on the timetable.
* Two things decide which one happens: how well teachers are prepared, and whether their material works in a real classroom. This role builds both as one system, and helps states use it at scale.

**Purpose of the role:**

* You will find the needs that keep coming up across states, build solutions many states can use, and help each state adapt them without losing what makes them work. You will always look for ways to reach more teachers with less manual effort, using technology where it helps and keeping people where they matter most.
* You will set the standard for how LAHI prepares teachers and builds learning material, and lead a small team that designs training and material.

**What you will do:**

* Prepare teachers and trainers. Decide what teachers, trainers, mentors and master trainers should be able to do, and build the path to get there. People move up by showing they can do the work, not by attending. Build a training cascade: a small group of strong trainers prepares the next level, who then prepare teachers. Support teachers after training through mentors, peer groups and short refreshers.
* Build material that works in many states. Keep the teaching approach, core skills, safety and assessment the same everywhere. Let language, local trades and examples change. Decide what to reuse, improve, build or stop using, including the material LAHI has built over twenty years, and make sure it works in schools with few resources. Keep one shared library, with one correct version of each resource and one person responsible for it.
* Release complete packages, and keep improving them. Each package has the student material, the teacher training to use it, and a way to check what students learned. Each must show what students will learn, what practical work helps, and what proves they learned it. You own their quality: try packages in real classrooms, learn from teachers and student work, and make the next version better.
* Use technology to do more with less manual work. For example: online modules for the knowledge part of training, AI-assisted drafts and translations checked by people, and simple phone tools for teacher support and observation.
* Work with state teams and state institutions. Our state teams bring real needs and deadlines from government. Work closely with them, and notice when several states need the same thing. Strengthen SCERTs, DIETs and district trainers so they can run day-to-day teacher training themselves, to the same standard.
* Lead the team. Guide the team and specialists, and manage budgets and timelines. When states need different things at once, decide what comes first and explain why.

**What success looks like:**

* Teachers use the material well in classrooms, and trainers can observe their work and help them improve.
* Students can show what they learned through practical work, not just that they did the activity.
* Material is reused across states without losing quality.
* States run more of the day-to-day training themselves.

**Who you will work with:**

* Your closest partners are LAHI’s state teams. You will lead a small team, including a senior associate for teacher training, writers, instructional designers and designers, supported by subject and language specialists.
* Training reaches teachers through master trainers and state and district trainers. Outside LAHI, you will work with SCERTs, DIETs, state departments, boards, universities and local practitioners.

**What will be demanding:**

* Several states may need different things urgently at once, and you will be asked to release work before it is tested.
* You will need to tell apart what one state needs now from what every state will need, keep quality while offering a practical way forward, and travel often to stay close to schools.

**About Lend A Hand India :**

For twenty years, Lend A Hand India has worked to make vocational education a real part of school learning. Our work reaches more than 20 states, 20,000 schools, 25,000 trainers and over 20 lakh students. India’s Economic Survey 2023–24 named our model as an example of how vocational education can work in schools. In many states, our teams work inside the state government as project management units.

Until now, we mostly ran programmes ourselves. Now we are becoming a resource organisation, helping governments run this work well on their own.

**Our Mission**

Equip School Students to Maximise Their Potential Through Skill Education

**Our Approach**

* Direct implementation in schools
* Partnership with central-state governments to define, and scale policy
* Building of Centres of Excellence that act as lighthouses for innovation
* Resource organisation for the skilling ecosystem

**Our Knowledge in Action**

Through the design & execution of innovative models from training centres, innovation hubs to mobile outreach initiatives, LAHI’s innovative knowledge resource drives both grassroots learning and systemic transformation across India. With 250+ LAHI staff embedded in state education systems across 20+ states, we provide technical and project management support, enabling governments to translate policy into action.

**Our Reach**

LAHI’s current scale of work includes -

* 20+ States and UTs
* 15000+ Schools
* 15 Lakh+ Students
* 250+ Team Members

**Who we are looking for**

* Most important: you have designed and run teacher training at scale, including training of trainers and master trainers, and you can watch a session and give feedback people can use the next day.
* About 12–15 years in teacher development, teacher education, curriculum or learning material, including leading a team.
* You know enough about curriculum and instructional design to set standards and judge whether material teaches well.
* You have worked with government education systems and worked to government timelines.
* You can find the common need behind many requests.
* You have managed external content partners and held their work to a clear quality standard.
* You can see where digital and AI tools can save effort at scale, and where people must stay involved. You do not need to be a technical expert.

Useful: vocational or skill education, more than one Indian language, university partnerships.

**How we will choose**

* We will discuss one lesson from a middle-school vocational subject with you: what practical work helps, how a t
* Teacher who is not a trade expert could run it, what shows learning, how to prepare trainers across a state, and which parts technology could handle. There is no model answer. We want to see how you think.

**Why join us**

* You will shape how lakhs of teachers are prepared, at the moment vocational education enters every school in India.
* You will work with governments, not around them, and see your work used in many states. And you will build something designed to last.

This is a hands-on program and content role. You'll build courses, produce sessions and run the operations behind them, working with Product Management, Customer Success and Marketing. * 4–10 years of experience in product development and service of laser machines, marking systems, automation.

* Experience with field troubleshooting and customer interaction is a strong advantage.

**Required Skills:**

* Familiarity with marking software, galvo tuning, and embedded control systems.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Knowledge of PCB design, solid works.

title: Regulatory Affairs Business Manager
description:
Job Title
  
  
Regulatory Affairs Business Manager
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the Role**
The Regulatory Affairs Business Manager plays a key role in supporting product development, regulatory approvals, market access, and product lifecycle management. The role ensures that regulatory, quality, safety, and product compliance requirements are effectively integrated throughout the product lifecycle.
  
  
Working closely with R&D, Lifecycle Management (LCM), Quality, Manufacturing, Clinical, and other cross-functional teams, the specialist translates regulatory and compliance requirements into practical solutions that enable business teams to deliver compliant products while maintaining project timelines.
  
  
The role also involves coordinating regulatory submissions, product registrations, global certifications, compliance testing, labeling, and technical documentation. It requires a collaborative, pragmatic, and solution-oriented professional who can engage with internal stakeholders, external testing laboratories, and certification bodies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the planning, preparation, and coordination of regulatory submissions, product registrations, certifications, and clearances across applicable markets.
* Partner with R&D, LCM, Quality, Manufacturing, Clinical, and other functions to integrate regulatory, quality, safety, and compliance requirements into new product development and lifecycle management.
* Interpret regulatory requirements, international standards, and internal policies and translate them into actionable product requirements and practical solutions.
* Coordinate product compliance activities to ensure alignment with applicable regulations, international standards, and company requirements.
* Establish and maintain relationships with external certification bodies and testing laboratories, coordinating product testing, verification, certification, and technical documentation.
* Monitor changes in relevant regulations and standards, evaluate their impact, and support implementation across business and product teams.
* Review development plans, quality documentation, technical evidence, and test reports to support verification and validation of regulatory and compliance requirements.
* Support product labeling, packaging, and regulatory documentation for applicable markets.
* Evaluate regulatory and compliance implications of product lifecycle changes, including design, components, suppliers, manufacturing processes, and labeling.
* Support internal and external audits, inspections, and associated corrective and follow-up activities.
* Provide practical regulatory guidance to cross-functional teams, helping stakeholders navigate compliance requirements and achieve business objectives.
* Continuously build expertise in relevant products, technologies, regulations, standards, and certification requirements and share knowledge across teams.

**Required Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in engineering or a relevant scientific/technical discipline, such as Biomedical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, Materials Engineering, Life Sciences, or Health Sciences.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in Regulatory Affairs, Product Compliance, Quality Compliance, Product Development, or a related technical function.
* Experience within medical devices, healthcare technology, consumer health, or other regulated product environments.

**Mandatory Skills And Experience**

* Experience supporting New Product Development (NPD) and/or Lifecycle Management (LCM) activities.
* Exposure to regulatory clearances, product registrations, testing, certification, labeling, compliance, or market access.
* Working knowledge of product safety and compliance standards, including IEC 60335IEC 60601EMC requirements Radio/Wireless compliance RoHS and REACH Global environmental compliance requirements.
* Experience coordinating with external testing laboratories and certification bodies for global product certification.
* Ability to understand and manage technical documentation, test reports, certification evidence, and compliance records.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including R&D, Engineering, Clinical, Quality, Manufacturing, Product Management, and Supply Chain.
* Ability to translate complex regulatory and technical requirements into practical actions and solutions.

**Preferred Skills And Competencies**

* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.
* Good understanding of products, technologies, and product development processes.
* Pragmatic, collaborative, and solution-oriented approach to problem-solving.
* Ability to build strong internal and external stakeholder networks.
* Knowledge of regulatory strategy implementation, regulatory intelligence, risk assessment, and mitigation.
* Project coordination and management capabilities.
* Curiosity and willingness to continuously learn about emerging technologies, regulations, and global standards.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Timely coordination of regulatory submissions, testing, and product certifications.
* Effective integration of regulatory and compliance requirements into product development and lifecycle activities.
* Strong collaboration with cross-functional teams and external certification partners.
* Proactive identification of regulatory changes and associated product compliance risks.
* Enabling business teams to achieve compliant product outcomes without unnecessary delays to project execution.

**How We Work Together**
We believe that we are better together than apart. For our office-based teams, this means working in-person at least 3 days per week. Onsite roles require full-time presence in the company’s facilities. Field roles are most effectively done outside of the company’s main facilities, generally at the customers’ or suppliers’ locations.
  
  
This is an office-based role.
  
  
**About Philips**
Are you ready to do the work of your life to help the lives of others? Learn more about our business, discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose.
  
  
If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care.

title: AI SDLC Enablement Lead
description:
**Who We Are**
Worldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across the globe. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.
  
  
Long Description
  
  
**About The Role**
Worldline has deployed Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, the AI-SDLC Portal, MCP integrations and the JedAI Champions Program. We’re looking for an AI-SDLC Enablement Lead to turn these foundations into measurable, lasting engineering outcomes across approximately 2,500 engineers.
  
  
You will own the enablement, adoption, measurement and improvement cycle for AI-assisted engineering—connecting tools and practices to productivity, engineering velocity and cost-of-change.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
**Lead the enablement flywheel**

* Own the continuous cycle of enable, adopt, measure and improve.
* Set the strategy, capacity and measurement model for AI-SDLC adoption.
* Align roadmaps with Engineering Excellence leadership, Product Owners and technical advocates.

**Scale the Champions network**

* Grow JedAI into a resourced, multi-site programme, empowering Champions to coach their teams.
* Build tiered learning pathways for fluent teams and broader engineering cohorts.
* Run power-user learning and office hours to keep skills current.

**Build readiness and efficiency measurement**

* Develop a deterministic repository-readiness audit covering standards, guardrails, architecture and test quality, running in Worldline’s environment.
* Establish AI usage and cost telemetry, including token economy, cache-hit rates and model mix.

**Prove business impact**

* Develop a robust before-and-after methodology using measures such as cycle time, review time and throughput.
* Report outcomes through existing AURA and Statistics dashboards, in business-relevant terms—not unsupported hours-saved claims.

**Codify advanced practice**

* Turn existing Jira, Confluence and GitLab MCP integrations into a governed ticket-to-merge-request workflow.
* Establish governance for a shared AI skills library, so proven practices can be reused safely.

**Influence across teams**
Partner with Developer Platform & Experience, Quality & Automation, Security Engineering & Enablement, and Tech Enablement & AI-Powered Engineering. Shape AI-first ways of working, including governance for AI artifacts, guardrails and shift-left security. Influence across sites and teams without formal line authority.
  
  
What you bring
  
  

* 3–5+ years in developer enablement, platform engineering, technical training, or senior/staff engineering with a strong coaching record.
* Daily hands-on experience with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot or similar AI development tools.
* Working knowledge of MCP, RAG/codebase indexing and agentic workflows, or a track record of quickly adopting new technologies.
* Strong analytical skills and experience defining adoption or productivity measures and presenting credible business cases.
* Experience building Champions networks or communities of practice across distributed teams.
* Excellent facilitation and stakeholder skills; fluent English.

You are engineer-focused, curious, data-driven and comfortable setting clear goals and reassessment gates. You enjoy developing others and balancing long-term strategy with practical delivery.
  
  
**Desirable:**
Developer-productivity dashboards; FinOps or AI/cloud cost optimization; security or compliance experience; managing external enablement partners.

title: Engineer_ Manufacturing Engineering
description:
HUSCO provides individuals with the opportunity to pursue a career within a fast-paced, industry-leading and entrepreneurial organization.
  
  
HUSCO is committed to building a diverse environment for employees to be able:
  
  

* To have the flexibility to put a personal ‘stamp’ on their work
* To continuously expand and develop their professional skills, knowledge, and career
* To create a product for our customers that serves a greater purpose to communities around the world

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**
Under general supervision, ME will identify, lead, and implement manufacturing process improvement initiatives by applying established engineering principles, analytical techniques, and hands-on problem-solving approaches to business challenges at HUSCO India Pune (HIP). The role is responsible for driving productivity, quality, cost, safety, and operational excellence improvements while providing comprehensive Manufacturing Engineering (ME) support to ensure efficient and uninterrupted production operations. The position requires close collaboration with cross-functional teams to support new product introductions, optimize manufacturing processes, implement automation and tooling solutions, enhance process capability, and sustain world-class manufacturing standards. Closely work with Corporate Manufacturing Engineering at Husco USA and implement standard manufacturing practices for productivity improvement.
  
  
**PRINCIPAL DUTIES:**
Below are the principal duties listed but not limited to,
  
  

* New Product Introduction (NPI)
* Prepare and review product documentation, technical literature, and work instructions in line with APQP and or Customer requirements.
* Develop and maintain PFDs, PFMEAs, Control Plans, SOPs, and PPAP documentation.
* Coordinate with Engineering and Project Management teams to achieve customer project timelines.
* Develop engineering and pilot samples and generate required validation reports.
* Capacity Planning and Installation and Commissioning of new Capital equipment.
* Develop newer suppliers to broaden supply base and gain cost competitiveness for the new Capital purchases.
* Process Engineering & Manufacturing Support
* Design and optimize manufacturing process flows.
* Develop efficient material handling systems and layouts.
* Provide technical support for honing, assembly, testing, and new product launches.
* Establish manufacturing processes from prototype through mass production.
* Tooling, Jigs & Fixtures
* Design and develop jigs, fixtures, and automation solutions to improve productivity.
* Conduct tooling trials and production validation.
* Manage tooling inventory and implement tool management systems.
* Lead selection, procurement, and qualification of capital equipment.
* Quality & Continuous Improvement
* Review manufacturing processes to ensure product quality and process compliance.
* Analyze process and test data to identify improvements.
* Apply Statistical Process Control (SPC) and data analysis using Minitab or Quantum XL, or similar software.
* Support customer audits, PPAP submissions, and quality system requirements.
* Hands-on Engineering & Problem Solving
* Perform product builds, testing, troubleshooting, validation, and equipment repairs.
* Support customer field activities when required.
* Independently execute engineering projects and implement process improvements.
* Cost & Productivity Improvement
* Conduct cost-benefit analyses for process and product changes.
* Identify and implement cost-reduction opportunities without compromising quality.
* Drive productivity, automation, ergonomics, and operational efficiency initiatives.

**AUTHORITIES:**

* Represents Manufacturing function in Customer process audits.
* Process trials in case of issues within process parameters and coordinate Change management process.
* Establish and refine process parameters without affecting product function while achieving >95% First time through. Coordinates this with CFT for relevant approvals before conclusions are implemented.
* Raise MR/PR’s and input Routings in IFS.
* Stop product if being produced outside of process parameters / product parameters.
* Train team members and recommend retraining where necessary.

**REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor or Master’s degree (BE/B-Tech, ME/M-Tech) in Mechanical/Production/Industrial/Mechatronics or related Engg discipline with reasonable years of hands-on experience in a similar role.
* Minimum 3-5 years of manufacturing or maintenance engineering experience, including a demonstrated ability to apply engineering principles to solve business problems.
* Ability to draft Bills of Materials (BOMs), detailed component data sheets, FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis), and engineering change notices (ECNs)
* Electromechanical Integration: Working knowledge of electronic controls, vision systems, various sensors, PLCs, and proportional/servo driver cards used in modern electro-hydraulic systems is preferred.
* Basics of Labview and other Automation techniques including Robotics is an added advantage.
* Experience in troubleshooting pressure leaks, bench-testing hydraulic power units (HPUs), preparation of test programs.
* Readiness to work in any production shift as per organizational needs and support production. To ensure maximum productivity and quality of product.
* Experience using any of the ERP systems like Oracle/IFS/SAP preferred.
* In depth knowledge of basics in engineering, Shopfloor layout design and exposure to CAD/Creo preferred.
* Knowledge of ISO 9001-2015 & ISO 14001, TPM, LEAN and Six Sigma Methodology is preferred.
* Knowledge of Hydraulic Control Systems and their application preferred.

**Who We Are:**
Imagine a place where your career can soar, where innovation meets excellence, and where your contributions truly matter. Welcome to Husco.
  
  
Here, you’ll find the freedom to shape your work and leave a lasting impact. We believe in empowering you to grow personally and professionally, continuously enhancing your skills and knowledge.
  
  
Your role at Husco goes beyond the ordinary – you’ll be at the forefront of supporting teams that develop innovative hydraulic and electro-mechanical systems that enhance efficiency and performance. These products make a real difference globally, building the communities we live in, growing the food that feeds us, and enhancing transportation around the world.
  
  
Join our vibrant, industry-leading team and experience a culture that values your creativity, dedication, and drive. Together, we’re not just achieving goals; we’re setting new standards and making a positive impact every day.
  
  
**HUSCO IS PROUD TO BE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.**

**Job Title: Officer - School Partnerships & Outreach**

**Location: Pune**

**Position Overview:**

We are looking for a highly driven and relationship-oriented
**School Partnerships & Outreach Officer**
to help us build and grow partnerships with schools.

This is a
**frontline school partnerships role**
. The person will be responsible for identifying and reaching out to schools, building relationships with key decision-makers, understanding their needs, presenting our offering, negotiating commercials and terms, and taking conversations through to closure.

The ideal candidate will have
**strong experience working with CBSE schools**
, preferably in an Edtech, education services, publishing, curriculum, learning solutions or related organization.

We are looking for someone who understands that selling to schools is fundamentally about
**trust, relationships, educational value and long-term partnerships**
, not simply making sales calls.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. School Outreach & Lead Generation**

* Identify and build a pipeline of relevant schools, particularly CBSE schools.
* Reach out to school leaders including Principals, Directors, Academic Heads, Coordinators and other decision-makers.
* Develop relationships with school networks, educators and other relevant stakeholders.
* Set up meetings and demonstrations with schools.
* Develop creative and effective approaches to opening conversations with schools.

**2. Relationship Building**

* Build strong, long-term relationships with school leadership and decision-makers.
* Understand the school’s priorities, challenges, academic approach and decision-making process.
* Act as a trusted partner and represent the organisation professionally.
* Maintain relationships even when a school is not immediately ready to partner.

**3. Sales & Partnership Conversion**

* Own the school partnership journey from first conversation → meeting → proposal → negotiation → closure → onboarding.
* Understand the school’s requirements and position our offering appropriately.
* Create and present proposals and partnership plans.
* Handle objections and concerns confidently.
* Negotiate pricing, commercial terms and partnership structures within agreed parameters.
* Drive conversations towards clear next steps and ultimately close partnerships.

**4. School Ecosystem Understanding**

* Develop a strong understanding of how CBSE schools operate and make purchasing/partnership decisions.
* Understand the different stakeholders involved in school decisions and how to navigate them.
* Keep track of relevant developments in the school and education ecosystem.
* Gather insights from schools and feed them back to the product/program/team.

**5. Pipeline & Reporting**

* Maintain an organised pipeline of prospects and opportunities.
* Track conversations, meetings, proposals, negotiations and closures through the CRM.
* Provide regular updates on pipeline, conversion rates, challenges and opportunities.
* Continuously improve outreach and conversion strategies based on what is working.

**About Lend A Hand India :**
Lend A Hand India (LAHI) is a leading national Think Tank/NGO with over 20 years of experience in strengthening India’s skill and vocational education ecosystem. LAHI works closely with 20+ State and UT governments through long-term partnerships, providing technical advisory and Project Management Unit (PMU) support to drive systemic reforms.

**Our Mission**

Equip School Students to Maximise Their Potential Through Skill Education

**Our Approach**

* Direct implementation in schools
* Partnership with central-state governments to define, and scale policy
* Building of Centres of Excellence that act as lighthouses for innovation
* Resource organisation for the skilling ecosystem

**Our Knowledge in Action**

Through the design & execution of innovative models from training centres, innovation hubs to mobile outreach initiatives, LAHI’s innovative knowledge resource drives both grassroots learning and systemic transformation across India. With 250+ LAHI staff embedded in state education systems across 20+ states, we provide technical and project management support, enabling governments to translate policy into action.

**Our Reach**

LAHI’s current scale of work includes -

* 20+ States and UTs
* 15000+ Schools
* 15 Lakh+ Students
* 250+ Team Members

**Minimum Experience:**

* **4+ years of experience in school-facing sales & partnerships.**
* Experience working directly with
  **CBSE schools**
  .
* Prior experience in
  **EdTech, education services, curriculum, publishing, school programs or a related education business**
  .
* Demonstrated ability to take a conversation from initial outreach to
  **successful closure**
  .
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Strong negotiation and persuasion skills.
* Comfort interacting with Principals, School Directors, Academic Heads and senior educators.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of targets and outcomes.

**Educational Background:**

* **Bachelor’s degree**
  in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, Education, Commerce, or a related field.
* **Master’s degree/MBA in Marketing, Business Development, Education or a related discipline**
  would be an advantage.
* Candidates with an understanding of the
  **CBSE school ecosystem and education sector**
  would be preferred.

**Skills & Competencies:**

* **A relationship builder -**
  able to earn the trust of school leaders.
* **Commercially sharp -**
  understands value, pricing and negotiation.
* **Persistent without being pushy -**
  knows that school sales can take time.
* **A strong communicator -**
  can have an intelligent conversation with a Principal, not just deliver a sales pitch.
* **Curious about education**
  - genuinely interested in improving learning experiences for children.
* **Resourceful**
  - can figure out how to get the right introduction or open a new school relationship.
* **Highly accountable**
  - owns the outcome rather than simply reporting activity.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity**
  - willing to experiment with new approaches to school outreach

**Personal Attributes :**

* Strong relationship-building and networking skills.
* Confident and persuasive communicator.
* Commercially driven and target-oriented.
* Persistent and resilient without being pushy.
* Proactive and resourceful in creating new opportunities.
* Strong ownership and accountability for outcomes.

**What This Role Is NOT**

This is not simply a lead-generation or telecalling role.

We are specifically looking for someone who can
**open doors, build relationships, understand the school’s needs, influence the decision, negotiate effectively and close the partnership.**

The person should be comfortable owning the entire journey from
**“Can I get a meeting with the Principal?” to “Let’s finalise the partnership.”**

The SAP SD, CS & GTS Consultant / Solution Architect provides end-to-end functional and solution architecture leadership across order-to-cash, customer service and global trade processes. The role combines manufacturing-process knowledge, deep SAP SD, CS and GTS expertise, integration architecture, cloud and BTP capabilities, data migration, change leadership and stakeholder management to deliver scalable, compliant and business-aligned solutions.
  
  

* Own end-to-end SAP SD process design, including customer and material sales data, quotations, contracts, sales orders, pricing, availability, delivery, shipping, billing, returns,credit-related integration and intercompany processes.
* Own SAP CS process design, including installed-base and equipment-related service processes, service notifications and orders, repairs, spare-parts consumption, warranties, service contracts, resource and cost integration, confirmations and service billing.
* Own SAP GTS process design, including compliance management, sanctioned-party screening, embargo and export-control checks, customs processes, classification, preference and trade-document requirements, as applicable to the business landscape.
* Apply strong manufacturing business-process knowledge and connect sales, service and trade-compliance requirements with planning, procurement, production, quality, logistics, finance and warehouse processes.
* Understand MRP touchpoints relevant to SD and CS, including demand transfer, availability, requirements, make-to-order or service-parts planning, procurement proposals and fulfilment dependencies.
* Design and govern integrations between SAP SD, CS and GTS and third-party applications such as customer portals, CRM, logistics providers, trade-content providers, customs authorities, tax or compliance platforms and document services.
* Own relevant SAP landscape architecture, including applications, environments, interfaces, data flows, security, availability, performance and lifecycle dependencies.
* Guide SAP Business Technology Platform adoption for integration, extension, workflow, data, analytics and document or event-driven use cases aligned with enterprise standards and clean-core principles.
* Identify practical AI opportunities across sales, service and trade processes, ensuring responsible, secure and value-driven adoption.
* Lead or support SAP implementations in Public Cloud and/or Private Cloud environments and contribute to fit-to-standard, design authority and solution governance.
* Lead SD, CS and GTS data-migration activities, including object inventory, mapping, cleansing, transformation, mock loads, reconciliation, cutover, validation and hypercare.
* Apply structured change management covering stakeholder alignment, communication, training, adoption, business readiness and resistance management.
* Apply ITIL practices across incident, problem, change, release, service-level and continual-improvement processes.
* Understand hyperscaler concepts relevant to SAP workloads, including connectivity, identity, security, resilience, monitoring, scalability and cost awareness.
* Lead and coach team members and delivery partners; coordinate priorities, quality, risks, knowledge transfer and commitments across projects, enhancements and support.
* Build trusted relationships with business process owners, key users, Group IT, Enterprise Architecture, vendors and senior stakeholders.
* Prepare clear process and architecture documents, decision papers, roadmaps, business cases, status reports and executive-quality PowerPoint presentations.
* Apply strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills to identify root causes, evaluate options, assess risks and drive topics to closure.

**Education, Experience And Languages**

* B.Tech. / B.E. degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a closely related discipline.
* 9-10 years of relevant SAP experience, with strong hands-on expertise across SAP SD, CS and GTS.
* Strong manufacturing business-process knowledge and module-wise understanding of SAP SD, CS and GTS business processes.
* At least two end-to-end SAP implementation experiences in ECC and Public Cloud and/or Private Cloud model with meaningful responsibility across design, configuration, testing, cutover and hypercare.
* At least two SAP application-support experiences covering incident resolution, problem management, enhancements, releases and business continuity.
* Demonstrated experience with third-party integrations, SAP landscapes, BTP, AI use cases, change management, MRP dependencies and SD, CS and GTS data migration.
* Experience working on SAP implementation in a Public Cloud and/or Private Cloud model.
* Practical understanding of at least one hyperscaler environment and its relevance to SAP solutions.
* ITIL certification and demonstrated application of service-management principles.
* Proven team-management and stakeholder-management experience.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication, analytical thinking and PowerPoint storytelling skills.
* PMP certification or equivalent formal project-management certification.
* SAP Activate Methodology certification.
* Relevant SAP SD, CS, GTS, S/4HANA, BTP, cloud architecture or hyperscaler certification.
* Experience with S/4HANA transformation, RISE with SAP, clean-core principles, trade-compliance modernization and application rationalization.
* A proactive, accountable and hands-on go-getter mindset with strong ownership and delivery orientation.

title: Senior Analyst - Cummins CARE Operations
description:
****Job Summary:****
Provide expanded support to customers, including end-users, distributors, and/or dealers seeking information through various mediums, under minimum supervision
  
  
****Key Responsibilities:****
Document customer inquiry information within appropriate Cummins systems.
  
  
Provide prompt assistance to customers through various media. Multi-Skill/Multi-channel support (Chat/Email/Phone)
  
  
Resolve non-routine customer issues through an understanding of Cummins processes, systems, and practices.
  
  
Escalate complex issues providing documentation through process.
  
  
Understands new and existing Cummins processes, systems, practices, and delivers training to new hires.
  
  
Support improvement projects intended to improve customer experiences and organizational goals.
  
  
Generates and maintains knowledge content, delivers training and is considered a Subject Matter Expert or Team Leader.
  
  
****Competencies:****
Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.
  
  
Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  
  
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  
  
Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  
  
Directs work - Providing direction, delegating, and removing obstacles to get work done.
  
  
Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  
  
Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.
  
  
Service Capability, Capacity and Coverage - Applies the Service Capability, Capacity and Coverage process to understand customer expectations, business priorities, and where products are operating to provide capable and consistent service through available parts, information, tools, and qualified technicians according to published standards; analyzes service capability metrics to identify, prioritize and resolve channel development opportunities within the service network.
  
  
Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.
  
  
Service Information Process - Organizes product technical information by utilizing available resources including established systems, processes, tools, teams, and suppliers to deliver service information to a target audience; identifies and resolves emerging issues by breaking down complex processes, tools, systems, or agencies in order to prevent delays in the delivery of desired outcomes.
  
  
Warranty Process - Analyzes customer issues to verify root cause of failure and associated progressive damage using Cummins published service information; interprets the warranty administration manual to determine eligibility for coverage and claim requirements; identifies items associated with repair that can be covered and communicates to stakeholders; files a claim in the appropriate system using proper documentation and requirements to receive accurate settlement.
  
  
Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  
  
****Education, Licenses, Certifications:****
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
  
  
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  
  
****Experience:****
Requires significant previous relevant work experience; prior technical experience and/ or customer service experience is preferred.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities:****

* Manage customer escalations ensuring timely and accurate resolution for the technical queries raised by Cummins dealers & distributors related to Cummins owned products.
* Lead or participate in continuous improvement initiatives targeting process efficiency and customer satisfaction.
* Respond to customer queries via phone or email regarding engine and PowerGen diagnostics and performance issues.
* Perform Level 1 troubleshooting using diagnostic service manual and search portal of Cummins.
* Accurately capture customer queries and identify basic level troubleshooting.
* Escalate complex issues to Level 2/3 support teams with detailed documentation.
* Maintain logs of diagnostic sessions and resolutions while utilization key applications including Salesforce and Genesys along with Cummins’ in-house applications.
* Ensure high-quality customer service and technical accuracy in every interaction.
* Expert in diesel engine commodity-related technical knowledge.
* Skilled in transferring product and process expertise to newly onboarded resources.

**Shift Timings**
– This role demands for suitable candidate to manage 24\*7 operations – Predominant night shift (4pm onwards)
  
  
****Qualifications:****

* Strong verbal communication skills and fluency in English to be able to interact with NAM customers, dealers and distributors.

* Proficiency in German (preferably at C1 level or higher)

* Provide technical support and guidance to users regarding SSO processes
* Document SSO configurations, procedures, and changes
* Assist in the daily operational tasks of managing Microsoft Entra identity services to maintain system health and performance.
* Support the resolution of IAM-related incidents and service requests in a timely manner.
* Help monitor identity systems for performance issues, potential breaches, and unauthorized access attempts.
* Contribute to the maintenance of operational documentation, including runbooks, procedures, and service records.
* Participate in the execution of routine access reviews, certifications, and audits.
* Collaborate with IT and security teams to align IAM operational activities with security policies and compliance standards.
* Learn and apply best practices for IAM operations, with a focus on continuous improvement and professional development.
* Engage in the implementation of basic automation and scripting tasks to improve operational efficiency.
* Provide input on operational reports and metrics for IAM services
* Ability to perform Root Cause Analysis and suggest solutions to avoid errors
* Work involves day to day health check, incident support (as per defined scope and levels), e-mail support, tool upgrades and monitoring of systems, reporting the status and working with development and QA teams to help them fix the issues.

* Basic understanding of identity and access management concepts and Microsoft Entra services.
* Strong desire to learn and develop skills in IAM operations and cloud security.

* Willingness to be on call support engineer and work occasional overtime as required

title: Senior Tier 2 Network Support Engineer (Immediate Joiners)
description:
We are hiring for a
**Senior Tier 2 Support Engineer (Immediate Joiner)**
for a one-year contract which is extendable according to the requirement that takes ownership of customer support tickets when the Tier 1 team cannot resolve them at first touch and who can join immediately.

**About GlobalStep**

GlobalStep is a creative and technical services company to the video games industry. We work with the world’s leading game studios and publishers from delivery centers in India, Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, Romania, and Portugal. We are approximately 1,500 people across six countries, supporting global clients across multiple time zones through services including Art Production, Engineering, Games QA, Localization, and Player Engagement.

We are privately held and founder led. We operate in a fast-moving, service-oriented environment where execution discipline, operational responsiveness, and continuous improvement matter deeply. As we continue to scale globally, we are investing in stronger processes, clearer workflows, and more effective operating models that allow the organization to grow without unnecessary complexity.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Senior Tier 2 Support Engineer to serve as the final customer-facing escalation point before engineering involvement. The role requires strong technical troubleshooting skills, deep networking expertise, and excellent customer communication capabilities.

**Responsibilities**

* Own complex customer escalations from investigation through resolution.
* Troubleshoot networking issues involving routing, NAT, DNS, firewalls, and VPN technologies.
* Analyze packet captures, logs, and diagnostic information.
* Mentor Tier 2 Support Engineers and contribute to knowledge sharing initiatives.
* Build troubleshooting guides and internal runbooks.
* Collaborate with engineering teams on product-level issues.
* Maintain excellent communication with enterprise customers.

**Requirements**

* 8+ years of experience in Technical Support, Network Engineering, or Infrastructure Support.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP and networking fundamentals.
* Experience with Linux troubleshooting and administration.
* Experience with packet analysis tools such as Wireshark and tcpdump.
* Exposure to Python scripting and REST APIs.
* Excellent customer communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CCNP or equivalent networking expertise.
* Experience with SD-WAN, VPN, or overlay networking technologies.
* Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with OIDC and SAML integrations.

title: Network Operations Engineer
description:
Since 2003, Entrata has evolved from a visionary, student-led startup into a global leader in AI-driven property management technology. Today, we power the industry's most essential operating system, serving owners and residents worldwide through a comprehensive suite of intelligent leasing, payment, and communication tools powered by cutting-edge AI. With a proven track record of sustained growth and a global team of more than 2,200 employees, we offer the rare combination of established stability and high-velocity innovation. Recognized by the Silicon Slopes Hall of Fame and the Utah Business Fast 50, Entrata fosters a culture of radical transparency and entrepreneurial energy. At Entrata, we create an environment where different perspectives are valued and respected. Those perspectives challenge assumptions, strengthen our decisions, and raise the bar as we reshape the global living experience through AI-powered solutions.
  
  
The Network Operations Engineer supports the reliability, stability, and performance of production infrastructure and applications by monitoring, troubleshooting, and resolving operational issues. This role applies working knowledge of systems, networks, and monitoring tools to address moderately complex incidents and service deviations. Operating with general guidance and limited day-to-day supervision, the engineer exercises judgment within established procedures to maintain system availability, improve operational processes, and enhance the customer experience. The position contributes to continuous improvement efforts and supports adherence to operational standards and best practices.
  
  
**Responsibilities Will Include**

* Monitor infrastructure systems, applications, and services to proactively detect, investigate, and resolve availability or performance issues
* Troubleshoot moderately complex technical problems across servers, networks, storage, and related systems, following established guidelines
* Provide clear, timely communication regarding service-impacting events and coordinate updates with internal stakeholders
* Address technical and non-technical escalations, determining appropriate resolution or escalation paths
* Contribute to the development, documentation, and maintenance of Network Operations standards, policies, and procedures
* Create and maintain Root Cause and Corrective Action (RCCA) documentation, assisting in identifying trends and preventative measures
* Implement and maintain monitoring configurations, alert thresholds, and dashboards in alignment with operational best practices
* Participate in process improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency and system reliability
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support infrastructure changes and deployments

**Essential Functions**

* Monitor, investigate, and respond to service-impacting events to maintain system availability
* Troubleshoot and resolve non-routine technical issues using established procedures and professional judgment
* Document incidents, root causes, and corrective actions accurately and in a timely manner
* Communicate operational status and incident updates to relevant stakeholders
* Ability to prioritize tasks effectively by meeting deadlines and managing workload efficiently
* Maintain professional interaction with internal and external stakeholders
* Ability to work in a fast-paced and high-stress environment

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Intermediate knowledge of infrastructure environments, including virtualized servers, storage systems, networking components, and databases
* Working knowledge of monitoring technologies such as Zabbix, New Relic, and Grafana
* Ability to apply company policies, procedures, and technical guidelines to resolve non-standard operational issues
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose issues across multiple systems
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Foundational scripting capability in Bash, Python, or similar languages, with the ability to apply automation to routine tasks
* Ability to work independently on the majority of assigned tasks and exercise judgment within defined practices

**Education And Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field; or equivalent work experience
* Typically requires a minimum of 2 years of related experience in technical support, systems administration, or a Network Operations Center environment
* Experience implementing and maintaining monitoring policies and operational best practices

**AI & Operational Fluency**

* AI Integration: Utilize company-approved GenAI tools to accelerate high-value deliverables
* Strategic Oversight: Exercise critical judgment as the "Human-in-the-Loop" by auditing AI outputs for factual accuracy, brand alignment, and the removal of hallucinations
* Data Governance: Ensures no proprietary or Personally Identifiable Information (PII) data is exposed to unauthorized models
* Prompt Competency: Demonstrates the ability to craft clear, context-rich prompts to achieve consistent, high-quality results across various business domains

Entrata is dedicated to creating a workplace where a diverse and inclusive team thrives in an environment free from discrimination. We provide equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, protected veteran status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.
  
  
It’s a great place to work! Will you join us?
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: CPQ Support Engineer
description:
Your role
  
  
We are seeking a CPQ Support Engineer who will contribute to the support efforts within the CPQ Support team . In this role, you will be the technical backbone ensuring that our Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) environment seamlessly communicates with SAP C4C and underlying SAP ERP system. You will triage, debug, and resolve complex application errors, data sync failures, and pricing mismatch issues, directly supporting our global service sales operations team to keep the Quote-to-Order pipeline moving.
  
  
Your day-to-day
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Ticket Queue Management: Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve incoming tickets Ticket Triage: Resolve Tier 2/Tier 3 tickets where quotes or sales orders fail to transfer from CPQ back to C4C or fail to trigger document generation and approval workflows. Accurately document issues and efficiently escalate tickets to senior team members, or relevant cross-functional teams.
* Problem solving: Root Cause Analysis: debugging & analyzing system logs, ability to investigate middleware issues (e.g. mappings to identify if an issue stems from core application behavior, custom scripting, or integration network layers) Identify and troubleshoot data integration sync errors between the CPQ platform and connected enterprise systems, reviewing system messaging and data payloads to resolve connection failures. Master Data Troubleshooting: investigate and fix issues related to master data replication, ensuring that product catalogs, business partners, account hierarchies, and pricing conditions match perfectly between C4C and CPQ.
* Collaboration & communication: Partner with CPQ developers and other business application teams to solve problems
* Participate in regular update activities: regression-test system upgrades, etc.

**Your Skills And Experience**
Required Skills & Qualifications
  
  

* 3+ years of technical application support experience, with a proven track record of supporting a CPQ platform integrated a CRM and ERP (SAP C4C, SAP ERP would be a plus)
* Strong analytical skills
* Hands-on experience with debugging activities: REST/SOAP/ODATA APIs, good understanding of Python, interpreting XML/JSON payloads.
* Good understanding of CPQ Logic: product modeling, configuration of attributes, constraints, document generation tagging logic, pricing procedures (such as SAP variant configuration or condition techniques) and Python scripting
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with a proven ability to provide high-quality, clear, and professional updates to all stakeholders.
* Good understanding of process knowledge - familiarity with the end-to-end Quote-to-Order business process is a plus

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SAP CPQ (formerly CallidusCloud) and scripting languages like Python used for custom pricing or validation rules.
* Familiarity with SAP ERP/S4HANA backend processing (e.g., how a quote in CPQ creates a follow-up Sales Order in SAP ERP via C4C).
* Understanding of SAP integration technologies, specifically SAP CPI (Cloud Platform Integration) is a plus
* Experience utilizing enterprise ticketing and ITIL frameworks (such as ServiceNow) for SLA-driven incident management.

**About Us**
Atlas Copco is a Swedish multinational industrial company that was founded in 1873. It manufactures industrial tools and equipment. The Atlas Copco Group is a global industrial group of companies headquartered in Nacka, Sweden.
  
  
At Global IT Hub, we are more than a technology organisation. We are a community of innovators, problem-solvers, and digital pioneers dedicated to accelerating Atlas Copco Group’s business potential through world-class technology solutions. Join us to shape the future of digital transformation, work on global challenges, and create impact for businesses and customers worldwide.

This role requires you to work on-site at our office in Hinjewadi, Pune, Maharashtra. You will be part of a dynamic team and enjoy the benefits of face-to-face collaboration.
  
  
This role offers a hybrid working arrangement (minimum three days working from office), allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our Hinjewadi Phase 1 office.
  
  
Why it is great to work with us
  
  
Your career grows through your skills, your curiosity, and the people you work with. You join a global network where we learn from each other and share knowledge openly. We focus on long‑term development and encourage you to explore new ideas that help us move forward. Innovation is part of how we think and act – we test, improve, and use what we learn to create solutions that matter. You can make a meaningful impact by contributing with your insights and taking ownership of your work, supported by flexible ways of working and leaders who empower you.
  
  
Application process
  
  
Our selection process includes interviews and, for some roles, skills assessments that help us gain a deeper understanding of your profile. We look forward to getting to know you, learning about your strengths, and discussing how you can grow with us. If you have questions during the process or need support, please contact us.

title: Technology Consultant - End User Computing (EUC) Engineer
description:
**India T&M Special Bonus:**
**Req ID:**
398097
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Technology Consultant - End User Computing (EUC) Engineer to join our team in Pune, Mahārāshtra (IN-MH), India (IN).
  
  
**Job Title:**
Technology Consultant – End User Computing (EUC) Engineer
  
  
**Location:**
Pune
  
  
**Overall Experience:**
5–7+ Years
  
  
**Role Summary**
We are seeking an experienced
**End User Computing (EUC) Engineer**
with strong expertise in
**desktop engineering, endpoint management, workplace services, Microsoft 365 support, virtual desktop technologies, and end-user computing platforms**
.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess hands-on experience in managing enterprise endpoint environments, supporting workplace technologies, implementing device management solutions, and providing advanced troubleshooting across desktop, laptop, mobile, and virtual desktop environments. The role will work closely with Infrastructure, Security, Service Desk, and Business teams to deliver a secure and efficient end-user computing experience.
  
  
**Day To Day Job Duties**

* Provide Level 2/Level 3 support for enterprise End User Computing environments.
* Manage and support Windows desktops, laptops, and workplace devices across the organization.
* Deploy, configure, and maintain endpoint devices using Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, and Autopilot.
* Support Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, and Office applications.
* Perform software packaging, deployment, patch management, and operating system upgrades.
* Troubleshoot complex hardware, operating system, application, printing, and connectivity issues.
* Manage device compliance, endpoint security, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Support Mobile Device Management (MDM) and BYOD environments.
* Administer Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) platforms such as Citrix, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), or VMware Horizon.
* Collaborate with Security teams to implement endpoint security controls and compliance standards.
* Monitor endpoint performance, device health, software inventory, and compliance metrics.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge articles, and support procedures.
* Support incident, problem, change, and release management activities.
* Perform root cause analysis and implement permanent fixes for recurring issues.
* Participate in workplace modernization, migration, and technology refresh initiatives.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5–7+ years of experience in End User Computing, Desktop Engineering, or Workplace Support.
* Strong experience supporting Windows 10/11 enterprise environments.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, and Microsoft Autopilot.
* Experience supporting Microsoft 365 applications and services.
* Knowledge of Active Directory, Azure AD (Entra ID), Group Policies, and endpoint security.
* Experience with software deployment, patch management, and device lifecycle management.
* Experience working in ITIL-based support environments.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Core Technical Skills**

* Operating Systems: Windows 10, Windows 11
* Endpoint Management: Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Autopilot
* Microsoft 365: Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, Office Applications
* Identity & Access Management: Active Directory, Azure AD (Entra ID), Group Policies
* Virtual Desktop Infrastructure: Citrix, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), VMware Horizon
* Device Management: MDM, BYOD, Endpoint Provisioning, Asset Management
* Security: Microsoft Defender, BitLocker, Endpoint Security, Compliance Management
* Patch Management: Windows Updates, Application Patching, Endpoint Compliance
* Automation & Scripting: PowerShell
* ITSM Tools: ServiceNow, Remedy, Jira
* Monitoring & Reporting: Endpoint Analytics, Device Health Monitoring
* Methodologies: ITIL, Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Windows 11 migration projects.
* Experience supporting Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) environments.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
* Experience with software packaging and application deployment tools.
* Familiarity with endpoint analytics and digital employee experience tools.
* Experience supporting global enterprise environments.
* Exposure to Zero Trust security concepts.
* ITIL Foundation certification.
* Microsoft Endpoint Administrator certification.
* Strong customer-facing and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Experience Profile**

* 5–7+ years of End User Computing and Desktop Support experience.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, and Microsoft 365.
* Experience managing enterprise desktop, laptop, and mobile device environments.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-resolution skills.
* Experience with endpoint security, compliance, and patch management.
* Familiarity with VDI technologies such as Citrix or Azure Virtual Desktop.
* Experience working with Infrastructure, Security, and Service Management teams.
* Strong communication and customer support skills.
* Experience working in enterprise IT support and operations environments.
* Knowledge of ITIL processes and workplace technology best practices.

**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. title: Marketing Specialist, APAC
description:
**Company Description**

Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.

At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.

Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.

**Job Description**

**Who You'll Work With**

As part of the regional marketing team, you will collaborate closely with APAC Sales and Engineering to equip them with compelling content and sales enablement assets. You’ll serve as the bridge to Global Marketing and Content teams to localize campaigns, work with Product and Technical Marketing to translate complex features into clear customer stories, and coordinate with external agencies and channel partners to execute joint demand-generation programs across the region.

**What You’ll Do**

The Marketing Specialist, APAC will play a critical role in supporting the regional team to execute integrated campaigns that drive demand, build brand awareness, and increase market share across the Asia-Pacific region. This hands-on role focuses on product marketing, technical content development, and campaign execution in close collaboration with APAC sales, engineering, and global marketing teams. The specialist will translate technical information into customer-friendly messaging and ensure the timely delivery of marketing activities aligned with regional priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Marketing and Messaging**

* Develop and adapt product marketing content, including case studies and presentations, by localizing global messaging to suit the APAC market’s specific technical and business requirements.
* Assist in creating product positioning and value proposition materials that resonate with APAC customers’ needs and use cases.
* Produce and maintain sales enablement assets to equip the APAC sales team with clear, compelling product information and messaging.

**Technical Marketing Support**

* Collaborate with technical marketing and engineering to produce technical blog posts, customer use cases, and feature highlight content tailored for technical buyers.
* Help create technical collateral and diagrams that clarify product capabilities for customers and partners.

**Campaign Execution**

* Coordinate and support the execution of regional marketing campaigns by delivering assets on schedule.
* Assist with demand-generation initiatives, including email campaigns, webinars, and digital marketing activities, ensuring alignment with campaign plans.
* Manage regional marketing content calendars and support social media updates and digital marketing tasks.
* Monitor basic campaign metrics and assist in preparing performance reports to help improve future initiatives.

**Regional and Partner Support**

* Support channel marketing activities by executing joint campaigns and distributing co-branded content for partners.
* Serve as a communication bridge between APAC sales, product, and global marketing teams to ensure executional alignment and flow of information.
* Provide local insights to ensure marketing activities meet the cultural and commercial context of various APAC markets.

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in B2B technology marketing with a focus on product or technical marketing execution.
* Good technical understanding and ability to simplify complex technology concepts for marketing content.
* Strong project coordination skills, capable of managing multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Familiarity with APAC markets, showing awareness of regional customer needs and cultural nuances.
* Familiarity with enterprise technology, especially networking, is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with attention to detail.
* Proficient in CRM (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation platforms (e.g., HubSpot), and basic marketing analytics.
* Collaborative team player who works effectively across functions and with external agencies.

title: Marketing Intern
description:
Want to learn B2B marketing at Asia's leading agentic AI platform for ESG and climate? Oren is hiring a
**Marketing Intern**
in Pune. You'll work on live campaigns from day one.

**About Oren**

Oren is Asia's leading agentic AI platform for carbon accounting, ESG reporting, supply chain sustainability, climate risk and sustainable finance. Enterprises across manufacturing, BFSI, real estate, infrastructure, pharma, auto, chemicals, FMCG and energy use Oren to measure Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions, manage supplier sustainability data, assess climate risk and produce audit-ready reports.

**The Role**

* Location: Pune, India (on-site)
* Duration: 6 months, with potential conversion to a full-time role
* Stipend: ₹20,000 per month
* Start date: Immediate joiners preferred
* Experience: 0–1 year (final-year students and recent graduates welcome)

You'll support our marketing team across content, social media, SEO, newsletters and events. Your work will build Oren's brand across India, the Middle East and South-East Asia. You'll work closely with the marketing lead, designers, sales and subject matter experts, and take on more ownership as you grow.

**What You'll Do**

* Draft blogs, case studies, e-books and sales collateral on ESG topics, in line with Oren's brand voice
* Write and schedule posts for Oren's LinkedIn page, and track engagement
* Edit and upload webinar and product videos to YouTube, with titles, descriptions and thumbnails
* Build, proofread and schedule the newsletter, and maintain the subscriber list
* Support SEO: keyword research, on-page optimisation, website publishing, guest posts and directory listings
* Coordinate webinars and events: speakers, invitations, registrations, promotion, on-ground execution and lead handover to sales
* Track weekly and monthly metrics across website, SEO, social, newsletter and events

**What We're Looking For**

* A bachelor's degree (completed or in final year) in Marketing, Mass Communication, Journalism, English, Business, Environmental Studies or a related field
* Strong English writing and proofreading skills
* A basic understanding of social media, SEO and email marketing
* Comfort with MS Office or Google Workspace, and Canva
* Willingness to learn tools like Mailchimp, Figma, GA4/GSC and AI tools such as Claude
* Attention to detail, a good eye for design, and the ability to juggle multiple deadlines
* Availability to work full-time and on-site in Pune for the full 6 months

**Bonus Points**

* Certifications in digital marketing, SEO, content or Google Analytics (e.g. HubSpot Academy, Google Digital Garage)
* You've run a company or college social page, blog, newsletter or event
* An interest in ESG, climate or sustainability

**What You'll Learn**

* How to write for senior audiences such as CFOs and sustainability heads
* Hands-on use of marketing, analytics and AI tools
* How to run webinars and industry events end-to-end

**Ready to apply?**

Apply here on LinkedIn, or send your resume to mansi@orennow.com with the subject line "Marketing Intern 2026".

title: Associate Marketing Manager
description:

**About The Role**
We are looking for an Associate Marketing Manager to join our Audience Solutions Marketing team, supporting the delivery of marketing programs across Wiley FOCUS Medicine, IME (Independent Medical Education) and Sciences.
  
  
In this role, you will manage integrated marketing campaigns and projects from initial brief and planning through launch, optimization, reporting and close-out. You will translate business and client objectives into effective, audience-focused campaigns across email, web, organic social, paid social, paid search and display channels.
  
  
You will work closely with cross-functional teams and use campaign insights and performance data to continuously improve results and deliver high-quality marketing experiences.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* Own integrated marketing campaigns and projects from initial brief and planning through launch, optimization, reporting and close-out.
* Plan, build, manage and optimize paid media campaigns across LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads, including audience targeting, budgets, bids, conversion tracking, UTMs, creative testing and campaign pacing.
* Deliver multi-channel marketing activity across email, web, organic social, paid social, paid search and display.
* Coordinate campaign briefs, copy, creative assets, landing pages, marketing plans and client-ready materials.
* Monitor campaign performance and translate data into actionable recommendations to improve targeting, content, creativity, channel mix and budget allocation.
* Manage multiple campaigns, timelines, stakeholders, assets and approvals while ensuring high-quality and timely delivery.
* Collaborate with Sales, Project Management, Editorial, Design, Events and wider Marketing teams to ensure smooth campaign execution.
* Support continuous improvement by maintaining campaign documentation, SOPs and playbooks and identifying opportunities to improve marketing workflows and processes.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Degree or equivalent professional experience in marketing, digital marketing, communications or a related discipline.
* Typically 3–5 years of hands-on multi-channel marketing experience, including independent ownership of campaigns and projects.
* Demonstrable recent experience directly building, managing and optimizing campaigns using LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* Experience managing multiple projects, stakeholders, deadlines and assigned media budgets simultaneously.
* Strong campaign planning, briefing, copywriting, quality assurance, stakeholder management and reporting skills.
* Working knowledge of GA4, campaign tracking and UTM governance, along with proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to understand and interpret key paid-media metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPM, conversion rate, CPL, frequency, reach and pacing.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate campaign performance data into clear insights and actions.
* Excellent written and spoken English, including strong copywriting and presentation skills.
* A proactive, collaborative and audience-focused approach with excellent attention to detail and the ability to work independently.
* Experience in B2B marketing, publishing, healthcare, life sciences, scientific communications, events or sponsored-content programs would be an advantage.
* Relevant certifications such as Google Ads, Meta Blueprint or LinkedIn Marketing Labs would be desirable.

**We power infinite possibilities.**
For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.
  
  
We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.
  
  
Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything.
  
  
Wiley is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. We evaluate all qualified applicants and treat all qualified applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. Wiley is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to applicants and employees with disabilities. Applicants who require accommodation to participate in the job application process may contact tasupport@wiley.com for assistance.
  
  
We are proud that our workplace promotes continual learning and internal mobility. We offer meeting-free Friday afternoons allowing more time for heads down work and professional development, and through a robust body of employee programing we facilitate a wide range of opportunities to foster community, learn, and grow.
  
  
We are committed to fair, transparent pay, and we strive to provide competitive compensation in addition to a comprehensive benefits package. It is anticipated that most qualified candidates will fall within the range, however the ultimate salary offered for this role may be higher or lower and will be set based on a variety of non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to, geographic location, skills, and competencies.
