title: Coordinator, Marketing Operations
description:
**About This Role**
Comscore is looking for a Coordinator, Marketing Operations to add execution capacity, depth and continuity to our global Marketing Operations team. Working closely with a U.S.-led team, this role will support the day-to-day execution of digital marketing campaigns, marketing platforms and data workflows, webinars and events, website publishing, reporting and other recurring operational processes.
  
  
The ideal candidate is highly organized, technically comfortable, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment. This is a hands-on role with opportunities to build expertise across marketing automation, website operations, campaign execution, analytics and other marketing technologies while developing broad knowledge of the team's core processes and providing dependable backup coverage.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Execute digital marketing campaigns, including building, QAing, scheduling and deploying emails, landing pages and related campaign assets.
* Support day-to-day administration and execution within Oracle Eloqua, including campaign setup, lists, segmentation, imports, testing and campaign-response processing.

* Support client-facing webinars, including registration setup, communications, Zoom administration, dry runs, recordings, follow-up and reporting.
* Create and manage marketing lists and audience segments and support ongoing database quality, contact preferences and data hygiene.

* Produce recurring and ad-hoc reporting across email, website, webinars, campaigns and other Marketing activities.
* Support event and conference execution, including event pages, communications, registrations, materials, lead processing and post-event activities.

* Document recurring processes and maintain operating procedures to improve consistency, cross-training and business continuity.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and automate recurring Marketing Operations activities.
* Collaborate with colleagues across Marketing, Sales, Product, Client Services and other functions to execute priorities and resolve operational issues.
* Develop broad working knowledge of core Marketing Operations processes to provide backup coverage and reduce single points of failure.

**What You’ll Need**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2-4 years of experience in Marketing Operations, digital marketing, marketing automation or a related role.
* Experience with a marketing automation platform such as Oracle Eloqua, Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud or HubSpot; Eloqua experience preferred.
* Experience with CRM systems; Salesforce experience preferred.
* Experience working with a content management system; Webflow experience is a plus.
* Experience building and executing email campaigns and managing marketing lists or audience segments.
* Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and comfort working with marketing data and reporting.
* Strong project-management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality assurance.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with colleagues across functions and time zones.
* Ability and willingness to maintain at least five hours of daily overlap with U.S. Eastern Time business hours.
* Curiosity, adaptability and willingness to learn new marketing technologies, systems and processes.

**About Comscore**
At Comscore, we’re pioneering the future of cross-platform media measurement, arming organizations with the insights they need to make decisions with confidence. Central to this aim are our people who work together to simplify the complex on behalf of our clients & partners. Though our roles and skills are varied, we’re united by our commitment to five underlying values: Integrity, Velocity, Accountability, Teamwork, and Servant Leadership. If you’re motivated by big challenges and interested in helping some of the largest and most important media properties and brands navigate the future of media, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
Comscore (NASDAQ: SCOR) is a trusted partner for planning, transacting and evaluating media across platforms. With a data footprint that combines digital, linear TV, over-the-top and theatrical viewership intelligence with advanced audience insights, Comscore allows media buyers and sellers to quantify their multiscreen behavior and make business decisions with confidence. A proven leader in measuring digital and set-top box audiences and advertising at scale, Comscore is the industry’s emerging, third-party source for reliable and comprehensive cross-platform measurement. To learn more about Comscore, please visit Comscore.com.
  
  
Comscore is committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity.

About the Role

We are looking for a dynamic, strategic and result-oriented
**Senior Sales & Marketing Leader**
to lead the sales, marketing, admissions and institutional growth initiatives across our Engineering, Undergraduate and MBA/PGDM programmes.

The individual will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive student acquisition strategies, strengthening the institution's brand presence, driving admission targets, building a strong outreach network and establishing strategic partnerships.

This is a senior leadership position requiring a combination of strategic thinking, business development, marketing expertise, revenue generation capabilities and strong team leadership. The selected candidate will work directly with the Chairperson to drive the institution's overall growth, expansion and admission strategy.

Key Responsibilities

1. Sales & Admissions Strategy

* Develop and execute comprehensive admission and student acquisition strategies across Engineering, Undergraduate and MBA/PGDM programmes.
* Drive annual admission targets, student enrolment numbers and revenue objectives.
* Build and manage admission funnels to improve enquiry-to-admission conversion ratios.
* Identify new markets, geographical territories and student segments for institutional expansion.
* Establish structured sales processes to monitor leads, counselling, follow-ups and conversions.
* Develop state-wise and region-wise admission strategies to maximise student enrolments.

2. Marketing & Brand Management

* Lead integrated marketing strategies, including digital, traditional, offline and campus-based marketing.
* Strengthen institutional brand positioning and visibility across target markets.
* Oversee digital campaigns, social media, performance marketing, SEO, content marketing and lead-generation initiatives.
* Plan and execute education fairs, career exhibitions, seminars, school/college outreach programmes and promotional events.
* Ensure consistent brand communication across all marketing channels.
* Drive innovative marketing initiatives to enhance institutional visibility and student engagement.

3. Business Development & Institutional Outreach

* Develop strategic relationships with schools, junior colleges, coaching institutes, corporates and educational consultants.
* Build and manage a strong network of education partners, channel partners and admission associates.
* Explore new opportunities for institutional collaborations, strategic tie-ups and market expansion.
* Drive outreach initiatives across multiple states and geographical territories.
* Develop regional networks to strengthen student sourcing and admission pipelines.

4. Team Leadership & Performance Management

* Lead and mentor sales, marketing, admissions, counselling and outreach teams.
* Define departmental KRAs, KPIs and performance benchmarks.
* Establish accountability through regular reviews, dashboards and performance tracking.
* Build a high-performance culture focused on targets, productivity and student experience.
* Manage regional and zonal sales teams to ensure effective execution of admission strategies.

5. Data Analytics & Business Planning

* Monitor admission trends, market intelligence, competitor activities and student preferences.
* Analyse lead generation costs, conversion ratios, campaign ROI and admission performance.
* Develop annual budgets, sales forecasts and marketing plans.
* Present periodic business performance reports and growth strategies to the Chairperson.
* Use data-driven insights to improve marketing effectiveness and admission conversion rates.

6. Strategic Leadership

* Work directly with the Chairperson on institutional expansion, new programme launches and market positioning.
* Identify emerging opportunities in the higher education sector.
* Drive innovative admission strategies to improve institutional competitiveness.
* Contribute to long-term business planning and sustainable institutional growth.
* Develop scalable sales and marketing models to support future expansion.

Desired Candidate Profile

* MBA/PGDM in Marketing, Sales or Business Management preferred.
* 10–15+ years of relevant experience in Sales, Marketing, Business Development or Admissions.
* Strong experience in the higher education industry, preferably Engineering, Undergraduate, MBA or PGDM institutions.
* Proven track record of achieving large-scale admission targets and driving student enrolments.
* Experience managing multi-location sales and marketing teams.
* Strong understanding of education marketing, student acquisition, counselling and admission cycles.
* Exposure to digital marketing, performance marketing, lead management and CRM systems.
* Excellent leadership, negotiation, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work directly with senior leadership and translate institutional goals into measurable business outcomes.

Preferred Geographical Experience & Market Coverage

We are specifically looking for senior Sales & Marketing professionals with strong regional market knowledge, established educational networks and proven student acquisition capabilities in the following states:

1. Uttar Pradesh
2. Bihar
3. Maharashtra
4. West Bengal
5. Madhya Pradesh
6. Rajasthan
7. Gujarat
8. Odisha
9. Jharkhand
10. Assam

Preferred Regional Candidate Profile

* Candidates currently working as Sales Heads, Regional Heads, Zonal Heads, State Heads or National Sales Heads in the higher education sector.
* Strong understanding of regional education markets, student demographics and admission trends.
* Established connections with schools, junior colleges, coaching institutes, education consultants and other student sourcing channels.
* Proven experience in driving admissions and managing regional sales teams across one or more of the above-mentioned states.
* Ability to develop state-wise admission strategies and expand the institution's presence across these markets.
* Preference for candidates who have independently managed regional admission targets and possess a strong network within the higher education ecosystem.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

1. Achievement of annual admission and enrolment targets.
2. Revenue growth and contribution from academic programmes.
3. Lead generation and enquiry-to-admission conversion ratio.
4. Cost per Lead (CPL) and Cost per Admission (CPA).
5. Marketing campaign ROI and institutional brand visibility.
6. Expansion of school, college and institutional partnerships.
7. Team productivity and achievement of individual and regional targets.
8. Market penetration and geographical expansion.
9. Improvement in admission funnel efficiency and student acquisition.
10. Achievement of state-wise and programme-wise admission targets.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a
**business-driven education leader rather than just a marketing professional**
— someone who understands how to build markets, generate demand, convert enquiries into admissions, establish strong regional networks, lead large teams and drive institutional growth.

The ideal candidate should have the vision, leadership and execution capabilities to take the institution to the next level while working directly with the Chairperson.

**This role is best suited for a senior professional who has a proven track record of driving admissions, expanding educational markets and delivering measurable business growth in the higher education sector.**

The Revenue Operations & Enablement team is looking for a Lead Business Analyst to support key systems such as Contra Revenue Systems (CRS) and FundApp, Mastercard’s Fund Administration platform. This role will operate as the connective tissue between Finance stakeholders and Technology, using a Revenue platform operating model focused on structured intake, clear requirements, prioritization, release readiness, UAT coordination, production support, issue triage, documentation, reporting oversight, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, analytical, comfortable working across business and technical teams, and able to bring structure to a growing platform support model. The role requires strong project management discipline, application support experience, consulting mindset, and the ability to communicate clearly while independently managing priorities across multiple projects and support efforts.
  
  
Role

* Ensure configuration documentation, process documentation, training guides, decision logs, and support materials are updated as application changes or new functionality are introduced.
* Support SOX and audit compliance by helping maintain control documentation, supporting control testing, identifying improvement opportunities, and ensuring platform changes align to accounting policy, controls, and reporting expectations.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying manual work, data quality gaps, reporting limitations, control risks, user training needs, and opportunities to simplify the system support model as adoption and platform complexity grow.

**All About You**
The ideal candidate for this position should:
  
  

* Have advanced business analysis experience supporting enterprise business platforms, preferably in Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Fund Administration, billing, order-to-cash, rebates/incentives, or related operational systems.
* Hold a Master’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Information Systems, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

* Communicate clearly and confidently with global stakeholders, including the ability to lead working sessions, ask structured questions, explain technical issues in business language, and create concise decision-ready materials.
* Quickly engage and influence business partners, drive change constructively, and build strong relationships within a multinational organization.
* Demonstrate strong ownership, curiosity, judgment, and follow-through; proactively identify gaps, clarify ambiguity, escalate risks appropriately, and help create a scalable operating model rather than only solving one-off issues.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Coupa and/or Oracle knowledge, particularly where fund administration, procurement, purchase order, invoice, general ledger, reporting, or downstream finance processes intersect.

* Familiarity with financial controls, audit/SOX readiness, reporting standardization, data quality, and cross-functional operating models.

title: Manager - People Acquisition (BPS)
description:
As a Manager within our People Acquisition team, catering specifically to the hiring demands of the BPS (Business Process Services) vertical, this role offers a dynamic blend of strategic leadership, business partnering, operational excellence, and talent management. You will play a critical role in shaping the organization’s success by connecting exceptional talent with pivotal roles across the BPS division.

This position not only empowers you to refine your recruitment and leadership capabilities but also provides a platform for continuous learning and innovation. You’ll stay at the forefront of market trends and best practices, driving impact through both talent strategy and execution.

In addition to managing day-to-day recruitment operations, you will also spearhead or collaborate on initiatives focused on process improvement, automation, and knowledge enhancement—ensuring our People Acquisition function remains agile, data-driven, and future-ready.

**About Nexdigm BPS (Business Process Services):**

Nexdigm is a leading multi-disciplinary professional services firm serving mid-market and enterprise clients across India, the US, and international markets. The Business Process Services (BPS) division delivers Finance & Accounting Outsourcing (FAO), Contract Management, and Commercial Operations services, with a growing roster of US-based clients including PE-backed mid-market companies.

**Key Result Areas:**

**Strategic Planning & Organizational Alignment**

* Actively contribute to the formulation of team objectives aligned with organizational goals
* Ensure strategic workforce planning through effective contingency measures and accurate forecasting of hiring needs (e.g., indent management)
* Align recruitment delivery with broader business priorities and long-term talent strategies
* Actively pursue predictive hiring and ensure requirements are fulflled within timelines

**Operational Delivery & Execution Oversight**

* Oversee smooth, timely, and high-impact delivery for all hiring within BPS upto Associate Director level, being personally responsible for/involved in sourcing, interviewing & finalizing candidates for supervisory roles (typically Assistant Manager and above)
* Monitor progress and remove roadblocks to ensure optimal resource utilization and stakeholder satisfaction
* Improve Time-to-Hire (TAT) and hiring efficiency
* Develop and maintain a pipeline of passive and active candidates for critical skill sets.
* Establish relationships with institutes, consultants, industry associations etc. to create sustainable talent pools.
* Ensure succession-ready candidate pipelines for high-demand or niche roles.
* Explore, evaluate and implement various hiring solutions (like training cum deployment institutes etc.) to cater to the unique hiring needs of the Practice, as required
* Ensure recruitment projects (departmental and cross-functional) are delivered within agreed timelines and budgets

**Stakeholder Management & Recruitment Advisory**

* Build strong relationships with internal BPS stakeholders through structured cadences, proactive solutioning, and consultative guidance
* Offer strategic recruitment insights for BPS (Business Process Services) hiring, using market intelligence and industry trends to support business decisions
* Serve as a key advisor to hiring managers and business leaders, fostering alignment on talent needs

**Team Leadership & Performance Development**

* Lead and manage a recruitment team by setting clear expectations and performance metrics
* Oversee delegation, productivity tracking, and career development plans to build a motivated, high-performing team
* Ensure recruitment efforts are directly contributing to billable headcount goals and revenue objectives

**Process Optimization, Compliance & Cost Control**

* Drive process excellence by implementing lean, compliant recruitment workflows
* Regularly review and improve processes for efficiency and consistency
* Monitor and control recruitment-related costs (budgeting) to ensure financial accountability
* Champion employer branding initiatives and integrate market insights to elevate the talent positioning for BPS (Business Process Services).
* Data-Driven Recruitment Management: Establish and track key recruitment KPIs including time-to-fill, quality of hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance rates etc.

**Desired Candidate Profile:**

* To be tailor-fit for the above, you need to have,
* 10+ years of experience in hiring talent for the BPS/accounting domain in high numbers and within a short TAT.
* A good understanding of the candidate pool, competitor firms and market dynamics in the BPS space, especially in Pune.
* Exposure in end-to-end recruitment, including market/talent mapping, salary benchmarking etc.
* Exceptional stakeholder and people management skills.
* Hands-on experience in recruitment analytics, reporting and presentation to stakeholders (using ATS/HRMS, reporting tools).
* A technological bent of mind and the ability to adapt to the latest technical advancements in the recruitment space.
* Good negotiation and convincing skills
* Good business acumen
* Key skills/attributes like emotional intelligence, agility and good decision making which are crucial to cater successfully as a talent acquisition lead.

If the above pique's your interest, please share your updated profiles with krupa.daniel@nexdigm.com

title: HR & Administration Manager
description:
**About The Role**

We are seeking an experienced
**HR & Administration Manager**
to establish and lead the plant's HR and administrative functions from the ground up.

This is a hands-on role requiring strong experience in industrial recruitment, labour law compliance, HR operations, and plant administration. The successful candidate will play a key role in the plant's establishment, workforce development, and subsequent operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Recruitment & Workforce Planning**

* Develop and execute recruitment plans for the plant's establishment and operational phases.
* Lead recruitment of engineering, production, QA/QC, technical, and administrative personnel, including skilled trades.
* Establish recruitment channels, partnerships with technical institutes (ITI), and apprenticeship programmes.
* Develop onboarding, induction, and employee retention processes.

**2. Labour Law & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable Indian labour laws, Labour Codes, Maharashtra regulations, and statutory requirements.
* Manage applicable registrations, licences, statutory records, returns, and inspections.
* Oversee PF, ESI, professional tax, gratuity, POSH compliance, and other statutory obligations.
* Manage contract labour compliance and monitor contractors' statutory obligations.

**3. Compensation, Benefits & Payroll**

* Develop salary structures, compensation policies, and employee benefit programmes.
* Manage payroll administration, statutory deductions, and timely payments.
* Support manpower budgeting, HR cost planning, and compensation reviews.

**4. HR Policies, Systems & Procedures**

* Establish the HR function, policies, procedures, and internal controls.
* Develop employment contracts, employee handbooks, HR documentation, and disciplinary procedures.
* Implement HR systems for employee records, attendance, leave, payroll, and performance management.
* Establish employee appraisal processes and support KPI development.

**5. Training, Competency & Quality Culture**

* Establish employee training, development, and competency management processes.
* Maintain training matrices, qualification records, and certification validity tracking.
* Support HR-related requirements under ISO 9001, ISO 19443, ISO 45001, ISO 14001 and other applicable quality standards.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, continuous improvement, and transparent reporting of quality concerns.

**6. Industrial Relations & Employee Engagement**

* Manage employee relations, grievance handling, disciplinary matters, and workplace disputes.
* Ensure compliance with applicable industrial relations and standing order requirements.
* Develop employee engagement, communication, and retention initiatives.

**7. Plant Administration & Facilities**

* Manage general plant administration, including security, housekeeping, canteen, transportation, and facility support services.
* Coordinate administrative contractors, service providers, and related budgets.
* Oversee visitor management, employee welfare facilities, and administrative procurement.
* Coordinate visa, immigration, FRRO, and logistical support for foreign personnel, where applicable.

**Candidate Requirements**

* **10+ years of progressive HR experience**
  , including significant experience in manufacturing or industrial facilities.
* Proven experience managing HR operations and statutory compliance at plant level in India.
* Strong knowledge of Indian labour legislation, statutory benefits, industrial relations, and contract labour management.
* Demonstrated experience recruiting engineering professionals, production personnel, and skilled industrial workers.
* Experience establishing or improving HR policies, systems, and administrative processes.
* Experience working in an international company with structured corporate policies and reporting standards.
* Familiarity with HR documentation, competency management, and training records in an ISO-certified or audited environment.
* Strong organizational, communication, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage operational tasks directly during the initial project stages.
* **Fluency in English and Marathi.**
* **High standards of professional ethics, confidentiality, and data protection.**

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in greenfield manufacturing projects or new plant commissioning.
* Background in engineering, energy, oil & gas, nuclear, aerospace, or other quality-regulated industries.
* Experience supporting foreign management and expatriate personnel.
* Relevant degree or postgraduate qualification in HR, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to establish and lead the HR and administration function of a new manufacturing facility.
* Direct involvement in the plant's development from project launch to full-scale operations.
* Exposure to international management practices and industrial quality standards.
* Long-term career development opportunities as the organization grows.

**How To Apply**

* Please submit your CV along with a brief description of an HR function, system, or process you have personally established or significantly improved to email address info@pwe-uae.com with a subject "PWE HRM Candidate - Your name"

title: Senior Benefits Partner
description:
**Ready to take your career global?**
Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a Senior Benefits Partner to join our ever evolving APAC team and help shape the future of global commerce.
  
  
**Job Description**
Are you ready to lead your next chapter? Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. With proven technology, we process the largest volume of payments in the world, driving the global economy every day. When you join Worldpay, you join a global community of experts and changemakers, working to reinvent an industry by constantly evolving how we work and making the way millions of people pay easier, every day.
  
  
We’re seeking a Senior Benefits Partner to join our People Office team and drive the delivery of best-in-class employee benefits across APAC, with a particular focus on India, Philippines, Australia and China, as well as other key APAC countries. Are you ready to make your mark as a strategic leader? Then you sound like a Worldpayer.
  
  
**About The Team**
As a Senior Benefits Partner, you will play a critical leadership role in shaping, overseeing, and administering employee benefits programs across APAC. You will provide advanced guidance to employees, influence external vendors and internal stakeholders, and ensure our benefits offerings are competitive, compliant with APAC labor law and statutory requirements, and strategically aligned with business objectives. This is a senior-level individual contributor position, ideal for a highly experienced professional with deep expertise in APAC benefits administration, with a particular focus in India, Philippines, Australia and China benefits.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Strategic Employee Support & Communication: Lead direct engagement with APAC employees regarding benefit programs, plan options, enrolment, policy features, and requirements. Serve as the principal contact for employee inquiries, ensuring clear, timely, and strategic communication.
* Benefits Program Leadership: Strategically oversee and communicate the company’s APAC benefits program, including medical, life, disability, retirement plans, and any country-specific offerings in key countries such as India, Philippines, Australia and China. Ensure robust records and data integrity across systems.
* Plan Design & Strategic Review: Drive the review, benchmarking, and design of benefit plans to optimize value for

employees and the organization. Lead annual plan renewals and recommend enhancements based on employee feedback, market trends, and compliance with APAC market practices.
  
  

* Advanced Data Analysis & Reporting: Lead the compilation, analysis, and reporting of benefit data (employee, plan, financial) for strategic planning, evaluation, and compliance. Prepare comprehensive management reports and oversee the annual audit process.
* Vendor & Systems Leadership: Direct integration and coordination with APAC benefits vendors and brokers, as well as internal stakeholders for all benefits, wellness, retirement, and HRIS/Workday systems, including file implementations and changes.
* Compliance & Regulatory Oversight: Ensure full compliance with APAC labour laws and statutory requirements. Lead preparation and submission of required government filings, coordinate employee communications, and oversee vendor billing. Stay up-to-date with regulatory changes and support internal/external audits.
* Process Innovation: Drive continuous improvement of processes and procedures to ensure efficient and accurate administration of APAC benefits programs.
* Annual Enrolment & Strategic Communications: Lead the design and communication of annual benefit enrolment materials for APAC employees. Conduct presentations and information sessions on benefit changes and legislative requirements.
* Wellness & Health Initiatives Leadership: Strategically support the implementation and communication of wellness and health education initiatives tailored to the APAC workforce.
* Contract & Proposal Management: Lead preparation of bid specifications, analyze vendor proposals and renewals, and interpret insurance carrier contracts to ensure optimal coverage and cost-effectiveness.
* Other Senior Duties: Perform other related duties as assigned to support the People Office and broader HR initiatives in APAC at a strategic level.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related discipline; or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
* Extensive knowledge of health, welfare, and retirement benefit plans, including statutory and market practices across APAC, with a particular focus on India, Philippines, Australia and China.
* Deep familiarity with APAC HR concepts, practices, and regulatory requirements (e.g. private medical care, group life insurance, retirement).
* Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Proven ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information at a senior level.
* Advanced analytical skills and attention to detail; ability to compile, analyze, and report business information for strategic decision-making.
* Mastery of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple complex projects, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
* Demonstrated ability to build influential relationships with employees, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Extensive experience with HRIS systems (e.g., Workday) preferred.
* Advanced understanding of benefit finance and cost analysis.
* Typically requires significant experience (at least five years) in a benefits role, with a strong focus on APAC benefits, particularly in India, Singapore and China.

**It’s a bonus if you have**

* Senior-level, professional individual contributor role.
* Fully qualified with comprehensive and advanced understanding of benefits administration in APAC, with a focus on India, Philippines, Australia and China.
* Works independently and leads on diverse and highly complex problems.

**What Makes a Worldpayer**
What makes a Worldpayer? It’s simple: Think, Act, Win. We stay curious, always asking the right questions to be better every day, finding creative solutions to simplify the complex. We’re dynamic, every Worldpayer is empowered to make the right decisions
  
  
for their customers. And we’re determined, always staying open – winning and failing as one.
  
  
Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Worldpayer. Apply now to write the next chapter in your career.
  
  
Worldpay is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.
  
  
**What makes a Globalpayer?**
Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.

title: Client Relationship Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Square Yards is a full-stack proptech platform that covers the end-to-end real estate journey from search and discovery through transactions, mortgages, home furnishing, rentals, and property management. The company also builds disruptive B2B platforms for developers, financial institutions, and real estate agents. Square Yards facilitates over 15,000 property transactions annually, with a transaction value exceeding USD 1 billion and strong unit economics. It has expanded successfully into global markets, including the Middle East, Australia, and Canada, which contribute a significant portion of its revenue. Leveraging data analytics and VR tools, as well as adjacent B2C platforms like Azuro, Interior Company, and Square Capital, Square Yards aims to transform the real estate ecosystem and lead across multiple categories.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Area Sales Executive role based in the Pune Division. The Area Sales Executive will be responsible for generating and converting leads, meeting prospective clients, and promoting Square Yards’ real estate offerings across residential and commercial segments. Daily activities include conducting property presentations and site visits, managing a sales pipeline, negotiating deals, and achieving monthly and quarterly sales targets. The role also involves maintaining strong relationships with developers and channel partners, gathering market intelligence, and providing regular sales reports and forecasts. The Area Sales Executive will collaborate closely with marketing, operations, and finance teams to ensure a seamless customer experience and support end-to-end transaction closure.
  
**Qualifications**

* Proven experience in real estate sales, business development, or field sales, ideally within the Pune market or similar urban markets.
* Strong client relationship management skills, with the ability to engage, influence, and build trust with diverse customer segments and stakeholders.
* Solid negotiation and deal-closing abilities, with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
* Comfort with using CRM tools, digital sales platforms, and basic data analysis to manage leads and track performance.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to conduct property demos and explain complex offerings clearly.
* High level of self-motivation, resilience, and ownership, with willingness to travel within the Pune Division for meetings and site visits.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce, or a related field preferred; relevant sales experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.
* Fluency in English and local languages used in Pune; familiarity with the regional real estate landscape is an advantage.

title: Services Sales Executive-B2B IT service
description:
**SERVICES SALES EXECUTIVE — INDIA**

Software Development & Managed Engineering · 12th Wonder · Pune

12th Wonder has delivered custom software and managed engineering teams to 100+ Indian enterprises since 2012. The delivery engine is proven — 70 engineers, a Pune centre operational since 2019, and a client base that renews.

What's missing is a dedicated hunter who can systematically connect this capability to new buyers. We're hiring a Services Sales Executive to own a territory, build pipeline from scratch, and close new-logo deals across India.

**THE ROLE**

This is a pure selling role. No team to manage in year one. No SDR motion to build. Your job is to find enterprise buyers who need custom software development or managed engineering capacity, and close them.

**You'll spend 80%+ of your time in front of customers**
— identifying strategic accounts, building relationships with CXOs and engineering leaders, running discovery, shaping solutions with our pre-sales and delivery teams, writing proposals, negotiating contracts, and closing. The remaining time goes into pipeline hygiene, forecasting, and sharpening your territory plan.

**You own your territory and your number.**
You'll define target accounts within assigned segments, decide your outbound approach, and run your own pipeline cadence. You'll have a pre-sales engineer and delivery leadership behind you on every qualified opportunity — but the deal is yours to win or lose.

**Your buyer:**
India-domiciled enterprises across three primary segments — automotive OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers, testing and certification (TIC) labs, and enterprise engineering R&D centres. Rupee-denominated, relationship-led, CXO-level deals averaging ~₹20 lakh. Pune's position inside the Chakan–Talegaon supplier belt puts the densest cluster of target accounts within a morning's drive.

**WHAT YOU'RE SELLING**

Two proven service lines, both with referenceable customers and repeatable delivery models:

**Custom software development.**
Full-stack engineering teams that design, build, and ship applications for enterprise clients — web, mobile, cloud, data, and integration. Engagements typically start as fixed-scope projects and expand into ongoing development partnerships.

**Managed engineering teams.**
Dedicated engineering capacity operated from our Pune centre, embedded in the client's product or platform roadmap. Longer-duration, higher-ACV engagements with sticky renewal economics. Clients retain technical control; we provide the team, the management layer, and the delivery infrastructure.

Both service lines sell to the same buyers through the same motion. The typical land is a ₹15–25 lakh project engagement; the expand is a managed team at 3–5x the initial contract value

**MILESTONES**

***Exhibit 1: Year-one de***

**First 30 days**

Territory plan defined. Target account list of 50+ accounts built and prioritised. CRM configured. First outbound sequences live.

**First 60 days**

Minimum 15 first meetings completed. At least 5 qualified opportunities in pipeline with identified budget and decision-maker.

﻿First 90 days

Pipeline value at 2x forward target. First proposals submitted. At least one deal in advanced negotiation

**First 180 days**

First closed-won deals on the board. Pipeline coverage at 3x forward target. Clear expansion path identified in at least two landed accounts

**End of year one**

₹75 lakh in closed revenue — roughly four deals at our average size. At least one account in active expansion from project to managed team.

**COMPENSATION**

Cash role — fixed plus variable, no ESOP attached. We'd rather be transparent about the economics than quote an OTE and let you reverse-engineer it.

***Exhibit 2: Compensation structure***

Fixed ₹12–15L

Target ₹75 lakh

Variable Plan ₹5.6L

OTE AT Plan ₹18–21L

**FIXARGE**
**VARIABLE AT PLA**
**OTE AT PLA**

**Variable is a flat 7.5% of closed revenue, uncapped.**
The rate doesn't taper past target — close ₹1 crore and the plan pays ₹7.5L variable, no renegotiation. Variable pays pro-rata from 70% of target, on revenue closed at or above floor margin. We're not going to pay you to discount, and you shouldn't want a plan that does.

**DETAILS**

***Exhibit 3: Role parameters***

**Location**

Pune. Remote (India) considered for strong candidates, with monthly onsite weeks.

**Buyer geography**

India-domiciled enterprises

**Reports to**

Chief Operating Officer

**Year-one target**

₹75 lakh in closed revenue

**Typical deal size**

~₹20 lakh

**Travel**

~30%, primarily metro India and the Pune industrial belt

**Team**

Individual contributor. Pre-sales and delivery support on qualified deals.

**Start**

Immediate

**HOW HIRING WORKS**

Three conversations over about two weeks:

**1. Screening call (30 min)**
— your track record, deal examples, and whether the buyer profile matches what you've sold.

**2. Pipeline walkthrough (60 min)**
— pick one of your best deals and walk us through it end-to-end: how you found it, how you qualified it, how you closed it, and what you'd do differently.

**3. Leadership conversation (45 min)**
— with the COO: territory, the number, and the terms.

Decision within 5 working days of the last conversation, either way.

3. **North America:**

title: Presales head - India (HCM Functional presales)
description:
Darwinbox is competing for the most complex enterprise HCM transformations in the market and the conversation is changing. As we move toward an AI-native HCM future and launch Cortex, our AI product, we need a Presales leader who can connect business problems, enterprise transformation, product capability, and commercial value into a story CXOs cannot ignore
  
  
We’re not looking for someone who simply presents the product.
  
  
We’re looking for someone who can shape the customer's thinking before they shape the solution.
  
  
Your role as India presales head is to make Darwinbox impossible to ignore in the enterprise HCM + AI conversation - shaping deals early, elevating the quality of customer conversations, increasing win rates, and building a presales organization that can scale with the business.
  
  
**What This Role Is**

* You will lead India Presales and a team of ~10-15, partnering closely with Sales and senior leaders to shape strategic enterprise and mid-market deals. You will be the person in the room who can understand what a business is trying to change, challenge the way it is thinking about the problem, and translate that into a compelling Darwinbox solution and business case.
* This is equal parts transformation advisor, deal strategist, and presales leader with the opportunity to influence how Darwinbox takes its next generation of HCM and AI capabilities to market.

**What Work Looks Like**

* Shape the deal before the demo. Partner with Sales from the earliest conversations to understand the account, shape the buying journey, qualify opportunities, and build a differentiated solution and value story.
* Be a CXO-level transformation advisor. Engage business leaders across functions, understand their strategic priorities, and connect HCM transformation to measurable business outcomes.
* Make complexity simple. Translate complex enterprise requirements into clear solution narratives, compelling demonstrations, POCs, and transformation roadmaps.
* Lead the India Presales engine. Set the strategy, operating rhythm, standards, resource model, and talent agenda for a 10-15-member organization; build capability and future leaders.
* Create a winning market motion. Define solution-led GTM strategies for new markets and product lines, strengthen competitive positioning, and identify what will move enterprise buyers.
* Turn the market into product insight. Bring customer and competitive intelligence into Product, influence roadmap discussions, and ensure market needs are represented in product decisions.
* Build AI-native presales. Use AI and modern tooling to improve research, discovery, solutioning, demos, POCs, and presales productivity—and help the organization operate differently as Darwinbox becomes AI-native.
* Drive initiatives. Participate and lead organizations initiatives as they come up from time to time

**Role expectations**

* Think beyond the RFP. Help customers rethink the problem before responding to the requirement.
* Own the commercial outcome. Balance customer value, solution quality, deal strategy, and presales investment to improve revenue, win rates, and sales velocity.
* Raise the talent bar. Build a high-performing team through coaching, capability building, succession planning, and strong standards for enterprise solution consulting.
* Influence without waiting for authority. Work across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and leadership to move strategic opportunities and market priorities forward.
* Have a point of view. Bring conviction on enterprise HCM trends, competitive dynamics, AI, and how customers will buy and operate differently in the future.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 12–15+ years of experience with significant enterprise presales / solution consulting leadership; proven ability to lead and scale presales teams.
* strong understanding of HCM and enterprise technology; exceptional executive presence and storytelling; strong deal strategy and cross-functional influence; and a demonstrated ability to use AI and modern tooling to improve how presales operates.

**Why this role is different**
You won’t just help sell what Darwinbox has built. You’ll help shape how the market understands where enterprise HCM is going—and how Darwinbox, including Cortex, can lead that shift.
  
  
**About Darwinbox:**
Darwinbox is Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1400+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries.
  
  
Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.

title: Sales Specialist
description:
Voy is a healthcare platform led by clinicians. We support people managing long-term health conditions with treatment plans backed by real evidence.
  
  
Founded in 2018, we started as MANUAL, focusing on hair loss, weight loss and men’s health. As we grew, we realised we could help more people. Today, Voy has around 750,000 active customers and has treated more than 2 million people since we began. We work across the UK, Germany, Brazil and India to make a new future of healthcare a reality. We’re approaching $1bn in ARR and have grown more than 100% year on year, every year since inception. At Voy, we let the evidence do the talking. In a published study of over 100,000 people, those who reached 12 months in the Voy programme and stayed engaged lost up to 24% of their body weight.

Voy entered India through the 100% acquisition of EarlyFit, which was started in 2025 by two passionate co-founders who spent 6 years in New York and witnessed first-hand the power of GLP-1s and how it grew from a niche solution to over 10cr real users worldwide. * Voy India: in

Have you heard of Ozempic? That’s a GLP-1. GLP-1s are diabetes and weight loss management medication that are the future of healthcare in India. They launched in the USA and Europe in 2017 but in India they have just launched in 2025 representing a massive opportunity. Voy is making life-changing treatment accessible to 250 million obese Indians for the first time. title: Relationship Manager - Retail Banking Group
description:
**Essential Services: Role & Location fungibility**

At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as One Bank, One Team. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be role and location-fungible with the understanding that Banking is an essential service. While the role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

**About the role**

A Relationship Manager is a core anchor in taking our banking solutions and services to our valuable customers. This involves a 360-degree banking approach. The Relationship Managers should have an inclination to understand the customer needs and offer solutions in line with the needs. The core philosophy to hold is being Fair to the Customer and Fair to the Bank. At ICICI Bank, our customer-centric relationship managers are responsible for acquiring new customer relationships and increasing the wallet share of existing customer relationships with a resolute focus on service quality and customer delight. They collaborate and work with different internal teams, thereby offering the best-in-class customer service. In line with our philosophy of taking the entire bank to the customers, our relationship managers work on the whole suite of offerings like saving solutions, loan products, overdraft solutions, Insta loans, investment solutions, care products, trade solutions, business loans, or wealth management solutions while upholding our fundamental value of being Fair to the Bank and Fair to the Customer.

**Bankable individuals not just Bankers: We hire from across industries!**

We at ICICI Bank are in continuous pursuit of creating consistent customer delight and superior experience. Our Relationship Managers are empowered individuals who champion the cause of customer experience and have penchant for building and nurturing business relationships. If you are an individual, whose heart echoes with our aspiration, look no more. We do not just choose diverse minds but celebrate their success. If you are a bankable individual without banking experience, you are very much welcome, irrespective of your present core responsibilities or the industry associated. Our training programs equip you to get ready for the role of a Relationship Manager. Professionals from across industries are welcome to apply for the role of Relationship Manager.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Customer Service:**
  Create service excellence by partnering with customers through their life cycle and offering suitable products and services based on their financial needs while being fair to the customer and fair to the bank in all engagements.
* **Business Development:**
  Ensuring a growth in wallet share of existing customers and on boarding new customers by offering 360-degree banking solutions that meet the needs of our customers
* **Champion 360-degree banking:**
  Offer products based on customer needs in collaboration with other internal teams in the bank for suitable product offerings.
* **Enhance the portfolio quality:**
  Work towards enhancing customer portfolio within the philosophy of Fair to the Bank, Fair to the Customer
* **Customized solutions:**
  As per branch guidelines. Upkeep and maintaining of the branch. Ensure availability of necessary infrastructure in the branch
* **Behold the values:**
  Offer products that are fair to our customers and fair to the Bank

**Key Qualification & Skills:**

* **Educational Qualification:**
  MBA or Graduates with 3-6 years of experience in the area of relationship management, Business development or allied roles.
* **Communication:**
  Good oral and written communication skills
* Synergize with Team: Willingness to work with various teams for on-ground support and deliver enablers as required.
* **Improvise:**
  Develop and implement overarching sales and customer relationship strategy, sales processes and structure.
* **Market Sensing:**
  Monitor and evaluate industry trends, customer drivers and potential partnerships

**About the Business Group**

Retail Banking Group at ICICI Bank serves customer segments consisting of individuals, self-employed professionals, SMEs, proprietors, government, and retail institutions. With widespread presence across the country, our relationship team is dedicated to serving customer needs with a 360-degree approach. ICICI Bank has a unique bouquet of digital solutions covering the diverse banking needs of customers. To facilitate a seamless customer banking experience, we have adopted the ICICI Stack approach. It covers a complete range of banking services from bank accounts, payments, banking transactions, and credit cards to personal, mortgage, vehicle loans, and business & institutional solutions.

title: Inside Sales Account Executive
description:
**About Huvo AI**

**Huvo AI is an AI sales platform built for Indian real estate. Arjun, our AI voice agent, calls and qualifies buyer leads, books site visits and follows up on WhatsApp. Our real estate CRM gives the human sales team AI lead assignment, call memory and team performance ratings.**

* **Who buys:**
  channel partners (CPs), brokerages and developers with sales teams of 5 or more
* **Where:**
  customers across Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai and Pune, and live in Dubai
* **Results:**
  customers have cut their cost per booking by more than half compared with Meta and Google pre-sales funnels
* **Backed by:**
  Leading investors in India

**Why this role exists**

**We have more demo requests than we can run. Every week, prospects who asked to see the product wait too long because the founder is still running most demos.**

**You will be one of our first inside sales closers. No cold calling:**
your pipeline is demos already booked with CP owners and sales heads who raised their hand. Your job is to run those demos well and turn them into paying accounts.

**What you’ll do**

* Run 5 to 7 video demos a day with CP owners and sales heads, in Hindi and English
* Diagnose each prospect’s lead flow (sources, response time, team size, current CRM), then show where Huvo fits
* Close the deal: explain the annual platform fee and prepaid wallet, recommend a pilot or a plan, and handle objections on price and switching CRMs
* Collect payment upfront. We are fully prepaid, so a deal counts when the recharge lands
* Follow up on no-shows and “call me next week” prospects until they re-book or say no
* Hand each new account to onboarding with complete requirements (projects, scripts, languages, lead sources), so it goes live in 4 to 7 days
* Keep every deal current in the Huvo CRM. You sell it, so you use it
* Send product a weekly note on objections, lost-deal reasons and feature requests

**Must have**

* 2 to 4 years in B2B SaaS inside sales, with deals you closed yourself, not only meetings you booked
* Comfortable running a demo on Google Meet or Zoom and closing without meeting in person
* Fluent Hindi and English, and at ease talking to brokers and CP owners in their language
* Comfortable with numbers: per-call pricing, wallet balances, ROI against cost per booking
* Disciplined CRM habits and fast follow-up

**Good to have**

* Experience selling to real estate developers, CPs or brokers, for example at Sell.do, Leadrat, LeadSquared, Housing.com, 99acres, MagicBricks, NoBroker or Square Yards
* Experience selling telephony, WhatsApp Business API or voice AI products
* A third language such as Marathi, Kannada, Telugu or Tamil

**Probably not a fit if**
you mainly cold-call lists, need face-to-face meetings to close, or prefer long enterprise sales cycles to high-volume closing.

**Compensation and benefits**

* **Fixed:**
  ₹5 to 8 LPA, depending on experience
* **Incentive:**
  10% of collected revenue on accounts you close, paid monthly, uncapped
* **ESOPs:**
  you’re eligible as part of the early team
* **Flexible hours**
  at our Udyog Vihar, Gurugram office
* **Growth:**
  work directly with the founder, reporting to our CBO, and grow into leading the inside sales team as we expand to Dubai and new markets

**How to apply**

* **Email**
  **tushar@huvo.ai**
  with your resume and a 2-minute voice note or Loom pitching a product you’ve sold, or call
  **+91 8867566505**
  .

Competitive fixed compensation, performance-linked incentives, and comprehensive corporate benefits.

title: Ads Sales Manager
description:
About the Company
  
Bachatt has transformed how India saves. Bachatt is a young Indian fintech startup founded by 3 friends from IIT/IIM with 10+ years of relevant experience (https://bachatt.app). Bachatt provides a savings and investment platform to specifically target over 30 crore self-employed individuals in India, who find regular mutual funds and investment platforms daunting, and often have irregular income streams. Further, the vision is to empower them to access the full suite of financial products like loans, insurance, and credit cards, in a simplified and curated experience, like an offline insurance or mutual fund agent provides them. The company was founded in November 2024 and raised over $15 million in two rounds of funding, by leading marquee investors of the likes of Lightspeed Venture Partners, Info Edge Ventures, and Accel Ventures. Founders: Anugrah Jain (CEO), Ankur Jhavery, and Mayank Agarwal.
  
About the Role
  
We are looking for an Ads Manager who sits at the intersection of ad technology, brand partnerships, and product thinking. This is not a pure sales role or a pure tech role — it is a techno-managerial position where you will own the full advertising lifecycle at Bachatt: from sourcing and closing brand deals, to configuring and operating campaigns inside Google Ad Manager, to working with engineering to build product features that improve ad performance and user experience. You will be the primary owner of Bachatt's publisher-side ad operations, acting as the bridge between our brand partners, our ad infrastructure, and our product and engineering teams.
  
Responsibilities
  
Ad Operations & Campaign ManagementOwn end-to-end campaign setup, trafficking, and optimisation in Google Ad Manager (GAM) — including line items, creatives, targeting, priority rules, frequency caps, and pacing.Manage AdMob configuration for programmatic backfill demand with floor price controls to maintain ad quality standards.Define and enforce native ad templates in GAM so all ads — direct or programmatic — render on-brand inside the Bachatt app.Monitor campaign delivery daily; identify under-delivery, creative issues, or pacing problems and resolve proactively.Maintain app-ads.txt, ads.txt, and all supply chain transparency requirements.
  
Direct Brand Partnerships & Advertiser RelationsSource, pitch, and close direct advertising deals with brands relevant to Bachatt's user base — fintech, BFSI, consumer goods, lifestyle, and e-commerce.Negotiate CPMs, flat-rate packages, sponsorship deals, and barter arrangements with brand marketing teams and their agencies.Build and maintain a rate card and inventory calendar for Bachatt's premium ad placements.Serve as the primary relationship manager for all active advertisers — from onboarding through campaign delivery and renewal.Collect campaign creatives, review them for brand safety and technical compliance, and coordinate approvals.
  
Agency PartnershipsIdentify and empanel media buying agencies and digital marketing agencies as channel partners to scale advertiser outreach.Negotiate agency commission structures and manage agency-facing rate cards.Own the agency pipeline — track deals in progress, forecasts, and revenue attributed to agency channel.
  
  
Qualifications
  
2-4 years of hands-on experience operating Google Ad Manager (GAM) — trafficking line items, managing orders, configuring native ad templates, setting up open bidding or mediation. Working knowledge of Google AdMob — mediation setup, ad unit configuration, floor prices. Direct experience in publisher-side ad sales — you have personally sourced and closed brand deals, not just managed campaigns handed to you. Strong understanding of in-app advertising fundamentals: ad formats (banner, interstitial, rewarded, native), CPM/CPC/CPL pricing, waterfall vs. header bidding, programmatic vs. direct. Comfort with analytics tools — Google Analytics, Firebase, or equivalent — to make data-driven decisions. Ability to write clear product requirements and work directly with developers without heavy hand-holding.
  
Required Skills
  
Experience with mobile app analytics platforms (AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Firebase).Familiarity with the GMA SDK integration process (Flutter, React Native, or native Android/iOS).Prior experience at a fintech, consumer app, or digital media publisher in an ad monetisation or growth role.Knowledge of OpenRTB, SSPs, DSPs, and the broader programmatic ecosystem — even if you won't be operating them day-to-day.Experience building or maintaining a rate card and agency empanelment process.
  
Preferred Skills
  
Why Join Bachatt: Own the entire ad monetisation vertical from day one — no bureaucracy, no middle layers. Work directly with the founding team; your decisions have immediate revenue impact. Opportunity to build a premium, brand-safe native ad business in one of India's fastest-growing fintech categories. Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside. Flexible, async-friendly work culture with a hybrid setup in Delhi NCR.
  
Pay range and compensation package
  
Competitive compensation with meaningful equity upside.
  
Equal Opportunity Statement
  
Bachatt is committed to diversity and inclusivity in the workplace.

title: Printed Circuit Board Design Intern
description:
**Company Description**
Greenverse is focused on creating cleaner, healthier air through innovative and intelligent air purification solutions. The company designs air purifiers that combine multi-level technological filtration with natural plant-based purification to address both harmful gases and particulate matter. * Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate in a multidisciplinary team environment.
* Interest in clean-tech, sustainability, and air-quality solutions; prior coursework or projects in embedded systems or hardware design are a plus.

title: Senior Programme Associate – Boiler and Heat Pump
company: International Forum for Environment, Sustainability & Technology (iFOREST)
description:
The
**International Forum for Environment, Sustainability & Technology (iFOREST)**
, is looking for experienced and dynamic professionals to support & lead the organisation’s research on decarbonising industrial heat in boiler-based industries and MSMEs.

A successful applicant must have a proven aptitude for technical and analytical research, industry surveys, and technical writing and presentation, and good communication skills with government, industry and related agencies. The candidate should ideally have
**working experience on energy, GHG emissions and techno-economics, and knowledge of industries/MSMEs, boilers, heat pumps, energy efficiency, energy audits and related policies.**

**Location**
: Sector 132, Noida, India

**Required Experience**
: 6+ years

**Number of Positions**
: 2

If you are interested, please apply at: https://forms.gle/8rjDK4ACwXA2m6gX7

**About iFOREST**

iFOREST is an independent not-for-profit research and innovation organisation that was established in 2019 to identify, promote and scale up solutions for pressing environment-development challenges in India and other developing countries in Asia and Africa.

Our work is rooted in regional priorities to accelerate environmental actions at the sub-national level and to improve national policies and plans to support it. Our mission is to address the unique needs of regions by leveraging our resources and expertise to scale up national action and make a global impact. We use our regional knowledge to inform national policy and plans and strengthen international collaboration.

To achieve our goals, we conduct independent evidence-based research, develop new knowledge and innovative solutions, convene stakeholders to increase awareness and build consensus, and partner with think tanks, civil society, government agencies, philanthropies and industry to scale up solutions.

***The Industrial Decarbonization Programme***

The Industrial Decarbonization Programme is a part of iFOREST’s flagship initiative on Enabling Energy Transitions. The objective of the programme is to steer a green industry transition to support green growth and green jobs, while improving local environmental conditions and achieving climate goals. The focus is on conducting evidence-based research, including modelling studies to develop comprehensive roadmaps, identify policy solutions and provide technical support for industrial decarbonisation in sectors like steel, fertilizer, cement, bricks and at-risk MSME sectors. The transition in these sectors has the potential to deliver significant emissions reductions and generate impact at the state and national level.

The Programme is strongly focused on technical research and stakeholder engagement (especially with government departments/agencies and the industry) to achieve a green transition of fossil fuel-dependent factories that are associated with various industries.

Within this, the
**Boiler and Heat Pump Programme**
focuses on decarbonising industrial process heat in boiler-based industries and MSMEs, such as food & beverages, textiles, chemicals and pharma, through energy efficiency, energy audits, industrial heat pumps, cleaner technologies and supportive policy, with on-ground engagement in industrial states such as West Bengal and Maharashtra.

***The Role***

The Senior Programme Associate will be responsible for leading the execution of research outputs on industrial heat decarbonisation across boiler-based industries and MSMEs. This would entail research and analysis, industry surveys and data collection, and technical report writing and presentations, while guiding junior team members. In addition, they would also be expected to identify new areas of work to support institutional goals.

Specific tasks to be undertaken are:-

**Research and analysis**

* Lead the design of research assignments, including research strategy, methodology and work plans.
* Conduct in-depth research and analysis on energy, technology, techno-economics, GHG emissions and pollution in boiler-based industries and MSMEs.
* Assess options such as energy efficiency, industrial heat pumps and cleaner fuels/technologies for process heat.
* Stay abreast with the latest developments, technologies and policies in the sector.
* Mentor young researchers in the team in executing research assignments.

**Industry surveys and data collection**

* Plan and lead industry surveys, plant visits, energy assessments and primary data collection.
* Manage, clean and analyse large datasets from field and secondary sources.
* Coordinate with state coordinators, industry and government agencies for field work and data access.

**Technical report writing and presentations**

* Write and review technical reports, policy papers and briefs based on evidence.
* Prepare and deliver presentations for industry, government and other stakeholders.
* Support roundtables, consultations and report release meetings with government, industry, civil society and media.

**Additional duties**

* Contribute to shaping the overall strategy for the programme, aligned with institutional priorities, sector-specific issues and ongoing work of other key institutions.
* Identify new pathways, initiatives, and partnerships that contribute to programmatic goals.
* Support development of new concept notes, proposals, theory of change and budgets for projects/interventions that further institutional objectives.
* Contribute to the institution’s brand building by representing iFOREST on various public platforms.
* Execute any related assignments that may arise in relation to the tasks or for further enhancement of the programme.

***Qualification & Work Experience***

* A
  **Bachelor’s or Master’s in Engineering is a must, preferably in Energy, Technology, Industrial Operations or related streams.**
* Working experience on
  **energy, GHG emissions and techno-economics**
  will be preferred.
* Knowledge of
  **industries/MSMEs, boilers, heat pumps, energy efficiency, energy audits and related policies**
  will be preferred.
* Experience in research, technical writing and presentation, with a track record of
  **technical research, policy papers and presentations**
  , will be preferred.
* **Project and team management**
  experience will be preferred.
* A
  **minimum of 6 years of relevant work experience**
  in industrial research, advisory, or consulting is required.

**Competencies & Responsibilities**

**The successful candidate should have the following competencies:-**

* Strong
  **technical knowledge**
  of industrial operations, boilers, process heat and energy
* Strong
  **quantitative skills, with ability to work with large datasets**
  .
* Ability to undertake technical research, techno-economic analysis, and surveys.
* Ability to prepare technical reports of high quality.
* Experience of engagement with industry partners, government agencies, and other stakeholders.

**Why Choose iFOREST**

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Job Description**

Company: Maliao

Designation: Human Resource Executive

Location: Netaji Subhash Place (NSP), Delhi (on-site)

Working Days: Monday to Friday

Experience 2–4 years in HR, with hands-on experience in recruitment

**We are looking for immediate joiner**

**About Maliao**

Maliao is a fast-growing colour cosmetics brand with more than 300 products. We sell through our website (maliao.in), leading e-commerce marketplaces, retail and social platforms. As we grow, we need good people and a workplace where they want to stay.

**Role Overview**

As Human Resource Executive, you'll manage hiring at Maliao from start to finish, be the voice of Maliao as an employer on LinkedIn, and help build an office culture people enjoy being part of. The role suits someone who is people-first, organized and energetic, and who likes to take ownership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Recruitment & Hiring**

* **Manage the full hiring cycle:**
* understand requirements from department heads, write job descriptions, source candidates, screen them, schedule interviews and close positions.
* Source candidates through LinkedIn, Naukri, Indeed, Instahyre, referrals, colleges and other channels
* Hire for roles across Marketing, Creative, E-commerce, SCM, CRM, Warehouse and other departments
* Conduct first-round screening calls and coordinate interviews with hiring managers
* Follow up with candidates, collect feedback, negotiate offers and share offer letters
* Maintain a recruitment tracker and a candidate database, and report hiring status and turnaround time (TAT) to management
* Build a talent pipeline for recurring and upcoming roles

* **Onboarding**
* Handle pre-joining formalities, document collection and background checks
* Plan the new joiner's first day: induction, workstation setup, introduction to the team and an overview of company policies.
* Check in with new hires during their first 30–90 days so they settle in well

* **LinkedIn Page & Employer Branding**
* Manage Maliao's LinkedIn company page, including posting job openings, hiring announcements, team highlights, work anniversaries, achievements and behind-the-scenes content.
* Plan a monthly LinkedIn content calendar and work with the Creative team on post designs.
* Grow page followers and engagement, and track page performance.
* Present Maliao as a great place to work, both on LinkedIn and on job portals

* **Office Culture & Employee Engagement**
* Plan and run culture activities such as birthday and work anniversary celebrations, festival celebrations, team lunches, fun Fridays, games and outings.
* Organize employee recognition programs such as Employee of the Month and appreciation shout- outs
* Collect employee feedback and suggest ways to improve the work environment
* Be a friendly first point of contact for employee concerns and escalate them to management when needed

* **HR Operations (Supporting)**
* Maintain employee records, attendance and leave data
* Help with exit formalities and exit interviews
* Help the team implement and communicate HR policies

**What We're Looking For**

* 2–4 years of HR experience with a strong focus on recruitment, preferably in D2C, FMCG, beauty, e-commerce or a startup
* Good experience sourcing through LinkedIn and job portals
* Experience managing a company LinkedIn page or doing employer branding
* A creative, energetic approach to planning engagement activities and events
* Excellent communication in English and Hindi, both spoken and written
* Well organized, able to handle several open positions at once
* Comfortable with MS Excel / Google Sheets and Canva (a plus)
* A graduate or MBA/PGDM in HR

**Why Join Maliao**

• Build the team and culture of a growing beauty brand

• Direct exposure to hiring across every function of a D2C business

• 5-day work week

• A young, fast-moving and friendly work environment

**How to Apply**

Send your CV to 
**hr@maliao.in**
. Use the subject line 
**“Application – HR Executive”**
.

We take pride in providing opportunities to our employees to create, explore, express, take risks and grow. As a ReNewer, you’ll always be doing things that would be beneficial to millions.
  
  
**About Company**
Founded in 2011, ReNew, is one of the largest renewable energy companies globally, with a leadership position in India. Listed on Nasdaq under the ticker RNW, ReNew develops, builds, owns, and operates utility-scale wind energy projects, utility-scale solar energy projects, utility-scale firm power projects, and distributed solar energy projects.
