We are looking for a
**Store HR**
who will be the HR point of contact for our store teams and play a hands-on role in managing the complete employee lifecycle at the store level.

About the Role

The Store HR will partner closely with the
**Store Manager and Operations team**
to ensure smooth people operations across the outlet. The role will be responsible for frontline hiring, onboarding, attendance and leave management, employee engagement, grievance handling, performance management, compliance, and overall employee experience.

The ideal candidate
**must have prior HR experience in the retail and/or hospitality industry**
, with a strong understanding of managing frontline, shift-based and customer-facing employees.

Key Responsibilities

1. Store Hiring & Recruitment

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for store-level and frontline positions.
* Work closely with Store Managers to understand manpower requirements and staffing gaps.
* Source candidates through job portals, referrals, walk-ins, local hiring networks, and other relevant channels.
* Screen candidates and coordinate interviews with the operations team.
* Drive timely closures for critical store positions.
* Maintain recruitment trackers and monitor joining ratios.
* Build and maintain a pipeline of suitable frontline talent for future requirements.

2. Onboarding & Employee Lifecycle

* Coordinate joining formalities, documentation, background verification, and induction.
* Ensure new employees receive a smooth and engaging onboarding experience.
* Conduct HR induction covering company policies, workplace conduct, attendance, leave, benefits, and employee expectations.
* Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation.
* Manage employee movements including transfers, promotions, confirmations, and exits.
* Conduct exit interviews and identify key reasons for attrition.

3. Attendance, Leave & Workforce Management

* Monitor daily attendance, shift rosters, leave, absenteeism, and manpower availability.
* Work closely with Store Managers to address attendance and staffing issues.
* Track late coming, absenteeism, overtime, and other workforce-related matters.
* Ensure timely and accurate payroll inputs from the store.
* Coordinate with the central HR/payroll team to resolve employee payroll queries.

4. Employee Relations & Grievance Handling

* Act as the primary HR point of contact for store employees.
* Build strong relationships with frontline employees and store leadership.
* Listen to and resolve employee concerns and grievances in a fair and timely manner.
* Support managers in handling disciplinary and behavioural issues.
* Maintain confidentiality while handling sensitive employee matters.
* Foster a positive, respectful, and inclusive workplace culture.

5. Employee Engagement & Culture

* Drive employee engagement initiatives at the store level.
* Organize employee activities, celebrations, recognition programs, and team-building initiatives.
* Support initiatives aimed at improving employee morale and retention.
* Promote Foodstories' values and culture across the store team.
* Regularly interact with employees to understand their experience and concerns.

6. Performance Management

* Coordinate store-level performance review and appraisal processes.
* Ensure employees and managers complete performance discussions on time.
* Support managers with performance-related concerns and improvement plans.
* Track employee confirmations and performance-related actions.
* Identify high-performing employees and support recognition initiatives.

7. HR Compliance & Documentation

* Ensure adherence to company HR policies and procedures.
* Maintain accurate employee documentation and store HR records.
* Support compliance with applicable labour and employment regulations.
* Ensure required statutory records and documentation are maintained.
* Coordinate with the central HR team on audits and compliance requirements.

8. HR MIS & Reporting

* Prepare and maintain regular store HR reports.
* Track headcount, attrition, absenteeism, hiring, vacancies, attendance, and employee movements.
* Highlight key people-related issues and trends to the HR and Operations leadership.
* Maintain accurate and timely HR data in HRMS and other systems.

Must-Have Experience

* **2–5 years of HR experience, preferably in Retail, Hospitality, QSR, Restaurants, Food & Beverage, or other customer-facing businesses.**
* **Prior experience managing frontline/store employees is mandatory.**
* Strong understanding of shift-based and high-volume workforce environments.
* Experience in frontline recruitment and employee engagement.
* Experience handling employee grievances, attendance, attrition, and HR operations at the store/outlet level.

Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM in HR will be an added advantage.

What We Are Looking For

* We are looking for someone who is
  **hands-on, approachable, energetic, and comfortable working on the store floor**
  .
* The right candidate should enjoy working closely with frontline teams, understand the realities of retail and hospitality operations, and be able to balance
  **employee needs with business requirements**
  .
* This is not a desk-only HR role. The Store HR will be expected to be
  **visible and accessible to employees, work closely with the Store Manager, and proactively identify and solve people-related issues.**

title: HR Generalist (Gurugram)
description:
**Role overview**

You should know what to expect if you're going to join Qcept. Lean in. A little closer.

At a company our size, and one that's growing fast, HR isn't a department. It's a person. That person needs to handle Talent acquisition, HR processes and compliance, and the occasional "can you help me find a good team lunch spot" request. That person might be you. Fancy coming along for the ride?

**What your day actually looks like**

You'll sit close to leadership, which means you'll have real visibility into how the business runs. Not just the people side, but hiring decisions, vendor negotiations, billing coordination, and how the team operates day to day. There's no HR hierarchy above you, no playbook handed down from a central function. You'll be building the processes, not just running them.

Some days you'll be sourcing candidates and coordinating interviews. Other days you'll be chasing an invoice, onboarding a vendor, or making sure a teammate's equipment request doesn't fall through the cracks. The role spans further than a typical HR title because the team needs it to. If that sounds like too much, it probably is. If it sounds like exactly the kind of ownership you've been waiting for, keep reading.

**Key responsibilities:**

* **Talent acquisition:**
  Lead end-to-end hiring processes, including sourcing, screening, coordinating interviews, and onboarding new hires.
* **HR processes and compliance:**
  Establish and maintain company-level HR policies, ensuring smooth operations and compliance with statutory requirements.
* **Employee operations:**
  Manage day-to-day HR operations such as leave and attendance records, payroll coordination, and equipment and access requests.
* **Operations support:**
  Assist in project coordination with teammates, set up the right processes such as capturing minutes of meetings, and follow up to ensure timely execution of key initiatives.
* **People partnering:**
  Act as a point of contact for employee queries, grievances, and HR support, ensuring a positive employee experience.
* **Documentation and Records:**
  Maintain accurate and up-to-date HR documentation, databases, and reports for management insights.
* **Employee engagement:**
  Plan and drive initiatives to strengthen team culture, foster collaboration, and keep employees motivated and connected.

**Requirements**

* 3 to 5 years of experience in HR or related functions.
* Previous experience working in a design agency, marketing agency, creative agency, or similar fast-paced service environment is preferred.
* Strong communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities with attention to detail.

**Location:**
Gurugram, India (On-site)

**Job type:**
Full-Time

**Company:**
Qcept Presentations

**Compensation:**
₹6–14 LPA (CTC will be based on the candidate’s experience, strengths, and the scope of responsibilities they can take on.)

**Values with which we intend to build the company**

* Building a team on meritocracy.
* Having fun at work, together.
* Integrity to ourselves and our customers.
* Maximise for long-term value over short-term value.
* In pursuit of excellence.

* Please visit our website at www.qceptpresentations.com and learn more about us
* Write to us at careers@qceptpresentations.com. Share your resume and a brief note on how you can help us acquire exceptional talent, build better people processes, and create a stronger workplace culture.

At Qcept Presentations, we help consulting firms, enterprises, and fast-growing businesses create memorable presentations. As we grow, we're looking for someone who can help us build the right people processes and culture.

**Position Title**

Deputy General Manager (DGM) – PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT & HR OPS (Payroll, Compliance & HR Technology)

**Location**

NCR (Delhi / Gurugram / Noida)

**Reports To**

Chief Human Resources Officer

**Experience Required**

15–20 years in HR, with significant depth in Payroll, Statutory Compliance and HRIS

**Employment Type**

Role Purpose

The DGM – HR will own the end-to-end payroll function, ensure robust statutory and labour-law compliance across all locations, and lead the selection, implementation and adoption of HR technology platforms. The role demands a hands-on strategic leader who can safeguard the organisation from compliance risk, deliver accurate and timely payroll, and digitise HR operations to improve employee experience and decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Payroll Management**

* Lead end-to-end payroll processing for all employee categories (permanent, contractual, consultants) with 100% accuracy and on-time disbursement.
* Oversee salary structuring, CTC design, variable pay, reimbursements, full & final settlements, and perquisite taxation.
* Ensure accurate TDS computation, Form 16/24Q filing, investment declaration and proof verification, and tax-optimisation advisory for employees.
* Manage payroll vendor/outsourcing partners, SLAs, and periodic payroll audits and reconciliations (payroll vs. GL).
* Establish payroll controls, governance, MIS and dashboards for leadership and Finance.

**2. Statutory & Labour Law Compliance**

* Ensure full compliance with PF/EPF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, Gratuity, Bonus, Maternity Benefit, Minimum Wages, and Shops & Establishments Acts.
* Drive readiness and implementation of the four Labour Codes (Code on Wages, Industrial Relations, Social Security, OSH) and related rules.
* Oversee POSH compliance, Contract Labour (CLRA) compliance, principal employer obligations, and Factories Act requirements as applicable.
* Manage statutory returns, registrations, licences, inspections, audits and liaison with PF, ESIC, Labour Department and other authorities.
* Maintain a compliance calendar, risk register and internal audit mechanism; handle notices, litigation and representations.
* Track regulatory changes and proactively advise leadership on impact and action plans.

**3. HR Technology & Digital Transformation**

* Define the HR technology roadmap and lead evaluation, selection, implementation and rollout of HRMS/HRIS, payroll, attendance, ATS, LMS, performance and employee self-service platforms.
* Own requirement gathering, process mapping, configuration, UAT, data migration, integration (with ERP/Finance, biometric, banks) and go-live.
* Drive change management, user training and adoption; track usage and measure ROI of HR tools.
* Manage technology vendors, contracts, SLAs, data security and privacy (including DPDP Act compliance).
* Leverage HR analytics, automation and AI-enabled tools to improve efficiency, reporting and workforce insights.

**4. Leadership & Business Partnership**

* Lead and develop the Payroll, Compliance and HR Operations team; set goals, build capability and ensure succession.
* Partner with Finance, Legal, IT and business heads on cost, budgets, headcount data and audit requirements.
* Support HR policy design, employee relations matters, due diligence and HR integration for M&A or new locations.
* Prepare and present periodic HR operations, compliance and technology updates to senior management.

Qualifications

* Master’s degree in HR / Personnel Management / Industrial Relations (MBA-HR, MHROD or equivalent) from a reputed institute.
* Additional qualification in Labour Law, Taxation or Compliance (e.g., PG Diploma in Labour Laws, LLB) is preferred.

Experience & Skills

* 15–20 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 8–10 years in payroll and compliance leadership roles.
* Proven track record of implementing or migrating HRMS/payroll platforms (e.g., SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, Oracle HCM, Darwinbox, Keka, greytHR, Zoho People, ADP or similar).
* Strong working knowledge of Indian payroll, income tax (TDS), PF/ESI and central/state labour legislation; multi-state experience preferred.
* Experience managing audits, inspections and statutory authority interactions.
* Strong analytical, project management and vendor management capabilities; advanced Excel and data-analytics skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence at senior levels.
* High integrity, attention to detail, and a process-driven, solution-oriented mindset.

Key Performance Indicators

* Payroll accuracy and on-time processing (target: zero errors / zero delays).
* 100% statutory compliance – nil penalties, timely filings, clean audit outcomes.
* On-time, on-budget delivery of HR technology projects and measurable user adoption.
* Reduction in manual effort and turnaround time through automation.
* Employee satisfaction with payroll and HR services; team engagement and capability building.

Compensation & Location

Compensation will be commensurate with experience and industry standards. The role is based in the National Capital Region (NCR).

title: Chief Human Resources Officer
description:
## About the Role

We are looking for a CHRO: a leader who will get the right talent in place, build an environment where people perform at their peak, and create a high-performance culture across plants, sales and the head office. The role works directly with both Managing Directors and carries real influence on how the company grows.

## Key Responsibilities

- Lead hiring for senior and critical roles; set selection standards for all levels, using structured interviews, references and validated assessments such as Thomas.

- Run annual talent reviews and succession planning for critical roles, separating ready-now successors from those who need development.

- Build leadership and manager capability, with priority on plant supervisors and sales managers.

- Build campus, ITI and lateral pipelines ahead of the Visakhapatnam expansion, which adds about 400 people over two years.

- Strengthen the PMS and Balanced Scorecard: clear goals, timely reviews, fair calibration, and consequences for both strong and weak performance.

- Design and lead a culture programme that makes high performance, accountability and the company values visible in daily behaviour.

- Measure engagement and act on it. Use Great Place to Work participation as a tool for improvement.

- Run a regular policy health check: identify policies and processes that frustrate employees or expose the company, and fix them. Examples include employee advances and loans, transfers, and grievance handling, each with clear eligibility, approval levels and turnaround times.

- Lead HR across Sitarganj (around 1,800 employees) and Visakhapatnam (around 300, rising to about 700), through the Plant HR Heads.

- Be personally present at the plants: shop-floor connect, major IR matters, wage settlements, sensitive disciplinary cases and contractor governance.

- Ensure plant HR has the people, policy and authority to keep sites staffed, stable and productive.

- Partner Ajay and sales leadership on structure, territory staffing, field productivity and manager quality for the 300-person national sales force.

- Own sales incentive governance: clear eligibility, calculation, timely payout and dispute resolution.

- Reduce regretted attrition and time to fill vacant territories.

- Lead HR for the 300-person head office.

- Head Admin and Facilities across locations through the admin team, including the Sitarganj admin function led by Umesh Tyagi. Set standards for facilities, travel, transport, canteen and office services.

- Own grading, pay structures, benefits and variable pay with Finance; ensure pay is competitive for critical roles and linked to performance.

- Own the manpower budget with Finance and track manpower cost against capacity, productivity and revenue.

- Improve HRMS, payroll controls and HR data so that decisions are based on reliable numbers; publish a monthly people dashboard.

- Lead the people side of the company's AI transformation: role redesign, reskilling and adoption, with safeguards for employee data and human review of material people decisions.

- Ensure compliance with employment laws, the four Labour Codes and state rules across all locations, with a location-wise compliance register maintained with Legal.

- Ensure effective POSH governance, respecting the Internal Committee's independence.

## Requirements

- 20 or more years of progressive HR experience, including at least 5 years leading HR for a business with 2,000 or more employees.

- Hands-on experience across all three worlds: manufacturing plants with IR and contract labour, a national field sales force, and a corporate office.

- A track record of building talent and performance systems that measurably improved results, not only designing policies.

- Experience working closely with promoters or founders, including handling two senior stakeholders with different priorities.

- Comfort spending real time at plants and in the field.

- MBA, PGDM or postgraduate qualification in HR or IR from a recognised institution.

## Preferred Qualifications

- Building materials, panels, paper, cement, ceramics or comparable process manufacturing with national distribution.

- Greenfield or major expansion experience, including large-volume hiring.

- HR transformation, HR analytics or technology-led change.

## Location & Work Mode

Base: Delhi head office, with regular travel to Sitarganj, Visakhapatnam and sales regions. Six-day working week.

title: Oliver Wyman - HR Operations Manager - Gurugram
description:
**Oliver Wyman is looking for an experienced HR Operations Manager to join our Human Capital team, supporting the IMEA (India, Middle East, and South Africa) region.**
**This role will be based out of our Gurugram office.**
**Role Purpose:**
Lead Human Capital Operations in India, supporting approximately 200 colleagues through reliable employee services, effective people process, and compliance with Indian employment requirements and global firm standards. As a trusted partner to local leadership, you will manage complex employee relations matters, oversee payroll and employee lifecycle operations, and develop the local HC Operations team to support a growing business.
  
  
**Why join us:**

* Play a meaningful role in supporting Oliver Wyman's growing India location, serving approximately 200 colleagues.
* Partner closely with India leadership and regional and global Human Capital teams on operational and complex people matters.
* Lead improvements to local HC Operations processes and support the integration of global teams and capabilities in India.
* Build expertise across Indian employment requirements, employee relations, payroll, and Workday-enabled operations.

**Meet the team:**

* Reports to: Senior HC Operations Manager.
* Collaborates with: India leadership, managers and colleagues; regional and global Human Capital teams; Employee Relations, Legal, Talent Management, payroll and benefits providers, and external counsel as appropriate.
* People management: Lead, coach, and develop the local HC Operations team, supporting collaboration, capability development, and high-quality service delivery. He/ She will manager 5-10 employees.

**How this role will contribute to team success:**

* Deliver consistent, accurate, and scalable employee services across the colleague lifecycle, helping the India business operate effectively as it grows.
* Support leadership and colleagues in navigating complex employee relations issues while managing employment compliance risks and maintaining appropriate confidentiality.
* Strengthen operational effectiveness through local process improvements, cross-functional coordination, and the development of the HC Operations team.

**Your day-to-day:**

* Lead employee lifecycle operations. Oversee onboarding, employee changes and transfers, mobility coordination, leaves, employment documentation, benefits, and exits. Coordinate with regional and global colleagues and external providers to deliver timely, consistent services, while maintaining accurate and confidential Workday and personnel records.
* Own India payroll operations. Manage monthly payroll inputs, validate payroll outputs, and provide final sign-off in partnership with payroll providers and regional Human Capital teams. Ensure payroll is processed accurately and on time, in line with local requirements, internal policies, and established controls.
* Manage employee relations and employment compliance. Advise local leaders on complex and sensitive employee matters, applying sound judgement and coordinating with Employee Relations, Legal, and external counsel as appropriate. Monitor Indian employment requirements, support policy localization and regulatory implementation, manage audits and corrective actions, and provide relevant guidance to managers and colleagues.
* Lead operational improvement, change, and team development. Manage local HC Operations projects, team integration, and relevant M&A-related employee transitions. Use Human Capital data and stakeholder feedback to identify opportunities for process improvement, while coaching and developing the local team to support reliable service delivery.

**Skills and what you bring to the team:**

* Approximately 8+ years of relevant Human Capital, Human Resources, or People Operations experience, including HC Operations and/or broad HR generalist responsibilities, with previous people-management or team-leadership experience.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labour and employment requirements, including experience handling complex employee relations matters and exercising sound judgement in sensitive situations.
* Experience managing employee lifecycle services, payroll operations, and employment-related processes, with the ability to coordinate across teams and external providers.
* Strong communication, stakeholder advisory, cross-cultural collaboration, organization, analysis, and project management skills, with a commitment to confidentiality and inclusive team leadership.
* Working knowledge of Workday or a comparable Human Capital system; strong Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook skills; ability to use HC data and reporting; and fluent written and spoken English.

**What will make you stand out:**

* Experience working in professional services, management consulting, or financial services.
* Experience supporting organizational integration or M&A-related change.
* Interest in the responsible use of AI and automation to improve Human Capital processes and the colleague experience, supported by proactive learning and knowledge sharing.

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. title: Senior Executive/Assistant Manager - HR Operations
description:
**Department:**
Human Resources

**Reports To:**
Head of HR

**Grade/Level:**
Sr. Executive/Assistant Manager (based on experience)

**Position Summary:**
We are looking for a hands-on HR Operations professional to own the end-to-end employee lifecycle for our BPO operations — from onboarding through exit — while ensuring statutory compliance, accurate documentation, smooth payroll coordination, and a positive employee experience. This role is central to how HR is experienced by employees day-to-day and requires someone who can balance process discipline with genuine employee connect.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Employee Lifecycle Management:**

• Own the complete employee lifecycle process — pre-joining, onboarding, confirmation, transfers/movements, and exit.

• Track and manage probation and confirmation timelines; coordinate confirmation reviews with reporting managers.

• Maintain accurate and updated employee lifecycle data in HRMS/trackers

**2. Induction & Onboarding:**

• Plan and conduct new hire induction sessions covering company policies, culture, facilities, and compliance requirements.

• Coordinate joining formalities: offer letter issuance, document collection, ID/access creation, and workstation readiness (with IT/Admin).

• Ensure a structured onboarding journey (Day 1, Week 1, 30/60/90-day check-ins) to improve early retention

• Collect and act on new hire feedback to continuously improve the onboarding experience

**3. Employee Relations & Engagement:**

• Act as first point of contact for employee queries, grievances, and concerns; ensure timely resolution and escalation where required

• Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives, R&R programs, and calendar of events

• Conduct regular floor connects/one-on-ones to gauge employee sentiment and flag attrition risks early

• Support managers on performance-related conversations, disciplinary processes, and conflict resolution

• Coordinate exit interviews and analyze exit feedback/trends to inform retention strategy

**4. Exit Management:**

• Manage the end-to-end separation process — resignation acceptance, notice period tracking, clearance coordination, full and final settlement inputs, and exit documentation Worxpertise (Edge Business Solutions Pvt. Ltd.)

• Conduct exit interviews and maintain attrition data/reporting.

• Ensure timely relieving letters, experience certificates, and compliance with exit-related statutory requirements.

**5. Documentation & Records Management:**

• Maintain accurate and audit-ready employee personal files (physical and digital) as per statutory and internal requirements.

• Ensure timely issuance of letters — offer, appointment, confirmation, increment, transfer, warning, relieving, experience, etc.

• Maintain HRMS data hygiene and ensure all employee records are current and error-free

**6. Background Verification (BGV):**

• Coordinate end-to-end BGV process with external vendors — initiation, tracking, follow-ups, and closure • Review BGV reports, flag discrepancies, and coordinate with TA/business on adverse findings as per policy.

• Maintain BGV trackers and ensure TAT adherence and compliance with data privacy requirements

**7. Payroll Support:**

• Provide accurate and timely inputs to Finance/Payroll team — new joiners, exits, LOP, attendance regularization, salary revisions, and other variable inputs.

title: Senior Operations Experience Associate
description:
**Senior People Experience Associate**
**The Role**
At Cint, we're reimagining how we support our people by creating a simpler, smarter and more seamless employee experience, powered by great service, technology and continuous improvement.
  
  
We're looking for a Senior People Experience Associate to join our global People Experience team. In this role, you'll be responsible for delivering high-quality support to employees and managers throughout the employee lifecycle, while helping us transform how our services are delivered through automation, AI and smarter ways of working.
  
  
You'll play a hands-on role in managing everyday People processes, resolving employee queries and ensuring our services are accurate, efficient and easy to navigate. But we also want someone who looks beyond the task at hand, understands how our systems and processes connect, and is curious about how technology can make things better.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people just as much as working with technology. You'll have the autonomy to solve problems, challenge existing processes and contribute to building a more proactive, scalable and employee-centric People Experience function.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Deliver an Exceptional People Experience & Operational Excellence**

* Be a trusted first point of contact for employees and managers, providing responsive, practical and people-first support.
* Own end-to-end employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, employment changes, leave management, benefits and offboarding.
* Take accountability for resolving employee and manager queries, ensuring a seamless experience with minimal handoffs.
* Maintain accurate employee records, employment documentation and HR systems, ensuring confidentiality, compliance and data integrity.
* Coordinate payroll inputs, benefits, background checks and other employee lifecycle requirements in collaboration with relevant teams.
* Maintain clear, accessible process documentation, knowledge articles and self-service resources.
* Use employee feedback and service insights to continuously improve quality, consistency and the overall employee experience.

**Drive Smarter Ways of Working Through Automation, AI & Ownership**

* Challenge existing ways of working, identifying opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate manual tasks and improve service delivery.
* Design, build and improve automated workflows and AI-enabled solutions that make People services faster, smarter and easier to access.
* Connect the dots between systems, data and processes to identify opportunities for better integrations and more effective digital solutions.
* Partner with People Technology and other teams to implement, test and continuously improve automation and employee self-service capabilities.
* Take ownership of problems and improvements from start to finish, applying sound judgement, anticipating risks and knowing when specialist input is needed.
* Measure the impact of improvements through service metrics, operational efficiency and employee experience outcomes.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 3+ years of experience in People Operations, People Experience, HR Shared Services or a similar role, ideally in an international environment.
* Knowledge of HR operations, payroll or employment practices across multiple countries.
* A passion for employee experience, with a proactive, service-oriented mindset and experience supporting employees and managers across the employee lifecycle.
* Strong technical curiosity and digital confidence, with hands-on experience using HR systems, workflow automation or AI-enabled tools to improve processes and service delivery.
* A natural problem-solver who can connect the dots, challenge existing ways of working and turn ideas into practical improvements.
* Ownership and sound judgement, with the confidence to work independently, navigate complex situations and know when to seek specialist support.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with strong written and spoken English, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Bonus if you have familiarity with HiBob, Ashby, Slack workflows, Jira, Confluence or similar HR and collaboration platforms.

**Why Join us?**
**You'll help shape the future of People Experience at Cint!**
This isn't just about keeping People processes running. It's about making them better.
  
  
You'll have the opportunity to combine your passion for people with technology, automation and AI to rethink how we support our employees and managers. From creating seamless employee journeys to building smarter, simpler ways of working, your ideas and contributions will make a real difference.
  
  
**If you love solving problems, experimenting with technology and turning great ideas into better experiences for people, this is your opportunity to make an impact!**

title: Subject Matter Expert (HR Ops)
description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.
  
  
**Ramboll in India**
Ramboll has more than 1800+ experts working across five offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job Summary:**
The India Subject Matter Expert (HR Operations) will serve as the go-to expert for statutory compliance, payroll input accuracy, and HR operations processes across the organization. The role owns end-to-end execution and advisory support on Indian labour law compliance, payroll inputs, employee lifecycle management, and system/process improvements, acting as an individual contributor working closely with HRBPs, Global Payroll, Legal, and business stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Payroll Input Management: Own end-to-end payroll input accuracy and timeliness (new joiners, exits, salary changes, LOP, arrears, full & final settlements) in coordination with the Global Payroll team ensuring compliance with local laws, and resolving any payroll discrepancies in collaboration with Global Payroll team.
* Statutory & Regulatory Compliance:

+ Support POSH Act (2013) compliance — Internal Committee (IC) coordination, quarterly/annual reporting, case management support, and mandatory awareness training.
+ Maintain statutory registers and ensure timely filings/returns (PF ECR, ESI challans, PT returns, LWF, annual returns under Shops & Establishment) and support statutory/labour audits, both internal and by regulatory authorities.
+ Liaise with legal/compliance and external consultants on labour law updates, notifications, and inspections; act as the internal subject matter reference point for statutory queries.

* Employee Lifecycle Management: Manage onboarding, offboarding, employee data management, and HR documentation — including statutory documentation full & final settlement compliance within statutory timelines.
* HR Systems: Maintain and enhance HRIS (Workday & ServiceNow) to improve data quality, statutory reporting accuracy, and process efficiency; partner with IT on implementation and troubleshooting.
* Process Improvement: Evaluate HR operations processes for automation, standardization, and compliance risk reduction; recommend and help implement improvements.
* Stakeholder Management: Partner with HRBPs, People Advisors, Legal, Finance, and business leaders to ensure statutory and process alignment with business needs.
* Employee Queries: Resolve employee queries on HR operations, payroll, and policy matters with customer centricity; escalate and collaborate with PA/HRBPs as needed.
* ServiceNow Dashboard / Quality & KPI Management: Track SLA/KPI adherence, conduct quality checks, and drive continuous process improvement, including compliance-risk KPIs (filing delays, audit non-conformities).
* The role is also responsible for interpreting and operationalizing India’s Four Labour Codes (Wage Code, Social Security Code, Industrial Relations Code, and OSH Code), leading policy redesign, transformation change, and cross-functional compliance readiness.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in HR, or Business Administration; MBA/Master's in HR preferred.
* Minimum 5–7 years of experience in HR operations, with demonstrated depth in Indian statutory compliance.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labour law and statutory compliance — PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Gratuity, Bonus, POSH, Shops & Establishment Act, and awareness of the new Labour Codes.
* Experience managing or directly supporting statutory audits, inspections, and government filings.
* Proficient in HRIS (Workday, ServiceNow) and MS Office.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced global environment.

**Personal Attributes**

* High integrity and confidentiality (especially with statutory/personal data)
* Detail-oriented, analytical, and audit-ready mindset
* Self-driven, proactive, and solution-oriented approach
* Comfortable working independently with minimal supervision

**Additional Information**
**What we can offer you**

* Investment in your development
* Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
* Be valued for the unique person you are.
* Never be short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects.
* The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company

**Work at the heart of sustainable change**
Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. At Ramboll, our core strength is our people, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act. Being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that looks for fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all forms to actively cultivate an environment where everyone can flourish and realize their full potential.
  
  
**Equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do**
We believe in the strength of diversity and know that unique experiences and perspectives are vital for creating truly sustainable societies. Therefore, we are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone can flourish and reach their potential. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and encourage you to contact our recruitment team to discuss any accommodations you need during the application process.
  
  
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
**Ready to join us?**
Please submit your application. Be sure to include all relevant documents including your CV, cover letter, etc.
  
  
Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

**What is the job?**
You'll lead the end-to-end Human Resources function for a cluster of Holiday Inn Express hotels as the sole HR lead. That covers recruitment, onboarding, performance management, employee relations, engagement, HR operations and statutory compliance.
  
  
**Your day to day**
*Employee lifecycle & HR operations*

* Maintain the online recruitment tracker – screening, shortlisting and TAT

* Ensure all employee files are scanned and saved digitally
* Post hiring updates on social media every Monday and Friday

*Recruitment & compliance*

* Ensure accurate and complete HR documentation across the cluster
* Ensure adherence to labour laws and IHG SOPs
* Conduct HR self-audits and lead IHG RLR audit readiness
* Update Hotel Legatrix and DocMax; complete the CSA monthly
* Circulate the weekly employee referral mail

*Employee relations & insights*

* Address grievances and workplace issues promptly and fairly
* Investigate ER cases and keep the HR Head and Cluster GM informed
* Escalate serious matters in line with IHG policy
* Review attrition, absenteeism and exit trends with GMs and agree actions

*People & culture*

* Drive the IHG Winning Ways culture across the cluster
* Lead engagement initiatives, including the 5-day Service Week
* Run the HeartBeat survey and follow through on action plans
* Run Champion of Champions recognition

*Hotel HR presence*

* Lead onboarding and deliver HR training for managers
* Maintain employee records and compliance at each hotel
* Conduct regular hotel town halls
* Keep Heart of the House areas and notice boards up to date
* Ensure adherence to WOT

*Workforce & community*

* Support HR budgeting; monitor staffing cost and productivity
* Build the hotels' local brand presence and drive CSR activities

*Accountabilities*

* Sole Human Resources lead for the cluster hotels
* Travels regularly across the cluster hotels to engage with stakeholders
* Supports regional HR initiatives as directed by the Portfolio HR Director

**What We Need From You**

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA / PGDM in HR or Hotel Management degree preferred
* Minimum 6 years' HR experience in hospitality; cluster / multi-property exposure preferred
* Sound knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory compliance (PF, ESIC, CLRA, S&E)
* Proven experience in high-volume hotel recruitment, onboarding and employee relations
* Hands-on with HRMS and MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) for HR trackers and reporting
* Strong stakeholder management with GMs and HODs; willing to travel across the cluster
* Fluent in English and Hindi; a regional language of the cluster is an advantage

**How do I deliver this?**
We genuinely care about people, and we show this by living out our promise of True Hospitality every day. It's what connects every colleague in all IHG® hotels.
  
  

* True Attitude: being caring, wanting to make a positive difference, and building genuine connections with guests
* True Confidence: having the knowledge and skills to perform your role, and giving guests the confidence that they can trust you to help and support them during their stay
* True Listening: focusing on what your guest is saying, picking up on body language that is often overlooked, and understanding what the guest wants and needs
* True Responsiveness: providing guests with what they need, in a timely and caring manner

**What We Offer**
We’ll reward all your hard work with a competitive salary and a benefits package that includes:
  
  

* 5-day working week
* Duty meals on shift
* Insurance coverage
* IHG colleague benefits, including great room discounts at IHG hotels worldwide
* Learning and growth opportunities, with superb training and a clear path to build your career with IHG

Join us and you'll become part of the family. Like all families, our team members share some winning characteristics. We work better together: we trust and support each other, we do the right thing and we welcome different perspectives. Show us you care, that you notice the little things that make a difference to guests, and that you're always looking for ways to improve. Visit careers.ihg.com to find out more about us.
  
  
IHG is an equal opportunity employer: Minorities / Females / Disabled / Veterans.
  
  
Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

title: Area Manager - Coronary Vascular

title: Senior Finance Executive
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Accounting & Reconciliation**

* Execute day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping activities, ensuring transactions are recorded accurately and on time.
* Record and review bank, vendor and customer transactions; maintain ledgers and perform periodic reconciliations.
* Handle sales and purchase accounting, including invoice verification, processing, accounting and reconciliations.
* Maintain inventory accounting records and supporting schedules, including movement and valuation-related information as applicable.
* Maintain fixed asset registers and supporting schedules, including additions, disposals and depreciation workings.
* Follow up on outstanding items and resolve reconciliation differences with relevant internal teams and external parties.
* Ensure books of account are complete, properly supported and up to date.

**2. MIS & Management Reporting**

* Prepare periodic financial reports, expense statements and supporting schedules for management review.
* Track actual expenditure against budgets and highlight material variances for review.
* Maintain project-wise expenditure and fund-utilisation statements, wherever applicable.
* Assist in preparation of cash flow, working capital and other management reports.

**3. Tax Compliance & Month-End Closing**

* Prepare GST reconciliations between books, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and GSTR-2B; assist with return preparation and related compliance.
* Prepare TDS workings, reconcile deductions and support timely payment and return filing.
* Assist in monthly closing, including accruals, provisions, prepaid expenses, expense cut-off and balance sheet reconciliations.
* Maintain tax, statutory and other finance-related schedules and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate with auditors and consultants for statutory, tax and other audits.

**4. Finance Controls & Process Improvement**

* Follow established finance processes and internal controls and promptly highlight deviations or control gaps.
* Maintain standardised documentation, reporting formats and reconciliation processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve accuracy, turnaround time and efficiency in routine finance activities.

**5. ERP & Technology**

* Work on accounting ERP systems such as Zoho Books / Zoho Finance, Tally or similar platforms.
* Use MS Excel for accounting, reconciliations, MIS and financial analysis, including Pivot Tables, lookup functions and SUMIFS.
* Use available finance tools and automation features to reduce repetitive manual work.

**What We Value**

* Hands-on approach – comfortable working through transaction-level details.
* Ownership – takes responsibility for assigned activities and follows issues through to closure.
* Accuracy and discipline – maintains reliable records, reconciliations and documentation.
* Analytical mindset – able to interpret financial information and identify unusual movements.
* Technology orientation – willing to learn systems and use automation to improve routine processes.

title: Manager / Assistant Manager – Finance (Compliance)
description:
Key Responsibilities1. GST & Indirect Tax Compliance

* Manage end-to-end GST compliance, including the preparation and/or review of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, annual returns and other applicable GST filings.
* Perform periodic reconciliations of books of accounts with GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B and electronic ledgers; identify mismatches, ineligible or unclaimed ITC and take corrective action.
* Monitor GST input tax credit eligibility, vendor compliance, blocked credits, reversals, reclaims and documentation requirements.

* Track GST notices, queries, assessments, audits and departmental correspondence; coordinate the preparation of responses and supporting records with the Finance Manager and external consultants.

* Manage TDS/TCS compliances, including applicability reviews, deduction workings, tax deposits, quarterly returns, certificates and reconciliations.
* Review vendor and expense transactions for withholding tax implications and ensure appropriate tax deductions and documentation.
* Coordinate advance tax and income-tax-related information, computations and filings with the Finance Manager and tax consultants.
* Track income tax notices, demands, assessments and other proceedings; maintain records and coordinate timely responses.

3. Other Statutory & Labour-related Compliances

* Coordinate applicable payroll-related statutory compliances, including PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund and other state-specific requirements, as applicable.
* Coordinate with HR, payroll teams, consultants and other stakeholders to obtain accurate data and supporting documentation.

4. Financial Closing, Reconciliations & Reporting

* Prepare and maintain monthly GST, TDS and other statutory reconciliations with books of accounts and relevant portal records.
* Provide compliance status, upcoming obligations, exposures and exceptions to the CFO through periodic reporting.
* Support the preparation of schedules and information required for management MIS, financial statements and audits.

5. Audit, Notices & External Coordination

* Coordinate GST audits, departmental audits, tax audits, statutory audits and other compliance reviews.
* Maintain a central repository of returns, challans, acknowledgements, notices, replies, orders and other statutory records.
* Track key deliverables, timelines, conditions precedent and subsequent, pending documents and action points arising from investment or other corporate transactions; follow up with relevant internal and external stakeholders for closure.
* Support fundraising, investment and other capital-raising rounds by coordinating with the Company Secretary (CS), lawyers, Finance Manager, CFO and other advisors on due diligence, data-room requirements, information requests, corporate approvals and transaction documentation.

6. Controls, Process Improvement & Systems

* Develop and maintain SOPs, checklists and review controls for recurring tax and statutory compliances.
* Identify compliance risks, process gaps and potential interest, late fee, penalty or ITC exposure; escalate issues promptly.
* Drive standardisation and automation of compliance workings, reconciliations and trackers using Excel, ERP and other finance tools.
* Work on Zoho Books / Zoho Finance, Tally, SAP or other accounting and compliance platforms, as applicable.

What We Value

* **Compliance Ownership:**
  Disciplined tracking and timely closure of statutory obligations.
* **Technical Curiosity:**
  Ability to research issues, understand tax positions and identify risks.
* **Accuracy & Documentation:**
  Strong attention to reconciliations, workings and supporting evidence.
* **Proactive Escalation:**
  Ability to flag potential defaults, exposures and deadlines before they become issues.
* **Stakeholder Coordination:**
  Effective follow-up with internal teams, consultants, auditors and authorities.
* **Technology Orientation:**
  Willingness to automate recurring compliance activities and improve controls.

description:

What will you do
  
  

* Process accounts payable, supplier invoices and employee expenses in line with internal controls. Maintain general ledger, journal entries and bank, vendor and intercompany reconciliations.
* Support month-end/year-end closing and regional financial reporting.
* Apply US GAAP ASC 606 and IFRS revenue recognition requirements.
* Support lease accounting under ASC 842 and IFRS 16.
* Apply US GAAP requirements for R&D cost accounting and expense recognition.
* Support US GAAP/IFRS reporting, foreign currency accounting and local-to-group reconciliations.
* Coordinate MEA tax compliance, including corporate tax, VAT and withholding tax.
* Support UAE Corporate Tax, VAT, Saudi ZATCA/FATOORAH and other applicable GCC tax requirements.
* Assist with regional e-invoicing, including Saudi ZATCA and Kenya eTIMS, where applicable. Support payroll compliance, including WPS, Emiratisation and Saudization, with HR and local advisors.
* Assist with multi currency consolidation, foreign exchange and applicable inflation accounting. Use ERP and accounting systems for transaction processing, master data and financial reporting.

* US GAAP & Financial Reporting Principles

* Knowledge of Economic Substance Regulations or related substance-reporting obligations only where they remain applicable to the entity and period, verified with local advisors.
* African Taxation & Compliance

* Familiarity with OHADA accounting and commercial law framework for relevant Francophone West and Central African entities, where applicable.

* Exposure to intercompany accounting and OECD aligned transfer-pricing documentation for cross-border related-party transactions.
* Understanding of foreign-exchange gains and losses, currency translation and inflation/hyperinflation accounting where required by the applicable reporting framework.

SUCCESS MEASURES

title: Chattered Accountant-International Taxation
description:
Job Description: Chartered Accountant – International Taxation

**Position**

Chartered Accountant – International Taxation

**Company**

House of EdTech

**Role Focus**

Tax matters of the group's UAE entity and India–UAE cross-border transactions

**Location**

Kolkata, West Bengal (Work from Office)

**Working Days**

6 days a week

**Experience**

1–2 years post-qualification in international taxation (preferred)

**Qualification**

Chartered Accountant (ICAI)

**Employment Type**

Full-time

**Reporting To**

[Designation]

About Us

House of EdTech is [brief description of the company and its business]. With operations in India and a sister entity in the UAE, we are building an in-house international tax function to manage our cross-border structure and keep the group compliant in both jurisdictions.

Role Overview

We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant to join our team in Kolkata and take ownership of international tax matters for our UAE entity and the group's India–UAE transactions. The role covers UAE Corporate Tax and VAT, transfer pricing, cross-border transactions and DTAA matters. The ideal candidate will have practical exposure to taxation in both India and the UAE (Dubai) and will work closely with our finance team, management and external advisors in both countries.

Key ResponsibilitiesUAE Corporate Tax and VAT (UAE Entity)

•    Manage UAE Corporate Tax registration, computation and return filing for the UAE entity on the FTA's EmaraTax portal.

•    Evaluate free zone status (Qualifying Free Zone Person), qualifying and excluded income, exempt income and other reliefs applicable to the entity.

•    Oversee UAE VAT compliance, including return filing, review of transactions and VAT treatment of electronically supplied and education services.

•    Track Pillar Two and Domestic Minimum Top-up Tax developments and assess their relevance to the group.

•    Coordinate with UAE tax agents, auditors and consultants, and respond to FTA queries.

Transfer Pricing

•    Manage transfer pricing for transactions between the Indian and UAE entities, including intra-group services, cost allocations, IP/content licensing and funding arrangements.

•    Prepare or review TP documentation in both jurisdictions: UAE Transfer Pricing Disclosure Form, Master File and Local File, and Indian TP documentation and the Accountant's Report (Form 3CEB or its equivalent under the Income-tax Act, 2025).

•    Conduct FAR analysis and support benchmarking studies, working with external TP advisors where needed.

•    Draft and maintain intercompany agreements and ensure pricing is applied consistently in the books.

Cross-Border Transactions

•    Advise management on the tax implications of cross-border flows between India and the UAE, such as service fees, royalties, dividends and capital infusions.

•    Manage Indian withholding tax on payments to the UAE entity and related remittance compliance (Form 15CA/15CB or equivalent).

•    Assess permanent establishment (PE) and place of effective management (POEM) risks arising from the way the group's India and UAE teams operate.

•    Review the tax treatment of online education and digital services delivered across borders, including GST/VAT implications.

•    Support structuring decisions on new business lines, markets and entity set-ups.

DTAA and Treaty Matters (India–UAE)

•    Apply the India–UAE Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement to group transactions, including treaty eligibility, beneficial ownership and Limitation of Benefits.

•    Assess the impact of the Multilateral Instrument (MLI), Principal Purpose Test and Indian GAAR on treaty positions.

•    Obtain UAE Tax Residency Certificates from the FTA and maintain documentation (such as Form 10F) for treaty claims in India.

•    Manage foreign tax credit claims and avoid double taxation across the group.

General

•    Prepare internal notes and present tax positions to management in clear, practical terms.

•    Track changes in UAE and Indian tax law and assess their impact on the business.

•    Maintain tax calendars, records and documentation for audits and assessments in both countries.

•    Support tax assessments, notices and proceedings in coordination with external counsel.

Qualifications and Experience

**Required**

•    Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI).

•    Good understanding of international taxation principles and transfer pricing.

**Preferred**

•    1–2 years of post-qualification experience in international taxation, transfer pricing or cross-border tax.

•    Practical exposure to taxation in both India and the UAE (Dubai), particularly UAE Corporate Tax and VAT.

•    Experience with a Big 4 or mid-tier consulting firm, or in the in-house tax team of a group with India–UAE operations.

•    Certification in International Taxation (e.g., ICAI DITL, ADIT from CIOT) will be an added advantage.

Skills and Competencies

•    Strong technical knowledge of UAE Corporate Tax, transfer pricing and DTAA interpretation.

•    Analytical and research skills, with the ability to turn tax law into practical business advice.

•    Clear written and verbal communication for working with management and external advisors.

•    Proficiency in MS Excel and familiarity with EmaraTax and the Indian Income Tax e-filing portal.

•    Ability to manage multiple compliance timelines across two jurisdictions.

•    Attention to detail, integrity and ownership.

•    Willingness to travel to the UAE as required.

Work Arrangement

•    Location: Kolkata office.

•    Work from office, 6 days a week.

What We Offer

•    Opportunity to build and own the international tax function for a growing India–UAE group.

•    Direct exposure to management and business decision-making.

•    Competitive compensation: [CTC range / "commensurate with experience"].

•    [Other benefits, e.g., health insurance, learning and certification support.]

Hi, We are an idea-stage start-up building India's First Ecosystem on a mission to revolutionize the Food, Health & Wellness space through innovative technology and sustainable practices. While we're early in our journey, our passion is clear: to build solutions that drive healthier choices, promote well-being, and create real impact.

This is NOT a typical CEO role. As Co-Founder & CEO, you will be the strategic and operational leader responsible for shaping and driving the organization forward. This role demands a passionate entrepreneur who thrives in startup environments, takes ownership end-to-end, and is eager to build something meaningful from the ground up.
  
  
This is a full-time, onsite role in Kolkata — not an advisory position. You will work closely with co-founders and stakeholders to translate vision into impact.

\* People looking for a structured corporate role.
  
\* Strategy-only professionals.
  
\* Those expecting high fixed salaries from Day one.

✳️ Design a phased expansion strategy — prioritizing focus, validation, and scalability at each stage.
  
✳️ Balance short-term execution with long-term ecosystem building.
  
  
Business Building & Execution:
  
✳️ Lead the company from idea stage to launch, growth, and expansion.
  
✳️ Own the development of business models, revenue strategies, pricing, and unit economics across verticals.
  
✳️ Ensure strong execution discipline while operating in high-ambiguity environments.

title: Service Engineer - Tech 2
description:
Role Purpose

title: Area Operations Manager
description:
**Job Requirements**
**Job Title –**
Area Operations Manager
  
  
**Place of work**
– Kolkata
  
  
**Business Unit**
– Rural Banking
  
  
**Function**
– Credit Operations
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
This role entails management and maintenance of the quality of the credit portfolio pertaining to the client portfolio from origination to collections while ensuring alignment with IBFC First's credit risk appetite and the overall credit strategy in order to minimize problematic accounts and losses in the assigned area to the bank. This role has a primary responsibility to review the customers’ credit evaluation and assessment results and proceed to the accurate and timely update of their credit limit at the relevant systems, so as to support the effective management and execution of the credit application process.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Implement approved departmental policies, processes, procedures and provides instructions to subordinates and monitor their adherence so that work is carried out in a controlled manner.
* Monitor the approvals / cancelation / freeze of the customers’ credit limits and proceed to the relevant account’s accurate and timely update to the available systems, so as to support the accurate provision of credit to customers.
* Communicates with the relevant Credit Analysts in case of clarifications required regarding the credit limits of the clients and proceeds to their accurate update.
* Provides the required information as requested from all the available systems regarding the customer accounts credit limit profile.
* Inform relevant teams regarding any potential change in the customer credit limit status, so as to support the accurate administration and management of the credit applications and customer accounts.
* Ensure implementation of the policies to ensure high quality of the retail portfolio while meeting the target TAT.
* Employ tools such as automation and digitization to increase process efficiency.
* Conduct detailed analysis of delinquencies and recommend changes to the product teams.
* Ensure the successful adoption of internal compliances & regulatory framework across the assigned region.
* Review and approve credit proposals given the discretionary authority and escalate others to those with the appropriate approval authority while ensuring compliance with the bank’s credit policy.

**Secondary Responsibilities:**

* Monitor and review the performance of the retail credit portfolio on a regular basis, providing recommendations for adjustment where necessary. Contribute to portfolio management programs i.e. limit increases, loan postponements etc.
* Provide recommendations regarding improvements and changes to the credit policies and procedures, documenting and circulating policies, to ensure that all requirements are fulfilled and risks are mitigated while delivering a high quality service to customers.

**Managerial & Leadership Responsibilities:**

* Monitor key parameters on productivity, hiring quality and attrition rates and make necessary improvements.
* Champion IDFC First's customer first culture by driving the team to take up high degree servicing norms to ensure absolute customer delight.

**Educational Qualifications:**
Graduate – Any
  
  
Post Graduate – MBA
  
  
**Experience:**
5-10 years in credit operations.

title: Search Engine Optimization Executive
description:
**Role at a Glance**

**Team - SEO & Organic Growth**

**Locatin- Remote / Hybrid(Park Street Kolkata)**

**Experience - 1–2 years**

**What this role actually does**

You run organic search delivery for a portfolio of 5–6 D2C brands. Keyword work, technical health, on-page execution, off page and answer engine optimisation. You work alongside the media buyers and account managers so organic compounds on top of paid instead of running in a separate lane. You report to our SEO & AEO Lead and work with two others in the team. You won’t be handed a script, but you won’t be left to invent the strategy either.

**About Studio APS**

Studio APS is a performance marketing agency in Kolkata. We manage crores in annual ad spend across Meta, Google and Amazon for fast-growing D2C brands, some you’ve seen on Shark Tank, some backed by Unilever, Amazon and Fireside Ventures. We work in pods, go deep on fewer brands, and measure ourselves on revenue rather than rankings. Our clients include One8, Inde Wild, Fixderma, Lux, FixMyCurls, Lakshita and Truth & Hair.

**Your week, roughly**

* Deliver SEO across 5–6 D2C brand accounts
* Technical SEO — audits, schema, crawl fixes, Core Web Vitals, page speed
* Optimise product, category and blog pages for real search intent
* Write content briefs and review what comes back before it ships
* Keyword research and mapping across your accounts, refreshed monthly
* Track rankings, traffic and revenue through Google Search Console and GA4
* Build for AEO — structuring content to surface in ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google’s AI results
* Execute off-page and earned link acquisition against an agreed plan
* Maintain Google Business Profiles where brands have a local presence
* Join monthly client calls and present the organic numbers on your accounts

**What we’re looking for**

* 1–2 years in SEO, ideally with D2C or eCommerce brands
* Working knowledge of GA4, GSC, Screaming Frog, and Ahrefs or SE Ranking
* Comfortable running more than one client account at a time
* You think in revenue and business outcomes, not just rank positions
* You can stand up in front of a client and explain why traffic moved
* AEO and AI search experience is a bonus, not a requirement. We’ll train the right person

**This probably isn’t for you if**

* You’ve only ever worked on one website or one brand
* You’ve never opened Screaming Frog or read a crawl report
* You want to stay behind the scenes and never speak to a client
* You want to do the same thing every month

**Why Studio APS**

* You’ll be one of very few people in India doing AEO seriously, while most agencies are still arguing about whether it matters
* You learn from a senior lead who actually does the work, not a manager who forwards briefs
* Four to five D2C categories in a year, the fastest way to build real SEO judgement
* Small enough that the founder knows what you’re working on and what you’re good at
* Brands people have actually heard of, on your CV
* Park Street office. Central, easy commute from most of the city

**Where this role leads**

SEO & AEO Lead, then Head of Organic. We build organic leadership internally rather than hiring it in, and this is the seat it starts from.

**How we work here**

This is a full-time, Remote / Hybrid Role. Our Office is in Park Street Kolkata. Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 6 PM, with alternate Saturdays off.

**How we hire**

1. Apply
2. 30-minute conversation with the founder about how you actually run an account
3. A 60-minute SEO task, under NDA. You get written feedback on it either way
4. Offer within five working days of the final step. We reply to every applicant.

**How to apply, whichever is easiest**

* Apply here on LinkedIn, or
* Fill the form: https://forms.gle/6gf5XS4Sqf6uRSJz6, or
* Email your CV to info@studioaps.in with “SEO & AEO Executive” in the subject

title: CRC Associate
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a CRC Associate, you will support the evaluation and improvement of internal ethics and compliance programs within our Internal Firm Services practice at PwC Acceleration Center India. This practice-support role focuses on how program design, execution, and controls help the firm manage risk and operate consistently across its businesses. You will contribute to work that examines program effectiveness, identifies opportunities to refine processes, and supports the internal teams that enable client-facing colleagues to operate compliantly and at scale. It is an opportunity to apply governance, risk, and compliance skills to work that helps shape how the firm operates.
  
  
As an Associate, you will build your knowledge of the firm’s services and technical standards while taking ownership of assigned work and contributing reliably to team priorities. You will approach unfamiliar questions with curiosity, draw on information from different sources to develop insights, and seek guidance when the path forward is unclear. By listening to colleagues with different perspectives, responding to feedback, and anticipating the needs of internal stakeholders, you will develop relationships and a clearer sense of your professional strengths. Your attention to quality, the firm’s code of conduct, and independence requirements will guide your work as your responsibilities grow.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Supporting evaluations of internal ethics and compliance program design and execution by gathering evidence, documenting processes, and comparing current practices with established policies and frameworks
* Mapping compliance workflows and internal controls with digital tools to identify implementation gaps, clarify ownership, and support consistent application of governance requirements
* Conducting policy reviews and compliance checks, summarizing regulatory requirements, and documenting findings that inform program improvements and guidance for internal stakeholders
* Assisting with controls testing and operating effectiveness reviews, including risk analysis and fraud prevention considerations, while recording methods, results, and follow-up items
* Examining findings from internal audit, IT audit, SOX testing, and financial reporting activities to identify patterns that may inform ethics and compliance priorities
* Using AI-enabled and other digital tools with human review to organize evidence, track follow-up activities, and assess compliance program outcomes
* Preparing summaries and presentation materials for senior leaders, translating findings into practical options that support business decisions and continuous improvement of program execution
* Collaborating with colleagues across finance and operational functions to understand process and operating model changes, incorporate feedback, and contribute to documented compliance recommendations

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Graduate or the post graduate degree
* At least 1 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* Applying compliance frameworks and policy review methods when assessing internal ethics and compliance programs
* Mapping processes and documenting internal controls when examining how compliance programs operate
* Supporting controls testing and operating effectiveness reviews by gathering evidence and recording observations
* Using risk analysis and compliance review techniques when examining program design and identifying improvement opportunities
* Leveraging digital tools and AI-assisted workflows when organizing information and checking outputs against source materials
* Communicating observations to team members, asking clarifying questions, and incorporating feedback when preparing program documentation

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Auro Industries Limited is a trading and distribution company headquartered in Kolkata, specializing in products such as motor vehicle tyres, batteries, refrigerators, paints, and water pump solutions. The company is an authorized distributor for leading brands including TVS Tyres, Exide VRLA Batteries, Enatron VRLA Batteries, NEURON LiPH Battery Packs and Chargers. Auro Industries Limited also markets its own in-house AURO battery brand, offering a comprehensive portfolio for automotive and power solutions. With a seamless distribution network of over 400 dealers across West Bengal, the organization is strongly focused on after-sales support and long-term customer relationships.

**Role Description**
The Field Sales Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Kolkata, responsible for driving sales and market penetration across the company’s product portfolio. The role includes visiting dealers and prospective customers, promoting tyres, batteries, pumps, and related products, and ensuring product availability and visibility in the assigned territory. The Field Sales Executive will identify new business opportunities, negotiate orders, execute sales plans, and follow up on payments and collections. The position also involves maintaining strong relationships with existing dealers, gathering market feedback, coordinating with the internal operations team for timely deliveries, and providing after-sales support information to customers. Regular reporting of sales activities, targets, and performance to the sales management team is expected.

**Qualifications**

* Proven field sales experience in distribution, automotive, power solutions, or related industries, with the ability to meet and exceed sales targets.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to build and sustain dealer and customer relationships.
* Basic understanding of tyres, batteries, pumps, or similar technical products, with the willingness to learn product specifications and applications.
* Good organizational and time-management skills, including territory planning, visit scheduling, and follow-up on leads and payments.
* Proficiency in using mobile and computer-based tools for reporting, order tracking, and communication.
* Ability to travel extensively within Kolkata and across West Bengal as required by the role.
* Minimum of a high school diploma; a bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is an advantage.
* Valid driving license and comfort with frequent field visits; prior experience working with dealer networks is preferred.

3–4 Years

IT Services, Technology Consulting, SAP, Cloud, Agentic AI & Digital Transformation

Mid-Size Enterprises, Large Enterprises, and Global Capability Centers (GCCs) across Pan India

CXOs, Business Heads, IT Leaders, Data & AI Leaders, Digital Transformation Leaders, GCC Heads

* Qualify prospects based on predefined criteria such as business need, budget, authority, timeline, and strategic fit (BANT).

* Schedule discovery meetings, solution demos, and introductory discussions for sales executives and solution architects.

* Follow up consistently with prospects to nurture engagement and move opportunities through the sales funnel.

* Collaborate with sales leadership to refine Ideal Customer Profiles (ICP) for mid-size, large enterprise, and GCC segments, and to sharpen outreach strategies.
* Support Account-Based Marketing (ABM) initiatives through targeted engagement of priority enterprise and GCC accounts.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

***Experience***

* 3–4 years of experience in Business Development, Lead Generation, Inside Sales, or Sales Development.
* Proven experience prospecting or selling SAP, Agentic AI/AI-led solutions, Cloud, or Digital Transformation services strongly preferred.
* Experience engaging mid-size enterprise, large enterprise, and GCC (Global Capability Center) accounts across India.
* Background in B2B technology services, IT consulting, Enterprise Software, Data & AI, Cloud, PIM/PXM, PLM, or related domains preferred.

***Skills***

* Strong cold-calling, email outreach, and LinkedIn prospecting experience.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong presentation and stakeholder engagement capabilities.

* Working knowledge of SAP, Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), and Agentic AI / AI-driven solution concepts, sufficient to hold a credible first-level conversation with enterprise buyers.
* Excellent research and lead qualification skills.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms such as HubSpot.

* Experience selling into or supporting sales for SAP implementation/consulting, Cloud migration, or Agentic AI/automation solutions.
* Prior exposure to GCC (Global Capability Center) ecosystems and buying patterns in India.
* Exposure to account-based marketing and outbound demand generation.
* Understanding of sales funnels, lead nurturing, and pipeline management.
* Continuous learner with curiosity about emerging technology (Agentic AI, Cloud, SAP innovations) and enterprise business trends.

Willingness to work with the distribution team for on-ground support and deliver enablers as required.

title: Business Development Analyst
description:
**About Pluribus Digital**
Join us and do work that matters: use your skills to improve how your government serves the public! Pluribus Digital partners with our government customers to design, develop, and deliver useful and impactful digital products. We are a hands-on digital services consultancy – part technologists, part change agents, and all heart.  We employ modern best practices in all that we do as we work to solve problems in public health, financial industry regulation, granting citizenship and asylum, and identity and access management.
  
  
**Role Description**
As a
**Business Development Analyst**
, you will play a key role in providing dedicated support for proposal development, capture activities, and execution and coordination of business development operations.  Gain hands-on experience across proposal execution, market research, capture management, teaming, solution development, and business development operations.  You will work across different federal agencies, mission areas, technologies and acquisition opportunities, while helping to shape how the company identifies, qualifies, pursues, and wins new business.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Proposal Management**
  
  
*Leads day-to-day proposal coordination and execution; manages schedules, compliance, reviews, and production.*
  
  

* Manages proposal development activities in response to federal solicitations, RFIs, sources sought notices, and other government requests, including development of proposal schedules, compliance matrices, outlines, and content assignments.
* Lead proposal kickoff meetings and color team reviews (Pink, Red, Gold, etc.), coordinating cross-functional contributors, tracking milestones and deliverables, consolidating feedback, and managing revisions through final submission.
