* Oversee proposal compliance, quality assurance, document production, and final submission; maintain reusable proposal content and support post-submission activities and lessons learned.

**Capture Management**
  
  
*Provides research, analysis, coordination, and execution support to capture leads.*
  
  

* Monitor federal procurement sources to identify opportunities and support qualification activities.
* Support the capture process in coordination with opportunity owners, which includes research, capture plan development, solution support, and activity tracking.

**Business Development Operations**
  
  
*Executes BD processes, maintains systems, coordinates activities, reports status, recommends improvements*
  
  

* Coordinate BD operations and reporting, including pipeline reviews, gate reviews, leadership briefings, dashboards, and tracking of key activities and action items.
* Maintain corporate BD resources and artifacts, including standard processes, templates, and procedures.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, marketing, communications, english, public administration, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience
* 5 – 8 years of experience in business development, capture management, proposal management, or a related role supporting federal government contracting.

* DMV Area

+ Ability to join the HQ team at headquarters on Wednesdays each week
+ Ability to attend industry events in person as needed
+ Demonstrated experience leading federal proposal efforts, including developing schedules, compliance matrices, outlines, content assignments, and managing proposal reviews through final submission.
+ Demonstrated experience supporting the full federal business development lifecycle, including opportunity identification and pipeline development, opportunity qualification, capture management, and proposal development and execution. Working knowledge of federal acquisition processes, solicitation types (RFPs, RFIs, and sources sought notices), FAR fundamentals, proposal requirements, and government evaluation processes.
+ Strong research, analytical, and writing skills, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, compelling, customer-focused content and communicate effectively with technical and executive stakeholders.
+ Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and deadlines, coordinate cross-functional contributors, anticipate needs, and drive assigned activities to completion with limited oversight.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in target Federal accounts

+ Homeland Security
+ Health and Benefits
+ Federal Financial
+ Government-wide

**Why Pluribus May Be a Fit for You**

* We are purpose driven. We support missions and products that serve the public good, and where our focused capabilities positively impact those mission outcomes. We bring a consultative approach to partner with our government customers and help them succeed as change makers.
* Pluribus is a calm company. We are knowledge workers. People do their best work when they are not rushed by artificial urgency or drained by a culture of facetime and workaholism. By having confidence in our people, we can get more done at better quality. When real crunch time comes, we are not already stretched to the limit.
* We are stronger because of the variety of skills and personal backgrounds of our team. We hold ourselves accountable with annual reporting on diversity statistics. As a woman owned and led company, diversity, equity, and inclusion is woven into all aspects of the organization.

**Compensation And Benefits**
*Pluribus Digital offers a competitive salary that is determined at the time of offer. Compensation will be based on experience and qualifications, with salary ranges aligned accordingly. If a candidate is a strong fit at a more junior or senior level to what is outlined here, we will assess them accordingly and apply the appropriate salary range during the hiring process. The range for this specific role is from $130,000 to $140,000 depending on experience. Salary is augmented with opportunity to earn annual bonus and medical/dental/vision benefits, PTO, company paid life insurance and a generous 401k match program. Details on benefits can be found here:*
*https://pluribusdigital.com/content/join/benefits.*
***Pluribus Digital is an equal opportunity employer.***

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, religion, age, disability, veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.*

title: Senior Trade Marketing Manager
description:
**Company:**
Baidyanath Ayurved & Goodcare

**Location:**
Kolkata - Corporate Office

**Department:**
Marketing & Branding

**Reporting To:**
AGM - Marketing & Branding

**Experience:**
8-12 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Preferred Industry:**
FMCG, OTC, Healthcare, Ayurveda, Wellness, Personal Care & Consumer Products

**Role Objective**

We are looking for an experienced, commercially driven and execution-focused
**Senior Manager - Trade Marketing**
to lead Trade Marketing, BTL Activations, Retail Visibility, Channel Promotions and Regional Marketing initiatives across Baidyanath Ayurved, Goodcare and any future brands under the company's portfolio.

The role requires a professional who can combine strategic market planning with strong on-ground execution, technical knowledge of marketing materials, commercial budgeting and effective coordination with Sales and Distribution teams.

The individual will be responsible for strengthening brand visibility, driving consumer and retailer engagement, improving market execution and ensuring marketing investments deliver measurable business impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Trade Marketing Strategy & Planning**

* Develop annual, quarterly and monthly trade marketing plans aligned with brand objectives, distribution priorities and business growth targets.
* Plan and execute initiatives across General Trade (GT), Modern Trade (MT), pharmacies, Ayurvedic stores, wholesalers and other relevant retail channels.
* Identify priority markets, cities, channels and outlets based on sales potential, distribution strength and consumer opportunities.
* Develop region-specific retail visibility, promotional and activation strategies for different brands and product categories.
* Work closely with regional Sales teams to strengthen product visibility, retailer engagement and consumer demand.
* Drive innovative, cost-effective trade marketing initiatives beyond conventional retail promotional activities.

**2. BTL Marketing & Consumer Activations**

* Plan and execute BTL campaigns, in-store activations, product demonstrations, sampling programmes, roadshows and consumer engagement initiatives.
* Develop activation strategies for retail outlets, residential communities (RWAs), corporate offices, local markets and other high-potential consumer touchpoints.
* Independently manage activity planning, outlet selection, manpower, logistics, vendor coordination, costing and execution.
* Design activations that address both short-term sales opportunities and long-term brand awareness objectives.
* Introduce new activation concepts based on consumer behaviour, product relevance and market opportunities.
* Monitor consumer participation, product trials, enquiries, conversions and the overall effectiveness of activations.

**3. Retail Visibility, POSM & Merchandising**

* Own end-to-end planning, development, production, dispatch and deployment of POSM across markets.
* Manage retail branding materials, including posters, danglers, shelf strips, standees, display units, counter branding, promotional banners and other merchandising assets.
* Ensure strong technical knowledge of printing specifications, paper GSM, materials, dimensions, substrates, fabrication methods and finishing standards.
* Independently validate vendor specifications, production quality, material consumption and commercial quotations.
* Coordinate with Creative, Procurement, Factories, Logistics and Sales teams to ensure timely availability of promotional materials.
* Establish systems for POSM allocation, dispatch tracking, receipt confirmation, installation and utilisation.
* Conduct periodic retail audits to monitor brand visibility, merchandising compliance, material condition and competitor activities.

**4. Trade Promotions & Channel Engagement**

* Work closely with Sales teams to plan retailer engagement, trade promotions and channel-specific marketing initiatives.
* Support the development and communication of approved retailer schemes, incentive programmes and promotional activities.
* Drive retailer participation in product launches, visibility campaigns and regional promotions.
* Support distribution expansion through appropriate trade marketing interventions and market development initiatives.
* Monitor retailer feedback, competitive offerings, product movement and effectiveness of promotional investments.
* Align trade marketing activities with secondary sales, retail offtake and channel growth objectives.

**5. Events, Exhibitions, CSR & Institutional Activations**

* Plan and execute sales conferences, trade exhibitions, regional fairs, melas, corporate activations and other brand engagement initiatives.
* Independently manage venue coordination, bookings, fabrication, stage setup, branding, logistics, manpower and execution.
* Develop cost-effective event management approaches while maintaining quality and brand standards.
* Coordinate CSR-linked activations, community engagement programmes and relevant healthcare awareness initiatives.
* Manage doctor-sample and promotional-material requirements in coordination with Factory, R&D, Logistics and Sales teams.
* Ensure proper sample allocation, dispatch tracking, documentation and accountability.
* Evaluate events and activations based on participation, consumer engagement, brand visibility and measurable commercial outcomes.

**6. Regional Marketing & Field Operations**

* Lead regional trade marketing and BTL execution across East India and other priority markets nationwide.
* Coordinate with regional Sales heads, field marketing resources, distributors and external activation partners.
* Develop city-wise, region-wise and channel-wise activation calendars with clear budgets, timelines and ownership.
* Supervise on-ground execution, retail branding installation, promotional material maintenance and field activities.
* Establish structured reporting systems covering activity photographs, outlet coverage, execution quality, expenditure and outcomes.
* Conduct regular market visits to assess retail visibility, competitor activities, consumer feedback and execution challenges.
* Ensure accountability, timely delivery and proactive follow-through across all assigned markets.

**7. Consumer Insights & Market Intelligence**

* Establish mechanisms to collect firsthand consumer and retailer feedback during market visits and activations.
* Identify consumer perceptions, product awareness gaps, purchase barriers and emerging category opportunities.
* Monitor competitor trade activities, retail promotions, merchandising practices and activation strategies.
* Translate market observations into actionable recommendations for Marketing, Sales, R&D and Product Development teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve product communication, promotional effectiveness and consumer engagement.

**8. Budgeting, Cost Optimisation & ROI**

* Prepare detailed annual, quarterly and activity-wise Trade Marketing and BTL budgets.
* Develop bottom-up costing models covering per-store, per-activation, per-event and per-region investments.
* Independently evaluate vendor quotations, material costs, manpower requirements and execution expenses.
* Negotiate commercial terms and identify opportunities to optimise costs through resource sharing and efficient planning.
* Track budget utilisation, planned versus actual expenditure and cost deviations.
* Measure activity effectiveness through retail coverage, consumer engagement, product trials, sales uplift and return on marketing investment, wherever attributable.
* Recommend continuation, modification or discontinuation of initiatives based on performance and business relevance.

**9. Product Launches & Integrated Marketing Execution**

* Lead trade marketing and BTL execution for new product launches, relaunches and seasonal campaigns.
* Work with Brand, Digital, E-commerce and Sales teams to ensure consistent communication across consumer touchpoints.
* Develop retail launch plans covering POSM, promotional activities, retailer education, market visibility and consumer engagement.
* Support execution of approved regional offline media initiatives, including print, outdoor and local promotional campaigns.
* Ensure timely market readiness, availability of promotional materials and effective execution of launch activities.
* Track post-launch visibility, retailer response, consumer engagement and market performance.

**10. Team Leadership, Vendor Management & Reporting**

* Lead and supervise Trade Marketing, BTL and field execution resources assigned to the function.
* Manage printing vendors, fabricators, activation agencies, merchandising partners, event vendors and temporary promoters.
* Establish clear responsibilities, execution timelines, quality standards and escalation processes.
* Develop standard operating procedures for costing, POSM production, quality checks, dispatch, activation execution and reporting.
* Maintain centralised dashboards covering planned activities, implementation status, budget utilisation and performance.
* Provide weekly operational updates and monthly performance reviews with clear recommendations.
* Ensure that all activities follow approved brand guidelines, relevant regulations and internal financial controls.

Candidate Requirements

* Graduate in Marketing, Business Administration, Commerce or a related discipline; MBA/PGDM in Marketing preferred.
* **8-12 years of relevant experience**
  , with substantial hands-on exposure to Trade Marketing, BTL, Retail Visibility and Channel Marketing.
* Strong experience in FMCG, OTC, Healthcare, Ayurveda, Wellness, Personal Care or consumer-focused businesses.
* Prior exposure to organisations with extensive GT distribution and retail networks will be an advantage.
* Proven ability to independently plan, cost, execute and evaluate multi-market trade marketing activities.
* Strong knowledge of retail merchandising, POSM production, printing specifications, GSM, fabrication and vendor quality management.
* Demonstrated commercial acumen in budgeting, vendor negotiation, cost optimisation and ROI evaluation.
* Experience managing exhibitions, sales conferences, consumer activations and regional field operations.
* Strong understanding of distributor networks, retailer behaviour, channel promotions and secondary sales.
* Ability to manage multiple brands, stakeholders, regions and projects simultaneously.
* Strong analytical, communication, negotiation, problem-solving and team-management skills.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, budget planning and management reporting.
* Excellent Hindi and English communication; Bengali will be an added advantage.
* Willingness to travel extensively across assigned markets.

title: Content Writer
description:
Full Time Ahmedabad 7+ years

  

Every campaign, service page, and client-facing asset needs words that actually land — clear enough to inform, sharp enough to persuade, and consistent enough to sound like one brand across dozens of formats. But good writing alone isn’t the goal here: this role exists to own the outcomes that content drives — traffic, engagement, rankings, and conversions — not just produce copy and move on to the next brief.

You’ll write high-quality content for blogs, service pages, case studies, landing pages, emailers, and social media, and you’ll stay accountable for how that content actually performs once it’s live. You’ll work closely with Designers, SEO Strategists, Developers, and Project Managers to bring campaigns to life — a genuinely hands-on role where your words, and their measurable impact, help shape the voice and results of our brand and our clients’ brands alike.

***This role is for someone who enjoys:***

* Writing content and then following through on whether it actually worked
* Balancing creativity with structure and measurable outcomes
* Translating complex ideas into content that’s clear and genuinely engaging
* Treating a published piece as the start of the work, not the finish line

If you’re someone who takes real ownership of what your content achieves — not just how it reads — this role will keep that instinct busy across a wide range of formats.

### **What you’ll really be doing**

#### **1. Content Creation**

* Write original, high-quality content for blogs, service pages, case studies, landing pages, emailers, and social media posts
* Develop messaging for agency-focused audiences, with clarity, purpose, and attention to brand tone
* Repurpose long-form content into bite-sized assets such as carousels, infographics, or sales collateral

#### **2. Content Performance & Accountability**

* Define a clear goal for each piece of content before writing it — traffic, lead generation, engagement, or conversion — and write with that outcome in mind
* Track the performance of published content against its intended goal (traffic, rankings, time on page, conversions, engagement)
* Review underperforming content, diagnose likely causes, and revise or repurpose it to improve results
* Report on content performance regularly, connecting output to measurable business impact rather than just volume produced
* Take ownership of content outcomes, treating a piece’s success or failure as part of the job, not a separate team’s responsibility

#### **3. SEO & Strategy Support**

* Collaborate with SEO teams to create keyword-focused content that improves rankings and drives relevant traffic
* Conduct topic research, competitor analysis, and on-page optimization to align content with business goals
* Use ranking and traffic data to inform what to write next, not just what was requested

#### **4. Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with design, development, sales, and project teams to create content that complements campaigns and solutions
* Participate in content planning and brainstorming sessions to align messaging with marketing and service objectives
* Share performance insights with Marketing and SEO teams to shape future content strategy

#### **5. AI-Assisted Content Workflow**

* Use AI tools (such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) to speed up research, ideation, and first drafts — while applying judgment and brand voice that AI output alone can’t provide
* Leverage AI for content repurposing — turning long-form pieces into social posts, summaries, or outlines faster
* Use AI-assisted SEO tools to support keyword research, content gap analysis, and optimization suggestions
* Stay critical of AI-generated output rather than publishing it as-is — editing for accuracy, tone, and originality every time

#### **6. Continuous Learning**

* Stay updated on digital marketing trends, AI-assisted writing tools, and emerging content formats
* Participate in training sessions to improve writing efficiency and marketing alignment

### **Who will thrive in this role**

* You think about what a piece of content needs to achieve before you write a single word
* You check back on your own work after it’s published, not just when asked
* You can write clearly and persuasively across very different formats without losing quality in any of them
* You use AI tools to move faster, but you never let them replace your judgment or voice
* You balance creative instinct with SEO, data, and business strategy rather than treating them as opposing forces
* You treat a disappointing result as something to investigate and fix, not someone else’s problem
* You collaborate naturally with design, SEO, and development rather than writing in a silo

### **Qualifications & Skills**

#### **Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in content writing, preferably in a B2B, SaaS, or agency setting

#### **Must Have Skills**

* Strong command of English grammar, storytelling, and structuring ideas for digital platforms
* Solid understanding of SEO principles, user intent, and content performance metrics
* Ability to read and interpret content performance data (traffic, rankings, engagement, conversions) and act on it
* Proficiency in writing for multiple formats and adapting tone as per audience (technical, strategic, creative)
* Practical, daily use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Jasper, Claude, or similar) for research, drafting, and repurposing, with strong editorial judgment over AI output
* Excellent time management skills and ability to work under tight deadlines while maintaining quality
* A portfolio that showcases blog writing, website content, landing pages, or marketing copy — ideally with measurable results attached

#### **Tools & Platforms**

* Grammarly, SurferSEO, Semrush, Google Docs, WordPress
* Google Analytics or similar performance tracking tools
* AI tools (ChatGPT, Jasper, Claude, Canva, or similar) for content ideation and drafting
* Project management platforms like Notion or Trello

### **Nice to Have**

* Experience writing for US-based agencies or white-label brands
* Exposure to writing for digital services such as web design, SEO, or WordPress development
* Understanding of buyer journey and writing for conversion across top, middle, and bottom funnel content
* Experience A/B testing headlines, CTAs, or content structure to improve performance

### **What this role offers**

* Real ownership of content outcomes, not just content output
* A hands-on role shaping the voice and measurable results of our brand and our clients’ brands
* Exposure to AI-assisted content workflows alongside strong editorial craft
* Close collaboration with Design, SEO, Development, and Project Management teams
* Room to grow into a more senior content strategy role as the team scales

**Job Location:** Ahmedabad

**Job Time:** 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM

**Job Experience:** 7+ years

title: Application Specialist – Textiles Wet Processing
description:
**Company Description**
  
  
Molikule Technologies Private Limited is a speciality chemistry company focused on innovative silicone-based solutions across textile technologies, home care, car care, laundry care, and F&B kitchen products. Established in 2008 with a strong foundation in textile applications, the company has pioneered advanced block silicones and functional finishes that enhance softness, durability, water repellency, and breathability in fabrics.
  
  
Molikule’s engineers and researchers design customised silicone formulations that address diverse industry needs while emphasising quality and sustainability. With a global client base, the company partners with businesses to deliver high-performance, eco-conscious products for both premium apparel and industrial textiles. Molikule continues to drive future-ready innovation in textile chemistry from its “LEAP WITH SILICONES” philosophy.
  
  
**Role Description**
  
  
The Application Specialist – Textiles Wet Processing is a full-time remote role responsible for supporting customers and internal teams in the application of silicone-based products in wet processing environments. * Provide creative and technical feedback to improve final output.
* Ensure consistency in storytelling, visual quality and brand identity.
* Manage revisions, client feedback and final approvals.
* Ensure final videos meet quality standards and delivery deadlines.

**5. Advertising & Creative Direction**

* Develop creative concepts for advertisements and promotional campaigns.
* Collaborate with ad directors and production teams.
* Translate client requirements into effective advertising ideas.
* Oversee brand films, promotional videos and digital advertisements.
* Maintain creative quality and consistency across projects.

**6. Team Handling & Leadership**

* Lead and manage content writers, video editors, designers and production professionals.
* Assign responsibilities and monitor team deliverables.
* Guide team members in storytelling, scripting and creative execution.
* Review work and provide constructive creative feedback.
* Manage production teams and ensure timely project completion.

**7. Client & Project Coordination**

* Understand client briefs and business requirements.
* Present creative concepts, scripts and production ideas.
* Coordinate with clients and internal teams throughout the production process.
* Manage multiple projects and production schedules.
* Handle client feedback and revisions while maintaining creative quality.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 3–6 years of experience in content creation, film production, creative direction, advertising or media production.
* Strong writing, storytelling and scriptwriting skills.
* Thorough understanding of pre-production, production and post-production workflows.
* Hands-on experience in planning, coordinating and directing video shoots.
* Experience working with ad directors, cinematographers and production crews.
* Knowledge of camera operations, shot composition, lighting and production techniques.
* Understanding of video editing, colour grading, animation, motion graphics and sound design.
* Experience managing creative and production teams.
* Strong leadership, communication and decision-making skills.
* Ability to manage production budgets, schedules and multiple projects.
* Portfolio showcasing scripts, advertisements, brand films or directed productions.

**Who Should Apply?**

This role is ideal for someone who:

* Can independently develop stories, concepts and scripts for advertisements and brand films.
* Has practical experience managing all three stages of video production.
* Can plan and direct agency shoots and coordinate with ad directors and production crews.
* Can supervise post-production, review final outputs and lead creative teams.

**What We Offer**

* Salary: ₹30,000 – ₹50,000 per month, based on experience and skills.
* Opportunity to lead creative and media projects.
* Exposure to multiple brands and advertising campaigns.
* Creative ownership and team leadership opportunities.
* Professional growth in a dynamic agency environment.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can share their updated resume along with a portfolio showcasing scripts, storyboards, advertisements, shoot direction and previous video productions.

description:
**Job Summary:**

**The Lead Pharmacist** - Store operations is the primary point of contact for the assigned pharmacy, responsible for overseeing **daily store operations, ensuring accurate dispensing of medications and regulatory compliance, addressing manpower and infrastructure issues, implementing operational SOPs, coordinating closely with the SCM team for store purchase and inventory management, driving store sales, and monitoring end-to-end** store performance.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Dispensing & Compliance Oversight**

* Ensure every prescription is dispensed correctly by the team, and set the dispensing checks they follow.
* Coach staff on brands, generics, substitutes, and dosage, so the whole team can counter-check each other.
* Ensure Schedule H/H1/X and narcotics registers, licences, and temperature logs are maintained as per the Drugs & Cosmetics Act.
* Keep the store inspection-ready and support audit teams with required records.

**2. Inventory & Stock Management**

* Coordinate with the SCM team on stock availability, replenishment, and returns.
* Ensure goods receipt, invoice checks, FEFO, and cold-chain storage are followed by the team.
* Flag stock-outs, near-expiry items, and fast-moving shortages to the SCM team on time.
* Support stock audits conducted by the SCM team and ensure variances are explained and closed.

**3. Decision Making & Problem Solving**

* Take quick decisions on emergencies, stock-outs, rush hours, and escalated customer issues.
* Resolve store-level problems within your authority, and find the root cause to prevent repeats.
* Escalate to the Operation Manager when an issue is beyond store authority.

**4. Customer Experience & Marketing**

* Set and maintain service standards across the team, and handle escalated complaints personally.
* Ensure the team counsels customers properly and suggests cost-saving generic alternatives.
* Implement company marketing plans at store level: offers, loyalty programmes, health camps, home delivery.
* Build relationships with nearby doctors, clinics, and the local community, and share market feedback with management.

**5. Accounting, Reporting & Business Tools**

* Review daily cash, billing, and digital payment reconciliation, and report discrepancies immediately.
* Verify purchase invoices, credit notes, and discounts, with working knowledge of GST on medicines.
* Track store KPIs (sales, margin, expiry, stock availability) and submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports on time.
* Use pharmacy billing software, Excel/Google Sheets, and email/WhatsApp for reporting and coordination.

**6. Manpower Management**

* Assign roles and responsibilities, prepare duty rosters, and ensure peak-hour coverage.
* Train and coach staff in processes, product knowledge, and customer service.
* Set targets, review individual performance, and give regular feedback.
* Maintain discipline and team morale, support hiring and onboarding, and escalate HR issues.
* Foster a collaborative team culture, drive continuous operational improvement, and empower staff through constructive performance coaching.

**7. Attention to Detail & Communication**

* Audit team work regularly for errors in prescriptions, batches, expiry dates, MRP, and billing.
* Hold daily team briefings on targets, updates, and reminders.
* Be the single point of contact between the store and head office, and report honestly and on time.
* Communicate clearly with customers, doctors, suppliers, and the team.

title: Marketing and Engagement Executive
description:
**Marketing and Engagement Executive**
======================================

#### **Full Time**

#### **BANGALORE**

Job Summary

  
  

We are looking for a dynamic, energetic, and target-driven Marketing Executive to promote our overseas education services and strengthen our presence across schools, colleges, coaching centres, and other educational institutions. This is a field-intensive role, with approximately 70% of the time spent travelling to educational institutions, conducting promotional activities, organising seminars, and building relationships with key stakeholders.

  
  

The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication and networking skills, be comfortable with extensive travel, and have a passion for interacting with students and educational professionals.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Institutional Outreach & Relationship Management

* Visit schools, colleges, universities, coaching institutes, and educational organisations to promote the company's overseas education services.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with principals, counsellors, placement officers, teachers, and institutional decision-makers.

* Identify and develop new institutional partnerships to expand the company's network.

  
  

* Marketing & Student Engagement
  

  

* Organise and coordinate seminars, career guidance sessions, education fairs, workshops, and promotional events.

* Deliver presentations on overseas education opportunities, study destinations, universities, admission processes, scholarships, and visa pathways.

* Represent the company at educational events and exhibitions.

* Distribute marketing materials and ensure effective brand visibility at partner institutions.

  
  

* Lead Generation
  

  

* Generate quality student leads through institutional visits and promotional activities.

* Collect and maintain accurate student data and enquiry information.

* Ensure timely follow-up of leads by coordinating with the counselling and admissions teams.

* Meet monthly lead generation and institutional visit targets.

  
  

* Business Development
  

  

* Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness and student engagement.

* Develop new marketing initiatives to expand the company's reach.

* Gather market intelligence, competitor information, and student preferences.

  
  

* Reporting & Administration
  

  

* Maintain records of daily field visits, institutional meetings, seminars conducted, and leads generated.

* Submit regular activity reports and market feedback to the reporting manager.

* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution of marketing campaigns and events.

  
  

* Qualifications
  

  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Education, Communications, or a related field.

* 1–3 years of experience in field marketing, educational marketing, business development, admissions, or sales.

* Experience in the overseas education industry is preferred but not mandatory.

  
  

* Required Skills
  

  

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

* Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.

* Confidence in speaking to large student groups and institutional representatives.

* Strong organisational and event coordination skills.

* Lead generation and business development skills.

* Good negotiation and persuasion abilities.

* Basic knowledge of overseas education, study abroad programmes, or international admissions is an advantage.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM software is preferred.

  
  

* Key Competencies
  

  

* Self-motivated and target-oriented.

* Professional and confident personality.

* Excellent interpersonal skills.

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

* Strong problem-solving and planning skills.

* Willingness to travel extensively.

  
  

* Working Conditions
  

  

\* Approximately \*\*70% field work\*\* involving regular travel to schools, colleges, coaching centres, and educational institutions.

* 30% office-based work for planning, reporting, coordination, and follow-up.

* Local travel on a daily basis, with occasional outstation travel for education fairs, seminars, and institutional partnerships.

* Flexible working hours during events and admission seasons.

  
  

* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  

  

* Number of institutional visits completed.

* Number of new institutional partnerships established.

* Number of seminars, workshops, and promotional events organised.

* Student enquiries and qualified leads generated.

* Conversion of leads into counselling appointments and admissions.

* Achievement of monthly and quarterly marketing targets.

* Quality of institutional relationships and repeat engagement.

* Timely submission of activity reports and market feedback.

  
  

* Preferred Candidate Profile
  

  

* Passionate about education and student engagement.

* Comfortable travelling extensively and working in the field.

* Energetic, proactive, and results-driven.

* Possesses a valid driving licence and own vehicle (preferred).

* Fluent in English and the local language.

  
  
  

Interested candidates can mail updated resume to vacancies@edwiseinternational.com or can call on **022 40813** **487**

**Content Platform & Services Manager**

**About the Role**

ZS seeks a Content Platform & Services Manager to join our team in Bengaluru, India. This role will own end-to-end content operations for marketing and promotional materials and Medical-Legal-Regulatory (MLR) review workflows. The position sits at the intersection of content production and compliance process management, ensuring that content moves efficiently and compliantly from creation through approval to publication and archival.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience managing content lifecycle platforms, such as Veeva Vault PromoMats or an equivalent platform, in a regulated industry and is comfortable partnering with Marketing, Medical, Legal, and Regulatory stakeholders to keep review cycles on track. The role will also lead the evaluation, build, and rollout of AI-based accelerators, such as automated tagging, claims and reference checking, and pre-MLR quality screening, that reduce manual effort and accelerate review cycles.

We are looking for someone with 10+ years of experience in content operations, marketing operations, or promotional review management, ideally within pharmaceutical, life sciences, or healthcare industries. A bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, marketing, communications, or a related field is required; an MBA is preferred.

**What You'll Do**

* **Own content operations.** Manage intake, tagging and metadata, routing, review coordination, approval, publishing, and archival of promotional and non-promotional materials.
* **Manage MLR reviews.** Schedule review cycles, track reviewer comments and claims, ensure timely turnaround, and maintain complete audit trails.
* **Administer the platform.** Optimize Veeva Vault PromoMats or similar DAM/CLM systems, including user access, workflows, and metadata taxonomy.
* **Enable review-ready content.** Partner with Brand and Marketing teams to plan content pipelines and ensure correct references, claims substantiation, and formatting.
* **Coordinate cross-functionally.** Work with Medical, Legal, Regulatory, and Compliance reviewers to resolve bottlenecks and maintain SLA adherence.
* **Maintain compliance.** Ensure content meets internal standards, brand guidelines, and applicable pharmaceutical marketing and regulatory requirements prior to release.
* **Govern the content lifecycle.** Maintain accurate records of approved content, expiry and renewal dates, and withdrawal of outdated materials.
* **Improve operations.** Identify inefficiencies and drive continuous improvement across workflows, templates, and SOPs.
* **Report performance.** Create leadership dashboards covering review cycle time, throughput, bottlenecks, and compliance metrics.
* **Build capability.** Train internal stakeholders and agency partners on platform usage and MLR submission best practices.
* **Shape AI use cases.** Identify opportunities in metadata tagging, claims and reference validation, pre-review compliance checks, content reuse, and modular content, and build business cases.
* **Deliver AI accelerators.** Lead requirements, pilots, testing, output validation against MLR standards, and impact measurement with Technology, Data, and vendor partners.
* **Establish AI governance.** Set validation, human-in-the-loop, auditability, and compliance guardrails for AI-assisted content workflows.
* **Integrate and scale AI.** Evaluate Veeva AI features, GenAI tools, and workflow automation, and lead stakeholder and agency adoption.

**What You'll Bring**

* **Content operations expertise.** 10+ years of experience in content operations, marketing operations, or promotional review management in pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare, or another regulated industry.
* **Platform experience.** Hands-on experience with content lifecycle or DAM platforms such as Veeva Vault PromoMats, Aprimo, or similar systems.
* **MLR knowledge.** Working knowledge of MLR review processes and regulatory and compliance requirements for promotional materials.
* **AI and automation delivery.** Demonstrated experience building, piloting, or testing AI/GenAI accelerators or automation solutions, including defining success metrics and validating outputs.
* **Technical partnership.** Ability to convert operational pain points into AI and automation requirements and work effectively with technical teams through delivery.
* **Modular content.** Experience with content reuse and modular content strategies enabled by AI.
* **Stakeholder leadership.** Ability to coordinate effectively across Marketing, Medical, Legal, Regulatory, Compliance, Technology, Data, and agency partners.
* **Operational discipline.** Excellent organization and attention to detail, with the ability to manage concurrent review cycles and deadlines.
* **Communication.** Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* **Education.** Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, marketing, communications, or a related field; MBA preferred.

**Preferred Experience**

* **Industry background.** Prior experience at a pharmaceutical company or healthcare-focused marketing or content services organization.
* **Content governance.** Familiarity with taxonomy, metadata standards, and digital asset management best practices.
* **Process improvement.** Experience driving automation or continuous improvement within content operations.
* **Reporting tools.** Exposure to Power BI or Tableau for operational reporting and dashboards.
* **GenAI tools.** Hands-on exposure to GenAI/LLM tools, prompt design, or low-code automation applied to content or compliance workflows.
* **Responsible AI.** Understanding of validation, auditability, data privacy, and responsible AI in regulated industries.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Faster, more predictable review cycles with improved throughput and sustained SLA adherence.
* Accurate, compliant, and audit-ready content across the complete lifecycle.
* Measurable reduction in manual effort through validated AI accelerators and workflow automation.
* Strong adoption of content platforms, MLR best practices, and AI-enabled ways of working across internal and agency teams.
* Clear operational visibility through reliable metrics on cycle time, bottlenecks, throughput, quality, and compliance.

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

Gallagher Center of Excellence (GCoE) is seeking to hire a Bid Content Specialist – Knowledge and Document Manager. As a **Proposal Response Specialist****,** you are responsible for ensuring Gallagher’s Bid Library is proactively maintained with fresh, relevant content. You will become an expert in using **Gallagher’s ‘Responsive – formerly RFPIO’** technology to work with Sales Teams to capture and communicate our value proposition. You will use the Bid Library to provide Sales Teams with answer content across all Gallagher propositions.

You will be responsible for content strategy development, advanced writing and editing skills, and working closely with the Bid Managers on a day-to-day basis.

This role requires a strategic thinker with excellent writing skills who can translate complex insurance concepts into clear, persuasive documents. You are required to collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather necessary information, ensuring that all proposals meet client specifications and industry standards. Success in this position involves producing compelling bid content that enhances the company's chances of winning new business and expanding its client base. Additionally, you will be responsible for fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer focus within the shared services team. You will be interacting with teams present in Bengaluru and Pune.

  
  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Response Development: Review assigned RFP questions and select the most appropriate responses from approved content libraries and knowledge repositories.
* Content Customization: Tailor responses to align with prospect requirements, industry considerations, and client-specific circumstances while maintaining approved messaging.
* Content Analysis: Evaluate requirements, identify content gaps, and determine when additional research or subject matter expertise is needed.
* Continuous Improvement: Incorporate reviewer feedback and lessons learned to improve future proposal responses and overall response quality.
* Content Knowledge Management: Maintain familiarity with approved content, response libraries, and become champion of knowledge sharing.
* Content Enhancement: Identify outdated, duplicate, inaccurate, or missing content and contribute to ongoing content improvement initiatives.
* Deadline Management: Manage multiple proposals simultaneously, ensuring deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
* AI Advocacy & Digital Enablement: Act as a champion for AI and digital technologies by promoting adoption, sharing best practices, identifying use cases, and leveraging tools such as Microsoft Copilot to enhance proposal development, content management, and operational efficiency.
* Project Management: Take ownership of the proposal and co-ordinate with Bid Managers till the proposal submission. Have regular connects with the Bid Managers to ensure the smooth progress of the project.
* All other duties as assigned.

  
  
**About you**

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

### **Education**

* Minimum Required Degree: Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field.
* Preferred Degree: Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field.
* Master's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, English, or a related field is preferred.

* Knowledge Capture Certification or equivalent.
* Certification in Insurance Bid Writing is highly preferred.
* Advanced training in SEO (Search Engine Optimization) and SEM (Search Engine Marketing) is advantageous.
* Proficiency in content management systems (CMS) such as WordPress.
* Training in analytics tools such as Google Analytics is beneficial.
* Project management certification (e.g., PMP, Agile) is a plus.
* Certification in advanced content strategy or copywriting is beneficial.

### **Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in content creation, SEO, and digital marketing, preferably within the financial or insurance industry.
* Strong knowledge of SEO tools (Google Analytics, SEMrush, Moz) and content management systems (e.g., WordPress, HubSpot).

### **Technical Skills**

* Working knowledge of Responsive software and Microsoft Suite.
* Ability to navigate and search large content libraries.
* Understanding of RFP workflows and proposal development processes.

### **Business Knowledge**

* Deep understanding of assigned line of business.
* Understanding of client buying considerations and industry-specific requirements.
* Ability to recognize when standard content should or should not be used.

### **Critical Thinking & Communication**

* Strong written English comprehension.
* Ability to interpret nuanced client questions and determine underlying intent.
* Ability to evaluate multiple possible responses and select the most appropriate option.
* Strong judgment and independent decision-making skills.
* Ability to apply coaching and feedback across future opportunities.

### **Writing and Editing Expertise**

* Advanced writing skills across different content formats, from blogs and articles to web pages and social media posts.
* Ability to edit content for clarity, style, tone, and consistency, ensuring that all content aligns with the brand's voice.

### **SEO and Content Optimization**

* Deep understanding of Search Engine Optimization (SEO) techniques.
* Experience with keyword research, on-page SEO optimization (headings, metadata, etc.), and creating SEO-friendly content while maintaining quality and readability.

### **Cross-functional Collaboration**

### **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

* SEO Knowledge.
* Content Strategy Development.

* Project Management.
* Analytics and Reporting.
* Creative Thinking and Innovation.
* Brand Voice and Tone.

* Communication and Stakeholder Management.

  
  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

With a comprehensive portfolio and deep technical expertise, we help customers meet the demands of the global market. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.

**Overview:**

The MPS and SIOP Manager is responsible for overseeing and coordinating the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP) processes within the aerospace company. This role ensures that production plans align with sales forecasts, inventory targets, and capacity constraints to meet customer demands while optimizing resources and costs.

**Job Title**:

Manager - Planning

**Job responsibilities**:

* Master Production Scheduling (MPS):Develop, maintain, and adjust the Master Production Schedule to ensure alignment with customer orders, sales forecasts, and inventory policies.
* Collaborate with production, engineering, procurement, and quality teams to ensure accurate and achievable schedules.
* Monitor and analyze production capacity and resource utilization to ensure effective scheduling and resource allocation.
* Identify and resolve scheduling conflicts and bottlenecks to maintain production flow and meet delivery commitments.
* Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP):Lead the SIOP process, ensuring cross-functional collaboration to develop integrated plans that balance supply and demand.
* Facilitate monthly SIOP meetings to review demand forecasts, production plans, inventory levels, and capacity constraints.
* Work closely with sales, marketing, finance, and operations to ensure alignment and effective communication of SIOP plans.
* Develop and maintain key performance indicators (KPIs) to track the effectiveness of the SIOP process and drive continuous improvement.
* Demand and Supply Planning:Analyze historical sales data, market trends, and customer forecasts to develop accurate demand plans.
* Collaborate with procurement and logistics teams to ensure timely and cost-effective supply of materials and components.
* Optimize inventory levels to meet service level targets while minimizing carrying costs and obsolescence risks.
* Manage and mitigate supply chain risks, including demand variability, supplier performance, and production disruptions.
* Process Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements within the MPS and SIOP functions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and responsiveness.
* Implement best practices and standardized processes to improve planning accuracy and execution.
* Lead or participate in continuous improvement initiatives, such as Lean or Six Sigma projects, to drive operational excellence.
* Reporting and Analytics: Develop and maintain reports and dashboards to provide visibility into production schedules, inventory levels, and demand forecasts.
* Conduct regular analysis of planning data to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for improvement.
* Present findings and recommendations to senior management to support decision-making and strategic planning.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration:
* Partner with engineering and product development teams to ensure new product introductions and changes are seamlessly integrated into the production schedule.
* Work with the quality team to address any production or quality issues that impact the schedule.
* Collaborate with finance to align production plans with budgetary constraints and financial goals.
* Supplier and Customer Management: Engage with SCM team to ensure alignment on capacity, lead times, and delivery schedules.
* Work with BU demand teams to communicate production schedules and manage customer expectations.
* Technology and Systems Management: Evaluate and implement advanced planning and scheduling (APS) tools like Kinaxis to enhance MPS and SIOP processes.
* Ensure the effective use and integration of ERP/MRP systems within the planning processes.
* Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies that could improve planning accuracy and efficiency.
* Training and Development:
* Develop and deliver training programs to build LSW, planning and scheduling expertise within the team.
* Mentor and coach junior planners and analysts to enhance their skills and career development.
* Promote a culture of continuous learning and improvement within the planning team.
* Risk Management: Develop contingency plans to address potential disruptions in the supply chain or production process.
* Monitor and assess risks related to supplier performance, production capacity, and demand variability.
* Implement strategies to mitigate identified risks and ensure business continuity.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or relevant master’s degree is a plus.
* 15+ years of experience in production planning, supply chain management, or a related field within the aerospace or manufacturing industry.
* Strong knowledge of MPS and SIOP processes, tools, and best practices
* Proficiency in ERP/MRP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and advanced Excel skills; experience with Kinaxis RapidResponse is an advantage.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong leadership and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across functions and levels .
* Effective communication and presentation skills, both verbal and written.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* APICS CPIM or CSCP certification.
* Experience with Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement methodologies.
* Knowledge of aerospace industry standards and regulations.

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
**Career Area:**

Product Support

**Job Description:**

**Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.**

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Role Overview**

As a **Customer Services Consultant**, you act as the primary technical interface for FG Wilson diesel generator products. This role is central to supporting the dealer network, resolving customer issues, and driving continuous product improvement through technical insights and field feedback. You will collaborate directly with internal teams, suppliers, and global dealers to uphold service excellence and strengthen product reliability.

FG Wilson’s success is a critical pillar of the Caterpillar Electric Power Division (EPD) growth strategy through 2030. As the brand expands, delivering a world‑class product support experience is essential to our long‑term success. With continued investment and growth in the FG Wilson organization, we now have an opportunity for a professional to join our Product Support team in a Pre-Sales Dealer Support role.

**Role Definition**

Provides first line of support, coordination of services, problem resolution and/or recommendations on selected products and services.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Addressing minor coverage issues and resolving minor complaints. Ensuring all customer communication is clearly documented.
* Answering inbound customer service inquiries. Providing product health analysis or troubleshooting and redirecting them when appropriate.
* Identifying issues and determining appropriate course of action for effective resolution.
* Processing results from analysis of technical data.
* Understand prime product or component health or status, if action is needed, and required next steps

* Provide technical, and general product support to dealers via the Dealer Solution Network (DSN).
* Respond to Product and general related technical inquiries, ensuring thorough and accurate case documentation.
* Support dealers by providing product support and other data relevant to the dealer query.

**Product Support & Field Insights**

* Support campaign and field action execution as required.
* Communicate field and quality insights to the relevant departments and Product Support teams to drive product improvements.
* Contribute to CPI (Continuous Product Improvement) and Field Rework Programs with technical and cost inputs.
* Contribute to NPI (New Product Introduction) programs by acting as a representative of the Product Support team so that wider Product Support requirements and activities are understood and planned for during the planning and execution cycle of the NPI program. Product Support activities must keep pace with the project timeline so that planned Product introduction dates are successfully met.
* Collaborate with Publications to develop service literature and technical or Product related bulletins (TIBs).

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

* Serve as a key interface between dealers, engineering teams, suppliers, and other internal groups.
* Build strong relationships to ensure timely issue resolution and improved ticket response quality.

**Required Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 5 - 10 years of experience in electric power generation engineering, product support, or warranty administration.

**Education**

* Degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering.

**Technical Proficiency**

* Strong understanding of diesel engines, generator systems, controllers, and alternators.
* Working knowledge of FG Wilson / Perkins engines and industry engineering standards.
* Familiarity with quality, manufacturing, and warranty evaluation processes.

**Microsoft Office 365 Skills**

* Advanced Excel for ticket data analysis (pivot tables, formulas, dashboards).
* Power BI experience for appropriate metric reporting and visualization.
* PowerPoint proficiency for presenting related technical data insights to stakeholders.

**Project Management**

* Strong organizational ability to manage technical support cases, investigations, and cross‑functional activities.
* Exposure to Six Sigma or similar methodologies is preferred.

**Communication & Collaboration**

* Excellent communication skills for interacting with dealers and internal teams on technical and general dealer support matters.
* Ability to present complex technical or general dealer support issues in a clear and structured manner and work through to resolution in a timely fashion to meet or exceed customer expectations.
* Ability to identify, liaise and communicate with any other internal and external customer as required in order to deliver technical support resolution for the inquiry in a timely fashion that meets or exceeds customer expectations.

**Other Requirements**

* Willingness to travel up to 25% for supplier audits, dealer visits, and product related investigations.
* Proficiency in English (written and spoken).
* Ability to work independently with urgency and accountability.
* Experience in customer-facing or dealer support roles is a plus.
* Ability to work **full-time, five days a week** from the office.

**Core Competencies**

* **Data Gathering and analysis:** Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.
* **Consulting:** Knowledge of techniques, roles, and responsibilities in providing technical or business guidance to clients, both internal and external; ability to apply consulting knowledge appropriately.
* **Decision Making and Critical Thinking:** Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.
* **Effective Communications:** Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
* **Customer Focus:** Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
* **Service Excellence:** Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner.
* **Problem Solving:** Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Ability to solve technical and process-related issues quickly and accurately.
* **Relationship Management:** Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers. Effectively manage interactions with dealers, suppliers, and internal teams.

title: Senior Finance Analyst, COO Finance, SPM
description:
Job ID

26WD101764

**Job Requisition ID #**

  
  
26WD101764

**Position Overview**

  
  

Autodesk is seeking an experienced Senior Financial Analyst to join the Chief Operating Officer (COO) Finance Spend team within the Worldwide Field Organization (WWFO).

In this role, you will partner closely with stakeholders across Finance, Go-to-Market Operations, and the COO Finance organization to drive financial planning, spending analysis, and strategic business decisions.

You will collaborate with business leaders at various organizational levels, develop and enhance complex financial models, improve financial processes, and deliver actionable insights that drive measurable business outcomes.

As a strategic finance partner, you will help identify spending optimization opportunities, support financial decision-making, and establish scalable processes that improve operational efficiency and financial performance.

You will report to the Finance Manager of the SPM team and support the Vice President of Sales, Finance Directors, and Finance Business Partners within the WWFO COO organization.

  
  

**Responsibilities**

  
  

* Drive annual budget planning and quarterly and monthly forecasting cycles for the Worldwide Field Organization
* Partner with Finance leadership, Finance Directors, and Finance Business Partners to support budget owners in identifying spending optimization opportunities and recommending effective cost management strategies
* Develop financial frameworks and models to support strategic business decisions, evaluate Return on Investment (ROI) for Sales and Marketing initiatives, and track progress against organizational objectives
* Lead monthly and quarterly management reporting, analyze financial performance, identify key trends, assess business risks, and communicate actionable insights to senior leadership
* Prepare monthly operating expense reports and provide ad hoc financial analyses to support business planning and decision-making
* Utilize SAP and Anaplan to track, manage, forecast, and report Operating Expenses (OPEX)
* Collaborate with Finance Business Partners and Human Resources (HR) to track headcount, planned hiring activities, and associated workforce costs
* Develop financial analyses and forecasts for fixed costs, headcount investments, and other operational expenditures
* Own quarter-end financial activities, including preparing and submitting cross-charges and accruals
* Serve as a primary liaison between Corporate Accounting, Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), and Sales Finance teams to support accurate and timely financial reporting
* Lead process improvement initiatives that enhance financial planning, reporting accuracy, operational efficiency, and consistency across the COO Finance organization
* Develop and improve financial models, reporting templates, analytical tools, and standardized processes to support evolving business requirements
* Identify financial risks, opportunities, and cost optimization strategies through data-driven analysis and proactive business partnering
* Support special projects and provide ad hoc financial analyses in response to changing business priorities
* Build strong relationships with cross-functional stakeholders and communicate financial insights clearly to support informed business decisions
* Maintain high standards of accuracy, accountability, and attention to detail across financial planning, forecasting, and reporting activities
  

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or a related discipline
* 6+ years of relevant experience in Finance, Financial Planning and Analysis, or financial support for a Sales organization
* Experience developing and maintaining financial models, budgets, forecasts, and management reports
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret financial data and recommend actionable solutions
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present financial insights and influence stakeholders effectively
* Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including the ability to take ownership of projects, processes, and cross-functional initiatives
* Strong collaboration and relationship management skills, with the ability to work effectively across Finance and business teams
* High attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy in financial analysis, forecasting, and reporting
* Ability to prioritize competing responsibilities, manage deadlines, and work effectively in a fast-paced business environment
* Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and initiative
* Growth mindset with the ability to learn quickly, adapt to changing requirements, and identify opportunities for improvement
  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  
  

* Chartered Accountant (CA), Master of Business Administration (MBA), Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA), or Certified Public Accountant (CPA) qualification
* Experience supporting Sales, Marketing, or Go-to-Market Finance organizations
* Knowledge of Software as a Service (SaaS) business models and Sales performance metrics
* Experience using SAP and Anaplan for financial planning, forecasting, and expense management
* Experience evaluating Return on Investment (ROI) for Sales and Marketing initiatives
* Experience partnering with senior Finance leaders and supporting strategic business decisions
* Experience improving financial processes, reporting frameworks, and operational efficiencies
* Familiarity with headcount planning, operating expense management, accruals, and cross-functional financial reporting
  

  

**The Ideal Candidate**

  
  

The ideal candidate is an analytical, commercially minded, and collaborative Finance professional who combines strong financial expertise with strategic thinking, sound judgment, and a proactive approach to driving business performance and operational improvements

  
  

* Demonstrates a customer-focused mindset by understanding stakeholder needs, building trusted relationships, and delivering financial insights that support business objectives
* Applies strong analytical thinking and financial expertise to evaluate complex business challenges and recommend practical, data-driven solutions
* Connects financial analysis and individual initiatives to broader organizational priorities and long-term business outcomes
* Takes ownership of responsibilities, follows through on commitments, and demonstrates accountability for decisions, actions, and results
* Establishes clear processes, performance measures, and feedback mechanisms to monitor progress and improve financial outcomes
* Demonstrates confidence and sound judgment when challenging assumptions, recommending improvements, and making informed decisions
* Approaches complex problems with creativity and a willingness to explore alternative solutions while managing risks appropriately
* Builds productive working relationships with Finance leadership, business partners, and cross-functional stakeholders across different regions and organizational levels

title: Portfolio Lead, Banking Partnerships
description:
**About Water.org**

1 in 4 people around the world lack access to safe water and 2 in 5 people don't have access to a safe toilet. We are working every day to change this. We are Water.org. We're here to bring water and sanitation to the world. We want to make it safe, accessible, and cost-effective because we believe that water is the way to empower a bright future that we can all share in, worldwide. We are an international nonprofit organization based in Kansas City, Missouri that has positively transformed millions of lives around the world through access to safe water and sanitation. Founded by Gary White and Matt Damon, we pioneer market-driven financial solutions to the global water crisis. For more than 30 years, we've been providing women hope, children health and families a bright future.

**Why this role**

If you have built your career in financial inclusion or retail and MSME lending, this role lets you apply that expertise to a different kind of outcome. You will turn partner institutions' lending capability into water and sanitation finance for households that need it, and you will do it with a leadership role, a team, and real room to shape strategy. This is one of the few roles where a banker's instincts for lending, product and partnerships go straight into measurable change in people's lives: shape our banking strategy in South Asia and see your work show up as safe water and toilets in millions of homes.

**What You'll Do**

The Portfolio Lead owns Water.org's portfolio of banking and financial institution partnerships in South Asia. You will lead a team of 3 Partnership/ Senior Partnership Account Managers, report to the Director, Financial Institution Partnerships, and manage MSME NBFCs, public-sector banks, apex industry & training institutions, private banks and small finance banks.

**What You'll Do**

As Portfolio Lead, you'll own a dynamic portfolio of banking and financial institution partnerships, driving the growth and performance of accounts that deliver affordable water and sanitation financing to families who need it most. You'll combine the strategic instincts of a portfolio leader with the relationship depth of a banker — shaping partner strategies, clearing the path for your team, and translating market opportunities into real-world impact.

* **Grow partnerships.**
  Engage senior decision-makers at banks, MFIs and related institutions to deliver year-over-year growth of new and existing accounts. Identify and open new partners who are ready to add water and sanitation finance to their offering.
* **Own the portfolio.**
  Lead planning, performance targets, financial objectives and critical milestones across the portfolio, using Water.org's global frameworks for partnership design, solution design and field monitoring.
* **Lead and develop your team.**
  Coach and challenge account managers and partnership professionals, align their efforts to results, and build effective collaboration across functions.
* **Clear the path.**
  Act as the first point of escalation when your team faces obstacles, and flag risks early.
* **Keep the data honest.**
  Deliver timely, accurate reporting on account performance, impact progress, forecasts and funding utilization.
* **Advise partners**
  . Help institutions assess readiness for water and sanitation finance and design solutions that fit their business, regulatory environment and customers.

**Requirements**

**What we are looking for**

* Bachelor's degree and/or equivalent related work experience.
* 10 or more years of progressive responsibility in retail and wholesale microlending and/or water and sanitation financing, including strategic account management, partner development, partnership management and/or project management.
* 5 or more years of supervisory experience.
* A proven record of business development: expanding accounts and contracts with banks, water and sanitation enterprises, MSMEs, or related networks. Please give specifics in your application, such as a banking partnership you launched or the growth you delivered.
* Strong written and spoken English.

**Strongly preferred**

* Experience in financial inclusion or retail lending, particularly within a bank or financial institution.
* Familiarity with MSME lending portfolios.
* Current knowledge of the Indian regulatory and business environment, and of trends such as MSME credit and blended finance, and how they shape partnership design.
* A track record of taking initiative: building something new, solving a problem without a playbook, or opening a market

**Also valued**

* Experience working directly with senior leaders at banks, NBFCs, MFIs or apex institutions.
* Comfort managing multiple complex relationships across different perspectives and cultures.

**How you will work**

Based in Chennai on a hybrid arrangement. Up to 25% domestic and international travel.

**Why Water.org?**

At Water.org, we're dedicated to breaking barriers to safe water access for everyone, everywhere. When you join us, you'll be part of a purpose-driven team committed to sustainability, diversity of thoughts, ideas and experiences, and making a lasting impact. We offer growth opportunities, a collaborative culture, and the chance to drive global change.

Discover What Makes Water.org a Great Place to Work

Ready to make a difference? Apply today and join a team that's transforming lives through partnerships!

**Benefits**

**Salary/Benefits**

This position offers country-specific benefits and market-based, competitive salary as well as periodic review for merit and incentive pay based on organizational and personal achievement. Being authorized to work in the country posted is a precondition of employment.

**Type and Estimated Length of Employment: Full-Time, Exempt**

*Water.org is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive environment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, gender identity, age, national origin, ancestry, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, pregnancy status, military and veteran status, genetic information, and any other status protected by law. We provide qualified applicants and employees reasonable accommodation, when necessary, to enable individuals to complete the application process and/or perform the essential functions of the job. We believe social change happens when people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and identities come together with a common purpose. We strive to build and maintain an inclusive team that will advance our mission and work and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.*
*Water.org participates in E-Verify.*
