title: Marketing Ops -Operations AVP
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Customer**
The Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper, more valuable relationships with customers by combining business strategy, creativity, data, technology, GenAI, and scaled operations. We help Deloitte client service teams drive customer value creation and sustained growth across customer and commercial strategy, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. Our multidisciplinary teams—strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects—bridge strategy and execution. Through Business Process as a Service (BPaaS), we also design, transition, and run technology-enabled operations that improve performance today while generating the data, insight, and learning required for continuous transformation.
  
  
**Level: Associate Vice President – Marketing Operations & BPaaS**
**Work you’ll do**
The AVP – Marketing Operations & BPaaS will define the strategic direction and lead the build-out of an integrated agency and marketing operations capability for enterprise clients. The role combines deep marketing domain expertise with large-scale operations leadership, commercial ownership, digital transformation, and AI-enabled innovation.
  
  
This leader will set the agenda across the portfolio—translating CMO priorities and market shifts into differentiated services; establishing repeatable operating models; steering complex transitions and multi-account delivery; and sponsoring automation and AI initiatives from opportunity identification through production deployment and benefits realization.
  
  
The VP will provide clear direction to capability, solutioning, transition, delivery, technology, and innovation leaders, while remaining close enough to the operation to challenge decisions, remove barriers, and protect quality. Success requires a leader who can move fluently between executive strategy and the operational detail of how marketing work is planned, produced, activated, measured, and optimized.
  
  
**LEADERSHIP MANDATE**
Set direction
  
  

* Scale operations
* Industrialize AI

**Job Responsibilities**
**Strategy, Thought Leadership & Growth**

* Set the strategic agenda and market point of view: Define positioning, growth priorities, the multi-year roadmap, and investment agenda; advise senior executives and lead market-facing thought leadership.
* Productize and grow the business: Build modular offerings, reference operating models, accelerators, commercial constructs, and go-to-market plans; shape complex opportunities and own pipeline, bookings, revenue, margin, and investment.
* Build executive and ecosystem relationships: Serve as a trusted adviser to client and Deloitte leaders and mobilize alliances and specialist partners around priority propositions and outcomes.
* Build market credibility: Lead thought leadership, executive forums, alliance narratives, case studies, and market-facing points of view that establish a differentiated position in marketing operations and managed services.

Marketing Operations & Enterprise Scale
  
  

* Provide end-to-end domain direction: Challenge the design and performance of operations across marketing demand and workflow, campaigns and media, CRM and personalization, creative and content supply chain, MarTech platforms, data, analytics, and measurement.
* Design the operating system: Define roles, handoffs, service boundaries, playbooks, controls, governance, and measures across retained marketing teams, agencies, technology partners, and global delivery.
* Build and scale enterprise operations: Set up, transition, stabilize, and expand multi-account, multi-tower operations supporting 300–1,000+ practitioners; standardize and reuse while protecting brand, creative, customer, market, and regulatory context.
* Scale operational delivery: Set priorities and govern service quality, capacity, risk, financial health, resilience, and continuous transformation; act as the senior escalation point when outcomes are at risk.

**AI-Enabled Transformation & Performance**

* Set a value-led AI and automation agenda: Prioritize analytics, automation, GenAI, and agentic use cases across intake, workflow, content, quality assurance, campaign operations, reporting, optimization, and knowledge management.
* Scale innovation into live operations: Sponsor initiatives from business case through production, adoption, and benefits realization; redesign processes, roles, skills, controls, KPIs, staffing, and commercial assumptions as work changes.
* Govern trust and performance: Establish responsible AI, data, privacy, security, intellectual property, and human-oversight guardrails, with scorecards covering marketing outcomes, SLAs, quality, productivity, innovation, financials, and risk.

**Enterprise & Talent Leadership**

* Lead through leaders: Build the organization and leadership system, clarify accountabilities, align multidisciplinary teams, coach senior leaders, and create succession depth.
* Build a differentiated talent model: Combine marketing craft, platform expertise, operational rigor, consulting capability, and AI fluency; mobilize consulting, creative, media, technology, data, finance, risk, talent, and alliance teams around a shared direction.

**Location:**
Hyderabad / Chennai
  
  
**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree required; postgraduate qualification or MBA preferred.
  
  
**Experience**

* Senior leadership experience: 16+ years of professional experience, including at least 10 years leading large-scale marketing operations, agency delivery, digital operations, or managed services and a minimum of 5 years in executive leadership roles.
* Proven build-and-scale track record: Demonstrated experience setting up, transitioning, stabilizing, and scaling global or enterprise operations, including organizations of approximately 300–1,000+ team members.
* Deep marketing operations credibility: Strong operational understanding across multiple marketing domains such as campaign and media operations, CRM and lifecycle marketing, creative and content supply chain, MarTech operations, customer journey orchestration, data, analytics, and measurement.
* AI and automation leadership: Evidence of identifying, sponsoring, and scaling automation, analytics, GenAI, or agentic initiatives within live operations, with responsibility for adoption, controls, operating-model change, and measurable benefits—not only pilots or technology implementation.
* Commercial and P&L ownership: Experience owning a multi-million-dollar portfolio or P&L and making decisions across growth, pricing, investment, margin, capacity, utilization, and risk.
* Global delivery and transformation: Experience leading distributed onshore, nearshore, and offshore models and large transformation programs across multiple clients, geographies, or service towers.
* Executive client leadership: Credibility with senior marketing, customer, digital, technology, operations, and procurement stakeholders and the ability to influence strategic decisions in complex client environments.
* Thought leadership and market orientation: A clear point of view on the evolution of marketing operations, agency models, platforms, data, AI, and managed services, with the ability to convert that perspective into propositions and client conversations.
* Leadership judgment: Strong analytical, commercial, organizational, negotiation, and influencing skills, with the ability to make timely decisions, manage ambiguity, and provide calm direction during high-stakes delivery situations.

**The team**
Our Digital Foundry Operate & Innovations (DFO&I) team helps organizations design, build, transition, and scale digital products, experiences, and operations that drive business growth and elevate customer engagement. As a multidisciplinary group of strategists, designers, engineers, data specialists, and operators, we connect the work of transformation with the discipline of ongoing operations. Our capabilities span the digital lifecycle from research, experience and platform design through content production, marketing automation, campaign operations, and continuous optimization—enabling clients to experiment, learn, and scale with confidence.
  
  
**Preferred Skills, Project Experience & Certifications**

* Marketing and technology platforms: Hands-on leadership exposure to major marketing ecosystems such as Adobe, Salesforce, Google, Meta, HubSpot, Marketo, Braze, leading media platforms, workflow tools, content platforms, and analytics environments.
* Operating excellence and transformation methods: Experience applying Lean, Six Sigma, process intelligence, service management, Agile, product management, or equivalent methods to redesign and improve live operations.
* Enterprise technology programs: Experience steering complex MarTech, data, cloud, workflow, or digital transformation programs and integrating those capabilities into managed operations.
* Responsible AI and data governance: Understanding of data privacy, information security, intellectual property, model risk, human oversight, and governance requirements relevant to AI-enabled marketing operations.
* Professional certifications: Relevant certifications in marketing platforms, analytics, AI, Agile, Lean Six Sigma, cloud, or program management are advantageous, but are not a substitute for demonstrated leadership and operational outcomes.
* Global mobility and collaboration: Flexibility to travel as required and work effectively with clients and teams across geographies and time zones.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

**About Cognizant Corporate**

Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose: to make a meaningful impact. We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter. Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.

At Cognizant, careers transcend titles. We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose, always guided by our core values. Join us in shaping the future of business.

**About the team:**

**The Global Large Deals Sales Intelligence team** helps Cognizant uncover, shape, and pursue strategic large-deal opportunities across global geographies and business units. Working alongside account teams, pursuit teams, solution leaders, and senior sales stakeholders, the team combines market intelligence, commercial insight, and AI-led innovation to originate differentiated opportunities and strengthen critical pursuits.

**About the role:**

As a **Senior Associate – Sales Intelligence**, you will help originate large opportunities for Cognizant by closely monitoring market-level triggers, industry shifts, and client developments, and shaping these signals into well-defined opportunities and compelling client pitches. You will also support active large-deal pursuits by delivering competitive, account, and market intelligence that helps pursuit leaders and senior sales stakeholders make informed decisions.

Generative AI and agentic AI are integral to how this team works. You will be expected to use AI tools fluently in your daily work, stay current with emerging models, features, and enterprise use cases, and apply them to sharpen the speed, depth, and quality of what you produce.

Success in this role looks like well-founded opportunities brought to the table, pitches that earn a client conversation, and intelligence that senior stakeholders trust and act on, all delivered with quick turnaround.

**In this role, you will:**

* Track market-level triggers, industry shifts, and client developments using AI-enabled research, and translate them into account-level deep dives that establish a clear rationale for pursuing an opportunity, collaborating cross-functionally with account, solutioning, and practice teams to validate and sharpen the hypothesis.
* Build robust business cases through thought-through baseline construction and savings and productivity modeling, quantifying cost take-out and growth upside in a way that is defensible with senior client and internal audiences.
* Develop proactive pitches that showcase the **art of the possible**, combining client context and the business case with sharp storytelling to create a persuasive, client-specific narrative.
* Provide competitive, account, and market intelligence for active large-deal pursuits, including opportunity hypotheses, competitive positioning, risks, and key pursuit considerations, using generative AI models and agents to accelerate research and validation.
* Industrialize proactive deal origination and deal pursuit intelligence processes by leveraging agentic AI, reusable workflows, prompts, and templates to improve repeatability, consistency, and quality while reducing lead time for pitch development.
* Work closely with pursuit, account, solution, and senior sales stakeholders, managing ambiguity, tight timelines, and competing priorities with professional judgment.

**What you must have to be considered**

* **MBA from a Tier-1 business school.**
* **3 - 6 years of experience** in business development, presales, pitch or proposal development, deal origination, or management consulting, ideally within IT services, technology, or a client-facing advisory environment.
* Demonstrated experience building client-facing pitches, proposals, or business cases, underpinned by a deep understanding of the IT services sales process, with the ability to construct a clear commercial argument and tell a persuasive story to senior audiences.
* Strong financial and commercial analysis skills, including the ability to interpret client financials, size cost-savings and growth opportunities, and build defensible value cases.
* Strong ability to read and synthesize complex information, analyze trends and benchmarks, and structure insights logically and clearly.
* A strong sense of ownership, a collaborative mindset, and the professional maturity to work effectively during high-intensity deal cycles.

**Tool proficiency expectations**

* High proficiency in PowerPoint for structured storytelling and executive communications, and advanced Excel skills for financial modeling, data analysis, and quantitative insights.
* Hands-on proficiency with day-to-day generative AI models such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or similar, and with agentic tools such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, LangChain, or similar, including practical experience building or configuring AI agents and workflows, and a working understanding of what current models can and cannot do.

**These will help you succeed**

* An undergraduate degree in information technology or computer science, along with a deep understanding of the IT services sales process.
* Experience with agent development frameworks such as LangChain, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or similar platforms, and with multi-agent workflows, AI orchestration, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or low-code AI solutions.
* Exposure to vibe coding or AI-assisted application development, paired with genuine curiosity for exploring emerging AI capabilities and applying them to business, sales, and client problems. Traditional software-development experience is not mandatory, but practical engagement with AI tools is highly valued.
* A proactive, can-do approach, with the ability to thrive in a demanding, high-speed environment, incorporate feedback without losing pace or quality, and go the extra mile for the team when the situation demands it.

**Work model**

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring a minimum of three days a week at any Cognizant location across India. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.

Compliance with GST and TDS regulations is non-negotiable. A Tally accountant ensures that all tax payments are made on time and returns are filed without errors, avoiding legal complications for the organization.

Reconciliation of accounts payable and receivable ensures that the organization's books are always balanced. Tally accountants manage discrepancies efficiently, contributing to financial clarity.

* Accuracy and timely processing of purchase orders.

* Time management and multitasking skills.
* Problem-solving and decision-making ability.
* Ability to handle multiple responsibilities independently.

Product: UnityESS residential Battery Energy Storage Systems

Locations: We are hiring for different locations – Varanasi, Bareilly, Lucknow, Jaipur, Ahmedabad, Nagpur, Pune, Chennai.

**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**

UnityESS residential batteries are already part of the Ornate Solar portfolio, and now we’re expanding our

reach across new territories. We’re looking for a dynamic, partnership-driven professional to lead this

expansion in your territory by leveraging the strength of the Ornate Solar brand and building a strong network

of trusted dealers and distributors across key districts.

If you enjoy building relationships, earning partners’ trust, developing new business opportunities, and driving

growth in emerging markets, this is your opportunity to make a real impact and establish UnityESS as a trusted

name in your territory.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**

1. Launch UnityESS and grow the network

* Lead the go-to-market launch of UnityESS in your territory.

* Map districts and towns by solar adoption, power-cut frequency and buying potential, then choose

where to start.

* Appoint and onboard district-level distributors and dealers, each with a clear territory.

2. Find and welcome the right partners

* Identify and sign solar installers, EPCs, inverter and electrical dealers, and battery or UPS distributors.

* Guide each partner through the full journey: due diligence, fair commercial terms, agreement and

activation.

* Train partners and their teams on the product, installation and selling so they succeed from day one.

3. Deliver sales and revenue

* Own monthly, quarterly and annual sales targets for the territory.

* Track primary and secondary sales, partner performance and pipeline, and keep management informed.

* Help partners sell through joint customer visits, demos, local promotions and shared leads.

4. Shape the channel model

* Help design margins, schemes, credit terms, stocking norms and territory rules that are fair to partners

and sustainable for us.

* Build simple, clear SOPs for on boarding, order processing, warranty and service coordination, and

claims.

* Keep an eye on partner ROI, because a profitable partner is a motivated partner.

5. Keep collections healthy

* Make sure payments arrive on time and receivables stay within credit limits.

* Check partner creditworthiness before appointing them and before raising limits.

6. Stay close to the market and the team

* Watch competitor products, pricing, schemes and channel moves, and share what you learn with

product and pricing teams.

* Work hand in hand with supply chain, service and marketing on stock, installations and local campaigns.

* Follow state subsidy and net-metering developments that influence demand for solar and storage.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YOUR FIRST YEAR

* A district-wise channel roadmap for your territory in your first 30 days.

* The agreed number of active dealers and distributors appointed across priority districts (target to be set

together with management).

* Monthly sell-in and sell-out targets met, with partners who are genuinely active and happy.

* Healthy collections, with little or no overdue receivables.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Education: Graduate (B.E./B.Tech preferred). An MBA in Sales or Marketing is a welcome plus.

Experience: 8–12 years in channel, distribution or franchise sales, including at least 3–5 years in a regional or

state-level role.

Background we love to see

* Experience in solar, inverters, batteries/UPS, home electrical, consumer durables or similar channel-led

businesses.

* A track record of appointing and growing dealers, distributors or franchisees in tier II, III and IV markets.

title: Marketing and Engagement Executive
description:
**Marketing and Engagement Executive**
======================================

#### **Full Time**

#### **CHENNAI**

Job Summary

  
  

We are looking for a dynamic, energetic, and target-driven Marketing Executive to promote our overseas education services and strengthen our presence across schools, colleges, coaching centres, and other educational institutions. This is a field-intensive role, with approximately 70% of the time spent travelling to educational institutions, conducting promotional activities, organising seminars, and building relationships with key stakeholders.

  
  

The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication and networking skills, be comfortable with extensive travel, and have a passion for interacting with students and educational professionals.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Institutional Outreach & Relationship Management

* Visit schools, colleges, universities, coaching institutes, and educational organisations to promote the company's overseas education services.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with principals, counsellors, placement officers, teachers, and institutional decision-makers.

* Identify and develop new institutional partnerships to expand the company's network.

  
  

* Marketing & Student Engagement
  

  

* Organise and coordinate seminars, career guidance sessions, education fairs, workshops, and promotional events.

* Deliver presentations on overseas education opportunities, study destinations, universities, admission processes, scholarships, and visa pathways.

* Represent the company at educational events and exhibitions.

* Distribute marketing materials and ensure effective brand visibility at partner institutions.

  
  

* Lead Generation
  

  

* Generate quality student leads through institutional visits and promotional activities.

* Collect and maintain accurate student data and enquiry information.

* Ensure timely follow-up of leads by coordinating with the counselling and admissions teams.

* Meet monthly lead generation and institutional visit targets.

  
  

* Business Development
  

  

* Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness and student engagement.

* Develop new marketing initiatives to expand the company's reach.

* Gather market intelligence, competitor information, and student preferences.

  
  

* Reporting & Administration
  

  

* Maintain records of daily field visits, institutional meetings, seminars conducted, and leads generated.

* Submit regular activity reports and market feedback to the reporting manager.

* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution of marketing campaigns and events.

  
  

* Qualifications
  

  

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Education, Communications, or a related field.

* 1–3 years of experience in field marketing, educational marketing, business development, admissions, or sales.

* Experience in the overseas education industry is preferred but not mandatory.

  
  

* Required Skills
  

  

* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

* Strong networking and relationship-building abilities.

* Confidence in speaking to large student groups and institutional representatives.

* Strong organisational and event coordination skills.

* Lead generation and business development skills.

* Good negotiation and persuasion abilities.

* Basic knowledge of overseas education, study abroad programmes, or international admissions is an advantage.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and CRM software is preferred.

  
  

* Key Competencies
  

  

* Self-motivated and target-oriented.

* Professional and confident personality.

* Excellent interpersonal skills.

* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

* Strong problem-solving and planning skills.

* Willingness to travel extensively.

  
  

* Working Conditions
  

  

\* Approximately \*\*70% field work\*\* involving regular travel to schools, colleges, coaching centres, and educational institutions.

* 30% office-based work for planning, reporting, coordination, and follow-up.

* Local travel on a daily basis, with occasional outstation travel for education fairs, seminars, and institutional partnerships.

* Flexible working hours during events and admission seasons.

  
  

* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  

  

* Number of institutional visits completed.

* Number of new institutional partnerships established.

* Number of seminars, workshops, and promotional events organised.

* Student enquiries and qualified leads generated.

* Conversion of leads into counselling appointments and admissions.

* Achievement of monthly and quarterly marketing targets.

* Quality of institutional relationships and repeat engagement.

* Timely submission of activity reports and market feedback.

  
  

* Preferred Candidate Profile
  

  

* Passionate about education and student engagement.

* Comfortable travelling extensively and working in the field.

* Energetic, proactive, and results-driven.

* Possesses a valid driving licence and own vehicle (preferred).

* Fluent in English and the local language.

  
  
  

Interested candidates can mail updated resume to vacancies@edwiseinternational.com or can call on **022 40813** **469**

Employment Type: Full-time

**About MrMed**

MrMed is a fast-growing digital healthcare platform committed to making specialty and life-saving medicines accessible and affordable across India. We support patients battling chronic and critical illnesses by simplifying access to high-cost therapies and providing end-to-end assistance throughout their treatment journey.

At MrMed, we work closely across multiple teams including marketing, sales, operations, logistics and city operations to build trust and presence in the markets we serve. Our offline marketing team plays a critical role in understanding ground realities and growing MrMed’s reach across cities.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive, result-oriented Offline Marketing Executive – Field Operations & Market Intelligence to drive on-ground marketing activities, conduct market visits, coordinate with multiple stakeholders and support data-driven marketing decisions. The role combines field execution, market intelligence, stakeholder coordination and advanced reporting.

You will be comfortable with extensive fieldwork, intercity travel and daily market engagement, and you will use Excel, PowerPoint and AI-powered tools to turn what you see on the ground into clear insights that support MrMed’s business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**On-Ground Marketing**

* Conduct regular market visits across assigned locations and identify business opportunities.
* Gather market intelligence and monitor competitor activities.
* Execute marketing initiatives on the ground and strengthen MrMed’s market presence.

**Market Research & Insights**

* Understand customer behavior, market trends, channel performance and local business opportunities through field observations.
* Conduct field assessments and document key learnings from each market.

**Reporting & Analytics**

* Prepare accurate and insightful daily, weekly and monthly reports using advanced Excel, PowerPoint presentations and dashboards.
* Maintain daily market visit reports, activity trackers, visit outcomes, action plans and follow-up records.

**AI-Driven Reporting**

* Leverage AI tools to streamline reporting and analyze market data.
* Identify trends and generate actionable business insights using AI-enabled reporting tools.

**Stakeholder Coordination**

* Coordinate effectively with internal teams, field executives, business partners, vendors and other stakeholders.
* Ensure smooth execution of marketing activities across locations.

**Intercity Travel**

* Travel across assigned cities and markets to execute marketing initiatives and conduct field assessments.
* Manage daily field visits and travel plans while meeting deadlines.

**Performance Tracking & Presentation**

* Monitor the effectiveness of marketing activities and identify gaps.
* Recommend improvements based on field feedback and data analysis.
* Present market findings, campaign updates and business recommendations to management in a clear and structured manner.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 2+ years experience in offline marketing, field marketing, market research, sales coordination or channel development; healthcare, pharma or e-commerce background preferred.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and data reporting.
* Familiarity with AI tools for reporting, analysis and productivity.
* Excellent communication, coordination and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Willingness to travel frequently and conduct daily field visits.
* Ability to manage multiple activities, meet deadlines and work independently.
* Proactive mindset with a strong understanding of offline marketing and market dynamics.

**Why Join MrMed?**

At MrMed, strong on-ground presence and sharp market understanding help ensure specialty and life-saving medicines reach more patients, safely and on time.

We value people who bring ownership, initiative, analytical thinking and the ability to turn field insights into action. This is a hands-on role for a professional who can seamlessly combine field execution, market intelligence, stakeholder coordination and data-driven reporting.

If you enjoy being on the ground and turning market insights into growth, we would love to meet you.

title: Finance Executive
description:
**Job Description – Finance Executive**
=======================================

**Department:** Finance & Accounts  
**Designation:** Finance Executive  
**Location:** Chennai  
**Experience:** Freshers / 0–2 Years

### **1. Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and motivated Finance Executive to support our Finance & Accounts operations. The candidate should have a good understanding of basic accounting principles, invoicing, billing, and financial documentation.

Freshers with strong accounting fundamentals and a willingness to learn are also welcome to apply.

### **2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Invoicing & Billing**

* Prepare, verify, and process customer invoices accurately and on time.
* Check invoices against supporting documents, service details, and agreed commercial terms.
* Handle vendor invoices and verify billing details before processing.
* Maintain proper records of invoices, credit notes, and debit notes.
* Follow up with internal teams for pending billing information and discrepancies.

**B. Accounting & Finance Operations**

* Maintain day-to-day accounting entries and financial records.
* Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable activities.
* Perform ledger scrutiny and basic account reconciliation.
* Assist with bank reconciliation and payment tracking.
* Verify expense claims, bills, and supporting documents.
* Support month-end and year-end accounting activities.

**C. GST & Statutory Documentation**

* Basic understanding of GST, GST invoices, CGST, SGST, and IGST.
* Assist in maintaining GST-related records and documentation.
* Support preparation of data required for GST returns and statutory compliance.

**D. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain proper financial records and documentation.
* Prepare basic MIS reports and Excel statements.
* Coordinate with internal departments for finance-related information.
* Ensure accuracy and timely completion of assigned finance activities.

### **3. Required Skills & Qualifications**

* B.Com / M.Com / BBA (Finance) or equivalent qualification.
* Good understanding of basic accounting principles.
* Knowledge of invoicing, billing, debit notes, and credit notes.
* Basic understanding of GST and financial transactions.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel.
* Knowledge of Tally, Zoho Books, or other accounting software is an advantage.
* Good communication, numerical, and analytical skills.
* Attention to detail and willingness to learn.

### **4. Experience Criteria**

* Freshers with good accounting fundamentals are welcome.
* Candidates with 0–2 years of experience in finance, accounts, or invoicing will be preferred.
* Practical knowledge of invoicing and accounting will be an added advantage.

### **5. Candidate Screening – Practical Accounting Assessment**

Candidates will be evaluated on the following basic accounting and finance concepts during the interview:

* **Accounting Fundamentals:** Understanding of Debit, Credit, Journal Entries, Ledger and Trial Balance.
* **Invoicing:** Ability to prepare and verify customer and vendor invoices.
* **GST Knowledge:** Understanding of GST invoices, CGST, SGST and IGST, with basic tax calculations.
* **Reconciliation:** Basic knowledge of bank reconciliation and ledger reconciliation.
* **MS Excel:** Knowledge of basic formulas, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and Pivot Tables.

**Suggested Practical Interview Questions:**

* What is the difference between Debit and Credit?
* What is a Journal Entry and Ledger?
* What is the difference between Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable?
* What is the difference between a Debit Note and Credit Note?
* What is the difference between CGST, SGST and IGST?
* How do you calculate GST on an invoice?
* What details should be checked before processing a customer invoice?
* What is Bank Reconciliation?
* What is the difference between a Purchase Invoice and Sales Invoice?
* How would you identify and correct an invoice discrepancy?

**Assessment Criteria:** Freshers should demonstrate strong accounting fundamentals and logical understanding. Experienced candidates should also demonstrate practical knowledge of invoicing, billing, reconciliation, and day-to-day accounting activities.

### **6. Ideal Candidate**

A candidate who has strong accounting fundamentals, understands financial transactions, is comfortable working with invoices and numbers, and is willing to take ownership of day-to-day finance operations.

**Note:** We encourage applications from fresh graduates who have good accounting knowledge. Prior work experience is not mandatory for candidates with strong fundamentals and a willingness to learn.

title: Partner Success Manager (GSIs-EMEA)
description:
**JOB LOCATION: HYDERABAD (work-from-office, 5 days)**

***Please note
:***
*This role requires working from our Hyderabad office location, and we are a 5-day work-from-office company; hence, we would appreciate you considering this work mode before applying to this job post.*

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

The Partner Success Manager (PSM) plays a critical role in supporting Kore.ai’s partner-led go-to-market strategy by managing day-to-day partner engagement, driving pipeline development, and enabling partners to effectively position and sell Kore.ai solutions.

Working closely with Partner Sales Directors (PSDs), AEs, SEs, the PSM acts as the operational and relationship backbone of the partnership ecosystem (hyperscalers, global system integrators, reseller partners) — supporting opportunity development, qualification, and close, as well as partner enablement and joint go-to-market execution. The PSM turns partner relationships and joint business plans into measurable opportunity creation and progression.

The PSM owns the day-to-day execution cadence for an assigned partner portfolio: joint account mapping, partner-seller activation, initial opportunity discovery, qualification, CRM accuracy and follow-through. The PSD retains ownership of strategic partner relationships and overall partner strategy; the AE owns customer deal strategy and commercial closure. The PSM is expected to increase partner productivity rather than act solely as a coordinator.

This role is ideal for early- to mid-career professionals with a strong interest in enterprise sales, partnerships, and ecosystem selling. The PSM will collaborate closely with Kore.ai Account Executives, Sales Engineers, Marketing, and partner teams to build pipeline, manage opportunities, and drive joint partner initiatives.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Support Partner Pipeline Development**

* Work with Partner Sales Directors and partner teams to develop pipeline opportunities within the EMEA region.
* Identify and nurture early-stage opportunities within partner ecosystems.
* Track partner-sourced and partner-influenced opportunities within CRM systems.
* Engage with partners and potential customers at partner events where needed.
* Support engagement with GSIs (Global System Integrators).

**Partner Relationship Management**

* Maintain regular engagement with partner sales teams, alliance managers, and practice leaders.
* Ensure partners are informed on Kore.ai solutions, product updates, and value propositions.
* Act as a primary point of contact for day-to-day partner interactions.

**Opportunity Management**

* Help qualify partner-generated leads and ensure opportunities are properly scoped.
* Coordinate with Account Executives and Sales Engineers to support opportunity progression.
* Track deal status, partner involvement, and next steps to ensure momentum.

**Partner Enablement**

* Support partner enablement initiatives to help partners effectively position Kore.ai solutions.
* Coordinate training sessions, workshops, and enablement activities for partner teams (sales and technical).
* Help partners understand Kore.ai’s platform capabilities and key use cases.

**Support Joint Go-To-Market Execution**

* Work with the marketing team to support joint marketing activities with partners, including: Partner events, Industry webinars, Field marketing campaigns, Executive roundtables.
* Assist in converting partner engagement into a qualified pipeline.

**Execute Partner Business Plans**

* Support Partner Sales Directors in developing and executing joint partner business plans.
* Track progress against partner objectives across: Co-sell pipeline, Co-marketing initiatives, Partner enablement milestones.
* Maintain reporting and insights on partner performance.

**Internal Coordination**

* Serve as a liaison between partner teams and Kore.ai internal teams, including sales, marketing, and product.
* Ensure alignment on account priorities, deal strategy, and partner engagement.
* Provide operational support for partner programs and initiatives.

**REQUIRED EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE**

* A bachelor’s or an MBA from a premier institute would be highly preferred
* 3–6 years of experience in partnerships, enterprise sales support, business development, or partner ecosystem roles within enterprise software, SaaS, AI, or cloud companies.
* Experience working with or supporting GSI partner ecosystems.
* Ability to run initial discovery, articulate a business-value proposition and assess customer readiness.
* Demonstrated ability to originate or qualify B2B opportunities, preferably through partners, and progress them with disciplined follow-up.
* Strong interest in building a career in enterprise partnerships and ecosystem sales.
* Strong CRM and pipeline management, commercial judgement, clear communication and proactive ownership across stakeholders.
* Familiarity with enterprise AI, automation, contact centres or digital transformation.

**CORE COMPETENCIES**

* Partner Relationship Management: Ability to build strong working relationships with partner teams and maintain consistent engagement.
* Pipeline Development: Experience supporting opportunity development and pipeline management.
* Sales Coordination: Strong ability to coordinate cross-functional sales activities across internal and partner teams.
* Partner Enablement: Ability to help partners understand and effectively position enterprise technology solutions.
* Operational Excellence: Highly organised with strong attention to detail in managing opportunities, reporting, and partner programs.

**SUCCESS METRICS**

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Growth in partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline
* Number of qualified opportunities developed with partners
* Effectiveness of partner enablement programs
* Execution of joint partner marketing activities
* Partner engagement and relationship health

**WHY JOIN KORE.AI**

* Work at the forefront of enterprise agentic AI transformation
* Partner with leading technology and consulting firms globally
* Support strategic deals that shape the future of AI-powered enterprise experiences
* A clear path for growth into senior alliance and partner sales leadership roles

title: Salesforce Success Architect - (Industry Specific)
description:
**Description**
**The Experience**
Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together technical architects, customer support engineers, and product advisors. This team delivers expert guidance on optimizing and demonstrating Salesforce technology to drive long-term business success, in addition to resolving technical issues.
  
  
Success Architects are a pivotal part of the Cloud Success team, supporting Salesforce's most critical and strategic customers. They provide expert guidance on solution design, focusing on scalability, security, and adherence to standard methodologies. By assessing system performance, they help to optimize efficiency and reliability while proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements to maintain technical health. Success Architects empower businesses to maximize their Salesforce investment by aligning technology with core business goals.
  
  
The Industry Success Architect collaborates across Customer Success and the Product organization to drive long-term customer solutions. This includes resolving immediate technical challenges with support engineers while identifying root causes, partnering with customer success managers on strategic guidance and long-term technology health, and liaising with product teams to surface customer feedback for product improvements.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Drive Customer Impact - Partner with our most strategic and high-priority customers, assessing their Industry Cloud implementations and delivering expert recommendations on technical architecture, solution design, application lifecycle management, reliability, and feature adoption.
* Lead with Multi-Cloud Expertise - Serve as a trusted Subject Matter Expert (SME) in your designated Industry Clouds, providing both proactive and reactive guidance on architecture, technology strategy, thought leadership, and product best practices. You will help the team stay at the forefront of Industry Cloud innovations, ensuring they are equipped with the latest product developments and emerging trends.
* Communicate with Clarity - Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor in key business and technology discussions.
* Innovate & Solve Problems - Identify capability gaps and design inefficiencies, recommending product enhancements or creative custom solutions that drive customer success and long-term adoption.
* Execute Proven Strategies - Leverage and tailor Success Architect playbooks to meet the unique challenges and opportunities of your Industry Cloud customers.
* Build Strong Relationships - Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement, and overall business growth.
* Lead enterprise success strategy with an AI First mindset — using Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, and AI-powered analytics as primary tools for designing, modeling, and continuously optimizing customer success programs
* Apply generative AI to develop executive-level deliverables including strategic business reviews, value realization frameworks, and multi-stakeholder success plans — with strong human judgment applied to business context and executive narrative
* Leverage AI-generated portfolio insights to identify whitespace opportunities, adoption barriers, and risk indicators, driving strategic recommendations and C-level alignment
* Serve as an internal thought leader and practitioner on AI-augmented success practices — defining standards, playbooks, and governance for AI tool usage in partnership with CS leadership

**You're Our Person If...**

* 8+ years of experience in software, system, or enterprise architecture.
* Expertise in Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance, and best practices.

* Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics, and security best practices.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and executive audiences.

* Proven ability to lead discussions, influence decision-making, and advocate for best practices.
* Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations, and drive customer transformation.
* Provide data-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.
* Deep, demonstrated AI First experience in a senior or strategic customer-facing role, with hands-on use of Salesforce Einstein, Agentforce, or equivalent AI-powered success platforms
* Ability to synthesize AI-generated insights into executive-ready narratives and strategic recommendations, demonstrating strong business and commercial acumen
* Experience defining or contributing to AI usage frameworks, governance policies, or AI fluency enablement programs within a CS or professional services organization
* Strong consultative skills with the ability to guide enterprise customers on leveraging Salesforce AI capabilities to achieve their own business outcomes and ROI

**Key Responsibilities**
As an Industry Success Architect, you will specialize in multiple Industry Clouds with primary, secondary, and tertiary areas of expertise. You will:
  
  
**Required Multi-Cloud Aptitude**
We are looking for individuals with expertise spanning multiple Industry Clouds (Primary, Secondary, and Tertiary) from the following list. Prioritization of these clouds is geographically diverse, but we are primarily seeking skills in:
  
  
Life Sciences Cloud
  
  
Public Sector
  
  
Financial Services Cloud
  
  
Revenue Cloud & Billing
  
  
Manufacturing Cloud
  
  
Automotive Cloud
  
  
Education Cloud
  
  
Net Zero Cloud
  
  
Non-Profit

**Desired Technical Skills**
Secure & Scalable Architecture: Expertise in role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets, and security configurations. Proven ability to design scalable, high-performance architectures aligned with Salesforce best practices, including Large Data Volume (LDV) considerations.
  
  
Salesforce Development: Hands-on experience with APEX programming, JavaScript, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC). Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.
  
  
Data Management & Integration: Proficient in designing and managing data models, validation rules, and data governance best practices. Experience with data import/export, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs and middleware (e.g., MuleSoft).

OmniStudio Knowledge: Experience with OmniStudio components is required.
  
  
DevOps (Core + Industry): Strong understanding of software development and delivery process, assessing architecture environments and requirements in order to implement management solutions.
  
  
**Certifications**

Highly Desired: Certified Architect Credentials (Application and System Architect), Platform App Builder, Salesforce Advanced Admin and an Accredited Professional credential in at least one Industry Cloud specialization (e.g., Financial Services Cloud, Health Cloud, or Public Sector Solutions).

title: Brand Account Manager
description:
**ABOUT THE STUDIO**

Cream Soda Social is a storytelling-led creative studio in Hyderabad, working with premium hospitality, fashion and F&B brands.

**THE ROLE**

Brands arrive with a story. Clients arrive with opinions. Somewhere in between, a shoot needs a location, a designer needs a brief and a post goes live at 7 pm. The Brand Account Manager holds all of it together.

Reporting directly to the founder, the Brand Account Manager leads client relationships, content strategy and the team’s day-to-day work, and knows each brand almost as well as the client does.

**A TYPICAL WEEK**

Monday sets the plan. Tuesday brings a client call and a moodboard for the next shoot. Midweek, the designer’s work is reviewed against the brief and returned sharper. By Saturday, a post the Brand Account Manager shaped is approved by the client in the first round, which in this industry is the highest praise there is.

**WHAT THE ROLE OWNS**

* Clients: the main point of contact for 3–4 brands, understanding what each one needs before they ask
* Strategy: building the content direction for each brand and knowing what to post, what to skip and why
* Creative direction: shaping how each brand looks, sounds and feels across content, campaigns and shoots
* Shoots: bringing them to life, from the first idea to the final frame
* The creative team: leading designers, photographers and videographers, and making sure the work that reaches a client is ready
* Delivery: keeping calendars, timelines and people moving in step
* The studio’s standard: guarding it in everything that leaves the studio

**THE IDEAL PROFILE**

* 2–4 years in account management, social media or brand servicing, ideally at an agency or studio. Candidates with fewer years and proven leadership are welcome.
* A strategic mind with real taste for content, who knows what works, what is overdone and what is about to be
* Chronically online, in the most professional sense: fluent in trends, culture and the conversations brands should be part of
* Opinionated, in the useful way: has a point of view, defends it and can say “not quite” to a client’s idea and be thanked for it
* A natural leader who earns the trust of clients and creatives alike
* Ownership and accountability as a default setting
* Highly organised, with the discipline to keep several clients and deadlines on track
* A clear communicator, in writing and in conversation
* Real shoot experience, with a story about the location that fell through or the light that vanished
* Fluent in Notion, Google Sheets, Excel and Canva

**THE HONEST BIT**

The role is demanding and rewarding in equal measure. It comes with real ownership, direct access to the founder and a seat in the room where creative decisions are made. The work approved here carries the Brand Account Manager’s name, and so does the credit when it lands.

**THINGS TO KNOW**

* Strictly based in Hyderabad
* Hybrid, Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 7 pm
* 6-month probation

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send a CV, a portfolio or LinkedIn link, and a short note (about 100 words) on your story. What drew you to creative work, and what keeps you in it? Tell us what shaped you and what you hope to build. Shortlisted candidates complete a screening exercise, followed by interviews. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and close on 24 December 2026.

title: Head of Product Deployment Engineering
description:

* 10 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* 3 years of experience in people management.
* Experience in either system design or reading code (e.g., Java, C++, Python).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or Applied Science, or a related field.
* 15 years of experience managing projects and working with analytics, software coding, or customer-side web technologies.
* Experience building and maintaining internal and external stakeholder networks, with a track record of navigating complex corporate structures to deliver against strategic plans.
* Knowledge of the online advertising/customer growth role and familiarity with the ad serving industry and internet technologies.
* Ability to navigate highly ambiguous situations, solve complex technical or business problems, and scale solutions.

**About The Job**
As the Product Deployment Engineering (PDE) Manager, you will be the strategic leader and primary link between gTech Ads, Google Customer Solutions (GCS) regional leadership, and PSA. You will unify these functions to graduate customers along the product adoption maturity curve. A critical mandate involves liaising with GCS PSA Leaders, Global Product Leads, and the Ads Solutions Engineering CoE to deploy excellent implementations. Your team will critically assesses customer needs to drive advanced product adoption.
  
  
You will serve as a product advocate for gTech Ads for complex technical product deployment. This role balances the operational management of a specialized technical team with the execution of high-impact, regional media and product business strategies.
  
  
Operationally, you will guide a high-performing team of Product Deployment Engineers (PDEs) through complex technical projects and advanced implementations. Strategically, you will act as the principal advisor to gTech Ads GCS, owning the complex implementation strategy across the region. You will partner with implementation program managers, PSA leads, and regional sales directors to accelerate product adoption.
  
  
You will act as a trusted advisor to align technical service delivery with media activation opportunities, balancing engineering support with sales targets and partner with global/regional product leaders and technical program managers to align resource allocation with market-specific goals, guide vendor execution, and provide technical mentorship to engineers. title: Senior Director, Customer Success
description:
**About Us:**
Seismic is the Go-To-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
  
  
**Overview:**
Seismic is seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Director, Customer Success – India to lead and scale our Customer Success Management organization in Hyderabad.
  
  
This senior leadership role will be responsible for building a high-performing Customer Success organization focused on delivering measurable customer outcomes, maximizing product adoption, strengthening customer relationships, and driving revenue retention and expansion opportunities across our global customer base.
  
  
The Senior Director will lead a team of Customer Success Managers through people managers, establishing a scalable operating model that enables consistent delivery of customer value, proactive risk management, and strong execution across Commercial/Mid-Market customer portfolios.
  
  
As a key member of the India Go-To-Market leadership team, this individual will partner closely with global Customer Success leadership, Renewals, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers realize the full business value of Seismic's solutions.
  
  
This role requires a leader who combines strategic thinking, commercial acumen, customer-centricity, and operational excellence with a demonstrated ability to build organizations, develop leaders, and influence stakeholders across geographies
  
  
**Who you are:**

* 18+ years of progressive experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Professional Services, Consulting, or related customer-facing functions within enterprise technology or SaaS organizations.
* Significant leadership experience managing Customer Success organizations, including direct management and development of people managers.
* Proven track record of leading large or complex customer portfolios with accountability for customer outcomes, revenue retention, and customer engagement.
* Strong understanding of enterprise SaaS business models, customer lifecycle management, recurring revenue, and customer retention and expansion strategies.
* Demonstrated ability to build and scale customer-facing teams, establish effective operating models, and lead organizational transformation.
* Experience partnering with global business leaders and managing teams supporting customers across multiple geographies.
* Strong commercial and business acumen, with the ability to connect customer success strategies to revenue protection, growth opportunities, and measurable customer value.
* Experience using customer health metrics, product analytics, and performance dashboards to inform strategic decisions.
* Exceptional executive communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to engage senior business leaders and customer executives.
* Strong ability to navigate ambiguity, lead change, manage competing priorities, and create organizational clarity in a dynamic business environment.
* Demonstrated success developing leaders, building high-performing teams, and fostering a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading Customer Success functions within a global enterprise SaaS, sales enablement, revenue enablement, or customer experience technology organization.
* Previous experience scaling an India-based Customer Success organization supporting North American and International customers.
* Experience managing from enterprise to commercial customer portfolios with complex, multi-stakeholder engagements.
* Familiarity with Customer Success platforms, CRM systems, customer health analytics, and adoption measurement frameworks.
* Experience leading operational transformation, process standardization, and automation initiatives within a Customer Success organization.
* Strong understanding of commercial partnerships between Customer Success, Account Management, Renewals, and Professional Services functions.

**Leadership Attributes**
The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
  
  

* Strategic Orientation: Connects Customer Success investments and execution with broader business objectives.
* Customer & Commercial Acumen: Balances customer value realization with revenue retention and sustainable growth.
* Enterprise Leadership: Operates effectively across functions, geographies, and organizational boundaries.
* Talent Builder: Develops strong people leaders and creates scalable organizational capability.
* Execution Excellence: Translates strategy into clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and consistent delivery.
* Change Leadership: Thrives in ambiguity and leads teams effectively through growth, integration, and transformation.

**What you’ll be doing:**
**Customer Success Strategy & Business Leadership**

* Lead the Customer Success Management portfolio in India, translating global Customer Success priorities into an actionable operating strategy that delivers measurable customer and business outcomes.
* Develop and execute strategies to improve customer retention, product adoption, customer satisfaction, account health, and long-term customer value.
* Drive consistent execution of Customer Success programs and engagement models across enterprise and strategic customer segments.
* Partner with global Customer Success leadership to define operating priorities, performance expectations, resource allocation, and organizational capabilities.
* Establish India as a strategic and integrated extension of the global Customer Success organization, ensuring strong alignment, accountability, and collaboration across regions.

**Revenue Retention, Customer Value & Growth**

* Drive execution against key Customer Success performance indicators, including Net Revenue Retention (NRR), Gross Revenue Retention (GRR), Renewal Rate (RR), customer health, adoption, and risk mitigation.
* Provide leadership oversight of customer portfolios, ensuring teams proactively identify and address risks to customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term relationships.
* Establish a data-driven approach to monitoring customer engagement, product adoption, customer sentiment, and business outcomes.
* Partner closely with Account Executives and Renewal Management leadership to develop retention strategies, identify expansion opportunities, and strengthen account-level execution.
* Ensure delivery of high-quality Mutual Value Plans, Success Plans, Solution Health Reviews, and Strategic Business Reviews that demonstrate measurable business impact and return on investment.
* Strengthen executive engagement and multi-level stakeholder relationships across customer organizations, including Sales, Marketing, Enablement, Operations, Finance, and IT.

**Organization Building & People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop four Customer Success Managers (people leaders), building a strong leadership bench and fostering a culture of accountability, customer obsession, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Build a scalable Customer Success organization by establishing clear roles, responsibilities, management practices, performance standards, and career development frameworks.
* Drive workforce planning, talent acquisition, onboarding, capability development, and succession planning to support current and future business needs.
* Establish consistent coaching and performance management mechanisms that strengthen customer engagement, strategic account management, commercial judgment, and execution excellence.
* Develop a high-performance culture grounded in ownership, cross-functional partnership, operational discipline, and measurable customer outcomes.

**Operational Excellence & Portfolio Governance**

* Establish and continuously improve Customer Success operating rhythms, governance mechanisms, account review processes, and performance reporting.
* Drive consistent application of customer segmentation, account health frameworks, risk assessment, escalation management, and proactive engagement strategies.
* Leverage customer usage analytics, health scores, sentiment indicators, and performance dashboards to identify trends and drive informed decisions.
* Ensure effective portfolio management, capacity planning, resource utilization, and prioritization across the Customer Success organization.
* Identify opportunities to improve productivity, simplify processes, introduce automation, and scale best practices across teams.
* Provide clear executive-level reporting on customer portfolio performance, emerging risks, operational priorities, and business outcomes.

**Global Stakeholder Partnership & Executive Engagement**

* Serve as a strategic partner to global Customer Success leadership and cross-functional executives, ensuring alignment on customer priorities and business outcomes.
* Collaborate with Sales, Renewal Management, Professional Services, Technical Account Management, Product, Engineering, and Support to resolve complex customer challenges.
* Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders internally and within strategic customer accounts.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives focused on improving customer experience, retention, product adoption, and expansion readiness.
* Represent the India Customer Success organization in global business reviews, strategic planning discussions, and leadership forums.
* Navigate complex organizational environments while driving alignment, accountability, and effective decision-making across geographically distributed teams.

**Key Performance Indicators & Deliverables**
Success in this role will be measured through:
  
  

* Revenue Retention: NRR, GRR, RR and performance against customer retention objectives.
* Customer Health & Value: Product adoption, customer engagement, value realization, and account health improvements.
* Risk Management: Early identification, mitigation, and resolution of customer risks.
* Customer Success Execution: Quality and consistency of Success Plans, Strategic Business Reviews, and customer engagement programs.
* Operational Excellence: Portfolio coverage, team productivity, process effectiveness, and forecast accuracy.
* Organizational Effectiveness: Leadership development, team performance, talent retention, and capability building.
* Global Collaboration: Effective cross-functional alignment and execution against shared customer and business priorities.

**What we have for you:**

ROLE SUMMARY

The International Purchase Executive will source FMCG, confectionery and food products from overseas suppliers, negotiate the best prices and terms, and make sure goods are procured on time with the right shelf life to fulfil export orders.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

- Identify, evaluate and onboard suppliers, distributors and brand-authorised stockists in India and overseas (Indonesia, Vietnam, Malaysia, China and others).

- Request and compare quotations, and negotiate prices, MOQs, payment terms and delivery timelines.

- Prepare and issue purchase orders, and follow up until goods are delivered and received.

- Check product details before purchase: MFD and expiry dates, remaining shelf life, pack sizes, labelling and batch details.

- Coordinate with the Sales team on customer requirements, product availability and price lists.

- Work with the Logistics team on pickups, container loading, Incoterms (EXW, FOB, CIF) and shipment schedules.

- Collect and verify purchase documents: proforma invoices, commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin and quality/FSSAI-related certificates.

- Coordinate supplier payments (TT / advance / LC) with the Accounts team and track outstanding payments.

- Maintain supplier database, price records, purchase registers and stock tracking in Excel or ERP.

- Track market prices, new product launches, promotions and stock availability, and report opportunities to management.

- Resolve supplier issues such as short supply, damaged goods, price differences or delays.

- Achieve monthly purchase targets and contribute to margin improvement.

REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

- Graduate in any discipline; MBA or diploma in International Business, Supply Chain or Foreign Trade is preferred.

- Good knowledge of import/export purchase processes, Incoterms and international payment terms.

- Strong negotiation and supplier relationship skills.

- Excellent written and spoken English for email and calls with overseas suppliers.

- Good working knowledge of MS Excel (VLOOKUP, pivot tables) and email communication.

- Understanding of FMCG products, shelf life and expiry management.

- Ability to handle multiple suppliers and orders under tight timelines.

PREFERRED

- Experience in FMCG, confectionery or food trading companies.

- Existing network of FMCG distributors or brand stockists.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive salary.

- Exposure to global FMCG brands and international markets.

- Growth opportunities in a fast-growing export company.

The Senior Marketing Manager, Brand Marketing Integration for the Lifecycle Value Lab will serve as the senior Amgen India (AIN) marketing leader for the Lifecycle Value Lab (LVL) Advance pillar of brands, supporting LUMAKRAS, VECTIBIX, and Nplate.

  
  

Reporting to the U.S. Executive Director, Brand Lead, this individual will lead a team of AIN-based marketers and partner closely with U.S. brand teams to translate commercial strategies into effective marketing plans and execution. Within the LVL construct, these brands have additional lifecycle management opportunities to be advanced through new indications, evidence generation, sales force engagement, and omnichannel experimentation, which will be key levers and deliverables of success.

  
  

This role is accountable for integrating AIN-based marketers into the broader LVL organization, leading marketing execution across the Advance brands portfolio, and ensuring the team delivers against brand priorities and business objectives. The individual will oversee a team of 4–5 marketing professionals, establish clear priorities and accountabilities, and serve as a key connection between U.S. brand leadership and AIN-based teams.

  
  

As LVL evolves its operating model, this leader will help establish a fully integrated marketing organization across the U.S. and India, where AIN marketers own meaningful portions of brand plans, contribute to strategic discussions, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Brand leadership and integration**

* Serve as the primary AIN marketing leader for the LVL Advance brand marketing pillar, partnering closely with U.S. Brand Leads and cross-functional stakeholders across LUMAKRAS, VECTIBIX, and Nplate.
* Develop a strong understanding of brand strategies, customer needs, competitive dynamics, and commercial priorities to ensure effective execution across the portfolio.
* Translate brand strategies into clear marketing priorities and executable plans for AIN-based marketers.
* Ensure AIN marketers are fully integrated into U.S. brand teams, participating in brand planning, performance reviews, agency discussions, and key business decisions.
* Provide marketing leadership and sound business judgment to help teams evaluate opportunities, make recommendations, and address execution challenges.
* Maintain strong connectivity between U.S. and AIN teams, ensuring alignment on business priorities, performance expectations, and evolving needs.

**Marketing execution and business performance**

* Lead and oversee the execution of marketing initiatives across the Advance portfolio, ensuring alignment with brand objectives and customer priorities.
* Establish clear ownership and accountability for defined portions of brand and tactical plans across AIN-based marketers.
* Partner with U.S. brand teams to identify opportunities to strengthen marketing effectiveness, improve customer engagement, and optimize brand performance.
* Guide the team in leveraging customer insights, market research, and performance analytics to inform marketing recommendations and decisions.
* Support LVL's test-and-learn approach by identifying opportunities for marketing experimentation, evaluating results, and applying learnings across brands.
* Manage priorities, resources, and competing business needs across the portfolio, ensuring high-quality and timely execution.
* Identify opportunities to simplify marketing processes, leverage shared capabilities, and improve efficiency across brands.

**People leadership and organizational development**

* Lead, coach, and develop AIN-based marketing professionals, fostering strong marketing capabilities, business acumen, and accountability for results.
* Establish clear performance expectations, development priorities, and individual ownership of marketing responsibilities.
* Build a high-performing team capable of operating with increasing independence, exercising sound judgment, and delivering meaningful business outcomes.
* Foster strong collaboration, trust, and shared accountability between U.S. and AIN-based marketers.
* Partner with LVL leadership to evolve roles, responsibilities, and ways of working as the AIN marketing organization matures.
* Champion a One LVL culture that encourages collaboration, continuous improvement, innovation, and a shared commitment to serving patients.
