title: General Manager, Pre-Sales
description:
Job Description:

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**General Manager – Pre-Sales, Academic & Education Market**

**Reports to**

Sales Head, India & MEA

**Business**

Schneider Electric · Education Equipment and Services

**Location**

India, with 25–50% travel depending on territory

**Scope**

Leads technical engagement, solution positioning and pre-sales support for universities, technical institutes and government education departments

About the Role

As the Pre-Sales Manager, you will partner with universities, technical academic institutes, and government education departments to understand their technical and business challenges. You will use these insights to articulate a compelling vision of how Schneider Electric can help address their education and training priorities.

Customer conversations will span energy management, industrial automation, smart buildings, motion control, and Industry 4.0. You will demonstrate the benefits of teaching and learning through industry-relevant content, show how Schneider Electric technologies are used in industry, and communicate the value of the Education portfolio in curriculum adoption, learning journeys, and hands-on experiential learning.

This role serves as the primary technical point of contact for universities and technical academic institutes across India. You will empower researchers, educators, and institutional leaders to solve technical and business challenges by combining deep engineering knowledge, consultative engagement, and effective solution positioning.

What You Will Do

Territory Planning & Strategy

Collaborate with sales colleagues to conduct data-driven account assessments and determine overall account health. Develop technical engagement plans, including webinars, technical discussions, demonstrations, workshops, and other interventions that help progress opportunities toward closure.

Execute Technical Engagement Plans

Travel to universities, institutes, and government education departments to advocate Schneider Electric technologies across the student learning journey, including curriculum and coursework, hands-on practical learning, competitions, projects, and other high-impact student activities. Prepare and deliver presentations, demonstrations, and application examples.

Create a Vision Beyond the Curriculum

Identify priority research projects and groups that can benefit from Schneider Electric technologies. Understand their goals and constraints, then apply product knowledge and industry experience to recommend relevant architectures, applications, and solutions.

Cultivate Champions

Build trusted relationships with leading faculty members, academicians, researchers, and institutional influencers. Enable them to advocate Schneider Electric technologies on campus and across the broader education community.

Be Resourceful

Mobilise operations, application engineering, product specialists, and other internal teams for key activities and specialised product areas, ensuring the successful technical progression of each opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

* Own and lead the pre-sales function for the Education market, including RFP and RFI response strategy, solution design, technical compliance, demonstrations, and engagement strategies for professors, researchers, and students.
* Present, explain, and defend technical solutions directly to academic and education customers, procurement teams, evaluation committees, government stakeholders, and other decision-makers associated with the opportunity.
* Convert customer needs into technically sound and commercially viable solution architectures, bills of materials, compliance statements, demonstration plans, and value propositions.
* Maintain disciplined technical opportunity management, including discovery records, solution assumptions, risks, dependencies, competitor positioning, and agreed next actions.

Key Competencies

* Deep knowledge of industrial automation, energy management, and cyber-physical systems.
* Strong understanding of motion control, variable frequency drives, industrial networks, connectivity, control architectures, and system performance.
* Strong customer focus, supported by excellent listening, discovery, and communication skills.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Understanding of the Academic and Education market, including key influencers, decision-makers, procurement stakeholders, faculty members, researchers, nodal officers, and channel partners.
* Ability to translate academic requirements into application-oriented learning solutions, technical specifications, and demonstrable outcomes.

Qualifications

* Minimum 15 years of experience in industrial automation design, engineering problem-solving, application engineering, or pre-sales activities.
* Experience in technical engineering, application design or validation, techno-commercial activities, demonstrations, and technical training.
* BE, BTech, or MTech in Electrical Engineering.
* Strong relationship-building, communication, presentation, facilitation, and negotiation skills.
* Willingness to travel frequently, typically 25–50%, depending on the assigned territory and opportunity portfolio.

Key Metrics for Success

**Measure**

**Definition**

**Technical opportunity conversion**

Progression of qualified opportunities from discovery and solution design through technical acceptance and commercial closure.

**Solution quality**

Accuracy, completeness, compliance, competitiveness, and commercial viability of proposed technical solutions.

**Customer engagement**

Quality and frequency of technical discussions, workshops, demonstrations, webinars, and institutional engagements.

**Curriculum adoption**

Adoption of Schneider Electric technologies, content, and practical applications within curricula, laboratories, projects, and student activities.

**RFP/ Prequalification effectiveness**

Quality, timeliness, compliance, and win contribution of technical responses, specifications, and supporting documentation.

**Academic advocacy**

Number and strength of faculty champions, research engagements, references, demonstrations, and reusable application success stories.

title: Sea Import Customer Service Executive
description:
Job Description – Sea Import Customer Service Executive

**Position:** Sea Import – Customer Service Executive  
**Department:** Import Operations  
**Experience:** 1.5 to 2 Years  
**Industry:** Logistics / Freight Forwarding  
**Location:** Andheri – Marol, Mumbai

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Sea Import Customer Service Executive to manage end-to-end import shipment activities. The candidate will be responsible for handling import documentation, IGM filing, billing, customer coordination and communication with shipping lines, overseas agents and CHA.

The ideal candidate should have practical experience in Sea Import Operations, particularly in IGM filing and billing.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Sea Import Operations & Customer Coordination**

* Handle day-to-day Sea Import activities and customer service operations.
* Coordinate with international agents for nominated cargo execution.
* Communicate with customers regarding vessel schedules and shipment updates.
* Track and monitor shipments from departure until arrival at the destination port.
* Coordinate with shipping lines, airlines, customers and internal teams.
* Handle customer queries and ensure timely shipment updates.

**2. Import Documentation & IGM Filing**

* Collect and verify draft shipping documents received from customers.
* Prepare and finalize Bill of Lading (BL) documentation.
* Handle Shipping Instructions (SI), House Bill of Lading (HBL) and Master Bill of Lading (MBL) finalization.
* Coordinate MBL surrender formalities.
* Ensure timely IGM (Import General Manifest) filing before cargo arrival.
* Prepare and send Cargo Arrival Notices (CAN) to customers.
* Maintain accurate import shipment documentation.

**3. Shipping Line & CHA Coordination**

* Coordinate with shipping lines and overseas agents for import shipments.
* Follow up with CHA regarding upcoming shipments and customs clearance activities.
* Prepare freight certificates and submit them to CHA.
* Monitor and follow up on shipment clearance and delivery activities.

**4. Billing & Import Accounts**

* Handle the complete billing cycle for import shipments.
* Prepare customer invoices and coordinate billing-related activities.
* Maintain fund planning for import shipments.
* Ensure timely billing and proper documentation of shipment expenses.

**5. Rate Procurement & Sales Support**

* Obtain competitive freight rates from overseas agents and shipping lines.
* Handle rate inquiries for FCL, LCL and Air shipments.
* Provide timely rate quotations and operational support to the sales team.
* Coordinate with international agents to meet customer rate requirements.

**6. System Updates & Job Closure**

* Handle shipment booking and dispatch coordination.
* Update shipment details and activities in the company system.
* Maintain proper records of import shipments.
* Ensure timely job closure in the system.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline (preferred).
* 1.5 to 2 years of experience in Sea Import Operations / Freight Forwarding.
* Hands-on experience in **IGM Filing and Billing is mandatory**.
* Good knowledge of Sea Import documentation and procedures.
* Understanding of FCL, LCL and Air Freight operations.
* Knowledge of SI, HBL, MBL, BL and CAN documentation.
* Experience coordinating with shipping lines, overseas agents, customers and CHA.
* Good communication, coordination and follow-up skills.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel and MS Office.

Ideal Candidate Profile

* Candidates currently working in a Freight Forwarding or Logistics company will be preferred.
* Should have practical knowledge of Sea Import documentation and operations.
* Must be capable of handling billing and IGM filing independently.
* Should be detail-oriented and able to manage multiple shipments efficiently.

**Key Requirement:** Hands-on experience in both Sea Import Billing and IGM Filing is essential.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

As financial industry experts at the center of markets and technology, we help our clients efficiently scale their business and quickly access markets. We are a global company headquartered in New York, with offices in Chicago, London, Singapore, Hong Kong and Tokyo.

Pico is seeking a **Business Development Manager – India** to join our APAC sales organisation. Based in **Mumbai**, this role will focus on growing Pico's presence in India and will be responsible for selling **Corvil**, **Pico Market Services** and **Redline** to Indian clients trading locally and internationally.

  

The successful candidate will combine direct sales execution, relationship-led business development and local market-building. In addition to developing new sales opportunities in India, the role will support existing global clients with Indian operations, strengthen exchange relationships, build reseller and partner channels, represent Pico at conferences and client events, and feed back market intelligence to help shape Pico's regional strategy.

  

This position reports into the **APAC sales organisation** and will require close collaboration with sales leadership, product, sales engineering, marketing and customer success teams.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage a balanced mix of relationship-led business development and direct sales activity, from early engagement through to commercial close.

* Strengthen relationships with Indian exchanges, market infrastructure providers and key industry stakeholders to support Pico's local market presence and long-term growth.
* Build local reseller, channel and partner relationships that can expand Pico's reach, support local execution and create additional routes to market.
* Support existing global Pico clients with operations, trading activity or strategic interests in India, ensuring local engagement is coordinated with global account teams.
* Develop executive-level relationships and deliver presentations to senior stakeholders across technology, trading, operations, market data and business leadership.
* Feed back local market intelligence, client requirements, competitive insight and exchange developments to APAC sales leadership, product, sales engineering and customer success teams.
* Support future commercialisation of Pico Market Services and Redline solutions in India and surrounding markets as the product portfolio evolves.
* Represent Pico at industry events, exchange forums, market structure discussions and client meetings.

  

**Required Experience and Skills**

* Strong understanding of the Indian financial services and capital markets ecosystem.
* Existing relationships with exchanges, market infrastructure providers, financial institutions, brokers, trading firms, technology vendors or relevant industry bodies.
* Proven ability to develop new business opportunities and manage complex relationship-led sales cycles.
* Experience selling to or working with technology, trading, market data, infrastructure, operations or regulatory stakeholders.
* Strong commercial judgment with the ability to identify client needs, shape value propositions and close revenue opportunities.
* Ability to understand market trends, regulatory developments and technology challenges affecting the financial services industry.
* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to engage senior executives.
* Self-starter with strong organisational skills, discipline around pipeline management and the ability to operate independently in-market.
* Comfortable working across time zones and collaborating with regional and global teams.

  

**Preferred Experience**

* Familiarity with Corvil, Pico Market Services, Redline or comparable capital markets technology platforms.
* Experience engaging with exchanges, regulators or market infrastructure bodies.
* Knowledge of electronic trading workflows, market data distribution, infrastructure performance, latency monitoring and operational resilience.
* Experience covering India and adjacent regional markets.

  

**Location**

**Job description**
-------------------

**About this role**

**Company Description**

  
  

HPS Investment Partners, a part of BlackRock, is a leading global, credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offers flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. At our core, we share a common thread of intellectual rigor and discipline that enables us to create value for our clients.

  
  
  

The HPS/BlackRock Transaction brings together BlackRock’s corporate and asset owner relationships with HPS’s diversified origination and capital flexibility. BlackRock and HPS have formed a new private financing solutions business unit (“PFS”) led by Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson, creating an integrated franchise with approximately $370 billion in client assets, including $205 billion of private credit assets. This combined platform, which has more than 590 investment professionals and approximately 1,300 employees globally, offers broad capabilities across senior and junior credit solutions, asset-based finance, real estate, CLOs and GP-LP solutions. As part of the HPS/BlackRock Transaction, Scott Kapnick, Scot French, and Michael Patterson have joined BlackRock’s Global Executive Committee, and Scott Kapnick has been appointed as an observer to the BlackRock Board.

  
  

**Department Description**

  
  

The Middle Office team (MO) within Private Financing Solutions (PFS) – Blackrock’s private credit platform – is responsible for ensuring the Fund’s positions and cash balances are accurate. They manage the lifecycle of all trades/investments. They are responsible for trade capture, trade settlement, loan administration, daily cash and position reconciliations, corporate action elections/recordings, audit requests, new mandate onboarding, and PnL break analysis and resolution with fund administrators. MO handles ad-hoc requests that come from the deal team and/or separately managed account clients. The team interacts closely with the Deal Execution, Treasury, Fund Accounting, Fund Finance, Cash Management, Portfolio Analytics, Data Analytics, Valuations and the Deal Teams daily.

**Position Description**

  

PFS is seeking to recruit an Associate to join the Middle Office Operations team based in Mumbai. The individual should be highly organized with strong attention to detail. They should have the ability to meet strict deadlines, as well as work independently and as part of a team. A desire for a fast-paced environment is crucial.

**Responsibilities**

Specific responsibilities will include but not be limited to the following:

* Daily street side cash and position breaks vs. prime brokers & custodians

* Liaise with firm custodians and prime brokers ensuring proper trading activity and settlement

* Daily oversight of loan administration in the firms accounting system to support internal post
* Investigate/help resolve any transactional or accrual discrepancies that may arise

* Provide full trade life cycle operational support for products including but not limited to Bonds,
* Perform performance metric analysis/reporting for the deal team / front office (IRR and MOIC)

* Daily interaction with internal and external groups to troubleshoot any booking and/or position

* undefined

* Manage the corporate action/amendment process from start to finish. Obtain vote from desk,
* Assist with CLO monthly tie outs of all positions & cash with the collateral agent/trustee

* Daily PNL reconciliation to fund administrators

* Assist front office with liquidity management and deal execution with budgeting

* Ensure proper recording/accounting, cashflow reconciliation and settlements of total return
* Maintenance and oversight of leverage facilities within the system; schedules of interest
* Assisting multiple managed service providers when they require support

* Perform Detailed Investment Return reconciliation versus full fund administrator

**Candidate Profile**

  
  

* Graduate with a bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting or business-related field
* 4+ years of experience in financial services industry

* Strong understanding of fixed income or bank loan

* Proficient in excel and outlook

* Knowledge of various operations and accounting related systems. Experience using a Security Master preferred

* Experience of using Indus Valley Partners (IVP) products, FIS VPM accounting system, or Aladdin a plus

* Familiarity with S&P ClearPar & Loan Platforms a plus

**Location**

* Mumbai, India

**Employment Type**

* Full-time, Exempt
  

  

**Hybrid Work Schedule**

* 4/1 split (M-Th in office, Friday optional work from home)
  

  
  

**Our benefits**
  
  
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

**Our hybrid work model**

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.

  

**Guidance on AI use for candidates**

  

At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided **guidance** (opens in new window) on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.

  

**About BlackRock**

  
  

At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.

  
  

This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.

  
  

To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com (opens in new window). We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn (opens in new window), Instagram (opens in new window), YouTube (opens in new window), X (opens in new window), and TikTok (opens in new window).

With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

We are looking for a **Senior Analyst, Credit & Collections** to support our Team in **Mumbai, India**

### **What You’ll Do :**

* Own the end-to-end credit and collections cycle for an assigned portfolio of agencies and advertisers across APAC, keeping overdue balances low and improving DSO
* Run daily and weekly follow-ups on overdue invoices via email, calls and client meetings, using a clear escalation ladder (reminder, intimation, suspension notice, demand letter, legal or agency handover)
* Secure and track Promises to Pay (PTPs) and follow up the next day on any broken PTP
* Drive down the 90+ ageing bucket and act on items approaching 360 days before they reach full ECL provisioning
* Chase unapplied cash with Finance so payments are applied within 14 days, and issue Statements of Account, dunning and suspension notices in line with the Group Collections Policy
* Log, classify and resolve disputes with Sales, Billing and Operations within 7 days (or escalate), and fix the root causes of recurring billing, PO and invoice-dispatch issues
* Monitor credit limit utilisation and exposure, initiate credit limit reviews in Salesforce, flag high-risk accounts early, and support sign-off on Insertion Orders and new client onboarding
* Contribute to the ECL review by identifying PDD cases, long-outstanding items and likely write-offs
* Join weekly AR calls with Sales and country heads, share AR and suspension lists a day ahead, and send same-day minutes with action owners and dates; escalate unresolved cases to the Senior Risk Manager and regional leadership
* Build strong relationships with key clients through regular touchpoints and, where possible, in-person visits
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports on ageing, DSO, 90+, disputes, PTPs and collection targets using BigQuery, SAP and Salesforce data
* Help standardise and automate routine follow-ups, templates and reporting (n8n, Google Workspace, Claude), and keep SAP, Salesforce and trackers clean and audit-ready
* Act as a go-to person for junior analysts and support policy, SOP and collector-journey improvements

### **What You'll Need For This Role :**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or a related field (ACCA, CMA or a credit certification is a plus)
* 4–7 years in credit control, collections or accounts receivable, ideally in a multinational, media, advertising, digital or services environment
* Experience managing a multi-country, multi-currency AR portfolio, with exposure to APAC markets preferred
* Strong AR and ageing analysis skills, with working knowledge of ECL/provisioning, credit limits and payment terms
* Hands-on SAP (FBL5N, ageing, payment blocks) and Salesforce experience; advanced Excel/Google Sheets; SQL or BigQuery is a plus

title: Relationship Manager - Private Banking
description:
**Essential Services : Role & Location fungibility**

At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as
**One Bank, One Team**
. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be
**role and location-fungible**
with the understanding that
**Banking is an essential service**
. The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

**About the role**

As a Relationship Manager in Private Banking Group, you would act as a core anchor in taking our banking solutions and services to our valuable customers comprising of High Net worth Individuals, Family Offices and Institutions. This involves a 360-degree banking approach. The Relationship Managers should have an inclination to understand the customer needs and offer solutions in line with the needs that comprises of various asset classes and investment propositions. The core philosophy to hold is being “Fair to the Customer and Fair to the Bank”. At ICICI Bank, our customer-centric relationship managers are responsible for acquiring new customer relationships and increasing the wallet share of existing customer relationships with a resolute focus on service quality and customer delight. They collaborate and work with different internal teams, thereby offering the best in class customer service. In line with our philosophy of taking the entire bank to the customers, our relationship managers work on the whole suite of offerings like investment solutions covering equities, commodities, Mutual Funds, Insurance product amongst others. As a Relationship Manager, the focus is on ensuring the needs of the customers are covered through the customer-360 degree approach without any particular allegiance to product or domain.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Service:**
Create service excellence by partnering with customers through their life cycle and offering suitable products and services based on their financial needs while being fair to the customer and fair to the bank in all engagements.

**Business Development:**
Ensuring a growth in wallet share of existing customers and on boarding new customers by offering 360-degree banking solutions that meet the needs of our customers.

**Champion 360-degree banking:**
Offer products based on customer needs in collaboration with other internal teams in the bank for suitable product offerings.

**Enhance the portfolio quality:**
Work towards enhancing customer portfolio within the philosophy of Fair to Bank, Fair to Customer.

**Customised solutions:**
As per branch guidelines. Upkeep and maintaining of the branch. Ensure availability of necessary infrastructure in the branch.

**Behold our values:**
Offer products that are fair to our customers and fair to the bank.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Educational Qualification:**
MBA/PGDM with 2 years of experience/Graduates with 6 years in the area of relationship management, Business development or allied roles.

**Synergize with Team:**
Willingness to work with various teams for on-ground support and deliver enablers as required.

**Improvise:**
Develop and implement overarching sales and customer relationship strategy, sales processes and structure.

**Market Sensing:**
Monitor and evaluate industry trends, customer drivers and potential partnerships

**Communication:**
Good oral and written communication skills.

**About the Business group**

ICICI Bank’s Private Banking Group (PBG) offers comprehensive investment solutions and services to high net worth individuals and Family offices across India and international geographies. We emphasize on our high quality investment management services along with leading banking and allied group capabilities.

Fulfilling the investment needs and aspirations of our clients is our constant endeavour. After extensive in-house research, the group’s handpicked product offerings help our customers achieve their goals. With the team of experts, group reviews various assets classes along with market and economic conditions to produce incisive insights. These house views, along with rigorous due diligence, help our team of Relationship Managers to suggest a range of products across asset classes. As the financial goals are unique, group creates a tailor-made investment strategy according to the needs of the customers. This is done based on a thorough understanding of financial needs and keeping customers’ investment attitude in mind. The group also offers advisory on Trust Services and Succession Planning. Family Office proposition aims to strengthen the governance structure in family owned businesses.

Thus, emphasis is on a holistic approach towards financial and business goals. The strategic collaboration with global product providers enables us to construct unique solutions. It allows us to complement our core competencies with world class, third party capabilities to deliver solutions to customer's specific needs.

* Value selling: building business cases around ROI, time saved and risk reduced, not features.

title: Manager, Security Operations Centre
description:
Edwards Lifesciences is expanding its global technology capabilities with the launch of a new IT Innovation Hub in Pune, India. The Hub strengthens the technology foundation that supports our business worldwide, working in close partnership with teams across regions to deliver reliable, high-quality solutions at scale.

  

Designed as a long-term investment, the Pune Hub will advance newer digital capabilities such as automation, data, AI, and cloud, and will include roles spanning end user services, application development, and enterprise platform teams.

  

**How you’ll make an impact:**

* Lead, mentor and grow the Security Operations Center (SOC) team, including hiring, shift scheduling, training, performance management and career development.
* Oversee daily alert triage, investigation and escalation across endpoint, identity, email, cloud and network, so cases are handled accurately and within SLA.
* Partner with Security Engineering on detection content: share feedback on false positives, request new use cases based on what analysts see, and identify gaps in log source coverage.
* Help prioritize and validate new data source onboarding into the SIEM so that analysts get usable, high-quality telemetry.
* Build and maintain playbooks, runbooks and escalation procedures, and find candidates for SOAR automation.
* Run the SOC's threat-hunting operations, including scheduled and intelligence-driven hunts based on current threats relevant to our industry.
* Coordinate SOC participation in purple-team exercises and assess analyst detection, triage and response performance.
* Turn hunt and exercise results into playbook updates, analyst training, and documented coverage gaps for Engineering.
* Define and report SOC metrics (alert volume, MTTA/MTTR, SLA adherence, escalation quality, DLP trends) to security leadership.
* Run quality reviews, tabletop exercises and ongoing training to raise analyst capability.
* Excellent problem-solving, organizational, analytical and critical thinking skills including high discretion/judgment in decision making.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and interpersonal relationship skills including negotiating and relationship management skills with ability to drive achievement of objectives.
* Strict attention to detail.
* Ability to work and excel within a fast paced, dynamic, and constantly changing work environment.
  

**What you’ll need (Required):**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field or equivalent work experience based on Edwards criteria Required.
* 8+ years in cybersecurity, with at least 5+ in SOC operations or incident response.
  

**What else we look for (Preferred):**

* Strong hands-on investigation experience using an enterprise SIEM (e.g., Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps/Chronicle, QRadar) and EDR tools (e.g., CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender).
* Proven ability to build processes, SLAs, metrics and documentation for an operations team.
* Solid understanding of common attack patterns: phishing, credential compromise, malware, lateral movement and data exfiltration, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
* Certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GSOC, CySA+, Security+ or CISSP.
* Experience in regulated industries (medical devices, healthcare, pharma), including HIPAA, GDPR or ISO 27001.
* Experience with SOAR platforms or basic scripting (Python, PowerShell).
Experience working with an MSSP/MDR partner or in a follow-the-sun global SOC.

title: Division Manager - Ocean
description:
Are you ready to lead the charge in shaping a sustainable energy future? At Alfa Laval, we don’t just overcome challenges—we pioneer solutions that create a positive impact for our customers, our people, and the planet. Our curiosity sparks innovation, and our commitment drives us to deliver transformative results every single day.

Join a truly diverse and inclusive team where your leadership will make a real difference. At Alfa Laval, you’ll be empowered to build bridges to the future, delivering sustainable solutions that address the world’s most urgent energy challenges. Together, we’re making the world a better place.

**About Alfa Laval**

Alfa Laval is a leading global provider of products and solutions in heat transfer, separation, and fluid handling, serving customers across the energy, food, water, and Ocean industries. Headquartered in Lund, Sweden, the company operates in more than 100 countries, enabling customers to improve energy efficiency, productivity, and sustainability in industrial processes.

With a heritage of over 140 years, Alfa Laval plays a critical role in supporting the global energy transition, focusing on solutions for energy efficiency, waste heat recovery, decarbonization, and sustainable industrial growth. Sustainability and responsible use of resources are central to the company’s purpose of pioneering positive impact.

**Alfa Laval India**

Alfa Laval has been present in India since 1937 and plays a strategically important role within the group. The India headquarters is located in Pune, with eight manufacturing facilities based at Pune and Satara, and multiple sales and service locations across the country. The Manufacturing facilities supplies key components and systems in Separation, Heat Transfer, and Flow technology. It is also a hub for Centrifugal Separators, Decanters, and Flow equipment delivered to the global markets from here.

The company's products and solutions are omnipresent in over 25 multiple Indian industries including food processing, dairy, edible oil processing, sugar production, pharmaceutical & biotechnology, brewery, distillery, starch, pulp and paper, oil & gas, Ocean and energy. Alfa Laval caters to many national and international clients based across India and neighboring countries like Sri Lanka, Nepal, and Bangladesh.

We are now looking for a for an **Inspirational leader to spearhead our Ocean division in India**, partnering closely with the business leaders and managers. Ocean Division is a strategic pillar of Alfa Laval India, to achieve our growth ambition for the coming years.

Head of Ocean is responsible for driving the overall Ocean business strategy and execution across India and Bangladesh, delivering sustainable growth in Capital Sales and After Sales while strengthening Alfa Laval's market leadership position. The role owns the Ocean business P&L, manages strategic customer relationships, develops high-performing teams, and drives business growth across Naval, Coast Guard, Commercial Ocean, Shipbuilding, Energy & Power, Environmental Solutions, and Service businesses

**Role Description**

You will be a member of AL India Management team, directly reporting to Managing Director, as well as the key representative for India region. Moreover, you will be responsible for leading, developing and securing a high performing team in line with the Alfa Laval culture.

This is your opportunity to be a **transition leader**, accelerating the transition, driving innovation, and positioning Alfa Laval as a **thought leader** in the industry. You will play a pivotal role in transforming our business, preparing us for a digital future, and differentiating Alfa Laval as the partner of choice for sustainable energy solutions.

To help Alfa Laval uphold its promises and foster a thriving service culture, we are seeking a dynamic leader for the role of **Head of Ocean Division** to join our skilled, dedicated, and passionate team.

The ideal candidate will have proven experience in Sales and Aftersales management and lead teams within a fast-paced environment. Success in this role hinges on delivering profitable growth and developing a high-performing team. Moreover, you will be responsible for leading, developing and securing a high performing Divisional team in line with the Alfa Laval culture.

We offer a unique opportunity for you to play a crucial role in transforming our Ocean business, preparing us for a digital future, and positioning us as a key differentiator for Alfa Laval.

**Key elements of the Role involve**

* Develop and execute the Ocean Division strategy, business plans, and growth initiatives aligned with Alfa Laval’s regional and global objectives, ensuring sustainable and profitable business expansion across India.
* Drive order intake, revenue, profitability, and market share growth by identifying and capturing opportunities across Ocean, Naval & Defense, Energy & Power, Environmental Solutions, After Sales, and Service businesses.
* Lead business development and strategic customer engagement with key stakeholders including naval and defense organizations, commercial ship owners and operators, ship management companies, shipyards, EPCs, OEMs, contractors, and global Ocean accounts.
* Establish and strengthen executive-level relationships with strategic customers such as the Indian Navy, Indian Coast Guard, Shipping Corporation of India, Great Eastern Shipping, leading ship management companies, and major regional shipyards to drive long-term business growth and customer loyalty.
* Develop and implement market penetration strategies by conducting comprehensive market, customer, competitor, and industry analysis, translating insights into actionable business plans and growth programs.
* Expand Alfa Laval’s sales footprint by promoting Capital Equipment, Service Agreements, Spare Parts, Retrofits, Upgrades, Lifecycle Services, Compliance Packages, Digital Solutions, Environmental Solutions, and integrated system offerings.
* Lead growth initiatives in shipbuilding, naval modernization programs, commercial shipping, technical management companies, energy and power applications, ballast water treatment solutions, OceanGlide opportunities, and emerging sustainability-driven Ocean technologies.
* Drive the After Sales and Service business by developing strategic service partnerships, increasing recurring revenue through service agreements, compliance services, performance audits, equipment upgrades, spare parts optimization, and lifecycle support solutions.
* Lead the Bangladesh Ocean and Energy & Power business strategy, expanding customer coverage, strengthening market presence, supporting distributor performance, and building a sustainable regional growth platform.
* Own the Ocean Division P&L and ensure achievement of agreed sales, revenue, margin, profitability, and operational targets through effective forecasting, budgeting, resource allocation, and performance management.
* Collaborate closely with local and global business units, leveraging cross-functional synergies and best practices to optimize commercial performance, customer value, and operational efficiency.
* Lead, coach, and develop the Ocean Sales and Service organization, building a high-performance culture focused on customer centricity, accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, talent development, and succession planning.
* Serve as a key member of the Sales Company Leadership Team, contributing to overall business strategy, organizational development, and execution of Alfa Laval’s growth ambitions in the region.

**Strategic Skills & Leadership Profile**

* Bachelor's Degree in Marine, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial or related Engineering discipline. MBA or equivalent business qualification preferred.
* 15+ years of relevant experience in Ocean, Shipping, Shipbuilding, Energy, Industrial Equipment or Engineering industries.
* Minimum 5 years in a senior leadership role with P&L responsibility.
* Strong experience in Capital Sales, Services, Business Development and Key Account Management.
* Proven track record of leading high-performing commercial organizations.
* Strong exposure to Marine markets, Defense, Naval, Shipyard or Energy sectors preferred

**Reporting Relationship:**

This role reports to the Managing Director, Alfa Laval India

**Location:** Pune

title: IT Manager
description:
**About Verto**
===============

At Verto, we're on a mission to democratise global finance and empower businesses in Emerging Markets to reach the world. Founded by British-Nigerian entrepreneurs Ola Oyetayo and Anthony Oduu, our roots in Africa provided a firsthand understanding of the significant challenges businesses face with cross-border payments, ranging from illiquid currencies and high fees to slow transactions. This deep-rooted insight is why Africa remains a core focus, as we're committed to bridging the gap between emerging and developed markets and fostering global economic growth.

What started as an FX solution for the Nigerian Naira has evolved into a market-leading platform, enabling thousands of businesses to seamlessly transfer billions of dollars annually. **We believe that where you do business shouldn’t determine your success or ability to scale.** We're creating equal access to the easy payment and liquidity solutions that are already a given in developed markets.

We're not alone in realising this crucial need; we're backed by world-class investors including Y-Combinator, Quona, and MEVP. With Verto receiving the Milken-Motsepe Prize, appearing on CNBCs list of fastest growing UK companies, the Deloitte Fast 50 and Sifted’s fastest-growing UK tech companies, we are building a seamless cross-border payment future.

Join us as we continue to grow and transform global finance.

**Role Overview**
=================

We are looking for a hands-on, strategic **IT Manager** (based in London or Pune) to own, scale, and secure Verto’s global IT operations across our 200+ employees in 8–9 countries. As a regulated SaaS fintech company, operational speed, seamless employee experience, and strict security are critical to our growth. In this role, you will lead our IT support function, architect automated onboarding and off-boarding workflows, and manage our global hardware fleet and vendor logistics - ensuring that whether a teammate is in our hubs *(London, Pune, Nairobi, Lagos, Cape Town, Dubai, Sliema)* or working remotely *(US, Hong Kong, or wider Africa)*, they have the tools and secure access they need to thrive from Day 1 while keeping our global IT spend lean and audit-ready.

**What You’ll Be Doing:**
=========================

* Lead, mentor, and manage our IT 1st & 2nd Line Support Technician, acting as the senior escalation point for complex Tier 3 technical issues and infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Own global IT support operations via Jira Service Management, setting SLAs, monitoring ticket trends, and continuously improving response times and employee satisfaction.
* Own the end-to-end global hardware lifecycle (procurement, zero-touch deployment, tracking, maintenance, and retrieval) for 200+ employees across multiple countries and time zones.
* Build and manage relationships with international hardware vendors, logistics partners, and couriers to reliably ship and retrieve devices in both regional office hubs and remote-only locations (including the US, Hong Kong, and across Africa).
* Maintain a 100% accurate, real-time global asset register and SaaS license inventory, optimising refresh cycles, vendor contracts, and software utilisation to keep costs efficient.
* Architect and automate global onboarding and off-boarding workflows so user provisioning, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), and hardware delivery happen seamlessly and securely.
* Administer Verto’s core Identity and Access Management (IAM), Mobile Device Management (MDM), and collaboration stack—including JumpCloud, Google Workspace, Slack, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Partner closely with the InfoSec Manager to enforce strict fintech security standards across all macOS and Windows endpoints, including EDR monitoring, disk encryption, patch management, and phishing/incident response.
* Lead regular access reviews, device audits, and asset reconciliations to maintain compliance with financial and data security regulations.
* Stay ahead of industry trends and leverage modern automation and IT tooling to eliminate manual bottlenecks as Verto scales.

**What You Need:**
==================

* 5+ years of experience in IT operations, systems administration, or enterprise IT support, including at least 1–2 years managing direct reports and supporting globally distributed teams.
* Deep hands-on expertise with MDM and IAM platforms (JumpCloud, Jamf, Kandji, Okta, or Intune), including device provisioning and security policy enforcement across both macOS and Windows.
* Proven experience managing global IT asset inventories and cross-border hardware logistics (customs, international shipping, regional vendor procurement, and remote device retrieval).
* Strong administrative command of Google Workspace, Slack, Microsoft Office Suite, and Jira Service Management (or equivalent ticketing platforms).
* Solid grasp of enterprise and fintech cybersecurity fundamentals, including EDR tools, MFA/SSO, RBAC, phishing remediation, and conducting regular security/access audits.
* Strong vendor negotiation and budget management skills, with a demonstrated track record of optimising hardware and SaaS spend without compromising employee productivity.
* Exceptional organisational and communication skills, capable of translating technical issues for non-technical stakeholders across diverse cultural contexts and time zones.

**Note**: We will not be able to progress your application without all the above skills/qualifications

**Best If You Have:**

description:
**Job Description**

**Engineering Manager: II**

**Location: Pune**

**What you will do**

Lead and manage a team of mechanical and design engineers focused on industrial refrigeration products. Oversee the end-to-end product development lifecycle from concept, design, prototyping, testing, to production release. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and marketing to ensure product feasibility and alignment with business goals. Ensure compliance with relevant codes, standards (e.g., ASHRAE, ISO, PED), and safety regulations. Drive continuous improvement in product performance, cost, and reliability. Mentor and develop engineering talent, fostering a high-performance team culture. Support customer-facing teams with technical expertise and customized solutions when needed.

* Lead the mechanical design of industrial refrigeration products, transforming conceptual ideas into practical, manufacturable solutions.

* Prepare comprehensive manufacturing documentation, including fabrication drawings, bills of materials (BOMs), and other supporting documents.
* Ensure timely delivery of engineering documentation to meet internal and external project schedules.

**What we look for**

**Required**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering .
* 14+ years of experience in industrial refrigeration product design, with at least 5 years in a leadership or managerial role.
* Strong knowledge of thermodynamics, heat transfer, and refrigeration cycles.
* Proficiency in CAD tools (e.g., AutoCAD, Creo)
* Experience with product development processes, DFMEA, DVP&R, and stage-gate methodologies.
* Excellent communication, project management, and team leadership skills.

* Prior experience working with global teams and suppliers.

* Shortlist and submit well-formatted profiles with clear screening notes to recruiters within the agreed turnaround time.

* Keep the ATS and tracking sheets accurate and up to date, and report daily sourcing and screening numbers.
* Build and maintain talent pools for recurring skill requirements.

Requirements

* 1–3 years of experience in sourcing and screening for IT or technical roles.
* Working knowledge of technology skills and roles, and the ability to tell similar technologies apart (for example Java vs JavaScript, DevOps vs cloud engineering, data engineer vs data analyst).

* Hands-on experience with Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter or Sales Navigator, and job portals such as Naukri.
* Clear communication on calls and in writing, with a confident, professional manner.
* Ability to handle multiple positions at once and to meet daily and weekly targets.

Nice to Have

Key Performance Indicators

* Number of positions worked on and profiles sourced per day.

* Mastery of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to prioritize tasks, manage multiple complex projects, and meet deadlines with minimal supervision.
* Demonstrated ability to build influential relationships with employees, vendors, and stakeholders.
* Extensive experience with HRIS systems (e.g., Workday) preferred.
* Advanced understanding of benefit finance and cost analysis.
* Typically requires significant experience (at least five years) in a benefits role, with a strong focus on APAC benefits, particularly in India, Singapore and China.

**It’s a bonus if you have**

* Senior-level, professional individual contributor role.
* Fully qualified with comprehensive and advanced understanding of benefits administration in APAC, with a focus on India, Philippines, Australia and China.
* Works independently and leads on diverse and highly complex problems.

-

for their customers. And we’re determined, always staying open – winning and failing as one.

**Your Role**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive acquisition and activation of net-new AWS customers.
* Develop and execute customer growth and expansion plans.
* Increase AWS consumption and accelerate workload adoption across customer environments.
* Identify opportunities across Cloud Migration, Modernization, Security, Data Analytics, AI/ML, GenAI, and AWS Marketplace.
* Collaborate closely with AWS and partner sales teams to accelerate customer growth.
* Build and maintain executive relationships with key customer stakeholders.
* Monitor customer health, adoption trends, and retention metrics.
* Drive business expansion and cross-sell opportunities within existing customer accounts.
* Support strategic initiatives that improve customer satisfaction and long-term value realization.

**Core Competencies**
**Technical Competencies**

* Understanding of AWS Cloud services and cloud adoption frameworks.
* Knowledge of Migration, Modernization, Security, Data Analytics, AI/ML, GenAI, and AWS Marketplace solutions.
* Experience in cloud consumption tracking and growth planning.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, sales reporting, and customer success platforms.
* Ability to analyze customer usage trends and identify expansion opportunities.

**Functional Competencies**

* Customer Success Management.
* Business Development and Revenue Growth.
* Consultative Selling.
* Account Growth and Expansion Planning.
* Partner Ecosystem Management.
* Stakeholder and Executive Relationship Management.
* Strategic Planning and Execution.
* Customer Retention and Adoption Management.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Communication: Strong presentation and executive communication skills.
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with AWS teams, partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Customer Focus: Passion for delivering customer outcomes and value realization.
* Problem Solving: Ability to identify growth barriers and implement effective solutions.
* Ownership & Accountability: Takes ownership of customer growth, adoption, and business objectives.

**Preferred Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Technology, or a related discipline.
* 5-8 years of experience in Customer Success, Cloud Sales, Business Development, Partner Management, or Technology Consulting.
* Experience in AWS or cloud-related businesses is preferred.
* Proven track record of driving customer acquisition, revenue growth, and retention.
* Strong executive stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

**Success Metrics (KPIs)**

* Net New Customer Acquisition
* Greenfield Customer Activation
* AWS Consumption Growth
* Expansion Revenue
* AWS Marketplace Revenue
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)

* Partner-Sourced Opportunities

The Customer Success & Growth Manager will be responsible for expanding the AWS customer base, increasing cloud adoption and consumption, driving customer retention, and delivering sustainable revenue growth through strategic customer engagement and partner-led initiatives.

**Description**
We are seeking an experienced litigation lawyer to join our India Legal team as Senior Corporate Counsel (SCC). In this role, the SCC will independently manage a large and diverse portfolio of contentious matters — spanning commercial arbitrations, civil suits, consumer disputes, and high-stakes regulatory and enforcement proceedings. You will be a trusted advisor to the business, driving litigation strategy, managing risk, and protecting the company's interests across a complex and fast-moving legal landscape.
  
  
This is a high-impact, high-ownership role suited to a self-starter who thrives in a dynamic environment, is comfortable handling matters of significant financial and reputational exposure and can balance strategic judgment with hands-on execution.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Litigation portfolio management: Independently manage a high volume of litigation matters end-to-end, including commercial arbitrations, civil and commercial suits, consumer disputes, and regulatory/enforcement actions.
* Strategy & risk assessment: Develop and drive case strategy, assess litigation risk and exposure, and advise business and leadership on potential outcomes, settlement options, and mitigation.
* External counsel management: Select, instruct, and manage external counsel and law firms; control legal spend, review strategy and work product, and ensure cost-effective, high-quality outcomes.
* Regulatory & enforcement matters: Lead responses to regulatory inquiries, investigations, notices, and enforcement proceedings; engage with regulators and authorities as appropriate.
* Stakeholder advisory: Partner with business teams, compliance, and cross-functional stakeholders to provide clear, practical, and actionable legal advice on contentious issues.
* Pre-litigation & dispute resolution: Handle pre-litigation disputes, demand/response notices, and negotiate settlements; explore and drive alternative dispute resolution where appropriate.
* Governance & reporting: Maintain accurate case tracking, prepare litigation reports and risk dashboards for leadership, and ensure timely escalation of material matters.
* Process & knowledge: Contribute to playbooks, standardization of litigation processes, and continuous improvement in how the team manages disputes at scale.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 13+ years of litigation experience
* Bachelor's degree in Law
* Enrolled and in good standing with the Bar Council of India.
* Strong track record in commercial arbitrations, civil/commercial suits, consumer disputes, and regulatory/enforcement matters — gained at a leading law firm and/or a reputed in-house legal team.

* Experience working independently and directly with all levels of legal and business partners or equivalent
* A blend of in-house experience at a large corporation, ideally in a high-volume, fast-paced industry, and experience as a practicing Advocate.

* Proven ability to work autonomously, prioritize across competing demands, and operate with a high degree of ownership and bias for action.

title: Senior Legal Manager
description:
We are looking for a Legal Manager to own end-to-end contract lifecycle management, lead a team of legal/compliance associates, and act as a trusted legal advisor across commercial, operations, and compliance functions. E-commerce spans a wide range of business domains — logistics and fulfilment, marketing and brand partnerships, technology and vendor tie-ups, finance and lending, consumer policy, cross-border trade, and more — each with its own commercial logic and risk profile. This role requires someone who can quickly understand the business context behind any given arrangement, identify the legal and commercial risks specific to it, and drive the contracting process forward in close coordination with management at every step, rather than someone specialized in any one transaction type.

The role sits at the intersection of legal, business, and compliance, and requires someone who can translate complex legal and regulatory issues into practical, commercially sound guidance for a fast-moving e-commerce business.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Contract Lifecycle Management***

* Draft, review, and negotiate commercial contracts across the full breadth of the business's operating domains — including but not limited to logistics/fulfilment, vendor and marketplace arrangements, technology and licensing tie-ups, marketing and brand partnerships, finance and lending, and cross-border distribution — with domestic and international counterparties.
* For any new or unfamiliar arrangement, get up to speed on the underlying business model and commercial objective first, so that contract structuring and risk flags are grounded in how that part of the business actually works, not applied generically.
* Own the full contract lifecycle: intake, drafting, negotiation, execution, amendment (including deeds of variation/restatement), renewal, and closure/termination — keeping management informed and looped in at each stage rather than only at sign-off.
* Build and maintain a contract repository/tracker with key dates, obligations, and renewal triggers.
* Structure and vet complex or novel commercial arrangements (e.g., service-to-lease conversions, related-party transactions, multi-party deeds) to avoid unintended legal characterisation, tax, or regulatory consequences.

***Business Risk Identification & Mitigation***

* Proactively identify legal and commercial risks embedded in business proposals, vendor arrangements, and internal transactions — including conflict-of-interest, related-party, and self-dealing exposures.
* Design and implement risk mitigation frameworks: escalation protocols, approval matrices, indemnity structures, and insurance alignment.
* Produce structured risk assessments/registers for high-value or high-risk agreements, with clause-level recommendations and prioritized action items.
* Coordinate with Finance and Tax on structuring decisions that carry legal risk (e.g., GST characterisation, stamp duty, related-party pricing).

***Regulatory Monitoring & Advisory***

* Track and interpret developments across applicable laws — corporate, contract, consumer protection, e-commerce/FDI, labour, IT/data security and privacy, trade/customs, and IP — and translate them into actionable guidance for management.
* Advise business and product teams on compliance implications of new initiatives, policies, or features (e.g., consumer-facing policy design, fulfilment models, cross-border trade structures).
* Support statutory and regulatory filings/compliance in coordination with company secretarial, tax, and compliance teams.
* Handle consumer forum matters (District/State/National Consumer Commissions) end-to-end — drafting replies, coordinating with external counsel, tracking hearings, and advising business on settlement vs. contest strategy.

***IP Protection (Domestic + Global)***

* Manage the company's IP portfolio — trademarks, brand assets, and proprietary tools/processes — across domestic and relevant international jurisdictions.
* Draft and enforce IP assignment, licensing, and confidentiality provisions in vendor, employee, and partner agreements.
* Lead or support responses to trade secret misuse, confidentiality breaches, or IP infringement, including civil/criminal remedy assessment and internal communications (circulars, employee notices).
* Advise on IP exposure in cross-border commercial structures and technology/vendor arrangements.

***Team & Inter-Team Coordination***

* Lead and mentor a team of legal/compliance associates — allocating work, reviewing output quality, and building their drafting and negotiation capability.
* Act as the legal point of contact for Business, Operations, Finance, HR, and Compliance teams, ensuring legal input is embedded early in commercial decision-making rather than bolted on at signature stage.
* Coordinate with external counsel, insurers, and regulatory consultants as needed.
* Support leadership with clear, decision-ready legal recommendations rather than open-ended risk lists.

**Requirements**

* **Experience:**
  6–8 years of relevant legal experience, with a strong preference for in-house experience in e-commerce, D2C, retail, or a fast-scaling commercial environment.
* **Qualification:**
  LLB (or equivalent); LLM or specialized certification in IP, technology, or corporate law is a plus.
* **Core Expertise:**
* Contract drafting and negotiation across commercial, vendor, and cross-border agreements
* End-to-end contract lifecycle management
* Team leadership — managing, mentoring, and reviewing the work of junior legal/compliance associates
* Business risk identification and mitigation design
* Working knowledge of IT/data security law and its business implications
* IP protection and enforcement, domestic and global
* Handling consumer forum/consumer commission matters, including litigation strategy and external counsel coordination
* Cross-functional coordination with Business, Finance, Operations, and HR
* **Regulatory Familiarity:**
  Indian corporate, contract, consumer protection, and IP law; working exposure to international/cross-border regulatory considerations (trade compliance, tax structuring touchpoints, data protection) is highly valued.
* **Other Attributes:**
* Strong commercial judgment — able to balance legal precision with business pragmatism
* Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and ownership
* Clear, concise written and verbal communication for both legal and non-legal audiences
* High attention to detail, especially in high-value or high-risk agreements

title: Commercial Contract Manager
description:
**Job Title :**
Manager – Commercial Contract Management

**Location :**
India

**Experience:**
9 to 11 years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, permanent

**About the Role**

We are building a single contract management function that every part of our business will use, and we are looking for an experienced contract professional to establish and own it. You will be responsible for all our commercial contracts across geographies and legal entities: customer MSAs and SOWs, supplier master agreements and purchase terms, subcontracts, and partner agreements.

Reporting to the Company Secretary, you will set the playbook, templates and workflows, build the central contract repository, and negotiate strategic contracts with customers and suppliers. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to shape how a global IT services organisation contracts.

**What You Will Do**

**Build the function**

* Set up one contract management process for all business units, from intake through negotiation, approval, signature, renewal and close-out.
* Build the customer and supplier templates, clause library, risk matrix and negotiation playbook.
* Strengthen our supplier master agreements and general purchase terms so that supplier obligations support our customer commitments.

**Review and negotiate contracts**

* Review customer contract terms at bid stage and flag key risks before pricing is finalised.
* Draft, redline and negotiate strategic and non-standard contracts with customers alongside Sales, and with suppliers and subcontractors alongside Procurement.
* Assess risk on liability, indemnity, IP, data protection, termination and other key terms, and decide when a position needs escalation or specialist legal advice.

**Run the contract lifecycle**

* Own the approval and signature workflow, including signing authority for each legal entity.
* Build and maintain a central repository of all executed contracts, and act as the business owner for contract management in Salesforce.
* Manage renewals, notice periods, amendments and post-signature handovers, and act as the escalation point for contract disputes.
* Track contract KPIs and report contract risk and portfolio performance to senior leadership.

**What You Will Bring**

**Essential**

* 9 to 11 years of experience in contract management, commercial contracting, legal operations or procurement contracting, including at least 5 years in IT or technology services with global customers.
* Hands-on experience drafting and negotiating MSAs, SOWs, supplier agreements and subcontracts, including aligning subcontracts with customer obligations.
* Experience setting up or running a contract management process end to end, including templates, approval workflows and a contract repository.
* Strong judgement on contractual risk, and on when a matter needs specialist legal advice.
* Confidence negotiating with senior stakeholders, internally and with customers and suppliers, across countries and time zones.
* Bachelor's degree in Law, Commerce, Finance or Business Administration.

**Preferred**

* LLB or LLM, MBA, or a post-graduate qualification in commercial law.
* Contract management or company secretarial certification, such as CCCM, CPCM or CS.
* Experience with Salesforce or another contract lifecycle management platform.
* Experience in a multinational organisation with multiple legal entities.

**Why Join Us**

* Build a new function from the ground up and set the standard for how the organisation contracts.
* Work on multi-country customer and supplier contracts across IT managed services, field services and projects.
* High visibility with senior leadership across business units.

Department: Governance & Assurance
  
  
Location: Gurugram, Haryana
  
  
Experience: 2 5 Years (Preferred)**
**Qualification: Semi-Qualified Company Secretary with completed mandatory training**
**About The Role**
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Semi-Qualified Company Secretary to join our Governance & Assurance team. The primary responsibility of this role will be to address and close pending statutory and corporate compliances, ensure proper maintenance of governance records, and establish and maintain compliance trackers and calendars.
  
  
The individual will work closely with internal stakeholders, including Finance, Legal, Auditors and senior management, to ensure timely completion of regulatory filings and adherence to applicable statutory requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Corporate and Statutory Compliance Manage and ensure timely completion of pending and ongoing company compliances under the Companies Act, 2013. Handle ROC filings, including AOC-4, MGT-7, DIR-3 KYC, ADT-1, PAS-3, DPT-3, SH-7 and other applicable MCA filings. Maintain statutory registers and corporate records, including registers of members, directors, charges and share transfers. Support incorporation-related compliances and matters relating to share capital, directorship and corporate governance. Assist with FEMA-related reporting, including FC-GPR, FC-TRS and FLA returns, wherever applicable. Support compliance requirements relating to LLPs and Section 8 companies.
* Board and General Meeting Compliance Prepare notices, agendas, minutes and attendance records for Board Meetings and General Meetings. Ensure compliance with Secretarial Standards SS-1 and SS-2. Draft board resolutions, shareholder resolutions, notices, letters and other statutory documentation. Review and assist in maintaining the company's MOA, AOA and other constitutional documents.
* Governance and Compliance Tracking Review and identify pending statutory and corporate compliance requirements and drive their closure. Develop and maintain compliance trackers, statutory registers and compliance calendars. Monitor filing deadlines, follow up with relevant stakeholders and ensure timely completion of compliance activities. Maintain proper documentation and records for audit readiness and internal governance reviews.
* Stakeholder Coordination Coordinate with Finance, Legal, external Company Secretaries, auditors and regulatory authorities for compliance-related matters. Provide necessary documentation and updates to senior management and directors. Ensure confidentiality and accuracy while handling sensitive corporate information.

**Technical Skills & Competencies**
Working knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013 and applicable corporate governance requirements.
  
  
Practical exposure to ROC filings and the MCA V3 portal.
  
  
Understanding of Board and General Meeting procedures and Secretarial Standards.
  
  
Familiarity with FEMA reporting and LLP/Section 8 company compliances.
  
  
Proficiency in MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint, particularly Excel-based trackers and compliance calendars.
  
  
Experience in handling Digital Signature Certificates (DSC), e-filing and board portals.
  
  
Familiarity with compliance management software or Smartsheet-type tracking tools will be an advantage.
  
  
**Desired Candidate Profile**
Semi-Qualified Company Secretary with completed mandatory training.
  
  
Prior experience in corporate secretarial activities, statutory compliance and ROC filings.
  
  
Strong attention to detail, organisational skills and deadline management.
  
  
Good written and verbal communication skills.
  
  
Ability to independently coordinate with multiple stakeholders and drive pending compliance closures.
  
  
High degree of integrity, confidentiality and professional judgment.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
A hands-on professional who can take ownership of pending corporate compliance activities, bring structure to governance documentation, maintain accurate compliance trackers and ensure that statutory obligations are completed within prescribed timelines.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Role Overview

Maxima — parent company of Pro Standard — is hiring a Performance Marketing Manager based in our India office to be the operational backbone of our paid media program. You'll handle daily campaign QA, async overnight monitoring while the US team is offline, oversight of 1-2 Hands-on Specialists, and clean handoffs back to our US-based Director of Performance Marketing each morning.

This is the first line of defense for our paid program — catching issues before they ship, enforcing the rules the Director sets, and making sure the team in India runs cleanly without the Director needing to clean up daily.

Reports to: Director of Performance Marketing

Location: India · Office-Based

Working Hours: US-aligned night shift · approx. 6:30pm – 3:30am IST

Director sync

Type: Full-time

Working Hours Detail

US-aligned night shift · approx. 6:30pm – 3:30am IST

What You'll Own

• Daily campaign QA across Meta and Google — every build reviewed before going live (copy, links, audiences, budgets, tracking pixels, conversion events).

• Cap enforcement and anomaly response — when CPMs spike, CTR drops, or pacing looks off, you take action or flag it depending on the threshold.

• Creative rotation oversight — what's tired, what's queued, what's overdue for refresh. You keep the rotation moving.

• Day-to-day management of 1-2 Hands-on Specialists — task assignments, daily standups, growth conversations, and clear scope for each report.

• Async handoff with the Director — overnight monitoring while US sleeps, EOD note prep, morning sync to align on the day's work.

• Routine exception calls inside the Director's thresholds — clear authority to act, clear bar for escalation.

• Documentation of patterns, learnings, and recurring issues so the team improves over time.

• Performance reporting to the Director — what shipped, what's running, what changed, what needs decisions.

Mindset for the Role

This role lives in the details and runs at speed. We're looking for someone who:

• Is energized by a clean QA queue and a smooth daily handoff.

• Catches what others miss — broken pixels, mismatched tracking, audiences targeting the wrong list.

• Acts decisively within their lane and escalates clearly when they hit the edge of authority.

• Documents reasoning so the Director can trust the handoff and the Specialists can learn the patterns.

• Treats async communication as an art form — the EOD note is one of the most important deliverables of the week.

• Thinks about how the team gets better, not just how today's queue gets cleared.

Working With AI

Maxima uses AI tools that build campaigns, monitor performance, and enforce budget rules. Your role is to validate that work, catch what AI misses, and apply the human judgment that determines whether a campaign actually ships. We're looking for someone who treats AI as a teammate that produces a lot of work, and who applies clear judgment on what gets approved.

Required Experience

• 3-5 years as a paid media operator with hands-on Meta and Google experience.

• Strong written and spoken English — daily Director sync depends on clear communication.

• Experience working with US or UK clients, or in a global team setting.

• Comfortable QA-ing AI-built campaigns and trusting your own judgment on overrides.

• Detail-obsessed without losing speed.

• Comfortable managing 1-2 specialists with daily standups and clear lanes.

Nice to Have

• Apparel, sports, DTC, or licensed-goods category experience.

• Experience with newer ad formats like Performance Max or Advantage+.

• Worked at scaled Indian DTC brands with strong operational rigor.

Why This Role Matters

The Director's bandwidth is the most valuable thing in the paid function — strategic decisions, creative direction, audience strategy, ROAS gate exceptions. Without a strong Manager in India, the Director becomes the daily QA bottleneck. With one, the team runs cleanly across time zones and the Director focuses on what only they can do.

This role will also be responsible of driving the marketing capability agenda for the India market across both Foods and Beverages.

This role is to elevate India PO1 marketing capability efforts through the partnership with Global marketing capability & operations team to develop and deploy world class marketing capability content and drive the capability building. This role will deliver and embed the global transformation & capability program which is expected to deliver step-changed brand-building capabilities to support development of Iconic Brands, embed the PepsiCo growth model, and elevate responsible and impactful AI usage and adoption.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

+ Marketing Transformation leadership: enabling, launching and removing barriers to embed the transformation in India with a focus on Iconic Brands inclusive of the overall Creative excellence and content workstream, Growth Navigator, and AI.
+ Land the priority workstreams of Iconic Brands that move culture, Growth Navigator and AI across India Foods & Beverages.
+ Ensure close cooperation with the CMO India Foods & CMO India Beverages to orchestrate the transformation within India Foods & Beverages.
+ Be the Change Agents for PepsiCo’s Consumer Organization in India.

* Upskilling against PPG priorities of Growth Navigator, Iconic Brands, and AI using the global PPG material, to build knowledge amongst relevant associates

* Governance process for key brand deliverables within the growth planning process (BGS, ABP, TCP Architecture, TCP Opportunity Brief) to drive oversight and accountability amongst India leadership
* Align agenda and collaborate on deployment with the Global Marketing Capabilities team, and ensure ongoing tracking of deployments within the global tracker.

* Aligning and executing a holistic plan to elevate the creative capability within the India teams with support from the global marketing capabilities team. Plan to include amplification of global Creative Spark townhalls/emails as well as any additional inspiration and learning opportunities for the India teams
* Coordinating execution of creative process embedding within India (Creative Council, Creative Kitchens)
* Establishing protocol for Market Creative Reviews within India as part of Global CMO Market visits

GN roll out across India in line with ExComm and partner the India Growth Navigator lead:
  
  

* Embed scorecards, develop and deliver core enhancements as needed
* Embedding GN through OU Growth planning processes

* Ongoing upskilling programming to drive AI usage and adoption
* Support deployment and embedding of AIM (AI for Marketing)
