title: Portfolio Revenue Manager - SWA
description:
**Role Purpose**
Direct key global revenue management projects and initiatives to hotel community through partnership with operations partners and Revenue Management that work directly with hotels. Participate in development of key global revenue management initiatives as the voice of the hotel community and once launched, provide continuous feedback to Americas revenue management leadership to ensure successful adoption. Manage the development, implementation and assessment of revenue-related strategies for hotels in an assigned region, encompassing all facets of pricing, demand analysis, yield management, market segmentation, business mix optimization, selling strategies and tactics in accordance with company policies and industry best practices. Assist in leadership of regional teams and hotels by providing revenue management strategies and tactics to maximize revenue and profit streams. Provide direct support to Company Managed Hotels (CMH) to drive performance metrics.
  
  
Drive the development, implementation and operation of both strategic and tactical programs designed to enhance revenue management services penetration and deliver significant competitive advantage for the Company. Incumbent will be responsible for the performance and business trend analysis, process evaluation, budgeting, field-level training, and deployment of Company resources to achieve strategic objectives.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**

* Facilitate the communication and training of key Americas revenue management projects and initiatives to the hotel community, through HPS area teams and other key operations partners.
* Provide feedback to global revenue management as the voice of the hotel community to ensure successful adoption of initiatives.

Investigate and communicate new ways to capture optimal revenue potentials. Provide directions to Brand and Revenue Management leadership to ensure hotel needs and revenue-generating improvements are incorporated into system enhancements or best practices.
* Foster the relationship between teams, Revenue Management Services and HPS, ensuring the communication pipeline of key strategies are in synergy and when conflicting, an internal resolution process exists.
* Develop, consult and manage implementation of revenue management systems and best practices for applicable brand and region. Direct and support hotels on revenue maximization through the full utilization of the Company's systems and best practices, in accordance with Brand Leadership/Revenue Management specifications, including HOLIDEX Plus, PERFORM/Price Optimization, GDS (Global Distribution System) interfaces, Distribution and Relationship Marketing interfaces, property management systems, etc.
* Analyze and review revenue management strategies and tactics for the brand and region with specific focus on key markets and management companies to further develop strategies for increasing revenues leading to increased profits.
* Support regional marketing program and product implementation as needed or requested.
* Coach and develop HPS team members (AM/AD) and Revenue Management Services RRM team. Serve as an advisor to area managers/directors, Revenue Management Services team and properties to help meet established goals.

* Provide guidance to direct reports in problem identification and resolution.
* Work with internal departments as needed to escalate consistent issues or noted trends and bring resolution.

* Drive revenue performance and delivery of our Winning Metrics
* Work with team and other key stakeholders to assess competitive data, brainstorming on new ideas to better implement strategies, developing innovative consulting or organizational tools, researching trends, planning for implementation of targeted programs to hotels, etc.).

**Key Skills & Experiences**
Education -
  
  
Bachelors Degree in Hotel Management, Business, Statistics, Marketing, Finance or a relevant field of work, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.
  
  
Experience -
  
  
8-10 years progressive work-related experience in hotel operations management, revenue management, or field consulting, with demonstrated proficiency in central reservations systems and revenue management systems, preferably HOLIDEX Plus and PERFORM, including knowledge and experience in hotel pricing concepts, yield management optimization and selling strategies.
  
  
Technical Skills and Knowledge -
  
  

* Demonstrated project management experience in organizing, planning and executing large-scale projects from conception through implementation.
* Demonstrated effective verbal and written communication skills for the purpose of providing information to clients, vendors, senior management and staff.
* Demonstrated ability to build and manage relationships with leadership, field support teams and key hotel representatives.
* Demonstrated effective conflict management/resolution and negotiation/persuasion skills to persuade key partners within revenue management, HPS and the hotels community to modify or implement various corporate-sponsored programs and initiatives.
* Demonstrated experience with industry and market trends as they relate to revenue opportunities, and demonstrated ability to drive revenue.
* Demonstrated knowledge of effective hotel pricing concepts, yield management optimization and selling strategies, and ability to determine which concepts to apply in given market conditions.
* Demonstrated experience in industry training, including preparation, implementation and delivery of training programs.

title: Order Fulfillment Executive (Full-kitting)
description:
* Role: Order Fulfillment Executive (Full-kitting)
* Location: Delhi
* Work timings: Monday to Saturday/ 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM

**About the role:**   
One of our clients is hiring for an Order Fulfillment Executive. This role owns the order from confirmation to dispatch readiness: ensuring every item, in the right quantity, is picked, kitted, and verified against the customer order before it reaches the packing lines. You will be the single point of accountability for complete, accurate, on-time fulfilment, with no shortages discovered at the last minute.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Review confirmed customer orders and plan fulfilment, including item availability, quantities, and dispatch timelines.
* Raise pick lists and kit requirements by order, ensuring every kit matches the order and SKU details exactly.
* Coordinate with the warehouse and stores team for timely picking, staging, and kit completion.
* Verify each kit against the order before handover to packing, checking part numbers, quantities, and any customer-specific requirements.
* Identify shortages, mismatches, or delays early and escalate to Procurement, Stores, and Sales with clear next steps.
* Coordinate with the Packing & QC Supervisor so kits move to the packing lines in line with order priority and dispatch plans.
* Prepare and verify order documentation such as packing lists and kit sheets, and share dispatch readiness with the Export Operations team.
* Update order status and fulfilment data in the system and the defined trackers daily, so order visibility is accurate and current.
* Track fulfilment performance (order completeness, kitting accuracy, on-time readiness) and report weekly to management.
* Investigate root causes of kitting errors, short shipments, and order rework, and implement corrective actions.
* Define packing guidelines for every product: how it should be packed, and the packing materials, quantities, and specifications required.
* Source and develop vendors for all packing materials.
* Purchase all packing materials required across the company, ensuring timely availability for the packing lines.
* Maintain stock levels of all packing materials through IMS, tracking consumption and raising replenishment before stock runs low.

**What we are looking for:**

* 3 to 5 years of experience in order fulfilment, order processing, warehouse operations, or dispatch coordination, ideally in auto components, engineering goods, or an export-oriented environment.
* Hands-on experience with kitting, picking, or order consolidation across a large SKU base.
* Working knowledge of ERP or inventory software and advanced Excel (lookups, pivots, trackers).
* Understanding of packing lists, order documents, and export dispatch requirements is a strong plus.
* Graduate (B.Com, BBA or B.Tech/B.E.) from a recognised university; a degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain/Logistics, or Engineering preferred.

* Check and validate KYC documents, including PAN, Aadhaar, address proof, bank proof, photograph and other required documents.
* Ensure proper collection and verification of client information as per applicable regulatory requirements.
* Identify incomplete applications, discrepancies and documentation errors and coordinate for necessary corrections.
* Track pending applications and ensure timely account activation.
* Coordinate with clients and internal teams for smooth onboarding.

2. KYC Verification & Compliance

* Perform KYC checks and document verification in accordance with applicable SEBI, KRA, KYC and exchange-related requirements.
* Ensure client details are accurate and consistent across application forms and supporting documents.
* Check for duplicate records, mismatches, missing information and other potential discrepancies.
* Follow prescribed internal compliance procedures and onboarding checklists.
* Maintain proper records of KYC documents and verification activities.
* Escalate suspicious, incomplete or non-compliant applications to the concerned team.
* Ensure client data is handled securely and confidentially.

3. Governance & Process Monitoring

* Ensure adherence to internal SOPs, policies and governance standards.
* Monitor account opening processes to identify procedural gaps and non-compliance.
* Maintain proper audit trails and documentation of client onboarding activities.
* Ensure that all mandatory approvals and verification steps are completed before account activation.
* Assist in internal audits, compliance reviews and documentation checks.
* Maintain records of errors, rejections, pending cases and corrective actions.

4. Call Recording Review & Quality Monitoring

* Listen to recorded client onboarding and verification calls.
* Review calls to ensure that proper information is communicated to clients.
* Check whether mandatory disclosures, consent and verification procedures are followed.
* Identify incorrect information, communication gaps or deviations from approved processes.
* Maintain call audit records and prepare observations wherever required.
* Escalate instances of mis-selling, incorrect commitments, incomplete disclosures or process deviations to the concerned authority.
* Provide feedback to relevant teams to improve onboarding quality and customer experience.

5. CRM & Data Management

* Upload and update client information, KYC details and onboarding status in the CRM.
* Ensure accurate data entry and timely updating of client records.
* Maintain proper digital records of application forms, supporting documents and verification status.
* Update case remarks, follow-ups, pending requirements and rejection reasons.
* Generate daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports as required.
* Maintain data accuracy and ensure there are no duplicate or incomplete records.

6. Coordination & Reporting

* Coordinate with Sales, Relationship Managers, Compliance, Operations and other internal departments.
* Follow up on pending KYC documents and account opening applications.
* Resolve documentation-related queries and onboarding issues.
* Track daily account opening numbers, pending cases, rejections and turnaround time (TAT).
* Share regular operational reports with the reporting manager.
* Suggest improvements to make the account opening process faster, smoother and more efficient.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate in any stream; preferably Commerce, Finance, Business Administration or Management.
* 1–3 years of experience in KYC, account opening, broking operations, banking or financial services preferred.
* Basic understanding of Demat and Trading account opening procedures.
* Knowledge of KYC documentation and verification processes.
* Familiarity with SEBI-related compliance requirements is an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, Word and CRM software.
* Strong data entry and documentation skills.
* Good listening, observation and analytical skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive client information.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Accuracy of KYC and account opening documentation.
* Number of accounts processed within the defined TAT.
* Reduction in application errors and rejection rates.
* Timely completion of pending KYC cases.
* Quality and accuracy of call recording audits.
* CRM data accuracy and timely updates.
* Adherence to internal SOPs and compliance requirements.
* Timely submission of MIS and operational reports.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for someone who is systematic, responsible, process-oriented and highly attentive to detail. The candidate should be comfortable handling documentation, reviewing recorded calls, working on CRM systems, identifying process gaps and ensuring that every client account is opened in accordance with the company's policies and applicable regulatory requirements.

Job Description – Technical Sales Executive

Company: Comhard Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Noida, Sector 62

Experience: 0–1 Year

Education: B.Tech (Mandatory)

About Comsky

Comsky (comsky.ai) builds cloud and SaaS products that help small and medium businesses run better. It is backed by Comhard Technologies Pvt. Ltd., a Noida IT company with 26 years in business and a partner network across India and abroad, including Dubai and Singapore.

The Comsky Suite brings our business software together under one login:

Comsky Cloud — public cloud servers, Linux VPS and GPU computing

Comsky CRM — sales pipeline, deals and follow-ups

Comsky Chat — one inbox for website chat, email and WhatsApp

Comsky HRMS — attendance, payroll and employee management

Comsky TallyBridge — Tally data on web and mobile

Comsky Books — online accounting

Comsky Backup — automated cloud backup

Comsky Telephony — business calling

Comsky Monitor — server and website monitoring

Comsky Mail and Comsky Orbit — business email, and team chat with tasks and video calls

Comhard also runs CoCloud, a managed cloud service used by thousands of businesses. New products are launching every few weeks, so you will learn and sell what is newest in cloud, SaaS and AI.

Why we want engineers in sales

This is tech sales, not core sales. Our customers buy cloud servers, CRM, HRMS and similar software, and they ask technical questions before they buy. An engineer understands the features, gives a confident live demo and explains how the product solves the customer’s problem.

That is why we hire B.Tech graduates and train them in sales, rather than hiring salespeople and teaching them technology.

It is also inside sales. You work from our Noida office using phone, video calls, email, WhatsApp and online demos. You do not travel to meet customers or do door-to-door or field sales.

What you will do

You will run the full B2B sales cycle for one or more Comsky products:

Prospect — call and message leads from our marketing campaigns, partners and existing customers

Understand — ask questions to learn the customer’s business and what they need

Demo — show the product live over a video call and answer technical questions

Convince — handle objections and show the value clearly

Negotiate and close — agree on plan and price, and bring the deal home

Follow up — help the customer get started and look for the next opportunity

You will work with two kinds of buyers:

Direct customers — businesses that buy from us directly

Channel partners — resellers and IT partners who sell our products to their own customers. You will onboard them, train them on our products and support their sales.

Each trainee joins a product team led by a Product Business Head and works on that product’s leads, demos and deals.

Who we are looking for

Eligibility

B.Tech, any branch (CS, IT and ECE preferred)

Available to join full-time at our Noida office

Required Skills & Qualifications

B.Tech graduates preferred, particularly in Computer Science, IT, or related fields.

0–1 year of experience in technical sales, IT sales, or business development.

Freshers with good technical knowledge and communication skills can apply.

Basic understanding of cloud computing, networking, servers, and software solutions.

Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

Willingness to learn new technologies and develop product knowledge.

Customer-oriented approach with a result-driven mindset.

About Ahamyo Care

Ahamyo Care is a healthcare and physiotherapy-focused organisation committed to delivering quality patient care through professional clinical services and a patient-centric approach. We aim to build strong healthcare partnerships and expand our reach by collaborating with doctors, medical professionals and healthcare institutions to create accessible and effective care solutions.

Role Brief

We are looking for a dynamic, target-oriented and relationship-driven **B2B Business Development Executive** to build and expand Ahamyo Care's doctor referral and partnership network. The candidate will be responsible for meeting doctors, developing new doctor tie-ups, onboarding healthcare professionals and maintaining long-term relationships to generate consistent business opportunities. The role will also involve managing doctor databases, activating dormant partnerships, planning outreach activities and developing revenue streams through an incentive-based partnership model.

Key Responsibilities1. Doctor Acquisition & Onboarding

* Identify and approach potential doctors, clinics, hospitals and healthcare professionals for business partnerships.
* Conduct regular field visits and face-to-face meetings with doctors to introduce Ahamyo Care's services and partnership opportunities.
* Build and onboard new doctors through structured B2B tie-ups and referral partnerships.
* Explain partnership models, referral processes, service offerings and incentive structures to prospective doctors.
* Achieve monthly targets for doctor acquisition and successful onboarding.

2. Doctor Relationship & Account Management

* Build and maintain strong, long-term professional relationships with onboarded doctors.
* Establish a dedicated communication channel with each doctor to ensure regular interaction and smooth coordination.
* Conduct periodic follow-ups and meetings to maintain engagement and encourage consistent referrals.
* Understand doctors' requirements, address concerns and coordinate internally to ensure a seamless partnership experience.
* Develop strategies to improve doctor engagement, retention and referral activity.

3. Doctor Database & Pipeline Management

* Create and maintain an updated database of active, dormant and prospective doctors.
* Maintain accurate records of doctor details, specialities, clinic locations, contact information, onboarding status and business potential.
* Regularly track doctor activity, referral contributions and partnership performance.
* Identify dormant or inactive doctors and implement reactivation strategies through calls, meetings and personalised outreach.
* Maintain a structured pipeline for new doctor acquisitions and follow-ups.

4. Outreach & Business Development Activities

* Plan and execute regular doctor outreach activities, field visits and partnership development initiatives.
* Identify new geographical areas, medical specialities and healthcare networks for business expansion.
* Develop engagement initiatives such as doctor meets, networking events, clinic visits and professional awareness activities.
* Explore new B2B partnership opportunities with clinics, hospitals and independent medical practitioners.
* Work towards expanding Ahamyo Care's referral network and market presence.

5. Revenue Generation & Incentive-Based Partnerships

* Develop and strengthen revenue streams through doctor partnerships and referral-based business models.
* Communicate and manage approved incentive-based partnership structures with doctors.
* Track referral conversions, business generated and revenue contribution from individual doctor partnerships.
* Identify high-potential doctors and develop strategies to increase business contribution.
* Work towards achieving monthly and quarterly business development and revenue targets.

6. Reporting & Performance Tracking

* Maintain daily field visit reports and regular follow-up records.
* Share weekly and monthly reports covering new doctor onboarding, active partnerships, dormant doctor reactivation and referral performance.
* Track key performance indicators such as:
* Number of doctors approached and met.
* Number of new doctor tie-ups and onboardings.
* Active versus dormant doctor ratio.
* Number of referrals received.
* Revenue generated through doctor partnerships.
* Doctor engagement and retention.
* Provide regular updates to the reporting manager on market feedback, competitor activities and business opportunities.

Eligibility & Skills Required

* Minimum 1–2 years of experience in sales or business development.
* Prior experience in healthcare sales, pharmaceutical sales, medical device sales or doctor relationship management will be preferred.
* Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable with field visits, doctor meetings and client acquisition.
* Ability to manage multiple doctor relationships and maintain structured databases.
* Target-oriented approach with a strong focus on business generation and revenue growth.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets and CRM tools.

Key Performance Expectations

* Consistent acquisition and onboarding of new doctors.
* Growth in the active doctor partnership network.
* Successful reactivation of dormant doctor accounts.
* Regular doctor engagement and relationship management.
* Measurable referral generation and revenue contribution.
* Achievement of assigned monthly and quarterly business targets.

# Job Description – Senior Sales Executive

\*\*Company Name:\*\* Olin Forest Ayurveda Private Limited

\*\*Position:\*\* Senior Sales Executive  
Location - Noida Sector 63

### Company Overview

Olin Forest Ayurveda Private Limited is looking for an experienced, confident, and target-driven Senior Sales Executive to lead sales activities, generate business opportunities, and drive revenue growth by promoting our Ayurvedic products.

### Job Details

- \*\*Salary:\*\* ₹25,000 – ₹40,000 per month (Depending on skills and experience)

- \*\*Office Timings:\*\* 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM

\*\*Job Type:\*\* Full-Time

- \*\*Work Location:\*\* B- Block, Noida Sector 63

### Roles & Responsibilities

1. Manage inbound and outbound sales calls to generate and convert potential leads.

2. Promote and sell the company's Ayurvedic products to prospective customers.

3. Identify customer needs and recommend suitable products.

4. Handle high-value leads and close sales effectively.

5. Achieve and exceed daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.

6. Build and maintain strong relationships with new and existing customers.

7. Follow up with potential customers to maximize conversion rates.

8. Handle customer objections, queries, and negotiations professionally.

9. Monitor sales performance and maintain accurate sales reports.

10. Support and guide junior sales team members to improve their performance.

11. Identify new business opportunities and contribute to overall sales growth.

12. Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth sales operations.

### Required Skills & Qualifications

- Excellent Hindi communication and convincing skills are mandatory.

- Strong sales, negotiation, and customer-handling abilities.

- Good knowledge of sales processes and lead conversion techniques.

- Basic computer knowledge, including MS Excel and CRM tools.

- Ability to handle sales targets and work under pressure.

- Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.

- Positive attitude, leadership qualities, and a result-oriented mindset.

### Experience & Eligibility

- Minimum 1–3 years of relevant sales experience preferred.

- Experience in FMCG sales will be an added advantage.

- Candidates with Ayurvedic medicine or Ayurvedic product sales experience will be highly preferred.

- Experience in telesales, telecalling, and customer conversion is also welcome.

- Candidates with team-handling or sales coordination experience will have an added advantage.

### Salary & Benefits

- Competitive salary package: ₹25,000 – ₹40,000 per month.

- Attractive performance-based incentives and commission.

- Additional earning opportunities based on sales performance.

- Professional and supportive working environment.

- Career growth and development opportunities.

- Product and sales training will be provided.

- Opportunity to grow with an expanding Ayurveda company.

### Who Can Apply?

- Experienced Sales Executives looking for career growth.

- FMCG Sales Professionals.

- Ayurvedic Product Sales Professionals.

- Tele sales and Tele calling Professionals with strong conversion skills.

- Candidates with excellent Hindi communication and proven sales abilities.

\*\*Interested candidates can apply now and become a part of Olin Forest Ayurveda Private Limited!\*\*

title: Accounts & Operations Executive
description:
1. Job Objective

To independently manage the company's accounting, taxation, billing, order processing and day-to-day operational activities. The role requires strong financial and taxation knowledge, effective vendor and logistics coordination, and the ability to ensure smooth execution of Cosmetologie's business operations from order receipt to final delivery.

2. Key Result Areas (KRAs) & Responsibilities

**A. Accounts, Finance & Taxation**

* **Accounting & Bookkeeping:** Maintain accurate and up-to-date daily accounting records, including ledgers, journal entries, expense records, purchase and sales entries, and other financial transactions.
* **Billing & Invoicing:** Prepare and issue customer invoices, quotations, proforma invoices, purchase bills, credit notes, debit notes and payment receipts accurately and within stipulated timelines.
* **GST & Statutory Compliance:** Independently manage GST returns, TDS compliance, tax-related documentation and other applicable statutory filings, ensuring accuracy and timely submission.
* **Tax & Financial Reconciliation:** Perform regular reconciliation of GST, TDS, sales, purchases, vendor accounts and customer accounts; identify discrepancies and ensure timely resolution.
* **Accounts Payable & Receivable:** Monitor vendor payments, customer outstanding balances, collections and payment schedules; ensure timely follow-ups and maintain accurate payment records.
* **Bank Reconciliation:** Maintain bank transaction records, conduct regular bank reconciliations and investigate and resolve discrepancies between bank statements and accounting records.
* **Financial Reporting:** Prepare periodic financial reports covering sales, purchases, expenses, cash flow, outstanding receivables, payables and other management-required financial information.
* **Compliance & Problem Resolution:** Proactively identify accounting and taxation discrepancies, resolve routine financial issues independently and ensure adherence to applicable laws, internal procedures and statutory deadlines.

**B. Business Operations – Cosmetologie**

* **End-to-End Order Management:** Manage all Cosmetologie orders from order receipt and confirmation through order processing, stock verification, invoicing, packing coordination and final dispatch.
* **Dispatch & Logistics Management:** Coordinate packing, courier partners, transporters and logistics providers; monitor shipment status and ensure timely dispatch and delivery of customer orders.
* **Inventory & Stock Coordination:** Maintain updated inventory records, monitor stock availability, track inward and outward movements and coordinate replenishment to prevent stock-outs and fulfilment delays.
* **Purchase & Procurement Management:** Prepare purchase orders, place orders with approved vendors, track supply requirements and follow up on procurement, production and delivery timelines.
* **Vendor Identification & Development:** Identify potential vendors and suppliers, evaluate them on quality, pricing, reliability and delivery commitments, and support vendor onboarding and relationship management.
* **Interdepartmental Coordination & Documentation:** Coordinate with sales, production, vendors, logistics partners and internal teams to ensure smooth operational execution. Maintain organised records of orders, purchase orders, invoices, dispatch details, delivery proofs and supporting documents.
* **Process Improvement & Operational Ownership:** Identify operational gaps and bottlenecks, streamline processes, control unnecessary expenses, improve coordination and take end-to-end ownership of assigned accounting and operational activities.

3. Candidate Requirements

* Graduate in Commerce (B.Com) or a relevant qualification in Accounting, Finance or Business Administration.
* Strong practical knowledge of accounting principles, GST, TDS, taxation and statutory compliance.
* Hands-on experience with Tally Prime or equivalent accounting software.
* Good working knowledge of MS Excel, billing systems and financial documentation.
* Understanding of purchase, sales, inventory, invoicing and order management processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving and reconciliation skills.
* Excellent coordination, communication and vendor follow-up abilities.
* Ability to independently manage multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines.
* High level of accuracy, accountability, integrity and attention to detail.

4. Key Performance Expectations

The candidate will be evaluated on the following parameters:

* Accuracy and timely completion of accounting entries and financial records.
* Timely preparation of invoices, quotations and purchase documentation.
* Timely GST, TDS and other applicable statutory compliance.
* Accuracy of bank, GST, purchase and sales reconciliations.
* Effective management of outstanding payments and vendor dues.
* Timely processing and dispatch of Cosmetologie orders.
* Accuracy of inventory records and stock coordination.
* Timely procurement and vendor follow-ups.
* Quality of financial and operational reporting.
* Ability to independently resolve issues and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

5. Overall Role Expectations

The candidate is expected to work independently, maintain complete accountability for assigned tasks and ensure that accounting and operational activities are executed accurately and within defined timelines.

This position requires a proactive, responsible and detail-oriented individual who can effectively manage both financial administration and business operations in a growing organisation.

The Area Sales Manager – ENT is a founding member of one of three regionally deployed ENT sales teams across India and is responsible for promoting and selling Stryker's ENT portfolio – high-speed drills, debriders, 4K camera systems and sinuscopes, balloon sinuplasty and the associated consumables – directly to current and new end customers. The role is accountable for taking the business from an early foothold to a scaled, dedicated ENT franchise: building on existing debrider relationships, deepening KOL advocacy and reference sites, driving adoption and utilization of capital and consumables, and preparing the ground for Stryker's strong pipeline of future ENT products. He/she will also inform customers of new product/service introductions and prices, create, monitor and revise lead generation plans to ensure a substantive sales opportunity pipeline, and maximize revenues from sales of the organization's products through direct sales and a base of dealers & distributors where appropriate.

**Essential duties & responsibilities:**

* Implement sales activities to achieve budgeted sales and profitability goals for the assigned area / territory (3-4 states), scaling the ENT business on the existing debrider base in 2027.
* Build and own a named target list of top ENT KOLs, premium hospital accounts and high-volume teaching institutes in Rhinology (FESS / sinus and skull base) and Otology, starting with existing debrider accounts and ENT surgeons already engaged by Stryker; tier accounts by procedure volume, installed base and adoption readiness, and drive structured account and call plans.
* Develop the market for the ENT portfolio – drills, debrider, camera systems / sinuscopes, balloon sinuplasty and consumables – through demonstrations, evaluations, in-OT case support and surgeon education, and convert trials into installed base and recurring consumable usage.
* Build deep, compliant relationships with ENT KOLs and academic leaders; identify and develop surgeon champions, faculty and reference sites, and support cadaver labs, workshops, proctoring, live-surgery and KOL-led training programmes.
* Execute launch readiness and go-to-market plans for new portfolio additions and pipeline products in the territory – pre-seed KOLs, qualify launch sites, support training and secure early adopters – and stay prepared to take new products to market as they become available.
* Position the ENT ecosystem (debrider + drill + camera) as an integrated offering, especially in high-volume FESS and skull base accounts, and differentiate against competing offerings through techno-commercial value selling.
* Reach out to identify new business opportunities by means of tender & government businesses, particularly government medical colleges and teaching institutes.
* Ensure efficient use of company's demo units and samples in the territory, with defined evaluation protocols and timely conversion follow-up.
* Retain existing ENT accounts & explore new accounts/business opportunities to expand Strykers‘ ENT customer pool.
* Identify, develop & manage different channels of business (distributors & direct sales) in the area, ensuring channel partners are aligned and trained on the ENT portfolio.
* Provide solutions to customers to meet their specifications on the basis of techno commercial discussions, including tender specifications and pricing proposals.
* Upgrade existing customers to newer technologies and cross-sell the wider ENT portfolio into existing debrider and camera accounts.
* Collaborate & cooperate with the National Sales Manager, ENT Marketing, Medical Education, Service, Regulatory and the Neurosurgery / Endoscopy sales teams – including a smooth transition of existing ENT and debrider accounts and surgeon relationships to the dedicated ENT team – and on shared accounts and credit principles, as & when required.
* Capture market intelligence – surgeon voice of customer, competitor activity, pricing and installed base – to shape the ENT business plan and future portfolio decisions; maintain CRM discipline, accurate forecasting and timely reporting.
* Adhere to Stryker's healthcare compliance, ethics and code-of-conduct requirements in all customer and KOL interactions.

**Special trainings: Preferrable**

* ENT anatomy, pathology and procedure training – FESS / endoscopic sinus and skull base surgery, and otology (including temporal bone / mastoid and cochlear implant procedures)
* Hands-on product and OR exposure – cadaver labs, live-case observation, and demo / set-up certification on drills, debrider, camera systems and balloon sinuplasty
* Consultative / solution selling, KOL management and negotiation skills
* Healthcare compliance and ethics training

**Qualifications & experience:**

**Qualifications:**

* Graduate/Post-graduate/MBA in any discipline (life sciences, biomedical engineering or pharmacy background preferred)

**Experience:**

* At least 4-6 years’ sales experience in healthcare, preferred (preferred Medical capital); experience in ENT, neurosurgery, endoscopy / visualization, powered surgical instruments or disposables is a strong advantage
* Proven record in sales management, channel management and key account management
* Demonstrated experience in KOL engagement and in selling to premium private hospitals and government teaching institutes, including tender processes
* Track record of launching or scaling a new product, segment or territory; comfortable with in-OT case support and live product demonstrations
* Existing network with ENT surgeons (rhinologists / otologists) and teaching institutes in the assigned region is preferred
* An understanding and application of procedures and concepts of own discipline. The job requires attention to detail in making evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information.

**Work Knowledge, skills & abilities**

* **Good communication** & interpersonal skills
* **Challengers:** Seeks out the hard projects and work to find just the right solutions.
* **Charismatic networkers:** Relationship-savvy people who intentionally make connections with both internal partners and external contacts, including ENT KOLs and academic leaders. Consistently prioritizes the right opportunities for Stryker and shows ability to construct the best customer pricing proposal. Collaborate and work efficiently with marketing team
* **Game Changers**: Persistent salespeople who will stop at nothing to live out Stryker’s mission to make healthcare better.
* **Customer-Oriented achievers**: Representatives with an unparallel work ethic and customer-focused attitude who bring value to their performance objectives.
* **Strategic closers:** Closes profitable business and consistently exceed their performance objectives.
* Able to build and execute basic business plan
* **Market builders:** Entrepreneurial, self-driven owners who thrive in a high-growth, start-up-like setting within an established organization, take full ownership of a 3-4 state territory and are comfortable scaling demand in a segment where Stryker has an early foothold and ambitious growth plans.
* **Clinical and technical aptitude:** Ability to quickly learn ENT anatomy and procedures (FESS, balloon sinuplasty, otology / cochlear implant surgery) and the technology behind drills, debriders and 4K visualization, and to discuss clinical and economic value credibly with surgeons.
* **Cross-functional collaborator:** Works well with Neurosurgery and Endoscopy teams on shared accounts, and with Marketing, Medical Education, Service and Regulatory partners to deliver launches and customer commitments.
* **Territory and account planning:** Strong planning, forecasting and follow-through across multiple states, with willingness to travel extensively (approximately 80%) and work flexibly around OT schedules, workshops and conferences.
* undefined

  
Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

Trafasa is building a technology-led B2B procurement ecosystem, and
**Trafasa Source**

We are looking for an exceptional
**AVP – Enterprise Sales & Revenue**
who can take ownership of building and scaling the revenue engine for Trafasa Source.

We are not looking for someone who only manages CRM reports, waits for marketing-generated leads or supervises a sales team.

We want a
**builder, hunter, closer and future sales leader**
.

Someone who can walk into a CXO or procurement leader's office, understand how the organisation currently buys, identify the commercial and operational problems in that process, quantify the opportunity for improvement, demonstrate relevant value and convert the organisation into a long-term paying customer.

**YOUR MANDATE**

You will own the enterprise sales journey for Trafasa Source—from market identification to acquisition, conversion, revenue, adoption, retention and expansion.

You will be expected to:

• Build the enterprise sales and revenue engine from the ground up.

• Personally prospect and open doors with CEOs, CFOs, CPOs, Procurement Heads, Purchase Heads, Supply Chain Heads and other senior decision-makers.

• Identify and prioritise the right ICPs, industries, accounts, buying personas and use cases.

• Build a high-quality target-account and opportunity pipeline instead of depending entirely on inbound leads.

• Understand a prospect's existing procurement workflow before proposing a solution.

• Diagnose procurement pain points involving sourcing, RFQs, vendor discovery, quotation comparison, approvals, negotiation, reverse auctions, visibility, cycle time, cost optimisation and supplier management.

• Conduct discovery meetings and consultative/value-based selling conversations.

• Translate Trafasa Source capabilities into measurable business outcomes instead of merely demonstrating product features.

• Run compelling enterprise demos and pilots linked to specific customer problems and success criteria.

• Build business cases and ROI/value propositions for prospective customers.

• Navigate multiple stakeholders and complex enterprise buying processes.

• Handle objections, commercial negotiations and closing.

• Convert pilots and opportunities into
**paid accounts and recurring revenue**
.

• Drive customer onboarding, adoption, retention, renewals, expansion and referrals.

• Build strategic relationships with customers instead of treating the sale as complete when the contract is signed.

• Develop referral, partnership and channel-led opportunities wherever commercially relevant.

• Create repeatable sales playbooks, discovery frameworks, objection-handling systems, pipeline discipline, forecasting and reporting.

• Capture structured Voice of Customer insights and work closely with Product and Marketing to continuously strengthen product-market fit, positioning and go-to-market execution.

• Identify gaps between what customers need and what the product currently delivers—without allowing product discussions to replace revenue accountability.

• Build, mentor and scale a high-performance enterprise sales organisation as the business grows.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

Success will not be measured by the number of calls, meetings or presentations alone.

It will ultimately be measured through:

**Qualified pipeline → Discovery → Demonstration/Pilot → Conversion → Paid Accounts → Revenue → Adoption → Retention → Expansion**

We want someone who understands that a sales leader owns outcomes.

**WHO WE WANT**

You should have:

✓
**Minimum 10 years of enterprise B2B sales experience.**

✓ Demonstrable experience selling directly to medium and large enterprises.

✓ Strong understanding of the
**procurement / purchase / sourcing process**
within enterprises.

✓ Proven ability to personally prospect, conduct discovery, negotiate and close.

✓ Experience dealing with CXOs, Procurement Heads, Purchase Heads, Supply Chain leaders and senior business stakeholders.

✓ Strong understanding of consultative, diagnostic, solution and value-based selling.

✓ Ability to create pipeline rather than merely manage leads generated by others.

✓ Ability to sell business outcomes and ROI rather than features.

✓ Strong commercial judgment and negotiation capability.

✓ Understanding of customer success, retention, expansion and account growth.

✓ High energy, exceptional communication skills, confidence and executive presence.

✓ Strong ownership mentality and comfort working in a founder-led, high-accountability environment.

✓ Ability to operate with speed, ambiguity and limited resources.

✓ Data-driven thinking with disciplined CRM, pipeline and forecasting practices.

Experience selling
**procurement technology, SaaS, ERP, supply-chain technology, B2B platforms, enterprise software, procurement services or adjacent solutions**
will be strongly preferred.

**WHO SHOULD NOT APPLY**

This role may not be suitable if you:

• primarily want to manage an existing sales team;

• depend heavily on inbound or marketing-generated leads;

• have limited experience personally closing enterprise customers;

• cannot demonstrate meaningful knowledge of enterprise procurement;

• prefer activity targets over revenue accountability; or

• are uncomfortable building systems and pipeline from scratch.

**WHY TRAFASA?**

This is an opportunity to join Trafasa at a stage where the person coming in will not simply inherit a sales function.

**You will help build it.**

For the right person, this role offers the opportunity to become one of the key leaders responsible for taking Trafasa Source from early market adoption to a scalable enterprise business.

We are looking for someone who wants to create—not merely maintain.

If you believe you can build pipeline from zero, earn the confidence of senior procurement leaders, diagnose before you sell, close enterprise customers and build a revenue organisation around those successes, we would like to speak with you.

**Apply through LinkedIn with specific evidence of enterprise accounts/revenue you have personally helped win.**

title: Senior Growth Manager I
description:
Swiggy is India’s leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.
  
  
**Overview**
**Job Description**
A Key Account Manager owns high-value restaurant partners within an assigned city, typically chains, established multi-outlet restaurants, and growing independents expanding to multiple locations. These accounts are more complex: they involve negotiations with multiple stakeholders, larger deal sizes, custom solutions, and deeper engagement around ROI and strategy. You combine field presence with office-based analysis and executive relationship management. Success requires both relationship skills and the analytical ability to build customized business cases. You mentor the Sales Manager tier and own a portion of the city-wide targets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own a portfolio of multi-outlet restaurants: Manage 30-40 high-value accounts(60 to 80 in case of Indianext cities), each with 2-10 outlets. These accounts represent 40-60% of city revenue
* Executive relationship management: Build relationships with franchise owners, regional managers, and operational heads. You are often dealing with decision-makers, not individual restaurant managers
* Consultative strategy: Move beyond product features. Help restaurants think about their growth strategy across, e.g., optimizing delivery times, increasing order frequency, and cross-location consistency
* Field presence with data: Conduct monthly visits to key accounts to understand operations, gather feedback, troubleshoot adoption barriers, and surface new opportunities
* Advanced analytics: Build detailed business reviews (QBR) for accounts. Analyze their performance across cuisine, compare against benchmarks, and present growth strategies
* Pipeline development: Identify expansion opportunities with existing accounts (new locations, new products/cuisine). Turn your relationship into revenue growth
* Excel excellence: Build executive presentations, ROI models for pitches, and monthly and quarterly business reviews with charts and trend analysis. Your spreadsheets must be presentation-ready for C-level stakeholders
* 60 to 70 in-person restaurant partner meetings in a month

**Qualifications**
**Experience & Background:**

* 0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
* Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
* Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partners.
* Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
* Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

description:
**Government Tenders & GeM**

SK Weldedmesh Pvt Ltd is hiring a Tender Executive to manage government and PSU bids from opportunity identification through submission, award tracking and handover. This is a full-time, on-site role in B B D Bagh, Kolkata, West Bengal.

Tender identification and eligibility

* Monitor GeM, CPPP, IREPS, state e-procurement and other government and PSU portals. Summarise scope, estimated value where available, eligibility, deadlines, EMD, payment terms and key contract conditions.

* Check technical, financial and documentary eligibility. Flag gaps in registrations, certifications, OEM authorisations or experience credentials. Prepare clarification requests and obtain management’s bid/no-bid decision before substantial preparation.

Bid preparation and submission

* Build a compliance checklist for each tender. Coordinate with presales, sales, finance and operations on specifications, BOQs, rates, documents and deadlines.

* Check that costing covers freight, installation, taxes, warranties and other obligations. Obtain management approval for the final quote and support reverse auctions within approved limits.

* Prepare and submit technical and commercial bids, declarations, undertakings and supporting paperwork. Manage GeM product catalogues and track corrigenda, deadline changes, buyer queries and document requests. Save complete bid packs and submission acknowledgements.

Documentation, finance and handover

* Maintain company credentials, certificates, past orders and completion records. Track document expiry and portal renewals.

* Coordinate tender fees, EMD, bank guarantees and performance securities with finance. Follow up on EMD refunds and guarantee releases.

* Track technical qualification, financial opening, auction outcomes and awards. Record documented rejection reasons, winning bidders and prices when available. Hand over awarded orders with scope, delivery milestones, payment terms, warranties and penalties. Support factory and buyer coordination, invoice uploads and payment follow-up as needed.

Weekly reporting and performance

* Maintain an Excel tracker of opportunities, submissions, results and awards. Report losses and disqualifications weekly, distinguish documented reasons from assumptions, and track corrective actions with owners and due dates.

* Success means submitting approved bids on time, avoiding preventable documentation rejections, identifying eligibility gaps early and improving technical qualification and win rates over time.

What you’ll bring

* 2–5 years in government tendering, including hands-on GeM bid submission and experience with government e-procurement portals.

* Ability to read tender documents, assess eligibility and commercial risks, and manage multiple deadlines independently.

* Strong Excel, documentation and coordination skills, and clear communication in English and Hindi.

* Manufacturing or engineering tender experience is preferred. An engineering qualification is preferred, and candidates from other disciplines with relevant experience are welcome.

title: Business Development Representative SaaS Sales (Saleshandy)
description:
**About Saleshandy**
--------------------

Saleshandy is built in Ahmedabad and has been helping businesses scale outreach since 2015. More than 25,000 businesses, agencies and sales teams use it to find leads in a B2B database of 852M+ contacts, set up and warm up sending mailboxes, and run multichannel sequences across email, calls, LinkedIn and WhatsApp. Replies and deals are managed in one unified inbox.

Plans run from $34 to $149 a month, with custom Enterprise plans above that. We're rated 4.6/5 on G2 and are SOC 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR compliant.

We're moving from marketing-led to sales-led growth, and we're hiring closers who want to own a number and grow with us.

#### **About the role** **close deals, own your number**

You'll own the full sales cycle at Saleshandy. You'll convert inbound trial users into paying customers and build your own pipeline through outbound, selling to founders, agencies and sales teams in the US, UK and EU.

* You'll work from our Ahmedabad office. If you live outside Ahmedabad, relocating is mandatory for this role
* You'll work US/UK hours, which means a night shift in India
* We're looking for 2 to 5 years in B2B SaaS sales, with at least 2 years of closing deals yourself
* Full-time role, reporting to the Head of Sales
* Your main market is the US and EU, with India as a secondary market
* Pay is 6 to 8 LPA fixed, plus an uncapped monthly incentive

**How we work**
---------------

We run a Results-Only Work Environment (ROWE). Nobody tracks your hours or how busy you look. You decide how to plan your day, and you're measured only on outcomes: pipeline created, deals closed, revenue and ticket size.

In return, you own your target completely. If you're behind, you raise it and fix it before your manager has to ask. This role won't suit someone who waits to be chased or leaves results to chance.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Inbound sales and trial conversion**

* Own inbound leads (trial sign-ups, demo requests, calendar bookings, chat conversations) from first contact to closed-won or closed-lost
* Respond fast: within the same business hour for demo requests, the same day for trial sign-ups
* Run discovery to understand the buyer's outreach goals, current tools, sending volume, team size and deliverability problems
* Give tailored demos that show only what solves the buyer's problem, instead of a full feature tour
* Handle pricing, competitor and "we're just researching" objections with value, not quick discounts
* Close deals and move customers from monthly to annual plans to grow ticket size

### **Outbound sales and pipeline building**

* Identify target accounts and decision-makers across the US and EU: lead-gen agencies, SaaS founders, and SMB and mid-market sales teams
* Build and run your own outbound campaigns on Saleshandy across cold email, LinkedIn and calls
* Write personalised sequences and keep improving subject lines, offers and messaging based on results
* Book meetings and build enough pipeline to cover at least 3x your monthly quota
* Track open rate, reply rate, positive reply rate, meetings booked and meeting-to-close conversion

### **Follow-up and pipeline discipline**

* Follow up on every lead across email, calls, LinkedIn and WhatsApp until you get a clear yes or no. One email followed by silence is not follow-up
* Keep every lead stage, meeting date, close date and lost reason updated in our CRM (Close). We report from the CRM, never from spreadsheets
* Review your own pipeline every week (stalled deals, overdue tasks, deals at risk) and bring a plan to your 1:1
* Forecast honestly every week and deliver the number you commit to

### **Product and technical understanding**

* Know cold email deliverability well: SPF, DKIM, DMARC, domain and mailbox warm-up, sender rotation, sending limits, bounce rates and inbox placement
* Know the full Saleshandy product: Lead Finder and credits, email infrastructure, unified inbox, multichannel sequences, AI Sequence Copilot, agency and white-label features, API, and CRM integrations (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Zoho)
* Explain technical concepts simply to non-technical founders and sales leaders
* Know the basics of cold email compliance in the US (CAN-SPAM) and EU (GDPR)
* Answer product questions yourself using our internal knowledge base instead of waiting on the product team

### **AI and sales automation**

* Use AI tools for account research, personalisation, call preparation and follow-up drafting
* Build simple AI workflows that cut research and admin time, so more of your day goes to selling
* Use AI to make outreach more personal, not more generic

### **Working with other teams**

* Hand closed customers over smoothly to onboarding and customer success, including setup expectations. New Pro-plan customers should finish domain and mailbox setup within their first month
* Share objections, lost reasons, competitor mentions and feature requests with product and marketing every week

**You'll fit well if you**
--------------------------

* Have 2 to 5 years of B2B SaaS sales, including at least 2 years of hands-on deal closing
* Have a record of hitting quota, with numbers you can share: quota, achievement, deal size and cycle length
* Have done both inbound conversion and self-sourced outbound pipeline
* Have sold to US, UK or EU customers over video calls
* Speak and write excellent English, and are strong at presenting, negotiating and handling objections
* Can write cold emails that get replies
* Have used a CRM (Close, HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive or similar) and at least one sales engagement or data tool (Saleshandy, Apollo, Clay, Lemlist, Instantly or similar)
* Are comfortable working US/UK night shift hours from Ahmedabad
* Keep learning. You read, listen to sales podcasts and review your own call recordings, and you can show how that improved your results

### **Good to have**

* Experience selling a cold email, sales engagement or martech product
* Experience selling to lead-gen or marketing agencies
* Hindi and Gujarati for Indian accounts

**How you're measured**
-----------------------

* Revenue against quota, meaning monthly new revenue closed from inbound and self-sourced deals. We share the quota at offer stage
* Inbound conversion, the share of assigned trial and demo leads you turn into paying customers
* Average ticket size per deal, and the share of deals you close on annual plans
* Open pipeline of at least 3x your monthly quota
* Speed to lead, the time from lead assignment to your first contact
* Follow-up consistency. Every open lead has a next step and a future task in the CRM
* Reply rate, positive reply rate and meetings booked from your own outbound campaigns
* CRM hygiene, with stages, meeting dates, close dates and lost reasons always up to date

**Your first 90 days**
----------------------

* By day 30 you're ready to sell. You know the product and deliverability basics well enough to run demos alone, and you've closed your first deals
* By day 60 you're at 70% or more of quota, your first outbound campaign is live, and your CRM stays clean without reminders
* By day 90 you're fully ramped and hitting 100% of quota consistently, with at least 30% of revenue from annual plans

**Why join us**
---------------

* A growing B2B SaaS product used by 25,000+ customers worldwide
* Uncapped incentives, so your earnings grow with your results
* Full ownership of the sales cycle, with real freedom over how you work
* You'll sell to US and EU founders, agencies and sales leaders every day
* Modern outbound and AI tools, and a path to senior AE or team lead roles as we scale

description:
**Job Description – Operations Executive (Visa)**

Job Summary

The Operations Executive – Visa is responsible for managing the end-to-end visa application process for individual and corporate clients. Documentation & Compliance

Operations & Record Management

* Ensure all client files are properly documented and archived.
* Maintain operational documentation and process records.

Quality Assurance

* Minimize application errors and document discrepancies.
* Ensure timely submission and collection of passports and documents.
* Maintain high service quality and customer satisfaction.
* Escalate critical cases or operational issues to the reporting manager promptly.

Team Coordination

* Work closely with the Sales, Customer Service, Finance, and Documentation teams.
* Assist colleagues during peak operational periods.
* Participate in process improvement initiatives and operational training programs.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of visa applications processed.
* Accuracy of documentation and submissions.
* Visa approval rate (where influenced by process quality).
* Turnaround time for application processing.
* Client satisfaction and response time.
* Compliance with embassy requirements.
* Error-free documentation.
* Timely updates in CRM/MIS.
* Adherence to internal processes and SOPs.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
* Diploma or certification in Travel & Tourism or Aviation is an added advantage.

Experience

* 1–3 years of experience in visa processing, travel operations, immigration services, or a similar operational role.

* Freshers with relevant internship experience and excellent communication skills may also be considered.

Technical Knowledge

Candidates should have knowledge of:

* Visa documentation requirements for multiple countries.
* Embassy and consulate procedures.
* VFS Global and BLS International processes.
* Passport regulations.
* Travel insurance requirements.
* Appointment scheduling systems.

Communication Skills

Personal Attributes

* Strong organizational skills.
* Accountability and ownership.

**Reporting To:** Accounts Head

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an **Accounts Executive** to manage day-to-day accounting activities for the **freight forwarding and CHA operations** of TICC. The role will be responsible for accounting, receivables, reconciliations, petty cash, verification of CHA/cargo/port expenses and coordination with the Accounts Head for statutory compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Purchase & Sales Accounting**

* Record and maintain purchase and sales invoices related to forwarding and CHA operations.
* Verify invoices, supporting documents and accounting entries.
* Ensure timely posting of transactions and proper ledger classification.
* Coordinate with internal teams for invoice discrepancies.

**2. Payment & Collection Follow-up**

* Follow up with customers for outstanding payments.
* Track receivables and maintain the outstanding/ageing report.
* Coordinate with vendors regarding pending payments and invoice-related queries.
* Escalate overdue and critical accounts to the **Branch Head**.

**3. Bank & Ledger Reconciliation**

* Prepare regular bank reconciliation statements.
* Reconcile customer, vendor and general ledgers.
* Identify and resolve reconciled entries and discrepancies.
* Ensure timely accounting of bank receipts, payments and adjustments.

**4. CHA, Cargo & Port Expense Verification**

* Check **daily CHA vouchers** and supporting documents for accuracy and completeness.
* Verify daily **cargo and port expenses** against approved documents, bills and job files.
* Ensure expenses are correctly recorded and allocated to the relevant shipment/job.
* Identify discrepancies, duplicate claims or unsupported expenses and report them to the concerned authority.
* Maintain proper records of verified expenses for accounting and audit purposes.

**5. Petty Cash Management**

* Maintain petty cash records and supporting documents.
* Verify bills and vouchers before processing expenses.
* Conduct regular petty cash reconciliation.

**6. GST & TDS Coordination**

* Prepare and share required **GST and TDS data with the Accounts Head** for review and compliance.
* Ensure invoices and accounting entries contain the required GST/TDS information.
* Support the Accounts Head with monthly/periodic GST and TDS activities.
* Provide supporting documents and reports as required.

**7. Tally & MIS Reporting**

* Maintain accurate accounting records in **Tally**.
* Prepare and submit outstanding, collection, expense and reconciliation reports.
* Ensure timely and accurate accounting entries.
* Maintain proper documentation and records for audit and management review.

description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.

  
  

**Global R2R Head / Director** : **FAP**

**Role Purpose**

The **Global R2R Head / Director** will provide strategic and operational leadership for the global Record-to-Report organization, with end-to-end accountability for service delivery, client outcomes, financial performance, operational excellence, transformation and talent.

The role will lead a large-scale global R2R organization supporting multiple geographies, entities, clients and finance operating models.

Beyond operational delivery, the leader will be responsible for building a scalable, technology-enabled finance operation, expanding the GCC/Global Delivery footprint, improving productivity and margins, strengthening controllership, and creating differentiated value for clients.

The leader will operate as a strategic partner to CFOs, Controllers, Global Finance leaders and business executives, while partnering closely with Sales, Solutioning, Technology, Transformation and Commercial leadership.

**1. Global R2R Leadership**

Own the complete global R2R portfolio covering:

* General Ledger
* Journal management
* Accruals and provisions
* Prepayments
* Fixed assets
* Intercompany accounting
* Balance-sheet reconciliations
* Month-end / quarter-end / year-end close
* Financial reporting
* Consolidation support
* Statutory accounting support
* Management reporting
* Accounting controls and compliance

Establish a globally standardized operating model while accommodating country and client-specific requirements.

**2. Organization & Scale**

Work with global organization potentially comprising ~5000 F&A professionals, depending on the delivery model and portfolio.

**3. P&L & Commercial Accountability**

The role will have meaningful financial accountability for the R2R business, including:

* Revenue
* Gross margin
* Cost-to-serve
* Productivity
* Utilization
* Workforce cost
* Offshore/onshore mix
* Pricing and commercial performance
* Contract profitability
* Transformation benefits

Partner with commercial teams on renewals, expansions, new business and pricing decisions.

**4. Client Leadership**

Serve as the senior operational executive for strategic global clients.

Build relationships with CFOs, Controllers, Finance Transformation leaders and senior client stakeholders.

**5. Transformation Mandate**

Lead the transformation of R2R from a traditional transaction-processing model toward:

**Standardized R2R** **Digital R2R** **Intelligent R2R** **Autonomous Finance**

Key priorities:

* Close acceleration
* Touchless accounting
* Automated reconciliations
* AI-assisted journal preparation
* Intelligent anomaly detection
* Predictive close
* Automated intercompany matching
* Process mining
* GenAI-enabled finance operations
* Digital controls
* Advanced finance analytics

Every transformation initiative should have measurable outcomes in cost, quality, speed, control or client value.

**6. Global Delivery Strategy**

Play a leadership role in expanding the Finance & Accounting Global Delivery footprint.

Responsibilities include:

* Establish global process ownership.
* Establish Centers of Excellence.

The leader should be capable of taking an R2R process from:

**Design** **Transition** **Stabilize** **Standardize** **Automate** **Scale**

**7. Operating Model Transformation**

Develop and continuously optimize the global F&A operating model.

Evaluate:

Retained Finance | Shared Services | Outsourcing | CoE | Automation

Determine the optimal location and ownership of each process based on:

* Cost
* Risk
* Complexity
* Talent
* Control
* Technology
* Client experience
* Strategic value

**8. Controls & Risk**

Ensure a robust controllership environment across the global operation.

Own governance around:

* SOX
* Internal controls
* Financial reporting controls
* Audit readiness
* Segregation of duties
* Risk management
* Compliance
* Control automation

The leader should maintain a zero-surprise culture around financial controls and audit.

**10. Strategic Innovation**

Create an **R2R Innovation Roadmap** covering:

* GenAI

title: Relationship Manager - Private Banking
description:
**Essential Services : Role & Location fungibility**

At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as
**One Bank, One Team**
. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be
**role and location-fungible**
with the understanding that
**Banking is an essential service**
. The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

**About the role**

As a Relationship Manager in Private Banking Group, you would act as a core anchor in taking our banking solutions and services to our valuable customers comprising of High Net worth Individuals, Family Offices and Institutions. This involves a 360-degree banking approach. The Relationship Managers should have an inclination to understand the customer needs and offer solutions in line with the needs that comprises of various asset classes and investment propositions. The core philosophy to hold is being “Fair to the Customer and Fair to the Bank”. At ICICI Bank, our customer-centric relationship managers are responsible for acquiring new customer relationships and increasing the wallet share of existing customer relationships with a resolute focus on service quality and customer delight. They collaborate and work with different internal teams, thereby offering the best in class customer service. In line with our philosophy of taking the entire bank to the customers, our relationship managers work on the whole suite of offerings like investment solutions covering equities, commodities, Mutual Funds, Insurance product amongst others. As a Relationship Manager, the focus is on ensuring the needs of the customers are covered through the customer-360 degree approach without any particular allegiance to product or domain.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Service:**
Create service excellence by partnering with customers through their life cycle and offering suitable products and services based on their financial needs while being fair to the customer and fair to the bank in all engagements.

**Business Development:**
Ensuring a growth in wallet share of existing customers and on boarding new customers by offering 360-degree banking solutions that meet the needs of our customers.

**Champion 360-degree banking:**
Offer products based on customer needs in collaboration with other internal teams in the bank for suitable product offerings.

**Enhance the portfolio quality:**
Work towards enhancing customer portfolio within the philosophy of Fair to Bank, Fair to Customer.

**Customised solutions:**
As per branch guidelines. Upkeep and maintaining of the branch. Ensure availability of necessary infrastructure in the branch.

**Behold our values:**
Offer products that are fair to our customers and fair to the bank.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Educational Qualification:**
MBA/PGDM with 2 years of experience/Graduates with 6 years in the area of relationship management, Business development or allied roles.

**Synergize with Team:**
Willingness to work with various teams for on-ground support and deliver enablers as required.

**Improvise:**
Develop and implement overarching sales and customer relationship strategy, sales processes and structure.

**Market Sensing:**
Monitor and evaluate industry trends, customer drivers and potential partnerships

**Communication:**
Good oral and written communication skills.

**About the Business group**

ICICI Bank’s Private Banking Group (PBG) offers comprehensive investment solutions and services to high net worth individuals and Family offices across India and international geographies. We emphasize on our high quality investment management services along with leading banking and allied group capabilities.

Fulfilling the investment needs and aspirations of our clients is our constant endeavour. After extensive in-house research, the group’s handpicked product offerings help our customers achieve their goals. With the team of experts, group reviews various assets classes along with market and economic conditions to produce incisive insights. These house views, along with rigorous due diligence, help our team of Relationship Managers to suggest a range of products across asset classes. As the financial goals are unique, group creates a tailor-made investment strategy according to the needs of the customers. This is done based on a thorough understanding of financial needs and keeping customers’ investment attitude in mind. The group also offers advisory on Trust Services and Succession Planning. Family Office proposition aims to strengthen the governance structure in family owned businesses.

Thus, emphasis is on a holistic approach towards financial and business goals. The strategic collaboration with global product providers enables us to construct unique solutions. It allows us to complement our core competencies with world class, third party capabilities to deliver solutions to customer's specific needs.

ABOUT THE ROLE

At Angroos, we help individuals and businesses turn thoughtful ideas into memorable gifts. We’re looking for a Corporate Sales Executive who enjoys connecting with people, understanding their requirements and bringing the details together.

You’ll handle corporate gifting enquiries, develop client relationships and coordinate with vendors and our team to turn enquiries into well-executed orders. Whether you’re starting your sales career or bringing previous experience, we’d like to hear from you.

description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector
  
  
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Sr. Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
* Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
* Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
* Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
* Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
