Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
* Experience developing and executing/delivering product and technical roadmaps influencing internal and external stakeholders
* Experience working with or evaluating AI systems
* Experience communicating and delivering presentations to customers, stakeholders, and/or teammates

As a Solutions Architect in GSD Industry Solutions (Healthcare and Life Sciences), you will combine deep HCLS domain fluency with direct Google Cloud and Generative/Agentic AI engineering expertise to take qualified, complex customer opportunities from defining requirements and architecting solutions through coding, rapid prototyping, implementation, and production rollout.
  
  
You will engage directly with customer C-suite, product, clinical, and engineering leaders to architect and build end-state cloud and agentic systems. Operating in a capacity, you will establish technical blueprints on strategic industry priorities, provide technical direction across cross-practice and partner delivery teams, write and review production-grade code for core architectural components aligned to the target architecture, and codify field-proven patterns into repeatable reference architectures, industry agents, and service offerings.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with customer product, clinical, and engineering stakeholders to translate complex healthcare and life sciences requirements into production-grade architectures and directly drive implementation engineering production-level code, building core agentic/RAG and data pipelines.
* Serve as the lead architectural advisor on strategic engagements, guiding design decisions, unblocking complex engineering challenges through coding, debugging, and performance tuning, data, infrastructure, and AI practices to ensure interoperability.
* Define and build standardized reference architectures, reusable Agentic workflows, and technical blueprints aligned to priority HCLS transformation themes.
* Architect and implement verifiable AI evaluation frameworks, PHI data-protection boundaries, source-citation grounding, human-in-the-loop governance into customer solutions.
* Collaborate with Google Cloud Product Management, Customer Engineering, and Regional Consulting teams to scope strategic engagements.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: Senior Application Engineer
description:
**About Us**
**Build the Future of Precision Engineering with UCAM**
**"UCAM manufactures world-class rotary tables and precision machine tools trusted by aerospace, defense, and automotive customers globally. Join a team of engineers and technicians who build things that matter with precision, at scale, from Bangalore".**
**Why Build Your Career at UCAM**

* Global Footprint, Indian Pride: Work on proprietary, high-precision engineering products designed and manufactured right here in Bangalore and exported worldwide.
* A Culture of Mastery: Surround yourself with brilliant technical minds who thrive on solving complex mechanical, kinematic, and structural puzzles.
* The Blueprint for Growth: Get hands-on experience in a highly sophisticated manufacturing environment, working with advanced CNC technologies and rigorous quality standards.
* Comprehensive Stability: We support our builders with robust health insurance, secure PF benefits, and reliable transport/commute facilities across our strategic hubs.

**Job Description**
**Dear All**
**We are looking for a technically strong and customer-focused Application Engineer to**
**support CNC gear manufacturing applications across customer trials, process**
**development, machine commissioning, and technical support activities.**
**The role involves working closely with customers, sales teams, tooling suppliers, and**
**machine development teams to deliver optimised gear manufacturing solutions through**
**technical evaluations, feasibility studies, process validation, and machine prove-outs.**
**The position offers hands-on exposure to advanced CNC gear hobbing technologies,**
**automation systems, process optimisation, and diverse gear manufacturing applications**
**across multiple industries.**
**Academic background :Diploma / Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering**
**Major Preferred :Mechanical Engineering**
**Work Experience :4-6 Years**
**Preferred Industry :Gear Cutting Machine tool industry**
**Main/ Essential Task**
**Customer &Technical Support**

* Support pre-sales activities through feasibility studies, technical discussions,

**cycle time analysis, and customer presentations.**

* Support machine trials, commissioning, customer training, and process

**troubleshooting activities.**
**Application & Process Development**

* Develop and optimise gear manufacturing processes for customer applications.
* Conduct component prove-outs, tooling trials, and process validation activities.
* Support application development for CNC gear hobbing and related gear cutting

**processes.**
**Technical Coordination &Documentation**

* Study customer requirements, engineering drawings, and manufacturing

**processes to recommend suitable machining solutions.**

* Prepare technical documents such as offers, cycle time studies, process sheets,

**and application reports.**

* Coordinate with sales, design, service teams, tooling suppliers, and customers

**during application development and project execution.**
**Competencies Required**
**Strong understanding of gear manufacturing processes, gear cutting**
**methodologies, tooling applications, machine setup, and process optimisation**
**for various gear components.**

* Understanding of CNC gear cutting machines, machine setup, process

**Parameters, And CNC Controls (Fanuc/Siemens Preferred).**

* Ability to study engineering drawings, customer requirements, and

**manufacturing processes for application development.**

* Knowledge of tooling selection, process optimisation, troubleshooting, and

**cycle time improvement.**

* Familiarity with gear metrology, inspection methods, and interpretation of

**measurement reports.**

* Strong problem-solving, communication, and customer-handling skills with

**willingness to travel for customer support activities.**
**Requirements**
**Skills Required**

* Strong technical and analytical problem-solving skills
* Good communication and customer interaction skills
* Ability to handle customer trials, troubleshooting, and application support

**activities independently**

* Coordination skills to work effectively with sales, design, production, and

**service teams**

* Willingness to travel for customer support, trials, and commissioning activities
* Adaptability and eagerness to learn new technologies and manufacturing

**processes**
**Benefits**
Transportation facility
  
  
Food facility

title: Presales head - India (HCM Functional presales)
description:
Darwinbox is competing for the most complex enterprise HCM transformations in the market and the conversation is changing. As we move toward an AI-native HCM future and launch Cortex, our AI product, we need a Presales leader who can connect business problems, enterprise transformation, product capability, and commercial value into a story CXOs cannot ignore
  
  
We’re not looking for someone who simply presents the product.
  
  
We’re looking for someone who can shape the customer's thinking before they shape the solution.
  
  
Your role as India presales head is to make Darwinbox impossible to ignore in the enterprise HCM + AI conversation - shaping deals early, elevating the quality of customer conversations, increasing win rates, and building a presales organization that can scale with the business.
  
  
**What This Role Is**

* You will lead India Presales and a team of ~10-15, partnering closely with Sales and senior leaders to shape strategic enterprise and mid-market deals. You will be the person in the room who can understand what a business is trying to change, challenge the way it is thinking about the problem, and translate that into a compelling Darwinbox solution and business case.
* This is equal parts transformation advisor, deal strategist, and presales leader with the opportunity to influence how Darwinbox takes its next generation of HCM and AI capabilities to market.

**What Work Looks Like**

* Shape the deal before the demo. Partner with Sales from the earliest conversations to understand the account, shape the buying journey, qualify opportunities, and build a differentiated solution and value story.
* Be a CXO-level transformation advisor. Engage business leaders across functions, understand their strategic priorities, and connect HCM transformation to measurable business outcomes.
* Make complexity simple. Translate complex enterprise requirements into clear solution narratives, compelling demonstrations, POCs, and transformation roadmaps.
* Lead the India Presales engine. Set the strategy, operating rhythm, standards, resource model, and talent agenda for a 10-15-member organization; build capability and future leaders.
* Create a winning market motion. Define solution-led GTM strategies for new markets and product lines, strengthen competitive positioning, and identify what will move enterprise buyers.
* Turn the market into product insight. Bring customer and competitive intelligence into Product, influence roadmap discussions, and ensure market needs are represented in product decisions.
* Build AI-native presales. Use AI and modern tooling to improve research, discovery, solutioning, demos, POCs, and presales productivity—and help the organization operate differently as Darwinbox becomes AI-native.
* Drive initiatives. Participate and lead organizations initiatives as they come up from time to time

**Role expectations**

* Think beyond the RFP. Help customers rethink the problem before responding to the requirement.
* Own the commercial outcome. Balance customer value, solution quality, deal strategy, and presales investment to improve revenue, win rates, and sales velocity.
* Raise the talent bar. Build a high-performing team through coaching, capability building, succession planning, and strong standards for enterprise solution consulting.
* Influence without waiting for authority. Work across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and leadership to move strategic opportunities and market priorities forward.
* Have a point of view. Bring conviction on enterprise HCM trends, competitive dynamics, AI, and how customers will buy and operate differently in the future.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 12–15+ years of experience with significant enterprise presales / solution consulting leadership; proven ability to lead and scale presales teams.
* strong understanding of HCM and enterprise technology; exceptional executive presence and storytelling; strong deal strategy and cross-functional influence; and a demonstrated ability to use AI and modern tooling to improve how presales operates.

**Why this role is different**
You won’t just help sell what Darwinbox has built. You’ll help shape how the market understands where enterprise HCM is going—and how Darwinbox, including Cortex, can lead that shift.
  
  
**About Darwinbox:**
Darwinbox is Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1400+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries.
  
  
Our vision of building a world-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.

title: Senior Technical Consultant - Loyalty Cloud
description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*
Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
Salesforce Professional Services focuses on delivering strategic engagements that define transformational opportunities and articulate clear plans for the execution of change programs. We rely on our team’s expertise and specialisms to engage with executive-level customers to agree on specific business goals and actions to ignite the full value of Salesforce. Our approach considers people, process, and technology — and a successful engagement includes recommendations to the business for change to support deeper, more relevant use of the Salesforce platform.
  
  
Role Description
  
  
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Senior Technical Consultant with a preferred expertise in Loyalty Cloud to provide our clients with strategic guidance, implementation, and support. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of Loyalty processes in different industries and hands-on technical consulting experience in a major software domain, along with proficiency in both English and French languages.
  
  
**Senior Technical consultants**
demonstrate thought leadership in technical aspects of customer and partner engagements that lead to the successful delivery of solutions, including enterprise integrations using middleware tools and platforms. As such, they are responsible for the analysis of options and subsequent presentations and education of the customer/partner. They will also identify and proactively handle risk areas, and commit to seeing issues through completion.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Collaborate with clients to understand their business requirements and translate them into Salesforce solutions leveraging Loyalty Cloud.
  
  
Design, configure, and customize Salesforce solutions to meet client needs, including but not limited to Loyalty processes.
  
  
Lead Salesforce implementation projects, including requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, and deployment.
  
  
Provide ongoing support and maintenance for Salesforce Loyalty Cloud implementations, including troubleshooting issues and optimizing system performance.
  
  
Develop and deliver training sessions and documentation for clients to enable them to effectively utilize Salesforce solutions.
  
  
Stay current on Salesforce best practices and industry trends, particularly related to Loyalty Cloud and proactively share knowledge with internal teams and clients.
  
  
Work independently and as part of a distributed team, taking ownership of problems and rapidly learning new technologies.
  
  
Build and maintain key relationships with key decision-makers, demonstrating strong presentation, communication, and facilitation skills.
  
  
Available to travel regionally and occasionally internationally depending on customer needs.
  
  
Contribute to broader goals by becoming a citizen philanthropist and giving back to our communities through volunteering activities.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field. Minimum of 5 years of experience working with Salesforce, with a focus on Loyalty cloud or Core, or equivalent experience in a similar role.
  
  
Proven track record of successful Salesforce implementations, including experience with full project lifecycle from requirements gathering to deployment.
  
  
Strong understanding of Loyalty cloud processes and best practices. Experience with Salesforce integrations, including third-party systems and APIs, is preferred.
  
  
Experience in defining and delivering enterprise applications on the Salesforce Platform, including coded solutions.
  
  
Salesforce certifications, such as Salesforce Certified Administrator, Salesforce Certified Platform App Builder, and Salesforce Certified Platform Developer, are a big plus.
  
  
Hands-on technical consulting and solution implementation experience for a major software domain (e.g., CRM, ERP, HR), including design skills in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, as well as coding experience in Apex and Lightning Web Components (LWC), or any other object-oriented languages/stack (Spring, Java, Angular, React, ...).
  
  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with clients and internal teams. Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Self-motivated and able to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment.
  
  
Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.
  
  
Accommodations
  
  
If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.
  
  
Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.
  
  
Posting Statement
  
  
Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Sr Business Consultant
description:
**All About Kantata**
Kantata provides the Kantata Cloud for Professional Services™, offering businesses the clarity, control, and confidence they need to optimize resource planning and elevate operational performance. Our purpose-built software is helping over 2,500 professional services organizations in more than 100 countries focus on and optimize their most important asset: their people. Kantata is well-capitalized, hiring, and growing our loyal and diversified customer base faster than ever. We have a clear vision of where we’re going and how to get there, and we're also an awesome place to work! You’ll have the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment with a team that loves what they do. A talented team, great perks, and an amazing culture make us an employee-rated Best Place to Work.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
As a Senior Business Consultant, you will drive the strategy of the Client solution, relative processes, configurations, and add ons to provide a Remarkable Client Experience. This includes providing tailored best practices and approaches to complex business use cases and needs, developing a configuration and business process strategy, and managing the Kantata implementation process.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
Delivery:
  
  

* Lead the solution strategy for the core Kantata solution liaising where needed with other delivery specialists to ensure a coherent, consistent and effective solution and implementation program.
* Understand Kantata’s technology, product offerings, service offerings, and industries served. Collaborate with the project team and client to understand all technical aspects and ensure the quality of deliverables.
* Identify, assess and solve complex business problems. Understand our clients’ business requirements and objectives while ensuring alignment with Kantata's solution and best practices to drive desired business results.
* Drive deployment activities such as requirements gathering, functional design, system testing, user acceptance testing, issue troubleshooting and resolution, change management, and training.
* Perform the full configuration of Kantata required for the deployment of the solution including custom reports, integrations, and data migrations as needed.
* Consult on both industry and Kantata best practices related to our clients.
* Effectively manage own tasks, task timelines and estimated remaining effort for services projects.
* Leverage Kantata’s implementation methodology and best practices to drive an efficient and successful Client implementation.
* Achieve high client success within the context of the project scope.

Tool Development:
  
  

* Contribute to the consultant tool set by identifying trends and facilitating updates to current tools and/or new tool development including (but not limited to)internal and external documentation as well as process improvements.

Practice Development:
  
  

* Seek opportunities to identify and foster improvements to organizational methodology, processes and practices
* Participate in the ongoing improvement of the Kantata product suite and the services implementation methodology. Build and share repeatable processes and quality deliverables that may be leveraged across multiple projects to increase efficiency and reduce costs.

Teamwork:
  
  

* Foster collaboration and teamwork through sharing experiences, information, perspectives, skills, and expertise.

What You Bring To The Role
  
  
Experience – Non-Technical
  
  

* Designing, configuring, and deploying SaaS-based software solutions, including custom reports/dashboards.
* Working in the services industry and/or experience working with a Professional Services Automation (PSA) solution is a plus.
* Implementing software with a demonstrated ability to execute to project plans, produce client facing deliverables
* Leading solution design workshops, defining business requirements and proposing business processes
* Documenting business requirements, business processes and technical specifications
* Building strong client relationships/partnerships with the consistent ability to keep the needs of the client at the forefront of his or her actions
* Working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment with autonomy
* Tackling difficult and complex problems
* Understanding scope management and how to identify potential risks to scope

‘
  
  
Experience - Technical
  
  

* Using or implementing common business applications
* Using or implementing common system integration methods and technologies including Web services preferred
* Working with relational databases and data interdependence preferred
* Designing, configuring, and deploying SaaS based software solutions preferred
* Using or implementing cloud-based or on-premise applications and architectures - web services, APIs and XML/JSON data structures is a plus.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; B.Tech or equivalent qualification preferred.
* 10+ years industry experience in a customer-facing technical field such as professional services, consulting or technical support
* Broad technical knowledge of internet based products and technologies.

EEOC Statement
  
  
Kantata is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions at Kantata are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

title: Associate
description:
**Key responsibilities**

**1. Client research and solutioning**

• Research on existing and target clients: strategy, financials, recent news, technology and data

initiatives. Track incumbent vendors and competitor moves at each account.

**2. Stakeholder mapping**

• Use LinkedIn (Sales Navigator) to find decision-makers, influencers and budget owners, e.g.

COO, CFO, CDO, heads of fund operations, finance and portfolio monitoring.

**3. Client and internal decks**

• Support in client-facing pitch decks, capability decks, proposals and RFP/RFI responses from the

storyline the lead sets; over time, draft the storyline yourself.

• Build internal collateral: account plans, quarterly business reviews, pipeline reviews, leadership

updates and deal approval packs.

**4. Marketing collateral**

• Draft outreach emails and follow-up sequences tailored by account and persona.

• Review one-pagers, case studies and point-of-view notes from the marketing team.

• Maintain a reusable library of slides, case studies and proof points.

**5. Finance and commercial management**

• Maintain budget, revenue forecast and pipeline trackers in Excel by account, month and service

line.

• Reconcile actuals vs forecast each month with the finance team and explain variances.

• Work with finance to diagnose revenue and EBITDA gaps by account, project and delivery mix,

and propose levers to close them.

**6. Cross-team coordination**

• Act as the single point of contact for pulling inputs from delivery, solutions, finance, marketing

and legal for proposals and reviews.

• Run trackers and timelines, chase inputs, and escalate early when a deadline is at risk.

• Write meeting notes and action logs after internal and client calls.

**Qualifications**

**Must-have**

• Bachelor's degree in engineering, commerce, economics or finance; an MBA (strategy, finance

or marketing) is preferred but 2–3 strong years can substitute.

• 2–3 years in one of: strategy or management consulting (analyst level), research and analytics

firms, presales or bid management in IT/data services, corporate strategy, FP&A, or investment research.

• Strong PowerPoint: can turn a rough brief into a 10–15 slide deck with a clear storyline, clean

charts and consistent formatting.

• Strong Excel: lookups, pivots, SUMIFS, driver-based forecasts and scenario tables.

**Good-to-have**

• Hands-on with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot or Dynamics)

• Fluent use of GenAI tools for research, drafting and deck building.

• Some clients exposure

Where to source

• Analysts and consultants (2–3 years) from Big 4 strategy and consulting practices.

• Research and analytics firms such as Evalueserve, The Smart Cube, Everest Group and Acuity

Knowledge Partners.

• Presales and bid teams at IT and data services firms (Infosys, Wipro, HCLTech, LTIMindtree,

Genpact, EXL).

• MBA graduates with 1–2 years post-MBA experience from strong tier-2 schools.

title: Sr.Client Account Manager (sales +Finance)
description: Job Description: The Central Account Manager (Control Tower) plays a critical role in managing client accounts across residential and commercial communities. The role ensures seamless delivery of services, ERP data accuracy, and high client satisfaction levels through centralized monitoring and coordination. The ideal candidate will manage client escalations, oversee operational reporting, and work closely with cross-functional teams to enhance service quality and ensure smooth ERP operations for all societies. Client Servicing & Relationship Management ● Manage end-to-end client relationships for assigned residential and commercial properties. ● Ensure consistent and high-quality service delivery in line with client expectations. ● Conduct periodic review calls and meetings with client representatives (RWA members, facility managers, etc.). ● Track client satisfaction and maintain target Net Promoter Scores (NPS). ● Build long-term relationships to ensure renewal, retention, and advocacy. description:

As a Senior Associate, you will play a critical role in supporting relationship teams through high-quality credit analysis, proactive risk management, and end-to-end portfolio management. * Perform detailed credit and financial analysis for corporate clients.
* Prepare high-quality credit submissions, annual reviews and risk assessments.
* Assess client business models, capital structures, financial performance and industry dynamics.
* Drive end-to-end credit processes including risk grading, credit approval, documentation review and portfolio monitoring.
* Manage a large and diverse portfolio while ensuring timely execution of key risk and credit deliverables.
* Monitor portfolio quality in line with ANZ's well-managed principles, regulatory requirements and internal policies.
* Partner with Relationship Managers, Credit teams, Legal and other support functions on transaction and risk-related matters.

* Proven ability to analyse complex business and industry information and translate insights into clear credit recommendations.
* Excellent report writing and financial modelling capabilities.
* Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes within tight timelines.

**So why join us?**
ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. title: AVP, FP&A
description:
**About Revantage**
Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services.
  
  
With a corporate purpose of ‘In Pursuit of Better,’ Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company’s footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.
  
  
Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry.
  
  
In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform.
  
  
**India**
With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.
  
  
Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly
**Build What Matters.**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Director – Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India.
  
  
The Director – FP&A leads the Bengaluru-based FP&A team in the execution of forecasting, management reporting and financial analysis across ACC’s portfolio. The role is accountable for the quality, accuracy and timely delivery of the team’s output, including performance analysis, planning-model integrity and the effective offshore-to-onshore handoff.
  
  
The Director works closely with US-based FP&A leadership and stakeholders across Operations, Leasing & Marketing, Accounting, Asset Management and other functions to support budgeting, forecasting, management reporting and business analysis. The role provides analytical and operational leadership cross-functionally to ACC’s Bengaluru-based team, strengthens planning and reporting processes, and identifies opportunities to improve automation, scalability and forecast quality.
  
  
**Primary Role**

* Lead and develop the Bengaluru-based FP&A team’s execution of recurring forecasting, budgeting and management reporting activities, ensuring accurate and timely delivery of financial outputs for onshore review.
* Lead first-pass analysis of portfolio performance, including actual-to-budget and forecast variances, operating drivers, trends, risks and opportunities, and ensure material findings are clearly identified and escalated to onshore FP&A leadership.
* Maintain the integrity of planning models within Oracle Fusion EPM, including driver logic, dimensional structures, allocations and report definitions, using Excel as an analytical and audit layer rather than the system of record.
* Lead the offshore preparation and review of monthly management reporting, ensuring financial and non-financial KPIs are complete, accurate and supported by appropriate variance and driver analysis prior to onshore review.
* Manage the offshore FP&A operating calendar and time-zone handoff, translating onshore priorities into clear deliverables, managing workload and capacity, and proactively identifying risks to timely completion.
* Maintain data integrity within Oracle Fusion EPM, monitoring integrations from operational, leasing and other source systems and escalating data-quality issues as appropriate.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators for the Bengaluru-based FP&A team, including timeliness of recurring deliverables, forecast and reporting cycle adherence, quality of work product, unresolved issues and other measures of execution effectiveness and service to the onshore team.
* Partner closely with US-based FP&A leadership and Operations stakeholders to support forecast development, variance analysis and other financial analysis, while maintaining clear alignment on priorities and deliverables.
* Manage and develop the FP&A team, establishing clear performance expectations, allocating workload, managing priorities and developing team capability through coaching, training and ongoing performance management.
* Partner with US-based FP&A leadership and Revantage India on staffing, hiring, formal performance management and organizational development to ensure the offshore team has the appropriate capacity and capabilities to support the business.
* Identify and drive improvements to FP&A models, workflows, systems and automation in coordination with US-based leadership to enhance forecast quality, reduce manual effort and improve scalability.
* Assist with the development and maintenance of business reporting in ACC Business Intelligence platform (PowerBI)
* Maintain clear documentation of key planning models, recurring analyses, processes and offshore-to-onshore handoffs to support consistency, controls and team continuity.
* Work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with working hours aligned to provide meaningful daily overlap with US business hours; flexibility is expected during budgeting, forecasting, month-end reporting and other peak planning cycles.
* Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Commerce or Business; a postgraduate qualification such as an MBA (Finance), CA, CMA or CFA is preferred.
* Five to eight years of combined experience in financial planning and analysis, including prior experience leading an analytics or reporting team.
* Hands-on administration of an enterprise planning or ERP platform, with Oracle Fusion strongly preferred — driver-based modelling, dimensions, allocations and report design.
* Exposure to real estate, student housing or multi-family operations is preferred, including familiarity with leasing and marketing, property management and asset management practices.
* Strong financial modelling and forecasting capability, with advanced Excel skills used as an analytical and audit layer over the planning system.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain data integrity and validation within an integrated ERP environment, including monitoring source-system integrations and escalating issues.
* Proven ability to lead and develop a small team across time zones, and to translate onshore priorities into structured offshore work plans.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in business English, with the ability to explain analysis and recommendations to onshore leaders and senior stakeholders.
* Strong project and time management skills, with the ability to track, prioritise and drive multiple concurrent deliverables to completion in a fast-paced environment.
* High attention to detail and a quality-control mindset, with the ability to review others' work and ensure the accuracy of the team's output.
* Self-starter with sound judgement, high energy and ownership, comfortable driving process and change in a dynamic, multi–time-zone operating environment.
* Familiarity with reporting and visualisation tools such as Power BI or comparable platforms is desirable.

title: Processing Cost Analyst
description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Product Accounting team at Stripe supports products across Stripe by providing guidance on accounting implications and enabling teams to make informed strategic decisions. The team records business transactions accurately and on time in the balance sheet and income statement, and partners with cross-functional and international teams in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
You'll join the Product Accounting team to support payment processing cost accounting. You'll use your technical expertise in US GAAP, including ASC 606, to identify accounting implications, advise cross-functional partners, and develop operating processes that help Stripe scale.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Build scalable accounting processes to support global growth in payment processing cost accounting
* Partner with product, go-to-market, and Finance teams to understand new products, features, and contracts
* Partner with systems and engineering teams to improve financial systems and automate accounting processes
* Assess the effectiveness of internal controls and design processes and controls for emerging business activities
* Develop and maintain current accounting procedure documentation
* Plan and perform monthly and quarterly close activities, including journal entries, balance-sheet reconciliations, variance analyses, financial reporting deliverables, and reviews
* Produce management analyses and reporting, and support external audit processes

Who you are
  
  
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* Professional accountancy qualification, such as CA, CPA, ACA, ACCA, or CIMA, and 2–3 years of relevant accounting experience
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
* Experience with monthly or quarterly close processes, journal-entry preparation and posting, audits, regulatory reporting, financial-statement preparation, and accounting systems
* Working knowledge of US GAAP, including ASC 606, and experience with internal controls
* Ability to structure ambiguous work, solve problems using Excel, build systems and automation, collaborate across functions and cultures, and adapt to changing requirements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in the technology or payments industry
* Experience with Oracle Suite
* Experience with data-querying and analysis tools, including SQL
* Experience with data-analysis tools, such as Power BI, Tableau, KNIME, Python, or Alteryx

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

**Hello. We’re Blood.**

**Our purpose is to revolutionize periods.**

**Who are we?**

Blood is a challenger brand in the period care space. We exist to challenge taboos, push boundaries, and help people with periods to bleed unapologetically. Our focus on deeply understanding our users drives our innovation in creating products that are both high performing, and better for their bodies and skin.

Blood is the creator of the world’s first Sanitary Pad made from Corn, and is the parent brand of MenstruHeat (menstrual cramp relief).

We’re scaling fast across Asia, with our core markets in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, and our newest market, India. Selling online and across more than 7,000 retail stores - making more than 12 million periods better so far.

**Today was good. Tomorrow will bleed better.**

**Why India, why now**

India is the biggest period care opportunity on earth and one of the least served. Most of the market still runs on skin-irritating products designed decades ago. Quick commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart) has torn down the distribution wall that used to keep challenger brands out for years. We can now reach millions in months, instead of decades.

We've proven product-market fit across markets in Southeast Asia, and India is where we prove it at an even larger scale. You'd join at the first inning, and help write our India story together.

**Who we’re looking for / The role**

We're looking for a dynamic
**Business Finance Manager**
to own the money math behind Blood's India launch across quick commerce, marketplaces, and D2C.

You'll own channel-level profitability, budgeting, settlement, receivables & payable settlement reconciliation across Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart, Amazon, and other channels, making sure growth stays profitable, with good and accurate cash flows.

This is a high-impact, high-ownership role for someone who thrives under ambiguity and can build finance systems from scratch while keeping monthly closes and reporting on track.

* 30% – Own receivables and working capital, collection follow-ups, ageing analysis and cash-flow visibility, monthly ledger reconciliation with all ecommerce/quick commerce platform

* 5% - Regularly liaise with Business and Operations teams to validate numbers, understand variances and drive timely action
* 5%: Local books. Work with our external bookkeeping partner, and progressively take over their bookkeeping and reporting scope as the business grows.

**Ideal candidate**

* 4-7+ years of experience in business finance, or commercial finance, ideally in D2C/e-commerce or quick commerce brand
* Hands-on experience with quick commerce/marketplace settlement structures (PLA/SOR/OR models, platform deductions and claims) is a strong plus
* Startup experience preferred - comfortable with ambiguity, limited hand-holding, and building financial systems from scratch rather than inheriting one
* Entrepreneurial, detail-obsessed, and analytical - the kind of person who catches the margin leak or reconciliation gap nobody else is watching

title: Treasury & India Controllership Assistant Manager
description:
**About OpenFX**
OpenFX is on a mission to
**move money as freely as data, unrestricted by time zones, banking hours, or legacy systems.**
We are building the infrastructure that will power the next generation of cross-border payment systems for institutions. The team’s execution has been exceptional, and we’re scaling at a remarkable pace. Our stellar early team comes with experience in companies like J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, FalconX, PayPal, Affirm, Polygon, Kraken, Nium & others. We’re backed by Accel, Lightspeed, NFX and other top-tier investors.
  
  
**The Role**
We are hiring an Assistant Manager to cover three areas: day-to-day treasury operations for the group, controls over payroll, and the books and compliance of our India entity, including its statutory audit. Most of the work runs on a fixed daily, monthly and annual calendar. By day 90 you run routine treasury, payroll controls and the India close yourself, with your manager reviewing exceptions. Money movement always keeps a second approver.
  
  
The role reports to the Finance Lead, India, and works closely with the Group Finance team.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Prepare and execute treasury transactions: drawdowns and repayments under lending facilities, FX and funding trades, and funding of group bank accounts in the UAE and elsewhere
* Track the group’s daily cash position across banks and wallets, maintain a rolling cash forecast, and track facility balances, interest, repayment dates and lender reporting
* Review each month’s payroll before approval against the HR system and payroll inputs tracker, covering joiners, exits, final settlements, bonuses and compensation changes
* Run contractor accruals and payouts, verify employee bank-detail changes, and log and fix payroll exceptions with a root-cause note
* Keep the India entity’s books in Zoho Books on an accrual basis and close within the first 3 business days of each month, with MIS and P&L inputs for the group flash P&L
* Own the India statutory audit end to end, from audit plan and PBC lists through signed financial statements and the AOC-4 filing
* Run TDS, GST, PF and Karnataka Professional Tax compliance, and prepare data for the tax audit, income tax return, transfer pricing and MCA filings with external advisors and the company secretary
* Review employee expenses and corporate card spend (Zoho Expense, Brex) against policy, and work with the AP analyst on vendor payments and approval flows in Zip
* Connect Zoho Books to group systems and automate recurring checks and journals with the group’s AI and data tools

**What We Are Looking For (Must Haves)**

* CA, CA Inter, ACCA or CMA with 4 to 5 years in accounting or finance operations in India (startup, fintech or Big 4)
* Accrual-basis bookkeeping and month-end close experience for an Indian private limited company
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS, PF and PT compliance, and hands-on experience of a statutory audit from the auditee or auditor side
* Treasury operations exposure: payments, FX, cash forecasting, lending facilities or bank administration
* Payroll review experience, and the judgement to handle confidential pay data
* Accuracy and integrity with money movement: you follow maker-checker controls without exception
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets, and comfort learning tools such as Zoho Books, RazorpayX, Brex and Zip
* Clear written English, to work daily with a global finance team across time zones

**What We Are Looking For (Good To Have)**

* Fintech, FX or digital-asset exposure (stablecoins, wallets, exchanges, liquidity providers)
* FEMA/RBI compliance for an Indian subsidiary of a foreign group, including FIRCs and inward remittances
* Experience automating finance work with scripts, AI tools or integrations

What we offer
  
  
Competitive salary and benefits, equity, and a fast-moving fintech environment with real ownership across treasury, payroll controls and the India books.
  
  
OpenFX is an equal opportunity employer.
  
  
We are an In-Office Company and hence expect our colleagues to collaborate and innovate while being present in the Office.

title: (IND) SENIOR MANAGER, FINANCE
description:
**Job Summary**
The Senior Finance Manager will lead a team of Finance Managers providing end-to-end FP&A support to Walmart US Commercial Finance teams. The role combines deep functional expertise, people leadership and stakeholder partnership to drive financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis and decision support.
  
  
A key focus of the role is to lead the shift toward AI-enabled finance, reimagining workflows, embedding AI and automation into day-to-day processes, and building the team’s capabilities to deliver faster, more forward-looking insights. The incumbent will be accountable for the quality and impact of the team’s work while maintaining strong financial controls and governance.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Finance CoE team at Walmart Global Tech Bangalore provides end-to-end FP&A support to Commercial Finance teams across Walmart segments, including Walmart US, Sam’s Club, International and Corporate. The team drives financial planning, reporting, analytics and transformation initiatives with a focus on accuracy, governance and business impact.
  
  
The CoE is evolving its ways of working by combining finance expertise with AI, automation and analytics to reduce manual effort, improve decision support and create more capacity for business partnership.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  
Lead and develop the team: Manage a team of Finance Managers, providing direction, coaching and feedback. Build financial, analytical and AI capabilities while fostering a culture of ownership, curiosity and continuous improvement.
  
  
Own FP&A delivery: Lead planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting and performance management across the assigned portfolio, ensuring timely, accurate and insightful outputs.
  
  
Bring functional depth: Guide the team on complex financial analysis, P&L management, financial modeling, consolidation and cost center analysis. Challenge assumptions and apply sound judgment to resolve complex issues.
  
  
Lead AI-enabled transformation: Identify and prioritize opportunities to reimagine recurring finance workflows using AI, GenAI and automation. Partner with finance, technology and analytics teams to design, implement and scale practical solutions.
  
  
Embed AI into ways of working: Encourage experimentation and adoption across the team, share effective practices and equip managers to use AI tools in their work. Track outcomes such as time saved, improved accuracy and faster access to insights.
  
  
Drive business insights: Translate financial results and operational drivers into forward-looking perspectives on performance, risks and opportunities. Use analytical and AI-enabled tools to deepen insights and recommend actions.
  
  
Partner with business leaders: Build strong relationships with Walmart US Commercial Finance stakeholders, understand their priorities and influence decisions through clear, data-driven insights.
  
  
Manage priorities and capacity: Allocate work across the team, balance recurring and ad hoc requirements, and ensure continuity and quality of delivery.
  
  
Strengthen governance: Establish effective controls, review mechanisms and documentation for both traditional and AI-enabled processes, including validation of outputs and appropriate handling of data.
  
  
Collaborate across teams: Work with finance, business, technology and analytics partners to align priorities, resolve issues and deliver outcomes.
  
  
What You’ll Bring
  
  
Chartered Accountant or equivalent qualification, with 12–15 years of relevant FP&A or corporate finance experience.
  
  
Experience leading, coaching and developing finance professionals, including managers or team leads.
  
  
Strong functional expertise in financial planning, forecasting, performance management, P&L analysis and financial modeling.
  
  
Practical experience using AI, GenAI or automation to improve finance workflows, with the ability to identify use cases, evaluate outputs and drive adoption.
  
  
A transformation mindset and curiosity to challenge existing processes, experiment with new tools and translate ideas into measurable outcomes.
  
  
Ability to connect financial and operational drivers, challenge assumptions and translate analysis into actionable recommendations.
  
  
Proven experience partnering with and influencing senior stakeholders in a global, matrixed environment.
  
  
Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to simplify complex financial topics for leadership.
  
  
Experience managing multiple priorities, team capacity and delivery across a diverse portfolio.
  
  
Familiarity with financial systems such as SAP, Hyperion, Essbase or OneStream, along with advanced Excel and Power BI.
  
  
Sound judgment in validating AI-generated outputs and maintaining appropriate data, financial and process controls.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate on a scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our Bangalore office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

**Job Overview**
Putting the right person in the right role is life-changing — for the individual and for the organization. That's not a tagline. It's the reason we come to work. We've applied 35 years of assessment science to one of the hardest problems in business, helping thousands of organizations hire with more confidence and less guesswork. Now we're entering our most exciting chapter yet — new products, a sharpened focus, and a market that genuinely needs what we've built.
  
  
The people here are something else. Smart, authentic, genuinely invested in the work and in each other. This isn't a place where you coast — you'll be pushed and expected to deliver. But you'll do it alongside people who care, led by a vision that's worth working hard for.
  
  
If that sounds like your kind of place, we'd love to meet you.
  
  
As a GRC Analyst at Harver, you will own the governance, risk, and compliance work that keeps our deals moving and our customers' data safe. This is a blend of roles in one: part contract reviewer, part due diligence partner, and part platform and policy subject matter expert. Your primary responsibilities are sales-adjacent but not customer-facing in a meeting setting. You will review and redline customer contracts, complete security and due diligence questionnaires, and communicate with clients primarily by email, all with a sharp eye for what Harver can and cannot agree to. You will also be a key part of the GRC team, including assisting in policy work, leading vendor management work, and working on internal and external audit engagements.
  
  
You will get to know Harver's platforms, including Symphony, and the procedures that keep our data secure, deeply enough to become a go-to expert on them. You don't need to be a technical or legal professional, but you do need to be able to put on your "lawyer hat" to parse contract language and understand its implications. This is a role we can train for, and it's ideal for a detail-oriented, scrupulous person who enjoys policy and governance work. Your impact will be measured in part through KPIs tied directly to contracts, ARR, and the velocity at which we turn over deals.
  
  
You will work closely with our GRC team, who will help ramp you up over your first few months, and collaborate across the organization, including working closely with Sales, Legal, Product, Customer Success, and Privacy. This role offers meaningful ways to grow as a GRC generalist while supporting business outcomes.
  
  
If you’re passionate about working in a dynamic, fast-growing company — with cutting-edge technology, smart colleagues, and opportunities for development — come grow with us!
  
  
**In This Role You Get To**

* Review and redline customer contracts, determining which terms Harver can agree to and flagging risk
* Complete due diligence work, including receiving, processing, and responding to customer security and compliance questionnaires
* Partner with Sales and other internal teams to keep deals moving and shorten contract turnaround time
* Become a subject matter expert on Harver's platforms, including Symphony, and the policies and procedures that keep our data secure
* Support governance efforts by working with company policies and helping keep them current and consistently applied
* Communicate with clients via email to clarify contract and questionnaire items
* Track and report on KPIs tied to contract volume, ARR impact, and deal velocity
* Support internal and external audits by gathering evidence and helping maintain policies and procedures
* Manage requests from go-to-market teams in Salesforce, and work in Vanta and customer-supplied trust portals
* Operate within our governance frameworks, owning workstreams like vendor intake and lifecycle management or access reviews
* Find ways to use AI and automation to make GRC work faster and more efficient

**We’re Looking For People Who Have**

* 1–2 years of experience in GRC or a related detail-driven role, such as junior internal audit, compliance, contracts, or procurement (the higher end is better for GRC experience)
* Exceptional attention to detail and a scrupulous, methodical approach to your work
* The ability to read, parse, and interpret contract language and assess whether terms are acceptable (no formal legal experience required)
* Interest in or experience with policy, governance, risk, and compliance work
* Internal or external audit experience (a plus)
* Strong written communication skills for professional client correspondence
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and other productivity software
* Curiosity about AI and a drive to automate and make work more efficient
* A willingness to learn complex platforms and procedures in depth
* Comfort with, or a strong interest in, understanding and speaking the language of data security (a plus; technical expertise is not required)
* The ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines in a fast-paced environment
* A collaborative mindset: you will be a connector of knowledge who knows who to reach out to across teams
* A relevant certification, such as CISA (a plus)

**Programs You Will Use**

* Vanta, our primary GRC platform
* Salesforce, where requests from go-to-market teams come in
* Customer-supplied trust portals
* Microsoft Word and Excel
* Harver’s platforms, including Symphony, which you will learn in depth
* The AI capabilities built into these platforms
* Email for client correspondence

Pssst… you don’t have to check all the boxes to apply!
  
  
**The Benefits Of Working At Harver**
As a global company, our benefits vary by location. Ask your recruiter to provide information about localized benefits. Harverians enjoy:
  
  

* Comprehensive insurance coverage and benefits plan
* Competitive salary
* Open and inclusive work culture
* Opportunities to work across projects

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

title: Practising Company Secretary
description:
We are looking for a CS Intern / Full-time Company Secretary - Corporate Affairs to work closely with the founding and finance teams at Variabl.

This role is ideal for Qualified Company Secretary (CS) or Practising Company Secretary wants to work exclusively with Variabl clients or a Qualified CS who wants to start practice who wants hands-on exposure to corporate compliance, governance, and legal operations within a fast-growing startup.

You will work across Companies Act compliance, MCA/ROC filings, corporate documentation, regulatory research, and day-to-day corporate affairs.

A. Corporate Compliance & MCA/ROC Filings

1. Assist with MCA and ROC filings and maintain compliance trackers for the company.

2. Support routine compliances under the Companies Act, 2013, including annual filings, board and shareholder compliances, and director-related filings.

3. Assist with share capital and allotment-related documentation.

4. Maintain statutory registers and corporate records.

5. Track statutory deadlines and maintain the company's corporate compliance calendar.

B. Corporate Documentation

1. Assist in preparing board resolutions and shareholder resolutions.

2. Prepare notices, minutes, consent letters, corporate declarations, and other secretarial documents.

3. Assist with legal documentation, basic agreements, NDAs, engagement letters, and corporate records.

4. Maintain organized digital records of incorporation documents, filings, certificates, agreements, and statutory documents.

C. Legal & Regulatory Research

1. Research the Companies Act, MCA, FEMA, and other corporate and regulatory requirements relevant to the business.

2. Track regulatory changes and prepare short internal notes explaining their potential impact on the company.

3. Support the team in understanding and addressing routine corporate and regulatory requirements.

D. Coordination & Corporate Affairs

1. Coordinate with practicing company secretaries, chartered accountants, lawyers, and other external professionals for filings and regulatory matters.

2. Support the founders and finance team with ad hoc corporate affairs, legal, and compliance matters.

3. Assist with the day-to-day management of corporate compliance and legal operations.

Other requirements

1. Candidates who are Qualified CS or Practising CS ready to work exclusively with Variabl clients.

2. Basic understanding of the Companies Act, 2013.

3. Comfortable navigating the MCA portal.

4. Strong research and documentation skills.

5. Extremely detail-oriented and organized.

6. Clear and effective written English communication skills.

7. Comfortable taking ownership of compliance trackers and statutory deadlines.

8. Strong interest in gaining practical exposure beyond textbook knowledge of company law.

This is a hands-on role that provides practical exposure to corporate compliance and allows you to understand how legal and compliance processes are executed within a company.
