The role drives consistency in contract management practices by establishing clear frameworks, maintaining high-quality contract data and supporting the fulfilment of contractual, regulatory and risk management requirements. Through effective governance, lifecycle oversight and stakeholder engagement, the role helps improve contract outcomes, reduce operational risk and enhance the overall effectiveness of supplier and contract management activities.
  
  
The role also contributes to the evolution of the contract management capability through process optimisation, technology adoption, data-driven insight and continuous improvement initiatives that increase efficiency, transparency and control across the contract portfolio.
  
  
This generalist role serves as the primary resource to provide triage support services to incoming requests, tasks or actions to ensure that Contract Managers/Owners receive the necessary guidance and support to meet their contract management and ownership obligations throughout the entire contract lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strengthen Contract Lifecycle Effectiveness**

* Implement support operating model and contract management practices for your assigned category or domain to deliver consistent CMS support and stronger outcomes.
* Monitor and manage queries and requests from stakeholders; channel them to the right colleague or SMEs in CMS Category teams to provide the responses in a timely and effective manner.
* Maintain visibility of key contract activities, milestones, commitments and renewal events to support effective contract ownership.
* Support the successful transition of contracts into operational management and ensure critical lifecycle requirements are completed.
* Improve the quality and consistency of contract management outcomes across contract portfolios and business areas.

**Strengthen Governance, Compliance and Control**

* Promote adherence to contractual requirements, internal standards and regulatory obligations throughout the contract lifecycle.
* Maintain transparent, accurate and auditable contract information that supports effective governance and oversight.
* Identify and address contract-related risks, control weaknesses and compliance issues in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.

Strengthen confidence in contract management activities through disciplined governance and effective controls.
  
  
**Improve Contract Visibility and Decision-Making**

* Provide support for developing reports and dashboards; generate weekly/monthly reports
* Maintain high standards of contract data quality, reporting and management information.
* Generate insights that improve understanding of contract performance, obligations, risks and opportunities
* Leverage analysis and reporting to support prioritisation, decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Enhance organisational visibility of contract commitments, key dates and operational dependencies.

**Optimise Contract Management Operations**

* Simplify processes, improve efficiency, and monitor and enhance the end-user experience.
* Help build scalable and sustainable support and contract management practices that meet evolving business needs.
* Promote standardisation, automation and technology adoption to increase consistency and operational effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to reduce operational friction and strengthen contract management outcomes.

**Advance Contract Management Capability**

* Foster strong partnerships with all CMS Category Teams, Contract Managers, Contract Owners and Supply Chain stakeholders to improve contract management outcomes.
* Strengthen understanding of contract ownership responsibilities, lifecycle obligations and governance expectations.
* Support the adoption of best practices, tools and ways of working that improve contract management maturity.
* Contribute to the continued development of the Contract Management Services capability through innovation, knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
* Own your development; agree and deliver a personal skills and learning plan with your line manager.

**Skills And Experience**
**Priority Skills**
Contract Lifecycle Management
  
  

* Contract Lifecycle Management involves overseeing the creation, execution, and analysis of contracts to maximize operational and financial performance and minimize risk. Key responsibilities include negotiating terms, ensuring compliance, and facilitating amendments and renewals. A distinctive feature of this skill is its ability to integrate with legal and financial frameworks to optimize contract terms

Supplier Contract Management
  
  

* Supplier Contract Management involves handling and optimizing contractual agreements with suppliers to ensure compliance and maximize value. Key responsibilities include negotiating terms, monitoring performance, and managing renewals. Its distinctive feature is the strategic alignment of contract terms with organizational goals to drive efficiency and reduce procurement costs.

Contract Documentation
  
  

* Contract Documentation involves the creation and management of formal agreements between parties, ensuring clarity, compliance, and enforceability. Key responsibilities include drafting, reviewing, and amending contractual agreements. Its distinctive feature is the meticulous attention to legal details and terms that can significantly impact the rights and obligations of the parties involved.

Compliance Management
  
  

* Compliance Management involves ensuring a company adheres to legal standards and regulations relevant to its business operations. Key responsibilities include identifying applicable laws, educating employees on compliance requirements, and implementing necessary controls. A distinctive feature of this skill is the proactive management of compliance risk, which prevents legal penalties and maintains company integrity.

Regulatory Compliance
  
  

* Regulatory Compliance ensures adherence to laws, regulations, guidelines, and specifications relevant to specific industries or processes. A primary responsibility is interpreting and implementing approved standards and procedures to prevent non-compliance issues. Its distinctive feature is its application across varying sectors, requiring customized understanding and

Risk Management
  
  

* Risk Management identifies, assesses, and prioritizes risks to minimize, monitor, and control the probability or impact of unfortunate events. Key responsibilities include risk analysis and developing strategies to manage potential threats. Its distinctive feature is the systematic approach to uncertainty, focusing on achieving greater security and reducing unexpected costs in project and business environments.

Issue Management
  
  

* Issue Management involves identifying, analysing, and resolving issues throughout the lifecycle of a project or operation, ensuring minimal disruption to the workflow. Key responsibilities include timely issue detection, prioritization based on impact, and implementation of effective solutions. Its distinctive feature is its structured approach to problem-solving which often includes rigorous documentation and follow-up, setting it apart from more informal resolution practices.

Operations Optimization
  
  

* Operations Optimization focuses on enhancing business processes and systems to increase efficiency and reduce costs. Key responsibilities include analysing current operations, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing solutions for improvement. Its distinctive feature is the application of methodologies like Lean and Six Sigma, which are tailored to minimize waste and maximize value in operational activities.

Data Analysis
  
  

* Data Analysis involves extracting insights and trends from raw data to support decision-making processes. Key responsibilities include collecting data, applying statistical methods, and interpreting results. A distinctive feature of this skill is its application across diverse industries such as finance, marketing, and healthcare, providing custom analytics solutions critical for strategic planning.

Financial Services
  
  

* Financial Services encompass managing money, investments, and other financial instruments for individuals and organizations. Key responsibilities include analysis of financial markets, advising on investment opportunities, and managing risk. A distinctive feature of this skill is the expertise in regulatory compliance and the ability to adapt strategies based on market conditions.

**Other Skills**
Strategy Development
  
  

* Strategy Development involves formulating plans to achieve specific organizational goals, focusing on long-term business growth and competitive positioning. Key responsibilities include analysing market trends, aligning resources with business objectives, and setting actionable milestones. A distinctive feature of this skill is its emphasis on a holistic view of the organization and its environment, enabling sustainable decision-making based on comprehensive analysis.

Talent Development
  
  

* Talent Development focuses on enhancing the skills and capabilities of an organization's workforce, fostering personal and professional growth. Key responsibilities include designing and implementing training programs and assessing their effectiveness in promoting career advancement. Its distinctive feature is its strategic alignment with organizational goals, ensuring that employee growth supports overarching business objectives.

Technology Adoption
  
  

* Technology Adoption involves the skilful implementation and integration of new technologies within a business environment to enhance operational efficiency and competitive advantage. Key responsibilities include assessing technological needs, facilitating user training, and managing the change process. A distinctive feature of this skill is its focus on achieving high user acceptance and maximizing the return on technological investments through strategic deployment and support.

Innovation Leadership
  
  

* Innovation Leadership fosters a culture of creativity and forward-thinking within an organization. The primary responsibilities include inspiring and managing teams to generate breakthrough ideas and solutions, while navigating through complex changes and technologies. Its distinctive feature lies in its focus on transforming traditional business approaches and introducing new, disruptive technologies or methodologies that significantly impact the market and organizational growth.

**Motivations**

* Creating structure, transparency and control across complex contract portfolios.
* Improving processes and operational practices to deliver more efficient and effective outcomes.
* Using data, insight and analysis to strengthen decision-making and governance.
* Solving contract, compliance and operational challenges through collaboration and problem-solving.
* Building scalable approaches that improve how contracts are managed across the organisation.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Contract Law, or a related field.
* 1-3 years of experience in procurement and/or contract management, business analyst and/or supplier management
* Basic knowledge of procurement and/or contract management services and operations.
* Attention to detail and fast learner who can work in a dynamic and evolving environment.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.

* Basic proficiency in procurement and contract management processes and systems and competency in software and reporting tools, including AI applications.

**Non-mandatory**

* Experience applying contract governance, compliance or risk management requirements within a regulated or controlled environment.
* Experience maintaining contract records, reporting, management information or data quality to support effective oversight and decision-making.

title: Company Secretary
description:
**About us:**

Goodera is the world’s leading employee volunteering platform, powering companies to scale employee volunteering experiences globally through our innovative technology platform and unique operating model. With a presence in over 100 countries and support for 30+ languages, we connect over 500 clients - including 60+ Fortune 500 companies with meaningful volunteer opportunities tailored to their communities. To date, our impact has reached over 10 million beneficiaries, powered by 1 million+ employee volunteers and a network of 50,000+ nonprofit partners. Growing at 100% year on year, we are backed by top investors including Zoom Ventures, Elevation Capital, Nexus Venture Partners, Omidyar Network, and Ursula Burns.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a qualified Company Secretary to own the corporate secretarial and governance function for the Goodera group, the Indian parent and its overseas entities, as we prepare for a public listing in India. This is a build-and-scale role: you will clean up legacy compliance, institutionalize processes that survive due diligence, and grow with the company into a listed-company secretarial function.

You will work directly with Finance, Tax & Compliance, and Legal leadership, and coordinate with statutory auditors, practicing company secretaries, RTAs, merchant bankers, and US counsel.

**Career arc:**
For the right candidate, this role is a pathway to Compliance Officer of a listed company under SEBI (LODR) Regulations - one of the most accelerated governance mandates available at this experience level.

**Responsibilities:**

**Core Secretarial & Statutory Compliance (India)**

* Own the full Companies Act, 2013 compliance calendar: board meetings, committee meetings, general meetings, resolutions, and filings (AOC-4, MGT-7, DIR-3 KYC, event-based forms) across the Indian entity and any Indian subsidiaries.
* Draft agendas, notices, and minutes in conformity with Secretarial Standards (SS-1 and SS-2); maintain statutory registers and minute books to due-diligence standard.
* Overhaul and digitize legacy statutory records, registers, and filings so the company is perpetually ready for investor, banker, and regulator diligence.
* Manage remediation of historical gaps: condonation of delay, compounding applications, revival or strike-off of dormant entities, and re-execution of defective corporate documents.
* Replace manual tracking with an automated compliance calendar covering ROC/MCA, FEMA/RBI, and (in time) SEBI/stock exchange deadlines with defined owners and escalation.

**FEMA / RBI & Cross-Border Compliance**

* Handle inbound investment reporting (FC-GPR, FC-TRS), annual FLA returns, and downstream/ODI compliance for the US subsidiary structure.
* Support compounding applications and regularization of past reporting delays with RBI/AD banks.
* Manage FEMA aspects of secondary share transfers, buybacks, and ESOP exercises by resident and non-resident holders, including valuation certificate coordination and pricing-guideline compliance.
* Coordinate with authorized dealer banks, valuers, and FEMA counsel; maintain a clean audit trail for every cross-border capital transaction.

**Cap Table, ESOP & Share Transactions**

* End-to-end ESOP administration: grant letters, vesting schedules, exercises, cancellations, surrender/lapse tracking, and pool reconciliation against board and shareholder approvals.
* Maintain a single-source-of-truth cap table reconciled across the register of members, depository records, and shareholder agreements.
* Execute share transfer mechanics: DIS processing, demat coordination, Deeds of Adherence, stamp duty, and CP completion for secondary transactions.
* Drive full dematerialization of shares and manage the RTA and depository (NSDL/CDSL) relationships - a listing precondition.
* Coordinate with VC investors and institutional board members on approvals, waivers, consents, and information rights under the Shareholders' Agreement; run the mechanics of rights issues, bonus issues, and any pre-IPO restructuring of instruments (e.g., CCPS conversion).

**IPO Readiness**

* Execute the secretarial workstream of IPO preparation under leadership direction, including:
* Conversion from private to public limited company and consequential charter document changes.
* Board and committee re-constitution: independent director onboarding, Audit Committee, Nomination & Remuneration Committee, Stakeholders' Relationship Committee, Risk Management Committee - with compliant charters.
* Corporate-approval backbone for the DRHP: authorizations, certifications, and secretarial due-diligence responses to merchant bankers and legal counsel.
* Policy suite build-out: related party transactions, materiality of events, code of conduct, whistleblower/vigil mechanism, insider trading code and structured digital database (SDD) under SEBI (PIT) Regulations.
* Secretarial audit under Section 204 and annual secretarial compliance report readiness.
* Data room ownership for all secretarial, capital, and governance records.

**Post-Listing Compliance (Knowledge Expectation)**

* This role is designed to mature into the listed-entity compliance function. Candidates must have working knowledge of and will be trained and supported to operate:
* SEBI (LODR) Regulations: quarterly and event-based disclosures, Regulation 30 materiality framework, corporate governance reports, shareholding patterns, and stock exchange intimations.
* SEBI (PIT) Regulations: trading window management, pre-clearance, UPSI handling, and SDD maintenance.
* Listed-company meeting mechanics: e-voting, record dates, dividend compliance, postal ballots, and investor grievance handling (SCORES).
* Ongoing engagement with stock exchanges, RTA, depositories, and the secretarial auditor.

**Overseas Entities - Coordination & Oversight**

* Coordinate (with US counsel and registered agents - not replace them) the corporate maintenance of the US subsidiary and affiliated US nonprofit: annual state filings, registered agent renewals, board consents and minutes, and officer/director records.
* Maintain a group-wide entity management tracker: good standing, filing status, intercompany agreements, and authorized signatory records across all entities.
* Support governance of the group's nonprofit foundation in coordination with its US counsel and auditors: board documentation, conflict-of-interest compliance, and policy maintenance.
* Ensure Indian-side compliance triggered by overseas entities (ODI reporting, APR filings, board approvals for guarantees/funding).

**What We Look For**

* **Qualification:**
  Member of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI).
* **Experience:**
  4-6 years of post-qualification core secretarial experience. Exposure to any of the following is strongly preferred: IPO/DRHP process, listed-company compliance, PE/VC-funded company secretarial work, or FEMA-heavy transaction work.
* **Technical depth:**
  Companies Act, 2013; Secretarial Standards (SS-1, SS-2); FEMA/RBI reporting (FC-GPR, FC-TRS, FLA, ODI); working knowledge of SEBI (LODR), (ICDR), and (PIT) Regulations.
* **Execution quality:**
  Demonstrated ability to build trackers, registers, and processes from scratch and keep them diligence-ready - not just file on time.

**Strong plus**

* LL.B. or equivalent legal training.
* Hands-on IPO or pre-IPO readiness experience (even as part of a team).
* Experience with demat/RTA processes, ESOP administration at scale, or cross-border group structures.
* Comfort with compliance tooling and automation (entity management software, compliance calendars, cap table platforms).

title: Analyst, NDA & Supplier Governance
description:
**Job Title: Analyst, NDA & Supplier Governance**
**About GlobalFoundries**
GlobalFoundries is a leading full-service semiconductor foundry providing a unique combination of design, development, and fabrication services to some of the world’s most inspired technology companies. With a global manufacturing footprint spanning three continents, GlobalFoundries makes possible the technologies and systems that transform industries and give customers the power to shape their markets. For more information, visit www.gf.com.
  
  
**Introduction**
The Analyst supports the team in managing
**Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs)**
associated with supplier and business engagements. The role coordinates NDA requests from initiation through execution, ensuring documentation is complete, stakeholders are aligned, records are maintained, and outstanding items are actively followed through.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**NDA Management**

* Coordinate NDA requests for new and existing suppliers, partners, and other external parties.
* Review incoming requests for completeness and ensure the appropriate NDA process is followed.
* Coordinate communication between internal requestors, suppliers, Procurement/GSM, Legal, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Track and follow up proactively NDAs from initiation through review, signature, and completion.
* Maintain accurate NDA records, status information, and supporting documentation.
* Monitor NDA expiry or renewal requirements where applicable.

**Governance & Compliance**

* Ensure NDA activities follow established company policies, templates, approval requirements, and document-retention practices.
* Escalate non-standard terms, exceptions, or process issues to the appropriate Legal or business stakeholders.
* Maintain appropriate confidentiality when handling supplier and company information.

**Stakeholder & Supplier Support**

* Serve as a point of coordination for routine NDA-related questions from the team.
* Guide requestors and suppliers on the applicable NDA workflow without providing legal interpretation.
* Work with stakeholders to resolve process bottlenecks and improve turnaround.
* Provide visibility to the team on open NDAs, aging requests, and issues requiring escalation.

**Process Improvement & Reporting**

* Maintain an NDA tracker/dashboard covering status, ownership, aging, and completion.
* Identify recurring process gaps and opportunities to simplify or standardize the NDA workflow.
* Support development of work instructions, standard templates, FAQs, and process documentation.
* Provide periodic NDA workload and status reporting to management.

**Qualifications**

* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Procurement, Legal Administration, or a related discipline.
* Experience in procurement, supplier management, contract administration, legal operations, or similar coordination work is preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and document-management skills.
* Good stakeholder-management and follow-up skills.
* Comfortable coordinating activities across different functions, suppliers, and geographies.
* Proficient in Excel and Microsoft Office; experience with procurement or contract-management platforms is advantageous.

**Key Competencies**

* Attention to detail
* Ownership and follow-through
* Process discipline
* Organization and prioritization
* Clear written communication
* Continuous improvement mindset

GlobalFoundries is an equal opportunity employer, cultivating a diverse and inclusive workforce. We believe having a multicultural workplace enhances productivity, efficiency and innovation whilst our employees feel truly respected, valued and heard.

All offers of employment with GlobalFoundries are conditioned upon the successful completion of background checks, medical screenings as applicable and subject to the respective local laws and regulations.

title: Senior Engineer - Technical Due Diligence

WSP is seeking an engineering professional to deliver technical due diligence services for large-scale Power and Water infrastructure projects across the Middle East region. This multifaceted role combines deep technical expertise with a strong understanding of techno-economic and techno-legal aspects of Project Finance, particularly within Public-Private Partnership (PPP) frameworks.
  
  
The successful candidate will support lenders and investors, including multilateral development banks, export credit agencies, and private equity firms, by providing independent technical assessments, monitoring project execution, and ensuring compliance with contractual, regulatory, and performance standards throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
This role offers exposure to high-value utility infrastructure projects and provides a unique opportunity to contribute to both technical and financial dimensions of infrastructure development.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Contribute to technical due diligence for project feasibility assessments, with a strong grasp of PPP procurement models.
* Identify and evaluate construction, technology, and regulatory risks.
* Review and validate project schedules, cost estimates, and risk allocation mechanisms.
* Analyze and assess key project documents including Offtaker Specifications, Project Agreements like Offtaker Contracts, EPC Contracts, O&M Agreements, and other technical contracts for compliance with international standards and regional precedents.
* Contribute in Preparation of comprehensive technical due diligence reports, construction monitoring reports, and operational performance reviews for lenders and other stakeholders.

* Participate in project meetings, contribute to business development efforts, and provide feedback on new opportunities.

title: Manager - Compliance
description:
**About CoinSwitch**
CoinSwitch is one of India's leading crypto investment platforms and is registered with FIU-IND as a Virtual Digital Asset Service Provider (VDA SP).
  
  
Our Compliance team works across AML/CFT controls, transaction monitoring, blockchain investigations, customer due diligence, regulatory reporting and engagement with FIU-IND and law enforcement agencies. We work closely with internal teams to strengthen controls, address emerging risks and meet our regulatory obligations.
  
  
We are looking for a Compliance Manager who brings strong AML/CFT experience, sound judgement and a hands-on approach to managing compliance operations in a fast-evolving virtual digital asset ecosystem.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
Transaction Monitoring and AML Investigations
  
  

* Lead the review and investigation of transaction monitoring alerts across fiat and virtual digital asset transactions, including complex and high-risk cases.
* Assess suspicious activity, determine appropriate escalation and reporting, and prepare high-quality Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) with clear, evidence-based narratives.
* Review transaction monitoring scenarios, thresholds and red flags to improve detection effectiveness and reduce false positives.
* Identify emerging typologies, unusual transaction patterns and potential misuse of the platform, and translate findings into actionable control improvements.

Blockchain Analytics and Travel Rule Compliance
  
  

* Conduct blockchain investigations using analytics tools to trace fund flows, assess wallet exposure and investigate links to illicit activity, including scams, darknet services, mixers and sanctioned entities.
* Review virtual asset deposits and relevant wallet exposure alerts, document findings and take appropriate action in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
* Support Travel Rule compliance, including information exchange with counterparty VASPs, and review cases involving unhosted wallets in accordance with applicable requirements.

Regulatory Compliance and FIU-IND Reporting
  
  

* Ensure timely and accurate filing of STRs and other applicable regulatory reports in accordance with PMLA, the PML Rules and FIU-IND requirements.
* Oversee compliance with customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, risk categorisation, periodic KYC updates and enhanced due diligence requirements.
* Ensure appropriate maintenance and retrieval of KYC, transaction and investigation records in accordance with applicable record-retention requirements.
* Monitor regulatory circulars, advisories, notifications and emerging AML/CFT typologies, and assess their impact on existing policies, controls and procedures.
* Support the Designated Director and Principal Officer in meeting applicable regulatory obligations, including independent AML/CFT audits and remediation of audit observations.

KYC, Screening and Enhanced Due Diligence
  
  

* Oversee customer screening against applicable sanctions lists, PEP databases, adverse media and other relevant watchlists.
* Review screening matches, ensure appropriate disposition of potential matches and support timely action on applicable sanctions and freezing requirements.
* Review high-risk customers and transactions, including complex fund flows, high-value activity and cases requiring enhanced due diligence.
* Strengthen customer risk assessment and ongoing monitoring processes based on customer profiles, transaction behaviour and emerging risk indicators.

Law Enforcement and Regulatory Engagement
  
  

* Manage responses to requests from law enforcement agencies, FIU-IND and other competent authorities, including information requests, notices and account-related directions.
* Coordinate the collection, validation and submission of relevant customer, transaction and investigation records within prescribed timelines.
* Support regulatory inspections, compliance reviews, audits and information requests, ensuring that responses are accurate, complete and appropriately documented.
* Track regulatory observations and agreed action plans through to closure, working with relevant stakeholders where required.

Compliance Governance, Reporting and Team Management
  
  

* Prepare management updates and periodic compliance reports covering key risks, suspicious activity trends, control effectiveness and regulatory developments.
* Contribute to enterprise-wide AML/CFT risk assessments and periodic reviews of policies, procedures and internal controls.
* Work with Product, Engineering, Data and Operations teams to strengthen monitoring capabilities, improve investigative workflows and address identified control gaps.
* Maintain clear investigation records, case documentation and audit trails to support regulatory scrutiny and internal reviews.
* Guide analysts on case investigations, STR quality, screening decisions and escalation standards, while supporting ongoing training and capability development.

What we're looking for
  
  

* Mandatory: CAMS certification from ACAMS.
* 5–8 years of overall professional experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on AML/CFT experience in a VDA platform, bank, NBFC, payments company, brokerage or a comparable regulated financial services environment.
* Strong working knowledge of PMLA, 2002, the Prevention of Money-laundering (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005, and FIU-IND's AML/CFT requirements for VDA SPs.
* A sound understanding of FATF Recommendations, particularly Recommendations 15 and 16, and their relevance to virtual asset activities.
* Practical experience in transaction monitoring, suspicious transaction investigations and STR preparation and filing.
* Experience handling law enforcement requests, regulatory information requests and time-sensitive compliance matters.
* The ability to analyse transaction data, identify patterns and draw meaningful conclusions using Excel and, preferably, SQL or similar data analysis tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear investigation reports, regulatory responses and management updates.
* Good judgement, attention to detail and the ability to independently manage complex cases while guiding junior team members.

Good to have
  
  

* Hands-on experience with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis Reactor/KYT, TRM Labs or Elliptic.
* Experience working with transaction monitoring, screening or case management systems, including rule configuration, threshold optimisation and control testing.
* Exposure to Travel Rule implementation and interactions with counterparty VASPs.
* Experience with virtual asset regulatory frameworks outside India, including VARA (Dubai) or CBB (Bahrain).
* Additional certifications such as CCAS, CFE or ICA qualifications.

**Location:**
Bengaluru (Hybrid)
  
  
**Experience:**
5–8 years, including at least 3 years of hands-on AML/CFT experience
  
  
**Certification:**
CAMS (ACAMS) – Mandatory
  
  
**Life at PeepalCo**

* We take great pride in what we do and are committed to our mission. And we have a lot of fun while at it!Here’s how we do things at PeepalCo:Customer-first: That’s the North Star. Everything we do is to make our users’ investment experience better and simplified.
* Ownership: We don’t sport lab coats, but we experiment—a lot. And we take ownership. We even have a catchphrase for this: Think big, fail fast, and build better.

You can get more updates, insights and everything behind the scenes at Pocket FM here - https://xtra.pocketfm.com/

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on Company Secretary to support our corporate secretarial, governance and transaction work. The role sits at the centre of our fundraising, due diligence and pre-IPO preparation. It suits someone who can run day-to-day compliance with care while building toward the governance standards of a listed company.

**What will you do?**

* Manage day-to-day corporate secretarial activities and ensure timely compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, applicable rules and other relevant laws and regulations
* Independently prepare first drafts of agendas, notices, resolutions, minutes and supporting documents for Board, Committee and General Meetings
* Maintain and update statutory registers, minute books, corporate records and other governance-related documentation
* Prepare, review and coordinate statutory forms, returns, reports and regulatory filings with the Registrar of Companies (ROC)
* Support the preparation and timely filing of RBI and FEMA-related regulatory compliances, including FLA Returns, FC-GPR, FC-TRS, ODI reporting and APR, along with other applicable regulatory filings
* Maintain compliance calendars, monitor regulatory deadlines and ensure timely completion of assigned statutory obligations
* Support fundraising transactions, including preparation of corporate approvals, transaction documentation and post-closing compliances
* Assist in corporate actions involving share issuances, transfers, capital restructuring, employee stock options and other securities-related matters
* Support the Company's pre-IPO readiness initiatives, including secretarial due diligence, corporate governance assessments, regulatory compliance and documentation
* Assist in drafting corporate governance policies and preparing Board and shareholder approvals required for IPO readiness
* Coordinate with merchant bankers, legal advisors, registrars, auditors and other stakeholders, and support the compilation and verification of information required for DRHP preparation
* Provide operational and documentation support for dematerialisation of securities, including coordination with Depository Participants, banks, shareholders and other relevant stakeholders
* Support corporate secretarial and governance requirements of group entities, including coordination with overseas legal counsel and relevant stakeholders on cross-border matters
* Independently research and interpret applicable laws, regulations, circulars, notifications and regulatory guidance, and translate regulatory requirements into practical business actions
* Identify potential compliance risks, assess their implications and recommend practical, compliant solutions, distinguishing between mandatory legal requirements and regulatory best practices

**What we’re looking for**

* Qualified Company Secretary (CS) with a minimum of 3-4 years of post-qualification experience
* Prior hands-on experience in a corporate secretarial role is mandatory
* Strong working knowledge of the Companies Act, MCA filings, corporate governance, SEBI Regulations and applicable secretarial compliances
* Demonstrated ability to independently research and interpret laws, regulations, circulars and regulatory requirements

title: Land Associate
description:
****What We Offer and Why This Role Is Worth Your Attention****

* Career Growth: Structured promotion path from Land Intern → Land Associate→ Land Examiner→ Land Expert and beyond.
* Training & Mentoring: Hands-on training with experienced mentors dedicated to your development.
* Niche Expertise: Build a globally rare skill set in US oil & gas title examination
* Stable, Purposeful Work: Work that matters — your analysis directly supports real investment decisions

****Who We Are Looking For****
: No prior oil & gas experience required. We hire for mindset, precision, and aptitude.
  
  

* Any graduate or 3-year diploma holder from any stream (Law, Commerce and Science

backgrounds all welcome)
  
  

* Freshers and interns with strong reading comprehension and analytical thinking
* People who are detail-oriented — the kind who re-reads before submitting
* Comfortable working with dense English-language legal and property documents
* Typing speed of 30 WPM or above with 98%+ accuracy
* Willing to adapt with technology changes and learn
* Curious, proactive, and unafraid to ask questions when something is unclear

**What You Will Actually Do**
This is detailed analytical and legal documentation work — not data entry, not clerical work. You will be entrusted with real title opinions that influence multi-million-dollar investment decisions.
  
  

* Conduct full title searches (Patent Searches) for oil and gas properties across US states
* Read and interpret complex legal documents: deeds, liens, probates, divorce decrees, and Affidavits of Heirship (AOH)
* Trace and verify the chain of ownership (chain of title) to confirm clear and unencumbered property rights
* Analyze legal property descriptions
* Make independent judgment calls on ambiguous title matters, supported by documents and established standards
* Collaborate with team leads and SME’s to resolve title defects and document exceptions
* Maintain strict accuracy and consistency — your work forms the foundation of investment-grade title opinions

****A Word of Honesty: This Is Not an Easy Job.****
Title examination demands precision, patience, and a willingness to learn. You will read dense legal documents. You will encounter complex chains of ownership spanning decades. You will sometimes hit dead ends that require creative problem-solving. We do not expect you to know all of this on Day 1 — but we do expect you to take it seriously, ask questions, and commit to
  
  
the craft. If you are looking for easy work, this is not the role. If you are looking for work that builds you into an expert, this is exactly the role.
  
  
**What We Will Teach You (Training Program)**
You will not be thrown into the deep end without preparation. Our structured onboarding covers:
  
  

* Foundations of US Oil & Gas land law and property rights
* How to read and chain title using real deed records, court documents, and county records
* Legal descriptions: Types of legal descriptions
* Document types: Deeds, Assignments, Liens, Probate records, AOH, Divorce decrees
* Working tools, systems, and internal quality standards
* Mentored practice on real files under guidance of experienced examiners

**Work Requirements**

* Mandatory Work from Office — Bangalore
* Commitment to accuracy
* Openness to ask for help, take feedback, and grow through structured review
* Team collaboration alongside individual accountability

title: Assistant Director - Commercial Contracting-Alliance
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title:**
Assistant Director – Commercial Contracting (Alliance)
  
  
**Qualification:**
Bachelor of Laws (LL. B)
  
  
**The opportunity**
This is an exciting opportunity to join EY’s rapidly expanding GDS GCO Enablement team and support EY's business on Alliance and third-party ecosystem relationships. As a senior lawyer, you will play a key role in facilitating the EY's strategic partnerships. You will work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to coordinate, facilitate, and advise on various aspects of contract development and execution. You will also help educate the business on the policies and processes related to Alliance and Ecosystem contracting. This is a great opportunity to develop your skills and expertise in a dynamic and global environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate, follow-up and collaborate with cross functional teams (GCO, Risk management) for contract finalisation process.
* Coordinate and provide business advice and guidance to stakeholders and end users regarding potential issues stemming from new and existing contracts.
* Work with internal stakeholders to develop strategies to address issues identified.
* Communicate progress, challenges, risks, and benefits to appropriate management levels and affected user groups and other members of the EY teams.
* Coordinate, review, advise, and summarise different documents such as Alliance Agreements, Teaming Agreements, NDA’s, Amendments, and other partner related documents.
* Understand the EY policies that are relevant to the transactions and adapt accordingly.
* Ensure that all contractual documents developed are compliant with EY policies and proactively identify and resolve any issues.
* Educate business teams on Alliance and Ecosystem contracting processes and requirements.
* Manage expectations with stakeholders on timing and progress.
* Communicate complex issues and resolve disputes with external stakeholders.
* Manage escalations from business teams, ecosystem teams, risk management and GCO.
* Facilitate monthly discussions with business, risk management, legal teams.
* Create content to build internal awareness of ecosystem relationships contracting activities.
* Compile, review, and distribute contract status reports.
* Mentoring junior team members

**Skills and attributes for success:**

* Be able to manage stakeholder expectations in a high-pressure, changing environment while maintaining a calm, professional working style.
* Knowledge of handing high visibility Alliance and teaming contracts.
* Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills, including creativity and innovative thinking.
* Possess excellent communication skills (oral and written) in English, strong interpersonal and presentation skills interacting with senior stakeholders.
* Be able to summarize complex, technical concepts into communications that can be understood by the team and other stakeholders.
* Feel comfortable and confident in a challenging global environment and be sensitive to cross-cultural differences and current international events.
* Demonstrate flexible teaming skills (both face to face and in a virtual setting).
* Bring innovation to improve processes/deliverables and can learn/adapt quickly when required.
* Ability to assess size, scope, and overall risk of transactions and to tailor contracts accordingly.
* Solutions – oriented with relentless focus on world class execution of projects and tasks.
* Strong service-oriented personality, proficient at delivering high quality of work within deadlines.
* High levels of personal energy and appetite for work and success.

**Other Personal Characteristics:**

* Unquestioned ethics and integrity.
* High level of self-confidence and energy.
* High level of intellectual agility, initiative, self-motivation, resourcefulness, and patience.
* Pragmatic with strong business acumen.
* Strong analytical skills.
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail.

**Qualifications:**
Law Degree with consistent strong academic record.
  
  
**Experience:**
8-10 years of relevant post-qualification experience (preferably in a multi-national corporate).
  
  
**What You Can Look For**

* A Team of highly qualified legal professionals with energy and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment.
* An opportunity to be a part of a global company and work with attorneys and teams across the globe.

**What Working At EY Offers**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across eight countries – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland, Spain, Hungary and Mexico – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Third Party Risk Analyst
description:
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About Third Party Risk**
The Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) team is accountable for defining, maintaining, and overseeing the third party risk framework, policy, and inventory in accordance with management expectations and best practices. We are focused on assessing and managing risks exposed through our relationships with third parties, adhering to regulatory guidance, and driving operational efficiencies across risk teams. TPRM is a regulatory obligation for Financial Services companies.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
We're looking for a Third Party Risk Analyst to join our growing team. This individual will support the ongoing operations of the existing framework for identifying, assessing, and managing third party risks to protect Stripe.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Conduct third party assessments while facilitating the process through closure.
* Conduct risk domain reviews owned by TPRM including reputation, financial, anti-bribery and corruption, and sanctions risk.
* Responsible for the integrity and maintenance of the third party risk inventory including reconciliation to other internal data sets.
* Prepare and continuously improve third party risk reporting for senior leaders, relevant stakeholders, and governance groups. ^
* Partner with the US TPRM team to drive execution and delivery of required procedures to maintain ongoing regulatory compliance operations for programs including the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and global outsourcing regimes.
* Work closely with internal teams at Stripe to coordinate procedures, gather inputs and handover to US TPRM.
* Maintain procedural documentation, driving consistency and alignment across our procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and contribute to scaling our program globally.
* Ability to escalate issues and risks to management upon identification.
* Be a part of building a brand new team for Stripe and leading the way towards a culture of compliance.

Who you are
  
  
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 3+ years of relevant experience in risk and compliance which could include third party, operational, enterprise, or other areas of risk and compliance management
* Self-disciplined, diligent, proactive, organized, and exceptionally detail oriented
* An extremely responsive and collaborative team-player
* User first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
* Solution-oriented mindset with enthusiasm for establishing best practices
* Humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams
* A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners
* A proven ability to be a self starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision
* The ability to maintain high performance under tight timelines and a “roll up your sleeves” mindset to get any job done
* The ability to bring structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems and data sets to make complex investigation decisions
* Independently analyze and evaluate information from various data sources to determine a course of action for a matched case
* Demonstrated experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders
* Demonstrated history of taking on various types of challenging projects and producing results

**You Will Also Likely Have (not Required)**

* \* Strong knowledge of gSuite tools, Tableau and other data reporting tools including experience working with/analyzing data sets.

+ Knowledge in the fintech industry
+ The ability to be flexible and comfortable with changing requirements
+ A builder's mindset and a willingness to question assumptions and conventional wisdom
+ A passion for creating new systems and solving problems via infrastructure and automation
+ Eagerness to stay updated on emerging trends, regulations, and industry standards related to third party risk management and integrate them into Stripe's program

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

title: Processor
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bancorp India gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Job description:**

* A professional in this role manages post-charge-off accounts through the litigation process, including account documentation, attorney vendor oversight, legal workflow monitoring, judgment activity, settlements, and recalls. The position requires handling sensitive account conditions such as bankruptcy, military status, fraud, complaints, etc., while ensuring compliance with legal, regulatory, and internal policy requirements.
* This role also coordinates with internal teams and external vendors, maintains accurate records, supports quality control, and escalates issues as needed. Strong attention to detail, excellent Microsoft suite skills, ability to complete complex tasks with minimal oversight and critical thinking skills.
* Performs a variety of document processing and record keeping tasks associated with customer accounts that require a thorough knowledge of products and services in the assigned area.
* Duties may include entering new account information; changing information on existing accounts; recording transactions; answering customer inquiries; receiving, classifying, consolidating and summarizing documents and information; completing reports and providing administrative support. Responsibilities may also include customer service duties such as answering customer inquiries, resolving customer problems and responding to customer requests for information.

**Role Responsibilities:**

* Identifying Accounts for Legal Placement - Accounts are systemically reviewed for litigation eligibility using criteria maintained by the Technology Reporting and Analytics (TR&A) Team. Exclusion criteria include bankruptcy, SCRA (Servicemembers Civil Relief Act), statute of limitations, consumer disputes, fraud, and other flagged issues.
* Right to Cure - Certain states (IA, KS, WI, SC, ME, MO, NE) require a Right to Cure (RTC) letter before litigation can proceed. RTC requirements do not apply to Small Business accounts.
* Account Review Process - Legal Designees manually review accounts flagged as litigation eligible (L01) in the Computer Assisted Collections System (CACS). Accounts not meeting criteria are removed from legal consideration; those meeting criteria are assigned for litigation.
* Attorney Vendor Placement - Eligible accounts are sent to Attorney Vendors, who receive required documentation (statements, agreements, applications). Vendors are responsible for collection efforts and legal actions.
* Legal Process - Vendors attempt collection before litigation (Initial Demand Letter, 30 days). If unresolved, lawsuits are filed, affidavits prepared, and court actions are pursued. Judgments are entered, and post-judgment remedies (garnishments, voluntary payments, liens) are applied. The team members monitor, and validates accuracy, key milestones and/or legal documents. Special handling for bankruptcy, SCRA, complaints, credit bureau disputes, fraud, cease and desist, and deceased account holders.
* Settlements & Recalls - Settlements can occur pre-litigation, during litigation, or post-judgment. Accounts may be recalled from Attorney Vendors for various reasons (strategy, bankruptcy, death, settlement, payment in full).
* Payment Processing - Payments are reconciled between U.S. Bank and Attorney Vendors monthly.

**Special Handling Accounts:**

* Bankruptcy: Accounts are recalled and handled according to bankruptcy rules.
* SCRA: Active-duty military accounts are placed on hold; litigation is paused or dismissed.
* Complaints & Disputes: Accounts are placed on hold and investigated; litigation may be recalled if complaints have merit.
* Fraud: Accounts are placed on hold during investigation; litigation resumes or is recalled based on findings.
* Cease and Desist: Accounts are coded and handled according to legal requirements.
* Deceased: Litigation is dismissed if all account holders are deceased; continues against surviving holders on joint accounts.

**Competencies:**

* Litigation Eligibility Assessment
* Regulatory Compliance
* Critical Thinking and Judgment
* Attention to Detail
* Risk Identification and Mitigation
* Account Analysis
* Decision Documentation
* Quality Assurance and Control Execution
* Complex Case Escalation
* Accountability and Independent Execution

Skills:
  
  

* Litigation eligibility review
* Delinquent and charged-off account analysis
* Regulatory and policy compliance
* Critical thinking and sound judgment
* Risk identification and mitigation
* Detailed documentation and recordkeeping
* Quality assurance and control validation
* Complex case escalation and resolution
* Microsoft 365 proficiency

Qualifications:
  
  
Basic Qualifications - High school diploma or equivalent - Typically four or more years of clerical and customer service experience Preferred Skills/Experience - Thorough knowledge of products, services, terminology, procedures and systems related to assigned area - Strong customer service skills - Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously while maintaining a high level of customer service - Ability to independently identify and resolve complex problems - Proficient computer navigation skills using a variety of software packages including Microsoft Office applications - Effective verbal and written communication skills
  
  
Years of experience – 4+ relevant years
  
  
Shift Timings - 6:30pm-3:30am IST
  
  
If there’s anything we can do to accommodate a disability during any portion of the application or hiring process, please refer to our disability accommodations for applicants.

This is an U.S. Bancorp India posting. U.S. Bancorp India is a part of the U.S. Bank family.

**Location**

title: Strategic Sourcing Analyst, Specialist
description:
As an ESM Sourcing Lead, you will join Vanguard's growing Enterprise Supply Management (ESM) team in Hyderabad and play an important role in managing third-party sourcing and supplier relationships for Vanguard's India office. You will partner with business leaders, suppliers, and global ESM teams to understand strategic business needs, refine sourcing requirements, forecast demand, assess supplier capabilities, and deliver sourcing strategies that create sustainable commercial value. You will lead sourcing activities across categories including Technology, Human Resources, Professional Services, and Facilities, while managing competitive bids, negotiations, contracting, supplier onboarding, and ongoing supplier governance. Working closely with Financial Planning, Legal, Risk, Third Party Risk Management, and other control functions, you will help ensure supplier relationships deliver value while meeting Vanguard's commercial, operational, risk, and regulatory expectations. This role reports to the ESM Manager in Hyderabad and has a matrix reporting relationship to a member of the ESM Leadership Team in London.
  
  
**About Vanguard**
Founded in 1975, Vanguard is one of the world's leading investment management companies. The firm offers investments, advice, and retirement services to tens of millions of individual investors around the globe—directly, through workplace plans, and through financial intermediaries.
  
  
**Vanguard India**
Vanguard’s office in India is a significant milestone in our global expansion. We are committed to establishing an enduring technology center in Hyderabad, Telangana and are excited to be adding talent who will focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI), mobile, and cloud-based technologies that drive our business outcomes and deliver a world-class experience for our clients.
  
  
**About The Role.**
As an ESM Sourcing Lead, you will join Vanguard's growing Enterprise Supply Management (ESM) team in Hyderabad and play an important role in managing third-party sourcing and supplier relationships for Vanguard's India office.
  
  
You will partner with business leaders, suppliers, and global ESM teams to understand strategic business needs, refine sourcing requirements, forecast demand, assess supplier capabilities, and deliver sourcing strategies that create sustainable commercial value. You will lead sourcing activities across categories including Technology, Human Resources, Professional Services, and Facilities, while managing competitive bids, negotiations, contracting, supplier onboarding, and ongoing supplier governance.
  
  
Working closely with Financial Planning, Legal, Risk, Third Party Risk Management, and other control functions, you will help ensure supplier relationships deliver value while meeting Vanguard's commercial, operational, risk, and regulatory expectations.
  
  
This role reports to the ESM Manager in Hyderabad and has a matrix reporting relationship to a member of the ESM Leadership Team in London.
  
  
Core Responsibilities
  
  
  

* Manages sourcing projects and workstreams, developing and monitoring plans, milestones, deliverables, and required activities
* Leads and executes low- and moderate-complexity sourcing transactions, negotiations, competitive bids, RFQs, RFIs, and RFPs
* Partners with business leaders to understand strategic requirements, forecast demand, define sourcing approaches, and support supplier selection
* Conducts supply market analysis and evaluates supplier capabilities, market developments, commercial opportunities, and potential risks
* Manages contracts and supplier relationships across categories including Technology, Human Resources, Professional Services, and Facilities
* Leads end-to-end contract management activities across the full supplier lifecycle, including sourcing, negotiation, contracting, onboarding, ongoing management, transition, and offboarding
* Builds and maintains effective relationships with business stakeholders, suppliers, and global partners and influences key decisions across stakeholder groups
* Communicates sourcing activity, project status, contractual requirements, obligations, risks, and issues to stakeholders and senior leaders
* Uses data, analytics, and market insights to develop sourcing strategies aligned with business priorities and demand forecasts
* Prepares and presents analyses, findings, and recommendations to support commercial and supplier decisions
* Partners with Financial Planning to identify and track savings, cost reductions, and other value delivered through sourcing activities
* Proactively identifies, manages, and mitigates commercial, contractual, operational, and supplier risks and escalates issues appropriately
* Partners with Legal, Risk, and other functions to understand contractual, regulatory, commercial, and risk considerations
* Works with Third Party Risk Management and risk domain groups including Global Privacy, Information Security, Compliance, Business Continuity, Financial Crimes, and Artificial Intelligence to support and enhance standard operating procedures and RACIs
* Maintains awareness of procurement industry trends and best practices and helps define standards across competitive bidding, contracting, and supplier management
* Champions global procurement processes, policies, controls, and fair business practices
* Educates stakeholders on commercial, compliance, legal, policy, and risk considerations throughout contract negotiation and supplier management activities
* Creates and delivers training to support adherence to procurement policies and procedures
* Ensures successful transaction closure and handoff to purchasing, contracting, and payables teams, including validation of agreed supplier payment terms and documentation
* Supports and leads onboarding and offboarding of suppliers, including supplier transition programs and projects
* Establishes and maintains appropriate governance for ongoing supplier relationship management in partnership with business stakeholders
* Supports internal audit requests, special projects, and other responsibilities as required

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience, including experience leading contract negotiations and competitive RFQ, RFI, and RFP processes
* Undergraduate degree or equivalent combination of training and professional experience; graduate degree preferred
* Financial Services and/or Technology sourcing experience preferred
* Experience across strategic sourcing, procurement, contract management, and supplier relationship management
* Understanding of end-to-end contract and supplier lifecycle management
* Strong commercial and negotiation skills with the ability to support supplier selection and sourcing decisions
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data, market insights, and business requirements into actionable recommendations
* Strong reporting and presentation skills with experience communicating recommendations, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders
* Strong communication and relationship management skills with the ability to work effectively across business, supplier, and control functions
* Ability to proactively identify and escalate risks and issues and collaborate with stakeholders to develop appropriate solutions
* Understanding of procurement governance, third-party risk management, compliance, and regulatory requirements
* Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and sourcing activities
* Experience collaborating with Legal, Risk, Finance, and other cross-functional stakeholders
* Ability to work effectively with stakeholders and teams across different regions and time zones
* Flexibility to work with global stakeholders outside standard India business hours approximately 10% to 20% of the work week

**Location**
This role is based in Hyderabad, Telangana at Vanguard India. Only qualified external applicants will be considered.
  
  
**Our mission**
Vanguard adheres to a simple purpose: To take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.
  
  
**Our commitment to you**
Vanguard takes the same long-term view of your success—at work and in life—with Benefits and Rewards packages that reflect what you care about, throughout all the phases and stages of your life. Our Total Rewards programs provide you and your loved ones with wellness support for key areas in your life:
  
  
**Financial wellness**
We're committed to enabling your financial success and provide competitive offers and programs.
  
  
**Physical wellness**
We're committed to providing benefits that support your physical health and wellness.
  
  
**Personal wellness**
We're committed to providing resources that help support the full scope of your life.
  
  
**How We Work**
Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for most of our employees (crew members), designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

title: Cloud Vendor Management Specialist
description:
**Primary Responsibilities**
**Vendor Onboarding and Due Diligence**

* Manage new vendor onboarding from initial request through approval, including supplier registration, document exchange, internal coordination, and completion of required procurement workflows.
* Ensure vendors satisfy company requirements for information security, privacy, legal, financial, insurance, compliance, business continuity, and operational readiness before services are approved or implemented.
* Coordinate the collection and review of contracts, statements of work, certificates of insurance, security questionnaires, compliance attestations, financial information, data-processing terms, and other required documentation.
* Maintain accurate vendor profiles, ownership records, risk classifications, documentation, approval status, and renewal dates in applicable procurement and contract-management systems.

**Vendor Evaluation and Selection**

* Coordinate vendor evaluations for data center hardware, infrastructure platforms, cloud services, cybersecurity solutions, software, telecommunications, support services, and managed service providers.
* Develop and apply consistent evaluation criteria covering technical fit, security, compliance, financial stability, service capability, implementation risk, support model, scalability, and total cost of ownership.
* Support requests for information, requests for proposal, demonstrations, proofs of concept, reference checks, and commercial evaluations.
* Prepare comparative analyses and recommendations that clearly document vendor strengths, weaknesses, risks, costs, and alignment with business and technology requirements.

**Contract Review, Renewal, and Commercial Analysis**

* Manage the vendor renewal calendar and begin renewal planning early enough to support requirements validation, competitive review, budgeting, negotiation, approval, and service continuity.
* Review contracts, statements of work, order forms, pricing schedules, service-level agreements, licensing terms, support provisions, renewal clauses, termination rights, and commercial commitments in coordination with Procurement and Legal.
* Compare renewal proposals against prior-year agreements, historical spend, consumption, market benchmarks, alternative vendors, and changes in scope or service levels.
* Identify unfavorable pricing changes, redundant services, unused licenses, minimum commitments, auto-renewal risk, and contractual terms requiring clarification or negotiation.
* Prepare concise renewal recommendations, financial impact summaries, negotiation positions, and approval materials for operational and executive stakeholders.

**Vendor Relationship and Performance Management**

* Build and maintain effective vendor relationships throughout onboarding, implementation, steady-state operations, renewal, escalation, and offboarding.
* Plan and lead vendor meetings, operational reviews, service reviews, quarterly business reviews, renewal discussions, and executive-level engagements.
* Establish agendas, document decisions and action items, assign owners, track commitments, and follow issues through resolution.
* Maintain vendor scorecards and monitor service-level performance, delivery quality, responsiveness, support effectiveness, risk, and contractual compliance.
* Coordinate escalations for service failures, unresolved incidents, delayed deliverables, commercial disputes, and other matters that could affect availability, security, cost, or business operations.

**FinOps and Financial Optimization**

* Partner with Finance, FinOps, Procurement, and technology owners to improve the financial management of vendor relationships and technology services.
* Analyze spend, usage, support coverage, license allocation, maintenance costs, commercial commitments, and pricing trends to identify savings and cost-avoidance opportunities.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, accruals, purchase-order planning, and variance analysis for assigned technology vendors and contracts.
* Develop total cost of ownership, return on investment, unit-cost, and multi-year financial analyses for vendor selections, renewals, migrations, and modernization initiatives.
* Recommend opportunities to right-size services, consolidate suppliers, eliminate duplication, optimize licensing, renegotiate commitments, improve discount structures, and align cost with actual consumption and business value.

**Governance, Reporting, and Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Serve as a central point of coordination among vendors and internal technical, procurement, finance, legal, security, compliance, and business teams.
* Maintain contract repositories, vendor records, renewal schedules, performance reports, meeting documentation, risk items, and decision history.
* Develop dashboards and reporting for vendor spend, savings, renewals, performance, risk, contract status, and action-item completion.
* Support audits, third-party risk assessments, compliance reviews, strategic sourcing initiatives, infrastructure modernization programs, and vendor offboarding activities.
* Participate in local and global cross-functional teams and perform related procurement, vendor management, contract administration, and financial-analysis activities as assigned

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, supply chain management, information technology, economics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4+ years of experience in vendor management, vendor procurement, supplier management, contract administration, technology operations, strategic sourcing, or a related discipline.
* Experience managing vendors that provide data center infrastructure, cloud services, cybersecurity products, enterprise software, telecommunications, hardware maintenance, professional services, or managed services.
* Demonstrated experience with vendor onboarding, due diligence, document exchange, supplier approvals, contract renewals, and ongoing relationship management.
* Ability to review commercial contracts, licensing structures, statements of work, service-level commitments, pricing schedules, renewal provisions, and vendor proposals.
* Experience comparing vendor proposals and renewal pricing against prior-year agreements, historical utilization, existing contracts, market alternatives, and business requirements.
* Strong financial and analytical skills, including spend analysis, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, total cost of ownership, return on investment, and cost-optimization assessments.
* Ability to organize and lead vendor meetings involving technical teams, business owners, procurement, finance, legal, and vendor executives.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, stakeholder-management, organizational, and documentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple vendor engagements, deadlines, approvals, renewals, and escalations while maintaining confidentiality and attention to detail.
* Advanced proficiency with spreadsheets, presentations, reporting tools, databases, and procurement or contract-management systems.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with NetSuite, or a comparable procurement, ERP, vendor-risk, or contract-lifecycle platform.
* Experience supporting hybrid infrastructure, on-premises data centers, VMware environments, public cloud platforms, cybersecurity operations, or enterprise technology modernization.
* Knowledge of FinOps principles, software asset management, license optimization, third-party risk management, and technology procurement best practices.
* Experience developing vendor scorecards, executive business reviews, sourcing recommendations, and multi-year commercial models, having knowledge of any visualization tool like QuickSight would be an added advantage.
* Relevant certification such as FinOps Certified Practitioner, CPSM, CSCP, PMP, ITIL Foundation, or a comparable procurement, finance, or technology credential.

description:

* Continuous Learning and Professional Development
* Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment

The Manager – Legal will serve as a strategic business partner supporting Darwinbox’s rapidly expanding India operations. 8 – 12 years

* Experience collaborating cross-functionally with sales, finance, procurement, and leadership teams
* Capability to manage multiple high-priority matters simultaneously in a high-growth, deadline-driven environment
