title: Head of Legal and Company Secretary, India [T500-28277]
description:
**About CIBC:**

CIBC is a leading North American bank, with a history of more than 150 years of living our purpose - to help make your ambition a reality. Client relationships are at the center of our strategy, and our growth is enabled by a highly engaged and connected global team. From digital banking to community impact, we’re proud to drive progress for our clients and our communities. Recognized for our culture, award-winning innovation and community investment, CIBC continues to evolve by putting people and progress at the centre of everything we do.

**About CIBC India:**

CIBC India is a technology and operations hub in Hyderabad, where you’ll be part of our highly engaged and global team, and play a central role in supporting our growth. Whether you’re driving innovation in digital banking or streamlining client onboarding, you’ll be part of a culture recognized for excellence and investment in people. At CIBC India, people and progress are at the center of what we do: you’ll develop skills, collaborate with industry leaders, and see your ideas realized in a culture that values progress and belonging. We provide cutting-edge resources, ongoing learning, and a supportive environment where people come first. If you’re ready to create meaningful change and build your future, CIBC India is where your ambition meets opportunity.

**What CIBC India Offers:**

At CIBC India, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career that goes well beyond your compensation.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including competitive fixed pay, performance-based incentive programs, a family-first benefits program, employer contributions for your retirement, attractive time off and leave offerings, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.

Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients worldwide

We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day, a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

**What You’ll Be Doing (position summary):**

This position functions as regional general counsel for all CIBC India business activities, principally supporting CIBC India as a global delivery centre servicing CIBC legal entities and business units globally. The overall purpose of the role is to provide leadership and advice regarding legal matters, with the objective of helping business leaders achieve business goals in a manner consistent with sound risk management. The Head of Legal, India negotiates agreements, manages litigation, and participates as the Legal representative on applicable regional governance committees.

At CIBC India we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (including on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

**How You’ll Succeed (responsibilities):**

**Value Added Partner:**

* Provide legal advice in relation to business plans and help to ensure proper implementation of those plans, consistent with legal and any applicable regulatory requirements.
* Act as Whole-Time Company Secretary for CIBC India.
* Active member of CIBC India regional senior management team and any related committees.
* Fulfill commitments embodied in the Legal Department mandate in relation to CIBC India.



**Transaction and Litigation Support:**

* Provide legal advice and related governance to support CIBC India’s business activities, including with respect to CIBC India’s employment law and intellectual property matters and regulatory changes.
* Negotiate CIBC's agreements India, either directly or through external counsel acting under your oversight.
* Manage CIBC's litigation in India and keep global Legal team and regional senior management apprised of significant developments and deadlines. Often such litigation involves complex cross border Issues requiring coordination and management among internal business and infrastructure groups, law firms, witnesses and courts in different jurisdictions and time zones.

**Internal and External Business Development/Client Service:**

* Monitor legal changes in the relevant jurisdictions to assess the impact on relevant lines of business, and identify new business opportunities and/or regulatory risks.

**Risk Management:**

* Identify legal risks, and significant incidents of non-compliance, and escalate these to global Legal team and senior management of India (as relevant), ensuring such risks are properly understood. Where possible, propose appropriate risk mitigation.
* Conduct quarterly Board Meetings in India (in person or virtually from India) and any ad hoc or additional Board meetings as necessary.
* Prepare and maintain statutory registers, minutes, resolutions, notices, and agendas.
* Support information requests relating to Legal’s accountabilities from internal and external auditors.
* Ensure compliance with up to 325 event-based activities and ~66 regular compliance requirements under the Companies Act, 2013.
* Advise on legal matters pertaining to corporate governance, corporate actions, drafting, and regulatory filings.
* Liaise with regulatory bodies and ensure effective communication and resolution of statutory matters.

**Governance and Reporting:**

* Prepare and present Legal reporting to senior management and Board in India and Legal global management.
* Partner with Legal’s Transformation & Operational Resilience team (as the 1B function for Legal) to complete attestation and certification of controls and deficiencies.

**Continuous Learning and Professional Development:**

* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry trends relating to CIBC India’s business activities.
* Pursue relevant training, certifications, and development opportunities.

**CROSS-FUNCTIONAL RELATIONSHIPS:**

* Collaborate with teams in India and globally to support corporate governance and legal requirements.
* Participate in or lead special projects related to legal, corporate governance, and process improvement.
* Reports to Head of CIBC India.
* [Dotted line to Head of Legal, Asia Pacific (Capital Markets – US, UK, Asia).]

**COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls.

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

* As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Ambiguity due to rapidly changing regulatory environment.
* Ability to maintain current knowledge of evolving regulations.
* Leadership in corporate governance and legal issues.
* Direct Operating Expenses: not applicable.

**Experience: 15+ years:**

**Who You Are (skills/qualifications):**

* Qualified Company Secretary in India (ICSI Membership required).
* University degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, Law, or related field (MBA, M.Com, LLB, B.Com), with a degree in law and admission to practice as an Advocate preferred.
* 8+ years of relevant experience in secretarial, legal, and corporate governance.
* Extensive knowledge of Companies Act, 2013, corporate governance, and statutory compliance.
* Strong understanding of Indian legal and regulatory requirements applicable to a global capability centre, in particular relating to employment law and intellectual property.
* Previous experience in a global delivery centre or a large international organization preferred.
* Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong communication skills (oral, written, presentational).

title: ETP Design & Project Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced ETP Design & Project Engineer to lead the end-to-end design, engineering, execution, installation and commissioning of Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) projects on a turnkey basis.

The candidate will be responsible for developing technically sound and commercially viable treatment solutions, preparing engineering designs and drawings, coordinating procurement and site execution, supervising installation and ensuring successful commissioning and project handover.

The role requires strong technical expertise in wastewater treatment processes, hands-on project execution capabilities and the ability to independently manage turnkey projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technical Assessment & Process Design**

* Understand client requirements, wastewater characteristics, inlet water quality and treated-water discharge/reuse requirements.
* Conduct site assessments and evaluate wastewater generation, flow rates and treatment requirements.
* Develop appropriate ETP process designs based on wastewater characteristics and applicable standards.
* Prepare process flow diagrams (PFDs), process calculations, hydraulic designs and equipment sizing.
* Design treatment systems covering physical, chemical and biological treatment processes.
* Determine treatment stages, tank capacities, retention times, chemical dosing and sludge management requirements.
* Optimise plant design for performance, energy efficiency and project cost.

**2. Engineering & Technical Documentation**

* Prepare process flow diagrams, piping and instrumentation diagrams (P&IDs), general arrangement (GA) drawings and equipment layouts.
* Prepare technical specifications and equipment datasheets.
* Identify and finalise pumps, blowers, agitators, filters, clarifiers, dosing systems, membranes and other treatment equipment.
* Prepare BOQs, material specifications and technical documentation.
* Coordinate with CAD/design teams and external engineering consultants wherever required.

**3. Turnkey Project Execution**

* Take ownership of ETP projects from design and engineering through execution and commissioning.
* Plan project schedules, resource requirements and execution milestones.
* Coordinate procurement, vendors, contractors and installation teams.
* Supervise civil, mechanical, electrical and instrumentation works.

title: Lead- Admissions
description:
**CHIREC INTERNATIONAL SCHOOL**
  
CHIREC International is a leading K-12 school located in Hyderabad, India offering International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme (IBDP), Cambridge International Examinations (CIE) and Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE). CHIREC was founded in 1989 by Founder-Director, Ratna Reddy as a summer camp that offered Programmes in fine arts, performing arts, computers, indoor and outdoor sports. Today, CHIREC is one of the premier educational institutions in the country for excellence in academics and co-curricular activities. CHIREC’s mission is to nurture the innate potential of its students to enable them to excel in whatever they choose. The school helps students to grow and evolve into open-minded, ethical and caring individuals who are focused and encouraged to set goals, attain them and exceed expectations. As a valued member of the Cognita global group, and recognized by respected educational bodies like the Council of International Schools (CIS) and the IB Organization, CHIREC International School is known for its exceptional quality of education.
  
  
**About Cognita**  
At Cognita, we know every student is unique. We nurture their distinct personalities and strengths. We support them academically, socially, and emotionally, wherever they are in the world, wherever they’re starting from. And each and every one of our schools is unique too. We protect what’s special about them, while offering them rich knowledge, opportunities, and best practices. And they get to be part of something bigger. We open their classrooms to the collective wisdom of over 100 schools in 16 countries, ensuring every child gets an education that’s, quite literally, world class. It’s an individual approach that empowers every school, teacher and student to focus on what they do best. And thrive.
  
  
**About the role**  
Lead - Admissions will lead and manage the admissions counselling function, serving as a key point of contact for prospective families and guiding them through the admissions journey. The role involves understanding needs, effectively communicating the school’s vision and the value of its IB programmes, and ensuring a seamless, personalized and engaging admissions experience.
  
  
**Position Responsibilities -**  
1.Lead and manage the campus admissions team, taking ownership of campus admission targets, conversion goals, and overall enrolment performance.
  
2.Develop and execute campus-specific admissions strategies to achieve enrolment targets and strengthen the admissions pipeline.
  
3.Monitor team performance, basic training to counsellors, identify gaps, and drive accountability against individual and campus KPIs.
  
4.Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective students, parents, educational consultants, feeder schools, and other key stakeholders.
  
5.Guide prospective families through the complete admissions journey, providing accurate information on programmes, curriculum, deadlines, eligibility, requirements, and school processes.
  
6.Review applications and supporting documents to ensure completeness, accuracy, and adherence to school admissions requirements.
  
7.Plan and coordinate campus tours, open houses, information sessions, parent interactions, orientation programmes, and other admissions events.
  
8.Ensure a consistent, high-quality parent experience across all admissions touchpoints, from enquiry through enrolment.
  
9.Maintain accurate and timely applicant records, ensuring complete data capture and follow-up through the admissions CRM.
  
10.Analyse Maintain admissions data, conversion trends, lead sources, competitor activity notes, and campus performance to identify opportunities and recommend corrective actions.
  
11.Work closely with Academic, Finance, Operations, Transport, IT, Marketing, and other teams to ensure a seamless admissions and enrolment process.
  
12.Conduct competitor mystery shopping and market analysis to identify emerging trends, parent expectations, positioning opportunities, and potential sources of enrolment.
  
13.Participate Suggest points for the development and implementation of admissions policies, SOPs, processes, and service standards.
  
14.Proactively address new parent concerns, objections, and escalations, ensuring timely resolution and a positive admissions experience.
  
15.Represent the school professionally at external events, parent forums, education fairs, community engagements, and other outreach opportunities.

**Who we are looking for:**  
**Position Requirements**
  
1.Proven experience in admissions, enrolment, counselling, sales, business development, or a related customer-facing function, preferably within a school or education environment.
  
2.Prior experience in an IB or Cambridge International school is preferred.
  
3.Demonstrated experience in leading teams and achieving enrolment/admissions targets.
  
4.Strong understanding of the complete school admissions funnel, from lead generation and enquiry management to application, offer, conversion, and enrolment.
  
5.Strong people-management, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  
6.Excellent organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
  
7.Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret admissions data and translate insights into actionable strategies.
  
8.High attention to detail and strong process orientation.
  
9.Excellent verbal and written communication skills with a customer-centric approach.
  
10.Ability to build trust and long-term relationships with parents, students, consultants, and internal stakeholders.
  
11.Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
  
12.Ability to work independently, take ownership, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
  
13.Proficiency in CRM/admissions management systems like Dynamics, HubSpot, and reporting dashboards.
  
14.Adaptable, resilient, and comfortable working in a dynamic school environment with changing priorities.
  
15.Strong commitment to confidentiality, professionalism, service excellence, and the school's values.
  
  
**Benefits at CHIREC**  

* Competitive salary depending upon qualifications and experience
* Lunch on all school-working days
* School transport as per the available bus routes
* Comprehensive Medical Insurance
* Personal accident policy
* Term Life policy
* Professional Development

Cognita Schools are committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment. Safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks will be undertaken before any appointment is confirmed.
  
We believe having a diverse workforce makes us better, smarter and happier and so welcome applicants from all backgrounds, genders, and races. We have an unwavering commitment to being fair and equitable in our recruitment process.

title: Head of Operations and Compliance
description:
**About The Role**
The Head of Operations and Compliance makes sure that every client account is right every day, that the firm meets every regulatory obligation on time, and that the controls around trading, clients and money work without depending on any one person. The role is hands-on: you will run the processes yourself before you build a team around them.
  
  
The role is deliberately independent of research, technology and sales. You report directly to the Managing Partner and CEO, and as compliance officer you have direct access to the Founder and the Investment Committee.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Daily trading operations
* Run the pre-market checklist: every client account ready, funded and margined, and the day's limits loaded.
* Reconcile every client account each day against the broker: trades, positions, margins, funds and P&L.
* Produce the end-of-day operations report and keep a log of every incident, its cause and its fix.
* Keep the expiry and holiday calendar and the operational procedures for expiry days.
* Be the operational contact for the broker and the exchanges: service levels, escalations, and account permissions.
* Check the daily post-trade analytics prepared by research: live trades reconciled against the backtest for every deployed strategy, covering strategy logic, execution logic and slippage, with gaps escalated.
* Client operations
* Run client onboarding: agreements, risk profiling and suitability records, account set-up with the broker, and readiness checks before trading starts.
* Produce or check client reports and statements, and make sure what clients see matches the reconciled records.
* Handle client service requests, changes to mandates, and offboarding.
* Run the client complaints process within the regulatory timelines.
* Fees and billing
* Calculate fees for every client under the terms of their agreement, including performance-linked fees and high-water marks.
* Issue invoices, track collections, and reconcile fee flows with the technology platform partner.
* Check that fee terms and billing follow SEBI's rules for advisers.
* Compliance and regulatory affairs
* Act as the firm's compliance officer for its Investment Adviser and Research Analyst registrations(TBD).
* Keep the compliance calendar: filings, renewals, certifications, and the annual compliance audit.
* Maintain the records the regulations require: client agreements, advice and research records, risk profiles, and communications.
* Write and maintain the firm's policies: code of conduct, personal trading, conflicts of interest, record-keeping, complaints and data protection.
* Track regulatory changes, including rules for algorithmic trading through brokers and for exchange-traded derivatives, and turn them into procedures.
* Work with the external compliance adviser, legal counsel and auditors, and close their findings on time.
* Operational risk and controls
* Write and maintain standard operating procedures for every recurring process.
* Set up access rights, approval workflows and separation of duties, so that no one person can both make and check a change to trading, client records or payments. With the CTO, maintain the user and group access matrix for dashboards, code and documentation, including the wall between research and trading, and review it every quarter.
* Run incident management and escalation, and report incidents and their fixes to the CEO.
* Maintain the business continuity plan with the CTO, and test it at least once a year.
* Review the operational risk of key vendors: the broker, the technology platform, data providers.
* Finance and administration
* Coordinate the outsourced accountants on bookkeeping, tax, statutory compliance and the annual audit.
* Approve expenses and payments for all spending, including learning and development within its budget, limits and categories. Requests come from the employee or their manager; you approve them, and the CEO also approves any amount above ₹50,000. Every payment needs two-person approval.
* Look after office administration and vendor contracts.
* HR and people
* Coordinate payroll and HR administration with the outsourced provider, and keep employee records and onboarding paperwork.
* Check that the HR policy is followed: the employee handbook (leave, work from home, travel), work-from-home days logged on the shared calendar and reconciled each month with biometric attendance and leave records, and the hiring pipeline run through Pajama HR.
* Own the master candidate sheet: one file of all potential and interviewed candidates, kept up to date by each hiring manager.
* Reporting
* A daily operations dashboard: reconciliation status, breaks, incidents.
* A monthly operations and compliance report to the CEO and the Investment Committee: open issues, regulatory deadlines, incidents and control gaps.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate degree in commerce, finance, law or a related subject. A CA, CS, CFA or MBA, or relevant NISM certifications, are an advantage.
* 6–10 years of relevant experience in operations, compliance or both, preferably with a stockbroker, portfolio management firm, AIF, investment adviser or trading firm.
* Working knowledge of Indian exchange-traded derivatives, including margins, settlement, expiry cycles and broker back-office operations.
* Hands-on experience with SEBI compliance requirements applicable to Investment Advisers, Research Analysts or Portfolio Managers.
* Experience in establishing operational processes, internal controls and compliance frameworks from the ground up.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Exact with numbers: reconciliations, fee calculations and reports are right the first time.
* Strong spreadsheet skills; SQL or scripting to automate reconciliations is an advantage.
* Clear writer of procedures and policies.
* Calm under pressure on the trading day, and firm about controls with senior colleagues.
* High integrity: the role requires independence and discretion. Skills: records,compliance,operations,technology

title: Contract Manager
description:
We are a leading chemical company, with the best teams developing intelligent solutions for our customers, and for a sustainable future.
  
  
We connect and develop people with diverse talents all over the world. For you, this means a variety of ways to progress.
  
  
Not only your performance but also your personality matter to us, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, orientation, and background. At BASF, careers develop from opportunities .
  
  
**About The Role**

* As Project Contract Manager, be responsible for awarding and management of service and works contracts within CAPEX projects in India, including identification of cost-saving opportunities, timely award, post-award contract administration, change and claims management, and contract close-out together with project stakeholders.
* Oversee the project services procurement process and create Contract Status Reports ensuring transparency; serve as the project-specific Services Procurement focal point for progress, commercial risk and escalation management; and implement company policies, guidelines, approval requirements and documentation standards into project contracting.
* Support the project team with contractual and commercial advice to safeguard BASF positions, including scope changes, extension of time, acceleration and catch-up plans, contractor non-conformances, contractual remedies, final account and close-out.
* Develop and manage the contractor pool for CAPEX projects in accordance with business targets together with Engineering, EHS, category teams and other project stakeholders.
* Provide end-to-end contract and commercial management across the full greenfield project contracting portfolio – technology licence, EPC, construction, unit/package system and other CAPEX and OPEX service contracts – from project development through execution, commissioning and close-out.

**What Will You Do**
**Project Contract Management Responsibilities:**

* Ensure compliance in the procurement process in accordance with the BASF Supplier Code of Conduct, local laws, company compliance requirements and global procurement guidelines.
* Develop and implement the Contract Execution Plan and contracting strategy for assigned CAPEX projects in India, aligned with the project schedule, packaging strategy, market conditions, commercial risk profile and applicable IA/FA approval requirements.
* Lead the contracting strategy, tendering, negotiation, award and post-award administration for technology licence agreements, EPC contracts, construction contracts, unit/package system contracts, and other general CAPEX and OPEX service contracts for greenfield projects, ensuring appropriate allocation of scope, interfaces, performance obligations, guarantees, liabilities, risks and commercial terms.
* Generate service and works contract bidder lists in collaboration with stakeholders from the operating division, Project Management, Engineering and category teams.
* Support Cost Engineering to establish BOQs, base prices, unit-rate structures and commercial benchmarks; evaluate bids to identify cost optimization opportunities and potential claim exposure.
* Ensure timely award of contracts, including expediting MRQs and scope readiness, driving RFQ generation and tendering, expediting TBE, conducting CNBs, negotiation and CBE, and preparing award recommendations.
* Lead post-award management of assigned contracts during project execution, including obligations, contractual correspondence, securities, insurances, warranties, payment conditions, change orders, claims, non-conformances and status reporting.
* Generate and track the Contract Status Report and an integrated contract-performance dashboard for assigned projects, providing regular updates to the project team on award status, budget, obligations, milestones, KPIs, payments, securities, commercial risk, changes, claims, non-conformances, contractor performance, forecast exposure and required decisions.
* Review and approve purchase orders and change orders according to project signing matrices and delegated authority.
* Manage the contract lifecycle and digital visibility in SAP, Icertis, Mercanis, SAP Analytics Cloud, JIRA, P2P Toolbox or other designated systems, ensuring complete, timely and audit-ready records.


+ Own readiness for internal, external and quality audits for assigned contracts and ensure corrective and preventive actions are closed.
+ Maintain a project contract-management plan, obligation register and contract-governance RACI covering Procurement, Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Project Controls, Legal, Finance, EHS and Operations.
+ Lead disciplined EOT, delay and disruption assessment using contemporaneous programme evidence, critical-path analysis, cause-and-effect records and cost substantiation appropriate to the contract.
+ Maintain an India-specific contractual risk checklist covering governing law, notice requirements, variation mechanisms, liquidated damages, liability, indemnity, insurance, force majeure, termination and dispute resolution, with Legal validation where required.

**Contractor Management Responsibilities:**

* Follow up on strategic contractor management and maintain regular exchange with core contractors; provide feedback to regional Procurement Management, Engineering and operating divisions; and transfer best practices and lessons learned.
* Conduct contractor audits and qualifications with the Procurement Verbund Team, EHS and project stakeholders, ensuring qualification covers technical capability, financial health, EHS, Responsible Care, sustainability, human rights, BPDD and EcoVadis requirements, as applicable.
* Act as first line for potential contractual issues and contractor non-conformances and escalate material issues to the Team Leader, Project Manager, Legal or regional management, as required.
* Support the Category Manager in developing the CAPEX contracting and contractor strategy.
* Coordinate contractor performance reviews, recovery actions, final evaluation and lessons learned for assigned projects.
* Apply risk-based contractor segmentation and differentiated governance for strategic, critical and routine contract packages.
* Define measurable contract KPIs covering safety, quality, schedule, productivity, commercial responsiveness, sustainability and close-out, with corrective-action or service-credit mechanisms where appropriate.
* Identify contractor capacity, workforce, subcontractor, regulatory, EHS and continuity risks and develop practical mitigation or alternative sourcing actions.

**Procurement Planning & Strategy:**

* Align Procurement, Project Management, Engineering, Construction, Legal, Finance, Cost Engineering, Project Controls, EHS and Operations on scope readiness, commercial strategy, tender progress and execution priorities.
* Identify diverging stakeholder interests early and facilitate conflict resolution while safeguarding BASF’s contractual and commercial position.
* Complete contract close-out including final account, claims settlement, securities and warranty status, release documentation, records retention, contractor evaluation and lessons learned.
* Evaluate bids on total service cost, risk, compliance, quality, schedule and capability, not price alone, applying should-cost, clean-sheet, productivity and risk-adjusted analysis for major packages where reliable data is available; document the award rationale and residual risks.
* Lead end-to-end change and claims governance, including early warning, timely notices, entitlement assessment, substantiation, valuation, negotiation, settlement, recovery and formal closure; ensure no changed work proceeds without written authorization except under an approved emergency process.
* Track value realization against the approved business case and contract baseline, including savings, avoided cost, recoveries, value leakage and forecast exposure.
* Drive dispute avoidance through early-warning reviews, defined escalation protocols, documented settlement authority and timely involvement of Legal and project leadership.

**What We Look For**

* Strong negotiation skills for prices, payment terms, securities, terms and conditions, changes, extensions of time and claims.
* Deep knowledge of supplier and contractor landscapes and types of contractual engagement in engineering, construction, EPC and EPCM projects.
* Deep knowledge of contract terms and conditions, deviation handling, contract administration, change and claim management, non-conformance remedies and contract close-out, including related tools and legal exposure.
* Comprehensive understanding of BOQs, unit rates, cost structures and procurement processes, with the ability to establish a Contract Execution Plan, carry out bidder qualification and shortlisting, and report contract status, changes and claims.
* Strong project-management and influencing skills for virtual and cross-functional teams without direct reporting lines.
* Solid knowledge of SAP, purchase orders, Microsoft Office (particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word) and contract/claims-management tools such as Icertis; knowledge of Mercanis, SAP Analytics, Power BI and SAP S/4HANA is advantageous.
* Solid knowledge of contractor audits, qualifications and EHS standards expected by large multinational companies.


+ Excellent written and verbal English for stakeholder interaction and for drafting contractual notices, correspondence and management reports; an additional Indian or international language is an advantage.
+ Full mobility within India for project relocation and willingness to travel extensively to support projects in India and, when assigned, Asia Pacific.
+ Practical knowledge of FIDIC-based and bespoke EPC/construction contracts used in India, together with awareness of the Indian Contract Act, 1872 and the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996; Legal remains responsible for legal interpretation.
+ Working capability in EOT, variation, delay, disruption and cost-claim substantiation; PMP, MRICS, CCM, CPCM or equivalent certification is advantageous but not mandatory.

**Minimum Education And Qualification Required For The Position**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Law, Commerce, Economics, Finance or a related discipline.
* More than 7 years of work experience in Indirect Procurement, Contract/Commercial Management and CAPEX projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing service or works contracts through tendering, award, execution, change/claims and close-out.

Conflict of Interest & Code of Conduct policies

Strong executive presence to advise the Board and challenge business heads constructively.

title: Lead Software Engineer I
description:
**Your growth matters.**
At IGT, we're building a culture where people Innovate with Purpose, Compete Intensely & Win, Lead with Heart, Make It Matter, and Create Value. Grow your career while helping shape what's next.
  
  
Build what's next at IGT.
  
  
**Role Overvie**
As a Senior Application Support Engineer (Level 5), you are the most senior technical authority below management within L3 RGS Global Operations — a hands-on specialist who resolves the most complex, code-level issues across the IGT RGS platform. You sit within a dedicated subject-matter-expert (SME) team that goes deeper than generalist application support, and you are expected to own a defined area of the product at genuine expert level.
  
  
This role exists because the platform’s architectural, integration and delivery complexity now demands engineers who can investigate at a code level — reading and reasoning about the application’s behaviour directly, not just its symptoms — and who can work shoulder to shoulder with core platform engineering on the most complex faults. Your development background is central to the role: the same skills used to build adapters, integrations and customisations are exactly what allow you to debug them precisely under production conditions.
  
  
You will act as the escalation destination for incidents the generalist L3 teams cannot resolve, partner directly with engineering to drive permanent fixes, and raise the technical quality of the wider support organisation through the evidence, tooling and documentation you produce — in a microservices-based, multi-vendor, globally distributed environment.
  
  
You will assist with operational delivery of new features and functionality across promotional tools, game engines and core functionality. Working with the wider operational teams and directly with product management and engineering you will ensure new features meet operational requirements and wider operational teams are ready to adapt and implement and support these features.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Serve as the technical SME for one or more core product domains, including promotional tools, core platform functionality, game engines, integration layers, and customizations.
* Independently diagnose and resolve complex, multi-system issues across application,integration, platform, and data layers, including code-level investigation across Java back-end and JavaScript/HTML front-end applications and event flows.
* Act as a senior escalation point for incidents that exceed generalist L3 support capabilities by forming and testing hypotheses, analyzing technical evidence, and isolating root causes under production conditions.
* Partner directly with core platform engineering to reproduce complex issues, identify failing components, provide complete and reproducible technical context, and validate permanent fixes.
* Trace and analyze API and integration flows using application code, technical documentation, and flow diagrams. Build or enhance scripts, queries, and diagnostic tools as needed to improve investigation and resolution.
* Perform log-driven investigations using OpenSearch/DQL or similar technologies and leverage platform data to support incident analysis, decision-making, and technical solutions.
* Lead root-cause analysis and problem-management activities, partnering with engineering to define corrective actions and reduce issue recurrence, customer impact, and mean time to resolution (MTTR).
* Create and maintain specialist runbooks, debugging playbooks, troubleshooting guides, knowledge articles, and diagnostic tools to improve the consistency and efficiency of technical support.
* Mentor and support other technical support engineers through case reviews, technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and coaching on investigation methodologies.
* Support operational readiness for new features, functionality, integrations, markets, migrations, and platform changes by validating expected behavior, identifying operational risks, and supporting successful rollout and handover.
* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and wider operational teams to support the delivery of new functionality across promotional tools, game engines, and core platform capabilities.
* Maintain a high level of technical ownership within assigned product domains and promote continuous improvement across the support organization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

**Experience Required**

* 10 years of work related experience is required.
* Extensive hands-on experience in senior technical application support, software engineering, integration/delivery, or a related technical role supporting business-critical, customer-facing platforms.
* Demonstrated experience diagnosing complex issues across distributed, multi-system environments, including application, integration, platform, and data layers.
* Experience investigating application behavior at the code level and isolating and validating technical fixes in production environments.
* Experience with API and system integrations and the ability to determine system behavior using application code, technical documentation, and flow diagrams.
* Experience performing root-cause analysis and supporting incident and problem-management processes.

**Skills Required**

* Strong development-level proficiency with Java for back-end applications.
* Strong knowledge of JavaScript and HTML, including the ability to understand and debug front-end application and event flows.
* Strong understanding of APIs and integration flows. Experience designing, developing, or extending APIs is a plus.
* Strong Linux server knowledge and scripting skills, including the ability to develop or adapt diagnostic tools.
* Experience with log-driven troubleshooting and analysis; knowledge of OpenSearch, DQL, or equivalent query tools is preferred.
* Ability to use technical and operational data effectively when investigating incidents and determining solutions.
* Strong understanding of operational risk and the impact of changes within business- critical production environments.
* Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to independently investigate highly complex technical issues.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to create clear, evidence-based incident narratives and high-quality technical documentation.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with Engineering, Product Management, Operations, and globally distributed technical teams.
* Ability to mentor and provide technical guidance to less-experienced support engineers.
* Ability and willingness to provide occasional out-of-hours support for major incidents as required.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within iGaming, casino gaming, or another regulated real-money platform environment.
* Experience supporting multi-vendor, microservices-based architectures and game/content platforms, including game engines, Remote Game Servers (RGS), and Player Account Management (PAM) integrations.
* Experience developing integrations, adapters, reverse integrations, or front-end and back-end customizations
* Experience working within globally distributed or follow-the-sun technical support environments.
* Experience mentoring, coaching, or providing technical leadership to other support engineers.

**Success Measures — What Good Looks Like**

* Recognised as the go-to SME for your assigned product domain(s), trusted by both generalist L3 and core platform engineering.
* Consistent, high-quality resolution of complex incidents that the generalist teams cannot resolve alone.
* A measurable contribution to reduced recurrence and MTTR for the hardest classes of problem within your domains.
* A growing body of specialist documentation and diagnostic tooling that demonstrably speeds up resolution across the wider support organisation.

**Why join IGT?**
At IGT, our greatest competitive advantage is our people. We take ownership, work with urgency, act with integrity, stay curious, and create value for our customers and each other. Join us and help shape what's next.
  
  
IGT is committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace that reflects the global communities and customers we serve. We strive to create an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered.
  
  
IGT is an equal opportunity employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. This commitment applies to all employment practices, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, benefits, training, and termination.
  
  
We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

As the world’s leading provider of AI-powered solutions for social impact, Blackbaud is looking for a Customer Lifecycle Marketing Manager to help create meaningful experiences throughout the customer journey. You’ll design scalable programs across onboarding, adoption, engagement, renewal, expansion, and advocacy that deepen customer relationships and drive long-term value. By bringing together customer insights, thoughtful engagement, and innovative technology, you’ll help strengthen loyalty and expand what is possible for purpose-driven people and organizations.

**What you'll do**

* Design and optimize lifecycle marketing programs across onboarding, adoption, engagement, retention, renewal, expansion, and advocacy.
* Develop targeted, multi-channel campaigns across email, in-product messaging, webinars, events, and other customer touchpoints to increase adoption, engagement, and loyalty.
* Build customer advocacy programs that create opportunities for referrals, references, testimonials, customer stories, reviews, awards, and community participation.
* Lead cross-functional customer engagement programs from planning through execution, measurement, and optimization.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, Sales, and Marketing to strengthen customer health, retention, and growth.
* Use customer feedback and lifecycle analytics to personalize experiences, identify opportunities, and continuously improve program effectiveness.
* Leverage marketing platforms and AI-assisted tools to improve segmentation, personalization, reporting, program execution, and experimentation.

**What you'll bring**

* 3+ years of experience in customer lifecycle marketing, customer marketing, customer advocacy, program management, or a related field.
* Experience building programs that improve customer adoption, engagement, retention, expansion, and advocacy.
* Experience supporting referral, reference, community, customer storytelling, or ambassador programs.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce, Gainsight, Marketo, HubSpot, or similar customer and marketing platforms.
* Experience using customer insights, data, and performance measures to assess and improve customer engagement programs.
* Experience managing cross-functional marketing programs and campaigns across multiple customer channels.
* Expected working hours are 1:00 PM–10:00 PM IST, with occasional flexibility to support collaboration during U.S. East Coast business hours.

title: Territory Manager - Neuro
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
About Lilly
  
At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients.
  
We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world.
  
Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve.
  
We bring our best to this work because people depend on it.
  
If you’re driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.
  
  
About Lilly’s India Affiliate
  
Few careers offer the opportunity to work directly for the people your work is ultimately meant to serve.
  
Lilly’s India affiliate is one of them.
  
Whether you are building brand strategies, developing sales capabilities, creating market access, or enabling the teams that do — the work you do here ensures that Lilly’s medicines reach the people who need them.
  
  
Job Summary
  
Responsible for achieving sales targets and driving market share growth for specialty products within a defined territory, building strong relationships with key healthcare professionals and institutions, and executing strategic sales plans in alignment with company objectives.
  
  
Job Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop and implement strategic territory plans to achieve and exceed sales targets for specialty pharmaceutical products.
* Identify, profile, and build strong, lasting relationships with key opinion leaders, prescribers, and other healthcare professionals in hospitals, clinics, and academic institutions.
* Conduct effective sales calls, presenting product features, benefits, and clinical data to healthcare professionals.
* Organize and conduct product presentations, CME programs, and other educational events for target audiences.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer needs to identify new business opportunities and threats.
* Collaborate with marketing, medical affairs, and other internal teams to ensure a coordinated approach to territory management.
* Manage and allocate resources effectively, including promotional budgets and samples.
* Maintain accurate records of sales activities, customer interactions, and market intelligence.
* Adhere to all company policies, industry regulations, and ethical standards.
* Participate in sales meetings, training programs, and professional development activities.

Job Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field. MBA is a plus.
* Minimum of 3–5 years of proven sales experience in the pharmaceutical industry, with a strong preference for specialty product experience (e.g., oncology, immunology, diabetes, neuroscience).
* Demonstrated track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Strong understanding of the Indian pharmaceutical market, healthcare landscape, and regulatory environment.
* Ability to analyze sales data, identify trends, and develop actionable strategies.
* Self-motivated, results-oriented, and able to work independently as well as part of a team.
* Proficiency in English and local languages relevant to the assigned territory.
* Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

At Lilly, caring is not only what we do for patients.
  
It is how we work.
  
We believe the people who dedicate themselves to making medicines better deserve an environment that makes their lives better too, one where they are supported, respected, and given the space to do their best work.
  
This is not just a policy.
  
It is who we are.

title: Marketing Campaign Operations Manager, Principal
description:
**About the Role**

Blackbaud is looking for a Campaign Operations Manager to define and support how our go-to-market teams plan, set up, track and manage campaigns, and to build the automation and AI-driven workflows that make that work faster and more consistent. In this role, you’ll set the standard for best-in-class campaign management and stay hands-on in the platforms, from request through setup, tracking, QA, launch and measurement.

You’ll work within Marketing Operations, across our Marketing Automation Team, Vertical Marketing, Web, Paid Media and Brand & Events teams, connecting process, technology, data and AI to create clearer ownership, faster delivery and measurable impact. This is an individual contributor role for someone who enjoys balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

**What You’ll Do**

* Define and own the campaign management standard, from request to close, including tracking, naming and UTMs, Marketo program and Salesforce campaign hierarchy, member statuses and what “done” means at each stage.
* Own marketing intake, triage, prioritisation and SLAs, and the Asana workflows and automations that support GTM Campaign Ops across vertical teams, Brand, Web, Events and Paid Media.
* Set up, track and manage complex and high-visibility campaigns hands-on, as well as building the playbooks, templates and QA checklists others support, and act as the expert escalation for our Marketing Automation Team.
* Lead our AI and agentic workflows initiative, deciding where agents earn a place and building them, starting with campaign setup, tracking and QA, intake completeness and campaign routing, status and risk monitoring.

* Partner closely with Marketing Automation and Marketing Operations colleagues who own our platforms, data and integrations.
* Understand the integrations and workflows that connect our martech ecosystem, including Marketo, Salesforce, event and webinar platforms, such as Goldcast and iCapture, plus web and CMS, Chat and Agentic Prospecting platforms such as Qualified, partnering with platform owners to establish a seamless operating model.
* Publish operational KPIs, and drive adoption through playbooks, documentation, training and change management across globally distributed teams.

**What We’ll Want You to Have**

* 10+ years of experience in marketing operations, campaign operations, marketing automation, program management or a related area, including leading a large-scale process transformation.
* Hands-on experience setting up, tracking and managing campaigns in a marketing automation platform and Salesforce, with Marketo especially relevant, including programs, member statuses, tracking and attribution.
* Experience designing or running intake, workflow and automation in Asana or a comparable work management platform.
* Experience building automations or AI-agent and LLM-enabled workflows, with an understanding of their risks and controls. Examples of your own builds are welcome.
* Working knowledge across the wider martech ecosystem, such as event and webinar platforms, web and CMS, chat, and sales engagement tools.
* Strong analytical skills, including experience using dashboards and performance data to identify opportunities and translate insights into action.
* Excellent communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across time zones.

**Success in this Role**

Success in this role will be measured by:

* A campaign management standard that is published, adopted and measurably followed.
* Campaigns set up right the first time, with complete tracking and fewer setup defects.
* Faster, more predictable delivery, with less rework and less senior time spent on production support.
* Automations and agents in production that save measurable time, with accuracy tracked against a baseline.
* Clear ownership and visible status across GTM Ops, and strong partnership with the teams you serve.

title: Marketing Operations Manager
description:
The Marketing Operations Manager will lead the strategy, execution, and optimisation of marketing systems, data, and processes within a dynamic B2B environment. This role is responsible for managing the HubSpot marketing automation platform, ensuring seamless integration with Salesforce and other marketing technology ecosystems. The successful candidate will drive workflow design, data governance, and campaign performance, collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance lead capture, subscription management, and email deliverability. The position requires hands-on technical expertise, strong analytical skills, and the ability to balance strategic leadership with operational execution. Compensation and benefits are not specified in the job description.

**Job Requirements**  

*We are looking for a results-driven and hands-on* ***Manager of Marketing Operations*** *to lead the strategy, execution, and optimization of our marketing systems, data, and processes.*

*This role will own the marketing automation platform primarily* ***HubSpot*** *and its ecosystem will be responsible for building complex workflows, managing lifecycle stages, maintaining database quality, strengthening subscription and consent governance, improving email deliverability, and ensuring reliable integration between HubSpot, Salesforce, and the broader marketing technology ecosystem.*

*The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with strong technical execution. You should be comfortable designing scalable processes, troubleshooting system and data issues, and partnering with Demand Generation, Sales, RevOps, Business Operations, and Technology teams to improve funnel efficiency, pipeline visibility, and revenue impact.*

***Core Responsibilities***
---------------------------

* *Serve as the primary owner and subject-matter expert for HubSpot, including Marketing Hub administration, governance, configuration, and optimization.*
* *Design, build, test, and maintain complex HubSpot workflows using branching logic, enrollment and re-enrollment criteria, lead scoring, routing rules, nurture paths, notifications, task creation, and data-update automation.*
* *Build scalable automation for lead capture, qualification, assignment, follow-up, recycling, disqualification, suppression, and re-engagement.*
* *Establish workflow documentation, naming conventions, QA standards, approval processes, and change-management controls.*
* *Regularly audit workflows, lists, forms, properties, campaigns, and automation dependencies to identify conflicts, redundancies, performance issues, and optimization opportunities.*
* *Troubleshoot workflow failures, sync errors, incorrect enrollments, routing delays, and data-processing issues.*

### ***Lifecycle Stages and Funnel Management***

* *Design, implement, and continuously optimize lifecycle stages, lead statuses, qualification criteria, and funnel definitions across HubSpot and Salesforce.*
* *Manage the progression of leads through stages such as Subscriber, Open, Engaged, MQL, SAL, SQL, Opportunity, Customer, Nurture, Recycle, and Disqualified.*
* *Build automation for MQL creation, sales acceptance, lead handoff, meeting progression, opportunity association, recycling, and disqualification.*
* *Partner with Sales and RevOps to define SLAs, lead ownership rules, follow-up expectations, and stage-entry and exit criteria.*
* *Monitor funnel conversion, lead aging, stalled records, routing exceptions, and lifecycle-stage inconsistencies.*
* *Ensure lifecycle stages and lead statuses remain synchronized and accurately reported across HubSpot and Salesforce.*

### ***Data Management and Governance***

* *Own marketing data quality, database governance, and contact-management processes across HubSpot, Salesforce, and connected platforms.*
* *Develop scalable processes for data collection, validation, enrichment, normalization, deduplication, segmentation, suppression, and archiving.*
* *Define and maintain data dictionaries, property standards, field mappings, required fields, naming conventions, and source-of-truth rules.*
* *Conduct recurring database audits to identify duplicates, invalid records, incomplete data, hard bounces, inactive contacts, incorrect owners, and lifecycle-stage discrepancies.*
* *Build automated data-cleaning and enrichment workflows while maintaining clear audit trails and governance controls.*
* *Manage marketing-contact eligibility and database capacity to ensure efficient platform utilization and cost control.*
* *Partner with Sales Operations and Business Operations to resolve cross-platform data conflicts and maintain reporting accuracy.*

### ***GDPR, Consent, and Subscription Management***

* *Own GDPR-aligned marketing data practices, including consent capture, lawful processing, preference management, suppression, retention, and deletion workflows.*
* *Design and maintain subscription types, communication preferences, consent properties, opt-in and opt-out processes, and subscription-management pages.*
* *Ensure unsubscribe and suppression requests are accurately synchronized across HubSpot, Salesforce, and connected email platforms.*
* *Maintain separate and compliant communication rules for prospects, customers, partners, event attendees, and other audience segments.*
* *Conduct periodic audits of forms, consent language, subscription types, imports, integrations, and email sends.*
* *Partner with Legal, Privacy, IT, and Security teams to ensure marketing processes meet applicable data-privacy and compliance requirements.*

### ***Email Deliverability and Warm-Up Management***

* *Develop and manage email warm-up strategies for new sending domains, subdomains, dedicated IPs, and newly introduced email platforms.*
* *Create controlled warm-up schedules based on audience quality, engagement levels, sending volume, domain reputation, and campaign requirements.*
* *Monitor deliverability indicators such as bounce rates, spam complaints, unsubscribes, engagement, inbox placement, and sender reputation.*
* *Work with IT and platform teams to validate email authentication and sending-domain configuration, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.*
* *Build audience tiers and suppression rules to protect sender reputation and improve campaign performance.*
* *Investigate and resolve deliverability issues, domain blocks, spam filtering, email throttling, and unusual performance changes.*
* *Establish email-governance standards for segmentation, send frequency, contact eligibility, testing, and campaign QA.*

### ***Salesforce and Marketing Technology Integrations***

* *Own and optimize the HubSpot–Salesforce integration, including field mapping, object synchronization, lifecycle alignment, lead and contact ownership, campaign associations, and error resolution.*
* *Understand Salesforce objects, campaign structures, campaign-member statuses, lead conversion, opportunity association, and marketing attribution requirements.*
* *Monitor integration health and resolve duplicate records, field conflicts, sync failures, permission issues, and data overwrites.*
* *Design and maintain reliable data flows across* ***HubSpot, Salesforce, Goldcast, ZoomInfo, Freckle, and Seamless.ai****.*
* *Manage Goldcast integrations for event registrations, attendance, engagement activity, campaign-member statuses, and post-event follow-up.*
* *Manage ZoomInfo and Seamless.ai integrations for prospect discovery, enrichment, segmentation, field mapping, ownership, and duplicate prevention.*
* *Manage Freckle integrations and workflows for email verification, contact validation, database cleansing, and record-quality improvement.*
* *Work with internal technical teams and external vendors to troubleshoot APIs, webhooks, connectors, authentication, and integration dependencies.*
* *Evaluate new marketing technologies based on business value, scalability, data security, integration feasibility, and total cost of ownership.*

### ***Campaign Operations and Reporting***

* *Enable Demand Generation and regional marketing teams to execute scalable email, webinar, event, nurture, and integrated campaigns.*
* *Build campaign templates, operational checklists, segmentation standards, UTM governance, testing processes, and launch QA frameworks.*
* *Establish reporting for funnel performance, campaign influence, attribution, lead velocity, lifecycle conversion, database health, and pipeline contribution.*
* *Develop dashboards and operational reports across HubSpot and Salesforce to provide actionable insights to marketing and sales leadership.*
* *Analyze marketing performance and recommend improvements to targeting, workflow logic, nurture programs, routing, and campaign execution.*
  
  
* *Support annual planning, platform budgeting, capacity planning, vendor management, and marketing-technology roadmaps.*
  

  
  
**Work Experience**  

***Professional Qualifications***
---------------------------------

* *Strong hands-on experience administering and optimizing* ***HubSpot Marketing Hub*** *in a complex B2B environment.*
* *Proven experience building advanced HubSpot workflows involving branching logic, lead scoring, routing, nurturing, lifecycle progression, data updates, and cross-platform automation.*
* *Deep understanding of marketing databases, data governance, segmentation, deduplication, enrichment, validation, and reporting.*
* *Strong knowledge of lifecycle-stage design, lead-status management, MQL processes, sales handoffs, recycling, and funnel governance.*
* *Practical experience managing GDPR compliance, consent capture, subscription types, communication preferences, suppression lists, and data-retention processes.*
* *Demonstrated experience with email deliverability, sending-domain setup, audience warm-up, sender-reputation monitoring, and database hygiene.*
* *Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, including leads, contacts, accounts, campaigns, campaign members, opportunities, and HubSpot synchronization.*
* *Experience integrating and managing platforms such as* ***Goldcast, ZoomInfo, Freckle, and Seamless.ai****.*
* *Ability to diagnose workflow, integration, data, routing, and reporting issues independently.*
* *Strong analytical, project-management, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.*
* *Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on platform execution.*
* *Experience working with Demand Generation, Sales, RevOps, Business Operations, IT, Privacy, and Legal teams.*

***Preferred Qualifications***
------------------------------

* *Experience working in a high-growth B2B SaaS or enterprise technology organization.*
* *Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, middleware, integration platforms, and automation tools.*
* *Experience with multi-region databases, global campaign operations, and complex consent requirements.*
* *Knowledge of marketing attribution, campaign influence, pipeline reporting, and revenue analytics.*
* *HubSpot and Salesforce certifications are preferred.*
  

  
  
**Benefits**  

***Success in This Role***
--------------------------

*Success will be measured by improvements in:*

* *Marketing database quality, completeness, and compliance.*
* *Workflow reliability and automation efficiency.*
* *Lead-routing accuracy and sales follow-up speed.*
* *Lifecycle-stage consistency across HubSpot and Salesforce.*
* *Email deliverability, sender reputation, and audience engagement.*
* *Subscription and consent-management accuracy.*
* *Integration reliability and reduction in data-sync errors.*
* *Funnel conversion, campaign effectiveness, pipeline visibility, and measurable revenue impact.*

title: Engagement Manager - Delhi
description:
**About the Company**

The Founders Finance is a Bangalore-based finance partner for founder-led businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets. The team runs Virtual CFO, Accounting and Taxation, Fundraising, Company Secretarial and Advisory functions for companies across consumer and D2C, food and beverage, fashion, SaaS and financial services, working to a disciplined monthly rhythm rather than year-end scrambles. Clients get their books closed early in the month, a clear read on their cash runway, and a compliance calendar where nothing slips through. It's a small, senior-heavy team by design, so founders work directly with people who understand both the numbers and the business behind them.

**About the Role**

As an Engagement Manager, you own the client relationship. You're the person founders trust to know their numbers, spot problems early and keep every deliverable on time. You'll run a portfolio of clients end to end, from monthly closings and compliance to the conversations that shape their financial decisions.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

1. Own a portfolio of client engagements end to end, and act as the primary point of contact for founders and their teams

2. Deliver accounting, taxation, compliance and financial reporting services to clients on a disciplined monthly rhythm

3. Gather information and data from clients' finance managers, teams and other sources, and make sure it's complete, accurate and on time

4. Review books, reconciliations, MIS and P&Ls prepared by the team, and ensure quality before they reach the client

5. Present monthly performance, cash flow and key insights to founders, and advise on the actions that matter

6. Track compliance calendars (GST, TDS and other statutory deadlines) so nothing slips through

7. Guide and review the work of associates on your engagements, and help raise the quality bar across the team

8. Spot opportunities to expand services with existing clients, such as Virtual CFO, fundraising support and advisory

9. Manage timelines, deliverables and client expectations across multiple engagements at once

**Requirements**

1. CA Qualified (must)

2. 5+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations or client-facing finance services

title: Senior Accountant
description:
**What is Hunch?**
Hunch is a dating app built for follow-through - designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back-and-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.
  
  
With 2.4M+ daters, 1.47M+ dates planned, and 100% photo-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post-AI world.
  
  
Link to our fundraising announcement
  
  
**Key Offerings Of Hunch**

* One Drop a Day: A small, hand-picked set of photo-verified profiles arrives daily - chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.
* Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place - no logistics to manage.
* Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing - just real, trustworthy connections.
* Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time - nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.

**About The Role**
We're hiring a Senior Accountant to own the accounting function day to day. You'll oversee the books rather than do the data entry yourself: reviewing what the accounting team records, running reconciliations, leading the month-end and year-end close, and delivering accurate financial reports to management.
  
  
You'll report to the Head of Finance and work across multiple entities and jurisdictions as Hunch grows in India, the US and beyond.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Books oversight & General Ledger**

* Oversee day-to-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks and Tally; review entries for accuracy, correct classification and supporting documents.
* Own the general ledger: review accounts regularly, investigate unusual balances and keep the chart of accounts clean.
* Set and enforce accounting policies, processes and controls so the books are always audit-ready.

**Reconciliations**

* Own all key reconciliations: bank, vendor, customer/receivables, payment gateway and intercompany.
* Resolve discrepancies quickly and escalate open items with a clear ageing view.
* Review vendor payment runs against invoices, POs and payment terms before release.

**Month-end & year-end close**

* Lead the month-end and year-end close to a fixed calendar.
* Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, provisions, prepaid and depreciation adjustments.
* Maintain close checklists and schedules that support every balance sheet line.

**Financial reporting**

* Lead preparation of monthly management reports: P&L, balance sheet, cash flow and cash outflow / burn reports.
* Prepare annual financial statements for each entity and support consolidation.
* Share timely insights with the Head of Finance on variances, cash position and cost trends.

**Compliance & audit**

* Own statutory compliance across entities: GST, TDS, advance tax, ROC/annual filings and equivalent filings in other jurisdictions, working with external consultants where needed.
* Maintain a compliance calendar and log and report status to management.
* Be the point of contact for statutory, tax and internal audits; prepare schedules and resolve queries.

**Team & collaboration**

* Guide and review the work of junior accountants or outsourced bookkeepers.
* Work with Ops, HR, Product and leadership on tax and finance queries.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, commerce or finance; CA Inter / CMA / CS Inter preferred.
* At least 3–4 years of hands-on accounting/taxation experience, preferably owning the month-end close and reconciliations.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian GAAP / Ind AS, Companies Act, GST and TDS.
* Experience reviewing others' work and running audits end to end.
* Hands-on with QuickBooks and Tally; advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, reconciliation workbooks).
* Detail-oriented, organised and able to hit close and filing deadlines without follow-ups.
* Clear communicator who can explain numbers to non-finance teams.

**Good to Have**

* Experience managing accounts for multiple entities and jurisdictions (e.g. India, Singapore, UAE), including inter-company and consolidation.
* Exposure to startup or subscription / app-based businesses (app store and payment gateway revenue).
* Familiarity with transfer pricing documentation and international tax basics.
* Openness to new accounting tools and automation.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive pay along with an annual performance-linked incentive (PLI).
* Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.
* Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).

**Life at Hunch**
Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall - getting two interested people into the same room.
  
  
**What We Hire For - The ABCs**
Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:
  
  

* Authenticity - Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.
* Boldness - Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.
* Curiosity - The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.

**How We Work**

* Ownership, not theater - You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.
* Flexibility that's real - We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week - show up for the stuff that matters.
* Move fast, don't burn out - Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.
* Small team, big problems - You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.

**Backed by Global Investors**
Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.
  
  
**Experienced Leadership**
Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) - serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer-tech startup.
