title: Relationship Manager - Wholesale Banking Group
description:
**Essential Services: Role & Location fungibility**

At ICICI Bank, we believe in serving our customers beyond our role definition, product boundaries, and domain limitations through our philosophy of customer 360-degree. In essence, this captures our belief in serving the entire banking needs of our customers as
**One Bank, One Team**
. To achieve this, employees at ICICI Bank are expected to be
**role and location-fungible**
with the understanding that
**Banking is an essential service.**
The role descriptions give you an overview of the responsibilities, it is only directional and guiding in nature.

**About the role**

ICICI Bank provides comprehensive banking solutions to corporate customers. As a Relationship Manager of Wholesale Banking, you will be responsible for credit appraisal, financial analysis, client servicing, writing of credit notes, end-to-end executive of banking transactions, documentation, and covenant management. In this role, you work under the guidance of a Senior Relationship Manager/ Regional Head. While serving customers, you will be responsible for 360-degree banking and looking for banking opportunities across the customer ecosystem. This will involve offering banking products and services across the customer segments of the Bank. In your responsibility, you also hold the principle of being “Fair to Customer, Fair to Bank. You will be responsible for generating new business leads as well as deepening relationships with existing customers.

**Bankable individuals not just Bankers: We hire from across industries!**

We at ICICI Bank are in continuous pursuit of creating consistent customer delight and superior experience. Our Relationship Managers are empowered individuals who champion the cause of customer experience and have penchant for building and nurturing business relationships. If you are an individual, whose heart echoes with our aspiration, look no more. We do not just choose diverse minds but celebrate their success. If you are a bankable individual without banking experience, you are very much welcome, irrespective of your present core responsibilities or the industry associated. Our training programs equip you to get ready for the role of a Relationship Manager. Professionals from across industries are welcome to apply for the role of Relationship Manager.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **360° Credit Assessment:**
  Understand in detail the client’s business and financials and prepare a quality appraisal note in collaboration with the Risk Management team.
* **Business Development:**
  Market scoping, segmenting and targeting to acquire new clients as per the risk appetite of the bank and drive ecosystem revenue o The RM for the purpose of business origination, will engage with banks, brokers, corporates, law firms, trade associations, chamber of commerce as well as attend events, participate in seminars, and trade fairs.
* **Collaboration:**
  Work in synergy with different internal teams of the Bank in order to deliver the right solutions to the customer. Collaborative working is key in this role.
* **Portfolio Management:**
  Manage a high-quality portfolio of corporate clients. Work towards generating new business leads as well as deepening relationships with existing customers.
* **Customer Service:**
  Create service excellence by partnering with customers through their life cycle and offer suitable products and services based on their financial needs while being fair to the customer and fair to the bank in all engagements.

**Key Qualifications & Skills**

* **Educational Qualification:**
  MBA/chartered accountants/ Graduates. Graduates with 3-6 years of work experience or MBA/CAs with 1-5 years of work experience in the area of relationship management across industries
* **Communication skills:**
  Ability to tailor conversations (both verbal & written) arounds the need of customer with utmost focus on service delivery.
* **Financial Understanding:**
  Understanding of the intricacies of financial analysis, the balance sheet, profit & loss accounts and cash flow statements. Knowledge of basic banking products.

**About the Business group**

The Wholesale Banking Group of ICICI Bank manages a wide range of clients, which includes large private sector business houses and companies, financial institutions and banks, public sector undertakings, and Central and State government entities. The group also has a strong franchise among Multi-National Corporations (MNCs), real estate companies, IT & ITES, and new-age services companies, along with a strong franchise in the financial sponsor's space with a special focus on private equity funds and their investee companies. Additionally, it also caters to the requirements of the capital market and custody participants through unique digital solutions, improving their operational efficiency.

title: Article Assistant -  Internal Audit
description:
**Company Description**
BGJC is a professional services firm that focuses on delivering high-quality audit and assurance solutions to a diverse range of clients. The firm emphasizes accuracy, integrity, and compliance with relevant financial and regulatory standards. Team members at BGJC collaborate closely to support clients in strengthening their internal controls and improving financial transparency. The work environment encourages learning, professional development, and practical exposure to various aspects of internal and external auditing.
  
**Role Description**
The Article Assistant – Internal Audit will support the internal audit team in planning and executing audit assignments for clients. Day-to-day responsibilities include assisting in risk assessment, testing internal controls, performing walkthroughs of processes, and reviewing financial records and documentation. The role involves preparing working papers, drafting sections of audit reports, and helping identify control weaknesses and process improvements. The Article Assistant will coordinate with client teams to collect information, clarify findings, and maintain clear communication throughout the audit process. This is a full-time, on-site role based in South Delhi, with opportunities to gain hands-on experience and develop professional skills in internal auditing and finance.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in financial audits and finance, with a solid understanding of accounting principles and internal control frameworks.
* Candidates should possess the ability to prepare and review audit reports, including clear documentation of findings, conclusions, and recommendations.
* Candidates should possess well-developed analytical skills to interpret financial data, identify discrepancies, and assess risks and control effectiveness.
* Candidates should possess effective communication skills, including the ability to interact professionally with clients and team members and present audit observations clearly.
* Relevant academic background in commerce, accounting, or finance; pursuing or completed professional qualifications such as CA Articleship or equivalent is an advantage.
* Attention to detail, ethical conduct, and the ability to work collaboratively in a structured, deadline-driven environment.
* Proficiency in basic office software (e.g., Excel, Word) and willingness to learn audit tools and methodologies.

title: Senior Analyst II FP&A
description:
Cvent is a leading meetings, events, and hospitality technology provider with more than 6000+

employees and ~34,000 customers worldwide, including 60% of the Fortune 500. Founded in 1999,

Cvent delivers a comprehensive event marketing and management platform for marketers and event professionals and offers software solutions to hotels, special event venues and destinations to help them grow their group/MICE and corporate travel business. Our technology brings millions of people together at events around the world. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers human connection.

Headquartered in Tysons Corner, Virginia, Cvent (formerly NYSE: CVT) was acquired by Blackstone

for $4.6B in 2023.

Cvent's strength lies in its people, fostering a culture where everyone is encouraged to think like

entrepreneurs, taking risks and making decisions confidently. We value diverse perspectives and

celebrate differences, working together with colleagues and clients to build strong connections.

Cvent is redefining the meetings and events industry through technology that advances human

connection.

**AI at Cvent: Leading the Future**

Are you ready to shape the future of work at the intersection of human expertise and AI innovation? At Cvent, we’re committed to continuous learning and adaptation—AI isn’t just a tool for us, it’s part of our DNA. We’re looking for candidates who are eager to evolve alongside technology. If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

Throughout our interview process, you’ll have the chance to demonstrate how you use AI to learn,

iterate, and amplify your impact. If you’re excited to be part of a team that’s leading the way in AI-

title: Associate - FDD
description:

Our services span Financial Due Diligence, Office of the CFO (OCFO), Valuation, and Data Analytics, delivered through a deeply integrated model that provides exceptional value to our clients worldwide.

Our India team collaborates directly with senior professionals at leading US-based firms, giving you real exposure to complex, high-stakes engagements from day one.

What sets Zinca apart is our deep commitment to developing our people. Senior leadership is directly involved in engagements, creating an environment of real on-the-job learning and mentorship. Every engagement is an opportunity to grow, guided by experienced professionals who are invested in your development. We are a merit-driven team that values intellectual curiosity, ownership, and quality.

**What will you be doing?**

As an Associate at Zinca, you will take ownership of defined workstreams within buy-side and sell-side FDD engagements, working closely with Senior Associates and VPs. You will deepen your technical skills across financial analysis and report writing, and build a strong grasp of industry-specific considerations in Quality of Earnings (QofE) analysis.

1. Participate in buy-side and sell-side transaction advisory engagements
2. Conduct in-depth analysis of financial information, including trial balances, income statements, balance sheets, and cash flows
3. Prepare databooks in accordance with firm and professional standards and in accordance with the requirements of the project
4. Identify key issues and carry out relevant financial analysis
5. Highlight unusual trends and observations, and frame questions for management
6. Take ownership of defined workstreams or sections of larger engagements, reporting to a Senior Associate or VP
7. Contribute to Quality of Earnings (QofE) analysis, including EBITDA normalizations, identification of one-time and non-recurring items, and supporting commentary
8. Write sections of an FDD / VDD report
9. Develop operational insights using data and analytics to identify drivers of profitability and evaluate key risks and opportunities
10. Begin developing sector expertise (e.g., industrials, SaaS, healthcare, etc.) aligned to the engagement portfolio
11. Learn and deploy new-age technologies to enhance insights and efficiency on engagements (our tech stack includes AI platforms, Alteryx, PowerQuery, PowerBI, etc.)
12. Other ad-hoc pre-acquisition and post-acquisition due diligence support tasks
13. Establish strong professional relationships with internal / external clients

**Basic Qualifications**

* Qualifications: CA / CPA / CFA / Master’s / MBA or PGDM in Finance or Accounting
* Experience: The candidate must have 2 to 4 years of relevant experience in a similar role in a professional services firm. FDD experience is preferred.

**Preferred Skills**

1. Strong knowledge of accounting and financial skills (US GAAP and IFRS)
2. Strong Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint skills
3. Excellent written / verbal communication skills and interpersonal skills
4. Highly motivated with an exceptional work ethic, and a demonstrated ability and desire to work cooperatively with team members and client professionals
5. Strong analytical abilities; knowledge of data analytics tools is an added advantage
6. Curiosity about and willingness to adopt AI tools to enhance the quality and efficiency of financial analysis and client deliverables
7. Ability to present findings clearly to US-based clients in written and verbal form; comfortable with some overlap with Client’s business hours as needed
8. Personal drive to deliver accurate, high-quality work under tight deal timelines
9. Intellectual curiosity with the ability to ask the right questions and go beyond the numbers

* A proactive approach to identifying and resolving process gaps, with a continuous improvement mindset.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior exposure to regulatory reporting frameworks such as PRA, Bank of England returns, or Basel III metrics.
* Familiarity with liquidity and capital concepts including LCR, NSFR, or RWA calculations.
* Experience working with financial data in Excel or other reporting tools.

Job Title: Head of Marketing

We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Head of Marketing to lead the organization's overall marketing strategy, brand positioning, go-to-market (GTM) execution, digital marketing, integrated campaigns, public relations, and corporate communications.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for strengthening brand visibility, driving business growth, generating qualified leads, enhancing market positioning, and ensuring consistent brand communication across all customer and stakeholder touchpoints.

Key Responsibilities

1. Marketing Strategy & Business Growth

• Develop and execute the overall marketing strategy aligned with business objectives, revenue targets, and organizational growth plans.

• Identify market opportunities, customer segments, competitive positioning, and emerging industry trends.

• Build annual marketing plans, budgets, and performance metrics to maximize marketing ROI.

• Collaborate with sales, business development, product, and leadership teams to drive customer acquisition and business growth.

• Monitor marketing effectiveness through KPIs, analytics, and performance reporting.

2. Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy & Execution

• Develop and execute GTM strategies for new product launches, services, market expansion, and new business initiatives.

• Define target audiences, value propositions, positioning, pricing communication, and market-entry strategies.

• Drive sales enablement through marketing collateral, presentations, product messaging, and customer engagement initiatives.

• Align marketing and sales teams to ensure effective lead generation, conversion, and pipeline growth.

• Track GTM performance, market adoption, campaign effectiveness, and revenue contribution.

3. Branding & Brand Management

• Develop and strengthen the organization's brand identity, positioning, messaging, and market differentiation.

• Ensure consistent brand communication across digital platforms, corporate presentations, marketing collateral, events, and external communications.

• Lead brand-building initiatives to improve awareness, reputation, recall, and customer trust.

• Oversee brand guidelines, creative development, visual identity, and corporate messaging.

• Conduct brand audits and market research to evaluate brand perception and positioning.

4. Digital Marketing & Demand Generation

• Lead digital marketing initiatives across SEO, SEM, social media, email marketing, content marketing, and paid advertising.

• Develop digital strategies to improve online visibility, website traffic, lead generation, and customer engagement.

• Manage digital campaigns, marketing automation, CRM integration, and lead-nurturing programs.

• Use analytics tools to measure campaign performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, and ROI.

• Optimize digital channels and marketing investments to achieve business objectives.

5. Integrated Marketing Campaigns

• Conceptualize and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital, print, events, trade shows, and other relevant channels.

• Lead campaign planning, creative development, content creation, media planning, and execution.

• Develop targeted campaigns for brand awareness, lead generation, customer engagement, and product promotion.

• Coordinate with internal teams, creative agencies, media partners, and external vendors.

• Measure campaign effectiveness and continuously improve performance based on data and insights.

6. Public Relations & Corporate Publicity

• Develop and implement PR strategies to strengthen corporate reputation and media visibility.

• Manage media relations, press releases, media interviews, corporate announcements, and leadership communications.

• Drive corporate publicity through industry publications, business media, thought leadership, and relevant public platforms.

• Build relationships with journalists, media houses, PR agencies, industry associations, and key stakeholders.

• Support crisis communication, reputation management, and proactive communication planning.

• Enhance executive visibility through speaking opportunities, interviews, articles, and industry events.

7. Corporate Communications & Content Strategy

• Develop corporate communication strategies aligned with organizational objectives and brand positioning.

• Oversee website content, company profiles, brochures, presentations, newsletters, case studies, and marketing collateral.

• Ensure consistent messaging across internal and external communication channels.

• Position the organization and its leadership as credible voices in the industry through thought leadership and expert content.

• Lead, mentor, and develop the marketing, branding, digital marketing, and communications teams.

• Manage external agencies, consultants, creative partners, and marketing vendors.

• Establish clear goals, budgets, workflows, and accountability across marketing functions.

• Work closely with senior leadership, sales, product, and business development teams to ensure marketing alignment with business priorities.

• Brand awareness, recall, and market positioning.

• GTM effectiveness and product/service adoption.

• Marketing-qualified leads (MQLs) and sales-qualified leads (SQLs).

• Lead conversion rates and contribution to sales pipeline.

• Digital marketing performance, website traffic, and engagement.

• Campaign ROI and cost per lead/customer acquisition.

• Media coverage, share of voice, and PR effectiveness.

• Marketing budget utilization and return on marketing investment.

Required Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.

• 12–18+ years of experience in marketing, branding, GTM, digital marketing, and corporate communications.

• Proven experience in developing and executing integrated marketing strategies.

• Strong understanding of digital marketing, demand generation, campaign management, brand management, and public relations.

• Experience leading cross-functional teams, managing budgets, and working with senior leadership.

• Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and leadership skills.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
**Position Title:**
Chief of Staff, ETLS

**Band:**
R

**Level: Manager**

**Reporting Manager:**
ETLS Business Leader

**People Manager: IC role**

**BU: ETLS**

**Location: Bengaluru**

**Position Type: Permanent**

**No. of Position:1**

**Overview**

NIIT Ltd. is a leading global skills and talent development organization, empowering enterprises to build future-ready workforces through innovative learning, digital transformation and capability-building solutions. With over four decades of expertise, NIIT partners with leading organizations across Banking, Financial Services, Technology, Manufacturing, Retail and other sectors to accelerate business performance through workforce transformation.

As organizations continue to invest in AI, digital capability and leadership development, NIIT is uniquely positioned to help enterprises solve their most critical talent challenges.

We are looking for a high-calibre, commercially astute and execution-driven professional to partner directly with the Enterprise Technology Business Head in driving business growth, strategic priorities and operational excellence.

The role requires a strong combination of strategic thinking, business analytics, financial acumen and cross-functional execution. The individual will operate as an extension of the Business Head, translating business priorities into measurable outcomes, driving critical initiatives and enabling faster, data-backed decisions.

**Job Description**

**Role Responsibilities**

**1. Business Strategy & Growth**

* Partner with the Business Head on annual business planning, growth strategy, market expansion and strategic priorities.
* Evaluate and provide inputs into the organization on new business opportunities, partnerships, offerings and emerging trends across Enterprise Technology, EdTech and Digital Learning.

**2. Business Performance & Commercial Intelligence**

* Track and analyse business performance across revenue, profitability, sales pipeline, forecasts, productivity and key operating metrics.
* Ensure concerned stakeholders provide actionable business insights, identified performance gaps and recommended corrective interventions.
* Support financial planning, budgeting, business reviews and resource prioritisation.

**3. Strategic Program Execution & Transformation**

* Program manage high-impact, cross-functional initiatives spanning Sales, Solutions, Delivery, Product, Finance and Operations.
* Drive strategic projects from business case development through execution, ensuring measurable project impact.
* Drive integration, process improvement, business transformation and operational scalability initiatives.
* .

**5. Market & Competitive Intelligence**

* Monitor market developments, customer requirements, competitive positioning and technology-led disruptions.
* Translate industry insights into recommendations for market penetration, solution differentiation and business growth.

**4. Leadership Office & Business Governance**

* Establish a structured operating rhythm through leadership reviews, performance scorecards, strategic dashboards and action tracking.
* Prepare sharp, insight-led business presentations, executive briefs and decision papers for senior leadership.
* Facilitate alignment across stakeholders, challenge assumptions constructively and drive accountability for business outcomes.
* Ensure the BU Head is thoroughly prepped for internal and external engagements by building slide decks, gathering data, synthesizing updates, and writing executive briefs.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong commercial understanding of revenue drivers, P&L fundamentals, business planning and operational performance.
* Proven ability to independently manage complex, ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives with senior leadership visibility.
* Advanced analytical capabilities, with proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, business dashboards and data-driven storytelling.
* Excellent executive communication, stakeholder influencing, structured problem-solving and project execution skills.

**Education Qualification & Certification**

* B. Com or B.Sc. with an MBA from a reputed institution preferred

**Experience Range**

* 7–12 years of relevant experience in business strategy, Chief of Staff / Founder's Office, management consulting, business operations or strategic program management.
* Experience in B2B businesses, EdTech, Learning Sciences.

title: Tech Talent-Advisor
description:

All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy
  
  
**Job Description**
3M Health Care is now Solventum! At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.
  
  
We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.
  
  
**The Impact You’ll Make in this Role**
We are seeking a proactive and results-driven Talent Advisor for our dynamic HR team. As a Talent Advisor you will be responsible for
**end-to-end recruiting**
including sourcing, identifying, and
**engaging top-tier talent**
across various channels to
**build a robust candidate pipeline, interview scheduling, Offer preparation, offer documents validation, stakeholder management.**
You will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and

**Your Skills and Expertise:**
To set you up for success in this role from day one, Solventum requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or higher from an accredited university 6+ years of recruitment experience in multinational -Tech Organizations.

* Strong sourcing capabilities and experience in both agency and corporate environments preferred.

Build strong collaborative relationships across different stakeholders. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Fluency in spoken and written English

Preferred Experience: Prior experience recruiting for Big Tech or large technology organisations is highly preferred.
  
  
Work location: Bangalore, India Mode of Work: Hybrid
  
  
Supporting Your Well-being: Solventum offers many programs to help you live your best life – both physically and financially. To ensure competitive pay and benefits, Solventum regularly benchmarks with other companies that are comparable in size and scope.
  
  
*This requisition is part of our talent pipeline strategy. Although we do not have an active opening today, we are investing in building these capabilities and exploring future opportunities aligned with this skill set. We welcome your interest and will reach out if a position becomes available that matches your background.*
Solventum is committed to maintaining the highest standards of integrity and professionalism in our recruitment process. Applicants must remain alert to fraudulent job postings and recruitment schemes that falsely claim to represent Solventum and seek to exploit job seekers.

title: Resourcing Manager
description:
We are a specialist data consultancy helping organisations unlock the true value of their data. Our work spans AI readiness strategy, data literacy, real-time reporting, and data management through mergers and acquisitions.

We are looking for an experienced Resourcing Manager to join our growing team and take ownership of "casting" the right data professionals onto the right client projects.

**About the role**

You will act as the bridge between our bench of consultants and live client engagements — matching skills, experience and culture to project requirements and ensuring we can deploy quickly and confidently.

**Key responsibilities**

* Match data professionals to client projects based on technical fit, client culture and project objectives.
* Build and maintain accurate role profiles reflecting required skills and experience.
* Manage a bench of available consultants in collaboration with our consulting capabilities team.
* Coordinate consultant transitions between assignments with project managers.
* Manage relationships with third-party partners to ensure talent is lined up against demand.
* Produce regular reports and metrics using casting and talent data; attend weekly standup's.
* Report directly into the Head of Talent & Casting.

**Requirement**

* 5+ years of experience in technical recruitment, resource management, preferably within data, technology, or consultancy sectors. If the person has contractor recruitment this would be preferable.
* Demonstrated understanding of data roles, skills, and technologies (e.g., data science, machine learning, data engineering, analytics).
* Strong knowledge of the UK data talent market and competitive landscape.
* Excellent networking abilities and relationship-building skills.

**Skills**

* Experience with Resourcing Planning Systems – Kantata Preferable.
* Experience of working and managing third party resources to supply demand.
* Experience with Hubspot Preferable.
* Advanced Excel and Office Suite.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Experience working with UK clients/stakeholders.

title: Human Resources Manager - India
description:
Experience: 6+ Years
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
Work Arrangement: Work from Office, Monday to Friday
  
  
Working Hours: 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM IST
  
  
**About Bestex Research**
BestEx Research is a financial technology and research company headquartered in the United States, with offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, and India. The company specializes in developing sophisticated execution algorithms and transaction cost modeling tools across multiple asset classes. BestEx Research delivers high-performance algorithmic execution services to hedge funds, CTAs, asset managers, and banks through both a traditional electronic brokerage model and a broker-neutral Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platform.
  
  
Its cloud-based platform, Algo Management System (AMS), is an end-to-end algorithmic trading solution for equities and futures that delivers an entire ecosystem around execution algorithms. This includes Transaction Cost Analysis (TCA), an algorithm customization tool called Strategy Studio, a trading dashboard, and pre-trade analytics, all integrated into a single platform. The platform is currently live for U.S., UK, European, and Canadian equities, as well as global futures trading.
  
  
BestEx Research is transforming a $100 billion industry by challenging traditional, black-box solutions offered by banks and providing next-generation execution algorithms that combine performance improvement, transparency, and customization. The company uses leading-edge technology to support its low-latency, highly scalable research and trading systems, with its backend developed in C++, research libraries in C++/Python and R, and web-based technologies powering its front-end platforms.
  
  
BestEx Research's mission is to become a global leader in the automation and measurement of trade execution across asset classes while significantly reducing transaction costs for its clients.
  
  
For more information, visit www.bestexresearch.com.
  
  
**WHY JOIN BESTEX RESEARCH?**
This is an opportunity to take ownership of and contribute to the development of the HR function in India for a growing global technology organization. You will work closely with senior management and play an important role in shaping the company's people practices, organizational culture, and employee experience.
  
  
**About The Role**
As the organization grows, the HR function plays a critical role in establishing the structure, processes, and employee experience required to support a high-performing global business.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on HR professional who takes ownership, builds strong teams, develops people, maintains high professional standards, and ensures effective execution of HR processes.
  
  
The ideal candidate should be proactive, sincere, dependable, and highly accountable, with a strong sense of ownership, commitment, and loyalty towards the organization. We expect someone who takes responsibility for their actions and deliverables, honors commitments, and ensures that assigned responsibilities are completed accurately and on time.
  
  
The candidate should demonstrate a positive, solution-oriented attitude, maintain professional relationships with management and employees, and approach challenges constructively rather than simply identifying problems. They should be comfortable accepting responsibility, receiving feedback, implementing management decisions professionally, and taking initiatives to improve HR processes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We are looking for someone who genuinely takes pride in their work, acts in the best interests of the organization, maintains confidentiality and integrity, and can be trusted to manage responsibilities independently with minimal supervision.
  
  
This role offers significant responsibility, independence, and the opportunity to strengthen and develop the HR function.
  
  
**HR LEADERSHIP AND STRATEGIC MANAGEMENT**
Take ownership of day-to-day HR operations in India and act as the primary HR contact for employees and management.
  
  
Work closely with management and department heads on workforce planning, organizational development, and people-related matters.
  
  
Develop, implement, and maintain effective HR policies, processes, systems, and procedures.
  
  
Ensure smooth execution of all HR activities and maintain clear accountability.
  
  
Identify HR challenges proactively and recommend practical solutions.
  
  
Maintain accurate employee records, HR documentation, and reports.
  
  
Provide regular updates and management reports on important HR matters.
  
  
Ensure timely execution and follow-up of management decisions and HR action items.
  
  
**TALENT ACQUISITION AND RECRUITMENT**
Manage end-to-end recruitment for technical, non-technical, and leadership positions.
  
  
Drive recruitment for Quant Developers, Software Developers, Quant Data Engineers, Trading Systems Engineers, Onboarding Engineers, Execution Engineers, and other specialized technology roles.
  
  
Develop effective recruitment strategies to attract high-quality talent.
  
  
Build strong networks with recruitment agencies, consultants, universities, and industry professionals.
  
  
Manage campus recruitment and graduate hiring initiatives.
  
  
Work closely with hiring managers to understand manpower requirements, define role expectations, and prioritize recruitment.
  
  
Ensure timely hiring through effective sourcing, screening, interviewing, and selection processes.
  
  
Coordinate interview schedules, candidate follow-ups, feedback collection, and offer management.
  
  
Maintain accurate recruitment trackers and monitor hiring progress.
  
  
Monitor recruitment performance, hiring timelines, and candidate experience.
  
  
**EMPLOYEE ONBOARDING AND INTEGRATION**
Manage the complete employee onboarding process, from offer acceptance to successful integration into the organization.
  
  
Ensure completion of employment documentation, background verification, reference checks, and joining formalities.
  
  
Develop structured induction and orientation programs.
  
  
Ensure every new employee understands company policies, processes, culture, and professional expectations.
  
  
Coordinate with managers to ensure proper role clarity and smooth integration into teams.
  
  
Conduct frequent onboarding reviews with employees and managers.
  
  
Monitor onboarding effectiveness and address early employee concerns.
  
  
Ensure timely completion of onboarding checklists and documentation.
  
  
**EMPLOYEE ENGAGEMENT, TEAM BONDING AND ORGANIZATIONAL CULTURE**
Develop initiatives to strengthen employee engagement, team bonding, collaboration, and organizational belonging.
  
  
Build strong relationships with employees across all departments.
  
  
Organize team-building activities, employee interactions, social gatherings, and engagement programs.
  
  
Conduct employee satisfaction surveys and regular feedback discussions.
  
  
Identify employee concerns, dissatisfaction, and workplace challenges.
  
  
Encourage collaboration and effective communication between different teams.
  
  
Promote a positive, inclusive, professional, and high-performance work culture.
  
  
Work with managers to improve team relationships and employee experience.
  
  
**PERFORMANCE MANAGEMENT AND EMPLOYEE EVALUATION**
Coordinate and implement structured performance management and appraisal processes.
  
  
Establish KRAs, KPIs, individual objectives, and measurable performance expectations in consultation with managers.
  
  
Coordinate quarterly, half-yearly, and annual performance evaluations.
  
  
Ensure regular performance feedback and communication between employees and managers.
  
  
Work with managers to identify high performers, underperformers, and employees requiring development.
  
  
Coordinate Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) and performance-related concerns.
  
  
Support decisions relating to promotions, increments, career progression, and employee retention.
  
  
Ensure performance evaluations are fair, transparent, consistent, and supported by documented feedback.
  
  
Monitor completion of performance reviews and follow up with managers.
  
  
**Company Policies, Discipline And Governance**
Develop, maintain, communicate, and implement company-wide HR policies.
  
  
Ensure policies are consistently applied across all employees, departments, and management levels.
  
  
Establish and monitor guidelines relating to attendance, working hours, leave, work-from-home arrangements, workplace conduct, and employee responsibilities.
  
  
Ensure managers and employees follow approved company policies and procedures.
  
  
Monitor policy compliance and maintain proper records of approvals and exceptions.
  
  
Address policy violations and disciplinary matters fairly and professionally.
  
  
Coordinate warnings, corrective actions, and disciplinary escalation in consultation with management.
  
  
Periodically review and update HR policies based on business requirements and regulatory changes.
  
  
Promote a culture of accountability, professionalism, and respect for organizational standards.
  
  
**EMPLOYEE INTEGRITY, ETHICS, CONFIDENTIALITY AND BACKGROUND VERIFICATION**
Coordinate employee background verification and reference-checking processes. Verify educational qualification, employment history, credentials and references
  
  
Promote honesty, integrity, accountability, confidentiality, and ethical workplace conduct.
  
  
Establish processes to identify and manage conflicts of interest.
  
  
Address employee misconduct, unethical behavior, and breaches of company policies.
  
  
Coordinate sensitive investigations objectively, confidentially, and based on documented evidence.
  
  
Ensure employees understand their responsibilities regarding confidential information, intellectual property, and company data.
  
  
Work with management to strengthen ethical standards and professional accountability across the organization.
  
  
**Compensation, Payroll And Benefits Management**
Coordinate monthly payroll processing and ensure timely and accurate salary payments.
  
  
Manage salary structures, compensation reviews, increments, bonuses, incentives, and other employee benefits in coordination with management.
  
  
Coordinate employee insurance, reimbursements, and welfare programs.
  
  
Work closely with Finance to ensure accurate payroll inputs, deductions, and payments.
  
  
**Maintain Accurate Employee Compensation And Benefits Records,**
Support competitive compensation and employee retention initiatives. Coordinate salary benchmarking and compensation reviews where required.
  
  
**EMPLOYEE RETENTION, CAREER DEVELOPMENT AND SUCCESSION PLANNING**
Support strategies to retain high-performing and critical employees.
  
  
Identify employees at risk of leaving and proactively communicate retention concerns to management.
  
  
Conduct employee feedback and career development discussions.
  
  
Understand employee expectations, career aspirations, and workplace challenges.
  
  
Support internal career progression and promotion opportunities.
  
  
Identify critical positions and assist with succession planning.
  
  
Conduct exit interviews and analyze attrition trends.
  
  
Recommend improvements to strengthen employee retention and organizational stability.
  
  
**LEARNING AND DEVELOPMENT**
Identify technical, functional, and managerial training requirements.
  
  
Coordinate employee training and professional development programs.
  
  
Organize leadership, communication, and management development initiatives.
  
  
Support managers in coaching and developing their teams.
  
  
Encourage knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
  
  
Monitor training effectiveness and employee development progress.
  
  
**HR COMPLIANCE AND LEGAL MANAGEMENT**
Ensure compliance with applicable Indian labor laws and employment regulations.
  
  
Coordinate statutory requirements relating to Provident Fund (PF) and Employees' State Insurance (ESI), where applicable.
  
  
Maintain employment records, statutory registers, and HR documentation.
  
  
Ensure employment contracts, policies, and procedures comply with applicable regulations.
  
  
Coordinate with legal advisors, payroll consultants, and statutory compliance vendors.
  
  
Manage statutory audits, inspections, and regulatory documentation.
  
  
Monitor changes in employment legislation and ensure timely implementation.
  
  
Keep management informed about potential employment-related legal and compliance risks.
  
  
**WORKPLACE MANAGEMENT AND EMPLOYEE WELFARE**
Ensure a professional, comfortable, safe, and productive workplace.
  
  
Coordinate with Admin and Operations on office facilities and employee amenities.
  
  
Address employee welfare requirements and workplace concerns.
  
  
Develop initiatives to improve employee well-being and workplace experience.
  
  
Promote workplace safety, professionalism, and a respectful working environment.
  
  
Coordinate employee-related office infrastructure and facility requirements.
  
  
**EVENTS, CELEBRATIONS AND EMPLOYEE RECOGNITION**
Plan and organize company events, festivals, celebrations, and annual gatherings.
  
  
Coordinate employee birthdays, work anniversaries, Diwali, New Year, and other special occasions.
  
  
Organize team outings, sports activities, and recreational events.
  
  
Develop employee appreciation, recognition, and rewards programs.
  
  
Encourage team bonding through regular social and collaborative activities.
  
  
Manage event planning, budgets, vendors, and execution.
  
  
**HR ANALYTICS, REPORTING AND MANAGEMENT REVIEWS**
Maintain accurate employee master data and HR records.
  
  
Prepare monthly HR dashboards and management reports.
  
  
Track headcount, recruitment progress, attrition, and employee retention.
  
  
Monitor attendance, leave, and work-from-home arrangements.
  
  
**EMPLOYEE RELATIONS AND GRIEVANCE MANAGEMENT**
Act as a trusted bridge between employees, managers, and senior management.
  
  
Establish transparent employee grievance and escalation procedures.
  
  
Address employee concerns, workplace conflicts, and interpersonal issues.
  
  
Support managers in resolving employee-related challenges.
  
  
Handle sensitive employee matters with confidentiality, fairness, and professional maturity.
  
  
Ensure timely follow-up and resolution of employee grievances.
  
  
Maintain appropriate documentation of significant employee matters and their resolution.
  
  
Communicate employee concerns to management constructively, with relevant facts and practical recommendations.

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**About the Company**

Book My Tour Now is a growing Tours & Travel company focused on creating smooth and memorable travel experiences for its customers. With a strong focus on service, teamwork, and continuous improvement, the company is building a professional and growth-oriented workplace. We believe that a strong team is the foundation of business growth.

Book My Tour Now provides a professional, supportive, and growth-focused work environment. The HR Executive will work closely with employees, managers, and management across different functions. The role provides opportunities to learn multiple areas of HR and contribute directly to building a strong workplace culture.

**About the Role**

The HR Executive will manage day-to-day HR activities including recruitment, employee onboarding, attendance, leave, payroll coordination, employee records, training, employee engagement, grievance handling, and exit formalities. The role will ensure that HR processes are completed accurately and on time while providing proper support to employees and managers. The HR Executive will also maintain updated HR records and support the company in building a disciplined, positive, and productive work environment.

* Manage recruitment activities by understanding manpower requirements and coordinating with departments for hiring.
* Prepare and update Job Descriptions and publish approved openings on job portals and recruitment channels.

**Qualifications**

* Graduate in HR, Business Administration, Management, or any relevant field.
* HR certification or relevant qualification will be an advantage.
* Freshers may apply if they have the right attitude and willingness to learn.
* Candidates with 1–3 years of HR experience will be preferred.
* Experience in recruitment, attendance, payroll coordination, or employee handling will be an advantage.

**Required Skills**

* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Good time management and follow-up skills.
* Ability to handle multiple HR activities at the same time.
* Good problem-solving and coordination skills.
* Basic computer and data management skills.
* Good attention to accuracy and confidentiality.
* Positive attitude and professional behaviour.
* Ability to communicate comfortably with employees, candidates, managers, and external agencies.

**Preferred Skills**

* MS Excel / Google Sheets.
* MS Word.
* Email and communication tools.
* HRMS / Attendance Management System.
* Job portals and recruitment databases.
* Google Drive / Shared folders.
* Basic knowledge of payroll and HR tracking systems.

* Represent Quest Alliance in regional ecosystem forums, industry engagements, and stakeholder consultations where required.
* Transition Activities and Program Execution (20%)
* Support coordination of placement drives, job fairs, industry visits, and transition-related activities in collaboration with institutional stakeholders.
* Provide implementation support for pilot initiatives related to entrepreneurship, green livelihoods, and career transition models.
* Support periodic reviews and tracking of institutional transition activities.

+ workforce development
+ industry engagement
+ livelihood programs

* Demonstrated experience in:

+ stakeholder management
+ ecosystem partnerships
+ capacity building
+ cross functional collaboration

title: People Operations Specialist
description:
**About Us**

Ushur delivers the world's first Customer Experience Automation platform built specifically for regulated industries. With guardrails and compliance-ready infrastructure, Ushur powers vertical AI Agents for healthcare, financial services, and insurance.

Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Santa Clara, California, Ushur is backed by Third Point Ventures, Tiger Global, 8VC, Iron Pillar, Aflac Ventures, and Pentland Ventures, with a sizable Fortune 500 customer base. Our Bengaluru office is one of two principal locations and is central to how the company is built and run.

We build AI agents for regulated enterprises, and we run our own operations the same way.

**About Ushur
|
Ushur GenAI**

**Title:**
People Operations Specialist |
**Experience:**
5–7 years |
**Location:**
Bengaluru |
**Work mode:**
Hybrid |
**Reports to:**
Director, People Operations

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on People Operations Specialist to independently manage and continuously improve HR operations for Ushur's India organization, working closely with our global People and Operations teams. You’ll own the day-to-day: payroll inputs, benefits, onboarding and exits, HR systems, recruitment operations and employee support. You’ll also make that work better. When you see a manual process, you’ll simplify it, automate it, or turn it into self-service, using AI and automation where they help, with care for employee data. You’ll build and improve these workflows yourself, not just identify them.

**AI-Native Operations**

At Ushur, we believe modern People Operations should be increasingly intelligent, automated, and employee-centric. You will actively explore how AI, automation, and better system integration can improve the quality and efficiency of HR operations.

* Identify repetitive, manual processes and implement practical automation.
* Improve employee self-service through digital workflows, knowledge resources, and intelligent assistance.
* Leverage AI tools for appropriate administrative, analytical, reporting, and recruitment-support activities.
* Measure improvements in turnaround time, data accuracy, employee experience, and manual effort.
* Apply human oversight, privacy safeguards, and sound judgment, particularly when handling confidential employee information or supporting people-related decisions.
* We value practical improvements that deliver measurable results, not technology adoption for its own sake.

**Responsibilities**

**Payroll and statutory compliance**

* Independently manage monthly payroll inputs, validation, reconciliations, and coordination with Finance and payroll partners.
* Administer full and final settlements, including applicable notice-period adjustments, leave encashment, gratuity, and recoveries.
* Manage employee tax declarations, investment proofs, Form 16, and payroll-related queries.
* Implement approved changes to compensation structures, payroll policies, and statutory requirements.
* Maintain accurate employee, compensation, attendance, and leave records.

**Benefits and vendor management**

* Administer employee benefits, including health insurance, life insurance and wellness programmes.
* Coordinate enrolments, changes, claims support and benefits queries.
* Prepare annual benefits reviews and renewals using data analysis, vendor comparisons and recommendations.
* Manage relationships with insurers, brokers and other partners, monitor service quality, and coordinate the related admin and invoicing.

**Onboarding and Offboarding**

* Manage onboarding from pre-joining documents through orientation and HR systems setup, so every new hire has a consistent, welcoming start.
* Coordinate lifecycle changes, including transfers, promotions, compensation updates and documentation.
* Manage offboarding: exit documents, clearances, F&F coordination and benefits transitions.

**HR systems and data**

* Administer our HRIS and applicant tracking system: records, workflows, reporting and data integrity.
* Configure, build and improve HR workflows, approvals and self-service, and fix them when they break.
* Build and maintain operational reports and dashboards that support decisions.
* Respond to employee queries on policies, benefits, documents and HR processes, and prepare employment letters and verifications.

**Hiring operations**

* Manage end-to-end recruitment operations: job postings, sourcing, initial screening, interview coordination, offers and background verification.
* Coordinate interviews and candidate communication across distributed teams.
* Keep the applicant tracking system and hiring reports accurate, and improve the candidate experience.

**Compliance, audits and calendars**

* Coordinate HR compliance activities, statutory reporting, POSH-related administration, and required employee training.
* Maintain appropriate records and documentation to support internal and external audits.
* Maintain key People Operations calendars, compliance deadlines, and recurring administrative processes.

**Performance, engagement and recognition**

* Support performance review cycles, compensation administration, and employee recognition programmes.
* Coordinate employee engagement initiatives, feedback surveys, and related activities.

**What success looks like**

**By day 90:**

* Build a strong understanding of Ushur's HR processes, systems, policies, and stakeholders.
* Independently manage core People Operations activities with accuracy and reliability.
* Establish effective working relationships across India and global teams.
* Identify and prioritize opportunities to simplify or automate existing processes.

**By month 12:**

* Demonstrate consistent accuracy, timeliness, and compliance across core HR operations.
* Improve operational efficiency and the employee experience through measurable process improvements.
* Implement meaningful automation or self-service enhancements.
* Build scalable, well-documented processes that support organizational growth.

**Qualifications**

**Essential**

* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT or a related technical field (B.Tech, BE, BCA, BSc CS or similar).
* 5–7 years in HR operations, ideally at a startup or scale-up.
* 3+ years preparing accurate monthly payroll inputs (joiners, exits, LOP, variable pay), with a working knowledge of India statutory benefits (PF, ESI, PT, gratuity) to answer employee queries and check F&F inputs.
* Proof that you build things and don’t just use them: workflows, reports, trackers or automations you set up yourself in an HRIS, Google Sheets, Apps Script, Zapier or similar.
* You use AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT every day to create real work, and you check what they give you before you rely on it.
* You’re comfortable reading, testing, and fixing formulas, workflow rules, and simple scripts. You don’t wait for someone else to do it.
* Hands-on setup of a modern HRIS and ATS: fields, workflows, permissions and reports.
* You can run onboarding, exits, benefits, employee queries and recruitment operations on your own from start to finish.
* You’re careful with data and treat confidential information that way.
* You write and speak clearly with teams in India and the US

**Nice to have**

* An MBA or Master’s in HR alongside your technical degree.
* Experience with Rippling or a similar all-in-one HRIS.
* Basic SQL, scripting or working with APIs.
* Experience with benefits renewals, audits or performance review admin.
* Experience at a global B2B SaaS company.

**You’ll enjoy this role if**
you see a manual process and want to fix it rather than repeat it, and you’d like HR to be an area where operations and technology meet.

**Attributes**

* **Ownership:**
  Takes responsibility for outcomes, follows through, and proactively resolves issues.
* **Operational discipline:**
  Maintains accuracy, confidentiality, and consistency, even under deadline pressure.
* **Problem-solving:**
  Identifies inefficiencies and takes practical steps to improve them.
* **Service orientation:**
  Approaches employees, candidates, and stakeholders with empathy and professionalism.
* **Adaptability:**
  Responds constructively to change, feedback, and evolving business requirements.
* **AI and automation mindset:**
  Curious about new technologies, willing to experiment, and thoughtful about where human judgment remains essential.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Meaningful ownership:**
  Take responsibility for a broad range of People Operations activities and shape how they evolve.
* **AI-native environment:**
  Work in a company at the forefront of enterprise AI, with opportunities to apply automation to real operational challenges.
* **Global collaboration:**
  Partner with colleagues across geographies and functions.
* **Company culture:**
  A values-driven workplace built on respect, inclusion, and collaboration.
* **Paid time off:**
  Twenty days of flexible paid time off annually.
* **Health and wellness:**
  Medical insurance for employees and eligible dependents, preventive health initiatives, and wellness programmes.
* **Compensation and equity:**
  Competitive compensation and stock options.
* **Professional development:**
  Opportunities for continuous learning, professional certifications, and access to internal learning resources.

title: HR Operations Team Lead - Compensation and Benefits
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
  
  
This Position reports to:
  
  
HR Delivery Manager
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Compensation & Benefits Operations - Cluster Countries

Lead and manage end-to-end C&B operations for assigned cluster countries, ensuring timely and accurate execution of all rewards transactions.
  
  
Oversee salary benchmarking, pay review cycles, merit increase processing, and market data analysis for cluster geographies.
  
  
Ensure country-specific compensation structures and benefit programmes are maintained and aligned with global ABB policy.
  
  
Manage benefits enrolment, renewals, vendor coordination, and employee queries related to health, wellness, retirement, and other benefit plans.
  
  
Partner with local HRBPs and country HR teams to address C&B escalations, exceptions, and complex cases.
  
  
Maintain data integrity in HR systems (Workday / SAP) for all compensation and benefits records across cluster countries.
  
  

* Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) Process Management

Own and drive the Annual Incentive Plan (AIP) process end-to-end for Global: from target setting, mid-year review, year-end calculation to payout processing.
  
  
Coordinate with P&R, HRBPs, and Business Leaders to ensure accurate AIP eligibility lists, payout calculations, and exception management.
  
  
Manage AIP communication and employee-facing documentation in coordination with HR Front Office and COE.
  
  
Ensure all AIP activities comply with ABB global guidelines, local labour laws, and audit requirements.Perform quality checks and reconciliation of AIP data before final payroll submission.
  
  
Track AIP timelines, identify risks, and proactively escalate issues to the Hub Delivery Manager.
  
  

* Team Leadership & Performance Management

Lead a team of C&B specialists; manage work allocation, capacity planning, and business continuity. Conduct regular performance reviews, one-on-ones, and development conversations. Coach and mentor team members to build technical C&B capability and process expertise.
  
  
Foster a high-performance, customer-centric, and collaborative team culture.
  
  
Handle escalations with composure and resolve complex issues in a timely manner.
  
  

* Compliance & Regulatory Adherence

Ensure all C&B operations comply with local labour laws, statutory regulations, GDPR, and ABB internal controls across cluster countries.
  
  
Support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation and evidence.
  
  
Monitor regulatory changes impacting compensation and benefits in cluster geographies and implement required updates.
  
  

* Stakeholder Engagement & Customer Experience

Build strong partnerships with HRBPs, COEs, Finance, and Payroll teams across cluster countries.
  
  
Proactively manage stakeholder communication on C&B matters, process timelines, and issue resolution.
  
  
Analyse customer satisfaction feedback and drive continuous improvement in C&B service delivery.
  
  
Serve as the primary point of contact for all C&B-related escalations from cluster country stakeholders.
  
  

* Operational Optimization & Innovation

Continuously review C&B processes to identify inefficiencies and implement improvements. Leverage HR technology (Workday, SAP, ServiceNow) to automate and streamline C&B workflows.
  
  
Support global HR initiatives such as total rewards redesign, policy harmonisation, and M&A activities. Explore AI-enabled tools and analytics to enhance C&B reporting, benchmarking, and decision support.

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human resources, Administration, or other relevant fields

title: Senior Global HR Specialist
description:
**Job Title**
Senior Global HR Specialist
  
  
**Job Description**
**So, who are we?**
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.
  
  
The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.
  
  
Join us at IG – the future gets built here
*.*
**Your team**
You’ll join People Services, part of People Excellence at IG, supporting 3,000+ colleagues across the globe.
  
  
**Your role in the Team's Success**
This is a 12-month fixed-term role, so you need to be productive from your first week. You’ll work independently from our documented procedures and take full ownership of the work you pick up. You’ll report to the Manager, HR Operation.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Resolve HR queries and requests in ServiceNow, accurately and within agreed timeframes
* Process employee lifecycle transactions in Workday, including hires, changes, and leavers
* Own the daily Workday task queue on your assigned days, including anything left over from the previous day
* Prepare, sign, and distribute accurate HR letters and documents, and maintain employee files in our online archive
* Support Japan HR Operations from November
* Handle correspondence from authorities and external bodies, making sure every item is resolved or escalated with a clear next step
* Support colleagues on complex cases and contribute to audits
* Work with team members across India, Poland, and the UK

**What You'll Need**

* You work out what to do when a case doesn’t match the procedure. Procedures cover most cases but not all. When something differs, you work out the right action, or you escalate with your analysis and a proposed next step. You never close a case because “no instruction applies”.
* You own the outcome. If something is unowned or overdue, you pick it up. You don’t wait to be assigned it or assume someone else has it.
* You flag risks early. If you can’t meet a deadline or you’re unsure about a case, you tell your manager straight away, with a proposed way forward.
* You work UK hours one to two days in every two weeks.

**Essential**

* 4+ years of hands-on HR operations or HR shared services experience, ideally in a multi-country environment
* Hands-on experience with Workday or SuccessFactors
* Experience with ServiceNow, Salesforce, or a similar HR case management tool
* Strong written and spoken English (C1)
* Proven track record of working independently from procedures and handling cases that don’t fit them
* Willingness to work UK hours as described above

**Nice to have**

* Experience supporting APAC, EMEA, or Japan HR processes
* Experience handling correspondence from authorities and labour office
* Experience supporting internal or external audits.

**The Perks**
It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognize your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.
  
  
**Join us for this exciting journey. Apply now!**

Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. title: Senior Manager - Organisational Culture Assurance
description:
**Job Purpose:**
The Organizational Culture Assurance Analyst develops A&A’s behavioral and risk analytics capability, delivering data-driven insights that strengthen assurance planning, audit execution and enterprise risk oversight.
  
  
The role acts as the technical and analytical lead for Organizational Culture Assurance and wider A&A analytics initiatives, combining expertise in data analytics, visualization, behavioral indicators, organizational data and emerging AI-enabled analytical approaches.
  
  
Working across A&A, Human Resources, Compliance, Risk Management and business leadership teams, the role develops analytical products that identify organizational conditions, behavioral patterns and emerging risks which may impact business performance, governance effectiveness and risk management outcomes.
  
  
The role plays a central part in delivering A&A's Organizational Culture Assurance model through:
  
  

* Development of organizational Culture dashboards to support audit teams.
* Creation of enterprise behavioral and risk intelligence products for senior leadership and governance forums.
* Advanced analytics supporting targeted organizational culture assurance & Insights reviews.
* Integration of data-driven behavioral insights into assurance planning, testing and reporting.

The role serves as a center of excellence for behavioral and assurance analytics and helps position A&A as a leading-edge assurance function that combines traditional audit techniques with advanced analytics and organizational insight.
  
  
The role acts as the technical owner for organizational cultural analytics, dashboard architecture, culture and behavioral risk indicators and analytical methodologies used by the Organizational Culture Assurance team and wider A&A function.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**
**Behavioral and Culture Analytics**

* Develop analytical models to identify behavioral patterns, cultural indicators and emerging organizational risks.
* Analyze large and complex datasets from multiple sources to identify trends, anomalies and relationships relevant to governance, risk management and organizational effectiveness.
* Interpret behavioral indicators associated with accountability, leadership effectiveness, collaboration, decision-making, challenge, escalation and psychological safety.
* Support development of methodologies that enable objective assessment of organizational behaviors.

**Dashboard Development and Reporting**

* Design, build and maintain a suite of behavioral and risk dashboards for A&A, leadership teams, RMCBs, ExCom and the ARC.
* Develop leading and lagging indicators that provide visibility of organizational and behavioral risk.
* Ensure dashboards are intuitive, evidence-based and aligned to strategic and enterprise risk priorities.
* Continuously enhance reporting capabilities through automation, visualization and advanced analytics techniques.

**Audit Enablement**

* Develop analytical products to support risk assessment, audit planning and assurance prioritization.
* Develop organizational Culture indicators relevant to key audit themes and enterprise risks.
* Provide specialist analytical support for complex or high-risk audit engagements.
* Support identification of audit targets and trigger points for dedicated Organizational Culture Assurance reviews.

**Data Integration and Insight Generation**

* Consolidate information from diverse data sources to develop enterprise-level insights.
* Analyze trends from workforce data, employee engagement surveys, speak-up reporting, compliance indicators, safety data, organizational structures, attrition metrics, performance measures and other relevant information sources.
* Identify themes that may signal emerging organizational vulnerabilities or opportunities.
* Translate analytical outputs into practical insights that support executive decision-making.
* Develop and maintain culture and behavioral risk models, trend analyses and predictive indicators that support identification of emerging organizational risks.
* Design and maintain data pipelines and analytical processes that consolidate information from multiple enterprise systems into consistent assurance products.
* Establish controls and quality assurance processes for behavioral and risk analytics outputs.

**AI and Innovation**

* Develop AI-assisted analytical techniques to identify behavioral patterns, cultural themes and potential risk indicators across large and complex datasets.
* Evaluate emerging analytical technologies and assess opportunities to improve assurance coverage, efficiency and effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to improve assurance effectiveness through automation and advanced analytics.
* Monitor emerging developments in analytics, data science and assurance technology.
* Promote the responsible and effective use of analytics across A&A.

**Capability Development**

* Support development of analytical capability across A&A.
* Support auditors and Organisational Culture Assurance Managers in using analytical tools and interpreting behavioral indicators.
* Establish analytical standards, controls and good practices.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of A&A methodologies and assurance strategies

**Skills & Experience**

* Significant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, audit analytics, people analytics, risk analytics or related disciplines.
* Strong capability in analysing large and complex datasets and translating findings into actionable insights.
* 10 to 15yrs of experience in audit and assurance.
* Experience designing dashboards, visualisations and executive reporting products.
* Experience using modern business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau or equivalent.
* Experience establishing analytics governance, controls and quality standards.
* Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking capability.
* Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to explain complex findings to non-technical audiences.
* Experience working within risk, assurance, audit, compliance, HR analytics or related environments.
* Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
* Bachelor's degree in analytics, data science, statistics, mathematics, business, psychology, economics, information systems or a related discipline.

**Preferred skills:**

* Experience applying analytics within Internal Audit, Risk Management or Compliance functions.
* Experience working with organisational health, workforce, engagement or behavioural datasets.
* Knowledge of behavioural science, organisational psychology or organisational effectiveness frameworks.
* Experience applying machine learning or AI-enabled analytical techniques.
* Professional qualifications in analytics, audit or risk management.
* Experience supporting Board, Executive Committee or senior governance reporting.

**Skills**
Audit Risk Assessments, Business Compliance, Digital Fluency, Industry Knowledge, Influencing Without Authority, Insight Generation, International Standards on Auditing (ISA), PESTLE Analysis, Stakeholder Management, Tactical Questioning
  
  
**Why GSK?**

title: Workplace Experience Coordinator, India (Contract)
description:
**About Handshake**
Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions.
  
  
In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to ~$1B run rate and pay ~$60M to over 30K individuals every month.
  
  
**Why Join Handshake Now**

* Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel
* Partner hand-in-hand with world-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions
* Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders
* Build a massive, fast-growing business with billions in revenue

**About Handshake AI**
Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data-intensive post-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re hiring a Workplace Experience Manager to run our Bangalore office. You’ll own how the office works every day: the food, the vendors behind it, the space, and what it feels like to walk in on your first day.
  
  
A lot of this doesn’t exist yet, so you’ll build it. You’ll find and negotiate with vendors, test new ideas through small pilots, listen to what the team tells you, and keep improving. You’ll also be one of the first people every new hire and visitor meets, which makes you their first impression of Handshake in Bangalore. We want someone who treats setting the culture as a core part of the job.
  
  
This is a contract, in-office role that requires five days a week onsite.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
**Vendor Management**

* Source and onboard vendors for meals, snacks, beverages, merch, transport, office supplies, etc
* Compare at least three quotes, check licensing and references, and run tastings before we sign anyone
* Negotiate pricing, minimum orders, payment terms, and service levels, and get them in writing
* Be the single point of contact for every vendor: resolve missed deliveries and quality issues quickly, and keep backup options ready for critical services
* Review each vendor monthly on quality, reliability, and cost, and renegotiate or replace the ones that slip
* Own the snack, meal, and supply budget: track spend weekly, flag overruns early, and bring a recommendation for fixing them

**Food Program**

* Plan weekly lunch and dinner menus that work for the whole team, including specific dietary needs (we just have vegetarian, non vegetarian, lactose intolerant now but this list might grow)
* Confirm headcounts, coordinate orders, and make sure food arrives on time and is set up well
* Keep the pantry stocked and rotate snacks based on what gets eaten and what gets left behind

**Pilots and Feedback**

* Test new ideas as short pilots before committing budget, whether that’s a new caterer, a snack subscription, or a weekly team ritual
* Define success before each pilot starts (participation, cost per person, satisfaction score), run it for two to four weeks, then decide whether to scale it, change it, or stop it
* Collect feedback continuously through pulse surveys, Slack polls, and conversations over lunch
* Share a short monthly update on what you heard, what you changed, and what you’re testing next
* Keep a simple log of every experiment and its results, so anyone can see what was tried and why it was kept or dropped

**Onboarding and Culture**

* Own the in-office side of onboarding: desk and equipment ready before day one, an office tour, an introduction to the neighborhood, and a check-in at the end of week one
* Set the tone for every new hire and visitor: how you welcome people shapes how they see Handshake
* Plan and run low-cost, high-impact monthly team bonding activities, plus small weekly rituals that bring people together
* Build traditions for the Bangalore team, from festival celebrations to marking launches, milestones, and new joiners

**Office Operations**

* Keep the office clean, organized, and well-stocked: manage stationery and supply inventory, set reorder levels, and work with housekeeping and building management to resolve issues fast
* Generate guest passes, greet visitors on arrival, and share helpful information about the office and surrounding area
* Be the go-to person for office requests, from a broken chair to a last-minute meeting setup
* Optional but a big plus: book flights and accommodation for employees traveling between the India and US offices

**What Success Looks Like**

* First 30 days: audit current vendors, spend, and supplies, get to know the team, and ship quick fixes from the first round of feedback
* By 60 days: run at least one vendor pilot and one culture pilot end to end, and share the results
* By 90 days: a stable vendor roster with agreed rates and service levels, a meal program that runs without daily escalations, and a monthly feedback cycle the team trusts

**Desired Capabilities**

* Prior experience in office operations, workplace experience, administration, hospitality, or a similar role
* Hands-on vendor management: you’ve sourced vendors, negotiated rates and terms, and held them to agreed service levels
* Comfortable with numbers: you can build a budget tracker in Google Sheets, compare quotes side by side, and explain where the money goes
* An experimenter’s mindset: you test small, ask for feedback, and change course based on what you learn
* Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail
* A warm, confident communicator who can welcome a visitor and hold firm in a vendor negotiation on the same day
* Ownership: you notice what needs fixing and fix it without being asked
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, in-person environment and managing multiple priorities at once

**Extra Credit**

* Experience supporting employee travel bookings
* Event planning or team engagement experience, especially on a tight budget
* Previous experience in a startup or fast-growing environment
* Experience setting up an office or food program from scratch
* Kannada or Hindi, for working with local vendors
