**About The Job**
Who are we?
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career
  
  
**About The Team**
The Stripe Delivery Center (SDC) strategy will provide operational leverage and expand Stripe’s portfolio of operational capabilities to support the scaled needs for external users and internal Stripe teams. Stripe’s People & Places Operations team will sit within the SDC and is a highly collaborative, cross-functional team that drives key support for the People and Places function. We work with many different teams at Stripe. We are nimble and flexible individuals that can wear many different hats. We don’t mind working through ambiguity and love adding organization to chaos. We believe that success is not defined by any one individual, but rather by the collective work of the entire team
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Provide strategic HR leadership to HR Operations. Effectively manage, develop and engage the global team
* Ensure an exceptional employee experience by simplifying key processes
* Lead and implement HR initiatives and projects which are aligned within HR and Centers of Expertise (COE)
* Coordinate and lead key projects for improvement across HR
* Identify best practices that can be applied to improve work tasks and processes
* Deliver service improvement activity across HR through employing process improvement methodologies and the application of innovative thinking
* Promote and lead change
* Supports the administration and maintenance of HR systems while driving process and data integrity across the HR landscape
* Participate in and/or lead projects aimed at expanding centralization, leverage technology to improve the employee experience, and discover actionable insights and recommend solutions
* Responsible for driving process consistency, data integrity and compliance to HR policies, procedures, data privacy, audit controls and regulatory requirements in all HR Service Center activities
* Serves as the escalation point for HR Operations guiding the root cause analysis, resolution and communication protocol
* Manage the case management system (Ops ticketing system) and team to establish service level agreements
* Partner with the HRIS team supporting HR technology upgrades
* Develop and maintain team standard operating procedures
* Oversees relevant employee data management to ensure that data is secure and maintained consistent with company policies and privacy regulations and that required reporting and filings are delivered
* Track HR metrics to identify areas for improvement. Develop and implement counter-measures to correct identified misses to goals

**Skills**

* Proficiency in verbal & written communication in English
* Good working knowledge of MS Office, MS Outlook; MS Excel. Proficiency is an advantage.
* Strong attention to details.
* Ability to analyze and identify patterns in large data sets.
* Decision making aptitudes based on given guidelines and in ambiguous contexts.
* Must be comfortable working with large data sets.
* Very good knowledge and experience in internet navigation and research – finding specific information about products in a timely manner.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Minimum 7+ years of people and operations management experience
* Education - Grad/Post Grad in human resources or a related discipline
* Desired 12+ years of overall experience
* Experience with HR systems such as Workday, Greenhouse, Confluence and Salesforce
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with minimal supervision
* Excellent leadership skills, data analytical & presentation skills, Written & Communication skills
* Understanding of overall HR lifecycle – Core HR, Benefits, Talent Mobility, Equity, Compensation, Exits etc

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

title: Workplace Experience Manager, Bengaluru
description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
The Workplace team’s mission is to create and support work environments that are welcoming, comfortable, and intuitive. These spaces are designed to promote collaboration, well-being, and productivity while adhering to the rigorous safety, security, and confidentiality standards required of a financial services company.
  
  
The Workplace Experience team comprises operations, hospitality-focused and financially responsible professionals who directly shape the daily experiences of Stripes, visitors, and candidates across 20+ global office locations. This geographically dispersed team oversees facilities management, daily operations, and programs, including a culinary team dedicated to preparing nutritious meals.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
We're looking for a strategic leader and experienced workplace manager with a high EQ who's enthusiastic about, and has a driving need to deliver, the best possible workplace experience for Stripes. You will be a key member of our Experience team and responsible for ensuring that workplace operations, experiences, facilities, and programs run smoothly at our Bengaluru office. As a business partner, you have a deep understanding of the needs, experiences, and day-to-day realities of Stripes at your location and build strong relationships not only with site leads but also with cross-functional partners across the organization.
  
  
This role requires a high level of expertise and operational oversight—from understanding how the building functions top to bottom to governance of contractor team performance and ensuring financial accountability. Bengaluru is a complex site with a significant employee transportation program, and you will be accountable for the reliability, service quality, and continuous improvement of these operations. You will work in close strategic partnership with our integrated facilities management partner, establishing clear expectations, maintaining strong governance, addressing performance gaps, and ensuring services meet Stripe’s operational and workplace experience standards.
  
  
You will also play a critical role in managing operational incidents and disruptions. This requires remaining calm under pressure, bringing structure to ambiguity, coordinating the appropriate internal and external partners, communicating clearly with stakeholders, and translating lessons from incidents into durable operational improvements.
  
  
A key part of the role is anticipating the needs of the business by understanding both the site and the broader context of company growth. You will gather and synthesize feedback from multiple sources to ensure the workplace strategy is informed by real insights from the ground. While enterprise workplace strategy is developed centrally, you are expected to bring informed recommendations based on local business needs and operational insight, and to own successful implementation and adoption at your site. You will develop site-level plans, surface material risks early, and provide leaders with clear recommendations and trade-offs rather than simply escalating problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Oversee workplace operations at your site(s), providing direction on all workplace services, including building operations, front of house, shipping & receiving, events support, and employee health and safety.
* Make sound, independent operational decisions by balancing business impact, risk, cost, and employee experience, seeking alignment when decisions create broader organizational impact or precedent.
* Lead, coach, and motivate a team of workplace services professionals, providing direction, coaching, and performance management to drive team excellence and continuous improvement.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders, including senior leadership, department heads, and cross-functional teams.
* Develop a strong rapport with locally assigned Stripes.
* Own operational performance for your site by monitoring service levels and utilization, identifying trends, resolving root causes, and driving continuous improvement across workplace operations.
* Proactively anticipate business needs by understanding both local context and company priorities.
* Develop thoughtful, data-informed recommendations that help shape workplace programs and experiences while maintaining alignment with global standards.
* Hold workplace partners and service providers accountable for performance, ensuring contractual obligations, service levels, and operational standards are consistently achieved while driving continuous improvement.
* Work closely with our Finance & Strategy partner and IFM partner to develop and oversee the opex budget for all facilities, opex, fixed assets and events of the Bengaluru office.
* Work closely with the local site leadership team to activate the office by creating engagement, connection, and an inclusive environment.
* Craft relevant communications and documentation regarding Workplace policies and programs for Stripes.
* Ensure consistent execution of global workplace programs, standards, and policies at your site, as developed by our Food, Space Planning, and Programs teams, adapting implementation to local operational requirements while maintaining alignment with enterprise objectives.
* Support the Workplace team's goals by taking on ad hoc tasks and projects as they arise.

Who you are
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 7 years of experience in workplace/hospitality management in a fast-paced environment with a strong customer service orientation and an understanding of operational best practices
* Strong demonstrated ability in facilities management, vendor, and budget management
* Strength in building relationships with key internal partners to ensure efficiency and understanding on cross-functional projects
* Experience managing a team focused on customer service, hospitality, and operations, with the ability and desire to develop and coach your team
* Ability to synthesize operational data, stakeholder feedback, and business context into clear recommendations that support sound decision making.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills
* An innovative mindset with the ability to drive exceptional workplace services and operational improvements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Proficiency in Google Suite, Slack and Jira
* A clear willingness to take a hands-on approach and dive into the details
* Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional partners and translate enterprise strategy into effective local execution.
* Ability to operate independently, digging into problems to understand the root cause and delivering scalable solutions
* The ability to thrive in a fast-paced workplace with rapidly changing priorities
* Adept at using and experimenting with provided AI tools for things like, identifying practical opportunities to automate routine work, generate operational insights from workplace data, and improve the experience for employees and visitors.
* An innovative mindset with the ability to drive exceptional workplace services and operational improvements

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

title: Manager I, AF, NA, Relay Operations Center
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

ROC Overview
  
Relay Operations Center (ROC) is the central command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting multiple geographies like NA / EU. It ensures hassle free, timely pick-up and delivery of freight from vendors to Amazon facilities and to carrier hubs. In case of any exceptions, ROC steps in to resolve the issue and keeps all the stakeholders informed on the proceedings.  
In addition to this tactical problem solving, ROC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data.  
Overall, ROC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.  
The candidate should have a working knowledge of Remote Gate Management Program who are responsible for the managing the remote check-in and check-out at the FC. Candidate should be good in carrier/stakeholder management, have potential to draw projects out of the programs and should be able to communicate with NA/EU stake holders clearly in the written and oral form. Candidate should be able to come up with process improvements, drive them through completion, including owning up the KPIs.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to  
Managing a shift, constantly identifying opportunities to improve team performance and owning associated change management.  
Developing and/or referring to performance metrics to drive team performance and business results.  
Identifying the business impact of trends and making data backed decisions.  
Communicating with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers (Retail, Finance, Software Support, Fulfillment Centers)  
Escalating problems or variances in the information and data to the relevant owners and following through on resolutions.  
Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis, as needed, is a plus.  
Serves as escalation point for transportation specialists.  
Owning process/business level reports/actions and diving compliance..  
Perform Ad-hoc reporting and analysis as per requirement.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 1+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
* Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
* Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Successfully completed the Interim Manager Program in ROC

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: EMEA SAP Functional Analyst – Finance O2C | Bangalore
description:
**Company Description**

***Colliers (NASDAQ, TSX: CIGI) is a global diversified professional services and investment management company operating through three industry-leading businesses: Commercial Real Estate, Engineering and Investment Management. With greater than a 30-year track record of consistent growth and strong recurring cash flows, we scale complementary, high-value businesses that provide essential services across the full asset lifecycle. Our unique partnership philosophy empowers exceptional leaders, preserves our entrepreneurial culture, and ensures meaningful insider ownership, driving strong alignment and sustained value creation for our shareholders. With $6.1billion in annual revenues, 28,000 professionals, and $110 billion in assets under management, Colliers is committed to accelerating the success of our clients, investors, and people worldwide. Learn more at*** ***corporate.colliers.com******.***

 **Job Description**

**Role Summary:**

The EMEA SAP Functional Analyst – Finance O2C plays a key role in supporting and enhancing Colliers’ SAP Finance platform across the EMEA region, with a focus on the Order to Cash (O2C) process. This role partners with Finance and Commercial stakeholders to resolve business process issues and identify opportunities for improvement in SAP S/4HANA. The role will act as a “co-owner” with business stakeholders for project proposals through the IS Governance process.

As Colliers EMEA continues its SAP transformation journey, the successful candidate will join a growing team responsible for service delivery and continuous improvement of SAP applications (SAP S/4HANA; Concur; SAC; BTP Services).

**Purpose of Role:**

The EMEA SAP Functional Analyst – Finance O2C will work in the Corporate Technology Finance Systems team to ensure the platform and its environment follow best practice ITIL standards in both day-to-day support and ongoing development.

**Role Overview and Responsibilities:**

***SAP S/4HANA – Finance O2C Domain***

* Support and maintain SAP Finance modules related to O2C, including Accounts Receivable (AR), Credit Management, Billing, Revenue Recognition, and Customer Master Data.
* Act as a liaison between technical teams, business users, and developers to expedite development and improve service delivery.
* Troubleshoot and resolve functional, configuration, and data-related issues within the O2C domain.
* Provide 3rd line support and liaise with SAP and AMS providers to ensure expert-level resolution.
* Perform root cause analysis for production errors and recommend long-term fixes.
* Collaborate on the design, development, and release of software changes aligned with architectural standards and Colliers IT strategy.
* Produce business analysis deliverables using Colliers-standard documentation and tools.
* Identify and manage technical projects to maintain service levels and improve platform performance.
* Support system integration design and implementation across Finance, Sales, and Customer Service functions.
* Maintain and update technical documentation in line with configuration changes.
* Conduct quality assurance to ensure compliance with functional and technical specifications. Ensure all required testing is completed prior to any changes or enhancements are implemented.

**Collaboration and Stakeholder Management:**

* Engage with key stakeholders in EMEA Finance and Commercial teams (Finance Leadership, Business Process Owners, in-country Finance and Sales Teams) to support platform operations and future enhancements.
* Work closely with the SAP Programme Team and Implementation Partners during rollouts and onboarding of new countries or business units.
* Ensure sufficient documentation is provided to support transition into live service, especially for localisations or customisations.
* Communicate progress, challenges, and recommendations to project stakeholders and senior management.
* Demonstrate strong organisational skills and a proactive approach to improving Colliers IT services.
* Ability to work well under pressure in a diverse and dynamic environment, effectively prioritising multiple issues simultaneously.

**Technical Expertise and Troubleshooting:**

* In-depth knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Finance modules, particularly in the O2C domain.
* Experience in SAP implementation and support roles, ideally 5–10 years.
* Ability to assist business users with SAP functionality and participate in business process reviews.
* Skilled in capturing, documenting, and delivering new business requirements.
* Confident in facilitating workshops to ensure configuration changes are understood and adopted.
* Familiarity with SDLC, Agile methodologies, and tools such as JIRA.
* Development of test artefacts and scripts for structured testing (unit, integration, UAT).
* Creation of knowledge articles and training materials to support adoption and resolve common issues.
* Provide ad hoc training and consulting to Finance and Commercial super users and SMEs.
* Stay current with industry trends and SAP certifications relevant to Finance and O2C.

Experience operating in an IT Service Management system, preferably ServiceNow

 **Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience in SAP Finance with certification in relevant modules (e.g., FI, SD, AR).
* Experience in at least one end-to-end SAP implementation, ideally across multiple countries.
* Knowledge of SAP ASAP or Activate delivery methodology.
* ITIL certification (desirable).
* Strong understanding of Finance and Commercial business processes, especially within O2C.
* Consultative mindset, self-directed, and capable of working independently in a dynamic environment.
* Commitment to customer service and continuous improvement.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

 **Additional Information**

**General Terms of Employment:**

This is a permanent role within the Colliers EMEA Technology Solutions team. Hybrid working arrangements apply, with a minimum of two days per week in an agreed Colliers office location.

**Reporting Line:**

This role reports to the Finance Systems Manager and collaborates closely with Functional Consultants and SMEs from the Colliers EMEA Finance and Commercial Teams.

title: Pricing Specialist & Competitive Analyst - VOIS
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking a **Pricing Specialist & Competitive Analyst** to develop and execute pricing strategies that support sustainable business growth, profitability and market competitiveness.

Based in **Pune or Bangalore**, this role combines pricing strategy, commercial analysis, cost modelling and market intelligence. The successful candidate will analyse internal cost structures and external market dynamics, monitor competitor activity and industry trends, and translate insights into commercial decisions that strengthen competitive positioning.

**What you’ll do**
------------------

**Develop pricing models and tools:** Design, build and maintain solutions for pricing calculations, analysis and reporting.**Monitor pricing performance:** Track key pricing metrics, identify trends and provide actionable insights to support management decision-making.**Manage annual pricing refreshes:** Update cost inputs, overheads and target margins, revise price books and communicate changes across VOIS.**Support digital pricing solutions:** Provide commercial expertise and define business requirements for digital pricing tools.**Maintain data accuracy:** Ensure pricing tables, business logic and cost information within standard pricing tools remain accurate and up to date.**Improve tool adoption:** Support adoption and effectiveness of standard pricing tools across the organisation.**Deliver pricing analysis:** Conduct research and data analysis to identify trends, patterns and opportunities for pricing optimisation.**Shape deal pricing:** Develop commercial strategies that support profitability while considering price positioning, customer requirements and overall deal structure.**Support cost modelling:** Define and analyse programme metrics, financial-year targets and strategic priorities, and review cost models to support competitive pricing.

**Who you are**
---------------

You bring a strong combination of commercial judgement, analytical capability and pricing expertise, with the ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

You should have:

* **8+ years of experience** working within a global organisation.
* **8+ years of experience in similar functions**, including experience working with or leading virtual teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with a data-driven approach.
* Demonstrable experience in **pricing strategy, pricing models, profitability optimisation and competitive analysis**.
* Experience collecting, interpreting and presenting pricing and commercial data.
* Strong understanding of business and competitive dynamics.
* Experience with **market intelligence** and the ability to identify commercially relevant trends and opportunities.
* Experience in **deal shaping and negotiation**.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across teams and stakeholders.
* Experience managing pricing-related projects from initiation through completion.
* **Advanced Microsoft Excel expertise**, including using advanced functionality to support analysis, reporting and business decision-making.
* Understanding of service-industry pricing principles and practices.
* Understanding of organisational complexity and its potential impact on customer proposals.
* A **bachelor’s degree in business, telecommunications or a related discipline**.
* An MBA or relevant professional qualification is desirable.
* Familiarity with finance processes is desirable.

**Not a perfect fit?**
----------------------

Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.

**What's in it for you**
------------------------

This role offers the opportunity to work across **pricing strategy, commercial decision-making, competitive intelligence and digital pricing tools** within a global environment. You will have the opportunity to influence pricing approaches that contribute to revenue, margin, win rates and improved quotation processes while collaborating with stakeholders across the organisation.

**What skills you will learn**
------------------------------

Through this role, you will have opportunities to further develop your capabilities in:

* Advanced pricing and profitability optimisation.
* Competitive and market intelligence.
* Commercial deal shaping and cost modelling.
* Digital pricing tools and pricing automation requirements.
* Pricing performance measurement and reporting.
* Cross-functional stakeholder collaboration in a global organisation.
* Data-led commercial decision-making

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
----------------------------------------------

Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

**Join Us**
-----------

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

* **8+ years of experience** working within a global organisation.

title: Site Manager
description:
**Position**
- Site Manager / Accounts Incharge

**Location**
- Oragadam Chennai

**Shift -**
Rotational

**Role Overview -**

The Site Manager is responsible for overseeing daily operations of a warehouse handling direct-to-consumer distribution. This role ensures seamless order fulfillment, inventory accuracy, and efficient warehouse operations while meeting customer satisfaction goals and adhering to safety and compliance standards. The role also ensures timely sorting, grading, transformation, and distribution of products to dark stores while maintaining quality, cold chain integrity, and operational efficiency

**Key Responsibilites-**

**Operations Management:**

Oversee all warehouse operations, including receiving, storage, order picking, packing, and shipping.

Implement and optimize processes to meet daily order fulfillment goals.

Ensure timely sorting, grading, transformation, and delivery while maintaining stock availability for all dark stores.

Handle complete day-to-day warehouse operations, including cold chain management, within defined cut-off timelines while ensuring quality and SOP adherence.

**Inventory Control:**

Maintain accurate inventory records through regular cycle counts and audits.

Manage inventory accuracy and share daily stock audit reports.

Collaborate with procurement and sales teams to forecast and manage stock levels.

Ensure timely inventory liquidation (damaged and expired) as per SOP and customer SLA.

**Team Leadership:**

Supervise, train, and motivate warehouse staff, including pickers, packers, and inventory personnel.

Manage shift schedules to ensure adequate staffing during peak periods.

Coordinate with vendors to ensure timely availability of resources such as contract associates, security staff, and transportation.

**Technology Utilization:**

Leverage warehouse management systems (WMS) to track inventory and orders efficiently.

Ensure staff are properly trained on WMS and other operational technology tools.

Ensure timely processing of vendor bills as per PR/PO process in SAP.

**Customer Experience & Vendor Management:**

Ensure all orders are fulfilled accurately and delivered on time to maintain high customer satisfaction.

Address and resolve any order discrepancies or operational issues promptly.

Manage relationships with third-party vendors and ensure service level agreements (SLAs) are consistently met.

Review vendor invoices thoroughly to ensure accuracy in calculations, rates, and supporting documentation, verifying alignment with contracts, SLAs, or purchase orders.

**Safety and Compliance:**

Enforce adherence to safety standards and operational regulations within the warehouse.

Ensure compliance with labor laws, health standards, and cold chain handling requirements.

**Reporting and KPIs:**

Monitor and report key performance indicators (KPIs) such as order accuracy, delivery timelines, inventory turnover, and productivity.

Ensure daily KPIs agreed with the customer are achieved and presented during daily operational reviews.

Track productivity across warehouse processes and minimize process waste to control variable costs.

Use operational data and insights to identify improvement opportunities.

**Required Experience & Skill:**

Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred).

Proven experience of 10+ years managing grocery or FMCG warehouse operations, preferably involving fresh produce or cold chain logistics.

Strong experience in warehouse management systems (WMS), SAP, and inventory control processes.

Demonstrated ability to manage vendor relationships and SLA-driven operations.

Strong leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication, coordination, and organizational abilities.

title: Engineering Management
description:
**Lead Global Cloud Innovation as Manager of Cloud Operations (COPS)**
Are you an experienced engineering leader passionate about scaling mission-critical cloud infrastructure and pioneering AI and agentic automation? Trimble is seeking an exceptional Manager of Cloud Operations (COPS) to lead our Chennai Cloud Operations team. In this pivotal leadership role, you will oversee the daily management of Trimble Viewpoint's Global Cloud Services—supporting 22,000+ servers and 6,000+ customers in North America—while driving our strategic operational roadmap toward an AI-first future.
  
  
**About Us**
Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. From purpose-built products and enterprise lifecycle solutions to industry cloud services, Trimble is transforming critical industries such as construction, geospatial, agriculture and transportation to power an interconnected world of work. For more information about Trimble (NASDAQ: TRMB), visit: www.trimble.com
  
  
**About Trimble Viewpoint:**
Trimble Viewpoint provides market-leading construction management software solutions that connect the office, team, and field. Our cloud services deliver enterprise-grade performance, high reliability, and integrated data visibility to thousands of construction organizations worldwide.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Great**
In this high-impact position, you will direct the global heartbeat of Trimble Viewpoint’s cloud estate. Operating from our Chennai office in an IST-driven collaborative model with our North American teams, you will champion agentic AI workflows, autonomous patch and incident pipelines, and FinOps cost-governance disciplines. You will have full executive support to cultivate an exceptional engineering culture, mentor top cloud talent, define technical standards with Information Security and Product Leadership, and lead the operational transition toward intelligent, self-healing cloud ecosystems.

* Strategic Leadership & AI Vision: Develop and implement the technical roadmap for AI-enabled cloud operations, championing agentic automation with human-in-the-loop (HITL) checkpoints across deployments, server lifecycle management, and daily workflows.

* Global Cross-Functional Alignment: Track record of driving standard processes, operational rigor, and unified metrics across distributed, multi-region teams.

**Bonus Points For**

* Cloud & AI Certifications: Professional certifications in Microsoft Azure and/or recognized AI/ML platforms.
* Agentic Automation & Scripting: Practical exposure to building or supervising automated agentic workflows, autonomous remediation runbooks, or modern telemetry stacks.
* Compliance Expertise: Direct experience managing audits and operational security controls under SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 frameworks.

From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

title: CMS Manager
description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.
  
  
We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.
  
  
The CMS Manager oversees day-to-day content operations across assigned business areas, ensuring digital content is implemented accurately, efficiently, and in line with business priorities. The role manages operational delivery across cross-functional partners and translates requirements into clear plans that balance deadlines, available capacity, technical requirements, and quality standards. A key part of the role is providing clear ownership and direction for CMS operations, particularly those delivered through WordPress.
  
  
The role combines team leadership with strong working knowledge of content management systems, especially WordPress, alongside operational workflows, quality assurance, and continuous improvement. The CMS Manager is expected to identify risks early, support the resolution of complex implementation issues, develop team capability, and improve the processes and tools used to manage content at scale.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
****Operational Planning & Delivery****

* Oversee delivery across assigned business areas, including CMS and WordPress activity, aligning execution with business priorities, deadlines, and quality expectations.
* Assess incoming demand against available capacity, prioritize work, and identify risks or dependencies that could affect delivery.
* Coordinate complex updates, launches, migrations, and recurring operational workflows within WordPress and other relevant systems, ensuring work progresses through the appropriate review and approval stages.
* Act as a key point of contact for partners across Editorial, SEO, Business Development, Revenue Operations, Compliance, Product, and Engineering, as relevant to assigned areas.

****CMS/Wordpress Expertise****

* Maintain strong practical knowledge of WordPress and related content management tools, templates, plugins, components, and workflows, providing guidance to the team where required.
* Oversee the effective use of WordPress across assigned business areas, ensuring agreed approaches, standards, and publishing practices are followed consistently.
* Support the team in troubleshooting complex CMS and WordPress implementation issues, identify root causes, and coordinate resolution with relevant technical partners.
* Identify recurring defects, manual tasks, and operational risks within CMS workflows, and recommend scalable improvements to tools, processes, and controls.

****Team Leadership & Development****

* Lead and support team members responsible for CMS operations, providing clear direction, coaching, feedback, and performance guidance.
* Develop team skills in CMS and WordPress usage, quality assurance, troubleshooting, operational judgement, and independent problem solving.
* Conduct regular check-ins and performance discussions, set clear expectations, and support individual development.

title: Head of Marine Operations/Senior Manager of of Marine Operations
description:
**Job Description**
Head of Marine Operations /Senior Manager of Marine Operations

**1. Role Purpose**

Lead Swire Digital Centre’s Marine Operations and Cargo Care, delivering safe, compliant, reliable and cost-effective services to Swire Shipping. The role is accountable for team performance, process governance, cargo care and dangerous goods expertise, operational analytics, continuous improvement and timely escalation. It drives operational excellence and a competitive operating structure that supports the liner network proposition, with a focus on schedule integrity, capacity utilization, voyage costs, on-time performance and quality assurance. In line with the Swire Shipping Supply Chain Sustainability Code of Conduct, the role also promotes and embeds Zero Harm practices across the Swire Shipping network.

**2. Role Scope and Decision Rights**

* **People and Service Delivery**
  |
  **Accountable within SDC:**
  Capacity, quality, productivity, SLA delivery, capability development and succession for the Chennai team |
  **Escalate / Consult:**
  Material service risks, structural capacity changes and policy exceptions.
* **Cargo Care and DG Support**
  |
  **Accountable within SDC:**
  Operate specialist desks, maintain SOPs, perform first-level technical review and coordinate responses |
  **Escalate / Consult:**
  Final carriage acceptance, regulatory interpretation or exceptions where authority is not formally delegated.
* **Marine Operations Support**
  |
  **Accountable within SDC:**
  Coordinate operational workflows, monitor performance, identify exceptions and recommend corrective action |
  **Escalate / Consult:**
  Vessel command, statutory ship-management decisions, repairs, dry-docking and conversion approvals.
* **Cost and Vendor Support**
  |
  **Accountable within SDC:**
  Improve activity registration, cost visibility, invoice accuracy and dispute resolution |
  **Escalate / Consult:**
  Commercial commitments, major purchases and payment approval beyond delegated authority.
* **Safety and Crisis**
  |
  **Accountable within SDC:**
  Stop and escalate unsafe work, record incidents and support emergency response |
  **Escalate / Consult:**
  Formal incident command, regulatory notification and crisis decisions under the approved framework.

**3. Key Accountabilities**

**3.1 Service Delivery and Governance**

* Own end-to-end delivery of the Marine Operations and Cargo Care services performed by SDC against agreed scope, service levels, quality standards and controls.
* Establish a clear RACI, delegation-of-authority matrix, escalation path and stakeholder cadence with HQ Operations, Trade, Ship Management, HSSEQ, Finance and Commercial teams.
* Maintain business continuity, cross-training, knowledge documentation and succession coverage for critical activities, including out-of-hours escalation arrangements.
* Monitor demand, capacity, productivity, quality and backlogs; act on root causes and provide transparent governance reporting.

**3.2 Cargo Care and Dangerous Goods**

* Develop, maintain and govern Cargo Management, special-cargo and hazardous-cargo SOPs in line with approved company standards and applicable regulations.
* Coordinate DG enquiries and approvals within formally delegated authority; act as the escalation coordinator for post-fixture issues.
* Ensure DG/IMDG activities are handled by appropriately trained and current personnel, with evidence of competence and refresher training.
* Provide subject-matter guidance to internal stakeholders on cargo acceptance, stowage, documentation and risk controls, while escalating exceptions to the authorised decision owner.
* Identify cargo-care risk trends and lead corrective and preventive improvement initiatives.

3.3 Marine Operations and Port Performance

* Coordinate and oversee operational support for owned and chartered-in vessels within the agreed SDC scope.
* Drive schedule reliability, port productivity, reduction of non-working time, capacity utilisation and operational quality through analysis, coordination and structured escalation.
* Partner with Vessel Managers and authorised functions on repairs, dry-dockings, conversions and charter-gear requirements; SDC responsibility is coordination, analysis and control support unless formally delegated otherwise.
* Benchmark performance, identify recurring exceptions and sponsor workflow improvements.

3.4 Cost and Vendor Payment Management

* Ensure complete supporting documentation for CVP activity reporting within the agreed service standard after vessel departure.
* Improve CAR-to-invoice accuracy, invoice-dispute resolution, upstream activity registration and cost visibility in partnership with HQ Operations and Finance.
* Explain material cost variances, identify leakage and recommend corrective actions using reliable operational and financial data.
* Ensure purchasing, invoice and vendor activities follow company policy, segregation-of-duties requirements and delegated approval limits.

3.5 Safety, Compliance and Crisis Management

* Promote Zero Harm and the “Behaving Safely, Always, Naturally” expectations across the SDC team and relevant service-provider interfaces.
* Record, escalate and track safety incidents, near misses and unsafe observations to closure through the approved reporting process.
* Exercise stop-work and escalation authority where unsafe acts or conditions are observed.
* Support safety audits and emergency-response activities, complete required training and participate in simulations.
* Maintain evidence of compliance with approved SOPs, training, access controls and audit actions.

3.6 People Leadership and Capability

* Lead, coach and develop the team with clear goals, regular feedback, performance management and career development plans.
* Plan staffing, rosters, leave, job rotation, cross-training and coverage for critical operations.
* Build a strong leadership and SME pipeline, with succession plans for key roles and controlled transfer of tacit knowledge.
* Create an inclusive, accountable and improvement-oriented culture aligned to Swire values.

3.7 Digital, Data and Continuous Improvement

* Own the integrity of operational data produced by the SDC team and ensure defined controls for access, change, retention and audit trail.
* Use dashboards and analytics to identify performance trends, operational risk and improvement opportunities.
* Lead standardization, automation and process-improvement initiatives with documented benefits, control assessment and adoption plans.
* Ensure changes to systems or workflows follow approved change-management and information-security requirements.

4. Key Performance Measures

* **Safety and Compliance**
  :Training currency; incident/near-miss reporting and closure; audit actions closed on time; SOP compliance.
* **Service Delivery**
  **:**
  SLA attainment; backlog ageing; quality/right-first time; stakeholder escalations; business continuity coverage.
* **Operational Performance :**
  Schedule and port-performance insights delivered; exception closure; cargo-care risk reduction; improvement benefits.
* **Cost and Controls**
  **:**
  CVP documentation timeliness; CAR-to-invoice accuracy; dispute ageing; cost leakage identified and prevented.
* **People and Capability**
  **:**
  Critical-role coverage; cross-training; attrition and engagement indicators; development and succession actions.
* **Transformation**
  **:**
  Standardization and automation delivered; benefits realized; adoption; control effectiveness after change.

5. Key Stakeholders

* GM Operations, Head of Port and Regional Operations and HQ Marine Operations leadership
* Trade, Commercial, Network, Port Operations and Cargo Care stakeholders
* Ship Management, Vessel Managers, vessels, Crewing and HSSEQ
* Finance, CVP, Procurement, Legal/Compliance, HR and Technology teams
* Ports, terminals, stevedores, agents, suppliers and customers, as relevant to the approved scope

6. Qualifications and Experience

Essential

* Tertiary or recognized technical qualification in Maritime Studies, Nautical Science, Marine Engineering, Shipping, Logistics or a closely related discipline; equivalent sea-going professional qualification may be considered.
* Substantial experience in liner shipping, vessel/port operations, cargo care or closely related marine operations, including leadership of a multi-disciplinary operational team.
* Demonstrated knowledge of dangerous goods and special-cargo operations, with current IMDG competence appropriate to the responsibilities assigned.
* Proven experience in operational risk, safety governance, incident escalation, process controls and audit readiness.
* Experience in cost management, vendor/invoice processes, operational analytics and cross-functional stakeholder management.
* Ability to lead teams or distributed service-delivery team across geographies, time zones and multiple business stakeholders.

Preferred

* Master Mariner, Chief Engineer, senior deck/engineering certificate of competency, or comparable maritime professional credential where the final role scope includes technical vessel decisions.
* 15+ years of relevant shipping experience, with evidence of progressively broader leadership accountability.
* Experience with SEACOS or equivalent shipping/operations platforms, ERP systems, BI dashboards and workflow automation.
* Formal training in incident investigation, crisis management, process improvement or project/change management.

7. Leadership and Professional Competencies

* **Safety Leadership:**
  Makes safety visible in decisions, intervenes on unsafe work and ensures issues are closed.
* **Strategic and Business Acumen**
  **r:**
  Connects SDC MO team delivery, operational performance, customer impact, cost and risk.
* **Operational Leadership**
  **:**
  Sets priorities, manages work, resolves exceptions and sustains reliable service.
* **People Leadership**
  **:**
  Builds effective teams, develops successors and creates accountability with support.
* **Stakeholder Influence:**
  Communicates clearly across cultures and functions; resolves ambiguity through governance.
* **Data-Led Improvement**
  **:**
  Uses evidence to challenge root causes, standardize work and deliver measurable benefits.
* **Integrity and Judgement**
  : Works within delegated authority, escalates conflicts and protects controls.

8. Working Arrangements and Role Conditions

* Based in Chennai with collaboration across global time zones.
* Participation in an agreed out-of-hours escalation roster may be required for urgent marine, cargo or crisis events.
* Travel to vessels, ports, terminals, service providers or Swire locations may be required, subject to business need and company policy.
* Appointment is subject to the candidate holding and maintaining any competence, medical, travel or regulatory requirements formally assigned to the role.

9. Company Culture and Values

The role is expected to demonstrate Swire values through safe decision-making, cultural sensitivity, customer focus, value excellence, teamwork, integrity, continuity, endeavor and humility

* Proven experience in process industries Cement and mining.

* Leadership, organisational design, change, risk, commercial or supplier-management qualifications would be advantageous.

title: Vice President - Production
description:
Position Summary
  
  
  

The
**Vice President of Manufacturing and Production**
is a critical executive role responsible for pioneering the transition of our advanced electric Vertical Take-off and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft from experimental prototype to scaled, commercially viable, and safety-certified mass production.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO), this individual will oversee advanced assembly, composite manufacturing, powertrain integration, avionics installation, and the implementation of automated production systems. The VP will balance the fast-paced innovation of an aerospace startup with the highly disciplined, zero-defect execution required to meet stringent aviation authority standards (e.g., DGCA Production Certification, DGCA POA).

Primary Responsibilities
  
  
  
1. Strategic Operations & Scaled Production
  

**Production Roadmap:**
Design and execute the industrialization roadmap to scale manufacturing facilities from Initial Prototyping, Limited Series Production and full scaled Production.

**Capital Allocation:**
Oversee the CapEx budget for manufacturing infrastructure, factory automation, robotics, and advanced tooling.

**Advanced Manufacturing Integration:**
Spearhead the integration of novel processes specialized for eVTOL, including advanced carbon fiber composite curing, high-voltage battery pack assembly, electric propulsion system (EPS) integration, and Fly-by-Wire avionics testing.

2. Regulatory Compliance & Quality Assurance
  

**Production Certification:**
Partner closely with Quality and Regulatory teams to secure DGCA
**Production Certificate (PC)**
and Production Organisation Approval (POA).

**AS9100 Compliance:**
Champion and enforce an
**AS9100**
certified manufacturing environment, embedding a strict safety-first culture.

**Traceability:**
Ensure 100% component traceability and rigorous conformity inspection processes are built into the manufacturing execution system (MES).

3. Supply Chain Collaboration & Design for Manufacturing (DFM)
  

**Concurrent Engineering:**
Act as the bridge between the Engineering/R&D teams and the factory floor. Drive
**Design for Manufacturing (DFM)**
and Design for Assembly (DFA) initiatives to lower unit costs and build times.

**Supplier Scaling:**
Collaborate with the Global Supply Chain team to ensure key tier-1 aerospace suppliers (battery cells, carbon composites, structure components) align with factory ramp-up schedules and quality metrics.

4. Operational Excellence & Lean Leadership
  

**KPI Management:**
Define and achieve strict operational metrics: Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), Cost of Quality (CoQ), Scrap Rate, Cycle Time, and Takt Time.

**Continuous Improvement:**
Deploy Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma principles tailored to a hybrid automotive/aerospace ecosystem.

**Team Building:**
Recruit, mentor, and scale a world-class manufacturing division, including plant managers, industrial engineers, manufacturing technicians, and safety leads.

Requirements
  
  
  
Requirements & Qualifications
  
  
  
Experience
  

**Aerospace:**
**15+ years**
of progressive manufacturing leadership experience. A combination of traditional aerospace structure assembly
**and**
high-volume advanced automotive manufacturing is highly preferred.

**Certification Track Record:**
Direct experience taking a novel vehicle or complex aerospace structure through a successful regulatory production certification process.

**Scale Up:**
Proven experience taking a facility from greenfield/brownfield setup to full-scale operations.

Technical Skills & Competencies
  

* Deep technical understanding of electric powertrains, high-voltage battery architecture, automated riveting/bonding, and carbon composite manufacturing (autoclave and out-of-autoclave).
* Expertise with
  **Industry 4.0**
  technologies, including smart manufacturing execution systems (MES), PLM software, and robotic automation.

Education
  

**Required:**
Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a highly related technical field.

**Preferred:**
Master’s degree in Engineering and/or an MBA.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Senior Product Manager, New Games**

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India

**About Liquidnitro Games**

Liquidnitro Games is a game development company built to create, launch, and scale ambitious games for a global audience.

Founded by industry veterans with deep experience across free-to-play, live services, and large-scale game production agnostic of platforms, we bring together product thinking, design craft, engineering depth, art execution, data, and live operations under one roof.

We build games from the ground up, take new ideas from 0 to 1, and work with select partners to strengthen, scale, and operate high-quality game experiences.

Our teams combine creative ownership with production discipline, helping projects move from early prototypes to validated products, and from launch to long-term growth.

At Liquidnitro, we are building the next generation of game teams, products, and tools from India for the global games industry.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Senior Product Manager**
to help build, launch and scale an ambitious new free-to-play mobile game.

This is a hands-on product leadership role for someone who understands what makes games fun, how players engage with systems over time and how to translate great gameplay into a sustainable product.

You will work closely with game designers, engineers, artists, producers, analysts and leadership to shape the product from development through launch and live operations.

We are looking for someone who can move comfortably between creative discussions and product analytics, challenge assumptions, make thoughtful trade-offs and take ownership of measurable player and business outcomes.

**What You’ll Do**

**1. Own Product Strategy and Player Experience**

* Define and drive the product vision, goals, roadmap and success metrics in collaboration with game leadership.
* Translate the creative direction into a compelling player experience with strong core gameplay, progression, engagement and retention systems.
* Understand player motivations, behaviors and friction points across the entire player journey.
* Establish product priorities and make decisions that balance player experience, development constraints and commercial opportunities.
* Identify opportunities to differentiate the game within the competitive F2P mobile market.

**2. Drive Development From 0 to 1**

* Partner with design, engineering, art and production to take the game through development, testing, launch and iteration.
* Define and prioritize features based on player impact, product goals and development feasibility.
* Establish clear acceptance criteria and measurable success outcomes for major features and systems.
* Drive playtesting, qualitative feedback and data-informed iteration to validate product hypotheses.
* Make pragmatic scope and prioritization decisions to deliver a focused, high-quality game.
* Work with cross-functional teams to resolve product ambiguities and ensure alignment around priorities.

**3. Build Retention, Progression and Monetization Systems**

* Partner with game design to shape progression, rewards, economies, content systems and long-term engagement loops.
* Understand how gameplay, difficulty, pacing and rewards influence player motivation and retention.
* Develop thoughtful F2P monetization strategies that complement the core player experience.
* Evaluate virtual economies, IAP systems and engagement mechanics to establish sustainable long-term product health.
* Identify and address issues such as progression friction, economy imbalance and retention drop-offs.

**4. Establish Product Analytics and Experimentation**

* Define and track KPIs across acquisition, activation, engagement, retention, conversion and monetization.
* Partner with analytics and engineering to ensure appropriate telemetry, dashboards and reporting are in place.
* Build hypotheses, interpret quantitative and qualitative insights and translate findings into actionable product decisions.
* Design and evaluate experiments to improve player experience and business performance.
* Analyze player cohorts, funnels, progression, content consumption and feature performance.
* Build a strong understanding of the relationship between game systems and product metrics.

**5. Lead Launch Readiness and Product Growth**

* Define product readiness criteria and success metrics for internal testing, soft launch and global launch.
* Partner with publishing, marketing, user acquisition and live operations teams on launch strategy.
* Identify product risks and performance gaps early, and drive corrective action.
* Support the transition from development into ongoing live operations.
* Develop post-launch priorities around player engagement, content, feature improvements and sustainable growth.

**6. Drive Cross-Functional Product Leadership**

* Be an accountable product decision-maker who brings clarity to complex and ambiguous situations.
* Communicate product strategy, priorities, risks and performance to leadership and stakeholders.
* Collaborate closely with producers while retaining ownership of product outcomes, player experience and feature priorities.
* Balance creative ambition, player needs, technical feasibility and business performance.
* Foster a culture of player empathy, experimentation, accountability and continuous improvement.

**What We’re Looking For**

**Must Have**

* 6–10 years of experience in product management or equivalent product ownership roles within the games industry.
* Demonstrated experience working on free-to-play mobile games, ideally across development, launch and live operations.
* Experience shipping at least one game or owning substantial product features and systems through launch.
* Strong understanding of mobile F2P design, including core loops, progression, economies, retention, engagement and monetization.
* Ability to use product analytics, player feedback and competitive insights to make decisions.
* Strong product judgment and the ability to identify what matters most for players and business outcomes.
* Experience collaborating with game designers, engineers, producers, artists and analysts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, structured thinking and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to operate independently and take ownership in a fast-moving game development environment.

**Good to Have**

* Experience building a game from prototype or pre-production through launch.
* Experience with action, survival, shooter, RPG or progression-heavy games.
* Experience developing cooperative, social or multiplayer game systems.
* Experience with live operations, content strategy, experimentation and soft-launch optimization.
* Hands-on familiarity with SQL, analytics platforms or product experimentation tools.
* Experience working with licensed IPs or established entertainment franchises.
* Experience collaborating with globally distributed development and publishing teams.

**What Success Looks Like**

* **Product clarity:**
  A well-defined roadmap, clear product hypotheses, priorities and measurable success criteria.
* **Strong player experience:**
  Core gameplay, progression and engagement systems that are validated through testing and iteration.
* **Product readiness:**
  A game that meets agreed quality, performance and product KPI thresholds through development and launch.
* **Data-informed execution:**
  Product decisions consistently backed by player insights, experimentation and sound judgment.
* **Cross-functional ownership:**
  Teams aligned on priorities, trade-offs and expected outcomes.
* **Sustainable growth:**
  A foundation for long-term retention, monetization and live operations.

**Why Join Liquidnitro?**

This is an opportunity to shape a new game from its early stages and have meaningful ownership over its product direction and outcomes.

You will work with experienced game creators, collaborate across disciplines and influence decisions that directly shape what players experience.

At Liquidnitro, we value people who are curious, hands-on, willing to challenge assumptions and excited about building great games. We offer the opportunity to work on ambitious projects with global audiences, while helping shape a growing game development organization.

title: Engagement Manager - Mumbai
description:
**About the Company**

The Founders Finance is a Bangalore-based finance partner for founder-led businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets. The team runs Virtual CFO, Accounting and Taxation, Fundraising, Company Secretarial and Advisory functions for companies across consumer and D2C, food and beverage, fashion, SaaS and financial services, working to a disciplined monthly rhythm rather than year-end scrambles. Clients get their books closed early in the month, a clear read on their cash runway, and a compliance calendar where nothing slips through. It's a small, senior-heavy team by design, so founders work directly with people who understand both the numbers and the business behind them.

**About the Role**

As an Engagement Manager, you own the client relationship. You're the person founders trust to know their numbers, spot problems early and keep every deliverable on time. You'll run a portfolio of clients end to end, from monthly closings and compliance to the conversations that shape their financial decisions.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

1. Own a portfolio of client engagements end to end, and act as the primary point of contact for founders and their teams

2. Deliver accounting, taxation, compliance and financial reporting services to clients on a disciplined monthly rhythm

3. Gather information and data from clients' finance managers, teams and other sources, and make sure it's complete, accurate and on time

4. Review books, reconciliations, MIS and P&Ls prepared by the team, and ensure quality before they reach the client

5. Present monthly performance, cash flow and key insights to founders, and advise on the actions that matter

6. Track compliance calendars (GST, TDS and other statutory deadlines) so nothing slips through

7. Guide and review the work of associates on your engagements, and help raise the quality bar across the team

8. Spot opportunities to expand services with existing clients, such as Virtual CFO, fundraising support and advisory

9. Manage timelines, deliverables and client expectations across multiple engagements at once

**Requirements**

1. CA Qualified (must)

2. 5+ years of experience in accounting, finance operations or client-facing finance services

3. Strong working knowledge of Tally (ERP 9 / Prime)

4. Solid understanding of GST, TDS and tax compliance

5. Strong Excel skills and experience in MIS and financial reporting

6. Proven ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines, and to review the work of others

7. Excellent communication, with the confidence to work directly with founders and senior stakeholders

8. Strong ownership, judgment and attention to detail

**Good to Have**

1. Experience working with or inside startups (preferred)

2. Familiarity with other accounting software such as Zoho or QuickBooks

3. Exposure to FP&A, fundraising support or investor reporting

4. Exposure to D2C, e-commerce, F&B, SaaS or financial services clients

5. Experience in a CA firm, advisory firm or virtual CFO setup

**What You'll Gain**

1. Full ownership of client portfolios across high-growth businesses

3. Exposure across virtual CFO reporting, fundraising and compliance

4. A fast track to larger portfolios and leadership responsibilities

* Analyse industry trends, competitive positioning and key business risks.

* Documentation & MIS:

* Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial information received from clients.

* Maintain databases of borrower financials, lender requirements and transaction information.

* Quality of financial models and projections
* Accuracy of credit ratios and financial calculations

* Turnaround time for credit appraisal and analysis
