title: Senior Credit Analyst
description:
**Purpose of the Job:**

To undertake comprehensive credit assessment, underwriting and execution of investment opportunities in the private credit / high-yield debt space.

The role involves evaluating businesses across sectors, assessing their financial strength, business fundamentals, management quality and debt servicing capabilities, and structuring bespoke credit solutions to address the financing requirements of borrowers. The individual will be responsible for end-to-end transaction execution, ongoing portfolio monitoring and proactive identification and mitigation of credit risks across the investment portfolio.

**Key responsibilities:**

**A. Credit Underwriting and Investment Evaluation**

* Undertake comprehensive credit evaluation of prospective borrowers across sectors, including assessment of business fundamentals, industry dynamics, competitive positioning, management quality, financial performance and corporate governance.
* Conduct detailed financial analysis, including historical financial performance, cash flow assessment, working capital requirements, capital structure, debt servicing capabilities and liquidity position.
* Prepare projections to evaluate sustainability of business cash flows and assess the borrower's ability to service debt under different operating and financial scenarios.
* Analyse the existing debt profile, including lender exposure, repayment obligations, security arrangements, contingent liabilities, guarantees and potential refinancing requirements.
* Assess promoter and management track record, financial discipline, governance standards, related-party transactions and historical conduct with lenders and other stakeholders.
* Prepare detailed credit appraisal notes, investment memorandums and recommendations for internal investment committees, clearly articulating the investment rationale, key risks and proposed mitigants.
* Evaluate new and existing borrowers across both operating company (OpCo) and holding company (HoldCo) structures.

**B. Transaction Structuring and Execution**

* Lead and drive end-to-end execution of credit transactions, from initial evaluation and due diligence through structuring, documentation and financial closure.
* Work across transaction structures, including secured / unsecured debt, senior / subordinated debt, structured credit, promoter financing, acquisition financing, refinancing and other bespoke credit solutions.
* Negotiate key commercial terms with borrowers, promoters, lenders and other counterparties, including finalisation of term sheets and transaction structures.
* Work closely with legal counsel, technical consultants, financial advisors, trustees, security agents and other external stakeholders for transaction execution.
* Review and negotiate key provisions of financing and security documents, including debenture trust deeds, loan agreements, share pledge agreements, guarantees, escrow arrangements and inter-creditor agreements.
* Ensure that appropriate structural protections, cash flow controls, security mechanisms, financial covenants and information covenants are incorporated into transaction documentation.
* Coordinate with internal legal, compliance, operations and investment teams to ensure timely completion of due diligence, satisfaction of conditions precedent and disbursement.
* Independently manage multiple transactions and drive timely closure without compromising the quality and rigour of credit assessment.

**C. Portfolio Monitoring and Risk Management**

* Independently monitor the performance and credit quality of existing portfolio investments through periodic financial reviews, management interactions and assessment of key operating and business developments.
* Track financial performance against approved business plans, projections and underwriting assumptions, identifying deviations and assessing their implications for debt servicing.
* Monitor key credit parameters, including leverage, liquidity, interest coverage, debt service coverage, working capital position and covenant compliance.
* Track repayment schedules, interest servicing, maturity profiles, refinancing requirements and adequacy of security cover.
* Undertake periodic reviews of borrower financials, rating actions, lender developments, industry trends and other relevant information.
* Maintain regular engagement with borrower management and promoters to obtain updates on business performance, financial position, liquidity and future plans.
* Identify early warning signals, including deterioration in financial performance, cash flow stress, governance concerns, delayed payments, rating downgrades and adverse industry developments.
* Prepare periodic portfolio review notes and updates for the Fund Manager, Investment Committee and other relevant stakeholders.

**D. Industry Research and Business Evaluation**

* Develop a strong understanding of various industries, business models, competitive dynamics and sector-specific operating risks to support informed credit decisions.
* Undertake sectoral research to evaluate industry growth prospects, regulatory developments, demand-supply dynamics, pricing trends and key business risks.
* Analyse the impact of macroeconomic developments, interest rate movements, commodity price fluctuations, regulatory changes and other external factors on borrower credit profiles.

**E. Reporting and Stakeholder Management**

* Maintain effective working relationships with borrowers, promoters, lenders, investment bankers, rating agencies, legal advisors and other relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth execution of transactions and timely resolution of operational, legal and documentation-related matters.
* Ensure timely and accurate dissemination of relevant information and updates to internal/external stakeholders.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and records of credit assessments, approvals, transaction execution and portfolio reviews.

**Behavioral Competencies:**

* **Ownership and Accountability:**
  Ability to assume end-to-end responsibility for credit evaluation, transaction execution and portfolio monitoring.
* **Analytical Thinking:**
  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to evaluate complex businesses, financial structures and credit situations.
* **Commercial Acumen:**
  Ability to balance commercial considerations with credit discipline and identify appropriate risk-return opportunities.
* **Decision-making Ability:**
  Ability to exercise independent judgement, challenge assumptions and arrive at well-reasoned credit recommendations.
* **Execution Orientation:**
  Ability to manage multiple transactions simultaneously and deliver outcomes within tight timelines without compromising analytical rigour.
* **Attention to Detail:**
  Strong focus on identifying financial, structural, legal and operational risks that may impact the investment.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Ability to effectively engage with senior management, promoters, lenders, advisors and internal stakeholders.
* **Adaptability and Learning Orientation:**
  Keen interest in understanding new business models, sectors, financing structures and evolving market dynamics.
* **Integrity and Professional Conduct:**
  High standards of professional ethics, transparency and independence in credit assessment and decision-making.

**Role Specific Competencies:**

* Strong understanding of credit underwriting, financial analysis, financial modelling, debt structuring and risk assessment.
* Experience in evaluating businesses across sectors, including assessment of business models, industry dynamics, management quality and financial performance.
* Sound understanding of structured / high-yield credit transactions, including complex OpCo / HoldCo structures, capital structures and cash flow waterfalls.
* Ability to evaluate security arrangements, financing documentation, covenants and lender protection mechanisms, and identify appropriate risk mitigants.
* Strong analytical, communication and execution skills, with the ability to independently manage transactions and engage with internal and external stakeholders.

**Formal Qualifications / Prior Work Exp:**

* Minimum 2–6 years of relevant experience in credit underwriting, credit analysis, structured finance or debt investments.
* Prior experience in NBFCs, private credit funds, banks, debt investment platforms, rating agencies or structured finance teams would be preferred.
* Strong experience in evaluating and executing structured / high-yield credit transactions, including OpCo and HoldCo financing structures, would be an added advantage.
* Experience in end-to-end transaction execution, including due diligence, financial analysis, structuring, term sheet negotiation and legal documentation.
* Professional qualifications in finance, including Chartered Accountancy (CA), CFA, MBA / PGDM (Finance) or equivalent, would be preferred.
* Strong proficiency in financial modelling, financial statement analysis, Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

Raise Financial Services is building technology-led financial products and infrastructure for India’s financially aware and digitally savvy consumers.

You will be responsible for performing a broad range of complex work, requiring in-depth conceptual and practical knowledge in Treasury as well as basic knowledge of related job disciplines. You will work independently within broad guidelines and policies with minimal guidance and act as a resource for colleagues with less experience. You will solve complex problems, take new perspectives on existing solutions, and exercise judgment based on the analysis of multiple sources of information. Your work performed in this role significantly impacts on the quality, efficiency and effectiveness of Treasury and the broader Finance organization.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Manage daily cash operations, including cash positioning, clearing, settlement activities and optimization of liquidity.
* Oversee and ensure compliance, operational stability and reporting for Dow Facility Lines, working capital facilities, credit lines, and corporate debt in the EMEAI region.

* Drive process improvements, documentation, training development and implementation across Treasury Operations to improve accuracy, efficiency and compliance.
* Provide Treasury expertise for cross-functional projects, ad‑hoc inquiries and structured finance or leasing-related activities.
* Effectively use AI and Automation technologies to achieve efficiency, increased effectiveness and improved awareness.

**Qualification**

* University bachelor’s degree required.
* Master’s Degree, Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) or other relevant Finance Certification preferred.
* Preferred 7–10 years relevant experience and for internal candidates 5+ years of Dow work experience.
* Expanded conceptual knowledge of Treasury and basic understanding of related Treasury disciplines.
* Working knowledge of Treasury Management Systems (TMS), SAP, and AI tools

**Skills:**

* Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, with the ability to interpret financial data and generate meaningful insights.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across a matrixed, multinational organization. Fluent in English (both written and spoken).
* Prior experience succeeding in complex, global MNC treasury environments, demonstrating comfort operating in matrixed structures.
* A naturally curious mindset with a proactive approach to problem‑solving and process improvement.
* Strong prioritization, time management, and independent decision‑making skills.
* Demonstrated drive, motivation, and aspiration to advance and grow into higher‑level Treasury responsibilities within a dynamic environment.
* Demonstrated ability to solve complex problems with little or no precedent.

**Additional notes:**

* Relocation assistance is not available for this position.
* The role necessitates working according to European working hours however, the ability to accommodate flexible schedule aligned with international time Zone is essential.

**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**

title: Assistant Vice President
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Debt Capital Markets & Investment Origination**

* Identify, source, and evaluate debt investment opportunities across NBFCs / financial institutions and corporates, including opportunities in Commercial Papers (CPs), Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs), and other debt instruments.
* Develop and maintain relationships with issuers, banks, financial institutions, intermediaries and market participants to build a strong pipeline of investment opportunities.
* Understand issuer business models, funding structures, financial performance, credit profiles, and liquidity positions to assess investment suitability and risk-return potential.
* Evaluate primary and secondary market debt opportunities, assess transaction economics, and identify attractive yield opportunities across different credit profiles and maturities.
* Leverage an established network of institutional investors, family offices, wealth managers, banks, and other market participants to distribute and place NCDs and other debt instruments and facilitate secondary-market transactions
* Structure, negotiate and execute debt transactions in line with the fund's investment mandate, risk appetite, liquidity requirements and return objectives.
* Prepare investment proposals, transaction notes, term sheets, cash flow models and issuer analysis for prospective debt investments.
* Coordinate with issuers, arrangers, rating agencies, debenture trustees, legal counsel, custodians, RTAs and other market participants to facilitate transaction execution and closure.

**2. Fund Management & Portfolio Strategy**

* Support the overall management of the Fund, including portfolio construction, investment allocation, asset selection and ongoing portfolio optimisation.
* Identify and evaluate investment opportunities across varied debt instruments to generate risk-adjusted returns in line with the fund's investment objectives.
* Monitor portfolio performance, portfolio yield, accrual income, mark-to-market movements, maturity profiles, duration and liquidity positions.
* Develop and implement investment strategies based on prevailing interest rate scenarios, yield curve movements, credit spreads, liquidity conditions and broader macroeconomic developments.
* Track concentration limits, issuer exposures, sectoral allocations, credit quality and other portfolio risk parameters to ensure adherence to the fund's investment mandate.
* Optimise portfolio allocation, cash deployment and overall fund performance.

**3. Credit Research & Investment Due Diligence**

* Conduct detailed fundamental credit analysis of prospective issuers, including financial statement assessment, cash flow analysis, leverage, liquidity, asset quality and debt servicing capabilities.
* Prepare comprehensive issuer credit notes / investment memorandums and instrument-specific investment recommendations.
* Analyse credit ratings, rating rationales, rating sensitivities and outlook changes to assess potential credit risks and investment implications.
* Evaluate transaction structures, security mechanisms, covenants, credit enhancements and repayment waterfalls to understand underlying investment risks.
* Monitor existing portfolio investments through periodic financial reviews, rating surveillance, issuer updates and early-warning indicators.
* Assess downside risks and conduct scenario analysis to evaluate the potential impact of interest rate changes, credit deterioration and liquidity stress on portfolio performance.

**4. Market Research & Investment Analytics**

* Track developments across debt capital markets, money markets, fixed-income instruments and the broader financial services industry.
* Monitor RBI monetary policy, interest rate movements, yield curves, credit spreads, liquidity conditions and regulatory developments to identify potential investment opportunities.
* Analyse primary and secondary market transactions to benchmark yields, pricing, issuer spreads and market liquidity.
* Develop market intelligence and investment dashboards to support portfolio allocation, investment decisions and fund performance monitoring.
* Identify emerging investment themes, market dislocations and relative value opportunities that can contribute to alpha generation.
* Work closely with internal risk, compliance, operations and finance teams to ensure investments and portfolio activities adhere to applicable regulatory requirements and internal investment policies.
* Support investment committee discussions through detailed investment proposals, market updates, portfolio reviews and recommendations.
* Ensure timely monitoring, reporting and documentation of investment transactions and portfolio activities.

**Mandatory Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of Debt Capital Markets, fixed-income securities, money market instruments and debt investment products.
* Sound knowledge of financial markets, interest rate dynamics, credit markets and investment products.
* Strong financial modelling, analytical and quantitative capabilities, particularly in Excel.
* Excellent relationship management, networking and business development capabilities, particularly with issuers, banks and financial institutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare investment notes and present recommendations to senior management and investment committees.
* Strong commercial acumen, independent thinking, analytical ability, and decision-making skills.
* Ability to build and maintain relationships with senior management at banks, NBFCs, corporates and other financial institutions.

title: Senior Analyst, Credit & Collections
description:
**Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?**
At
**Aleph**
, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.

We are looking for a
**Senior Analyst, Credit & Collections**
to support our Team in
**Mumbai, India**
**What You’ll Do**

* Own the end-to-end credit and collections cycle for an assigned portfolio of agencies and advertisers across APAC, keeping overdue balances low and improving DSO
* Run daily and weekly follow-ups on overdue invoices via email, calls and client meetings, using a clear escalation ladder (reminder, intimation, suspension notice, demand letter, legal or agency handover)
* Secure and track Promises to Pay (PTPs) and follow up the next day on any broken PTP
* Drive down the 90+ ageing bucket and act on items approaching 360 days before they reach full ECL provisioning
* Chase unapplied cash with Finance so payments are applied within 14 days, and issue Statements of Account, dunning and suspension notices in line with the Group Collections Policy
* Log, classify and resolve disputes with Sales, Billing and Operations within 7 days (or escalate), and fix the root causes of recurring billing, PO and invoice-dispatch issues
* Monitor credit limit utilisation and exposure, initiate credit limit reviews in Salesforce, flag high-risk accounts early, and support sign-off on Insertion Orders and new client onboarding
* Contribute to the ECL review by identifying PDD cases, long-outstanding items and likely write-offs
* Join weekly AR calls with Sales and country heads, share AR and suspension lists a day ahead, and send same-day minutes with action owners and dates; escalate unresolved cases to the Senior Risk Manager and regional leadership
* Build strong relationships with key clients through regular touchpoints and, where possible, in-person visits
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports on ageing, DSO, 90+, disputes, PTPs and collection targets using BigQuery, SAP and Salesforce data
* Help standardise and automate routine follow-ups, templates and reporting (n8n, Google Workspace, Claude), and keep SAP, Salesforce and trackers clean and audit-ready
* Act as a go-to person for junior analysts and support policy, SOP and collector-journey improvements

**What You'll Need For This Role**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or a related field (ACCA, CMA or a credit certification is a plus)
* 4–7 years in credit control, collections or accounts receivable, ideally in a multinational, media, advertising, digital or services environment
* Experience managing a multi-country, multi-currency AR portfolio, with exposure to APAC markets preferred
* Strong AR and ageing analysis skills, with working knowledge of ECL/provisioning, credit limits and payment terms
* Hands-on SAP (FBL5N, ageing, payment blocks) and Salesforce experience; advanced Excel/Google Sheets; SQL or BigQuery is a plus
* Confident negotiating payment plans and escalating firmly but professionally, balancing collections with client and Sales relationships
* Excellent written and spoken English; additional APAC languages are a plus
* Proactive, organised and detail-oriented, with strong follow-through, comfortable working across time zones and open to automation and AI tools

**What Will Make Us Really Love You**

* You bring a track record of success in a similar role, with hands-on experience.
* You’re not afraid to challenge the status quo and bring fresh, out-of-the-box ideas to the table.
* You anticipate challenges before they arise and take initiative to find effective solutions.
* You have an eye for detail.
* You thrive on teamwork but also bring a driven, goal-oriented spirit.
* You’re genuinely enthusiastic about advertising, ad-tech, and staying ahead of industry trends.
* You have the ability to engage and communicate with internal and external stakeholders in a positive and approachable way.

**What You’ll Love About Us**

* We care about your individuality by giving you freedom to grow and create within the company, regardless of your position
* Learn from the best: Our state of the art workshops guarantee the latest insights into digital advertising
* Be part of a company with a truly global footprint, working with leading brands, platforms, and publishers across 90+ markets.
* We foster a dynamic environment where creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas are encouraged and celebrated.
* Join a diverse, multicultural team that values and embraces different perspectives, experiences, and talents.
* At Aleph, your work directly contributes to connecting brands and consumers in meaningful ways, shaping the future of digital advertising.

This is your chance to take real ownership of your portfolio across multiple APAC markets, with a direct line to regional leadership. You'll help shape how Credit & Collections is standardised and automated across the region. If you're ready to make a measurable impact on cash and credit risk, we want to hear from you!
  
  
“Share our similarities, celebrate our differences.” – M. Scott Peck
  
  
#ALEPH
  
  
**Why Join Us?**
Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.

title: Senior Analyst
description:
**Who You'll Work With**
You are someone who thrives in a high-performance environment, bringing a growth mindset and entrepreneurial spirit to tackle meaningful challenges that have a real impact.
  
  
In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we’ll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities to help you quickly broaden your expertise, grow into a well-rounded professional, and contribute to work that truly makes a difference.
  
  
When you join us, you will have:
  
  

* Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey.
* A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes.
* Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
* Exceptional benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.

**Your Impact**
You will manage the firm's client engagement economics from client onboarding to managing project to collections and extending support primarily to our India based engagements.
  
  
Your primary responsibilities will include Project financial management including budgeting, forecasting, managing project schedules, maintaining compliance with our internal policies & US GAAP, monthly project audits, financial analytics incl. monthly cost variance reviews & pricing analysis, project billing and collections, with a primary focus to minimize the engagement risks and revenue leakage.
  
  
You will build long-term relationships with many stakeholders and act as an expert helping consultants think strategically through their budget plans and partner with them on long-term client programs. You will work closely with project managers to prepare robust financial budgets and forecasts and understanding the financial implications and outcomes of project activities.
  
  
You will prepare monthly financial information and analysis for projects to explain actual financial performance to partners and senior partners and where required forecast for subsequent periods. You will track the progress of project activities and milestones to enable appropriate project financial accounting for revenue recognition, cost recognition and billing. If needed, you will address inconsistencies to the partners and senior partners and propose solutions. You will be a one-point contact for partners and senior partners to support onboarding, clients’ agreements, project code creations from finance perspective.
  
  
You would be generating invoices and working with partners to ensure client invoices are sent to clients on schedule; also send invoices directly to clients as needed. You will work with partners when client invoices are outstanding past invoice due date. You will also engage with stakeholders as thought partners for problem solving. You will work with partners to ensure that non-standard arrangements (client investments, performance-based arrangements, and deferred billing arrangements) are accounted for properly.
  
  
You will work with the finance team members to improve financial management practices and financial awareness across the business. You will evaluate the financial implications of various strategic decisions, builds scenarios and recommends actions. Additionally, you will research and address all ad hoc partners queries.
  
  
Finally, you will perform year-end and any other requisite analytics and reporting and assist in special projects or process improvements projects as may be assigned from time to time.
  
  
**Your Qualifications and Skills**

* University degree, preferably in finance/accounting or business administration combined with sound knowledge in finance and accounting, preferably a chartered accountant.
* 3+ years of experience in a similar role and environment (project accountant or project finance controller desirable) or/and experience in supporting management and leadership by providing insight, analysis and financial results for review
* Proactive and tenacious in follow up; self-motivated, “can-do attitude”, results-oriented with a high level of integrity
* Solid working knowledge of MS Office programs - Excel, Access, and PowerPoint; knowledge of SAP is an added advantage
* Excellent skills in solving problems, making decisions, and resolving conflicts.
* Confidence and ability to communicate with various levels of authority throughout the business (excellent communication skills to tailor messages over the phone and via email to senior partners, partners, and associate principals)
* Business level language skills, both verbal and written, in English

title: Programme Lead –Just Transition Policies and Institutional Engagement
company: International Forum for Environment, Sustainability & Technology (iFOREST)
description:
**About the Role**

iFOREST is seeking a senior law and public policy professional to lead the Policy interventions and engagement of its Just Transition programme. The Programme Lead will shape iFOREST’s policy responses and public outreach, and help central and state governments develop the laws, policies and institutional frameworks needed for a just transition.

The Programme Lead will be responsible for policy engagement at the national and state levels, will provide policy and legal support across the programme’s other workstreams, and will work closely with the Director, Just Transition.

Please apply online at iFOREST Careers (https://iforest.global/careers/) or via LinkedIn https://forms.gle/JUkKaFFpWoSeBVfJ9

**Key Responsibilities**

**Programme Strategy and Leadership**

* Lead the Policy workstream, setting quarterly, six-monthly and annual priorities and workplans with the Programme Director, each tied to clear policy outcomes.
* Drive measurable policy outcomes: secure the adoption of iFOREST’s recommendations in national and state policies, laws, rules, schemes and institutional frameworks.
* Track the national and state policy landscape and identify priorities for iFOREST’s policy response and engagement.
* Provide policy and legal support to the programme’s all workstreams, ensuring coherence across the programme’s policy positions.
* Build strategic partnerships with government agencies, parliamentarians, policy institutions, industry, and other concerned agencies at the national and state levels.
* Identify emerging policy priorities and new areas of work, and develop proposals and partnership opportunities in coordination with the Programme Director.

**Research**

* Lead policy and legal research on just transition, including analysis of laws, policies, regulations and institutional frameworks governing sectors that must plan for a green transition, as well as cross-cutting areas including land, labour and skilling, social protection, public finance, and environmental governance.
* Prepare timely policy responses and comments to central ministries, state departments, and other concerned agencies.
* Develop policy briefs, legal reviews, draft policy text and implementation frameworks with actionable recommendations for government.
* Review reports and outputs from other workstreams for policy and legal soundness.
* Track and analyse international just transition polices, frameworks and processes, including the UNFCCC Just Transition Work Programme, G20 and other economic platform deliberations, and multilateral initiatives, and country experiences, to inform national strategies, and strengthen India’s global South’s position.
* Identify emerging research areas and strengthen the programme’s knowledge agenda on just transition law, policy and governance.

**Government and Stakeholder Engagement**

* Work with the Director and senior management on policy engagement with central ministries, state governments and their agencies.
* Lead the programme’s policy outreach and commentary, including op-eds, explainers, media engagement and rapid responses to policy developments, in coordination with the communications team.
* Conduct high-level meetings, deliver presentations, and design and facilitate consultations, roundtables and policy dialogues.
* Build and leverage networks with government bodies, public sector enterprises, industry, the legal and policy community, and civil society organisations.
* Represent iFOREST’s perspectives in key policy forums and public platforms.

**Team Management and Mentoring**

* Lead and guide team members on policy engagement
* Oversee the quality and rigour of policy outputs for various work streams, ensuring consistency with iFOREST’s institutional quality standards.
* Ensure timely delivery of the workstream’s policy responses, outputs and stakeholder engagements against agreed milestones.

**Education and Qualifications**

* A degree in Law (LLB or LLM) and/or a Master’s degree in Public Policy. A combination of law and public policy qualifications is strongly preferred.
* Candidates with other combinations of education and strong, demonstrated expertise in legal and policy analysis may also be considered.

**Experience**

* 10 to 12 years of relevant professional experience.
* A proven record of policy engagement and high-level communication with central or state governments is essential.
* Experience in legal and policy analysis, including drafting policy submissions, legal reviews or policy text, is required.
* Experience working with think tanks, government departments, legal policy organisations, or research-oriented consulting.
* Experience in environment, energy, natural resources, mining, labour, or development law and policy is highly preferred.
* A record of published policy writing, such as policy briefs, op-eds or journal articles.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Excellent persuasive communication skills, with the ability to build a compelling case and engage with senior officials, legislators and industry leaders, and hold ground in high-stakes negotiations and
* Strong ability to read, interpret and analyse legislation, regulations and policy documents.
* Strong understanding of government decision-making and policy processes at central and state levels.
* Excellent writing skills, with the ability to produce clear, persuasive pieces quickly for both expert and public audiences.
* Project management capabilities, ownership, and the ability to work independently.

**Location and Commitment**

* Noida, India (on-site), with travel as required.
* Full-time.

**About iFOREST**

The International Forum for Environment, Sustainability & Technology (iFOREST) is an independent, nonprofit research and innovation organisation dedicated to driving India’s transition towards an economically prosperous, environmentally sustainable, and socially just future. The organisation’s work is rooted in rigorous research, stakeholder engagement, and developing innovative solutions to shape subnational, national, and global agendas.

Enabling and supporting a Just Transition to Net Zero is a core initiative of the organisation. Its focus areas include just transition planning for coal-dependent regions, repurposing and economic diversification of mining areas, socio-economic research with affected workers and communities, and green jobs and skilling for India’s energy transition.

**Why Choose iFOREST**

* **Purpose-driven work:**
  Shape how India manages one of the largest economic and energy transitions in the world, from districts and states to national and global policy.

title: Recruiter (deep-tech or hardware-tech hiring)
description:
Okulo Aerospace is a Bengaluru-based deep-tech startup, specialising in the design and development of autonomous aerial systems. We have built India’s first DGCA-certified solar-electric Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV); it is also India’s first certified fixed-wing UAV. For a small UAV, we have the highest flight times in the country. In a parallel program, we have developed a high-altitude tactical UAV under the IDEX program for the Indian Army. Our larger vision is to develop what’s called HAPS (high-altitude pseudo-satellites). These are stratospheric UAVs with the potential to transform how we think about cellular connectivity, earth observation, remote sensing, PNT, border monitoring, maritime surveillance, disaster response, and C3 for defence.

**Why do we need a Recruiter?**

Development of HAPS-like technology requires niche aerospace engineers, and even more skillful marketers to commercialise the technology. Because talent in this frontier is rarely accessible through standard job boards or traditional sourcing, finding passionate technologists and storytellers requires a creative, proactive discovery strategy. We are looking for a recruiter who thrives on exploring unconventional talent channels, testing new hiring workflows, cultivating lasting relationships with prospective candidates, and building an enduring pipeline.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end recruitment process from sourcing, screening, and assessments to offer rollouts, salary negotiations, and candidate onboarding.
* Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements, streamline interview processes, and build tailored recruitment workflows for both entry-level and leadership positions.
* Proactively source and nurture talent pipelines for active and future roles, maintaining a high bar for technical excellence and cultural alignment.
* Explore alternate sourcing channels, identify specialised talent across technical forums, academic publications, scientific conferences, patent databases, drone clubs, etc.
* Map the Indian landscape of engineers skilled in ultra-light structures, high-altitude aerodynamics, solar-electric propulsion, autonomous avionics, and composite materials

**Requirements:**

* 2+ years of experience hiring in robotics, aerospace, automotive, embedded, hardware engineering, or adjacent hard-tech domains.

* Manage the complete recruiting process for executive-level hiring, which includes creating compelling job descriptions, sourcing candidates, marketing the organization's talent brand, screening applicants, advising hiring managers, and negotiating job offers
* Stay updated on labor regulations, understand inclusion practices, and ensure that the recruitment process is fair and compliant with legal requirements. Be proactive in maintaining high ethical stands to protect the organization and ensure equitable treatment of all candidates

* A strong viewpoint on recruiting processes across technical and non-technical hiring, with the ability to identify gaps and implement improvements that scale with the company.
* Demonstrated experience operating successfully in a dynamic, startup environment, willing to flex between strategic leadership and hands-on execution as needed.
* Expertise across the full recruiting lifecycle, with a strong focus on scaling processes efficiently.
* Strong business acumen with an understanding of how recruiting drives and impacts organizational success and goals.

title: Senior Recruiter
description:
Who Are We?
  
  
RZR is an AI-native advertising platform built for the next era of performance marketing. We operate at the intersection of machine learning, programmatic media, and full-funnel mobile growth, powering campaigns for some of the world's most ambitious advertisers. Our platform is purpose-built to deliver outcomes at scale, not just impressions.
  
  
We are a team of builders, operators, and technologists who believe the advertising industry is overdue for a fundamental rethink. We move fast, operate with a high degree of ownership, and hold ourselves to an exceptionally high standard of craft.
  
  
RZR is scaling aggressively with an active M&A pipeline and a platform vision that puts us on a path to becoming an industry leader. This is a rare opportunity to join a company at an inflection point and help shape what it becomes.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
As a Senior Recruiter based in our Bangalore office, you will run full-cycle hiring across a mix of roles at RZR and bring senior-level judgment to every search you own. You will report to our Global Head of Talent Acquisition and work closely with them on how the team hires.
  
  
You will be the go-to recruiting partner for our revenue leaders across Sales, Business Development, Account Management, and Marketing. You will also take on our more complex, hard-to-fill searches, where market knowledge and creative sourcing make the difference.
  
  
We're looking for someone who operates independently, advises leaders with data, and knows how to close candidates who have options.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Revenue Hiring
  
  

* Own full-cycle recruiting for revenue and revenue-adjacent roles across Sales, Business Development, Account Management, Marketing, and Revenue Operations, from intake through offer acceptance
* Partner with revenue leaders to shape role definitions, calibrate the hiring bar, and advise on level, compensation, and market realities before a role opens
* Build and maintain warm talent pipelines for recurring revenue roles so no search starts from zero

Niche and Hard-to-Fill Roles
  
  

* Lead searches for specialized roles with small talent pools, using market mapping, targeted outreach, and creative channel strategy
* Produce talent market insights, including compensation benchmarks, competitor org mapping, and talent availability, that shape hiring decisions

Recruiting Craft and Team
  
  

* Run high-stakes closes alongside hiring managers, including counteroffers, competing offers, and complex negotiations
* Raise the bar for the team by sharing your sourcing approaches, search strategies, and closing techniques with fellow recruiters
* Keep ATS data clean and use it to report on pipeline health, conversion, and time-to-fill for your roles

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 4 to 6 years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including at least 3 years in a tech, SaaS, or growth-stage environment
* A proven track record hiring for revenue roles (Sales, Business Development, Account Management), including quota-carrying positions
* Experience filling niche or hard-to-fill roles through proactive sourcing and market mapping, not just inbound applicants
* Confidence advising and pushing back with senior stakeholders (Director and above) using market data
* Strong closing skills, with examples of winning candidates against competing offers or counteroffers
* Deep knowledge of the Bangalore and broader India talent market
* Proficiency with Greenhouse or a comparable enterprise ATS

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience in ad tech, martech, or mobile advertising
* Experience hiring for global or regional revenue teams outside India, such as APAC or the U.S.
* Experience working in a globally distributed talent acquisition team
* Advanced sourcing tools (LinkedIn Recruiter, SeekOut, or similar) and Boolean search expertise

The RZR Code
  
  
Our Values
  
  
Our values define the company we want to be. They guide the decisions we make, the environment we create, and how we treat customers and each other.
  
  

* Win with Customers: We don't call it a win unless our clients win too. We earn long-term trust by putting their success at the center.
* One Team: No team wins when the company loses. We optimize for the company, not our function.
* Challenge with Respect: We say what we think and challenge ideas regardless of title. We are direct without being disrespectful.
* Learn Forward: Thoughtful experiments can fail; failing to learn from them cannot. Share what you learn.

Our Competencies
  
  
Our competencies define what we expect from each of us. They describe the behaviors and capabilities we demonstrate in our day-to-day work.
  
  

* Extreme Ownership: Own the outcome end to end, including problems you didn't create.
* Courage: Speak up, make hard calls, and take thoughtful risks.
* Move Fast: Act with urgency and decide with the information available.
* Curiosity: Ask why, look for better ways, and keep learning.
* Drive for Excellence: Set a high bar for quality and keep raising it.
* Deliver Results: Focus on outcomes that move the business forward.
* Proactive Communication: Share information early, before anyone has to ask.
* Manage Ambiguity: Make progress when the path isn't clear.

**RZR is an equal opportunity employer**
RZR is a place where everyone can grow. However you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this role excites you.
  
  
RZR provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

description:
**About Airwallex**
Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.
  
  
**How You'll Make Impact**
Build the recruiting strategy for Airwallex’s Global Sales Hub in Bangalore, supporting hiring across multiple regions and helping accelerate our SME sales efforts worldwide. You’ll own full-cycle recruitment from sourcing and screening through interviewing, offer negotiation and placement, partnering directly with executives and hiring managers on roles ranging from junior to Director level. You’ll use creative sourcing strategies, recruitment data and market insight to attract diverse, high-quality talent, improve hiring decisions and deliver an exceptional candidate experience. As an early member of our India team, you’ll help shape how we hire and grow in a rapidly expanding market.
  
  
You’ll work from our Bangalore office four days a week.
  
  
**Essentials**
**What we're looking for**

* 3–5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, including at least 2+ years in an in-house environment hiring commercial sales talent.
* Experience partnering directly with executives and senior leaders, with the confidence to influence hiring decisions and push back when needed.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy when managing Applicant Tracking System records and the offer process.
* Ability to use recruitment data and analytics to drive decisions, optimise processes and provide actionable insights to hiring managers.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present data and recommendations clearly and confidently.
* Experience negotiating offers and managing complex candidate scenarios.
* Experience developing and executing creative, data-driven sourcing strategies across multiple channels.
* Ability to manage end-to-end recruitment processes, including screening, interviewing, assessment, stakeholder management and candidate experience.

**Preferred**

* Experience hiring for corporate functions.
* Experience hiring for an international Sales Hub or talent working shift hours.
* Ability to pivot strategies quickly, solve problems creatively and manage competing priorities.
* Strong sense of urgency and a track record of delivering results in a fast-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree.

**You'll thrive here if**

* You’re comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.
* You’re comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.
* You communicate clearly and directly across cultures, and you're thoughtful about how context shifts meaning across borders.

title: Senior Candidate Experience Specialist, APJ

An overview of this role
  
  
As the Candidate Experience Team Lead for [Region], you'll own how candidates experience GitLab across your region by raising the capability of the specialists around you. You'll set the quality bar, balance workloads, onboard and develop specialists, and serve as the first escalation point when a process breaks down or a candidate situation needs judgment. You'll stay hands-on with interview coordination, background checks, and offers, while spending most of your time making the regional function run well. You'll use candidate experience data to surface patterns and risks to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement, and partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global process. At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead Candidate Experience Specialists in [Region], setting and modeling standards for interview coordination, candidate communication, contract and offer accuracy, and data hygiene in the applicant tracking system.
* Balance coordination work across the regional team, monitor capacity against hiring volume, and flag resourcing gaps to the Director, Talent Acquisition and Enablement before they affect candidates.
* Resolve escalated scheduling conflicts, candidate issues, and process gaps, bringing clear recommendations to leadership when further support is needed.
* Own onboarding, ramp, and ongoing development for new specialists through documentation, shadowing, and direct feedback on work quality.
* Coordinate interviews, prepare offers and employment contracts, manage background and reference checks, and partner with People Operations on the handoff to onboarding.
* Build and maintain reporting on candidate satisfaction, specialist response times, scheduling turnaround, and data accuracy to identify patterns, bottlenecks, and risks.
* Partner with leads in other regions to maintain one global coordination process, contribute regional evidence to process and tooling improvements, implement agreed changes, and keep documentation accurate in the applicant tracking system and GitLab repositories.
* Collaborate with recruiters, hiring managers, Talent Acquisition leadership, Information Technology, and People Operations across time zones to keep hiring moving, modeling GitLab's values, culture, and all-remote approach in every interaction.

What you’ll bring
  
  

* Substantial experience in candidate experience or recruiting coordination, covering interview scheduling, offer and contract preparation, background checks, and onboarding handoffs, including serving as a senior or go-to team member.
* Ability to lead and develop team members without formal authority through mentoring, onboarding, direct feedback, and influence.
* Attention to detail in scheduling, contracts, and candidate data, with a record of professionalism, responsiveness, sound judgment under pressure, and maintaining confidentiality.
* Experience anticipating risks, resolving scheduling and process problems early, prioritizing competing demands, and setting clear expectations about timelines, next steps, and trade-offs.
* Experience building and maintaining candidate experience or scheduling reports, using data to identify bottlenecks and make a case for change.

Instawork is on a mission to create meaningful economic opportunities for skilled hourly professionals in communities around the globe. Closing that gap is the defining infrastructure challenge of the physical AI era. IRL is Instawork’s answer to it. We deploy skilled workers into real commercial and residential environments - kitchens, warehouses, hotel floors, homes - to capture the high-fidelity task data that the world’s leading Robotics labs use to train their foundation models. title: Head - Talent Acquisition
description:
**About Kapiva**

Kapiva is a fast-growing, Ayurveda-led nutrition and wellness brand focused on making traditional Indian wellness relevant to the modern consumer. We are building a high-growth, performance-driven organisation that values ownership, speed, innovation and a strong bias for action.

As we scale, our ability to attract and bring in the right talent will be a critical competitive advantage. We are looking for a
**Head of Talent Acquisition**
to build a robust, scalable and data-driven hiring engine that supports our next phase of growth.

**The Mandate**

Own and build Kapiva's end-to-end Talent Acquisition function across three critical hiring channels:

1. **Campus Hiring:**
   Establish a structured campus recruitment programme to build a strong early-career talent pipeline through management trainee, graduate trainee and internship programmes.
2. **Lateral Hiring:**
   Drive high-quality mid and senior-level hiring across business functions, ensuring strong business alignment, speed and candidate experience.
3. **Replacement & Volume Hiring:**
   Build predictable hiring pipelines for high-attrition and volume-intensive roles, ensuring business continuity and minimal disruption due to attrition.

Beyond closing positions, the mandate is to institutionalise the entire hiring ecosystem – processes, technology, data, employer branding and talent pipelines – so that hiring becomes a proactive business capability rather than a reactive HR activity.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Build and Drive the Talent Acquisition Strategy**

* Partner with the CHRO and business leaders to translate business plans into an annual and quarterly manpower and hiring strategy.
* Own hiring across corporate, sales, supply chain, operations, technology and other business functions.
* Drive campus, lateral, leadership and replacement hiring with clear ownership of delivery, quality and cost.
* Build proactive talent pipelines for critical and recurring roles rather than relying solely on open requisitions.

**2. Establish a Scalable Hiring Engine**

* Build standardised hiring processes covering requisition approvals, sourcing, screening, assessments, interviews, offer management and onboarding handover.
* Implement an Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and integrate it with the HRMS and other relevant tools.
* Introduce structured interview frameworks, assessment scorecards, hiring SLAs and clear accountability for hiring managers.
* Develop referral programmes, direct sourcing capabilities, talent communities and external hiring partnerships.
* Build playbooks for high-volume and replacement hiring, including sourcing events, vendor management and accelerated hiring drives.

**3. Drive Employer Branding & Candidate Experience**

* Define and strengthen Kapiva's Employer Value Proposition (EVP) and create a compelling talent narrative.
* Build Kapiva's presence across campuses, digital platforms and relevant talent communities.
* Partner with Marketing and business teams to showcase employee stories, culture, leadership and career opportunities.
* Strengthen candidate experience at every stage of the hiring journey.
* Build a strong external employer reputation through consistent engagement and Glassdoor / AmbitionBox performance.

**4. Build and Lead the TA Team**

* Build a high-performing, lean recruitment team as hiring requirements scale.
* Establish clear ownership, productivity metrics and delivery standards across the team.
* Manage recruitment budgets, external consultants, agencies and strategic hiring partnerships.
* Act as the single point of accountability for talent acquisition across the organisation.

**Who Are We Looking For?**

**Experience & Background**

* 7–8 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, with at least 3 years in a high-growth organisation.
* Experience in D2C, consumer brands, e-commerce or startup environments is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in building TA processes, systems and teams, preferably from the ground up.
* Strong exposure to campus, lateral, leadership and large-scale replacement / volume hiring.
* Hands-on experience in implementing ATS platforms and establishing recruitment dashboards and metrics.
* Proven experience in employer branding and building sustainable sourcing channels.
* MBA / PGDM in HR is preferred.

**This role offers an opportunity to build a critical organisational capability at a high-growth consumer business, with direct access to the CHRO and leadership team and the potential to grow into a larger Talent Acquisition leadership mandate.**

title: SDC Recruiter
description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
The recruiting team seeks to build the culture of Stripe by aligning the strongest global talent to our highest impact business needs. They focus on bringing Stripe’s operating principles to life in their recruiting processes, providing the highest-quality candidate experience, and leveraging data driven storytelling to influence the business.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
To further this important mission, we are looking for a consultative and creative recruiter to grow and scale our Business & Core teams in APAC. You can expect high impact and wide-ranging responsibilities: owning full-cycle recruiting, driving hiring strategy, and delivering best-in-class candidate experience. This person must be a builder who thrives in a learning environment—unafraid to try new things, embrace new ideas, and welcome suggestions for how we can iterate on our processes.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Fulfill junior to senior level and high volume requisitions, scaling up teams across Stripe Delivery Center in India, Bangalore
* Partner with multiple senior stakeholders with varying priorities to understand their hiring objectives and drive recruiting strategies to build a strong leadership team for the Operations org
* Partner closely with recruiting analytics to ensure accurate reporting of hiring progress back to the business
* Build and drive cross-functional partnerships with compensation, human resources, finance and others to scale hiring across Stripe
* Consistently generate a healthy pipeline of high quality candidates by driving initiatives across branding, events, and employee referral channels
* Provide timely reporting of key metrics and insights to drive decisions and improve processes

Who you are
  
  
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 8+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience (in-house experience strongly preferred)
* Strong track record in target achievements, experience managing high volume hiring in fast moving environment
* Experience partnering with senior executives throughout the recruiting process, acting as an effective hiring partner and trusted advisor
* High agency, can handle ambiguity in a fast-moving organization, and thrives on a high level of autonomy and responsibility
* Proven abilities to attract passive candidates and build a diverse pipelines
* Strong in data driven approach to problem solving; you enjoy making sense of the trends and using the insights to improve recruiting strategies
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders internally and externally

**Preferred Requirements**

* \* Experience with India market hiring

+ Experience with reporting work, proficient in data tools such as Visier, Greenhouse Reports, GoodTime, Gem etc
+ Ability to quickly adopt new recruiting technologies, AI and optimize workflows for scale

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Stripes on the Works in Progress team based in the London, UK office also work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

title: People Services Advisor
description:
**Our Global Structure**
Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.
  
  
**About The Team**
The People Services team is the heartbeat of our Global People Operations, driving the employee experience across three of the world’s most iconic local commerce and delivery platforms: Deliveroo, DoorDash, and Wolt. Operating behind the scenes of this massive multi-brand ecosystem, our team delivers seamless, world-class frontline HR support and administrative excellence to thousands of employees and Managers globally. We thrive on operational precision, navigate complex local labor landscapes with ease, and build the scalable HR infrastructure that allows our teams to innovate and grow at speed.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented People Services Advisor to join our growing People Operations team in Hyderabad. This is an exciting opportunity to help establish and scale our brand-new India hub during a period of rapid expansion. In this role, you will be the backbone of our frontline HR support, delivering efficient administrative services to employees and managers across the region. As a primary point of contact for HR inquiries, you will ensure a seamless employee experience while maintaining accurate records in full compliance with local labor laws and company policies.
  
  
This role offers a hybrid work arrangement, requiring you to be in the Hyderabad office at least 3 days per week and giving you the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining 2 days. You will report to the People Services Manager on the Global People Services team.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Act as a confident and empathetic first line of support for employees, managers and stakeholders, translating complex HR processes into clear, accessible language
* Own the ticket escalation process on our case management platform: monitor incoming cases, assess urgency, collaborate with the relevant teams, and escalate complex issues to the appropriate HR specialist or HR Manager where required, managing high volumes efficiently without compromising accuracy or response times
* Execute full cycle, end-to-end HR administration while maintaining accurate and up-to-date employee records, ensuring HRIS (Workday) data integrity and confidentiality, including but not limited to:

+ Onboarding: preparation of employment contracts and new hire documentation, medical insurance registration and new joiner orientation, supporting high-volume hiring and acting as the key point of contact across HR, IT, facilities and hiring managers for a smooth first day
+ Offboarding: processing resignation and termination paperwork and conducting exit administration
+ Employee lifecycle: accurately processing high volumes of employee data changes (e.g. job changes, promotions, transfers, salary adjustments) and supporting leave and absence queries

* Support payroll preparation, ensuring records are accurate and processed in a timely manner, particularly during high-volume payroll cycles
* Prepare HR-related letters, certificates and other documents as required (e.g. employment verification and salary certificates, relieving and experience letters)
* Provide accurate and timely reporting on key people metrics and support the preparation of HR data dashboards for relevant teams, to enable data-driven decision-making across the business
* Collaborate with Government Relations, COEs, HRBPs, Talent Acquisition and IT on India statutory and regulatory requirements and any other queries on request, proactively keeping stakeholders informed
* Stay current with changes and emerging trends in India Labour Law, ensuring all HR administrative activities comply with India Labour Law, company policies and data protection requirements (including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act and GDPR principles)
* Identify opportunities to streamline HR administrative processes and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives within the People Services function
* Support the development and documentation of HR processes and procedures with a focus on scalability for high-volume periods, identify opportunities to use AI to address inefficiencies, and proactively recommend improvements
* Any other tasks as directed by your Line Manager

**Requirements**

* 2–3 years’ proven experience in a similar role, preferably in India
* Strong understanding of standard HR administration processes and best practices
* Foundational knowledge of India Labour Law
* Experience using Workday desirable
* Great stakeholder management skills, proactively keeping all stakeholders up to date
* Excellent organisational skills with a strong ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and document preparation
* Strong communication skills (both written and verbal) in English, able to adapt your style depending on the audience
* Proficiency in Hindi and/or Telugu is a plus

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.
  
  
We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.
  
  
If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
  
  
If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Manager, Regional Security Operations Center
description:
**About the Team**
DoorDash is one of the world's most trusted on-demand logistics platforms. The Global Safety and Security team exists to keep it that way, protecting our people, property, operations, brand, and reputation across all our markets. We manage risk and create value through agility, technology, and a people-first approach. Our DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt brands now span more than 40 countries, dozens of offices, and tens of thousands of employees. We strive to stay ahead of emerging threats and be there for our people anytime, anywhere.
  
  
**About the Role**
We're hiring a
**Manager, Regional Security Operations Center**
to ensure the operational integrity and continuous improvement of one of DoorDash's 24/7 remote physical security monitoring and response centers. The Regional Security Operations Center monitors physical security threats and coordinates responses to incidents affecting our people, facilities, and operations around the world. This is an in-person position based in Hyderabad, India. This is not a cybersecurity role.
  
  
Reporting to the Manager, Global Safety and Security Operations, you will directly manage a team of analysts, ensuring effective incident response, consistent execution, and scalable performance across an always-on operation. You will work across operations, training, reporting, and incident response to translate global security strategy into reliable day-to-day execution.
  
  
**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**

* **Manage and develop a team of analysts:**
  Directly lead a team of analysts, set clear expectations, coach performance, support professional development, and build accountability and engagement.
* **Serve as an escalation point during significant incidents and emergencies:**
  Exercise sound judgment and critical thinking to assess rapidly evolving situations, make timely decisions, and coordinate response efforts through resolution.
* **Support 24/7 physical security operations in a follow-the-sun model:**
  Help maintain around-the-clock readiness for threat detection, risk assessment, and physical security incident response across all shifts, including support for global incidents and other operations center locations.
* **Strengthen incident management:**
  Support escalation frameworks and response quality for complex incidents.
* **Own metrics, reporting, and continuous improvement:**
  Ensure performance targets are met, monitor service health, and drive continuous improvement in operational performance. Regularly report on operational health to leadership and address deficiencies.
* **Drive efficiency and automation:**
  Identify opportunities to streamline and automate repetitive or high-volume work, reduce analyst workload, and improve response speed.
* **Lead training and capability development:**
  Build and maintain training programs, exercises, and assessments that strengthen analyst capabilities.
* **Strengthen standards and procedures:**
  Partner with leadership to develop, maintain, and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs), escalation frameworks, and quality standards.
* **Model leadership under pressure:**
  Demonstrate accountability, structured problem-solving, and calm execution during periods of heightened operational activity.

**We're excited about you because you bring…**

* **Operational and crisis management experience:**
  At least six years of experience in crisis management, security operations, law enforcement, the military, a GSOC, RSOC, or SOC, or a comparable 24/7 operations or incident response environment.
* **Leadership and team development experience:**
  At least three years of experience leading or supervising a team, including coaching, providing performance feedback, and hiring.
* **Relevant education:**
  A bachelor's or master's degree in a related field from an accredited college or university.
* **A bias for action:**
  A proven ability to act with urgency, anticipate challenges, and implement practical solutions that deliver measurable improvements.
* **Training and program execution skills:**
  The ability to design, deliver, and evaluate training programs, exercises, and continuous learning initiatives.
* **A data-driven mindset:**
  Proficiency with key performance indicators (KPIs), dashboards, trend analysis, and performance improvement metrics.
* **Cross-functional collaboration skills:**
  The ability to partner effectively with technical and non-technical teams across complex organizations.
* **Composure and sound judgment:**
  Calm, structured decision-making in time-sensitive or ambiguous operational situations.
* **Availability for escalation support and travel:**
  The ability to provide escalation support at any time, including nights, weekends, and holidays, and to travel up to 25% of the time, as needed.

**About DoorDash**
At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.
  
  
DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
