title: Engineering Delivery Manager I
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Delivery Manager**
Job Description | Product Engineering Organization
  
  
**Overview**
As a Delivery Manager, you hold program-level execution accountable on a day-to-day basis within Deloitte's Product Engineering organization, one or more product teams operating against a shared set of intents.
  
  
Delivery in this organization operates inside an intent-driven development model with three concurrent layers — governance, execution, and learning — that run simultaneously. Execution advances in evidence-gated dashes, not sprints.
  
  
The activities that used to define this role — status compilation, schedule maintenance, risk-log upkeep, and ceremony documentation — are increasingly AI-assisted. What remains, and grows, is the judgment work: cross-team coordination on initiatives larger than a single product team can self-coordinate, stakeholder alignment, dependency management, and the operational discipline that keeps evidence-gated delivery.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Program-level coordination for one significant initiative or a set of related programs. Ensure dashes start when slices are ready and end when deployed evidence confirms the intended behavior shifted.
* Day-to-day stakeholder orchestration with internal Deloitte stakeholders at the program level, including reconciliation of AI-drafted artifacts when stakeholders arrive with their own briefs.
* Drive cost-efficient adoption of LLM, agentic AI, and cloud platforms through effective governance, FinOps practices, and consumption optimization.
* Operational integrity of the evidence-gated cycle in your scope: proof signals being read, harm watches honored and exit gates respected before slices expand.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Outcome-Driven Leadership: Deliver the right customer and business outcomes by engaging product teams on structure, skills, leverage models, and measurement. Scope dashes against ready slices and observable evidence, so work advances when deployed evidence confirms the behavior shifted — not at a sprint boundary.
* Delivery Leadership and Advocacy: Champion fit-for-context delivery methodologies and work with Product Managers to drive priorities and execution. Form skilled teams, remove roadblocks, and set cadence to the rhythm the program needs. Surface coordination friction before it becomes a blocker, escalating to the Delivery Leader when it exceeds your authority.
* Craft Mastery: Foster delivery excellence through quality processes, program value delivery, and team growth — coaching junior professionals via pairing, observation, and feedback. Experiment with new tools like GenAI and support the AI Workflow Orchestrator on your program, knowing which workflows are AI-driven and how exceptions route. Spread knowledge through community sessions.
* Communication: Inspire and influence stakeholders, serving as the contact for value achievement across product engineering teams. Communicate status accurately on the cadence the program needs. Hold the room when stakeholders disagree: surface trade-offs, recommend a path, drive to decision. Facilitate co-creation workshops.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work as a connected member of the program alongside the triad ensemble (Product, Engineering and Experience) and cross functional groups. Maintain a live picture of dependencies across the product teams and platform services you touch. Manage conflict, foster collaboration, and enable cross-skilling.
* Discovery & Delivery Proficiency: Apply deep SDLC expertise with continuous planning and refinement. Watch for drift between intent and execution and raise it early. Hold evidence-gate discipline — proof signals read, harm watches honored, exits and expansions respected. Identify risks, adapt scope, and embed continuous improvement.
* Customer-Centric Delivery: Drive lean solutions through rapid experimentation, engaging customers before, during, and after delivery to land the right solution effectively.
* Operational Excellence: Build inclusive, engaged teams; remove obstacles and coach; improve satisfaction and reduce attrition. Govern the intake of AI-drafted artifacts so they become productive inputs, not noise. Report on financials, innovation, and engagement, and drive efficiency and productivity.
* Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage stakeholders at all levels and foster a culture of co-creation. Hold the relationship with program sponsors and affected stakeholders, informing them in proportion to their stake, and reconcile conflicting AI-generated artifacts on the same initiative. Align diverse perspectives to deliver quality solutions.
* Domain Expertise: Rapidly acquire domain-specific knowledge and navigate enterprise functions to drive product value and organizational alignment.

**The Team**
US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value and outcomes. It leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure across a four-capability matrix: Product, Experience, Engineering, and Delivery. As Deloitte's primary product development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results. We develop and deploy cutting-edge go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required Experience**

* 10+ years of delivery management with direct experience leading a cross-functional program or set of programs with meaningful dependencies and multiple stakeholders.
* Experience operating inside an Agile or Lean model and demonstrated readiness to operate inside intent-driven, evidence-gated delivery patterns.
* Experience working in a product-staffed model where durable product teams stay with their products across build, deploy, operate, and evolve.
* Strong expertise in AI/Cloud FinOps, budget management, financial forecasting, vendor management, cost optimization, and data-driven delivery governance.

**Required Skills**

* Coordination at scale: Track record of managing dependencies, surfacing risks, and driving alignment across teams that do not naturally talk to each other.
* Engineering fluency: Able to follow technical conversations, ask useful questions, and challenge feasibility claims constructively. More than passive listening.
* Evidence orientation: Comfortable measuring delivery by outcome validation rather than velocity proxies. Able to hold the line on evidence gates.
* AI-augmented working practice: Fluent with current GenAI assistants and agentic delivery tooling. Able to direct AI output for status, risk, and coordination tasks rather than only consume or produce it manually.
* Specification literacy: Able to read and reason about charter, persona, intent, constitution, and blueprint artifacts and understand how a program is governed through them.
* Communication: Writes clearly. Presents to senior stakeholders without over formatting. Tells the truth about status, including bad news, without varnish.

**How You Will Grow**
At Deloitte, we’ve invested a great deal in creating a rich environment in which our professionals can grow. We want all our people to develop in their own way, playing to their own strengths as they hone their leadership skills. And, as a part of our efforts, we provide our professionals with a variety of learning and networking opportunities— including exposure to leaders, sponsors, coaches, and challenging assignments—to help accelerate their careers along the way. No two people learn in the same way. So, we provide a range of resources including live classrooms, team-based learning, and eLearning.
  
  
**#pxe**
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

description:
We are seeking an experienced
**Team Manager – Quality**
to lead account-level quality operations, manage Quality Team Leaders, and drive continuous improvement across Digital Operations.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in quality governance, audit management, operational excellence, RCA/CAPA frameworks, quality automation tools, and cross-functional stakeholder management.

The role involves directly managing 3–6 Quality Team Leaders and overseeing 12–25+ Quality Analysts/Evaluators across 1–3 client accounts or operational queues supporting approximately 400–1,000+ FTEs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Quality Operations Management**

* Oversee daily quality operations across multiple client accounts and operational queues.
* Manage 3–6 Quality Team Leaders and oversee 12–25+ Quality Analysts/Evaluators.
* Ensure adherence to quality scorecards, audit sampling requirements, and compliance frameworks.
* Monitor quality performance and drive improvements across operational teams.

**2. Audit Governance & Quality Assurance**

* Establish and implement audit strategies to identify process gaps, anomalies, and quality defects.
* Ensure consistency and accuracy in transaction quality evaluations.
* Lead quality calibration sessions involving Quality and Operations leadership.
* Eliminate evaluation bias and minimize scoring variations.
* Design and evaluate Quality Analysts and Quality Team Leaders using established scorecards.

* Drive operational adoption of automated quality audit tools and real-time agent assistance systems.
* Monitor automated evaluation accuracy, system triggers, and evaluator usage.
* Utilize speech analytics and text analytics platforms to identify quality trends and improvement opportunities.
* Ensure effective implementation of quality monitoring technologies.

* Lead structured RCA sessions using methodologies such as Fishbone Analysis, 5-Why Analysis, and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA).
* Identify recurring quality defects and operational performance gaps.
* Develop and monitor Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) plans.
* Partner with Operations Managers to implement sustainable quality improvements.

**5. Customer Experience & Quality Improvement**

* Drive targeted improvement initiatives for Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), Net Promoter Score (NPS), and First Contact Resolution (FCR).
* Identify systemic process and knowledge gaps affecting customer experience.
* Collaborate with Training and Operations teams to implement improvement plans.
* Monitor quality trends and error-reduction initiatives.

**6. Team Leadership & Performance Management**

* Supervise, mentor, and develop Quality Team Leaders.
* Review team productivity, audit accuracy, and coaching effectiveness.
* Evaluate team performance using defined quality scorecards.
* Support leadership development and continuous capability improvement.

**7. Process Excellence & Business Reporting**

title: Talent Acquisition - Senior Associate
description:
About Apollo Finvest

We are a publicly listed tech-first NBFC — think AWS, but for lending. Armed with advanced APIs and capital, we partner with the best fintechs to power digital loans across India.

Now, we’re scaling Apollo’s lending business as well as Apollo Cash, our digital personal loan app. As Apollo Cash scales, our team needs to scale rapidly across engineering, product, business, and operations.

We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Associate who has spent their career inside startups and technology companies, building teams from the ground up.

This role is heavily focused on engineering, product, and data hiring, and requires someone who has independently driven hiring in fast-paced environments where speed, ownership, and resourcefulness matter.

This is a high-ownership recruiting role where you will work closely with founders and hiring managers to build a scalable, AI-native hiring engine as Apollo Cash grows.

What You’ll Do

* Own end-to-end hiring across roles, with a primary focus on engineering, product and data hiring
* Partner with founders and hiring managers to define hiring strategy, role clarity, and ideal candidate profiles
* Build strong pipelines for critical and hard-to-fill roles as Apollo Cash scales
* Source candidates using LinkedIn, referrals, startup communities, networks, and AI-driven sourcing tools
* Drive the entire hiring funnel — sourcing → screening → interviews → offer → closure
* Act as the hiring owner for Apollo Cash as teams scale across engineering, product, business, and operations
* Build hiring processes, playbooks, and sourcing strategies from scratch rather than relying on agencies or inbound applications
* Ensure a strong, fast, and consistent candidate experience at scale
* Build and improve hiring systems, trackers, dashboards, and reporting
* Use automation and AI tools to improve sourcing, screening, scheduling, and follow-ups
* Track and optimize hiring metrics such as TAT, conversion rates, offer acceptance, and quality of hire

What You’ll Need

* 3–7 years of talent acquisition experience exclusively within startups, fintechs, or technology companies
* Strong experience in tech hiring is non-negotiable
* Must have independently hired for engineering, product, and data roles
* Demonstrated experience owning the complete hiring funnel — sourcing, screening, stakeholder management, offers, and closures
* Strong sourcing skills beyond job portals, including LinkedIn, referrals, communities, and founder networks
* Experience working in lean, high-growth environments with aggressive hiring goals
* Comfortable experimenting with AI tools, automation, sourcing tools, and ATS platforms
* Ability to assess candidates for ownership, execution ability, and startup mindset
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, founder-led environment with high autonomy and accountability

Bonus if you have:

* Experience hiring in fintech or lending startups
* Experience building hiring processes from scratch
* Familiarity with engineering roles such as backend, frontend, full-stack, mobile, data, ML, and DevOps
* Exposure to AI-driven sourcing, screening, or recruiting workflows

What Success Looks Like

* Apollo Cash hiring scales smoothly across functions as the business grows
* Strong pipelines for engineering, product, and business roles exist at all times
* Hiring becomes faster, more predictable, and less manual through automation
* High-quality hires with strong ownership and cultural fit
* Founders and hiring managers rely on you as a true hiring partner

Why Join Us?

* Work directly with Founders: Mikhil Innani, former co-founder of PharmEasy and ex-Product Head at Hotstar, and Diksha Nangia, a former banker and CFA Charterholder
* Own hiring for a fast-scaling fintech and directly shape the team
* Best of both worlds: startup speed + listed company stability
* High ownership, fast-track growth, and direct impact

Interested?

Drop us a message at anuj@apollofinvest.com / careers@apollofinvest.com

Let’s build the team powering the next phase of Apollo Cash.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**About the Role-**

We are looking for a result-oriented Talent Acquisition Specialist to drive end-to-end recruitment across multiple functions in a fast-paced advertising, creative or production environment.

The ideal candidate will be proactive, solution-oriented and comfortable managing high-volume hiring requirements while balancing speed, quality and stakeholder expectations. This role requires strong sourcing capabilities, a keen understanding of talent markets, and the ability to build strong relationships with candidates, hiring managers and external partners.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of hiring mandates, works with a sense of urgency and consistently delivers against recruitment priorities.

**Key Responsibilities-**

End-to-End Recruitment: Own the complete recruitment lifecycle, from understanding hiring requirements and sourcing to selection, offer management and onboarding coordination.

Proactive Talent Sourcing: Build and maintain a strong pipeline of relevant talent through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, networking and other sourcing channels.

Hiring Delivery & TAT: Drive timely closure of open positions by prioritising requirements, maintaining sourcing momentum and proactively addressing bottlenecks.

Quality of Hire: Evaluate candidates for skills, experience, role suitability and cultural alignment to ensure quality shortlists and effective hiring outcomes.

Stakeholder Management: Partner closely with hiring managers and business leaders to understand requirements, align on expectations and provide regular updates on hiring progress and challenges.

Candidate Experience: Ensure timely communication, smooth interview coordination and a professional, positive experience throughout the recruitment journey.

Offer Management & Onboarding: Coordinate offer discussions, follow up on candidate commitments and work with relevant teams to facilitate smooth joining and onboarding.

Employee Referral Programme: Drive employee referrals and explore ways to improve participation and referral-led hiring.

Recruitment Reporting & Analytics: Maintain accurate recruitment trackers and provide regular updates on open positions, pipeline health, interview conversions, offer status, joining ratios and turnaround time.

Employer Branding: Support initiatives that strengthen the organisation's employer brand and attract relevant talent.

Continuous Improvement: Identify recruitment challenges, recommend practical solutions and improve sourcing strategies, hiring efficiency and overall delivery.

**What We're Looking For-**

5–6 years of experience in recruitment, preferably within an advertising agency, creative, digital, marketing or production environment.

Proven ability to manage multiple hiring mandates simultaneously in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

A strong track record of delivering against hiring timelines and recruitment targets.

Excellent sourcing, screening and candidate assessment skills.

Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence, align and manage expectations.

A proactive, result-oriented and solution-driven approach, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Ability to work independently, prioritise competing requirements and take timely action to overcome hiring challenges.

Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), Workday or other recruitment tools.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to use recruitment data to track progress, identify gaps and improve outcomes.

How Success Will Be Measured

Success in this role will be reflected in:

Timely closure of hiring requirements against agreed timelines.

Quality and relevance of shortlisted candidates.

Strong offer-to-joining conversion and reduced candidate dropouts.

Effective management of hiring manager expectations and stakeholder satisfaction.

Healthy talent pipelines and proactive follow-up on critical requirements.

Accurate recruitment reporting and consistent delivery against hiring priorities.

Interested candidates can share their updated resume at sara.mashruwala@omc.com.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
A global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly. Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences. A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.
  
  
  
  
**Overview**
  
  
The Talent Partner plays a critical role in attracting, engaging and hiring high-quality talent for MUFG MPMS India Hub, while supporting broader talent management and mobility priorities across the business. The role is responsible for delivering effective end-to-end recruitment activity, building talent pipelines, advising hiring managers, and creating a consistent, fair and positive candidate and hiring manager experience.
  
Reporting to the Head of Talent Acquisition, this role contributes to cross-functional squads and collaborates with People Partners, business leaders and specialist teams to design and deliver strategic people solutions and services that respond to business priorities. The role supports workforce capability, internal mobility and succession outcomes by helping identify talent gaps, agency panel management, surface talent opportunities and enable the movement of talent across the organisation.
  
The role requires strong recruitment expertise, stakeholder management, commercial judgement, data orientation and the ability to operate collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. It partners closely with the Head of Talent Acquisition.
  
  
 
  
**Key accountabilities and main responsibilities**
  
Strategic focus
  

* Develop and execute targeted sourcing strategies to attract passive and active talent through talent pools, social media, industry networks, referrals, market mapping and other contemporary channels.
* Build and nurture talent pipelines for critical and recurring roles, anticipating future workforce requirements in line with business strategy and portfolio demand.
* Contribute to employer brand, EVP, onboarding, retention, diversity, engagement and talent capability initiatives that strengthen attraction and employee experience outcomes.

  
Operations management
  

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from requisition through to offer and onboarding, ensuring a high-quality candidate and hiring manager experience at every stage.
* Help connect internal talent to opportunities by supporting mobility discussions, role matching, candidate shortlisting and pathways that enable career development and retention.
* Support talent capability-building initiatives, including internal mobility, graduate or emerging talent activity and other workforce capability programs.
* Embed diversity, equity and inclusion principles into recruitment and talent mobility activity to support fair access to opportunities and diverse talent outcomes.
* **Agency panel, vendor and market management**
* Monitor agency usage, performance, terms, candidate quality, role coverage and compliance with agreed processes and governance requirements.
* Guide hiring managers on appropriate agency engagement, direct sourcing opportunities and external search requirements.
* Maintain strong external market networks to support sourcing strategy, benchmarking, talent intelligence and access to specialist or senior talent pools.
* **Squad contribution, collaboration and people solutions**
* Bring recruitment, sourcing and talent market expertise into squad-based initiatives to support business change, workforce planning, capability uplift and improved service delivery.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of recruitment tools, templates, processes, service models and candidate or hiring manager experience through squad and functional ways of working.
* **Reporting, insights and continuous improvement**
* Maintain accurate recruitment data, requisition updates, candidate records and pipeline information to support transparency, reporting and informed decision-making.
* Prepare recruitment updates, insights for the Head of Talent Acquisition and relevant stakeholders, highlighting trends, risks, bottlenecks and opportunities.
* Use recruitment analytics to improve sourcing effectiveness, time-to-fill, candidate quality, diversity outcomes, hiring manager experience and process efficiency.
* Leverage recruitment technology and process improvements to streamline workflows, strengthen data integrity and improve candidate and stakeholder experience.

  
People leadership
  

* Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to understand role requirements, develop fit-for-purpose hiring strategies and support timely, informed recruitment decisions.
* Provide guidance to hiring managers on recruitment process, interview planning, candidate assessment, selection quality, inclusion and fair, consistent decision-making.
* Maintain clear communication with candidates, leaders and stakeholders, ensuring recruitment activity is well coordinated, transparent and aligned to agreed service expectations.
* Partner with the Head of Talent Acquisition where required on escalations, complex recruitment activity, senior role support, governance requirements and best practice process improvement.

  
Governance, risk and compliance
  

* Ensure recruitment activity complies with internal policies, approval requirements, legal and regulatory obligations, privacy requirements and audit standards.
* Ensure all requisitions have appropriate approvals before recruitment commences and that new hire records meet required governance and audit standards.
* Actively promote inclusive hiring practices, including fair assessment, balanced shortlists, pay equity, flexible working considerations and mitigation of unconscious bias.
* Escalate risks, sensitive matters, process exceptions, candidate concerns or governance issues to the Head of Talent Acquisition and People Partners in a timely and appropriate manner.
* Ensure a safe, healthy and sustainable workplace for employees and contractors by reporting workplace hazards and role modelling safe and positive workplace practices.

  
The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.
  
  
 
  
**Experience and personal attributes**
  

* 5-8 years’ experience in end-to-end recruitment, talent acquisition, sourcing or workforce resourcing within a complex, fast-paced environment.
* Strong knowledge of contemporary sourcing methods, candidate engagement strategies, recruitment technology and talent pipeline development.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with hiring managers and business leaders to understand workforce needs and deliver practical, commercially aligned talent solutions.
* Experience contributing to talent management, internal mobility, capability-building initiatives is highly desirable.
* Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams or squads, contributing specialist recruitment and talent expertise to broader people solutions and services.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing and communication skills, with confidence advising leaders and managing candidate and hiring manager expectations.
* Data-driven mindset with the ability to interpret recruitment metrics, identify trends and develop actionable insights to improve hiring outcomes.
* Sound judgement, discretion and professionalism in handling confidential candidate, employee, remuneration and workforce information.
* Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple roles, competing priorities, deadlines and stakeholder requirements.
* Understanding of fair, inclusive and compliant recruitment practices, including diversity, equity and inclusion, privacy, employment and audit requirements.
* Personal commitment to role modelling the organisation’s values and behaviours.

This role involves close coordination with Sales, Hiring Managers, third-party recruitment partners, candidates, and internal HR teams to ensure timely hiring, compliance, and a positive candidate experience. Schedule interviews and coordinate between candidates, recruiters, hiring managers, and interview panels. Prepare and send offer letters, rejection emails, and other recruitment-related communications.

Maintain and update candidate databases and support the creation, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of centralized Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS). Prepare, manage, and maintain recruitment-related documentation, reports, and trackers. Assist with background verification checks and validation of candidate information. Conduct market research on industry hiring trends, talent availability, and US salary benchmarks to support recruitment strategies. Support onboarding activities for new hires, including documentation and paperwork, ID proof collection, system and login setup, coordination of orientation sessions, and employee data management. Coordinate with third-party payroll providers for US employees and ensure timely account setup. Follow up with immigration consultants and monitor visa and work authorization application status through immigration portals, as applicable. Ensure compliance with internal HR policies, data privacy requirements, and applicable labor regulations.

**DESIRED / PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* 2—4 years of experience in US recruitment, HR operations, or talent acquisition support roles.
* Hands-on experience working with US hiring processes, recruitment vendors, and job boards.
* Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment databases.
* Basic understanding of US employment practices, background checks, and onboarding requirements. Exposure to US payroll coordination and immigration processes is an added advantage.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with candidates, vendors, and internal stakeholders across geographies.

title: Sr. Manager, Talent Acquisition (APAC)
description:
**Who We Are**
Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.
  
  
**The Role**
Addepar is looking for a Sr. Manager, Talent Acquisition to lead our APAC recruiting function from our Pune, India office. This is a player-coach role: you will lead and develop a team of recruiters while also owning a portfolio of critical requisitions yourself, across our Go-to-Market (Sales & Services), R&D (Engineering, AI, Data, and Product), and G&A (Finance, Legal, People, IT) organizations.
  
  
You will act as the senior recruiting voice for the region, setting hiring strategy in partnership with regional and global leaders while staying close enough to the work to know exactly what's happening in the pipeline. You are comfortable operating in a matrix organization, balancing global talent acquisition standards with the realities of local markets, and you know how to translate broad company hiring goals into a concrete regional plan.
  
  
Applicants must have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is based on the first day of employment. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters across multiple functions, setting clear goals, providing regular feedback, and building a strong bench of recruiting talent in the region
* Personally own and manage a portfolio of high-priority, senior, or complex requisitions end to end, from intake through offer and close, across GTM, R&D, and G&A
* Set the APAC recruiting strategy in partnership with regional business leaders and global TA leadership, translating company-wide hiring goals into a regional plan that reflects local market realities
* Operate effectively in a matrix organization, balancing global process and standards with the needs of local hiring managers, functional leaders, and business units
* Partner closely with hiring managers and business leaders to understand their staffing needs, advise on hiring strategy, and build durable, trust-based relationships across the region
* Drive workforce planning conversations with business and People leaders, helping them think ahead of open reqs rather than react to them
* Bring a strong point of view on how AI and modern recruiting tools (sourcing, screening, scheduling, and candidate engagement) can improve speed, quality, and consistency across the team, and lead adoption of new tools and workflows
* Use recruiting metrics (time to fill, pipeline health, source effectiveness, offer acceptance, and more) to diagnose bottlenecks and drive continuous improvement across the funnel
* Ensure a consistently excellent, high-touch candidate experience, and represent Addepar's employer brand across APAC markets
* Stay current on employment law, hiring practices, and market compensation trends across the APAC countries in scope, ensuring recruiting activities remain compliant and competitive
* Partner with University Recruiting and campus programs where relevant to build long-term talent pipelines in the region

**Who You Are**

* 8-10+ years of progressive talent acquisition experience, including at least 5-7 years directly managing and developing a team of recruiters
* Proven experience recruiting across multiple functions (for example: GTM, R&D, and G&A/Corporate), not just a single specialty, with the range to flex between technical, commercial, and operational hiring
* Experience operating in a matrix or global organization, working across functional and geographic reporting lines and building consensus without formal authority over every stakeholder
* A genuine player-coach: equally comfortable setting strategy in the boardroom and getting into the details of a live requisition
* Strong track record using data and recruiting metrics to make decisions, tell a clear story to leadership, and hold the team accountable to outcomes
* Hands-on experience with AI-enabled recruiting tools and modern sourcing technology (for example: AI sourcing/screening tools, conversational scheduling, or GenAI-assisted workflows), with an eye for what's genuinely useful versus hype
* Proficiency with applicant tracking systems (Greenhouse preferred) and the broader recruiting tech stack
* Deep familiarity with APAC talent markets and the employment landscape across the relevant countries in scope; working knowledge of local employment law and compliance considerations
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior business leaders and adjust style across cultures and seniority levels
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Human Resources, Business, or a related field; MBA or relevant certification is a plus

**Our Values**

* Act Like an Owner - Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* Build Together - Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* Champion Our Clients - Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* Drive Innovation - Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* Embrace Learning - Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.
  
  
We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.
  
  
PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

title: Talent Acquisition and People's Manager
description:
We're Hiring | Talent Acquisition& People Manager
  

**Company:**
Janus Koncepts

**Location:**
Janpath, Connaught Place, New Delhi

**Experience:**
2–5 Years

**Employment Type:**
Full-time | Work from Office

About Janus Koncepts

Janus Koncepts is a 20+ year-old, full-service 360° marketing and advertising agency, bringing together creativity, strategy, branding, digital media, technology, and experiential marketing.

We operate in an industry where ideas evolve constantly, roles are rarely one-dimensional, and great talent doesn't always come with conventional qualifications.

We believe that building an exceptional agency requires more than hiring people with the right experience. It requires the ability to recognise potential, understand different creative and professional disciplines, and bring together individuals whose strengths complement one another.

We are looking for a
**sharp, adaptable, street-smart, and people-intelligent HR Manager**
who understands the dynamics of an agency environment and can contribute meaningfully to talent acquisition, people management, and organisational development.

Role Overview

We are looking for someone who understands that hiring for an advertising agency is fundamentally different from hiring for a conventional organisation.

A great copywriter may not have a conventional writing degree. An exceptional designer may have an unusual educational background. A brilliant strategist may demonstrate more acumen through curiosity and observation than through certifications.

**We need someone who can recognise the difference between a good résumé and genuine capability.**

**The ideal candidate should understand the nuances of different roles across advertising, marketing, creative, digital media, design, technology, and client servicing.**

**Someone who can assess talent beyond job titles, identify individual strengths, evaluate potential, and understand how different personalities and skill sets fit within an agency ecosystem.**

**Equally important is the ability to manage people, navigate difficult conversations, balance organisational needs, and build a productive, accountable, and creatively stimulating work environment.**

**We don't just want someone who can hire people. We want someone who understands people, identifies what makes them exceptional, and knows how to bring out their best.**

Key Responsibilities

**1. Strategic Talent Acquisition**

**Manage end-to-end recruitment across creative, marketing, digital, strategy, media, client servicing, production, and operational functions. Understand role requirements, source relevant talent, assess capabilities, coordinate interviews, and support hiring decisions.**

**2. Understanding Diverse Professional Disciplines**

**Develop a practical understanding of the skills, tools, workflows, and competencies required across different agency functions. Be capable of distinguishing between technical proficiency, creative ability, strategic thinking, and execution skills.**

**3. Talent Assessment Beyond Conventional Credentials**

**Evaluate candidates through portfolios, practical assignments, situational questions, behavioural observations, and competency-based interviews rather than relying solely on degrees, previous designations, or years of experience.**

**4. Identifying Strengths & Potential**

**Recognise individual capabilities, unconventional strengths, transferable skills, and growth potential. Identify candidates who may not fit a traditional profile but demonstrate exceptional aptitude for a particular function.**

**5. Recruitment Research & Talent Mapping**

**Research talent markets, evolving creative and digital roles, industry skill requirements, sourcing channels, and relevant professional communities to strengthen recruitment effectiveness.**

**6. Employee Relations & People Management**

**Build strong professional relationships across departments, address employee concerns, facilitate constructive conversations, and maintain a healthy balance between employee well-being and organisational accountability.**

**7. HR Operations & Processes**

**Manage onboarding, employee records, attendance, leave management, HR documentation, policies, exit formalities, and other essential HR activities with accuracy and professionalism.**

**8. Performance & Capability Development**

**Coordinate performance reviews, identify skill gaps, support feedback processes, and contribute to professional development initiatives that align individual capabilities with organisational goals.**

**9. Agency Culture & Team Dynamics**

**Understand and support the working dynamics of creative, strategic, and execution-oriented teams. Encourage collaboration, ownership, professional discipline, and an environment where creativity and accountability coexist.**

**10. Conflict Resolution & Diplomacy**

**Handle challenging interpersonal situations, competing expectations, feedback conversations, and workplace concerns with maturity, discretion, empathy, and sound judgement.**

**11. Stakeholder & Leadership Coordination**

**Work closely with agency leadership and functional teams to understand hiring priorities, resource requirements, team structures, and organisational challenges.**

**12. Adaptability & Process Improvement**

**Identify opportunities to improve recruitment, assessment, onboarding, employee engagement, and HR workflows. Adapt HR practices to the changing needs of a fast-moving advertising and marketing environment.**

What We're Looking For

* 2–5 years of relevant experience in HR, talent acquisition, recruitment, or people operations.
* Experience working with advertising, creative, digital marketing, media, branding, or similar agency environments is strongly preferred.
* A practical understanding of different roles, capabilities, and working styles within the marketing and advertising industry.
* **Strong interpersonal intelligence, presence of mind, and a street-smart approach to problem-solving.**
* **Ability to assess talent beyond conventional qualifications and recognise creativity, aptitude, potential, and transferable skills.**
* **Excellent communication, negotiation, relationship-building, and conflict-resolution skills.**
* **Adaptable thinking and the ability to manage different personalities, functions, and professional expectations.**
* **Curiosity to research unfamiliar roles, technologies, creative disciplines, and evolving industry requirements.**
* **Strong observational and analytical abilities with sound judgement.**
* **Ability to balance empathy with assertiveness and organisational discipline.**
* **Understanding of HR operations, employee documentation, onboarding, performance management, and relevant workplace practices.**
* **Proficiency with recruitment platforms, HR tools, spreadsheets, and digital productivity applications.**
* **Familiarity with AI-powered recruitment and research tools will be an added advantage.**
* **High standards of professionalism, confidentiality, ownership, and integrity.**

Experience & Eligibility

* **2–5 years of relevant professional experience**
  in talent acquisition or people management.
* Candidates with hands-on HR experience in advertising agencies, creative studios, digital marketing companies, media organisations, or integrated marketing agencies will be preferred.
* Candidates from related industries who demonstrate a strong understanding of creative talent, agency culture, and multidisciplinary hiring may also be considered.
* Educational qualifications in Human Resources, Management, Psychology, Business Administration, or related disciplines are advantageous.

**We value professional judgement, adaptability, talent-spotting ability, and people intelligence over conventional HR experience alone.**

Who Should Apply?

If you're someone who:

* Can look beyond a résumé and recognise what a person is genuinely capable of.
* Understands that hiring a designer, a copywriter, a strategist, and a client servicing professional requires four different evaluation approaches.
* Is fascinated by human behaviour, personalities, motivations, and individual strengths.
* Can recognise potential even when it doesn't come packaged in an impressive designation or degree.
* Is street-smart enough to navigate difficult situations and diplomatic enough to maintain strong professional relationships.
* Can understand creative personalities without compromising on accountability and performance.
* Is curious about advertising, brands, marketing, media, design, technology, and emerging professional skills.
* Knows how to ask intelligent questions, evaluate answers critically, and make informed hiring recommendations.
* Can balance employee aspirations with business realities.
* Believes
  talent acquisition or people management
  should contribute to how an organisation grows, performs, and evolves—not merely manage its administrative processes.

**Then we'd love to meet you.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their CV at ritika@januskoncepts.com.

As a Talent Acquisition Associate, you will play a critical role in building the teams that power our growth and learner success. This is a high-impact, execution-focused role that goes beyond traditional recruitment. You will be responsible for identifying, attracting, and hiring exceptional talent across business functions while helping create scalable hiring processes and a strong employer brand.

You will work closely with Hiring Managers, Business Leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to understand talent requirements, drive hiring outcomes, and ensure a seamless candidate experience from sourcing through onboarding. The ideal candidate is highly organized, data driven, target-oriented, and passionate about building high-performing teams in a fast-paced environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Talent Acquisition & Recruitment**

* Own and drive the end-to-end recruitment lifecycle across multiple functions and levels.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand role requirements, team structures, hiring priorities, and workforce plans.
* Source high-quality candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, networking, campus partnerships, and other talent channels.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
* Conduct initial candidate screening and assessment to evaluate skills, experience, motivation, and cultural alignment.
* Ensure timely movement of candidates through the recruitment funnel while maintaining a positive candidate experience.
* Drive closure of open positions within defined timelines and hiring targets.

**Stakeholder Management & Candidate Experience**

* Act as a trusted recruitment partner to hiring managers and business leaders.
* Maintain regular communication with stakeholders regarding hiring progress, challenges, and market insights.
* Coordinate interviews and assessments while ensuring a smooth and professional experience for candidates.
* Build strong relationships with prospective candidates and effectively communicate Digiaccel and Altera’s vision, culture, and opportunities.
* Serve as a brand ambassador throughout the hiring journey.

**Recruitment Operations & Process Excellence**

* Maintain accurate recruitment trackers, hiring dashboards, candidate records, and reporting systems.
* Ensure high levels of accuracy and efficiency in recruitment documentation and process management.
* Support offer management, documentation, onboarding coordination, and pre-joining engagement activities.
* Leverage data and hiring metrics to improve recruitment effectiveness and decision-making.
* Identify bottlenecks in the hiring process and proactively recommend improvements.

**Employer Branding & Talent Pipeline Development**

* Contribute to employer branding initiatives aimed at attracting high-quality talent.
* Build relationships with colleges, institutes, professional communities, and talent networks.
* Support campus hiring, internship programs, and strategic talent acquisition initiatives.
* Stay updated on talent market trends, hiring best practices, and competitor hiring activity.

**Collaboration & Organizational Support**

* Work closely with HR, Business, Operations, Marketing, and Leadership teams to support organizational growth.
* Assist in HR operations related to onboarding, employee documentation, and people processes whenever required.
* Support special projects focused on workforce planning, talent mapping, and organizational development.
* Contribute towards building scalable recruitment systems and best practices.

**Performance & Outcome Ownership**

* Take ownership of individual hiring targets and recruitment KPIs.
* Demonstrate a strong bias for action, urgency, and execution excellence.
* Continuously improve sourcing effectiveness, candidate quality, and hiring efficiency.
* Maintain a high level of professionalism, confidentiality, and attention to detail in all recruitment activities.

**What We're Looking For**

* 0-1+ years of experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, Executive Search, Staffing, or HR.
* Strong understanding of end-to-end recruitment processes and candidate lifecycle management.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong sourcing capabilities across LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, and networking channels.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and recruitment tracking/reporting.
* Ability to manage multiple hiring mandates simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze hiring metrics and generate insights.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and problem-solving abilities.
* Passion for people, hiring, and building high-performing teams.

**Good to Have**

* Experience hiring for education, EdTech, consulting, marketing, sales, product, or technology roles.
* Exposure to Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment automation tools.
* Experience with campus hiring, internship hiring, or employer branding initiatives.
* Understanding of end-to-end recruitment process and familiarity with sourcing tools.

**Why Join Us?**

* **Make a Meaningful Impact -**
  Play a critical role in building the teams that are redefining business education and helping professionals build future-ready careers in the digital economy.
* **High-Growth Learning Environment -**
  Work with a fast-scaling education company where ownership, innovation, and excellence are valued and rewarded.
* **Learner-Centric Culture -**
  Join a team that places learner outcomes at the center of every decision and takes pride in delivering world-class educational experiences.
* **Accelerated Career Growth -**
  Benefit from continuous learning opportunities, mentorship, structured development, and the opportunity to take on increasing responsibility as the organization grows.
* **Build the Future of Education -**
  Contribute to a mission-driven organization that is transforming how business education is delivered and creating measurable impact for thousands of learners across the country.

**About the Company**

Digiaccel Learning is a Gurgaon headquartered education company that is redefining the gold standard of management education for the digital and AI first world. By doing so, it is building the next generation of business leaders in the country. The mission of the company is to build employability through education.

Education is a hard and important problem to solve for. India needs to double its higher education infrastructure in order to serve its large demographic of youth. Within what exists, quality is a large problem with studies reporting that 50% of Indian graduates are unemployable. Add to this the shift in the skills ecosystem at the workplace with AI and digitization. All of this has led to a higher-education infrastructure that is unable to serve the aspirations of its students. So, you have MBA students from legacy institutes who are unplaced and professionals who are struggling to level up in their careers because they don’t have the skills to progress.

The secret sauce at the company is its instructional design, a learner centric ethos and a bar for quality that runs across touchpoints. This reflects in a 80%+ NPS across all programs since inception.

We are looking for smart passionate folks to join us in this mission of building a better, smarter and more outcome-oriented education system. We are a young company and each role has the ability to make a large impact. We can assure of a very talent dense, intellectually honest, action oriented and collaborative environment. We are sure that you will join for the opportunity and stay for the impact of seeing your work help thousands of others.

title: Senior Technical Recruiter - AI-Powered Hiring
description:
About the role

GoodSpace is an AI recruitment company. We are hiring a technical recruiter who runs hiring end to end: understands an engineering role well enough to judge candidates, uses AI tools and workflows to find and screen people faster, and closes them through offer and joining.

What you will own

- Role intake: Turn a hiring manager's brief into a clear scorecard (must-have skills, deal-breakers, compensation range) and a calibrated shortlist within 48 hours.

- AI-powered sourcing: Build and run search and outreach workflows with LinkedIn Recruiter, our own AI tools, ChatGPT or Claude, and automation such as n8n, Zapier or Clay. Keep prompts and templates documented so others can reuse them.

- Technical screening: First-round calls for software, data, AI/ML and product roles, checking real depth (what they built, stack, scale) rather than keywords.

- Candidate pipeline: Fast, honest communication at every stage, with every candidate tracked in our system with a next step and a date.

- Closing: Compensation discussions, offer negotiation, counter-offers, notice periods and follow-through until the candidate joins.

- Reporting: Weekly numbers for your roles: sourced, screened, submitted, interviewed, offered, joined.

What we are looking for

- B.Tech or B.E. (required).

- Typically 2 to 6 years in technical recruiting, agency or in-house, with offers and joinings you can name.

- Has hired engineers: can tell a backend developer from a full-stack one, read a resume or GitHub profile for real depth, and explain why a candidate is strong.

- Uses AI tools every day in recruiting work (search strings, screening, outreach, scheduling) and can show a workflow they built.

- Clear spoken and written English and Hindi; comfortable negotiating with senior candidates.

- Comfortable with a fast pace and weekly goals.

Useful additional experience

- Hiring for startups, or for several clients at once (RPO, staffing or search firm).

- Automation tools (n8n, Zapier, Make, Clay) or basic scripting (Python, Apps Script, SQL).

- Employer branding or recruitment marketing on LinkedIn.

Your first 30 days

- By day 7: Learn our AI recruiting product and tools, take over two live roles and share calibrated shortlists for both.

- By day 14: An AI sourcing and screening workflow documented and running on your roles.

- By day 21: First candidates in final rounds.

- By day 30: First offer accepted, and a weekly report on your funnel.

How success will be assessed

- Offers accepted and candidates joined.

- Time from brief to first shortlist, and how many shortlisted candidates reach interviews.

- Offer acceptance and joining rate (drop-offs after offer).

- Feedback from candidates and hiring managers.

What to share when applying

Your resume, one example of an AI workflow you use in recruiting (a prompt set, an automation or a sourcing method), and one hire you closed: the role, how you found the person and how you handled the offer. Redacted examples are welcome.

description:

**About the role**
------------------

As a Technical Sourcer, you’ll identify, engage and qualify technology talent for Digital and Networks UK. Based in Gurugram, you’ll partner with TA Professionals and Hiring Managers to turn hiring requirements into targeted sourcing plans and build pipelines for current vacancies and future demand.

Your focus will be proactive talent discovery and engagement, particularly for specialist and hard-to-fill roles across areas such as software engineering, cloud and platforms, data and AI, cyber security and network engineering. You’ll research talent markets, create personalised outreach and hold initial conversations to understand candidates’ relevant experience, interests and expectations.

You’ll bring evidence-led recommendations to hiring conversations, maintain reusable talent pools and provide a clear handover of qualified candidates to TA Professionals, who lead the wider recruitment process. Success means relevant, engaged talent pipelines, useful market insight and a consistent candidate experience—not simply high volumes of outreach.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

* Partner with TA Professionals and Hiring Managers at role briefing to agree essential skills, transferable experience, target talent markets, the candidate proposition and what a strong shortlist looks like.
* Build and deliver sourcing plans for priority technical vacancies, agreeing channels, milestones and review points, and adapting the approach when market evidence shows a change is needed.
* Identify active and passive candidates through Boolean and advanced search, professional networks, technical communities, referrals and existing candidate databases, using approved tools and channels.
* Map relevant companies, skills, locations and talent communities, sharing insight on talent availability, candidate salary expectations, competition and barriers to attracting candidates.
* Create personalised, relevant outreach that explains the role and its technical context, follow up thoughtfully and maintain clear, timely communication with candidates.
* Hold structured initial conversations to understand relevant technical experience, career motivations, salary expectations, availability and alignment with role requirements, recording evidence rather than relying on keyword matches.
* Present qualified candidates to TA Professionals with concise screening notes, the evidence against agreed criteria and any areas requiring further assessment. Use feedback to refine targeting and improve shortlist relevance.
* Build, maintain and re-engage talent pools for recurring and emerging skill needs. Keep records current and share reusable market maps, search approaches and pipelines with the wider TA team.
* Track sourcing activity, response and qualification rates, time to qualified shortlist and progression of sourced candidates. Use these measures to improve channel effectiveness and candidate quality, not just activity volume.
* Broaden access to opportunities through varied sourcing channels, inclusive language and consistent, job-relevant criteria. Challenge unnecessary requirements that restrict the available talent pool.
* Maintain accurate candidate records in recruitment and talent-pooling systems, handle personal information responsibly and use approved AI tools with human oversight, checking outputs for accuracy and relevance.
* Manage competing sourcing priorities, provide clear progress updates and flag delivery risks early, recommending practical options to the TA Professional and Hiring Manager.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Technical sourcing experience
* Previous recruitment of technical roles

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Experience across a variety of technical requirements
* UK hiring experience:
* Proactive approach, including reaching out to team members
* Candidate-focused approach and interest in finding candidates
* Ability to understand new technologies and explain how they learn them
* Ability to screen candidates and present notes to recruiters and hiring managers
* Creative sourcing and talent mapping.
* UK talent landscape knowledge
* Use of data to inform sourcing decisions.
* LinkedIn Recruiter familiarity

BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers.

BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive.

Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. title: HR Advisor, Employee Services
description:
**Role Summary**

The Advisor, Employee Services role is part of the Employee Services team within LSEG's People Function. The role supports the delivery of a positive employee experience by providing timely, accurate, and employee-focused support through Live Agent channels. Working in a global environment, the role helps employees navigate HR processes, policies, and systems while contributing to operational excellence and continuous improvement.

  

Reporting to the **Manager, Employee Services** , you will serve as a primary point of contact for employees, managers, and key stakeholders, providing real-time advisory support on HR policies, processes, and Workday transactions across the end-to-end colleague experience lifecycle. You will own inquiries through to resolution, using ServiceNow, HRSD, and Workday to deliver an efficient and seamless service experience. The role requires building and maintaining strong partnerships with stakeholders across the People Function, demonstrating comprehensive knowledge of People Services Solutions (PSS) processes, and collaborating effectively with HR teams to ensure consistent, high-quality support. You will also contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, utilizing digital capabilities, automation, and AI-enabled solutions to enhance employee experience, service delivery, and operational effectiveness.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide real-time support through Live Agent chat and other approved channels as a primary point of contact for HR inquiries.

* Resolve employee and manager questions related to HR policies, benefits, payroll, leave, time management, employee lifecycle transactions, and Workday self-service activities.

* Investigate moderately complex issues, determine appropriate resolutions, and assess potential downstream impacts.

* Apply HR policies, procedures, compliance requirements, and service standards consistently and accurately.

* Document and manage cases in ServiceNow, HRSD and Workday, ensuring complete and accurate records.

* Own inquiries through to resolution, providing timely updates and meeting service level commitments.

* Collaborate with HR Operations, Payroll, Benefits, Employee Relations, and other stakeholders to resolve or escalate cases as required.

* Support adoption of digital HR tools and self-service capabilities through employee education and guidance.

* Identify recurring issues, knowledge gaps, and process improvement opportunities to enhance service effectiveness.

* Maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgement when handling sensitive employee information.
  

  

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 4-6 years of experience in Employee Services, HR Operations, HR Shared Services, HR Service Delivery, Contact Centre Operations, or a related support function.

* Experience supporting employees and managers through live chat, case management, email, or other high-volume service channels.

* Knowledge of employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, job changes, leave management, benefits, payroll, and offboarding.

* Hands-on experience with Workday, ServiceNow HR Service Delivery (HRSD), and related HR service management platforms.

* Strong customer service, problem-solving, and case management capabilities.

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain HR processes clearly and professionally.

* Experience working in a global, matrixed environment and collaborating across multiple stakeholder groups.

* Ability to leverage data and operational insights to improve service performance and employee experience.

* Strong analytical skills, sound judgement, and the ability to manage confidential information.
* Demonstrated adaptability and resilience, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and effectively manage changing priorities and business needs.
* Experience contributing to continuous improvement initiatives, including process optimization, automation, digital adoption, and the use of AI-enabled tools to improve service efficiency and employee experience.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience preferred.
  

**ABOUT US:**

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

  
  

**OUR PEOPLE:**

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

**Career Stage:**

Senior Associate  
  
  

**LSEG unlocks the power of markets to create opportunities across the global economy.**

Through our connected network of market infrastructure, data and analytics, we help customers access capital, manage risk and make confident decisions.

  
  

Our insights bring clarity to complex markets, and our trusted services ensure resilience and stability. With deep expertise and global scale, we partner with customers to drive innovation and shape the future of finance.

  

Few organisations operate at the scale, complexity and reach of LSEG. Here, you’ll work alongside experts, be inspired to deliver your best work and help shape what’s next for our business and the global economy.

  
  

Guided by our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change, we bring together diverse perspectives, encourage fresh thinking, and create an environment where learning never stops.

  

Join more than 26,000 colleagues across 60 countries, supporting customers in over 170 countries. Alongside flexible ways of working, you'll have access to benefits that support your wellbeing and your future, including 26 weeks' parental leave, healthcare, retirement planning and a wellness allowance. Through the LSEG Foundation and two paid volunteering days each year, you’ll also have opportunities to get involved in your local community and support causes that matter to you.

  
  

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

  
  

Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject .

  

By clicking on "Apply", the process for submitting an application will begin. If you have any questions prior to clicking "Apply", please contact the recruiter.

  
  

If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.

title: Customer Support Specialist - Contractor Hub
description:
**About Rippling**
------------------

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the team**

The Customer Support Payroll team at Rippling is a dedicated group of professionals committed to ensuring that our customers have a seamless experience with our robust Finance, HR, and IT platform. Our team provides expert guidance and swift resolutions to any technical challenges or inquiries that our customers have. We pride ourselves on our customer-centric approach, offering support to businesses across various time zones and ensuring help is always available when needed.

Our team is composed of individuals with diverse backgrounds and expertise, all united by a shared passion for problem-solving and continuous learning. We foster a collaborative and supportive environment where team members are encouraged to share insights and innovate solutions to enhance customer satisfaction. Additionally, our team is driven by a commitment to personal and professional growth, with ongoing training and development opportunities to ensure we stay adept with the latest features and updates in our platform.

At Rippling, we are actively seeking enthusiastic individuals to join our Customer Support Payroll team. We value candidates who are eager to learn and passionate about growing their skills in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. We believe that fresh perspectives are crucial for continuous improvement and innovation, and we are committed to providing ample opportunities for professional development. If you are motivated, quick to adapt, and excited about contributing to a team that helps businesses operate more efficiently, we encourage you to apply and bring your unique talents to Rippling.

**What you will do**

  

* US Payroll - Troubleshoot and resolve payroll-related issues and guide customers through payroll processing, tax filing, and compliance questions
* Become the go-to product expert on our Global Payroll and HR capabilities for customers in your designated region.
* Develop and maintain clear, accurate content, documentation, and FAQs to support both customers and internal teams.
* Analyze customer support interactions to identify trends, pain points, and opportunities to improve the support experience.
* Partner with regional Product Managers to provide insights on support volume, customer feedback, and critical compliance concerns.
* Serve as a senior resource and point of escalation for Customer Support Specialists on complex, region-specific payroll issues.
* Personally own and resolve the most challenging customer cases by leveraging your deep platform and country-specific payroll expertise.

**What you will need**

  

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field.
* 1–4 years of experience in customer support or a similar client-facing role.
* Prior experience working night shifts is mandatory.
* Willingness to work night shifts between 6:30 PM IST and 7:00 AM IST (any 9-hour shift). Weekly offs will be rotational, consisting of any two consecutive days during the week and may not necessarily fall on weekends.
* Availability to work primarily in US business hours. As a global organization, employees may also be scheduled for APAC or EMEA shifts based on business requirements.
* Proven experience in troubleshooting SaaS products with strong attention to detail and effective problem-solving skills.
* Excellent time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving abilities, with experience investigating and resolving complex payroll discrepancies.
* Experience working with a payroll service provider, HR software company, or within a large in-house payroll function is highly preferred.

**Additional Information**

Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com.

Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.
