title: Talent Management & OD
description:
Job Description

**Organization Chart**

  

**Position reports to :** GM / Head – Learning and Development, TM & OD

**Positions reporting :** Team – TM / OD and R&R

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Talent Management & Succession Planning:** Lead the annual talent review and calibration cycle across designated employee levels and functions; ensure completion of Hi-Potential identification, succession plans for critical positions, leadership pipeline mapping and Individual Development Plans (IDPs). Track successor readiness, IDP completion and closure of identified talent gaps through quarterly reviews.

* **Leadership Development:** Design, deploy and evaluate Future Fit Leaders (FFL), Technical Leadership Pipeline, Future Women Leadership Program, GET Development Program, and Junior, Middle and Executive Development Programs (JDP/MDP/EDP). Establish annual programme calendars, participant criteria, learning outcomes and post-programme effectiveness measures; track completion and demonstrated application of learning.

* **Organisation Development & Effectiveness:** Lead approved organisation development, workforce transformation, culture-building and change management initiatives. Define project milestones, stakeholder responsibilities and success metrics for each initiative; review progress periodically and measure outcomes against agreed business and organisational effectiveness objectives.

* **Policies, Processes & HR Digitisation:** Develop, review and standardise Talent Management (TM), Organisation Development (OD), and Rewards & Recognition (R&R) policies, SOPs and governance frameworks. Maintain an approved review calendar, ensure timely revision of documents, digitise prioritised workflows and monitor process compliance, turnaround times and error rates.

* **Rewards & Recognition:** Own the governance and execution of Long Service Awards, Spot Awards, Excellence, Innovation, Leadership and other employee recognition programmes. Publish annual programme calendars and eligibility criteria, ensure transparent nominations and approvals, monitor participation and expenditure against budget, and review programme effectiveness and employee feedback annually.

* **Talent Pipeline & Campus Engagement:** Develop and execute annual Engineering and Management Internship and campus engagement plans in partnership with academic institutions and business stakeholders. Establish intake targets, selection timelines, structured learning plans and evaluation criteria; track internship completion, business feedback and conversion to employment, where applicable.

* **Higher Education & Capability Building:** Administer B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA, Executive Education and other approved employee development programmes. Maintain programme eligibility and approval controls, track enrolment, attendance, completion, expenditure and academic outcomes, and conduct periodic reviews of learning effectiveness and return on learning investment.

* **HR Analytics & Continuous Improvement:** Develop and maintain periodic dashboards, MIS and scorecards covering talent reviews, succession readiness, leadership development, programme participation, R&R, higher education and talent pipeline outcomes. Establish data definitions, reporting timelines and accountability for data accuracy; use insights to identify gaps and drive measurable improvements.

* **Quality, Compliance & Business Excellence:** Ensure adherence to applicable QMS, IATF, ISO and other relevant business excellence requirements within the functional scope. Maintain audit-ready documentation, conduct periodic process reviews, close audit findings within agreed timelines and implement corrective and preventive actions to strengthen process compliance.

* **Stakeholder Management & Business Alignment:** Partner with Business Heads, Functional Leaders, Plant Leadership, HR teams and Corporate Centres of Excellence (COEs) to translate business priorities into annual people-development plans. Establish clear ownership, milestones and review mechanisms for cross-functional initiatives, resolve implementation dependencies and report progress and outcomes to relevant stakeholders.

**Educational Background and Work Experience**

  

* **Qualification & Experience**

* **Educational Qualification & Experience:** Full-time MBA/PGDM/Master’s degree in HR, Personnel Management, Industrial Relations, or an equivalent discipline from a reputed institute, with **14+ years of post-qualification HR experience in (large) manufacturing organisations**, including at least **5+ years of focused experience** in Talent Management, Organisation Development (OD), Leadership Development, Succession Planning, and Competency Management.

* **Industry & Organisational Exposure:** Experience in large-scale manufacturing or process industries, preferably Steel, Metals, Mining, Automotive, Cement, Engineering, Power, Oil & Gas, or Chemicals. Exposure to large Indian or multinational organisations with a workforce of **3,000+ employees**, along with demonstrated experience in designing and implementing enterprise-wide talent management initiatives, will be an added advantage.

* **Preferred Professional Certifications:** SHRM-CP/SHRM-SCP; certifications in Psychometric Assessment, Talent Management, Organisation Development (ODCP or equivalent), and Assessment & Development Centres.

**Competencies**

  

* **Functional & Technical Expertise:** Strong expertise in Talent Management, Succession Planning, Competency Framework Design, Organisation Development, Leadership Development, Learning Architecture, HR Analytics, Assessment & Development Centres, Process Excellence, Audit & Compliance, HRMS/LMS, Data Analytics, and Dashboarding.

* **Strategic Stakeholder Management:** Demonstrated ability to influence and advise senior leaders, partner effectively with Business Heads and Plant Leadership Teams, provide consulting support, and build productive cross-functional relationships to drive business-aligned HR outcomes.

Learning, Leadership and Manager Development:

Manage vendor coordination, SoW inputs, invoicing follow-ups, budget / PO tracking and VMO compliance in line with organizational and regulatory standards.

title: Operations Manager - Healthcare
description:
Our client is hiring for a Project Manager – Healthcare Programme, responsible for planning, implementing, and monitoring the Thalassemia Management Programme across designated centres. The role involves coordinating patient-care activities, managing programme teams, monitoring KPIs, handling budgets, and maintaining effective relationships with hospitals, donors, and other stakeholders.

**Job description:**

A. Programme Planning & Implementation

* Develop annual, quarterly, and monthly programme plans in alignment with Sankalp’s organisational objectives.
* Translate programme goals into measurable activities, deliverables, timelines, and responsibilities.
* Ensure smooth implementation of the Thalassemia Management Programme across all designated centres.
* Monitor programme activities and ensure adherence to approved processes, protocols, and SOPs.
* Identify operational gaps and develop appropriate corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure continuity of patient services and minimise disruptions to critical care activities.
* Review programme requirements and recommend improvements in processes, staffing, infrastructure, and resources.

B. Patient-Care Programme Coordination

* Ensure that patients enrolled in the programme receive timely and coordinated support.
* Monitor key patient-care activities such as:
* Regular blood transfusions
* Chelation adherence and monitoring
* Laboratory investigations
* Complication screening
* Patient counselling
* Follow-up and appointment adherence
* Referral and coordination with treating hospitals/doctors
* Ensure proper documentation and tracking of patient-related activities.
* Monitor missed appointments, delayed investigations, and other patient-care gaps and ensure timely follow-up.
* Coordinate with medical and nursing teams to address operational issues affecting patient care.
* Ensure that patient concerns and grievances are appropriately addressed and escalated when required.

C. Team Management & Leadership

* Lead, supervise, and support the programme team, including coordinators, counsellors, nurses, social workers, administrative staff, and other programme personnel.
* Define responsibilities and ensure clarity of roles within the team.
* Conduct regular team meetings and review programme performance.
* Set individual and team objectives in consultation with reporting managers.
* Monitor employee performance, attendance, productivity, and work discipline.
* Identify training and capacity-building requirements.
* Mentor team members and encourage professional development.
* Address performance or behavioural concerns in coordination with HR and senior management.
* Ensure adequate manpower planning and support recruitment requirements.

D. Monitoring, Evaluation & Performance Management

* Develop and monitor programme Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
* Track patient enrolment, retention, transfusion adherence, follow-up, investigations, counselling, and other programme indicators.
* Prepare regular programme dashboards and performance reports.
* Analyse trends, identify gaps, and recommend corrective actions.
* Conduct periodic programme reviews with the team.
* Establish systems for tracking action points and ensuring timely closure.
* Evaluate programme effectiveness and recommend evidence-based improvements.

E. Data Management & Documentation

* Ensure accurate, complete, and timely entry of programme and patient data.
* Maintain appropriate programme records and documentation.
* Ensure confidentiality and responsible handling of patient information.
* Coordinate with MIS/data teams to ensure accuracy of reports.
* Conduct periodic data verification and identify discrepancies.
* Develop and maintain appropriate trackers and dashboards for programme monitoring.
* Ensure documentation is audit-ready and readily available when required.

F. Financial & Resource Management

* Prepare programme budgets in coordination with the Finance and Senior Management teams.
* Monitor programme expenditure against approved budgets.
* Ensure optimum utilisation of programme resources.
* Review financial requirements and provide timely inputs for budget planning.
* Monitor programme-related procurement and resource requirements.
* Ensure compliance with financial policies and approval processes.
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising patient care or programme quality.

G. Donor & Stakeholder Management

* Coordinate with donors, funding partners, hospitals, laboratories, blood centres, government agencies, and other stakeholders as required.
* Prepare timely programme updates, reports, presentations, and impact reports for donors and management.
* Ensure donor commitments and reporting requirements are met within agreed timelines.
* Provide accurate programme data and success stories for donor communication.
* Maintain professional and effective relationships with key stakeholders.
* Represent Sankalp in relevant meetings, workshops, conferences, and programme reviews when delegated.

H. Quality, Compliance & Risk Management

* Ensure programme activities comply with organisational policies, SOPs, applicable statutory requirements, and quality standards.
* Work closely with the Quality team to identify and address process gaps.
* Conduct periodic internal programme reviews.
* Identify operational, patient-care, data, financial, and compliance risks.
* Develop mitigation plans and monitor implementation.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and corrective actions.
* Promote a culture of quality, accountability, patient safety, and continuous improvement.

I. Coordination with Medical & Clinical Teams

* Coordinate with treating physicians, consultants, nurses, counsellors, laboratories, blood centres, and hospital teams.
* Facilitate smooth communication between programme and clinical teams.
* Escalate patient-care or clinical concerns to the appropriate medical authority.
* Ensure that the Project Manager does not independently make clinical decisions outside their professional competence.
* Support implementation of approved clinical and programme protocols.

J. Process Improvement

* Regularly review existing programme processes and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop and implement SOPs, workflows, checklists, and monitoring systems where required.
* Use programme data to identify recurring problems and develop sustainable solutions.
* Promote technology-based systems for patient tracking, reporting, communication, and monitoring.

Pay: ₹450,000.00 - ₹750,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

title: People Operations - Learning Systems Advisor
description:
**Reports to: People Operations – Learning Systems Support Team Lead**

At Maersk we have a vision that’s larger than the ocean: to be a true integrator of container logistics connecting and simplifying our customers’ supply chain through global end-to-end solutions. We count on our people to make it happen.

That’s why we are building a new global HR service enabled by new technology: to make sure we deliver great experience to our people, so they can deliver great experience to our customers.

The Employee Experience Organization will work across brands, geographies and cultures to support one global Maersk.

***We are looking for a Learning Platform Specialist who will work on the “Learning Management System” (LMS) and will be responsible for managing the daily operations, use and governance of the LMS. The Learning Platform Specialist will also be responsible for working with stakeholders to support the usage and performance of the LMS.***

**About the position and what we offer**

This is an exciting and challenging opportunity where you can take ownership and draw your path in a complex and fast-paced environment. This role will report into the People Operations – Learning Systems Support Team Lead. There will be plenty of room for you to apply and develop your skills in this role. You will stretch your capabilities learning from, sparring and building lasting relationships with diverse and professional colleagues all over the world.

**Key responsibilities**

* Provide support to all LMS related queries and requests via ticket
* Perform administrative tasks such as uploading course material, creating learning plans, scheduling enrolments, and generating reports.
* Manage administrative tasks related to Certifications on LMS platforms and respond to queries related to Certifications.
* Administer classroom training and classroom related activities such as managing event and sessions, adding trainers, creating venues, resources and custom classroom training request forms.
* Perform ongoing maintenance to existing programs and removal of programs which have been deprecated.
* Support internal and external stakeholders on LMS functionality and usability, ensure timely communication regarding LMS updates and changes and provide ongoing end user system support.
* Take part in the testing of new features to the LMS Platforms and share results and suggestions.
* Develop and implement reporting strategies that meet regulatory requirements and collate training reporting for various stakeholders as required.
* Support the learning requirements of all businesses in the most efficient way.
Planning and strategy to support the growth of LMS innovations and operations.  

The EEO is a truly international team where you will work alongside, learn from and build lasting relationships with colleagues from all over the world. By joining our regional team, you have a unique opportunity to influence the vision and delivery of the EEO.

Joining Maersk, you will become part of the global family of the company that moves 20% of global trade everyday all the way, where one of our core values is Our Employees. It goes without saying that we value diversity: we thrive on the diversity of our talent in all its forms and we see it as a strength in building high-performance teams across brands, cultures and locations.

**What we are looking for**

We hope the position sounds as exciting to you as we see it. To succeed in this role, you should have a passion for building strong relationships and trust with internal stakeholders. This is a unique opportunity in a time of great transformation, so you should ideally enjoy working at a fast pace environment and enjoy dealing with ambiguity.

As for the skillset and experience, we are looking for:

* 3+ years of demonstrated experience administrating integrated LMS system.
* Individuals with core learning platform competencies with hands on experience (Cornerstone, Saba, Litmos, Adobe captivates etc..)
* Desire to add value to the business in a specialist role, providing knowledge and expertise, whilst ensuring the LMS solution meets the needs of the business and users.
* Problem solving and delivering timely resolutions through an IT service ticketing system/chat/phone support.
* Technical skills
  + Good understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  + Familiar with eLearning standards such as SCORM or xAPI or cmi5
  + Good to have experience in integrating with other platforms such as ERP, HRMS etc.
  + Familiar with accessibility standards such as WCAG 2.1
* Organized, detail oriented, autonomous, and collaborative, able to handle multiple priorities.
* Experience working in a best practice environment with an agile mindset would be advantageous.
* Strong English written and oral communication skills, and ability to communicate technical issues in relatable terms

If you have been reading so far, we’re are glad to see you are interested. If you are ready to take on the challenge, we look forward to hearing from you!

Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

title: IT Infrastructure and Operations Lead
description:
**Company Description**

BlueOptima gives CIOs, CTOs and CFOs objective, code-level visibility into software productivity, AI ROI, and engineering cost. This is a problem that until recently could not be measured at all. With AI-generated code now flowing into enterprise codebases at scale, that measurement gap has become a board-level priority.

10B+ code revisions analysed · 800,000+ developers on platform · 9 of the top 16 universal banks

The business is profitable, bootstrapped, and 20 years deep in enterprise relationships. You are joining a sales organisation that is mid-build. The foundations are in place, the product has genuine enterprise traction, and there is real room to grow fast.

Buyers are CIOs, CTOs, VP Engineering and CFO stakeholders at large software engineering organisations. The conversation is about developer productivity, engineering cost, and AI ROI. These are budget-backed problems that sit at the top of the technology agenda right now. You are not convincing anyone the problem exists.

 **Job Description**

We're hiring a hands-on IT Manager to run day-to-day IT operations across our global offices while also building the IT strategy that scales with us. This is a working-manager role: you'll be in the trenches with your team resolving issues and administering infrastructure, while also thinking two steps ahead about what our technology environment needs to look like in a year.

You'll lead a team of 3 IT professionals, own our endpoints, network, directory services, and internal IT systems, and partner closely with Technology Leadership, DevOps, and Security to keep our environment secure, compliant, and reliable across four countries.

**What You'll Own**

* Endpoints & Devices — laptops, desktops, and mobile devices used by employees across all offices
* Office Networks — performance, uptime, and segmentation across India, UK, US, and Mexico
* Internal IT Systems — ManageEngine (UEM), Sophos (endpoint AV/security), ServiceDesk/ITSM platform, and related tooling
* Directory Services — Active Directory, group policies, and identity/access management, including administration of Google Workspace, SSO, and MFA enforcement
* Service Provisioning & User Management — onboarding/offboarding, access requests, asset lifecycle
* Procurement & License Management — hardware refresh cycles, software license tracking and renewals, and avoiding overspend or lapses
* Security & Compliance Alignment — working with Security to keep infrastructure and practices audit-ready

**Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership**

* Manage, coach, and develop a 3-person IT Operations team
* Participate in hiring, onboarding, and training of new team members
* Run regular 1:1s, feedback, and performance reviews
* Identify skill gaps and build development plans
* Ensure coverage across time zones (India, UK, US, Mexico) and resolve team conflicts or performance issues as they arise

**Day-to-Day Operations**

* Own resolution of IT issues raised via the ITSM/ServiceDesk platform, ensuring SLAs are met
* Manage team schedules to ensure coverage across all office hours and time zones
* Manage vendor relationships and contracts related to IT operations (ISPs, hardware, SaaS tools, MSPs)
* Own hardware procurement and lifecycle management, including laptop refresh cycles and cross-border logistics
* Track and manage software license renewals across the organization, avoiding lapses and unnecessary spend
* Maintain and support core infrastructure: laptops, desktops, servers, firewalls, routers, switches, printers, VPNs, LANs, and Active Directory

**Strategic Leadership**

* Proactively identify technology gaps and organizational IT needs; build and execute strategic plans to close them
* Define and evolve IT strategy as the company scales past 120 employees and adds offices or headcount
* Own the IT infrastructure budget: forecast costs, evaluate vendors, and optimize spend
* Report regularly to Technology Leadership/Operations on key metrics: SLA performance, ticket resolution times, system uptime, and IT spend
* Champion a strong IT experience for all employees, regardless of office location

**Security & Compliance**

* Implement and maintain information security processes, policies, and controls
* Run regular system and compliance audits against internal and regulatory standards
* Work with Legal/Compliance on data privacy obligations relevant to our footprint (e.g., UK GDPR, India's DPDP Act, and applicable US state privacy laws)
* Run security awareness training for employees, including phishing simulations and onboarding security education
* Lead incident response for security breaches and major operational disruptions

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with DevOps, Security, and Technology Leadership on infrastructure and tooling decisions
* Translate technical issues and trade-offs into clear, actionable updates for non-technical stakeholders
* Support cross-border technology initiatives with external vendors and legal stakeholders

**Business Continuity**

* Develop, implement, and maintain disaster recovery (DR) and business continuity (BC) plans for IT systems, appropriately scoped to a 120-person organization

 **Qualifications**

**Experience**

* 7–9 years in IT operations/ITSM, including hands-on support and infrastructure administration
* 2+ years directly managing a team (formal or informal management experience considered)
* Experience supporting a distributed or multi-office workforce across time zones
* Experience scaling IT support functions and driving IT change through an organization
* Some exposure to information security practices (risk assessment, policy enforcement, security awareness)

**Technical Skills**

* Strong desktop support experience across Windows, macOS, and Linux
* Hands-on experience with Active Directory, group policies, patch management, and backup strategies
* Practical network management experience, including VLANs, network segmentation, and gateway/firewall administration
* Solid understanding of core networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, ACLs, and routing basics
* Comfortable operating with significant autonomy and limited oversight

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail
* Able to communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Comfortable partnering across Legal, Compliance, and Risk functions
* High ownership and bias toward action

**Travel**

* Some travel between offices (India, UK, US, Mexico) may be expected periodically; frequency to be confirmed

**Good to Have**

* Scripting/automation experience (PowerShell, Bash, or Python)
* Familiarity with IPTables

  
**Additional Information**

**Benefits we offer**

* 33 days of holidays (this includes public and religious holidays)
* Contributions to your Provident Fund which can be matched by the company above the statutory minimum as agreed
* Gratuity payments
* Private Medical Insurance provided by the company (Employee + Spouse + 2 Children + 2 Parents)
* Personal Accident Insurance (Employee Only)
* 12 Weeks Paid Paternity Leave, 6 months Maternity leave
* Support with childcare costs (50%)
* Work from Home Equipment allowance
* Flexible Work from Home policy - 2 days home p/w
* Flexible Work from Long Distance - 4 weeks a year
* Sponsored Learning Opportunities
* Team Socials

Stay connected with us on LinkedIn or keep an eye on our career page for future opportunities!

title: Senior Analyst- HRCS- Apprentice & Intern Administration
description:
**Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?**

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

**About the role:**

Position Title -Senior Analyst - Apprenticeship & Internship Administration

Corporate Title - Analyst

Reporting To - Vice President - HR Service Center

Location - Bengaluru

Function -Human Resources Central Services (HRCS)

Experience - 5 to 8 years

  

**Purpose of Role**

The Senior Analyst - Apprenticeship & Internship Administration will be responsible for the end-to-end administration, governance,

compliance, reporting, and operational delivery of apprenticeship and internship programs across MGS.

The role will coordinate with Business Units, HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Payroll, Procurement,

compliance partners, and apprenticeship service providers to support workforce planning, , onboarding, statutory compliance,

stipend administration, reporting, conversions, and exits.

The incumbent will maintain appropriate controls, documentation, and audit evidence to ensure that apprenticeship and internship

programs are administered in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and approved organizational processes.

  

**Main Responsibilities**

1. Apprenticeship and Internship Program Administration

* Manage the end-to-end administration of apprenticeship and internship programs.

* Coordinate apprenticeship and internship activities from workforce planning through onboarding, engagement, conversion,

and separation.

* Maintain accurate records of apprentices and interns across locations and Business Units.

* Track apprenticeship agreements, engagement periods, extensions, conversions, and exits.

* Serve as the central point of contact for apprenticeship and internship administration.

* Ensure operational activities are completed within established timelines.

* Maintain appropriate supporting documents, approvals, and audit evidence.

2. Workforce Planning and Hiring Projections

* Coordinate with Business Units to understand apprenticeship and internship hiring requirements.

* Consolidate annual and periodic hiring plans received from Business Units.

* Prepare hiring forecasts and projections based on approved workforce requirements.

* Track approved positions, open requirements, hiring pipelines, and fulfilment status.

* Monitor actual hiring against approved workforce plans and highlight material variances.

* Provide regular updates to HR and business stakeholders on hiring progress.

* Support planning discussions relating to apprentice and intern deployment across functions and locations.

3. Campus Program Support

* Support the planning and execution of campus programs for internships, apprenticeships, and graduate/MBA intake in

partnership with Talent Acquisition and Business Units.

* Maintain the annual campus calendar, including college slots, pre-placement talks, assessments, interview days, offer

timelines, and joining dates.

* Act as the operational point of contact for partner colleges and placement offices for schedules, student data, documentation,

and follow-ups.

* Coordinate logistics for campus visits and on-site/virtual events, including travel, venue, panel availability, presentation

materials, and branding collateral.

* Support assessment and interview logistics, including scheduling, panel coordination, feedback-form collation, and

consolidation of results for decision-makers.

* Coordinate offer letters, internship letters, and joining documentation for campus selects, and track acceptances, reneges,

and pending documents.

* Support campus-to-corporate and induction programs for interns and graduate joiners, including onboarding schedules and

engagement activities.

* Track intern performance evaluations and Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) recommendations, and coordinate approvals and

documentation for conversions.

* Maintain campus trackers and MIS covering colleges engaged, demand versus fulfilment, offers, joiners, conversions, and

campus-related costs.

* Support campus budget tracking, including event, travel, and vendor costs, in coordination with Finance and Procurement.

* Capture post-season feedback from colleges, students, and Business Units, and recommend improvements for subsequent

campus cycles.

4. Onboarding and Joining Formalities

* Coordinate pre-joining and onboarding activities for apprentices and interns.

* Ensure timely completion and verification of joining documents.

* Coordinate with Business Units, Talent Acquisition, IT, Facilities, Security, and service providers.

* Support apprentice and intern induction and orientation activities.

* Ensure apprentices and interns are appropriately mapped to the relevant Business Unit, manager, location, and training

program.

* Track pending documentation, system access, workplace readiness, and other onboarding requirements.

* Address onboarding-related queries and coordinate timely resolution.

5. Apprenticeship Compliance

* Coordinate apprenticeship compliance activities in line with applicable regulatory requirements and approved organizational

processes.

* Work with the appointed compliance partner or apprenticeship service provider for registration, documentation, and statutory

administration.

* Track the completion of apprenticeship agreements and other mandatory documentation.

* Maintain a compliance calendar covering applicable activities, submissions, reviews, and renewals.

* Monitor compliance requirements throughout the apprenticeship lifecycle.

* Review compliance reports and follow up on exceptions, gaps, and pending actions.

* Coordinate timely closure of identified compliance issues.

* Escalate material compliance risks to the appropriate stakeholders.

6. Vendor and Compliance Partner Coordination

* Act as the primary operational contact for apprenticeship service providers and compliance partners.

* Coordinate hiring, registration, onboarding, documentation, stipend support, compliance reporting, and separation activities

with vendors.

* Monitor service delivery against agreed timelines and requirements.

* Conduct periodic operational and governance reviews with service providers.

* Maintain issue trackers and follow up on open actions through closure.

* Review vendor reports and validate information against internal records.

* Support vendor contract reviews, renewals, scope discussions, and service-performance assessments.

* Escalate recurring service issues, compliance gaps, and delivery risks.

7. Apprentice and Intern Lifecycle Management

* Maintain accurate lifecycle records for apprentices and interns.

* Coordinate changes relating to reporting managers, Business Units, locations, training assignments, and engagement

periods.

* Track attendance, leave, training completion, and other required information in coordination with relevant stakeholders.

* Coordinate apprentice extensions, early exits, completion of training, and conversion to full-time employment.

* Ensure lifecycle changes are supported by appropriate approvals and documentation.

* Coordinate with Business Units and HR stakeholders on apprentice performance and learning-related matters.

* Monitor upcoming completion dates and initiate required actions within defined timelines.

8. Stipend, Payroll and Benefits Coordination

* Coordinate apprentice and intern inputs required for stipend or payroll processing.

* Validate joining, attendance, leave, exit, and other relevant inputs before the applicable cut-off.

* Coordinate with Payroll, Finance, service providers, and Business Units to resolve discrepancies.

* Track stipend-processing issues and ensure timely follow-up and closure.

* Support administration of approved benefits applicable to apprentices and interns.

* Maintain supporting documents and approval evidence for stipend-related inputs and changes.

* Escalate unresolved payment issues and recurring exceptions to the appropriate process owner.

9. Budgeting, Forecasting and Provisioning

* Support annual and periodic budgeting for apprenticeship and internship programs.

* Prepare hiring projections and estimated costs based on approved workforce requirements.

* Maintain cost trackers for apprentice and intern hiring, stipends, vendor charges, and other program costs.

* Coordinate with Finance on budgeting, forecasting, accruals, and provisioning requirements.

* Monitor actual expenditure and hiring against approved budgets and forecasts.

* Provide periodic updates on projected costs, utilization, variances, and financial commitments.

* Maintain supporting calculations and documentation for provisioning and management reporting.

10. Reporting and Analytics

* Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual, and ad hoc reports relating to apprentices and interns.

* Report on approved positions, hiring status, headcount, onboarding, attendance, attrition, extensions, conversions, exits, and

compliance.

* Develop dashboards and management information reports for HR and business leadership.

* Reconcile internal data with information received from vendors and compliance partners.

* Analyse trends, exceptions, and recurring operational or compliance issues.

* Provide accurate data for workforce planning, budgeting, governance meetings, and management reviews.

* Ensure reports are validated and shared within agreed timelines.

11. Business Unit and Stakeholder Coordination

* Partner with Business Units to understand hiring requirements and program expectations.

* Provide Business Units with regular updates on hiring, onboarding, compliance, and apprentice lifecycle activities.

* Coordinate with managers on training plans, apprentice performance, learning objectives, extensions, conversions, and exits.

* Work with HR Business Partners, Talent Acquisition, Payroll, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Compliance, and HR Operations.

* Communicate process requirements, timelines, responsibilities, and changes to relevant stakeholders.

* Track stakeholder actions and ensure timely follow-up and closure.

* Escalate delays, exceptions, and material risks through the appropriate governance channels.

12. Governance, Risk and Audit

* Maintain SOPs, process maps, checklists, compliance trackers, approval records, and evidence repositories.

* Ensure apprenticeship and internship records remain complete and audit-ready.

* Support internal, external, statutory, and regulatory audits.

* Coordinate responses to audit queries and provide supporting documentation.

* Identify process gaps, compliance risks, and control weaknesses.

* Track audit observations and ensure timely closure of agreed corrective actions.

* Maintain confidentiality and appropriate access controls for apprentice and intern information.

* Ensure personal information is handled in accordance with applicable data-privacy and information-security requirements.

13. Process Improvement

* Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize apprenticeship and internship administration.

* Improve hiring, onboarding, compliance, reporting, vendor governance, and lifecycle-management processes.

* Support automation of trackers, reports, reminders, and reconciliation activities.

* Develop and maintain SOPs, templates, checklists, and knowledge articles.

* Participate in system enhancements, user acceptance testing, and implementation activities.

  

**Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Commerce, Finance, or a related discipline.

* 5-8 years of relevant experience in HR Operations, apprenticeship administration, internship administration, workforce

management, compliance administration, or HR Shared Services.

* Experience supporting apprenticeship, internship, contingent workforce, or early-career programs is preferred.

* Working knowledge of apprenticeship-related administration and compliance requirements.

* Experience coordinating with Business Units, external vendors, and compliance service providers.

* Experience in workforce planning, hiring projections, budgeting, cost tracking, accruals, or provisioning.

* Strong experience in management reporting, data reconciliation, and preparation of operational dashboards.

* Working knowledge of Workday or a comparable HR management system is preferred.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.

* Good understanding of governance, documentation, audit evidence, data privacy, and control requirements.

* Strong stakeholder-management, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow up with stakeholders for timely closure.

* Experience in a Global Capability Centre, shared-services environment, banking captive, or large organization is preferred.

* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with integrity and discretion.

title: Programme Engagement Lead
description:
**Job Description :**

**About the Function:** Global Business Operations keeps our business moving, connecting markets, streamlining processes and keeping everything running smoothly at scale.

With teams across Bangalore, Budapest, Bogotá, Gurugram, and Manila, GBO delivers the essential services that support our day-to-day performance, from finance to operations and beyond. It’s a truly global environment, where collaboration across time zones and cultures is part of everyday life.

You’ll gain exposure to different markets, build skills for the future and develop a broad understanding of how a business operates at scale. It’s a great place to learn, grow and see the bigger picture.

**About the role: The Programme Engagement Lead (Programme Management Leader for Customer Operations Transformation) is accountable for delivering the programme, operationalisation of change and drive value realisation. The role owns integrated programme management — governance, planning, Programme Increment delivery, reporting and value tracking — and the programme’s change, communications and business readiness, so that capabilities built by the workstreams are adopted in markets and GBS hubs and their value is realised.**

**It is the accountable Diageo owner of the strategic partner engagement for Integrated Programme Management and Change (October 2026 to April 2027) and must leave a Diageo-owned programme management and change capability in place at partner exit.**

**Success measures: PI commitments delivered on time; 90% of value realisation targets achieved; adoption against agreed readiness criteria; partner deliverables accepted to milestone; capabilities transferred to named Diageo owners by April 2027.**

**1. Programme governance and integrated control (20%)**

**Own the COT operating model: governance forums, terms of reference, cadence, RACI, decision rights and escalation routes, including interlock and ex-core governance with GBS, IT, Data, Service Delivery and regional leadership.**

**Run the Steering Committee and programme decision forums; maintain the decision log and drive accelerated referral and escalation.**

**Own the integrated programme plan with regional and country breakouts; manage RAID and cross-workstream dependencies, including Voyager (S/4HANA) and platform interlocks.**

**Assure alignment to the simplified PACE methodology and programme archetypes.**

**2. Programme Increment planning and Agile delivery (20%)**

**Lead PI planning and delivery of PI commitments across all delivery workstreams and the Integrated Control Tower; close PI02, baseline and deliver PI03.**

**Own the single prioritised programme backlog covering workstreams, PoVs, PoCs, enablers and roadmap items; enforce definition of ready and done.**

**Establish Azure DevOps as the programme source of truth: hierarchy, workflows, boards, dashboards and delivery controls.**

**Manage capacity, sequencing and delivery performance against the Programme Performance Outcome scorecard.**

**Ensure a centralised assurance of quality of deliverables and documentation, especially in vendor deliverables**

**Work with the workstreams, HR and lead the resourcing track to ensure that the programme is continuously resourced for outcome delivery.**

**3. Change, communications and business readiness (20%)**

**Lead the programme Change Management team; set the change, communications and business readiness approach for the programme.**

**Drive the change communications team ownership of the COT narrative and key messages, the Tier 1 stakeholder map and the executive engagement plan.**

**Mobilise and run the Change Network; own change impact assessment, readiness criteria, the readiness dashboard and readiness inputs to deployment decisions.**

**Direct workstream Change Leads on change and learning plans; track adoption and drive corrective action with the Regional Deployment Lead and markets.**

**4. Strategic partner management (15%)**

**Act as accountable Diageo owner of the EY Integrated Programme Management and Change engagement: scope, contractual deliverables, milestones, acceptance and change control.**

**Direct partner resources day to day and hold them to agreed acceptance criteria and the Programme Performance Outcome scorecard.**

**Secure the Diageo inputs the partner depends on (role-holders, data, access, approvals) so that dependencies do not delay milestones.**

**Plan and assure transition: knowledge transfer and Diageo ownership of governance, reporting, Azure DevOps administration and change activities by April 2027.**

**5. Reporting, value and programme financials (15%)**

**Own integrated programme, workstream, sprint and executive reporting, including the weekly programme status pack and executive dashboard.**

**Run the interlock with the Value Office: KPI and benefit baselines, targets, owners, forecasts and variance, with Diageo retaining ownership of value data.**

**Manage the programme budget, forecast and partner spend; report variance and corrective action to the Director.**

**Assure compliance to PACE methodology and audit & controls requirements for the programme.**

**6. Team leadership and capability build (10%)**

**Lead the Programme Management and the Change Management teams; set objectives and develop capability.**

**Produce reusable assets for standing up and scaling programme structures across Diageo: role profiles, performance scorecards, generic RACI and terms of reference.**

**KEY COMPETENCIES**

**Integrated programme leadership. Runs complex multi-workstream, multi-market programmes to plan; makes trade-offs on scope, capacity and sequence and holds teams to commitments.**

**Change leadership and influence. Drives adoption across markets and functions without line authority; engages Regional Presidents, Market MDs and GBS leaders credibly and manages resistance.**

**Partner and commercial control. Directs consultancy partners to outcomes; manages SOWs, deliverable acceptance and change control; builds internal capability rather than dependency.**

**QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE REQUIRED**

**20+ years in programme management and business transformation, including leadership of a large, multi-workstream global programme.**

**Track record of combined programme and change delivery on ERP-enabled or GBS operating-model transformations.**

**Proven delivery of Agile at scale, including Programme Increment planning; SAFe certification preferred; MSP, PRINCE2 or PMP, and Prosci or APMG change certification desirable.**

**Experience directing Big Four or tier-one consultancy engagements, including SOW management, deliverable acceptance and transition.**

**Hands-on Azure DevOps experience; track record in benefits tracking and programme financial management.**

**FMCG experience essential; BWS strongly preferred; Order-to-Cash or customer operations domain knowledge desirable. Degree required; MBA desirable.**

**Experience / skills required:**

**Working with us**  
Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you’re supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.  
  
We recognise and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package including:

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

We value diversity in its broadest sense and want everyone to feel they can belong, contribute and strive for their personal best. You’ll work alongside people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives — challenging, supporting and learning from one another as one outstanding team.

Together, we’re constantly learning and improving, combining the strength of our people, capabilities and iconic brands to raise the bar, grow and win. Wherever you join us, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute, make an impact and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Ready to bring your best? This could be your opportunity.

*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.*

Regular

Gurugram

title: Tech Talent-Advisor
description:

All roles listed are with Solventum, and we’re committed to protecting your personal information—learn more in our Privacy Policy

**Job Description:**

3M Health Care is now Solventum! At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. **Joining:** Immediate / Short Notice Preferred

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly professional, proactive and exceptionally organised **Executive Assistant to the Founder – Brand Partnerships & Operations** to work directly with Rinima Borah across three areas:

* **Miss Momo:** A premium women's fashion brand.
* **Rinima Borah:** Personal brand, digital content, public appearances and brand collaborations.
* **BRICS:** International pageant-related administration, stakeholder coordination and official communications.

This is a high-responsibility role combining executive assistance, business operations, brand partnerships, public relations, social-media coordination and administrative management.

We are looking for someone who can independently manage responsibilities, communicate confidently with senior stakeholders, handle repetitive administrative work with equal attention to detail, and consistently follow through without requiring reminders.

**This is not a fashion-design position or a full-time content-creation role.**

Key Responsibilities1. Executive Assistance & Founder Operations

* Manage the Founder's calendar, appointments, meetings, reminders and professional correspondence.
* Draft professional emails, letters, proposals, meeting agendas and follow-up communications.
* Coordinate with banks, chartered accountants, legal advisers, vendors, consultants and other external professionals.
* Prepare, organise and track NDAs, agreements, contracts, forms and business documentation using approved templates.
* Handle administrative applications, registrations, submissions and documentation requirements.
* Conduct online research, gather information, compare options and present actionable recommendations.
* Maintain accurate records, task trackers, contact databases and follow-up schedules.
* Take ownership of pending assignments and ensure timely completion.
* Handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion.

2. BRICS – Executive & International Coordination

* Coordinate official correspondence with national and international stakeholders.
* Schedule meetings, manage communications and maintain follow-up records.
* Assist with administrative documentation, presentations, proposals and agreements.
* Coordinate with event organisers, participants, partners and other relevant representatives.
* Support planning, timelines, research, travel arrangements and event-related administration.
* Maintain professional communication across different time zones.
* Track pending actions and ensure deadlines are met.

3. Brand Partnerships, PR & Business Development

**For both Miss Momo and Rinima Borah:**

* Research and identify potential brands, PR agencies, stylists, influencers, celebrities and collaboration partners.
* Build and maintain structured outreach databases using Excel or Google Sheets.
* Draft and send professional collaboration proposals, introductory emails and follow-ups.
* Proactively approach potential partners and develop new business relationships.
* Coordinate gifted, barter and paid collaboration enquiries.
* Track responses, discussions, deliverables and partnership opportunities.
* Assist with preparing media kits, brand proposals and pitch presentations.
* Coordinate with external stakeholders through email, WhatsApp, telephone and virtual meetings.
* Follow up consistently to move potential collaborations forward.
* Escalate commercial negotiations and contractual commitments for Founder approval.

**This role requires proactive outreach, not merely responding to incoming enquiries.**

4. Social Media & Digital Brand Coordination

* Understand Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and relevant digital platforms.
* Monitor professional DMs, collaboration enquiries and designated communication channels.
* Coordinate content calendars, posting schedules and campaign deadlines.
* Follow up with editors, social-media managers and creative teams to ensure timely publishing.
* Assist with scheduling approved content using relevant social-media tools.
* Identify relevant influencers, content creators and brand partnership opportunities.
* Maintain trackers for content deliverables, collaborations and campaign performance.
* Coordinate professional responses to audience enquiries and brand messages.

The role does not require independently filming or editing content. Creative production and design remain the responsibilities of the designated teams.

5. Miss Momo – Customer & Business Coordination

* Monitor and respond to assigned customer enquiries across WhatsApp, Instagram and email.
* Coordinate with internal teams regarding purchases, rentals, sizing, availability and order-related queries.
* Communicate with stylists, collaborators, influencers and potential business partners.
* Follow up on customer complaints and pending resolutions.
* Maintain accurate enquiry records and ensure no important communication is overlooked.
* Support operational coordination as required.

Required Skills

**Essential**

* Excellent spoken and written English, including professional business correspondence.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets, including formulas, filters, sorting and structured trackers.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.
* Good understanding of Instagram, YouTube and digital brand communication.
* Experience with professional email communication, research and stakeholder coordination.
* Strong organisational and time-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Confidence communicating with brands, agencies, vendors and senior professionals.
* Excellent attention to detail, follow-through and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently while knowing when approvals are required.
* High standards of professionalism, discretion and confidentiality.

**Preferred**

* Previous experience as an Executive Assistant, Founder’s Associate, Brand Partnerships Coordinator, PR Executive or Business Operations Executive.
* Experience in influencer marketing, brand outreach or digital creator management.
* Familiarity with Canva, Meta Business Suite, scheduling tools and CRM systems.
* Experience supporting founders, entrepreneurs, senior executives or public figures.
* Experience coordinating international stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will:

* Ensure important emails, messages and enquiries are handled promptly.
* Maintain an organised calendar, documentation system and task tracker.
* Follow through on assigned work without repeated reminders.
* Independently complete administrative tasks, including forms, research and documentation.
* Build and maintain an active pipeline of brand collaboration opportunities.
* Ensure consistent outreach and follow-ups with potential partners.
* Keep Miss Momo, Rinima Borah and BRICS administrative activities organised.
* Coordinate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Reduce the Founder's involvement in routine administrative matters while escalating important decisions appropriately.

Candidate Profile

We are particularly interested in candidates who are:

* Self-motivated, resourceful and solution-oriented.
* Comfortable performing both high-level coordination and routine administrative tasks.
* Persistent with follow-ups and professional outreach.
* Confident communicators who represent the Founder and associated organisations professionally.
* Highly organised, detail-oriented and dependable.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced entrepreneurial environment.
* Willing to take ownership and accountability for results.

Compensation & Employment

**Salary:** ₹35,000 – ₹50,000 per month, depending on experience, demonstrated skills and suitability.

**Probation:** 3 months, with performance evaluation.

**Work Schedule:** Monday to Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM, with Sunday as the regular weekly off and leave/holidays as per applicable company policy.

**Location:** Bengaluru. This is a full-time, office-based position.

How to Apply

Please submit:

* Updated CV
* Relevant professional experience
* Current and expected salary
* Notice period / earliest joining date
* A brief introduction explaining your experience in executive assistance, brand partnerships, social-media coordination or business operations

Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete a practical assessment involving professional email drafting, Excel-based tracking, brand research and task prioritisation.

Pay: ₹35,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off

title: C&S Technology Business Management Sr. Director
description:
**Req ID:** 391815
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a CS Technology Business Management Sr. Director to join our team in Bengaluru, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).
  
  
CS Technology Business Management, Manager
  
**Location:** India
  
**Reporting To:** CS Finance Leader
  
**Experience:** 5+ years in Asset Management, IT Asset Management (ITAM), Asset Operations, Infrastructure Asset Management, or a related function
  
Role Summary
  
The Technology Business Management manager is responsible for establishing and leading the Cloud Security Technology Business Management function. This role provides end-to-end ownership of hardware and software asset visibility across private, public, and hybrid environments, ensuring assets are effectively tracked, allocated, utilized, maintained, and retired throughout their lifecycle. The manager partners closely with Operations, Delivery, Finance, Sales, Partner Programs, Procurement, Global Sourcing, and Regional teams to optimize asset utilization, improve cost recovery, reduce stranded costs, and support data-driven investment and lifecycle decisions.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* Own and maintain the authoritative inventory and system of record for all Cloud Security hardware and software assets.
* Ensure asset records include asset identifiers, configuration details, deployment locations, contract information, licensing entitlements, and lifecycle status.
* Partner with Finance to ensure accurate financial and commercial asset data, including cost basis, book value, depreciation/amortization status, charge-out rates, ownership, and associated contracts.
* Oversee asset commitment and allocation management, ensuring accurate tracking of reserved, available, and deployed capacity.
* Partner with Delivery to monitor asset utilization and capacity metrics to identify opportunities for asset redeployment, cost optimization, and improved return on investment.
* Lead lifecycle management activities, including upgrade planning, hardware refresh cycles, end-of-life (EOL), end-of-support (EOS), and replacement planning in collaboration with Delivery.
* Develop governance standards, reporting dashboards, and executive insights on utilization, financial exposure, asset availability, and refresh requirements.
* Drive asset data quality, process compliance, and lifecycle discipline across the organization. Partner with Partner Programs, Global Sourcing and Regional teams to align asset acquisition and vendor contract decisions with approved standards and negotiated agreements.
* Collaborate with Sales and Delivery teams to ensure customer commitments, Statements of Work (SOWs), licensing rights, support requirements, and capacity assumptions align with asset availability and contractual obligations.
* Support financial forecasting, capacity planning, and scenario analysis related to future demand, asset commitments, and unexpected client churn.
* Identify and implement continuous improvements to asset management processes, tools, controls, and reporting capabilities.

Required Qualifications
  
Requirement Qualifications
  
Education Bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year college or university in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Finance, Supply Chain, or a related discipline
  
Experience Minimum 5 years of experience in Asset Management, IT Asset Management (ITAM), Technology Operations, Infrastructure Management, Procurement Operations, or related fields
  
Location Based in India with the ability to work across global time zones and support a geographically distributed organization
  
Asset Management Expertise Strong understanding of hardware and software asset lifecycle management, inventory governance, utilization tracking, capacity management, and asset redeployment
  
Financial Acumen Experience managing asset financial data including depreciation, amortization, cost allocation, charge-back/charge-out models, and asset investment analysis
  
Technology Knowledge Familiarity with data center infrastructure, cloud platforms, software licensing, CMDBs, asset management systems, and monitoring tools
  
Vendor Contract Management Experience working with vendor contracts, procurement processes, licensing agreements, support renewals, and sourcing organizations
  
Analytical Skills Strong analytical and reporting capabilities with the ability to translate operational data into actionable business insights
  
Communication Skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills with experience presenting recommendations to leaders and cross-functional stakeholders
  
Leadership Skills Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, influence stakeholders, establish governance processes, and drive operational excellence
  
  
Success Measures
  

* Accurate and trusted asset inventory across all in-scope environments.
* Increased asset utilization and reduced stranded capacity.
* Improved asset lifecycle compliance and reduced EOL/EOS risk.
* Enhanced cost recovery and financial transparency.
* Timely executive reporting and decision support.
* Strong alignment between Operations, Finance, Procurement, Sales, and Delivery teams.

About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. description:

You consistently help customers realize measurable business outcomes through AI and automation while driving strong adoption, executive engagement, revenue expansion, and long-term customer retention.

* You have 6-10 years of experience in Consulting, GTM Strategy, Growth Strategy, Founder’s Office or Strategic Account Management roles.

* You have successfully driven business growth, strategic initiatives, customer expansion, or transformation programs.

* You have experience managing global or multi-market enterprise accounts.

**Why should you be interested?**

**Here’s what you will gain from this role:**

* Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI-powered customer experience transformation.
* Exposure to enterprise customers across industries and international markets.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your role**  
As an AI Data Engineer at Kyndryl, you’ll be the architect behind the high-performance data infrastructure that powers our autonomous systems. We aren't just moving tables; we’re building the real-time pipelines that allow agentic AI to reason over the world’s most complex enterprise environments.
  
  
**What you will do**

* Architect for RAG: You’ll design and scale the pipelines for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), transforming massive volumes of unstructured IT logs and documentation into optimized Vector Embeddings.
* Scale vector infrastructure: You will be responsible for the health and performance of our vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, or Weaviate), ensuring sub-second retrieval speeds for agentic reasoning loops.
* Engineer semantic layers: Move beyond simple ETL to build knowledge graphs and semantic layers that provide agents with the necessary context to navigate complex infrastructure puzzles.
* Automate data excellence: Using a keen eye for detail, you’ll build automated data guardrails to detect noise, bias, or PII (Personally Identifiable Information) before it reaches the model, ensuring our AI remains safe and impactful.
* Solve meaningful challenges: Serve as the bridge between raw, messy data sources and deep technical AI work, identifying and resolving quality issues at the source.
Progress to production: With a well-defined methodology and software engineering prowess, you will build, deploy, and maintain the CI/CD pipelines for our data infrastructure, ensuring that our context window remains fresh and reliable.  

  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
You’ll be creating a well-rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications.You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non-technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a Senior Project Manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best.

  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 7+ years of experience in data engineering/data warehousing, 4+ years of hands-on experience with Databricks/Spark and Snowflake.
* Advanced hands-on experience with: Databricks Python SQL Spark/PySpark Delta Lake Snowflake
* Strong experience with Databricks Workflows/Jobs, notebooks, Unity Catalog, Git, and CI/CD.
* Experience building metadata-driven ELT frameworks, reusable pipeline templates, data-quality frameworks, reconciliation utilities, and automated testing.
* Strong knowledge of performance tuning, partitioning, incremental processing, schema evolution, and large-volume data processing.
* Knowledge of dimensional and normalized data modeling.
* Experience working with healthcare data, including patient identity, effective dating, PHI handling, lineage, and audit requirements.
Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause-analysis skills.  

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience building GenAI/RAG applications on Databricks, Agentic AI / AI Agents, Generative AI and LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Prompt Engineering, Embeddings & Vector Search
* Experience with MLflow and AI/ML lifecycle practices.
* Exposure to Azure OpenAI or equivalent enterprise LLM platforms.
* Knowledge of agent frameworks/orchestration approaches.
* Experience moving AI/GenAI solutions from POC to production, including CI/CD, monitoring, security, and governance.
Healthcare domain experience and familiarity with PHI-sensitive datasets  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.
