They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
**Overview**

The Talent Partner plays a critical role in attracting, engaging and hiring high-quality talent for MUFG MPMS India Hub, while supporting broader talent management and mobility priorities across the business. The role is responsible for delivering effective end-to-end recruitment activity, building talent pipelines, advising hiring managers, and creating a consistent, fair and positive candidate and hiring manager experience.

Reporting to the Head of Talent Acquisition, this role contributes to cross-functional squads and collaborates with People Partners, business leaders and specialist teams to design and deliver strategic people solutions and services that respond to business priorities. The role supports workforce capability, internal mobility and succession outcomes by helping identify talent gaps, agency panel management, surface talent opportunities and enable the movement of talent across the organisation.

The role requires strong recruitment expertise, stakeholder management, commercial judgement, data orientation and the ability to operate collaboratively in a fast-paced environment. It partners closely with the Head of Talent Acquisition.

  
  

**Key accountabilities and main responsibilities**

Strategic focus

* Develop and execute targeted sourcing strategies to attract passive and active talent through talent pools, social media, industry networks, referrals, market mapping and other contemporary channels.
* Build and nurture talent pipelines for critical and recurring roles, anticipating future workforce requirements in line with business strategy and portfolio demand.
* Contribute to employer brand, EVP, onboarding, retention, diversity, engagement and talent capability initiatives that strengthen attraction and employee experience outcomes.

Operations management

* Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from requisition through to offer and onboarding, ensuring a high-quality candidate and hiring manager experience at every stage.
* Help connect internal talent to opportunities by supporting mobility discussions, role matching, candidate shortlisting and pathways that enable career development and retention.
* Support talent capability-building initiatives, including internal mobility, graduate or emerging talent activity and other workforce capability programs.
* Embed diversity, equity and inclusion principles into recruitment and talent mobility activity to support fair access to opportunities and diverse talent outcomes.
* **Agency panel, vendor and market management**
* Monitor agency usage, performance, terms, candidate quality, role coverage and compliance with agreed processes and governance requirements.
* Guide hiring managers on appropriate agency engagement, direct sourcing opportunities and external search requirements.
* Maintain strong external market networks to support sourcing strategy, benchmarking, talent intelligence and access to specialist or senior talent pools.
* **Squad contribution, collaboration and people solutions**
* Bring recruitment, sourcing and talent market expertise into squad-based initiatives to support business change, workforce planning, capability uplift and improved service delivery.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of recruitment tools, templates, processes, service models and candidate or hiring manager experience through squad and functional ways of working.
* **Reporting, insights and continuous improvement**
* Maintain accurate recruitment data, requisition updates, candidate records and pipeline information to support transparency, reporting and informed decision-making.
* Prepare recruitment updates, insights for the Head of Talent Acquisition and relevant stakeholders, highlighting trends, risks, bottlenecks and opportunities.
* Use recruitment analytics to improve sourcing effectiveness, time-to-fill, candidate quality, diversity outcomes, hiring manager experience and process efficiency.
* Leverage recruitment technology and process improvements to streamline workflows, strengthen data integrity and improve candidate and stakeholder experience.

People leadership

* Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to understand role requirements, develop fit-for-purpose hiring strategies and support timely, informed recruitment decisions.
* Provide guidance to hiring managers on recruitment process, interview planning, candidate assessment, selection quality, inclusion and fair, consistent decision-making.
* Maintain clear communication with candidates, leaders and stakeholders, ensuring recruitment activity is well coordinated, transparent and aligned to agreed service expectations.
* Partner with the Head of Talent Acquisition where required on escalations, complex recruitment activity, senior role support, governance requirements and best practice process improvement.

Governance, risk and compliance

* Ensure recruitment activity complies with internal policies, approval requirements, legal and regulatory obligations, privacy requirements and audit standards.
* Ensure all requisitions have appropriate approvals before recruitment commences and that new hire records meet required governance and audit standards.
* Actively promote inclusive hiring practices, including fair assessment, balanced shortlists, pay equity, flexible working considerations and mitigation of unconscious bias.
* Escalate risks, sensitive matters, process exceptions, candidate concerns or governance issues to the Head of Talent Acquisition and People Partners in a timely and appropriate manner.
* Ensure a safe, healthy and sustainable workplace for employees and contractors by reporting workplace hazards and role modelling safe and positive workplace practices.

The above list of key accountabilities is not an exhaustive list and may change from time-to-time based on business needs.

  
  

**Experience and personal attributes**

* 5-8 years’ experience in end-to-end recruitment, talent acquisition, sourcing or workforce resourcing within a complex, fast-paced environment.
* Strong knowledge of contemporary sourcing methods, candidate engagement strategies, recruitment technology and talent pipeline development.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with hiring managers and business leaders to understand workforce needs and deliver practical, commercially aligned talent solutions.
* Experience contributing to talent management, internal mobility, capability-building initiatives is highly desirable.
* Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams or squads, contributing specialist recruitment and talent expertise to broader people solutions and services.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing and communication skills, with confidence advising leaders and managing candidate and hiring manager expectations.
* Data-driven mindset with the ability to interpret recruitment metrics, identify trends and develop actionable insights to improve hiring outcomes.
* Sound judgement, discretion and professionalism in handling confidential candidate, employee, remuneration and workforce information.
* Strong planning and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple roles, competing priorities, deadlines and stakeholder requirements.
* Understanding of fair, inclusive and compliant recruitment practices, including diversity, equity and inclusion, privacy, employment and audit requirements.
* Personal commitment to role modelling the organisation’s values and behaviours.

  

MUFG Pension & Market Services is a global, digitally enabled business that empowers a brighter future by connecting millions of people with their assets – safely, securely and responsibly.

Through our two businesses MUFG Retirement Solutions and MUFG Corporate Markets, we partner with a diversified portfolio of global clients to provide robust, efficient and scalable services, purpose-built solutions and modern technology platforms that deliver world class outcomes and experiences.

A member of MUFG, a global financial group, we help manage regulatory complexity, improve data management and connect people with their assets, through exceptional user experience that leverages the expertise of our people combined with scalable technology, digital connectivity and data insights.

  

India Hub is a central part of MUFG's transformation program, which has rapidly expanded over the past 5 years to nearly 1100+ employees, to provide services to our clients across two of our businesses. We have offices in Mumbai and Pune.

India Hub has allowed us to streamline our operations and forms one of our global centres of excellence. This has allowed us to focus our skillsets, innovate our current operations and create new capabilities for the future. The Hub has been designed to support flexible operations processing our three businesses - Retirement Solutions, Corporate Markets and Investor Services. In addition, our Global Functions team provide centralized expertise and support—like HR, Finance, and IT—to ensure consistency, efficiency, and strategic alignment across all business units.

At India Hub, we are building a dynamic, client-focused, caring, and inclusive culture based on entrepreneurial spirit, effective risk management, empathy, and trust, underpinned by core values. We work collaboratively, supporting and valuing the talents and perspectives of our people, and promoting a flexible work environment where their wellbeing is prioritized. We believe diversity drives better client outcomes, improvement, and growth.

Be part of the MUFG Pension & Market Services journey and together we will achieve our full potential. Candidates must have the relevant work rights. Successful applicants must complete background screening before employment.

title: Advisor, People Operations
description:
***World Change Starts with Educated Children®***
=================================================

**IMPORTANT: All applicants must be legally eligible to work in the country where the position is located. Room to Read is not able to provide sponsorship.**
=============================================================================================================================================================

**Position Overview:**
----------------------

The Advisor, People Operations is responsible for providing functional direction, guidance and oversight to ensure the effective and timely delivery of People Operations processes and services across Room to Read India. The role oversees the implementation of key People Operations functions, including learning and development, performance management, HRMIS, payroll, recruitment, compliance, employee lifecycle and employee relations. Working closely with the People Operations team, employees, managers and operational teams, the role provides guidance on priorities, monitors implementation and ensures quality, consistency and adherence to organizational policies and processes. The position also identifies operational gaps, facilitates timely resolution of challenges and ensures that agreed People Operations priorities and deliverables are effectively executed across the Country Office and operational states, in alignment with the direction of the Director – People Operations.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

### **Learning and Development:**

  

* Provide direction and oversight for the implementation of approved learning and development priorities across the Country Office and operational states.
* Guide the consolidation of organizational and individual learning needs and oversee the development and implementation of the annual training calendar.
* Ensure that learning activities are appropriately planned, resourced and delivered within agreed timelines and budgets.
* Review training plans, progress reports, participation levels and feedback to assess the effectiveness and relevance of learning interventions.
* Guide the team in addressing implementation challenges and ensure timely follow-up on agreed learning and development actions.
* Identify recurring capability gaps and recommend appropriate learning interventions in alignment with organizational priorities.

### **Performance Management and Employee Relations:**

  

* Provide direction and oversee the effective implementation of the annual performance management cycle, ensuring adherence to established timelines, processes and standards.
* Guide managers and the People Operations team on performance management processes, including goal setting, performance reviews, feedback discussions and performance improvement plans.
* Monitor completion of key performance management milestones and ensure timely resolution of delays or process gaps.
* Review performance management reports and identify organizational trends, concerns and areas requiring management attention.
* Provide oversight on employee relations matters, including grievances, complaints, disciplinary cases and other employee concerns, ensuring fair, consistent and confidential handling.
* Guide the team on appropriate documentation, initial assessments and resolution approaches, escalating complex, sensitive or high-risk matters to the Director – People Operations.

### **HRMIS, Data Management and Reporting:**

  

* Provide direction and oversight on the effective use, maintenance and continuous improvement of HRMIS and other People Operations systems.
* Ensure the timely updating and maintenance of accurate and complete employee data across the Country Office and operational states.
* Oversee the maintenance and quality of key People Operations records and trackers relating to staffing, recruitment, payroll, performance, learning, compliance and employee movements.
* Review periodic People Operations reports and dashboards to assess data accuracy, identify trends, gaps and emerging issues, and facilitate informed decision-making.
* Guide the team in strengthening data quality, reporting processes, documentation standards and system utilization.
* Identify opportunities for process improvements, automation and greater efficiency in People Operations data management and reporting.

### **Payroll, Compensation, Benefits and Compliance:**

  

* Oversee the timely and accurate submission of payroll inputs and ensure effective coordination with the Payroll team for resolution of discrepancies and employee-related queries.
* Provide direction on the administration of compensation, benefits, insurance, retirement and other employee-related programmes, ensuring consistency with approved policies and procedures.
* Monitor the implementation of salary revisions, pay schedules, benefits and other compensation-related changes.
* Oversee statutory compliance requirements, ensuring timely completion of applicable filings, audits, reviews, documentation and corrective actions.
* Guide the team in implementing and monitoring organizational policies and frameworks, including the Child Protection Policy, Code of Conduct and Prevention of Sexual Harassment processes.
* Monitor compliance risks and ensure that legal, regulatory, safeguarding and other high-risk matters are appropriately escalated and addressed.

### **Recruitment and Selection:**

  

* Provide direction and oversight to the recruitment function, ensuring alignment with approved staffing plans, organizational priorities and recruitment timelines.
* Guide the recruitment team and hiring managers on job descriptions, selection criteria, sourcing strategies, assessment processes and recruitment planning.
* Provide strategic support and participate in the recruitment of senior, critical, sensitive and specialized positions, as required.
* Review recruitment progress, candidate pipelines, time-to-fill, pending approvals and potential hiring risks, ensuring timely interventions where required.
* Guide the team in addressing complex recruitment challenges and identifying appropriate sourcing and selection approaches.
* Ensure recruitment practices are fair, consistent, transparent and compliant with organizational policies and established procedures.

### **Employee Lifecycle and Field Engagement:**

  

* Oversee the effective implementation of employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, transfers, promotions, contract renewals, changes in employment status and exits.
* Monitor key employee lifecycle milestones, including probation reviews, contract expiries and employee movements, ensuring timely action and appropriate documentation.
* Ensure the maintenance of complete, accurate and confidential employee records, contracts and personnel documentation.
* Provide direction to the team on employee query management and ensure timely and effective resolution of employee requests.
* Undertake periodic field visits to understand employee experiences, operational requirements and People Operations-related challenges across state offices.
* Guide the team in providing appropriate field-level support and ensure that observations, concerns and agreed actions are followed through.
* Share significant field-level insights, operational risks and unresolved matters with the Director – People Operations and recommend appropriate interventions.

### **Team Leadership, Coordination and Performance Oversight:**

  

* Provide functional direction and guidance to the People Operations team, ensuring clarity on priorities, roles, responsibilities and expected deliverables.
* Translate approved People Operations priorities into actionable work plans, timelines and measurable deliverables for the team.
* Oversee the execution of key People Operations functions, including recruitment, learning and development, performance management, HRMIS, payroll, compliance and employee administration.
* Review team progress and outputs to ensure accuracy, quality, consistency and adherence to organizational policies and established procedures.
* Provide guidance, coaching and constructive feedback to team members, strengthening their functional capabilities, ownership and accountability.
* Identify implementation bottlenecks, delays, duplication and quality concerns, and guide the team in taking timely corrective action.
* Monitor overall delivery against agreed priorities and proactively address issues that may affect timelines, quality or service delivery.
* Provide regular updates to the Director – People Operations on progress, key developments, emerging risks, pending decisions and areas requiring support or intervention.
* Drive the implementation of India Country Office-wide People Operations initiatives and projects, as assigned by the Director – People Operations.
* Undertake other responsibilities as assigned by the Director – People Operation.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

### **Required:**

  

* Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of ten years of progressive experience in Human Resources, including at least two years in a supervisory, team-lead, or managerial role.
* Broad generalist People Operations experience covering learning and development, performance management, HRMIS, recruitment, payroll coordination, employee relations, compliance, and employee lifecycle processes.
* Experience coordinating learning programs, performance management cycles, HRMIS data, People Operations reporting, and recruitment activities.
* Experience supporting recruitment for senior, critical, sensitive, or specialized positions.
* Experience coordinating or supervising the work of People Operations team members.
* Strong proficiency in HRMS, recruitment tracking systems, Microsoft Excel, spreadsheets, databases, and reporting tools.
* Working knowledge of applicable employment laws, statutory requirements, Child Protection requirements, and the Prevention of Sexual Harassment framework.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Strong organizational, analytical, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain confidentiality, meet deadlines, and exercise sound judgment.
* Ability and willingness to undertake regular travel to operational states within India and, where required, outside India.

### **Preferred:**

  

* Experience working in the development, nonprofit, education, or social sector.
* Experience supporting People Operations across multiple states or geographically dispersed locations.
* Experience with HR dashboards, people analytics, performance management modules, or learning management systems.
* Experience coordinating field-based employee engagement or People Operations activities.
* Experience working with multicultural teams and diverse stakeholders.

**Compensation:**
-----------------

Room to Read offers a competitive salary with excellent benefits. Benefits include thirteenth month bonus, health insurance and a retirement plan. The non-monetary compensation includes a unique opportunity to be part of an innovative, meaningful, and rapidly growing organization that is changing transforming the lives of millions of children in developing countries on literacy and gender equality in education.

**Room to Read is a child-safe organization.**
----------------------------------------------

**Read is a child-safe organization; all personnel must adhere to Room to Read’s Child Protection Policy, Child Protection Code of Conduct and Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Policy.**
===========================================================================================================================================================================================================

**Room to Read is an equal opportunity employer committed to identifying and developing the skills and leadership of people from diverse backgrounds.**
=======================================================================================================================================================

  

**Child Protection Principles**
===============================

* Room to Read is committed to the education and welfare of children and protecting them from abuse and exploitation
* Room to Read has zero tolerance for child abuse and exploitation.
* All children have the right to be free from abuse and exploitation, including neglect, maltreatment, and physical, mental or sexual violence, injury or abuse.
* All children should be treated with respect and dignity.
* The well-being of the child is Room to Read’s first priority when dealing with all identified or suspected cases of child abuse.
* Room to Read shall integrate child protection into all its organizational strategies, structures and work practices.

**Protection from Sexual Exploitation and Abuse (PSEA) Principles**
===================================================================

* Room to Read Representatives must create and maintain an environment that prevents sexual exploitation and sexual abuse.
* Room to Read has zero tolerance for adult sexual exploitation and abuse.
* Sexual exploitation and abuse are serious violations of fundamental human rights and will not be accepted or tolerated.
* All adults should be treated with respect and dignity.
* Room to Read implements a survivor-centered approach, putting the survivor’s rights and dignity at the forefront.
* Survivors referred to available professional assistance (e.g. mental health counselling), upon consent.

***About Room to Read:***

Founded in 2000 on the belief that World Change Starts with Educated Children®, *Room to Read envisions a world free from illiteracy and gender inequality, where all children have room to read, learn and grow – creating lasting change*. Through our Literacy Portfolio, we train and coach teachers of the early grades in literacy instruction; create and publish quality books and curricular materials in local languages; and establish children’s libraries filled with diverse children’s books that can be enjoyed at school and home. Our Gender Equality Portfolio supports adolescents, particularly girls, in developing life skills that promote gender equality, helping them to pursue lifelong learning and make informed decisions.

We support young people of all genders to overcome gender biases and build the knowledge and skills to create a gender-equal world. Room to Read collaborates with local communities, partner organizations, publishers, and governments to test and implement innovative models that can be integrated into the education system to deliver positive outcomes for children at scale. To date, Room to Read has benefited more than 50 million children in 28 countries.

Learn more at www.roomtoread.org.

title: Senior Manager - Workday
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

Join us on our mission to elevate customer experiences for people around the world. As a member of the Everise family, you will be part of a global experience company that believes in being people-first, celebrating diversity and incubating innovation. Our dedication to our purpose and people is being recognized by our employees and the industry. Our 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor and our shiny, growing wall of Best Place to Work awards is a testament to our investment in our culture. Through the power of diversity, we celebrate all cultures for their uniqueness and strengths. With 13 centers around the world and a robust work at home program, we believe great things happen when we work with people who think differently from us. Find a job you’ll love today!

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Function:** HR Systems and Processes / HR Technology

**Location:** Remote

**Reports to:** Head of HR Systems / HR Technology Leader

  

**Role purpose**
================

Lead the delivery, operation, and continuous improvement of Workday across the employee lifecycle. Partner with HR, IT, Payroll, Finance, and business leaders to translate requirements into reliable system capabilities, simpler processes, accurate workforce data, and a better employee and manager experience. Combine hands-on functional expertise with team leadership, delivery oversight, and strong governance in a global environment.

**Key responsibilities**
========================

**Workday delivery and process improvement**
--------------------------------------------

* Manage the Workday enhancement roadmap, prioritize demand with process owners, and deliver agreed outcomes within approved budgets and timelines.
* Lead requirements gathering, process design, configuration oversight, testing, deployment, and adoption for Core HCM, Recruiting, Onboarding, and Compensation, according to the deployed scope.
* Standardize hire-to-retire processes while accommodating approved country requirements. Identify opportunities for self-service, automation, and reduced manual work.
* Lead Workday implementations, country rollouts, and enhancements; coordinate dependencies, data migration, user acceptance testing, training, and post-launch support.

**Platform operations and integrations**
----------------------------------------

* Own day-to-day Workday service delivery, including incident resolution, problem management, enhancement requests, and service-level performance.
* Coordinate with IT and integration specialists to maintain reliable interfaces with payroll providers, identity platforms, and other enterprise applications; oversee monitoring, reconciliation, and issue resolution.
* Assess Workday releases, coordinate regression testing, and introduce relevant capabilities through controlled change and release processes.

**Data governance and leadership**
----------------------------------

* Establish data-quality checks, reporting standards, and ownership with HR process owners. Deliver meaningful workforce reports and dashboards with appropriate access controls.
* Partner with security, privacy, and compliance teams on role-based access, segregation of duties, audit evidence, and protection of employee data.
* Lead and coach Workday analysts and functional specialists; manage partner delivery, knowledge transfer, documentation, and service continuity.
* Communicate priorities, delivery risks, and outcomes to stakeholders; lead change adoption and maintain configuration records, operating procedures, and support guides.

**Required qualifications and experience**
==========================================

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant HR systems, HR technology, or HR transformation experience, including at least 5 years working with Workday and 3 years leading teams or significant delivery programs.
* Strong functional expertise in Workday Core HCM and business processes, with substantial delivery experience in Recruiting, Onboarding, or Compensation.
* Demonstrated experience in a Workday implementation or significant rollout, plus ongoing platform support and enhancement delivery in a multinational environment.
* Practical understanding of Workday security, reporting, data loads, integrations, and release testing; ability to work effectively with technical specialists.
* Proven ability to manage stakeholders, vendors, priorities, risks, and service performance while translating business needs into clear requirements.

**Preferred experience**
========================

* Relevant Workday certification or formal Workday training; exposure to additional modules such as Absence, Time Tracking, Benefits, or Talent and Performance.
* Experience with payroll integrations, vendor transitions, data reconciliation, and multi-country payroll governance.
* Exposure to Workday reporting and calculated fields, Enterprise Interface Builder, integration delivery, and HR analytics.
* Experience in a high-volume, geographically distributed workforce, shared services, or business process outsourcing environment; familiarity with Agile delivery and structured process improvement.

**Measures of success**
=======================

Performance will be assessed against agreed targets for service-level achievement, resolution of recurring issues, data accuracy, integration reliability, delivery milestones, user adoption, process efficiency, and timely closure of audit findings.

If you’ve got the skills to succeed and the motivation to make it happen, we look forward to hearing from you.

title: Talent Development Manager
description:
Are you a change maker who wants to play a pivotal role in restoring vision for millions of people in low-income settings across India? Would you like to work for an organisation that is a pioneer in social impact practices?

We are seeking a highly motivated, dynamic, and self-driven candidate who would like to have a challenging and meaningful career path in Learning and Development (L&D), Human Resources (HR), and the social sector. Talent Development is a key focus area of our organisation and requires a proactive and dynamic approach. The candidate must be dedicated and sincere towards her/his work and should always be open to learning new things. The candidate must have in-depth subject matter knowledge, expertise, and experience. Timely and high-quality delivery of goals would be essential and will be a key performance measurement criterion. S/he will be responsible for enhancing organisation-wide learning and capacity-building with the aim of strengthening the learning delivery and augmenting the skills set of internal staff and external partners. The role will lead the development and growth of the learning pathways, training content, certification, and learning analytics. It will help embed the Learning Management System (LMS) and institutionalise learning culture. S/he will be based out of Delhi NCR (Noida), India, and report to the Senior Manager, People, Culture, and Talent Development.

**About You**

* You will be expected to apply your organisational and communication skills while displaying a positive, high-energy attitude.
* You must have outstanding project management skills demonstrated across multiple locations, cultures, and sectors, strong knowledge of and proven proficiency in adult learning, and a proven ability to create high level training courses that incorporate experiential learning activities to meet the needs and culture of the audience.
* You must have strong expertise in developing learning and development content, facilitating professional training programs, a comprehensive understanding of HR learning and how it relates to policies, job descriptions, workforce analytics, retention, and culture, and the ability to teach/instruct individuals and groups and measure transfer of learning.
* You must have experience and expertise in delivering learning content through both online/digital and offline/in-person mediums.
* You are curious about Artificial Intelligence (AI) and technology and excited about the myriad possibilities that they can create in the way we learn.
* You must have outstanding communication and presentation skills, strong organisational capabilities, the ability to work in a team environment with a service mindset, and the maturity to handle confidential and sensitive information with the appropriate discretion.
* You must have strong analytical skills with minimal supervision needed, outstanding organisational and time management skills needed to prioritise multiple projects and deadlines effectively, and excellent language skills including reading, grammar, spelling, and vocabulary.
* You should have well-developed and professional interpersonal skills, the ability to interact effectively with people at all organisational levels.
* You should be tech savvy with knowledge and proficiency in Windows, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, AI tools, LMS, and other relevant softwares.

**About Us**

* We are creating access to eyeglasses for low-income people. Clear vision creates opportunities for increased learning, work, safety, civic participation, and quality of life.
* As a social organisation, social change motivates us first. Our focus is on advancing our mission objectives - to increase functioning, productivity, and income earning potential for our low-income people by correcting impaired vision with eyeglasses.
* We are working to transform the systemic dysfunction which has failed to deliver eyeglasses - a 700-year-old technology - to approximately 55 Crore people in India in need of vision correction.
* We serve low-income people who are more than beneficiaries for us. Our program participants and eyeglasses users expect high-quality eye-screenings and eyeglasses.
* We run our operations on metrics and social impact measures. We leverage a range of processes and practices to get the work done.
* We believe in scaling our impact, not our organisation. We are a lean team of doers.

**What You’ll Do**

* Drive implementation and adoption of LMS.
* Implement the organisational learning architecture.
* Be a student of AI and technology and explore how it can revolutionise learning.
* Develop structured learning pathways for different staff and external stakeholder groups.
* Identify learning and capacity-building needs across internal teams and external partners.
* Drive adoption and regular use of the LMS across internal and external users.
* Develop and curate training content, including multilingual and role-specific modules.
* Deliver content through both online/digital and offline/in-person mediums.
* Build learning modules across a wide range of technical and non-technical areas, focusing both on hard and soft skills.
* Work with program teams and subject-matter experts to ensure technical accuracy and practical relevance of content.
* Establish assessment and certification mechanisms.
* Develop mechanisms to assess partner readiness and learning outcomes.
* Track learning participation, completion, certification, and application.
* Use learning analytics and feedback to improve content and learning pathways.
* Support government, NGOs, private eye care providers/hospitals, frontline networks, and other partners in strengthening their implementation capabilities.
* Develop systems for documenting and sharing organisational knowledge and implementation learning.
* Prepare and maintain a training repository for the organisation, including a database of internal and external trainers, training providers, training materials, and training records.
* Be the values champion of the organisation and build a strong organisational culture by encouraging adherence to the organisational code of conduct and policies.
* Help develop a ‘mindful’ culture to embrace and reflect change and drive high performance in a fast-paced environment.
* Assist with the maintenance of HR processes and policies as per the organisational guidelines, and with HR initiatives that make us a “Great Place to Work”.
* Onboard new employees and provide the support they need to get inducted into the organisation.
* Provide support and counselling to employees on employee-related matters, including disciplinary matters, policies, and benefits.
* Participate in investigations when employee complaints and/or concerns are brought forth.
* Keep the entire organisation updated proactively on all HR initiatives and policies.
* Design and implement employee engagement programs, celebrations, offsites, and workshops to create a positive, ethical, collaborative, and effective work environment.
* Conduct employee satisfaction surveys, collate reports, and work on enhancing employee satisfaction.
* Build an employee communication and feedback loop through periodic organisation-wide meetings, one-on-one meetings, and feedback sessions.
* Ensure that employees have a clear understanding of their statutory obligations and proactively communicate changes in HR statutory and compliance requirements.

**What’s Required**

* Preferably MBA or a postgraduate qualification in human resources, organisational behaviour, psychology, learning and development, teaching, and/or a related field.
* 8-12 years of experience in learning and development, organisational capability building, training, teaching, or capacity development is a must.
* Experience designing digital learning programs on LMS platforms.
* Experience working with diverse stakeholders and string negotiation and representational skills.
* Experience of handling employee relations/grievances is preferred.
* Experience of designing and implementing employee engagement programs is preferred.
* Comfortable working in complex and changing environments.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi with the ability to engage with and influence diverse stakeholders in local languages. Knowledge of regional languages is a plus.
* Must meet the highest standards of ethics and personal integrity.
* Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time, mainly within India.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* Salary based on experience and education.
* Competitive benefits, including health insurance and generous vacation time.

**To Apply**

* We want to know more than just what you have done. We want to know who you are. What are the passions and talents that draw you to this role?
* Please apply to the link: https://visionspringfoundation.qandle.com/#/jobs?jobId=6aed6bbc4ec79ea3980100fb
* Please ensure there is a short description of each organisation on your CV/resume. Include your last name and “Manager, Talent Development” in the subject line.
* Please note that only candidates to be interviewed will be contacted.
* Evaluation of qualified candidates will include an assessment exercise, which will be followed by a competency-based interview.
* We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: HR Reporting Team Lead
description:
**Job Description**
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking a highly organized and analytically driven HR profession to join our Global Capability Center (GCC) as an HR reporting lead, supporting HR Technology & Insights across multiple regions. The role combines day-to-day people and workload leadership with hands-on delivery of reports, dashboards, data analysis, workforce structure maintenance, and mass data load coordination.
  
  
You will lead the intake, triage, prioritization, assignment, and timely delivery of reporting requests across the team, while ensuring consistent quality, clear stakeholder communication, and adherence to global standards. Working across multiple systems, data sources, countries, and business processes, you will consolidate and validate workforce data and identify opportunities to simplify, automate, standardize, and globalize reporting and HCM operational services.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Main Activities and Responsibilities:
  
  

* Deliver hands-on ad-hoc and recurring reports, data extracts, dashboards, and workforce insights for global HR and business stakeholders.
* Consolidate, reconcile, and validate data from Oracle HCM and other systems, sources, and countries to produce accurate and consistent global outputs.
* Manage the request intake process, including triage, clarification, prioritization, assignment, capacity planning, and escalation of risks or competing deadlines.
* Monitor workload, service levels, quality, and delivery commitments; provide stakeholders with clear status updates and proactively resolve delivery constraints.
* Translate stakeholder requests into well-defined reporting and operational requirements, confirming scope, definitions, logic, timing, and delivery expectations.
* Establish and enforce quality controls for reporting, data maintenance, and mass loads, including peer review, reconciliation, audit trails, and documented approvals.
* Analyze the reporting and operational portfolio to eliminate duplication, reduce manual effort, and identify opportunities for automation, standardization, globalization, and scalable delivery.
* Create and maintain SOPs, report catalogs, data definitions, process documentation, knowledge articles, and team delivery standards.

Provide operational metrics and insights on request volumes, cycle times, backlog, service performance, quality, automation benefits, and improvement opportunities.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Information Technology, Business, Human Resources, or a related field.
* Typically 5+ years of experience in HR reporting, analytics, HR systems, workforce data, or shared services operations, including experience coordinating or leading the work of others.
* Demonstrated experience supporting global or multi-country stakeholders and delivering across multiple priorities and time zones.
* Experience with Oracle HCM Cloud and Oracle reporting tools, particularly OTBI, is strongly preferred.

Key Competencies and Skills
  
  

* Strong hands-on reporting, data analysis, reconciliation, and data quality capabilities.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills; experience with dashboarding, data visualization, automation, or query tools is an advantage.
* Proficiency with Power BI (data modelling, DAX, visualization design)
* Ability to manage an intake queue, assess urgency and business impact, balance capacity, and drive work through to completion.
* Strong team leadership, delegation, and quality review skills, with the ability to develop junior analysts.
* Ability to translate complex or ambiguous requests into clear requirements, delivery plans, and practical solutions.
* Strong process improvement mindset, with demonstrated ability to standardize, automate, document, and scale services.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence working across cultures, functions, and levels of seniority.
* High attention to detail and sound judgment when handling sensitive workforce data.

Personal Attributes
  
  

* Service-oriented and accountable, with a strong focus on reliable delivery and stakeholder experience.
* Collaborative and inclusive team leader who builds capability, encourages knowledge sharing, and supports others’ success.
* Proactive, organized, and comfortable making prioritization decisions in a fast-paced global environment.
* Curious and improvement-focused, with a willingness to challenge inefficient or inconsistent ways of working.
* Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to navigate changing priorities, incomplete information, and cross-regional complexity.

BGV:
  
  

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

**About Us**
WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
With approximately
**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**
, in 550
**offices across 40 countries**
, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
**Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**

* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.

***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***
**Working with Us**
At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.

title: General Manager - HR (People & Culture)
description:
This is a full-time role at WTF's head office in Sector 9, Noida, six days a week, fully on-site. It is not remote or hybrid.

WTF is a fast-growing group of fitness and health businesses: gyms, a fitness academy, gym business services, digital products and a doctor-led health programme. We are hiring across every one of them at the same time. We need one senior person to run the whole people function, from day one, in a company that is still being built.

This is a startup seat. There is no settled system to inherit and no large team waiting. You will find things half-built or broken, decide what matters this week, do the work yourself where needed, and build the team and process as you go. If you have only worked where HR was already set up, this will not suit you.

**What you will run**

* Hiring: every role across the group, from front-desk and trainers to sales teams and senior hires, with a funnel you can show in numbers (applied, interviewed, offered, joined, stayed 90 days).
* HR business partnering: one accountable HR partner for each business head.
* Performance: goals, monthly reviews, a clear system for rewarding and exiting.
* Payroll and HR operations: attendance, records, payroll inputs on time and correct, HRMS.
* Compliance: PF, ESI, labour law, POSH, contracts and documentation.
* Learning and development: onboarding and training that shows up in results.
* Employee happiness: people know what is expected, get heard, and stay.

**Who fits**

* 8 to 15 years in HR, with at least 3 years owning the full function, not one speciality.
* You have built or rebuilt HR at a startup or scale-up that grew fast, ideally from under 100 people to several hundred or more, with frontline, sales and corporate teams.
* You have hired at volume and can quote your own numbers.
* You are comfortable with speed, changing priorities and incomplete information, and you still close things.
* You work from data: trackers, dashboards and written processes you made yourself.

**How we assess**

A conversation about what you personally built, a short practical HR case, and one tracker or process you authored (redacted). A senior title alone is not evidence.

Please be ready to share your current CTC, notice period and where you live. Compensation is discussed after we meet.

description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

The **Support Manager – Corp Systems** builds and leads an offshore team responsible for troubleshooting, diagnosing, resolving, and preventing production issues across corporate applications, platforms, integrations, and shared services. The role combines people leadership, technical judgment, and service discipline to minimize business disruption and improve reliability.

Working with enterprise service management, technology teams, vendors, and business stakeholders, the manager oversees incident response, operational readiness, problem resolution, and continuous improvement. All support activities follow enterprise incident, problem, change, request, and knowledge-management processes, approved tools, standards, and governance; improvements and exceptions are coordinated with the appropriate enterprise owners.

  
  
**How you'll make an impact**  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Support Team Leadership and Capability Building**

* Build and lead an offshore production-support team with clear roles, coverage expectations, escalation paths, and accountability for service outcomes.
* Plan capacity, hiring, onboarding, development, succession, and retention to meet support demand and build cross-platform diagnostic capability.
* Set clear expectations, coach and recognize colleagues, address performance concerns promptly, and foster ownership, collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning.
* Maintain sustainable shifts, on-call coverage, handoffs, and backup arrangements aligned with enterprise coverage requirements and workforce policies.

**Incident Management, Troubleshooting, and Resolution**

* Oversee incident intake through closure in the enterprise IT service-management (ITSM) platform, ensuring accurate records, timely escalation, validated recovery, and follow-up.
* Guide structured diagnosis using approved tools, logs, telemetry, and runbooks to isolate failures, assess business impact, and identify application, data, integration, or infrastructure dependencies.
* Lead the Corp Systems technical response within enterprise major-incident command, coordinating responders, vendors, workarounds, recovery, and executive engagement.
* Agree Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 ownership and handoffs, applying enterprise severity definitions, service targets, routing, escalation, and swarming practices.
* Drive root-cause analysis and permanent remediation for recurring or material incidents through enterprise problem management, maintaining known-error records, tracking corrective actions to verified completion, and escalating overdue or ineffective remediation.
* Provide timely, audience-appropriate incident updates on impact, status, recovery, and next steps using enterprise communication protocols and channels.

**Service Operations and Reliability**

* Manage support queues, backlog, service levels, aging, reopen rates, and demand trends using enterprise ITSM tools and metric definitions.
* Assess support readiness for new services and material changes, confirming ownership, knowledge transfer, runbooks, monitoring, access, and recovery arrangements; route unresolved risks and acceptance decisions through authorized release and change governance.
* Partner with service owners and enterprise monitoring teams to improve detection, actionable alerting, and routing while reducing missed incidents and alert noise.
* Coordinate maintenance, release support, peak-period readiness, disaster recovery, and business continuity within enterprise plans, calendars, and testing standards.
* Enforce enterprise production-access, security, data-protection, and change controls, escalating suspected security incidents through established procedures.

**Stakeholder, Vendor, and Cross-Functional Partnership**

* Build trusted partnerships across business and technology teams, clarifying service ownership and coordinating cross-platform resolution through established escalation paths.
* Manage vendor performance against contracted support commitments and corrective actions in partnership with enterprise vendor-management and procurement owners.
* Report service health, incidents, risks, capacity, and improvement priorities using enterprise dashboards and metrics; use trends to guide reliability, remediation, technical-debt, and investment decisions.
* Partner with local HR on workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, development, performance, engagement, retention, and organizational changes, following enterprise policies and local requirements.

**Knowledge, Automation, AI, and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain current runbooks, known errors, service maps, diagnostic guidance, escalation contacts, and recovery procedures in approved repositories, incorporating incident lessons and enterprise knowledge standards.
* Implement and measure improvements that prevent recurring issues and reduce support demand through better controls, shift-left, self-service, and automation; agree tier transfers with receiving teams and follow enterprise change controls.
* Apply approved AI and automation to accelerate triage and diagnosis, improve knowledge use, and reduce repetitive work, following enterprise AI, security, data, testing, and change governance with human oversight.

Build technical depth and reduce reliance on individual experts through cross-training, simulations, incident reviews, and ongoing learning in support engineering, observability, AI, platform capabilities, cybersecurity, and service management.

  
  
**About you**  

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 7+ years in enterprise support, production operations, support engineering, service management, or related technology roles, including 3+ years leading technical support teams.
* Demonstrated success building and managing offshore, global, or follow-the-sun support teams.
* Strong cross-platform troubleshooting skills, using logs, telemetry, alerts, and technical evidence to diagnose application, cloud, API, data, identity, integration, and infrastructure issues.
* Experience leading major incidents through restoration and corrective action, with sound judgment on business impact, severity, escalation, security, data protection, and production change.
* Working knowledge of incident, problem, change, request, knowledge, and service-level management, with experience applying enterprise processes, tools, data standards, and governance.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, workforce planning, and vendor-management capability.
* Clear written and verbal communication and strong stakeholder management in a global, matrixed environment, including high-pressure incident updates for technical and business audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience supporting corporate systems across SaaS, cloud, packaged, custom-developed, and integrated solutions.
* Experience with ITSM, observability, application monitoring, log analytics, AI-assisted operations, and intelligent automation.
* Experience establishing support readiness within Agile, product, DevOps, or release-management models.
* Experience in insurance, financial services, professional services, or another regulated global enterprise.
* ITIL, cloud, service-management, platform, or relevant technical certification.

  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

title: Senior Software Engineer - CPD
description:
**Location : Bangalore/Pune**  
**About Team & About Role:**

  

As a Senior Software Engineer (SSE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org.

You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup & management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains.

We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and harden identity and access flows — OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations — that sit in front of mission-critical systems.
* Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions.
* Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought.
* Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic.
* Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly.
* Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed.
* Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET.
* Write and enhance end-to-end tests covering auth flows, failure modes, and edge cases (clock skew, revoked tokens, malformed assertions, etc.).
* Document known issues, workarounds, and design decisions in the team knowledge base as the team and product mature.
* Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status.

**Requirements**
  
  
**Must-have**

* Minimum experience of at least 8 Years
* Strong hands-on programming skills in **Golang**.
* Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols: **OIDC/OAuth 2.0** and **SAML 2.0** — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes.
* Working knowledge of **Active Directory**.
* Applied cryptography/PKI experience: **X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS**.
* Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work.
* Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency.
* Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts.
* Simple, effective written and verbal communication.

**Nice-to-have**

* Directory internals (schema, bind operations).
* HTTP internals and reverse proxying (TLS, header injection).
* Build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI).
* Secret-manager internals, Redis, Win32, policy engines.
* Basic C#/.NET (to maintain the companion app).

* **Emergency Plan Execution: Activate and manage site Emergency Action Plans (EAPs), standard operating procedures (SOPs), and evacuation protocols.**

* **Evacuation & Accountability: Direct full or partial plant evacuations, oversee assembly/muster points, and coordinate roll-call tracking for employees, contractors, and visitors.**

* **Agency & First Responder Liaison: Act as the primary onsite point of contact for external fire departments, police and regulatory bodies (such as local disaster management).**

* **Containment & Mitigation: Direct initial containment operations (e.g., sprinkler/deluge system activation, emergency shutdown of specific production / R&D lines, power isolations) while safeguarding personnel.**

* **Communication & Alerting: Issue emergency notifications, plant-wide alarms, and status updates to senior plant leadership, corporate crisis teams, and neighbouring facilities.**

* **Post-Incident & Reporting: Lead initial incident debriefings, preserve accident scenes for investigation, coordinate root-cause analysis with the EHS team, and draft official emergency logs.**

* **Readiness & Drills: Conduct routine emergency drills, inspect emergency response equipment (AEDs, spill kits, eyewash stations, SCBA gear, fire suppression systems), and verify ERT shift rosters.**

title: Manager, Regional Security Operations Center
description:
**About the Team**
------------------

DoorDash is one of the world's most trusted on-demand logistics platforms. The Global Safety and Security team exists to keep it that way, protecting our people, property, operations, brand, and reputation across all our markets. We manage risk and create value through agility, technology, and a people-first approach. Our DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt brands now span more than 40 countries, dozens of offices, and tens of thousands of employees. We strive to stay ahead of emerging threats and be there for our people anytime, anywhere.

**About the Role**
------------------

We're hiring a **Manager, Regional Security Operations Center** to ensure the operational integrity and continuous improvement of one of DoorDash's 24/7 remote physical security monitoring and response centers. The Regional Security Operations Center monitors physical security threats and coordinates responses to incidents affecting our people, facilities, and operations around the world. This is an in-person position based in Hyderabad, India. This is not a cybersecurity role.

Reporting to the Manager, Global Safety and Security Operations, you will directly manage a team of analysts, ensuring effective incident response, consistent execution, and scalable performance across an always-on operation. You will work across operations, training, reporting, and incident response to translate global security strategy into reliable day-to-day execution.

**You're excited about this opportunity because you will…**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Manage and develop a team of analysts:** Directly lead a team of analysts, set clear expectations, coach performance, support professional development, and build accountability and engagement.
* **Serve as an escalation point during significant incidents and emergencies:** Exercise sound judgment and critical thinking to assess rapidly evolving situations, make timely decisions, and coordinate response efforts through resolution.
* **Support 24/7 physical security operations in a follow-the-sun model:** Help maintain around-the-clock readiness for threat detection, risk assessment, and physical security incident response across all shifts, including support for global incidents and other operations center locations.
* **Strengthen incident management:** Support escalation frameworks and response quality for complex incidents.
* **Own metrics, reporting, and continuous improvement:** Ensure performance targets are met, monitor service health, and drive continuous improvement in operational performance. Regularly report on operational health to leadership and address deficiencies.
* **Drive efficiency and automation:** Identify opportunities to streamline and automate repetitive or high-volume work, reduce analyst workload, and improve response speed.
* **Lead training and capability development:** Build and maintain training programs, exercises, and assessments that strengthen analyst capabilities.
* **Strengthen standards and procedures:** Partner with leadership to develop, maintain, and enforce standard operating procedures (SOPs), escalation frameworks, and quality standards.
* **Model leadership under pressure:** Demonstrate accountability, structured problem-solving, and calm execution during periods of heightened operational activity.

**We're excited about you because you bring…**
----------------------------------------------

* **Operational and crisis management experience:** At least six years of experience in crisis management, security operations, law enforcement, the military, a GSOC, RSOC, or SOC, or a comparable 24/7 operations or incident response environment.
* **Leadership and team development experience:** At least three years of experience leading or supervising a team, including coaching, providing performance feedback, and hiring.
* **Relevant education:** A bachelor's or master's degree in a related field from an accredited college or university.
* **A bias for action:** A proven ability to act with urgency, anticipate challenges, and implement practical solutions that deliver measurable improvements.
* **Training and program execution skills:** The ability to design, deliver, and evaluate training programs, exercises, and continuous learning initiatives.
* **A data-driven mindset:** Proficiency with key performance indicators (KPIs), dashboards, trend analysis, and performance improvement metrics.
* **Cross-functional collaboration skills:** The ability to partner effectively with technical and non-technical teams across complex organizations.
* **Composure and sound judgment:** Calm, structured decision-making in time-sensitive or ambiguous operational situations.
* **Availability for escalation support and travel:** The ability to provide escalation support at any time, including nights, weekends, and holidays, and to travel up to 25% of the time, as needed.

**About DoorDash**
==================

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
=============================================

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.
  
  
If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

* Strong knowledge of computer hardware and experience supporting Windows and macOS operating systems.
* Hands-on experience with hardware troubleshooting, device imaging, configuration, and deployment.
* Strong technical troubleshooting skills with the ability to identify and resolve moderately complex technical issues.
* Experience supporting end-user devices, peripherals, printers, and audio-visual equipment.
* Understanding of IT asset management, hardware lifecycle processes, and ticket management systems.

------------------------------

**Mindset**

* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a strong willingness to learn.
* Ability to prioritise competing requirements and manage time effectively.
* Dependable and accountable, with a strong sense of ownership for resolving technical issues.
* Flexible and adaptable, with the willingness to support after-hours requirements and travel to other locations when needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Bachelor's degree in a related field is preferred.
* CompTIA A+ certification.
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
* Experience with Windows and macOS operating systems, imaging systems, Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, and antivirus solutions.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Opportunity

HSBC is looking for an experienced Post Trade Technology Engineering Lead within Markets & Securities Services Operational Technology in a global role based in India. This role will shape engineering across Debt Trading, Equities Post Trade and Markets Asset Servicing Technology. You’ll own a multi-year, multi-million-dollar programme to build strategic middleware from the ground up. The platform will set the future standard for how HSBC systems connect with vendor platforms and will provide a repeatable blueprint for future implementations across the bank. Success means delivering a robust, scalable solution built with strong engineering practices, modern automation and clear business outcomes.

  

What you'll be doing

* Design and build a strategic middleware platform using Core Java and Microservices with hands-on coding where needed
* Set the architecture and technical direction for the programme and ensure alignment to long-term engineering strategy
* Own solution design decisions and governance to keep delivery focused on quality, performance and maintainability
* Establish engineering practices that strengthen automation, quality controls and continuous improvement across the team
* Implement and mature DevSecOps and CI/CD pipelines with a focus on security, efficiency and high levels of automation
* Champion the use of AI tooling in software development and translate adoption into tangible business benefits
* Oversee delivery accountabilities across the middleware build whether operating as a team manager or senior individual contributor
* Mentor engineers and build ways of working that support a collaborative high-performing engineering culture

What we're looking for

* Bring extensive hands-on engineering or architecture experience with deep expertise in Core Java and Microservices-based architectures
* Show proven delivery of complex large-scale systems built from scratch within financial services preferably in post-trade processing
* Apply strong working knowledge of DevSecOps principles and tooling including building and running automated CI/CD pipelines
* Demonstrate practical experience using AI in software development including AI coding assistants and articulating business value
* Evidence effective technical decision-making and the ability to mentor engineers and shape team engineering standards
* Bring domain understanding of the trade lifecycle including clearing settlement and securities servicing
* Apply structured problem-solving to deliver in complex fast-paced environments
* Work effectively with global stakeholders in agile DevOps teams to deliver outcomes at pace

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.
  
www.hsbc.com/careers

Building the future of post-trade

This is a rare opportunity to create a strategic platform that will shape how systems connect across HSBC. You’ll have the scope to set technical direction, embed modern engineering practices and build something that becomes a reference point for future delivery. If you’re excited by hands-on engineering impact at scale and want to help set a new standard for post-trade technology we’d like to hear from you.

  

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. title: Associate Technical Support Consultant
description:
**Overview**
------------

Provides frontline technical support to clients via the telephone, email, chat, and monitoring alerts. Logs, triages, and resolves common, known issues at the first point of contact wherever possible, following standard operating procedures (SOPs) and knowledge base (KB) articles, and escalates unresolved or complex issues to the appropriate technical team within defined SLA timelines.

**Primary Objective:** Log, troubleshoot, and resolve tickets at the first level wherever possible, escalating only when the issue requires advanced technical investigation.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Receive client issues through phone, email, chat, or monitoring alerts and create tickets in ServiceNow (or the relevant ticketing tool) with accurate details, business impact, and priority.

* Investigate reported issues using standard operating procedures (SOPs), knowledge base (KB) articles, Windows utilities, and basic SQL queries.

* Identify and resolve common, known issues at the first point of contact wherever possible, minimizing ticket turnaround time.

* Record all investigation steps, actions taken, findings, and resolution details in the ticketing system.

* Categorize tickets, assess impact and urgency, assign the appropriate priority, and route or triage unresolved issues to the relevant technical team.

* Monitor ticket queues, identify pending or high-priority incidents, and ensure tickets are acknowledged and actioned within defined SLAs.

* Keep clients informed about ticket progress, immediate workarounds, resolutions, and escalations.

* Document outstanding tickets, actions taken, pending activities, and next steps for the incoming shift.

* Use company-approved AI tools (such as AI assistants and copilots) to help search knowledge base articles, summarize tickets, and draft client updates, while reviewing all output for accuracy and never entering PHI or confidential client data into unapproved tools.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Academic Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.

* Equivalent combination of education and relevant technical support experience may be considered.

### **Experience**

* 1 to 2 years of relevant experience in technical support, IT service desk/help desk, or a related technical domain.

* Working knowledge of ServiceNow or a relevant ticketing tool.

* Basic understanding of Windows operating systems.

* Basic SQL query skills.

* Good written and verbal communication, documentation, and customer service skills.

* Ability to prioritize tickets and resolve issues within SLA timelines.

* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.

* Good to have basic understanding of healthcare workflows and enterprise software support.

* Good to have basic exposure to HL7 or healthcare IT concepts.

### **Basic AI Knowledge**

* Basic understanding of what AI is, including generative AI and large language models (LLMs), and how AI assistants can support day-to-day technical support work.

* Familiarity with writing clear, specific prompts to get useful results, such as summarizing ticket history, drafting client communications, or finding relevant KB articles.

* Awareness that AI output can be inaccurate or incomplete, and the habit of validating AI-generated content against SOPs, KB articles, and system behavior before using it.

* Understanding of data privacy and security expectations when using AI tools, including never sharing PHI, credentials, or confidential client information with unapproved tools.

* Willingness to learn and adopt new AI-enabled tools and workflows as they are introduced.

**Travel / Shift Requirements**
-------------------------------

* Position requires working late evening and night shifts, as part of a 24/7 rotational shift pattern.

* Participation in after-hours, weekend, holiday, and on-call support rotations will be required to support critical client needs.
