title: Technical Support Consultant
description:
**Overview**

Provide help desk and technical support to clients through inbound telephone calls, ServiceNow, email, and chat, including after-hours coverage. Assess business impact, document and prioritize requests, troubleshoot application, server, database, and access issues, and resolve problems within established support procedures. Coordinate timely escalation to the appropriate teams when additional expertise is required.

Primary Objective: Deliver responsive, professional call support and after-hours assistance, maintain clear client communication, and work with internal teams to resolve critical and escalated issues with minimal business disruption.

**Responsibilities**

* Answer inbound support calls and respond to email, chat, and monitoring alerts. Create accurate ServiceNow tickets that capture the issue, business impact, priority, contact information, and troubleshooting performed.

* Guide clients through troubleshooting with clear, professional communication, confirm understanding of the issue, and set expectations for next steps and follow-up.

* Troubleshoot client questions and technical issues involving system configuration, product functionality, SQL Server, and HL7 interfaces; document suspected defects and enhancement requests.

* Investigate application, server, database, access, and infrastructure-related issues using Windows Event Logs, IIS logs, and SQL queries.

* Execute SQL queries, including multi-table JOINs, to investigate application errors, validate records, and identify data inconsistencies.

* Identify root causes where possible, implement approved fixes or workarounds, validate service restoration, and update tickets with complete resolution details.

* Triage complex issues and route or escalate cases to the appropriate support, Development, Hosting, or Professional Services teams, providing complete troubleshooting details and business impact.

* Coordinate with internal teams during critical or major incident calls and follow established after-hours escalation and notification procedures.

* Support P1/P2 incident triage by gathering logs, analyzing error patterns, documenting incident timelines, and assisting incident coordinators with technical updates.

* Maintain ownership of assigned tickets, communicate progress and blockers, and provide timely client updates in accordance with service-level agreements (SLAs).

* Maintain complete case documentation, troubleshooting guides, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and known-error articles. Provide clear shift handovers covering open issues, business impact, actions taken, ownership, and next steps.

* Share recurring issues, suspected defects, and client feedback with Product Development to support product improvements.

* Stay current with supported products, releases, technical changes, and support tools, including approved AI-assisted capabilities.

* Use company-approved AI tools to assist with knowledge searches, case summaries, troubleshooting research, and drafting client updates or knowledge articles. Verify outputs before use and protect client, patient, and company information in accordance with applicable policies.

* Work assigned late-evening and overnight shifts to provide consistent after-hours client support.

* Participate in weekend, holiday, and on-call rotations as part of a 24/7 support schedule.

**Qualifications**

**Academic Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Nursing, Pharmacy, Nursing Informatics, or related discipline.

* Equivalent combination of healthcare, clinical, and information technology experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* 2–4 years of relevant experience in help desk support, technical support, healthcare IT, enterprise software support, or a related technical field.

* Working knowledge of ServiceNow or a comparable ticketing system, including case documentation, prioritization, routing, and queue management.

* Experience supporting international clients across multiple regions and time zones.

* Strong telephone, written, and verbal communication skills, with a customer-focused approach and the ability to explain technical information clearly.

* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team.

* Ability to prioritize incoming calls and support requests, manage multiple active cases, and meet established response and follow-up expectations.

* Experience with writing SQL and T-SQL queries, including multi-table JOINs, using Microsoft SQL Server.

* Intermediate Windows Server troubleshooting skills, including IIS, and basic knowledge of the U.S. healthcare industry.

* Experience troubleshooting software issues, analyzing technical evidence, and recognizing when additional expertise or escalation is required.

* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams and managing complex client situations.

* Foundational knowledge of generative AI and AI-assisted support tools, including writing clear prompts, reviewing outputs for accuracy, recognizing limitations, and handling sensitive information responsibly. Practical experience using AI for support research, documentation, or communication is preferred.

* Basic understanding of HL7 messaging and interfaces is preferred.

* Basic functional and technical knowledge of enterprise healthcare software solutions is preferred.

* Familiarity with healthcare workflows, clinical systems, and healthcare industry practices is preferred.

**Travel / Shift Requirements**

* Some travel may be required for client engagement, collaboration, or onsite support activities.

* Availability for assigned evening, overnight, weekend, holiday, and on-call rotations is required to support 24/7 client needs.

**Cloud Automation Engineer(3-5 years)**

  

Here at Anaplan, we have reinvented how companies see, plan, and run their businesses. Our platform allows our customers to uncover new insights, connect their strategy to their plans, and work in ways they had not previously thought possible. We're growing fast, constantly innovating, and couldn't be prouder to help our customers move forward with confidence in a sophisticated and changing world.

We are looking for forward-thinking people who bend over backward to put customers first. Individuals who thrive on challenge and are ready to grasp the opportunity of a lifetime. Because we fundamentally believe every colleague brings unique value to our whole. We are a workplace where each person feels seen, heard, and valued, and can contribute their unique talent to our collective effort. We believe that for ourselves and for our customers.

  

**Cloud Automation Engineer – Anaplan IN**

We are looking for a Cloud Automation Engineer to join our growing team at Anaplan IN as part of the Foundation Engineering team. You'll be working in a global environment, supporting the development and maintenance of our hybrid multi-cloud infrastructure.

  

This role is ideal for someone eager to grow their cloud automation skills while working on meaningful projects. You'll work closely with experienced engineers, learning best practices in cloud architecture, automation, and infrastructure management.

  

**What you will do:**

* Support the design and implementation of scalable and secure infrastructure in a hybrid, multi-cloud environment (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* Assist in managing infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform and Docker.
* Develop and maintain configuration code with a focus on reusability and scalability.
* Participate in the automation of testing and deployment of infrastructure.
* Collaborate with Platform Engineering and other teams to ensure infrastructure meets scalability and resilience requirements.
* Learn and contribute to cloud architecture best practices.
* Help identify opportunities to optimize cloud resource usage and improve efficiency.
  

**What we're looking for:**

* Hands-on experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure).

* Experience with scripting languages such as Python or Bash.
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
* Understanding of automation tools such as Terraform.
* Working knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems and basic networking concepts.
* Experience with or willingness to learn about REST APIs and automation pipelines.
* BSc degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  

**Preferred Experience (Nice to have):**

* Exposure to monitoring tools like Grafana or Prometheus.
* Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins).
* Basic knowledge of containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Chef).

  

This is a great opportunity to develop your cloud automation skills in a supportive environment while working on impactful projects at scale. If you're eager to learn and ready to dive into cloud technologies, we'd love to hear from you!

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren't just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it's how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

**Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer**

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

* Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
* Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

title: Network Engineer-Assistant Manager-Bangalore
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a Network Consultant to provide first-line diagnosis and troubleshooting for IPVPN, Internet and other IP network faults. You will handle customer-reported incidents from initial diagnosis through resolution, working with customers, internal support teams, service providers and vendors to restore services within agreed service levels. The role operates in a 24/7 environment and requires shift working, including night shifts.
  
  
The position requires practical telecommunications and IT service knowledge, particularly across IP and transmission networks, alongside effective customer communication and incident management capabilities.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Perform first-line diagnosis for IP-related incidents, including IPVPN and Internet faults
* Handle customer calls, raise incident tickets and gather the technical information required to investigate reported problems
* Diagnose and troubleshoot technical issues, including network configuration and complex faults involving Cisco routers, switches and Alcatel routers
* Manage fault reporting, isolation and escalation in line with established processes and agreed service levels
* Work with internal support teams, service partners and vendors to resolve circuit and network faults
* Coordinate with global service providers and follow incident management processes to resolve customer-reported incidents
* Take ownership of customer issues throughout the incident journey and provide prompt, accurate updates
* Identify when escalation is required and support effective escalation and de-escalation throughout incident resolution
* Support timely fault resolution within agreed SLAs and KPIs, helping minimise the risk of service credits and maintain a positive customer experience
* Work within a 24/7 shift environment, including night shifts

**Who You Are**
You bring a combination of technical network troubleshooting expertise, telecommunications knowledge and customer-focused communication. The role requires:
  
  

* 1+ years' experience within a telecom service provider or systems integrator environment.
* Good knowledge of troubleshooting transmission and IP networks.
* Technical troubleshooting knowledge across IP networks, including Cisco routers, switches and Alcatel routers.
* Knowledge of telecommunications and IT service models and their practical application.
* Experience escalating incidents and working with technology vendors, other service providers and third-party suppliers to drive resolution.
* Experience contributing to process, system and capability improvements.
* Good customer-handling, communication and collaborative teamwork skills.
* An Engineering degree or equivalent technical background. The JD specifies a Bachelor of Engineering degree with CCNA as essential, while Diploma/BE qualifications in Telecom or Computer Science and CCNA/CCNP certifications are identified as desirable
* ITIL Foundation-level qualification.
* An understanding of submarine cable systems and basic CCNA Voice knowledge.
* Previous fixed-line IP troubleshooting and customer service experience is desirable.
* Curiosity and willingness to develop knowledge across different technologies and technical disciplines

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
This role provides hands-on exposure to global telecommunications operations, customer-facing incident management and troubleshooting across IP and transmission networks. You will collaborate with customers, internal teams, service providers and technology vendors while developing practical experience in resolving network incidents within an SLA-driven environment.
  
  
**What Skills You Will Learn**

* IPVPN, Internet, transmission and IP network troubleshooting
* Structured incident diagnosis, escalation and end-to-end resolution
* Practical troubleshooting across Cisco routers and switches and Alcatel routers
* Working effectively with global service providers, technology vendors and internal technical teams
* Customer communication throughout the incident lifecycle
* SLA- and KPI-focused network service management
* Continuous improvement across processes, systems and technical capabilities

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
  
  
#JDEnhancedByTARA

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/voisglobal/

Come as you are!
  
  
As a trailblazer and catalyst for change, Lighthouse rises to each opportunity to help our clients and our people do what they do best—shine.

description:

https://www.msxi.com/en/

, we’ve been partnering with le ading automotive companies for over 25 years, helping them enhance their retail strategies and streamline operations. **Job Summary:**
The Diagnostic Support Engineer will be responsible for monitoring DTC (Diagnostic Trouble Codes) and CAN (Controller Area Network) parameters at the Command Center (CC) 24/7. The role involves guiding customers and drivers, managing escalations, and coordinating with dealers to resolve vehicle issues efficiently.
  
  
**Location:**
Oragadam, Tamil Nadu
  
  
**Experience:**
1-2 years
  
  
**Industry:**
Automotive
  
  
**Working Days :**
6 days (Rotational week off & National Holidays)
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* 24/7 Monitoring: Monitor DTC/CAN parameters at the Command Centre and raise tickets immediately when an issue is detected.
* Ticketing: Respond to triggered DTC/CAN alerts by creating internal tickets in the DMS system (with automation in phase 2).
* Customer Assistance: Provide Level 1 (L1) support over the phone, guiding customers/drivers to resolve minor issues.
* Critical DTCs: For vehicles with critical DTCs (e.g., "Service Now" category), guide them to the nearest dealer.

title: Specialist II, Audit & Advisory (IT and Cybersecurity Audit)
description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

**Team Overview**

The Global Audit & Advisory (GAA) function is an independent and objective assurance and advisory organization that helps strengthen governance, risk management, and internal controls across the enterprise. The India Global Capability Center (GCC) serves as a strategic extension of the global GAA organization, providing audit and advisory support across the United States, United Kingdom, APAC, Africa, and Global business functions.
  
The IT & Cybersecurity team within GAA GCC partners with global stakeholders to assess technology and cybersecurity risks, evaluate the effectiveness of controls, and provide insights that support business resiliency and regulatory compliance. The team executes audits and advisory engagements covering cybersecurity, cloud technologies, infrastructure, identity and access management, vulnerability management, SDLC, data protection, disaster recovery, and emerging technology initiatives.
  
This role offers exposure to a broad range of technologies, cybersecurity domains, cloud platforms, and business initiatives, providing significant opportunities for professional growth and global stakeholder engagement.

This is a hybrid position and involves regular performance of job responsibilities virtually as well as in-person at an assigned TU office location for a minimum of two days a week.  
  

**Role Overview And Core Responsibilities**

* Support the planning and execution of IT and cybersecurity audits, advisory reviews, and risk assessments.
* Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of IT and cybersecurity controls across applications, infrastructure, databases, networks, and cloud environments.
* Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of IT General Controls (ITGCs), cybersecurity controls, and technology governance processes.
* Assess key areas including cybersecurity, access management, cloud security, incident management, business continuity, disaster recovery, and system implementations.
* Perform control testing, analyze results, and document audit conclusions and observations.
* Prepare audit reports and communicate risks, control gaps, and remediation recommendations to stakeholders.
* Communicate observations, control weaknesses, and associated risks to stakeholders in a clear and professional manner.
* Where appropriate, lead portions of engagements and facilitate discussions regarding remediation actions and risk mitigation strategies.
* Track and monitor remediation activities for open audit findings and validate the implementation of corrective actions.
* Stay informed of emerging cybersecurity threats, industry trends, and leading practices, while contributing to departmental initiatives and continuous improvement efforts.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with global stakeholders while preserving audit independence
* Participate in departmental initiatives, special projects, knowledge-sharing activities, and continuous improvement efforts that support GAA objectives and strategic priorities
  

  

**Required Knowledge And Experiences**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 3-7 years of experience in IT Audit, IT Risk, IT Assurance, or Information Security, including at least 2 years with a public accounting or professional services firm.
* Strong understanding of IT and cybersecurity frameworks, including NIST, CIS Controls, ISO 27001, and COBIT.
* Knowledge of key information security domains, including governance and risk management, access management, cloud security, network security, security architecture, application security, incident management, and business continuity/disaster recovery.
* Experience assessing IT and cybersecurity controls across on-premises and cloud environments, with a solid understanding of infrastructure, operating systems, databases, networking, and vulnerability management.
* Familiarity with security and governance tools such as Splunk, SailPoint IIQ, BMC Remedy, and audit management tools such as Optro (formerly AuditBoard).
* Strong analytical, risk assessment, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Self-motivated and adaptable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and respond effectively to changing business needs.
* Professional certification such as CISA or CISSP required.

Be a part of our **Workforce for Good** – you’ll work with great people, pioneering products and cutting-edge technology.

title: Senior Analyst - Risk Analytics
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

Exposure Management is a high profile and continuously growing area of the Gallagher Specialty business. The team works closely with the various Gallagher Specialty business units, which includes US Property, International property, Facilities, Natural Resources, Marine, Construction, Financial Lines, along with the Gallagher US Retail as well as various Gallagher retail offices globally, to assist clients in managing their exposure data, using RMS and AIR catastrophe models to ensure clients have the correct cover in the correct locations. The role also involves the visualisation of data and facility catastrophe modelling.
  
  
We also work closely with Lloyds and London Market Insurers to provide exposure data and modelled losses on singular and at a portfolio level, which includes binders and facilities.

  
  
**How you'll make an impact**

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Play a key role in growing the Exposure Analytics and Catastrophe Modelling function within
    
  Gallagher Specialty which will involve taking responsibility for delivering Exposure Analytics &
    
  Catastrophe Modelling reports (both Moody’s RMS and AIR) for the various business units we work
    
  with
* Performing Schedule of Values (SOV) data cleansing and scrubbing where required
* Help create new opportunities for the business through the expansion of client and carrier analytics
* Perform quality control checks on all policies entered the Catastrophe Models across multiple lines of
    
  business to ensure data accuracy
* Ensure any errors found are rectified and correct before delivery of analytics to stakeholders
* Ensure standard operating procedures and minimum data quality standards are adhered to
* Ensure internal and external KPI’s and SLAs are met
* Develop new initiatives in this exciting and fast-growing area of the business

  
  
**About you**

**Qualifications:**

  

* Educated to degree level in a subject such as Mathematics, Statistics, Geography, Engineering or Meteorology
* Professional qualifications such as a DIP CII or ACII or a desire to take them
* CCRA qualification is desirable but not essential

**Key Skills and Experience:**

* 3+ years previous Catastrophe Modelling experience gained at either an Insurer or Broker
* Experience should include Property Catastrophe Modelling ideally using RMS Risk Modeler or Risk  
  Link
* Knowledge of LMP slips & the Lloyds and London Insurance Market
* Minimum of 3 years' experience using Catastrophe Models, in particular RMS Risklink / Risk Modeler
* Good knowledge of Moody's RMS and Verisk AIR data cleansing & coding best practices including  
  when using HD models
* Good technical understanding of data enrichment, manipulation and data cleansing best practices
* Ability to work quickly and precisely with large data sets
* A keen interest in data and Natural Catastrophes
* Self-Motivated
* Good communication and presentation skills
* Proactive in finding solutions to problems without waiting to be prompted by others
* Good MS office skills particularly Microsoft Excel and ideally Power BI
* Knowledge of GIS software such as Arc GIS
* Advanced SQL coding knowledge is essential for this role
* Python or R programming knowledge is desirable but not essential

  
  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation

description:
This is a full-time, on-site role in Delhi NCR, six days a week, based out of WTF's head office in Sector 9, Noida and our gyms across the city.

WTF Gyms is a fast-growing fitness group. The City Operations Head owns every WTF gym in the city: how each one runs, what it sells and how members feel about it. You are responsible for the city's revenue and its operations together.

**What you will own**

**1. Gym operations**

* Day-to-day running of all gyms in the city, to one standard.
* Operating procedures followed at every site: opening and closing, cleanliness, equipment uptime, safety.
* Facility maintenance and vendors, so that a breakdown is fixed the same day.
* A weekly scorecard for every gym.

**2. Sales and revenue**

* The city's membership and personal-training revenue targets, gym by gym.
* Local marketing and on-ground campaigns with the marketing team.

* Hiring, training and managing cluster managers, gym managers, front desk, sales and trainers.
* Regular performance reviews, clear targets, fast decisions on people.
* A team that takes ownership of its own gym.

**4. Member experience**

* A high standard of service at every gym, with complaints closed quickly.
* Member feedback collected and acted on.
* Retention and referrals as numbers you track.

**5. Money**

* A budget and a profit-and-loss view for each gym.
* Costs under control without hurting the member experience.

**6. Growth**

* New gym launches in the city: site readiness, team, pre-sales and opening.
* Market and competitor knowledge that shapes pricing and offers.

**Who fits**

* 5 or more years in multi-site operations with a sales target, in fitness, retail, quick-service restaurants, hospitality, co-living, quick commerce or similar.
* You have run several locations at once and can quote your numbers: sites, team size, revenue, growth.
* You are on the floor most days, not behind a desk.

title: Associate, Equity Trading Operations
description:
**Reports to**

Founder and Managing Partner

**Base**

Noida office, near Amity University (Sector 125). Office based.

**Engagement**

Full time, permanent. Three months' probation.

**Experience sought**

1 to 4 years

**Remuneration**

As per competency and market standards.

**Hours**

Market days, 9:00 am to 6:00 pm.

**Submission**

Send your CV and a short cover note to info@garnetglobalconsultants.com. Subject line: Associate, Equity Trading Operations.

**Purpose of the position**

The firm invests its own capital in Indian listed shares using a rules based trading system. The Associate will run this system day to day: operate the trading software, generate the system's recommendations, analyse and assess them, and put up buy and sell recommendations to the founder. The Associate will also work with AI tools such as Claude to improve the system and to run its scheduled tasks.

This is a hands on role for a person who follows a written process, keeps accurate records and learns new software quickly.

**Key responsibilities**

**●**
 Operate the trading software, charting platform and broker terminal every market day.

●     Generate the system's recommendations, analyse and assess them, and give buy and sell recommendations with reasons.

●     Place approved orders, confirm fills and keep the trade records up to date.

●     Work with AI tools such as Claude to run scheduled tasks, test improvements and keep the system's documents current.

●     Prepare the weekly and monthly review notes for the founder.

●     Prepare short, plain language updates for the firm's social media from the firm's own records.

●     Support the firm's other activities as assigned.

Full details of the system and the daily routine will be shared with shortlisted candidates at interview.

**Qualifications and experience**

Essential

● Graduate in commerce, finance, economics, engineering, statistics or a related field.

●     1 to 4 years in equity markets: dealing, research, trading operations, broker operations, or own trading with records that can be shown.

● Able to read price charts and understands stops, position sizing and timeframes.

●     Comfortable with spreadsheets, broker terminals and AI tools.

●     Writes clear, simple English and Hindi.

● Based in Noida or Delhi NCR.

Good to have

● NISM Series VIII (Equity Derivatives) or Series XV (Research Analyst).

●     Experience with TradingView and Zerodha Kite or similar platforms.

●     Experience with Claude, ChatGPT or similar AI tools in daily work.

●     Experience running social media for a brand or community.

●     Basic Python or spreadsheet automation.

**Competencies**

**●**
 Accuracy and discipline. Follows the written process and records what happened.

●     Reliability. Market hours are fixed and the routine runs every market day.

●     Plain writing. Short sentences, numbers from the record, no hype.

●     Discretion. The firm's system, data and records are confidential.

**Conduct and confidentiality**

**●**
 The firm invests its own capital only. It does not manage money for others and does not give investment advice. The Associate does not give tips or recommendations to anyone outside the firm.

●     A confidentiality agreement and a personal trading code apply.

●     Background and reference checks are completed before confirmation.

**Selection process**

* CV screening, a short chart reading test, and an interview with the founder.

description:
**Job Title**

Technical Help Desk Executive – ICE (Electrical & Mechanical)

Automobile Technical Help Desk

**Job Description**

The Technical Help Desk Executive – ICE (Electrical & Mechanical) plays a vital role in delivering real-time, remote technical support to dealership Technicians and Technical coordinators across the nation. Operating in an advanced AI-enabled help desk environment, the executive receives inbound calls that are auto-classified by an AI Voice Bot into Electrical or Mechanical streams. The AI pre-logs structured tickets containing Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs), vehicle details, and symptom summaries, pushing them via Screen Pop directly to the executive's monitor. The executive is responsible for guiding workshop technicians through systematic troubleshooting, coordinating with field teams, and achieving rapid ticket closure within target lead time SLAs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Inbound Call Handling & AI Screen Pop Integration
* Attend pre-routed incoming technical calls from dealership technicians across regional zones.
* Review pre-populated CRM ticket summaries (auto-generated by Speech-to-Text AI) on screen before engaging with the technician.
* Validate caller identity, dealership location, vehicle model, and confirmed diagnostic symptoms.

**Technical Diagnostics Support – ICE Electrical**

· **Ignition & Charging Systems:** Guide mechanics through step-by-step testing of ignition coils, spark plug circuits, magneto/stator coil output, and rectifier/regulator (RR) units.

· **Wiring Harness & Continuity:** Assist in diagnosing short circuits, open circuits, earth grounding issues, and harness voltage drops using digital multimeters.

· **ECU & Sensor Diagnostics:** Analyze Diagnostic Trouble Codes (DTCs), interpret ECU flashing/re-mapping failures, and troubleshoot sensor signals (O2, Throttle Position Sensor, Engine Temp Sensor).

· **Battery & Digital Display:** Address parasitic battery drain issues, charging circuit faults, and digital instrument cluster communication errors.

**Technical Diagnostics Support – ICE Mechanical**

· **Engine Core & Head Assembly:** Provide remote troubleshooting for engine knocking/noises, valve clearance/tappet settings, compression loss, and piston/cylinder wear.

· **Transmission & Clutch:** Guide technicians on clutch slipping, hard gear shifting, gearbox noise, and clutch assembly tolerances.

· **Fuel Injection (FI) & Intake:** Troubleshoot electronic fuel pump pressure, fuel injector clogging, throttle body cleaning/calibration, and air-fuel ratio faults.

· **Brakes & Suspension:** Assist in hydraulic brake air-bleeding, ABS mechanical binding, front fork oil leakage, and rear shock absorber performance.

**Field Team Coordination & Escalation Management**

· Maintain continuous telephone/ticket coordination with Manager Technical support for chronic or critical field issues.

· Escalate to Product monitoring when remote phone diagnosis reaches a boundary limit.

· Escalate unresolved, high-complexity, or repeated technical failures to Level-3

· Log detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and component replacement codes into the CRM to enrich the Knowledge Base.

**Criteria Parameter**

Work Experience / Apprenticeship at authorized 2W OEM Dealerships, Multi-brand Workshops, or Auto Service Centers is highly desirable.

title: Supply Chain Project Manager / Project Supply Lead
description:
**Create a better future!**
Do you want to make a difference in the world and contribute to a sustainable future? We believe we can develop technology and gain the knowledge to make that difference. We have launched our ambition, Mission Zero – enabling our customers to move towards zero emissions in mining and cement. We need your leadership skills, curiosity, and drive for change to fulfill our goal. Together, we enable our customers to produce the materials needed for a better future.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Supply Chain Project Manager / Project Supply Lead is responsible for managing the supply chain workstream within customer projects in a project-focused, engineered-to-order capital equipment business. Acting as the link between procurement, planning, logistics, supplier quality, and the project execution team, this role ensures that materials, components, and sub-systems are delivered on time, within budget, and to quality standards. The position requires a combination of project management discipline, supply chain expertise, and stakeholder leadership to support successful project delivery.
  
  
**Location:**
Chennai
  
  
**Supply Chain Project Manager / Project Supply Lead**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Project & Supply Chain Integration**

* Lead the supply chain aspects of assigned customer projects, from order intake through final delivery.
* Ensure supply chain milestones (purchase orders, supplier readiness, logistics handoffs) are achieved on time.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans aligned with overall project schedules, milestones, and deliverables, monitor and report progress.

**Supplier & Procurement Management**

* Coordinate sourcing strategies with category managers and buyers to meet project-specific needs.
* Support negotiation of delivery schedules, expediting, and resolution of supplier delays.
* Coordinate with Strategic Sourcing to provide all estimates associated with material costs (internally manufactured or purchased); with quality for all material certifications, inspections; and with logistics for packing and delivery costs.
* Manage supplier onboarding, qualification, and performance monitoring, if new.

**Logistics & Material Flow**

* Oversee inbound and outbound logistics for project-critical materials and equipment.
* Ensure packaging, transportation, and documentation meet customer and regulatory requirements.
* Collaborate with logistics partners to avoid bottlenecks or delays in global transport.

**Risk & Issue Management**

* Identify supply chain risks (supplier capacity, long lead items, logistics disruptions) and develop mitigation plans.
* Escalate critical supply risks to project management leadership with recommended solutions.
* Manage change requests affecting supply chain scope, schedule, or cost.

**Financial & Performance Tracking**

* Track and report supply chain costs, savings, and budget adherence for assigned projects.
* Monitor supply chain KPIs, including on-time delivery, supplier performance, and logistics efficiency.
* Support project cash flow management by aligning supplier payment terms with invoicing milestones. Provide regular project reporting to leadership.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Work closely with project managers, engineering, manufacturing, and site services to ensure supply chain alignment with project goals.
* Contribute to lessons learned and process improvements across the supply chain function.
* Support digital and ERP enhancements for project-driven supply chain execution.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Engineering, Business, or related field (master’s preferred).
* 8+ years of experience in supply chain, procurement, or logistics, preferably in capital equipment or engineered-to-order industries.
* Strong understanding of project management processes (PMP or equivalent certification desirable).
* Knowledge of supplier development, contract management, and international logistics.
* Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Epicor, D365 or similar) and project planning tools (MS Project, Primavera).
* Prior experience with reporting and data analysis tools such as PowerBI.
* Excellent stakeholder management, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, matrix organization and travel to supplier or customer sites as needed.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic and critical thinking
* Strong interpersonal and influencing skills
* Adaptability to shifting priorities in a project-driven environment
* Strong project execution discipline within a supply chain context
* Supplier and stakeholder management
* Risk identification and mitigation
* Results orientation with focus on on-time delivery
* Strong analytical and organizational skills
* Continuous improvement mindset]

**What We Offer**

* Competitive remuneration package & access to salary packaging options to allow you to maximize your after-tax income.
* Competitive benefits package including Health Insurance, Personal Accident / Disability, Group Term Life Insurance, Annual health check-up, and voluntary insurance options.
* Work-life balance with a flexible work schedule so you can focus on professional and personal priorities.

Go Integra Facility Management is looking for Facility Manager Tech to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey

A Facility Manager is responsible for overseeing the maintenance, operation, and management of buildings, facilities, and infrastructure within an organization.

· Their primary goal is to ensure that the facilities are well-maintained, safe, and efficient in supporting the organization's operations.

· Here are some key responsibilities and tasks typically associated with the role of a Facility Manager:Maintenance and Repairs: Ensuring that buildings and facilities are properly maintained and in good working condition

· This involves developing and implementing preventive maintenance programs, scheduling repairs, and coordinating with maintenance staff or external vendors.

· Facility Operations: Managing day-to-day operations of facilities, including security, cleaning, waste management, and utilities

· This may involve overseeing service contracts, managing service providers, and monitoring performance to ensure compliance with service level agreements.

· Space Management: Optimizing the use of space within facilities, including allocation, layout, and configuration

· This involves assessing space requirements, planning office layouts, coordinating office moves or relocations, and ensuring efficient utilization of space.

· Health and Safety: Ensuring compliance with health and safety regulations and standards within facilities

· This includes conducting safety inspections, implementing safety procedures, training staff on safety protocols, and maintaining emergency preparedness plans.

· Budgeting and Cost Control: Developing and managing the facility budget, including expense forecasting, cost control, and expenditure tracking

· This involves identifying cost-saving opportunities, negotiating contracts, and optimizing facility-related expenses.

· Vendor Management: Selecting, contracting, and managing vendors and service providers for facility-related services, such as maintenance, cleaning, security, or landscaping

· This includes monitoring vendor performance, resolving issues, and maintaining good working relationships.

title: M&A and Divestments - Integration & Separation Finance Lead
description:
**Position Purpose**
Lead the financial execution and value realization of Sandoz’s acquisitions, divestitures, carve-outs, and strategic partnerships. Act as the finance lead for integration and separation programs, ensuring delivery of synergies, business continuity, regulatory compliance, and support successful transition of commercial, manufacturing, IT, and support functions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
Your responsibilities include, but not limited to:
  
  

* Deal Value Realization
* Translate acquisition and divestiture business cases into actionable value creation plans.
* Track and deliver commercial, procurement, manufacturing, SG&A, tax, and working capital synergies.
* Monitor deal performance against acquisition assumptions, ROIC targets, and investment thesis.
* Drive corrective actions to mitigate value leakage and execution risks.
* For transaction completed, carry out impairment testing to assess the need for adjustment in the carrying value of investments and assets
* Integration Finance
* Lead Finance for Day 1, Day 100, and long-term integration planning.
* Support integration of:

+ Financial reporting and controls
+ Planning and forecasting processes
+ ERP and finance systems
+ Shared services operations
+ Commercial and supply chain finance activities

* Track integration costs and provide executive-level reporting on value capture and financial performance.
* Separation & Carve-Out Finance
* Develop standalone financial models and separation business cases.
* Lead TSA costing, governance, and exit planning.
* Support legal entity restructuring, financial disentanglement, and carve-out financial reporting.
* Manufacturing & Supply Chain Finance
* Partner with Technical Operations and Supply Chain finance teams to assess financial impacts of:

+ Site, Product or Business transfers
+ Network optimization initiatives
+ Contract manufacturing arrangements
+ Inventory and working capital transitions

* Ensure supply continuity and financial risk mitigation throughout integration and separation programs.
* IT, Portfolio & Commercial Finance
* Support portfolio optimization decisions related to product divestitures, acquisitions, and licensing transactions.
* Evaluate financial impacts of pipeline transfers, product rights transactions, and commercialization strategies.
* Partner with Commercial and IT Finance leadership on financial planning and value realization initiatives.
* Governance & Stakeholder Management
* Serve as the Finance Lead within the Global Integration and Separation Office (GISO)
* Provide executive decision support through financial modelling, scenario analysis, and risk assessments.
* Present progress, risks, synergies, and value realization updates to senior leadership and steering committees.
* Coordinate with M&A, Business Finance, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Procurement, HR, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and IT.

**Essential Requirements**
**What you’ll bring to the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Economics, or Business.
* CA, CPA, ACCA, or equivalent preferred.
* 12-14 years of experience; Pharmaceuticals, Life Sciences experience will be an advantage
* Finance Controlling, Financial Accounting or Business Finance
* Experience supporting acquisitions, divestitures, carve-outs, integrations, licensing transactions, or large-scale transformation programs.
* Strong understanding of pharmaceutical commercial, manufacturing, IT and R&D operating models.
* Technical Expertise: Finance Controlling, Accounting, Business Finance, M&A and corporate finance, Synergy identification and value capture, financial modelling and valuation, Manufacturing and supply chain finance, TSA management, Business case development and performance tracking

**Why Sandoz?**
Sandoz is the global leader in Biosimilar and Generic medicines, a segment of the healthcare industry that delivers 80% of the world’s medicines at 30% of the cost, touching the lives of more than 1 billion people across 100+ countries! While we are proud of our achievements, we have an ambition to do more, so that everyone can achieve the basic human right of access to good healthcare.
  
  
With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help even more people gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably.
  
  
Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills, experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful careers, where diversity of thought is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!
  
  
  
  
Join us, help us make healthcare fairer and faster.
  
  
**Commitment To Diversity & Inclusion**
We are committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse teams representative of the patients and communities we serve.

**Account Reconciliations**

* Perform timely and accurate balance sheet account reconciliations using various reconciliation tools and systems, including TrinTech Cadency, Microsoft Dynamics D365, JD Edwards, and Microsoft Excel. Reconcile balances to subledger activity and/or appropriate supporting documentation. Utilize strong Excel skills, formatting standards, and automation techniques to efficiently reconcile high‑volume transactional data.

Review account activity and postings throughout the month‑end close process to ensure accuracy, completeness, and reasonableness of balance sheet and income statement accounts. Stay prepared throughout the month to streamline tight close calendar deadlines.

* Complete assigned monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities within established deadlines. Leverage the TrinTech Close module to track and maintain compliance with close requirements.

* Keep management informed of significant developments, risks, or potential issues. Coordinate activities and communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders to support a collaborative and efficient work environment.

* Working knowledge of Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP), substantive balance sheet account reconciliations, and financial statement preparation.
* Understanding of profit and loss statements, including standard layout, structure, and data flow.

When You Join Our Team, You’ll Enjoy a Comprehensive And Competitive Compensation Package That Includes

title: Operations Manager , Risk, Accts Payable, Financial Waste Program
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon is seeking an Operations Manager to oversee its Anomaly Detection program in India. Vendor Investigations &Transaction Accuracy (VITA) identifies and prevents waste from all vendors globally. VITA has a goal to prevent financial waste through the Procure to Pay process. This individual will support teams objectives in identifying anomalies in invoicing to prevent erroneous payments. This individual will lead an excellent team of analysts who review invoices suspected of having errors. The team works closely with technology and Product teams in India. The candidate will use these skills to train the next generation of investigators to identify waste, escalate appropriately, complete complex case summaries, and support the feedback loop to improve machine learning and rule-based analytics to detect anomalies. The Manager will be responsible for growing the operations team with proper and efficient processes that complex investigations in a timely manner. The selected individual must possess data analysis and investigation skills, and problem-solving skills. The ideal candidate understands the invoicing lifecycle, from procurement to payment, and has a good intuition about where errors can occur. The Manager will work with stakeholders across Finance Operations to ensure that erroneous invoices are prevented and corrected in a timely manner.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
- Program & Operations Leadership - Single-threaded owner of VITA's Anomaly Review, Duplicate Review, Fraud Holds, and AI Prototyping programs in HYD  
  

* Responsible for driving key FGBS goals for Controllership through Operations oversight in HYD

  

* Transforms complex operational challenges into sustainable solutions by identifying systemic issues in various key Procure to Pay (P2P) systems and working with Root Cause Analysis (RCA) team.

  

* Lead key forums (WBR/MBR) to highlight key operational metrics and make the necessary adjustments, per guidance from leadership.

  

* Conceptualize, prototype and execute AI/LLM solutions to further enable comprehensive anomaly and duplicate review of flagged cases with efficiency

  
A day in the life  
As the key leader of the HYD Financial Waste Team, you will start the day by reviewing daily metrics from operational dashboards and making decisions on focus areas. You will work closely with the operations teams in both Anomaly and Duplicate Review to ensure team members are operating at a high bar. You will lead a daily standup to bring forward key messaging and highlight areas of success and/or improvement. The next part of the day will include reviewing high value cases that require a level two approval. You will attend key meetings with the Product/Tech teams to ensure progress is being made on enhancements and key initiatives that will drive improvement with our key detectors. You will also lead sessions with your prototyping and quality control teams to monitor progress in key initiatives in both AI/LLM and new opportunity areas the team will forward. You will partner with SJO Operations leader to ensure there is parity between the operations functions in both India and Costa Rica.

title: Operation and Supply Chain Manager
description:
1. Procurement Planning & Inventory Management

* Develop weekly SKU/product-wise purchasing plans based on actual sales, open orders, demand forecasts, reorder levels, supplier lead times and available stock.
* Maintain a rolling six-month procurement and inbound shipment calendar.
* Coordinate with the Inventory Control team to identify stock shortages, excess inventory, ageing stock, damaged materials and stock discrepancies.
* Ensure procurement plans are aligned with factory production schedules, material requirements, available capacity and customer priorities.

2. Import Planning & Coordination

* Plan imported material procurement considering approved minimum shipment quantities of 1 × 40-foot FCL container.
* Account for supplier manufacturing lead times, transit periods, port clearance, customs procedures and factory receipt timelines.
* Ensure timely material availability while avoiding unnecessary stock accumulation and preventable stockouts.
* Coordinate import documentation and shipment movement with overseas suppliers, freight forwarders, Customs House Agents (CHAs) and Accounts.

3. Supplier Sourcing & Vendor Management

* Identify, source and evaluate domestic and international manufacturers and suppliers.
* Compare supplier quotations, product specifications, MOQs, payment terms, manufacturing lead times and overall landed costs.
* Prepare and monitor RFQs, Purchase Orders (POs), Proforma Invoices (PIs), internal approvals and supplier confirmations.
* Regularly follow up with suppliers regarding production status, delayed dispatches, quality concerns and revised delivery schedules.

4. Logistics & Shipment Management

* Monitor freight rates, transporter performance, shipment tracking, dispatch turnaround time and proof of delivery.
* Coordinate with logistics partners to resolve shipment delays, shortages, damages and transportation-related claims.
* Work closely with Dispatch, Customer Success and Accounts teams to ensure timely material movement and exception resolution.
* Track container ETAs, freight turnaround time and delivery performance.

5. Factory & Cross-Functional Coordination

* Coordinate with factory and production teams to ensure procurement schedules meet operational and customer requirements.
* Align material availability, GRN (Goods Receipt Note), QA status and put-away readiness with authorised departments.
* Work with the Stores and Inventory Control teams to maintain accurate stock records and ensure timely identification of discrepancies.
* Escalate material shortages, production constraints and potential delivery risks in advance.

6. Cost Control & Commercial Management

* Prepare SKU-wise purchase cost and freight inputs to support management's pricing and margin decisions.
* Identify unfavorable landed-cost variations, supplier price changes and potential margin risks before purchase commitments.
* Evaluate alternative suppliers and sourcing opportunities to improve procurement efficiency and cost competitiveness.
* Coordinate with Accounts for landed-cost inputs and import documentation. Payment processing and foreign exchange approvals will remain under Finance's authority.

7. Reporting & MIS

* Maintain and regularly update the purchase, import and shipment trackers.
* Prepare and submit weekly MIS reports covering:
* SKU-wise stock coverage and procurement requirements.
* Pending purchase orders and supplier confirmations.
* Supplier On-Time In-Full (OTIF) performance.
* Container status and expected arrival dates (ETAs).
* Freight rates and logistics turnaround time.
* Purchase cost and landed-cost variances.
* Material shortages and excess inventory.
* Ageing purchase orders and pending action items.

8. Quality Coordination & Process Improvement

* Support supplier quality complaints, debit/credit note documentation, root-cause investigations and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) follow-ups.
* Improve procurement SOP compliance and ERP data accuracy.
* Identify discrepancies between ERP records, factory inventory records and physical stock, and coordinate controlled reconciliation with management approval.
* Ensure proper documentation, process discipline and transparency across procurement and import operations.

9. Authority & Responsibility Boundaries

* Quality certification and independent quality approvals remain with the authorised Quality team.
* Physical stock custody and approved stock movements remain with the Stores team.
* Inventory adjustments require appropriate authorisation.
* Supplier payment processing and foreign exchange approvals remain under the Finance team's authority.
* Procurement commitments and delivery timelines must be based on confirmed supplier, inventory and production information.

A Sheet Metal Production Manager oversees the entire manufacturing cycle of metal fabrication. They plan schedules, manage budgets, ensure compliance with ISO/IATF quality standards, and supervise processes like CNC laser cutting, bending, welding, and stamping. Their goal is to optimize efficiency and minimize scrap rates. Job SummaryWe are seeking an experienced and results-driven **Production Manager** to lead our sheet metal and fabrication operations. The ideal candidate will optimize production workflows, ensure strict adherence to quality control standards, and manage a team of supervisors, machine operators, and quality inspectors to meet delivery deadlines.

**Production Planning & Execution**

* Develop and execute comprehensive production schedules based on customer requirements and order volumes.
* Coordinate with Planning and Purchasing teams to ensure raw materials (e.g., steel, aluminum) are available and allocate manpower efficiently.
* Oversee daily shop floor operations, including CNC punching, laser cutting, shearing, bending, welding, and assembly.

**3. Equipment & Maintenance**

* Oversee machinery utilization and establish strict preventive maintenance programs to eliminate unplanned downtime.
* Troubleshoot machinery malfunctions and coordinate with technicians or external vendors for emergency repairs and hardware upgrades.

**4. Team Leadership & Financials**

* Supervise, mentor, and evaluate the performance of shift supervisors and floor operators.

* Prepare and present regular Management Information System (MIS) reports detailing production output and improvement strategies.

title: Lead Specialist - Operations Management
description:
**Introduction**  

Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.

  
**Overview**

You'll help account teams and clients make sense of financial monitoring reports. You'll use financial decision making tools to track client financial status, spend by product line, renewal projections, funding levels, and rates. You'll also speak for the Financial Monitoring Report team, share clear updates, and flag anything unusual quickly. Your work will help turn data into practical guidance that people can use.

You'll prepare and review financial monitoring reports that show how a client is doing and where attention may be needed. You'll analyse carrier data for complex clients, make clear recommendations, and support client servicing teams with deliverables that sit within the agreed scope of work.

You'll also check whether the numbers make sense, not just whether they add up. You'll gather the data and materials needed to complete projects, work with internal systems, and support special assignments when needed. When things move fast, you'll share your view clearly, work through conflict in a calm way, and help keep work on track.

  
  
**About you**

Here’s what you’ll bring to the role:

* You can explain financial reports and findings in clear, plain English, in writing and when speaking to others.
* You can review data from carriers and turn it into practical recommendations.
* You can use internal systems and proprietary tools to calculate and review financial results.
* You can spot when analysis does not quite make sense and dig deeper.
* You can ask for the information you need and follow through within agreed timescales.
* You can work well with colleagues from different backgrounds.
* You can stay calm and professional when views differ.
* You can share new ideas in a direct and respectful way.
* You can keep learning as the industry and business needs change.
* Any graduation is fine.

  
**Additional Information**

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning
* A collaborative, people-first culture with accessible leadership
* The opportunity to do meaningful work with global reach and local impact

**At Gallagher, we are dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace.** If your past experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to join our Talent Community to stay connected to additional career opportunities. At times, we will consider transferable skills from previous roles.

*Gallagher is an affirmative action/equal opportunity employer (Minorities/Females/Veterans/Disabled)*

title: Global IT Application Operations Director
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As IT Services Director, Application Operations, you will lead the transformation of BCG's enterprise application support function, establishing a consistent, reliable, and AI-enabled operating model across technology portfolios. You will strengthen service governance, oversee a strategic outsourcing partnership, and drive improvements in service performance, operational resilience, user experience, and cost efficiency.

A key priority will be advancing BCG's AIOps strategy, introducing intelligent automation, predictive insights, and knowledge-driven support to shift application operations from reactive

issue resolution toward proactive service management. Working with Portfolio Application Support Leads, technology teams, and strategic partners, you will translate strategic priorities into actionable plans, measurable improvements, and sustainable ways of working.

Enterprise Application Operations: Lead the development and implementation of a consistent application support operating model, establishing clear governance, accountability, service standards, and performance expectations across technology portfolios.

* **AIOps Strategy and Transformation:** Develop and drive the AIOps roadmap, identifying opportunities to apply AI, predictive analytics, and automation to improve service reliability, reduce manual effort, and deliver measurable operational benefits.
* **Intelligent Service Delivery:** Partner with technology teams and service providers to advance intelligent incident detection, automated triage and remediation, and preventive problem management, supported by appropriate governance and risk controls.
* **Knowledge Management and Self-Service:** Strengthen knowledge-driven support, intelligent self-service, and shift-left capabilities to accelerate issue resolution, reduce avoidable support demand, and improve the employee experience.
* **Strategic Partner Governance:** Oversee service provider performance, contractual obligations, and continuous improvement initiatives. Collaborate with Procurement on commercial priorities and negotiations within approved authority, ensuring alignment with service and financial objectives.
* **Service Performance and Operational Resilience:** Establish consistent performance reporting, service-level oversight, and risk management practices. Guide major-incident escalation and cross-portfolio service reviews, using operational insights to identify risks and improve service stability.
* **Capacity and Financial Management:** Oversee support capacity, resource planning, and operational costs across portfolios and partner teams. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, strengthen capabilities, and optimize investment through automation and service improvements.
* **Cross-Functional Leadership and Change:** Provide functional leadership to Portfolio Application Support Leads and Dedicated Partner Leads, building alignment around shared standards and priorities. Partner with technology and senior IT leaders to manage dependencies, support adoption, and embed lasting operational improvements.

What You'll Bring

* 10+ years of experience in enterprise IT service management, application operations, or related disciplines.
* Proven experience transforming complex application support environments and implementing enterprise-wide operating models.

* Hands-on experience leading AIOps implementations, intelligent automation, and measurable service improvement initiatives.
* Strong understanding of enterprise ITSM practices, AI-enabled operations, predictive analytics, and automation technologies.
* Experience governing strategic outsourcing partnerships, commercial performance, service quality, and supplier accountability.
* Demonstrated ability to manage operational risks, establish AI governance controls, and maintain service resilience.
* Ability to influence senior leaders, align cross-functional teams, and deliver transformation in complex global organizations.

Who You'll Work With

You will be part of BCG's IT Services function within the Digital Workspace Experience group, reporting to the Global IT Service Senior Director. Working in a global, matrixed environment, you will provide functional leadership to Portfolio Application Support Leads and Dedicated Partner Leads, collaborating closely with Technical Area Leads and IT Product and Service Owners to strengthen application operations across technology portfolios. You will also partner with Procurement and our strategic service provider to drive service performance, commercial accountability, and continuous improvement. Together with these teams, you will advance the adoption of AIOps, intelligent automation, and proactive service management to deliver a more reliable, efficient, and consistent application support experience.

Additional info

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Analyst - IT Risk & Compliance
description:
Company Profile:

**Lennox (NYSE: LII)** Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.

Job Description:

**Job Description – Analyst – IT Risk and Compliance**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assists with planning and execution of information technology SOX assessments by understanding organizational objectives, processes, policies, internal controls, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Supports risk and control assessments by identifying potential areas of non-compliance, process weaknesses, control gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
* Performs compliance testing under established procedures and guidance, including documenting testing performed, results, exceptions, and supporting evidence.
* Tests **IT General Controls (ITGCs)** covering logical access, change management, computer operations, and system development/change lifecycle.
* Performs **SAP ITGC/SOX control testing**, particularly across logical access, privileged access, change management, and IT operations.
* Supports testing of **IT Automated Controls (ITACs)** and application controls supporting key business processes such as Payroll, Inventory, Revenue, and Financial Reporting.
* Prepares clear and complete compliance assessment workpapers, testing documentation, and supporting evidence in accordance with established standards.
* Participates in walkthroughs with business and IT stakeholders to understand applications, infrastructure, business processes, risks, and controls.
* Documents processes, risks, and controls through narratives, flowcharts, control matrices, and other supporting documentation.
* Supports evaluation of new or changed processes, systems, and controls to determine their potential impact on the **SOX compliance program**.
* Assists in identifying control deficiencies and supporting root-cause analysis and remediation activities.
* Tracks and follows up on IT audit and compliance findings to ensure remediation activities are completed within agreed timelines.
* Supports external and internal auditors by coordinating documentation, evidence, walkthroughs, and other information requests.
* Communicates testing progress, observations, and identified issues to the Internal Audit Team and relevant stakeholders.
* Obtains, analyzes, and evaluates technical and business documentation, reports, system-generated data, process flows, and supporting evidence.
* Maintains confidentiality of organizational and compliance-related information.
* Continues to develop knowledge of IT controls, SOX requirements, cybersecurity, business processes, emerging technologies, and industry practices.
* Contributes to team objectives and supports other compliance activities and improvement initiatives as required.

Qualifications:

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Information Technology, Information Systems, Cybersecurity**, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* **3 to 7 years of relevant experience** in IT audit, Risk Management, SOX Compliance, ITGCs, technology risk, internal controls, or related fields.
* Previous experience with a **Big 4 or similar audit/consulting environment is preferred but not mandatory**.
* Working knowledge of **Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX)** requirements and IT control concepts.
* Good understanding of **IT General Controls**, including:
* + Logical access
  + Change management
  + Computer operations
  + System development/change lifecycle
* Hands-on experience with **SAP ITGC/SOX testing** is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of **SAP GRC and SAP Security**, including access provisioning, User Access Reviews (UAR), Segregation of Duties (SoD), Firefighter/Emergency Access, and privileged access controls.
* Understanding of **SAP change management and transport controls**, including approvals, testing, production changes, and segregation of duties.
* Basic to intermediate understanding of **IT Automated Controls, application controls, and interfaces**.
* Ability to understand business and IT environments through walkthroughs with application owners, control owners, and other stakeholders.
* Ability to identify key risks and understand controls designed to mitigate those risks.
* Experience performing control testing, reviewing supporting evidence, documenting test procedures, and identifying exceptions.
* Familiarity with business processes such as **Finance, IT, HR, Payroll, Inventory, Revenue, and Financial Reporting** is preferred.
* Exposure to enterprise applications such as **ServiceNow, Oracle, Salesforce**, or similar platforms is an advantage.
* Professional certifications such as **CISA, CPA, CISSP, CRISC**, or similar certifications are preferred or may be pursued as part of professional development.

**Skills and Competencies**

* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to execute assigned compliance activities independently while seeking guidance for complex or judgmental matters.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with IT, business teams, control owners, and auditors.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet established timelines.
* Detail-oriented with strong documentation and organizational skills.
* Proactive and willing to learn new technologies, business processes, and compliance requirements.
* Working knowledge of **Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Visio**. Experience analyzing data using Excel or other analytics tools is an advantage.
* Ability to work independently on assigned activities and collaboratively as part of the broader IT Compliance team.

title: Billing Analyst
description:
**Billing Analyst**
===================

**Position Description: Our ideal Billing Analyst will perform billing and revenue duties with a high degree of precision, confidentiality, and customer service. The position provides an opportunity for an individual to gain an overall understanding of the Company's financial statements by playing an integral role in supporting business operations, facilitating the timely completion and analysis of billing transactions, and contributing to an efficient financial close process. This role requires an energetic individual who enjoys problem solving and has a passion for learning about our business, customers, and financial operations.**

===============================

* Upload invoices to customer portals and customer billing systems after invoice generation.

* Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies, customer billing issues, and invoice-related inquiries.

* Enter requested debits on customer accounts and close billing issues through appropriate transaction processing in TRUX.

* Send autopay enrollment and account information to Cash Applications teams and follow up to ensure timely completion.

* Support month-end billing activities by ensuring invoices, account updates, and billing transactions are completed accurately and on time.
