=====================

* 3+ years of relevant Accounts Receivable and Billing experience.
* Accounting experience in a service-based industry is preferred; waste management industry experience is a plus.
* Ability to understand complex billing processes, customer contracts, and financial systems; experience with TRUX experience preferred.
* Strong Microsoft Excel and overall computer skills required.
* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational abilities with keen attention to detail.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment, prioritize competing responsibilities, work under pressure, and consistently meet deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with customers, levels of management, collections personnel, and cross-functional departments.
* Experience working with customer portals, invoice delivery platforms, and high-volume billing environments preferred.

* Attention to Detail

title: Finance Analyst- Global Record to Report
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

Join us as we embark on a journey to transform BCG’s Finance organization. “Future Finance” is a multi-year journey to prepare the Finance function for the BCG of the future: a BCG that continues to grow, and one that has become more complex, more diverse and more interdependent. By rethinking structures and standardizing processes across geographies and business entities, we will make it simpler and more efficient to work together and flex to meet the needs of BCG.

As a part of the Global Finance & Operations Services team, you will support and deliver on day-to-day activities in the Record-to-Report (RTR) function including finance & accounting management process of collecting, processing, consolidating, closing and reporting on relevant, timely and accurate information used to provide financial, strategic and operational feedback which aids in decision making process. You should have experience in financial accounting and reporting, revenue accounting. fixed assets and lease accounting, intercompany accounting, accrual/prepaid accounting and reconciliations, month end/year end close, accounting systems and procedures, consolidation of financials, audit controls and governance etc. Your key stakeholders will include various internal BCG functions and the local finance teams located in multiple geographies.

**Roles and responsibilities:**

* Master accounting principles and financial systems, manage data flow, consolidation processes, and system hierarchies.
* Support Financial statement and related schedule preparation for Indian Legal entity.
* Support Indirect tax activities.
* Execute monthly accounting tasks, including revenue and expense recording, ledger management, accruals, and journal entries, ensuring compliance with relevant standards.
* Review and reconcile financial statements, focusing on consolidation, accruals, and variance analysis.
* Reconcile balance sheet and expense accounts according to BCG policies.
* Collaborate with IT and finance teams to resolve month-end system issues.
* Maintain strong internal controls and support the development of accounting procedures.
* Work independently, handle ad hoc requests, and contribute to key projects.
* Assist the team in developing and documenting accounting procedures to ensure a seamless monthly, quarterly, and annual close process.
* Actively participate in organization-wide projects and initiatives, contributing effectively to their success.

What You'll Bring

**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor’s / master’s degree in accounting or finance or CA, with experience and strong interest in accounting concepts.
* 4-6 years of relevant experience in financial accounting and reporting, fixed assets and lease accounting, accrual/prepaid accounting and reconciliations, month end/year end close, accounting systems and procedures, consolidation of financials, audit controls and governance etc.
* Prior experience in taxation would be preferred.
* Must be able to perform successfully in a fast-paced, intellectually intense, service-oriented environment and to interpret rules and guidelines flexibly to enhance the business and in keeping with BCG’s values and culture.
* Willingness to provide a wide range of financial services from routine tasks to intricate financial management data
* Oracle experience a plus (GL, Fixed Assets and AP), Hyperion, SAP Business Objects, MS Access and other comparable ERP systems experience preferred
* MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word proficiency and adaptable to different software applications
* Advanced Excel skills and/or experience with other analytical tools (such as Tableau, Alteryx, etc.) will be added advantage.

Who You'll Work With

We pride ourselves on a collaborative working environment and utilize digital tools to foster that collaborative environment across a global company. The Global Finance Operations Centre aims at providing best in-class operational excellence and execution through partnership, building trust and credibility. It provides a foundation to ensuring smooth finance operations, coordinating change and ensuring performance of individual processes with high service levels.

Additional info

**YOU'RE GOOD AT:**

* Proficiency in Excel, including complex spreadsheet and database management.
* Ability to analyze and synthesize data from multiple perspectives.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, resourceful in cross-validating results.
* Strong judgment, initiative, and ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
* Flexible and detail-oriented, with a focus on continuous improvement.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, effective in both independent and team settings.
* Proven ability to prioritize and perform under pressure.
* Experience in matrix-structured organizations and driving process improvements.

At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.

We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.

description:
**Description**
**What We're Looking For**
We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to join our AI engineering team in Hyderabad. The team is new and built around strong early-career engineers - what it needs now is senior craft alongside them.
  
  
Our goal is to automate expert work for two audiences. Internally, we build AI systems that let teams across the company produce more and better work in less time. Externally, we build custom AI solutions for enterprise customers - bespoke enrichment pipelines, data feeds, and automated workflows shaped around a specific customer's problem. The internal tools we build usually become the foundation of what we sell.
  
  
AI engineers and software engineers build and jointly own our solutions. You will work alongside them from problem framing and prototyping through production and iteration, and help set the engineering bar for a team that is still forming it.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Build and ship AI systems**

* Design, build, and operate LLM-powered agents and multi-step workflows - tool use, planning, state and memory, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and sensible recovery when a step fails.
* Build forward-engineering agents: systems that take an ambiguous customer or business input and produce working technical output - queries, configurations, enrichment logic, briefs - that internal teams and customers then rely on.
* Take solutions into production and keep them healthy - deploy, monitor, and optimize for reliability and cost together.

**Get the quality right**

* Do prompt engineering properly: task decomposition, context design, structured outputs, tools and schemas, and the right model for each step. We treat prompts as engineering artifacts - versioned and reviewed like code.
* Build evaluation into the work - golden datasets, regression suites, and the metrics that matter for each workflow: accuracy, groundedness, hallucination rate, latency, and cost per unit of work.
* Know when an LLM is not the answer, and when retrieval, a classical model, or plain deterministic code is better.

**Lift the team**

* Mentor early-career engineers through code review, pairing, and design discussion. Most of the team is within a year of graduating and learns fast when it is taught well.
* Help set the standards the team works to - testing, prompt and evaluation conventions, observability, and what “done” means for an AI feature.
* Work with product managers, platform engineers, and the teams who use what we build, across several time zones - translating fuzzy requirements into a technical approach with the trade-offs stated plainly.

**What You'll Bring**

* 4-9 years in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, or a related technical role, including hands-on experience taking AI-powered applications into production.
* A system you have built and operated where an LLM did real work - and a clear sense of how you knew it was working, what broke, and what you changed.
* Strong Python and solid software engineering fundamentals, with a good understanding of API design and integration patterns.
* Practical experience with agent and orchestration frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP-based tooling, or equivalent) and with frontier model APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, or comparable).
* Working knowledge of RAG, vector and keyword search (OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, or equivalent) for grounding models in proprietary data.
* A solid grounding in traditional ML alongside the generative side - classification, clustering, embeddings, feature engineering, and standard evaluation methodology - and the judgment to pick a classical model when it is faster, cheaper, and more predictable than a prompt.
* Experience with at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud), containers, and CI/CD.
* Some experience mentoring or technically guiding less-experienced engineers.
* Clear communication and comfort with ambiguity - a working prototype that proves the idea, then the engineering to make it durable.
* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science or an equivalent degree.

**Nice to Have**

* Large-scale LLM enrichment or classification pipelines, where cost and quality per document both matter.
* A background in NLP, information retrieval, or media and text analytics.
* Transformers, fine-tuning, PyTorch or TensorFlow; or computer vision and speech-to-text in production.

**Why This Role**
The team is new, the problem space is genuinely unsolved, and the work goes straight into the hands of people who depend on it daily. You will shape how a team builds AI systems rather than maintain someone else's decisions.
  
  
*You do not need every item on this list. If you are strong across most of it and curious about the rest, we would like to hear from you.*
**What We Offer:**

* Enjoy flexible paid time off options for enhanced work-life balance.
* Comprehensive health insurance tailored for you.
* Employee assistance programs cover mental health, legal, financial, wellness, and behaviour areas to ensure your overall well-being.
* Complimentary Calm App subscription for you and your loved ones, because mental wellness matters.
* Energetic work environment with a hybrid work style, providing the balance you need.
* Benefit from our family leave program, which grows with your tenure at Meltwater.
* Thrive within our inclusive community and seize ongoing professional development opportunities to elevate your career

**Where You'll Work:**
Hyderabad
  
  
**When You'll Join:**
As per the Offer Letter.
  
  
**Our Story**
At Meltwater, we believe that when you have the right people in the right environment, great things happen.
  
  
Our best-in-class technology empowers our
**27,000 customers**
around the world to make better business decisions through data. But we can’t do that without our global team of developers, innovators, problem-solvers, and high-performers who embrace challenges and find new solutions for our customers.
  
  
Our award-winning global culture drives everything we do and creates an environment where our employees can make an impact, learn every day, feel a sense of belonging, and celebrate each other’s successes along the way. We are innovators at the core who see the potential in people, ideas and technologies. Together, we challenge ourselves to go big, be bold, and build best-in-class solutions for our customers. We’re proud of our diverse team of
**2,200+ employees**
in
**50 locations**
across
**25 countries**
around the world. No matter where you are, you’ll work with people who care about your success and get the support you need to unlock new heights in your career.
  
  
We are Meltwater. We love working here, and we think you will too.
  
  
*"Inspired by innovation, powered by people."*

Our Product & Learning Solutions team builds the products that power learning and careers at scale: an AI-powered language learning app, a job readiness assessment platform, an international careers platform and career services tools, with more in build. Our learners are young people starting their careers across India, and most of them use our products on budget Android phones.

**Why This Role**

This is a full time role that owns design across every product we build, from research to shipped screens.

•    Build and own one design system for all our products, used across web and mobile.

•    Shape how learners across India experience learning, assessment and career journeys.

•    Bring our AI learning companion to life through animation and interaction.

•    Work directly with the President of Product & Learning Solutions, the product team and the engineers who build your designs.

**What You Will Do**

**1. Own design across our products**

•    Design user flows, wireframes, high fidelity screens and interactive prototypes for web and mobile.

•    Turn product requirements into simple, clear journeys for learners, trainers, colleges, recruiters and internal teams.

•    Redesign existing screens where they confuse users, and design new features from scratch.

**2. Build and run the design system**

•    Create one design system for all products: components, variants, typography, colour, spacing, icons and states.

•    Document how it is used so engineers can build consistently without asking.

•    Review every release against the design system before it reaches users.

**3. Motion and interaction design**

•    Design animations, micro-interactions, transitions, loading and feedback states that make products easier to use.

•    Animate our AI learning companion so it feels alive while learners practise and speak.

•    Keep every animation light and fast, so it runs smoothly on low-end phones and slow mobile data.

•    Create motion guidelines and hand off animations in formats engineers can ship, such as Rive or Lottie files.

**4. Research and usability**

•    Speak with learners, trainers and internal users to understand how they actually use our products.

•    Run usability tests, find where users struggle and fix it.

•    Design for accessibility and for first-time smartphone users.

**5. Work closely with engineering**

•    Hand off complete specifications: states, spacing, assets and interaction notes.

•    Review what is built against the design and get gaps fixed before release.

•    Present your work at our weekly product reviews. We work in two-week sprints, tracked in Linear.

**Your First 90 Days**

•    By day 30: audit all our products, list every design inconsistency, and agree priorities with the product team.

•    By day 60: the first version of the design system is live in Figma and engineers are building from it.

•    By day 90: one complete learner journey redesigned and shipped with motion, and the motion guidelines documented.

**What You Must Have**

•    4 to 6 years of experience in UI/UX, product design or interaction design.

•    A portfolio of shipped web and mobile products, showing your process and not only final screens.

•    A motion portfolio or reel with real animation work used in live products.

•    Hands-on experience with at least one of Rive, Lottie, After Effects or Framer Motion in shipped work.

•    Advanced Figma: components, variants, auto layout, design systems and interactive prototyping.

•    Strong grasp of typography, colour, layout, visual hierarchy, responsive design and accessibility.

•    The confidence to own design decisions end to end, and to explain them clearly to product and leadership.

•    Working knowledge of HTML, CSS and JavaScript, enough to understand what engineers can build.

**Good To Have**

•    Experience with EdTech, SaaS or AI products, including chat or voice based experiences.

•    Rive state machines or animated characters that react to user input.

•    Designing for low bandwidth, budget Android phones or users new to smartphones.

•    Familiarity with React, React Native or Flutter.

•    Experience with Linear, Jira or similar sprint tools.

**How To Apply**

Email ranjeet@edubridgeindia.in with your resume, your portfolio link and your motion reel. Use the subject line: Senior UI/UX Designer. Applications without a portfolio link will not be reviewed.

**Role Details**

**Role:**
Senior UI/UX Designer, Motion and Interaction

**Department:**
Product & Learning Solutions

**Reports To:**
President, Product & Learning Solutions

**Location:**
Mumbai, full time in office

**Employment Type:**
Full Time, Permanent

**Experience:**
4 to 6 years

**Industry Type:**
E-Learning / EdTech

**Education:**
B.Des, M.Des or a degree in Design, HCI, Fine Arts, Multimedia or a related field. A strong portfolio matters more than the degree.

**Key Skills**

UI/UX Design · Product Design · Figma · Design Systems · Prototyping · Interaction Design · Motion Design · Rive · Lottie · After Effects · Framer Motion · Micro-interactions · Usability Testing · Accessibility · Responsive Design · HTML/CSS

Vymo transforms how financial institutions manage their distribution networks and collections operations. Our AI-powered DMS and CMS platform serves 350,000+ users across 70+ global financial enterprises, enabling banks and insurers to optimize performance across their distribution channels, and empowering banks to drive operational excellence in collections.

**Why Global Leaders Choose Vymo**

Vymo partners with financial institutions through a comprehensive solution that combines deep domain expertise with cutting-edge technology. Our platform's human-centric design, coupled with enterprise-grade scalability and AI-powered intelligence, delivers measurable business outcomes while ensuring high user adoption and engagement.

**Recognition & Trust**

● Backed by $45M+ funding from Peak XV partners (formerly Sequoia), Emergence Capital, and Bertelsmann Investments.

● Trusted by leading global financial institutions including Berkshire Hathaway, AIA, AXA, SBI Life, HDFC Bank, Aditya Birla Capital, Tata AIA, ABSLI and many more!

● Recognized by Celent in their 2024 Distribution Management Solutions report, with an Advanced Functionality ranking.

● Featured in Gartner's Market Guide for Sales Engagement Applications and recognized as a

"Strong Performer" in Forrester's Sales Engagement Wave Report.

● Microsoft 'AI for All' award winner for innovation in artificial intelligence

**The Role**

As a
**Principal - Pre Sales,**
you will sit at the intersection of enterprise software architecture, executive financial strategy, and business transformation. You will bridge the gap between complex AI-driven technology and prospective client business outcomes, owning the financial justification (ROI, TCO, net revenue uplift) and strategic value narrative for Vymo's largest prospective clients across global BFSI markets.Working alongside Regional VPs, Account Executives, and Enterprise Architects, you will act as a trusted advisor to CFOs, CROs, COOs, and CIOs, translating technical capabilities into multi-million-dollar business impact.

**What You will do**

**Strategic Discovery & Enterprise Solution Design**

* Run discovery workshops with prospects to identify key business bottlenecks and sales productivity gaps.
* Design secure enterprise architecture blueprints that integrate Vymo with core banking, insurance, and CRM systems.

**Value Quantification, Proposal Leadership & Proof of Value (PoV)**

* Build financial models, ROI business cases, and TCO comparisons to prove the monetary value of Vymo to prospective clients.
* Lead major RFP submissions and Proof of Value (PoV) pilots to demonstrate tangible business impact before contract signing.

**C-Suite Engagement & Executive Storytelling**

* Work directly with C-suite leaders to align Vymo’s platform capabilities with executive-level business goals.
* Translate complex AI features and technical workflows into simple, persuasive stories for non-technical leaders.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Partner with product and engineering teams to share market feedback and improve Vymo's product roadmap.
* Collaborate with implementation and post-sales teams to ensure smooth client onboarding and handover.

**Experience and Fluency**

* **Domain Expertise:**
  Strong knowledge of banking and fintech software platforms (e.g., Digital Engagement Platform, core banking, or payment rails)
* **Experience & Workflow Depth:**
  8 –12 years in B2B SaaS Presales, Solutions, or Management Consulting with deep domain expertise mapping BFSI workflows across Lending, Collections, Insurance Distribution, and Sales Productivity.
* **Discovery & Value Engineering:**
  Proven track record leading discovery-led engagements to build data-backed ROI/TCO models, commercial pricing structures, and clear financial and operational business cases for C-suite decision-makers.
* **Enterprise Sales Partnership:**
  Hands-on experience co-owning complex enterprise sales cycles alongside AEs, effectively balancing customer requirements with commercial viability and post-sale delivery feasibility.
* **AI & Tech Transformation:**
  Strong technical ability to translate complex software stack breakdowns, CRM ecosystems, and security standards into clear CXO conversations around AI-enabled operating models, integration architectures, and data governance.

**Mindset & Core Traits**

* **Curiosity & Agency:**
  Obsessed with diagnosing root causes before proposing tech; you use discovery to isolate structural problems rather than treating symptoms, building the operational script as you go.
* **Grounded Builder:**
  Guided by a natural curiosity that balances customer needs with delivery feasibility; you intuitively map messy enterprise workflows into viable, structured platform frameworks from scratch.
* **Diplomatically Direct:**
  Possess the structural thinking and commercial credibility to tell a banking CXO when their legacy process is the bottleneck, balancing customer expectations with realistic commercial boundaries.

**Title:**
Sr. Associate HR Business Partner (Candidates from IT Services Industry background only)

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Experience Level:**
6-10 Years

**Work format:**
Full time work from office role

**Travel:**
Candidates should be open to travel on need basis to different cities.

**Mandatory Industry background:**
Candidates from Global IT Services & Consulting Organizations preferred

**Summary:**

The Senior Associate HR Business Partner is a developing subject matter expert, responsible for supporting with the application of corporate policies related to HR, organizational and employee advancement.

This role supports HR management in the development of solutions through organizational development and cultural and process-oriented perspectives and administers talent management and succession planning activities within the assigned business unit.

This role also supports the execution of all the programs developed by the relevant HR management team in the assigned stakeholder group.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provides HR support and guidance to employees, managers, and HR team members.
* Facilitates the onboarding process for new hires, ensuring a smooth transition into the organization.
* Handles and resolves employee relations issues, collaborating with HRBPs and HR leadership as needed.
* Supports the performance management process, including goal setting and performance reviews.
* Supports the design and delivery of training programs to enhance employee skills and capabilities.
* Ensures compliance with HR policies, procedures, and legal requirements, providing guidance to HRBPs and employees.
* Prepares and presents HR reports and data analysis to HRBPs and business leaders.
* Participates in HR projects and initiatives, collaborating with the HR team and other departments.
* Supports employee engagement initiatives and action plans to improve workplace satisfaction and productivity.
* Assists in managing organizational change initiatives and communication with employees.
* Utilizes HR technology systems and tools to streamline HR processes and enhance efficiency.
* Serves as the primary point of contact for employees and managers across all levels.
* Ensures both HR and business managers have the information they need related to running the talent aspects of their organizations.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**Knowledge and Attributes:**

* Developing knowledge of HR planning, talent management, and organizational development.
* Developing knowledge of labor laws, employment regulations, and HR compliance requirements.
* Developing expertise in performance appraisal processes, goal setting, and performance improvement techniques.
* Knowledge of recruitment strategies, candidate sourcing, and selection methods to attract and retain top talent.
* Displays ability to handle employee relations issues and resolve conflicts.
* Good communication and influencing skills to engage with senior executives and stakeholders.
* Developing proficiency in managing organizational change and leading change initiatives.
* Displays ability to make informed and data-driven decisions that impact HR and organizational outcomes.
* Displays skills in using HR data and metrics to derive insights and support data-driven decision-making.
* Demonstrates high ethical standards and maintaining the confidentiality of sensitive HR information.
* Developing ability to influence and persuade business stakeholders to gain support for HR initiatives.
* Eagerness to stay updated with the latest HR trends, industry best practices, and professional development.

**Academic Qualifications and Certifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a Human Resources or a related field.

**Required experience:**

* Moderate level of experience working in a similar role preferably gained within a global IT organization.
* Moderate level of experience working closely with a variety of internal and external stakeholders at different levels in the business.
* Moderate level of experience working leveraging HR technologies including some experience in HRIS, LMS, e-Recruitment and Payroll systems.
